items.title: Kaisa ye ghul macha
items.body:
kaisa ye ghul macha hai elaahi furaat par
maara gaya hussain ka bhai furaat par
kaisa ye ghul macha…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya nazar na jabke alam ghash hue hussain
jab dekhne ko chashm uthaai furaat par
kaisa ye ghul macha…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyon shor uth raha hai taraai se baar baar
akbar chalo kare to rasaii furaat par
kaisa ye ghul macha…
<<DIVIDER>>
beta padar ko le chalo apne chacha ke paas
bhai ne kaafi dayr lagayi furaat par
kaisa ye ghul macha…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat may haye kya kare daulat baneen ki
battees saal baad gawahi furaat par
kaisa ye ghul macha…
<<DIVIDER>>
darya ki samt dekh ke zainab ne ye kaha
bhai sakina to nahi aayi furaat par
kaisa ye ghul macha…
<<DIVIDER>>
roze alam se uth'ta rahega dhuan anees
pani ne aisi aag lagayi furaat par
kaisa ye ghul macha…
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Masjide kufa may
items.body:
masjid e kufa may mehboobe khuda zakhmi hua
baad e ahmed jo tha deen ka peshwa zakhmi hua
<<DIVIDER>>
ibne muljim ki shakhawat ne sitam dhaaya hai ye
hogaya tar lo musalla murtaza ke khoon se
dehr may khaaliq ka jo tha maujiza zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad e maadar aur bhi shiddat se tadpane lagi
ghair haalat hogayi zainab bhi ghash khaane lagi
jab suna masjid may baba be-khata zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar manzar ye turbat may payambar ro pade
haalat e sajda may shamsheer e zehar aalood se
be-khata be-jurm nafse kibriya zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath phaila kar ali kehte hai ye ay kirdegaar
tu gawara rahiyo ke waqte taa'at e parwardigar
tere sajde may ye tera ba-wafa zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayaton ke darmiyan kohraam tha kohraam tha
qaima e quran may charon taraf hangaam tha
waqt e sajda haye faqre ambiya zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar hyder ko ubhra lab pe zainab ke sukhan
ab kise baba kahenge boliye bhaiya hassan
hogayi be-amaan baba mera zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha yehi bachon ka nauha ya nabi fayrad hai
aaiye behre madad ye sa'at e imadad hai
dekhiye masjid may shaahe do sara zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
sayyeda ka aaj pehlu aur zakhmi hogaya
aur haalat hogayi hai qabr may unki tabaah
ro ke kehti hai ke phir pehlu mera zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand taare ro ke karte hai jigar afgaar bain
dayam o yazdan lahoo rote hai behrobar ke nain
kya qayamat aagayi mushkil kusha zakhmi hua
masjid e kufa may...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Mere andar basi hai
items.body:
mai jahan jaun mere andar basi hai karbala
banke dhadkan mere dil mein goonjti hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
mere seene mein azal se bas raha hai ya hussain
ye jo dhadkan ki musalal ek sada hai ya hussain
har ghadi awaazein mujhko de rahi hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...
<<DIVIDER>>
gooonjte hai ya hussaina se musalsal baam o dar
chauda sadiyan se hai jaari sheh ke matam ka safar
is tarha seena ba seena chal rahi hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ne dikhlaya hai rasta farsh e majlis ka hamein
halqa e matam mein lekar aaye hai baba hamein
godh se maa baap ki humko mili hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam o kufa ke safar mein bediyan thaame rahi
tauq ka bosa kabhi zanjeer ka bosa kabhi
abid e bemaar se lipti hui hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...
<<DIVIDER>>
taaziyane khayegi himmat magar dikhlayegi
shaam tak mazloom ka paigham le kar jayegi
sheh ki mayyat se qasam kha kar uthi hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr waale taaza dam hai zulm waale thak gaye
khanjaron ne haar maani naize waale thak gaye
peeche hatne ki jagah aage badi hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kahin akbar jawan ka sar kahin baysheer ka
sar bureeda hai kahin abbas ka shabbir ka
noke naiza pe safar karti rahi hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-kafan us syed o sardar par laakhon salaam
ek din hoga takallum uske khoon ka inteqam
muntazir ibne ali ki aaj bhi hai karbala
mai jahan jaun...

items.title: Nauha ye sakina ka
items.body:
nauha ye sakina ka raha pyaas bujha do
darya se palat aao chacha pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
murhjaye huwe hont hai kaatein hai zaban may
hai halq mera sookha hua pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo rann ko gaya jaise mujhe bhool gaya hai
ek ek ko mai deti hoo sada pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere chacha mere chacha mere chacha jaan
israar sakina ka raha pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya na koi phir bhi mere pyaas bujhane
sun'ne ko to har ek ne suna pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai baithi hoo darwaze pa kab aaoge ammu
yun do na yateemi ki saza pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad pa meri koi deta nahi awaaz
kab tak mai karoo aah o buka pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tum se khafa thi na khafa hoo na rahungi
bas itni tamanna hai chacha pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasaar aseeri ke nazar aane lage hai
bandh jaye na rassi se gala pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishrat ye pasay sheh thi sakina ki sadayein
pani may hai dam atka hua pyaas bujha do
nauha ye sakina ka...

items.title: Aalam may yun
items.body:
aalam may yun shareek e risalat hai fatema
rehmat nabi hai saaya e rehmat hai fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
shauhar wali padar hai payambar pisar imam
kitni azeem deen ki taaqat hai fatema
aalam may yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
maryam ka fatema se bhala kya muqabla
maryam to aabida hai ibadat hai fatema
aalam may yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono ke ishteraak se sajda qubool hai
hyder agar namaz hai niyat hai fatema
aalam may yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte mubahila may payambar ko dekh kar
kehna padega jumb e risalat hai fatema
aalam may yun...

items.title: Abide bemaar
items.body:
abid e bemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
karb mein doobe zakhmi wo manzar
zulm hazaron ek dil e muztar
tha yehi nauha tere labon par
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
shehr tamasha haye wo bazaar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa sitam ye tujhpe hua hai
kaisi aseeri kaisi jafa hai
tauq mein jakda tera gala hai
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
zainabe kubra teri madadgaar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raahon mein kaante paaon mein chaale
maaon se bichde godh ke paale
kaun kise ab kaise sambhale
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
zulm musalsil manzil e dushwaar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas ki shiddat karbe yateemi
nanhi si gardan aur wo rassi
kaisi thi ghurbat choti behen ki
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
tere jigar par chalti talwaar

<<DIVIDER>>
khaak mein ghaltan khoon mein doobe
ek rasan mein baara galay thay
unko sitamgar khaynch rahe thay
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
koi nahi tha unka madadgaar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
girya kuna thi aale payambar
baazu mein rassi aur thi khule sar
kursi nasheen thay saare sitamgar
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
waye musibat shaam ka darbar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ka zindan aur wo andhera
kehti thi roke pyasi sakina
aaiye baba aaiye baba
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
maa hai pareshan bhai hai bemaar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote hai baqar lab pe hai nauha
kehte hai ro kar mai hua tanha
zehre sitam se mar gaye baba
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
mar gaya pyason ka ghamkhwar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota hai veeran shehre madina
aaj hai khamosh deen ka maseeha
goonj raha hai uska ye nauha
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
hogaya ruqsat sheh ka azadaar
abid e bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne masayeb likhe rasheed ab
toot raha hai hausla ya rab
roti hai aankhein kaampte hai lab
as-shaam as-shaam as-shaam
bas yehi awaaz aati hai har baar
abid e bemaar...
items.author: Rasheed Shaheedi

items.title: Al amaan al hafeez
items.body:
aamad hui jo bar sare maidan hussain ki
aur dilbare rasool shahe mashraqain ki
sardar e do jahan shahe qibla qain ki
hyder ke laal fatema zehra ke chain ki
shabbir ne shuru kiya apne khitaab ko
sun kar pasina aane laga aaftab ko
al amaan al hafeez al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi jalwa numaan shaah ki talwaar hui
fauje aada pe chali bar sare kuffaar hui
sirf phirti hui maidan mein nazar aayi ajal
ek sada thi jo zabane dar o dewaar hui
al amaan al hafeez al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
pal mein chamki sare sar pal mein sare saani
jism ke shehr mein har simt hui veerani
chod kar rooho mein jismo ko chuni raahe faraaq
thi sare dasht sada tehro ali ke jaani
al amaan al hafeez al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
tab ran mein zulfeqar e ali jalwagar hui
yak dam faza e karbobal mein sahar hui
zeb e yade hussain shahe behrobar hui
sannata ran mein cha gaya jyun jyun khabar hui
ghazi ki aadhi jang thi dekhi taraayi ne
thaani hai pura karne ki ghazi ke bhai ne
<<DIVIDER>>
dast e shabbir ne jab ghaiz mein toli talwaar
par sameinte huwe peeche hatay jibreel ek baar
itni dehshat hui taari ke laraz uthi zameen
har taraf goonj uthi dashte wigha mein ye pukar
al amaan al hafeez al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
apni haibat dil e baatil pe raqam karti hui
hasti e ahle sitamgar ko adam karti hui
apni thokar pe liye hai sare maidan e wigha
jhoomti hai sare baatil ko qalam karti hui
al amaan al hafeez al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi panje mein chala aaya wo fin naar hua
dasht kuch dayr mein hi laashon ka ambaar hua
us taraf kasrate afwaaj mein aayi khillat
shaah ki taygh ka rukh jis taraf ek baar hua
al amaan al hafeez al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
soormaon ko zameen doz kiye jaati hai
khoon e aghyaar e shahe deen piye jaati hai
aaj thoda sa meinassar hua mauqa isko
fatema zehra ka badla bhi liye jaati hai
al amaan al hafeez al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke haatif ki sada shaah ne roki talwaar
phir hujoome sitam aala hua shal se ek baar
zeen se suye zameen shaahe khush atbaar chale
godh phailaake ye zehra ne pukara zin haar
hussain hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shor hai girya hai ek maa ka ye nauha hai
har samt fazaon mein bas ek hi naara hai
hussain hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
be-khata haye tujhe qatl kiya
ek lamha na tujhe chain diya
khanjar e ahle sitam ahle jafa
aur mazloom tera khusk gala
shiddate tashnalabi haye hussain
aur zaalim ki churi haye hussain
khoon ugalti hai zameen wavaila
chain zehra ko nahi wavaila
maqtal e shaah ka manzar hai ajab
seena e shaah pe zaalim hai ghazab
ek maa karti hai faryad o fughan
hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bare imdad ali aaye yahan
lutne waala hai nabi ka kunba
katne waala hai shahe deen ka gala
ye sada thi ke qayamat guzri
phir gayi halq e shahe deen pe churi
karbala roti rahi haye hussain
aur maa kehti rahi haye hussain
haye hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aasman khoon ugalta hai baraye maula
od kar gham ki rida sogh mein doobi hai faza
kaisa manzar tha ajab dayam o yadzan ba-khuda
ek maa roti thi aur padti thi rokar nauha
hussain hussain hussain hussain
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Ashoor ka manzar
items.body:
sajjad ki aankhon mein sughra
ashoor ka manzar dekhegi
<<DIVIDER>>
lut'te huwe apni aankhon se
zehra ka bhara ghar dekhegi
<<DIVIDER>>
wo lamha nazar aayega usay
qaime se chale thay jab akbar
kuch dayr lade phir zakhmi huwe
ghode se gire thay jab akbar
phat jayega seena sadme se
jab seena e akbar dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chashme baradar mein usko
aayega nazar ghazi ka alam
chehre pe sukoon aa jayega
kuch dayr mein kam ho jayega gham
do baazu unhi aankhon mein phir
wo jalti zameen par dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab baap ke kaandhe par ghatri
dekhi to khayaal aaye honge
sughra ne kaha hoga dil mein
qasim ki bari laaye honge
jab ghatri khulegi to sughra
tukdon mein gul e tar dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko un aankhon mein har soo
dhoondegi bahot bemaar behen
shabbir ke haahton pe ek dam
aayega nazar wo tashna dahan
ek teer chalega us dil par
jab teer gale par dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dhoop mein turbat asghar ki
do laashein qareeb e darya hai
samjhegi nahi kuch dayr talak
ke dasht mein baba tanha hai
royegi bahot aur samjhegi
jab laashe bahattar dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab na sunane payegi
shabbir ki ghurbat ka qissa
dekhegi nighaon mein phir se
baba ke saath hua kya tha
tootegi qayamat sughra par
jab halq pe khanjar dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e ghariban dekhegi
be-aas haram aur aag dhuaan
dil thaam ke apne haathon se
bemaar karegi aah o fughan
ruqsaar sakina ke zakhmi
aur naizon pe chadar dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas safdar o mazhar khatm karo
roodad e sitam ko ye keh kar
sajjad ki aankhein band hui
aur bain yehi aaye lab par
mar jayegi gham se jab khwahar
bazaar ka manzar dekhegi
sajjad ki aankhon...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ay saani e hyder
items.body:
ay saani e hyder e karrar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe nahi rukta hai kyun sar
ay mere ghazanfar ay quwwate sarwar
khwahar ko bata ay mere ghamkhwaar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
ay saani e hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab teri ghairat ke hai qurban
ay baba ke armaan kunbe ke nigehban
behna teri ab jaayegi bazaar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
ay saani e hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi zara dekho to sina par
barpa hua mehshar shabbir ka hai sar
rote hai sina par shahe abraar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
ay saani e hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ka gulistan hua barbaad
kis se kare faryad abbas tere baad
ro ro ke ye kehte hai dilafgaar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
ay saani e hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ki mai sunti hoo sadayein
leti hai balayein tujhe deti hai duayein
tujh sa nahi dunya mein wafadaar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
ay saani e hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aaj musibat mein sakina
mushkil hua jeena mar jaaye kahin na
zulmon ki yateema pe hai bauchaar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
ay saani e hyder e karrar...

items.title: Baba ab na aayenge
items.body:
hum rote reh jayenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge
bali sakina soja
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban aayi hai
kaisi udaasi chaayi hai
bikhre hai ran may laashe
kis jaa mera bhai hai
ke dhoondte hum reh jayenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jab pani maangogi
shimr tamache maarega
dikhla ke tum ko pani
mitti par wo daalega
hum pyase reh jayenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis may itni himmat thi
ke aag lagaye qaimon may
ek bhai ke marte hi
aada aaye qaimon may
ab qaime jal jayenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana ke deen ki khaatir
ranj o gham ye sehna hai
saare kunbe ko le kar
qaid may hum ko rehna hai
hum qaidi ban jayenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe baba keh kar
ran may jab tum jaogi
sun kar awaaz e sarwar
laashe ko tum paogi
tumko gham tadpayenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar dar humko phirna hai
dukh ye saare sehna hai
ghar hai apna aur na bichona
khaak pa hum ko rehna hai
hum kaise so payenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hum par guzri usko
hashmi kaise likhega
padte hi irfan ye nauha
saara aalam royega
aansu behke aayenge
bali sakina soja
baba ab na aayenge...
items.author: Alamdar Hashmi

items.title: Bhai se milaade
items.body:
nana bhai se milaade
<<DIVIDER>>
chod ke maqtal mein aayi hoo
nana bhai se milaade
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoore ko aisa ujdi
bhai se chooti ghazi se bichdi
akbar barchi khaaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban baba thay aaye
mai beparda sar ko jhukaye
roti thi mai sharmeine
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagte thay durre chinti thi chadar
rote thay bacche ye keh keh kar
ghazi kyun nahi aaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se chali thi bhai ko lekar
jaaun mai kaise sab ko kho kar
dil mera ghabraye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka maqsad aise bachaya
pusht pe durre maine khaaya
bacche yaad na aaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum apna ghar baar luta kar
jalte huwe qaime se bacha kar
deen ko tere laaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataun mai wo manzar
seene pe qatil halq pe khanjar
kyun ye din dikhlaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dua zehra ki tum ko
nauhakhan o matamdaro
aanch na tum par aaye
nana bhai se milaade...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin ki hai khwahish zahra
jitna ho dushman ka pehra
aap ko nauha sunaye
nana bhai se milaade...
items.author: Toosi Zangipuri

items.title: Dafn kaise hui
items.body:
shikasta baazu shikasta pehlu
baalon mein safedi hai
haye zahra haye zahra haye zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn kaise hui zahra ye ali jaante hai
kaise turbat mein utaara ye ali jaante hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dar ke girne se hua jiska shikasta pehlu
phasliyan zakhmi thi aur toot chuka tha baazu
kaise utha wo janaza ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
samne us ke tha amma ne tamacha khaaya
kitne din jaane hassan kuch na kisi se bola
wo na bhoolega tamacha ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghusl dete huwe zahra ko ali rote rahe
ab talak haath pe zakhmon ke nihsan baaqi thay
kis ne maara tha wo durra ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan toot chuki jab ye ali ne dekha
karb se cheekh ke maula ne kaha ya zahra
ghusl kis tarha diya tha ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
saans lete huwe takleef se karrahti thi
dard itna tha ke karwat bhi na le paati thi
kab se soyi nahi zahra ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud to sab seh gayi seh na saki bete pe sitam
maut se kam na tha mohsin ki judaai ka gham
kaise ek maa ko sambhala ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ka pursa jise dene na aaya koi
roti rehti thi jo turbat se lipat kar bibi
kitna yaad aate thay baba ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm khaa kar bhi wilayat ki hifazat ki hai
jaa ke dar dar pe yun zahra ne gawahi di hai
kitna ehsaan hai uska ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni mazloom thi zakhmi thi nabi ki beti
qabr bhi maula ne zeeshan chupa di uski
hai kahan marqad e zahra ye ali jaante hai
dafn kaise hui zahra...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ghamon ki inteha
items.body:
zabeehe maariya hussain
qateele nainawaz hussain
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ki laash laate hai lehad koi banate hai
watan se door dasht may hussain gham uthaate hai
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai be-khata mera pisar koi bachaye aan kar
sadayein de rahi ye tadap tadap ke nauhagar
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
na to kafan naseeb hai na to watan naseeb hai
nabi ka laadla hussain is khadar ghareeb hai
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamon se choor choor hai lahoo lahoo hai shaahe deen
magar hai sajda e khuda may kham hussain ki jabeen
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina ki nok par azan naye jahad ka imtehan
sina pe aage aage hai hussain meer e karwan
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ghurbat e shahe zaman naseeb kab hua kafan
ye inteha e zulm thi juda juda kiya badan
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
laraz rahi thi khud zameen falak pe hashr tha bapa
churi hai kund aur gardan e ghareeb e fatema
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan sitam ka silsila kahan ghareeb e nainawa
ye kehke dayam aur yazdan ro padi wo ghamzada
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Hamare ghar mein
items.body:
jab kisi ghar mein koi marta hai
pursa dete hai log aa aa kar
kitni mazloom hai hussain ki maa
pursa leti hai sab ke ghar jaa kar
<<DIVIDER>>
chod diya maa ne baqayya
aagaya muharram
ya hussain kaho ya hussain
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hoti hai majlis jahan aati hai wahan pe fatema
ghareeb hoon to kya hua wo aayengi
hame bhi khush naseeb wo banayengi
utha ke haath de ke waasta hussain ka
dua karo dua karo
hamare ghar mein aaj aaye bibi fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
bichha ke farshe gham yahan jinhe bula rahe hai hum
wo phasliyon ko thaam kar rakhengi ghar mein jab qadam
sunana unko daastan hussain ki
bahot ghareeb hai wo maa hussain ki
jo pursa lene aati hai ghareeb laal ka
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
alam ke saath laazmi sajana ek mashk bhi
chacha se door na rahe hussain ki wo laadli
zaroor bibi aayengi hamare ghar
sakina ko bhi layengi hamare ghar
saja ke sheh nasheen rakh ke sheh ka taaziya
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sirf rasm hi nahi hamari jaan hai ye gham
karenge matame hussain isi liye bane hai hum
ke hum rahe ya na rahe rahe ye gham
kabhi tumhara hausla nahi ho kam
rahe hamesha jaari ye aza ka silsila
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
falak pe khoon bhara tera libaas bich gaya hussain
jabhi to surkh chand par likha hua hai ya hussain
rakhenge dil ko karbala bana ke hum
ghareeb khaane mein diya jala ke hum
kahenge ya hussain hogi majlise aza
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jhoola us ki yaad hai jo cheh mahine jee saka
salaam us sagheer par jo pani bhi na pee saka
sabeel us ke naam ki laga ke tum
pilaana pani sab ko jab bula ke tum
dua wo de to haath jod kar ye bolna
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
batool ek haath se libaas jis ka khud siye
yeh maahe gham mein kaise ho hum us ko yaad na kare
jab aathween ko ghazi ki ho haazri
nahi ho ehteraam mein koi kami
adab se haath mein utha ke nazre bawafa
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzar gaye hai kitne din mile huwe hussain se
mai unse door ab yahan rahunga kaise chain se
jab aayengi hamare ghar mein fatema
mai un ko apna haale dil sunaunga
wo keh de to bula lenge hussain karbala
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kitni jaldi guzar jayenge ye din
phir poora saal yaad bahot aayenge ye din
layenge hum kahan se ay zeeshan aur raza
matam ki goonj aah o buka raunaq e aza
agle baras jo hoga wohi royega hussain
zinda rahe to hum bhi pukarenge ya hussain
dua karo dua karo hamare ghar mein...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Haye mazloom hasan
items.body:
haye mazloom hasan askari
mere imam hasan askari
<<DIVIDER>>
saamara mein phir chali karbobala ki jab hawa
jigar maula askari ka tukde tukde ho gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
lehad mein binte nabi ka hogaya dil muztarib
haye maula askari ka dil bata tukdon mein jab
ye meri aulaad par zulm kaisa hai khuda
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ko aaya yaad phir beta hassan
zehr se chalni jigar tha khoon se tar tha kafan
jo mila kya hai yehi ajre risaalat ka sila
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein bhoole na maula askari karbal ke gham
jo huwe aale aba par shaam o kufa mein sitam
ya hussaina ya hussaina ki rahe de de sada
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
askari imam ke farzand e mehdi aayenge
har jagah farshe aza phir dekhna bich jayenge
khud bayan farmeinenge maula bayan e karbala
saamara mein phir chali...
<<DIVIDER>>
askari maula ka nauha ho likha aqil qabool
tujhpe raazi ho aneem hashr mein binte rasool
baargah e askari maula mein hai ye ilteja
saamara mein phir chali...
items.author: Saeed Aqil

items.title: Insaf maangti hoo
items.body:
roze jaza adalat e parwardigar mein
haazir hai jo bhi muztarib hai ashke baar mein
faryad kar ke ro rahi hai maa hussain ki
khaalik bhi aaj fatema ka gham gosaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar mein maa ye kehti hai nauha hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
wo karbala ki dhoop wo tapti zameen par
ummat ne kar diya mera beta lahoo mein tar
shahid hai mere haath mein kurta hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad ke dukhon se sataya gaya usay
laashe pe us jawan ke rulaya gaya usay
humshakle mustafa tha jo beta hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor ruqsate qayyaam alwida
matam tha isterab tha kohraam alwida
zainab ko dekh chod kar jaana hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom sirf ek tha zaalim hazaar thay
aur be-khata ki chaak mein teeron ke waar thay
dushman tha jaise saara zamana hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehndi ka rang khoon mein doobi ye baaliyan
asghar ki pyaas dasht mein akbar ki wo azan
laayi ho zuljanah se girna hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ko jala ke shaam e ghariban guzar gayi
zainab rasan ka baar liye shaam ko chali
sehra mein chodna pada laasha hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar tha khataar mein behne aseer thi
thaame chadi wo takht pe baitha tha ek layeen
aur tasht mein kata hua sar tha hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri fughan hai jaun abhi daste yaas mein
irfan inteqam hai chupke libaas mein
ashkon mein leke aayi hoo sajda hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
items.author: Jaun

items.title: Kis jurm par maara
items.body:
bee aayi-ye zambin khutilat
kis jurm par maara usay ay zabt gaahe nainawa
<<DIVIDER>>
tauheed bhi khatre may thi islam bhi khatre may tha
quran bhi majboor tha jab deen hi khatre may tha
shaahi ke aage dat gaya kyunke imame waqt tha
kis jurm par maara...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab se taaba maariya yun to bahot afraad thay
lekin shabe ashoor lashkar may bahattar reh gaye
bayyat bahana ban gayi dar asl sar darkaar tha
kis jurm par maara...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sehar ashoor ki teeron se hamla ho gaya
aur ghalbaye awwal may bas thoda sa lashkar hi bacha
as'haab kuch baakhi bache aur kuch aaizza aqraba
kis jurm par maara...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne taqabbal kehke phir akbar ko dekha yaas se
akbar ka chehra khil utha us izn ke ehsaas se
maidan may jaa kar yun lada seene may naiza gad gaya
kis jurm par maara...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani pilaane laaye thay aagosh may lekar jise
ran may bujhayi tashnagi zaalim ne aab e teer se
phir uska khoon chullu may lekar sheh ne chehre par mala
kis jurm par maara...
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar tha jiske haath may ahle haram ki aas tha
shabbir ki dhaaras akela sirf ek abbas tha
be-dast hokar nehr par be-aas hokar so gaya
kis jurm par maara...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ke nafse mutmain itmaame hujjat ho chuki
mard'on may bas abid bache sab ki shahadat ho chuki
reh jaye naam allah ka kehkar ada sajda kiya
kis jurm par maara...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid zameen larza rahi khoon aasmano se baha
moo par saja kar sheh ka khoon rahwaar qaime ko chala
sar se ridayein chin rahi thi hashr tha har soo bapa
kis jurm par maara...
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Mai bahot pyasi hoon
items.body:
zindan se aa rahi hai yehi aaj bhi sada
sadiyan guzar gayi mujhe pani nahi mila
mai bahot pyasi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
wo saathween ki shab thi ke baba hussain ne
pani diya tha mujhko shahe mashraqain ne
sairaab hoke phir kabhi pani nahi piya
mai bahot pyasi hoon
zindan se aa rahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani piyun mai kaise chacha jaan mar gaye
ek roz mein sakina ke armaan bikhar gaye
karna na mujhse koi bhi pani ka tazkira
mai bahot pyasi hoon
zindan se aa rahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo pyaas thi ke meri chatakti thi haddiyan
mera ye haal dekh ke roti thi bibiyan
sajjad khoon rote thay sun kar ye marsiya
mai bahot pyasi hoon
zindan se aa rahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek roz qaid khane mein sajjad ne kaha
kyun teri khaal hone lagi jism se juda
maine kaha tadap ke mere bhai ba-khuda
mai bahot pyasi hoon
zindan se aa rahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehsoos ab bhi hota hai roti hai bibiyan
sunte hai log ab bhi sakina ki siskiyan
haan ab bhi qaid khane se aati hai ye sada
mai bahot pyasi hoon
zindan se aa rahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasi shaheed hogayi zindan mein wo hazeen
dukhiya ko marte waqt bhi pani mil nahi
is waaste ye nauha sharar naqvi hai likha
mai bahot pyasi hoon
zindan se aa rahi hai...
items.author: Sharar Naqvi

items.title: Masjide kufa mein
items.body:
masjid e kufa mein zakhmi hogaya ek rozadaar
zainab o kulsoom ki ab khair ho parwardigar
<<DIVIDER>>
is namazi ne namak se ki thi sehri ya khuda
ibne muljim ne kiya hai sajda e khaliq mein waar
masjid e kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se tar hogayi mehrab zakhmi ay ali
betiyan ghar mein tadap kar kar rahi hai intezar
masjid e kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbar o shabbir rote hai ali ko dekh kar
masjid e kufa mein hai saare namazi sogwaar
masjid e kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dehkh kar hyder ko zakhmi ghash mein hai ummul baneen
aur hai chote se abbas e dilawar ashk baar
masjid e kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha padta hai musalla hai namazein matami
aaj se hyder ke gham mein hai azaanein gham gusaar
masjid e kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar zainab ko hyder jaane kyun rone lage
dekhti hai bhai ko hasrat se zainab baar baar
masjid e kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaynk kar sar se amaama ro raha hai kyun tabeeb
betiyan baba pe karti hai duaon ka hisaar
masjid e kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth raha tha jab janaza mere maula ka zafar
tha madina ghamzada aur shehr e kufa sogwaar
masjid e kufa mein...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Mere asghar aa gayi
items.body:
chod ke turbat ghar may aaja
godh may kar aaraam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
bano dukhiya karti hai nauha
qaime may hai korhaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban phaili hui hai
masnad e zainab khaak bani hai
tujhko dhoonde teri sakina
pani ka le kar jaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mat bhulo ulfat ke kareene
ghutniyo chalte aao madine
khat may likh kar bheja hai tumko
sughra ne paighaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal gaye qaime lut gaya jhoola
aah karoo to padta hai durra
subha se shab tak shab se saher tak
rona hai mera kaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ko aa kar ruqsat kar do
aankhon ke saagar ashkon se bhar do
qaidi ban kar karbobala se
jaate hai hum shaam asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mahir hai bano ke naale
godh may meri kyun nahi aate
raat ke sannate may tumko
kaise mila aaram asghar
mere asghar aa gayi...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Abbas chale aao
items.body:
abbas chale aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
kya chain se sotay ho darya ke kanare par
chod aaye sakina ko ho kiske sahare par
dar par hai khadi kabse lagaye huwe wo aas
abbas abbas chale aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yun to shahe deen ne maqtal ki raza de di
kis tarha uthayenge mayyat ali akbar ki
bhai ki zaeefi ka zara kuch karo ehsaas
abbas abbas chale aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki nazron may tareek zamana hai
uljha hua barchi may akbar ka kaleja hai
hamshakle nabi ka bhi udoo ne na kiya paas
abbas abbas chale aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon may rawan har soo ek aag ka darya hai
aur pusht pe zainab ki bemaar bhatija hai
aulaad e payambar ka udoo ne na kiya paas
abbas abbas chale aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch tumko khabar bhi hai kya ye hai pata tumko
khaati thi tamache aur deti thi sada tumko
durron se bujhayi gayi masoom ki jab pyaas
abbas abbas chale aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hai ke zainab ke baazu may rasan hogi
darbar e sitam hoga sar nange behan hogi
aankhon se lahoo royenge sajjad basad yaas
abbas abbas chale aao abbas

items.title: Abide bemaar ka
items.body:
momino ye hai janaza abid e beemar ka
jo kabhi bhoola na manzar shaam ke bazaar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop thi aur pyaas thi aur taziyana tha ghiza
khoon bhi jaari jism se tha shaah ke dildaar ka
momino ye hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
di sada zainab ne baba ko layeeno ne ke jab
pusht se khayncha gaya tha bistar abid e beemar ka
momino ye hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa phupi bhene khadi thi be-rida bazaar mein
tha ajab ye imtihan us khaafila saalaar ka
momino ye hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
bar sare mehfil taaruf bibiyon ka jab hua
sharm se sar jhuk gaya us bekas o lachaar ka
momino ye hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch nahi parwa sataaish ki ba-roz e hashr hi
denge maula khud sila mujhko mere ashaar ka
momino ye hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab dua ye hai shajeeha ki imam e asr se
silsila jaari rahe afkaar ke izhaar ka
momino ye hai janaza...
items.author: Sibte Jafar

items.title: Al atash ki dare
items.body:
al atash ki dare qaime se sada aane lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
mehre purtaab o tapish apne safar par jo chala
roshni hogayi darya ka kanara chamka
rafta rafta ye sama dhoop ki shiddat mein dhala
rayt mein aag lagi dasht hararat se jala
garm hoke jo sehra se hawa aane lagi
al atash ki dare…
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke abbas bade ask fishan suye haram
dekha bachon ki jo ye tashnalabi ka aalam
khuskh honton pe zaban phair rahe thay paiham
kaha shehzadi sakina ne ye ba deedae nam
teen din hogaye hai karna sake lab kalabi
mai bhi pyasi hoo chacha jaan ali asghar bhi
al atash ki dare…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye abbas jhukaye hue sar sheh ke khareeb
paon par sher ne rakh di shahe waala ke jabeen
jaag utha qalbe wafadar mein soz-e-yaqeen
arz ki ran ki raza do mujhe ay qibla-e-deen
sheh ko abbas ka israr-e-raza tha dar pesh
ishq ko marhal-e-hijr wafa tha dar pesh
al atash ki dare…
<<DIVIDER>>
al atash kehti hai jab bali sakina aaqa
tooth jaata hai mere dil ka nageena aaqa
ab to kuch aur hi kehta hai kareena aaqa
aap par saaya e sarkar e madina aaqa
hukm hojaye to is shaan se pani laun
qaid kar mauja e kausar ki rawani laun
al atash ki dare…
<<DIVIDER>>
tum chale jaoge reh jayenge ek hum tanha
ranj par ranj sahe jayenge ek hum tanha
aah kis kis ka kiye jayenge matam tanha
hum se uthega bahattar ka na ye gham tanha
kya tumhe ban ki balaon ke hawale kar doo
shamma raushan ko hawaon ke hawale kar doo
al atash ki dare…
<<DIVIDER>>
jao bhai tumhe allah o nabi ko saumpa
lo tumhe saaya e daaman e ali ko saumpa
jo sabhi ka hai khuda uske wali ko saumpa
yani tum jiski amanat ho usi ko saumpa
hum to har haal mein hai saabe rashakil abbas
lo alam aur khuda hafiz o nasir abbas
al atash ki dare…

items.title: Alwida ay behan
items.body:
alwida ay behan alwida
bole shaahe zaman alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl ka mere lamha khareeb aa gaya
ek andhera sa charon taraf cha gaya
waqt se pehle suraj bhi gehan aa gaya
mai hoo tanha mera har sahara gaya
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalte chalte faqat tumse hai ek sawaal
meri pyari sakina ka rakhna khayal
bin mere zinda rehna hai iska mohaal
meri bachi ko hone na dena malaal
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab girun apne ghode se suye zameen
aur jhuka dun mai sajde may apni jabeen
mujhko zibha karega jo shimre laeen
tum na aa jana qaime se bahar kaheen
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere kunbe ki ab ho tumhi paasban
hai mera janasheen laaghar o natawan
raahe koofa hai zanjeer aur bediyan
ab tumhare hawale hai ye karwan
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
lootne aaye qaimon ko jab ashqiya
ho sake to bacha lena apni rida
sabr karna na karna kabhi bad'ua
har qadam par madadgaar hoga khuda
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun na gardish may aaya sitara kabhi
yun hue thay na hum be-sahara kabhi
saat ek pal na choota hamara kabhi
ab na aayega bhai tumhara kabhi
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay behan aisi bhi aayegi rehguzar
jab mile tumko raste may shireen ka ghar
aur pehchanle tumko shireen agar
kehna waada hua poora ay khudsiyar
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sogaye khaak par tashnalab shaahe deen
jalgaye qaime aur chadare chin gayi
hogayi khaali shabbir se ye zameen
ek sadaye alam aaj tak hai yahin
alwida ay behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhej mehshar gharibul watan par salam
tashnalab qastatan bekafan par salam
sheh ke ansaar par panjatan par salam
ek bhai pe aur ek behan par salam
alwida ay behan...
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Ashoor ka suraj
items.body:
ashoor ka suraj jalta hai
har khaak ka zarra jalta hai
jalti hai zameene karbobala
ya arsh e moalla jalat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ansar ke qaime jalte hai
shabbir ka qaima jalta hai
islam ki dunya jalti hai
kaabe ka musalla jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
naize jo jaga di hai dil mein
aisay ke jigar ka kya kehna
akbar ko sukoone qalb mila
laila ka kaleja jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ke padne walon ne
quran ko jala kar khaak kiya
yaseen ka sura jalta hai
quran ka paara jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar baar jalaya ummat ne
kya khoob ye ajre risalat hai
jalti hai mohamed ki masnad
baysheer ka jhula jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
itrat pe nabi ke jor o sitam
kya khoob musalmano ne kiya
zainab ki rida kya jalti hai
islam ka parda jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
rakhi jo fidak mein chingari
ye sholay usi ke nikalte hai
kya aag baghawat ki phaili
ran karbobala ka jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ki tashna dahani ne
ek aag lagadi pani mein
asghar ke tabassum par ab tak
darya ka kinara jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein sakina dekhti hai
jab yaas se khaali saagar ko
saahil pe tadapta hai laasha
saqqa ka kaleja jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
thi kufr ko emaan se takkar
ghar baar nabi ka jal ke raha
jalti hai jidaar e kaaba e deen
emaan ka qibla jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeer zani ye seena zani
tum hum ko na samjho deewane
shabbir tumhare matam se
dil aur kisi ka jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
<<DIVIDER>>
sad-haif ke misle range hina
kubra ka suhaag ab jal hi gaya
is dashte bala mein ay mirza
kya kya mai kahoo kya jalta hai
ashoor ka suraj…
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Ay saarban
items.body:
ai saarban ai saarban
aahista chal ay natawan
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi badan tashna laban
aahista chal ay natawan
<<DIVIDER>>
ek reesma baara galay
ye khaafila kaise chale
sar pe bala ki dhoop hai
pairon talay dharti jale
hai bibiyan sab neem jaan
aahista chal ay natawan
ai saarban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay saarban salaar e gham
ghurbat may ye jaaho hashm
tu naayab e abbas hai
kehte hai sab ahle haram
ban kar zameen par aasman
aahista chal ay natawan
ai saarban...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqon ki jo raftaar hai
chalna mera dushwaar hai
bacche hai naaqon par bandhe
durron ki bhi bauchaar hai
kehne lagi asghar ki maa
aahista chal ay natawan
ai saarban...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko ghash aane laga
jab shimr ne aa kar kaha
jaldi badhao ab qadam
tay jald ho ye faasla
koi na ab khole zaban
aahista chal ay natawan
ai saarban...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki maa kehne lagi
ay shimr ye jurrat teri
mai zauja e shabbir hoo
maa hoo imam e waqt ki
bas ab chalega hukme maa
aahista chal ay natawan
ai saarban...
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaah ye aayi khabar
zainab hui hai nauhagar
tehro sakina gir gayi
rone lage naizon pe sar
kehne lage ahle jina
aahista chal ay natawan
ai saarban...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar se jaate huwe
sajjad jab jaldi chale
sakte may thay rehaan sab
phir yak bayak ko ruk gaye
kehne lagi saut e azan
aahista chal ay natawan
ai saarban...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Baba ab to aajao
items.body:
shaam e ghariban
mere pyare baba mere ache baba
<<DIVIDER>>
lutgaya hamara ghar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao baba ab to aajao
chin gayi meri chadar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao baba ab to aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban dekho khoon ka ye samaa dekho
ab hamare qaimon se uth'ta hai dhuan dekho
koi bhi nahi sar par baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba baba kehti thi roke zainabe muztar
aina qasime muztar aina shakle payghambar
kaun de jawab uth kar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaal par sakina ke jab tamacha lagta tha
jabke sholo ki zad par ghamzada ka kurta tha
kehti thi yehi rokar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay haram jo be parda rote jaate thay sajjad
durra jab bhi lagta tha karte thay yehi faryad
mai sitam ke hoo zad par baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ke zaanu par kat raha tha sheh ka sar
dekh kar suye yasrab keh rahi thi maa rokar
lut raha hai mera ghar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid may sakina ko kaat'ti hai tanhai
kabhi kehti hai ammu kabhi kehti hai bhai
kabhi kehti hai rokar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ki sada'on par aagaye ali haider
ye pukare zainab ko tab galay se lipta kar
ab na yun kaho rokar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
likh raha hai jo majid shadman padho nauha
goonjta hai kaano may bekason ka ye naala
ay yateemo ke yawar baba ab to aajao
baba ab to aajao...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Bhaiya abbas
items.body:
abbas abbas abbas mere bhaiya
bazaar mein zainab hai bhaiya bhaiya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bhai bata doo kisko sada ab tere siwa abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
na sar pe tera saaya na sar pe rida ghazi
majma hai tamashayi aati hai haya ghazi
aa ghazi aa mere bhai aa deti hoon sada abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
bazaar mein zainab hai...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi mere baba ki jis shehr mein thi shaahi
us shehr mein qaidi hai us shehr ki shehzadi
tere baad mera kya haal hua aa dekh zara abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
mere bhai bata doo kisko...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tere sahare par pardes chali aayi
kuch bhi na raha mera jab tu na raha bhai
bin tere safar aur be-chadar dil toot gaya abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
bazaar mein zainab hai...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad na bhoolega yun shaam shehr aana
bazar nibha aayi darbar hai ab jaana
waada ho wafa bhai se mera karna ye dua abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
mere bhai bata doo kisko...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna mere bhaiya se sharminda ye behna hai
saumpa tha jise mujhko zakhmi wo sakina hai
masooma ko mazlooma ko zindan mila abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
bazaar mein zainab hai...
abbas abbas abbas...
items.author: N. Sarwar, J. Jaffri & A. Shanawar

items.title: Dushman ko bhi
items.body:
daaghe jawan dekh ke shabbir ne kaha
dushman ko bhi khuda na dikhaye pisar ka daagh
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hoo baargah e elaahi mein ye dua
dushman ko bhi khuda na dikhaye pisar ka daagh
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka jawan laal ho akbar sa naujawan
khud aake jiska sadqa utaare hai kehkashan
sadma koi uthaye na aise jawan ka
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
bichda jawan to phir nahi jeene ki koi chaah
ta umr khoon ke ashk hi barsaati hai nigaah
hota hai band jeene ka har ek raasta
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
seh jaye gar ye sadma to himmat hai baap ki
warna jawan ke saath hi mayyat hai baap ki
mayyat jaean ki goya janaza hai baap ka
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
humraah tere hogaya ruqsat hamara chain
ay mere laaal baad tere kab raha hussain
sheh ne jawan ki laash pe nauha yehi padha
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil tukde tukde hogaya kisko dikhaun mai
kya kaifiat hai rooh ki kisko sunaun mai
ye keh ke khoon bahata hai zehra ka dilruba
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat thi sar pe sehra sajaunga mere laal
haathon se apne dulha banaunga mere laal
armaan saare khaak huwe wa musibata
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz de rahe hai bulaate hai tumko hum
labbaik to kaho tumhe allah ki qasam
yun daagh deke baap ko jao na mehlekha
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
har lamha teri yaad satayegi baap ko
tasveer teri khoon rulayegi baap ko
ye daagh leke kaise jiyega pidar tera
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaghe jawan libaas e zaeefi pinhata hai
dunya ko baap ke liye turbat banata hai
hai lab pe ek baap ke bas itni ilteja
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
<<DIVIDER>>
majboor hoo sunaayi nahi deta kya karoo
khud tum galay se aa mil lago aisa kya karoo
dayam tha baap ka yehi mayyat pe marsiya
dushman ko bhi khuda na...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Ghamzada quran
items.body:
ya fatema zehra ya umme abiha
sayyeda raaziya marziya
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamzada quran zakhmi aaya e tatheer hai
darmiyan deewar o dar ke maadare shabbir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baad baba ke diya ummat ne ye kaisa sila
chain pal bhar bhi madine mein na zehra ko mila
kis khata pe fatema par haye ye ta'zeer hai
ghamzada quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya pehlu shikasta bas tadapti reh gayi
phasliyon ke tootne se jaan aadhi reh gayi
ashk aankhon mein zuban par naara e tatheer hai
ghamzada quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh pe khatoone jina ke hai tamachon ke nishan
taaziyana yun laga ke haath uth'ta hi kahan
choor zakhmon se khuhdaya deen ki tauqeer hai
ghamzada quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sitam zehra pe yasrab mein hua itna shadeed
dar gira pehlu pe haye hogaye mohsin shaheed
ye sitam zehra ke dil par bakhuda ek teer hai
ghamzada quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
is sitam ne sayyeda ko yun zaeefa kar diya
sin tha athara baras ka thi magar thaame asa
ye nabi ki laadli ya dard ki tasveer hai
ghamzada quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi khadi darbar e haakim mein kayi ghante magar
keh nahi paaya magar afsos ye koi bashar
isko tadpana rasool e paak ki taqseer hai
ghamzada quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mial hai ye hassan ko aur shahe mazloom ko
kaun aa kar ab sambhale zainab o kulsoom ko
kohe nam se sar jhukaye shaahe khyber geer hai
ghamzada quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar o altaf khoon rone lagi roohe rasool
jab bi haye ya nabi keh kar bulaati thi batool
ye sada zehra ki haye dard ki tafseer hai
ghamzada quran...
items.author: Altaf Hussain

items.title: Hamare khoon mein
items.body:
hamare khoon mein shaamil hai ye aza e hussain
khuda ne khalq kiya hai hamay baraye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ataa kiya abu talib ko laal kaabe se
khudayi teri hai mamnoon ay khuda e hussain
hamare khoon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere habeeb na sajde se aaj sar uthay
ye hukme rabb hai ke jab tak na ho raza e hussain
hamare khoon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere hussain ne tauheed ko bachaya hai
hussainiyat ko bachayega kibriya e hussain
hamare khoon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhi se aaj bhi qaayim hai naam e rabb e ulaa
tabhi to naaz mashiyat tere uthaye hussain
hamare khoon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba-surate shahe duldul sawaar al madadi
fiza mein goonj rahi hai abhi sada e hussain
hamare khoon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ataa karega wohi be-pisar ko saath pisar
raza e kaatib e taqdeer hai raza e hussain
hamare khoon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pisar ki laash ko dekhegi kis tarha maadar
dar e rabab pe baithe hai sar jhukaye hussain
hamare khoon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka shukr ada kar rahe hai maqtal mein
jawan bete ki mayyat galay lagaye hussain
hamare khoon mein...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Haye mazlooma
items.body:
haye mazlooma fatema zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise sadme aape bibi seh gayi baba ke bin
gar ye pad jaate dino par misle shab ho jaate din
haye masooma fatema zehra
haye mazlooma fatema zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
hai laqab siddiqa tera jaante thay ye sabhi
zulm ke darbar mein tu phir bhi tu jhultayi gayi
haq nahi paaya fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere dar par khud risalat jhuk ke karti thi salam
par nahi ummat ne samjha tera mansab aur maqam
ghar jalaa daala fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
mit nahi paaya tha bibi baap ka gham qalb se
gham naya ek mil gaya hai qatl e mohsin ka tujhe
qalb rota tha fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e nazha apne waali se yehi faryad ki
aap ki khidmat jo poori kar na paayi ya ali
yun hai sharminda fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad mere pyar se bachon ko rakhna ya ali
na kabhi mehsoos hone dena maadar ki kami
ab chali dukhiya fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shab ki tareeki mein mayyat ko meri le jaana tum
zaalimo ko meri mayyat par na aane dena tum
hogi mehwe buka fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad mere karbala mein sheh ki nusrat ke liye
ya ali farzand ek abbas hona chaahiye
maangti hai dua fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi pehlu ko sambhale zabt e gham kis tarha ho
jaane kyun hasrat se dekha karti hai shabbir ko
sochti hai kya fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e shabbar ko chooma aur gala shabbir ka
choom ke zainab ke baazo ro padi be saakhta
kya khayaal aaya fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai fizza se bibi ay kaneez e bawafa
tere zimme zainab o kulsoom ko maine kiya
roti hai fizza fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaana e hyder mein barpa ek qayamat hogayi
waqt wo aaya ke bibi kI shahadat hogayi
arsh tharraya fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab o kulsoom o fizza shabbar o hyder yahan
door kone mein khade shabbir rote hai wahan
maajra hai kya fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole hyder waqte ruqsat maa ko kya rulwayenge
bole shaah amma bulayengi hamein to aayenge
ro padi jo suna fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke awaaz e shah e deen khul gaye bande kafan
boli bibi haath utha ke aa mere gul pairahan
de rahi hai sada fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek na ek din banega marqad e veeran bhi
dekhne aayenge bibi mazhar o farhan bhi
aap ka rauza fatema zehra
haye mazlooma...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Hussain farz ada
items.body:
hussain farz ada kar rahe hai sajde may
yazidiyat ko fana kar rahe hain sajde may
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain de ke bahattar saron ki qurbani
khuda ka shukr ada kar rahe hai sajde may
hussain farz ada kar rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hayaat deen e mohamed ko ay musalmano
ba waqte asr ata kar rahe hai sajde may
hussain farz ada kar rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zamane waalo ye sabr e hussain to dekho
ke dushmano ka bhala kar rahe hai sajde may
hussain farz ada kar rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
layeen ki kund churi chal rahi thi gardan par
magar hussain dua kar rahe hai sajde may
hussain farz ada kar rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ummati hai ke pad kar rasool ka kalma
sar e hussain juda kar rahe hai sajde may
hussain farz ada kar rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
urooj khoon se apne hussain ibne ali
zameen ko khaake shifa kar rahe hai sajde may
hussain farz ada kar rahe...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Labon pe aaj bhi
items.body:
labon pe aaj bhi hai jaise gham sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
<<DIVIDER>>
sadayein aaj bhi deewar o dar se aati hai
ke jaise karte hai matam haram sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
labon pe aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo uske baad riha ho saki na zindan se
gaya kuch aise khafas mein khadam sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
labon pe aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke sayyede sajjad khoon rote thay
sitam zyada tha aur sin tha kam sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
labon pe aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
in aandhiyon mein larzti thi ek lau itni
wo taaziane wo nanha sa alam sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
labon pe aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shor karti hui bediyon ka tham jaana
sada lagana khuda ki qasam sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
labon pe aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
udhar ke lafz e do aalam ubhar rahi hai naved
idhar khafas mein labon par hai dam sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
labon pe aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo nauhe padta hai sajid naved likhta hai
sada hai dono pe eksa karam sakina ka
andhera yaad dilaata hai gham sakina ka
labon pe aaj bhi...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Mai deene mohamed
items.body:
mai deen e mohamed ko baqa dene chali hoo
beemar hai wo usko shifa dene chali hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
islam tera dhoop may baatil ki hai ya rab
islam pe mai sar ki rida dene chali hoo
mai deen e mohamed ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah mera hausla tum dekhna ban may
abbas sa mai shaah e wafa dene chali hoo
mai deen e mohamed ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle payambar hai mujhe jaan se pyara
mai tere liye us ka gala dene chali hoo
mai deen e mohamed ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab rang shahadat ka tere deen pe chadhega
mai qasim o-kubra ki hina dene chali hoo
mai deen e mohamed ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauheen imamat ki hui dasht e bala may
mai shaam may zaalim ko saza dene chali hoo
mai deen e mohamed ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum aale mohamed hai nahi zulm se darte
sufiyan ke potay ko bata dene chali hoo
mai deen e mohamed ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauqeer kaha bibi ne matam ki sada se
mai qasr e yazeedi ko mita dene chali hoo
mai deen e mohamed ko...
items.author: Tauqeer Kamalvi

items.title: Masnade gham
items.body:
masnad e gham bichayi jaati hai
bazme matam sajayi jaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ran ko akbar chale to maa ne kaha
umr bhar ki kamayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may doobe hai yun ali akbar
jaise chadar udayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisko ghayre hue hai ahle haram
kiski mannat badhayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek rida dedo shah ko kubra
laashe qasim uthayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
<<DIVIDER>>
teer gardan pe khalo ay asghar
pyaas yun bhi bujhayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aati hai ek nanhi lehad
jab bhi shamma jalayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab utho utho abid
aag ghar may lagayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
<<DIVIDER>>
zikre maula ka faiz hai mehshar
teri shohrat jo paayi jaati hai
masnad e gham…
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Mere asghar kahan
items.body:
mere asghar kahan ho aajao
raat ka waqt hone wala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaad yazdan to kar diya tumne
khuld veeran to kar diya tumne
nazr shehda ko kar diya tumne
surkh roo maa ko kar diya tumne
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani peene gaye thay maqtal mein
lab dikhane gaye thay maqtal mein
teer khane gaye thay maqtal mein
dil dukhane gaye thay maqtal mein
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
mere asghar ye kya kiya tumne
teer gardan pe kha liya tumne
maut ka jaam yun piya tumne
has ke sab ko rula diya tumne
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
ansuon se lahoo ko dhoti hai
aur ghusse se laal hoti hai
khod kar qabr jaan khoti hai
shaah ki zulfiqar roti hai
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
yun andhero mein ki ziya tumne
kaam mushkil tha jo kiya tumne
bujh raha tha jo wo diya tumne
andhiyon mein jala liya tumne
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
chal base mujhse rooth kar haye
maine kapde naye na pehnaye
baal bikhre hue na suljhaye
kaun ab maa ke dil ko behlaye
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
ban ki wehshat tumhe rulayegi
neend kis tarha tum ko aayegi
kya kya sadme na maa uthayegi
tumko pehlu mein jab na payegi
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
gham galay se laga rahi hoo
khaali jhoola jhula rahi hoo mai
khoon ke aansu baha rahi hoo mai
ab suye shaam ja rahi hoo mai
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay urooj ab urooj par gham hai
dono aalam mein shor e matam hai
jisko dehru mein aaj gham kam hai
maa ke dil ki pukar payham hai
mere asghar kahan…
raat ka waqt…
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Aalam o masaib mein
items.body:
aalaam o masaib mein giraftar hai sughra
bemaar hai sughra lachaar hai sughra
aalamo masaib mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab chor gaye amma phuphi aur biradar
socha na kisi ne bhi ke bemaar hai sughra
aalamo masaib mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab bhool gaye jaake khabar tak nahi bheji
kya aisi furqat ki sazawaar hai sughra
aalamo masaib mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai wajhe judaai yehi sehat ki kharaabi
ab apni hi bemaari se bezaar hai sughra
aalamo masaib mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
milta hai sukoon din ko na neend aati hai shab ko
akbar teri aamad ki talabgaar hai sughra
aalamo masaib mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kam hoti nazar aati nahi ashk fishani
kuch aise hi haalaat se do char hai sughra
aalamo masaib mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai anees aah o buka padke ye noha
kunbe ki judaai se dilafgaar hai sughra
aalamo masaib mein...
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Abbas chale aao
items.body:
abbas chale aao
akbar bhi nahi baakhi asghar bhi nahi baakhi
quran tha jis ghar may wo ghar bhi nahi baakhi
har tarha ke sadmon se betaab sakina hai
aa kar usay samjhao
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
kano ki lawaen khenchi kano se gowhar tode
ya kaah-kashan todi ya shams-o-qamar tode
tode hai zamane may iqlaaq ke saanche bhi
maare hai tamache bhi bachi pa taras khao
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye raat ye tareeki ye dasht ye sannata
lamho ke taghayyur ne sadiyon ka safar kaata
ye jalte hue qaime ghabrake na mar jaaye
masoom kidhar jaaye masoom ko samjhao
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya aise bahadur ko dekha kabhi dunya ne
daaton se alam thaama baazu se katay shaane
sar giriya e wehshat may deewar se maaregi
ammu ko puka-regi ammu ko bula lao
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek haul sa uth'ta hai is shaam e ghariban may
ek khauf sa dasta hai jangal may biyaban may
zanjeeer bapa bhai phuphi bhi rasan basta
phir band har ek rasta ab aur na tadpao
abbas chale aao…
items.author: Abdul Rauf Urooj

items.title: Al madad al madad
items.body:
al madad al madad ya ali
berida ho ke zainab chali
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab tadap kar ye haye
ghar hamare layeen ne jalaye
bekhata taaziyane lagaye
zulm aada ne is tarha dhaaye
sab ke mushkil kusha sun hamari dua
de ghareebon ko aa kar sahare
gham ke maaron ko aa kar bachale
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahi hai musibat ki maari
kaisi bigdi hai kismat hamari
be-kajawa mili hai sawari
aur muqaddar mein hai aah o zaari
shaam tak ka safar berida nange sar
shaahe waala hai ab aur na akbar
zulm hi zulm hai har qadam par
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke dada thay shaahe madina
jis ka takiya tha sarwar ka seena
dar badar hai wo baali sakina
ab to dushwaar hai uska jeena
kis se shikwa karun kisko awaaz dun
koi sunta nahi aah o zaari
aaj bekas hai zainab tumhari
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye qaidi banaye gaye hai
dar badar hum phiraye gaye hai
shaam emin aaj laaye gaye hai
koocha o dar sajaye gaye hai
zulmat e shaam mein balwa e aam mein
ghair hai koi apna nahi hai
haye koi sahara nahi hai
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera maajaya pyasa sidhara
mar gaya bhai abbas jaisa
maine aulaad ka gham bhi paaya
phir bhi shikwa zaban par na aaya
rasme parda dari mere ghar se chali
berida besahara hoon baba
kaise darbar mai jaaun baba
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro azadare sibte payambar
tere seene mein hai yaade sarwar
ungliyan hai teri khoon mein tar
shayar e karbala hai tu gohar
hai ye nuha tera teri dil ki sada
koi bhi gham na hoga tujhe ab
teri bakshish ki zaamin hai zainab
al madad al madad...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Alwida ay hussain
items.body:
alwida ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dashte nainawa ay shaah e karbala
ay kushta e jafa ay deen ki baqa
alwida alwida alwida alwida
alwida ay khooni kafan
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe aqi pe kehte huwe ye behan chali
waada nibhane apna ghareebul watan chali
ay bekafan hussain tashna dahan hussain
dekho aseer hoke chali binte mustafa
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
utho ke taabe zabt ki quwwat nahi rahi
tumse bichad ke jeene ki hasrat nahi rahi
sultan e mashraqain quran ki zeb o zain
ruqsat ki aagayi hai ghadi aayat e khuda
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhai qaid e shaam nibhane chali ho mai
sang e sitam ka boj uthane chali hoo mai
tasveer e mustafa mehboob e kibriya
utho salaam e aakhri lelo ghareeb ka
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
karna dua ke pairon mein larzish kabhi na aaye
quwwat mein meri zarra barabar kami na aaye
zahra ke dilruba ay roohe murtaza
mai jaa rahi hoo uthke dua do mujhe zara
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kya karoo ke baazu hai bhaiya bandhe huwe
badthe hi jaa rahe hai masayib ke silsile
dushwaar hai dagar mushkil hai rah guzar
har ek qadam pe hoga masayib ka saamna
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hai tera haal pe charkhe kohan hussain
allah kya ghadi hai ke teri behan hussain
jaan kho nahi saki ro bhi nahi saki
ye daagh leke dil pe mai jaati hoo ba khuda
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwat to lo nigaahein to kholo shahe zaman
jumbish zara si lab ko to bolo shahe zaman
ay haami e safar yun tumko dekh kar
kaise kahe ki tumko ye ghamkhaar e benawa
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamaad e safar hai behan alwida hussain
jaati hai ab pahan ke rasan alwida hussain
zahra ke noor e ain qalb e ali ke chain
waada hai tumse waada nibhaungi mai sada
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
har gaam har maqaam pe ashke aza ke saath
ay bhai tujhse waada hai teri dua ke saath
abbas ki behan ay shaah e zulm e nan
ghurbat ka teri sab ko sunaungi marsiya
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise kahoo ke toot chuka hai ye dil mera
akbar ke gham ne mujhko zaeefa bana diya
kya kya karoo ayan kaise karoo bayan
gham ne tere labon ko hai ye marsiya diya
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam karo dua yehi yazdan ke roo baroo
mehfooz rakhna ay mere allah aabroo
hurmat ka hai sawaal ay rabbe zuljalaal
badta hi jaa raha hai masayib ka silisla
alwida alwida alwida alwida
ay dashte nainawa...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Ashoor ka suraj dekhega
items.body:
ashoor ka suraj dekhega
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e dilawar maqtal mein
be-izne wigha jab aayega
toofan uthega sehra mein
aur darya se takrayega
maqtal ki fazaon ko phir se
ek baar ali yaad aayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ka suraj dekhega
shaane pe sajaye mashkeeza
aayega jari haathon mein liye
bas ek alam aur ek naiza
jab ghaat ka pehra tootega
dil zaalim ka ghabrayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil ki hawa ki thandak mein
ghode ka badan jab haampega
bechain sumon ki taapon se
jab darya thar thar kaampega
jab abr ki soorat darya pe
ek tashna dahan chajayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab maujein behte darya ki
uth uth ke raqaabe choomengi
jab garm hawaein pyason ke
qaimon ki tamaawe choomengi
jab aab rawan ke seene pe
ghazi ka alam lehrayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani mein girega mashkeeza
jab katne waale haathon se
kat kar bhi apne maqsad se
na hatne waale haathon se
jab farte nidamat se darya
mashkeeze mein aajayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham dil mein sambhale bachon ke
haathon ke larazte koozon ka
jab pani lekar palthega
qaimon ki taraf sardare wafa
be taygh jari ke seene pe
har samt se hamla aayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gurz lagega chehre pe
jab shaane girenge kat kat kar
jab khaak udegi maqtal mein
jab laash bahegi matti par
jab mashq chidegi teeron se
dil saqqa ka phat jayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ghazi kahega maula se
ek baar hamiyat hai aaqa
qaimon mein mujhe na le jaana
bas itni wasiyat hai aaqa
gar laash gayi qaimon ki taraf
sar zainab ka khul jayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab maula tanha lautenge
aankhon mein lahoo ke ashk liye
ek khoon mein dooba surkh alam
teeron se chidi ek mashk liye
jab kooze girenge haathon se
kulsoom ko ghash aajayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina poochegi
hai mashk o alam pe kiska lahoo
kyon laut ke wapas aaye nahi
kyon laaye nahi pani ammu
ye sunke amma fizza ki
aankhon mein lahoo aajayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil apna dhadakta hai mazhar
naqvi jo ishqe karbal mein
ye bhi hai karam un haathon ka
jo haath kate thay maqtal mein
jab ahle aza ke ashkon mein
har lafz mera dhal jayega
ashoor ka suraj dekhega...
items.author: Mazhar Naqvi

items.title: Ay sabz qaba maula
items.body:
ay sabz qaba maula ay surkh kafan maula
barsaat hai teeron ki kyun tujhpe hassan maula
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa janaza haijo laut ke ghar aaya
is teri ghareebi pe roti hai behan maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye zehr e halahal ne kaise ye sitam dhaya
tukde hai jigar tera zakkhmi hai dahan maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ye ro ro ke kehne lage sarwar se
dekhe to zara kitne zakhmi hai hassan maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tere janaze par teeron ki hui baarish
kis tarha sahi tu ne teeron ki chuban maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad e mohamed par jaari hai sitam haye
kyun ahle madina ka badla hai chalan maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha jigar tera tukde hai isi tarha
bat jayega tukdon may qasim ka badan maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin haaton se zainab ne teeron ko nikaala hai
hogi unhi haathon may ek roz rasan maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay maula teri tarha zakhmi hai teri turbat
hai ghair teri khaatir apna hi watan maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan o raza haye girya na kare kyun kar
phir fatema zehra ka ujda hai chaman maula
ay sabz qaba maula...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Baba abhi mat
items.body:
baba abhi mat jaaiye
mayyat pe zainab ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhein to apni kholiye
khamosh kyun hai boliye
kya hogaye humse khafa
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat uthi gar aap ki
baba yahin mar jaaungi
mujh mein nahi ab hausla
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
eid aa rahi hai baba jaan
kaise rahengi betiyan
veeran ghar ho jayega
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun mere baazu choom ke
aise tadap kar roye thay
batlaye kya yaad aa gaya
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar kaise jaaungi
darbar kaise jaaungi
mei seekh loo chalna zara
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitne bhi hai kufi khade
pathar na maare ye mujhe
keh dijiye in se zara
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aata nahi usko chain
bhoola nahi maa ko hussain
mar jayega bhai mera
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrayegi amma meri
ghusl o kafn ke baad bhi
khoon beh raha hai aap ka
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
parda chinega jab mera
aayenge milne karbala
ye waada kar lije zara
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad kaisi thi ghadi
roti thi khud binte ali
jis dam yateemon ne kaha
baba abhi mat jaaiye...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Bhaiya ali akbar
items.body:
baba ki zaeefi pe nazar kar lo to jao
bhaiya ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane lagi maqtal ko jo akbar ki sawari
kohraam bapa hogaya sheh kehte thay zaari
zainab ne jigar thaam liya farte alam se
lipti hui daaman se sakina ye pukari
<<DIVIDER>>
aise nahi jaao
aankhon mein chupe ashk na tum hum se chupao
bhaiya ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya tumhe maloom hai baba hai akele
tooti hai kamar baba ki sadme se chacha ke
us dard ki shiddat ko khudara na badhao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangi thi dua hum ne to din byaah ke aaye
kya khabr thi tabeer ne kya rang dikhaye
mujh par na sahi tars phupi jaan pe khao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se nahi rukte to mai kis tarha rokun
tehro zara dam nad e ali seene pe kardun
ho sakta hai mushkil se nikal kar chale aao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
phoolon ka nahi ashkon ka sehra hi sajalun
sughra ki taraf se mai armaan nilakun
kya kehdun khat e sughra jo aaye ye batao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ki taraf dekh ke maango zara ruqsat
khul jayegi seene mein hai kitni tere taaqat
sar apna jhukaye huwe nazrein na churao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaan gayi tum bhi na aaoge palat kar
mai choti behan hoo mere majaye baradar
baba ki tarha seene pe ek baar sulao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe maqtal ko rawana huwe akbar
saanson ko sambhale huwe peeche chale sarwar
awaaz e sakina thi na baba ko rulao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan o raza kya wo qayamat ka samaan tha
jab seena e akbar mein laga zulm ka naiza
kehti thi sakina mere dil pe laga ghao
bhaiya ali akbar
aise nahi jaao...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Dushwar kitni qaid
items.body:
zindan ke andhere qaidi mera imam
<<DIVIDER>>
dushwar kitni qaid thi kazim imam ki
dekhi na kabhi subho aayi na shaam thi
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kis qadar wo kothri tang o tareek thi
na sajda hi ki jaa thi na thi qayaam ki
dushwar kitni...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch zehr de ke maare aur kuch qatal kiye
tazeem khoob ki hai khairul anaam ki
dushwar kitni...
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeer o tauq to rag o pay mein paywast thay
mazdoor le ke aaye mayyat imam ki
dushwar kitni...
<<DIVIDER>>
najfi adab se choom le bedi malang ki
jo aaj tak bataati hai tareekh shaam ki
dushwar kitni...
items.author: Afzal Hussain Najfi

items.title: Ghamzada sakina
items.body:
ghamzada sakina pad rahi hai nauha
haye meri ghurbat haye meri ghurbat
<<DIVIDER>>
itne chote sin mein mai hui yateema
haye meri ghurbat haye meri ghurbat
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsini mein kha rahi hoon dar badar ki thokar
mere ammu jaan sogaye neher pe jaa kar
mera qasim na raha mera akbar na raha
koi monis na raha koi yawar na raha
shimr aa raha hai leke taaziyana
haye meri ghurbat...
ghamzada sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi aa raha hai maarta hai taaziyane
kaun hai jo aayega sakina ko bachane
mera qasim na raha mera akbar na raha
koi monis na raha koi yawar na raha
jis pe tha bharosa jab wohi na aaya
haye meri ghurbat...
ghamzada sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera cheh mahine waala bhai bach na paaya
haye zaalimon ne usko maar daala pyasa
mera qasim na raha mera akbar na raha
koi monis na raha koi yawar na raha
kis tarha bhoolun bezuban ka chehra
haye meri ghurbat...
ghamzada sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere baap ka gala kata hai mere aage
ek din mein mera ghar luta hai mere aage
mera qasim na raha mera akbar na raha
koi monis na raha koi yawar na raha
mujhko bad naseebi ne ye din dikhaya
haye meri ghurbat...
ghamzada sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay jahan waalon usko chain kaise aaye
jiska baap ran mein bhooka pyasa maara jaye
mera qasim na raha mera akbar na raha
koi monis na raha koi yawar na raha
phat raha hai gham se ab mera kaleja
haye meri ghurbat...
ghamzada sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
chadarein bhi cheen kar ke le gaye sitamgar
aale mustafa ko maare jaa rahe hai pathar
mera qasim na raha mera akbar na raha
koi monis na raha koi yawar na raha
khoon mein tar batar hai aaj mera kunba
haye meri ghurbat...
ghamzada sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi sunayi de rahi hai wo karahein
duktare hussain ki wo dard naak aahein
mera qasim na raha mera akbar na raha
koi monis na raha koi yawar na raha
goonjta hai waiz aaj bhi ye nauha
haye meri ghurbat...
ghamzada sakina...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Hamare maula ghazi
items.body:
mere sayyed maula sayeen
babul hawaij maula hamare
ay saqi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dar pe alam hai tera
mai tera hoo tu mera
bas ek dua karta hai
maula har aashiq tera
mere ghar may aaye ek baar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum log julooson may ghazi
tera alam utha kar chalte hai
abbas abhi tak zinda hai
ye dekh ke dushman jalte hai
haye nasli aur asli alam bardaar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baab e ata ka maalik hai
dunya waalon na ghabrao
tum waasta le kar zainab ka
abbas ke dar par aa jao
nahi karte kabhi inkaar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza le kar aane par
maidan may khauf ka aalam tha
wallah mai aksar sochta hoo
nau laakh ka jaane hota
le jaate agar talwaar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko funoon e harb sabhi
tu ne hi sikhaye hai maula
ustad hai zainab zaadon ka
shagird hai qasim bhi tera
hashim ke sipaah saalaar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bainul harmain may jaa kar ye
har zaair ko kehte dekha
kya manzar hai subhanallah
shabbir ke rauze ke jaisa
lagta hai tera darbaar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo baabe hawaij ka dar hai
jahan bichde huwe mil jaate hai
is baar kahenge hum jaa kar
maa baap bahot yaad aate hai
milwado hamay ek baar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zeeshan o irfan e aza
jab maahe moharram aata hai
ye soch ke roz e ashoora
har matami khoon bahata hai
galay mil ke karenge pyar
hamare maula ghazi sarkar...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Haye mera pyasa
items.body:
haye mera pyasa bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi qayamat asr ko aayi
ho gayi tan se sar ki judaai
zainab ro ro dewe duhaai
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may dooba chand sa mukda
halq se tune teer nikala
nanhi lehad bhi khud hi banayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr ki taaqat sab ko dikhadi
ya ali kehkar khaynch li barchi
mayyat e akbar tune uthayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis may bandha tha raat may kangna
us may pada hai phanda rasan ka
kubra dekhe apni kalaayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna chehra khoon may bhar kar
aaya jo duldul qaime ke dar par
daudti dar pa sakina aayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ke baad aaye hai sataane
reham nahi khaaya aada ne
qaime loote aag lagayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laakhon ka lashkar tera budhapa
hamle se tere larzan hai kufa
kisne dekhi aisi ladaayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi mahir zainab e muztar
laasha e sheh se ruqsat hokar
jee bhar kar mai rone na paayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Is chand ki das
items.body:
doobi hui dukh ke saagar mein
suraj ki sunehri thaali thi
is chand ki das ko saanj talak
shabbir se dunya khaali thi
<<DIVIDER>>
baba hi ke dam ke saathi thay
akbar bhi gaye qasim bhi gaye
moo takne ko ek ek ka rahi
chaati pe jo sone waali thi
is chand ki das ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
is dhab se na ujda baagh kahin
is dhab se na laagi aag kahin
sookhi hui patti patti thi
tooti hui daali daali thi
is chand ki das ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ke hassan ki widwa ne
do chand se tukde waar diye
bacche to jiyale thay thi magar
maata bhi badi dil waali thi
is chand ki das ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya lutke gaye karbal se haram
jab aayi hai sakhiyan milne ko
jis maang ko dekha ujdi thi
jis godh ko dekha khaali thi
is chand ki das ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
najmi ye hussaini chaukhat hai
yan aa ke muraein milti hai
is daawar se bhiksha le ke chale
aaye thay to jholi khaali thi
is chand ki das ko...
items.author: Najm Afandi

items.title: Kis liye chup ho
items.body:
kis liye chup ho mujhe itna bata do fatema
ya ali ek baar bas keh ke bula do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan tooti hui hai hogayi mujhko khabar
dil phata jaata hai gham se bas ye manzar dekh kar
meri khaatir haath pehlu se hata do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatima toota hai pehlu haye ye zulm o sitam
rukh pe sayli ke nishan hai haath mein bhi hai waram
jee rahi thi kis tarha itna bata do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi deta hai jawab ab aur na karta hai salaam
aisi ghurbat mein nahi karti ho kyun mujhse kalaam
mujhse tum baatein karo kuch gham mita do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema pal bar judaai seh nahi paaunga mai
dard e dil apna kisi se keh nahi paaunga mai
mujhko jeene ka zara sa hausla do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema faryaad ye hasnain ki sun lo zara
keh rahe hai hum na kuch khayenge amma ke bina
apne haathon se inhe khaana khila do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad kar ke ro raha hai ek goshe mein hussain
uth ke tum pani pilaati thi usay milta tha chain
laal pyasa hai utho pani pila do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao bachon aakhri deedar ab maa ka karo
betiyon khud ko sambhalo maa ka chehra choom lo
jaate jaate apne bachon ko dua do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e ruqsat aisa lagta hai ke mai mar jaunga
apne haaton se tumhe mai kis tarha dafnaunga
sakth mushkil hai meri himmat badha do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo chehre par abhi tak aansuon ke hai nishan
kar rahe hai ye tumhari saari ghurbat ko bayan
kuch to apne gham mujhe khud se suna do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho moo par moo rakhe kaise hassan karta hai bain
ro raha hai nanhe haathon se kafan thaame hussain
in ke aansu poch kar in ko sula do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahe hai sun ke sab ahle aza gham ka bayan
kaash khud keh de payambar ye dabeer o shadman
hai tumhare matami inko jaza do fatema
haye ya zehra haye ya zehra
kis liye chup ho...
items.author: Dabeer Akhter

items.title: Masoom lahoo may
items.body:
masoom lahoo may dooba hua
baysheer ka laasha dekh na le
ye maut isi ka kharcha hai
maa khaali jhoola dekh na le
masoom lahoo may dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye abbas zara parda kar le
ay maut zara haayil ho ja
sar khole hue nikli hai behan
shabbir ka laasha dekh na le
masoom lahoo may dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye abbas e ali ki aamad par
aapas may ye faujein kehti thi
shabbir ka bhai pyasa hai
darya ka kanara dekh na le
masoom lahoo may dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye garmaye huwe sooraj ki kiran
aur godh may baba ki asghar
ye phool aba ke saaye may
bedard zamana dekh na le
masoom lahoo may dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jab qatl huwe suraj dooba
ghar aal e nabi ka loota hai
aagosh may jalte qaimon ki
maa nanha sa jhoola dekh na le
masoom lahoo may dooba...

items.title: Mere asghar kidhar
items.body:
haathon se apna pakde kaleja jigar figaar
umme rabab dhoondti hai apna gulazaar
qaime ke dar par aati hai ho ho ke bekharar
rukh karke phir baqiye ka kehti thi baar baar
jaise pisar sunaar ka khoya hua mila
mujhko bhi mere laal ka batlaiye pata
ay bibi sayyeda mera asghar kidhar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
mojiznuma hai taahera khairunnisa hai aap
hum auraton ke waaste mushkil kusha hai aap
baahon mein meri jhoolne waala kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar se kabhi na aap ke khaali gaya koi
murda dulhan ko aap ne bakshi thi zindagi
mujhko bhi ab batayein khudara kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole mein dhoonti hoo kabhi qaimagah mein
phirta hai mera laadla meri nigaah mein
hasta hua wo pyara sa chehra kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos ek baras ki kamayi hui na thi
haye haye abhi to doodh badhayi hui na thi
papdaye honton waala wo pyasa kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ka hai laal mere dil ka chain hai
thandak hai meri aankhon ki wo noore ain hai
roshan tha jis se ghar wo sitara kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadmon se apne chal ke sidhara na haye haye
maa kehke ek dafa bhi pukara na haye haye
qaime mein mujhko chod ke tanha kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
taqseer behel kijiye laundi hoon aap ki
ek maa ka dard maa hi hai dunya mein jaanti
poochun mai kis se hasliyon waala kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada ay beti meri kyun udaas hai
asghar to tera aaj se daadi ke paas hai
kehna na ab kaleje ka tukda kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee sada ye sunte hi khamosh hogayi
gehwara khaali dekh ke behosh hogayi
aamir kaha na phir ye dubara kidhar gaya
ay bibi sayyeda...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Mujhe abbas na
items.body:
abbas ameer e lashkaram kaisa hai jaah o hasham
ek haath mein hai mashk aur ek haath mein parcham
chalo bhaago yahan se chodo darya aagaye hai hum
<<DIVIDER>>
mai qamar e bani hashim hoo suno abbas hoo mai
mere baba ali jaisa agar na ho mera hamraah
nahi kehna nahi kehna mujhe abbas na kehna
<<DIVIDER>>
suno darya ke pehradaron ye ghazi ka naara hai
hamari milkiyat hai pani par qabza hamara hai
agar himmat hai to bolo ke ye darya tumhara hai
suno ay shaamiyon sunlo
agar ek waar mein na cheen loo tumse mai ye darya
nahi kehna nahi kehna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka laal ho jarrar hoo naade ali hoo mai
jalaal aaye to sar se paon tak yaad e ali hoo mai
ye hargiz bhool na jaan ali baad e ali hoo mao
suno ay shaamiyon sunlo
agar talwaar ki tarha na kaate tumko ye naiza
nahi kehna nahi kehna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladoge mujhse kya tumko mera ash'al kuchal dega
agar mai hukm dedun nehr ka naqsha badal dega
lehad tak yaad rakhoge tumhe aisi ajal dega
suno ay shaamiyon sunlo
jo kehta hoo wo karta hoo agar aisa na ho wallah
nahi kehna nahi kehna...
<<DIVIDER>>
jeena hai ya marna hai khud sochlo kya karna hai
naslon ko tumhari warna mere naam se hi darna hai
agar roohon ko bhi na kaat doo mai jismon ki tarha
nahi kehna nahi kehna...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ladne ki ijazat hai na ladne ka iraada hai
sakin akab se pyasi hai ye gham sab se zyada hai
bas ek mashkeeza bharne do mere tumse ye waada hai
suno ay shaamiyon sunlo
agar pani piye ek boond ye seh roz ka pyasa
nahi kehna nahi kehna...
<<DIVIDER>>
wahan zeeshan o irfan e aza pehra hai ghazi ka
jabhi to karbala koi yazeedi jaa nahi sakta
wafa ke baadshah ka unhe hai khauf itna
ali ka sher hai wo saron ko kaat dega
suno ay shaamiyon sunlo
abhi tak yaad hai unko mere ghazi ka ye kehna
nahi kehna nahi kehna...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Naukri shabbir ki
items.body:
haya ala khairal amal
<<DIVIDER>>
mere khoon ki taharat kehti hai
mujhe har shaahi se achi hai
naukri shabbir ki
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sab ko mayasar hoti nahi
ye hurr jaison ko milti hai
naukri shabbir ki
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mansab jisko mil jaye
zahra ki duayein paata hai
wo khaak ka zarra ho kar bhi
khud khaake shifa ban jaata hai
ye naymat to hum jaison ki
taqdeer banaye rakhti hai
naukri shabbir ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye farshe aza taboot o alam
ye nauhe majlis aur matam
pani ke sabeelein aur langar
masoom ali asghar ki qasam
hum ahle aza ki mazhab may
kehlaati thi kehlaati hai
naukri shabbir ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye log jo nauha padte hai
ye log jo matam karte hai
