ye maa behne jo roti hai
zaakir jo khitabat karte hai
darwaza e zehra par in ki
ta roze qayamat pakki hai
naukri shabbir ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke jitne naukar hai
sairaab e jaam e kausar hai
khuddaam azakhano ke jo hai
qismat ke abuzar qambar hai
is izzat ko khud binte ali
quran ki zuban may kehti hai
naukri shabbir ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis may siyasat mat karna
maula se baghawat mat karna
is farshe aza par aake talab
is zikr ki keemat mat karna
belaas jo matam karte hai
bas unko shifa'at deti hai
naukri shabbir ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sajada e aakhir jalti zameen
jis sajde ka saani hi nahi
khanjar ke talay jis dam rakhi
shabbir ne haye zakhmi jabeen
jibreel ne aa kar di ye sada
manzoor khuda ne karli hai
naukri shabbir ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan qalam bhi naukar hai
kaaghaz bhi ghulame sarwar hai
darvesh sifat har lafz mera
likhta jo aza ka manzar hai
kehti hai meri nauha goyi
taqdeer may teri likhdi hai
naukri shabbir ki...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Aale aba mein
items.body:
aale aba mein matame shere khuda hai aaj
roze widae hazrate mushkil kusha hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid mein ibne muljim e maloon ki taygh se
zakhmi jo hogaya tha usi ki qaza hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shiyon udao khaak gareban phaad do
uryan jina mein farqe rasoole khuda hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat ke gird rote hai baara pisar khade
jin ko yateem daure falak ne kiya hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pursa do aaj ahmed e mursal ko bhai ka
nayeb rasoole haq ka jahan se utha hai aaj
aale aba mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiq jahan mein hashr ke aasaar hai ayan
maahe siyam maahe moharram hua hai aaj
aale aba mein...
items.author: Sadiq

items.title: Abbas chale aao
items.body:
abbas chale aao bachi na guzar jaaye
darwaza e zindan par ro ro ke na mar jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se lahoo payham shano pe tapakta hai
bibi ke tadapne par dil sab ka tadapta hai
zindan ke andhere mein bemaar kidhar jaye
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
baazar se ho aayi darbar se ho aayi
ashoor ko jangal mein shabbir ko kho aayi
ab sirf yehi zid hai tum aao to ghar jaye
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
aahat koi hoti hai seene se lagati hai
aaghosh mein bachi ko ghabra ke chupati hai
madar ko ye dhadka hai sote mein na darr jaye
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunain ki shahzadi hai khaak basar kab se
ik pal ko nahi soyi tum door gaye jab se
ghut ghut ke aseeri mein zainab hi na mar jaye
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dayr ko laila ke shahzade ko le aao
aate huye godhi mein shish maah ko le aao
ukhda hua dam shayad ik pal ko thehar jaye
abbas chale aao…
<<DIVIDER>>
itrat pe jo guzri hai waaqif hai jahan saara
shahid hai zameen saari shahid hai zamaan saara
ay kaash kisi surat sughra ko khabar jaye
abbas chale aao…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Abul fazle bawafa
items.body:
abul fazl e bawafa alamdar e lashkaram
maahe hashmi nasab ameere dilawaram
<<DIVIDER>>
tu shahenshahe wafadari hai
tera gham misle hawa jaari hai
tere parcham ki chamak kya kehna
taa qayamat ye alamdari hai
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bakhuda chashm e karbala tum ho
hum fakheeron kaa aasra tum ho
aap ki zaat hai shaoor e falaak
baazu e ibn e fatema tum ho
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh e pur noor surat e gul hai
juz nahi aks e hyderi kul hai
tum uloom e ali ke taare ho
teri jurrat ka chaar soo ghul hai
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum sada e dili ki sunte ho
yun bhi haajat rawayi karte ho
dast geeri baghair baazu bhi
chauda sadiyon se karte rehte ho
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ghulam e hussain ibne ali
bar sar e alqama bhi tashnalabi
tere hi khoon se tar tha tera alam
pyaas jeeti hai alqama haari
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain karti hai ek masooma
wo sakina gala bandha jis ka
aaj bhi tere intezaar mein hai
ab bhi zindan se aa rahi hai sada
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer ek aankh mein tha ek mein lahoo
jab kiya hai paye namaz wazoo
qalb e zainab lahoo ugalne laga
aayi pani mein jab teri khushboo
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar barehna thi jis ghadi zainab
zer e naiza thi jab khadi zainab
nok e naiza pe tera sar na ruka
khaak pe ro ke gir padi zainab
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere laashe pe jab gaye shabbir
dekha paywast aankh mein hai teer
shiddat e gham se jhuk gayi thi kamar
khoon mein ghaltan thi baap ki tasveer
abul fazl e bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi bhar hamein kaha aaqa
bole ghazi se shaah e karbobala
mere nasir meri rehaan dili
bhai keh do hamein paye zehra
abul fazl e bawafa...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Al madad baba
items.body:
ek shor ka aalam hai madine ki gali hai
yeh kis ka hai darwaza jahan aag lagi hai
bibi hai koi jis pe wo darwaza gira hai
bas chaaron taraf ek sada goonj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
al-madad baba al-madad baba
jalte darwaze ke neeche hai tumhari zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
mai giri khaak pe darwaza gira hai mujh par
ghar mein daakhil hui ummat ye usi pe chal kar
phasliyan toot ke deti hi rahi tum ko sada
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni haalat mai ali se bhi nahi keh sakti
itni zakhmi hoon ke zinda bhi nahi reh sakti
har ghadi khoon mein tar rahti hai ab meri rida
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun nahi aate bhala aap kahan hai baba
dekho chehre pe tamachon ke nishan hai baba
maine zainab se chupaya hai ye zakhmi chehra
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse darbar ne ek din mein jawani cheeni
ghar talak bhi hoon mai beton ke sahare aayi
haal athara baras mein hai zaeefa jaisa
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
keel paywast jo pehlu mein hui hai mere
is liye baba mere haath nahi uth sakte
kuch nahi maangna bas maut ki karni hai dua
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kam qayamat se nahi hai ye ajab din baba
mujh mein hi dafn hua hai mera mohsin baba
saare zakhmon se hai mere yehi ek zakhm bada
al-madad baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi azlaan baqayya se sada aati hai
phasliyan tooti thi kal aj lehad tooti hai
jaane kis baat ki di ahle madina ne saza
al-madad baba...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Alwida ay hussain
items.body:
alwida alwida ay hussain alwida
kehti thi dukhiya behen mere hussain alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
banda e mabood ada sidq o safa ki kitaab
paikare sabr o riza roohe risalat ma'ab
faatahe karbobala lakhte dil e bu-turaab
ambiya ki zindagi fatema ke jaan o tan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis jagah taqdeer ka laaya safeena mujhe
dekh mila hai yahan gham ka dafeena mujhe
kaash ke kar le qubool jadh ka madina mujhe
jaati hoon saughaat mein leke nishane rasan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri qasam ay hussain qabr pe aati zaroor
aake lehed par teri shamma jalati zaroor
chadar e ashke aza roke chadhati zaroor
kya kare zindan mein qaid thi teri behen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
peshe nazar har ghadi ghurbate ahle haram
qasime muztar ki yaad aun o mohamed ka gham
baad tere ay hussan mujhpe thi har har qadam
dard o alam ki ghata baarishe ranj o mehen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki har ek daastan jaake sunaungi mai
neel jo shaano pe hai wo bhi dikhaungi mai
roke mazaar e nabi par ye bataungi mai
loota gaya kis tarha nana tumhara chaman
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ke nageenein sar e dashte bala kho gaye
ran mein dileron ko aayi qaza so gaye
bhai bhatije pisar mujhse juda ho gaye
sone na degi mujhe ab mere dil ki chubhan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mein tere raat din roye na kyun dil malool
khusboo e deene khuda baaghe imamat ke phool
haye re ghurbat teri raakib e doshe rasool
na hui turbat naseeb laash rahi bekafan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki meri daastan haal safar ka suno
roohe payambar utho mere baradar utho
uth ke zara qabr se daade shuja'at to do
jeet ke kufa o shaam aayi hai dukhiya behen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
raas na aaya tujhe ye safar e karbala
maa ki lehed bhi chuti nana ka rauza chuta
zindagi bhar ke liye door madina hua
koi nahi deher mein tujhsa ghareebul watan
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya teri fikre rasa kya tera nauha bilal
khatra e na-cheez tu aur wo darya bilal
dil mein faqat hai yehi ek tamanna bilal
kaash ye karle qubool shaahe huda ki behen
kehti thi dukhiya behen...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Ashoor ka suraj keh
items.body:
ashoor ka suraj keh dega
khamosh kinara keh dega
jo baat ke asghar keh na sake
behta hua darya keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha jawani khaak hui
laila ka kaleja keh dega
behte huwe aansu keh denge
utra hua chehra keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed ki nawasi ka aalam
uth'ta hua parda keh dega
kis tarha chini sar se chaadar
jalta hua qaima keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha gaye asghar ran mein
aabad hui kyun kar turbat
bano ki udaasi keh degi
ujda hua jhoola keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki ajal aayi pehle
ya barchi ka phal nikla pehle
shabbir ki kismat keh degi
akbar ka kaleja keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ke liye asghar aaye
pani na mila pyase hi gaye
chup hogi agar nanhi si lehad
ujda hua jhoola keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
nawak ki khatak dil ki himmat
ummat pe nazar baba ka khayal
kya raaze khuda samjhe asghar
hasta hua chehra keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
har gaam pe thokar kha kha kar
jab baap pisar ko dhoondega
kis samt hai akbar ki mayyat
uljha hua rasta keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza chida pani to baha
mayyat na hati turbat hi bani
darya ki tarayi kiski hai
abbas ka rauza keh dega
<<DIVIDER>>
shadi se gharaz shadi kab thi
ye dars e alam tha dunya ko
kuch dayr ka dulha keh dega
ujda hua sehra keh dega

items.title: Ay sakina ke chacha
items.body:
ay sakina ke chacha ay mere bhai abbas
maar daalegi hamein teri judaai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nahi hoti to mai aa bhi nahi sakta tha
tere laashe pe mujhe maa meri laayi abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum yahan zeen se giray aur wahan qaime mein
sar se zainab ke rida gir gayi bhai abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise tanha mai sambhalunga ali akbar ko
laash hum ne hai har ek mil ke uthayi abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis se sharminda ho tum uski qasam deta hoo
aankhein khole ke sakina nahi aayi abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gaye hai tere qasim se zyada tukde
laash uthaun mai teri kis tarha bhai abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera armaan mere dil mein na reh jaye kahin
bhai shabbir ko ab bol do bhai abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad ye kehte rahe akbar se hussain
meri bat'tees baras ki hai kameini abbas
ay sakina ke chacha...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Baba ali
items.body:
subhe unees falak par jo namudaar hui
mere maula ki shahadat ki khabar le aayi
sar pe talwaar chali shor utha haye ali
apne baba ko musalle pe jo dekha zakhmi
hasnain shareefain ne di ro ke sada
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya maahe aza
<<DIVIDER>>
zarb lagi hai sher e elaahi ko
chehra lahoo may dooba hai
abbas aur hasnain ke baba ko
sajde may kis ne maara hai
baba ke sar ko zaanu pe rakh ke
haye hassan ne ro kar kaha
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ki taraf jab le ke chale bete
bole ali girya na karo
saath hamare koi nahi aaye
jao hassan sab se keh do
aisa na ho ke aa jaye baahar
karti hui zainab ye buka
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon ali ki aankhon se jab pocha
chaadar se apni zainab ne
aankhein khuli to saamne beti ko
dekh ke hyder rone lage
zainab tadap ke baba se boli
chod ke hum ko na jaana
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi jab ekkeeswi ramzan
zehra ke ghar shaam e ghariban
band hui hyder ki aankhein
ruk gayi saansein hogaye be-jaan
shaana hila ke kehne lagi zainab
baba utho aankhein kholo
baatein karo khamosh ho kyun baba
bolo zara kuch to bolo
aap ke gham may ab rote rote
dam na nikal jaaye mera
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan aur irfan e aza bete
ghar se janaza le aaye
koi naqaab may jab mayyat lene
aaya hassan bole haye
kaun ho apna chehra dikhao
bole hassan jab parda hata
baba ali baba ali
maahe ramzan ban gaya...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Bhaiya kyun nahi
items.body:
pooch rahi hai karbobala ke raston se bemaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rulaate hai mujhko yasrab ke dar o deewar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se ojhal nahi hota chehra akbar ka
dhoondti rehti hoon khwabon mein sehra akbar ka
toot ke roz bikhar jaate hai aansuon ke haar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se falak par chand nazar aaya hai moharam ka
lagta hai mujhko arsh bhi jaise farsh ho matam ka
chand ke peeche jaise chipi ho barchi aur talwaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dua ay maalik mera baabul khair se ho
ghayr na le sehrayi darinde duldul khair se ho
ache nahi haalat bhi shayad kufe ke us paar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hui aakhir mujhse khata maloom to ho mujhko
paayi hai kyun furqat ki saza maloom to ho mujhko
rooth gaya majboor behen se kyun beeran ka pyaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khat bheja aur qasid se sandes bhi keh laaya
phir bhi mujh birhan ka kisi ko dhyaan nahi aaya
bhool gaya pardes mein jaa kar mujhko mera pariwar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haar gayi mai kismat ki tehreerein jeet gayi
raasta takte takte do do eidein beet gayi
ho na saka hamshakle nabi ke chehre ka deedar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataun kitna kathin hai hijr ka gham bhaiya
choomti rehti hoon mai tere nakshe qadam bhaiya
darr hai mit jaaye na kahin in qadmon ke aasaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere maalik mere pardesi kunbe ki khair
behno ke maaon ke phupiyon ke parde ki khair
khwaab mein maine dekhe hai kuch pathar aur bazaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh rahi hoon naiza naiza chadar chadar khoon
basti basti sehra sehra pathar pathar khoon
sheeshe mein jo khaak thi wo bhi hogayi khoon ki dhaar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise kisi barchi ki chuban mehsoos ho seene mein
rone lagti hai ek bibi ab bhi madine mein
sunte hi aamir ki zaban se nayyar ke ash'aar
bhaiya kyun nahi aaye...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Ehad naama
items.body:
zameen e qalb pe sheh ki aza ka mausam hai
khata e hurr pe hussaini ata ka mausam hai
mareez nafs ki khaatir dawa ka mausam hai
hussain asr se ahde wafa ka mausam hai
imam e waqt se waada hai sar kata dunga
lahoo ka aakhri khatra bhi mai baha dunga
<<DIVIDER>>
al ajal al ajal ajal ya imame zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha
na khat likh ke mujhko bulana
<<DIVIDER>>
bujha kar diya aur na hal min
ki awaaz se aazmana
tere saamne haath baandhe
mai hurr banke tehra milunga
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha...
<<DIVIDER>>
nigahein pareshan sadiyon se
kaabe ki jaanib lagi hai
tere paak qadmon ki aahat
zameen se abhi uth rahi hai
teri aarzoo may najaf se
mai karbobala tak chalunga
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bandha mere maathe ke zakhom
pe rumaal wo fatema ka
ho ghodon ki taapon se ran may
badan kaash pamaal mera
mai sau baar bhi jee uthoo to
mai sau baar tujhpe marunga
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zakhmi jigar jis ki baais
tu maqtal may ghutno chala tha
kayi baar khaayi thi thokar
kayi baar ran may gira tha
mai akbar ke seene ki barchi
kaleje pe maula sahunga
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shaam e ghariban abhi bhi
mere qalb pe dhal rahi hai
wo raste kadi dhoop may jo
sakina bhi chal rahi hai
yateema ki raahon ke kaante
mai palkon se apni chununga
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghiri shaam waalon may zainab
madad ki sada de rahi hai
jhuka dunga gustaakh nazrein
jo rauze ki jaanib uthi hai
ay binte ali teri khaatir
mai abbas ban kar ladunga
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha...
<<DIVIDER>>
pade tauq gardan may chaahe
bandhe mere pairon may bedi
sunega zamana kisi din
garajdaar lalkaar meri
mai tareek zinda ki zulmat
se mukhtar ban kar uthunga
habeeb e mazahir ki tarha...
items.author: Syeda Naqvi

items.title: Ghar chalo ay
items.body:
ghar chalo ghar chalo ay sakina
qabr e zindan pe zainab pukari
hogayi hai rehaai hamari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
poochti thi ye har baar mujhse
dekh kar aasman ke parinde
phupi amma ye mujhko batado
kab talak jayenge hum madine
utho utho sarwar ki pyari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan zakhmi hai ab tak tumhare
utho marham unhe mai lagadoo
gar tum na saath aao hamare
kaise ghazi ko chehra dikhaun
apne ammu ki tum ho dulaari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ghazab ka andhera yahan par
aur kisi simt ujaala nahi hai
hai parayi ye basti yahan ki
koi ghamkhwar apna nahi hai
hogayi ye phupi tumpe waari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to paidal bhi tum na chalogi
aur na zulm o sitam ko sahogi
na rasan koi baandhega tumko
aur na haaton se parda karogi
mil gayi hai jo chadar tumhari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mai jaungi apne watan ko
ujde ghar ko mai seh na sakungi
meri masooma meri sakina
ye batao usay kya kahoongi
tumko pooche jo behna tumhari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki zameen pe hai asghar
aur saath uske soye hai sarwar
kaun dilaasa usay dega dilbar
jo yahan sogayi ho zameen par
mar na jaye ye maadar tumhari
ghar chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid e zindan se haye ahmed
ab talak bhi reha ho na paayi
sheh ki is laadli ko ay mohsin
ye zameen kis tarha raas aayi
keh rahi thi phupi gham ki maari
ghar chalo…
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Hamay ye husne
items.body:
hamay ye husne aqeedat bahot hai kya kam hai
agar hussain nahi hai hussain ka gham hai
<<DIVIDER>>
utha hi tha sare baatil ke di sada haq ne
abhi jahan may salamat hussain ka dam hai
hamay ye husne aqeedat…
<<DIVIDER>>
unhe uthao jo parde pade hai aankhon par
ye keh rahe ho charaghon may roshni kam hai
hamay ye husne aqeedat…
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam umr tadapne ke baad samjha hoo
hayaat kya hai musalsal hussain ka gham ka
hamay ye husne aqeedat…
<<DIVIDER>>
jinhe masayab e aale rasool yaad nahi
rasool ko bhi wo bhoolenge jab ye aalam hai
hamay ye husne aqeedat…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ki laash ko shabbir laaye hai shayad
ke qaimagah may awaaze al atash kam hai
hamay ye husne aqeedat…
<<DIVIDER>>
udao khaak ke shabbir hogaye hai shaheed
urooj jin o malak may shor e matam hai
hamay ye husne aqeedat…
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Haye mera sajjad
items.body:
haye mera sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gaya bazaar maula mera
haye mera sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
saath hai bibiyan kya kare natawan
haye mera sajjad
sayyed e sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeeron mein jakda maula
saath saara qaidi kunba

items.title: Is jawan ki magar
items.body:
is jawan ki magar baat hi aur hai
naaze har do jahan sheh ke lashkar mein hai
saare shere jehan sheh ke lashkar mein hai
kitne aburu kama sheh ke lashkar mein hai
kaise kaise jawan sheh ke lashkar mein hai
is jawan ki magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
un mein hyder ke sarway sahi khad bhi hai
baaghe muslim ke saywo bahi khad bhi hai
maadane haq ke laal o zabar jad bhi hai
yun to qasim bhi aun o mohamed bhi hai
is jawan ki magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun hai jaan ko jisne waara nahi
kaun hai jo ke aankhon ka taara nahi
kaun hai jo shahe deen ko pyara nahi
kisne ghoday se gir kar pukara nahi
is jawan ki magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisne sheh se bala'on ko taala nahi
khud ko dushman ki faujo mein daala nahi
kaun hai jo ke ghar ka ujaala nahi
kaun hai jisko zainab ne paala nahi
is jawan ki magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake tayghe giray ran mein kya kya haseen
laash par jinki tanha gaye shaahe deen
kaamp utha falak aur larzi zameen
bibiyan phir bhi qaime se nikli nahi
is jawan ki magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisne zakhme sina dil pe khaya nahi
kisne seene ko chalni banaya nahi
kiske laashe ko sheh ne uthaaya nahi
haath lekin behan ne bataya nahi
is jawan ki magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein har ek aisa tha shireen zaban
jiske lehje pe dawood bhi dede jaan
inmein jisko bhi kehte shahe ins o jaan
subhe ashoor wo badhke deta azan
is jawan ki magar...

items.title: Jawab kya denge
items.body:
amal se haath hai khaali hisaab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir jawab kya denge
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hai ghulam e zamana wo nasiraan e wafa
yahan pe khwahish e dunya wahan hai ilm o ata
yahan pe raks o ghinahai wahan pe ashk e aza
yeh behayaii ki dal dal wh nusraton ki faza
hum apni nasl ko aakhir nisaab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kab se hai masroof gheebaton mein lab
namaz o roza o hajj se nahi koi matlab
zakat o khums ke hum ho gayi hai mujrim sab
bula rahe hai imam e zaman ko hum ya rab
amal ki rooh se khaali habaab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazab khuda wo kaisi khushi ki mehfil thi
ke maaon behno ki be-pardagi wahan dehki
abhi hadees e kisa thi wahan kisi ne padi
phir uske baad wahin par hai raks o mausiqi
ghina ki leh pe ye chang o rabab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot bada hai ye karb e imam e arsh e waqaar
ali ki betiyan balwe mein itrat e athaar
nazr se jaata nahi unke shaam ka bazaar
wo hai zahoor ko tayyar hum nahi tayyaar
shahadaton ke bina inquilaab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir...
<<DIVIDER>>
gharon mein honge jo ibleesiyat ke rang o nishan
na paida honge wahan naasiran e shaah e zaman
karenge majlisein be-pardagi bhi hogi yahan
aza ke farsh pe aayegi jab hussain ki maa
saboot e ishq e risalaat ma'ab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aur kitni jihalaat ki pairawi hogi
chamak nigaah mein aur dil mein teeragi hogi
iza fakaul mein kirdaar mein kami hogi
wo jin ki fikr mein deemak lagi hui hogi
hum unke haath mein deen ki kitaab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir...
<<DIVIDER>>
agar kahenge wo shamme wafa jalaani hai
jo zindagi ki kameini hai wo lutaani hai
agar kahenge wo ke akbar ki jaan bachani hai
jawan bete ki mayyat hamay uthani hai
jawan pisar ka qamar hum shabab kya denge
imame asr ko aakhir...

items.body:

baab e hitta se bada dar hai dar e maula hussain

items.title: Masoom sakina pyasi
items.body:
masoom sakina pyasi hai
ye sookhe huwe lab khusk zuban

masoom sakina pyasi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye tashna labi ye jalti zameen
pani ka koi imkaan nahi
nazuk se jigar se uth'ta dhuan

bachi ki sada pani pani

items.title: Mere baba
items.body:
mere baba mai karun kya
khaak par neend nahi aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aata hai mujhe reh reh kar
aap ka seena tha mera bistar
aaj ye waqt pada hai baba
khaak bistar hai andhera chadar
din tadap kar mai guzarun
raat matam mein guzar jaati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun faryad sunega meri
saath hai mere meri tanhaai
kaan zakhmi hai jigar zakhmi hai
khoon kano se abhi jaari hai
koi marham na dawa hai
maut nazdeek hui jaati hai
mere baba mai karun...

shaam ko jaake dar e zindan par
roz mai dekhti hoo ye manzar
laut ke jaaye parinde jab ghar
dil mera rota hai bas ye keh kar
jaane kab mai jaaungi ghar
kab rehaai ki khabar aati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo shaam e ghariban baba
bhool sakti hi nahi ye dukhiya
aag qaimon mein lagi jab baba
jal gaya aag se daaman mera
keh rahi thi mai ye khud se
tu yateemi ki saza paati hai
mere baba mai karun...

neel dekho mere rukhsaron ke
ye tamachon ke nishan hai gehre
mai jo roti hoo tumhare gham mein
maarta hai mujhe zaalim aa ke
jism qaidi rooh qaidi
ye aseeri mujhe tadpaati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan de dungi yahin ro ro kar
maut jeene se yahan hai behtar
aap talqeen padhana meri
ek ehsaan ye karna mujh par
chain se mai mar sakungi
ek yehi aas nazar aati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn jo mazhar o mesum ne padhe
thay yehi bali sakina ne kahe
saath gar aap hamare hote
hai yaqeen thaam ke dil ro dete
kya jahan mein koi ummat
yun yateemon pe sitam dhaati hai
mere baba mai karun...

items.title: Mujhe baba ka sar
items.body:
bhaiya sajjad
ye meri aakhri shab hai sakina ne kaha bhaiya
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
<<DIVIDER>>
sakhi ke laal ho ye aakhri khwahish na radh karna
tumhare ghar ka shewa ghareebon ki madad karna
sawali hai jale daaman ko phailaye huwe dukhiya
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
padar ke baad beti ka tamachon par guzara hai
bataungi unhe shimr e layeen ne kaise maara hai
zara nazdeek se aa kar wo mera dekhle chehra
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajab haalat may dekha tha sar e darbar baba ko
nahi pani mayassar qaid khane may sakina ko
mai apne aansuon se dho'ungi mazloom ka chehra
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai royi jab padar ko shimr ne badla liya tum se
qasam hai mujhko baba ki mera waada raha tum se
sakina na ab na royegi na ab khaoge tum durra
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zuban hai khushk itni baat karna mujhpe bhari hai
tumhe maloom hai bhai sakina kab se pyasi hai
magar karti nahi dukhiya taqaza tum se pani ka
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...

padar ka dekh kar chehra sada bedaar hoti thi

items.title: Al madad maula raza
items.body:
al madad maula raza
nana nabi dada ali
dadi teri khairunnisa
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hai maseeha e jahan
shaahe khurasan hai laqab
yun har farishta rauze par
aata hai tere ba-adab
haa radh nahi hoti tere
rauze pe koi bhi dua
nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
<<DIVIDER>>
beenayi bhi deta hai tu
goyaai bhi deta hai tu

nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zaamine aahu bhi tu
gul bhi hai tu khushboo bhi tu

girte huwe aansu bhi tu
teri ataayein dekh kar
dushman ko bhi kehna padha
nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri karamaate nazar
shab ho ke ho waqte sahar
lehta hai har zaayir tera
rauze ki jaali choom kar
mashad muqaddas ho gaya
tune jo aa kar di azan
nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere hi dastar khaan par
hota hai jannat ka gumaan
jinn o malak lete hai sab
tere hi dar se rotiyan
maula tera makrooz hai
har ek gada o baadshah
nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
<<DIVIDER>>
rauze se tere door hai
hum to bahot majboor hai
aankhon se aansu hai rawan
dil bhi ghamon se choor hai
tujhse kahenge haal e dil
izne ziyarat kar ataa
nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle aza ke haal par
dukhta to hoga dil tera
ishq e ghame shabbir mein
maare gaye jo bekhata
hai monis o yawar tu hi
ibne shaheede karbala
nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan mujhko hai yaqeen
maula raza ki zaat se
ye naukri shabbir ki
jayegi ab na haath se
nauhe likhunga mai sada
dete rahenge wo sila
nana nabi dada ali...
al madad maula raza...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Alwida hussain
items.body:
qaid ho kar jo suye shaam chali binte ali
pahunch kar laash e baradar pe buka karne lagi
tu mere baalon pe khaak daal de
mai tere laashe pe khaak daal doo
tu mujhe rida de de mai tujhe kafan de doo
alwida hussain alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein tujhko layeeno ne kafan bhi na diya
cheen li sar se mere haye sitamgar ne rida
na raha koi madadgaar sar e dasht e bala
tu raha bekafan mai aseer e mahan
mai hui berida tu ghareeb ul watan
tu mere baalon pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera laasha hua pamaal sar e karbobala
haye tukde hua zainab ka jigar wawaila
aayi be-saakhta bhai mere honton pe sada
ye sitam kya hua mera ghar lut gaya
koi yawar nahi kya karun mai bhala
tu mere baalon pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere mazloom baradar mai tujhe deti kafan
haye pardes mein majboor hui teri behan
yaad aata hai mere bhai mujhe mera watan
dard se choor hoo gham se ranjoor hoo
imtehan hai mera haye majboor hoo
tu mere baalon pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo mere dil pe guzarti hai bayan kaise karun
jo lage zakhm jigar par wo ayan kaise karun
mai bhala sabr mere tashna dahan kaise karun
khaak udaungi mai gham uthaungi mai
kis tarha berida shaam jaungi mai
tu mere baalon pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye tera jism nahi khoon mein tar hai quran
nok e naiza se chini chadar e tatheer yahan
beridayi ka hai ehsaas mere dil pe garan
mai karungi ada jo mera farz hai
mere bhai magar ye meri arz hai
tu mere baalon pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
binte zehra pe qayamat ki ghadi hai bhai
bekafan ran mein teri laash padi hai bhai
aur behan dasht mein be-aas khadi hai bhai
mai jigar thaam kar reh gayi khaak par
apni hamsheer par ek ehsaan kar
tu mere baalon pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e ruqsat ye layeen hum pe sitam dhayenge
bar sar e nok e sina tera ye sar layenge
berida mujhko bhi bazaar mein le jayenge
tera dil royega zakhm wo paungi
suye bazaar mai berida jaungi
tu mere baalon pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya qayamat ka wo manzar tha nadeem o safdar
laasha e shaah tadapta tha ye naale sun kar
aur sar peet ke kehti rahi binte hyder
alwida khastatan alwida bekafan
alwida bewatan alwida pur mahan
tu mere baalon pe...
items.author: Nadeem

items.title: Ashoor ki garmi hai
items.body:
emaan ke ujaale hai ashoor ki garmi hai
shabbir ki qismat hai aur godh ke paale hai
imaan ke ujaale hai ashoor ki garmi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan dil taho baala hai wahan jaan ke laale hai
shabbir zayeefi mein akbar ko sambhale hai
ashoor ki garmi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha koi chaahe ghar lootle pyason ka
jalti hui reti par sab chaahne waale hai
ashoor ki garmi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ko koi dekhe darbar mein koofe ke
bedi ko uthaye hai zanjeer sambhale hai
ashoor ki garmi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
suljhaya tha laila ne uljhi hui zulfon ko
phir maut ne ay akbar bal gaysuon waale hai
ashoor ki garmi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to ali asghar aaghosh mein baba ki
kya kaampte haaton se ummat ko sambhale hai
ashoor ki garmi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-faiz zamane se kya usko gharaz koi
ab fazl ki dunya ke shabbir ujaale hai
ashoor ki garmi hai...
items.author: Fazl Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay sakina mai
items.body:
zindan mein sajjad buka karte thay ro kar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sakina mai teri laash uthaun kaise
in layeeno se kafan tujhko dilaun kaise
<<DIVIDER>>
teri mazloomi mujhe khoon rulaati hai behan
ban gaya khoon bhara kurta ghareebi mein kafan
hai bandhe haath teri qabr banaun kaise
ay sakina mai teri...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz karti thi buka aao madad ko baba
sun ke faryaad teri koi nahi aata tha
kyun nahi aaya koi tujhko bataun kaise
ay sakina mai teri...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ghareebi mein tujhe haye qaza aayi hai
jakda zanjeeron mein is waqt tera bhai hai
aakhri baar kaleje se lagaun kaise
ay sakina mai teri...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi kaano se tere khoon hai abhi tak jaari
amma bano pe isi gham mein ghashi hai taari
maa ki nazron se tera laasha chupaun kaise
ay sakina mai teri...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq gardan mein meri tere galay mein thi rasan
mai chala kaanto pe aur tu chali panjo pe behan
ay behan mai tere zakhmon ko bhulaun kaise
ay sakina mai teri...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu jo roti thi to dil mera tadap jaata tha
rehm tujh par na koi ahle sitam khaata tha
in ghamon ko mai kaleje se mitaun kaise
ay sakina mai teri...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke haathon pe tha laasha behan ka mazhar
bain karte thay haram dekh ke gham ka manzar
nauha sajjad ka safdar mai sunaun kaise
ay sakina mai teri...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Baba ay mere baba
items.body:
baba ay mere baba aao dhal gaya suraj
har taraf hai sannata aao dhal gaya suraj
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf apne seene par shab guzaar lene do
subha phir chale jaana aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono haat phailaye mai tumhe bulaati hoon
ab nahi raha jaata aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
neend se bhari aakhein tumko yaad karti hai
so'un kis tarha tanha aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam tak sabhi apne ghar ko laut aate hai
raat hogayi baba aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushmano ki basti mein khaufnak sehra mein
be-rida hoon be-saaya aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr mere kaano se cheen le gaya gauhar
zulm ho gaya kya kya aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas tumhare jaate hi ghar jale chini chadar
hum se phir gayi dunya aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya tumhe gawara hai mai yateem kehlaun
tum to ho mere baba aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi suroor aksar rauza e sakina par
goonjta hai ye nauha aao dhal gaya suraj
baba ay mere baba...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Barchi akbar ke
items.body:
haye baba hai dard bada
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri waqt hai dil apna sambhalo baba
barchi akbar ke kaleje se nikalo baba
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi uljhi hai kaleje mein ye barchi baba
saath barchi ke kaleja bhi nikal aayega
waqt mushkil hai bada khud ko sambhalo baba
barchi akbar ke kaleje se nikalo baba
aakhri waqt hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
waar zaalim ka tha aisa mai sambhal na paaya
us ne seene mein hi barchi ki ani ko toda
mujhko is dard ki mushkil se nikalo baba
barchi akbar ke kaleje se nikalo baba
aakhri waqt hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to kuch dayr mein jaan meri nikal jayegi
phir kabhi behna meri mujhse na mil payegi
ho sake to meri sughra ko bulalo baba
barchi akbar ke kaleje se nikalo baba
aakhri waqt hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaan laash meri qaimon mein jab jayegi
maa to ye haal mera dekh ke mar jayegi
zakhm seene ka kisi tarha chupalo baba
barchi akbar ke kaleje se nikalo baba
aakhri waqt hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk rukhsar pe raasha hai tere haathon mein
ye bhi mushkil hai ke beenayi nahi aankhon mein
tum madad ke liye dada ko bulalo baba
barchi akbar ke kaleje se nikalo baba
aakhri waqt hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabt farhan qayamat hai likhe kya mazhar
aakhri baat yehi keh ke sidhare akbar
ya ali keh ke mera laasha uthalo baba
barchi akbar ke kaleje se nikalo baba
aakhri waqt hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Bhaiya mere bhaiya
items.body:
bhaiya mere bhaiya, bhaiya mere bhaiya
mai doongi kafan aap ko dafna'ungi laasha
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aazad hui qaid se lo mil gayi chadar
ay bhai utho qaid se mai aagayi lutkar
mai ashkon se baandh'ungi tere laal ka sehra
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek roz mai is tarha teri laash se guzri
jis tarha ke tujhse mera rishta nahi koi
par ab to zara uthke kaleje se lipatja
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhai bahot royi hoo furqat mein tumhari
rone ke siwa karti bhi kya dard ki maari
hotay thay sitam leti thi jab naam tumhara
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas utho dekho behan milne ko aayi
kya baat hai uth'te nahi deti hoo duhaai
hamsheer se moo aapne kis baat pe phera
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaaro se darbaro se zindano se aayi
be-parda phirayi gayi aur maut na aayi
balon se chipati rahi baazaro mein chehra
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein sakina ko ajal aagayi bhai
us ghor andhere mein lehad uski banayi
bachi ka kafan bangaya us bachi ka kurta
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ko jakda gaya zanjeere sitam mein
ek ek qadam marti rahi hoo tere gham mein
pardes mein kismat ne nabi zadi ko loota
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha watan ja'un tumhe chor ke ban mein
tanha to nahi ja'ungi ay bhai watan mein
batla'ungi kya jab poochegi jab fatema sughra
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis kis ko nishan rassi ke dikhla'ungi mai jaa kar
na qasim o akbar hai na abbas e dilawar
bin aap ke ghar qabr se to kam nahi hoga
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehan fughan zainab e dilgeer ki sun kar
goya hua hamsheer se yun laasha e sarwar
milta hai sukoon mujhko behan yuhin kahe ja
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Hame raas na aayi
items.body:
ashoor ko maqtal mein thi sada
hamein raas na aayi karbobala
kehti thi bilak kar ek dukhiya
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko maqtal mein thi sada
hamein raas na aayi karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
ay paalne waale mujhko bata
zaanu pe sar hai bete ka
jise pees ke chakki paala tha
jibreel ne jhoola jhulaya tha
ab shimr ka khanjar sookha gala
lete thay rasool allah bosa
hamein raas na aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis shaan se kunba aaya tha
mera sher sameinta laaya tha
baazu jo kate mashkeeza chida
sota hai taraayi pe tanha
jo bhai ko kehta tha aaqa
dunya na dekhi aisi wafa
hamein raas na aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi khaa kar akbar ne kaha
jab teer lag asghar ne kaha
jab gurz laga ghazi ne kaha
taqseeem huwe qasim ne kaha
ek baat rulaati hai aaqa
maa behne hongi beparda
hamein raas na aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghere huwe fauj e baatil hai
baba seene par qatil hai
ye zulm ki kaunsi manzil hai
ek maa pe kitni mushkil hai
ye beta aap hi ka dil hai
jise dekh ke rota saahil hai
hamein raas na aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye arsh e bari se aayi sada
ay mere pyase laut ke aa
raazi hai tujhse tera khuda
waada jo kiya tha poora hua
phir shimr ke khanjar ne ye kaha
mai haara jeeta sabr tera
hamein raas na aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bibi mohsin ki hai dua
zinda rahe matamdaar sada
aur hota rahe nauha tera
nazron mein rahe bas karboabala
bachpan se hamein ye dars mila
bakshish ke liye hai ashk e aza
ab dedo hussain ka kuch sadqa
hamein raas na aayi...

items.title: Haye mere bemaar
items.body:
haye mera bemaar imam
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e qatle shaahe anaam
haye re ghurbat ki wo shaam
ghash mein pada hai tashnakaam
hojaye gham se na tamaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
durre hai tazeerein hai
paon mein zanjeerein hai
haath mein taqdeerein hai
chalna hai mushkil do gaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm lahoo barsaata hai
dil hai ke chalka aata hai
durre khaata jaata hai
lamha lamha gaam ba gaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
bughz o hasad se keeno se
lau dete huwe seeno se
kalma go be-deeno se
chalta hua bazaare shaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
maa'on behno ke chehre
baalon ke peeche hai chupe
haath bandhe hai sar hai khule
saamne hai ek majmeine aam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
majma saara hasta hai
dil ka zehr ugalta hai
khoon ke aansu rota hai
sar ko jhukaye tashnakaam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
kalmagoyo ka majma
aur payambar ka kunba
haif hai sar nange hai khada
aaj sar e darbare shaam
haye mera bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer sa dil pe lagta hai
ek rasan mein basta hai
shimr e sitamgar hasta hai
le le kar ek ek ka naam
haye mera bemaar…
<<DIVIDER>>
umme rabab ye laila hai
ye kulsoom ye kubra hai
ye masoom sakina hai
aur hai zainab iska naam
haye mera bemaar…

items.title: Hussain girta hai
items.body:
hussain girta hai ghode se aaiye amma
lage na zakhm khudara bachaiye amma
<<DIVIDER>>
sadyein deta hai ro ro ke aap ko sarwar
mujhe galay se laga lijiye khareeb aa kar
khudara naaz mere phir uthaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye imtehan bhi shabbir dene jaate hai
zameen e garm pe zakhmon ke saath aate hai
sulagti rayt hai daaman bichaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua kare ke na mujh sa koi ghareeb howe
kahin se khatra agar aab ka naseeb howe
hamari tashna labi ko bujhaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zauf kehta hai utha na jayega sarwar
karoo mai aap ki tazeem maadar e muztar
sahara de ke mujhe bas uthaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sukoon mujhko milega yaqeen hai mujhko
jo zakhm hai wo silega yaqeen hai mujhko
jo ho sake to galay se lagaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aap maa meri mai aap ka ghareeb hussain
qaza se hogaya is waqt to khareeb hussain
qaza ka waqt hai himmat bandhaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mangaya tha kabhi kapda bahisht se mera
phir ek baar ye zehmat gawara ho lilaah
jina se mera kafan ab mangaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi thi dayam o yazdan ghareeb ki hasrat
na dekh paye behan mere zakhm ki kasrat
rida se zakhm hamara chupaiye amma
hussain girta hai...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Jawan ali akbar
items.body:
raahat e jaan wird e zaban
saa'at e azan jaan ali akbaram
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ali akbar naujawan ali akbar
ay gul e laila ali jaan ali akbaram
jawan ali akbar naujawan ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dil o jaan e pidar shakle payambar akbar
ay qaraar e dil e zainab gul e maadar akbar
misle abbas e jari shere dilawar akbar
yusuf e fatema zahra dil e hyder akbar
husn e zaman akbar ay naaz e chaman akbar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula shabir ne maanga hai duaon mein tumhe
ghazi abbas ne rakha hai panaaho mein tumhe
mil ke do maaon ne paala hai ridaon mein tumhe
rabb e akbar ne rakha noori hijabon mein tumhe
naaz e dil e sarwar ay shabih e paighambar
<<DIVIDER>>
boli laila ke galay mujhko lagate jao
boli zainab mujhe surat to dikhate jao
bole shabbir meri aas bandhate jao
mujhko nana ki ziyarat to karate jao
haye lahoo mein tar humsurat e paighambar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise maqtal tumhe jaane ki ijazat de doo
kaise qaime se nikalne ki ijazat de doo
kaise is pyaas mein ladne ki ijazat de doo
maa hoo kaise tumhe marne ki ijazat de doo
ay jaan e dil e maadar ye maa ho fida tum par
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake seene pe sina zeen se akbar jo gira
ho gaya qaimon mein kohraam bapa wawaila
ye sada dasht mein deta tha ghareeb e zahra
haye akbar mera akbar mera akbar na raha
noor e nazar akbar ay naaz e pidar akbar
ay gul e laila...
jawan ali akbar...
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Kaun hai jo imdad
items.body:
kaun hai jo imdad ko aaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash meni pade sajjad e muztar
jalte hai qaime chinti hai chadar
kaun bhala ab aake bachaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb ki raahat aankhon ke taare
aun o mohamed ran ko sidhare
bekas ki dunya lut gayi haye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
charon taraf aghiyar ki mehfil
sakht ghadi dushwar hai manzil
des paraya log paraye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere asghar hasliyon waale
kaise phupi ab dil ko sambhale
dhal gayi shaam aur tum bhi na aaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainabe muztar shaam e ghariban
khaak pe baithi baal pareshan
gham ki hai dhoop aur dard ke saaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek rasan mein baara galay hai
chote bade sab qaidi bane hai
kaun inhe aafat se chudaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aake watan se door safar mein
sab kuch luta hai ek dopahar mein
dushman pe bhi ye waqt na aaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise ho ab parde ki hifazat
jiske bharose li thi zamanat
nehr pe usne shaane kataye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed qasim e muztar
soye huwe hai abbas o akbar
ab to hame jo chaahe sataye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ho mayassar mausam aza ka
dard mein dooba zainab ka nauha
likhe bilal aur aamir sunaye
saani e zahra kisko bulaye
kaun hai jo imdad...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Lahoo lahoo
items.body:
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ki beti ke dil ke tukde hai jaa ba jaa
khaak o khoon mein lathde
hai barchiyon mein koi kaleja
churi ke neeche koi gala hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap utha alqama ka pani
guzar gaya fatema ka jaani
baras raha hai lahoo falak se
zameene maqtal ko zalzala hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na paas ammu hai aur na baba
kise ab awaaz de sakina
koi layeen cheenta hai baali
koi rida le ke jaa raha hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb hai bekasi ka manzar
na koi monis na koi yawar
jo laash bhai ki bekafan hai
to sar behan ka bhi berida hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun bachi hai mehwe zaari
hai jiske kaano se khoon jaari
kahan ho ammu madad ko aao
layeen tamache laga raha hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhuan dhuan hai qayaam saare
ali ki beti kise pukaare
kahin pe bistar jhulas raha hai
kahin pe jhoola sulag raha hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere khuda kaun kis ko roye
hai sab ke sab apni jaan khoye
kisi ke baazu kate huwe hai
kisi ka baazu bandha hua hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda e ghairat kathin hai saa'at
nawaz zainab ke dil ko quwwat
dayaar e karbobala se aage
abhi to kufe ka saamna hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
azan e gham de raha hai aamir
karam hai kadiyal jawan ka nayyar
kalaam mera likh raha hai nauha
bureeda shaano ki ye ata hai
lahoo lahoo dashte karbala hai...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Mai husain ka ghulam
items.body:
labbaik labbaik labbaika ya hussain
maula hussain hussain ya maula
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mera rasta aur meri manzil syed badshah
hai sar pe alam ka saaya mera kaam nahi darna warna
saat samandar paar rahun ya apne des ke logon mein
gali gali aur nagar nagar gaon gaon har shehar shehar
har majlis mein har mimbar par elaan karunga subho shaam
ya zahra ya maula
ana majnoon al hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
chaahe zamana bole mujhko deewana
saare jahan mein ya hussain leke tera naam
mai to kahunga sare aam mai hussain ka ghulam
maula hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa azeem tu ne karbala mein kaam kiya
sab kuch khuda ne ya hussain tere naam kiya
tu hi to hai wo badshaah ya hussain
jisko dunya ke saare baadshahon ne salaam kiya
jiska baba ho ali aur maa ho fatema
sab ko naseeb kahan hota hai aisa imam
mai to kahunga sare aam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaisa hussain tu hai badshaah masha allah
tujhko mile hai sab ghulam bhi subhan allah
mai aaj hurr ko alaihis salaam kyun na kahun
jis ne ashoor ki shab tere liye ya saarallah
maal o daulat ko choda haathon ko joda aur bola
ya hussain aap pe mera salaam
mai to kahunga sare aam...
<<DIVIDER>>
saara zamana hai gawah ya hussain maula
tu ne bachaya la ilaaha ya hussain maula
hussaino minni wa ana minal hussain yani tu
ban gaya nabiyon ka shaah ya hussain maula
dil waalon ka hai naara hussain hamara
tere ghulam hi to bante hai aali maqam
mai to kahunga sare aam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ana majnoon al hussain
ana majnoon al hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ya sayyidi ya murshadi hussain yabnaz zahra
jo hai ghulam tera us pe ho salaam mera
bhoola nahi hoon mai wo kufe ka darbar jahan
aakar jalal mein muslim bine aqeel bola
ibne marjana sunle rokega kaise
tu kya hai aaj chaahe aa jaaye faqeer e shaam
mai to kahunga sare aam...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula abbas tum se fatema zehra hai raazi
tum ne wafaon ke maidan mein jeeti hai baazi
tum bhi to ho ali ke bete jab zaalim ne poocha
kyun ban ke rehte ho hussain ke ghulam ghazi
ghaiz mein aa kar wallah sher ye bola
ho ja khamosh de apni zaban ko lagaam
mai to kahunga sare aam...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota rahega ya hussain ye aelaan e aza
chalta rahega na rukega karwan e aza
pabandiyan ho chahe jitni bhi in majlison par
nauhe sunayenge zeeshan aur irfan e aza
majlis bhi hogi maula matam bhi hoga
ishqe hussain mein taqayya hota hai haraam
mai to kahunga sare aam...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain imame manasto
manam ghulame hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mera syed tu meri jaan bhi tu
mera deen bhi tu emaan bhi tu
mere maula teri qasam karam mein
sab se aali shaan bhi tu
ye izzat bhi tera sadqa hai
ye shohrat bhi tera sadqa hai
jo kuch bhi mere paas hai maula
sab kuch tera sadqa hai
karta hoon mai ye waada ya abaabdillah
tera zakir hoon jab bhi saamne hogi awaam
mai to kahunga sare aam
mai hussain ka ghulam
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Mujhe jaana hoga
items.body:
haye mazlooma fatema zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke kehti thi ye zehra mujhe jaana hoga
kya sitam hogaye baba ko batana hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm pehlu pe hai maujood na dekhe hyder
mujhko maloom hai mar jayenge wo ghut ghut kar
zakhm ye unko kisi taur chupana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas yehi soch ke dil doob raha hai mera
kaisa maahol tha darbar ka dekha na gaya
meri zainab ko to bazaar bhi jaana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko darbar mein jhutlaya mera dar bhi jala
mera mohsin na raha koi sahara na raha
mere bete mere mehdi tumhe aana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan toot gayi hai mai nahi uth paati
saans lene mein bhi hoti hai mujhe dushwari
ay khuda paas tujhe apne bulana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte darwaze ko dekha hai hassan ne mujh par
is liye rota hai tanhaai mein mera ye pisar
usko le aao galay apne lagana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine bas itna kaha chod do shauhar ko mere
ye khabar thi nahi badle mein tarafdari ke
taaziyana mujhe baazu pe bhi khaana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro padi fatema zainab se suni jab ye fughan
karbala jaaungi kaise mai akeli amma
har jagah saath tumhe mere nibhana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas yehi soch ke faazil ki hai aankhein pur nam
kaise rote thay sabhi bacche suna ye jis dam
alwida ay mere bacchon mujhe jaana hoga
ro ke kehti thi ye...
items.author: Faazil

items.title: Nazb darya par
items.body:
nazb darya par shahe bekas ka qaima ho chuka
manzilein aafat pa pardesi ka dera ho chuka
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj apni waada gah sadiq ul wbaad aa gaye
ab jo hona hai wo hoga tha jo hona ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr ki thandi hawa aati hai jab bemaar ko
kehte hai sajjad ay baba mai acha ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri ghar ke liye lete hai hazrat kuch rabeeb
karbala mein hashr tak maloom rehna ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
naizo o shamsheer o khanjar jama laakhon ho chuke
dawat e mehman ka sab saaman muhayya ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu e abbas ke lete hai bosay baar baar
shaah par kya jaaniye kya raaz afshan ho chuka
nazb darya par...

items.title: Aale rasool par
items.body:
kufe ki shahzadiyan shaam ke bazaar may
zainab o kulsoom hai majma e mehkhaar may
jis tarha aale nabi be-rida ho kar gayi
is tarha koi na ho be-rida darbar may
<<DIVIDER>>
har jaanib hai khaas o aam
zainab aur bazaar e shaam
be maqna be chadaar haye
fatema zahra ke gulbaar
nauha tha abid ke lab par
haye haye zainab haye haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
aale rasool par ye kaisa maqaam aaya
chadar nahi hai sar par baazar e shaam aaya
aale rasool par ye kaisa maqaam aaya
haye haye zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghairat se sar jukaye saydaniyon ko le kar
tauq e garan may jakda chautha imam aaya
chadar nahi hai sar par baazar e shaam aaya
aale rasool par ye...
haye haye zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab bibiyon ke peeche ghairat se chup rahi thi
darbar e shaam may jab zainab ka naam aaya
chadar nahi hai sar par baazar e shaam aaya
aale rasool par ye...
haye haye zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa behne sar khule hai aur sar jukaye abid
ek imtehan dene baazar e shaam aaya
chadar nahi hai sar par baazar e shaam aaya
aale rasool par ye...
haye haye zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar e ashqiyan may ashk e aza bahata
durron pe durre khaata mera imam aaya
chadar nahi hai sar par baazar e shaam aaya
aale rasool par ye...
haye haye zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aayi wo sakina jo qaid hai musalsal
jab saamne hamare zindan e shaam aaya
chadar nahi hai sar par baazar e shaam aaya
aale rasool par ye...
haye haye zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaisar ka nauha kehna aur shadman ka padna
bakshish ke sa'aton may dono ke kaam aaya
chadar nahi hai sar par baazar e shaam aaya
aale rasool par ye...
haye haye zainab...
items.author: Qaisar Jafri

items.title: Achay mere baba
items.body:
achay mere baba
hazrat se sakina ne kaha bhool na jaana
achay mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khuld may pahuncho to sakina ko bulana
achay mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mere pyare mere aashiq mere shayda
is waqt phuphi se batlaiye kyon maanga hai
malboos purana
achay mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaan gayi jaate ho sar apna katane
darya ke kanare
pani ka to laane ka faqad hai ye bahana
achay mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jaate ho marne ko hamay kis pa hai sompa
ye ghaur ki hai ja
sajjad to bemaar hai batlao thikana
achay mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
durr kano se cheenega to faryad karoongi
mai shimre layeen ki
beti ko sitamgar ke tamachon se bachana
achay mere baba

items.title: Ashoor ko jalte qaimon
items.body:
ashoor ko jalte qaimon may
kya janiye kya kya choot gaya
ghabra ke nikal aayi bano
baysheer ka jhoola choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
<<DIVIDER>>
noor aankhon ka akbar le ke gaye
nazron may andhera choot gaya
yun laash uthayi maula ne
barchi may kaleja choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya ke kanare mehmani
aur band hai kismat se pani
ay bahti maujon dekh to lo
baysheer bhi pyasa choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte…
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ki nazrein dekh to le
emaan zara pehchaan to le
ye kaun hai bibi kufe may
ye kiska parda choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil ke khareeb ghode se gire
abbas ko jalti khaak mili
shabbir ka daaman chut na saka
behta hua darya choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye paara paara laasha hai
shabbir ka jalti reti par
peshani e aalam jhukne ko
ya khaak pa kaaba choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke bache ki himmat
anjaam se nazrein takrayi
honton par hasi lehrane lagi
baysheer ka rona choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya le ke gaye kya le jaate
bano ko nishani de ke gaye
ek khaali jhoola choot gaya
ek nanha sa kurta choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye fazl hussaini shayar ka
shabbir se bad kar koi nahi
maula ka bharosa jab se kiya
dunya ka sahara choot gaya
ashoor ko jalte...
items.author: Fazl Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay saniye zehra
items.body:
hai shame ghariban ki ye awaaz
ay saniye zehra ay saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
soona hua ran cha gayi maqtal mein udasi
sairaab hui khoon se jo khaak thi pyasi
gulshan hua pamaal har ek phool hai baasi
qaime ki nigehban hai mohamad ki nawasi
din chup gaya raat aagayi sunsaan hai sehra
ay saniye zehra ay saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ke mehboob to jannat ko sidhare
jangal ki hawa sunti hai ab bain tumhare
madhosh huwe neend mein akaash ke taare
maare gaye abbas bhi darya ke kanare
ab unki jagah girde alam do tumhi pehra
ay saniye zehra ay saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom behan bhai ke laashe pe khadi hai
lab bandh rawan aankhon se ashkon ki jhadi hai
be-goro kafan laash biyaban mein padi hai
ek hashr ka maidan hai qayamat ki ghadi hai
jab bheeg gayi yaad to saraaab hua gehra
ay saniye zehra ay saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai se kaho aake sakina ko sulado
qasim ko pukaro ali akbar ko sada do
abbas zara aake rida sar par udha do
beton se kaho aun ke mehmil mein bitha do
kal suboh ko jaana hai tumhe chod ke sehra
ay saniye zehra ay saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal se sakina ko to le aayi hoo jaa kar
asghar ko bhi tum godh mein le aao utha kar
behlao kahani koi baqar ko suna kar
kyon laayi na tum khaak se akbar ko jaga kar
jangal bhi hai purhol andhera bhi hai gehra
ay saniye zehra ay saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi se basad arz yahi kehta hai akhtar
ay noore dil e fatema lakhte dil e hyder
ay kooshtae gham sayyade mazloom ki khaahar
mai misle qadab hoon mujhe kar dijiye gowhar
tareekhe abad mein mera parcham ho sunehra
ay saniye zehra ay saniye zehra
items.author: Akhtar

items.title: Baba badi takleef
items.body:
chain akbar ko kahan baba badi takleef hai
khaynch lo dil se sina baba badi takleef hai
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawan bete ki kuch takleef kam kar dijiye
zakhm pe nade ali padh padh ke dam kar dijiye
mustaqil hai khoon rawan baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt ye manzar na dikhlaye kisi bhi baap ko
mujhpe kya guzri hai batlaun mai kaise aap ko
ladkhadati hai zaban baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saans bhi lene nahi deta mujhe barchi ka phal
kijiye bas ye dua ab mujhko aa jaaye ajal
dil pe hai baare giran baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnagi mein zakhme dil ki taab laaun kis tarha
ye batao haath seene se hataun kis tarha
dard hota hai yahan baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab yaqeen hai mujhko mushkil hai bohat jeena mera
paar naiza hogaya hai tod kar seena mera
kyun na ragdun aediyan baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal maadar se ne kehna jaake mujh ghamgeen ka
poch lo aankhon se aansu waqt hai yaseen ka
aa rahi hai hichkiyan baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere qaatil ne mere seene mein barchi tod'di
ab to bas umeed bhi jeene ki maine chod'di
jism se khichti hai jaan baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
noor aankhon ka pisar ke hijr mein jaata raha
aamir o akhtar dile shabbir tharrata raha
sun ke akbar ka bayan baba badi takleef hai
chain akbar ko kahan...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Barchi ali akbar ke
items.body:
barchi ali akbar ke kaleje may lagi hai
dam tod'te farzand ko maa dekh rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay maut tehar ja mere akbar ko na leja
rasta ali akbar ka behan dekh rahi hai
dum todte farzand...
barchi ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
samjha hai tumhe aun-o-mohamed se zyada
athara baras paala hai aanchal may chupa ke
tumko to abhi baap ka ban'na tha sahara
tum sogaye maidan may phal barchi ka khaake
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha haaye mere naazon ke paale
barchi tere seene pe nahi mere lagi hai
dum todte farzand ko maa dekh rahi hai
barchi ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ne kaha jiska jawan laal ho aisa
us maa ki rida fauje shaqi cheen rahi hai
dum todte farzand ko maa dekh rahi hai
barchi ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa kehti din byaah ke jab aaye to beta
dunya se sawaari teri jannat ko chali hai
dum todte farzand ko maa dekh rahi hai
barchi ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne ke liye izne wigha maang rahe hai
din jeene ke hai phir bhi qaza maang rahe hai
do ghoont milay pani ye akbar ne sada di
shabbir se kis waqt ye kya maang rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan ka nowha hai ke ye bazm-e-aza may
akbar teri awaaz-e-azan goonj rahi hai
dum todte farzand ko maa dekh rahi hai
barchi ali akbar...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Bhaiya tum laut ke
items.body:
bhaiya tum laut ke ke kab khair se ghar aaoge
waada karte to ho kya is ko nibha paoge
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se pardes gaye aayi nahi des ki yaad
kya tumhe khat se bhi pahunchi nahi meri faryad
kitne din aur mujhe des mein tarsaoge
bhaiya tum laut ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek behan saath mein hai phir meri yaad aayegi kyun
tum ko kya gham hai alaalat mein jiyun ya ke marun
mai agar mar gayi tum bhi nahi jee paoge
bhaiya tum laut ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand hi roz ko zinda hai tumhari behna
kaisi naraazgi bemaar behan se bhaiya
kab naya eid ka joda mujhe dilwaoge
bhaiya tum laut ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine ro ro ke guzaare hai khushi ke mausam
yaad mein aankh hui bhai meri khoon se nam
dil ki takleef meri tum na samajh paoge
bhaiya tum laut ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
log diljoyi kiya karte hai bemaaron ki
haath rakhta nahi sar par mere bhaiya koi
ye na samjhi ke tum bhi mujhe rulwaoge
bhaiya tum laut ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaah ek khabar doshe hawa par aayi
khaa ke seene pe sina mar gaya sughra bhai
ab nahi kehna ke kab khair se ghar aaoge
bhaiya tum laut ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise tehreer ho rehaan o raza haye wo baat
tashnalab maare gaye karbobala mein sadaat
farshe majlis pe bayan kar ke tadap jaaoge
bhaiya tum laut ke...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Dar dhoond ke
items.body:
dar dhoond ke zindan ka ye kehti hai sakina
baba mujhe seene pe sulane chale aao
<<DIVIDER>>
is aalam e tanhaai mein mar jaaun na baba
marne se sakina ko bachane chale aao
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt teri yaad mein roti hai sakina
maghmoom teri aas mein hoti hai sakina
naraaz teri lakhte jigar tujhse hai baba
roothi hui beti ko manane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai chain ka ek saans bhi baba nahi leti
ye pyaas ki shiddat mujhe sone nahi deti
ab neend teri beti ko na aayegi baba
ek chain ki lori hi sunane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar mera bhaiya wo meri jaan kahan hai
cheh maah jo dunya mein tha mehman kahan hai
baba mujhe bhaiya ki judaai nahi bhooli
asghar ko sakina se milane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek daagh hai bhai ka kamar tod'di jis ne
ek daagh hai bete ka nazar cheenli jis ne
jo dil pe lage zakhm tumhe karbobala mein
baba wo sakina ko dikhane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bistar nahi sone ke liye farshe zameen hai
mai sheh ki yateema hoon mera qalb hazeen hai
zindan ka andhera hai muqaddar mera baba
tareeki e zindan ko mitane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aale mohamed ke gharane ka nagina
is waaste baba mujhe kehte thay sakina
zaalim ke tamachon ne sukoon cheena hai mera
kab aaoge baba ye batane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zulm kiye shimr ne chehre se ayaan hai
rukhsaar pe zaalim ke tamachon ke nishan hai
baba mere rone pe yahan pehre lage hai
in pehron ko ay baba hatane chale aao
dar dhoond ke...
items.author: Zulqarnain

items.title: Ghar fatema zehra
items.body:
ghar fatema zehra ka ajab shan ka ghar hai
ye wahi ki manzil hai ye quran ka ghar hai
islam ke maahol mein emaan ka ghar hai
momin ki munafiq ki ye pehchan ka ghar hai
kuch log mare jaate hai is ranjo mehan mein
is ghar ka jo darwaza hai masjid ke sehan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ne is ghar ko nabuwat se nawaza
dunya mein isay deen o shariyat se nawaza
qismat se imamat se wilayat se nawaza
har fard ko quran ki aayat se nawaza
saanche mein mashiyat ke ye afraad dhale hai
sab chadare tatheer ke saaye mein pale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye azm ke faulaad isi ghar mein milenge
ye noor ke ajsaad isi ghar ay milenge
jibreel ke ustaad isi ghar mein milenge
is satha ke afraad isi ghar mein milenge
maqlooq ki baat aakhri sarhad nazar aaya
jis fard ko dekha wo mohamed nazar aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ashaab mukarram hai magar apni jagah par
ghair apni jagah laqte jigar apni jagah par
khaar apni jagah ghunchaye tar apni jagah par
sang apni jagah laal-o-gohar apni jagah par
pehlu mein jo baitha ho usay dil nahi kehte
rehro kabhi rehbare manzil nahi kehte
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re izzo sharafe binte risalat
qandeele haram shamme shabistane imamat
rehmat jo mohamed hai to ye paraye rehmat
wo kulle nabuwat hai to ye juzze nabuwat
aasaan kaho maarifate khatme rasul ko
jo juz ko na samjha ho wo kya samjhega kul ko
items.author: Hasan Imdad

items.title: Haye mere bemaar
items.body:
ahle madina kehte thay ro kar
haye mere bemaar imam
<<DIVIDER>>
kar gaye rehlat jaanib e kausar
haye mere bemaar imam
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime jalaye chadarein cheena
aur zar o zewar loota
legaye aada aap ka bistar
haye mere bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hathkadi bedi tauq pinaaya
ahle jafa ne baad e hussain
baandhe kamar mein aap ke langar
haye mere bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote rahe chalees baras tak
baba ko apne roz wo shaam
chain ne aaya aap ko din bhar
haye mere bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
roti thi jab baali sakina
durre lagaata tha zaalim
sadme sahe sab aap ne dil par
haye mere bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaanton pa paidal aap gaye
az karbobala taa kufa o shaam
aabile paaon ke phoote hai ye keh kar
haye mere bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra lene ko pursa
aati hai majlis mein us jaa
pursa do farhat tum bhi ye keh kar
haye mere bemaar...
items.author: Farhat

items.title: Hussain godh may
items.body:
hussain godh may laashe pisar jo laate hai
wo baar hoo hai ke har gaam dagmagate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nikaalte hai pisar ke galay se teer e sitam
ye sheh karaamat e sabr o riza dikhate hai
hussain godh may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain chehra e aqdas tarz e noke charagh
lahoo se asghar e masoom ke jalate hai
hussain godh may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye tifle khaana e zehra hai ispe hairat kya
galay pe teer lagay phir bhi muskurate hai
hussain godh may...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagi hai qaime ke dar par rubab ki nazrein
ke sab sagheer ko le kar hussain aate hai
hussain godh may...
<<DIVIDER>>
chida hua hai gala phir bhi farte ulfat se
hussain laal ko apne galay lagate hai
hussain godh may...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagaye maa hai kaleje se laashe asghar ko
hussain rayt pe nanhi lehad banate hai
hussain godh may...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawab karz hai abid ye fauje aada par
ke cheh mahine ke bache bhi teer khaate hai
hussain godh may...
items.author: Abid Jafri

items.title: Jawan bete ko haaton
items.body:
bajuz hussain kisi se ye kaam ho na saka
jawan bete ko haaton se koi kho na saka
<<DIVIDER>>
bhara tha chillu may peene may dayr hi kya thi
wafa e hazrate abbas se ye ho na saka
jawan bete ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam umr mai rounga uski turbat par
ghareeb baap ki mayyat pe bhi jo ro na saka
jawan bete ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam raat tadapte hue kati meri
kahin hussain ka tha taskira mai so na saka
jawan bete ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
ilaahi zulm ki had hogayi mua'zallah
pisar ka khoon bhi chehre se baap dho na saka
jawan bete ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
uthunga qabr se rota hua khuda ki qasam
mere hussain mai jee bhar ke tujhko ro na saka
jawan bete ko…

items.title: Kaise guzare teen
items.body:
yasrab mein haye tooti hui phasliyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen mahine batool ne
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu shikasta choor hui haddiyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen mahine batool ne
<<DIVIDER>>
takleef de rahi thi har ek saans mein badi
wo keel jo batool ke pehlu mein thi gadi
har ek qadam larazti hui pindliyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
<<DIVIDER>>
larze sutoon-e-kaaba jo teora ke gir padi
aisa tamacha maara ke ghash kha ke gir padi
tapka zameen pe khoon bhi kuch baaliyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
<<DIVIDER>>
chehra chupaye rehti thi bacchon se fatema
is waaste ali se na kuch dard e dil kaha
rukh par nishane dast thay kuch ungliyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashke ghame batool mein daaman jo bhar sake
hai koi is jahan mein jo dark kar sake
ro ro ke ghar mein sehmi hui bachiyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dam tasavurat mein phaila raha dhuaan
uth'te huwe wo shole wo darbar al-amaan
jalti hui khayal mein un lakdiyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shole uthay aur aag lagi ghar bhi jal gaya
baade rasool saara madina badal gaya
baandha gaya ali ka gala rassiyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaadi thi jo layeen ne tehreer e mustafa
seene se apne haye lagaye rahi sada
baba ki un phati hui kuch parchiyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq fatema ka logon ne aamir nahi diya
sadma dil e batool pe ainee yehi raha
lipta ke apne bacchon ko tanhaiyon ke saath
kaise guzaare teen...
yasrab mein haye...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Kaun kaafir hai
items.body:
kaun kaafir hai kaun momin hai
waqt aane pe faisla hoga
baat khul jayegi qayamat mein
jab adalat ka saamna hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
zul asheera say hajj-e-aakhir tak
kis ko waaris kiya muhammad ne
kis ne tareekh ko badal daala
ye bhi taareekh mein likha hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
mas'ala baagh ka nahi hargiz
mas'ala iddeaye haq ka hai
kis ki takzeeb kaun karta hai
bas isi pe mubahila hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
badshahat ko sabse pehli baar
kis ne pehnayi deen ki poshak
kab khilafat mulukiat mein dhali
kam se kam ab to sochna hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
khair to khair shar bhi acha hai
kaun samjhay ye falsafa kya hai
ek hi saath haq-o-baatil se
kaise raazi bhala khuda hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jiski takhleeq ka sabab giriya
jiske vird e zaban ali maula
usko nabood kar sakega kaun
jiski ta'eed mein khuda hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb par jinke mohr lag jaye
phir inhe saeyban naseeb kahan
ibne zehra ke rone walon par
hashr tak saaya-e-kisa hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
majlise gham hai fatema bhi hai
matame shaah-e-karbala hoga
ay azadaar ashke gham tera
nazre rumaal-e-sayyeda hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sina khaynchne chale honge
akbar-e-naujawan ke seene se
aastine ulat ke sarwar ne
kis tarha ya ali kaha hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf mashk-o-alam liye shabbir
aaye honge furaat se jis dam
binte shaah e zaman ke haathon se
khaali kuza bhi gir gaya hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil larazta hai aankh roti hai
thar'tari si badan mein hoti hai
shaah ka haal kya hua hoga
teer asghar ko jab laga hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya saans rok kar shahid
tak rahe hai hussain ki surat
garm reti pe zer-e-khanjar ab
sajdaye aakhri ada hoga
kaun kaafir hai…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Kise nasir mile aise
items.body:
kise nasir milay aise shahe dilgeer se pehle
wafa ki laaj rakhli mar gaye shabbir se pehle
<<DIVIDER>>
badi sharmindagi unko hui maidan e khyber mein
alam lekar jo nikle shaahe khyber geer se pehle
kise nasir milay…
<<DIVIDER>>
sanad quran ki ahlebayt ke haq mein batati hai
ye taahir thay nuzoole aaya e tatheer se pehle
kise nasir milay....
<<DIVIDER>>
pata chalta hai ye anjaam e hur se dekhle dunya
dare jannat nahi milta dare shabbir se pehle
kise nasir milay…
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheede raahe haq akbar hue baysheer se pehle
kaleja sheh ka tha noke sina par teer se pehle
kise nasir milay…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha akbar se sheh ne mujko kyon majboor karte ho
raza marne ki maango zainab e dilgeer se pehle
kise nasir milay…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame sarwar diya haq ne tajammul shukr laazim hai
badi daulat ata ki khuld ki jageer se pehle
kise nasir milay…
items.author: Tajammul Lakhnavi

items.title: Lahoo mein doob
items.body:
lahoo mein doob gaya jab shabihe paighambar
zameen e karbobala par tha hashr ka manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain dhoond rahe thay jawan ke laashe ko
thi muntazir dar e qaima pe ghamzada maadar
lahoo mein doob gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
na koi dost na bhai na aasra tha koi
lahoo ke sher mein tanha tha fatema ka pisar
lahoo mein doob gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek baar ye mud mud ke dekhe thay hussain
nikal na aaye kahin ran mein zainab e muztar
lahoo mein doob gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukaarte thay andhera hai meri aankhon mein
mere jawan mere dilbar mere ali akbar
lahoo mein doob gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan talaash karun kuch nazar nahi aata
zameen e garm pe dekho bhatak rahi hai nazar
lahoo mein doob gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe idhar gir ke uth rahe thay hussain
kaleja thaam ke akbar tadap rahe thay udhar
lahoo mein doob gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada sune to sahara mile zaeefi ko
ajeeb waqt hai mushkil kusha ke bete par
lahoo mein doob gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
fareed sheh ki musibat bayan kya karte
nazar nazar thi qayamat qadam qadam mehshar
lahoo mein doob gaya...
items.author: Fareed Baig

items.title: Mai hussain hoon
items.body:
karta rahunga shukre khuda mai hussain hoon
khanjar ke neeche doonga dua mai hussain hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
mal lunga apne rukh pe lahoo apne laal ka
phir bhi na uff karunga zara mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
aedi ragadta hoga jahan mera naujawan
hoga wahin budhapa mera mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai baazuon mein mere kate baazuon ki laaj
dekhe zamana meri wafa mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
fidya diya tha tum ne to patti thi aankh par
dekho khaleel mujhko zara mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
roohe rasool nikli mere khushk halq se
qatil samajh raha hai mera mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde mein thay hussain to gardan pe thi churi
maula ne tab khuda se kaha mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab karbala ke dasht mein goonjegi siskiyan
zehra karengi mujhpe buka mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
tatheer be-rida hai to kaaba be-ghilaaf
laasha bhi be-kafan hai mera mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte rahenge aamir o nayyar meri azaa
dono pa hogi meri ataa mai hussain hoon
karta rahunga shukre...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Aale zehra ka
items.body:
aaram kahan hai aaram kahan hai
zainab o kulsoom ko aaram kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aale zehra ka hai nauha qatl hyder hogaye
khoon se tar hai musalla qatl hyder hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
sajda e khaaliq mein jab maula ne peshani rakhi
aur ali ke sar pe jis dam taygh zaalim ki chali
ro diya ye kheke sajda qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid e kufa ke dar pe aagaye hai sab yateem
keh rahe hai hum haqeeqat mein huwe hai ab yateem
hogaye hum be-sahara qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dek kar masjid mein surat khoon mein doobi baap ki
seena e sarwar se lag ke ro diye abbas bhi
bhai se bhai ne bola qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ki jaanib baap ko hasnain jab le kar badhe
peeche peeche chaahne waale bhi sab rote chale
tha har ek ke lab pe nauha qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab o kulsoom ke dil pe churi chal jayegi
kaan mein awaaz unke jis ghadi ye aayegi
ek farishta jab kahega qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
raaste mein ruk ke ye kehne laga maula mera
dekhti hai betiyan darwaze pe rasta mera
ab nahi kehna khudara qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke laashe pe ye shabbir ne ro kar kaha
jab gaye nana o amma aap ne pursa diya
kaun dega ab dilaasa qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ali yazdan thi kufe mein yateemi nauhagar
ro diye hasnain tashna us ghadi sar peet kar
marsiya abbas ka tha qatl hyder hogaye
aale zehra ka hai nauha...
items.author: Jaffer Tashna

items.title: Abbas e alamdar
items.body:
kis sher ki aamad hai ke ran kaamp raha hai
ran ek taraf charkhe kohan kaamp raha hai
rustum ka badan zere kafan kaamp raha hai
har qasre salateene zaman kaamp raha hai
shamsheer bakaf dekh ke haider ke pisar ko
jibreel larazte hai sameinte huwe par ko
abbas e alamdaar abbas e alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
is shaan se islam ke parcham ko uthaya
sar de diya aur deene mohammad ko bachaya
kya maqsade shabbir ye tune hai bataya
ay sheh ke wafadar ay abbase alamdaar
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sab se juda teri wafaon ka kharina
pani na piya tune taraayi ko to cheena
aankhon se juda kaise ho tasveere sakina
us se hai tujhko pyar ay abbase alamdaar
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ashq fishan aaj bhi gham mein tere pani
ye mashk sakina ki alam teri nishani
rota hai jahan sun ke tere gham ki kahani
ay fauj ke sardar ay abbase alamdaar
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ki duaon ka sila hai mere abbas
zahra ne tujhe beta kaha hai mere abaas
har daur mein har dil ki sada hai mere abbas
zainab ke madadgaar ay abbase alamdaar
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ko na pukarein to bhala kis ko pukarein
hai khushk bhatiji ka gala pyaas ke maare
roti hai sakina jo kabhi gham mein tumhare
haste thay sitamgaar ay abbase alamdaar
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke laashe pe ye kehte rahe sarwar
rukhsat huwe beenayi jo ruksat huwe akbar
todi hai kamar gham ne tere meri baradar
ay fauj ke sardaar ay abbase alamdaar
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai dua ahmad o mohsin yehi paiham
haathon pe uthaye huwe abbas ka parcham
jayenge ziyarat ko teri karbobala hum
hum tere hai ghamkhaar ay abbase alamdaar
abbas e alamdar...
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Ache mere baba
items.body:
zindan ke andhere mein ek bachi roti hai
wo bachi ro ro kar faryad ye karti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ache mere baba pyare mere ammu
<<DIVIDER>>
sunli jo meri faryad o fughan
aa jaaye dilaane mujhko amaan
is qaid mein jo hai haal mera
ho sakta nahi kuch uska bayan
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab laut ke hum ghar jayenge
zindan se rehaayi payenge
gar lene na aaye aap hamein
hum ghut ghut ke mar jayenge
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
lilaah karam kuch farmeine
lilaah yahan se le jaaye
ehsaan kare hum pe aa kar
surat to khudara dikhlaye
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis qaid mein humko rakha gaya
ehwaal bada wo tha uska
qaidi ke bhi rehne ke khaabil
wo qaid nahi hai ay baba
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek lamha sukoon milta hi nahi
zindan ka dar khulta hi nahi
kab din guzre kab raat hui
kuch iska pata chalta hi nahi
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
darr lagta hai is veerane mein
tauqeer na kije aane mein
kya zulm na hote hum par
is haam ke qaid khaane mein
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
taskeen dilaane aate nahi
kyun humko bachane aate nahi
bas itna batade kyun humko
azaad karane aate nahi
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye qaid e sitam ye qaid e bala
hum rehte hai jis mein wawaila
ye maskan e insan ho kaise
is mein hai basera zulmat ka
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun sunte nahi hai aah o fughan
faryad kare kis se be-jaan
pardes hai zaalim hai dunya
imdad karega kaun yahan
ache mere baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
har lamha bulaati thi dukhiya
har lamha ye padti thi nauha
ho dayam o yazdan kaise bayan
jis karb se wo deti thi sada
ache mere baba...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Alwida mai ja raha
items.body:
alwida khairul wara mai jaa raha hoo karbala
tujhse ab hone juda mai jaa raha hoo karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
martaba mera zamane ko dikhaya aap ne
meri khaatir ya nabi sajda badhaya aap ne
sehne ab jor o jafa mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat e zehra pe aa ke shaah e karbal ne kaha
chod kar ab qabr teri deen par hone fida
maa meri khairunnisa mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e ruqsat aap se hai bas yehi kehna mujhe
saaya ban kar fatema sughra pe rehna hai tujhe
mere bhaiya mujtaba mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se apne charagh e deen jalana hai mujhe
farsh ko arsh e moalla se milaana hai mujhe
farz ye karne ada mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
<<DIVIDER>>
wan zameer insano ki yehi banegi dars gaah
ye batayega jahan ko rayt par sajda mera
keh raha hoo barmala mai jaa raha hoo karbala
alwida khairul wara...
items.author: Zameer Hussain

items.title: Askari ki saamra may
items.body:
askari ki saamra may haye shahadat hogayi
aaj phir se fatema ke ghar qayamat hogayi
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may apne hi ghaltan hai ghareeb e saamra
surkh apne khoon may phir se imamat hogayi
askari ki saamra may...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr paa kar yun tadapte jaa rahe hai askari
mujtaba ki zehn may taaza musibat hogayi
askari ki saamra may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aur masoom ko maara hai zulm o jor se
yun shahadat is gharane ki riwayat hogayi
askari ki saamra may...
<<DIVIDER>>
chupke chupke ro rahe hai askari ke ghar may sab
rone pe pehra laga aisi shakhawat hogayi
askari ki saamra may...
<<DIVIDER>>
paanchwa hi saal tha mehdi ka jab zulm o sitam
is khadar badne laga har soo adawat hogayi
askari ki saamra may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehwe girya hyder e karraar bhi zehra bhi hai
ghamzada shehr e madina may risalat hogayi
askari ki saamra may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahe hai sab muhib sun kar musibat ka bayan
is tarha rizwan ki kaamil ibadat hogayi
askari ki saamra may...
items.author: Rizwan Rizvi

items.title: Ay sayyede sajjad
items.body:
hoti hai ayan dasht may ab shaam e ghariban
ay sayyed e sajjad ay sayyed e sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
ujde huwe is ghar ke ho ab tum hi nigehban
ay sayyed e sajjad ay sayyed e sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal may shah e deen ka bhara ghar hua barbaad
kis se kare faryaad
afsos ke sab mil gaye wo khaak may armaan
ay sayyed e sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay jis may ali asghar o qasim se sahare
wo aankhon ke taare
maqtal may hai bikhra hua zehara ka wo quran
ay sayyed e sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab zainab o kulsom ke sar par nahi chadar
ay haye muqaddar
bazaar may jayenge ye le kar sar e uryan
ay sayyed e sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal se guzar aaye magar zulm na tehra
hai zakhmon ka pehra
hai khaak saron par huwe hai chaak gareban
ay sayyed e sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab zabt ka yaara bhi kahin toot na jaye
hai dard ke saaye
darbar may ab jaana hai zainab hai pareshan
ay sayyed e sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom shah e deen ki nishani ko sambhalo
dukhiya ko bachalo
masoom sakina hui zakhmon se lab e jaan
ay sayyed e sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bhi zafar nasir o ghamkhwar nahi hai
hubdaar nahi hai
khaa jayegi masooma ko tareeki e zindan
ay sayyed e sajjad...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Baba dam ghutta hai
items.body:
veeran udaas ghar may sughra ki ye sada hai
tanhiyon may baba dum mera ghut raha hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rudaad apne gham ki ashkon se likh rahi hoo
tanha mai baithe baithe har dum ye sochti hoo
lene nahi tum aaye kya tumko hogaya hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ko dekhlun mai asghar ko dekhlun mai
choti bahan se mil loon akbar ko dekhlun mai
bemaar hoo mai baba meri yehi dawa hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali pade hai hujre soone pade hai bistar
dasta hai mujhko baba ujda hua mera ghar
kya aap ki nazar may meri yehi saza hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aajaye aap wapas ya phir mujhe bulaale
furqat may aapki hum ghut ghut ke mar na jaaye
wo shiddat e aalam hai dum lab pe aa gaya hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehli si rounaqe wo sab yaad aa rahi hai
bhai behan ki yaadein mujhko sata rahi hai
ek darde mustakhil hai ashkon ka silsila hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas may nahi hai mere ab intezaar karna
mere taraf se baba tum usko pyar karna
asghar ka muskurana nazron may phir raha hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
moula ye sher kab hai tukde hai ye jigar ke
yeh nauha teri beti sughra ko yaad karke
ahmed ne keh diya hai mohsin ne pad diya hai
baba dum ghut'ta hai...
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Bhaiya ye sitam
items.body:
zindane sitam mein kehti thi
abid se sakina ro ro kar
bhaiya ye sitam kab tak honge
<<DIVIDER>>
itna to bata do ay bhai
kya ab na mayassar hoga ghar
bhaiya ye sitam kab tak honge
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos ki aisi manzil par
taqdeer hamay le aayi hai
ek din mein luta hai saara ghar
ab charon taraf tanhaai hai
kya koi taras na khayega
pardes mein aale ahmad par
bhaiya ye sitam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kitna bahyanak zindan hai
dil mera bahot ghabrata hai
