mai kaampne lagti hoon us dam
jab shimre layeen aa jaata hai
saansein bhi meri ruk jaati hai
us zaalim ki ghudki sun kar
bhaiya ye sitam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt baseron ki jaanib
ud ud ke parinde jaate hai
us waqt mujhe apne ghar ke
deewar o dar yaad aate hai
mujhse to parinde acche hai
wo jab chaahe tab jaaye ghar
bhaiya ye sitam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai karbobala se qaid talak
jab royi ghut ghut kar royi
aur gyara moharram se aba tak
ek pal ke liye bhi na soyi
neend aayi thi ashoor ke din
bas baba jaan ke seene par
bhaiya ye sitam...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt mujhe mere bhai
is baat ka rehta hai sadma
cheh maah ka tha mera bhaiya
usko bhi layeeno ne maara
rone bhi nahi dete zaalim
mere shish maahe bhai par
bhaiya ye sitam...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagta hai ke ab is zindan mein
mai ghut ghut kar mar jaaungi
kismat mein nahi hai ghar jaana
sughra se bhi mil na paaungi
yaad aati hai mujhko ab har pal
bemaar meri pyari khwahar
bhaiya ye sitam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai char baras ki hoon lekin
har zulm o sitam mujh pe toota
jitna bhi layeeno ne chaaha
bin baap ki bacchi ko maara
kya chain sitamgar payenge
bhai mere mar jaane par
bhaiya ye sitam...
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt bahot roye abid
behna se lipat kar ay waiz
ye kehne lagi jab ro ro kar
shabbir ki dukhtar ay waiz
jab aap ko lagte hai durre
chalta hai mere dil par khanjar
bhaiya ye sitam...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Ek abbas tere jaane
items.body:
ek abbas tere jaane se
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke halq pe chala khanjar
mere sar se bhi chin gayi chadar
haye kya kya guzar gayi hum par
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
hausle dekhiye sitamgar ke
pass aane laga wo sarwar ke
has ke lehra raha tha wo khanjar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh mein aansu dil tadapta raha
jab chale shaah karbala tanha
cheh mahine ki jaan ko le kar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehmi sehmi hai bibiyan saari
khaak par zindagi hai pyason ki
jal gaye qaime jal gaya bistar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
thokare ran mein khaate dekha hai
laashe akbar pe jaate dekha hai
dhundli dhundli thi shaah e deen ki nazar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop thi pyaas thi rukay na kahin
do ghadi chain ke milay na kahin
aise jaari tha bekason ka safar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sard mausam phata hua kurta
bas khuda jaane gham sakina ka
zulm sehti rahi wo shaam o sehar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq o zanjeer zakhm be taabeer
kaise batlaun kya aziyat thi
phir bhi chalta raha mera dilbar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi bazaar e aam se guzri
kabhi zindan e shaam se guzri
mai aseer e mehan phiri dar dar
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahun dil pe mere kya guzri
bazm e haakim mein sun rahe thay sabhi
naam tha mera ghair ke lab par
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ki khwahar fida tadapti thi
ashk barsa ke wo ye kehti thi
kitne khanjar chale mere dil par
ek abbas tere jaane se
haye abbas haye abbas...
items.author: Mir Fida Ali

items.title: Hamsheer ko chadar
items.body:
hamsheer ko chadar hai na bhai ko kafan hai
shabbir sa bhai hai na zainab si behan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kis zulm se maara gaya zehra ka dulaara
sar naize par aur rayt pa majrooh badan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke liye aati rahi jannat se khabayein
laasha usi mazloom ka mohtaj e kafan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-dast hua nehr par abbas e dilawar
yun zainab e dilgeer ki haathon mein rasan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde hui maidan mein tasveer e payambar
paighambar e islam ka sad paara badan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab koi nahi naaz uthaane ko sakina
bas jor o jafa zulm o sitam ranj o mahan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhra hua maqtal mein hai ek raat ka dulha
bewa jo bani hai wohi ek shab ki dulhan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasa tha dam e qatl jo cheh maah ke sin mein
asghar sa zamane mein koi tashna dahan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maajaye ne sar de diya maajayi ne chadar
esaar mohamed ke gharane ka chalan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaano ka lahoo jis pe hai durron ke nashan hai
kurta wohi masoom sakina ka kafan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai dar o baam se rone ki sadayein
jaawed bada dard bhara tera sukhan hai
hamsheer ko chadar hai...
items.author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood

items.title: Haye mere maula
items.body:
sar peeto momino ke qayamat ki ghadi hai
aale ali pa dekho musibat ye badi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ali maula haye ali maula
qatl sajde mein ho gaye maula
khoon ugalti hai masjid e kufa
hae mere maula aa mere maula
hae mere aaqa aa mera aaqa
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid mein shor utha ali qatl ho gaye khaalik ke ghar mein rab ke wali qatl ho gaye
khaalik ke ghar mein rab ke wali qatl ho gaye
tar khoon mein musalla hua bu-turaab ka
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har zarra ro raha hai ali gham mein aap ke
kaaba bhi ghamzada hai ali gham mein aap ke
aansu baha rahe hai nabi aur ambiya
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa sitam kiya hai ye dekho shareer ne
talwaar has ke mari hai us be-zameer ne
do neem hogaya hai sare shaahe la fata
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain sar ko peet ke hote hai beqarar
abbas bhi tadapte hai rote hai zaar zaar
ab kaun hai yateemon ka dunya mein aasra
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ko is tareeqe se hasnain uthaye thay
jis tarha koi kaandhe pe mayyat ko laadle
mushkil kusha ke beton pa mushkil ki inteha
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye ali jo ghar mein to roti thi bibiyan
kulsoom sar ko peet ke leti thi hichkiyan
zainab giri hai khaak pe karti hui buka
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir ye nauha sunke bahot roye soghwaar
haathon ko apne jod ke ye bole soghwaar
arif ne pursa aap ka dil se ada kiya
qatl sajde mein...
khoon ugalti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peete fatema
khoon roye mustafa
shabbar ka tadapna
shabbir ka girya
ghazi ka machalna
kulsoom ghamzada
zainab ne ye kaha
sar dekh ke tera
haye haye mere baba
items.author: Nasir Hussain

items.title: Hussain haye hussain
items.body:
kahan se laaun bhara ghar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad to ab jab bhi shaam aati hai
saron ko dar se patakne ki kaam aati hai
baraste rehte hai aankhon se ta-sehar sab ki
lahoo bhare hue manzar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
palat ke aun o mohamed bhi ghar nahi aate
ab umme laila ko akbar nazar nahi aate
tadapti rehti hai qasim ki yaad mein farwa
rubab kehti hai asghar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzur gaye hai kayi din na sabr hai na kharaar
tumhe bulaati hai raaton ko neend mein kayi baar
kabhi kabhi yahan hum sab se chup ke kone mein
sakina roti hai aksar hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kate jo pani ki khaatir kareeb nehr e furaat
wohi to thay mere baazu wohi to thay mere haath
mila huwa hai dil o jaan mein zakhm ki soorat
hai jiska naam alam par hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
badan tha jism ali ka lahoo rasool ka tha
jigar hassan ka tha seene mein dil batool ka tha
wo jism chod ke aayi hoo tapte sehra mein
wo sar hai noke sina par hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hum pe toot gaya aasman e ranj o mehan
qayaam qaid mein hota hai aur safar mein rasan
aseeri bebasi o bekasi ke aalam mein
mera salaam ho tum par hussain haye hussain
pukari zainab e muztar...
items.author: Husnain

items.title: Jawan hokar jahan se
items.body:
jawan hokar jahan se tum sidhare ay ali akbar
jiye ab maa bata kiske sahare ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
badi umeedein wabasta thi tumse jab jawan hoge
phuphi ke maa'on behno ke sahare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
safeena doobta hai maa ka ab majdhaar may beta
lagaye kaun kashti ab kanare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
balaye chand se chehre ki loon ek baar to aaja
nazar ka maa teri sadqa utaare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shama roti rahi kadiyal jawan ki dekh kar surat
wo jab maa ne tere gaysu saware ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagaye aas baithi hai udhar sughra madine may
behan ko lene kab jaa'oge pyare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina khogayi hai ban may kehdo uske ammu se
ye dukhiya maa kahan jaa kar pukare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar....
<<DIVIDER>>
pidar se yun bhi koi root'ta hai maan bhi jao
zaeefi kis tarha tujh bin guzare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada anjum wo kya deta jigar tukhde badan chalni
na bolay moo se wo aur maa pukare ay ali akbar
jawan hokar jahan...
items.author: Anjum Zaidi

items.title: Kaise ho musalman
items.body:
kaise ho musalman charaghon ko bujhado
shehzadi e kaunain khule sar hai rida do
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hua qaimon se dhuan dekhne walon
islam ke ghar may hai lagi aag bujhado
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
is din ke liye paala tha kya binte nabi ne
shabbir ka sar kaat ke naize pe chadado
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghodon se tan e sibte nabi raundh rahe ho
dar par hai behan ran ki zara khaak uda do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shaam ka bazaar mohamed ki nawasi
uryan sar e islam hai chadar to udha do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa dekh na le sar ko kahin bar sare naiza
jis par sar e asghar hai zara door hata do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrake tamachon se ye kehti thi sakina
achi phupi amma mere ammu ko bula do
kaise ho musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke matam ki sada goonj rahi hai
utho meri awaaz se awaaz mila do
kaise ho musalman...

items.title: Kaun kehta hai ke
items.body:
kaun kehta hai ke darya ki rawani de do
zaalimo asghar e baysheer ko pani de do
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne ehtemaam ki hujjat ali asghar tum bhi
ab jo dena ho wo paigham zabani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummate jad ki hai bakshish ka sakina ye sawaal
tashnagi lelo ghame tashna dahani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak bhool na paye ye zamana jis ko
aaj tareekh ko ek aisi kahani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik e kausar o tasneem ali ke ho pisar
alqama cheez hai kya hyder e saani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
khusk reti pe safeena hai kate haathon se
kashti e deen e elaahi ko rawani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
baksh do deen ko hamshakle payambar ye shabab
aaj islam ko akbar ye jawani de do
kaun kehta hai ke...

items.title: Kisi ki mayyat tadap
items.body:
ye sham e ashoor ka hai manzar
hai karb main itrat e payambar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye koi mehve buka hai shayad
kisi ne ammu kaha hai shayad
bada hai shayad koi sitamgar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bholi bhali si ek bachi
najaf ki jaanib jo tak rahi thi
kisi ne cheene hai uske gohar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
atash se bache machal rahe hai
ye phool sholon may jal rahe hai
chaman may kumla gaye gule tar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hujoom e gham se jo neem jaan hai
wohi jo bemaar o natawan hai
kisi ne kheyncha hai uska bistar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rahi jo kufe ki shaahzadi
kisi ne shayad usay sada di
chini hai kausar ab uski chadar
jabeen pa saahil pa alqama ke
kisi ki mayyat tadap rahi hai
items.author: Kausar Naqvi

items.title: Mai jaa raha hoo
items.body:
hogayi poori dua marhaba salle alaa
uth gaye mere qadam jaanib e karbobala
is din ka barso se tha intezaar
mai bhi ziarat to tha be qaraar
hai arbaeen shabbir ka mai jaa raha hoo karbala
paidal safar karta hua mai jaa raha hoo karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
do jannato ke darmiyan sajda karoo ye khwab tha
jaa kar kafe abbas par nauha padhoo ye khwab tha
jo khwab tha sacha hua mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
us maqtal e shabbir mein dena hai pursa khoon ka
karna hai us dehleez par seena zani ka haq ada
maangoo khuda se aur kya mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
haji kahe zaair kahe mujhko sabhi ahle aza
maula mujhe de ye sharaf karta tha mai har dam dua
mujhko sharaf mil hi gaya mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein ek lekar alam abbas ka mehwe buka
jaa'un najaf se karbala muddat se ye armaan tha
armaan ye poora hua mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab matami jeete rahe aao kare mil kar dua
maula ka ho hum pe karam bibi ki ho hum par ata
honton pe ho bas ye sada mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek maqam e shahadat pe mai
matam karunga sare karbala
akbar ne khaayi jahan par sina
pamaal qasim jahan par hua
ghazi ke baazu jahan par kate
paalon ka asghar jahan so gaya
aur jis jagah sheh ke qaime jale
cheeni gayi bibiyon ki rida
mai us jagah karke aah o buka
majlis kara'unga behre aza
mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo safdar o mazhar ho ya zaair koi shabbir ka
abbas de jis ko sada jaata wohi hai karbala
ghazi ne di mujhko sada mai jaa raha hoo karbala
hai arbaeen shabbir ka...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Mere baba ab nahi
items.body:
mere baba ab nahi aayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
pichle pahar mere aangan mein koi bibi kartihai bain
jaise meri dadi kehti ho ro kar haye hussain
lagta hai mujhko mere baba jaan gawayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
itne bade ghar mein mera ghamkhwar nahi koi
saath mujhe le jaane ko tayyar nahi koi
mujh bemaar ko sab aakhir kab tak samjhayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein jo mere dard hai sab se kehna mushkil hai
mai wo mareeza hoon mera zinda rehna mushkil hai
jaane waale phir meri surat dekh na payenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazha mein mujhko qible ki jaanib kaun litayega
kaun meri turbat pe mujhe talqeen sunayega
ghar waale kya mera janaza bhi na uthayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein mere kaise kasie andeshe aate hai
mujhko hamesha ke liye akbar chod ke jaate hai
apne kaleje par ali akbar barchi khayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kyun reh reh ke mujhe ek wehm sataata hai
khauf yehi ek mujh bemaar ko khaaye jaata hai
mere ammu darya par shaane katwayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kahan sab mujhko akela chod ke jaate hai
bemaari mein saare rishte tod ke jaate hai
sab jaaye meri godhi se asghar to na jayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sacche hai sab mjuhko magar dunya pe nahi hai yaqeen
kaash ye waada poora ho ay mera khuda aameen
kehna hai sab ka jaate hi mujhko bulwayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
nayyar o aamir kaise bayan ho sughra ki uftaad
koi mareeza aaj bhi jaise karti ho faryaad
dunya ko us dukhiya ke nauhe tadpayenge
mere baba ab nahi...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Mujhe koi gham nahi
items.body:
mujhe koi gham nahi hai magar ay hussain tera
meri fiqr ki hai manzil safar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
kya ajab tha ghayr leti mujhe har tarha ki fikrein
na jo gham rafeeq hota agar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi kufr ke muqabil to kabhi munafiqon ke
raha sar bakaf hamesha padar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
na ameer e shaam baqi na wo taaj o takht e shaahi
hai dilon pa ab bhi lekin asar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
isay apne khoon se tu ne nayi zindagi ata ki
hai ye deen mustafa ka shajar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi hukmuran ka sadqa na muballighon ki koshish
hai ye deen ki baharein samar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
ay jina ke shaahzade tu zameen pa aa gaya kyun
ke musalsal ibtela hai safar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi dosh par nabi ke kabhi nok par ani ke
raha auj par hamesha qamar aey hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
hui kehkashan si roshan sar e raahe shaam o kufa
gaya sar ba noke naiza jidhar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
na to aankh par hai patti na hi haath mein hai raasha
to khaleel dekhte hai jigar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
kya ajab tha paa e asghar se ubalta khoon ka chashma
agar aediyan ragadta pisar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hashr mere aaqa tu hi ye bhi dhyan rakhiyo
ke hai soz-o-khwan-o-shayir kidhar ay hussain tera
<<DIVIDER>>
na dubara haazri gar ho naseeb e sibte jafar
to phir us ki samt se ho guzar ay hussain tera

items.title: Neend kya khaak
items.body:
shaam ke ghup andhere mein sakina ki fughan thi
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ka seena to teeron se bhara hai
neend kya khaak pe aayegi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki aaghosh ya aaghosh padar bhaati hai
neend bachon ko andhere mein kahan aati hai
yaad seene ki satayegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag aur khoon ke mahaul se ghabrayi hoo
is liye aap ke laashe pe chali aayi hoo
kuch kami dard mein aayegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab dehekte huwe sehra ko kahungi bistar
mera takiya hai ye pathar to falak hai chadar
haan ye ghurbat hi rulayegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap roothe to muqaddar bhi mera rooth gaya
ho gaya tukde jigar gham se ye dil toot gaya
zindagi chain na payegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya isi din ke liye rab se mujhe maanga tha
waqt e mushkil mein akela jo mujhe chod diya
ab sakina kahan jayegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum tadap jaate sakina jo kabhi roti thi
aah karti thi mai takleef tumhe hoti thi
ek ek baat rulayegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dafa mujhko hi seene pe sulaya baba
aaj kyun teeron ko seene pe sulaya baba
na sakina ye bhulayegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise farhan ye roodad likhega mazhar
baap se kehti thi maqtal mein sakina ro kar
baat ye mujhko jagayegi baba
aap ka seena to...
neend kya khaak pe...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abbas e jari
items.body:
ay faatah e khyber ke bete
ay sher e jawan abbas e jari
karti hai tumhari turbat par
zainab ye fughan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
hum gheerat hyder shaan e ali
poocho to behan par kya guzri
utho mai dikhane aayi hoo
baazu ke nishan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
di maine sada bhaiya tum ko
amma ne pukara tha tum ko
jab pyase galay par sarwar ke
khanjar tha rawan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne tum ko yaad kiya
hasrat se suye saahil dekha
peeri mein uthayi bekas ne
jab laashe jawan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e ghariban qaime jale
jab hum pe baraste thay kode
saahil pe suni hogi tum ne
bewon ki fughan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke dil par kya guzri
kuch tum ko khabar iski na hui
tooti mere akbar ke dil mein
jab nok e sina abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
be-maqna o chadar aale nabi
bazaar mein darbaron mein gayi
har lamha tumhe deti thi sada
ashkon ki zuban abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
tum naaz uthaate thay jis ke
hum qaid mein usko chod aaye
ta hashr tumhari pyari ka
zindan hai makan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher e dilawar kya bayan
phat'ta hai jigar rukti hai zuban
pamaal hua tanha ran mein
zehra ka nishan abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ne jo asghar ka laasha
shabbir ke haathon par dekha
manzar tha qayamt ka bhaiya
mehshar ka samaa abbas e jari
<<DIVIDER>>
jawed tha ek mehshar barpa
ghazi ka larazta tha rauza
awaaz jo deti thi zainab
ay sher e jawan abbas e jari
items.author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood

items.title: Al madad ya zahra
items.body:
fatema zahra
haye haye zainab haye haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ko jaate huwe
kehti thi saani e zahra
al madad ya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
sharm aati thi mujhe mai baap se na keh saki
aap maa hai jaanti hai kaifiyat dil ki meri
ho gayi binte ali na mehramon mein beparda
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekasi dikhla rahi hai kya qayamat ka samaa
mar na jaaye gham se maqtal mein kahin asghar ki maa
kaise dekhegi bhala naize pe jism asghar ka
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
door na hone diya tha apni nazron se jise
us jawan bete ko laila alwida kaise kahe
laashe akbar saamne rone pe hai laga pehra
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hathkadi haathon mein hai aur bediyan hai paon mein
ab kaha mohlat milegi baithne ki chhaon mein
shaam tak sajjad ka kaanto se hai hai bhara rasta
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladkhadate hai qadam aur aankh mein aansu bhare
marhala dushwaar hoga ye ruqayya ke liye
laasha e abbas se guzregi kaise beparda
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein taqseem kaise hogaya wo mahjabeen
sar kahin tukde kahin hai aur sehra hai kahin
apne qasim ko bhala pehchane kis tarha farwa
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
berida binte ali hai bekafan ibne ali
shaam jaaye ya sambhale laash ko shabbir ki
kaampte honton pe ye fizza ke isteghasa tha
al madad ya zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein aun o mohamed ki takallum thi sada
bhar na aaye maa ka dil laashe chupade ay hawa
ruk na jaaye ye qadam hai sakht imtehan maa ka
al madad ya zehra...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Alwida ya hussain
items.body:
shaah e mashraqain fatema ke chain
ya maula hussain alvida
alvida ya hussain alvida ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
roke zainab ye karti thi bain alvida
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj akbar ki mayyat pe mai ro chuki
haath afsos abbas se dho chuki
kisko kisko kahun mai kisay kho chuki
bhai ab zulm ki inteha ho chuki
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai kya kehke bewon ko samjhaungi
sar khule kaise darbar may jaungi
kaise baali sakina ko behlaungi
mere maajaye tumko kahan paungi
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai tum thokare ran may khaate rahe
laash maidan se qaime may laate rahe
har tarha deen e haq ko bachate rahe
apni manzil ke nazdeek aate rahe
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab wo baysheer ki bezubani kahan
akbar e naujawan ki jawani kahan
ab wo abbas ki paasbani kahan
al-atash ki sadaein hai pani kahan
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao tumko galay se lagaye behan
aao bhaiya ke qurban jaye behan
kaun baaqi hai kisko bulaye behan
aao ghode pe khud hi bithaye behan
alvida ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran se halmin ki nagaah aayi sada
choor zakhmo se hai ab badan shaah ka
ay muazzam hui zulm ki imtehan
kat gaya shaah e bekas ka sookha gala
alvida ya hussain...
items.author: Moazzin Pasha

items.title: Askari maula
items.body:
ye gham wo gham hai ke dono jahan rote hai
yateem aaj imam e zamaan hote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haye hassan askari maula
ay bine zehra askari maula
shaahe saamara askari maula
ay bine zehra askari maula
<<DIVIDER>>
haye qayamat ki ghadi aa gayi kaisi
saaye se mehroom tere hogaye mehdi
hoke juda rota raha aap ka beta
ay mere baba askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa aseeri ka sitam tumpe hua hai
tere liye ghar tera zindan bana hai
maula tera ghar mein hua dafn janaza
haye ghurbata askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamara har saal chale aate hai zawwar
aap ka taboot uthaate hai azadaar
farshe aza bichta raha bichta rahega
lijiye pursa askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
saare azadaron ke lab par ye dua hai
waasta tujhko tere bete ka diya hai
dil mein basa rauza tera mehdi ke baba
hum ko bulana askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaidi o mazloom mere gyaarwe sarkar
dene ko pursa tumhe aaye hai azadaar
pursa qubool ho ay mere syed o sardar
hum log teri nazre karam ke hai talabgaar
gham ye tera dil mein sada zinda rahega
roti hai dunya askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi tere naam ki hoti hai ye majlis
saath mein zahra ke chali aati hai narjis
dekh zara mehve buka hai teri zauja
karti hai nauha askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
parda e ghaibat mein jo beta hai tumhara
bhejein usay jald pareshan hai dunya
sunlo zara behre khuda waaris e kaaba
hai ye ilteja askari maula
ay bine zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mesum o azlan pe bas itna karam ho
naam tere chaahne waalon mein raqam ho
kardo ata hum ko sila nauhe ka maula
khwaab ho poora askari maula
ay bine zehra...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Ay seem tana
items.body:
chandi sa badan phool sa tan khaak hua hai
zainab ka jigar rashke qamar chaak hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
ay seem tana gulbadana aun o mohamed
zainab hai kahan aur kahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase rahe darya ki taraf ki na nigahein
de aaye thay zainab ko zuban aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dard ki dunya hai basi dashte bala mein
kafoor huwe dono jahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein thay jab tak to faqat dono thay bacche
maidan mein huwe jaake jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo maut ke sehra mein raha manzar e mehshar
angdaiyan lete thay wahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo maqsad e sarwar pe fida dono ka hona
tum jaise kahan deeda varan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashon pe kiye hai zainab e dilgeer ne sajde
un sajdon ke raushan hai nishan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko dulhan thi bani ashoor ko bewa
pamaal hua ran mein jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ki gardan par chala teer e sitamgar
honton pa jo pheri hai zuban aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki ani jo dhans gayi khud mere jigar mein
ab hai meri aankhon mein dhuaan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya ko bhi abbas ne darya nahi samjha
tha husne wafa se ye ayan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e jari sogaye darya ke kanare
bedast huwe sher e jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar bhi nahi abbas nahi tum bhi nahi ho
bhai ke bina hum hai yahan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nusrat e haq ke siwa maa ne na socha
ay jaane dileraane jawan aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
iqbal ke nauhe ye sada haq ki sada hai
dhoondenge tumhe haq talaban aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed...
items.author: Iqbal

items.title: Barchi ki ani qabr
items.body:
asghar ka laasha dhoondte phirte thay jab udoo
naize chubho chubho ke sar e dasht char soo
ek baar goonji dashte bayaban mein ye sada
baba jaan baba jaan baba jaan baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki ani qabr talak aayi hai baba
asghar ne bhi seene pe sina khaayi hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jab asr ko sab chaahne waale gaye maare
nusrat ko chala jhoole se haathon pe tumhare
hal min ki sada ran mein mujhe laayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqif thay sitamgar bhi meri tashnalabi se
hai pyaas bujhayi meri ek teer chala ke
sadaat pe ummat ne jafa dhaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
tay kar ke chala dasht se jab teer ki manzil
paywast hua naize mein nanha sa mera dil
tadpaya badan rooh bhi tadpayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene ko lahoo kar diya zaalim ki sina ne
manzar ye magar dekh liya qaime se maa ne
taqdeer meri maa ko kahan laayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
is waqt qayamat hui maidan mein barpa
wo neem hua naize se jab mera kaleja
yaade ali akbar ye mujhe aayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe ko lehad se meri naize pe utha kar
aada ne chalaya mere halqoom pe khanjar
ghurbat ki ghata kaise yahan chaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon naize pe rota tha ye sun kar sar e sarwar
altaf sada dete thay jab naize se asghar
asghar ne bhi seene pe sina khaayi hai baba
barchi ki ani qabr talak...
items.author: Altaf Hussain

items.title: Dar se deti thi
items.body:
dar se deti thi awaaz maadar
raat hone ko hai aao asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
shaq ab hai judaai ye dil par
raat hone ko hai aao asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna pur haul hai ye biyaban
khauf o dehshat hai kitni rumeinan
darr na jaana kahin mere dilbar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaag kar raat tum ne guzaari
subho se thi ajab bekharari
ab to sojao pehlu mein aa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab na paaungi pehlu mein tum ko
neend beta na aayegi hum ko
so sakoge na tum bhi bichad kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer gardan pa teri laga hai
kya ye sach hai jo maine suna hai
maa ko dikhlao to ran se aa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kaha maine tum ne suna tha
aur jawab uska has kar diya tha
hogaye kyun khafa ghar se jaa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang maidan mein ki sab ne pyare
par na dekhe thay aise nazaare
kya kiya tum ne roya jo lashkar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya koi kehna un ka na maana
ho ke nazraaz shaah e madina
chod aaye tumhe ran mein sarwar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum na kuch gham karo mere beta
kya hua gar jala tera jhoola
doongi lori mai godhi mein le kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya malak ne khabar ye sunaayi
sab anees e shahe karbalayi
jaaye jannat mein nauha ye padh kar
raat hone ko hai...
items.author: Anees

items.title: Ek akbar ki maa
items.body:
shehzadi laila shehzadi zehra
shehzadi zainab salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hai ye dashte sitam kehte hai sab ahle qalam
jumle ki ye rawani nahi alfaaz aur maani nahi
bas teen hi maayein hai ye jin ka koi saani nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
ek akbar ki maa ek zainab ki maa
ek aun o mohamed ki maa
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki fitrat se hat kar diye imtehan
inke eesaar pe sadqe dono jahan
kar gayi haq pe qurban rifl o jawan
ek akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haadson se bachaati hai bacchon ko maa
maa ka aanchal hai aulaad ka sayeban
haan magar is rawish par chali hai kahan
ek akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke aun o mohamed se maa ne kaha
apne mamu pe hona hai tumko fida
kar ke beton ko qurban thi shadman
ek akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand laila ka tha hum shabihe nabi
uske laashe pe khud maut rone lagi
kaisi bemisl maayein hai rabb e jahan
ek akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne baalon se khud fatema nauhagar
jhaadne aa gayi qatl gaahe pisar
inko rab ne chuna hai pare imtehan
ek akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme farwa rubab aur bano ka gham
karbala ki sabhi maayein hai mohtaram
haan magar inka saani milega kahan
ek akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
khatm mazhar ne safdar kiya yun kalaam
karbala ki sabhi bibiyon ko salaam
bibiyon ki nigahon mein thi sayeban
ek akbar ki maa...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ghar ghar mein
items.body:
ghar ghar mein safe matame shabbir bicha de
<<DIVIDER>>
nemat ghame shabbir ki gar tujhko khuda de
dunya ko payame shahe mazloom suna de
matam ki sada se dil e baatil ko hila de
parda jo nigahon pe hai dunya ki hata de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mard wohi kar ke jo waade ko nibha de
ek sar ki zaroorat ho bahattar ka gala de
baazu e alamdar de behno ki rida de
jo kuch bhi ho sab raahe mohabbat mein luta de
itna de ke badle mein khuda soche ke kya de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya mein sada ban ke raho haq ke payami
zaalim ke mukhalif raho mazloom ke haami
aamaal ko kha jaati hai emaan ki khaami
har ek ko milti nahi sarwar ki ghulami
nemat ye mayassar hai usay jisko khuda de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq kya hai zamane ko bataate huwe niklo
parda rukhe baatil se hataate huwe niklo
jaage huwe fitno ko sulaate huwe niklo
sote huwe zehno ko jagaate huwe niklo
naara wo karo kufr ki deewar jo dhaa de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kausar ghame sarwar mein lutaate huwe niklo
rote huwe dunya ko rulaate huwe niklo
mazloom ka paigham sunaate huwe niklo
abbas ke parcham ko uthaate huwe niklo
har naqshe qadam raahe haqeeqat ka pata de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
batlao ke shabbir sa rehbar na milega
kaunain mein inka koi hamsar na milega
sardar e jina saaqi e kausar na milega
is dar ke siwa aur koi dar na milega
jis dar pe farishta bhi gada ban ke sada de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mumkin na hua kar ke jo sarwar ne dikhaya
khushnoodi e maula mein bhare ghar ko lutaya
akbar ko uthaya kabhi asghar ko sulaya
shabbir ne sar de ke zamane ko bataya
zinda hai wohi maut ki gardan jo jhuka de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
badte huwe baatil ke qadam todne waale
aiwaan e takabbur ke sanam todne waale
ay tashna dahan khaak pe dam todne waale
hairaan hai khud tujhpe sitam todne waale
hai kaun tahe taygh jo ummat ko dua de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sabr ye zabt aur ye himmat nahi dekhi
insan ki ye meraaj ye azmat nahi dekhi
juz tere kisi mein bhi ye jurrat nahi dekhi
hyder ki qasam hum ne ye quwwat nahi dekhi
qillat se jo kasrat ke iraadon ko mita de
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehne ko musalman thay wo zulm ke baani
mehman bula kar na diya shaah ko pani
mitti mein mila di ali akbar ki jawani
hamshakle paighambar tha wo shabbir ka jaani
tasveer ka ye rukh bhi zamane ko dikhaade
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ka haathon pe tadapte huwe marna
taapon ke tale laasha e qasim ka bikharna
phal barchi ka akbar ke kaleje mein utarna
sab saamne aankhon ke ho aur uff bhi na karna
kis dil mein ye himmat hai ye taaqat ye batade
ghar ghar mein safe...
<<DIVIDER>>
chehre pe malay khoon qadam tez badhaye
ek nanhi si mayyat ko kaleje se lagaye
ye kaun chala jaata hai gardan ko jhukaye
maa dar pe hai qaime ke kahin dekh na paaye
fizza se kaho qaime ke parde ko gira de
ghar ghar mein safe...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Hangame asr hai
items.body:
hangame asr hai ye sheh khoon ugal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
kul ambiya sirhane haaton ko mal rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa koi sitara sur khaasima hai saara
wo aandhiyan hai seeno mein dil behal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
yani na hai wo zeen par yani na hai zameen par
teeron pe shaahe wala karwat badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon to ragon mein kya hai khushk is khadar gala hai
khaatil bhi thak ke apne khanjar badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud gardane katane shabbir ko bachane
jaane ko ran mein haye kamsin machal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se jo rawan hai haye lahoo kahan hai
ye noor e kibriya ke chashme ubhal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
har shaam roz jisko royegi yaad karke
wo shaam dhal rahi hai qayyam jal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hogaya zamana shane se taaba shana
taboot chal raha hai kaandhe badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ay naved hai ye kul karbala ka haasil
hal min ke lafz sheh ke moo se nikal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Haye moosae kazim
items.body:
haye moosa-e-kazim
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ghareebul watan qaid mein mar gaya
pul pe baghdad ke hai janaza rakha
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon aankhon se apni bahate hue
hatkadi bediyan tauq pehne hue
qaid sajjad ki yaad karta hua
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke athara bete jawan saal ke
uski mayyat ko mazdoor le kar chale
bain karti chali saath mein sayyeda
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
ajnabi shehr hai door ahle watan
tere baba ko de kaun ghusl o kafan
aao jaldi watan se imam e raza
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr karna hai sughra ke jaisa tujhe
raasta dekhna baap ka chod de
jaa ke masoom-e-qum se kehde hawa
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein chal basa shaahe kaun-o-makan
ab to mazloom ki khol do bediyan
tumne chaaha tha jo lo wohi hogaya
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
laash par bhi nahi rone wala koi
warise deen ki haye bewaarsi
dhoonti hai khaza dafn karne ki jaa
ek ghareebul watan…
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn karte takkalum sabhi aa gaye
karbala se madine se aur sham se
chauda barson ka qaidi reha hogaya
ek ghareebul watan…
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Hussain haye hussain
items.body:
ye bain karti thi zehra hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sada e girya o zaari ki roz o shab aayi
hussain baad tere aisi wehshatein aayi
ujad gaya hai madina hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere baghair madine may reh ke kya karti
mai tere saath hi is dasht may chali aayi
akeli reh gayi sughra hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai teri maa hoo har ek ranj o gham uthaungi
ay mere laal tujhe chod kar na jaaungi
mai tere saath hoo beta hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
na paas aun o mohamed hai aur na akbar hai
na ab alam na alamdar hai na asghar hai
ghareeb hogaya mera hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
udaas tashna dahan khoon may nahaye huwe
akela khaak pe baitha hai sar jhukaye huwe
kya haal hogaya tera hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi mai aayi hoo qaime se ho ke ay beta
hai tere gham may ajab haal teri behna ka
tadap rahi hai sakina hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke ghamzada mazloom maa ye kehti hai
zara sa pani pilaade hussain ko koi
hai teen roz ka pyasa hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamaam raat mai ro ro ke aahein bharti rahi
mai us maqaam ko baalon se saaf karti rahi
karega tu jahan sajda hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain se naawar tha ghamzada gohar
chala jo khaafla to saath hi chali maadar
labon pe tha yehi nauha hussain haye hussain
ye bain karti thi zehra...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Jawani ali akbar ke
items.body:
salaam ali akbar salaam ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
hum jawano ki jawani hai ali akbar ke naam
kaash unke kaam aaye hum kare kuch aise kaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
khadimon ki tarha hum bhi pesh aaye baap se
jis tarha karte thay akbar baba jaan ka ehteraam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khadar padhlo wakeel e fatema zehra bano
ho tumhare haath mein saara adalat ka nizaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tahra abbas ko akbar samajhte thay sada
us tarha ustad ko dein baap ke jaisa maqam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
is jawan ka naam lekar dil se tayyari karo
imtehan mein kamiyabi khud milegi gaam gaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
paon choone chaahta tha roka maatha choom kar
is kareemi par tumhari ro pada hurr ka ghulam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab sawalon ke milenge sciencee tumko jawab
tum kalaam e paak se kar ke zara dekho kalaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
laut aaye qaime mein sajjad ki awaaz par
tum ne sikhlaya bade bhai ka kya hai ehteraam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath ka matam ho ya phir matam e zanjeer ho
dil se bas matam karo tum kya halal aur kya haram
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye adab sajjad bat jaaye tabarruk mein kahin
sar jhuka kar jis tarha karte thay wo maa se kalaam
ay ali akbar salaam ay ali akbar salaam
hum jawano ki jawani...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Kaise mai dafnaun
items.body:
shaam ke zindan may ek choti si qaidi
haathon may paon may aur gardan may hai rassi
aur seene pe baba ka hai sar sar se hai lipti
moo pe moon ko rakh ke bahot dayr wo royi
haye rote rote us ne jo li aakhri hichki
zindan may dam tod gayi shaah ki pyari
sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
karte thay sajjad ye nauha
kaise mai dafnaun sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
qaidi agar qaid may mar jaata hai koi
laash ko rassi se chuda dete hain us ki
zakhmon may paywast rasan hai tere aise
maine teri laash se rassi nahi kholi
laasha bikhar jaye kahin na
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rulaata hai ye manzar meri behna
jism tera khoon may hai tar meri behna
haathon pe laasha hai tera soch raha hoo
ghusl ko pani bhi mayassar nahi behna
tu hi bata de meri behna
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi musibat ye padi door watan se
baba bhi mehroom hai aur tu bhi kafan se
chaahun chudhana to chuda bhi nahi sakta
khoon bhara kurta jo chipka hai badan se
tera kafan hai yehi kurta
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad mujhe aata hai ay ghamzada khwahar
mujhse yehi poochti rehti thi tu aksar
dafn mai ho jaun agar qaid e sitam may
shimr na aa jaye kahin meri lehad par
ab isi zindan may dukhiya
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hi nahi teri to saansein bhi thi qaidi
dekhi nahi pehle kahin aisi aseeri
sona jo chaaha to tujhe neend na aayi
rona jo chaaha to tamachon ki saza thi
hogi teri qabr bhi tanha
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar o farhan yehi baat hai nauha
haathon pe ek qaidi ke ek qaidi ka laasha
kaise bandhe haathon se mai qabr banaun
sab ko rulaata tha ye sajjad ka jumla
haye wo sajjad ka kehna
kaise mai dafnaun sakina...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Kaun sambhale
items.body:
girte huwe naaqe se zameen par
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi baradar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
athara bhai ki behen pe
kaisi musibat aayi hai
haath bandhe hai pusht ke bal
aur gard badan par chaayi hai
sar pe nahi hai maqna o chadar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed qasim aur
abbas e dilawar koi nahi
kaun madad ko aayega aakhir
monis o yawar koi nahi
abid hai par wo bhi hai laaghar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi agar girta hai to wo
haathon ka sahara leta hai
lekin zainab ke girne ka
haal bahot ranjeeda hai
chehre ke bal girti hai muztar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ko bachaya khud ko faqat
takleef mein dhaala zainab ne
karbobala se shaam talak
har ek ko sambhala zainab ne
lekin ab hai shaam ka manzar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ye chali thi apne watan se
saani e hyder saath mein thay
inki amaari sab se haseen thi
saare baradar saath mein thay
ab hai magar tanha ye yahan par
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh rahi hain uski nigahein
bheed mein apna koi nahi
shaam ke logon ka majma hai
ahle madina koi nahi
chaaron taraf hai zulm ka lashkar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke zaalim maar rahe thay
zainab ko jab patthar se
dekh ke nok e naiza par
abbas e dilawar ke sar se
kehne lagi fizza ro ro kar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na-mahram hai log sabhi
aur ghairon ki aabadi hai
shaam ke bazaron mein khule sar
kufe ki shehzadi hai
dukhiya par haste hai sitamgar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke zainab ko is gham mein
sab ko khayaal aaya hoga
dil mein kumail o aamir ye
logon ke sawaal aaya hoga
nok e sina par sar hai bahattar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Kisko bedeeno ne
items.body:
kisko be-deeno ne maara ay zameene karbala
hai payambar ka dulara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani pani jab ke ho jayegi ye kheti tamam
ek tu hogi kanara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha khodi lehad kya guzri dil par shah ke
jab ke asghar ko utara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
laa rahe hai shaahe wala asghare baysheer ko
ya koi quran ka paara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
lo chali maqtal ko ye kehti hui umme rabab
mujhko asghar ne pukara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
baap peeri mein utha'ta hai jawan bete ki laash
de zara bad kar sahara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna turbat mein asghar ka zara rakhna khayal
saare ghar ka hai dulara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye batade kis tarha mayyat pe pahunche thay hussain
jab ke akbar ne pukara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
le liye tune meri godhi ke paale boli maa
ab karoon kyun kar guzara ay zameene karbala
kisko be-deeno ne…

items.title: Laila ka chand
items.body:
laila ka chand doob gaya qatlgaah mein
ab roshni nahi shahe deen ki nigaah mein
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki laash dhoodne nikle hai shaahe deen
har har qadam pe thokarein khaate hai raah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e ahlebait ke baazu jo kat gaye
darya lahoo ka beh gaya pyason ki chaah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon ke aage bhai ka sar tan se kat gaya
zainab pachadein khaati rahi qatlgaah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek laash ghar mein laaye to ek laash le gaye
din kat gaya hussain ka faryad o aah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
milta nahi qaraar kisi jaa hussain ko
hai qaimagaah mein to kabhi qatlgaah mein
laila ka chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dam gulu e asghar e baysheer chid gaya
na jaane kitne teer chube qalbe shaah mein
laila ka chand...
items.author: Yawar Azmi

items.title: Mai jaa rahi hoo
items.body:
ye keh rahi thi fatema
hai aakhri meri sada
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
haafiz mere ghar ke ho tum
haafiz tumhara hai khuda
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
dard uthaati hi rahi
har zarb par khamosh thi
tum se shikayat hi na ki
mai ab nahi jee paungi
ek zakhm hai asia laga
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
is zulm ki aadi na thi
kya mai nabi zaadi na thi
qismat ki shehzadi na thi
mai sabr bhi karti rahi
phir bhi sitam badta raha
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat se naata tod ke
dunya se moo ko mod ke
khaaliq se rishta jod ke
bachon ko tanha chod ke
karti hui aah o buka
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zainab o kulsoom hai
kamsin hai aur masoom hai
meri tarha mazloom hai
parda hai in ki zindagi
hone na paye berida
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
leti hoo jab mai siskiyan
aati hai mujhko hichkiyan
tooti hui hai phasliyan
mayyat ko meri qabr may
aahista se rakhna zara
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai sochti hoo ya ali
paas unke jab mai jaaungi
guzregi kya baba pe bhi
rukh par tamachaon ke nishan
dekhega jab baba mera
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ahmed e mukhtar ki
beti thi ay majid wohi
zulm o sitam sehti rahi
rone lage sher e khuda
sun kar ye zehra ki sada
mai jaa rahi hoo ya ali
ye keh rahi thi fatema...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Mere baba chale aao
items.body:
mere baba chale aao sakina yaad karti hai
kabhi zindan mein roti hai kabhi faryad karti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
andhera din ye chaaya hai ke bas mai hoo andhere mein
raha na farq kuch shab ki siyaahi aur savere mein
fughan masoom ki har dil yahan nashaad karti hai
mere baba chale aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zindan ke andheron mein bhatak hi rahoo baba
tumhari yaad mein rokar tadapti hi rahoo baba
ghamon se aapki qurbat mujhe azad karti hai
mere baba chale aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
chini hai baliyan kano se mere khoon tapakta hai
tamache shimr ke khaati hoo dil seene mein rota hai
naye mujh par sitam fauje sitam ejaad karti hai
mere baba chale aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe dekhe bina dil ko sukoon milta nahi baba
charaghe ashk e gham jalta hai to bujhta nahi baba
sakina ab andheron ka nagar aabad karti hai
mere baba chale aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi yaade ali asghar kabhi yaade ali akbar
satati hai mujhe pyare chacha ki yaad reh reh kar
bayan karbobala ki tay mein rudaad karti hai
mere baba chale aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi aaye agar baba tadap kar jaan dedungi
mai dadi jaan se khuld e bari mein jaake keh doongi
buka mehboob masooma paye faryad karti hai
mere baba chale aao...

items.title: Aankhein taras gayi
items.body:
aankhein taras gayi hai akbar ke dekhne ko
ali akbar ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ke lab pe har dam rehta tha ek naala
wo tha to us ke dam se ghar mein tha ek ujaala
aankhein taras gayi hai akbar ke dekhne ko
ali akbar ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
at jayenge wo gaysoo sab khaak mein lahoo mein
ye din bhi dekhna thay sehre ki aarzoo mein
aankhein taras gayi hai akbar ke dekhne ko
ali akbar ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir eid aayi sabne pehne naye libaday
aaye nahi palat kar ummat ke shaahzade
aankhein taras gayi hai akbar ke dekhne ko
ali akbar ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khursheed sa wo chehra rangat mein tha sunehra
palkon ki chilmano par tha abru'on ka pehra
aankhein taras gayi hai akbar ke dekhne ko
ali akbar ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hai uska chehra sab khoon mein bhar gaya tha
kehte hai uske dil mein naiza utar gaya tha
aankhein taras gayi hai akbar ke dekhne ko
ali akbar ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab se hoke ruqsat jab ran ko wo chala tha
har koi badke uske maathe ko choomta tha
aankhein taras gayi hai akbar ke dekhne ko
ali akbar ali akbar...
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Abbas ek baar
items.body:
ek baar sada do na
maa keh ke pukaro na
ya abbas ya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e ruqsat hussain ko bhai
jab alamdar ne kaha hoga
sochta hoo ke roohe zehra ne
roke us waqt ye kaha hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi maa keh de
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ko bhai tu ne kaha
bhai ka kiya armaan poora
armaan mera poora kar de abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal mere maa hone ka
har farz nibhaya hai maine
shabbir ke haathon se tujhko
jhoola bhi jhulaya hai maine
ehsaan tera hoga mujhpe abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi thi bohat phir bhi tujhse
is maa ko mohabbat thi itni
ek haath tha mera pehlu pe
ek haath se kurta seeti thi
sab zakhm mere bhar jayenge abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt gira tu ghode se
mai dekh rahi thi wo manzar
aaghosh mein tujhko rote huwe
maine hi sambhala tha bad kar
kab door hui hoo mai tujhse abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
bacchon ke liye jab darya se
mashkeeza bhara pani na piya
seh roz ka pyasa ho kar bhi
kya khoob nibhayi tu ne wafa
ay tashna dahan mere pyase abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
teri aankh se teer nikalun mai
tu dekhle bhai ka chehra
ye waqt e judaai hai dil mein
hasrat na rahe koi beta
aa khoon hata doon aankhon se abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein sakina pyasi hai
ye baat tujhe tadpati hai
is haal mein bhi tujhko haye
zainab ki rida yaad aati hai
aa tujhko laga loon seene se abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan sunaya ro ro kar
irfan e aza ne ye nauha
darya ke kanare ghazi ne
maa kehte huwe dum tod diya
zehra ne kaha jab ro ro ke abbas
ek baar mujhe bhi..
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ata e kibriya hai
items.body:
ata e kibriya hai aur mai hoo
dua e fatema hai aur mai hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
paa e jibreel e midhat bait e dil ka
dar e aamad khula hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saf e alfaaz hai kaaghaz qalam hai
ajab ye takhliya hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi ehsaas e tahaai zara bhi
koi dil mein basa hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na sajde se mujhe koi uthaye
yahan mera khuda hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi ehsaas apne gham ka mujhko
khayal e fatema hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamanna e nabi ki roshni mein
sana e murtaza hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar chaukhat se uth'ti hi nahi hai
dar e mushkil kusha hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahin aana hai to phir kyun mai jaaun
yahan khaak e shifa hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e dosh e aqeedat har qadam par
alam abbas ka hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
faraat e jaan hai aur is ke kinare
wafaon ki fiza hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh kar jhuk gaye sadje mein sarwar
mere rab ki raza hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda se kehta tha ye qalb e abid
tera bas aasra hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi kehte thay hyder tumhara
shanasa ek khuda hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
adeel ab aur kya mujhko talab ho
zameen e karbala hai aur mai hoo
ata e kibriya hai...
items.author: Adeel Zaidi

items.title: Ay shaahe ambiya
items.body:
ay shaahe ambiya ye musalman ne kya kiya
minbar pe fatema ka mujrim bitha diya
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dar pe aap rukte thay lene ijazatein
aate farishte arsh se karne ziyaratein
ek behaya ne aag se wo dar jala diya
ay shaahe ambiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasne laga layeen jo rone lagi batool
ghasib ne sayyeda ki gawahi na ki qabool
khud saccha ban ke bibi ko jhoota bana diya
ay shaahe ambiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
utri hai jin ki shaan mein aayaat baar baar
jin ki raza ko rad na kare rabb e kirdgaar
haq maangne gayi wo to khaali lauta diya
ay shaahe ambiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis shakhs ne di aap ko hizyan ki saughaat
jis se mila na aap ko kaghaz qalam dawaat
darbar mein batool ko us ne rula diya
ay shaahe ambiya...
items.author: Tauqeer Kamalvi

items.title: Baba hyder
items.body:
ye waqia hai pas e qatle shaahe karbobala
koi na monis o ghamkhwar bibiyon ka raha
sukoot e sehra mein taapon ki goonj uthi sada
ali ki beti ne bad kar utha liya naiza
hisaar tod ke nazdeek aagaya sawaar
tadap ke saani e zehra pukar uthi ek baar
baba hyder baba hyder
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi shaam e ghariban baba
hum huwe be sar o saaman baba
laashein maqtal mein hai uryan baba
hai safar jaanib e zindan baba
laadli aap ki hai be-chadar
baba hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai athara thay koi na raha
aap ki laadli ban mein tanha
khaak daale huwe sar pe baba
dekhiye karti hai ab aah o buka
haath rakhta nahi koi sar par
baba hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ki abbas kamar tod gaye
hum se pardes mein moo mod gaye
gham ke toofan mein hamay chod gaye
rishta har dukh se mera jod gaye
daagh seene ke dikhaun kyun kar
baba hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere akbar ka kaleja chalni
kar gayu naiza e khooli ki ani
tha jo hamshakle rasool e madani
us ke marne se jo is dil pe bani
kaise batlaye tumhe ye muztar
baba hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>

haath malti thi tumhari beti

khoon ka sailaab tha gham ki aandhi
aap ne kaise wo dekha manzar
baba hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat gaye baazu e abbas e jari
reh gayi bali sakina pyasi
khoon se qasim ne lagayi mehendi
maang ek shab ki dulhan ki ujdi
kya masayab thay jo toote hum par
baba hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar ke mashk na seene se hati
saath abbas ke maidan mein rahi
kehti ho jaise sakina pyasi
mashk ammu mai na yun loongi kabhi
layenge aap na jab tak bhar kar
baba hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye ubhre wo sar naizon par

tauq mein jakda sambhale langar

baba hyder...

jeeti tu haar gaye baani e shar

tujhpe qurban meri pyari dukhtar

<<DIVIDER>>
majlis e gham mein ye aah o zaari

items.body:
barchi lagi akbar ke to maa kehti thi ro kar

din byaah ke aaye to ajal aagayi tum ko
bigda mera pardes mein ye kaisa muqaddar
barchi lagi akbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal jawan hoke ye kya daagh diya hai
barchi lagi seene pe gaye jaanibe kausar
barchi lagi akbar ke...

abbas ka qasim ka abhi gham kam to nahi tha

barchi lagi akbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra tere waade pe madine mein hai baithi

<<DIVIDER>>
afsos layeeno ne to itna bhi na socha

<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ka tadapna teri furqat mein ghazab hai

items.title: Bhare darbar may
items.body:
bhare darbar may roti rahi khadi zahra
na jaane kis tarha haq maangti rahi zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
sanad ke tukde hawa may uda ke hasne laga
rasool zaadi se gustaakh aise kehne laga
batao kaun si jageer hai teri zahra
bhare darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan hussain se sache gawah bhi jhutlaye
rula ke bibi ko zaalim zara na sharmaye
bhula na payegi ummat ke berukhi zahra
bhare darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye uski beti hai jisne do lakht chand kiya
wo jis ke noor ne har roshni ko maand kiya
isay satao na dukhiyari hai badi zahra
bhare darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ke baad ye kya hogaya zamane ko
kyun kalmago hai chale tera ghar jalane ko
sahegi kis tarha tu ye sitamgari zahra
bhare darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
siyaah baal jo maa ke safed kar dekhe
tauqeer kaise kahoo betiyon ne sar peete
gayi thi jis tarha ghar thaki thaki zahra
bhare darbar may...

items.title: Darbar bulaya jaata
items.body:
afsos ke zainab ko darbar bulaya jaata hai
kaisa ye sitam haye sadaat pe dhaaya jaata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bain ye zainab ka mai aaj hoo be-parda
ab koi nahi mera mai qaidi hoo wavaila
haye zainab haye haye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye des paraya hai kya waqt ye aaya hai
chadar hai na saaya hai baazu hai rasan basta
haye zainab haye haye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ye kahan laayi majma hai tamashayi
zainab pe hai tanhaai hai waqt qayamat ka
haye zainab haye haye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas na akbar hai na fauj na lashkar hai
ye shaam ka manzar hai bemaar hai ab tanha
haye zainab haye haye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ashk bahaati hoo darbar may jaati hoo
ab khutbe sunati hoo dushwaar hai har lamha
haye zainab haye haye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai waqt e madad ya rab darbar hai aur zainab
abbas nahi hai ab aajaiye ay baba
haye zainab haye haye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se skaina ke jaari hai lahoo ab tak
hamsheer ki ghurbat par sajjad bahot roya
haye zainab haye haye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar may be-parda jab ahle haram aaye
us waqt mohib yazdan ye bain tha zainab ka
haye zainab haye haye shaam...

items.title: Ek bachi gham ki
items.body:
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki maari aur raat karbala ki
kano se khoon jaari aur raat karbala ki
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron se hogaya hai chalni pidar ka seena
neendh aa rahi hai isko awaaz de sakina

haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...

jangal mein hurr ki bewa aayi hai leke pani

haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...

bachi ki bekasi ka ye imtehan kada hai

har lamha dil pa waari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
meinoosiyon ka saaya badta hi jaa raha hai
kya kya khayal dil mein dukhiya ke aa raha hai
honton pa aah o zaari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehmi hui hai bachi aur jal rahe hai qaime
koi nahi jo aake jangal mein hal banaye
abid pa ghash hai taari aur raat karbala ki
haye haye haye sakina
ek bachi gham ki...

nanhe se dil ke upar gham ka pahad toota

haye haye haye sakina

items.title: Ghar hogaya nabi
items.body:
ghar hogaya nabi ka barbaad karbala mein
mardon mein bas bache hai sajjad karbala mein
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas hai na akbar zainab kise pukaare
maqtal mein bujh gaye hai ghar ke chiraag saare
ranj o alam se dil hai aabaad karbala mein
ghar hogaya nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaise dil mein is dard ko chupaya
kis darja saabira thi aansu na ek bahaya
bhai pe kar ke sadqe aulaad karbala mein
ghar hogaya nabi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko karbala mein kitne ghamon ne loota
saydaniyo ke zewar na mehramon ne loota
kya kya na guzri haye bedaad karbala mein
ghar hogaya nabi ka...

sab cheente thay zaalim bewon ki chadaron ko

maa'on ki godiyan bhi ran mein ujad gayi hai

baad e hussain akhtar zainab ka tha ye noha

items.title: Haq hai ali ke saath
items.body:
haq hai ali ke saath ali hai nabi ke saath
ye jiske saath hai hai khuda bhi unhi ke saath
haq hai ali ke saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi ali ke koi hai ghaire ali ke saath
momin kisi ke saath munafiq kisi ke saath
haq hai ali ke saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
roza namaz haj o ziaraat sab khubool

qurban karke hum ne zamane ki har khushi

qayam hai deen farshe aza e hussain se

bete ke dil se kyanch rahe hai sina hussain

items.body:
islam ko bacha gayi kulsoom fatema

wo sansanata teer wo baysheer ka gala

allah jaane kaise saha hai rabaab ne

zainab ke saath saath...

nana ka baba jaan ka bhai ka gham liye

zainab ke saath saath...

sar par wo khaak udaati hai iqbal aandhiyan

items.title: Jawani bain karti
items.body:
jawani bain karti hai ali akbar ke laashe par
zaeefi aagayi mujh par tere gham mein ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan bete ke seene par jo roya toot ke naiza
zaeefi mein shahe waala ke dil pe chal gaya khanjar

<<DIVIDER>>
bada armaan tha usko ali akbar ki shadi ka

jawani bain karti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhulasti dhoop mein hai ek pyase sher ka laasha
lahoo kyun roye na aankhein qayamat khaiz hai manzar
jawani bain karti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e saahil tadapta reh gaya abbas ka laasha
chale shabbir jab tanha utha kar laasha e akbar
jawani bain karti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ho haahmi sheron akele hai shah e waala
koi imdaad ko aao pukari zainab e muztar
jawani bain karti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rahi jab tak bhi maa zinda yehi kehti rahi haye
ali akbar ali akbar ali akbar ali akbar
jawani bain karti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali akbar ke hujre ko sajaati reh gayi sughra
na aaya laut kar bhai to gham se mar gayi khwahar
jawani bain karti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
woh apne chaand se bete ka sehra dekh na paayi
ali akbar ki maa ko bas yahi gham kha gaya gohar
jawani bain karti hai...

items.title: Kisko de sada zainab
items.body:
jab laasha e farzande nabi ho gaya pamaal
us waqt ajab haal mein thi fatema ki aal
tareekh ne kuch is tarha likha hai wo ehwaal
sab bibiyon mein ek tha bibi ka bura haal
bechaini se aati thi dare qaime pe har baar
bachon ko sameinte huwe kehti thi dilafgaar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay jari diler bawafa
baazu e shaheede karbala
jaane fatema o murtuza
tashnalab sakina ke chacha
kisko de sada zainab
fauj ab qareeb aayi
ay hussain ke bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ko nahi hai ye khabar
lut gaya hai fatema ka ghar
so rahe ho jaa ke nehr par
naize pe rakha hai sheh ka sar
kisko de sada zainab…
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar-e-jawan nahi raha
bezuban bhi qatl hogaya
qasim-e-hazeen bhi chal basa
khaatema hua sipaah ka
kisko de sada zainab…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bataun ran ka haal
laash ko karenge paemaal
bhai ka karo to kuch khayaal
shaah-e-laafatah ke laal
kisko de sada zainab…
<<DIVIDER>>
karti hai rabab ye fughan
hone ko hai raat ab ayaan
ran mein hai hamara bezuban
le ke aaye usko bhai jaan
kisko de sada zainab....
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon ko jala na de layeen
loot le na maal-o-zar kahin
kya karega abid-e-hazeen
usko tab se hosh hi nahin
kisko de sada zainab…
<<DIVIDER>>
fauje shaam baaniye jafa
jaan ke akela benawa
karde zulm ki na inteha
cheen le ne aa ke ye rida
kisko de sada zainab…
<<DIVIDER>>
kin jafaon ka ho taskira
shaam-e-gham mein aale mustufa
hogayi ghamon mein mubtila
lab pe thi anees ye buka
kisko de sada zainab…

items.title: Laila ka dil
items.body:
haye kya qayamat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e akbar se takrayi sina
tukde tukde hogaya laila ka dil
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein ghode se gira kadiyal jawan
tukde tukde hogaya laila ka dil
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi laaya gaya maadar ko laashe ke khareeb
ungliyan thi zulf e akbar mein tadapti thi ghareeb
dekh kar seene pe barchi ka nishan
tukde tukde hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand se seene mein uljha hai kahan barchi ka phal
maa ko batlade nikalegi koi mushkil ka hal
kuch to moo se bol ay baba ki jaan
tukde tukde hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon ho kar reh gayi sab hasratein akbar ke saath
barchiyon ne lootli lamhon mein maa ki kayenat
keh rahi hai ro ke saari bibiyan
tukde tukde hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar naize pe apne laal ko rone lagi
kaifiyat ek ghamzada maa ki ajab hone lagi
qaatil e akbar nazar aaya jahan
tukde tukde hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar naize pa sar akbar ka sab ne sar dhuna

mar gayi ho is jawan bete ki maa
tukde tukde hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur kuch bhi badh gaya ek ghamzada maa ka malaal
sun ke aansu aagaye bemaar beti ka sawaal
hai kahan jis dam pukari bhai jaan
tukde tukde hogaya...

ye hua mehsoos ke ashoor ka din aagaya
yaad ay karbobala tera muazzin aagaya
masjidon mein jab kabhi goonji azaan
tukde tukde hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne yusuf ki judaai maa ko tadpane lagi
chand si surat ali akbar ki yaad aane lagi

tukde tukde hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe majlis par azadaron ka chehra zard hai
aamir o akhtar har ek misre mein itna dard hai
sun ke nauha keh rahe hai do jahan
tukde tukde hogaya...

items.title: Mai jee ke kya karoo
items.body:
umme rabab baithi shahe deen ki qabr par
thi mehwo is tarha se ke hat'ti na thi nazar
zainab badhi ye dekh ke boli jhuka ke sar
uthiye bahot hai door ka bhabi abhi safar
ek aah ki rabab ne yun phat gaya jigar
boli tadap ke zainabe muztar se nauhagar
<<DIVIDER>>
beta hai karbala mein to beti hai shaam mein
kije dua ye bargahe khaas o aam mein
so jaun mai bhi qabre shahe tashnakaam mein
hasrat nahi kuch aur mai ab jee ke kya karoo
jee ke kya karoo
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar sidhare saamne nazron ke aap ki
toda hai dam sakina ne godhi mein aap ki
jholi mein kuch raha nahi bibi rabab ki
ye aa gaya hai daur mein ab jee ke kya karoo
jee ke kya karoo
<<DIVIDER>>
jisse tha zindagi mein ujaala chala gaya
cheh maah jisko godh mein paala chala gaya
bibi hamara hasliyon wala chala gaya
kya reh gaya aur mai ab jee ke kya karoo
jee ke kya karoo
<<DIVIDER>>
maangegi mujhse fatema sughra jo bhai ko
doongi jawab kya mai bhala gham satayi ko
kya moo dikhaun ahmad e mursal ki jaayi ko
jeene ke hai ye to aur jee ke kya karoo
jee ke kya karoo
<<DIVIDER>>
shauhar hai mere saath na beta hai saath mein
dekhun mai kiski raah jiyun kiski aas mein
kya reh gaya hai jism ki boseeda saans mein
mai jee chuki bas aur mai ab jee ke kya karoo
jee ke kya karoo
<<DIVIDER>>
bewa hassan ki kubra si beti ujad gayi
auron ka kya khud aap ki godhi ujad gayi
zehra ka ghar batool ki kheti ujad gayi
khud sochiye ba-ghaur mai ab jee ke kya karoo
jee ke kya karoo
<<DIVIDER>>
kabse khadi hoo aas lagaye mai raah mein
jaun kahan bataye is haale tabaah mein
shak hoke le le mujhko bhi apni panaah mein
ay dashte zulm o jaur mai ab jee ke kya karoo
jee ke kya karoo

items.title: Mere baba dekh
items.body:
zahra ye bain karti thi qabre rasool par
zulm o sitam ki hadh hui baba batool par
dar ko gira ke todi hai zahra ki phasliyan
lamha ba lamha jaati hai zahra ki haye jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan tooti hui hai dard kab seh payegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
aap bhi royenge baba dekh kar chehra mera
neel hai rukhsaar ab tak aankh hai meri siyah
zakhm jab sayli ki zehra aap ko dikhlayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha dar ko giraya kis tarha maara mujhe
kis tarha dewaar o dar may haye hai peesa mujhe
har sitam beti tumhari aap ko batlayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab ye socha tha musalman is khadar gir jayenge
mujhko darbar e sitam may be-khata bulwayenge
ek siddiqa ko ummat is tarha jhutlayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne bachon ke maara kya bataun baba jaan
dard se tadpti bahot hai saamne bachon ke maa
yaad is manzar ki inko har ghadi rulwayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko jab awaaz denge mere bache be-amaan
tod kar bande kafan ko aayegi mazlooma maa
apne bachon se galay phir fatema lag jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
daagh sayli ke kisi ko baba dikhlaati nahi
phasliyan tooti magar hyder ko batlaati nahi
dard pehlu ka ye zehra qabr tak le jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jeete ji hyder ke mujhpar har sitam hota raha
toota ye pehlu kabhi to taziyana bhi laga
hashr tak ghurbat ali ki khoon bhi rulwayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne tukde karega aap ki zaalim sanad
mujhko degi chunte chunte is tarha ka gham sanad
chand lamho may zaeefa fatema ho jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
danish o rehaan ro kar bas karo har dam dua
naukri tasleem kar le kaash bibi fatema
bil yaqeen aisa hua to aakhirat ban jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...

items.title: Neher se aati hai
items.body:
mauje alqama kar rahi hai bain
lut gayi zainab lut gaye hussain
binte shahe lafata kar rahi hai marsiya
haye alamadar
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr se aati hai ye sada
qatl alamdar ho gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaase thay sab nauha gar
thaam li sheh ne kamar
zainab e dilgeer ne kaha
qatl alamdar ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna wafadar tha sab ka madadgaar tha
saaya e deewar tha fauj ka salaar tha
hogaye laachar hum kehte hai shaahe umam
ro rahi hai saath mein wafa
qatl alamdar ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtare shaahe umam kaise sahe ab ye gham
khaak nasheen hai haram dekhte girta alam
karne lagi marsiya pani nahi aayega
ek naya mujhko gham mila
qatl alamdar ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha jawan bhai ka kaise uthega bhala
bole shahe karbala aaiye sher e khuda
mera sahara bano koi dilaasa to do
koi madadgaar na raha
qatl alamdar ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ye laachargi pyasi sakina rahi
tooti umeedein meri aur kamar kham hui
mashk e sakina chidi beh gaya pani sabhi
kohe alam uspe jab gira
qatl alamdar ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte ho akbar sada rote hai shaahe huda
fizza ne rokar kaha aao sambhalo zara
choota watan ghar luta pyase rahe gham na tha
ab hai masayeb ki inteha
qatl alamdar ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek alamdar ke jaane se ye gham mile
tashna dahan ro diye haath se kooze gire
hum ne to nauhe kiye ahle sitam khush huwe
shimr ne jab fauj se kaha
qatl alamdar ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein shabbir par zulm huwe is qadar
safdar o mazhar magar tha wo ali ka pisar
sabr bhi karta raha shukr bhi karta raha
zabt ye gham ho nahi saka
qatl alamdar ho gaya...

items.title: Aankhein to khol
items.body:
maa keh rahi hai rakh kar
zaanu pe khoon bhara sar
aankhein to khol akbar
aankhein to khol akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
pehchaan lo to jaano
surat hai kya hamari
aankhein to khol dekho
haalat hai kya hamari
maa keh rahi hai...
aankhein to khol...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehre ki har ladi to
ashkon mein dhal gayi hai
mehendi ki thi jo hasrat
wo khoon mal gayi hai
maa keh rahi hai...
aankhein to khol...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarhane dekho sughra
ka naamawar khada hai
dekho to gird beta
sab ghar ka ghar khada hai
maa keh rahi hai...
aankhein to khol...
<<DIVIDER>>
khursheed sa ye chehra
sab khoon mein bhar gaya hai
dekho to maa ke dil mein
naiza utar gaya hai
maa keh rahi hai...
aankhein to khol...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab par ye umme laila
ke hai naved naala
tum kya gaye gaya hai
ghar se mere ujaala
maa keh rahi hai...
aankhein to khol...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Abbas hai
items.body:
deen e ahmed ki baqa tu kyun na ghazi ye kahun
karbala mein kar diya hai tu ne baatil sar-nigun
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi lehra raha jo parchame abbas hai
hai diya ghazi ko rutba kibriya ne khaas hai
<<DIVIDER>>
parchame islam hai ye na kabhi hoga ye kham
mustafa hamza ali abbas ka hai ye alam
likhe jo iski fazeelat qalm na qirtaas hai
aaj bhi lehra raha jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
arzoo ye hai ali ki sayyeda ki hai dua
is liye kehta zamana hai isay rab e wafa
poori karta hai alam ye har dukhi ki aas hai
aaj bhi lehra raha jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad rakhega zamana iski meraj e wafa
pani mein bheege jo baazu wo diye dono kata
maar di pani to thokar teen din ki pyaas hai
aaj bhi lehra raha jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha maula ali hai ye bhi hai mushkil kusha
hai yehi babul hawaij hai yehi behre ataa
paas hai jo jo ali ke sab unhi ke paas hai
aaj bhi lehra raha jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar barehna bibiyon ko dekhe kaise alamdar
unka sar khursheed naize se hai girta baar baar
kis khadar behno ke parde ka unhe ehsaas hai
aaj bhi lehra raha jo...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Alam aagaya
items.body:
shabbir ki aahon mein pyason ki ye goonji sada
alam aagaya alam aagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina ne bachon ko bula kar kaha
alam aagaya alam aagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne bhi hamein choda kis waqt e musibat mein
ab kaun sahara hai is aalam e ghurbat mein
abbas ke parcham se zainab ne lipat kar kaha
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun bachayega ay bhai ridaon ko
sunte nahi kya bhai bekas ki sadaon ko
zainab ne kaha ro kar chin jayegi sar se rida
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna tha yehi ran mein sab zulm ke maaron ka
zainab ne kiya matam ye kehke dulaaron ka
ab hum pe layeen ran mein dhayenge jafa par jafa
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein aaye thay hum jis ke sahare par
wo sher to sota hai ab darya kinare par
ab tu hi muhafiz hai hum ahle haram ka khuda
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein sakina ka jab aakhri waqt aaya
aise mein zafar us ne sajjad ko rulwaya
darwaza e zindan par masooma ne ro kar kaha
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...

items.title: Alwida zainab
items.body:
zakhmi baba ki ghar mein jab aamad hui
binte zahra yun faryad karne lagi
haye baba mai pardes mein lut gayi
to laadli se mukhatib huwe yun ali
meri pyari zainab meri pyari zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
bole ali ye ro kar mehman hai lamhon ka
zainab tumhara baba
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se karo baatein na laut ke aayega
zainab tumhara baba
<<DIVIDER>>
hoga qadam qadam par majma e aam beti
karbobala se kufa kufa se shaam beti
aayega hausla wahan karne buland tera
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
is waaste hi maine bulwaya tum ko kufa
haathon se tum sajao khud baap ka janaza
lagni thi zarb mere pehle hi jaanta tha
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe dekhna jo chaaha bhai ko dekh lena
har ek apni mushkil abbas ko batana
abbas ki surat mein maujood hi rahega
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban mein tum pehre pe khadi hogi
na beta hoga koi na saath koi bhai
maqtal mein tum se milne phir aayega dobara
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar aake seene lag jao aao beti
mumkin hai aisa mauqa tum phir na pao beti
shayad ke ye taqaza kar paaye na dobara
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt ghar se nikle mera janaza zainab
tum ho shabihe zahra baahar na aana zainab
dekhe jo koi tum ko kaise kare gawara
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
afraz o shadman ye beti se bole maula
ruqsat ki ye ghadi hai mera hai tum se waada
har ek qadam pe beti tere saath saath hoga
zainab tumhara baba
bole ali ye ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zakhm bohat gehra ab jee nahi payega
zainab tumhara baba
alwida zainab alwida zainab
alwida alwida alwida zainab

items.title: Ay shaam ke musafir
items.body:
ay shaam ke musafir manzil teri kahan hai
zanjeer hai badan par zakhmon se khoon rawan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
be parda aaj zainab darbar jaa rahi hai
sajjad par khudaya ye kaisa imtehan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shehr e bewafa ye hai inqilaab kaisa
kufe ki shaahzadi kufe may be-amaan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
sad haif ke musalman baithe hai kursiyon par
jakda hua rasan may bemaar saarban hai
ay shaam ke musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum gir gaye zameen par amma bachao hum ko
oonton se girne waale bachon ki ye fughan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai shaam ki musafat tay kar ke aa gaya hoo
rauze pe mustafa ke sajjad ka bayaan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...

zainab ki be-ridayi pe chup hai kyun zamana
is waqt kalmago ki insaniyat kahan hai
ay shaam ke musafir...

hargiz na chup sakegi ye ran ki dastan hai

items.title: Baba idhar na
items.body:
hua ye shor ke ghode se gir gaye akbar
hussain aaye hai maqtal mein ghutniyo chal kar
sar apne laal ka zaanu pe shaah ne rakkha
zaeef baap ye kadiyal jawan se bola
rakha hai haath kaleje pe kyun mere beta
hata le haath ke ab phat raha hai dil mera
hata ke haathon ko kehne laga pisar baba
jo ho sakega to na dekhna idhar baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bole akbar apne baba se idhar na dekhna
ay mere baba mera zakhmi jigar na dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki khaatir bada hi sakht hai bete ka gham
naujawan hoon jis ghadi baba mera niklega dam
mera chehra us ghadi mere pidar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
door hat jaana mere seene se barchi khaynch kar
khoon niklega uchal kar mere seene se agar
dil to tadpega bahot baba magar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok kar akbar ko sarwar ne kaha mere hilal
imtihan e sabr hai ye baap ka ay mere laal
ab mujhe kuch dayr ay mere pisar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasteen apni chadha kar jab mai khaynchunga sina
waasta tujhko tere baba ka ay kadiyal jawan
meri jaanib ay mere noor e nazar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kiya qaime ka rukh akbar ne rokar ye kaha
doobta hai karbala mein chaand ay amma tera
chaand ki jaanib kabhi ab umr bhar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hichkiyan jab maut ki aayi to bola naujawan
aap par qurban ho akbar ay mere baba jaan
godh ke paale ka ye mushkil safar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay surani ro pada dil maine jis dam ye likha
aakhri saanson mein di sughra ko akbar ne sada
ab mera rasta behen shaam o sehar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...

items.title: Bhare darbar may
items.body:
bhare darbar mein zainab ne sada di ghazi
teri khwahar ko kisi ne na rida di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala kya thi hai kya shaam ye mujhse poocho
sakhti har deesh e ayyam ye mujhse poocho
sola sau meel ne dunya hi mita di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baaghi ki behan kehke bulaya mujhko
kya bataun tujhe kis tarha sataya mujhko
yun mohamed ki nawasi ko saza di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon ne likhi tehreer jale daaman par
dard hote gaye tasveer jale daaman par
aisi haalat hai sakina ki bana di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha jab khoon mein tar fatema jaaya maine
bhai ki laash pe tha khud ko giraya maine
maine allah ko ya tujhko sada di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tez khanjar se kahin tez hai nazron ki chuban
ab nishan daal chuki meri kalayi mein rasan
aane jaane ki na thi behan ye aadi ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
saikdon kursi nasheen baithe hai darbar mein dekh
teri khwahar hai ghiri majmeine aghyaar mein dekh
karbala shaamiyon ne shaam mein laa di ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghair ki nazron se zainab ko chupane ke liye
apni maajayi ka parda sa banane ke liye
nauke naiza se kehef sar ne sunaadi ghazi
bhare darbar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
maaf karna hai unhe ahsan o abid hai kahan
kal haqeeqat mein dhale aaj hai dono ka gumaan
kaash ho hashr mein ek ye bhi manadi ghazi
bhare darbar mein...

items.title: Ek behan bhai ke
items.body:
haye hamsheer e raza
ya masooma
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr e masooma e qum se ab bhi aati hai sada
ek behan bhai ke laashe pe na jaane paayi
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi shehr e khurasan mein bulwaye gaye
baani e zulm o jafa zulm se kab baaz aaye
tumko mamoon ne kyun zehr khila kar maara
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shehenshah e watan tumne bigada kya tha
mere pardesi aqi tera sahara kya tha
qum mein mai tanha rahi tum thay toos mein tanha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr ne apna asar jis ghadi choda hoga
kat gaya hoga mere bhai kaleja tera
kitni takleef hui hogi ghareebul ghurba
qabr e masooma e qum se...

aap seene pe rakhe haath tadapte honge
bad naseebi ye meri mujhko bulaate honge
na wahan jaa saki mai tu na behan tak pahuncha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai teri laash pe hoti to ye nauha karti
kam se kam tere janaze ki to zeenat hoti
mere bhai ye magar mere muqaddar mein na tha
qabr e masooma e qum se...

kya musafir ko kabhi zehr e dagha milta hai
jab safar mein koi pardesi guzar jaata hai
yaad aa jaata hai hamshakle payambar bhaiya
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse behtar kayi kismat thi mere jadda ki
laashe shabbir thi aur saani e zehra bhi thi
kam se kam bhai ki mayyat ko behan ne dekha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye irfan na tha mera muqaddar aisa
kya mubarak tera kam hoga ye nauha mera
mai bhi tanha thi kahin bhai kahin tha tanha
qabr e masooma e qum se...
