items.title: Haye muslim ke dono
items.body:
tiflaan e muslim ibne aqeel
<<DIVIDER>>
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai dar badar
<<DIVIDER>>
dono kufe ki galiyon se anjaan hai
inko koi thikaana bhi milta nahi
pyaase rehte hai pani bhi milta nahi
bhooke rehte hai khaana bhi milta nahi
rote rehte hai shaam o sahar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chup ke karte hai din raat dono basar
darr ke maare ye ek pal bhi sote nahi
dhoondte hai sitamgar inhe har jagah
zor se darr ke maare ye rote nahi
zaalimon ka hai har waqt darr
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khairiyat koi baba ki milti nahi
dono bhai tadapte hai ye soch kar
roke kehte hai baba ko kya ho gaya
kyun na aaye wo lene hamari khabar
kaise baba ke bin jaaye ghar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath rakhne koi sar pe aata nahi
koi aakar ke himmat badhata nahi
thokarein kha rahe hai kayi roz se
koi yasrab ka rasta bataata nahi
dekhte hai idhar aur udhar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise honge mere laal is fikr mein
us taraf hai pareshan dono ki maa
maamta ko kahin chain aata nahi
roke bacchon ki furqat mein khoti hai jaan
aur ye ro rahe hai idhar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsini hai musafir hai pardes hai
waqt kaisa ye zahra ke pyaron pe hai
koi kufe mein deta nahi aasra
ye sitam murtaza ke dularon pe hai
be-watan hai ye jaaye kidhar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
leke haaris taraayi pe jis dam gaya
kaatne dono bacchon ka sookha gala
dono bhai bahot roye mil kar galay
aur dono ne mil kar ye nauha padha
amma ab hum na aayenge ghar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye waiz wo manzar qayamat ka tha
roye abbas e ghazi bhi be-saakhta
ho gaya us ghadi ek mehshar bapa
jab ali shaahe waala ne ro kar kaha
ab nahi aayenge laut kar
haye muslim ke dono pisar
shehre kufa mein hai...

items.title: Hussain hote hai
items.body:
dilon ki ghair hai haalat kaho khuda hafiz
luta ke ashkon ki daulat kaho khuda hafiz
hai aaj roz e qayamat kaho khuda hafiz
bujhi hai shamme imamat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat kaho khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
musafiron ka moharram manalo ahle aza
jo aag dil mein lagi hai bujhalo ahle aza
tum apni aankhon mein aansu sajalo ahle aza
hai ek raat ki zehmat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sayyeda se hai waada usay wafa kar do
aza e sipte payambar par dil fida kar do
gham e hussain manane ka haq ada kar do
nahi to hogi shikayat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
baha ke ashk dil e fatema ko shaad karo
dil e rasool ki poori har ek muraad karo
laga tha seena e akbar pa zakhm yaad karo
milegi qalb ko raahat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
alam utha ke alamdar ko karo ruqsat
zameen pa baith kar beemar ko karo ruqsat
saron ko peet kar sardar ko karo ruqsat
bana ke nanhi si turbat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajao nanha sa taboot sheh ke asghar ka
alam uthao padho marsiya bahattar ka
saron pe taaziya rakho nabi ke dilbar ka
yehi hai ajre risalat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
udao khaak saron par hussain jaate hai
lutao ashkon ke gauhar hussain jaate hai
hamare ghar se bahattar hussain jaate hai
baha ke ashk e nidamat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
aza e shaah ki raunaq jo ghar se jayegi
alam ki yaad hamein saal bhar satayegi
uthega taaziya ghar se to saat jayegi
imambadon ki zeenat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bujha charaagh to tareek ye zamana hua
udaas udaas mere ghar ka aashiana hua
rasool zada suye karbala rawana hua
rasool e paak ki ummat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadayein aati hai reh reh ke saare aalam se
sukoon milta hai dil ko hussain ke gham se
magar hussain ki khidmat na ho saki hum se
dilon mein reh gayi hasrat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
raza na haath se choote hussain ka daaman
sada barasta rahe aansuon ka ye saawan
aza e sheh se mehekta raha mera gulshan
na kam ho sheh ki mohabbat kaho khuda hafiz
hussain hote hai ruqsat...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Islam ko fana se
items.body:
islam ko fana se bachaya hussain ne
qasre yazeediyat ko giraya hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re hifazat e millat ka ehtemam
toofan mein charagh ko jalaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khushboo usi ki phaili hai saare jahan mein
jo phool karbala mein khilaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
paigham jo nabi ne sunaya tamaam umr
sab kuch wo ek din mein sunaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kaam ambiya e salaf se na ho saka
kis shaan se wo kar ke dihkaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber ka dar uthana to kuch aur baat thi
laasha pisar jawan ka uthaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
katwa diya sar apna bade shaukh se magar
baatil ke aage sar na jhukaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek se poochte thay mera chand hai kidhar
jab ran mein naujawan ko na paaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chehre pe mal ke asghar e masoom ka lahoo
kya hai maqaam e sabr dikhaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se apne qabr bana kar sagheer ki
pani ke badle ashk bahaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayar bana ke aale rasool e anaam ka
rutba tera viqar badhaya hussain ne
islam ko fana se...
items.author: Viqar Nagri

items.title: Jawani to ali akbar
items.body:
jawani to ali akbar luta di
magar islam ki khuwat badha di
jawani to ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
azadaro tumhare aansuon ne
bahisht o khuld ki kheemat badha di
jawani to ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap kar gir pade jhoole se asghar
hussain ibne ali kaisi sada di
jawani to ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali asghar ne ran may muskurakar
yazeedi fauj may halchal macha di
jawani to ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha bano ne asghar ki lehad par
hamay kis jurm ki beta saza di
jawani to ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke naam par sarwar ne ran may
kamayi zindagi bhar ki luta di
jawani to ali akbar…

items.title: Kaise na nikle aankh
items.body:
kaise na nikle aankh se aansu
aur honton se haye
mere nabi ka pyara nawasa
sajde may maara jaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dharti kya aakash bhi larze
dard se nadiya karwat badle
pyasa baalak pani ke badle
teer gale par khaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon may kohraam macha hai
akbar akbar ek sada hai
paala hua athara baras ka
seene pa barchi khaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti zameen par laash padi hai
aisi shaadi nahi suni hai
khoon ki boondon se qasim ka
sehra goondha jaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aake madine chain na paaya
ro ke guzaara saara zamana
bhai ki baatein karti zainab
qabr e nabi par jaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat ka sannata hai darona
hoo ka jangal koi na apna
laash se lipti bali sakina
roye aur ghabraye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may dooba chappa chappa
maara gaya hai shayad saqqa
yasrib ka shehzada dekho
nehr pa dauda jaaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere aansu wo hai aansu
mahir ajr e payambar aansu
ho jo kisi ke aise aansu
saamne mere aaye
kaise na nikle aankh se...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Kazim ka hai janaza
items.body:
kazim ka hai janaza baghdad ke pul par
rone ko aayi zehra baghdad ke pul par
<<DIVIDER>>
pacheeswi rajab ko taboot hai ye kaisa
dooba hua lahoo may zanjeer may hai jakda
hai teen din se rakha baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
haroon ne na-jaane kaisa zehar diya hai
tan paash paash haye kazim ka ho gaya hai
gathri may aaye maula baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta imam ka hai baba imam ka hai
sheh ki tarha se is pe ghurbat ki inteha hai
be-gor o be-kafan tha baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis be-watan ki mayyat mazdoor ne uthayi
mayyat pe jis padar ki beti bhi ro na paayi
roti hai us ko dunya baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
utre badan ke tukde zanjeer may lipat kar
masooma dekhti to mar jaati wo wahin par
kis haal may hai baba baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ki laadli pe chauda baras jo roya
abid ko saath leke karne ko us pe girya
aati hai khud sakina baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hai jab janaza haye saathwe ali ka
karne ko us pe girya aati hai bibi zehra
logon adab se aana baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kazmayn jao kazim ka gham manane
ay arsalan o mesum wajib hua hai tum pe
taboot tum uthana baghdad ke pul par
kazim ka hai janaza...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Kisko doo mai lori
items.body:
kis ko doo mai lori
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar mera reh gaya ran mein
maa ye ro kar boli
kis ko doo mai lori
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban cha gayi ban mein
mera dil ghabraye
ghar nahi aaya asghar mera
phail gayi tareekhi
kis ko doo mai lori...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum nahi aaye tum nahi aaye
kitna pukara maine
maa se khafa kya ay shehzaade
yun hota hai koi
kis ko doo mai lori...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja mere asghar aaja
rooth gaya kyun beta aa
ujde ban mein nauha kuna hai
maa phailaye jholi
kis ko doo mai lori...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko kahan mai dhoondne jaaun
tujhko kahan se laaun
meri godhi chod ke tu ne
basti door basaali
kis ko doo mai lori...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere bina is dukhiya maa ko
kaise bhala chain aaye
tera jhoola bhi soona hai
meri godh bhi sooni
kis ko doo mai lori...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne watan se door yahan par
karbobala ke ban mein
kho gaya mera laal kahin par
reh gayi jholi khaali
kis ko doo mai lori...
<<DIVIDER>>
gohar yehi kehte kehte
mar gayi maa asghar ki
godh mein apni kis ko sulaan
kis ko doo mai lori
kis ko doo mai lori...

items.title: Mai kinte teer nikalu
items.body:
lipat ke shaah se kehti hai fatema ro ke
mere hussain mai kitne teer nikaloo tumko chain milay
<<DIVIDER>>
bata hussain zyada hai dard kis jaa par
ke maa nikaal le wo teer ya ali keh kar
tadapna dekha nahi jaata ab to maadar se
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ko pyar se athara saal paala hai
usi ke seene pe zaalim ne naiza maara hai
jawan ke seene se khaynchi hai khud sina tune
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na haath pehlu se utha na tham sake aansoo
tumhe to yaad hai zakhmi huwa mera pehlu
chupa na paoge pehlu ka dard ab maa se
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe rakha hai sada apni cha'on may maine
bala ki dhoop hai maqtal may ay mere bache
tumhari laash pe saaya karoongi baalon se
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaza ne tujhse mujhe kamsini may cheen liya
zamana hogaya tujhse milay huwe beta
lagaloo phir tujhe seene to mujhko chain milay
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
naseeb tak na huwa jalti khaak ka bistar
damay akheer tumhara badan hai teeron par
tumhe ye teer tadapne talak nahi dete
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain bolay mubarak ye maa se rote huwe
ay maa nikaal lo bas teer mere pehlu se
jabeen ho sajde may jis waqt mera dum nikle
mere hussain mai...
items.author: Mubarak

items.title: Mere baba ke zuljana
items.body:
jab karbobala mein sare shabbir kata
zuljana e shahe wala bhi buka karta raha
uske bhi teer lage baah kati zeen dhala
aise aalam mein suye qaima e shabbir chala
dekh kar usko sakina bhi fughan karne lagi
haye baag ghode ki pakad kar ye bayan karne lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
mere baba ke zuljana
kya meri yateemi ki tu laaya hai khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
kar yaad ke samjhaya tha tujhko dame ruqsat
kha jayegi is dil ko mere baap ki furqat
mai roti rahi aur kiya tune safar
mere baba ke zuljana...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay tujhe baba mere asme wafadar
ye kaisi wafa tune dikhayi mere ghamkhwar
chod aaya unhe dashte bala mein kyunkar
mere baba ke zuljana...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dekh mere baalon mein hai khaake yateemi
ab seene pe har saans bhi dushwaar hai meri
aankhon mein meri dekh zara gham ka asr
mere baba ke zuljana...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai roti rahi aur tujhe tars na aaya
le dekh mere sar se utha baap ka saaya
seene pe mujhe kaun sulayega magar
mere baba ke zuljana...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khaake bayaban bani mera muqaddar
ab cheen ke le jayenge bunde ye sitamgar
hai daaghe yateemi hi aseeri ki khabar
mere baba ke zuljana...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khaak ke bistar pe mujhe sona padega
kya neendh mujhe aayegi tune nahi socha
jaagungi shab o roz yehi keh keh kar
mere baba ke zuljana...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaadare cheenenge layeen qaime jala kar
ammu ko bulaungi kabhi baba ko rokar
cheenenge udoo jab mere kaano se gohar
mere baba ke zuljana...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shadman mazhar bhi likhe kaise wo manzar
dam toda qalam ne bhi isi baat ko likh kar
baba jo nahi hai to jiyun mai kyunkar
mere baba ke zuljana...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Mujhe qaidi samajh
items.body:
mujhe qaidi samajh nahi shireen
kar ghaur zara mai zainab hoo
tere shehr mein dekh ye haal hua
nahi sar pe rida mai zainab hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
kar yaad wasiyat bhai ki
mehmaan banenge hum tere
pehchan mujhe in baalon se
chehre pe pade hai jo mere
dil gham se phata jaata hai mera
kar koi dawa mai zainab hoo
mujhe qaidi samajh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis shehr ki mai shehzadi thi
aayi hoo wahan qaidi ban kar
quran ki tilawat karta hai
wo dekh mere bhai ka sar
pehchan mujhe kya aur kahoo
ab iske siwa mai zainab hoo
mujhe qaidi samajh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazron ko utha kar dekh zara
naizon pe shaheedon ke sar hai
bemaar bhatija saath mere
aur ahle haram be-chadar hai
aulaad e ali hone ki yahan
paayi hai saza mai zainab hoo
mujhe qaidi samajh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shireen kya kya batlaun tujhe
jo zulm sahay hai raahon mein
sunti hai yateemon ke naale
kya karb inki aahon mein
sehti hoo jafayein ummat ki
be-jurm khata mai zainab hoo
mujhe qaidi samajh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum aal e mohamed hai shireen
ye kunba koi aur nahi
tu ghaur se dekhle chehron ko
pairon se tere niklegi zameen
ye hai laila ye bano hai
ye hai farwa mai zainab hoo
mujhe qaidi samajh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar roodad ye zainab ki
sun jar shireen behosh hui
kehti thi peet ke sar apna
hae maut mujhe kyun na aayi
jab mujhse meri aaqa zaadi
zainab ne kaha mai zainab hoo
mujhe qaidi samajh nahi...
items.author: Safdar Abbas

items.title: Nehr pe hazrate
items.body:
nehr pe hazrate abbas ke laashe ke khareeb
ek behan khastatan o kushta jigar khufta naseeb
benawa bekas o beparda o lachaar o ghareeb
lekin uspar bhi mohamad ke gharane ki nakheeb
zard chehre pe hai bikhre hue balon ki naqaab
jaise juz daan mein lipti hui ismat ki kitab
<<DIVIDER>>
ja baja jism pe hai khoon ke dhabbon ke nishan
jaise peeri mein uthayi ho koi laashe jawan
waram ankhon mein kamal kham hai to khamosh zaban
zapt ka phir bhi ye aalam hai ke girya na fughan
kaun bibi hai jo is tarha se jaan khoti hai
jis tarha laash pe bhai ke behan roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mehwiyat ka hai ye aalam ke nazar hat'ti nahi
choomti hai kabhi shaane to kabhi jhuk ke jabeen
kabhi tharra'ta hai laasha kabhi maqtal ki zameen
khauf hai arshe ilaahi na ulat jaye kahin
laashe abbas pe ye dukhtare hyder to nahi
dekhiye dekhiye ye zainab e muztar to nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti hai utho saahib e shamsheer utho
hyder e asr utho waqt ke shabbir utho
aale tatheer ki soyi hui taqdeer utho
kaat do abide dilgeer ki zanjeer utho
aag hi aag hai bhadki hui qaimon mein tamaam
chin gayi sar se rida jati hoo mai suye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
shaane kya tere kate band gayi baazu mein rasan
sar pe kya gurz laga hogayi beparda behan
teri kya jaan gayi maare gaye shaah e zaman
fasle gul aisi luti hogaya barbaad chaman
chain se soyenge sab ahle sitam raaton ko
khaufe aada se na so payenge hum raaton ko
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e ruqsat hai mere sher ijazat de mujhe
khaafila chalne ko tayyar hai himmat de mujhe
khilmane kufr jala doo wo hararat de mujhe
yani taqreer mein shamsheer ki khaslat de mujhe
ran mein shamsheer chalana to mere kaam nahi
shaam o kufa na ulat doo to mere naam nahi
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Aao adab se hydere
items.body:
aao adab se hyder e safdar ke shehr mein
jaana agar ho izn e payambar ke shehr mein
<<DIVIDER>>
jee chaahta hai waadi e makkah se poochlun
bigda kahan se aayi payambar ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
inkaar se hussain ne aisi lagayi aag
sholay uthe yazid e sitamgar ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye inquilaab dekha hai naad e ali baad
darwaza toota jaata hai khyber ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeze mein sameint ke darya ko le gaya
hyder ek aur dekha hai hyder ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se ali ne toda hai josh e jihaad mein
darwaza phir saja nahi khyber ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
milta nahi hai fauj e ababeel ka jawab
mabood e kayenat ke lashkar ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr aaya aur ho gaya sadqe hussain par
khatre ki kya thi zaat samandar ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
yak jaan hai aaj panjetan e paak dekhiye
hai kayenat noor ki chadar ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hai la-fata ke qaside ke saath saath
talwaar utar ke aagayi hyder ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushman ke dil jalaata hua aasman se
taara utar ke aa gaya hyder ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnalabi ne hadh ke jigar phaad daale hai
ek paak kali ye phool ki pathar ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
<<DIVIDER>>
mahir najaf ki khaak se hum apne waaste
kaaba bana ke baithe hai hyder ke shehr mein
aao adab se hydere...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Abbas hai jalaal
items.body:
ay shaamiyon furaat ko laazim hai chodna
abbas hai jalaal mein rasta na rokna
<<DIVIDER>>
sher e khuda ka sher hai salaar e fauj hai
is ke qadam ko choom ke darya ko auj hai
isko nazar mila ke na taa dayr dekhna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ki har sifaat ka aeena-daar hai
be-taygh apni zaat mein khuid zulfeqar hai
tum iske saamne kabhi ooncha na bolna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chaahe cheen sakta hai tum se hayaat ko
ulte misaal e aas ki ye kayenaat ko
maidan mein isay dam e paikaar dekhna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khath kyanch kar zameen pe lashkar ko rok de
chalte huwe ye maut ke khanjar ko rok de
aata hai isko waqt ke khyber ko todna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaahe to ek mashk mein darya utaar le
rukh suye qaimagah samandar ka mod de
aata hai isko sang se pani nichodna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu qalam huwe bhi to ooncha rakha alam
darye se is jari ne hataye nahi qadam
aata nahi dilayr ko maidan chodna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ki aas zaamin e chadar hai ye jari
hai wakf e kayenat e wafa iski zindagi
is se kalaam karne se pehle ye sochna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
iske alam pe naad e ali ka hisaar hai
mashkeeza is alam pe wafaon ka haar hai
isko nigaah e saaqi e kausar se dekhna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki raza hai raza e hussain se
rehaan hukme faatahe badr o hunain se
bekhauf hum ne seekha hai jumla ye bolna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Aeliya hai ali
items.body:
ali aeliya hai ali
<<DIVIDER>>
wo faqre do aalam wo noore mujassam
ali haq ka mehrab ali dam hama dam
ali aulia hai ali aulia hai ali aeliya hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo haq ki taraf hai namazon ki saf hai
wo shaahe najaf hai wo deen ka sharaf hai
wo haajat rawa hai wo haajat rawa hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali raahe mushkil ali haq ki manzil
ali deen e kaamil ali shamme mehfil
khuda ki ataa hai khuda ki ataa hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo husne payambar wo mehwe munawar
shuja'at ka paikar wo fattahe khyber
shahe la fata hai shahe la fata hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali mera qibla ali mera kaaba
ali mera maula ali mera aaqa
wo mushkil kusha hai wo mushkil kusha hai
ali aeliya hai ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shabbir o shabbar chale peet'te sar
uthi binte hyder giri sar se chadar
haram berida hai haram berida hai
ali aeliya hai ali...

items.title: Baba jaan
items.body:
haye jab raah e shaam mein
dekha ghareeb baap ka sar
nok e sina par to sakina ne
tadap kar ye kiya tha nauha
baba baba baba baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jab koi yateema kehta hai
mujhe aap bahot yaad aate hai
kab hoga safar khatm ye mera
raahon mein kaanton par
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se rasan mein ye gala hai
baba mera dam ghut raha hai
mushkil hai ye safar ay baba
mai is safar mein mar na jaaun
aakar sambhalo gir na jaaun
khaak par dekho na panjon par
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan

baad aap ke jab shimr aaya
baba mera daaman jalaya
cheene mere gauhar ay baba
deti rahi ro kar duhaai
baalon se kheencha jab mai aayi
laash par zakhmi hai mera sar
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle to mujhko ek qadam bhi
chalne nahi deta tha bhai
kya wo bhool gaya ay baba
baba teri jis par nazar hai
haan wo mere bhai ka sar hai
poocho zara sunta nahi kyun akbar
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
sab dekhte hai bas tamasha
jo bhi mila dekho tamacha
usne maara mujhe ay baba
kab tak reha hogi sakina
yaad aa raha hai ab madina
baba mujhe jaaungi mai kab ghar
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ro kar sakina ne sada di
seene pe sone ki hoon aadi
neend aayi hai mujhe ay baba
mai khaak par so na sakungi
bas ye sada deti rahungi
baba tujhe godhi mein lo aakar
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasi ko sab ne yun sataya
pani dikhaya aur bahaya
kya kya maine saha ay baba
naize se ammu ka gira sar
jab shaam waalon se tadap kar
maine kaha pani mujhe do laa kar
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein manzar jo dekha
zeeshan wo kaise likhega
ay irfan e aza ay baba
beti ne ro ke jab sada di
baba ka sar godhi mein uski
aa gaya kehti rahi ro ro kar
chalte chalte mai thak gayi hoon
baba jaan

items.title: Barsare karbala
items.body:
haye kunba rasool e anaam ka
khanwada payambar ka loota gaya
barsare karbala barsare karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ki jaan tha akbar e naujawan
muttaqi paarsa raunaqe khaandan
hamshabihe mizaaj o shahe mursala
khush mizaaji pe garweeda saara jahan
aur phir uske seene pe naiza laga
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

saath zainab ke do laal bhi aaye thay
jinki khaahish thi ye subhe ashoor se
kaash unko bhi ran ki ijazat milay
lashkare shaam unke hunar dekhle
aur phir unki laashon pe matam hua
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

izn jab sheh se qasim ko mil na saka
laake baazu ka taveez sheh ko diya
padhke khat bhai ka khoob girya kiya
izn paa kar bhatija bhi ran ko chala
aur ghodon ki taapon se raundha gaya
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

sochte thay ali baat kaise badhe

barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

aur phir usko payka'n ne zibha kiya
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

keh raha tha musalsal pisar saad ka
asr ka waqt nazdeek tar aagaya
kya namazein khaza sab ki karwaega
kaat ay shimr jaldi se sheh ka gala
aur phir sheh ki gardan pe khanjar chala
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

chadare bibiyon ke saron se chini
sirf qaime nahi saari cheezein jali
bar bariyat ne saari hadein paar ki
nafs kaunain ki jaise ruk si gayi
phir ghareebon ki shaam aayi din dhal gaya
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

jaane kaise jahan se jo pani mila
sabse pehle sakina ko dhoonda gaya
aur jab usko kooze mein pani diya
maa se poocha ke asghar kahan hai mera
phir chali suye maqtal wo karti buka
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

zainabe benawa hoke zainulliba
maqsade shaah dono ki nazron mein tha
aur tahaffuz shariyat ka aise hua
ke maqtal pe sab ne tayammum kiya
farz shahid sabhi ne ada kar diya
barsare karbala barsare karbala
khanwada payambar ka...

items.title: Darbar kaise jaun
items.body:
mai fatema ki dukhtar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai chadar darbar kaise jaaun
<<DIVIDER>>
qatil ka saamna hai kitni kathin ghadi hai
darbar saj raha hai zainab abhi khadi hai
ek ek pal hai doo bhar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haakim kahan kahan ke kursi nasheen honge
royegi binte zehra aur khush layeen honge
peshe nazar hai mehshar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai kahan hai zinda pehra jo aake dete
hote agar bhatije halqe mein mujhko lete
abbas hai na akbar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
narghe mein ashkiyan ke hoga mera ta'arruf
mai kuch na keh sakungi uff meri bekasi uff
maut aa na jaaye ghut kar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar ke ghamon se hasti bikhar chuki hai
darbar kaise jaaye zainab to mar chuki hai
baalon se moo chupa kar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis shehre bewafa mein laayi hai mujhko ghurbat
apne ko mai chipa loon paaun jo koi turbat
wo bhi nahi mayassar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil bahot hai lekin abid ye gham utha lo
zanjeer e zulm thaamo tauq e sitam sambhalo
haan khaynchlo ye langar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai har sitam sahungi dhaayega jo zamana
bhai se jo kiya hai waada hai wo nibhana
ab ye kahun to kyun kar darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir qareeb e baabe sa'at pe zalzala tha
nayyar yahin pe zainab ne marsiya padha tha
nauha hai har zaban par darbar kaise jaaun
sar par nahi hai...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Ek bemaar ko tum
items.body:
ek bemaar ko tum itna rulaya na karo
zaalimo aale mohamed ko sataya na karo
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddate dhoop se abid ka badan jalta hai
garm zanjeer ko tum itna hilaya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
<<DIVIDER>>
natawan hai mera bemaar ye zainab ne kaha
tauq o zanjeer mein abid ko phiraya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
<<DIVIDER>>
do qadam chalte hi bemaar ko ghash aata hai
paon mein chaale hai abid ko chalaya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
<<DIVIDER>>
neend bemaar ko aati hai badi mushkil se
bediyan khaynch ke abid ko jagaya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
<<DIVIDER>>
maang lo bali sakina se ye bachi hai saqi
baaliyan khaynch ke kano se rulaya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule zainab e dilgeer hai bazaaron mein
berida aale mohamed ko phiraya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein phoot ke roti hai sakina bibi
baap ka sar usay har baar dikhaya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashmi rote hai irfan se nauha sun kar
munkiron rone do rone se rukaya na karo
ek bemaar ko tum...
items.author: Alamdar Hashmi

items.title: Ghar jaiyo zainab
items.body:
sheh ne kaha jab shaam se ghar jaaiyo zainab
sughra ko meri seene se liptaiyo zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
maange jo kaneezi mein sakina ko sitamgar
tu minnate kar kar usay chudwaiyo zainab
sheh ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil jaaye agar pani to sab pyason se pehle
pani meri sakina ko pilwaiyo zainab
sheh ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhe jo nishan rassi ke sughra dam e giryan
baazu mein rasan thi na ye farmiyo zainab
sheh ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil jaaye agar chadarein to sab bewon se pehle
chadar tu meri kubra ko pinwaiyo zainab
sheh ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil jaaye agar doodh to do koozon mein bhar ke
fateha mere asghar ki tu dilwaiyo zainab
sheh ne kaha...
items.author: Shakir Hussain

items.title: Haq ki azmat hai
items.body:
haq ki azmat hai azal se ghame shabbir ke haath
jao aur kar do qalam kaatibe taqdeer ke haath
<<DIVIDER>>
keh do dunya se koi aur thikana dhoonde
khuld to bik chuki ashke ghame shabbir ke haath
haq ki azmat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen ki uqda kushayi ka jab aaya hai khayaal
shaah ne choom liye zainab e dilgeer ke haath
haq ki azmat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye musalman bhala aaj musalman hote
bayyat e kufr ko bach jaate jo shabbir ke haath
haq ki azmat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash abbas ko ladne ki raza mil jaati
dekhti fauje adoo hyderi shamsheer ke haath
haq ki azmat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
itna nazuk tha nishana ke ghalat ho jaata
teer ki zad pe laraz jaate jo shabbir ke haath
haq ki azmat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kausar o khuld ki keemat se zyada dengi
bech do ashke aza maadare shabbir ke haath
haq ki azmat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala jaaye wasi dil mein tamanna hai magar
aabru apni tamanna ki hai taqdeer ke haath
haq ki azmat hai...
items.author: Wasi

items.title: Haye muslim ke pisar
items.body:
haye muslim ke pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
neem jaan rote rahe apni jaan khote rahe
kuch na faryad suni us sitamgar ne magar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin dekhi na suni ye ghareebul watani
taygh haaris ki chali kat gaye dono ke sar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
behre shaah e shohada dono bache ba khuda
apne baba ki tarha ho gaye khoon may tar
haye muslim ke pisar...

kaun kufe may bhala jaa ke muslim se kahe
nehr par maare gaye aap ke lakhte jigar
haye muslim ke pisar...

papliyan honton pe thi thay ghazab ke pyase
chal pade shehzade suye hauze kausar
haye muslim ke pisar...

roke zauja ne kaha ye hai be-jurm o khata
kuch taras kha haaris in pe ye zulm na kar
haye muslim ke pisar...

dono laashe ba khuda yun ba ghalgeer hui
jaise milta ho galay aake suraj se qamar

items.title: Hussain hussain hussain
items.body:
jangal pahaad karte hai nad-e-ali ali
mushkil ko meri hal karo mushkil kusha ali
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ruksat ko ahlebait-e-nabi mein gaye imam
qadmon pe lotne lagi saydaniya tamam
wo shor al-firaaq ka wo yaas ke kalaam
bache bhi sar patak'te thay le le ke sheh ka naam
rote thay yun to lipte hue sab hussain se
lekin kaleje phat'te thay zainab ke bain se
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt tha ajab sheh-e-deen par hoojume yaas
dhalna wo do pahar ka wo aandhi wo loo o pyaas
laashe pade hue thay azeezo ke aas paas
rokar falak ko dekhte thay shaah-e-haq janas
ut'ta tha darde dil to qadam ladkhadate thay
farmake ya-ali-e-wali baith jaate thay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke sar ko chaati se lipta ke ye kaha
batlao kya irada hai ay mere mehlekha
daste adab ko jod ke bola wo bawafa
pyasi sakina marti hai ya shaah-e-karbala
guzre hai teen din yuhin is pusht pa par
gar izn ho to pani ko ja'un faraat par
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
yan chad chuke thay ghode pe abbas-e-haq shanas
aayi sada bhatiji ki sunte hi dar ke paas
boli ye mashq de ke sakina ba dard-o-yaas
qurban ammu jaan bujhado hamari pyaas
phat'ta hai dil atash se kaleja kabab hai
saqqayi kijiye ke ye kaare sawab hai
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne kaha ke mera faqr hai ye kaam
bibi tumhare baap ka adna hai ye ghulam
di tumne aabru mujhe ay dukhtare imam
ab hogaya jahan mein bahishti hamara naam
kausar mai samjhu dosh pe gar mashke aab ho
tum bhi dua karo ke chacha kaamiyab ho
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
chaati tak usne pani ko dekha jo ek baar
ghode ka dil hua sifat-e-mauje beqarar
hasrat se moo phira ke nazar ki suye sawaar
bole ye baag jod ke abbas e naamdar
tu pile ay faraz ke bahot tishna-kaam hai
hum par to be-hussain ye pani haram hai
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bouchaar yak-bayak hui teero ki hai ghazab
tayghe chali aqab se shareeron ki hai ghazab
ye shakl do jahan ke ameeron ki hai ghazab
bujhne na paayi pyaas sagheero ki hai ghazab
naize thay aur chand se pehlu diler ke
teero ne chaan dala safeene ko sher ke
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
shaane se yun ubhal ke baha khoon ke al-amaan
thirra ke jhoomne lage abbas-e-naujawan
machli ki tarha haath to reti pe tha tapan
lekin juda na hoti thi qabze se ungliyan
de-dast hogayi thi jo is tafdari ke saath
talwar bhi tadapti thi daste jari ke saath
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
raste mein ladkhadate thay jab zouf se qadam
akbar sambhaal lete thay baba ko dam-ba-dam
farmate thay tadap ke pisar se shahe-umam
jo haal ho baja hai ke bhai ka hai alam
baazu padak ke dilbare zehra ko le chalo
beta chacha ki laash pe baba ko le chalo
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ghul pad gaya ke sheh ke alamdar haye haye
ay noore chasme hydare karaar haye haye
ay ibne fathima ke madadgaar haye haye
ay fauje sheh ke jaafare tayyaar haye haye
chote se haat rakh ke dile dard naak par
de maara sar ko bali sakina ne khaak par
hussain hussain hussain

items.title: Jee nahi payegi maa
items.body:
laasha e akbar pe hai ye umme laila ki fughan
jee nahi paaegi maa

khol de aankhein wagarna ay mere kadiyal jawan
jee nahi payegi maa
<<DIVIDER>>
hai teri be-noor aankhein ay mere noore nazar
ay mere lakhte jigar barchi mein hai tera jigar
ye qayamat se bada hai maamta ka imtehan
jee nahi payegi maa
laasha e akbar pe hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi mein tha ujaaala jis ke dam se dilruba
dekh kar jis ko savera roz hota tha mera
dekh kar chehra wohi ab bar sar e noke sina
jee nahi payegi maa
laasha e akbar pe hai ye...

fajr ka jab waqt hoga yaad aayegi teri
maa musalle par bhi tera gham manaane jayegi
jab tere lehje mein beta sun na payegi azan
jee nahi payegi maa
laasha e akbar pe hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine socha tha tera sehra sajana hai mujhe
maine socha tha tujhe dulha banana hai mujhe
le ke ye armaan dil ke jaaye to jaaye kahan
jee nahi payegi maa
laasha e akbar pe hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye na socha tha tujhe kaandhon pe sarwar layenge
pal mein athara baras yun raayegan ho jayenge
dekh kar tere jigar ka khoon seene se rawan
jee nahi payegi maa
laasha e akbar pe hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nahi hai hukm beta ye hai meri ilteja
kya kahun sughra se jaa kar bas mujhe itna bata
jab wo poochegi kahan hai mera bhai naujawan
jee nahi payegi maa
laasha e akbar pe hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash par bete ki yasir ghash pe ghash khaati thi wo
hodh mein aate hi phir behosh ho jaati thi wo
laash ke shaane hila kar de rahi thi ye azan
jee nahi payegi maa
laasha e akbar pe hai ye...

items.title: Kaise qaidi hai
items.body:
kaise qaidi hai qaid khane mein
hind khud dekh kar pareshan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk aankhon mein lab pe quran hai
kaise qaidi hai qaid khane mein
<<DIVIDER>>
malka e shaam mehwe hairat hai
khaak par noor ki jama'at hai
be ridaai se dil pasheman hai

<<DIVIDER>>
waqt rota hai gham naseebo par
jaane guzri hai kya ghareebo par
lamha lamha azeeyatein jaa hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm ashkon se dho rahe hai sabhi
karbala keh ke ro rahe hai sabhi
bas tasavvar mein ek biyaban hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
in pa gham ka pahaad toota hai
waqt ne haye kaise loota hai
chadarein hai na koi saaman hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ki aankhon se khoon hai jaari
mehwe girya hai bibiyan saari
kya hua sab ki godh veeran hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya nahi koi gham ke maaron ka
haal mat poocho be-saharon ka
chaak bachon ka bhi gareban hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise gham ki rida hai odhe huwe
sab hai jeene ki aas chode huwe
koi khwahish na koi armaan hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaifiyat hai ajeeb aahon mein
sab ki bheegi hui nigahon mein
ek ujda hua gulistan hai
kaise qaidi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar bekasi ka ye manzar
hind roti hai aamir o akhtar
saara zindan marsiya khwan hai
kaise qaidi hai...

items.title: Laila ki umeedon ka
items.body:
laila ki umeedon ka kya haal hua hoga

<<DIVIDER>>
laila ne tasavvur mein socha bhi na tha shayad
sar akbar e ghazi ka naize pe chada hoga
laila ki umeedon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras ka sin naize ki ani dil mein
dunya ne sitam aisa dekha na suna hoga
laila ki umeedon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dekh rahi hogi laila dar e qaime se
maadar ke kaleje ka kya haal hua hoga
laila ki umeedon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi jo lagi dil par awaaz di baba ko
bete ki sada sun kar kya haal hua hoga
laila ki umeedon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
andher jahan tha sab nazron mein shahe deen ke
laashe tak shahe waala kis tarha gaya hoga
laila ki umeedon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai tadapte hai seene pe sina khaake
zaqmi jigar jawaan ka barchi mein laga hoga
laila ki umeedon ka...

items.title: Mai kya karun
items.body:
tanhaai mein kulsoom pada karti thi nauha
mai kya karun mai saahibe aulaad nahi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor hai shabbir ka dam bharti hai maayein
islam pe beton ko fida karti hai maayein
ye mera muqaddar hai ki mai aaj hoon tanha
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon pe jo sheh layenge laashe ali akbar
aa jayengi laila dar e qaima pe tadap kar
bete ko dua dengi jo dekhengi kaleja
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab teer lagega to machal jayega baysheer
le aayenge maqtal se usay godh mein shabbir
yaad aayega bano ko hamesha koi jhoola
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
farwa ke liye kam nahi shabbar ki nishani
jee khol ke karlengi wo tab marsiya faani
pamaal shuda aayega jab bete ka laasha
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jurrat mein kisi se nahi kam aun o mohamed
sheron ki tarha todenge dam aun o mohamed
armaan dil e zainab ka bhi ho jayega poora
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kaash pisar aaj koi mera jo hota
is waqt wo shabbir pe qurban to hota
sar deta wo karti mai adaa shukr ka sajda
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki tarha asghare baysheer ki surat
katwaata wo sar dilbare shabbir ki surat
hota mere aulaad ka sar bhi sar e naiza
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek pal bhi mai ghairat ki sabab jee nahi paati
kya maadar e shabbir ko mai shakl dikhaati
abbas na banta meri jaanib se jo fidya
mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsoom ne tab maangi dua aamir o nayyar
mayoos na karna usay ay khaaliq e akbar
maange koi ab mere waseele se jo beta
mai kya karun...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Mere baba mere baba
items.body:
mere baba mere baba
bhai jab maara gaya aap kahan thay baba
teer asghar pe laga aap kahan thay baba
qatl abbas hua aap kahan the baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ye kehte hai ke hai naymate daawar pani
band karta hai kahan kaun kisi par paani
ye sitam ham pe hua aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase bachon ke liye jung jo abbas ne ki
aise yalghaar hue mashq e sakina na bachi
ek ek baazu kata aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya asghar sar e maidan to hua aur sitam
sukhe honton pe zuban usne phirayi jis dam
teer jab iske laga aap kahan the baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
mera dil-bande hasan jab nahi haara baba
is tarha milke sabon ne usay maara baba
laasha pamaal kiya aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shabbir hamara koi waris na raha
ashqiya aagaye qaimo mein hua hashr bapa
jab chini mere rida aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab har ek ehle sitam aag lagane aaya
itna sajjad tha bemaar ke utha na gaya
jal ke sab khaak hua aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke farmeina ali ne mere beti mat ro
aazmaish ye hai ham sab ki abhi sabr karo
dil magar kehta raha aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
mai to har gaam pe tha saat tumhare beti
chup tha bas marzi e mabood ke maare beti
tum ne ye kaise kaha aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kabhi chasme tasavvur se ye shabbar dekha
baap ko girya mein beti ke barabar dekha
haye kaisa tha gila aap kahan thay baba
mere baba…

items.title: Aao akbar sehra
items.body:
aao akbar sehra baandho
<<DIVIDER>>
koi masnad laa ke bichao
koi aanchal sar pe chao
koi kaajal surma laao
koi mehndi rang rachao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera laal sada aabaad rahe
dil maa behno ka shaad rahe
sukhi jug jug ye aulaad rahe
mere mann ki poori muraad rahe
koi naade ali dohrao
poshaak shahani laao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi chaadar amma zehra ki
koi pagdi laao nana ki
chalo behno aao akbar ki
akbar ke lagao ab mehndi
phoolon ki sej sajao
ye baam o dar mehkao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
phooloan ko aabe kausar se
dhulwa ke buzar o qambar se
ye sehra lagana tab sar se
jab abr najaf se aa barse
abbas ka parcham lao
saaye mein is ko bithao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi sughra ko paigham ye do
akbar ki behan tum shaad raho
aane ki sakat ho to aao
aur naig tum apna le jaao
bhaiya ke gale lag jaao
ghoongat dulhan ka uthao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai sakina khush ho kar
doolha jo bane bhaiya akbar
main naig mein maangoongi gauhar
sar rakh ke un ke seene par
haq mera mujhe dilwao
mujhe bunde naye pehnao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaah ye di haatif ne sada
ye zulm hua umme laila
seene mein laga us ke naiza
armaan tha jis ki shaadi ka
akbar ko kafan pehnao
zakhmon se khaak chudao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi hai kaleje mein tooti
haathon mein lagi khoon ki mehendi
sau tukde hui sehre ki ladi
sarwar pe qayamat ki hai ghadi
zainab ko hosh mein lao
lo farshe azaa ka bichao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
do qasid e sughra ko ye khabar
sughra ko bataye wo jaa kar
akbar to gaye suye kausar
kya takti hai sughra raah guzar
mat un se aas lagao
ab fateha un ki dilao
aao akbar sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan tujhe akbar ki qasam
mat rok abhi tu apna qalam
wo baat tujhe karna hai raqam
gham ahle aza ka jis se ho kam
akbar ka sehra sunao
khud tadpo aur tadpao
aao akbar sehra...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Alam ghazi ka
items.body:
baatil ka dam ghut'ta hai
ye jab bhi kahin uth'ta hai
alam ghazi ka alam ghazi ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ejaaz e atash dikhlata hai
mafhoome ata samjhata hai
ek mashk liye ye aata hai
aur abre karam barsata hai
jab lutf o karam karta hai
har jholi ko bharta hai
alam ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
roshan hai charaagh e haq jis se
wo iske pharere ki hai hawa
abbas se nisbat hai isko
har sar pe isi ke taaj e wafa
taufeeq e aza deta hai
paighame wafa deta hai
alam ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hairaan hai yusuf bhi jis par
paayi ha jawani bhi aisi
waliyon ki tarha ye chalta hai
khaamat hai farishton ki jaisi
jab majlis mein aata hai
kaunain pe cha jaata hai
alam ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ne wafa ke jalwon se
is tarha sajaya hai ye alam
taqreeb e halaf bardari mein
waliyon ne uthaya hai ye alam
paymana e salaari hai
minaar e wafadari hai
alam ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo haazir hona chaahte hai
darbar e imamat mein dil se
nazdeek bulata hai unko
panje se ishare kar kar ke
manzil ki khabar deta hai
khud zaade safar deta hai
alam ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab waqt kada aa jaata hai
shabbir ke ghamkharon ke liye
sheron ki tarha se uth'ta hai
maula ke azadaron ke liye
aandhi se ulajh padta hai
toofano se ladta hai
alam ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh gawahi deti hai
koi saani nahi is parcham ka
zinda hai agar beenayi teri
ay munkir ghaur se dekh zara
sab jhande hogaye thande
uncha hai khuda ke bande
alam ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re iska jaah o hasham
chauda sau baras ka hai ye alam
na ispe zaeefi aayi hai
na iski kamar mein aaya hai kham
azmat ka nishan hai gohar
sadiyon se jawan hai gohar
alam ghazi ka...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Aulade payamabar pa
items.body:
aulaad e payambar pa ajab jor o jafa hai
zanjeer may jakdi hui ab aale aba hai
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kar na sakega koi islam ko uryan
islam ab odhe huwe zainab ki rida hai
aulaad e payambar pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek ke sar par to nazar aati hai chadar
sar nange faqad khaafila e aale aba hai
aulaad e payambar pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shaam ke zindan may ye karbobala may
lagta hai ke sharminda bhatiji se chacha hai
aulaad e payambar pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
oonton se giray tifl to koi na uthaye
ay saahib e aulaad kahin aisa hua hai
aulaad e payambar pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ke khulne ki jo karti thi duayein
wo qabr may band hogayi zindan khula hai
aulaad e payambar pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
phookon se mukhalif ki taqi kaise bujhegi
wo shamme aza jis ka nigehban khuda hai
aulaad e payambar pa...
items.author: Taqi Abedi

items.title: Ay shabihe mustafa
items.body:
ay shabihe mustafa akbar mere tum ho kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
baad tere karbala mein ek qayamat aa gayi
qatl sarwar hogaye aur shame ghurbat aa gayi
har taraf phaila huwa tha jalte qaimon ka dhuwan
ay shabihe mustafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt kaisa aa gaya aale nabi hai berida
durron se beemar par zaalim bhi karte hai jafa
gham mein tere ro rahe hai ye zameen o aasman
ay shabihe mustafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaano se behna ke tere ab talak hai khoon rawan
cheeni hai zaalim ne uske kanon se jo baaliyan
neel hai galon pe uske hai galay mein reesma
ay shabihe mustafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
tha bahut armaan mujhko la'un ghar teri dulhan
tere sar pe sehra baandhoo ay mere tashna dahan
koi bhi armaan mera poora na ho paya yahan
ay shabihe mustafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
baandh kar bara galon ko ek rasan mein behaya
qaid karke le gaye hum logon ko ehle jafa
dil mera phat'ta hai jab bhi sochti hoo wo samaan
ay shabihe mustafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
likha tha sughra ne khat mein ay mere akbar jawan
lene kyun aate nahi mujhko mere ay bhai jaan
poochegi sughra tujhe to kya kahegi us se maa
ay shabihe mustafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
paala tha jisne wo zainab gham mein tere roti hai
haye akbar haye akbar haye akbar kehti hai
tu batade aa ke mujhko kaise samjhayegi maa
ay shabihe mustafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye teri mujhse judaai hai bada mujhpe sitam
hashr tak bhoolegi na dunya ay beta tera gham
hai tera shayar ye ahmed aur hassan hai nauhaqan
ay shabihe mustafa…
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Baba jaan alwida
items.body:
baap ka ghar se taboot jis dam chala
haye beti ne ro kar padha marsiya
baba jaan alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon ke ashk aankhon se honge rawan
chain ek pal na payega ab dil mera
baba jaan alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ab talak mai tadapti thi maa ke liye
aap ki yaad aayegi ab raat din
sar pe maa baap dono ka saaya nahi
ye qayamat rulayegi ab raat din
ab to zainab hai aur ye yateemi ka gham
zindagi har qadam ab lagegi qaza
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke kehti thi zainab mere baba jaan
chain ek pal kahin ab na paungi mai
aap ka aur amma ki furqat ka gham
dono ek saath kaise uthaungi mai
ab nigahon mein chaaya rahega dhuaan
aur rulayega har dam khayaal aap ka
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam jab bhi yateemi ka sunti thi mai
kaamp jaata tha seene mein mera jigar
kaise rehte hai bacche pidar ke bina
dil dehelta tha is baat ko soch kar
mujhko himmat ki dekar ke jaayein dua
ab yateemi se zainab ka hai saamna
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard ki taygh se us ghadi ay pidar
haye mera kaleja to kat jayega
aap ke soone hujre mai jab aap ka
mujhko khaali musalla nazar aayega
aap ko dil tadap kar ke dega sada
sabr kaise karungi wahan mai bhala
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap kehte thay kufa badal jayega
lag raha hai wo din aagaya hai khareeb
ab yaqeen hogaya aap ke shehr mein
ek din hone waali hai zainab ghareeb
hai jahan meri shaahi usi shehr mein
qaid ho kar ke aaungi mai berida
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere baba jaan hum ne socha na tha
chod kar aap hum ko chale jayenge
baap ki wo nigahein mohabbat bhari
aaj ke baad bacche kahan payenge
mera abbas jaa karke dehleez par
kiske aane ka dekhega ab raasta
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye waiz hua ek mehshar bapa
ay ali jab ye zainab ne rokar kaha
roye hasnain o abbas sar peet kar
baap se jab beti ne ki ilteja
waqt e shaam e ghariban jo doon mai sada
aap aakar badhana mera hausla
baba jaan alwida...
baap ka ghar se...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Darbar ke diye
items.body:
chaaya hayaat e binte nabi par wo izteraam
tadpe tahe mazaar bhi mehboobe kirdigaar
darbar mein khadi rahi ismat ki taajedaar
is waaqaye pe aaj bhi insaan hai ashk baar
haye zahra badi mazloom hai zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar ke diye huwe zakhmon ne keh diya
dunya mein chand roz ki mehman hai fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza tere supurd hai ab mere gulsitaan
tu mere baad hai mere bacchon ki paasban
bacche tujhe samjhte meri tarha se maa
ab mera pyaar teri mohabbat se ho ayan
ehsaas e ranj ho na kisi noor e ain ko
rakhna sukoon se mere hassan aur hussain ko
haye zahra badi mazloom hai zahra
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza mere hussain pe royegi bekasi
sehra ki nazr hogi mere ghar ki roshni
lut jayegi tamaam kameini batool ki
khallaaq e do jahan tujhe bakshega zindagi
rakhna khayaal sadma e zehra siwa na ho
zainab ke sar se chadar e zainab juda na ho
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhir mein bu-turaab se itna kiya kalaam
mera salaam lijiye aisa hi be-anaam
zehra pe is jahan ke maraahil huwe tamaam
mai jaa rahi hoo chod ke ye aarzi maqam
ukhdi hai saans waqt mein vus'at koi nahi
keh dijiye ke mujhse shikayat koi nahi
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmeina bu-turaab ne ay jaane mustafa
tum se mujhe ho koi shikayat ye kya kaha
kaati tamaam umr ba khushnoodi e khuda
quran jis pe naaz kare wo amal kiya
taabindagi e shehr e nabi fatema se hai
roshan charaghe mustafa bhi fatema se hai
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
naagaah fatema ne kiya khuld ka safar
rone lage wasi e payambar jhuika se sar
shor e fughan mein doob gaya fatema ka ghar
fizza pukari paon ke talwon ko choom kar
ay shaahzadi ay meri maqdooma alwida
ismat ki rooh saabira mazlooma alwida
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo josh e gham wo fatema ke phool beqaraar
sab se zyada zainab o kulsoom ashk baar
ghamgeen faza pe likh gaye aankhon ke aab shaar
uht'ta hai ab janaza e khatoon e rozegaar
manzar mein ehteraam e wasiyat liye huwe
taboot par bhi raat hai parda kiye huwe
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
taboot suye qabr e payambar hua rawan
jis tarha gulsitan ke taraf boo e gulsitan
lekin wo be-zameer nazar aaye darmiyan
mashoor hai jo aale nabi ke udoo e jaan
khusboo tadap ke reh gayi gulshan na mil saka
beti ko apne baap ka daaman na mil saka
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay jannatul baqi e madina salaam le
tukda dil e rasool ka saumpa gaya tujhe
zaahir ye gham hai aaj bhi qabre batool se
rauza giraya dushmane aale rasool ne
sadiyon ke baad bughz ki haalat wohi rahi
paykar badal gaye pa shakawat wohi rahi
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay jannatul baqi wo din aayega zaroor
ghaarat garon ka khaak mein mil jayega ghuroor
insan se kahega khud insan ka sha'oor
islam ki hayaat hai aale nabi ka noor
ek din tamaam qasre raunaq girayenge
phir bhi misaale rauza e zehra banayenge
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaisar ba-zikre fatema zehra dua karo
ya rab imam e waqt ka jaldi zahoor ho
awaaz aaye ahle mawaddat utho utho
jaldi chalo madina e khairul wara chalo
majlis bapa hai rauza e binte rasool mein
zikre hussain chahiye baaghe batool mein
darbar ke diye huwe...
dunya mein chand roz ki...
items.author: Qaisar Barhvi

items.title: Ek beta ro diya
items.body:
dekh kar baba ka laasha ek beta ro diya
reh gaya jis dam akela ek beta ro diya
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
natawan bemaar laaghar aur safar ki sakhtiyan
dekh kar humraah apne sar barehna bibyan
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas ki shiddat se chehra zard aur pairon mein khaar
har qadam par dekh kar taaza musibat ka dayaar
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath mein ahle haram hai aur sab hai nange sar
karbala se shaam tak jayenge kaise soch kar
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq o langar ki garani se thaame huwe
uth raha tha har qadam qalb o jigar thaame huwe
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo musibat aayi abid par padhi nade ali
karbala se shaam tak jab bhi koi thokar padi
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
chal rahi thi raah mein seena utha kar mushkilein
jab safar mein pesh aayi har qadam par mushkilein
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sitam ne apna andaaz e sitam badla nahi
raaste bhar bekasi ne saath jab choda nahi
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke zindan mein jis dam sakina mar gayi
aur apne bhai ko ek dam akela kar gayi
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar raha hoo mai bayan bemaar ka huzn o malaal
aa rahe hai zehn mein ishrat masyab ke khayaal
gham ki zanjeeron mein jakda ek beta ro diya
dekh kar baba ka laasha...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Haq maangti hai
items.body:
darbar mein khadi hui kehti hai fatema
baba wo ab madina madina nahi raha
<<DIVIDER>>
haq maangti hai zehra majma hai baaghiyon ka
baba tere watan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
pardesiyon ki tarha rehti hai ab ye dukhiya
baba tere watan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
ab log fatema ko pehchante nahi hai
mai aap ki hoon beti ye maante nahi hai
koi nahi hai mera mai reh gayi hoon tanha
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ye nahi hai mujhko darwaza jal gaya hai
is se bada sitam to zehra pe ye huwa hai
dar jal raha tha mera koi na ghar se nikla
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar mujhpe zaalimon ne jalta hua giraya
mai gir padi zameen par ghash is tarha se aaya
mohsin jahan se guzra pehlu hua shikasta
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhi khadi hui thi hasnain bhi khade thay
masjid mein meri jaanib sab log dekhte thay
ye zakhm na bharega mai ban gayi tamasha
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi salaam aa kar karta nahi tha pehle
ab to jawab dena laazim nahi samajhte
har shakhs bhool baitha rutba abul hassan ka
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghut ghut ke apne ghar mein aansu baha rahi hoon
har zakhm murtaza se apna chupa rahi hoon
khaaya hai taziyana zakhmi hai mera chehra
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza ke ab sahare mai uth'ti baith'ti hoon
kha kar tamacha jab se mai khaak par giri hoon
ye zulm mujhpe toota mai ho gayi zaeefa
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se wo takallum shikwa ye kar rahi hai
ummat ko fatema se kya jaane dushmani hai
ho raat ya sawera turbat pe hai andhera
baba tere watan mein
haq maangti hai zehra...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Hussain ibne ali ka
items.body:
hussain ibne ali ka kalma
padha diya tu ne la ilaah ko
kata ke shaane alam utha kar
basa diya tu ne la ilaah ko
<<DIVIDER>>
banayi zeenat jo nauhakhwan ki
zameer goondha jo matami ka
nabi mila ke ali mila ke
mila diya tu ne la ilaah ko
hussain ibne ali ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
labalab apne lahoo se bhar ke
ye tishnagi se kasheed kar ke
yehi ke abid baqa ka saaghar
pila diya tu ne la ilaah ko
hussain ibne ali ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
diye hai baazu de di hai saansein
diya hai chehra de di hai aankhein
khuda ye hoi ye jaa ke pooche
ke kya diya tu ne la ilaah ko
hussain ibne ali ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhana rabb e azeem hai tu
hai rabb e aala kareem hai tu
nashayb e maqtal se taa ba sidra
saja diya tu ne la ilaah ko
hussain ibne ali ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sar ka nauha malak ka nauha
zameen ka nauha falak ka nauha
har ek zamane mein khud ujal ke
basa diya tu ne la ilaah ko
hussain ibne ali ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ki tasbeeh bhi yehi hai
naved ka bhi yehi hai sajda
lahoo ka apne libaas e dillat
pinha diya tu ne la ilaah ko
hussain ibne ali ka...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Kazime muztar
items.body:
qaid mein chauda baras zulm o sitam dhaaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
phir nishane ismate sadaat mitwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid kar ke le ke aaye kazim e naushad ko
phir azadar e janabe syed e sajjad ko
paon mein bedi galay mein tauq pehnaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad abid ki aseeri aagayi rote rahe
pesh e haakim pa barehna haye peshi ke liye
jis ghadi sarkar ko darbar mein laaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
char jaanib ghup andhera tha ke jaise qabr ho
qaid khana aisa lagta tha ke jaise qabr ho
jeete jee is qabr mein maula ko dalwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane ki aziyat kam thi kya ay zaalimon
kyun nabi ki aal se itni adawat hai kaho
dhaa liye sab zulm to phir zeher dilwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha zainab hui thi apne baba se juda
be-padar masooma e qum bhi hui wa ghurbata
bekhata jaise ali ko qatl karwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema sughra ko jaise yaad karte thay hussain
us tarha milta na tha beti ke bin kazim ko chain
qaid khane ko bhi baitul huzn banwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand mazdooron ne laashe ko uthaya aap ke
aur janaza pul pe laa ke rakh diya baghdad ke
haye zanjeeron mein bhi mayyat ko bandhwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghul hua kaunain mein maara gaya ek be-khata
hogaye hai be-padar maula raza yasir raza
haye masooma ke sar se baap ka saaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
items.author: Yasir Raza

items.title: Kitna mushkil waqt
items.body:
kitna mushkil waqt qaidi saarban par aagaya
khaafila lekar kahin se wo kahan par aagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
sar utha kar usne poocha ye jagah hai kaunsi
haye lafze shaam ye kiski zuban par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
noke naize pe sare sheh ne sunaya haale gham
hashr ka pal karbala ki daastan par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak sar mein paon mein chaale hai aankhon mein lahoo
dukh to saara natawan kadiyal jawan par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
gul macha har ek jagah barpa qayamat hogayi
karbala ka haal kehta ye jahan par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
rodiya bemaar ek dam karke baba ko salaam
saamne shabbir ka sar jab sina par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
rab pe kya guzri qayamat rab ko hi maloom hai
jo huwa utha kahin wo aasman par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
paak zehra ke chaman mein kab raha waqte bahaar
jaldi jaldi waqt wo waqte fiza par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard ki tehreer abid likh ke ye karde tamaam
aqif har imtehan ek natawan par aagaya
kitna mushkil waqt...
items.author: Abid Zaidi

items.title: Lailatul qadr hoo
items.body:
jab se hai giraya zaalim ne
mujhpe jalta darwaza
pal pal mai dard se marti hoo
aaram nahi ek lahza
jo zakhm diye hai ummat ne
ta hashr rahenge taaza
hasrat hai raat ke parde may
mera uthe paak janaza
<<DIVIDER>>
lailatul qadr hoo mera taboot
ya ali raat ko uthana tum
mujhko jis jis ne bhi sataya usay
meri mayyat pe na bulana tum
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jigar daar hai shaheedon ke
ye kaleje chabane waale hai
mai hoo mazdoor inki nazron se
meri turbat ko bhi chupana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere pehlu ka zakhm gehra hai
mera shabbir seh na payega
dafn ke waqt bhi mera maula
haath pehlu se na hatana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere baazu ke neel dekh chuki
meri chadar se khoon ponch chuki
in masayib se wo bhi guzregi
kuch na zainab se ab chupana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jabse zakhmi hui hoo mai maula
wo meri godh may nahi soye
raat ke waqt mere bachon ko
meri turbat may leke aana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam leke mujhe pukara gaya
mere ghar aake mujhko maara gaya
teri amma batool qatl hui
mere abbas ko batana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan tod di hai ummat ne
thak chuki hoo mai zulm sehte huwe
jaa rahi hoo mai paas baba ke
ab wahin mujhse milne aana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch to imran haq ada hoga
saahib ul asr se karo waada
jaan de dena sar katana magar
haq e zahra ko mat chupana tum
lailatul qadr hoo...
items.author: Imran Jatki

items.title: Mai laash uthaun
items.body:
hai jalti zameen tu hi bata ay mere asghar
mai laash uthaun ya teri qabr banaun
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh bhi to nahi sakta teri laash zameen par
mai laash uthaun ya teri qabr banaun
<<DIVIDER>>
rakhunga zameen par jo tujhe mere jiyale
hai garm zameen jism pe pad jayenge chaale
shabbir ko ab tu hi bata hasliyon waale
khud sambhla nahi jaata tujhe kaise sambhale
asghar ko kaha shaah ne seene se laga kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baat alag hai ke taraste ho kafan ko
dafnana zaroori hai bahot nanhe badan ko
warna ye layeen kar denge pamaal badan ko
maa teri na seh payegi is ranj o mahan ko
phir rote rahe dayr talak shaah ye keh kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye bhi khabar qabr mein na chain milega
hai garm zameen garm hawa jism jalega
pani ke bina dhoop ki shiddat na sahega
gar dafn na ho paaya to godhon se rundhega
laaya hoo tujhe is liye daaman mein chupa kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein andhera hai nazar kuch nahi aata
tooti hai kamar baith ke utha nahi jaata
zaanu pe sula kar mai tujhe lori sunaata
ek haath se phir beta teri qabr banaata
majboor hoo ab uth bhi nahi sakta mai gir kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek boond hi pani tu faqat maang raha tha
sookha hua seh roz se nanha sa gala tha
jo teer teri nanhi si gardan pe laga tha
wo teer mere laal tere qadh se bada tha
pani na diya qatl tujhe kar diya asghar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai phool sa nazuk ye tera chand sa chehra
kis dil se dabaunga isay khaak mein beta
mar jaunga sadme se yahin baap hoo tera
aa jayega us waqt mere moo ko kaleja
daalunga tere rukh pe jo mai rayt utha kar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
<<DIVIDER>>
al kissa qamar qabr banane lage sarwar
asghar ko utha lete thay rakh rakh ke zameen par
ay shadman kehte thay ajab waqt hai hum par
bekafn hi dafnaana padega tujhe asghar
ab taab nahi baaqi mere jism ke andar
mai laash uthaun ya...
hai jalti zameen...
items.author: Qamar Buknalvi

items.title: Matam haan sheh ka
items.body:
har pal hai saath hai har dam
matam haan sheh ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
jab naam e shabbir liya
bhool gaye dunya ke gham
matam haan sheh…
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunche laashe akbar par
girte padte shaahe umam
matam haan sheh…
<<DIVIDER>>
le aaye hai maqtal se
laasha e akbar shaahe umam
matam haan sheh…
<<DIVIDER>>
lo wo kanare nehr huwe
baazu e abbas qalam
matam haan sheh…
<<DIVIDER>>
tar hai khoon se ghazi ke
mashkeeze ke saath alam
matam haan sheh…
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna baap ke haathon par
kho diya baysheer ne dam
matam haan sheh....

items.title: Mujhko maanga gaya
items.body:
bain kartI thi shaah ki dukhtar
mujhko maanga gaya kaneezi mein
<<DIVIDER>>
meri ghairat bhi ro padi sun kar
mujhko manga gaya kaneezi mein
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne gham aaye seh liye maine
apne bunde bhi de diye maine
satween se nahi mila pani
ashk aankhon ke pee liye maine
haa magar ye sitam sahoon kyun kar
mujhko maanga gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam mein dar badar phiri hoo mai
aur tamache bhi khaa rahi hoo mai
kal to baba ke dil ka tukda thi
aaj qaidi bani hui hoo mai
ek naya zakhm ye laga dil par
mujhko maanga gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-khataon ko kyun sataate hai
kyun aseeron pe zulm dhaate hai
hukmraan jis qadar bhi zaalim ho
chote bachon pe rehm khaate hai
kyun tumhare huwe hai dil pathar
mujhko maanga gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
di sakina ne ye sada baba
imtehan hai ke ye saza baba
kaunsa bughz hai layeeno ko
ek yateema pe ye jafa baba
haal dekho zara mera aa kar
mujhko maanga gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi dekhi nahi zameen koi
reham khaata nahi layeen koi
shaam ke takht par jo baitha hai
is se bad kar nahi shaqi koi
is sitam se to maut hai behtar
mujhko maanga gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghurbat ke baad haa baba
hai musalsal ye sakhtiyan baba
na ruka khoon mere kaano se
na ruki hai meri fughan baba
aur is par sitam yahan aa kar
mujhko maanga gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yateema ka haq yehi safdar
bain rote huwe likhe mazhar
choti zehra ye bain karti thi
mere dada hai shaafa e mehshar
unko batlaungi mai ro ro kar
mujhko maanga gaya...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Aao alamdar
items.body:
binte ali ke liye hashr ka hai saamna
nargha e aada mein hai aale nabi berida
aagaya bazaar aao alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqon pe mehmil nahi sar pe bhi chadar nahi
kaun dilaye rida koi baradar nahi
shaane kataye huwe shere jari so gaya
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kahan aagayi fatema ki betiyan
aayi na bandi kahan aur kahan saydaniya
khatm bhala hoga kab zulm ka ye silsila
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shor qayamat ka hai shaam ke bazaar mein
kafiron ki kursiyan sajti hai darbaar mein
sar ko uthaate nahi hazrate zainul abaa
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
fikr hai bemaar ko kaise bataunga mai
dil pe guzarti hai jo kaise sunaunga mai
chaahne waala koi aise mein gar mil gaya
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aale payambar hai wo qaid jo rassi mein hai
waaris e kausar hai wo qaid jo rassi mein hai
aur sakina hai wo kasta hai jis ka gala
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyan jo qaid hai waaris e tatheer hai
dukhtare khairul wara khwahare shabbir hai
bain sune to koi roti hai khud fatema
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein laila ki hai khoon bhari akbar ki laash
dasht mein chod aayi hai bano bhi asghar ki laash
laadlon ki suratein dhoondhti hai maamta
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
naizon pe akbar bhi hai asghar e baysheer bhi
aun o mohamed bhi hai qasim e dilgeer bhi
wo sar e abbas hai naize se jo gir pada
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabt kahan tak kare binte ali ka jigar
kab se ye saydaniya hai dare saa'aat par
uth ke najaf se zara dekhlo mushkil kusha
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nayyar o aamir ye dil gham wo bhulata nahi
saahib e ghairat wahan sar ko uthaata nahi
aaj bhi hum shaam mein pahunche to nauha padha
aagaya bazaar aao alamdar...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Abbas hai na
items.body:
sab ki ridaon ka nigehdaar hai
ghazi mera aisa wafadaar hai
cheen nahi sakta koi chadarein
jab talak abbas alamdaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke behno ko zainab ka tasalli dena
abbas hai na abbas hai na
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek behan ko bhai pe maan hota hai
jahan mein bhai to behno ki jaan hota hai
ghamon ki dhoop mein wo sayeban hota hai
bas is yaqeen se qaimon mein mutmain rehna
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
haram ki aas bandhaati raho meri khwahar
batao in ko bharosa hai kitna ghazi par
rahe wo baazu salamat dua karo mil kar
nazar utha ke dar e qaima par to dekho na
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
isi ke saath amaari mein aayi thi ghar se
bahot mujhe bhi hai dhaaras isi baradar se
na hone dega wo mehroom hum ko chadar se
bade jo ranj ke saaye to bas yehi kehna
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhayi de tumhe jis dam yazeed ka lashkar
dikhaye wo tumhe talwar o naiza o khanjar
chamakhte naizon pe pad jaaye gar tumhari nazar
tum apne dil mein jagah khauf ko nahi dena
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye ghazi ne kulsoom se meri khwahar
fida hussain pe har maa karegi apne pisar
jo tere bete nahi hai to koi gham na kar
teri taraf se fida sheh pe hone ko behna
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
phupi ye boli sakina se ay meri bacchi
chacha se kehdo wo le aayenge abhi pani
ye mashk kya hai wo darya utha ke laa de abhi
bas apni aankh mein aansu nahi aane dena
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayan kaise wo manzar ho dono jaanib ka
udhar tarayi pe ghazi ka mashk ko bharna
kate jo baazu chhidi mashk saara pani baha
idhar sakina ka pyason ko dilaasa dena
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere hasham pe hai qurban mazhar o farhan
alam gharon pe lagata hai aaj saara jahan
hai tu hi ab bhi ghareebon ka bekason ka maan
alam ko dekh ke har waqt bas yehi kehna
abbas hai na abbas hai na
ye kehke behno ko...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Alam hamara
items.body:
kitne zamane guzar gaye
alam hamara jhuka nahi
junoon se gham may kayedaton ka
jo silsila tha ruka nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
choo raha hai arsh ki bulandiyan
gir raha hai zaalimon pe bijliyan
ke is alam ki bulandiyon par
janabe zehra ki hai dua
<<DIVIDER>>
alam hamara rahega ooncha
sitam ki laakhon chale hawayein
<<DIVIDER>>
isi alam par muraad maange
tamaam aalam ke saath hum bhi
hai is alam ki kayedaton may
hussainiyat bhi juoloos e gham bhi
hum is alam se hi maangte hai
dawa shifaris aur wafayein
alam hamara rahega...
<<DIVIDER>>
isay waseele bana ke maango
jo maango parwardigaar dega
jo iske saaye may saans lega
ye uski naslein sawaar dega
jab is pe saaya hai sayyeda ka
to iske saaye may kyun na jaaye
alam hamara rahega...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain karte thay naaz jis par
usi maseeha ka ye alam hai
jo maut taale nazar utha kar
usi maseeha ka ye alam hai
to kyun na phir is alam ko ghar ghar
uthaye bete sajaye maayein
alam hamara rahega...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan pe abbas ka alam ho
wahan pe mushkil ka kaam kya hai
alam uthaate hi jaan loge
ke maut kya aur dawaam kya hai
hayaat tasqseem karti jaaye
alam jo choo kar chali hawayein
alam hamara rahega...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamari izzat hasham hamara
azeem tar hai alam hamara
rakhega dunya o aakhirat may
qasam khuda ki bharam hamara
karenge raayij hum ek naara
alam uthayein najaat paayein
alam hamara rahega...
<<DIVIDER>>
wazeefa safdar hai zindagi ka
aqeeda hai mazhar abidi ka
alam ye jis ne lagaya ghar par
na hoga mohtaaj wo kisi ka
hamare daawe pe jin ko shak ho
wo aake kismat ko aazmaye
alam hamara rahega...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ameere lashkare hussain
items.body:
hizabre dashte nainawa ameere lashkare hussain
nihange qulzume wagha ameere lashkare hussain
khadange tarkashe khaza ameere lashkare hussain
barange shaahe la fata ameerre lashkare hussain
jari diler bawafa ameere lashkare hussain
wafa ba hadde maujeza ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zulfaqare hyderi ye shere beshaye najaf
ye taygo tayz hashmi nishane jurrate salab
har ek ka markaze nazar kafeele tashnagane taf
kanare nehre alqama tamam fauj ka hadaf
kisi se par na ruk saka ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
<<DIVIDER>>
bahadurane safshikan mein is jari ke tazkire
dilwarane taygho zan mein is jari ke tazkire
har ek wafa ki anjuman mein is jari ke tazkire
rasoole paak ke chaman mein is jari ke tazkire
ghuroore aale mustafa ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ka aqi bhi hai hussain ka ghulam bhi
hussain ki sipar bhi hai tabar bhi hai husaam bhi
hussain ki zira bhi hai kamaa bhi hai sihaam bhi
hussain hukm de agar to shimr se kalaam bhi
wagarna wo kuja kuja ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain izn de agar abhi ye sab ko dekhle
abhi iraq o shaam ko abhi halab ko dekhle
abhi abhi ye koofiyane be-adab ko dekhle
muqabila jo aa pade to kul arab ko dekhle
misaale shaahe la-fata ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
<<DIVIDER>>
ishara e imam ho to fatha mein dhara hai kya
shoyae mehr ke liye ye shaam ki ghata hai kya
furaat tak na jaane de kisi mein hausla hai kya
ali ke sher ke liye ye jang e karbala hai kya
ulat de taqt shaam ka ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeed e bad nihaad se sukoone zaat cheen le
muhafizeene nehr se haqe hayaat cheen le
jo marziye hussain ho abhi furaat cheen le
furaat kya hai ye wo hai ke kayenat cheen le
bada baland hausla ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
<<DIVIDER>>
magar yahan to hukm hai ke bas ali ke sher bas
hussain apni zindagi se ho chuka hai sayr bas
qareeb e waqte asr hai bas ab mere dilayr bas
hamare kooch mein kahin mazeed ho na dayr bas
karega taaba gar wagha ameere lashkare hussain
hizabre dashte nainawa…
items.author: Hasan Imdad

items.title: Aun o mohamed
items.body:
hai khoon mein doobe huwe hyder ke nawase
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
jafer ke hai potay
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
abdullah ke pyare
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
zainab ke dulaare
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
shabbir ke pyare
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
sarwar ke sahare
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
azmat ke sitaare
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
rif'fat ke ujaale
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
quran e shuja ke
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
tum dono ho paare
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
ghazi ke chaheete
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
islam panayi mein lade aisi ada se
dikhlaye gaye shaan kayi roz ke pyase
be-jaan diye palte na maidane wigha se
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke khazane ke ye anmol gohar hai
islam ki aankhon ke ye do noor e nazar
shamsheer hai mamu ke to emaan ke sipar hai
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
zinda na kisi sarkash o maghroor ko choda
kya maimana kya maisara har morcha toda
laakhon se lade fauj ke har bal ko maroda
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se lahoo behta hai tayghon se badan choor
maa kehti hai bache meri aankhon mein nahi noor
hai maamta nazdeek magar mai hoo bahot door
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode se gire jalti hui khaak pe jarraar
ek shor utha chal basay mamu ke tarafdaar
dil par ali fitrat giri ek barkh shar arbaar
aun o mohamed aun o mohamed
items.author: Ali Fitrat

items.title: Ay shaheede karbala
items.body:
ay shaheed e karbala tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
haath se asghar diye akbar diye
ay khaleel e karbala tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam
ay shaheed e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
deene haq jab taalib e nusrat hua
tu bana deen ki panaah tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam
ay shaheed e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ka ghar deen ki baqa ke waaste
kar diya pesh e khuda tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam
ay shaheed e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne ahlebait ko quran se
na diya hone juda tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam
ay shaheed e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar diya hai zinda deen ko hashr tak
de ke zainab ki rida tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam
ay shaheed e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaye mein teeron ke tu ne ay hussain
ki namaz e haq ada tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam
ay shaheed e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr bhi ho kar aagaya jab sharm saar
baksh di uski khata tujh par salaam
ay zabeeh e nainawa tujh par salaam

kaha shabbir ne ro kar chalega halq par khanjar
bas ab amma chali jao
<<DIVIDER>>
na dekha jayege tumse hamari maut ka manzar
bas ab amma chali jao
<<DIVIDER>>
meri gardan pe ay amma churi zaalim chalayega

bas ab amma chali jao
kaha shabbir ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek mushkil mein ay amma madad ki aap ne meri

tumhara shukriya tumne uthaya laasha e akbar
bas ab amma chali jao
kaha shabbir ne ro kar...

madina yaad aajaye na karbal mein tujhe amma

bas ab amma chali jao
kaha shabbir ne ro kar...

yahin se alwida kehdo hamare peeche mat aana

hamein takleef hoti hai jo tum chalti ho jhuk jhuk kar

kaha shabbir ne ro kar...

tadap jayegi abbas e jari ki laash darya par

jo tum jhuk jhuk ke chalti ho tumhe pehchaan jayegi

kaha shabbir ne ro kar...

bas ab amma chali jao

items.title: Ek boond bhi
items.body:
maa ne di sada ay mere beta

ek boond bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta tere baad jee na sakungi

tu hai bekafan mai hoo berida
ek boond bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola jhulaati lori sunaati

pal mein lut gayi meri kameini
khoon ka darya ban mein beh gaya
ek boond bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer khaa ke tu muskura diya
roti reh gayi fauj e ashkiyan
nehre alqama arz e karbala
dekhti rahi tera hosla
ek boond bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hai tujhko haye sakina
ab kahan tujko paaye sakina
jhoola bhi khaali jholi bhi khaali
dukhiya jhulaye kis ka jhoolna
ek boond bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise ye manzar bhool paaungi
ashk lehed mein bhi bahaungi
laal tumhari phool si gardan
kar gaya zakhmi teer e hurmala
ek boond bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chal diye tum bhi maa ko chod kar
kaise karungi shaam ka safar
maang bhi ujdi kokh bhi ujdi
koi nahi hai mera aasra
ek boond bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop mein jawwad umr bitaayi
pal bhi na mesum saaye mein aayi
tapti zameen par tadpa tha asghar
maa ko wo manzar yaad reh gaya

items.title: Haye namazi
items.body:
ek shor utha haye namazi
hai qatl hua haye namazi
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shere khuda nafse khuda nafse nabi hai
ye ilm ibadat may shuja'at may dhani hai
ahmad ka biradar hai ye khaaliq ka wali hai
kaunain may sab ke liye bas ek ali hai
maula ali maula ali maula ali maula ali
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed ka madadgaar hai imran ka jaani
ye ilm ka darya hai badi jiski giraani
ab tak na hua iska koi dunya may saani
kardega ishaare se wo pathar ko bhi pani
maula ali maula ali maula ali maula ali
<<DIVIDER>>
ramzan may sitamgar ne namazi ko hai maara
talwaar lagi farq pe aur wo hai do paara
allah ka ghar surkh hua khoon se saara
hilne laga is gham se har ek arsh ka taara
maula ali maula ali maula ali maula ali
<<DIVIDER>>
kehne lage sar thaam ke ye hyder e safdar
fuzto be rabbe kaaba mere maalik o daawar
hasnain ali ko jo utha le ke gaye ghar
sar peet'ti thi zainab o kulsoom tadap kar
maula ali maula ali maula ali maula ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ki badalne lagi kuch is tarha haalat
us waqt bula kar kiya bachon se wasiyat
deen ke liye sehna hai tumhe ranj o musibat
phir hone lage aaj ke din sab se wo ruqsat
maula ali maula ali maula ali maula ali

karti thi ye ro ro ke bayan saani e zehra
bin maa ke to pehle se hi mai ho chuki dukhiya
ab sar se pidar aap ka bhi uth'ta hai saaya
batlao kahan paaungi mai aap ko baba
maula ali maula ali maula ali maula ali
<<DIVIDER>>
ek shor tha kaunain ka sardar sidhara
sab ahle aza kehte thay ghamkhaar sidhara
hum saare ghareebon ka madadgaar sidhara
aayi ye nida hyder e karraar sidhara
maula ali maula ali maula ali maula ali

ab tak na ruka zikre ali hota hai payham
ekkeeswi ramzan ko ye uth'ta hai ye parcham

arif bhi bober karte hai jab nauha o matam

items.title: Itrat e athaar
items.body:
itrat-e-athaar ke ghamkhwar ashaab-e-hussain
lashkar-e-abbas ke jarrar ashaab-e-hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jab charag-e-qaimae-shah-e-shaheeda gul hua
kya habeeb ibne mazahir kya zaheer-o-ausaja
joshe nusrat mein har ek chehra munawar hogaya
karbala mein hai falak asaar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
raat bhar mehve talaya hai haram ke pasban

itrat-e-athaar ke…

koshishe ye hai ke hamla ho to aage hum bade

itrat-e-athaar ke…

hur azaan-e-subh par aaye haraval hogaye
khoon ki surkhi se apni sab khatayein dho gaye
mil gaya rumaal-e-zehra neend aayi sogaye
dasht-e-ghurbat mein bhi hai meyar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…

waqt-e-nazha john ka sar apne zano par rakha

maut se hai kis qadar sarshaar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima-e-shabbir mein ab be zaban koi nahi
qabre asghar dhoop mein hai sayeban koi nahi
shaah-e-deen maqtal mein hai aur meherban koi nahi
kaash jee ut'the faqat ek baar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk na jaaye shiddate gham se kahin nabz-e-imam
be-rida hai bibiyna shahid sare bazaar-e-shaam
peysh honge sab haram ab bar sar-e-darbar-e-aam
aur udhar maqtal mein hai lachaar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…

items.title: Kaise sakina dekhiye
items.body:
jee rahi hai baba jaan kaise sakina dekhiye
neel chehre par hai kitne mera chehra dekhiye

jab mere pairon ko baba khaar zakhmi kar chuke

nanhe nanhe bachon ko bazaar may le aate thay
shaam waale maar kar mujhko rulaate jaate thay

patharon se is tarha zakhmi ye peshani hui

items.body:
