lut gaya mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ne ishrat dua mujhko di
saamne karbala aa gayi
jis ne jis ne ye nauha suna
mere bacche ka ghar lut gaya
lut gaya mere...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Aao ali akbar
items.body:
girta hai pidar ran mein sambhalo ali akbar
aao ali akbar aao ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmo se mere khaak chudao mere dilbar
aao ali akbar aao ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
furqat mein teri shaam o seher karti hai girya
ye haal hai uska
batlao ke ab kaise jiyegi teri maadar
aao ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras jis ne tujhe laad se paala
bachon se zyada
sar peet thi hai gham mein tere zainab e muztar
aao ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
har aan teri yaad mein sughra ka hai nauha
kab aayenge bhaiya
takti hai madine mein tera raasta khwahar
aao ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jeeta tha tujhe dekh ke har pal mere jaani
ay yusuf e saani
ab shakl dam e nahza dikhado mere dilbar
aao ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghere hai sitamgaar pidar kisko pukare
tum chod sidhaare
ab paas nahi koi bhatija na baradar
aao ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
peeri mein jawan laal ki mayyat ko uthana
bachon ko bulana
furqat teri guzri hai bahot shaaq pidar par
aao ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha gham e shabbir mein hyder ne likha hai
lab par ye dua hai
maqbool ye ho jaaye bara e ali akbar
aao ali akbar...
items.author: Hyder

items.title: Aun o mohamed
items.body:
zainab ne kaha noor e nazar aun o mohamed
tum kar gaye dunya se safar aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
tum log bhi mamu pa fida hogaye ran mein
aayi hai ye maqtal se khabar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
deedar ki hasrat mein musalsal meri aankhein
dhoondegi tumhe shaam o sahar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sochna maa baithi hai nazdeek tumhare
aajaye meri yaad agar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ye na samajhna mai tumhe bhool gayi hoo
hai dil pa judaai ka asar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye soch ke kab khelte aajao mere paas
darwaze pa rehti hai nazar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir tum pa naye zulm ki yalghaar na hojaye
har waqt laga rehta hai darr aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt madine mein qadam rakhungi jaa kar
veeran nazar aayega ghar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis roz se khoya hai tumhe karbobala mein
daaman mera ashkon se hai tar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehsoos ye hota hai mujhe ay mere beta
tum laut ke aa jaaoge ghar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt chali jaati hoo hujre mein tumhare
takleef se uth'ta nahi sar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishrat hai abhi tak yehi zainab ki sadayein
aajao ke phat'ta hai jigar aun o mohamed
zainab ne kaha...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay shaheedon
items.body:
lo salaami raah e haq ke jaanisaron ay shaheedon
bekafan aur sar bureeda be-mazaron ay shaheedon
<<DIVIDER>>
gulsitan e deen ki saari hai baharein bas tumhi se
aasman e haq ke roshan chaand taaron ay shaheedon
lo salaami raah e haq ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne apne sar kata kar laaj rakhi hai wafa ki
fatema o murtaza ke ay saharon ay shaheedon
lo salaami raah e haq ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekafan laashon ko chadar garm reti ne udaayi
ran mein quran ke bikhre huwe paaron ay shaheedon
lo salaami raah e haq ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum se seekha hai zamane ne itaa’at ka kareena
ay gulistan e imamat ki baharon ay shaheedon
lo salaami raah e haq ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
raunak e baagh e nabuwat khushboo e jism e imamat
azm o eesaar o wafa ke shaahkaron ay shaheedon
lo salaami raah e haq ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ho safdar ya ho mazhar aaj tak tum pe hai naazan
tum ho quran e wafa ke maah paaron ay shaheedon
lo salaami raah e haq ke...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Baba jaanam
items.body:
baba jaanam baba jaanam baba jaanam
mai suye zindan chali aap ki naazon ki pali
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaanam baba jaanam baba jaanam
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafila jab suye zindan chala
apne baba se sakina ne kaha
ho gaya qaid tumhara kunba
baba dekho mera rassi may gala
haye meri yateemi haye meri ghareebi
baba jaanam baba jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ek baar to aankhein kholo
qaidi beti ki ye haalat dekho
baba ek baar sakina keh do
bolo baba mere kuch to bolo
haye meri yateemi haye meri ghareebi
baba jaanam baba jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba pani ki mujhe aas nahi
mera saqqa mera abbas nahi
ashk pilungi mujha pyaas nahi
hum ko ye karbobala raas nahi
haye meri yateemi haye meri ghareebi
baba jaanam baba jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ek baar sada do baba
apne nazdeek bula lo baba
shimr aata hai bacha lo baba
apne daaman may chupa lo baba
haye meri yateemi haye meri ghareebi
baba jaanam baba jaanam...
items.author: N. Sarwar, R. Azmi & M. Qasemi

items.title: Bas ek rishta hussain
items.body:
kashtiye deene khuda ka na-khuda hussain
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hame na jaah o saltanat na taqt o taaj chahiye
baland tha jo taqt se magar mizaaj chahiye
shaheede karbala ka bas dilon pe raj chahiye
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zohair o muslim ibne ausaja shabeeb ki tarha
janabe hurr ke aur john ke naseeb ki tarha
hame ye faqr hai ke hazrate habeeb ki tarha
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kaun apna chaara gar hussain hai hussain hai
hai kaun humse ba-khabar hussain hai hussain hai
hai kaun apna raahbar hussain hai hussain hai
hai kaun dil mein jalwagar hussain hai hussain hai
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek simt dehr mein ya hussain ki nida
har ek qaum ki har ek deen ki bhi hai sada
kamaal to ye hai ke bud parast bhi ye bol utha
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara chaara gar nahi koi hussain ke siwa
hamara ba-khabar nahi koi hussain ke siwa
hamara raahbar nahi koi hussain ke siwa
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo hussain hai mila hai jisko doshe mustufa
yehi waqaar e arsh hai yehi hai naaze kibriya
ana minal hussain kehke ye nabi ne keh diya
isi sabab se aaj hum bhi de rahe hai ye sada
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ko dilon mein tum bithalo ay hussainiyo
hussain ko nazar mein tum basalo ay hussainiyo
ye kehke apna dehr ko banalo ay hussainiyo
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
samaan se leke ta samak hussain hi hussain ho
zameen se aasman talak hussain hi hussain ho
jahan jahan falak falak hussain hi hussain ho
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan pe gham hussain ka wahan pe bhi siyasatein
jahan pe gham hussain ka wahan pe bhi kadooratein
khuda ke waaste mita do dil ki ye ghalazatein
munafiqat ko chod kar payak zaban yehi kahein
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rahenge yaume hashr bhi wohi to log shadman
ghame hussain mein jo kar rahe hai naala o fughaan
ay majid apne paas aa na payega ghame jahan
hamara rishta hussain se hai
bas ek rishta hussain se hai
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Bhool paayi sakina
items.body:
tanhaiyan sarghoshiyan
haan sakina ki hai ye fughan
meri gardan mein baandhi gayi rasiyan
mere kaano se nochi gayi baaliyan
khoon behta raha dard badta raha
taaziyane layeeno ke aur wo jafa
bhool paayi sakina kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
mujh ko kaanto pe paidal chalaya gaya
baap ka sar dikha kar rulaya gaya
tha wo kaisa safar bibiyan nange sar
ek ek zakhm se khoon behta raha
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jo royi to mujhko tamache lage
thak ke soyi ko abid ko durre lage
beech bazaar mein shehre aghyaar mein
haye saadaat ka jo tamasha bana
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bola darbar mein aake yun ek shaki
tu kaneezi mein ja haakim e waqt ki
kaisa lamha tha wo kaisa sadma tha wo
roke us dam pukari mai haye chacha
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere baba ka sar tasht mein tha rakha
ussay gustakhiyan karte thay ashkiyan
koi haami na tha kis ko deti sada
ek ghayyur bete ko ghaiz aagaya
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein pani aata meinasar agar
daal deti thi abid ki zanjeer par
har qadam ek jafa rona bhi jurm tha
darmiyan shamiyo ke thi aale aba
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha haakim ne darbar mein shimr se
in aseeron mein binte ali kaun hai
ro rahi thi phupi thi wo kaisi ghadi
naam phupiyon ka leta tha wo be-haya
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pe pathar rakha aur jeeti rahi
taaziyane layeeno ke sehti rahi
dushmano ka watan mai aseere mehan
jis jagah ek lamha tha ek saal sa
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsini aur aseeri wo zindan ki
jis jagah maut bhi aake rone lagi
yaad nashtar bani khaak bistar bani
phi ye zindan meri lehad ban gaya
bhool paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek paigham hai zaairon ko yehi
shab ko bibi ke rauze pe jao kabhi
ro rahi hai wahan ab bhi tanhaiyan
sun ke aaye hai farhan o mazhar sada
bhool paayi...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Darbar se jab
items.body:
darbar se jab aayi ghar beti nabi ki roti rahi
ek din nahi phir umr bhai beti nabi ki roti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jeene diya kab chain se ummat ne dhaaye itne sitam
jhutlaya us tehreer ko jo de gaye thay shaahe umam
haste rahe sab ahle shar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir aag le kar ahle shar zehra ke darwaze par gaye
dar bhi jala ghar bhi jala sab gham sahe thay rote huwe
jis dam gira pehlu pe dar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu bhi ek zakhmi hua pehlu se haye tha khoon rawan
ro kar sada baba ko di tooti jo zehra ki phasliyan
is dard mein shaam o sahar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke bas roti rahi mohsin bhi mera maara gaya
bhoolungi mai kaise usay ye gham mujhe bas kha jayega
is baat par sar peet kar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghusl o kafan dete huwe sher e khuda bhi rone lage
pehlu ko jab dekha kiye sher e khuda bhi rone lage
ab ye khula kyun umr bhar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar nahi taabe bayan mazhar karega ab kya raqam
lafzon mein kya kar payge koi bayan ye bibi ke gham
hai marsiya bas ek satar beti nabi ki roti rahi
darbar se jab aayi ghar...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ek choti si lehad
items.body:
ek choti si lehad dekho bana kar abid
khoon roya hai sakina ko sula kar abid
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise baba ne uthaya tha badan asghar ka
uth na paaya hai sakina ko utha kar abid
ek choti si lehad...
<<DIVIDER>>
phoool se gaalon pe kehte hai tamachon ke nishan
kaash baba ko dikhaati mai bitha kar abid
ek choti si lehad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay musalmano tumhe ab na satayegi sada
bole turbat mein sakina ko sula kar abid
ek choti si lehad...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar khoon bhare kurte ko badan se chipka
gir gaye khaak pe ye nauha suna kar abid
ek choti si lehad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek kohraam utha roye tadap kar maula
amma zainab ko gale apne laga kar abid
ek choti si lehad...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha sunti thi baba se ye bibi lori
aise talqeen padhi shaane hila kar abid
ek choti si lehad...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool na payega momin ye judaai yawar
gham sakina ka chale dil mein basa kar abid
ek choti si lehad...
items.author: Yawar Yusufi

items.title: Ghar lut gaya rasool
items.body:
ghar lut gaya rasool ka amma ab aayi ho
bhai shaheed hogaya amma ab aayi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataye qasim e nausha ki dastaan
bikhre pade hai phool zameen par yahan wahan
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
atthara saal paala tha jisko khushi khushi
qurban wo bhi kar gaya sarwar pa zindagi
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ghutniyo bhi chalne ka khaabil abhi na tha
wo bhi qaza ke haathon se bejaan hogaya
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai pa mere laal bhi qurban ho gaye
qabza kiya furaat par be-aab so gaye
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala may aa ke uthayi wo saktiyan
cheeni gayi sakina ke kaano se baaliyan
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ye sochti rahi zainab ke bain par
kya kya sitam huwe hai hamare hussain par
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bain kis zaban se ishrat karun raqam
ye likhte likhte ashq bahane laga qalam
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Haq pe jeo
items.body:
haq pe jeo haq pe maro
zaalim ki sohbat may jeena zillat hai kalma goyo
haq pe jeo....
<<DIVIDER>>
degaye ye paigham shaheede karbobala
haq pe fana hojane may hai raaze baqa
sar ko katane may izzat hai sar na jhuka
zillat se jeene se behtar hai izzat ki maut maro
haq pe jeo....
<<DIVIDER>>
izzat ki ek saans mile to naymat hai
zillat ki har saans musalsal laanat hai
kalmaye haq kehne may aur hi lazzat hai
jaabir se jaabir sultan ke aagay haq ki baat karo
haq pe jeo....
<<DIVIDER>>
na haq hum naadaro par ye tohmat hai
hukme khuda hai aur nabi ki sunnat hai
jhooton par quran ne bheji laanat hai
humko kehne se pehle quran se aayat hazaf karo
haq pe jeo....
<<DIVIDER>>
jisme ho salman o abuzar se ashaab
us saf may shaamil ho kaise aap janab
ahl nahi jiske dekhe kyon uska khwaab
ilm ki masnat jehl ke haaton logon mat barbaad karo
haq pe jeo....
<<DIVIDER>>
ilm khuda hai ilm nabi hai ilm wali
ilm hi se hai taamere islam hui
ilm ka shehr mohamed hai darwaza ali
shehre ilm ko jaane walon dar to pehle paar karo
haq pe jeo....
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske ghar ki baat hai uske ghar se pooch
ilm hai kya ye ahle bayt ke dar se pooch
kaun hai haq par ye shabbir ke sar se pooch
nauke naiza par hai baland honton par hai quran suno
haq pe jeo....

items.title: Hussain ibne ali ki
items.body:
hussain ibne ali ki choti beti qaid khane may
abhi tak ro rahi hai ek bachi qaid khane may
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sajjad ne baba ke jo seene pa soti thi
qayamat tak rahegi ab akeli qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
padi hai khaak par ranj o musibat ki rida odhe
hussain ibne ali ki shaahzadi qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam e aakhir jab aaya tasht may sar shaahe waala ka
na poocho kya qayamat ki ghadi thi qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
galay may tauq bedi paon may haathon may hatkadiyan
lehad sajjad ne kaise banayi qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam e aakhir kaha baba madad ka waqt aa pahuncha
sakina ne bhi hal min ki sada di qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jise baba ke seene par bada aaram milta tha
wo apni maut se pehle na soyi qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
tasalli ke alawa kuch bhi tum ko de nahi sakta
sakina hai bahot bekas ye bhai qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
andheri raat thi honton pa sab ke ya hussaina tha
na poocho kis tarha se laash uthi qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
rabab e khastatan ki bekasi to dekhiye ishrat
lehad par ashkon ki chadar chadayi qaid khane may
hussain ibne ali ki...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Izatdaar gharana
items.body:
ye izzatdaar gharana hai
syed sardar gharana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
malika hai khadija is ghar ki
maalik hasnain ka nana hai
ye izzatdaar gharana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
saari aayaat e qurani
is ghar ki shaan mein utri hai
ye paak mohamed ka ghar hai
yahan fatema zahra rehti hai
awaaz yahan neechi rakhna
allah ka yeh farmaana hai
ye izzatdaar gharana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo inka dushman hai us par
allah bhi laanat karta hai
is ghar mein rehne waalon ka
quran mein shajra milta hai
kaaba karta hai salaam usko
is baat ko jis ne maana hai
ye izzatdaar gharana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sardar farishton ka aa kar
is ghar mein jhulata hai jhoola
takht aur taaj ko thukra kar
aayi hai kaneezi mein fizza
naukar jo bhi hai is ghar ka
andaaz uska shahana hai
ye izzatdaar gharana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali nahi jaata koi bhi
sab ke daaman bhar jaate hai
jab rotiyan baant'ti hai zahra
yahan aasman waale aate hai
bat'ta hai tabarruk ki surat
is ghar ka jo bhi khaana hai
ye izzatdaar gharana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghar par ho ghazi ka alam
karti hai fatema zehra karam
hum log hussaini hai chath par
kyun na lehraye ye parcham
ye alam lagane ka maqsad
dunya ko ye batlana hai
ye izzatdaar gharana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqa ye diya hai bachon ka
bibi ne apne naukar ko
farhan inhi ki majlis ne
zeeshan banaya hai ghar ko
mera ghar koi aam nahi is mein
zahra ka aana jaana hai
ye izzatdaar gharana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
izzat jo badi thi to
musibat bhi badi thi
jo ghar tha mohamed ka
wahan aag lagi thi
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dar pe nabi karte thay salaam
us darwaze ko jalaya gaya
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
kaabe mein zahoor hua jiska
masjid mein usko qatl kiya
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu mein nabi ke jo tha pala
wohi pehlu mein na dafn hua
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
jise khuld se kapde bheje gaye
be-kafn raha uska laasha
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ghar kausar ka maalik tha
usay dasht mein pyasa maar diya
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
qayam tha parda jinse unhe
bazaar mein laaye be-parda
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jin ke sadqe mein dunya
un pe sadqa phaynka gaya
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
<<DIVIDER>>
azaad karaye jo qaidi
haye wo gharana qaid hua
izzat bhi badi ghurbat bhi badi
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Jhoola
items.body:
maa ne rote huwe asghar ka jhulaya jhoola
kabhi chooma kabhi seene se lagaya jhoola
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar roti rahi asghar e baysheer ko maa
shabe ashoor bahot dayr jhulaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro padi bano e muztar jo ye manzar dekha
khaak pe haath se bacchi ne banaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali asghar ko sada de ke tadapti thi rubab
raaste mein jo kabhi saamne aaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki yaad mein rote huwe behosh hui
jab nazar fatema sughra ko na aaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
raakh bhi aayi hai loote huwe asbaab ke saath
kalma goyo ne hai kuch aise jalaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gayi shaam se rote huwe asghar ki behan
jab sar e farshe aza hum ne uthaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
neem shab aati hai bibi koi girya karne
jab se ghar mein ali asghar ka sajaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kabhi rizq ki tangi nahi dekhi yasir
roz e ashoor jo faaqe mein uthaya jhoola
maa ne rote huwe...
items.author: Yasir Raza

items.title: Kaisi hai ye islam
items.body:
kaisi hai ye islam ke suraj ki ziya dekh
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sheh ke azadaar zara hosh mein aaja
kufe se ubharte huwe suraj ko zara dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ikhlaq o murawwat ki ye meraj hai wallah
ek hurr ki khata dekh shahe deen ki ata dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
panja ye nahi mere tasavvur mein alam par
abbas hai pehne huwe ye taaj e wafa dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay qatil e masoom zara khauf e khuda kar
nawak ko zara dekh zara nanha gala dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
behlaati thi asghar ko ye keh keh ke sakina
tere liye pani abhi laate hai chacha dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-ghusl o kafan dafn hui naazon ki paali
kis haal mein aayi hai sakina ko qaza dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baalon se na chehre ko chupaye to kare kya
afos mayassar nahi zainab ko rida dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar tere ash'aar to hai apni jagah par
ye seena zani dekh ye nazim ki sada dekh
kaisi hai ye...
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Keh rahi thi ye bali
items.body:
keh rahi thi ye bali sakina
koi mera sahara nahi hai
ho gaye qatl maqtal mein baba
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis se pani ka shikwa karungi
umr bhar ab musibat sahungi
aa gaya raas ammu ko darya
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaye ran mein abbas o akbar
ab na qasim rahe aur na asghar
ho gayi aaj se be-sahara
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan de ke kis ko sulaaun
kis ko apne galay se lagaun
mar gaya ran mein asghar bhi mera
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise baare masayib uthaun
darr ye hai mai kahin mar na jaaun
zindagi ne diya aisa tohfa
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya karun koi shikwa kisi se
ab hai dhaaras to bas ek phupi se
kaun aayega dene dilaasa
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye asghar bhi ran ko sidhara
ho gayi aaj se be-sahara
ab jhulaungi mai kis ko jhoola
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaaro jaanib se ghere hai lashkar
lootne aa rahe hai sitamgar
aa gaya daur be-chadari ka
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahi ye jab binte sarwar
karwatein le rahe thay bahattar
kya nahi koi mera sahara
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
munharif is khadar tha zamana
raas aaya nahi qaid khana
mar gayi kehte kehte sakina
koi mera sahara nahi hai
keh rahi thi ye...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Lakhte dile hasan
items.body:
lakhte dil e hassan ke tukde utha utha ke
daaman mein rakh rahe hai sarwar saja saja ke
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein beta maadar ki laaj rakhna
bachpan se maa ne paala lori suna suna ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
de kar raza e maqtal bhai ke laadle ko
karte hai pyaar sarwar dil se laga laga ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke ran mein qasim fauje jafa pe toote
ladte nahi hai ran mein jaan ko bacha bacha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
josh e wafa e qasim ghazi se mil raha hai
darya se uth rahi hai maujein wafa wafa ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tashna lab ko ran mein laakhon ne mil ke maara
taapon se rond daala ghode bhaga bhaga ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde badan hai saara shabbir ro rahe hai
chunte hai laash e qasim aansu baha baha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal ho ke pyasa sairaab ho raha hai
tashna labi ko apne khoon mein bujha bujha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa dekhne na paaye tukde badan hai saara
laate hai laash maula maa se chupa chupa ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
deti rahi sadayein farwa kahan ho qasim
haste rahe sitamgar qaime jala jala ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
farwa ka chand khoon mein dooba kuch is tarha se
rota raha falak bhi taare bujha bujha ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde nahi ye qasim ran mein tere badan ke
naqshe baqa rakhe hai tu ne bana bana ke
lakhte dil e hassan ke...
items.author: Ali Rizvi Sachey

items.title: Mai maa hoo pyase
items.body:
jab tadape ne ki bhi taaqat na rahi sarwar ko
ghul hua ke ghash aaya khalaf e hyder ko
aur phir shimr badha khaynche huwe khanjar ko
sab se kehta tha ke kaatunga sar e sarwar ko
moo na mai daulate dunya se kabhi pherunga
aaj zahra ke kaleje pa churi pherunga
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada e fatema tars itna to khaa le zaalim
mai maa hoon pyase hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
na khanjar chala ay zaalim isko pani pilade zaalim
mai maa hoon pyase hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
choomte thay payambar jise wo gala
kaise dekhun usay zer e khanjar bhala
jis ka kalma padhe ye zamana
wo mohamed hai iske nana
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
isko mehman bula kar sataate ho kyun
mere bacche pe khanjar chalate ho kyun
tars itna to khaa ay zaalim
mera dil na dukha ya zaalim
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise paala hai isko tujhe kya khabar
mera haathon ke chaale huwe nauhagar
kaise dekhun bata de sitamgar
apne bacche ki gardan pe khanjar
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
chakkiyan pees kar maine paal jise
kya bana hai ye khanjar isi ke liye
qatl karna hi hai gar che tujhko
dasht se door jaane de mujhko
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne pehlu mein isko sulaati rahi
iski raahon se kaante hataati rahi
aaj iske galay pe khanjar
kaise dekhun bata de sitamgar
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan isko deti thi mai raat bhar
kitni raatein guzari hai yun jaag kar
kab se soya nahi dilbar
bojh bas hai yehi mere dil par
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
faaqe kar kar ke khaana khilaya jise
pyasi reh reh ke pani pilaya jise
aath pehron se hai aaj pyasa
kaise de dun tujhe ye asaasa
mai maa hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki faryad farhan kya ho bayan
chashme mazhar se hai khoon ka gajra rawan
chal gaya ibne hyder pe khanjar
nauha karti rahi ban mein maadar
mai maa hoon...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Mere bacche palat
items.body:
haye mere raaj dulaare
haye meri aankhon ke taare
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke kehti thi muslim ki bewa
mere bacche palat kar na aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh paayi na phir unka chehra
mere bacche palat kar na aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
meri saansein ukhadti hai har dam
aur nikalta hai har dam mera dam
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
unka na jaane kya haal hoga
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwaab jis din se maine ye dekha
khoon mein tar hai dono ka kurta
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
moo ko aata hai mera kaleja
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aaghosh bharti hai aahein
dhoondti hai unhe meri baahein
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
dil mein chubta hai har waqt naiza
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chain bacchon ke bin kaise aaye
ab sukoon maamta kaise paayein
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
hai nigahon mein meri andhera
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khabar jab se mai ne suni hai
unka kufe mein koi nahi hai
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
dard ka dil pe chalta hai aara
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko qismat ne ye din dikhaya
waqt ne ye sitam mujhpe dhaaya
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
uth gaya sar se waali ka saaya
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne baba se dono bichad kar
kha rahe honge dar dar ki thokar
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
dil tadapta hai is gham se mera
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye waiz wo dukhiyari maadar
ay ali ro ke kehti thi aksar
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
leke apne dulaaron ka kurta
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Mujhko seene pe
items.body:
bain ye shaam e ghariban mein sakina ne kiya
neend kya aayegi ke bistar hai na takiya na rida
mujhko seene pe sulalo baba
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle in teeron ko seene se nikalo baba
aur phir mujhko kaleje se lagalo baba
ye batlao ke kyun hogaye tum mujhse khafa
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doobe biyaban se darr lagta hai
kabhi maqtal kabhi zindan se darr lagta hai
hausla do mujhe dhaaras to bandha do baba
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaaye durre to mai samjhi ke aseeri kya hai
aaj maloom hua mujhko yateemi kya hai
khaak par baithi hoon ab haal hai ye ghurbat ka
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi marqad nahi aur koi janaza bhi nahi
laash par kaisa kafan ab to wo kurta bhi nahi
tu ne maanga tha jo fizza se purana kurta
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum thay mashoor mere naaz uthane waale
apni beti ko kaleje se lagane waale
aaj tum sogaye aur dhyan bhi aaya na mera
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khushboo ye aap ki mai paa ke chali aayi hoon
wo andhera hai ke ghabra ke chali aayi hoon
jise qaimon ka phuphi de rahi hongi pehra
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye khaakh pe bikhra hua kooza mera
aap ke baad bhi toota nahi faakha mera
kabhi khaaye hai tamache to kabhi ashk piya
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki saanson se har saans mein raahat thi mujhe
aap ke seene pe sone ki to aadat thi mujhe
kaun sota hai badal jaaye jo sone ki jagah
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tadapti hi rahi aap khafa ho bhi gaye
khaakh par aap ko neend aa bhi gayi so bhi gaye
kya isi waaste khaalik se mujhe maanga tha
mujhko seene pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat bhar shaam e ghariban hamay tadpati hai
neend phir aamir aur nayyar ko kahan aati hai
yaad aata hai jo shehzadi e gham ka nauha
mujhko seene pe...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Aflaak pe rone ki
items.body:
aflaak pe rone ki matam ki sada jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
mohtaj hai ye dunya dunya tumhe kya degi
shabbir ki madar hi bas tum ko dua degi
shabbir ka hai gham ye sauda na kiya jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam hai shahe deen ka aaye hai ambiya bhi
mushkil kusha ke hamraah aaye hai mustufa bhi
matam ke taqaddus ko malhooz rakha jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
rumaal fatema ka phir payenge ye aansu
taskeen e dil e zehra ban jayenge ye aansu
ashkon ke samandar ka nazrana diya jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar pesh aayi mushkil sabr o rahe wafa mein
islam gir raha tha maidan e karbala mein
abbas ne kaha jab haaton ko diya jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki fatema ki kulsoom ki sada hai
sabir dil e hazeen ki masoom ki sada hai
shabbir ka hai matam jee bhar ke kiya jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se ashk jaari seeno se lahoo jaari
shabbir ke matam mein maut aaye to hai pyari
matam pe harf aaye to sar bhi diya jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein sar kataye ansar sab sidhare
mayyat jawan ki hai shabbir hai akele
laasha ali akbar ka kis tarha utha jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hal min ki ek sada ne maidan mein usko laaya
gardan pe teer kha kar asghar ne muskuraya
pursa ali asghar ka zehra ko diya jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil chod aaye ghazi pehlu e sakina mein
abbas sar jhukaye hai nehre alqama mein
pyaso ko kis tarha se sehraab kiya jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom ke nauhe ko ro ro ke padha jaye
shabbir ki madar ko pursa yun diya jaye
iqbal sheh ka nauha ashkon se likha jaye
aflaak pe rone ki...
items.author: Iqbal Abedi

items.title: Alam kiska hai
items.body:
dabdaba kiska hashm kiska alam kiska hai
mere ghazi ke muqabil ho ye dam kiska hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen waale usay toote dilon ki aas kehte hai
shariyat mein usay sadaat ka ehsaan kehte hai
karam sabr o raza ki saltanat ka naam hai shabbir
wafa ki aakhri sarhad ko hum abbas kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna to kahin ay dil ye payambar to nahi
sardar e fatema zehra pe ye kham kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
hur ne ek pal mein shifa'at ki sanad paayi hai
shab e ashoor ye andaz e karam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
sawaal e ajr e risalat maaf hona hai
munafiqat ko abhi be-naqaab hona hai
ali ka beta zamane mein aane waala hai
abhi to baagh e fidak ka hisaab hona hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ye kehte ho fidak haq hai nabi zaadi ka
hum ye kehte hai arab aur ajam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ko zinda kiya aulad e abu talib ne
warna tareekh e shuja'at mein bharam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunnat e ahmed e mukhtaar hai shabbir ka gham
is hawaale se zara soch ye gham kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag ye kisne lagayi hai dar e zehra par
tu hi tareekh batade ye sitam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jahan waale jise mohr e nabuwat samjhe
dosh e ahmed pe muhib naqshe qadam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Amma fizza
items.body:
amma fizza mai thak gayi chal ke
zaalim baithne na deta hai
ye beti ali ki kis se kahe
ke zaalim baithne na deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra jo gayi thi zaalim ke
darbar mein maine poocha tha
amma tu mujhko itna bata
darbar ye kaise hota hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se laga kar zahra ne
ro ro ke mujhse itna kaha
mai sab ko bata sakti hoo magar
dekhun jo tujhe dil rota hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma fizza tu itna bata
mai beti ali ki hoo lekin
zaalim ke ghulamon ne tumko
shehzadi keh ke pukara hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne muqatib ho ke kaha
ay zaalim tu itna sun le
hum aaye nahi majboori mein
teri haar ne hum ko bulaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar ke baahar mai thi khadi
aur bacchi mujhse poochti thi
bas itna batadije mujhko
darbar ye kaahe sajaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab naam pukara zaalim ne
zainab ka to abid ne kaha
abbas chacha dekho to zara
kya waqt ne hum ko dikhaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi beti ne ye dunya mein nahi dekha ho
kund khanjar se baba jiska zibha ho
<<DIVIDER>>
sar tasht e tila mein rakha tha
aur zaalim sab se kehta tha
ye kis ki bacchi hai jis ne
darbar mein sab ko rulaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz suni zanjeeron ki
tab zainab ne fizza se kaha
amma ye kaisa qaidi hai
nazron ko jis ne jhukaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shukr tera ay shehzadi
auqaat kahan thi mohsin ki
wo sar ko jhuka ke kehta hai
ye nauha tum ne likhaya hai
amma fizza mai thak gayi...
items.author: Toosi Zangipuri

items.title: Aun o mohamed mere
items.body:
zainab ke dulaare aun o mohamed
aun o mohamed mere aun o mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab ye mere maan badhana bachon
surkh roo jang ke maidan se aana bachon
maut ko zeest ka unwaan banana bachon
pyase seh roz ke ho khoon may nahana bachon
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj ke din ke liye maine tumhe paala tha
ibne makhdooma e kaunain hai mushkil may ghira
aarzu aun o mohamed hai tumhari maa ki
dono ho jao mere bhai ke akbar pe fida
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm maidan may tum khao to khush ho maadar
shaan ajdaad ki dikhlao to khush ho maadar
suye darya na utha kar kabhi nazrein dekho
pyase dunya se guzar jao to khush ho maadar
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang is tarha karo ahl e wafa yaad kare
aise hamle ho jinhe shaami sada yaad kare
neemche khol ke lamhon may ulat do lashkar
daad abbas de aur sher e khuda yaad kare
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
dum karun naad e ali sar ko jhuka lo bachon
saare armaan ladayi ke nikaalo bachon
haye sehra na saja sar pe tumhare lekin
maut ko aaj dulhan apni banalo bachon
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm zainab ka baja laaye dulaare bache
maut to haar gayi ran may na haare bache
dekh kar laashe pukari ye ali ki beti
surkh roo mai hui dunya se sidhare bache
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli maa laashon se kyun neend hai aayi utho
maa ko batlao ladi kaisi ladayi utho
ba adab tum ho bahot phir ye ghazab hai kaisa
kab se baali pe khade hai mere bhai utho
aun o mohamed mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaffri royi kahan bachon ko binte zehra
haa magar laut ke jab ghar may wo aayi dukhiya
khaali hujre jo nazar aaye to phir zabt hua
haat phailaye huwe ro ke ye zainab ne kaha
aun o mohamed mere...
items.author: Jaffri

items.title: Ay shame ghariban
items.body:
ay shame ghariban ay shame ghariban
tareekh ka hai gham se tere chaak gareban
<<DIVIDER>>
ek zakhme sina se ali akbar gaye maare
kausar ko sidhare
kya kya na thay laila ko abhi byaah ke armaan
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke baysheer bhi maare gaye pyase
ek teer e khaza se
is zulm pa khud ahle jafa hogaye girya
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
bete thay wo zainab ke ajab faqre abujad
wo aun o mohamed
hamsheer ne dono ko kiya bhai pa qurban
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar hai na qasim hai na asghar hai na abbas
ab koi nahi paas
ek pehr may shabbir ka ghar hogaya veeran
ay shame ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
shehzadi sakina bhi aaghaze safar hai
lagte hai tamache
aur shaam ka zindan to hai pir shaam ka zindan
ay shame ghariban…

items.title: Bas itna batado
items.body:
jab khafila pahuncha tha madine ke zara paas
maqtal mein hua kya ye suna usne basad e yaas
kat'ta tha jigar dil mein nidamat ka tha ehsaas
har ek se yehi poochti thi maadar e abbas
jab gardan e shabbir pe khanjar wo rawan tha
bas itna batado mera abbas kahan tha
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ke pisar jaane nabi sayyade waali
akbar ke kaleje se sina kaise nikali
jab khaak pe dum tod'ta laila ka jawan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein baysheer ko jab laaye thay shabbir
nanhe ali asghar ki jo gardan pe laga teer
jab baap ke haaton pe pisar tashna dahan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaqa mera maidan mein kyun rehgaya tanha
haa doodh na bakhshungi mai ye kya kiya beta
zehra ka pisar khaak pe jab girya kuna tha
bas itna batado...

jab bibiyan jalte hue qaimon ke thi andar
jab zainab e dilgeer ki cheeni gayi chadar
jab gardane beemar mein wo tauqe garan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ko liye phirti thi jab zainab e muztar
jab aag lagayi gayi cheena gaya bistar
phaila huwa jab shaam e ghariban ka dhuan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e ghariban mein bhi pyase rahe bache
jab dukhtare shabbir ke lagte thay tamache
jab uska jigar karbe yateeme se tapan tha
bas itna batado...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha usko wafa ka tha bahot paas
jab zibha huwe bhai tho zindan na thay abbas
bin haaton ke tha ghairate ilyaas ka laasha
saahil pe tadapta raha abbas ka laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sun ke kiya shukr magar phir bhi hai ehsas
ab tak ye qamar poochti hai madare abbas
jab gardane shabbir pe khanjar wo rawan tha
bas itna batado...

items.title: Bhoola hai na
items.body:
bhoola hai na bhoolega ta hashr zamana
darbar e yazeedi mein tera khutba sunana
<<DIVIDER>>
tere parde pe qurban tere bhai ke sadqe
aata hai jise deen pe ghar baar lutana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne ye dars zamane ko diya hai
aage kisi zaalim ke kabhi sar na jhukana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmul ye tera jurm kabhi chup nahi sakta
pani ke ewaz teer se asghar ko sulaana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki azmat hai ye shbbir ke jurrat
maqtal mein wo akbar ke laashe ko uthana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushtaq kiye jaa tu isi dar ki ghulami
bakshish ka nahi aisa koi aur thikana
bhoola hai na...
items.author: Mushtaq Hussain

items.title: Darbari baithe hai
items.body:
jisne sada se pehle hamesha ata kiya
beti usi ki ban ke sawali khadi rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jo samjhe musalaman musibat yehi hai
ke darbari baithe hai zahra khadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam hai muhammad ki thereer padh kar
sabhi has rahe hai wohi ro rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hijab e khuda hai jo binte nabi hai
wo darbar may jaane kabse khadi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya aise ummat ne baba ka pursa
batool apne pehlu ke bal gir padi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bata mujhko amma mera jurm kya tha
ye mohsin ki ab bhi sada aa rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karegi na zahra ab apna koi gham
ali ke galay may rasan dekhti hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khayaal aa gaya berida betiyon ka
wo ghazi ka kurta jabhi see rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mushkil bada qabre zahra banana
ali ke labon pe bhi nade ali hai
ke darbari baithe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
batool ab bhi qabre shikasta se ahsan
imam e zaman ko sada de rahi hai
ke darbari baithe hai...

items.title: Ek dadi hai ek poti
items.body:
dono ki ajab hai mazloomi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai
ek binte nabi
<<DIVIDER>>
dadi bhi bhare darbar gayi
poti bhi sare bazaar gayi
dono ko mili hai mehroomi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dadi ka bhi pehlu choor hua
poti ka bhi dil ranjoor hua
dono ki hai phasli tooti hui
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono hi sidhaari ghut ghut kar
ro paye na apne baba par
dono ki musibat ek jaisi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono ki fazeelat kya mai kahoon
ek baap ki maa ek sheh ka sukoon
dono ke hai mansab ibne jali
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono ko mile ye ranj o mehan
ghar ek ka jala ek ka daaman
dono ko ajab saughaat mili
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyon se judaai mit na saki
mar kar bhi rehaai mil na saki
dono hai ghamon mein qaid abhi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bibi pe ye zulm hua
ahmed ke khareeb sone na diya
ek seena e sheh se door hui
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bibi ne ghar apna diya
ek bibi ne di apni rida
dono ne bachaya deene nabi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kaash bilal e karbobala
haasil ho tujhe irfan e aza
hai jiski musibat tune likhi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Haye qasim
items.body:
sehriyan waala qasim
maa ka dulaara qasim
pehchaane maa kaise
laasha tumhara qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
ek gathri mein aa gaya qasim
maa ko itna hi mil saka qasim
haye qasim haye haye qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
gir gaye shaah e deen ye kehte huwe
dekho abbas gir gaya qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek tukda de raha tha sada
ye raha ammu aap ka qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maqtal mein chaar jaanib se
sheh ki tazeem ko utha qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere tukdon ko chun'ne ki khaatir
khud chali aayi fatema qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sumon ke nishan chehre par
tera kya haal ho gaya qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
itna kamsin tha ran mein girte huwe
tu ne amma ko di sada qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne dhoonda usay bahot ran mein
par mukammal nahi mila qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad apne ammu se
pehle pamaal ho gaya qasim
haye qasim...
ek gathri mein...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Hussain ibne ali ki
items.body:
jee rahe hai aabroo se hum jo hindustan mein
doston bas ye ghame shabbir ka ehsaan hai
jism mein kis kis ke kaisa khoon hai khud dekhlo
ye azadari nahi ye nasl ki pehchan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ibne ali ki karo azadari
furaat e ashq e aza hashr tak rahe jaari
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
falak pe chand nazar aagaya moharram ka
hai soghwaar mahina hussain ke gham ka
khuloos e dil se karo ehtamam matam ka
nabi ki aal se karte raho wafadari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare waaste zehmat uthaai maula ne
ye dukh ye ranj o musibat uthaai maula ne
jawan bete ki mayyat uthayi maula ne
do pursa shaah ko ab karke girya o zaari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bala ke dasht mein wo paasban e ahle haram
kata ke shaane bachaya hai deen ka parcham
hum isliye bhi uthate hai bawafa ka alam
zamana dekh le bedast ki alamdari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
huwe hai baap ke haathon pe munqalib asghar
lahoo mein dooba hua hai ye dard ka manzar
jo teer aake laga bezaban ki gardan par
wo teer wazn mein tha bezaban se bhaari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen royi hai chashme falak bhi hai purnam
nabi ki aal pe dhaaya gaya wo zulm o sitam
sawaar e doshe payambar jo tha khuda ki qasam
usi ki laash ko pamaal karte hai naari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam huwe jo haram par bataun mai kaise
gala hussain ka kaata hai jab sitamgar ne
ridayein bibiyon ki chin gayi jalay qaime
tamache khaati thi har dam hussain ki pyari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
nigahe haq mein ibadat hai majlis o matam
ho daur koi bhi karte raho hussain ka gham
yehi to fatema zehra ki dil ka hai marham
adaye ajre risalat hai sheh ki gham khaari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo khaar paon mein daste hai aur nikalte hai
hai zauf itna ke girte hai aur sambhalte hai
jo raahe sham mein sajjad jhuk ke chalte hai
hai tauq bediyon ki is qadar gara bari
<<DIVIDER>>
hilal nauha ye rehan ne pada aisa
har ek simt hai chaayi gham o alam ki ghata
utha hai majlis e sarwar mein shor girya ka
har ek aankh se ashk e aza huwe jaari
furaat e ashq e aza...
hussain ibne ali ki...

items.title: Izzat khuda ke deen
items.body:
izzat khuda ke deen ki bachali hussain ne
nana tumhari baat nibahyi hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun hai jo qaimon may jaa kar khabar kare
asghar ki qabr ran may banaali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon pe pattiyan aap ne baandhi thi ay khaleel
kadiyal jawan ki laash uthaayi hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ro pade thay kamar apni thaam kar
dekha jo ghar batool ka khaali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala may apna bhara ghar luta diya
lekin nabi ki baat na taali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sach to ye hai ke hurmat e islam ke liye
shariyat ki baag e dor sambhali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen e khuda mohib jo andhere may ghir gaya
shamma hussaniyat ki jalaali hussain ne
izzat khuda ke deen ki...

items.title: Jhoola hai jala
items.body:
haathon mein liye nanhe se jhoole ko ye madar
bikhraye apne balon ko kehti rahi asghar
tu kya gaya ke chaya hai aankhon mein andhera
karbobala mein hogaya barbad mera ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola hai jala ay laal tera
hai khaak basar ran mein bano
rone bhi nahi dete aada
hai khaak basar ran mein bano
<<DIVIDER>>
asbab luta qaime bhi jale
chadar bhi chini durre bhi lage
dooba hua gham mein hai kunba
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hookh si dil mein uth'ti hai
aur dard jigar mein hota hai
hasta hua gulshan loota gaya
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se lahoo jo behta hai
shikwa bhi kare to kisse kare
baba hai aur na uska chacha
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sookhi labon ki yaadein bhi
yaad aati hai uski pyari haseen
yaad aati hai uski har ek ada
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisi qayamat aayi hai
murjhayi gayi nanhi si kali
dhadkan mein hai matam ki sada
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
wan ghash mein pade hai zainul-liba
yan zainabe kubra ki hai fughan
kya maajra hai ya rab tu bata
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun sahara de usko
ab kaun dilaasa de usko
barbad hui uski dunya
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
us din se lekar maut talak
saaye mein na baithi ahmed wo
dil ke hai hassan ke gham ye bada
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Kaisi ye shaam aayi
items.body:
kaisi ye shaam aayi aulaad e sayyeda par
sajjad ro rahe hai zainab se moo chupa kar
<<DIVIDER>>
ek samt be kafan hai bhai ka uske laasha
abbas ki behan ka baaqi raha na parda
ab sochti hai zainab maange kafan ya chadar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu kahin pade hai laasha kahin pada hai
zainab ki bebasi pe par ghazi tadap raha hai
roti hai bekasi bhi farsh e aza bicha kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ghar may do qadam bhi paidal nahi chali hai
ek din may wo hi zainab abbas ban gayi hai
pehre pe aa gayi hai tanha alam utha kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad se lipat kar kehti rahi sakina
ehsaas ho raha hai mai hogayi yateema
zaalim dara raha hai naiza dikha dikha kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashon ke darmiyan wo baba ko dhoondhti hai
moo apna peet kar ye faryad kar rahi hai
qadmon may hi sula do baba mujhe bula kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aa gaye najaf se beti ko milne baba
zaano pe rakh ke sar ye kehne lagi wo dukhiya
zainab ujad gayi hai karbobala basa kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon ke saath jhoola bistar bhi jal gaya hai
namoos e mustafa ko baaghi kaha gaya hai
le jayenge subha ko qaidi hamay bana kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzregi kaise yawar maqtal se shaahzadi
abid ne raat momin ye soch kar guzaari
zainab ka naam lega zaalim jo muskurakar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
items.author: Yawar Yusufi

items.title: Kitni mazloom hai
items.body:
ya zahra ya zahra ya zahra
phelu shikasta tooti phasliyan
haye ummat ne kyun darbar bulaya
kitni mazloom hai zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
baade rasool e paak jo zulm o sitam huwe
ta marg unki aankh se aansu nahi ruke
aankhon ke gird pad gaye halqe batool ke
ye zulm ghair ne nahi apno ne dhaaye thay
sadiyan guzaar di gayi jaari hai wo jafa
ahle aza to aaj bhi karte hai ye buka
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
roodad e gham sunaun zara kalmago suno
tareekh de rahi hai gawahi ye aap ko
aaye thay aag leke dar e sayyeda pe jo
eesayi bhi nahi thay yahoodi nahi thay wo
bibi pe jab giraya dehakta hua wo dar
islam keh raha tha yehi cheekh cheekh kar
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh bu-turab thay manshaye kibriya
darbar mein layeen ke pahunchi jo sayyeda
hasnain ke siwa koi hamdard hi na tha
sab jaan nisaar hogaye qatil ke hamnawa
jo chod kar gaye thay janaza rasool ka
karte bhala rasool ki beti se kya wafa
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
attharwen baras mein uthaye hai ye mahan
din raat sayyeda ke kaleje mein thi dukhan
dekhi gulu e hyder e karrar mein rasan
roye hussain zainab o kulsoom aur hassan
jab thay ali hisaar mein us din ko royi hai
tanhaiyon mein baith ke mohsin ko royi hai
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwat se daaye jaanib kabhi so nahi saki
khoon ruk nahi raha tha jo zakhmi hui jabeen
tooti jo phasliyan sukoon tha kahin nahi
ab jee nahi sakungi ye zehra ko tha yaqeen
is darja zakhm tha ye kunfaz ki zaat se
tasbeeh pad na paaye kabhi seedhe haath se
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghusl o kafan ka waqt jo aaya tha bakhuda
maula ke ghar qayamat e sughra hui bapa
girya ali ka sun ke ye zainab ne ki buka
jaan se guzar na jaaye kahin sher e kibriya
yaara raha na zabt ka rone lage ali
phelu ka zakhm dekh ke kehne lage ali
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch to batao logon rulaya gaya hai kyun
makhdooma e jahan ko sataya gaya hai kyun
ye zulm baad e marg bhi dhaaya gaya hai kyun
mayyat ko fatema ki chupaya gaya hai kyun
chalees qabr e zehra banayi thi is liye
zehra ki qabr koi musalman na dekh le
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mismaar qabre fatema zahra ko kar diya
jaari hai phir bhi zulm ka ummat mein silsila
le lo jo naam e qatil zehra to hai saza
sadiyon ke baad bhi hai wohi zulm aur jafa
socha kabhi nahi tha ke ye din bhi aayega
padna hai jurm marqade zehra pe fateha
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mesum ke askh tera qalam mazhar abidi
kar hi nahi sakenge bayan wo sitam kabhi
jo zulm seh gayi hai wo beti rasool ki
ta umr meri bibi azadaar hi rahi
ro kar hayaat kaati ghamon ki aseer ne
likha hai marsiya mein anees o dabeer ne
kitni mazloom hai zahra...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Mai pyasa tahe
items.body:
sarwar ka gala khushk tha aur kund tha khanjar
reh reh ke phirata tha layeen sookhe galay par
teeron pe muallaq raha shabbir ka laasha
maa kehti rahi godh may aaja mere beta
<<DIVIDER>>
mai pyasa tahe taygh tadapta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
<<DIVIDER>>
kat'ta tha gala mera qayamat ki ghadi thi
zainab dare qaime se khadi dekh rahi thi
khanjar mere halqoom pe chalta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehwara jhulate thay kabhi jiska farishte
is tarha usay qatl kiya shimr e layeen ne
pyasa dam e aakhir mai tadapta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hota jo zinda to mujhe kuch nahi hota
aajata madad ko mera abbas kahan tha
laasha mere bhaiya ka larazta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
tapte huwe sehra pe ajab zulm tha mujh par
amma wo sitamgar ka bahot kund tha khanjar
kat'ti thi ragay jism uchalta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay zakhm bahot hi tane mazloom pa amma
khanjar tha rawan shimr ka halqoom pa amma
pehlu may jo naiza tha wo chubta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha tha mai har simt se ghere thay sitamgar
abbas na zinda thay na zinda ali akbar
sadma mujhe in sab ka rulaata raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa tahe khanjar tha guluye shahe waala
haa zer-e-tan-e-shaah wo tapta hua sehra
har saans pe takleef utha'ta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ke masayab pe zamana hai tadapta
pur dard ye nauha jo mubarak ne hai likha
is bayn pe rehan tadapta raha amma
aur saamne behta hua darya raha amma
mai pyasa tahe taygh...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Mere bacche tujhe
items.body:
farsh majlis ka kahin bichta hai jab bhi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete hai salaami zainab
haye zainab haye zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
taaziya khano mein aankhon ko bighone waale
kaise bhoole tujhe shanbir ko rone waale
ki ye bunyad e aza tu ne hi rakhi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri qurbaniyan bhoolengi na insano ko
raunaqein de gayi dunya ke azakhano ko
tere ujde huwe qaime ki udaasi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisko kehte hai sukoon tera jigar kya jaane
terri nazron mein hai ghazi ke tadapte shaane
aur phelu mein kisi jhoole ki garmi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne mit'ti hui shabbar ki nishani dekhi
khoon ugalti hui akbar ki jawani dekhi
tu ne dekhi hai sakina ki yateemi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
uff wo tapta hua sehra wo hussain ibne ali
haye wo khushk gala haye wo zaalim ki churi
haye maqtal mein wohi tu bhi khadi thi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
rassiyon mein jo jakadte hai tere shaano ko
kaash itna koi batlade musalmano ko
tu hai mukhtare do aalam ki nawasi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
umr bhar sar kabhi ghairat se uthaya na gaya
dard minhaal se bhi dil ka sunaya na gaya
pooche abid se koi teri aseeri zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
is qadar tashna jigar tashna dahan koi nahi
laakhon behnein hai magar aisi behen koi nahi
bhai ki yaad mein beton ko na royi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye hai nayyar o aamir bhi salaami ke liye
hum to paida hi huwe teri ghulami ke liye
maaon behno ka sharaf teri kaneezi zainab
mere bacche tujhe dete...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Aao baba ko ruqsat

ye koi aur nahi hai ye ali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah baandhi gayi uske galay mein rassi
jis mein khayncha gaya usko wo gali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam o girya se faariq nahi koi maujood
aalam e sarmadi o lam yazali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayyat e silsila e zakhm hai jaari ye naved
har wali ibne wali ibne wali zakhmi hai
ghar mein allah ke...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Haqdar mujahid
items.body:
haq daar mujahid ay abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e haram mashkeeza liye jald aaiye darya se
pani ke liye bechain yahan bacche hai khade pyase
aa dekhle pyasa hai mujahid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haibat se teri bhaage hai layeen abbas darya se
aada se taraayi cheen liye do roz ke pyase
aa dekhle tareekh hai shahid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde ke muhafiz aa bhi jaa ye kaisi neend aayi
bewon ki ridayein lene ko hai fauje yazeed aayi
aa koi nahi behosh hai abid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher e dilawar aa bhi jaa zainab ki himayat ko
hai raat bhayanak nikli hai qaimon ki hifazat ko
aa dekhle islam ki qayad ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
farzande nabi hota hai zibha abbas sajde mein
tanha hai shahe deen koi nahi juz yaas sajde mein
aa aakhri sajde mein hai saajid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...

items.title: Haye re majburiyan
items.body:
haye re majburiyan abbas ki majburiyan
ek bahadur par laga di jang ki pabandiyan
haye re majburiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayz may abbas kehte thay ke sun ay fauj e shaam
ek thokar may bikhar jayengi ye nigraniyan
haye re majburiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke kehti thi sakina aaye na ab tak chacha
lambi hote jaa rahe hai aas ke parchaiyan
haye re majburiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon behta hai mere kaano se ammu dekhiye
zaalimo ne kitni bedardi se cheeni baaliyan
haye re majburiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn thay zainab ke hote gar alamdar e hussain
ghair mumkin tha ke phirte wadiyan dar wadiyan
haye re majburiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaam kausar ka mujhe kisne diya kyunkar mila
aansuon may doob kar samjha hoo ye gehraiyan
haye re majburiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e qatl e saani e jafar qayam e shaah may
na koi awaaz rone ki thi na thay siskiyan
haye re majburiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir jamal e ghamzada ne ek naya nauha kaha
phir aza e shaah ki chalne lagi purwaiyan
haye re majburiyan...
items.author: Jamal Meerthi

items.title: Hussain ibne ali ko
items.body:
hussain ibne ali ko pukarte jao
qadam qadam pe muqadar sawarte jao
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain wo ke jo sipte rasoole athar hai
hussain wo ke jo noore nigahe hyder hai
hussain wo ke jo binte nabi ka dilbar hai
hussain ibne ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo haq ke waaste gardan kata diya wo hussain
jo taqt otaaj ko thokar laga diya wo hussain
hukumato ko jo neecha dikha diya wo hussain
hussain ibne ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
milay hussain to bande ko haq ki zaat mili
milay hussain to islam ko hayaat mili
jise hussain milay usko kayanat mili
hussain ibne ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
badi khushi se jo akbar ko de diya wo hussain
jo apne haaton pe asghar ko de diya wo hussain
namaze asr mein jo sar ko de diya wo hussain
hussain ibne ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
sare ghuroore hukumat jhuka diya isne
yazeediyat ko thikane laga diya isne
jahan ko sabr ke jauhar dikha diya isne
hussain ibne ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
nihaale gulshane emaan ki taazgi hai hussain
charaghe khanaye kaabe ki roshni hai hussain
meine kamale imamat ki chandni hai hussain
hussain ibne ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
bano hussain ke mehman hurr e jari ki tarha
khade khade na suno naara ajnabi ki tarha
chadao phool akhidat khilo kali ki tarha
hussain ibne ali....
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ghark hoke lahoo mein ubhar gaya wo hussain
jo sabr o shukr se dil fatha kar gaya wo hussain
jo dard banke jigar mein utar gaya wo hussain
hussain ibne ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aaj aal ko choray wo kal kare na gilay
ke daare faani ke milte hai aakhibat mein silay
khusha naseeb jo mirza ko ahlebayt milay
hussain ibne ali…
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Ja ali asghar
items.body:
jaa ali asghar jaa
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ke din ali asghar ko
maa ro ro kar samjhati hai
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhe laaj meri rakhna hai
tujhe baba sang jaana hai
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
is din ke liye hi maa teri
tujhe karbobala may laayi thi
is din ke liye hi beta
tujhe naaz se maa ne paala
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
jaa ali asghar jaa
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu maa ka raaj dulaara hai
tu sab ki aankh ka taara hai
tu sher e khuda ka pota
tera naam ali hai beta
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa laal tere kapde badlun
maqtal ke liye tayyaar karun
aa chehra choom loo tera
jee bhar ke dekh loo beta
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
jaa ali asghar jaa
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi godh may zainab leti hai
kabhi pyaar sakina karti hai
qaimon may shor hai barpa
tu sab ki dua leta jaa
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan may ali ban kar jaana
baba ki nusrat farmaana
shabbir ka tu hai beta
abbas chacha hai tera
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
jaa ali asghar jaa
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
har maa ne di qurbani hai
tujhe meri laaj nibhani hai
jab zaalim teer chalaye
baba ko na lagne paaye
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
ashoor ke din...
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Kalame haq ki
items.body:
kalaame haq ki tilawat hai saani e zehra
ke tarjumane risalat hai saani e zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
agar hai panjatan e paak aaya e tatheer
to ye hai hurmate quran ki bolti tafseer
nabi ke seena sipar hai jo shaahe khybergeer
to inke naam se qaayam hai maqsade shabbir
hussainiat ki niyabat hai saani e zehra
kalaame haq ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
barehna sar bhi rahi haq ki aabru bankar
ke ab hai chehra e islam par wazu bankar
gayi jo sajde mein to haq ki justuju bankar
hai aaj deen ki rag rag mein ab lahoo bankar
azan hussain iqamat hai saani e zehra
kalaame haq ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo pahunchi karbobala qaid-e-shaam se chutkar
pukara ganje shaheedan mein sab ko ro ro kar
kahan ho mere alamdaar aur ali akbar
kahan ho qasime muztar kahan ali asghar
sarapa sog hai hasrat hai saani e zehra
kalaame haq ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad qayamat guzar gayi bhaiya
hujoome aam mein mai nange sar gayi bhaiya
tumahre sar ki qasam dar badar gayi bhaiya
sakina qaid mein ro ro ke mar gayi bhaiya
meinan e ranj o musibat hai saani e zehra
kalaame haq ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
watan ko jaati hoo bhaiya hamare saath chalo
hai intezar mein sughra hamare saath chalo
udaas hoga madina hamare saath chalo
lagega dil na hamara hamare saath chalo
tareek e ashk e mohabbat hai saani e zehra
kalaame haq ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban pe zikr bahattar hai aur zainab hai
ke shab ko khaak ka bistar hai aur zainab hai
hamesha matame sarwar hai aur zainab hai
ek aansuon ka samandar hai aur zainab hai
ghame hussain ki fitrat hai saani e zehra
kalaame haq ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
khuloose dil se yehi kijiye dua mehshar
ke ho har ek ko deedar e karbala mehshar
bulaye rauze pe jo binte sayyeda mehshar
chadaun apne salaamon ki ek rida mehshar
mere qalam ki ibadat hai saani e zehra
kalaame haq ki…
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Kehta hai tumse
items.body:
kehta hai tumse maahe moharram hussainiyo
mazloome karbala ka hai ye gham hussainiyo
ya maula ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hai dard shor e buka se utha kare
jalta hai gar adoo e aza to jala kare
taskeen e qalb e binte payambar hua kare
humko ghame hussain ki daulat mila kare
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo gham ke jis se hogaye maghmoom khud rasool
wo gham ke jis ne aale nabi ko kiya malool
wo gham ke jis se baakhi hai deen ke sabhi usool
wo gham ke jiska dark nahi ho saka usool
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo gham jo har shareef ke dil ko rula gaya
wo gham jise hararat e emaan kaha gaya
wo gham jo deen e haq ka muqaddar bana gaya
roze azal se kauno makan mein kiya gaya
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo gham ke jisne murda zameerein jila diye
wo gham ke jisne raaste haq ke dikha diye
wo gham ke jisne dard ke dunya basa diye
wo gham ke jisne kufr ke maqsad mita diye
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo gham ke jisko zainab e dilgeer ne kiya
be pardagi mein chaadare tatheer ne kiya
dashte bala mein maadare shabbir ne kiya
tauq e gulu ne paon ki zanjeer ne kiya
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo gham jise na bhoolenge sadaat e fatemi
wo gham jo khoon rulaata hai maula ko aaj bhi
wo gham ke jisne bali sakina ki jaan li
wo gham ke jiska badla liya jaana hai abhi
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
lene ko badla zulm ka maula hai beqaraar
be-kal hai inteqam e shahe deen ko zulfeqar
apni zabane haal se kehti hai dilfigaar
mujhko hai bas niyaam se aane ka intezar
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun kar na inteqam ko machlegi zulfeqar
wo bhi hai ahlebait e nabuwat ki soghwaar
wo dekhti hai shaah e zamana hai ashk baar
hoti hai wo bhi saath mein maula ke beqaraar
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
tabooti taakhaton se nahi ho sakega kam
waada hai ye khuda e mohamed ka ahle gham
toofan e haadsaat mein rukte nahi qadam
dil ko sukooon hai saath hai abbas ka alam
kehta hai tumse...
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hai taaha majlise sarwar mein ye fughan
arif hamari nazron mein wo taab hai kahan
dekhe jo haale maadare shabbir khasta jaan
allah dil shikasta shahe karbala ki maa
kehta hai tumse...
items.author: Mir Taha Istefa

items.title: Mai qaid hoke bhi
items.body:
mai qaid ho ke bhi ghar karbala se jaaungi
yazeediyat ki imarat gira ke aaungi
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke sher ki beti behan hoo ghazi ki
hila ke rakh doongi bunyad zulm o zaari ki
jinho ne kaata hai sar unke sar jhukaungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe qasam hai teri tashnalab shuja'at ki
mujhe qasam hai mere bhai teri ghurbat ki
ameer e shaam ko barbaad kar ke aaungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi hussain nazar aaungi kabhi abbas
yateem bachon ko hone na dungi kuch ehsaas
har ek zulm o sitam se unhe bachaungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinho ne ay mere bhaiya tujhe kafan na diya
jinho ne cheeni ay bhai mere sar se rida
mai unke rukh se naqabon ko hataungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mita ke chodungi bhaiya mai tere qatil ko
har ek mahaaz pe hogi shikast baatil ko
har ek mahaaz pe tera alam lagaungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukari dekh ke maqtal ki simt binte ali
salaam le mere bhai mai suye shaam chali
mai waapis aaungi aur ghazi ban ke aaungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ahle zulm ka jeena haraam kar dungi
jahan se upri jo qismat tamaam kar dungi
jo waada tu ne kiya tha wo mai nibhaungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chali ye kehte huwe karbala se wo gohar
khitaab mere pidar ka hai faatah e khyber
jo aaj maine kaha hai wo kar dikhaungi
mai qaid ho ke bhi...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Mere bachon meri
items.body:
wo zakhmi ali aur wo ekkeeswi ki shab
bahcon se ali bole khareeb aao mere sab
sar baap ka chooma to ye kehne lagi zainab
saaya mere baba ka salamat rahe ya rab
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sunte hi moo phayr ke rone lage hyder
kyun rote hai jab bachon ne ye poocha lipat kar
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar may kohraam tha jab ali ne kaha
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kal yahin se uthega janaza mera
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kafan odh kar ghar se jaunga mai
jaanta hoo bahot yaad aaunga mai
mujhko dhoondoge hujre may jaa kar magar
chaah kar bhi tumhe mil na paunga mai
dekhlo chehra jee bhar ke tum baap ka
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
ghar may kohraam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal bazaar ka aaya jab roo baroo
ro ke hyder ne beton se ki guftugoo
mere sar se jo aaya hai beh kar abhi
saaf kar do meri aankh se wo lahoo
dekhlun mai zara betiyon ki rida
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
ghar may kohraam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho abbas jab qaid hogi behan
na hi tum hoge aur na hussain o hassan
mere sajjad ko paas lao mere
usne chalna hai kaanton pe seh kar chuban
bosa lelun mai sajjad ke paon ka
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
ghar may kohraam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere hote huwe dar giraya gaya
fatema ko tamacha lagaya gaya
mar chuka tha wahin jab mere saamne
haath par taziyana lagaya gaya
dafn ho jaye ab badan bhi mera
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
ghar may kohraam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri ek zarb par dekho rona nahi
yaad karna wo khanjar wo jalti zameen
hoga jab maa ki godhi may bete ka sar
tera zarbein chalayega jis par layeen
aakhri baar mai choom loo wo gala
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
ghar may kohraam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinko khaana khilaata tha jaa kar ali
unka mere ilaawa nahi hai koi
tum khayal un yateemon ka rakhna hassan
baithna saath jab yaad aaye meri
kal se doonga unhe kaise mai hausla
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
ghar may kohraam tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay raza aur zeeshan kya waqt tha
haath zainab ka shabbar ko saumpa gaya
sar jhuka kar bahot royi ummul baneen
aakhri saans may jab ali ne kaha
saump doo haath ghazi ko shabbir ka
mere bachon meri aakhri raat hai
ghar may kohraam tha...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Aao chale karbala
items.body:
hai hamari dars gaah karbala karbala
haq ka seedha rasta karbala karbala
chalo chalo hame tumhe pukarti hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala ban ke safeerane aza
tum bhi chalo hum bhi chale
saath ho zehra ki dua
aao chale karbobala ban ke safeerane aza
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein tumhe quran milega
fatema tuz zahra ka faizaan milega
tum ko har ek mulk ka insaan milega
parcham e abbas nigheban milega
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao chale parcham e abbas utha kar
shehr e najaf se chale karbobala mil kar
sheh ke azadaro ka ho saath samandar
pal mein badal jayega hum sab ka muqadar
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dene chale pursa hussain ibne ali ka
nauha padhe chal ke alamdar e jari ka
momino matam kare humshakle nabi ka
qasim o baysheer ka pursa de sabhi ka
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
shukr e khuda maula ke zawaar bane hum
aal e mohamed ke tarafdaar bane hum
hyder e karaar ke hub daar bane hum
zehra ke bachon ke azadaar bane hum
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maango dua unki bhi poori ho duayein
dete hai maula ko jo ro ro ke sadayein
maula mere jald unhe dar pe bulayein
karte huwe matam e shabbir wo aayein
chalte raho saath liye saara zamana
aao chale karbobala...
items.author: N. Sarwar, J. Jaffri & A. Shanawar

items.title: Abbas ja rahe hai
items.body:
saqqa e haram sunte hai pyason ki sadayein
abbas ko tadpati hai qaimon ki fizayein
is tarha se mashkeeza bhara nahr pe ghazi
choo paaye na abbas ko darya ki hawayein
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas jaa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hosh o hawaas le kar
bachon ki aas le kar
aankhon may pyaas le kar
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab gham ki inteha hai
qaimon may ghul macha hai
ek majlis e aza hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk e sakina khaali
thi jaise ek sawaali
saqqe ne hai uthaali
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon ko de ke ghazi
jeeti hai ran may baazi
pyasa hai ab namazi
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abr o falak hai zakhmi
farq e falak hai zakhmi
baazu talak hai zakhmi
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gurz e sitam laga hai
teer e sitam chala hai
qalb e falak hila hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mask o alam mile hai
ahle haram mile hai
loh o qalam mile hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saabir hai bawafa hai
farzande fatema hai
iqbal ghamnawa hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
items.author: Iqbal Abedi

items.title: Alam ooncha rahe
items.body:
hawaon may fazaon may sakina ki duaon may
hai ghar ghar par alam tera alamdar e wafa ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
alam ooncha rahe tera alamdar e wafa ghazi
hai ye armaan zainab ka alamdar e wafa ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
kahe har matami tera alam jhukne nahi denge
hawa ka zor ho jitna alam jhukne nahi denge
kate baazu chide seena alamdar e wafa ghazi
alam ooncha rahe tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
alam se jo hawa aaye shifa baante qaza taale
pharera jab bhi lehraye muhibbon ki bala taale
nahi koi tabeeb aisa alamdar e wafa ghazi
alam ooncha rahe tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera naukar mere ghazi kisi dar par nahi jhukta
alam jo bhi uthaata hai to sar nahi uska jhukta
julooson may yehi dekha alamdar e wafa ghazi
alam ooncha rahe tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum arshi hai ya farshi hai yehi hum bhool jaate hai
alam ke saaye may aa kar sabhi hum bhool jaate hai
karam tera hai ye kaisa alamdar e wafa ghazi
alam ooncha rahe tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
wafadari ka hai rishta taqaza hai mohabbat ka
bhigo deta hai aankhon ko alam ke saath mashkeeza
karoo ye dekh ke nauha alamdar e wafa ghazi
alam ooncha rahe tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhara pani se mashkeeza udoo se cheen kar darya
ye bola shimr lashkar se na dena sher ko rasta
bada wo jaanib e qaima alamdar e wafa ghazi
alam ooncha rahe tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazab ke bain hai safdar likhe jo aaj mazhar ne
alam jhukte huwe dekha kaha beti se sarwar ne
ke darya par gaya maara alamdar e wafa ghazi
alam ooncha rahe tera...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Amma kab ghar
items.body:
amma kab ghar jayenge
qaid may kya mar jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
subho parinde jaate hai
sham ko wapas aate hai
kya hum bhi ghar jayenge
amma kab ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ka sar be-peeron may
bhai hai zanjeeron may
kaise le kar jayenge
amma kab ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwaab may baba aaye thay
mujhse lipat kar kehte thay
khuld may le kar jayenge
amma kab ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ka sar par hai saaya
aisa lagta hai bhaiya
qabr bana kar jayenge
amma kab ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai nahi hargiz manungi
bas ek shart pa jaungi
ammu le kar jayenge
amma kab ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ka laasha maidan may
ahle haram hai zindan may
hum to yahin mar jayege
amma kab ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gayi ek din wo anwar
jo ye kehti thi aksar
qabre nabi par jayenge
amma kab ghar...
items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Aur phir shaam aagaya
items.body:
karbobala se laut ke aaya jo khaafla
qabr e nabi pe matam e shabbir jab hua
zainab ne baal khole nabi ke mazaar par
boli luta ke aayi hoo jangal mein saara ghar
aray nana
mai roti rahi mera ghar ujda tera deen bacha nana
lekin mere hussain ne waada nibha diya
hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>

jo parinda hai be-aashiyana
