<<DIVIDER>>
kaise jeeti wo jab ek din mein
lut gaya zindagi ka khazana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo na ro paayi baba par usko
royega hashr tak ab zamana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer jitne chale ranj o gham ke
uska masoom dil tha nishana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsini mein milay zakhm itne
maut ka ban gaya ye bahana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap maqtal mein beti lehed mein
ab kahan roothna aur manana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi amaari sakina ki khaali
khafila jab hua tha rawana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni ghurbat mein maut aayi usko
tha kafan uska kurta purana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaagte jaagte mar gayi wo
jisko dushwaar tha neend aana
ghar sakina ka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad karna suroor uski turbat
jab andhere mein shamma jalana
ghar sakina ka hai...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Jhoola veeran hai
items.body:
jhoola veeran hai aur godh bhi khali asghar
maa ko batlade kahan basti basaali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe chadar jo na thi maa ne kafan ki soorat
khakh maqtal ki teri laash pe daali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
maar kar teer tabassum ka sitamgaron ko
aabru deen e mohammad ki bachali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool jaaye tera gham bali sakina kaise
teri soorat hai kahan bhoolne waali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
baab e khyber jo utha'te to na hoti diqqat
laash sarwar ne teri kaise uthaali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ghabragayi maathe pe paseena aaya
maut ki aankh may yun aankh hai daali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise ho jaye kisi dar ka bikhari rehaan
hai azal se ye tere dar ka sawaali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Kalmago ye to bata
items.body:
kalmago ye to bata hum teri kya baat kare
tu ne jo aal e mohamed pe sitam dhaaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hum se kehte ho ke shabir ka matam na karo
hum to ghamkhaar hai rone ke liya aaye hai
kalmago ye to bata...
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gayi karbobala may fatema ki beti
is ke bhaiyon ke jo sar naizon pe uthwaye hai
kalmago ye to bata...
<<DIVIDER>>
chin gayi chadare zainab rahe abbas na jab
haye bemaar ko zanjeer bhi pehnaye hai
kalmago ye to bata...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar diya qatl bula ke ghar musalmano ne
ahl e ahmad ke farad khoon may nehlaye hai
kalmago ye to bata...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani maanga tha laga teer galay asghar pe
boond pani ke ewaz teeron ke jaam aaye hai
kalmago ye to bata...
<<DIVIDER>>
bosa lete thay mohamed jis galay ka logon
us pe shabbir ne ummat se zakhm khaye hai
kalmago ye to bata...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha sajjad se zainab ne ye chalte chalte
shaam hai door abhi kitni hum kahan aaye hai
kalmago ye to bata...

items.title: Mai qaidi hoo
items.body:
na maaro na maaro
haye pathar na maaro
pathar barsane waalon
mai qaidi pardesi hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko tadpaane ki khaatir
zehra ka rulaane ki khaatir
raston ko sajaane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte ho azan mein naam uska
dar asl wo hai mera nana
aaye ho tamashayi ban kar
be-makhna hoo mai be-chadar
ay mujhko rulaane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaanto pe chalaate ho mujhko
har gaam sataate ho mujhko
durro se aziyyat dete ho
rone pe qayamat dhaate ho
bazaar mein laane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
din dhoop mein hai shab oss mein hai
har ek lamha afsos mein hai
zardi hai alam ki chehron par
aur gard e safar hai baalon par
dil mera dukhaane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
is shehr ki mai shehzadi thi
sab ko parda sikhlaati thi
azaad kaneezo ko bhi kiya
apna yateemo ko samjha
mujhe qaidi banaane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaye mein nahi chalne dete
aaraam nahi karne dete
girte hai jo oonton se
bache marte hai wo dab kar pairon se
ay rehm na khaane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bhai bhatije maar diye
sar kaat ke phir naizon pe rakhe
raste mein ko thokar khaata hai
bemaar ko ghash aa jaata hai
ay zakhm lagane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan meri aaqa zaadi
darbar mein yun thi faryadi
kohraam bapa darbar mein tha
us waqt nabi zaadi ne kaha
ghar mera jalaane waalon pardesi hoo
pathar barsane waalon...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Matam karo azadaro
items.body:
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka matam karo azadaron
karbal ki shaam o sehar ka matam karo azadaron
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle ahmed tha haye kadiyal jawan ali akbar
maqatal may jaa kar hai soya seene pe barchi ko kha kar
laila ke noor e nazar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghodon ki taapon se jiski pamaal ki laash haye
jis ke janaze ko maula chun chun ke ghatri may laaye
maula hassan ke pisar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sookha gala kund khanjar seene pe shimr e sitamgar
kaise qayamat ka manzar dekhe bhala koi maadar
zehra ke khoon e jigar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane se jiske thi tooti haye kamar shaah e deen ki
zainab ke parde ka haafiz dhaaras mohamed ke ghar ki
ummul baneen ke qamar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
pairon may chaale thay jis se abid ka chalna tha dubar
maare gaye taaziyane bemaar baitha jo thak kar
kaaton bhare us safar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch is tarha se shaqi ne boondon ko kaano se khayncha
zakhmi lawein hogayi thi kaano se tha khoon rista
cheene gaye us gohar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ko kabhi aasman ne dekha nahi tha khule sar
cheeni gayi un ki chadar afsos naize chuba kar
be parda zainab ke sar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
roodad karbobala ki kaise koi bhool paaye
khadim likhe isko kaise rehan kaise sunaye
gham se bhari is khabar ka matam karo azadaron
ujde mohamed ke ghar ka...
items.author: Hasan Abbas

items.title: Nikla hai janaza koi
items.body:
nikla hai janaza koi allah ke ghar se
aflaaq mein ek shor hai matam ke asar se
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos ke masjid mein namazi gaya maara
kuch kam nahi ye hashr qayamat ke asar se
nikla hai janaza koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ko yaad aagayi khud apni sakina
zainab ko hataya gaya jab laashe padar se
nikla hai janaza koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas zara zainab e muztar se khabar daar
faryad mein hat jaaye na chadar kahin sar se
nikla hai janaza koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aagaya zainab ko wo pehlu e shikasta
rumaal hataya gaya baba ke jo sar se
nikla hai janaza koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab se ye kehdo ke wo dil khol ke roye
shabbir ki hamsheer hai rone ko na tarse
nikla hai janaza koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
haan bhool na jaane inhe kufe ke makeeno
guzrengi ye shehzadiyan is raah guzar se
nikla hai janaza koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
as'haab bhi sun paaye na jis bibi ki aahat
sar nange wohi guzregi is raah guzar se
nikla hai janaza koi…

items.title: Aao hum karein
items.body:
aao hum karein ye sheh ka matam
ay hussainiyo
<<DIVIDER>>
majlise aza jahan hui hai
wo makan irum se kam nahi hai
dekh kar ye bole chand taare
har haseen jagah se ye haseen hai
sache dil se jo aayega yahan
dil ki aarzoo payega yahan
sheh ke gham mein karlo aankhein purnam
ay hussainiyo
aao hum karein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnalab sakina ki sabeelein
kis haseen tarhe se ye saji hai
aaj bhi mashk o alam ki nizbat
chacha aur bhatiji se judi hai
shehed se shireen iska zaaeqa
har maraz ki hai bas yehi dawa
ye aza hai zakhme dil ka marham
ay hussainiyo
aao hum karein...
<<DIVIDER>>
matami juloos shahe deen ka
parcham e abbas hai nigehban
ismat e alam ke waaste tum
kardo apne jaan o dil ko qurban
parchame ghazi jo uthayega
zehra ki dua wo shaks payega
uncha hi rahega apna parcham
ay hussainiyo
aao hum karein...
<<DIVIDER>>
har amal se ooncha ho gaya ye
sheh ke gham mein jo ashk bahe hai
ashk e gham hai motiyon ke maanid
kaakni rumaal mein sajay hai
zakire hussain gham shuda bhi hai
gham mein mubtila ambiya bhi hai
ji usool deen ka hai ye gham
ay hussainiyo
aao hum karein...
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe gham jahan jahan bicha hai
arsh ke farishte bhi wahin hai
karte hai nabi bhi aah o zaari
jaani iski zainabe hazeen hai
matami yahan murtuza bhi hai
nauhago yahan fatema bhi hai
hai badi pur noor majlise gham
ay hussainiyo
aao hum karein...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha marsiya ki ye sadayein
goonjti hai jab kabhi faza mein
paata hai sukoon muztarib dil
zikre shahe deen ki diya mein
hai aza e shah haq ka raasta
aake tum yahan maanglo dua
sheh ka naam lete raho har dam
ay hussainiyo
aao hum karein...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis o matam mein raat bhar jo
jaagti rehti hai jinki aankhein
arshe aaftab se munawer
hashr mein hoti hai unki aankhein
ahmed o mohsin ki ye sada hai
dono ki is gham se hi baqa hai
karte hai nauha ye dono baaham
ay hussainiyo
aao hum karein...
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Abbas ja rahe hai
items.body:
bacche tadap rahe hai
abbas jaa rahe hai
har bibi ro rahi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai
apne rida ko zainab
haye hasrat se dekhti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas jaa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhe huwe labon par
bachon zaban na phero
mashk o alam ko dekho
kuch dayr mein yahan tak
khud nehr aa rahi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun mashk tum ne dedi
ghazi ko shahzaadi
ay ranj o gham ki aadi
khush kyun hai ay sakina
kuch dayr ki khushi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhukne lagi kamar hai
abbas ka safar hai
sheh mar na jaaye darr hai
aafat gham o alam ki
sarwar pe gir padi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek shor e al-atash hai
phaila hua faza mein
masroof hai dua mein
kya sog karbalaa mein
umeed aakhri hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein shor e matam
hone laga hai paiham
har aankh hogayi nam
shaam e ghariban daaman
phailaati jaa rahi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke baazuon ko
chooma tha jab ali ne
lamhaat e zindagi mein
baazu bandhenge mere
zainab samajh gayi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan azmi wo
manzar na likh sakunga
bas itna keh sakunga
kehte thay shaahe waala
kam meri zindagi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Amma ki wasiyat
items.body:
zainab utho shabbir badho
zainab utho bhai ke galay ko bosa do
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir badho tum choomo
behen ke baazu ko
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab rakhna ye dhyaan zara
shabbir na tanha reh jaaye
bachon ko fida tum kar dena
bhai pe musibat jab aaye
ab zainab tum bhi saath chalo
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
zainab utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai deen ko bachaunga zainab
har dukh mai uthaunga zainab
gardan ko kataunga lekin
gardan na jhukaunga zainab
nana se waada poora ho
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
zainab utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
sandook may rakkha tha maine
le aao wo kurta meri behen
jab laash ko meri loote to
reh jaaye badan par ek kafan
poshaak purani le aao
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
zainab utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan chil jaaye tauq se jab
abid ke zakhmon ko dhona
ummat ka parda rakhne may
chin jaaye rida to mat rona
tum to tatheer ki waaris ho
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
zainab utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai hai tadapta maqtal may
qaime se nikal kar pahuncho ab
shabbir ke be-sar laashe ko
haathon pe uthaalo ay zainab
majaaye ko ab qurban karo
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
zainab utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka maqsad leke chalo
haq baat karo darbaron may
majlis ho bapa zindanon may
ho farshe aza bazaaron may
tum karbobala ka zikr karo
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
zainab utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate hai namaze asar ko sheh
lab tishna hai aur tan zakhmi
kehte hai qamar maula in se
reh jaaye namaze shab na kabhi
bhai ko shabon may yaad rakho
amma ki wasiyat poori ho
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Ay sheerkhar asghar
items.body:
ay sheer khaar asghar ay tashnalab sakina
hum nanhe zakiron ka pursa qubool karna
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ko dono tarse maidan e karbala mein
dono rahe hamesha shabbir ki dua mein
bhai behan ka bistar shabbir ka tha seena
ay sheer khaar asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono ki gardano se dekha hai khoon jaari
rasssi ke ek galay mein ek teer se tha zakhmi
ek shaam ki musafir ek karbala ka pyasa
ay sheer khaar asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek noor e chashme maadar ek baap ka sapooti
na wo juda hua tha na ye juda hui thi
maa baap se qaza ne pardes mein cheena
ay sheer khaar asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sheer khaar bacha ek naunehaal bachi
dono ne laaj rakhli mazloom e karbala ki
thukrake alqama ko pani piya qaza ka
ay sheer khaar asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman jala behan ka bhai ka ban mein jhoola
bhai ne teer khaaya hamsheer ne tamacha
sughra se phir watan mein milne gaya koi na
ay sheer khaar asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe sone waali jhoole mein mein sona waala
sote hai khaak par ab shehzadi shaahzada
hum sab hussaini bache padte hai inka nauha
ay sheer khaar asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay asghar o sakina bachon ka hai ye waada
haathon se chote chote dete rahenge pursa
aansu ki hai sabeelien haazir lahoo hamara
ay sheer khaar asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad o hooria ki meesam ki nauhakhani
rehaan azmi ke lafzon ki tarjumani
ye zindagi hamari hai aap hi ka sadqa
ay sheer khaar asghar...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Baba ki wasiyat
items.body:
ekkees ki shabe aakhri saanson ka hai qissa
aulaad ko hasrat se ali maula ne dekha
dil phatne laga dekha jo zainab ne ye girya
maula ne tadapte huwe ghazi ko pukara
bolay ke ay abbas bhale jaan lutaana
ye hukm mera aakhri dam tak na bhulana
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ki wasiyat hai isa dil mein basa le
ghazi meri zainab ki rida tere hawaale
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas tum ab uski rida ban ke dikhana
kurte tere jisne hai badi dayr sambhale
baba ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke kabhi nakshe dekho to ghazi
suraj se bhi kehna ke nazar apni hataale
baba ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir se zainab ko bichadne nahi dena
zehra ne ye dono hai bade naaz se paale
baba ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne suna roke kaha baba ne ghazi
zanjeer na zainab ke koi haath mein daale
baba ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha baba mere ghazi ke hote
jurrat hai kise koi mujhe qaidi banale
baba ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ne kaha waqt hai badal jaate hai beti
ehsaas nahi karte kabhi lootne waale
baba ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ne kaha john mai tab tak hoo muhafiz
jab tak ye mere baazu koi kaat na daale
baba ki wasiyat hai...
items.author: Madad Ali John

items.title: Bas yehi ajre risalat
items.body:
ye jo itrat se mohabbat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat hai zamane walon
<<DIVIDER>>
ye azadari ye girya e hamara matam
ye to bid'at nahi ulfat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak mit nahi sakta shahe mazloom ka gham
isko tauheed se nizbat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hote karbal mein to hum apne gale katwaate
ab bhi dil mein yehi hasrat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum bahate lahoo apna ghame sarwar mein
humko andaza e nusrat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne seene pe sulaate thay mohamed jisko
us nawase ki shahadat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon matam mein bahana hai daleele ulfat
ghame shabbir ibadat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisko emaan ka sarmaaya samajhta hai ghulam
ghame shabbir wo daulat hai zamane walon
bas yehi ajre risalat...
items.author: Ghulam Abbas

items.title: Bibiyon ke qaime
items.body:
abbas alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke hisaar se kis shaan se aabaad thay
bibiyon ke qaime
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khareedi zameen sheh ne pardes mein
zulm ke des mein
thay darinde wahan chaar jaanib khade
khair ke bes mein
jab se abbas se alqama par lagay
gulsitan ban gaye bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehla qaima to khud chote hazrat ka tha
kaampti thi fiza
jaise pehra ho qaimon pe ek sher ka
door thay ashqiyan
hashmi chand ke noor ki chaon mein
jagmate rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon ke jo qaime thay salle alaa
yun bani qaimagah
ek ek taar tha un mein tatheer ka
aagayi sayyeda
saut e quran se thi muattar fiza
kitne pur noor thay bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke hisaar se kis shaan se aabaad thay
bibiyon ke qaime
<<DIVIDER>>
phir hua yun ke darya ki jaanib badi
fauj kuffaar ki
aur udhar taygh abbas ne khaynch li
jang hone ko thi
hukme sheh pe magar door abbas ne
nehr se kar diye bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
saatween se moharam ko roka gaya
pani sadaat ka
pyaas se bacche karte thay aah o buka
boond pani na tha
shiddate pyaas thi al atash ki sada
se larazne lage bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi sakina ki asghar ki sookhi zaban
aagayi lab pe jaan
ho wo akbar ke asghar ke qasim ki maa
saari shahzadiyan
kar rahi thi buka naame abbas se
goonjte hi rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab ye bachon se sheh ke liye
jaan haazir rahe
sheh sakina ke gohar kabhi dekhte
rukh kabhi choomte
pehra ghazi ka tha shab thi ashoor ki
khoon rote rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe ashoor akbar ne di jo azan
thi qayamat bapa
asr tak khoon se dasht mein bich gaya
haye farshe aza
bibiyan reh gayi berida dasht mein
aur jalaye gaye bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehra dene ko rehaan binte ali
dasht mein reh gayi
pursa dene raza aaye maula ali
kaampti thi zameen
jal gaye thay magar raah abbas ki
phir bhi takte rahe bibiyon ke qaime
bibiyon ke qaime...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Dardo ghamo alam
items.body:
dard o gham o alam ki aziyat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai ye shahadat ki raat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mayoos zindagi hai sare paak dekh kar
maula ke doston pe musibat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya dardnaak dard yateemi ki hai khaza
aulaad ro rahi hai ke furqat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai sar ke zakhm se ro ro ke ye namaz
doobi hui lahoo may ibadat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ke harf harf se behne laga hai khoon
shariye mohamadi pe musibat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: Ek faqeer deta tha
items.body:
alwida kul ke madadgaar alwida hyder e karrar
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko dafn kar ke jo aaye hasnain
dekha gali mein rota hai koi ba-shor o shain
aaye aur uske pass kaha bhai kya hua
wo ro ke sar patakta tha aur karta tha ye bain
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo nahi aaya haye wo nahi aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ek faqeer deta tha sada haye wo nahi aaya
teen din ka faqa hogaya haye wo nahi aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab andhera sar pe chaata tha
wo hamare paas aata tha
khaana hum sabhi ghareebon ko
apne haathon se khilata tha
tha ajeeb banda e khuda
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hamara gham gusaar tha
yaadgar e kirdigaar tha
bolta to phool jhadte thay
khamoshi mein rob daar tha
tha zameen pe mazhare khuda
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha se ab jiyenge hum
ashk raat din piyenge hum
uske hote fikr hi na thi
khayenge o kya piyenge hum
jaane wo kidhar chala gaya
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis taraf kahan pe jaun mai
kis tarha usay manaun mai
apne mohsin o maseeha ko
dhoondh kar kahan se laaun mai
naam tak mujhe nahi pata
haye wo nahi aaya

har taraf udaasi chaayi thi
jaane kaisa din ye laayi thi
aaj subha aasman se
ek sada ajeeb aayi thi
dil dhadak raha hai ab mera
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke us faqeer ke sukhan
ro pade hussain aur hassan
kahte thay ye sar ko peet kar
uth gaye jahan se bul-hassan
haye wo hi baba tha mera
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...

kufe ki zameen hil gayi

maara aisa rozedaar ko
zindagi ki shamma bujh gayi
aasman zameen pe gir padha
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...

kab talak ye gham uthayega
ro ke humko bhi rulayega
jisko yaad kar raha hai tu
ab kbhi bhi wo na aayega
humne usko di bahot sada
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekasi aur aisi bekasi
lag raha hai aamir aaj bhi
chauda sadiyan hogayi magar
ainee rizvi us faqeer ki
goonjti hai kufe mein sada
haye wo nahi aaya
ek faqeer deta tha...

items.title: Jhoola veeran hua
items.body:
jhoola veeran hua hai mera asghar na raha
dil pe sadma hai bada mera asghar na raha
<<DIVIDER>>
baad tere mujhe ab neend nahi aati hai
chain ab bali sakina bhi nahi paati hai
kaisi aayi ye khaza haye haye
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…
<<DIVIDER>>
boondh pani ke aewaz tujhko mila teere sitam
zulm ne baandhe rasan kaise karoo tera gham
doo mai ab kisko sada
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

ab bhi khaabon mein mere hasta hua aata hai
tab kahin jaake mera dil bhi sukoon paata hai
meri aankhon ki ziya
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja aghosh mein mai tujhko chupa loo beta
apne bahon mein tujhe jhoola jhulaun beta
ye sitam mujhpe hua
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua....

jab mai jaungi madine to kahoo kya dilbar
pooche gar sughra kahan hai mera bhaiya asghar
kya kahoo us se bhala
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise manzar wo bhula payegi maadar beta
tere seene pe jo maara tha layeen ne naiza
zibha to laal hua
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…
<<DIVIDER>>
waada hai tujhse mera saaye mein na baithungi
gham mein ay laal tere har ghadi mai roungi
meri jaan tujhpe fida
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

darde dil uska bhala kaise ho ahmed se rakhm
na bhula payega mohsin ye jahan uska gham
thi ye ek maa ki sada
mera asghar na raha
jhoola veeran hua…

items.title: Kamar ko thaame
items.body:
kamar ko thaame chale hai maula
jawan bete ki laash uthaane
jahan pe zeen se gira tha beta
wahin pe khoon e jigar bahane
<<DIVIDER>>
badan mein raasha bala ki garmi
aur us pe ghalba hai tashnagi ka
zameen pe bikhre pade hai laashe
ajeeb aalam hai bekasi ka
kise pukaare kise bulaye
juda kiya sab ko hi qaza ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
sujhaayi deta nahi hai kuch bhi
ke noor aankhon ka jaa chuka hai
har ek laashe se khaye thokar
koi dilaasa hai na asa hai
larazte qadmon se ja rahe hai
bas ek ahde wafa nibhaane
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya tha yaum e alast waada
mai ishq ka imtehan doonga
utha ke sadme luta ke kunba
mai apni sajde mein jaan doonga
tamaam ahle falak ne dekha
kaleje thaame hai ambiya ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
na lab pe shikwa na bad'dua hai
magar hai aankhon mein ek samandar
zaeefi chalne se rokti hai
sambhalte jaate hai khaa ke thokar
koi to aaye madad ki khaatir
kiye hai ye bain karbala ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb e zehra ka hai ye nauha
kahan ho noor e nazar batao
mai kab se maqtal mein dhoondta hoo
padar ko awaaz to sunao
sada ye sun kar kiya hai nauha
har ek shaheed e rahe khuda ne
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye din kisi ko na rab dikhaye
jawan ki mayyat padar uthaye
utha raha hai jo laashe akbar
hussain ka ye jigar hai haye
khaleel sabr e hussain dekhe
ke apne dil ka lahoo bahane
kamar ko thaame...
<<DIVIDER>>
badi qayamat ka hai ye manzar
bayan kaise karun mai safdar
lahoo qalam se tapak raha hai
ye baat kaise likhun mai mazhar
hai kaisa saabir ghareeb e zehra
ye sirf mera khuda hi jaane
kamar ko thaame...

items.title: Kehte hai nabi
items.body:
kehte hai nabi fatema zehra se tadap kar
ghar par malakul maut jo tayyar hai beti
ye tum se ijazat ta talabgaar hai beti
<<DIVIDER>>
maloom hai beti ke satayegi ye dunya
jab mai na rahunga to rulayegi ye dunya
afsos tere ghar ko jalayegi ye dunya
paaunga na ek lamha sukoon qabr ke andar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek roz lehed mein hai har ek shaks ko sona
sab ke liye ye khaak ka hota hai bichona
deha nahi jaata hai ye beti tera rona
jaana hai bulaata hai mujhe khaaliq e akbar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitne ye munafiq hai bazaahir hai jo qadim
dukh denge bahot aur zara honge na naadim
darbar mein bulwayenge ek din tujhe zaalim
allah salamat rakhe beti teri chaadar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum honge na tum hogi na hyder hi rahenge

be-gor o kafan dhoop mein hoga tera dilbar
kehte hai nabi...

zinda na bichad kar zara reh paogi beti

kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ye hai khaaliq ki nazar mein teri azmat
dekhi nahi aisi malakul maut ki haalat
ye tera sharaf hai jo ye maangi hai ijazat
de do isay aane ki ijazat meri dukhtar
kehte hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai qamar deen ko allah bachaye
bas bakshish e ummat ki dua hont pe aaye
farzand mera amn o amaan deher mein laaye
ek roz zaroor aayega ghaibat se nikal kar
kehte hai nabi...

items.body:
matam karo hussain alaihis salam ka

items.title: Aaj maqtal may
items.body:
aaj maqtal may ajab be saro samaan hai haram
dil hai majrooh khule sar hai pareshan hai haram
qatle shabbir se betaab hai girya hai haram
waarison may nahi ab koi to hairaan hai haram
zikre mazloomi shaahe madani karte hai
kabhi aahein to kabhi seena zani karte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime sab jal chuke hai loot chuke hai aada
farq par hai kisi bibi ke na maqna na rida
shaam hone ko hai sunsaan hai jangal saara
paas bacchon ko liye baithi hai binte zahra
pyar karti hai isay gah usay samjhati hai
koi masoom jo rota hai to behlati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke farmati hai ye khwahare sultane anam
utho sajjad ki ab din hua jaata hai tamaam
jhat pata waqt hai kuch der may hone ko hai shaam
ab na qasim hai na abbas na akbar na imam
dil e paj murda pa ek gham ki ghata chaayi hai
raat hone ko hai aur aalame tanhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan may pahunchi jo sajjad ke zainab ki sada
khol kar aankh ye ki arz basad aah o buka
kya kahun aap se qaabu may nahi dil mera
tap zyada hai to ghaflat bhi hai kuch aaj siwa
kaun maara gaya aur kaun juda hota hai
mujhko kuch hosh nahi hai ke ye kya hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bole fizza se ye phir abid e bemaar o hazeen
jitne bacche hai bula lo to unhe mere qareen
jamah fizza ne kiya bacchon ko la la ke wahin
par na do ladke thay aur ek sakina ghamgeen
dhoondne chaar taraf misle nazar jaati thi
un ke rone ki sada bhi na magar aati thi
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha abid ne ki ay khwahare sultane huda
laaiye sheh ne banayi hai jo farde shohda
dekh loo wo to mere dil ko tasalli ho zara
naam twhreer hai us fard may kiska kiska
jo gaye khuld me ab khwaab hai surat unki
jo mere saath hai laazim hai hifazat unki
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke ye kehne lagi zainabe tafteeda jigar
le gaye loot ke asbaab to sab baani e shar
usi asbaab may wo fard bhi thi ay dilbar
sun ke kehne lage sajjad ye badeeda e tar
fikr kuch aur mai pabande alam kar loonga
qatl jo hogaye naam unke raqam kar loonga
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke ye likhne lage khaak pe naam e shohda
yaad aaye jo wo sab karne lage aah o buka
dil pe ek teer laga naam jo asghar ka likha
ghame jaankah se tharra gaye saare aaza
yaad karte thay unhe jab to jigar jalta tha
teen bachon ka kahin par na pata chalta tha
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke karne lagi sajjad se zainab ye kalaam
jaye tashveesh hai din koi ghadi may hai tamam
dhoondne bacchon ko jaati hoo ki ho jaye na shaam
do ijazat mujhe beta ke tumhi ab ho imam
raasta bhool gaye hai na idhar aayenge
dasht may jaa ke pukarungi to mil jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke abid se chali khwahare sultane huda
aa zara saath mere mud ke ye fizza se kaha
wo bhi hamraah hui karti hui aah o buka
paon rakhti thi kahin aur kahin padta tha
jaa baja dasht may laashe jo nazar aate thay
dil dhadakta tha qadam khauf se tharrate thay
<<DIVIDER>>
aah thi lab pe rawan ishq thay aur dil tha fugaar
ek taraf ko ye chali jaati thi ba haalat e zaar
nagahan door se dikhlayi diya ek sawaar
boli fizza se ye zainab ke zara badh ke pukar
minnate uski karenge to taras khayega
us se bachon ka pata dasht may mil jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm paana tha ki fizza ne ye di bad ke sada
ay sawaar is taraf aa is taraf aa behre khuda
koi takleef na denge tujhe hum iske siwa
hum gareebon ki hai ek arz usay sunta jaa
dil hai majrooh bahot roye jo hai bhai ko
tujhse kuch poochna hai fatema ki jaayi ko
<<DIVIDER>>
mutawaje hua wo sunte hi fizza ki sada
paas aakar kahan kya poochti hai ay dukhiya
boli ye khwahare shabbir ke ay mard e khuda
kisi bacche ko to dekha nahi tu ne ye bata
tashna lab hai watan awaara hai dikh paye hai
choot kar saath se jangal may chale aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arz ki us ne jigar thaam ke ba-deeda e tar
abhi sehra may jo ek simt padi meri nazar
dekha ek laashe par khoon hai zameen par be-sar
ladki ek choti si baithi hui roti hai magar
wo bhi rota hai udhar jiska guzar hota hai
us ke naalon se ajab dil pe asar hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
roke farmane lagi zainab e majrooh e jigar
meharbani ka sila de tujhe rabb e akbar
bas pata mil gaya ehsaan hua tera mujh par
kehke us simt chali girya kuna khaak e basar
ashk e khoon behte thay qaabu may dile zaar na tha
ek fizza ke siwa doosra ghamkhwar na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunchi maqtal ki taraf dhoondti binte zehra
dekha us jaa pa hai ek noor se mamoor gadha
laash ek usme padi hai ke nahi sar jiska
aur sakina wahin baithi hui karti hai buka
ghash jo hoti hai maza maut ka mil jaata hai
chaunk padti hai to dil seene may hil jaata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi nazdeek gharaz zainab e tafteeda jigar
baith kar le liya aaghosh may ba-deeda e tar
boli lipta ke kaleje se mai qurban tujh par
tu ne pehchan liya baap ka laasha kyun kar
hijr se maadar e nashaad hui jaati hai
bibi ab ghar may chalo raat hui jaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arz ki usne phuphi se ye basad aah o buka
furqate sheh may tadapne jo laga dil mera
aake is dasht may chillayi mai baba baba
ay phuphi mujhko isi laash se aayi ye sada
aayi hoo seena e shabbir pe sone ke liye
kaha zainab ne ke ab ghar chalo rone ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to behlati thi ro ro ke wo deti thi jawab
aatish e gham se wo nanha sa kaleja tha kabaab
godh may machli hua dil jo zyada betaab
pyaar karke use zainab ne ba chashme pur aab
li balaaein kabhi gah aankhon se aansu poche
khoon e sarwar se bhare jo thay wo gaysu poche
<<DIVIDER>>
dono bacchon ko chali dhoondne phir wo muztar
dekhti kya hai ke wo baaghe nabi ke gultar
nagahan jaa padi ek simt biyaban may nazar
baahein gerdan may hai aur so rahe hai rakhe sar
gard is tarah hai un chand se rukhsaron par
abr bareek ho jis tarah se sayyaron par
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi nazdeek jo roti to ye naksha dekha
mitti sarka ke wahan lete hai wo maahleqa
hont sookhe huwe thay pyaas jo thi had se siwa
jis jagah paa ke tari kuch ho kaleja thanda
baap ka seena nahi maa ki bhi aaghosh nahi
aise ghaafil hai ki tan ka bhi unhe hosh nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhte hi inhe bas baith gayi zainabe zaar
le ke dono ki balayein kiya phir khoob sa pyar
sar rakhe khaak se zaanu pe utha kar ek baar
boli ab ghar may chalo neend se ho kar hoshiyar
sard jangal ki hawa baaees aaram hui
dashte ghurbat may khabar bhi hai tumhe shaam hui
<<DIVIDER>>
neend se jab huwe hoshyaar na wo rashke qamar
dam na paaya to ye farmane lagi peet ke sar
jhuk ke phir ghaur se chehro pe ki zainab ne nazar
shayad in dono ka ab ho gaya dunya se safar
dashte ghurbat may kiya sab se kinara bachon
haye be maut tumhe pyaas ne maara bachon
<<DIVIDER>>
arz karne lagi zainab se ye fizza ghamgeen
bibi hae hae mere dil ko yehi hota hai yaqeen
loot kar qaimon ko jaane lagi jab fauje layeen
aagaye ghodo ke paon may ye khursheed e mubeen
haal inke jigar o qalb ko tadpaate hai
phool se jismon pe sab neel nazar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bas haseen rok qalam ab nahi taabe tehreer
dil may nashtar ki tarha chubte hai ab ranj ke teer
saaf har zakhm sada dete hai hae hae shabbir
kaisi bargasta hui ahle haram ki taqdeer
aasman gir na pada phat ke sitamgaron par
zulm kya kya na kiye fatema ke pyaron par

items.title: Aao matam kare
items.body:
aao matam karein aao matam karein
zeb e farshe aza hogayi sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
aansu'on ki rida rukh pe daale huve
aakhri hichki ye dil sambhale huve
gham ki tehzeeb mein khud ko dhaale huve
tum ho sadiyon se ye dard paale huve
zeenat e lab rahe zikre karbobala
aao matam kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok sakta nahi jabr dena tumhe
hai payambar ka haasil waseela tumhe
daad deti hai jannat se zehra tumhe
haq ne baksha hai gham ka saleekha tumhe
rooh ka faisla zehan o dil ki sada
aao matam kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
shamiyon ke sitam bhool sakte nahi
sabre shahe umam bhool sakte nahi
daastan e alam bhool sakte nahi
aale ahmed ka gham bhool sakte nahi
daamane rooh par naqsh hai karbala
aao matam kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash qasim ki tukde huwi dasht mein
qalbe akbar pa barchi lagi dasht mein
nanhe asghar ki gardan chidi dasht mein
hogaye qatl abbas bhi dasht mein
lut gaya dasht mein gulshan e fatema
aao matam kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
choor zakhmon se hai fatema ka pisar
hai jabeen sajdae haq mein qam farsh par
kund khanjar se kat'ta hai pyase ka sar
khoon chehre pe malte hai khairul bashar
az zameen ta falak ab hai shore buka
aao matam kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab padar ko sakina kahan payegi
kis ke seene pe bachi ko neend aayegi
yaad baba jab aayenge ghabrayegi
narghaye ahle shar hai kahan jayegi
dhayr lashon ke hai khoon hai bikhra huwa
aao matam kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham naseebo ke qaime jalaye gaye
farsh par arsh waale bithaye gaye
ek bachi ko durre lagaye gaye
jitne mumkin thay sab zulm dhaye gaye
ek bemaar aahan mein jakda gaya
aao matam kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
aal ka gham magar juzve emaan hai
ashq aayat hai dard quran hai
hashr ka marhala kitna aasan hai
daaghe matam hi bakshish ka saaman hai
jazb karlo usi ashq mein karbala
aao matam kare...

items.title: Abbas ka alam hai
items.body:
ooncha rahe ooncha rahe ghazi alam tera
har daur mein ooncha raha ghazi alam tera
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sau baras se jhuk na saka
yeh rab ka karam hai
abbas ka alam hai abbas ka alam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
panja hai jalaale daste khuda
patka iska zainab ki rida
taweez e wafa hai mashkeeza
ye mashk o alam honge na juda
patke par raqam hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyon pe muheet is ka saaya
ye shaan wafa ki keh laaya
hyder ne mohamed se paaya
zainab ki dua zehra ki ataa
pyason ka bharam hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ghar se juloos e gham nikle
taboot ke saath alam nikle
hum karte huwe matam nikle
roke jo julooson ka rasta
ab kis mein ye dum hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
go laakh mitana chaaha magar
jaari hai azadari ka safar
har samt alam aate hai nazar
mit paaya nahi jhuk paaya nahi
dunya ko ye gham hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa dekh zamane dekh zara
ye paak alam ki paak hawa
karti hai ataa deti hai shifa
ghabrana nahi kahin jaana nahi
jo maango wo kam hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hazma ko mila jafar ko mila
phir khyber mein hyder ko mila
hyder se dil e sarwar ko mila
nisbat ka sharaf ya shaahe najaf
kya jaaho hasham hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh e alamdari hai alam
zainab ki azadari hai alam
zehra se wafadari hai alam
deti hai sada ye sheh ki aza
rehbar jo alam hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab baarwa hyder aayega
haq kya hai pata chal jayega
kaabe pe alam lehrayega
ye manzar haan dekhega jahan
ooncha jo alam hai
abbas ka alam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hashr ki dhoop mein pahunchenge
ghazi ka alam jab dekhenge
farhan aur mazhar keh denge
ab roz e qayamat ka hum ko
na darr hai na gham hai
abbas ka alam hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Agar shabbir ka matam
items.body:
agar shabbir ka matam na hota
to phir islam mustehkam na hota
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e maqtal tadapti kyun jawani
agar barchi mein uljha dam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
agar dhaaras na banta sabr e shabbir
lahoo baysheer ka tha kam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
na hoti gar bahattar ki shahadat
khushi dunya mein hoti gham na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
na hote gar hussain islam haq par
tumhara aaj tak maatam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
na gar abbas hote jazb e nusrat
buland itna tera parcham na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
na chut jaata agar godhi ka paala
to phir bano ke dil mein gham na hota
agar shabbir ka matam..
<<DIVIDER>>
agar haq par na hote marne waale
azadari ka ye aalam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
na chinti gar sar e zainab se chadar
zameen se aasman tak gham na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
behan gar qaid khane mein na jaati
to bhai faatha e azam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
na milti karbala ko gar bulandi
to phir kaaba kisi se kam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
agar shabbir ke aansu na hote
to dard e qalb e akbar kam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
na milti fazl gar sheh ki tajalli
to moti aansuon se kam na hota
agar shabbir ka matam...
items.author: Fazl Lakhnavi

items.title: Alamdar
items.body:
alamdar alamdar abbas e alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e haram sayyed o salaar na aamad
wo sher-e-bahadur wo jigar daar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash abbas ko ladne ki ijaazat hoti
kya hai nau laakh yahan ek bhi bachta na koi
ek lamhe mein bicha deta wo laashe sab ki
kehti rahi abbas ki talwaar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
hoo ba hoo jafar e tayyar thi qaamat us ki
jang ladne ki adayein thi qayamat us ki
hukme shabbir azaan aur aqaamat us ki
shagird e hassan aahani dewaar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ke chehre pe jalaal aur hashm tha kaisa
rob tha jiski nigahon mein ali ke jaisa
koi shabbir ke lashkar mein nahi tha aisa
ye kis ki nazar kha gayi jarraar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki umeed pe pardon ki zamanat li thi
jab ye zainab ne kaha maara gaya wo ghazi
khud ba khud sar se sarakne lagi chadar sab ki
ay bibiyon chadar ka nigehdaar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
goonji qaimon mein ye awaaz dil e zahra ki
ae behan mar gaya battees baras ka bhai
yaad baba ki jab aayegi kise dekhogi
darya se rukhe hyder e karrar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein gir ke kuchal jayega naaqe se koi
taaziyane koi khayega tamache koi
ab nahi aayega durron se bachane koi
jo karta tha bachon se bohat pyar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne pani tha lekin na piya us ko khayal aata raha
ke abhi qaimon mein sab bacche hai pyase
pani jab le ke chala teer chale mashk chidi gir gaya parcham
bina haath gira khaak pe jis dam
wo pyasa wo pyason ka wafadaar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi bulwaya hai ghazi ne karam farma kar
dekha zeeshan ne darwesh ye manzar jaa kar
roz e ashoor talak roz haram mein jaa kar
sar peet ke kehte hai azadaar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
saqqa e haram...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Amma kise bulaye
items.body:
dekha jo dashte khooni mein zehera ke chain ne
faryaad amma zehra se yun ki hussain ne
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mehmab bula ke ummat ne dil ka sukoon loota hai
naiza sitam ka ay amma seene mein mere toota hai
toofan aasuon ka hai saahil bhi mujhse rootha hai
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
maanga duaon mein jisko usko bhi kho chuka hoo mai
kadiyal jawan ke laashe par maqtal mein ro chuka hoo mai
beenayi kho chuka hoo mai barbaad ho chuka hoo mai
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein jhoola rota hai rota hai qalb maadar ka
tadpa hai mere haathon par nanha sa laasha asghar ka
ye aakhri sipaahi tha ay amma mere lashkar ka
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ki pyaas par amma qurban hogaya ghazi
ek mashk par fida ho kar bejaan hogaya ghazi
amma wafa ki dunya ka quran hogaya ghazi
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ansaar o aqroba mere sar ko kata ke sote hai
pardesiyon pe ay amma kya aise zulm hote hai
dekho hussain ki ghurbat sab zakhm dil ke rote hai
akbar asghar qasim ghazi saare chale gaye
amma kise bulaye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bete ki guftagu sun kar royi rasool ki beti
jalti zameen pe baith kar boli rasool ki beti
mai tere saath hoo beta yani rasool ki beti
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
har imtehan mein beta mai tujhko hausla doongi
zakhmon pe tere ashkon ka marham bhi mai laga doongi
in zaalimon ki nazaron se aaja tujhe bachaungi
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode ke zeen se maula jis dam zameen par aaye
gham se kaleja thaam kar zehra pukaar uthi haye
phaila ke apne haathon ko jhoola bana liya haye
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shadman ke lab par nauha janabe zehra ka
maqtal ne is riwayat ko kuch is tarha se likha tha
khud mazhar abidi jisko nauhe mein dhaal kar roya
aaja meri godh mein aaja qurban ho ye maa
aaja mere hussain aaja...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Awaaz do ali akbar
items.body:
aina aina ali akbar
haye akbar haye akbar
ay naujawan ay naujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz do ay ali akbar awaaz do
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hai meri jaan
maqtal mein hai dhuaan
beta ho tum kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
maara hai kis tarha se tumhe sochta hoon mai
patthar hata hata ke tumhe dhoondta hoon mai
chaaron taraf hai khoon milta nahi sukoon
laashon ke darmiyan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch bhi dikhayi deta nahi mai ghareeb hoon
khushboo se lag raha hai tumhare khareeb hoon
ay mere dil ke chain baba ke noore ain
ab lo na imtehan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine suna hai ghode se tum khud nahi gire
ay mere laal baalon se khayncha gaya tumhe
tum ho yahin kahin kyun bolte nahi
khamosh hai zuban
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise gire ho mujhko batao to zeen se
lagta hai tumne khaayi hai barchi layeen se
chehra bhi zard hai seene mein dard hai
kuch to karo bayan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein aate aate bhi maara gaya mujhe
dooba hua hoon khoon mein patthar ke zakhm se
zakhmi hai ye jigar dekho mere pisar
chehre pe hai nishan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
himmat karo zara si kaleje ko thaam kar
hai waqte asr jaago mere naujawan pisar
laila ki aas hai zainab udaas hai
do aakhri azaan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum khud ali ho beta zara hausla karo
badhne laga hai dard to nade ali padho
aankhein hai meri nam sughra ki hai qasam
ragdo na aediyan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
do maa'on ne jawan kiya tum ko paal kar
qaimon mein jaa ke kaise milaunga mai nazar
mai unse kya kahun behta hai tera khoon
kaise sahegi maa
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
azlaan ro ke kehta raha ye mera imam
beta hamare haal pe hasti hai fauje shaam
dhundhla hai sab jahan hai surkh aasman
chalti hai aandhiyan
awaaz do ay ali akbar...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Ay sheh ke alamdar
items.body:
ay sheh ke alamdar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay zay ghame hyder, ay hyderi talwar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hai behan teri aa dekh mere ghazi
hai dard bhara manzar chadar bhi nahi sar par
hai majmae kuffaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khoon bhara parcham karta hai tera matam
qaimo se dhuwa utha ay bhai mere aaja
faujo ki hai yalghaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad meri sunlo darya se chale aao
tum de chuke qurbani dar kaari nahi paani
jeena huwa dushwar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum baazue sarwar thay shabbir ka lashkar thay
zainab ka bharosa thay bachon ka sahara thay
hoti hoo dilafgaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ka chaman ujda pardes mein ay bhaiya
mai dasht mein tanha hai char taraf aada
mar jaye na bemaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina hai garmi ka mahina hai
do boondh nahi pani hone ko hai zindani
mehshar ke hai aasaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole mein nahi asghar lori de kise maadar
darwaza e qaima par kehti hai wo ro ro kar
mai kisko karoo pyar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ko hoo mai royi keh sakta nahi koi
wo bhai ka sadqa thay bas is liye zinda thay
kya unse saropaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hoo sare zindaan ay bhaai sare uriyan
bazu hai rasan basta purkhaar bahot rasta
nazron mein hai darbaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ne sina khaayi mujko na ajal aayi
seena hua do-paara naizo se usay maara
mai uski hoo ghamkhaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai laut ke aaungi marqad bhi banaungi
mai doongi kafan tujko mohlat de ajal mujko
ay mere wafadaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan kalam roya jab lik chuka ye nowha
majlis mein hua matam jab aaya tera parcham
rote thay azadaar, ay sheh ke alamdar alamdar
ay sheh ke alamdar...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Baba ko kaise bulaun
items.body:
sochte thay ye maqtal may akbar
ran may baba ko kaise bulaun
<<DIVIDER>>
phal hai barchi ka seene ke andar
ran may baba ko kaise bulaun
<<DIVIDER>>
mere seene may tooti hai barchi
hai lahoo mere seene se jaari
kaise dekhenge baba ye manzar
ran may baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
saans meri ukhadne lagi hai
chand lamho ki ab zindagi hai
kya karenge wo maqtal may aakar
ran may baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
choomte thay jise roz baba
pesh e sarwar jo kham hi raha tha
khaak o khoon may bhara hai wohi sar
ran may baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake naiza zameen par gira hoo
dard jitna bhi hai seh raha hoo
dekh kar mujhko honge wo muztar
ran may baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shahe deen pe waqt e musibat
ho chuke haye ammu bhi ruqsat
ab kahan hai koi unka yawar
ran may baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tadapta hoo reti pe ban may
ho raha ha izafa dukhan may
aake tadpenge maqtal may sarwar
ran may baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai pukarunga baba ko jis dam
honge qaime may jab shaah pur nam
meri haalat samajhlegi maadar
ran may baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ye izhaar nauha jawan ka
aayenge ran may jab mere baba
khayenge wo to thokar pe thokar
ran may baba ko...
items.author: Ali Izhaar

items.title: Basar ho maahe
items.body:
ay khuda aagaya maahe aza
<<DIVIDER>>
basar ho maahe aza is tarah khuda e hussain
ho haath seene pe lab par rahe sada e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
namaz e ishq hai padhni ke ba-wazu ho kar
mai intezar may hoo kab mujhe bulaye hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
larazte guzre nabi nainawa ki dharti se
na kar saka koi abaad maa siwa e hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo rakhna dhaar galay par thi inteha e khaleel
yahan pe laasha e akbar hai ibteda e hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
suna to shukr ke sajde may gir gayi farwa
jab ek laashe ko gathri may leke aaye hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawab kyun nahi dete mujhe ali akbar
behan ke khat ko ab aakhir kise sunaye hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhuki hai sheh ki kamar jab se tum abbas gaye
kise awaaz dey bhai kise bulaye hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam ko aage badhaya kabhi gaye peeche
chale jo mayyat e baysheer ko uthaye hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaleja phat'ta hai rehan aur khadim ka
batool kehti hai jis waqt roke haye hussain
basar ho maahe aza...
items.author: Hassan & Najam Abbas

items.title: Bicha ke farshe
items.body:
bicha ke farshe aza sayyeda ko yaad karo
lahoo bahao to zainnul liba ko yaad karo
dua e zainab o zehra hai majlis o matam
safe aza pe jo aao dua ko yaad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema aisi azadari karo
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ibadat hai na reh jaaye kahin is mein kami
shukr khaaliq ka karo tum ko banaya matami
majlis e shabbir se har dam wafadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis e shabbir hai ilm o adab ki darsgaah
ye usi ki yaad mein hoti hai jo hai deen panah
shabbedari se aqeedon ki bhi bezaari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabr o eesaar o wafa ka ye bharam hai doston
ye alam abbas e ghazi ka alam hai doston
zehen mein ghazi ko rakho tab alamdari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis e sarwar ke rutbe mein nahi koi sawaal
ho na paaye farshe matam ka taqaddus payemal
jaise padte ho namazein yun azadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum agar apne ko kehte ho azadar e hussain
dil se ban'na chaahte ho taziyadar e hussain
khatm kar do har siyasat bas azadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe ashoora alam zainab ke haathon se saja
wo alam abbas ko de kar ye sarwar ne kaha
ay mere abbas tum lashkar ki salaari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar aun o mohamed ko ye zainab ne kaha
sar pe rakhlo tum amaame aur kamar baandho zara
apne mamu par fida hone ki tayyari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ultaf e aale mohamed majid apna hai nishan
unke gham mein muztarib unki khushi mein shadman
unke ban jao ghulam un se wafadari karo
sunnat e zainab yehi hai taziyadari karo
jis se khush ho fatema...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Dare najaf se
items.body:
dare najaf se hatunga na sange dar ki tarha
isi sadaf mein rahunga sada gohar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
<<DIVIDER>>
wegha mein hazrate abbas thay pidar ki tarha
jabeen se ghaiz tapakta ba sher e nar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
<<DIVIDER>>
chamakte arsh ke taare thay sab bani hashim
aur unmein hazrate abbas thay qamar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
<<DIVIDER>>
juda huwe shabe meraj kab nabi o ali
baham thay arshe bari par dil o jigar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
<<DIVIDER>>
salami kheemate ashke aza e shah na pooch
bikega hashr ke bazaar mein gohar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan pisar ke kaleje se khaynch'li barchi
hussain kisme hai himmat tere jigar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
<<DIVIDER>>
bala ke dasht mein uryan padi hai laashe hussain
dayare shaam mein saydaniyo ke sar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
<<DIVIDER>>
chaman kisi ka ho taraaj yun khuda na kare
kisi ka ghar na lutay fathima ke ghar ki tarha
dare najaf se…
items.author: Saleem Lakhnavi

items.title: Ek karwan rota raha
items.body:
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan rota raha
karwan kya karwan ka saarban rota raha
<<DIVIDER>>
jab giri bali sakina be-kajawa oont se
dayr tak ek sar sare noke sina rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek peher mein lut gaya pardes mein zehra ka ghar
ye suna jisne jahan bas wo wahan rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
muskurakar jaane kya ran mein kaha baysheer ne
hurmala thaame huwe teer o kamaa rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar be-haal gham se baap ko waqte sahar
umme laila ka pisar de kar azan rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali kooze tishnalab bachon ko takte dekh kar
dasht mein mashk o alam ka paasban rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe ashoora se lekar asre ashoora talak
dekh kar ran ki zameen ko aasman rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kashti e deen e khuda ka na-khuda dil thaam kar
dekh kar akbar ke seene mein sina rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar bureeda be-kafan teeron se chalni laash par
abid e bemaar muztar natawan rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis e shabbir mein nauha sunata hai ahsan
irteza sun kar ye gham ki dastan rota raha
be-rida be-aasra ek karwan...
items.author: Irtaza Johnpuri

items.title: Ghar se nikal raha
items.body:
ghar se nikal raha hai janaza batool ka
girya kuna hai saara gharana batool ka
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e rasool itne masayib huwe nuzool
athara saal hi mein zaeefa hui batool
matam sara bana hai madina batool ka
ghar se nikal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaza e ali ko adoo ne jala diya
pehlu pe haye jalta hua dar gira diya
dushwaar kar ke rakh diya jeena batool ka
ghar se nikal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dewaar o dar ke darmiyan shehzadi aa gayi
ek keeli phasliyon mein jo paywast hogayi
haye shaheed ho gaya beta batool ka
ghar se nikal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
le aaye ghusl khaane mein mayyat ko aeliya
daurane ghusl cheekh pade sher e kibriya
aaya nazar jo pehlu shikasta batool ka
ghar se nikal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wallah de koi to dilaasa hussain ko
mayyat pe maa ki rone na dena hussain ko
rone se iske phat'ta hai seena batool ka
ghar se nikal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain muztarib hai to bechain hai ali
ghash mein padi hai zainab o kulsoom ya nabi
ranj o alam mein gharkh hai kunba batool ka
ghar se nikal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt hai madine mein shor e buka mujeeb
rote hai sar ko peet ke ahle aza mujeeb
rehan ke labon pe hai nauha batool ka
ghar se nikal raha hai...
items.author: Mujeeb Alipuri

items.title: Har dam hussain
items.body:
har dam hussain tera gham hussain
hai yehi dua har momin ki
rahe aankh hamari nam hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tasveer e payambar kai gham mein
ye saara aalam rota hai
ghar ghar mein majlis jaari hai
ghar ghar mein matam hota hai
zanjeer se matam akbar ka
ta hashr karenge hum hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon hyder ka hai asghar mein
is baat ko hurmal bhool gaya
tha teer e sitam halqoom pe jo
naize pe jhoola jhool gaya
hai kar gaya saare aalam ki
har aankh ko wo purnam hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom jawani qasim ki
ab chain se khaak pe soti hai
kar kar ke yaad samandar ko
karbal ki zameen bhi roti hai
jis tarha hua tukde tukde
maqtal mein tera qasim hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
le pursa us masooma ka
kaano se jis ke khoon baha
jo dafn hui zanjeeron mein
jala kurta jis ko kafan mila
takraati thi jo sar zindan se
ro kehti thi har dam hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
na sar ko jhukane paaye layeen
chaaha tha jhukana jis sar ko
khud apne saron se bhi ooncha
pada unko uthana jis sar ko
goh kat gaya tera sar lekin
phir bhi na hua ye kham hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dam karo sunnat hai matam
hai karte rahe ye khud khaatam
na rokne se ruk payega
badta hi rahega ye matam
zainab ki dua hai ye matam
hoga na kabhi ye kam hussain
har dam hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujda hai paak mohamed ka
ban mein hasta basta gulshan
karti hai matam zainab ka
khursheed ke dil ki har dhadkan
tere akbar qasim asghar ka
har saans mein matam hussain
har dam hussain...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Hussain jaanam
items.body:
mera hussain hai sab kuch naseeb kuch bhi nahi
sayyed zaada hussain shahzaada hussain
dilon ka badshaah aayat e kibriya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam farmande farmande
salaam farmande ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jaanam hussain jaanam hussain
aah jaanam ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ya hussain salaam hussain
salaam hussain salaam hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam e dilbare zahra hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaanam hussain jaanam hussain jaanam
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shehenshah e zaman aqile hasan ya maula
tera deedar azadaar ki ulfat ka sila
usko dunya mein sab mila hussain jaan
jis ne ek baar bhi kaha hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrate dil hai ke jab karbobala jaun mai
sajda e shukr karun khaake shifa laun mai
yabnaz zahra hussain qibla hussain jaan
ban ke naukar rahun tera hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek karam aur meri zaat pe maula kar de
aasmano se bhi aaye jo nazar wo ghar de
jis pe parcham lage tera hussain jaan
sadqa ghazi ka ho ataa hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sogaye nehr pe abbas e jari bhi jaa kar
koi monis na raha paas na koi yawar
reh gaye dasht mein tanha hussain jaan
bar labe toh dilam fida hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeen se gir ke zameen par ye kaha akbar ne
zakhme dil aap se baba mai chupaun kaise
aake dekho mera seena hussain jaan
pisar et zakhmiye biyaa hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajda e shukr adaa aap ne maqtal mein kiya
sura e fajr se aane lagi awaaz e khuda
aaja meri taraf aaja hussain jaan
tujhse raazi tera khuda hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mimbar e nok e sina par tera khutba sunke
saamne maaon ke rote rahe pyase bacche
khafila keh ke ye chala hussain jaan
toyi zikram hussain maula hussain jaan
salaam e kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
akhtar o naade ali hai jise irfan e azaa
us se raazi hai qasam rab ki qasam janabe zahra
shukriya dilbar e zahra hussain jaan
shukriya kaabae dilha hussain jaan
hussain jaan...
items.author: Akhtar Abbas Zaidi

items.title: Jaa rahi hai behan
items.body:
utho hussain suye shaam jaa rahi hai behan
salaam karne ko maqtal may aa rahi hai behan
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari bali sakina ke chin gaye gohar
lahoo hai kaano se jaari bata rahi hai behan
salaam karne ko maqtal may aa rahi hai behan
utho hussain suye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
rida bhi chin gayi bhai tumhare qatl ke baad
faqat duaon ki chadar udha rahi hai behan
salaam karne ko maqtal may aa rahi hai behan
utho hussain suye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
waraq zameen pe quran ke hai bikhre huwe
inhi ko dekh ke aansu baha rahi hai behan
salaam karne ko maqtal may aa rahi hai behan
utho hussain suye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhatije bhai aur unke mohib shaheed huwe
isi liye saf e matam bicha rahi hai behan
salaam karne ko maqtal may aa rahi hai behan
utho hussain suye shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
rawan rakhe hai jo zulm o sitam layeeno ne
tamaash beeno ko wo sab suna rahi hai behan
salaam karne ko maqtal may aa rahi hai behan
utho hussain suye shaam...

items.title: Jhuka jaata hai ab
items.body:
jhuka jaata hai ab jism e figaar aahista
zameen par aa raha hai ek sawaar aahista aahista
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda jaane usay kis ke nikal aane ka hai dhadka
ke mud kar dekhte hai baar baar aahista aahista
jhuka jaata hai ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
sinaan o teer ne upar hi roka jism e zakhmi ko
idhar se ab udhar hote hai paar aahista aahista
jhuka jaata hai ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadapne ki bhi gunjaish na rakhi teer o paika ne
bas apni jaan phadakta jism e zaar aahista aahista
jhuka jaata hai ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aisa zauf jaane natawan aayi hai honton par
magar jaari hai shukre kirdegaar aahista aahista
jhuka jaata hai ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sar patka to reti par nashan kuch ban gaye reh kar
jo ragdi aediyan utha ghubaar aahista aahista
jhuka jaata hai ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayour aahista aahista to ye sab kuch hua ab tak
magar chalti nahi khanjar ki dhaar aahista aahista
jhuka jaata hai ab...
items.author: Ghayour

items.title: Kamsin gaye zaeef
items.body:
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye naujawan gaye
manzil bahot kathin thi magar natawan gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ran mein aate hai ab khairiat nahi
mehsoos ho raha hai zameen aasman gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dene gawahi asha-duan-la-ilaah ki
islam par jo waqt pada bezaban gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko sughra karti hai shayad watan mein yaad
qaime se ran mein lete huwe hichkiyan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt e jihaad ye bhi tha ehsaas shaah ko
humlo ki daad kaun de sab khadradaan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aelaan e fatha karte huwe sibte mustufa
sar kat gaya to bar sare nauke sina gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad karbala se chale thay bukhaar mein
ta shaam phir bhi pehne huwe bediyan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
anwar ghame hussain ke sadqe mein ab talak
izzat hui naseeb hamein hum jahan gaye
kamsin gaye zaeef gaye...
items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Kehte thay abide bemaar
items.body:
hoo mai aafat mein giraftaar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar mujhe rone do
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun baaqi hai jo aakar mere aansu poche
bekasi kehti hai har baar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek jiska koi marta hai to rota hai wo shaks
lutgaya sab mera gha rbaar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinko taqdeer hasaati hai wo haste bhi hai
mujhko rona hai sada baar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi baaqi nahi shabbir ka rone waala
hoo mai bekas ka azadar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah e deen chod gaye hai mujhe rone ke liye
koi baaqi nahi ghamkhaar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabt karta hoo to shaukat mera dil ketha hai
hoo bahattar ka azadar mujhe rone do
kehte thay abide bemaar...
items.author: Shaukath

items.title: Mai safeere hussain
items.body:
muslim e aqeel hoon safeer e hussain hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
baatil ka khauf e haq se kaleja laraz utha
bas ek sada se haakim e kufa laraz utha
ehsaas e qalb e haq hoon zameer e hussain hoon
mai aashiq e ali hoon asseer e hussain hoon
zainab ka intekhab musheer e hussain hoon
pehchaan lo mujhko mai safeer e hussain hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim e aqeel hoon mai jaan le jahan
ashjaul arab kahe zameen o aasman
hashmi wirasaton se azm hai jawan
hyderi shuja'atein lahoon mein hai rawan
mai waqt ka hisaar hoon
mai noor ki bahaar hoon
zameen ka ikhtetaar hoon
falak ka iftekhar hoon
mai ishq ka sheaar hoon
wafa ka aetbaar hoon
dua ka ikhteyar hoon
mai sheh ka jaan nisar hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
aetmaad rakta hai ali ka noor e ain
ki mujhe imam ne siparaton ki zain
sar pe hai mere dua e shaah e mashraqain
mai akela zaat mai hoon lashkar e hussain
mai hausle ki jast hoon
wafa e haq parast hoon
maye wila se mast hoon
mai deen ka bandobast hoon
mai aetebaar e hast hoon
mai har hisaar e dast hoon
mai kufa e zameer mein
yazeed ki shikast hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ghulame shaahe deen haq batayega
sheh ka saath dega jo falaah payega
jang jo karega mujhse maat khayega
taygh se meri na koi bach ke jayega
mai daur e inqelaab hoon
mai taygh ka shabab hoon
mai nusraton ka khwab hoon
mai khoon ka hisaab hoon
mai ilm ki kitaab hoon
mai jehl par azaab hoon
hussain ki haseen sifaraton ka intekhab hoon
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa raha hoon choom kar qadam imam ka
haat mein baland hai alam imam ka
leke aa raha hoon mai bharam imam ka
kufiyon pata hai tum ko gham imam ka
zindagi hai tashna kaam
din ka kab hai ehteram
qatl o khoon hai aaj aam
mushkilon mein hai imam
chod kar wafa awaam
khwahishon ki hai ghulam
jo bhi hai mera kalaam
hai hussain ka payam
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaibate imam mein ho aisa intezar
ilm par yaqeen ho amal pe aetebaar
nasiran e haq ka phir se hona hai shumaar
muntakhib safeer hoga kaun ab ki baar
agar ho saum aur salaat
hajj o khums aur zakat
amr aur nahi ki deen e haq mein saari mumkinaat
ho hussain hi hussain
bhool jaaye apni zaat
deen pe yun amal kare
to keh sake ye hum ye baat
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim e ghareeb ne kiya hai jab kalaam
marte dam naseeb ho ziyarat e imam
karbala uthi kiya hawaon par qayam
dekh kar hussain ko kaha hai as-salam
as salamo alaika ya aba abdillah
as salamo alaika yabna rasoolillah
<<DIVIDER>>
choor choor jism hai jigar hai paash paash
hai kahan pisar mere kahan karun talaash
qatl kar ke le chale hai mujhko bad-khamash
maut ke bhi baad hai safar mein meri laash
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazim aur razi ki tarz sab se hai juda
jaffar aur baksh bhai aur ali zia
javedan hai lehja ab bhi sachey bhai ka
hum hai tifle maktab aur ye asaateza
ye hai aza ka kaarwan
ye hai lehen ki kehkeshan
ye lehja o khayal mein ghame hussain ki azan
ye karbala ki dastaan
yeh zikr sheh ka sayeban
azeem hai jo nauhakhwan unhi ka hoon mai tarjuma
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
rizwan farhan sab hai nauha gar
nasir o shujah aur ali safdar
shadman shahid o nadeem sarwar
sab ke sab ki ek hi sada hai ye qamar
mai hoon aza ke paksh par
mai hoon dilon ke arsh par
mai majlison mein nauha gar
majlis aur juloos mein hoon jalwa gar
gali gali nagar nagar
mai aansuon ka hamsafar
mai poori kayenat mein hussain ka payaam bar
mai safeer e hussain hoon...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Matam karo hussainyo
items.body:
ho salaam ya imam ya imam ho salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
matam karo hussainiyo sab musa raza ka
ummat ne jis imam ko diya zehr jafa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
matam hamare paas hai zainab ki amanat
zahra hi iska dengi sila roz e qayamat
ye hukm bakhuda hai mahboob e khuda ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
meelon ka safar kar ke behan milne jo aayi
bhai ki shakl haye kahin dekh na paayi
dam tod gayi jab suna bhai ki qaza ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis jurm mein tukde huwe musa ke jigar ke
kis se kare sawaal koi to jawab de
doge jawab aayega jab roz jaza ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal kabhi kufa mein jaane kahan kahan
ummat ne qatl kar diye thay jo deen ke paasban
kiya zaalimon ne haye na kuch khauf khuda ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhsa hai bhala kaun muqaddar ka sikandar
mujhko banaya aal ka khursheed nauhagar
kis tarha karun shukr mai panjetan ki ataa ka
matam karo hussainiyo...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Mere bhaiya hussain
items.body:
gir gayi laash pe behen aa ke
mere bahiya hussain uth jao
meri dunya ujad gayi bhaiya
kahin zainab ne kaha ghash kha ke
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahi thi ye tadap ke zainab
kis tarha aap ka chupaun tan
kaash chadar mere sar pe hoti
aap ko bhai mai de deti kafan
so rahe ho behen ko tadpake
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
so rahe ho kyun jalti reti par
aankh kholo mujhe dekho uth kar
hai rasan haath mein khula hai sar
mere sar pe nahi baaqi chadar
kaun chadar udhaye ab aa ke
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein hogayi wo tar dekho
jaan basti thi aap ki jis mein
wo sawari nahi rahi bhaiya
ab sakina safar kare kis mein
wo taraayi pe so gaya jaa ke
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi haalat mein chod ke tum ko
kaise dil ko sukoon aayega
bekafan khaak pe tera laasha
chod ke shimr chala jayega
mai chali shaam ko ye gham kha ke
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine maqtal mein ye manzar dekha
rayza rayza hua laasha tera
kaise tum ko mai sameintun bhaiya
itni bebas hai tumhari behna
has rahe hai layeen sitam dhaa ke
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tapte sehra ki jalti reti par
chod kar laash ko chali khwahar
laash ko dekhti thi mud mud kar
aur kehti thi ye zainab ro kar
ab galay hum ko laga lo aake
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe be sar se ye sada aayi
rakhna apna khayaal maajayi
sun ke hyder rehaan ye bibi
apne bhai se ro ke farmeini
shaam jaati hoo thokarein kha ke
mere bhaiya hussain uth jao
gir gayi laash pe...
items.author: Haider Sultanpuri

items.title: Aaj shabbir pe kya
items.body:
aaj shabbir pe kya aalam e tanhaai hai
zulm ki chaand pe zehra ke ghata chaayi hai
us taraf lashkar e aada mein saf aarayi hai
yan na beta na bhatija na koi bhai hai
barchiyan khaate chale jaate hai talwaron mein
maar lo pyase ko hai shor sitamgaaron mein
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi baazu hai kamar kham hai badan mein nahi taab
dagmagate hai nikal jaati hai qadmon se rakaab
pyaas ka ghalba hai lab khushk hai aankhein pur aab
taygh se dete hai har waar ka aada ko jawab
shiddat e zaof mein jis jaa pe teher jaate hai
saikdon teer e sitam tan se guzar jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
gaysu aalooda khoon lipte hai rukhsaaron se
shaane kat kat ke latak aaye hai talwaron se
teer payvast hai khoon behta hai sofaaron se
laakh aafat mein hai ek jaan dil aazaaron se
fikr hai sajda e mabood mein sar dene ki
waar se tayghon ke fursat nahi dam lene ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se tar pech amaame ke hai sar zakhmi hai
hai jabeen chaand si pur noor magar zakhmi hai
seena sab barchiyon se taaba kamar zakhmi hai
teer e beedaad se dil zakhmi jigar zakhmi hai
zarb e shamsheer se bekaar hai baazu dono
zulm ke teeron se majrooh hai pehlu dono
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi aa kar koi pehlu mein laga jaata hai
maarta hai koi naiza to ghash aa jaata hai
badte hai zakhm e badan zor ghata jaata hai
band aankhein hai sar e paak jhuka jaata hai
gird zahra o ali girya kuna phirte hai
ghul hai ghode se imame do jahan girte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
girte hai khatra e khoon zakhm e jabeen se paiham
daste majrooh se khaynch sakte nahi teer e sitam
fikr hai bakshish e ummat ki kuch apna nahi gham
karte hai shukre khuda khushk zuban se har dam
hai abaa teeron se ghurban qaba gulgoon hai
honth ya waqt se zakhmi hai dahan par khoon hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zeen se hota hai juda doshe mohamed ka makeen
chaman e fatema ka sard hai maa'il ba zameen
barchiyan gird hai beech mein hai sarwar e deen
hai ye nazdeek gire mehre nabuwat ka nageen
paon har baar raqabon se nikal jaate hai
ya ali kehti hai zainab to sambhal jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
laakh talwaarein hai aur ek tan e athar hai
ek mazloom hai aur zaalimon ka lashkar hai
saykdon khanjar e faulaad hai aur ek sar hai
na koi yaar na humdam na koi yawar hai
baag ghode ki latakti hai utha sakte nahi
saamne ahle haram rote hai jaa sakte nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
koi syed ka nahi aah bachane waala
harbe laakhon hai aur ek zakhm uthane waala
pyaas mein koi nahi pani pilaane waala
sambhle kis tarha bhala barchiyan khaane waala
charkh se aag barasti hai zameen jalti hai
maare garmi ke zuban khushk hai loo chalti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin dam lene ko saaya nahi hai waqt e zawaal
aenthi jaati hai zuban pyaas ki shiddat hai kamaal
kabhi zainab ka hai ghamgaah sakina ka khayaal
din jo dhalta hai to hazrat huwe jaate hai nidhaal
misle khursheed badan zauf se thar tharata hai
nayyar e burj e imamat pe zawaal aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai zaalimon se khushk zuban dikhla kar
behre haq pani ka ek jaam pila do laa kar
ahle keen kehte hai tayghe sitam chamka kar
aab e shamsheer piyo barchiyon ke phal kha kar
ye sukhan sun ke bhi ghussa nahi farmate hai
yaas se suye falak dekh ke reh jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arz karte hai ye khaaliq se ke ay lab e ghafoor
tu hai aalam ke nahi kuch tere bande ka kasoor
karte hai ye mujhe be-jurm o khata tayghon se choor
haath ummat pe uthaana ko nahi mujhko manzoor
jaante hai ke mohammed ka nawasa hoo mai
pani dete nahi do roz ka pyaasa hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne bachpan se mere naaz uthaye ya rab
wo inayat kya jo tujhse kiya maine talab
tera mehboob bana eid ko mera murakkab
roza rakha to chupa mehr numaya hui shab
bhook mein khuld ka khana mujhe imdaad kiya
bhej kar hirni ka baccha mera dil shaad kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
ab agar hai ye teri maslehat ay rab e qadeer
ho rawan halq pe is pyaase ke aab e shamsheer
mere maula ba-sar o chashm hai haazir shabbir
hukme haakim mein ye taaqat hai karun mai taakheer
jald gardan pe rawan khanjar e baraa howe
ay khushaa wo jo teri raah mein qurban howe
<<DIVIDER>>
gham nahi kuch mujhe go bekas o beyaar hoo mai
zer e shamsheer gala rakhne ko tayyar hoo mai
tu madadgaar hai mukhtar hai lachaar hoo mai
waqte mushkil hai inayat ka talabgaar hoo mai
tere sajde mein ye sar tan se juda ho jawe
ehd e tifli ka jo waada hai wafa ho jawe
<<DIVIDER>>
sakhtiyan marg ki kar apne karam se aasan
lab pe takbeer ho jab khalq pe khanjar ho rawan
dil mein ho yaad teri band ho jis waqt zuban
dam bharun tera hi tan se jo nikalne lage jaan
baad e chehlum jo mujhe qabr mayassar howe
zakhmi tan par na fishaar ay mere daawar howe
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm kar rehm kar sharminda hoo ay yaar e khuda
bandagi ka tere jo haq tha ada ho na saka
khauf e mahshar se badan kaampta hai sar tapa
hogi aamaal ki pursish to kahunga mai kya
koi tohfa tere laayiq nahi paata hai hussain
haath khaali tere darbar mein aata hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
taqwiat dil ko karam se hai tere ya rahman
nahi mayoos ke rehmat hai teri be-paayan
mushkilein bando ki kar deta hai dam mein aasaan
shukr altaaf o inayaat mein qaasir hai zuban
aasiyon se bhi mohabbat nahi kam karta hai
jurm wo karte hai tu lutf o karam karta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai teri raah mein mazloomi se hota hoo fida
tu hai aagaah ke do din ka hoo bhooka pyasa
chahta hoo mai yehi apni shahadat ka sila
maghfirat ummat e aasi ki ho ay baar e khuda
hai gawara mujhe jo kuch ke aziyyat howe
unko dunya mein bhi aakhirat mein bhi raahat howe
items.author: Mir Anees

items.title: Aao ro lein
items.body:
aao ro lein shahe karbala ko
zindagi ka bharosa nahi hai
jo bhi girta hai is gham mein aansu
koi bekaar jaata nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chand maahe aza ka jo nikla
dekh kar ro padi binte zahra
baad is chand ke zindagi mein
koi lamha khushi ka nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand badli mein chup jaa tu jaake
na khabar de moharram ki aake
jab se dekha hai tujhko falak par
mera sajjad sota nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jale honge qaime haram ke
jab chini hongi sar se ridayein
guzri hogi kya saydaniyon par
wo samaa dil se jaata nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer itne lage hai badan mein
bhai mera tadapta hai ran mein
dekh kar mere bhaiya ki haalat
mera dam kyun nikalta nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein jo jayegi zainab
kya batayegi bhai ko zainab
chutt ke zindan se jo aa rahe hai
un mein pyari sakina nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
behre ta'zeem utho ay akbar
parda daari karo mere dilbar
aa rahi hai sawari phupi ki
jis ka koi sahara nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaye mere saare dulaare
kaun mehmil se mujhko utaare
amma fizza do aake sahara
paas abbas mera nahi hai
aao ro lein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab madine mein jayegi zainab
kya batayegi sughra ko zainab
wo nishan e rasan baazuon par
neel ab tak bhi choota nahi hai
aao ro lein...

items.title: Abbas ka gham
items.body:
abbas ka gham hum karte hai
hum apna lahoo zam karte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe gaya laane pani
nazron mein sakina thi pyasi
abbas e dilawar sher e jari
oonchayi pe parcham karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sher tarayi par biphra
ghazi ko koi kya rokega
darya pe wo qabza kar ke kaha
jo chahenge wo hum karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza chida tooti hai aas
pani nahi pahuncha hai ehsaas
sharminda bhatiji se abbas
ehsaas ye paiham karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode se gira abbas e jari
aaqa lo khabar aakar uski
sheh bole kamar tooti meri
sheh rote hai matam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein alam laaye sarwar
sab bibiyan kehti hai ro kar
ab zulm o sitam honge hum par
saqqe ka sabhi gham karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya hai alam ammu hai kahan
maangungi na pani aao yahan
lab par ye sakina ki hai fughan
shikwa na yahan hum karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sau baras ke baad abhi
lagta ha ke gham kul hai yehi
rote hai malayek aur nabi
har aankh wo pur nam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to zara matam ka asar
har saal se hota hai bad kar
yaad aata hai karbal ka manzar
matam na kabhi kam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aap ke baad ye haal chacha
durre wo tamachon ka lagna
ro ro ke sakina ne ye kaha
is tarha basar hum karte hai
abbas ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke ay matamdaron
kismat pe sabhi tum naaz karo
sab mil ke raza awaaz ye do
maula tera matam karte hai
abbas ka gham...
items.author: Raza

items.title: Agaya mahe moharam
items.body:
ay azadaron sheh ke pursadaron
<<DIVIDER>>
aagaya maahe moharram aao tayyari karein
karbala waale shaheedon se wafadari karein
<<DIVIDER>>
royein zainab ki rida ko gham kare shabbir ka
mil ke sab aale mohamed ki azadari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
farsh hum dil mein bicha ke matami mil kar sabhi
majlis e shabbir barpa zindagi saari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
matame shaahe saheedan kar ke sab ahle aza
sog mein ibne ali ke girya o zaari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar ke izhaar e aqeedat fatema ke laal se
ehtemam e zuljanah o taziyadari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar ke matam sheh ka de ke ya hussaina ki sada
gham ali ke laal ka kayenat par taari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik e kausar labe darya huwe pyase shaheed
naam par unke sabeelein hum sada jaari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam e shabbir hai jawad saaman e shifa
jo bhi dushman hai azaa ke unse bezaari karein
aagaya maahe moharram...
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Alamdar kahan ho
items.body:
alamdar kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki buka thi mere ghamkhwar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho alamdar alamdar alamdar kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor gaya aayi hai ab gyara moharram
naaqe pe rasan basta suye shaam chale hum
hai aale nabi gham mein giraftaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ghar se chali tum ne amari mein bithaya
bazaar karo band ye aelaan karaya
mai jaati hoo ab shaam ke bazaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
maloom hai tujhko ye bada sakht safar hai
unnees maqamaat se zainab ka guzar hai
har gaam wahan honge sitamgaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho barasne lage sadaat pe pathar
jab rote hai sadaat to haste hai sitamgar
hai aale nabi bekas o lachaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
lamhon ki musafat hui sadiyon ke barabar
darwaza e sa'ad pe khade hum hai khule sar
awaaz tumhe deta hai bemaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh hai sab haakim e badkaar ke darr se
gustakhi layeen karta hai sahbbir ke sar se
ay baazu e shabbir wafadaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad thi zainab ki yehi safdar o mazhar
kis tarha bayan hoga wo darbar ka manzar
aao mere parde ke nigehdaar kahan ho
alamdar kahan ho...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Amma lahoo luhan
items.body:
amma haye amma
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane laga watan se jo kunba hussain ka
nana ki qabr se huwe rukhsat shaahe huda
bhai ki qabr pe padha bhai ne marsiya
wan se hua jo turbate zahra ka saamna
maa ki lehad pe chal ke gaye ghutniyo hussain
lipte hai maa ki qabr se karte huwe ye bain
<<DIVIDER>>
amma haye amma amma haye amma
amma lahoo luhaan chaman dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein rasan dekhne chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
jis mein mai apne godh ke paalon ko ro'unga
aur khud bhi sar kata ke mai jis ban mein so’unga
amma hamare saath wo ban dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ko mere aise karenge wo payemal
tukdon mein leke aayega chaadar mein tera laal
amma wo laashe ibne hassan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
naiza jahan lagega mere naujawan ko
teer e sitam lagega jahan bezaban ko
rakh kar ke haath dil pe wo ran dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud aap jis ke naaz uthaati thi raat din
pani ka jaam laa ke pilaati thi raat din
karbal mein usko tashna dahan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode pe jab sambhal na sakega tera hussain
zakhmon se choor ho ke girega tera hussain
teeron pe apne laal ka tan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim tere hussain pe dhayenge sakhtiyan
amma ye tod daalenge meri bhi phasliyan
tukdon mein mera saara badan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro kar ali ye shaah ne ki maa se iltejaa
ud ud ke mere sogh mein wo khaake karbala
kaise banegi mera kafan dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein...
amma lahoo luhaan chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma haye amma
amma meri amma
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein aa ke aag lagayenge ashqiya
qaidi meri behan ko banayenge ashqiya
zainab ko mere baad satayenge ashqiya
chadar bhi cheen lenge rulayenge ashqiya
zaalim nabi ki aal ko dar dar phirayenge
paidal chala ke shaam talak le ke jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
amma lahoo luhaan chaman dekhne chalo
zainab ke baazuon mein rasan dekhne chalo
items.author: Ali Mohd. Sultanpuri

items.title: Ay shehre madina
items.body:
kya tujhse kahe haal e safar zainabe muztar
ay shehr-e-madina
laut aayi hoo mai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar
ay shehr-e-madina
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras naazon se maine jise paala
wo gaysuon wala
dunya se gaya seene pa phal barchi ka khakar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaze pe qaime ke mai majboor khadi thi
aur dekh rahi thi
jab sibte payambar ke galay par chala khanjar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
thay shah jise pyar se seene pa sulaate
aur naaz uthaate
zindan ke andhere mein usay aayi hoo khokar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
bache hi nahi saath mai kis tarha se jaaun
ye soch rahi hoo
ghar dekhungi jab khaali to sabr aayega kyunkar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil tham ke rote thay saeed ahle madina
jab kehti thi dukhya
mai aayi hoo amma ke bhare ghar ko lutakar
ay shehr-e-madina
kya tujhse kahe…
items.author: Saeed Shaheedi

items.title: Baba ko la rahe
items.body:
