uneesvi ki subha wo mehshar bapa hua
aati thi aasman se jibreel ki sada
masjid mein mustafa ka wasi qatl hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
daude saron ko peet'te sibtain e mustafa
dekha ki khoon mein lot'te hai shaahe mashraqain
lipta ke apne seene se roye ba-shor o shain
pehle namaziyon ko padayi namaz phir
masjid se leke baba ko nikle hassan hussain
koi zainab ko thaam le jaa kar
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar mein baba ko laa rahe hai hussain
hoga barpa abhi yahan mehshar
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mein baba ke ro rahi hogi
hosh apne wo kho rahi hogi
haye aa jaaye na wo deodi par
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh waale pachade khaate hai
chand taare bhi thar'tharate hai
subha aayi hai aaj nauha gar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pe sadme sabhi uthalunga
kaise zainab ko mai sambhalunga
sochte jaa rahe hai ye shabbar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyar karne ko nana jaan nahi
haye amma ka sayeban nahi
kaun dhaaras bandhayega bad kar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
taygh zaalim ne aisi maari hai
zakhm sar ka bahot hi kaari hai
koi jaa kar bicha de ek chadar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm sar ka na dekh payegi
wo pachaade zaroor khayegi
kaise samjhayenge usay jaa kar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein khoon tapakta jaata hai
aur amaama latakta jaata hai
kaise thaame do paara sar sarwar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyon ki ajeeb hai fitrat
hoti hai baap se badi ulfat
koi ehwaal keh na de jaa kar
ghar mein baba ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar pe aaye junhi shahe waala
ainee kohraam hogaya barpa
koi aamir ye kehta tha ro kar
ghar mein baba ko...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Basta ba zanjeer
items.body:
basta ba zanjeer basta ba zanjeer
jumla yateema haye
aah hussaina shaahe shaheedan
basta ba zanjeer jumla yateema
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte huwe ghar lut'ti ridayein
kisko sada de kisko bulayein
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek zanjeer e sitam baara aseero ke galay
uspe ye hukm ke har peer o jawan tez chale
ee sitam haye hussaina
pusht pe padte rahe saath durron ke nishan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek beemar aseeron ka jo salaar bana
thaame zanjeer e sitam jaanibe darbar chala
ee sitam haye hussaina
roya shabbir ka sar barsare noke sina
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop se pyar hai saaye se sarokaar nahi
koi bano ki tarha bekas o ghamkhwar nahi
ee sitam haye hussaina
kaise asghar ke bina saaye mein jayegi maa
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme laila ka jigar hogaya paara paara
us ne dekha hai jawan laal ke dil mein naiza
ee sitam haye hussaina
moo ko aata hai jigar sunti hai jab bhi azan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naushaah ki mayyat ke bahattar tukde
maadare qasim e muztar ki nazar se guzre
ee sitam haye hussaina
sar kahan jism kahan dil kahan haath kahan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jo lashkar ka alamdar tha daste shabbir
bar labe nehr likhi jisne wafa ki tehreer
ee sitam haye hussaina
wo nahi hai to nahi ab mere jism mein jaan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan zakhmi hai gala khushk jala hai daaman
saans lene nahi deti hai sakina ko rasan
ee sitam haye hussaina
neend aati hai usay wo magar soye kahan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
beridayi ki aziyyat ko uthaane waale
haye wo aale mohamed ke gharane waale
ee sitam haye hussaina
apne is haal pe bhi kar nahi paaye fughan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha rehaan aseeron ki zuban mein likh kar
is qadar roya qalam ho gaya khirtaas bhi tar
ay meri jaan hussaina
farshe majlis pe huwe qalb o jaan nauha kuna
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Bikherti hui raahon
items.body:
milta nahi tha koi sahara yazeed ko
zainab ne is tarha se ujaada yazeed ko
khatoon jang kar nahi sakti thi is liye
khutbon ki zulfiqar se maara yazeed ko
<<DIVIDER>>
as salaam ya zainab e kubra as salaam
bikherti hui raahon mein roshni zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
mizaaj e hazrate shabbir le chali zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan mein maqsade shabbir aam karti rahi
jo kaam bhai ne saumpa tha kaam karti rahi
kabhi hussain ki surat kabhi ali ki tarha
yazeed e waqt ki neendein haram karti rahi
teri zuban hai ya tayghe hyderi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeediyat ke liye kaam khoob ho jaata
jo aaftab e shariyat ghuroob ho jaata
zamana jehle murakkab ki neend so jaata
khuda ke deen mein shaamil uyub ho jaata
pase hussain na karti jo rehbari zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera wujood sadaqat ka pasban raha
tera wujood imamat ka pasban raha
quran e paak ki tatheer ki shahadat hai
tera wujood taharat ka pasban raha
hai tu hi makhzane ismat ki chaaoni zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki laadli hamsheer e shabbar o shabbir
janabe fatema zehra ki hoo bahoo tasveer
masahebeen e sitamgar ki larzaban hamdaam
dayare shaam mein karke kuch is tarha taqreer
misaale hydare karraar chaa gayi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgaron ne to chaaha magar na hone diya
khuda ke deen mein biddat ka ghar na hone diya
gawara kar liya khud daagh beridayi ka
barehna deene payambar ka sar na hone diya
hai tere khoon mein shaamil tawangari zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
siraate haq o sadaaqat se hat gayi hoti
isaare kufr mein dunya simat gayi hoti
tamam nabiyon ki mehnat bhi zere takhte yazeed
qurane paak ke hamraah pat gayi hoti
agar mizaaj e zamana na modti zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda tera hai imaam o rasool tere hai
jo panjetan ke hai zainab usool tere hai
mehek raha hai gulistane kibriya jis se
sabhi kali hai tere saare phool tere hai
hai tujhse deene mohamed ki dilkashi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan bayan ka mohtaaj zikr hai tera
har ek zikr ka sartaaj zikr hai tera
tere amal tere kirdaar ki badaulat hai
zuban zuban pe agar aaj zikr hai tera
hai tere zikr ki mohtaaj har sadi zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
misaale hazrate meesam dahan ataa kar do
hamay janabe farazdaq sa fan ataa kar do
dua ye monis o kausar ki shadman ki hai
ay bibi hum ko bhi auje sukhan ataa kardo
tumhari bazm mein karte hai naukri zainab
bikherti hui raahon mein...

items.title: Dare zindan par
items.body:
dar e zindan par koi masooma
padha karti hai ye ro kar nauha
baba baba baba baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot darr mujhko yahan lagta hai
bahot tanha hoo chale aao na
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud aake dekh lo meri haalat
nahi pehchaan paoge meri surat
sahe bachpan mein masayib itne
zaeefa dikhne lagi ye dukhiya
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada dushwaar hai is qaid mein jeena
bahot yaad aa raha hai aap ka seena
gaye ho jab se nahi soyi mai
sukoon se ab tak kabhi ek lamha
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe phir qabr mein lagne laga hai darr
nikaala tha jinhone laasha e asghar
wo zaalim phir se palat aaye hai
phupi aur mai hoo yahan phir tanha
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai royun leke kab tak siskiyan baba
bahot dukhti hai meri phasliyan baba
sakina is dam hai kis haalat mein
faqat samjhengi ye daadi zahra
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar aata nahi aankhon ko malti hoo
sahara leke deewaron ka chalti hoo
pakad kar zulfein mujhe zaalim ne
na jaane kaisa tamacha maara
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
<<DIVIDER>>
lage hai zakhm jitne sab dikhaungi
jab aaoge to mai sab kuch bataungi
bahot maara hai bahot tadpaya
mujhe logon ne samajh kar tanha
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nadeem us waqt khud zindan rota tha
sakina jis ghadi padti thi ye nauha
mujhe lagta hai ke ab ghut ghut kar
nikal jayega yahin dam mera
baba baba baba baba
dar e zindan par...
items.author: Nadeem Sultanpuri

items.title: Ek luta khafela safar
items.body:
ek luta khaafela safar mein hai
har qadam karbala nazar mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb mein sab ke daag-e-akbar hai
aur nazron mein zakhm-e-asghar hai
paas shehrag ke kund khanjar hai
khushk honton pa naam e hyder hai
maqsad e shahe deen nazar mein hai
ek luta khaafela…
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafile mein bohat se bache thay
gyarvi ko jo karbala se chale
raaston mein giray thay oonto se
is tarha se ke phir kabhi na uthe
maut ki gunj reh guzar mein hai
ek luta khaafela…
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafile mein hai aisi maayein bhi
godh ujdi chini ridayein bhi
ab to lab par nahi duayein bhi
sogaye thak ke sab sadayein bhi
bas dhuwan hi dhuwan nazar mein hai
ek luta khaafela…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek beemar khaafela salaar
tauq o zanjeer ka uthaye baar
maaom behno ka saath aur bazaar
aakhri marhala bhara darbaar
sabr hi sabr rahbar mein hai
ek luta khaafela…
<<DIVIDER>>
raunaq e khaafla thi ek bachi
baap ko yaad kar ke jab roti
us ko is jurm ki saza milti
zulm itna hua ke ji na saki
ab wo bachi andhere ghar mein hai
ek luta khaafela…
<<DIVIDER>>
ho chuki jab tamaam ruswayi
yaani islam ki maseehayi
khaafla le ke sheh ki maa jaayi
lut ke nainawa ki simt aayi
asr e ashoor chashm e tar mein hai
ek luta khaafela…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab madine ko jayega kunba
hogi shahid qayamatein barpa
sochti hai ye zainab e kubra
kaise sughra ka saamna hoga
shakl sughra ki bas nazar mein hai
ek luta khaafela…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Ghareeb baba
items.body:
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti
<<DIVIDER>>
wo be-kafan tha ye be-rida thi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti
<<DIVIDER>>
tamache dono ne ban may khaaye
hai dono pehlu shikasta haye
wo ibne zehra ye zehra jaisi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
musalla baba ka ye bichaati
hussain dete thay isko lori
ye uski aadi wo iska aadi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha usko maara rula rula ke
bahaya pani isay dikha ke
tha wo bhi pyasa hai ye bhi pyasi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
huwe jo khanjar ke waar sheh par
khadi thi pehlu may unki dukhtar
wo jitna tadpe ye utna royi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye durre zaalim se kha rahi hai
padar ke seene ko dhoondti hai
wo jab se soya ye so na paayi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay zakhm shabbir ke badan par
sakina khaati rahi hai pathar
tha wo bhi zakhmi hai ye bhi zakhmi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar uska sandooq may rakha hai
rasan may iska gala bandha hai
safar may rehte thay dono qaidi
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
nibhaya har ek waada jis ne
uthaaya dono ka laasha jis ne
behan thi uski phupi thi iski
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha mir sajjad kaisa lamha
jab uske baba ka naam poocha
to hind se ro ke bachi boli
ghareeb baba ghareeb beti...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Haye sakina meri
items.body:
waqt e nizha kehta raha sheh ka alamdar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna dahan mar na kahin jaye dilafgaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein kooza liye qaime ke dar par khadi
pani ki ummeed mein hogi sakina meri
payegi jis dam khabar mashk meri chid gayi
roke kahegi chacha pyaas meri bujh gayi
dil mein rahega ye qalaq sayyed e abraar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz uthaata raha jiska mai shaam o sahar
aaj bhatiji meri hai wohi tashna jigar
kya kahun kis darja ab gham ka hai dil par asar
tashna dahani faqat uski hai peshe nazar
chashm hui kehke yehi ghazi ki khoon baar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye nahi bujh saki bacchon ki tashna labi
waada na poora hua aur qaza aagayi
kaise kahun kis qadar mujhko hai sharmindagi
laash na jayegi ab qaime mein aaqa meri
roke yehi kehta raha sheh ka alamdar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hoon mai to safar hogi qayamat magar
chaayegi gham ki ghata bekas o mazloom par
zulm sahegi bhala kis tarha jaan e pidar
phat'ta hai ye soch kar bakhuda mera jigar
baad mere uspe sitam dhayenge aghiyaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron ki baarish hui naiza o khanjar chale
zulm ki hadh hogayi baazu qalam ho gaye
mashk nahi laa sake gurz laga gir pade
nehr pe maare gaye bekhata ammu mere
sun ke khabar royegi wo bekas o lachaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
shakl bhatiji ko mai kaise dikhaun bhala
maut se majboor hoon kaise mai jaaun bhala
pyaas sakina ki ab kaise bujhaun bhala
mashk mein pani nahi kaise bataun bhala
nauha yehi padta raha sheh ka madadgaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka bilakna kabhi mujhko gawara na tha
pyaas se tadpegi wo maine ye socha na tha
pani mai laata nahi ba khuda aisa na tha
jang mai karta yahan sheh ka iraada na tha
keh ke yehi rone laga paikar e eesaar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye tasavvur faqat nauha alamdar ka
kaun likhega bhala ranj wafadaar ka
maqsad e khursheed hai ashk azadaar ka
tazkera karta hai wo shaah ke ghamkhwar ka
samjho zaban ahle aza kehte hai ash'aar
haye sakina meri haye sakina
waqt e nizha kehta raha...
items.author: Khursheed

items.title: Hussain jaate hai
items.body:
aza tamaam hai riqqat karo azadaron
hussain jaate hai ruqsat karo azadaron
<<DIVIDER>>
safar ka waqt hai mehman ko alwida kaho
juloos e shaah e shaheedan ko alwida kaho
ujad ne waale hai kuch dayr mein azakhane
kisi behan ko kisi maa ko alwida kaho
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zareeh tashna musafir ki badne waali hai
imambadon ki raunaq ujadne waali hai
bujhe huwe hai diye ro rahi hai deewarein
jo mehman thi wo bibi bichadne waali hai
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saron pe gard hai aansu hai aasteeno par
udaas baithe hai sab matami zameeno par
rula rahe hai ye murjhaye phool sehron ke
na taaziye hai na patke hai sheh nasheeno par
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan se aaj ye manzar aza ke layegi
ye khamoshi ye udaasi hamein rulayegi
jiyenge kaise zari o alam se hoke juda
na din ko chain na raaton ko neend aayegi
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ke chain ko kaise kahe khudahafiz
shahe hunain ko kaise kahe khudahafiz
ye soch soch ke aankhon mein ashk aaye hai
ke hum hussain ko kaise kahe khudahafiz
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
suqood bazme aza ka bahot rulayega
khud apne ghar ka ye sannata humko khayega
kisay khabar ke ye din phir naseeb ho ke na ho
jo agle saal jiyega wo gham manayega
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
udaasiyan sabhi maaon ke rukh pe chaayi hai
labon pe bayn ko aankhon mein ashq laayi hai
phupi ko dena hai pursa tumhare baba ka
sakina bibi tumhari kaneezein aayi hai
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari yaad mein bechain hote jaate hai
tumhari hijr mein jaan apni khote jaate hai
inhe bhi dekhlo jhoole se ay ali asghar
ye bache godhi mein maaon ki rote jaate hai
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aayega kisi barchi ka dhyan royenge
faza mein goonjegi jab jab azan royenge
tumhare hijr mein hum ay shabihe paighambar
dil apna peet ke saare jawan royenge
hussain jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai itna aamir o nayyar ko bhi yaqeen maula
pasand tum ko hai dono hi sar zameen maula
watan hamara hai bharat bhi karbala bhi magar
jahan chale ho hamein le chalo wahin maula
hussain jaate hai...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Jaake baba ko sab
items.body:
boli darbar may ye binte nabi
jaa ke baba ko sab bataungi
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne tauheen ki meri kitni
jaa ke baba ko sab bataungi
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din wo tha dekh kar mujhko
apne mimbar se uth gaye baba
ek ye din hai mere aane par
koi tazeem ko nahi utha
kitni ummat badal gayi unki
jaa ke baba ko sab...
boli darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko darbar my khada rakh ke
kar rahe wo kalaam has has ke
haye afsos meri zainab ke
saamne keh rahe ho jhoota mujhe
tum ne tehreer chaak ki unki
jaa ke baba ko sab...
boli darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar mujhko poochenge baba
zakhm chehre pe kaisa aaya hai
mai bataungi poori taaqat se
kisne moo par tamacha maara hai
gir gayi kaise kaan ki baali
jaa ke baba ko sab...
boli darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
oonchi awaaz se mere dar par
tum ali ko bulaye jaate thay
mai thi behosh jalte dar ke talay
aur dar par se tum guzarte rahe
jhuk gayi kis tarha kamar meri
jaa ke baba ko sab...
boli darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne azaad qaidiyon ko kiya
tum ne usko bana diya qaidi
jisne kuffaar se bachaya tha
uski gardan may daal di rassi
be-wafayi ki inteha kar di
jaa ke baba ko sab...
boli darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai shikayat karungi baba se
kisne zehra pe haath uthaya hai
kisne pehlu pe thokare maari
kisne mohsin ko mere maara hai
ek bhi shakl mai nahi bhooli
jaa ke baba ko sab...
boli darbar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad kya bayan ho bhala
ghar may jab aayi laut kar zehra
hoke bechain poochte thay ali
bolo darbar may hua kya kya
sirf ro ro ke bibi kehti rahi
jaa ke baba ko sab...
boli darbar may...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Jhutlayi gayi fatema
items.body:
jhutlayi gayi fatema zahra ki gawahi
ya ahmad e mukhtar duhaai hai duhaai
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein bulwaya gaya binte nabi ko
afsos musalman ko ghairat bhi na aayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin ki shahadat ki zimedar hai ummat
darwaza gira zahra pe allah re duhaai
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat ki bandhe toot gaye haath utha kar
shabbir ko lipta liya zainab ko dua di
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ki sanad le ke gayi saath thay apne
quran ki aayat bhi bibi ne sunayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain se bad ke na gawah koi wahan tha
tha kaun musalman wafa kis ne nibhaai
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha pehlu shikasta na magar rukta tha khutba
kaise thay shaqi qalb ke ghairat na aayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ki judaai ka na seh paayi wo sadma
aur dar pe nabuwat ke hai phir aag lagayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai sukoon milta hai marne se lehad mein
zehra hai magar qabr mein ummat ki satayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab asghar e masoom ka laaya gaya laasha
sar peet'ti qaima se sakina nikal aayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir zara dekho to betaabi e asghar
jhoole se gira jaata hai ye nanha sipahi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacche bhi diye bhai bhi aur shaam bhi dekha
nana tere islam pe chadar bhi lutayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar e yazeedi mein aghyaar ka majma
fizza ko nabi zaadi ki haalat nazar aayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zulm huwe baad e nabi zahra pe qambar
roodad woh baba ko lahad mein hai sunayi
jhutlayi gayi fatema...
items.author: Qambar

items.title: Kehte thay roke
items.body:
kehte thay ro ke abid e dilgeer kya karun
zaalim bahot hai lashkare be-peer kya karun
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar hoo ke raah ka chalna mohaal hai
us par sitam hai paaon mein zanjeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein aa ke ye ehsaas bhi na tha
ye din mujhe dikhayegi taqdeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat ki garm rayt pa sookhi zaban liye
tadpa hai mera asghar e baysheer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kadiyal jawan ke seene pa naiza jo chal gaya
royi bahot hai maadar e dilgeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to khabar thi honge bahattar ke sar qalam
be-pardagi dikha gayi taqdeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen e nabi ko jis ne ujaala ata kiya
hai teeragi mein aaj wo tanveer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache tadap ke mar gaye pani nahin mila
wo tashnagi ki dekhi hai tasveer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab kuch luta ke dasht mein daaman ko jhaad kar
baihte thay ran mein hazrate shabbir kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
baagh e fidak ko cheen ke jab dil nahi bhara
karbobala mein loot li jageer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab phupi hai shaam ke balwe mein berida
aur har taraf hai majma e be-peer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat liye madine ki zindan e shaam mein
zer e zameen so gayi hamsheer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha likha raza to qayamat guzar gayi
dil ro raha hai aur mai tehreer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Kiya tha maa se jo
items.body:
kiya tha maa se jo waada nibhaya zainab ne
zamane bhar ko hussaini banaya zainab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
baha ke ashke aza aur keh ke haye hussain
bicha ke farshe aza khaak ar baraye hussain
ek aasman zameen par bichaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ulat ke shaam ka darbar karke fathe mubeen
jahan hussain ka qatil tha hukmaraan wahin
hussaini fauj ka parcham lagaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
charaghe khaana e kaaba bujhane aaye thay
jahan pe shaami andhere basane aaye thay
usi zameen ko suraj banaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeedi khud bhi ye kehte hai haan nahi milta
kahin yazeed ka naam o nishan nahi milta
usay to khaak mein aisa milaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan pe kaata gaya tha hussain ke sar ko
jahan pe loota gaya tha hussain ke ghar ko
wahin hussain ka rauza banaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hawa e zulm bana khaiz o khoon ke darya mein
suna hai aun o mohamed ki tarha dunya mein
khuda ke deen ko chalna sikhaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sache muarrikh ka halfiya hai bayan
nabi rasool wali deen karbala quran
aseer ho ke bhi sab ko bachaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo chaahe dekh le khud shaam jaa ke ye manzar
hawayein kaampti hai jis ko dekh kar gohar
charagh shaam mein aisa jalaya zainab ne
kiya tha maa se jo...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Mai sakina hoo
items.body:
mai sakina hoo mera dard hai itna baba
mujhko zaalim ne kaneezi mein hai maanga baba
<<DIVIDER>>
maine daadi ki tarha itne masayib dekhe
chaar barson mein hi lagti hoo zaeefa baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo teri laash pa daudaate thay ghode ran mein
wo tamachon se mujhe dete hai pursa baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash mar jaaun mai asghar ko hi rote rote
mai kahan karti hoo pani ka taqaza baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
poori shiddat se mujhe maara tamacha jis ne
uske haathon se mera chehra hai chota baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ungliyon ke to kahin par hai angoothi ke nishan
kaise pehchanoge tum beti ka chehra baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
is qadar shaam ke zindan mein tareeki hai
haath apna bhi nahi mujhko hai dikhta baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya sajjad se nazrein na milayi maine
maine bazaar mein jab khaaya tamacha baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam waalon se na pani na kafan maangungi
mai na ehsaan yahan loongi kisi ka baba
mai sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh ke moo baap ke sar par wo pukari darwesh
ab na jaagegi kabhi teri sakina baba
mai sakina hoo...
items.author: Shahid Baltistani

items.title: Matam ki sada se
items.body:
matam ki sada se
soya hua ehsaas jagaya jaata hai
jo aale nabi par guzri hai
majlis may bataya jaata hai
matam ki sada se…
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ke shehdayi seekhe
yun deen bachaya jaata hai
sar tan se kataya jaata hai
ghar baar lutaya jaata hai
jo aale nabi par...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne ye dikhlaya hai
ghurbat may bhi saare aalam ko
peeri may jawan ke laashe ko
kis tarha uthaaya jaata hai
jo aale nabi par...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar tan se kata kar bhi logon
hoti hai ibadat khaaliq ki
ya noke sina ke mimbar se
quran sunaya jaata hai
jo aale nabi par...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ki shahadat hote hi
ek shab ki suhagan rand hui
afsos ke ek ek choodi ko
bewa ki badhaya jaata hai
jo aale nabi par...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha na utha paaya na kafan
wo jiski lahad bhi ban na saki
har samt usi ka dunya may
taboot uthaaya jaat hai
jo aale nabi par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye naqshe ghame sarwar hai zaki
mitne ka nahi ye dunya se
utna hi ubharta rehta hai
jitna ke dabaya jaat hai
jo aale nabi par...
items.author: Muhammad Zaki

items.title: Mere dono shehzade
items.body:
muslim ki bewa har dam roti thi ye nauha pad kar
na jaane kis haal mein honge mere dono shehzade
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhi nahi hoon paas mein ab na baap ka saaya hai sar par
na jaane kis haal mein honge mere dono shehzade
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se suna hai kufe ke haalaat bahot hi badtar hai
meri nazron mein na janae kaise kaise manzar hai
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
har dam lagta hai wo bulaate hai mujhko amma keh kar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera mohamed baap ke bin ek pal na kahin rah paata tha
ibrahim bhi baba ke bin chain kahin na paata tha
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
dono pidar se bichde hai khaate honge dar dar thokar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe waalon ne jab se mere waali ko maar diya
kaamp raha hai mera kaleja ab to na jaane kya hoga
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
kaun mere dil ke tukdon ko aayega ab ghar lekar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye mere dono pardesi mere liye rote honge
jaane kya khaate honge na jaane kab sote honge
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
khaana kaun khilayega aur kaun lagayega bistar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz mai apne bacchon ke har waqt uthaya karti thi
chand sitaron ki tarha dono ko sajaya karti thi
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
unki yaadein har dam mere dil pe chalati hai khanjar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono musafir hai tanha hai raat o din darte honge
koi nahi hai poochne waala kaise basar karte honge
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
kufe se anjaan hai dono kamsin hai aur hai beghar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere khawab mein aksar dono khoon mein doobe aate hai
amma hum mushkil mein hai ye keh kar ashk bahate hai
apne dil ke tukdon ko mai gar na paungi
ruk jayengi saansein mai to mar jaungi
dono kahte hai ab hum lautenge kabhi na ay maadar
na jaane kis haal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz us maadar ka din kyun tukdon mein na bat jaaye
jis ke shehzadon ka sar be jurm o khata hi kat jaaye
jis ke dono bacche maare jaaye pyase
aur bacchon ka laasha dukhiya maa na dekhe
kyun na nikle us dukhiya ke dil se sadayein reh reh kar
na jaane kis haal mein...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Bakhi jo rafiqe shahe
items.body:
baakhi jo rafiq e shah e deen reh gaye do chaar
hasrat se unhe dekhte thay sayyed e abraar
ki bad ke habeeb ibne mazahir ne ye guftaar
ye peer ghulam ab hai ijaazat ka talabgaar
bande ko bhi marne ki raza dijiye aaqa
firdaus ke raste pe laga dijiye aaqa
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne seene se lagaya kayi baar
ruqsat jo kiya aankhon se aansu huwe jaari
ghabra ke dar e qaima se zainab ye pukari
logon kaho maidan may chali kis ki sawari
kaun bachayega shah e jinn o bashar ko
sab chode chale jaate hai zehra ke pisar ko
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sunte hi kohraam hua ahle haram may
pahuncha wo jari sher sa maidan e sitam may
kaamil tha zabas ishq e shehenshah e umam may
betaab tha maula ki judaai ke alam may
seena tha jari ka tabar o teer ki jaanib
phir phir ke nazar karta tha shabbir ki jaanib
<<DIVIDER>>
peeri may jo dikhlayi jawano ki shuja'at
tharrane lage azwe badan ghut gayi taakhat
dam chad gaya garmi se hui pyaas ki shiddat
dil se kaha ab aalam e faani se hai ruqsat
na lashkar e aada ko na shamsheer ko dekha
kis yaas se mud kar rukhe shabbir ko dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
phirna tha ke bas padne lagi teeron ki bouchar
dekha jo udhar pusht pe naize ka laga waar
chaaha usay maare ke lagi farq pa talwaar
aur zulm ki barchi bhi kaleje ke hui paar
kehte they tan o jaan shahe dilgeer ke sadqe
har zakhm pa naara tha ke shabbir ke sadqe
<<DIVIDER>>
chaati bhi chani teeron se aur farq do paara
rag rag jo kati phir na raha zapt ka yaara
sheerazae ajza e badan khul gaya saara
girte huwe ghode se ye aaqa ko pukara
yan aap ka aana meri bakshish ki sanad hai
ay sher e elaahi ke pisar waqt e madad hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaah safein cheer ke aaye shahe zeeshan
dekha ke wo mazloom koi dam ka hai mehman
laashe se lipat kar ye pukaare basad afghaar
ay dost mere teri mohabbat ke mai qurban
dikhla do mujhe zakhm kahan khaaye hai bhai
seene se lipat jao ke hum aate hai bhai

items.title: Aao sakina roti
items.body:
aao sakina roti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal hai soona kya karoo
kya haal hai kis se kahoo
palkon pe ashke gham liye
moo ashkon se wo dhoti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ke dil jaane ali
murjha gayi gham se kali
gowhar chine kurta jala
uftaad us par hoti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr e layeen se darti hai
jab yaad tumko karti hai
marti hai tere gham mein wo
bechain o muztar hoti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
usko tasalli deti hoo
aaoge bhaiya kehti hoo
bolo kahoo mai kya karoo
be-kal wo gham se hoti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhi si jaan laakhon sitam
hai ek us par gham pe gham
seena kahan shabbir ka
kab chain se wo soti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ke us par kode hai
tum saath jab se chode hai
seene pe sone waali thi
wo khaak par ab soti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise nehr par so gaye
bin bhai ke hum hogaye
zainab ki thi ran mein sada
shaam o sehar wo roti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabir ghame abbas mein
bali sakina pyaas mein
iqbal binte shaahe deen
ammu ke gham mein roti hai
abbas abbas aao sakina...
items.author: Iqbal Abedi

items.title: Abbas ka jab zikre
items.body:
abbas ka jab zikr e wafa karti thi sughra
bas khair ki us waqt dua karti thi sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bar bhare ghar ko mai in aankhon se dekhoo
ro ro ke madina mein dua karti thi sughra
abbas ka jab zikre...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein baba ne mujhe dil se bhulaya
shikwa yehi nani se kiya karti thi sughra
abbas ka jab zikre...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab ghutniyo chalne laga hoga mera asghar
ye keh ke bohat yaad kiya karti thi sughra
abbas ka jab zikre...
<<DIVIDER>>
aata tha madina mein agar koi musafir
bechain bohat sunke hua karti thi sughra
abbas ka jab zikre...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aas lagaye hue wo baithi thi dar par
aayenge chacha lene kaha karti thi sughra
abbas ka jab zikre...
items.author: Qamar Naqvi

items.title: Alamdar kahan ho
items.body:
karti thi buka zainab e ghamkhwar
alamdar kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
beparda haram hai sar e bazaar
alamdar kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se mujhe dar pesh hui teri judaai
tareek nazar aane lagi saari khudayi
zainab hai masayib mein giraftaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
maara jo kabhi shimr e sitamgar ne tamacha
masoom sakina ne tera naam pukara
bacchi ko madad hai teri darkaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab mein kabhi mera qadam ghar se na nikla
bas thi meri dunya bani hashim ka mohalla
ab mera safar hai sar e bazaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
beparda sar e shaam haram hote hai tash'heer
rota hai lahoo noke sina par sar e shabbir
ay aale mohamed ke madadgaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hote hai bade zulm o sitam ahle haram par
durre kabhi khaate hai kabhi khaate hai pathar
sadaat pe haste hai sitamgaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aa gayi taqdeer kahan aale aba ki
ye fauj e jafakaar hamein kehti hai baaghi
is tanz ko sun kar hoo dilafgaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai haath rasan basta nahi sar pe ridayein
sadaat bhala behre madad kis ko bulayein
hai shaam ka rasta bada dushwaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhi nahi jaati mere sajjad ki haalat
chalne bhi nahi deti usay uski naqaahat
mar jaaye na gham se kahin bemaar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sibtain mai bhala kaise likhun shaam ka manzar
jab shaam ke bazaar mein saydaniya safdar
kehti thi ye har baar
alamdar kahan ho
karti thi buka...
items.author: Sibtain Kazmi

items.title: Ay sher tu na jaa
items.body:
ay alamdare wafa
saqqa e haram behno ka bharam
hai tere hone se bhaiya
sunle ghazi zainab ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas tere haath mere sar ki hai rida
ay sher tu na jaa
ye haath kat gaye to karungi rida ka kya
ay sher tu na jaa
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun aayega bachane ko teeron se bhai ko
khanjar chalega jab to kise doongi mai sada
ay sher tu na jaa
abbas tere haath mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
naiza har ek ke haath may hoga ba waqt e shaam
kis kis se apne sar ki bachaungi mai rida
ay sher tu na jaa
abbas tere haath mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt kya karungi jab pyasi sakina ko
pani dikha dikha ke bahayenge ashkiyan
ay sher tu na jaa
abbas tere haath mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai hai tu kisi ka alam aur kisi ki aas
bhai hai mere waaste tu saaya e khuda
ay sher tu na jaa
abbas tere haath mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ye tere haath haram ka hai sayeban
parde ki ibteda hai ye parde ki inteha
ay sher tu na jaa
abbas tere haath mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayega khoon may dooba hua jab alam naved
qaime ke dar pe goonj rahi hogi ye sada
ay sher tu na jaa
abbas tere haath mere...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Baba ko na leke
items.body:
bali sakina ne ro kar kaha
baba ko na leke jaa zuljana
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se hai choor baba mera
baba ko na leke jaa zuljana
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaanti hoon wafadar tu hai
baba ke ghode samajhdar tu hai
daaghe yateemi se mujhko bacha
baba ko na leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai gham yateemi ka seh na sakungi
bin baba jaan ke mai reh na sakungi
ehsaan kar mujhpe ay bawafa
baba ko na leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
neend aati hai mujhko sadr e padar par
mai khaak pe haye soungi kyun kar
hai meri tujhse yehi ilteja
baba ko na leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataun jo sadma hai dil par
maare gaye bhai qasim o akbar
darya se aaye na mere chacha
baba ko na leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dayr pehle jo gaya tha asghar
aaya tha wo apne khoon mein naha kar
shesh maaha bhaiya bhi maara gaya
baba ko na leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maujood hote agar mere ammu
behte na yun mere aankhon se aansu
deti na mai tujhko ro kar sada
baba ko na leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz sakina ki aah o buka par
rehwaar rota tha sar ko jhuka kar
nauha tha wo gham mein dooba hua
baba ko na leke...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Batayegi fatema
items.body:
ay azadaron ay wafadaron
farshe aza ke taaron
shabbir ke matamdaron
fikr na karna fatema hai na
<<DIVIDER>>
matam kiya hai tum ne batayegi fatema
jannat mein tum se pehle na jayegi fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
waada hai bakhshwane jab aayegi hashr mein
ghazi ke dono baazu bhi layegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansu bahaye tum ne jo naame hussain par
rumaal khol kar wo dikhayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ko tum ne pani pilaya sabeel par
kausar ka jaam tum ko pilayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir rashk ki nigahon se dekhenge sab tumhe
jab tum ko apna keh ke bulayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo betiyon ko rakhti hai chadar ke saaye mein
un maaon ko gale se lagayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe aza bicha ke bulao to ek baar
dekho tumhare ghar mein bhi aayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke do hussain ke zakhmo ka waasta
zawwar karbala ka banayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis ka ehtemam karo fikr mat karo
aayega bas wo jis ko bulayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne kabhi bhulaya nahi gham hussain ka
tum ko kabhi bhi bhool na payegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan abidi ho ya farhan koi bhi
har matami ki shaan sunayegi fatema
matam kiya hai tum ne...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Dare zindan pe
items.body:
dare zindan pe sakina yehi karti thi buka
shaam hone ko hai ab laut ke aao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
tang hai shaam ka zindan andhera hai bahot
hai nahi aap to ab khaak bichona hai sada
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
takti rehti hoo parindo ko basad hasrat o yas
kya watan jaungi is qaid se chutkar mai bhala
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar haalate sajjad wo roke kehti
haye bemaar mere bhai pe hai kaisi jafa
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aajate jo asghar kabhi akbar usko
bhai aajao yahan ro ro wo deti thi sada
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki aagosh mein kis tarha usay neendh aaye
baap ke seene pe soti rahi bachi jo sada
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha dil ko mai behlaun ghuta jaata hai dam
hai na nanhe mere saathi hai na ammu baba
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
iska daaman bhi jala kaano se durr cheen liye
pusht par neele thay aur kaano mein bhi khoon tha jama
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote rote yuhin ek shab jo zara aankh lagi
chaunk kar uthi sakina yehi madar se kaha
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shor ye sunke utha neendh se badaqt yazeed
bola zindan mein lejao sare shaahe huda
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ne bad bad ke salaami shahe mazloom ko di
godh mein leke sare shaah sakina ne kaha
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad mujhe shimr ne maare durre
baad baba tere kya kya na sitam humne saha
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mujhe lene ko aaye hai mai sadqe unke
baba ke saath mai jaungi hui poori dua
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bolte bolte khamosh hui jab bibi
roke bano ne kaha dekho to sajjad zara
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hua baat nahi karti hai mazloom meri
paas abid jo gaye dekha ke sadma hai naya
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hatkadi pehne hue khodi lehad abid ne
khoon bhara kurta kafan bangaya shehzadi ka
dare zindan pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha aijaz o hasan ka ye padha ahsan ne
aap bulwaiye rauze pe kare izn ata
dare zindan pe...
items.author: Aijaz Rizvi

items.title: Ek maa ka ye nauha
items.body:
ek maa ka ye nauha tha aajao ali asghar
dushwaar hua jeena aajao ali aghar
<<DIVIDER>>
kya dil pe guzarti hai batlaun tumhe kaise
is waqt kamar thaame rote hue hasrat se
kehte thay shahe waala aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kis se kahoon beta ab khatm hua lashkar
shabbir akele hai abbas hai na akbar
hai waqt qayamat ka aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar chale aao phir jaane nahi doongi
godi mein uthaungi seene se lagaungi
jangal mein nahi sona aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal teri surat phirti hai nigahon mein
laut aao ke ab lori dhalne lagi aahon mein
khoon rota hai dil mera aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
behaal sakina hai dekho to zara aakar
hai neel tamacho ke mazloom ke gaalon par
mar jaye na masooma aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre hue laashe hai har ek taraf ran mein
khauf aata hai ay beta is ujde hue ban mein
maqtal mein hai sannata aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai raaton ko uth uth kar jo jhoola jhulati thi
de de ke tumhe lori mai jisme sulaati thi
veeran hai wo jhoola aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aakhri sajde mein wo waaris e paighambar
ab shimr ka khanjar hai shabbir ki gardan par
lut jaye na ghar mera aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar tha bapa gohar is dashte musibat mein
tadpa to zaroor hoga baysheer bhi turbat mein
jab maa ne kaha hoga aajao ali asghar
ek maa ka ye nauha tha...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ghareeb baba
items.body:
haye o mera ghareeb baba
ay shaam de logon mai sayyed haan
<<DIVIDER>>
na kafan mila na dafan hua
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar e shaam ka majma tha
sajjad ghareeb ka nauha tha
kyun baaghi baaghi kehte ho
kya jurm tha mere baba ka
sajde mein namazi qatl kiya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera baba shaan e rasoolallah
mera baba jaan e madina tha
chauda baara aur paanch mein bhi
beshak anmol nagina tha
sadaat ke dil ko chaak kiya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera baba paak namazi tha
allah bhi jis se raazi tha
mera baba aisa qaari tha
quran bhi jis ka haami tha
sajde mein us par zulm kiya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle to pyar se khat likh ke
dhoke se bulaya baba ko
phir karbobala ke sehra mein
kitna hai sataya baba ko
mehman bana kar loot liya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...
<<DIVIDER>>
batlao kya mera baba
ek kafan ka bhi haqdaar na tha
batlao kya mera baba
nana ka virsadaar na tha
laakho ne us ko ghayr liya
mera baba pyasa maar diya
haye o mera ghareeb...

items.title: Har dil ki sada
items.body:
kehte hai ahle aza har dil ki hai ye sada
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hai khud ye khuda zehra ki jaan marhaba
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne bichaya musalla wahan
dam tod de khud ibadat jahan
is hausle par tere qurban salle alaa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aadam ke dam ke muhafiz ho tum
musa ki haibat mein naafiz ho tum
isaa ka tum maujiza tum khizr ke rehnuma
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
raushan tere noor se noore hai
ghairat zada jalwa e toor hai
khoon se tere hogayi matti bhi khaake shifa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hausla to kisi mein nahi
quwaat kisi ye nabi mein nahi
tu ne uthaaye magar baazu e shaah e wafa
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne sitam kis tarha se saha
tum ne ye gham kis tarha se saha
laasha jawan laal ka kaandhon pe kaise rakha
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
is gham mein kaampe zameen aasman
is gham mein tadpe ye kaun o makaan
asghar ka tu ne lahoo chehre pe kaise mala
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein musibat ye tum par padi
tum par qayamat ki thi ye ghadi
khanjar talay haath jab maa ne teri rakh diya
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi kisi ki bhi mayyat nahi
yasir kisi ki ye ghurbat nahi
tareekh mein ek hai teeron pe laasha tera
ya hussain ya hussain
kehte hai ahle aza...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Haye shaame ghariban
items.body:
jis shaam jalaye gaye sadaat ke qayyaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
paywast hai khanjar ki tarha dil pe wo hangaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ban ke rida ban ke sare noke sina hai
shola hai dhuan hai
hai jo tahe zanjeer tahe tauq tahe naam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ka tawaf ab bhi usi tarha hai jaari
ek zauf hai taari
khola hi nahi waqt ne us shaam ka ehraam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis shaam ki ghurbat ne dukhaya dil e sajjad
rulaya dil e sajjad
zainab ne jise shaam e ghariban ka diya naam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye saare azal saare abad jis mein sameine
ab kya kahoo haye
jis mein simat aaya hai har aghaaz har anjaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ti hai wohi aandhiya kat jaata hai seena
phat jaata hai seena
har shaam mujhe yaad dilaati hai wohi shaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis raakh mein dil mera naved aah daba hai
aur raakh hua hai
us raakh mein reh reh ke bhadakti hai wohi shaam
guzri nahi wo shaam
jis shaam jalaye gaye...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Hussain janam
items.body:
hussain jaanam hussain jaanam
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein khule sar yehi kehti rahi maadar
hussain jaanam hussain jaanam
pyase gale pe chala haye zulm ka khanjar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra e karbala mein hua zehra ka nazool
beti ke saath rote huwe aa gaye rasool
zehra ka baazu thaame huwe rote hai haider
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho na alamdar raha aur na lashkar
na aun o mohamed rahe na qasim o akbar
ladte huwe laakhon se nazar aaye jo sarwar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladte hue shabbir ne jis dam suni sada
ay nafse mutmain aa palat kehta tha khuda
sajde mein rakha shaah ne sar khaak ke upar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar ko liye haaton mein wo shimr chala hai
pyase gale pe shaah ke khanjar ko rakha hai
ye dekh ke roti rahi shabbir ki maadar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay ke ay shimr ye ahmed ka pisar hai
aur pyaas ki shiddat se jala uska jigar hai
pani usay pilado dua denge payambar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khole huwe fatema karti rahi faryad
sar kaat ke hathon mein utha legaya jallaad
zainab ne dare qaima se dekha tha wo manzar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon aasman se barsa udhar karbobala mein
aur fathe ki naubat baji wan ahle jafa mein
sajjad se kehti thi utho abid e muztar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ne tab chaunk ke sar apna uthaya
sar hazrate shabbir ka wan naize pe paaya
kehte thay salaam aap pe ay zehra ke dilbar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmati thi zehra ke mere yusuf e saani
pyase hi gaye dunya se paaya nahi pani
ab khuld mein nana tere denge tujhe kausar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra se ye farmane lage ahmad e mukhtar
de sabr tujhe fatema ab khaaliq e ghaffar
zibhe azeem bangaya hai ab mera sarwar
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmate thay ye zehra se ro ro ke murtaza
zaalim ne mere bache ko maara hai be-khata
shabbir ke laashe pe yehi kehte thay hyder
hussain jaanam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sab ghulam aap ke hai hazrate shabbir
aijaz o aaqif ki badhi is liye taukeer
rote huwe kehte hai jo aakar sare mimbar
hussain jaanam...
items.author: Aijaz Rizvi

items.title: Jaan ali akbar
items.body:
shabihe payambar haye haye ali akbar
kaise jiyegi tere bin haye ye maadar
ay jaan ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
beta ali akbar maadar ko pukaro
ghamzada maadar ko chehra to dikhado
khaak se utho mujhko bula lo
maa hai pareshan kahan ho mere dilbar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid hui beta zindan chali maa
saare shaheedon ka allah nigehban
ghar hua veeran aao meri jaan
ho gya sajjad akela mera dilbar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ka ye armaan tha tujhe dulha banaati
maa teri dulhan ko naazon se sajaati
ho nahi paayi aas ye poori
aise gaye aaye na maidan se palat kar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa hai rasan basta sar tera sina par
balwa e aada mein laaya hai muqaddar
ay mere pyare nok e sina se
dekh le maa teri hai balwe mein khule sir
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta ali akbar maadar ka hai waada
sogh manaungi ta umr tumhara
ab na piyungi thanda mai pani
ab na mai baithungi kabhi saaye mein jaa kar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pooch liya mujhse sughra ne jo tera
kaise bataungi akbar nahi aaya
royegi sughra tadpegi sughra
tere bina kaise jiyegi teri khwahar
ay jaan ali akbar
shabihe payambar...

items.title: Jinki raahon se
items.body:
jinki raahon se payambar ne hataye kaante
<<DIVIDER>>
har qadam par unhi logon ne bichaye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi may jo sitam dhaaye wohi kya kam thay
baad marne ke jo pehlu may rakhaye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaar phir khaar hai fitrat hai aziyat dena
pehlu e gul se koi kaash hataye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle gulshan ki nigahon may sada khatkenge
laakh phoolon may rahe hai to paraye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
waye ho ummate marhooma teri kismat par
gul ke hotay huye daaman may sajaye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar jalane ko chale aaye nabi zaadi ka
ban gaye baade nabi raah ke saaye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar dashte musibat may gulay zehra ko
naiza taane hue har soo nikal aaye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diye ahle sitam sukhe huye honton par
jab zaban phayr ke asghar ne dikhaye kaante
jinki raahon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tane shabbir hai yun teero ke gehware par
mayyate gul ko ho jis tarha uthaye kaante
jinki raahon se...

items.title: Kar diya islam
items.body:
ya hussain as salaam
as salaam ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kar diya islam ko hai surkh roo shabbir ne
is ki khaatir ki hai aisi justuju shabbir ne
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh mein aansu thay har ek ki shabe ashoor ko
ki hai is andaaz se guftugu shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
leke aaye thay layeen jo karbala ke dasht mein
khaak mein wo sab mila di aarzoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na kiya na kar sakega koi ghazi is tarha
khoon mein jaise kiya hai wazoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufr ke haathon ye deen ke chid gaye thay jo libaas
wo zibha sab kar diye hai wo rufoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ameer is deen ki khaatir bala ke dasht mein
kar diye qurban bete khoon baroo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Kehte thay shaah
items.body:
kehte thay shaah ay ali akbar kahan ho tum
ay mere laal ay mere dilbar kahan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
apne zaeef baap ki aa kar madad karo
ghere huwe hai shaam ka lashkar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz de rahe hai pisar ko shah e huda
ay naujawan shabihe payambar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime ke dar pa aas lagaye khadi hai maa
veeran ho gaya hai bhara ghar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke keh rahi hai ye zainab jawab do
qaime jala rahe hai sitamgar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ke dil ko kaun sambhale mere pisar
dar dar phira rahe hai sitamgar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se gaye ho tum dil e maadar udaas hai
aankhon ka noor ay ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
baithi hui hoo moo ko chipaye zameen par
aade ne cheen li meri chadar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab shaam ho rahi hai sakina ki lo khabar
ay naujawan hussain ke dilbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ghir chuke hai nargha e aada mein ay pisar
durre laga rahe hai sitamgar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tooti hui kamar ko sambhalo hussain ki
kehti hai ro ke zainab e muztar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ki aarzoo hai ek baar dekh loo
hamshakle mustafa ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ke galay pa shimr ka khanjar ghazab hua
aayi sada ke ay ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram mein hashr bapa hogaya aseem
sarwar ne jab kaha ali akbar kahan ho tum
kehte thay shaah...
items.author: Aseem Lakhnavi

items.title: Lashkare aada mein
items.body:
lashkare aada mein jitne thay sabhi kehne lage
dekh kar abbas ke tewar ali kehne lage
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar andaaz e jang e hazrate abbas ke
aagaye maidan mein hyder khyberi kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath mein abbas ke chamki jo wo tayghe hyderi
lashkari be-saakhta bijli giri kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar o akbar pe ki nazrein to dil mein ashkiyan
unko tasveer e ali unko nabi kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho nazar to aao dekho kya hai tasveer e hussain
raushni apne ko kaise rasuhni kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waalon ne zinda kar diya islam ko
marne waale maut ko hi zindagi kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash akbar ki uthaayi jo zameen e garm se
har qadam pe shaahe waala ya ali kehne lage
lashkare aada mein...

items.title: Mai seene pe baba
items.body:
ye nauha sakina ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai seene pe baba ke so'un kahan
teer hi teer hai
haye teer hi teer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar se sookha gala kat gaya
mera baba magar phir bhi pyasa raha
aagayi raat maine na pani piya
itne seene pe hai zakhme noke sina
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye dada baba ka kya haal hai
dadi zahra yehi aap ka laal hai
laash ghodon ki taapon se pamaal hai
jism tukde hua tooti hai phasliyan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar teer hi teer roti hoo mai
bolte kyun nahi jaan khoti hoo mai
aap ke sirf sine pe soti hoo mai
neend aati hai lekin mai so'un kahan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal chuke qaime aur chadarein chin chuki
berida meri phupiyan hai baithi wahin
is jagah bhi na aajaye shimr e layeen
mera kurta jala chin chuki baaliyan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya sajjad par ab hai mushkil badi
aap ke baad kya kya musibat padi
dekhiye aap ke paas mai hoo khadi
ye tamachon ke rukhsar par hai nishan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai to samjhi thi yan hoga asghar mera
teer se chid gaya jiska nanha gala
aake seene pe wo aap ke sogaya
baba batlayein hai mera asghar kahan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim ki surat hai laash aap ki
hai kamar bhai ke gham se tooti hui
zakhme akbar jigar se hai rista abhi
ab bhi nikli nahi hai wo noke sina
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
akhm baazu pe pyase baradar ka hai
zakhm seene pe baba ye akbar hai
hai jo gardan kati zakhm asghar ka hai
kaise so'un ye hai ap ka imtehan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai zameen rota hai asmaan
ay qamar ye batayein imam e zaman
seena sone ko mil jaaye ho shadman
teer kaise nikalegi ye natawan
teer hi teer hai
mai seene pe baba ke...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Matam kya hai
items.body:
matam kya hai dunya waalon zulm se nafrat ka aelaan
majlis kya hai sheh se mohabbat aur aqeedat ka aelaan
<<DIVIDER>>
haq kya hai aur baatil kya hai kufr hai kya islam hai kya
karbobala mein sheh ne kiya hai sab ki haqeeqat ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
boj gunahon ka bhi bada to fikr nahi ha roz e jaza
ashke ghame sheh pe karenge apni shafa'at ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufr ki koshish hai ye musalsal zikre shahe deen mit jaaye
zikre shahe deen mit nahi sakta hai ye mashiyat ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheen liya abbas ne darya phir bhi labon ko tar na kiya
tashna labi ke saath kiya hai apni shuja'at ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nargha e aada mein bhi hua ek hashr bapa kohraam macha
asghar ke honton pe tabassum aakh e qayamat ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chup na sakega khoon e shaheedan taaba qayamat zainab ne
shaam ke bazaaron mein kiya is tarha shahadat ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein jab sheh ne pukara hai koi meri nusrat ko
gir gaye jhoole se asghar ye sun ke imamamt ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala waalon ki kahani hum ko bataati hai urooj
sibte nabi ne phir se kiya hai deen o shariyat ka aelaan
matam kya hai...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Aao zaware hussain
items.body:
karbala tumko bulaati hai azadar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
khud lagayenge galay tumko sab ansar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ek jaanib hai maqame ali akbar dekho
ek maqam aisa ke gehwara e asghar dekho
har jagah sheh ke azadaron ka manzar dekho
ambiya aur malak bhi hai azadar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaum e ashoor zara karbobala ko dekho
jis jagah zulm hua uski fiza ko dekho
khoon ugalti hui tum khaak e shifa ko dekho
ab to har qaum hui jaati hai bemaar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki qabr pe jis roz ke aayi khwahar
aao zawwaro usi din safar e chehlum par
lehad e shaah talak hoga jo paidal ye safar
dengi har gaam dua maadar e ghamkhaar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shehr e shabbir mein aajao fazeelat pao
rizq o aulaad mein aur saanso my barkat pao
zinda reh kar bhi yahan fazle shahadat pao
ho ye koshish ke hamein dekhle sarkar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek jali aayat e allah hai ye karbobala
ambiya ki bhi guzar raah hai ye karbobala
azme shabbir se aagaah hai ye karbobala
mil ke shabbir se khud seekh lo kirdar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein shabbir ho har dam chalo karbobala
lab pe ho deen ka paigham chalo karbobala
baand kar kaabe ka ehraam chalo karbobala
baith e allah bhi har waqt hai ghamkhaar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud ba khud haath wahan jaate matam ko uthe
roz e ashoor jahan baazu e abbas kate
shaah jab laasha e abbas pe ye kehte chale
tum kamar tod gaye meri madadgaar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chashm ko ashke ghame shaah tar karna hai
dil mein har naasir e shabbir ke ghar karna hai
suye shabbir kuch tarha safar karna hai
ho sada aagaye wo majid o mukhtar e hussain
aao zawwar e hussain
karbala tumko bulaati hai...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Abbas ka laasha
items.body:
abbas ka laasha mai nahi laaya sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
laaya hoon tarayi se alam khoon mein dooba
abbas ka laasha mai nahi laaya sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se meri laadli naaraz na hona
abbas ka laasha mai nahi laaya sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khaali alam leke mai darya se chala tha
har ek qadam par mai yehi soch raha tha
phat jaaye na masoom sakina ka kaleja
jab apni dulaari se mai ye jaa ke kahunga
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalta hai kaleje pe mere dard ka khanjar
maara gaya pyasa mera mazloom baradar
malta hua haathon ko mai aaya hoon palat kar
ye dard mere dil se juda ho nahi sakta
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse tere ammu ne kaha tha meri pyari
abbas ki ye aakhri khwahish thi dulaari
le jaana na qaime ki taraf laash hamari
poori hui abbas e dilawar ki tamanna
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chota na karo dil meri naadan sakina
qismat ka likha hai ye meri jaan sakina
tujh par ye tera baap ho qurban sakina
ye baat meri laadli dil mein nahi rakhna
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke laashe ko tasavvur mein bana lo
jee bhar ke chacha jaan pe ashkon ko baha lo
ammu ka alam laaya hoon seene se laga lo
reh jaaye na ye dil mein khalaq ay meri dukhiya
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil par jo mere zakhm laga kaise bataun
is waqt mera haal hai kya kaise bataun
sadma jo mujhe aaj hua kaise bataun
ab dil mera har waqt isi gham se phatega
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina ko kaleje se laga kar
roye hai bahot dayr talak sibte payambar
kehte thay ki ab sabr karo ay meri dukhtar
maine wo kiya jo mere bhai ne kaha tha
abbas ka laasha mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz wo musibat ki badi sakht ghadi thi
masoom sakina dar e qaima pe khadi thi
aur laash alamdar ki darya pe padi thi
shabbir ke is bain se kohraam tha barpa
abbas ka laasha mai...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Ahlan wa sehlan
items.body:
matam kuna nauha kuna
ahle aza suye jina
pahunche lahoo may ho ke tar
aati thi jannat ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
marhaba marhaba marhaba marhaba
ahlan wa sehlan marhaba
<<DIVIDER>>
aashiq e shabbir aa
hai muntazir meri fiza
mai kya meri auqaat kya
kehti hai khud bhi sayyeda
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye matam e zanjeer hai
khushnoodi e sahbbir hai
ye faisla to ho chuka
jannat pe bhi tehreer hai
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne uthaaya tha alam
jalti zameen par thay qadam
ghazi kahega hashr may
de kar dua kehte hai hum
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhme ali akbar ka gham
seene pe tere hai raqam
karta hua seena zani
jannat may rakh apne qadam
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehwara e asghar ko tu
lekar phira hai koo ba koo
kehne lagi asghar ki maa
jannat teri jannat ka tu
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo choti choti baaliyan
rakh kar alam ke darmiyan
rota tha dhaade maar kar
ay bewatan ke nauhakwan
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ka matamdaar hai
nazron may wo bazaar hai
roya hai ek bemaar ko
jannat ka tu haqdaar hai
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke baazu ki rasan
deti rahi tujhko mehan
jannat teri maqrooz hai
aaja baraye panjetan
ahlan wa sehlan...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan kya taqdeer hai
tu shayar e shabbir hai
har sher par ek ghar mila
jannat teri jageer hai
ahlan wa sehlan...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Alamdare hussain
items.body:
jaan e hussain alamdar e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain
bawafa monis o ghamkhwar e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye azadaar na bhoolenge kabhi aap ka gham
hum na bhoolenge kabhi khoon mein dooba wo alam
hashr tak aap ki ghurbat ka karenge matam
ay jari aap ke baazu e bureeda ki qasam
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke dar se liya dars e sharafat hum ne
aap se seekhi hai bhai ki mohabbat hum ne
chadar e saani e zahra ki qasam ay ghazi
aap se seekhi hai behno ki hifazat hum ne
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek masooma ke ehsaas pe rona aaya
uski mazloomi pe aur pyaas pe rona aaya
jab bhi parcham pe lagi mashke sakina dekhi
aap ki tooti hui aas pe rona aaya
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maula wo qayamat ki ghadi
sheh ko jis waqt sada aap ne di
aasman dard ka sarwar pe gira
daude ye kehte huwe shaahe huda
mere ghayyur mere shere jari
tere bhai ki kamar toot gayi
aur jeena nahi ab mujhko gawara ghazi
maar daalega mujhe daagh tumhara ghazi
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maqtal ka wo manzar wo musibat maula
ta abad yaad rahegi wo qayamat maula
seena e sayyede waala pe layeen ka zaanu
aur tadpti hui wo aap ki mayyat maula
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil bahot rota hai ye soch ke mera ghazi
aap ko jaan se pyari thi sakina ghazi
shimr ne usko tamachon pe tamache maare
aap ne kaise saha hoga ye sadma ghazi
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil laraz jaata hai ye sun ke azadaron ka
bhare bazaar mein thay ahle haram beparda
haye kya aap pe guzri hai qayamat us dam
jab ye zainab ne kaha cheeni gayi meri rida
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kis dil se nadeem aap ki ghurbat likhe
is tasavvur se jigar hota hai tukde tukde
mai bayan kaise karun aap ke zakhmi sar ko
shimr ne gardan e rahwaar se baandha kaise
ay abalfazl alamdar e hussain...
items.author: Nadeem Sultanpuri

items.title: Amma laut aayi hoo
items.body:
amma laut aayi hoo mai
daagh dil pe bahattar ke laayi hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gaye thay yahan se to ghar tha bhara
gulsitan tera phoolon se abaad tha
haye dashte sitam haye karbobala
loot kar legayi sab bhara ghar mera
sab luta aayi teri kameini hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
qasimo akbaro asghare dilruba
sab ke sab hogaye karbala mein juda
sher jaisa wo abbas bhai mera
katgaye haath saahil pe maara gaya
nehr pe bekafan chod aayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
choomti thi bade pyar se jo gala
dasthe ghurbat mein tan se hua wo juda
ek khatra dame zibha mil na saka
laadla tera pyasa jahan se gaya
khoon bhara payrahan saath laayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shabbir itna bada hausla
cheen kar legaye chadare ashkiyan
qaima e ahl par thay rasoole khuda
aag lagti gayi khaak hota gaya
jalte qaimon se abid ko laayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa baja pa barehna yuhin sar khule
shaam o koofa ki galiyon mein khaynche gaye
kya kahoon waaliye shaam ke saamne
haath thay rassiyon mein hamare bandhe
neel baazu ke dikhlane aayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dulaari sakina bhatiji meri
kha rahi thi tamache mai chup thi khadi
haye re bebasi haye bechaargi
wo sitam jhelte jhelte mar gayi
shaam ki qaid mein chod aayi hoo mai
amma laut aayi hoo....

items.title: Baba ko sadayein
items.body:
baba ko sadayein deti hai
jangal may sakina raat gaye
jab kaan may uske aati hai
awaaz e ilayya raat gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas nahi qasim bhi nahi
akbar bhi nahi asghar bhi nahi
be-gor o kafan hai jangal may
shabbir ka laasha raat gaye
baba ko sadayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki dulaari sar kholay
be-makhna o chadar baithi hai
roodad e alam dohrata hai
jalta hua qaima raat gaye
baba ko sadayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sham e ghariban ko lekar
ashoor ka suraj doob gaya
sajjad ko bhi be-deeno ne
zanjeer may jakda raat gaye
baba ko sadayein...

items.title: Batees baras waar
items.body:
sar choom ke abbas ka kehte rahe sarwar
battees baras waar diye char baras par
<<DIVIDER>>
ek mashke sakina ke liye baazu kata kar
battees baras waar diye chaar baras par
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha liye godhi mein sada deti hai zahra
is sher ka khoon beh gaya pani se zyada
abbas ka ehsaan hai ye aale nabi par
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu ko qalam dekh ke kehne lage maula
ye haath mere haath mein baba ne diya tha
phir suye najaf dekh ke goya huwe sarwar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir pe sadqe hua shabbir ka banda
ya fatema zehra mera maqbool ho hadiya
kehti hai baqaiya mein ye abbas ki maadar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
saadat ki ab kaun bujhayega bhala pyaas
ek gurz laga zeen se gire khaak pe abbas
ye sunte hi qaimon mein bapa hogaya mehshar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun ho na dile abide bemaar ke tukde
qasim se zyada thay alamdar ke tukde
turbat bhi bani qabr e sakina ke barabar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis mein kabhi naam jo abbas ka aata
ye kehte huwe uth'ta tha shabbir ka beta
qurban chacha aap pe ye abid e muztar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke sada deti thi ye paalne waali
abbas hui aaj se jholi meri khaali
tha shor bapa qaima e kulsoom ke andar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya nehr pe guzri hai ye kehti thi sakina
kyun khoon mein dooba hai alam mere chacha ka
sheh beti ko kehte rahe seene se laga kar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko ghareebi ki khabar kaise sunate
maare gaye abbas ye kis dil se batate
sheh kehte rahe choom ke hamsheer ki chadar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe ki tarha haathon pe parcham ko utha kar
shabbir sada dete thay rote huwe akbar
jaan waar doon tujh par ay mere sher e dilawar
battees baras waar diye...
sar choom ke abbas ka...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Bin bhai ke ab
items.body:
ay bhaiya mere bhaiya
haye hussain pyase hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bin bhai ke ab kaise watan jayegi zainab
mar jayegi mar jayegi mar jayegi mar jayegi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
poochegi jo sughra ke kahan hai mere baba
mujhko mera baysheer nazar kyun nahi aata
sab qatl huwe kaise bata payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab chaahne waale hai mere karbobala mein
sab godh ke paale hai isi dasht e jafa mein
yeh kehte huwe jahan se guzar jayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan e masayib se to laut aayi hoon bhaiya
par saath sakina ko kahan laayi hoon bhaiya
ye daagh kaleje pe na seh payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek hi aaram hai is qalb e hazeen ko
bazaar ke sab zakhm abhi yaad hai mujhko
baaghi ki behan ab nahi kehlayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab ke makeen poochenge sajjad se aa kar
pardes mein barbaad hua kaise bhara ghar
khoon royega sajjad to ghabrayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayenge nazar aun o mohamed ke jo hujre
ho jayenge sab zakhm hare mere jigar ke
jab aun o mohamed ko nahi payegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kohe sitam qalb pe nani ke girega
amma ki lehad kaamp uthegi mere bhaiya
jab neel rasan ke unhe dikhlayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun aayi nahi saath mein farzand tumhare
gar pooch liya mujhse ye abdulla ne aa ke
sau baar wohi waqeya dohrayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar wo ghadi kaisi thi mai likh nahi sakta
mehmil se nazar aaya jo zainab ko madina
fizza ne kaha dard se mar jayegi zainab
bin bhai ke ab...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ek maa ki aa rahi
items.body:
ek maa ki aa rahi hai sada ay mere hussain
aaja tu meri godh mein aa ay mere hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan mein ladkhada ke tu girta tha jab kabhi
tujhko sambhalne mein kayi baar mai giri
aati thi mere rab se sada ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta wo tere naala ho ya maa ho wo teri
tujhko na dekh sakte thay rote huwe kabhi
ab ro ke de rahe hai sada ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsat hua tu shehre madina se jis ghadi
nana ki qabr se ye sada maine bhi suni
beta bacha le deen mera ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada falak se jo tu pahuncha karbala
shabbir ye maqam hai ta hashr ab tera
is khaak par katega gala ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan mein tere naaz uthaati rahi hoon mai
pehlu mein apne tujhko sulaati rahi hoon mai
ye tujhpe kaisa waqt pada ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne uthaya akbar o asghar ki laash ko
ibne hassan ke laasha e sad paash paash ko
ghazi ka laasha uth na saka ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mukhtar ran mein bain ye karti thi fatema
majid kaleja phat gaya zehra ne jab kaha
pamaal tera laasha hua ay mere hussain
ek maa ki aa rahi...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Ghareeb imam alvida
items.body:
haye hussain alwida haye hussain alwida
maula hussain alwida aaqa hussain alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb imam alwida shaheed imam alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ranj o gham ki barishein ye khoon mein doobi aasteen
ye beshumar zakhm aur tumhara jism e nazneen
hai kaun jo samajh sake tumhare gham ki inteha
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
na waqte zibha zaalimon ne aab boondh bhar diya
rula rula ke tujhko dushmano ne qatl kar diya
tadap rahe hai mustafa bilak rahi hai fatema
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan aza ki wus'atein kahan ye ashke mukhtasir
isi ka shaahe behrobar qalaq rahega saal bhar
tumhare gham mein rone ka hua na hum se haq ada
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara ghut raha hai dum hamay rula rahe hai kyun
abhi to aap aaye thay abhi ye ja rahe hai kyun
hamay batate jaaiye hui hai hum se kya khata
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
na aap aise jaaiye na is tarha rulaiye
jo ja rahe hai aap to ghulamon ko bataiye
ye saal bhar ka faasla ghatega kis tarha bhala
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap rahi hai aurtein bilag rahi hai bacchiyan
sawaal kar rahi hai hum se hind ki udasiyan
thi jis ke dum se raunaqein wo ab kahan chala gaya
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ye gham ki barishein kahan aza ki raunaqein
kahan naseeb hongi saal bhar wafa ki raunaqein
alam jo hum badhayenge lagega ghar luta luta
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
khata jo hogayi ho kuch tu usko bakhsh dijiye
gunah gaar hai bohat humay muaaf kijiye
qasam hai aap ko janabe hurr ki shaahe karbala
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hoga beqarar dil to farshe gham bichayenge
mere imam aap ko hum apne ghar bulayenge
zaroor aaiyega aap ko azaa ka waasta
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kareem ho karam karo qasam hai tumko shaahe deen
bilal e kazmi tumhara ho ke aamir e hazeen
ye dono beqarar hai bula lo jald karbala
ghareeb imam alwida...

items.title: Haye shame ghariban
items.body:
haye sham e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
kunbe ki nigehban ye kehti hai laraz kar
ruk ja sawaar mera lut agya hai ghar
ruk ja ke abhi soye hai bacche mere ro kar
daala jo haath ghaiz se aspe lagaam par
parda utha diya phir ghode ke sawaar ne
zainab ye ro ke kehne lagi baba ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aaye ho baba mere kunba hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas kho chuki hoo mai akbar pe ro chuki
bhaiya tumhare baad mai barbaad ho chuki
zinda mai kaise reh gayi meri maut hai kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ki laash tukdon may taqseem ho chuki
bhaiya hassan ki ye bhi nishani bhi mit chuki
dulhan hai ek roz ki dulha hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ke hausle pe jawani bhi ro chuki
sookhi zuban pe fauje sitamgar bhi ro chuki
aaghosh may rabab ki asghar hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
laayi thi apne saath wo ansaar kho chuki
nana tumhare deen pe qurban kar chuki
mai bhi to berida hui chadar hai ab kahan
haye sham e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mai kya bataun ke kya kya mai seh chuki
bhaiya ki laash teeron ke bistar pe so chuki
bhai ke mer jism pe ab sar bhi hai kahan
haye sham e ghariban...

items.title: Jinko tu samjhi hai
items.body:
jinko tu samjhi hai ay hind yahan wo to nahi
hum to awara watan qaidi hai aur khaak nasheen
<<DIVIDER>>
wo to hai noore mohamed ki ziya arshe makeen
haal ye dekh ke bhi aata nahi tujhko yakeen
tune kya dekh ke kya soch ke ye baat kahi
kalmago qaid karenge bhala aulad e nabi
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
boli wo kaun ho tum log mujhe ye to batao
apna afsana e gham mujhko mufassar to sunao
roko in aansuon ko apne khudara na bahao
sar ko ooncha karo ay bibiyon surat to dikhao
boli ek bibi bada ranj hai maajayi ko
tere shauhar ne kiya qatl mere bhai ko
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna pur dard tha ye zainab e muztar ka bayan
sunte hi hind ki ankhon se huwe ashk rawan
roke kehne lagi ba qaatire sultan e zaman
mai chudaungi tumhe qaid se ba izzat o shaan
naam leke na ab kijiyo yun shor o shain
mere aaqa mere maula ka bhi hai naam hussain
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
shab ko ek khaab wo dekha hai ke allah ki panaah
yani hai teen shab o roz se pyasa mera shaah
boli phir apne kaneezo se basad ashk o aah
naam ab leti hoo saydaniyo ke haq e dawa
paas behad hai mujhe aale mohamed ka janab
jao le aao wazoo karne ko mere liye aab
jinko tu samjhi hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
lab pe abbas kabhi akbar o asghar tha anees
qasim o aun o mohamed kabhi jafar tha anees
zikr e ansaar kabhi ya shahe safdar tha anees
teen din shaam azakhana e sarwar tha anees
majlise sibte payambar hui pehli barpa
zaakira jiski thi khud binte ali o zehra
jinko tu samjhi hai…

items.title: Kar rahi hai dastane
items.body:
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
kar rahi hai daastane gham bayan qaimon ki raakh
haye ye kismat kahan zainab kahan qaimon ki raakh
<<DIVIDER>>
sar chupane ke liye jaaye bhi to jaaye kidhar
khoon ke pyase nazar aate hai ta-hadhe nazar
door tak phaili hai zer aasman qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
aalam e islam ko ghairat dilaane ke liye
zulm kis hadh tak huwe hai ye bataane ke liye
le gayi hai shaam tak saydaniya qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki khaak par khoon mein naha kar so gaye
naaz zainab ko tha jin par qatl wo sab ho gaye
kaash udte dekhte peer o jawan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
bediyan naize rasan pathar atash aur ghurkiyan
kya yehi kismat mein likha tha ke dekhe hum yahan
naiza o shamsheer o khanjar barchiyan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum isay ghurbat sakina ki kahein ya bebesai
sar chupane ke liye jaane hussain ibne ali
daalti hai sar mein bhar ke mutthiyan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
raakh ne behte lahoo ko jazb jis dam kar liya
chand lamhe hi sahi par dekhne mein yun laga
ban gayi kaano ki jaise baliyan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehmaton ka raat din wallah hota hai nuzool
khil rahe hai aaj is jaa sabr e shabbiri ke phool
chaar soo phaili hui thi kal jahan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah karbala se shaam tak ka imtehan
kar nahi sakta koi asif kisi surat bayan
shadman is gham mein khud hai nauhakhwan qaimon ki raakh
kar rahi hai daastane...

jigar figaar hote thay buland hoti thi sada

items.title: Mai us ghareeb ka
items.body:
arbaeen e hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bula ke ban mein sata kar jise shaheed kiya
aaj chehlum hai mere us ghareeb bhai ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kar diya jis ka sitamgaaron ne tukde tukde
thaam ke apna jigar kehti hai binte zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
paraye des mein jisko kafan talak na mila
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jiska dasht mein pamaal ho gaya laasha
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
layeen phirata raha jiske halq par khanjar
sawaar shimr e sitamgar tha jiske seene par
mai jiska dekh ke aayi hoon bekafan laasha
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
paraye des mein jisko...

mujhko zaalim ne gala jiska dikha kar kaata
jis ke rukhsaar pe zaalim ne tamacha maara
dekh kar mujhko sukoon milta tha jiska chehra
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
paraye des mein jisko...

ke jis ke phool se bacche ko na mila pani

galay mein jiske pisar ke tha teer seh shohba
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
paraye des mein jisko...

bhatije bhanje bhai shaheed jiske huwe
mai dekhti rahi pamaal ho gaye laashe
bas ek roz mein wo jiski lut gayi dunya
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
paraye des mein jisko...

wo jiska laal na turbat mein reh saka haye
layeen nanha sa laasha nikaal kar laaye
mai dekhti rahi nazuk galay ko kat'ta hua
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
paraye des mein jisko...

giri mazaar pe bhai ki nauhakhwan zainab
bata do bhaiya mere jaaye ab kahan zainab
ye kehke qabr pe behosh ho gayi dukhiya
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon
paraye des mein jisko...

ye dekh lo mere bhai hai chut gayi zainab
dilaaun nazrein bhala kis pe lut gayi zainab
bala ke dash mein loota gaya hai ghar mera
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon

ghareeb e fatema zahra ka arbaeen hai ye

dhadakta qalb hai rehaan aur mubarak ka
mai us ghareeb ka chehlum manane aayi hoon

items.title: Matam meri hayaat
items.body:
matam meri hayaat tabarruk meri ghiza
zinda mera wujood hai karbobala ke saath
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyon se ab bhi jaari hai matam ka silsila
zulm o jafa bujha na sake shamma e aza
jalta hai ye charaagh hamesha hawa ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
is matam e hussain ke ghazi hai sayeban
raushan alam se ho gayi tareek bastiyan
ahle aza azal se hai shaah e wafa ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir khauf e maut rehta hai unko bhala kahan
jo zayareen jaate hai behre mashi wahan
dete hai rizq aaj bhi maula sakha ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza jaise parcham e ghazi ke saath hai
kaaba khuda ka jaise namazi ke saath hai
bas yuhin zayareen hai khaak e shifa ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko sitam shiyaar bhala kya mitayenge
bid’at ke fatwe ashkon mein sab doob jayenge
jeete hai hum to maadar e sheh ki dua ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani tawaaf karta hai ghazi ki qabr ka
kaaba ho goya qabr sujaat ka sabr ka
ye alqama ka rishta hai ab bhi wafa ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
zikre ghame husaain ka aejaz dekhiye
kausar ko meri aankh pa hai naaz dekhiye
chalki hui furaat hai ashq e aza ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek rang o nasl ke insan doston
sabke dilon mein ek hai armaan doston
ghazi bulale sab ko sahar ki hawa ke saath
matam meri hayaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir ko aur toosi ko karbobala mili
taskeen e dard ke liye khaak e shifa mili
gham bhi mila to hum ko mila hai dawa ke saath
matam meri hayaat...

baanto tabarruk nazr dilao
bachon ko apne saqqa banao
ghar ghar mein farsh aza ka bichao

mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...

mere ghar maula aaye hai

mere dehleez par dekho
khataarein ambiya ki hai
atayein kis khadar mujh par
sakina ke chacha ki hai
alam dekha to dil bola
mere ghar maula aaye hai

karam mujh par hua aisa
ke ek din khawab mein dekha

dar o deewar mehke hai
aqeedat ye bataati hai
kisi hasti ki aamad hai
khabar khushboo sunati hai
jisay tu ghar bulaata tha
sawari us ki aati hai
ujaala ho gaya har soo
giray phir aankh se aansu
raha na qalb na qaabu
lagay ek khwaab ke jaisa
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bulaya maine maula ko
to wo tanha nahi aaye
kisi ko laaye maqtal se
kisi ko shaam se laaye
aur un ke saath hai zehra
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajab hai kaifiyat dil ki
khushi hai aur hai gham bhi
karun mai shukr ke sajde
musalle par hai matam bhi
dhala hai shukr mein nauha
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha farhan ne ro kar
likhi kya baat mazhar ne
ajal ka jab payaam aaya
to mai bola farishte se
abhi mai aa nahi sakta
mere ghar maula aaye hai
bicha hai farsh majlis ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya sayyed e mazloom lutay ghar ka lo pursa
naizon par shaheedon ke har ek sar ka lo pursa
ali akbar ka lo pursa ghazi ka lo pursa
ali asghar ka lo pursa
haan aun o mohamed ka lo qasim ka lo pursa
kulsoom ka zainab ka sakina ka lo pursa
qaimon ka lo pursa luti chaadar ka lo pursa
bemaar ka pursa jalay bistar ka lo pursa
haye mere maula ye bare ghar ka lo pursa
<<DIVIDER>>
ya mazloom hussaina
hussain hussain hussaina
pyase hussaina
hussain hussain hussaina
ghar tera loota gaya
hussain hussain hussaina
kunba bhi pyasa raha
hussain hussain hussaina
har ek qaima jhal gaya
hussain hussain hussaina
chin gayi sab ki rida
hussain hussain hussaina
rote hai ahle aza
hussain hussain hussaina
matam ki goonje sada
hussain hussain hussaina
ghar ghar hai farsh e aza
hussain hussain hussaina
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Murtaza ki tarha
items.body:
nahi hai koi bhi dunya mein murtaza ki tarha
kahin bashar ki tarha hai kahin khuda ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ko rehna hai ta-hashr sar buland ke wo
nabi ke dosh pe kaabe mein hai dua ki tarha
nahi hai koi bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hawa ki rou mein wafa thi to apna hurr kaise
udhar se aaya idhar moj mein hawa ki tarha
nahi hai koi bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb log thay ay dashte nainawa tere
gale mile bhi qaza se to aashna ki tarha
