nahi hai koi bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame hussain ne rakhli hai aabru warna
ujad hi jaati ye dunya bhi karbala ki tarha
nahi hai koi bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chale jo abid e bemaar khafela le kar
sada ye aayi guzar jao ambiya ki tarha
nahi hai koi bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ko khwahish e tameer hai to aaye naseer
najaf ki raah mein rehta hoon naqshe paa ki tarha
nahi hai koi bhi...
items.author: Naseer Turabi

items.title: Abbas ka laasha
items.body:
karbobala may dekh ke bikhre huwe laashe
har laasha e besar par bahot royi hai zahra
sar saare shaheedon ke jab aaye sare naiza
zahra ne kaha dekh ke abbas ka laasha
haye shaam haye bazaar haye ghairat e abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
naizon par nazar aata hai abbas ka laasha
sab ko lahoo rulwaata hai abbas ka laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
sambhla na gaya laashe pa zahra ne giraya
phir seene se laashe ko yehi keh ke lagaya
shabbir ke laashe sa hai abbas ka laasha
naizon pa nazar aata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise hi kaha shaah ne sheron mere utho
labbaik kaho uthke hussain ibne ali ko
ye sunke bahot tadpa hai abbas ka laasha
naizon pa nazar aata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
barsaat tamachon ki sakina pa hui hai
hadh zulm o sitam ki ye yateema pa hui hai
har zulm pa sar patka hai abbas ka laasha
naizon pa nazar aata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ne wilayat ke liye sar ko kataya
asghar ne wilayat ke liye teer hai khaaya
paigham yehi deta hai abbas ka laasha
naizon pa nazar aata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime jo jale roke ye zainab ne sada di
ghazi na raha chin gayi behno ki rida bhi
ye dekh ke khoon rota hai abbas ka laasha
naizon pa nazar aata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay zakhm bahot sar pa tere ay mere ghazi
nauha ye padha karte hai tanhaai may mehdi
khoon ghaib may rulwaata hai abbas ka laasha
naizon pa nazar aata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
irfan se kehta hai jo gham aale nabi ka
nasir ho ya ho koi bhi ghamkhwar ali ka
har lafz pa yaad aata hai abbas ka laasha
naizon pa nazar aata hai...
items.author: Nasir Hussain

items.title: Alamdare hussain
items.body:
alamdare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waalon ka pyara hai alamdare hussain
be-saharon ka sahara hai alamdare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khayaal aata hai ghazi tere parhcam ke talay
arsh se taygh e yadullah ki tarha haq ne
tera parcham bhi utaara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh raha hai yeho sardaab mein pani ruk kar
roz e ashoor se ab roz e jaza tak mukh par
tera bas tera ijaara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kul ke maula ne duaon mein khuda se maanga
fatema zehra ne bhi tumko kaha hai beta
ye sharaf bhi to tumhara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye pukara tha sar e karbobal deen e nabi
meri taqdeer ka maalik hai hussain ibne ali
meri qismat ka sitara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
saari dunya pe ayan hoga tera jaah o hasham
ek din aayega har ghar pe sajega ye alam
sab pukarenge hamara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis se khul jaata hai insan ka jauhar wo bhi
jis se banta hai zamane ka muqaddar wo bhi
tere abroo ka ishaara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab se anmol bhala kyun na wohi kehlaye
tere parcham ke talay tere alam ke saaye
hum ne jo waqt guzara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bhoolenge us aalam e tanhaai ko
jis mein zehra ke dulaare ko tere bhai ko
ghayr ke laakhon ne maara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
har qadam bali sakina ka tamache khaana
raahe pur khaar mein bacchi ka tadapna rona
kis tarha tum ko gawara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar pe abbas ke izhaar koi bhi aaya
shadman hoke wo kehta hua yehi lauta
be-saharon ka sahara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
items.author: Ali Izhaar

items.title: Amma mai jaa raha
items.body:
amma mai jaa raha hoo deen e khuda bachane
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar mera karega nana ki tarjumani
dega khuda ke deen ko maqtal may naujawani
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hui ye sheh ki awaaz thar tharayi
de dunga raahe haq my abbas jaisa bhai
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ki laash ke bhi tukde uthaunga mai
baysheer ki lehad bhi ran may banaunga mai
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
meri behan jo mujhko hai jaan se bhi pyari
sun'ni hai us behan ki maqtal may aah o zaari
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko kataunga mai ghar ko lutaunga mai
nana se jo kiya hai waada nibhaunga mai
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha se karunga ayaat ki hifazat
naize pe bhi karunga quran ki tilawat
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye maa bhi chal rahi hai tere saath gham uthane
tu jaa raha hai beta karbobala basane
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
veraan hai madina veraan hai haveli
maa kya karegi dukhiya reh kar yahan akeli
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
din honge aafaton ke ghurbat ki raat hogi
is maut ke safar may maa saath saath hogi
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
<<DIVIDER>>
maa saath saath pahunchi bete ka gham manane
aayi nazar ye dukhiya har laash ke sirhane
phir aaun ya na aaun wapas khuda hi jaane
amma mai jaa raha hoo…
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ay shimr mere laal
items.body:
bole shabbir ke sarwar ko sambhalo amma
aakhri baar kaleje se lagalo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke bete ki sada aagayi khatoon e jina
dasht mein kehne lagi maa hai mera laal kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhraye baal kehti hai jangal mein fatema
ay shimr mere laal ko aise na zibha kar
<<DIVIDER>>
paala hai chakki pees ke maine hussain ko
do boondh pani dede zara noor e ain ko
hai teen din se khushk gala wa musibata
ay shimr mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai maa hoo mere saamne mat qatl kar isay
sookha gala hai kis tarha khanjar tera chale
manzar ye dekh dekh ke rote hai mustafa
ay shimr mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
maloom tha ki hogi shahadat hussain ki
maloom tha ke jaan na bachegi pisar teri
aise koi bhi qatl nahi aaj tak hua
ay shimr mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
itne badan mein teer chube hai mai kya karoo
mai kaunsa badan se bhala teer khaynch loo
aisa chuba hai teer ke hilta nahi zara
ay shimr mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat utha chuka hai bahattar ki laadla
akbar ke khoon mein doob gayi shaah ki aba
uski jabeen se khoon hai baysheer ka laga
ay shimr mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai isko dekh dekh ke roti rahi sada
jab jab bhi choomti thi mai halqoom shaah ka
amma na roiye yehi kheta tha baareha
ay shimr mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir qatl hogaye mai dekhti rahi
sheh ki zameen garm pa mayyat padi rahi
chalees roz dhoop mein laasha pada raha
ay shimr mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah karbala ko mubarak agar gaya
tadpega dekh dekh ke rauza hussain ka
rehan hai yaqeen ke goonjegi ek sada
ay shimr mere laal ko...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Baba mai kya karun
items.body:
ro ro ke baba jaan se kehti thi fatema
baba mai kya karun
daswi ko karbala mein mera ghar ujad gaya
ek do paher mein haye muqaddar bigad gaya
baba mai kya karun
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed apne abo jadd ki thay misaal
zainab ke dono laal
maa ne nisaar unhe bhi biradar pe kar diya
phir bhi mera hussain jafa se na bach saka
baba mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim sa naujawan ke nihayat haseen tha
kitna zaheen tha
aada ne uski laash ko pamaal kar diya
nasle hassan ko qata kiya haye kya kiya
baba mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
farzand mera kitna jari aur diler tha
sheron ka sher tha
mai dekhti rahi mera abbas mar gaya
shaane kata ke nehr pe ghazi guzar gaya
baba mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
kadiyal jawan aap ki bilkul shabih tha
kaisa wajeeh tha
khaa kar sina kaleje pe akbar guzar gaya
ek aah ki hussain ne aur dil pakad liya
baba mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar wo cheh mahine ki jaan haye natawan
pyasa tha bezaban
lekin shaqi ne teer e seh shoba chala diya
aaghosh mein hussain ki baccha ulat gaya
baba mai kya karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba idhar to dekhiye balwa e aam mein
izdehaam emin
wo jaa raha hai dard raseedon ka khafila
zainab bhi saath saath chali hoke berida
baba mai kya karun...
items.author: Izzat Lakhnavi

items.title: Batlaiye ye kaisi
items.body:
batlaiye ye kaisi aseeri hai phuphi jaan
kya mere muqaddar may tha ye shaam ka zindan
<<DIVIDER>>
yan khaak udati hai jahan shaam se wehshat
har suboh tapakti hai jahan baam se wehshat
hoga isi zindan may mere dafn ka saaman
batlaiye ye kaisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye raat ye tanhai ye khamoshi ye ghurbat
amma isi goshay may banana meri turbat
kya meri tarha se meri ho qabr bhi veeran
batlaiye ye kaisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ho kahan kuch bhi dikhayi nahi deta
haaton ko mere haath sujhaayi nahi deta
aisa hai andhera ke khata hote hai ausaan
batlaiye ye kaisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sham tamachon bhari ruqsat hui amma
daman jalay gowhar chinay muddat hui amma
hai aaj talak dard se dukhte hai mere kaan
batlaiye ye kaisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
socha tha ke zindan se reha jab bhi mai hoongi
jaungi madine ko mai sughra se miloongi
lagta hai magar yan se rehaai nahi aasan
batlaiye ye kaisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
pur shor naved itna hai jitna hai ye sunsaan
ek qabr ke hote hue ye sham ka zindan
aabad kahan baad hai veeran ka veeran
batlaiye ye kaisi…
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Ek mehre karbala
items.body:
ek mehre karbala aur uski tanveere bahot
aaene mein yun nazar aati hai tasveere bahot
<<DIVIDER>>
haasile ashke ghame shabbir jannat hi nahi
khuld se pehle bhi hai maqsoos jaagere bahot
ek mehre karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
tu bhi khaake karbala apni jabeen par mal ke dekh
hum ne yun bante hue dekhi hai taqdeere bahot
ek mehre karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
rishta e quran o ahlebait kya samjhenge wo
apni marzi se jo karlete hai tafseere bahot
ek mehre karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ali ka sher aaya aur pani le gaya
sar patakti reh gayi darya pe shamsheere bahot
ek mehre karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
raaste ki har kadi zanjeer kat kar gir gayi
thi agarche paon mein abid ke zanjeere bahot
ek mehre karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
is mein shaamil hai lahoo sibte payambar ka urooj
kyun na rakhe karbala ki khaak taaseere bahot
ek mehre karbala…
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Ghareebe karbala
items.body:
ya ghareebe karbala
ya ghareebe nainawa
haa qateele be-khata
ya zabeehe nainawa
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte bala mein aa ke ghera
mehman bula kar rukh apna phera
be-aab kar ke tumko sataya
alqama ro kar karti thi girya
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aada ne tujhpe hai zulm dhaaya
darya kinare pehra lagaya
ro ro ke kehti thi ye sakina
mai bhi hoo pyasi tum bhi ho pyasa
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim o akbar bhi gaye maara
tanha khade hai ab shaahe waala
maara gaya sab godh ka paala
kaisi musibat ka hai ye lamha
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ke badle maara hai payka
nehr hua hai masoom bacha
phat gaya sheh ka us dam kaleja
darya ki maujon ne ye pukara
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer o tabar aur khanjar o naiza
mein chup gaya haye wo pyasa
pushte farash pe mushkil hai rehna
asr ka mehshar aur sheh ka sajda
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
hae hae wo asghar cheh maah waala
ghutno ke bal bhi jo chal na paaya
uska badan jo naize pa dekha
baba ke sar se boli sakina
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
sattar qadam pe zainab e kubra
roti thi haye karti thi girya
koi bacha lo aake khudara
jalti zameen pe hota hai zibha
ya ghareebe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aqif o aazam manzar ajab tha
kaata gala jab hilta tha sehra
naize pe sar jo baap ka dekha
sajjad ro kar us dam pukara
ya ghareebe karbala...
items.author: Azam Hussain

items.title: Har durood aur har
items.body:
har durood aur har salaam
madare hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
zaujaye ali e sar baland
fatema azeem arjumand
jiske aastane paak ke
qudsiyane arsh hai ghulam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai wo fatema wo fatema
aarzoo-e-qalb e mustufa
jiske laadle hassan hussain
jiski betiyan falak muqaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
kat raha tha farte shaahe deen
chal raha tha khanjare layeen
bibi aap dekhti rahi
lut gaye haram jalay khayaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
har durood aur salam
khwahare hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
sani e janabe sayyeda
allah allah tera hausla
khoob ki hifazate haram
baad-e-qatle sayyede anaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi gham uthaye hai bahot
dil pe daagh khaaye hai bahot
tujpe ay hussain ki behan
hogayi musibatein tamaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein apne dilruba
kardiye hussain par fida
aun aur mohamed e jari
hogaye shaheed e tashnakaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
daulate batool lut gayi
dukhtare rasool lut gayi
chin gayi saro se chadarein
jal gaye hussain ke qayam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyatein padi hai bekafan
kya kare hussain ki behan
bekasi aur aisi bekasi
shaam aur karbala ki shaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
inqilaabe waqt dekhiye
imtihane saqt dekhiye
sar khule rasool zadiyan
aur ahle shar ka ijtema
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
har durood aur salam
dukhtare hussain tere naam
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr kibriya ka waasta
tujko mustafa ka waasta
binte shaah be-gohar na thi
mubtela e gham hai tashnakaam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ke tamache khaye hai
bibi kitne gham uthaye hai
baap ki judaai kam na thi
tujpe qaid ke sitam khatam
har durood aur…
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi aap par sitam hue
mar gayi pidar ka gham liye
haaye jeete ji na chut saka
qaid qaanaye ameere shaam
har durood aur…

items.title: Haye shame ghariban
items.body:
din dhal gaya hai logon
ghar jal gaya hai logon
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke sar se dekho chadar bhi cheen li hai
bemaar ek jaan ko kaisi saza ye di hai
abid bhi ro raha hai daaman bhigo raha hai
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
loota hai zalimon ne zahra ke gulistan ko
dekho lage tamache nanhi si ek jaan ko
be-aasra sakina bhai padar bhi cheena
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe pe jaake baap ke kehti hai ye sakina
phir kab milega baba mujhko tera ye seena
dushman jahan hai mera cheena hai pyar tera
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya sawaar koi qaimon mein ek hijab mein
poocha batool zaadi ne tu kaun hai naqaab mein
bole ali na ghabra ye kya hua hai batla
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kaha ye zainab ne hum lut gaye hai baba
maidan e karbala mein hum mit gaye hai baba
haye zulm kya hua hai haye kya sitam hua hai
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman kisi ka dekho aatish se jal raha hai
logon yehi sakina asghar se jo juda hai
bhai kisi ka bichda gulshan ali ka ujda
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir ye shaam kaisi aayi hai karbala mein
kya kya musibaton ko laayi hai karbala mein
bhai bichad gaya hai ghar bhi ujad gaya hai
zainab ujad gayi hai
haye shaam e ghariban

items.title: Hussain ka dame
items.body:
haye hussain haye ghareeb
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ka dam e ruqsat ye tha sukhan zainab
chala mai ran ko khuda hafiz ay behan zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ab tumhare hawale tamaam ahle haram
ye honge baad mere qaidi e mehan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalega ab meri gardan pa shimr ka khanjar
rahegi laash meri ran mein bekafan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot rulayenge zaalim meri sakina ko
galay mein uske bandhi jayegi rasan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap tadap ke guzar jayegi wo zindan mein
kafan banega sakina ka pairahan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehad mein bhi na sukoon payega mera asghar
rahega naize pe sar khaak par badan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
<<DIVIDER>>
aqeel qaimon mein ek hashr tha bapa us dam
kaha jo sheh ne khuda hafiz ay behan zainab
hussain ka dame ruqsat...
items.author: Aqeel

items.title: Jaane kaise thay
items.body:
pehchano musalmano mai fatema zehra hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kaise thay musalman ghar jalaane aagaye
baap ke jaate hi beti ko sataane aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr pe baba ke di ye ro ke beti ne sada
kis tarha badle musalman dekhiye ukda kusha
aap ke jaate hi mujhpe zulm dhaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar jaldi thi unko aap ki ruqsat ke saath
ahle baatil ek jaa ho kar yahan shiddat ke saath
jalta darwaza mere uar giraane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha in aankhon ne kya kya al amaan o al hafeez
is qadar badla zamana al amaan o al hafeez
hyder e karraar ko qaidi banane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki beti kahan aur zulm ki shiddat kahan
ehteram e fatema zehra ke badle baba jaan
aap ki beti ka haye dil dukhaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ko deti rahi awaaz ye khasta jigar
ya nabi allah lije aake dukhiya ki khabar
fatema ko kalmago durra lagaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar dushwaar hota hai bichadne baap ka
haq to ye tha ghamzada ko dete pursa baap ka
pursa dene ke bajaye khoon rulaane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aalam e islam ka dastoor ehsan hai yehi
uske ghar chula na roshan ho jahan guzre koi
hum thay ghar mein aur stiamgar ghar jalane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam o yazdan tha ek ghamkhwar ka ye marsiya
baba jaan kya aap roothe lut gaya mera jahan
baani e mushkil meri mushkil badhane aagaye
jaane kaise thay musalman...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Jis dum dulhan ne
items.body:
jis dam dulhan ne laash ke tukdon pe ki nigaah
nikli lahoo may doobi hui ek jigar se aah
<<DIVIDER>>
qadmon pe sar jhuka ke pukari wo rashk e maa
mera kasoor af ho ay mere baadshah
jis dam dulhan ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli na thi hijab se taqseer waar hoo
ab hukm ho to laash pe uth kar nisaar hoo
jis dam dulhan ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahib bata to do tumhe rone may kya kahun
bekas kahun ke fidya e raah e khuda kahun
jis dam dulhan ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasa kahun shaheed kahun ya bana kahun
dulha kahun ke qasim e gul goo kaba kahun
jis dam dulhan ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
choda dulhan ko laash pe rone ke waaste
dulha bane thay qabr may sone ke waaste
jis dam dulhan ne...

items.title: Kar rahi hai lehad se
items.body:
zulm jab bhi tha ab bhi hai mujh par yahan
baba jaan baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
kar rahi hai lehad se sakina fughan
baba jaan baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
jald bhijwaiye ab alamdaar ko
badla lena hai karbal ke ghamkhwar ko
ro ke ye keh rahi hai meri dadi jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wohi nasl hai jisne baysheer ki
khodi nanhi lehad mere dilgeer ki
ab mazaaron ko todenge zaalim yahan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tod daali lehad tere ghamkaar ki
hujr ki bhi lehad aur ammar ki
kis khadar zulm hota hai hum par yahan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
todne rauze aaye hai aghiyaar ab
aap ki hai madad hum ko darkaar ab
aake hum ko bacha lo mere baba jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm jo dha rahe hai ye salfi hai sab
karbala ke munafiq yazeedi hai sab
zaalimo se bacha lo hame ammu jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon nikalta tha kaano se jab bhi mere
dard hota hai kaano mein ab bhi mere
mujh pe roti rahi khoon bhari baaliyan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne tab bhi maare tamache mujhe
taaziyane lagaye thay durre mujhe
baaliyan khenchi kaano se khoon tha rawan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashmi ne ye ro ro ke nauha kaha
padke irfan bhi nauha rone laga
rone walon ko dengi dua dadi jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
items.author: Alamdar Hashmi

items.title: Kehti hai khud
items.body:
kehti hai khud amariyan taqreer ke baghair
zainab watan mein aayi hai shabbir ke baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ke intezar mein sughra ko kya khabar
maa karbala se aayi hai baysheer ke baghair
kehti hai khud amariyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummul baneeen sunti hai haal apne laal ka
kyunkar lada layeeno se shamsheer ke baghair
kehti hai khud amariyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana hamari peet pe durro ke ye nishan
khatre kitaabe daur hai tehreer ke baghair
kehti hai khud amariyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana utha janaza meri maa ka raat mein
balwe mein thi mai chadar o tauqeer ke baghair
kehti hai khud amariyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid tha is tarha thi musalsal ye bediyan
ab paon thar-tharate hai zanjeer ke baghair
kehti hai khud amariyan...

items.title: Kohraam hai taboote
items.body:
kohraam hai taboote hassan uth'ta hai ghar se
kulsoom buka karti hai lipti hui dar se
ay waaye musibat
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kiye peet ke sar baal pareshan
khoon behta hai ashkon ki jagah deeda e tar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hashr hua charkh se girne lage taare
tukde jo gire tasht mein shabbar ke jigar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim jo jawan hote huwe karbobala tak
dekhenge hassan bete ko farwa ki nazar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate huwe shabbir se shabbar ne kaha tha
ab kashti e deen tumko bachana hai bhawar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek janaza hai ye dunya mein hassan ka
do baar uthaya jo gaya ek hi ghar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil seene mein majid na teher payega us dam
dekhe koi is gham ko shahe deen ki nazar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
items.author: Majid Raza Abdi

items.title: Laut kar aajao
items.body:
qaime ke darwaze se ye di sakina ne sada
laut kar aajao wapas ho kahan ammu
ho gaya pardes mein ab jurm pani maangna
laut kar aajao waapas ho kahan ammu
<<DIVIDER>>
hoo khadi qaime ke dar par khaali kooza thaam kar
pyaas ki shiddat nahi seh paungi mai lamha bhar
phat'ta hai gham se jigar aur khushk hai mera gala
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad ab aate hai mujhko guzre jo yasrab mein din
saamne rakhte thay pani kuch zuban se bole bin
lamha bhar bhi pyaas ka ehsaas na hone diya
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gaya maloom ab to pyaas kehte hai kise
kya khabar thi din ye mujhko bhi padenge dekhne
char saala umr mein ye dard hai sehna pada
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
paas aate thay hamesha meri ek aawaz par
dekh kar hairaan hoo ab badle se andaaz par
kyun nahi aate palat kar kya hui mujhse khata
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kho na jaaye pyaas ki in wadiyon mein hum kahin
lag raha hai ab banegi shaam tak turbat yahin
daalne turbat pe pani aaoge kya ab chacha
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr rakhe kis tarha se bhai bhi cheh maah ka
pani maange kis tahra se bhai bhi cheh maah ka
chand lamhon mein hai lagta aayegi usko qaza
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bujha'ungi chacha jaan apne hi ashkon se pyaas
hai dua ke jald aao khairiyat se mere paas
ab kabhi na pyaas ka shikwa karungi ba-khuda
laut kar aajao wapas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap hote to munaver hoti meri kayenaat
aap ke bin ho gayi hai ab andheri kayenaat
likh ke ye nauha najaf bhi karta hai aah o buka
laut kar aajao wapas...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Matame husain zindabad
items.body:
humse poochte ho karte ho matam kyun
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh mahine ka asghar bhi maara gaya
saal athara akbar bhi maara gaya
haye hurre dilawar bhi maara gaya
aur ghazi biradar bhi maara gaya
kitne haathon se laashe uthaye hussain
hum ko matam hi karna sikhaye hussain
matame hussain zindabad
parchame hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ne aab khatra bhi paaya nahi
sar ko sajde se hargiz hataya nahi
shikwa allah ka lab pe laaya nahi
peeche qadmon ko apne hataya nahi
shaan hyder ki kaise dikhaye hussain
hum ko matam hi karna sikhaye hussain
matame hussain zindabad
parchame hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
waada nana ka poora wafa hogaya
ghar ka ghar raahe haq mein fida hogaya
sar bhi mazloom tan se juda hogaya
dhoom matam ki haye ye kya hogaya
teri mayyat pe ghode chalaye hussain
hum ko matam hi karna sikhaye hussain
matame hussain zindabad
parchame hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke saare qaime jalaye gaye
haye saydaniya sab sataye gaye
dar badar raaston pe phiraye gaye
sab ke sab haye zindan basaye gaye
khandan apna poora lutaye hussain
hum ko matam hi karna sikhaye hussain
matame hussain zindabad
parchame hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
dehr mein aaj tak bhi hai matam hussain
mit nahi sakta ye aap ka gham hussain
rote rote hi mar jayenge hum hussain
hum uthate hai ab tak bhi parcham hussain
aap islam ko hai bachaye hussain
hum ko matam hi karna sikhaye hussain
matame hussain zindabad
parchame hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
dard angayz sheh ki shahadat hui
zere khanjar tumhe kya aziyat hui
qatl hokar rahe kya musibat hui
jaan allah ki khaatir amaanat hui
sar ko naize pe tere chadaye hussain
hum ko matam hi karna sikhaye hussain
matame hussain zindabad
parchame hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak tabrez tu apne sar par udha
karbala mein mohamed ka ghar hai tabaah
lut gaya haye irfan aale aba
reh gaya naam karbal mein allah ka
khatra e aab peene na paye hussain
hum ko matam hi karna sikhaye hussain
matame hussain zindabad
parchame hussain zindabad
items.author: Shams Tabrez

items.title: Mere ghazi
items.body:
shabbir ke maqsad ko bachalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang ko taalo mere ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
maana ke bohat josh pe toofan e sitam hai
baazu ye salamat hai to kis baat ka gham hai
abbas tumhe chadar e zainab ki qasam hai
qaimon ko tarayi se hatalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ghaiz ke sholon se pighal jayega suraj
tum taygh uthaloge to jal jayega suraj
haan maut ki aagosh mein dhal jayega suraj
ubhre huwe ghusse ko dabalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-deeno ke qaimon ko gade rehne do bhai
aajao idhar unko khade rehne do bhai
wo zid pe ade hai to ade rehne do bhai
tum behre khuda khud ko sambhalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum baazu e shabbir ho haalaat ko samjho
ay bhai zara behno ke jazbaat ko samjho
mai maa ki jagah hoon meri baat ko samjho
filhaal bhatiji ko manalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
paighambar e inkar dua deta hai tumko
ghairat ka khuda daad e wafa deta hai tumko
saqqayi ka ohda bhi sada deta hai tumko
talwaar rakho mashk uthalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke lashkar ke alamdar tumhi ho
hamza ki qasam jafar e tayyar tumhi ho
armaan e dil e hyder e karrar tumhi ho
mashkeeze mein darya ko chupalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
lau dete huwe sholon ko shabnam mein badal do
zau dete zakhmon ko marham mein badal do
siffeen ke toofan ko zam zam mein badal do
ye ghaiz o ghazab zabt mein dhaalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din mere maathe ki shikan tumse kahegi
ehsaas ke sholon ki chubhan tumse kahegi
waada hai bohat jald behen tumse kahegi
haan jang ke armaan nikalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
<<DIVIDER>>
nayyar ke liye waqt gham angez bohat hai
dunya paye aamir sitam aamez bohat hai
haalaat ke suraj ki tapish tez bohat hai
tum hi inhe saaye mein bithalo mere ghazi
kuch dayr abhi jang...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Aap agar aa jaate
items.body:
aaye jab shaam e ghariban mein ali duldul sawar
jalti reti se uthi zehra ki beti bekharar
baap ke khadmon se lipti aur ye rokar kaha
aap agar aa jaate baba aap agar aa jaate baba
cheenta na shimr chadar aap agar aa jaate baba
<<DIVIDER>>
aap agar aa jaate baba ghar nahi lut'ta mera
aap agar aa jaate baba sar pe reh jaati rida
aap agar aa jaate baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnagi aur bekasi se dil sabhi ke choor thay
mai bohat majboor thi darya se qaime door thay
aap agar aa jaate baba khushk na rehte ye saagar
aap agar aa jaate baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ka hangaam tha chalta tha khanjar bhai par
ro rahi thi karbala ki dhoop is tanhaai par
aap agar aa jaate baba qatl na hota baradar
aap agar aa jaate baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekas o majboor hai sehra mein beti aap ki
hogayi tanha bhari dunya mein beti aap ki
aap agar aa jaate baba yun nahi lut'ta bhara ghar
aap agar aa jaate baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
sogaye karbobala ke dasht mein tashna dahan
akbar o abbas o asghar qasim e ibne hassan
aap agar aa jaate baba daagh na sehti ye dil par
aap agar aa jaate baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya bunaya ki sada sun kar sakina dasht mein
dhoondti phirti thi wo baba ka seena dasht mein
aap agar aa jaate baba dekh na paate wo manzar
aap agar aa jaate baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap agar aa jaate to jalte nahi baba qayaam
ap agar aa jaate na mai dekhti ghurbat ki shaam
ap agar aa jaate baba khaak na hoti saron par
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhti thi bano e dilgeer hasrat se mujhe
jis ghadi bali sakina ke gohar cheene gaye
aap agar aa jaate baba kaano se chinte na gohar
aap agar aa jaate baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho sada rehaan o safdar ki sar e karbobala
haa usi ka shor dobara sar e zindan utha
aap agar aa jaate baba ghudkiyan khaati na dukhtar
aap agar aa jaate baba...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ahle haram ka khafla
items.body:
ahle haram ka khafila salaar
abid e bemaar abid e bemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
kis se kahe wo apni musibat
paon mein chaale raasta purkhaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ko pukare kisko sada de
koi nahi hai uska madadgaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye sitam ki kaun si manzil
saaye mein dunya dhoop mein bemaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se pada hai tauq gale mein
saans bhi lena hogaya dushwaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ko nigahein dhoond rahi hai
chaaron taraf hai sirf sitamgaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid hai phupiyan wo bhi khule sar
sar hai jhukaye bekas o laachar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ke liye hai raah mein kaante
jis pe nichawar khuld ke gulzaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon badan ka pee gaye chaale
haathon mein raasha zard hai rukhsaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
thokarein kha kar karta hai sajde
dekha nahi hai aisa giraftaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na wo roye khoon ke aansu
naksh hai dil par shaam ka bazaar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne suroor aaj khoon e jigar se
dil pa likhe hai nauhe ke ash'aar
abid e beemar...
ahle haram ka khafila...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Alamdare lashkare
items.body:
abbas e alamdar wafaon ka khuda hai
hyder ki tamanna hai to zehra ki dua hai
islam ki sheh-rag mein hai khoone dile shabbir
saanson mein rawan parcham e ghazi ki hawa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
alamdare lashkare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
naam abbas hai zehra ki tamanna mai hoo
sher e khaaliq ki duaon ka nateeja mai hoo
hashmi khoon ki jurrat ka asasa mai hoo
pyas pani ki bujhe jis se wo darya mai hoo
mai hoo ghairat ka khuda
mai hoo zehra ki dua
mai alamdare wafa
mai hoo zainab ki rida
saani e shere khuda hoo mai
alamdar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ki dukhtar ne mujhe maanga hai
sayyeda binte payambar ne mujhe maanga hai
karbala ke liye sarwar ne mujhe maanga hai
rab se har sajde mein hyder ne mujhe maanga hai
mai hoo khaaliq ki ata
mai ali ki hoo dua
mai alamdare wafa
mai sakina ka chacha
apni taqleeq mein allah ka shaah-kaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne khadmon mein zamane ko jhuka sakta hoo
karbala mein tumhe khyber mai dikha sakta hoo
apne naize ko mai talwaar bana sakta hoo
sab ko ek waar mein dunya se mita sakta hoo
mai bhi hoo sher e khuda
hashr kardoonga bapa
mai alamdare wafa
maut ki dar se ghata
tum pukaroge khud hydere karaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisme jurrat hai ke roke mera rasta koi
aaj tak saamne mere nahi tehra koi
hoga fin-naar agar saamne aaya koi
aa nahi sakta khareeb e shahe waala koi
mai bhi hoo sher e khuda
quwwate shahe huda
mai alamdare wafa
sab ko kar doonga fanaah
kufr ki raah mein ek aahni dewaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai mita sakta hoo ek lamhe mein tum sab ka nishan
hashmi khoon hai kya tum pe ye kardoonga ayan
hukm doo mai to abhi nehr khud aajaye yahan
izn shabbir agar de to ulat jaaye jahan
mai hoo marzi e khuda
la fata ki hoo dua
mai alamdare wafa
mere khadmon mein jahan
apne maula ki razaon ka talabgaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sakina tera gham zainab e dilgeer ka gham
maa ka gham behno ka gham asghare baysheer ka gham
chadar e zehra ka gham chadar e tatheer ka gham
khoon rulaata hai mujhe hazrate shabbir ka gham
al atash ki ye sada
mashq ka qalb chida
mai alamdare wafa
aankh mein teer e jafa
hai ye zanjeer e alam jisme giraftaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sakina ye tera rona rulaata hai mujhe
pyas mein tera tadapna ye satata hai mujhe
jang karne se mere maula ne roka hai mujhe
hukme shabbir ki zanjeer ne baandha hai mujhe
mai bhi dikhlaata vigha
karta dushman ko fanaa
mai alamdare wafa
tujhpe hoti na jafa
ay sakina bada majboor hoo lachaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yehi noor ali hazrate ghazi ki sada
shaah ke gham mein bichate hai jo farshe aza
nauha o majlis o matam mein jo rehte hai sada
dil mein aabaad jo rakhte hai ghame karbobala
qalbe wo gham ki ziya
baabe haajat ho ata
mai alamdare wafa
mai bhi hoo unka kusha
aise sab logon ka har gaam mein madadgaar hoo mai
alamdare lashkare...
items.author: Noor

items.title: Ay aasman
items.body:
ay aasman ay aasman
tune bhi dekha wo samaan
jab karbala ke dasht mein
thay imtehan par imtehan
ay aasman…
<<DIVIDER>>
hilta tha arshe kibriya
saktay mein thay kul ambiya
jab naujawan ke qalb se
kheynchi zaeefi ne sina
ay aasman…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo waqt nauha bangaya
sadiyon ka lamha ban gaya
jab bewagi ki zarb say
tooti dulhan ki chudiyan
ay aasman…
<<DIVIDER>>
bachi sisakti reh gayi
chehro ko takti reh gayi
jab nehr par maara gaya
ahle haram ka paasban
ay aasman…
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hai sab tharra gaye
moo ko kaleje aa gaye
jab khoon say tar hogayi
baysheer ki sookhi zaban
ay aasman…
<<DIVIDER>>
ya bekasi maqtal mein thi
y alaash thi mazloom ki
jab paemaali ke liye
hone lagi tayyariyan
ay aasman…
<<DIVIDER>>
taskeen e shar hoti rahi
insaniyat roti rahi
jab gardane bemaar mein
dekha gaya tauq e garan
ay aasman…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid sare karbobala
juz bebasi koi na tha
jab khoon se likhi gayi
tashna labon ki daastan
ay aasman…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Ay shimr rehm kar
items.body:
kis tarha se bayaan ho ghurbat hussain ki
chalne lagi jo halq pe mazloom ke churi
ek chaar saala bachi thi maidan mein khadi
sehme huwe qadam se suye shimr wo badi
kehti thi shimr dilbare zehra ko maar ke
tujhko milega kya mere baba ko maar ke
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein sakina kehti thi haathon ko jod ke
ay shimr rehm kar mere baba ko chod de
<<DIVIDER>>
daulat ke waaste na inhe maar thehr ja
mat maar tu galay pe inhe waar thehr ja
mai de rahi hoo khud tujhe gohar utaar ke
ay shimr rehm kar mere...
ran mein sakina kehti thi..
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad yehi wajha hai jo kat’ta nahi gala
dadi ne khud galay pe gala hai rakha hua
lipti hui hai fatema baba hussain se
ay shimr rehm kar mere...
ran mein sakina kehti thi..
<<DIVIDER>>
pani mai baba jaan ko pila loo to zibha kar
godhi mein unke sar ko utha loo to zibah kar
laashe utha utha ke hai baba thake huwe
ay shimr rehm kar mere...
ran mein sakina kehti thi..
<<DIVIDER>>
zaanu hata de baba ke seene se is ghadhi
lene de chain se inhe saansein ye aakhri
bas baba jaane waale hai dunya ko chod ke
ay shimr rehm kar mere...
ran mein sakina kehti thi..
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr ki tarha se ab bhi tera intezar hai
un ki nazar mein tere liye ab bhi pyar hai
ab bhi muaaf kar denge ay shimr wo tujhe
ay shimr rehm kar mere...
ran mein sakina kehti thi..
<<DIVIDER>>
daadi pakad ke kyun tu tamache lagata hai
zehra ki betiyon ke dilon ko dukhata hai
kyun maarta hai bhai ko behno ke saamne
ay shimr rehm kar mere...
ran mein sakina kehti thi..
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad uske saamne kat'ta raha gala
karti rahi wo minnatein khanjar nahi ruka
sarwar bhi apni beti ki ghurbat pe rote thay
ay shimr rehm kar mere...
ran mein sakina kehti thi..
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Baba mai lut gayi
items.body:
haye shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ki wo shaam qayamat ka wo samaan
aaye najaf se milne ali jis ghadi wahan
beti lipat ke baap se karti thi ye fughan
athara bhaiyon ki behen ab nahi rahi
baba badal do naam mai zainab nahi rahi
baba mai lut gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala basa ke ye zainab ne di sada
baba mai lut gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
nazrein mila na payenge ek doosre se hum
ay mere baba jaan tumhe abbas ki qasam
aankhein na kholna mere sar par nahi rida
baba mai lut gayi
karbobala basa ke ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle ke jaisi aap ki beti nahi rahi
pehchan'ne mein aap ko kuch dayr yun lagi
beenayi bhi gayi meri akbar bhi chal basa
baba mai lut gayi
karbobala basa ke ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar rakh ke zakhmi seene pe royi wo tishnakaam
akbar ne kar diya mere parde ka intezaam
chehre pe khoon hai mere kadiyal jawan ka
baba mai lut gayi
karbobala basa ke ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujdi hai ek roz mein amma ki kayenat
kitne janaze uthe hai is ghar mein ek saath
bikhri hui hai dasht mein tasveer e fatema
baba mai lut gayi
karbobala basa ke ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahzadiyon ki tarha se rakha tha aap ne
jaate huwe hussain ko saumpa tha aap ne
wo dekhiye sina pe hai sar mere bhai ka
baba mai lut gayi
karbobala basa ke ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba najaf khareeb hai har shaam aaungi
mai qabr par hussain ki shamme jalaungi
tum saath apne le chalo ab kaun hai mera
baba mai lut gayi
karbobala basa ke ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehte kehte mir takallum wo ro padi
abid ko jalte qaimon se laayi hoon mai abhi
beton ka imtehan bhi beti ne de diya
baba mai lut gayi
karbobala basa ke ye...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Batlao mar gayi
items.body:
ye kaun hai jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ke sar ko dekh ke naize ki nok par
har koi poochta tha ye abid ko rok kar
batlao mar gayi hai ya zinda hai iski maa
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon ko apne band kiye hai ye zee hasham
bazaar mein jo aaye hai beparda kuch haram
kya iski rishtedar hai ye saari bibiyan
batlao mar gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-rehm isko maarne waala tha kis qadar
sookhi hui galay ki ragein hai jo is qadar
marne se pehle kab se ye pyasa tha naujawan
batlao mar gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar ye gham ka dekh ke dil khoon rota hai
kuch yaad kar rahi hai ye mehsoos hota hai
ek bibi isko takti hai hoti hai jab azaan
batlao mar gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya dushmani kisi ki thi aise haseen se
thaame jigar zameen pe aaya tha zeen se
sunte hai iske seene mein todi gayi sina
batlao mar gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se naiza zulm ka nikla hai kis tarha
dam naujawan ne khaak pe toda hai kis tarha
maa ne na iski dekha ho ghurbat ke ye samaan
batlao mar gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
phoolon ka sehra sar pe sajane ki umr thi
ye to jawan ko dulha banane ki umr thi
jaana kaha tha maut usay le gayi kahan
batlao mar gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai gard mein ghareeb ke gaysu atay huwe
talwaron se sitam ki hai abroo kate huwe
kya zulm is pe toota hai chehre se hai ayan
batlao mar gayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ko dekha aur kabhi akbar pe ki nazar
khamosh thay wo mir takallum jhukaye sar
sajjad us sawaal pe rote thay shadman
batlao mar gayi...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Binte zehra ka aasra
items.body:
aake sarwar ye bain karte hai
haye zainab nahi raha ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
binte zehra ka aasra ghazi
hua karbal may jab juda ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi binte hussain roti hai
qaid se aake tu chuda ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar se zainab ki gir gayi chadar
jis ghadi ran ko tu chala ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar se shimr yun maare
jaanta hai nahi raha ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri chadar khuda ka parda hai
meri chadar ki tu baqa ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise jaungi shaam aur kufa
mujhko mehmil may tu bitha ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
pooche ummul baneen zainab se
kis tarha zeen se gira ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh jagah se hussain chun aaye
phir bhi poora na mil saka ghazi
binte zehra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime jalte rahe bulaati rahi
shimr se aake tu bacha ghazi
binte zehra ka...

items.title: Ek musafir watan
items.body:
shor e matam hai aah o buka hai
ya elaahi ye kya maajera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek musafir watan se chala hai
shehr bhar kis liye ro raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj o hasrat jo hadh se siwa hai
ek mareeza ko ghash aagaya hai
gham ki maari musibat zada hai
chota bhai abhi chut gaya hai
ek musafir watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
uff ye sannata bojhal faza hai
rehnuma e sadaqat chala hai
aage aage rawan khaafila hai
peeche peeche koi ro raha hai
ek musafir watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne ham rahiyon se ye poocha
bolo kya naam hai is jagah ka
doston ke labon par ye aaya
karbala karbala karbala hai
ek musafir watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaye saaye hawa beh rahi hai
ek behen bhai se keh rahi hai
kaun dukhiyari gham seh rahi hai
dekhna bhai kis ki sada hai
ek musafir watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun qayamat bapa ho rahi hai
kya hua hai jo jaan kho rahi hai
karb se aise maa ro rahi hai
jaise baccha abhi mar gaya hai
ek musafir watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke shaahe umam ne bataya
tum ne ab bhi na pehchana lehja
ye hai maadar hamari azeeza
jin ki awaaz hi marsiya hai
ek musafir watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
raasta saara ro kar guzara
lab pe faryad thi haye baba
kis liye zaalimon ne sataya
mere bacche ki taqseer kya hai
ek musafir watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad kije wo gham naak manzar
shimr e bad bakht kheenche hai khanjar
dekhiye qatl hote hai sarwar
godh mein maa ne sar rakh liya hai
ek musafir watan...

items.title: Ghareebe zehra
items.body:
safar tamaam hua dekh chuka karbobala
alvida kehne jo maula ke haram mein pahuncha
aankh se aansu bahe dil mein udaasi chaayi
yaad jab syed e sajjad ki rukhsat aayi
haye wo dasht e bala be-kafan tha laasha
apne haathon mein kafan dekh ke maine ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb e zahra shaheed e karbobala
kahan hamara safar kahan hamara safar
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne jab pehla qadam karbobala mein rakha
tum ne zawwaron ka is tarah se ehsaas kiya
rakh diya haath azadaron ke dil par haye
hum ne rona bhi agar chaaha to rone na diya
haa magar tumko yahan jab bulaaya mehmaan
mil ke nau laakh ne maqtal mein rula kar maara
ghareeb e zahra...
kahan hamara safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj rauze se bahot door hai darya maula
haa magar phir bhi in aankhon ne ye dekha maula
har qadam raah mein pani ki sabeelein to mili
karbala mein na mila koi bhi pyasa maula
teen din tak tum pe band pani rakh ke
kar diya qatl isi shehr mein bhooka pyasa
ghareeb e zahra...
kahan hamara safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula hum bhool nahi payenge zainab ki thakan
aap ki tarha mere saath bhi aayi hai behan
wo bhi ghar laut ke jayegi yahan se lekin
sar pe chadar bhi hai haathon mein nahi koi rasan
aur tumhari wo behan ho ke paaband e rasan
shaam ruqsat hui baalon se chupa kar chehra
ghareeb e zahra...
kahan hamara safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap se door kahan rehti hai koi beti
jab meri beti mere seene se aakar lipti
koi na aaya usay mujhse chudaane ke liye
haa magar aap ki wo chaar baras ki pyasi
dasht mein roti hui aap se jab lipti
shimr ne khaynch ke baalon se tamacha maara
ghareeb e zahra...
kahan hamara safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din rauza e abbas pe hum baithe thay
chalte chalte wahan ek shakhs gira jab aa ke
khud wo uth sakta tha baazu thay salamat phir bhi
jis ne dekha wo chala aaya sahara dene
aur gire yun ghazi hua chehra zakhmi
apne haathon ka sahara bhi nahi tha maula
ghareeb e zahra...
kahan hamara safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil yahin chod diya laut ke jaata hoo watan
karne aaya hoo salaam aakhri ay shaah e zaman
na andhera hai na mujh par hai museebat koi
tauq gardan mein na zanjeer mein jakda hai badan
aur wo abid ka safar ek qaidi ban kar
sar jhukaye huwe laashe se tumhare guzra
ghareeb e zahra...
kahan hamara safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gaya mesum o zeeshan mai rukhsat ho kar
na hi kaanto ki chubhan na koi sar naize par
taaziyane bhi kisi ne nahi maare mujhko
aag na khaulta pani na baraste pathar
jitna chaaha roya kab kisi ne maara
raah mein apna safar dekh ke mai kehta raha
ghareeb e zahra...
kahan hamara safar...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Har ek tukde se
items.body:
har ek tukde se tukda mila rahe hai hussain
hassan ka laal dobara bana rahe hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan ke laashe se jaise nikaala teeron ko
ab aise laash ke tukde utha rahe hai hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ke maathe pe sehra saja ke bheja tha
ab uske tukdon se gathri bana rahe hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun maa hai jo ghash se sambhal nahi paati
ye kis ke laal ko qaime mein laa rahe hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen se tukde uthaate nahi hai qasim ke
ye apne sabr ko khud aazma rahe hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi ye girya nahi laash par bhatije ke
ghareeb hone ka nauha suna rahe hai hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
<<DIVIDER>>
bata rahe hai ke maara gaya hai laal tera
magar janaze ko maa se chupa rahe hai hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin se seena kahin se badan kahin se haath
kahin se paaon ke tukde utha rahe hai hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahadat e ali akbar se pehle noor ali
hassan ke laal pe aansu baha rahe hai hussain
har ek tukde se tukda...
items.author: Noor Ali

items.title: Hussain ka gham
items.body:
labbaik ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ka gham manane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
suno suno ay zamane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi to hai intezar e mehdi
sada e halmin ka hai ye matlab
wafa e abbas mein bano tum
mahafizaan e mazaar e zainab
wafa ka parcham uthane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
azeem hurr tha ke jisne aakhir
hussain par jaan apni di hai
kabhi ye socha hai zaakiron ne
kabhi ye awaaz bhi suni hai
ke zikr hurr ka sunane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo khyber e waqt mein ladoge
to karbala se na hogi doori
jahan bhi mazloom pis rahe hai
wahan pe imdaad hai zaroori
ali ke naare lagaane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi to maqsood e karbala hai
ke imtehan e wafa yehi hai
hai mil chuke tum ko sab wasayil
magar iraade mein kuch kami hai
ziyaraton pe na jaane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ibne zehra pe jaan denge
unhi ke honge bade muqaddar
zohair qain aayenge yaqeenan
kaha hai zauja ne aage bad kar
chalo chalo ay zamane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo al ajal ki sada lagaye
wo apna kirdaar bhi dikhaye
imam e mehdi ke hai jo nasir
habeeb ibn e mazahir aaye
ke dosti ko nibhane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi to paigham e karbala hai
hai nusraton ka sawaal laazim
ke nasiron ke liye raha hai
hamesha rizq e halaal laazim
halaal rozi kamane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
namaz ko chod dene waalon
imam ka saamna karoge
amal ke baare mein kya kahoge
hussain ko kya jawab doge
ghina ki mehfil sajane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghira hua hai jo lashkaron mein
imam e dauran bula raha hai
suna hai jab se ye isteghasa
sagheer jhoole se gir gaya hai
ke teer par muskurane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ma'ashre mein madad karo tum
yateem mazloom mar raha hai
qamar baseerat ki aankh kholo
yahin kahin par hi karbala hai
juloos o majlis mein jaane waalon
hussain tum ko bula rahe hai
hussain ka gham...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Jaane kyun naizon
items.body:
jalte jhoole ki raakh pe baithi
maa ki nazrein hai naize waalon par
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kyun naizon se ek sar talaash karte hai
wo maa ke saamne asghar talaash karte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sheerkhwar ka khyber shikan ka sar to nahi
jise yazeed ke lashkar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
layeen naize se asghar talaash kar ke bhi
zibha ke waaste khanjar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo naize jin pe hai asghar tera lahoo taaza
wo ab rabab ki chaadar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina kaise jhulaati thi jhoola e asghar
hussain ro ke wo manzar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo muskurane ka lete hai is tarha badla
wo is ki laash ko has kar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo aise maar rahe hai zameen par naize
ke jaise sar nahi patthar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chupa liya na ho teeron ke darmiyan kahin
wo sheh ke seene ke upar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
batool nauhe pe mujhko wo ajr dengi raza
jise tamaam sukhanwar talaash karte hai
jaane kyun naizon se...
items.author: Nadeem Raza

items.title: Kar rahi thi sakina
items.body:
kar rahi thi sakina fughan
kyun nahi aaye ay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan se chin gayi baaliyan
kyun nahi aaye ay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
seh ke shaam e ghariban ki uftaad ko
lab hilaye phupi ne jo fariyad ko
unke baba chale aaye imadad ko
koi sunta nahi meri rudaad ko
kar rahi hoon mai kab se fughan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ghurbat mein saare sahare gaye
pusht par taziyane bhi maare gaye
chadrein chin gayi goshware gaye
al-madad al-madad hum pukare gaye
goonjti reh gayi siskiyan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
seh liya ammu jaise fidayi ka gham
asghare bezaban jaise bhai ka gham
jaan lelega daaghe judaai ka gham
aur sitam dar sitam beridayi ka gham
haye baandhi gayi reesma
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin se dhaaras thi mujhko wo saare gaye
aur phupi jaan ke dono dulaare gaye
saare hamdard maqtal mein maare gaye
is aziyat se gohar utaare gaye
khoon hai kaano se ab tak rawan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahe hum ye kya kya jafa hogayi
jo jafa hogayi bekhata hogayi
hadh ye hai zulm ki inteha hogayi
hai aale nabi berida hogayi
durre khaata raha natawan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
phande rassi ke gardan mein kaste rahe
phusht par taziyane baraste rahe
dekh kar hum ko kuffaar haste rahe
aah karne ko bhi hum taraste rahe
har qadam thi nayi sakhtiyan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunsa hai sitam jo na dhaaya gaya
hum ko kaanto pe paidal chala gaya
berida karke dar dar phiraya gaya
aur bazaar mein hum ko laaya gaya
dil se uth'ta hai gham ka dhuaan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
humko kitna sataya gaya be-sabab
haye darbar mein hum ko ghere thay sab
dha rahe thay sitamgaar ye bhi ghazab
kar rahe thay kaneezi mein mujhko talab
haye gham se nikalti thi jaan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko bazaar se bhi guzara gaya
saath bemaar e gham besahara gaya
haye be-maut yun humko maara gaya
naam lekar phupi ka pukara gaya
kya qayamat ka tha wo samaan
kyun nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni aagosh mein leke baba ka sar
waqte rehlat sakina hui nauhagar
aamir o fakhri bole shahe behrobar
tha mai hamraah naize pe laqte jigar
ab na ro kar karo ye bayan
kyun nahi aaye...
items.author: Fakhri Meerthi

items.title: Kohram hai barpa
items.body:
ummul baneen roti hai sar peet peet kar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ke baba pe chala zulm ka khanjar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
<<DIVIDER>>
jibreel ye sar peet ke karte hai manadi
maara gaya mabood ke sajde mein namazi
talwaar se zakhmi hua islam ka rehbar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
ummul baneen roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ne pehle taygh zeher mein bujhayi hai
phir sher e kirdigaar ke sar pe lagayi hai
apne lahoo mein doob gaye saaqi e kausar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
ummul baneen roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zainab o kulsoom ke honton pe ye naale
ay paalne waale mere baba ko bachale
abbas bohat rote hai is bain ko sun kar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
ummul baneen roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peet ke karte hai buka shabbar o shabbir
kulsoom se ye kehti hai jab zainab e dilgeer
ab daagh yateemi ka dikhayega muqaddar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
ummul baneen roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hashr ka manzar hai qayamt ki ghadi hai
aakar ke yateemi dar e shabbar pe khadi hai
bin baap ke ho jayenge zehra ke gule tar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
ummul baneen roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aalam mein ye pur dard sada goonj rahi hai
dunya se wo jaata hai jo waliyon ka wali hai
waiz hai azadaron ki aankhon mein samandar
kohram hai barpa kohram hai barpa
ummul baneen roti hai...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Laut ke aaja mere
items.body:
deti thi sughra ye duhaai
laut ke aaja mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
tum mujhe le jaoge ye waada kiya tha
kyun mujhe le jaane nahi aaye hua kya
haye bohat dayr lagayi
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
raasta takti hui mar jayegi behna
tere bina ab nahi jee payegi behna
seh nahi sakti mai judaai
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baithi hui dar pe kabhi karti ye nauha
haye mera bhai abhi tak nahi aaya
koi khabar bhi nahi aayi
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phirta hai in aankhon mein ab tak tera chehra
ek bhi pal aisa nahi guzra hai bhaiya
jab ke teri yaad na aayi
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
main to har ek waqt tere gham mein hoo roti
mujh ko mere bhai khabar hi nahi hoti
kab huwa din raat kab aayi
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hua aisa mujhe chod gaya tu
rukte nahi bhai meri aankhon se aansu
aisi ghata dard ki chaayi
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jeene ki ab koi mujhe aas nahi hai
koi bhi ay bhai mere paas nahi hai
mujhpe taras khaa mere bhai
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gohar e dilgeer yehi lab pe tha nauha
haye yehi kehte huwe mar gayi sughra
laut ke aaja mere bhai
laut ke aaja mere bhai...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Mai zainab hoo
items.body:
shaam haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zainab hoon aseer e shaam nana
bacha ke laayi hoon islam nana
<<DIVIDER>>
main apne baap ki zeenat thi lekin
hai ab ummul masayib naam nana
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin patthar kahin par taaziyane
sitam sehti rahi har gaam nana
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha baaghi hussain ibne ali ko
diya ummat ne ye inaam nana
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare sar se bhi hizyaan waala
mita ke aayi hoon ilzaam nana
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya jab hyderi lehje mein khutba
larazta tha faqeer e shaam nana
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachayi laaj jis ne ambiya ki
mai kar ke aayi hoon wo kaam nana
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
na aankhon se lahoo sajjad rota
na jaate hum jo kufa shaam nana
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha jawad zainab ne rahega
tumhara hashr tak paigham nana
mai zainab hoon...
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Matame hussain
items.body:
ba yaad e sibte nabi jo bahaye jaate hai
un aansuon se muqaddar banaye jaate hai
yaqeen na ho to wahin karbal mein chal kar dekh
kaise tamaam se jangal basaye jaate hai
udoo e aal ko zid hai ke zikre aal na ho
kahin ye naam bhi dil se bhulaye jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk na paaya kabhi ruk na payega ye gham tera
arsh se farsh tak farsh se arsh tak hai sada
matam tera hai maujiza matam tera
<<DIVIDER>>
hai marze la dawa ki dawa matame hussain
mushkil mein behtereen dua matame hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
marta hai jism rooh mein hoti hai zindagi
rooh ki hai behtereen ghiza matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh dekh asr e shaheedan se aaj tak
karte rahe hai arz o samaa matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ehd hai wafa hai ta'alluk hai baqt hai
mesaak se hi hum ne chuna matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
is matame hussain ki waaris butool hai
wirse mein jis ne hum ko diya matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa loriyon mein nauhe sunaati rahi hamein
hum ne to apni maa se liya matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
pooca khuda ne laaye ho zaad e nijaat kya
maine basad yaqeen kaha matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aashiqane aale mohamed na chodna
ishq e ali namaze khuda matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisko ye gham mila hai wohi khush naseeb hai
farshe aza mein darse wila matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ki sehar se ghareebon ki shaam tak
karti hai soghwaar fiza matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jiski qabooliyat mein na shak hai na dayr hai
mere har ek amal se bhala matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte bala ki rayt pe bhai tha bekafan
karti rahi behan ki rida matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sidhra se jibraeel ne mujhko ye di khabar
shaukat raza khuda ki raza matame hussain
hai marze la dawa ki...
items.author: Shaukat Raza Shaukat

items.title: Mere halaat suno
items.body:
mere haalaat suno mere jazbaat suno
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt nazar sar ki padhi apne badan par
dekha ke saja zakhmon se hai wo tane athar
na gor mayassar na kafan ke liye chaadar
goya hua tab apne badan se sar e sarwar
kya haal mere baad hua kuch to bata de
kya guzri badan tujhpe wo ehwaal suna de
<<DIVIDER>>
mere haalaat suno mere jazbaat suno
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaah badan par hua ek larza sa taari
jo zakhm thay sab phat gaye khoon hogaya jaari
kehne laga wo sar se ye ba girya o zaari
ay sar bani purdard hai taqdeer hamari
tu naize pe quran suna ta jo chala tha
ghodon ne mujhe dasht mein paamal kiya tha
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui reti ne mujhe dhaampna chaaha
mujh par pare jibreel bhi karne laga saaya
suraj ne tamazat ko bahot apni ghataya
par nana ki ummat ne kafan bhi na udhaya
mai khaak pe jalta raha roti rahi zehra
sadqe mere is haal pe hoti rahi zehra
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron pe muallaq tha kahan mai tha zameen par
ghurbat pe meri tadpa bahot laasha e akbar
phir baad mein wo teer huwe seene se baahar
acha hua us waqt na thi seene pe dukhtar
sab teer guzar jaate sakina ke badan se
gir jaata falak farsh pe is ranj o mahan se
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab khaafila ruqsat hua mai reh gaya tanha
phir jashne safar dasht mein karne lage aada
abbas ka laasha jo pada tha labe darya
wo bhi meri mazloomi pe khud nauha kuna tha
is jism pe ay farqe jafa baade qaza thi
ay sar tu bata shaam ki kya aab o hawa thi
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sunke sar e shaah se khoon hogaya jaari
lab hilne lage dasht mein larza hua taari
sar bola na sun payega roodad hamari
wo raahe musibat badi mushkil se guzari
manzar wo alam naak meri aankhon ne dekhe
dushman ko bhi dikhlaye na allah wo lamhe
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke khule sar pe baraste rahe patthar
thi zad pe tamachon ke sakina meri dukhtar
sajjad pe durron ki thi barsaat barabar
badta tha sitam aur jo mai kehta tha ro kar
ay zaalimon dekho meri bacchi ko na maaro
kuch dayr ko sajjad ka ye tauq utaaro
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakha gaya jis waqt mujhe tashte tala mein
sar nange haram aaye thay darbare jafa mein
kuffaar ki sab aurtein baithi thi rida mein
beparda behen meri thi darbare bala mein
dandaan pe chadi maar ke zaalim ye pukara
awaaz do kyu aata nahi sher khuda ka
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam tod'te maine to sakina ko hai dekha
zindan mein marqad meri bacchi ka bana tha
kuch ghusl o kafan bhi nahi paaya tha uska
chipka jo badan se to utarta na tha kurta
aankhon mein meri ye jo lahoo dekh raha hai
ye haal sakina ke janaze pa hua hai
mere haalaat suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye guftugu sar aur badan mein jo hui thi
karbal ki zameen aur fiza kaamp rahi thi
roodad e sitam jism pe aur sar pe likhi thi
godhi mein liye sar jo khadi binte ali thi
ay shams wo laashe jo sar e dasht padhe thay
aamir wo gham o ranj se sab kaamp rahe thay
mere haalaat suno...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Noha kuna zainabe
items.body:
nauha kuna hai zainabe muztar ali ke baad
kohraam hai machaa hua ghar ghar ali ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
mehraab ghamzada hai namazi kidhar gaya
veraan hai rasool ka mimbar ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar ubhar ke aa gaya bazaar e shaam ka
zainab ke sar se jab giri chadar ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shehzaadi ban ke aayi thi kufe mein kal yehi
dar dar phiri hai zainabe muztar ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sar tha bosa gaahe ali o mohamadi
naize pe chad gaya hai wohi sar ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch khoon e murtaza ki hai kuch karbala ki hai
surkhi jo chaa gayi hai falak par ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke kufa waalon se kehte thay ye ali
zainab ko koi maare na pathar ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar sa naunehaal bhi khoon mein naha gaya
ujda hai is tarha se bhara ghar ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzra hai ye bhi saaneha is ghar pe ay zafar
zehra ki betiyan hai khule sar ali ke baad
nauha kuna hai...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Aap jab se huwe
items.body:
ya rasool allah
apni tanhaai mein zehra yaad karti hai tumhe
<<DIVIDER>>
aap jab se huwe juda baba
fatema ka hai bus khuda baba
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle amma ko khoya ab tumko
paas zahra ke kya bacha baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad guzre din aise
fatema aur nahi jafa baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
lakdiyan aag le ke aaya koi
aur jalaya tha dar mera baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta aap ka diya maine
phir bhi zaalim nahi ruka baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke gham mein rona chaaha agar
mujhko rone nahi diya baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
har masayab ki inteha hai yehi
mera mohsin nahi raha baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e mohsin samajh gayi hoo mai
karbala ki hai ibteda baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
nafs apna kaha jise tumne
uski khaatir kare dua baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to milta nahi jawabe salaam
haal e hyder hai is tarha baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam lewa sahabiyo ne tere
haq bhi cheena yateem ka baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
<<DIVIDER>>
najm o rehan par bhi kar do karam
hai ye zahra ki ilteja baba
aap jab se huwe juda...
items.author: Najam Azmi

items.title: Abbas ka parcham
items.body:
abbas ka parcham mujhe jis ja nazar aaya
mashkeeza wahin dukhtare sheh ka nazar aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se jigar saaqiye kausar ne sambhala
jab tashna dahan unka khabeela nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya mein usay milgayi jannat ki basharat
gham mein jo shahe deen ke rota nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
sairaab kiya saaqiye kausar ke pisar ne
jab lashkare hurr dasht mein pyasa nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota hai jahan matame farzande payambar
ghazi ka alam bhi wahin uncha nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya guzri na jaane dil e maadar pe elaahi
jab khoon mein tar bete ka laasha nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazron mein wohi phir gayi tasveere sakina
ghazi ko jo behta hua darya nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ki tareekh mein chauda sau sadi se
khanjar ke talay ek hi sajda nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan pe laga teer magar daste pidar par
hasta hua shabbir ka pyara nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai khaleel aaj mili khaab ki tabeer
sehra mein jo shabbir ka laasha nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se meri ashk chalakne lage mazhar
jab jab bhi mujhe pani ka kooza nazar aaya
abbas ka parcham...
items.author: Mazher Abedi

items.title: Ahle haram may hai
items.body:
ahle haram mein hai rone ki dhoom
wawaila
haye maara gaya sayyed mazloom
wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
lut'ta hai ghar jalti hai qanate
rote hai sab bache masoom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
<<DIVIDER>>
desh madina kaahe choda
zahra bhayo ghamnaak
bairi satave ban ma bulawe
bewa udawe khaak
sar se ridayein lete hai wawaila
taane sitamgar dete hai wawaila
koi nahi hai sar par waaris
kisko pukare ye mazloom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek chadarwa deth na koi
sharm bhari sharmeine
chupke chupke rowat rowat
haath kadi bandhwaye
sehti hai kulsoom aah mehan wawaila
baazu e zainab aur rasan wawaila
betiyan zehra aur ali ki
aaj ye kaisa hai maqsoom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
<<DIVIDER>>
soye zameen par saare baraati
byahu na aayo raas
pagdi kahat hai qasim dulha
todi hamari aas
qaid huwi ek shab ki dulhan wawaila
lut gaya kangna baandhi rasan wawaila
roti hai zainab khaak uda kar
dekhti hai umme kulsoom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal ban ma loot machi hai
bindri kare faryaad
soye sab pardes ma musafir
desh bhayo barbaad
bachon ko koi roti hai wawaila
bewa koi jaan khoti hai wawaila
kehti hai bano asghar jaani
chida tera nazuk halqoom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur dukhawe dukhte dil ko
taras na koi khaaye
dukh ma satave qaidi banave
laakh dukhi chillaye
tauq pinaya abid ko wawaila
kehte hai isko chain na do wawaila
tan mein hai tap aur bediyan bhaari
kaisi bala mein hai mazloom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi na aawe koi na pooche
koi na deve daad
man mein jaisu aave machave
zulm kare jallad
sab ko bithaya ooton par wawaila
di na kisi ko ek chadar wawaila
shaam ko mazloom aah chala hai
leke haram ko lashkare shoom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan ko sulawe chaati upar
zahra ka dildaar
wan ko litawe dharti bheetar
maare shimr har baar
baliyan cheeni bachi ki wawaila
us par eeza aur bhi di wawaila
kaan phate hai khoon hai behta
tadapte hai bache masoom wawaila
ahle haram mein hai..
haye maara gaya sayyed...
items.author: Fazl Lakhnavi

items.title: Amma mai pyasa
items.body:
farzand e payambar pe wo ashoor ki raat
moo chupane lagi ghabrane lagi nehre furaat
sogaye baat ke shabbir jo maqtal mein hayaat
fatema aagayi sehra mein gham o ranj ke saath
kya sada aati thi us waqt mai bataata hoo
sada shaeedon ki kya thi wohi sunaata hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
amma mai pyasa hoo amma mai pyasa hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
binte rasool pehle gayi jaanibe furaat
kya dekhti hai khaak pe do hai bureeda haath
saahil pe jism jism pe teeron ki kayenaat
dekha jo maa ko aagayi ghazi ke lab pe baat
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein ek jawan jo seena figaar tha
zahra pukari ye to hai tasveer e mustafa
royi tadap ke boli mere laal kya hua
ek aah bhar ke laasha e akbar ne di sada
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
do chote chote laashe bhi be-sar thay khaak par
zahra pukari ye mere zainab ke hai pisar
laashon ke paas baith gayi dil ko thaam kar
kehte thay laashe aun o mohamed ke khoon mein tar
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr john ausaja habeeb e wafa shinaas
in ke khareeb jab gayi zahra falak viqaar
taazeem ke liye uthi har laash baar baar
bola har ek sayyed e waala ka jaanisaar
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek laash qatlgaah mein itni sagheer thi
aamad pe jiski tha bada qatil ko teeragi
boo aa rahi thi aankhon se khoon aur sheer ki
zahra ka dil ulat gaya awaaz jab suni
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaampi zameen e karbobala zalzala utha
jaise hi ek nasheb mein maa ka guzar hua
dekha tha tan hussain ka teeron pe hai rakha
zahra ne haal poocha to laashe ne di sada
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
zahra ne baal khole rida daali laash par
boli tadap ke ay mere mazloom tera sar
kis ne shigaaf kar diya zakhmi kiya jigar
lab tar karungi ashkon se tere kahe agar
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole hussain kya piyun pani ay amma jaan
pyasa shaheed hogaya masoom bezuban
sunta hoo qatlgaah mein pyason ki hichkiyan
amma is alqama ne liya mera imtehan
amma mai pyasa hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan dard naak hai kitna ye waqiya
aale nabi ko dasht mein pani nahi mila
girya kuna hai khuld mein zahra o murtuza
aati hai karbala se mohsin yehi sada
amma mai pyasa hoo...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ay abbas teri zainab
items.body:
dukhiyari zainab ke labon par tha nauha
ay abbas teri zainab beparda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
le jaate hai qaid mujhe kar ke aada
ay abbas teri zainab beparda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
suraj ne jis ko na dekha beparda
usko nange sar dekhegi ab dunya
waqt ye kaisa ghurbat ka mujh par aaya
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu jab se jaa kar darya pe soya hai
saara kunba khoon ke aansu roya hai
jal gaye qaime chin gayi chadar ghar ujda
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke atthara bhai thay wo khwahar
qaidi ban kar khaati hai dar dar thokar
mujhko muqaddar ne kar daala hai tanha
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl huye mere bete aur sab bhai
haye mujhe taqdeer kahan lekar aayi
kaun kare imdaad nahi koi apna
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se suna hai aane waala hai bazaar
dard ki chalti hai mere dil par talwaar
waqt hai teri behna ke mar jaane ka
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mera ghabrata hai kya hoga ab
bazaron se kaise guzregi zainab
chaaron jaanib na-mehram majma hoga
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ek din jis kufe ki shehzadi thi
jaati hoon us shehr mein ban kar ke qaidi
ay ghazi ab phat jayega dil mera
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek jaisi hai maa aur beti ki ghurbat
dono ko darbar talak laayi qismat
farq hai itna parde mein thi maa zahra
ay abbas teri zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay waiz ek hashr ka manzar tha us dam
roke ali ye kehti thi zainab jis dam
sar hai khula baalon se chupaya hai chehra
ay abbas teri zainab...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Ay teen din ke pyase
items.body:
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain ya mazloom
<<DIVIDER>>
ay teen din ke pyase ye tera maujiza hai
tu ne lahoo diya to islam jee utha hai
raah e khuda mein tu ne sab kuch luta diya hai
mehsoos karne waala har dil tadap raha hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ne khoon ugla gardan pe teer kha kar
barchi lagi jo dil par tadpe zameen pe akbar
baazu kata ke soya darya pe sher e hyder
tera baras ka qasim pamaal ho gaya hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ojhal har ek sahara aankhon se ho gaya hai
abbas bhi sidhare akbar bhi kho gaya hai
hadh ye hai bezuban bhi turbat mein so gaya hai
ghar tera lut gaya hai aabaad karbala hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
gurbat mein dushmano ne yun dushmani nikaali
murjha gayi hai tere gulshan ki daali daali
dono jahan mein pahunchi tere lahoo ki laali
sookhe galay se tere itna lahoo baha hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono chale thay ghar se islam ko bachane
bhai behan pa guzri kya kya hai kaun jaane
dono ko mil ke loota is arz e karbala ne
bhai bhi bekafan hai khwahar bhi be-rida hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jannat ki shahzadi hai maadar e girami
sher e khuda padar hai hyder hai naam e naami
bhai hassan hai jiski shah hone ki ghulami
itne laqab ka maalik mazloom e karbala hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haara hai jang tujhse baatil ka har sipahi
tu ne mitayi hurr ki taqdeer ki siyahi
di mazjidon ne bad kar is baat ki gawahi
mazloomiyat se teri islam ki baqa hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
lohay ki bediyon ka beemar boj uthaye
tere hi raaste par apne qadam jameine
allah ki raza mein khamosh sar jhukaye
phoolon pe chalne waala kaanton pe chal raha hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek do pahar mein tujh par kya kya sitam huwe hai
sharminda tere aage dunya ke gham huwe hai
ab tak tere masayeb tehreer kam huwe hai
jo dil pa tere guzri wo kaun likh saka hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
masroof e gham hai kab se ye kaayenat saari
kaise suroor kam ho is dil ki bekharari
har zakhm se abhi tak us ke lahoo hai jaari
sadiyan guzar gayi hai marham nahi mila hai
ya hussain ya hussain...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Baba mai teri zainab
items.body:
haye ali haye haye zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se jab hyder e safdar ka janaza utha
sun ke hasnain bhi rone lage zainab ki sada
baba mere baba mai teri zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri baar kaleje se lagao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
tod kar bande kafan mujhko bulao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
kya gawara hai tumhe sar se hataun chadar
bolo kyun chup ho padar
mujhse baatein karo yun moo na chupao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhala kaise judaai ka uthaungi ye gham
aap ko maa ki qasam
doosri baar yateemi se bachao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm tha aap ka zainab se chupa kar rakhna
kuch na isay kehna
ab to jaate huwe wo zakhm dikhao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun jannat ke manga kar mujhe ab dega libaas
eid bhi aagayi paas
ab mai zid kis se karungi ye batao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne amma ki shahadat pe tasalli di thi
abhi zinda hai ali
ab mujhe kaun sambhalega batao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha milne ke liye tum se kabhi aa na sake
qabr par jaa na sake
is qadar door to basti na basao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad bhi is tarha wafadaar rahe
sang baari na kare
kufiyon se zara kehte huwe jao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ko is ne takallum na di awaaz kabhi
sirf ashoor ko di
mai hoon muhskil mein najaf chod ke aao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Binte zehra ne
items.body:
binte zehra ne bhare ghar ka ujadna dekha
apne pyaron ka tahe taygh tadapna dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
ay hussain aap ki himmat pa zameen kaamp gayi
apne haathon pa jab asghar ka tadapna dekha
binte zehra ne bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan hi dedi alamdar ne pani ke liye
pyaas se jab ke sakina ka bhilakna dekha
binte zehra ne bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kya waqt tha kin aankhon se laila tum ne
naujawan bete ka dunya se guzarna dekha
binte zehra ne bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon bahaate huwe aankhon se har ek zarre mein
fatema aap ki aulaad ka lutna dekha
binte zehra ne bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
thaam kar dil dar e qaima se dame asr ali
baap se beti ka zainab ne bichadna dekha
binte zehra ne bhare...

items.title: Ghareebo bekaso
items.body:
ghareeb-o-bekaso laachar awara watan zainab
muqadar ho chuke tere liye ranjo mehan zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
nawasi mustafa ki noore chashme fatema zehra
ali ki laadli hai aur shahe deen ki behen zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
<<DIVIDER>>
duhaai hai duhaai baylcha zaalim ne mara hai
hui hai jaa ba haq pardes mein majrooh tan zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
<<DIVIDER>>
tameeme bad-gohar ke na khalaq ne kya sitam toda
aseere ranjo gham hai be-dayaro be-watan zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ibne ali ka jis shajar mein sar tha aavezaar
usi ke zere saaya khoon mein tar hai khastatan zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo teri pushte athar aur jarahat taziyano ki
har ek ko khoon rulata hai tera zakhmi badan zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi bazaare kufa mein kabhi khasre yazeedi mein
kabhi darbar mein hai berida sheh ki behen zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
<<DIVIDER>>
na bhoola hai zamana aur na bhoolega qayamat tak
wo darbare yazeedi tere baazu aur rasan zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua mirza ki hai bigdi kaneezo ki bana dije
tumhare dar pa aaye azaar hai charkhe gohan zainab
ghareeb-o-bekaso...
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Har gali abbas ki
items.body:
har gali abbas ki hai har nagar abbas ka
dushman e deen ko laga rehta hai darr abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jab imam e waqt layenge alam abbas ka
aqs aayega zamane ko nazar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh diya itni bulandi par wafa ke naam ko
bewafayi aaj bhi rakhti hai darr abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki jang ka naksha badal jaata zaroor
dekhti fauj e yazeedi ghaiz agar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nazar pe ruk gaya nau laakh ka lashkar jahan
ashkiyan pe rob tha kuch is qadar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na hui himmat kabhi dushman ki aaye karbala
hai khat e abbas mein ab bhi asar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sindh ki dharti pe saaya kar raha hai aaj bhi
tumko aayega alam ghar ghar nazar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar karo waada kisi se usko poora bhi karo
chaahne waalon mein bhi to ho asar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh do mujhko bhai bas ek baar ay bhai mere
bole sarwar godh mein le kar ye sar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai amood o shadman ki ye dua abbas se
in pe ho nazr e karam shaam o sahar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
items.author: Amood Peryanivi

items.title: Haye tanha sakina
items.body:
haye sakina haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane se yehi ab bhi aati hai sada
haye tanha hai sakina kitni tanha hai sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun aayega bhala ab jalane ko diya
haye tanha hai sakina kitni tanha hai sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas masoom sakina ki bujha do jaa kar
nauha ammu ka bhatiji ko suna do jaa kar
ho kahan ahle aza shaam ka waqt hua
haye tanha hai sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa chuke ahle haram usko rehaai na mili
qabr mein jaa ke bhi bacchi hai abhi tak qaidi
is ka nanha sa gala reesma se hai bandha
haye tanha hai sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak zinda thi fizza ye kiya karti thi
roz roshan usi turbat pe diya karti thi
aayi jab usko qaza dil e fizza ne kaha
haye tanha hai sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein choot gaye saare sahare uske
saare pyare huwe allah ko pyare uske
aaye baba na chacha saath koi na raha
haye tanha hai sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa madine mein bahot door tadap jaati thi
shaam ke waqt bahot shaam ki yaad aati thi
jab diya ghar mein jala maa ne sughra se kaha
haye tanha hai sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne qaayam ko zara jald bula lo maula
ab sakina ko andheron se bacha lo maula
roz ye karbobala jaa ke kehti hai hawa
haye tanha hai sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bechain har ek ahle nazar hota hai
shaam ke sunte hai halaat to dil rota hai
na wo majlis na buka phir hai khamosh faza
haye tanha hai sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman hai ye dua phir se ho matam barpa
phir sakina ko takallum de chacha ka pursa
phir biche farshe aza dil tadapta hai mera
haye tanha hai sakina...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Jaane payambar
items.body:
matfool tujhpe jaane payambar hai karbala
kitna buland tera muqaddar hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
kaabe ki azmaton ka hai mujko bhi ehteraam
lekin tera muqaam kuch aur hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni hai khush naseeb ke ab tere paasban
abbas ibne saaqiye kausar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
arze najaf bhi kam nahi turbat ke waaste
kuch aur teri baat ka bistar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
koofa hai be-wafaai ka sehra-e-tashnagi
ash-haar ka wafa ka samandar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
milta nahi pata kahin fauje yazeed ka
baaqi abhi hussain ka lashkar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaili hui hai khoon-e-shaheedan ki roshni
tanveer haq se ab bhi munawar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ka aur rabab ka dil dafn hai yahan
aaram-gaahe akbar o asghar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jispe rasool-e-paak ke bosay ke hai nishan
ab is galay pe shimr ka khanjar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
do gaz kafan bhi de na saki ummat e rasool
jalti zameen pe laasha-e-sarwar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
irfan aur viqar ne sar ko jhuka diya
sajdon ke aetbaar ka meyvar hai karbala
matfool tujhpe jaane...
items.author: Viqar

items.title: Jis ne jaana hai
items.body:
labbaika ya hussain
haya ala khairul amal
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne jaana hai chale karbobala bismillah
baaghe firdaus ka rasta hai khula bismillah
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala jaane ka armaan sada deta hai
muntazir tera alamdar e wafa rehta hai
marhaba hyder e karrar tujhe kehta hai
hai tere saath teri maa ki dua bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
goshe goshe se sada aati hai matam ki sada
nauha padte huwe jahan chalte hai ahle aza
rizk milta hai azadaron ko jannat ka pata
ay azadaar teri shaan juda bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
shauk e jannat ka talabgaar chale saath mere
ibne hyder ka madadgaar chale saath mere
aa chale sheh ka azadaar chale saath mere
hai ye pur noor sitaron ki sada bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh e baatil pe tamacha hai suno seena zani
