ye safar ishq e khuda ishq e nabi ishq e ali
matami tujhko dua deti rahe binte nabi
saath chalti hai tere teri baqa bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
daur e haazir ke yazeedon ko mitane ke liye
chehra baatil ka zamane ko dikhane ke liye
hurmat e deen e mohamed ko bachane ke liye
ek sayyed sar e maidan chala bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
pursa dena hai tujhe binte nabi ko ro kar
jis ne maqtal mein ujdate huwe dkeha hai ghar
khoon rote huwe zehra thi jahan nauhagar
aane waalon se ye kehti hai jagah bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
labbaika ya hussain
labbaika ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
har qadam yaad rahe ibne ali ka lehja
teri marzi pe hi raazi hoo mai ay mere khuda
zeen se khaak pe girte huwe maula ne kaha
deen e mursal pe meri jaan fida bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi jeena azadaron ki khidmat karna
shadman tera ye mansab hai ataa e zehra
sheh ke ghamkhwar hai yawar ye sabhi ahle aza
mai bhi khidmat ko hoo tayyar khada bismillah
jis ne jaana hai chale...
items.author: Yawar Yusufi

items.title: Laut ke ghar aajao
items.body:
laut ke ghar aajao baba
aaj sakina hogayi tanha
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ye maahol hai kaisa
zulm ka hai andaaz niraala
kaash chacha aa jaata mera
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao mujhe godhi mein uthaalo
baba mujhe seene se lagalo
khaak pe hai bechain sakina
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan bhi lele tashna dahani
ab nahi maangungi mai pani
ammu se ye keh ke khudara
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ali akbar bhi khafa hai
mera chacha bhi rooth gaya hai
kaun mujhe ab dega dilaasa
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise apna jee behlaaun
ab tak yun hi ashk bahaun
kis ko pukarun kaun hai mera
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
phail rahe hai shaam ke saaye
chaane lage har soo andhiyare
baba dil ghabraata hai mera
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab ye sakina so nahi sakti
gham mein musalsal ro nahi sakti
mera bistar aap ka seena
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho meri gardan mein rasan hai
durron se sab zakhmi badan hai
chin gaye gohar jal gaya kurta
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ne maare hai tamache
kaan hai zakhmi soyun mai kaise
aao dekho haal hamara
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ro ro ke sakina
mushkil hai ab mera jeena
aur na ab tadpao baba
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aane mein ab dayr na karna
dekho kehna maan lo mera
baba mar jaayegi sakina
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain rasheed us bibi ke sun kar
rote thay paiham abid e muztar
tha ye musalsal uska nauha
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
items.author: Rasheed Shaheedi

items.title: Mai zainab hoo
items.body:
logon mai ali ki beti hoo
kainain ki mai shehzadi hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
be chadar hoo aur qaidi hoo
bazaar mein ro kar kehti hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
kis shaan se nikli thi ghar se
is gham ne rulaaya tha mujhko
baazu se pakad kar ghazi ne
mehmil mein bithaya tha mujhko
wo manzar soch ke roti hoo
hairaan mai khud par hoti hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khaafla us ke ghar pahuncha
shireen ne mujhe pehchana nahi
qadmon se lipat kar rone lagi
jab maine kaha kyun jaana nahi
pardes mein lut kar aayi hoo
pehchaan mai aaqa zaadi hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt sare muslim dekha
sajjad ke lab par tha nauha
pehle to salaami di maine
phir rote huwe muslim se kaha
qismat ki rasan mein jakdi hoo
aankhon se salaami deti hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamraah kaneezon ke ek din
zindan e sitam mein hind aayi
zainab se kaha jab kaun hai tu
zainab ye sukhan lab par laayi
mai ranj o alam ki maari hoo
aur sher e khuda ki beti hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan se reha ho kar qaidi
jab karbobala mein aaye thay
bhai ki lehad par jaate hi
yun bain kiye thay zainab ne
kuch neel rasan ke laayi hoo
tera chehlum karne aayi hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad se kehti thi ro kar
darbar mein kis tarha jaun
mai sharm o haya ki shehzadi
ay kaash zameen mein gad jaun
mujrim ki tarha se chalti hoo
khaaliq se duhaai deti hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara biradar thay jiske
wo bibi rida ko roti hai
wo zakhm diye hai ummat ne
marham ko dawa ko roti hai
har kalmago se kehti hoo
kyun aaj rida ko tarasti hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunche jo madine ahle haram
tha mesum o mazhar hashr bapa
sughra se kaha shehzadi ne
chehre pe mere kar ghaur zara
zindan se chut kar aayi hoo
baalon mein safedi laayi hoo
mai zainab hoo mai zainab hoo
logon mai ali ki...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Matame sibte payambar
items.body:
matame sibte payambar ki nishani ho kar
khoone dil aankh se behna laga pani ho kar
matame sibte payambar…
<<DIVIDER>>
umme laila ke liye gham ki nishani ho kar
maut aayi ali akbar ki jawani ho kar
matame sibte payambar…
<<DIVIDER>>
misle sailaab bada deen e khuda khandaq se
zulfeqar e asadullah ka pani hokar
matame sibte payambar…
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr e shabbir ne ran mein wo dikhaye jauhar
reh gaya khissa e ayub kahani ho kar
matame sibte payambar…
<<DIVIDER>>
log akbar ka madine mein adab karne lage
yun shabab aaya mohamed ki jawani ho kar
matame sibte payambar…
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi baksh di sar de ke shahe waala ne
warna reh jaata ye islam kahani ho kar
matame sibte payambar…

items.title: Mere humsafar
items.body:
ba waqte ruqsate hyder jo aayi roohe batool
tadap ke boli mere humsafar wasi e rasool
huwa na aapki tarha koi bhi yun maqtool
ye jaan leva musibat kiya ise bhi qabool
bas ab ye zabt e sitam khatm kijiye maula
hamein bhi apna zara waqt dijiye maula
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere hamsafar mere hyder mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar mai aayi hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
ab sang chalo ke zulm o sitam seh chuke bahot
hum bhi baghair aap ke ab reh chuke bahot
is waaste bhi ay mere shauhar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa sitam hai kaisa musibat ka hai samaa
ghash mein hai aap aur hai sar se lahoo rawan
marham lagane zakhm ke upar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ka kitna dhyan rakha mere baad mein
ehsaas e maa na hone diya mere baad mein
karne tumhara shukriya dilbar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehra hai zakhm e taygh amama hai khoon mein
dooba hua jo aap ka chehra hai khoon mein
karne ko saaf wo rukh e anwar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab saump ke hassan ko mere saath mein chalo
ab odhlo kafan ko mere saath mein chalo
faryad ye zaban par lekar mai aayi hoon
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrao mat ke shabbar o shabbir bhi to hai
abbas bhi hai zainab e dilgeer bhi to hai
ye soch kar wasi e payambar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
firdaus mein bhi ho ke ye dukhiya udaas hai
haan aap ke baghair ye zehra udaas hai
behre sukoon ay mere hamsar mai aayi hoon
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dam gayi hayaat ko deke rehaai mai
leke gayi thi aap ke ghar se vidaai mai
phir ek baar aap ke ghar par mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir o kumail wo manzar ajeeb tha
godhi mein sar ko rakh ke ye kehti thi fatema
baba ke paas ashk baha kar mai aayi hoo
lene tumhe ay saaqi e kausar...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Noha lubaba ka tha
items.body:
nauha lubaba ka tha abbas jalad aao
waqte madad hai waali ab dayr mat lagao
<<DIVIDER>>
kis yaas se sadayein hal min ki de rahe hai
narghe mein hai adoo ke aaqa unhe bachao
nauha lubaba ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai bekasi ne ghera hai har taraf se
lillaah is bala se aakar unhe chudao
nauha lubaba ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalni badan hai saara zakhmon se khoon rawan hai
apni wafa ka marham laa kar zara lagao
nauha lubaba ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
betaab hoke dar tak shehzadiyan gayi hai
dhalki hai sar se chadar aakar zara udhao
nauha lubaba ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaqa ke tan se sar ki lo hogayi judaai
be-sar ki laash koi qaime mein ran se lao
nauha lubaba ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal kar rahe hai sibte nabi ka laasha
mushkil kusha ke dilbar aao madad ko aao
nauha lubaba ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch sa'aton ki bewa karti rahi jo ro kar
tum bhi anees nauha wohi hamay sunao
nauha lubaba ka tha...
items.author: Anees

items.title: Aap ke baad mujhe
items.body:
aap ke baad mujhe shimr ne maara baba
choor zakhmon se hui teri sakina baba
<<DIVIDER>>
kya yateemo ko dilaasa nahi deta koi
kya aseeron ka koi ghar nahi hota baba
aap ke baad mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko is baat pe zaalim ne tamache maare
maine bas aap ka sar shimr se maanga baba
aap ke baad mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
itni be-rehmi se durr mere layeen ne cheene
jaise daadi se fidak logon ne cheena baba
aap ke baad mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
moo ke bal daudte naaqe se girri thi jab mai
shimr ne baalon se tab mujhko uthaya baba
<<DIVIDER>>
haath pehlu se nahi jaise utha dadi ka
hath rukhsaar se mera nahi uth'ta baba
aap ke baad mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise ujde na koi meri dua hai rab se
jaise pardes mein ujdi hai sakina baba
aap ke baad mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sogayi shaam ke zindan mein sakina mohsin
qaid khaane mein sada reh gayi baba baba
aap ke baad mujhe...
items.author: Mohsin Jaffri

items.title: Abbas ka parcham
items.body:
abbas ka parcham hai alamdar ka parcham
uncha hai mere sayyed o sardar ka parcham
<<DIVIDER>>
parcham mere murshid ka jo ghar ghar pe laga hai
ye saare azadaron pe zehra ki ataa hai
is parchame abbas ko zainab ki dua hai
kaun isko jhukayega bhala kis mein hai ye dum
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ka sakina se wafa ka hai ye aalam
parcham se juda mashk hai na mashk se parcham
jaise kisi baazu pe ho taweez muqaddam
ye bali sakina ki dua saath hai har dum
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam na ruka tha na ruka hai na rukega
parcham na jhuka tha na jhuka hai na jhukega
har lehza julooson ki qayadat ye karega
ho koi faza koi waba koi bhi mausam
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
parcham ye mareezon ko shifa baant raha hai
dunya ko mohabbat ki fiza baant raha hai
aulaad makan rizq o wafa baant raha hai
kya fikr ho dunya ki hamay kya ho bhala gham
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baat hai bachpan ki mujhe yaad abhi bhi
har aat moharram ko jo baba se kahi thi
ye parcham e abbas uthana hai mujhe bhi
kuch saath mera di jiye hai umr meri kam
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar ye julooson mein nazar aata hai hum ko
tasleem kiya sab ne isi jood o karam ko
sar jhukta nahi uska uthaye jo alam ko
ye naara lagate hai kabhi aap kabhi hum
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan mazhar o farhan nazar aayega ek din
maula ka alam kaabe pe lehrayega ek din
dil fatema zahra ka sukoon payega ek din
khush honge bahot dekh ke ye waaris e adam
uncha hai mere...
abbas ka parcham hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ahlebaite paighambar
items.body:
ahlebait e paighambar sar katane aaye hai
haq ke naasir o yawar sar katane aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nabi ka kunba hai haq pa adne waala hai
aandhiyo se toofan se bad ke ladne waala hai
phir bhi kya khabar kaisa waqt padne waala hai
ya khuda mohamed ka ghar ujadne waala hai
ibne hyder e safdar sar katane aaye hai
ahlebait e paighambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khair ho mere maula saamne hai ek lashkar
zulm ka koi naiza pad na jaye seene par
khaak par na gir jaaye naujawan theora kar
khoon mein na mil jaye ye shabihe paighambar
haye naujawan akbar sar katane aaye hai
ahlebait e paighambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ke sehra mein hai rasool ka gulshan
ban na jaye phoolon ke haq mein kal yehi madfan
sab rasool zaade hai sab ali ke jaan o tan
ek raat ka dulha ek raat ki dulhan
haye waarise shabbar sar katane aaye hai
ahlebait e paighambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ke ye nigehban hai dushmanane baatil hai
inke dil ka kya kehna sar se paaon tak dil hai
chand ho ke laakhon ke aaj ye mukhabil hai
phool jaise bache bhi kaarwan mein shaamil hai
haye bezaban asghar sar katane aaye hai
ahlebait e paighambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufiyon ke ye mehman qatl hone waale hai
ye rasool ke armaan qatl hone waale hai
bolte huwe quran qatl hone waale hai
sab mahafiz e emaan qatl hone waale hai
fatema ke sab dilbar sar katane aaye hai
ahlebait e paighambar..
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase bache tadpenge chain jab na payenge
mashk ba-wafa lekar alqama pe jayenge
gir padenge ghode se itne zakhm khayenge
shaane kat rahe honge khoon mein nahayenge
aaj saani e hyder sar katane aaye hai
ahlebait e paighambar...

items.title: Amma mai thak
items.body:
gardan se sheh ki khanjar e qatil khareeb tha
zehra sirhaane aa gayi karti hui buka
zaanu ki maa ki shaah ne tab sar ko rakh diya
aankhein thi band aur ye nauha labon pe tha
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir keh rahe hai aansu baha baha ke
amma mai thak chuka hoon laashe utha utha ke
<<DIVIDER>>
maine uthayi amma haathon pe laashe akbar
in haathon se banayi khud maine qabre asghar
yun maarte hai zaalim mujhko rula rula ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan se mujhko jis dam abbas ne pukara
kham aa gaya kamar mein toota mera sahara
darya pe jaa raha tha mai sar jhuka jhuka ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar meri nazar ki beenayi le gaye thay
gir gir ke poochta tha beta mera kidhar hai
wo mujhko dhoondta tha gardan utha utha ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
do bhanjon ke mere jab ran se aaye laashe
zainab ne laadlon ke jis waqt paaye laashe
sajde wo kar rahi thi aansu baha baha ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma meri nazar mein manzar wo chaa rahe hai
bacchi pe meri aada yun zulm dhaa rahe hai
pani baha rahe hai us ko dikha dikha ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzrenge aur masayib meri behan ke upar
aankhon mein phir raha hai ye dardnaak manzar
wo sham ja rahi hai nauhe suna suna ke
amma mai thak chuka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shadman o majid kaise padhe ye manzar
jab halq rakh rahi thi zehra gulu e sheh par
gardan jhuka jhuka ke khanjar hata hata ke
amma mai thak chuka...
items.author: Majid Raza Abdi

items.title: Ay akbar ye sehra
items.body:
akbar akbar haye akbar
akbar mera sehriyan waala akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay akbar ye sehra sajane ke din thay
kahan teri mayyat uthane ke din thay
<<DIVIDER>>
wo galiyan jahan tera bachpan hai guzra
jahan dekhte hai sabhi tera rasta
wahin laut ke ab to jaane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai baithi hui dar pe bemaar sughra
tujhe lene aaunga tha jis se waada
behen ko watan se bulane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhe naaz se aise paala phupi ne
duayein tujhe di hai khud zindagi ne
nigahon may tujhko basane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe deen ye laashe pe kehte hai ro kar
sukoon kaise paaye bhala qalb e muztar
sahara tera ab to paane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek subha maadar ne jab tujhko dekha
utaari nazar tera sadqa utaara
ay beta ye mannat badhane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadapte huwe keh rahi hai ye maadar
mere naujawan ay mere laal akbar
kaleje se tujhko lagane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha izhaar aur shadman gham ka manzar
lipat kar jo laashe se kehti thi maadar
ye naushaah tujhko banane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
items.author: Ali Izhaar

items.title: Ay warise adam
items.body:
ay waaris e adam teri qurbaniyan
farzande fatema teri qurbaniyan
<<DIVIDER>>
ya hussain teri qurbani ki sunnat koi bhi kar na saka
teer par teer bhi kha kar tu dua deta raha
aisi anmol ibadat koi bhi kar na saka
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak ko khaake shifa tu ne kiya ek taraf
ek taraf aayi ye awaaz e shehenshahe najaf
tu ne maidan e jafa ko laaeq e sajda kiya
ek maidan ko jannat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhse bayyat ka taqaza jo layeeno ne kiya
tu ne baatil ke taqazon ka jawab aisa diya
ban gaya qaari e quran bar sare noke sina
aur phir aisi tilawat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe se shaam talak laashein uthaye thay magar
yun lada jang ke maidan mein hyder ka pisar
dasht laashon se sajaya keh uthe jinn o bashar
pyasa reh kar bhi ye himmat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud raha pyasa magar pyason ko sairaab kiya
zarf maula tere jaisa kahin dekha na suna
hurr ko seene se lagaya to yehi hurr ne kaha
aisi insan se mohabbat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere hone se azaan hai tere hone se namaz
tere sajde se mila deen e mohamed ko faraaz
har dhadakte huwe dil ki hai yehi ek awaaz
yun dilon par to hukumat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
faqr e adam bhi tu hi hai faqr e hyder bhi tu hi
naazish e ahle haram naazish e daawar bhi tu hi
tu hi sardar e jina hai aur kausar bhi tu hi
khud ko aaeena e aayat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasa darya ke kanare se alamdar chala
kat gaye baazu magar nazron mein asghar hi raha
mashk se pani gaya aur deen se ghazi gaya
ye wafayein ye ata'at koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek mastoor ne mushkil mein bada kaam kiya
teri mazloomi ka parchaar sar e aam kiya
khud to be-ghar hui ghar ghar tera paigham diya
is tarha teri himayat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman hogayi zehra jo qalam chalta raha
apne alfazon mein pursa tu unhe deta raha
raat din nauhe jo mazhar ro ke tu likhta raha
zikre sheh mein ye riyazat koi bhi kar na saka
ya hussain teri qurbani...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Bismillah
items.body:
bismillah
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal khoon ki mehendi lagao bismillah
ghareeb maa ki ijazat le jao bismillah
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain denge ijazat tumhe ye mushkil hai
magar ay laal shahadat tumhari manzil hai
khadam hussain ki jaanib uthao bismillah
ay laal khoon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baba hassan ki yehi wasiyat hai
jehad tum pe hai laazim ye waqte nusrat hai
ay laal sar pe amaama sajao bismillah
ay laal khoon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
milengi tum ko ijazat hussain se beta
tumhare baazu pe taweez wo jo baandha tha
usay hussain ko jaa kar dikhao bismillah
ay laal khoon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ek baar ye zulfein sawaar deti hoo
ruko tumhari mai mannat utaar deti hoo
qareeb maa ke mere laal aao bismillah
ay laal khoon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussaini fauj ko qasim ki jang yaad rahe
tumhari shadi tumhari umang yaad rahe
hassan ki dayr ke jauhar dikhao bismillah
ay laal khoon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
suno ke waqt judaai ka aane waala hai
andhera shaam e ghariban ka chaane waala hai
tadati maa ko galay se lagao bismillah
ay laal khoon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohib hussain ne qasim ko ran may bhej diya
nishani bhai ki ruqsat hui to ro ke kaha
kahun mai kaise ke maqtal may jao bismillah
ay laal khoon ki...

items.title: Darya hai abbas ka
items.body:
abbas alamdar alamdare hussaini
<<DIVIDER>>
hat jao shaamiyon hat jao kufiyon
mai ibne murtaza hoo mere naam hai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe aamad e khalafe bu turab hai
dehshat se mauj mauj ka dil aab aab hai
kis pehar ka jalaal ghazab ka itaab hai
gayti ko zalzala hai ke matti kharaab hai
roohul ameen ko khuaf se wasvaas aate hai
wasvaas kyun na aaye ke abbas aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye darya hai abbas ka ye darya hai abbas ka
khud pani sadayein deta hai har khatra hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
<<DIVIDER>>
bhatke na koi ab saahil par ye saara ilaaka hai mera
ay ghasib e haq e zahra suno ye pani mehr hai zehra ka
mai teesra beta hoo unka ye virsa hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shaamiyon tum mein hai hi nahi abbas se ladne ki himmat
is darya mein hi doob maro baaki hai agar thodi ghairat
atthara laakh nigahon mein kyun khatra hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
naara kiya wo rokne waale kahan gaye
tayghein wo kis taraf hai wo bhaale kahan gaye
lekar khat e shakast risaale kahan gaye
shimr o umar ki godh ke paale kahan gaye
zinda abhi hai ya pisar e saad mar gaya
khaali pada hai dasht ye khooli kidhar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
hat jao shaamiyon hat jao kufiyon
mai ibne murtaza hoo mere naam hai abbas
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh haan to kahe mai haakim ko uske hi mehal mein maarunga
ay shaamiyon shaam se pehle mai is shaam pe qabza kar lunga
ye baat nahi afsaano ki ye daawa hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas itaa'at mein har dam psaband hai apne aaqa ka
pehle jo hata tha darya se wo hukm tha mere aaqa ka
ab hatna padega tum sab ko ye rasta hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
o shimr apni fauj ka andher dekh le
ek dam mein bismilon ke huwe dher dekh le
bhaage hai jis se sher wo shamsher dekh le
o bekhabar taraayi pe hai sher dekh le
ladte hai yun hi zabr jo aate hai baat par
ab hashr tak hai sher ka qabza faraat par
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar to baahar aane do tum sab ki mai jurrat dekhunga
haan kis ka hai darya saahil par jis dam mai aakar poochunga
khud thodi dayr mein bologe abbas ka hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai khul ke agar hamla kar doon wo khoon ka darya darya mein
mai taygh yahan par khaynchunga aur shor uthega kufa mein
muslim se kahenge baba bhi ye hamla hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e hussain sayyed o sardar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
ay ahle haram meer o alamdar na aamad
alamdar na aamad alamdar na aamad
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqe se giraya hai khud ko ye keh ke ali ki beti ne
kulsoom se boli lagta hai abbas khada hai pehle se
ye khushboo hai chote bhai ki ye saaya hai abbas ka ya
ye darya hai abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad kaha usne ro kar ay jaan meri qasim utho
shahzade abhi tak pyase ho ammu ki qasam pani peelo
sairaab ho jee bhar ke beta ab qabza hai abbas ka
ye darya darya darya hai abbas ka
ye darya hai abbas ka...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Ek natiqe quran
items.body:
ay natiq e quran ya maula
ay waaris e quran ya maula
<<DIVIDER>>
ek natiq e quran naize par quran sunata jaata hai
aur waaris e quran marqad mein khaak udaata jaata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
quran e masayeb ke sar se juzdaan utaare jaate hai
ek ek aayat ke seene mein khanjar jo utaare jaate hai
quran ke haafiz ke haathon quran jalaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek chota sa quran abhi naize pe jo maine dekha hai
seh pehlu teer se us ka gala takbeer suna kar cheda hai
ek rehl-numa jhoole ko sar e maidan jalaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran sifat wo do bacche jo doshe nabi ke raakib thay
wo jin ke galay mehboobe khuda chooma karte thay aankhon se
kabhi zehr pilaaya jaata hai teeron pe sulaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ka parda rakhna hai ay umme abiha teri tarha
sajjad ki majboori dekho tadpa hai kisi machli ki tarha
kausar si choti aayat ko turbat mein chupaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch choti badi aayaat bhi thi ek soora bhi qaidi dekha
bazaar e sitam mein be parda suraj ne wo chehra bhi dekha
jise saani e zahra kehte huwe palkon ko jhukaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
tatheer ki aayat jin ke liye khud kaatib e qismat ne likhi
us aayat ki tafseeron ko saaya na mila chadar na mili
baala e sitam be-maqna unhe darbar mein laaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kalmago kuch sharm to kar ay qaari e quran doob ke mar
quran e imamat ki dukhtar kis tarha kare kaanton pe safar
in pairon ke riste khoon se zam zam ko banaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-ghusl o kafan kitne quran pamaal kiye haye haye
afsos ke baa e bismillah naizon pe utha ke le aaye
quran ki hurmat loot ke ye kyun jashn manaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
chonsat paare raston mein giray aaghosh se apni maaon ki
khoon rang hui raahon ki zameen in bacchon ki turbat na bani
in ujdi godh ki maaon ko phir khoon rulaaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran mein rakha hai khudrat ne har khushk o tar ka zikr magar
kuch aise quran dekhe gaye ashoor ko apne khoon mein tar
wo jin ke paseene se kaabe ko ghusl karaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran e aza hai farshe aza rehaan e aza rizwan e aza
ye nauha e gham roadad-e-sitam zahra ki qasam bar doshe hawa
majlis mein suna kar zahra ko mehman banaya jaata hai
ek natiq e quran...

suno rozadaron ali murtaza ke

lahoo mein hai dooba hua mera bhai
ye ajre risalat diya mujhko kaisa
hua qalb muztar ghazab hogaya hai
hai gham ka ye manzar kaho khaak uda kar
ghazab hogaya hai

hai kufe ki galiyon mein ye aah o zaari
madad kaun haye kare ab hamari
ghareebon yateemon mein hai shor e matam
hai nauha labon par ghazab hogaya hai
hai gham ka ye manzar kaho khaak uda kar
ghazab hogaya hai

ye hasnain zainab se kehte hai ro kar
yateemi ka sadma sahe kaise dil par
hai tanhaai kaisi na baba rahe aur
na hai sar pe maadar ghazab hogaya hai
hai gham ka ye manzar kaho khaak uda kar
ghazab hogaya hai
suno rozadaron...
<<DIVIDER>>
janaza ali ka utha haye haye
hai ehle aza mein buka haye haye
bapa shor e matam falak par hai baqar
jo kehta hai safdar ghazab hogaya hai
hai gham ka ye manzar kaho khaak uda kar
ghazab hogaya hai

items.author: Baqar Hussain

items.title: Har gham ki khabar
items.body:
baba ko sakina tere har gham ki khabar hai
naize ki ani par hai magar tujh pa nazar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
takleef teri noore nazar dekh raha hoo
dekha nahi jaata hai magar dekh raha hoo
is gham se meri rooh talak khaak basar hai
baba ko sakina tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaano se tapakte hai tere khoon ke khatre
ye dekh ke hota hai kaleja mera tukde
aansu nahi aankhon mein mera khoon e jigar hai
baba ko sakina tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai dekh raha hoo teri gardan mein rasan ko
kya kya na aziyat hai tere gul se badan ko
ghabrake na mar jaye masayab se ye darr hai
baba ko sakina tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein khush hoke chali jaana sakina
baba ki qasam tujhko na ghabrana sakina
naize pe pareshan tere baap ka sar hai
baba ko sakina tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab tere muqadar mein kahan shehr e madina
ay beti seekh le zindan mein jeena
ay lakhte jigar aaj se tera yehi ghar hai
baba ko sakina tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki sangat hai ye ehwale sakina
irfan bayan kaise kare haye sakina
dil hilta hai akhtar tere nauhe mein asar hai
baba ko sakina tere...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Haye wo asr ka
items.body:
haye wo asr ka hangaam wo maidan e bala
haye wo tauq o rasan uff wo ghareebon ka gala
har taraf chaayi hui zulm o sitam ki wo ghata
jaa ke takraati thi saahil se ye zainab ki sada
tum ne to jaa ke basali hai taraayi abbas
yan rida chin gayi behno ki duhaai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
lut'ta hai khaana e khatoone jina dekh to lo
in sulagte huwe qaimon ka dhuaan dekh to lo
paaye abid mein ye zanjeer e garan dekh to lo
pushte khwahar pa ye durron ke nishan dekh to lo
hoti hai shaam e ghariban e watan jangal mein
utho bhaiya ke akeli hai behan jangal mein
<<DIVIDER>>
kat gaye nakhle gulistane ali tum na uthe
jal gaya qaima e farzande nabi tum na uthe
luti sarkar e rasool e arabi tum na uthe
mera abbas mere sher e jari tum na uthe
kaise ye zulm hua haye gawara tumko
har tamache pa sakina ne pukara tumko
<<DIVIDER>>
chaahne waale nahi darde jigar baakhi hai
saamne dard ki ek raah guzar baakhi hai
chut gaye hum safari aur safar baakhi hai
ab bhatije hai salamat na pisar baakhi hai
koi manzil hi nahi kaise sukoon paaye behen
bhaiya itna to bata do ke kahan jaaye behen
<<DIVIDER>>
goonj kar reh gayi jab binte payambar ki sada
sunke faryad koi chaahne waala na utha
daudi maqtal ki taraf binte shahe uqda kusha
kehti thi haye shaheedon ko kafan bhi na mila
pahunchi maidan mein to kis tarha kahun kya dekha
rondte ghodon se shabbir ka laasha dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
kehke ye baith gayi jisme shahe deen ke khareeb
boli aayi hai teri laash uthane ye hazeen
jald qaime mein mujhe jaana hai ay sarwar e deen
phir sakina ko tamache na lagaate ho layeen
keh ke ye kaampte haathon se sambhali mayyat
ya ali keh ke kaleje se lagaali mayyat

items.title: Jaane sakina
items.body:
baba kujaai baba kujaai
kahan ho baba
<<DIVIDER>>
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mai qaid may hoo aap kahan ho baba
laadli beti ko ek baar pukaro baba
paas aao ya mujhe paas bulalo baba
apne daaman may sakina ko chupalo baba
mere baba mujhe do aa ke sahara
ay jaan e sakina kahan ho kahan ho
charagh e zindan...
ai baba ye khubam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sehti hai sitam aap ki beti baba
khoon behta hai mere kaan hai zakhmi baba
cheen kar le gaye kyun baaliyan meri baba
maangte aa ke jo mujhse to mai deti baba
kitna mushkil hai sakina ka guzara
ay jaan e sakina kahan ho kahan ho
charagh e zindan...
ai baba ye khubam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
baba kal khwaab may tum paas mere aaye thay
godh may asghar e masoom ko bhi laaye thay
bhai akbar chacha abbas yahin baithe thay
baari baari galay lipta ke mujhe rote thay
jaane kab dekhungi kunba mai dobara
ay jaan e sakina kahan ho kahan ho
charagh e zindan...
ai baba ye khubam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din baba ka sar bali sakina ko mila
ashk baar aankhon se baba ne sakina se kaha
haye kis haal may tum hum se mili ho beta
ab wo seena hi nahi jis pe sulaaye baba
apna sar rakh de mere sar pe sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
items.author: N. Sarwar, J. Jaffri & M. Abdollahi

items.title: Lauta diya janaza
items.body:
gham se dil e rasool e zaman kat raha hai aaj
dunya mein fatema ka chaman kat raha hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
lauta diya janaza ummat ne kyun hassan ka
rauze pe mustafa ke jhagda kiya dafan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada e girya ek jannatul baqi se
kya haal kar diya hai logon mere chaman ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke sar ko chooma farmeina ye hassan ne
fizza khayaal rakhna ab tu meri behan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ne roke poocha maadar se ye batao
rang laal hogaya hai baba ke kyun kafan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aan mein jigar ke kitne huwe hai tukde
lab rayz hogaya hai paymana bhi lagan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
rone ke waaste kya tauqeer itna kam hai
nana ke paas rauza ban na saka hassan ka
lauta diya janaza...
items.author: Tauqeer Kamalvi

items.title: Maidan ki jalti reti
items.body:
maidan ki jalti reti par
ek pyase ki peshani hai
is sajda e aakhir par sheh ke
aalam ko badi hairani hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har aane waale ko bacche
takte hai nigaahe tishna se
is dard mein doobe manzar se
darya bhi pani pani hai
maidan ki jalti...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon pe pidar ke maidan mein
islam bachane jaaunga
hyder ke ye nanhe pote ne
kya baat ye dil mein thaani hai
maidan ki jalti...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom isharon ke hamle
baatil ki kamar ko tod gaye
ye fatha quloob e aada par
baysheer teri la-saani hai
maidan ki jalti...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek laasha e be-sar se lipti
masoom sakina roti hai
khushboo e pidar se maqtal mein
is laash ko wo pehchani hai
maidan ki jalti...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis roz se kunba qatl hua
us roz se ahlebait ke ghar
har waqt hai ya to seena zani
ya lab pe nauha khwani hai
maidan ki jalti...
<<DIVIDER>>
israar na itna gham hota
zainab ki aseeri ka dil par
ek fard bhi keh deta us dam
loota na isay saydani hai
maidan ki jalti...
items.author: Israar

items.title: Matami
items.body:
haya ala qairil amal
<<DIVIDER>>
ye matami jo rehte hai har waqt ashk baar
na bhoole hai ye bazaar na bhoole darbaar
<<DIVIDER>>
palkon ka jhapakna hi jinka karna ho matam
kya matam e zanjeer ho kya matam e talwaar
ye matami jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise wo isay chod de ke jin ki jahan mein
matam ki sadaon se chale saans ki raftaar
ye matami jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
takbeer uthe haath jhuke dil se hai sajda
ye aise namazi hai ye zehra ke azadaar
ye matami jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam e hussain se wo juda ho nahi sakte
gardan juda jo tan se ho karwane ko tayyar
ye matami jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik ki mashiyat ki hai takhleeq ye insan
zehra ki mashiyat ki hai takhleeq ye azadaar
ye matami jo...
items.author: Salamat Feroz

items.title: Mere hussain fi
items.body:
mazaar e fatema zahra se ye sada aayi
mere hussain fi amanillah
<<DIVIDER>>
sada ye sun ke ajab ranj ki ghata chaayi
mere hussain fi amanillah
<<DIVIDER>>
mere hussain safar mein na hoge tum tanha
tumhare saath rahegi tumhari maa zahra
na chain payegi ek pal kabhi ye dukh paayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare saath rahungi tumhe sukoon mile
hamesha aalam e ghurbat mein tumko chain rahe
mai dekh sakti nahi hoo tumhari tanhaai
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya jalaya kabhi aur kabhi padha quran
tumhare rehne se marqad nahi raha veeran
bahot purani hai gham se meri shanasaayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri duayein tere saath hai hussain hussain
dil e ghareeb ke jazbaat hai hussain hussain
hamari aankhon ki ay laal tum ho beenayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
madina dikhne laga ab to soona soona sa
har ek gali mein nazar aa raha hai sannata
kali har ek nabi ke chaman ki murjhayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare karbobala saath jaayegi zainab
tumhara saath hamesha nibhayegi zainab
tumhare saath rahegi tumhari maa jaayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhi batao tumhe kis tarah karun ruqsat
ke izn deti nahi hai mujhe meri chaahat
hai mere qalb ki thandak tu meri parchayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
lipat ke rone lage qabre fatema se hussain
bapa fizaon mein hone laga hai naala o shain
falak larazne laga aur zameen tharrayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye boli ro ke hazeen ay shams aur aamir
udaas hoga madina ay shams aur aamir
magar mai karti rahungi teri pazeerayi
mere hussain fi amanillah...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Musalle pe akbar ki
items.body:
labon se nikal kar azan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dua hai yehi ghamzada maa ke lab par
khudaya salamat rahe mera akbar
wo le le ke bas hichkiyan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi khaak par baith kar reh guzar mein
judaai mein akbar ki veraan ghar mein
behan ghamzada neem jaan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadapti hai sughra chale aao bhaiya
kahin mar na jaye judaai mein sughra
wo bemaar aur natawan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to gaya hi nahi ran mein akbar
abhi dil hai akbar ka seene ke andar
magar phir bhi noke sina ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wahan par madine mein roti hai sughra
yahan par sakina ke lab par hai nauha
behen ek yahan ek wahan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua kar rahi hai ye karbal mein laila
na maut aaye akbar ko mere khudaya
jawani ye sun kar bayan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay naazon ke paale zara sa teher jaa
ke zainab sajaale tere sar pe sehra
ke aun o mohamed ki maa ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi dekhte hai falak se ye manzar
safon mein khade sab namazi hai muztar
imamat liye hichkiyan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
madine mein akbar jahan se chale hai
zameen pe qadam ke nishan wo pade hai
behen dekh kar kuch nishan ro rahi hai
musalle pe akbar ki maa ro rahi hai
labon se nikal kar...

items.title: Aap ke baad na soyi
items.body:
ek roz madine waalon ne
hyder se kaha zehra se kahe
wo raat may mehlan ro le ya
baba ke liye din may role
ye baat ali ne batlaayi
jab fatema zehra ko aa kar
boli zehra mai rolungi
ab ghar se door kahin jaa kar
ye sunke madine se baahar
ek baitul huzn banaya gaya
jahan baith ke zehra roti thi
aur ro ro ke ye kehti thi
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baba aap ke baad na soyi zehra
bas roti rahi haye wavaila wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi jalta hua mujhpe wo darwaza gira
phasliyan toot gayi pehlu shakista bhi hua
tumhari ye beti sada de rahi thi
haye maara gaya mohsin
haye baba aap ke baad na...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum jab se gaye hogayi tanha zehra
aap ki yaad may jab ghar may bicha farsh e aza
isi gham may royi yateemi may koi
dene nahi aaya hausla
haye baba aap ke baad na...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash wo waqt kabhi mujhpe na aata baba
maine hyder ka gala rassi may dekha baba
gayi jab bachane lagay taaziyane
aur haath mera zakhmi hua
haye baba aap ke baad na...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ek maa ka liye waqt bahot mushkil tha
ek zaalim ne mere rukh pe tamacha maara
chupaati thi chehra hassan dekhta tha
jab surkh huwa chehra
haye baba aap ke baad na...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere aane pe jahan aap bhi uth jaate thay
wohi darbar tha aur saamne sab baithe rahe
akeli khadi thi fidak maangti thi
afsos mujhe haq na mila
haye baba aap ke baad na...
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf athara baras may ye mera aalam hai
dekho baalon may safaydi hai kamar bhi kham hai
zaeefa hai ab to mera haal dekho
mai thaam ke chalti hoo asa
haye baba aap ke baad na...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke zeeshan yehi kehta hai irfan e aza
cheen kar saaya layeen ne wo shajar kaat diya
jahan baith'ti thi bas ab doop may bhi
honton pe yehi tha marsiya
haye baba aap ke baad na...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Abbas ka sar
items.body:
aale nabi ka khaafila bazaar jo pahuncha
chehre thay zard gham se saron par na thi rida
ghazi ka sar jo naize se aaya zameen par
fizza ne dil ko thaam ke nauha yehi kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
na dekh sakega zainab ko
haye be-chadar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai naize par
dauran e safar abbas ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad se zainab kehti thi
manzar wo dekh na paungi
ye zulm hua to mere pisar
ro ro ke yahin mar jaungi
naaqe ke galay mein daal diya
zaalim ne agar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
girti hai wo pusht e naaqa se
ye baar uthana mushkil hai
ammu se bhatiji ki ulfat
kya hai ye batana mushkil hai
naaqe pe sakina rukti nahi
aur naize par abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zakhm kabhi bhar sakta nahi
bhulega dil e hassaas nahi
baba ki shahadat par roya
phir roya kabhi abbas nahi
karbal se yahan tak rota raha
har manzil par abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan se watan jaa kar bhi hum
aaram se kab so payenge
jab band karenge aankhon ko
manzar wo hamein tadpayenge
shabbir ka qasim o akbar ka
baysheer ka sar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad batana chaahun agar
tujhse bhi nahi keh paaungi
kuch zakhm e jigar to aise hai
jo qabr talak le jaaungi
shabbir ka sar baazu mein rasan
akbar ka jigar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar wo qayamat ka manzar
likhte huwe mazhar rota tha
kehti thi behan aaja ghazi
aur shimr ye has kar kehta tha
kya teri madad ko aayega
ay nauhagar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ali akbar ali akbar
items.body:
ay mere noore nazar ay mere laqte jigar
baap aaya hai utho dekho to haal e padar
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ne kaha bete ke shaane ko hila kar
ali akbar ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun uth'te nahi ho meri awaaz pe akbar
ali akbar ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
baba hai pareshan zara aankhein to kholo
barchi kahan khaayi hai kahan dard hai bolo
yun aediyan ragdo na mere laal zameen par
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
taari hai ghashi tum pe lahoo beh gaya kitna
himmat nahi uthne ki to letay raho beta
mai theek hoo aahista se kehdo mere dilbar
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir gir ke har ek laash se mai pooch raha tha
kya tum mere akbar ho bata do mujhe itna
mai laash pe pohuncha hoo teri ghutniyo chal kar
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan mein meri haath zara daal do beta
baba ke sahare se utho ghar chalo beta
godhi mein utha sakta nahi mai tumhe akbar
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum saara nahi padh sake akbar khat e sughra
is baat ka mai kya doo jawab usko ay beta
shaadi ka teri pooch rahi hai teri khwahar
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache ko mere maar ke haste hai jo aada
mai bad'dua de doon to koi bhi na bachega
ay laal hai hum naakha e saaleh se to badh kar
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sona to hai to aajao meri jaan sulayein
aao phupi amma ki tumhe lori sunayein
hum baith gaye baba ki zaanu pe rakho sar
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
aahista se sajjad pukare shah e waala
shabbir ki ghairat ko gawara nahi beta
uth jao nikal aaye na zainab meri baahar
ali akbar ali akbar
maula ne kaha bete ke...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Amma mai thak
items.body:
kehte thay ran mein sarwar
maara gaya baradar
tooti kamar hai meri
laashe utha utha kar
<<DIVIDER>>
amma mai thak gaya hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
seh roz ka hoo pyasa
mai hogaya akela
asghar ko dafn kar ke
khud ban gaya hoo laasha
dekho mera muqaddar
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye fikr khaa rahi hai
ab shaam aa rahi hai
mansoobein fauje aada
ab ye bana rahi hai
cheene haram ki chadar
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay amma ye na poocho
kya hogaya hai mujhko
tum khud hi zakhme akbar
maidan mein aake dekho
qaabu nahi hai dil par
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal se chun ke laaya
pamaal ek laasha
haathon ki jiski mehndi
deti thi mujhko pursa
aansu baha baha kar
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bedast ho ke ghazi
sota hai neend gehri
dooba lahoo mein parcham
zakhmi hai mashk uski
usko jagaa jagaa kar
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tooti kamar sambhalun
ya dil pe haath rakhun
jo teer aa rahe hai
haathon se kaise rokun
khud ko bacha bacha kar
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khushboo bata rahi hai
aap aagayi hai rann mein
mai kab se dhoondta hoo
karbobala ke ban mein
aajao khud hi maadar
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada e zehra
rehaan karbala mein
tanha nahi hai ab tu
is maqtal e jafa mein
kyun keh raha hai dilbar
amma mai thak gaya hoo...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ay alamdar abbas
items.body:
ay alamdar alamdar alamdar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
tune qurban dil o jaan kiye sarwar par
bibi zehra ke pisar lakhte dile hyder par
tu hi bhai tane tanha tha har ek lashkar par
lashkar e shaam tha abbas teri thokar par
tu bhi hai misle ali haq ka wali sher e khuda
ay alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko beta kaha zahra ne sharaf tera hai
karbala teri madina o najaf tera hai
jo bhi dushman hai shahe deen ka hadaf tera hai
khelna taygh se khanjar se shafaq tera hai
hyderi waar hai abbas har ek waar tera
ay alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr ke taaj ka ek saaya mein akkas hai tu
kitne jasbon ka haseen paykar o ehsaas hai tu
qaima e shah mein pyason ke liye aas hai tu
naaz tujhpar hai shujaat ko ke abbas hai tu
sahibe haq o yaqeen maalike tasleem o raza
ay alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala kya hai wafaon ke samandar ke siwa
sabr o eesaar hai kya ek tere paikar ke siwa
deen e haq aur hai kya zarbate hyder ke siwa
deen ki bunyad hai kya sajda e sarwar ke siwa
quwwate baazu e shabbir rukhe haq ki riza
ay alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raahe islam mein haaton ko kataya tune
zulm jhela kabhi sar na jhukaya tune
lafze bayyat ko zamane se mitaya tune
parcham e deen e elaahi ko bachaya tune
tujhpe qurban dil o jaan wafaon ke khuda
ay alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aabroo pyas ki rakhli hai tere honton ne
haath islam ko bakshe hai tere shano ne
alam o mashk sambhala hai tere daaton ne
haq ko zakmo se bachaya hai tere zakhmo ne
goonjti nauhe mein hai akhtar o mohsin ki sada
ay alamdar...
items.author: Akhtar

items.title: Ay yateem shehzade
items.body:
ay yateem shehzade maa ke dilruba qasim
jane murtaza qasim jane mustafa qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kamsini teri kya ujad gayi qismat
sar se utgaya saaya baap ke tere qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke janaze par teer chalte dekha tha
daag tha yateemi ka sabr karte thay qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
shakl aur shabahat mein hoo ba hoo thay hyder ke
umme farwa kehti thi haye naujawan qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ko pasand aayi teri jaane naushayi
karbala ke jangal mein byah racha diya qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
nausha banke aalam mein jaa raha hai marne ko
baap ki wasiyat ko jo nibha diya qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
jange khyber o khandaq phir gayi nigahon mein
jang mein anokha tha tera hausla qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran se jab sada aayi jald ab chacha aao
dam ruka hai seene mein kehte jaate thay qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunche jab shahe wala choor tan tha zakhmo se
ghar ujad gaya saara marne se tere qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe sehre ki ladiyan aur joda shahana
kya khaba suhani thi zebe tan kiya qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat ko bani dulhan subho ho gayi bewa
kaisi qismate kubra sochte rahe qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash utha ke laaye jab qaime jab shahe wala
peet'ti hai sar apna saari bibiyan qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar se khoon jaari tha choor choor tan saara
shaah kehte thay rokar haye mar gaye qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat ki dulhan kubra sar jhukaye ghoongat mein
zaar zaar roti hai bad-naseebi par qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
daastan shadi ki sunke rote hai saare
dulha dulha kehti hai saari dunya ay qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainabe jigar khasta mehdi kehti thi rokar
daagh saare kunbe ko haye de gaye qasim
ay yateem shehzade...
items.author: Mehdi Nazmi

items.title: Baba mera maara
items.body:
baba mera maara gaya aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
baba pe jab khanjar chala aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsaas ye mujhko hua aulaad ki ulfat hai kya
tumko sada beti ne di aaye najaf se karbala
deti rahi jab mai sada aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
baba mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho saahil pe zara ammu ka hai laasha wahan
maara gaya saqqa mera mai reh gayi tashna dahan
ammu gaye bhaiya gaya aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
baba mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumko sada deti rahi ya aeliya kehti rahi
kyun ro rahe hai dada jaan ab dekh kar haalat meri
sun kar meri aah o buka aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
baba mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashkon se hi tashna labi maine bujhayi dada jaan
maare gaye is dahsht mein sab mere bhai dada jaan
mera bhara ghar lut gaya aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
baba mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
le kar gaya shimr e layeen kaano se jab gohar mere
maine sada di aap ko us waqt hi rote huwe
aajaiye behre khuda aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
baba mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hashr sa ran mein utha safdar hua matam bapa
ro ke sakina ne kaha aana hi tha jab karbala
baba pe jab khanjar chala aaye nahi kyun dada jaan
baba mera maara gaya...
items.author: Safdar Abbas

items.title: Batool ro padi
items.body:
jo dard fatema ne ali se chupaye hai
tanhaai may kaneez ko apni sunaye hai
batool ro padi fizza ko ye bataate huye
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan ne dekha hai mujhko tamache khaate huye
batool ro padi fizza ko ye bataate huye
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kya kiya zaalim ne fatema pe sitam
zaeef ho gayi beti rasool ki ek dam
sanad ke tukdon ko darbar may uthaate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aaj shehr e madina ko hi mita doongi
agar ali ko na choda tu bad'dua doongi
kaha batool ne sar se rida hataate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo mujhpe guzri hai mujhse na ho sakegi bayan
wo dekho ab bhi hai dewaar par lahoo ke nishan
mai dekhti hoo inhe roz aate jaate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bataya sab ko jo mafhoom hai wilayat ka
labon pe shikwa na binte rasool ki aaya
ali ali hi kiya taaziyane khaate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
woh mujhse chup ke meri bekasi pe rota hai
khayaal rakhna ye nazuk mizaaj beta hai
mere janaze se shabbir ko hataate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
abu haasan ko tha patke se maine thaama huwa
magar layeen ne durre se yun mujhe maara
zameen pe gar gayi fizza mai ladkhadate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba roze hashr mai mehdi ko yeh bataungi
tamaam phasliyan tooti hai is liye meri
layeen ne maara tha thokar se aate jaate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera fareeza nibhayegi laadli meri
ghirayga sholon may jis waqt ek aur ali
chalegi aag pe zainab usay bachate huye
batool ro padi...
<<DIVIDER>>
padar ki qabr pe akbar wo ro ke kehti thi
hifaazat aap ne mujhko ali ki saunpi thi
tamache maine hai khaaye unhe bachate huye
batool ro padi...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Bismillah alamdar
items.body:
subhe ashoor puakre ye shahe karbobala
kahan ho baazu e shabbir sakina ke chacha
aaya shabbir ki awaaz pe wo rab e wafa
sheh pukare ay mere bhai ay baba ki dua
fatema zehra ki ummeed bano
afsar e lashkar e tauheed bano
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
afsar e fauj e khuda
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
aks e shaahe la fataa
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
afsar kabhi aisa kisi lashkar ne na paaya
rutba kabhi aisa kisi safdar ne na paaya
misle hyder koi jarraar kahan milta hai
aap ke jaisa alamdar kahan milta hai
mere baba ke zabardast pisar
ay mere bhai mere zor e kamar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bole ye farman e khuda wande jali hai
farzand e nabi mai hoo tu farzand e ali hai
tu agar noor e jali hai to jali ban ke dikha
baith ash'al pe zamane ko ali ban ke dikha
maut ko aagayi ye sun ke qaza
choom kar ghazi ko sarwar ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
sultano ke sultan ne waliyon ke wali ne
maanga hai tumhe apne duaon mein ali ne
parchame azmate tauheed ke haqdaar ho tum
mai hoo meyaar e khuda aur mera meyaar ho tum
badr mein arsh se utra jo alam
saumpte hai wo tumhe aaj se hum
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
dam kis mein hai nazron se teri nazrein milaye
haibat teri toofanon ko khaatir mein na laaye
tu agar chaahe to baazi ko palat sakta hai
jumbish e abru se kaunain ulat sakta hai
aao baba ki zira bhi pehno
dosh par unki abaa bhi pehno
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
seh paaunga kaise mai bhala teri judaai
kis dil se kardun tujhe ruqsat mere bhai
jao ab binte payambar se basharat lelo
jisne paala hai tujhe us s e ijazat lelo
maa ne haathon se jo kurta tha siya
kehna shabbir ne wo maang liya
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
sun kar ye bayan zainab e muztar ne sada di
pardes mein ye kaisi khabar haye suna di
kyun kar dil e umeed jahan tod rahe ho
sunti hoo ke ab tum bhi hamein chod rahe ho
aur phir bibi ne ro kar akhtar
ek taweez yun baandha keh kar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
items.author: Akhtar Zaidi

items.title: Darya hai hamara
items.body:
lo baand chuka mashk ko parcham se alamdar
darya ki taraf dekha bade ghaiz se ek baar
taweez sakina ki duaon ka utha ke
zainab se kaha baandh de baazu pe hamare
<<DIVIDER>>
is shaan se nikla suye darya wo wafadaar
ek shor utha aaya shahe deen ka alamdar
abbas alamdar abbas alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne ye keh ke layeeno ko pukara
darya hai hamara darya hai hamara
<<DIVIDER>>
hum hyder e karrar ke keh laate hai saani
le jayenge pani
bas keh diya hum aagaye ab chodo kanara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-taygh hi ladne ke liye aate hai dekho
lo raasta roko
hat'te ho ke siffeen ka dikhlaye nazara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum maalik o mukhtar hai is kon o makan ke
is aab e rawan ke
ye khaam khayali hai ke darya hai tumhara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum baazu e shabbir hai saqqa e haram hai
pyason ka bharam hai
shahid hai isi baat pe ye dasht bhi saara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dukhtare shabbir hamay jaan se pyari
hai saans hamari
keh kar yehi aaye thay karo zabt ka yaara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehre jo bithaye hai bohat naaz hai tum ko
darya se to poocho
khud tum ko batayega ye darya ka kanara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir se kehti thi yehi fatema jaayi
deti hoon duhaai
ye keh ke alamdar ko bulwao khudara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke marqad ke jo atraaf hai pani
ye bhi hai nishani
goya ke alamdar ye karta hai ishaara
darya hai hamara...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke qabze mein hai darya o samandar
kehta hai ye safdar
phir kyun na azadaar lagaye yehi naara
darya hai hamara...
items.author: Safdar Abbas

items.title: Ghazi alam tumhara
items.body:
hamay jaan se hai pyara ghazi alam tumhara
abbas ye alam hai qaumi nishan hamara
<<DIVIDER>>
nisbat se teri ghazi haajat rawan hai ye bhi
parcham ye mushkilon mein momin ka hai sahara
hamay jaan se hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sher e khuda ali hai tu sher e murtaza hai
har lab pe goonjta hai abbas tere naara
hamay jaan se hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hai dua e zehra tu hai rida e zainab
ummul baneen ki tu aankhon ka hai sitara
hamay jaan se hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
imdaad uski karne ban ke ali hai aaya
jab bhi jahan bhi jis ne ghazi tujhe pukara
hamay jaan se hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer hai jagata aulaad baant'ta hai
sunta hai iltejayein maula ali ka pyara
hamay jaan se hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi diya jala ke abbas ko sada di
gham paas matami ke aaya nahi dobara
hamay jaan se hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
banta nahi hai koi zawwar karbala ka
abbas bawafa ka jab tak na ho ishara
hamay jaan se hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawad kar raha hai tazeem ke jo sajde
ghazi tera alam bhi rauze ka hai nazara
hamay jaan se hai...
items.author: Muslim Jafri

items.title: Har nafas hai ye
items.body:
har nafas hai ye wirde zainab-e-zaar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
maut hai door zindagi dushwaar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
subho jiski azan goonji thi
bas wohi umr bhar ki poonji thi
baad-e-akbar kahan sukoon-o-qaraar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm tha apni aakhri had par
halq-e-asghar tha teer ki zad par
arsh tharra ke reh gaya ek baar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
chaar jaanib hai shamiyon ka hujoom
aisi raunaq hai jaise eid ki dhoom
jashn-e-ruswai hai sare baazar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ke khauf se jo ro na saki
wo sakina kabhi jo so na saki
aa ke zindan may soyi aakhir kaar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bemaar ki hai ye tauqeer
tauq gardan may paon may zanjeer
wo lutay khaafile ka hai saalar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash koi uski tanabain kas jaye
kaash ye sar zameen dhas jaye
be-rida hai haram sare darbar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
un ke seeno may ho yaqeen ki zia
shahid-e-nowhagar ki hai ye dua
aaye rauzon pa aap ke ghamkhaar
ya ali ya hussain ya abbas
har nafs hai....
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Haye wo qaid khana
items.body:
sajjad kaise bhoolein ghurbat ka wo zamana
haye wo qaid khana haye wo qaid khana
<<DIVIDER>>
beparda bibiyon ka baalon se moo chupana
haye wo qaid khana haye wo qaid khana
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein bas gayi zindan ki udaasi
baba ko dhoondti hai mazloom ek pyasi
dukhiya ka khauf se wo abbas ko bulana
sajjad kaise bhoolein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhooli nahi sakina bazaar ka wo manzar
patthar baras rahe thay majboor qaidiyon par
wo shimr ke tamache zaalim ka taziyana
sajjad kaise bhoolein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom qaidiyon ko abid na bhool paaye
hat'ta nahi nazar se bazaar e shaam haye
bemaar saarban ka aankhon se khoon bahana
sajjad kaise bhoolein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasi sakina hum se afsos haye bichad gayi
har lab pe tha ye nauha ruqsat ki ye ghadi hai
zindan se watan jab qaidi huwe rawana
sajjad kaise bhoolein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi muhib musalsal bemaar ro raha hai
aale nabi ke ghar mein farshe aza bicha hai
ye bain kar raha hai sadaat ka gharana
sajjad kaise bhoolein...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Hussain ka muslim
items.body:
ghareeb hogaya kitna hussain ka muslim
hua hai kufe may tanha hussain ka muslim
<<DIVIDER>>
wo darbadar sar e kufa hai mil nahi sakte
paraya shehr hai jaa kar unhe kahan dhoondein
hai apne bachon se bichda hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne maare thay pathar kisi ke teer chale
to koi maar raha tha ghareeb ko naize
tab ek gaday may gira tha hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ibne ziyad zaban ko lagaam de apni
ameer hussain ka naukar hai ye tujhe to kabhi
salaam tak na karega hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
layeen ne kaat ke sar chath se laasha phaynk diya
usay uthane ko jis dam koi nahi aaya
zameen pe zahra ne thaama hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay maula bas wahin ruk jao tum abhi ho jahan
hai kufe waale dagha baaz tum na aana yahan
khabar ye de nahi paaya hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aaya khaafila kufe may ro padi farwa
jo dekha laasha e be-sar hai khoon aalooda
hai dar pe kufe ke latka hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
liya jo jayega khoon e hussain ka badla
ay naqsh lashkar e qaim badhega jab kufa
to saath ghazi ke hoga hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
items.author: Naqsh Kazmi

items.title: Jaanta hai bas
items.body:
jaanta hai bas khuda kaise sambhal paaye hussain
qatlgah mein laash par akbar ki jab aaye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
di sada akbar ne baba lo salaam e aakhri
tooti hai seene mein barchi saans rukti hai meri
yun gire sun kar zameen par na sambhal paaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghutniyo chalte huwe pahunche jo akbar ke khareeb
ibne zehra aaye hamshakle payambar ke khareeb
dekh kar seene mein barchi gham se chillaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhi jis dam naujawan ke seene mein barchi ki ani
ho nahi sakti bayan haalat dil e shabbir ki
zindagi aur maut se ladte nazar aaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par dam todta tha ye ali akbar mera
ho kahan abbas aao dete hai sarwar sada
koi monis hi nahi hai kis ko bulwaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par baithe padi nade ali shabbir ne
khaynch li seene se barchi ki ani shabbir ne
naujawan ki laash maqtal se utha laaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e akbar mein barchi ka suna ghabra gayi
uthna chaaha jab musalle se to ghash khaa kar giri
ab sambhalo maadar e akbar ko maajaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay behan akbar tumhara khaak par hi so gaya
jis ko paala naaz se zainab wo akbar na raha
haye ye zainab ko kis tarha se samjhaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
kijiye ehsaan maula aap ka zaair banun
roo baroo yazdan ho rauza aur mai nauha padhun
dil ki dhadkan band ho aur saans ruk jaaye hussain
jaanta hai bas khuda...
items.author: Dilshad Zaidi

items.title: Kehti rahi sakina
items.body:
kehti rahi sakina beemar saarban se
hogi rehaai mar ke bhaiya meri zindan se
<<DIVIDER>>
is kaal kothari mein hai zulm ka andhera
mujhe chod ke na jao dam ghut raha hai mera
asghar ki tarha mai bhi bichdi hoo aaj maa se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai daagh tamachon ke mehshar talak rahenge
bhaiya yateem ho ke kab tak sitam sahenge
masoom poochti thi beemar natawan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
durr cheen kar kamina raahon mein keh raha tha
thay kaan mere zakhmi aur khoon beh raha tha
roti ho kyun lipat kar abbas ke nishan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad waale mil ke insaaf khud kare wo
jin betiyon ke baba pardes jaa maray wo
roti nahi bichad kar kya apne baba jaan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko yaad kar ke zindan mein ro rahi hai
seene pe sone waali matti pe so rahi hai
kya jurm ho gaya tha masoom nanhi jaan se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ne janaza zindan se jab uthaya
afsos saath koi hai kalmago na aaya
aisa sulook koi karta nahi mehman se
kehti rahi sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh ke muarrikh insaaf se batayein
masoom ko mili hai kis jurm ki sazayein
sardar poochta hai har ek musalman se
kehti rahi sakina...
items.author: Sardar

items.title: Koi aisa mujahid
items.body:
koi aisa mujahid to dikhade
galay par teer kha kar muskurade
<<DIVIDER>>
badi mushkil hai koi baap kaise
jawan bete ko marne ki riza de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
charaghe zindagi bujhta hai laila
ali akbar ko daaman ki hawa de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha shabbir ne ay khuwwate dil
jawan laashe ali akbar utha de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
riza e jang de kar shaah bole
ajal qasim ko ab dulha bana de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali akbar ko hichki lag rahi hai
koi ab to isay pani pilaade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
bade jallaad hai ye shaam wale
badal sakte nahi inke iraade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
sare zainab ki chadar chin chuki hai
ghubare khaak uth chehra chupa de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
lagi hai aag bistar jal raha hai
koi bemaar ka shana hilaade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
guzar bazaar se hai bekaso ka
koi in shaam walon ko hatade
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhare darbar mein jaati hai zainab
zara ay khuwwate dil hausla de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina se yateemi keh rahi hai
charaghe ashk zindan mein jala de
koi aisa mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
koi kaaton pe paidal chal raha hai
zaheer ab raah mein aankhein bicha de
koi aisa mujahid…
items.author: Zaheer Jaffery

items.title: Maidan mein hussain
items.body:
maidan mein hussain ka ghamkhar gir pada
alamdar gir pada
shane kata ke ghode se jarrar gir pada
alamdar gir pada
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhla gaya bahare wafa jaane murtaza
dooba hua lahoo mein hai armane murtaza
hai paara paara nehr pe qurane murtaza
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha hussain hogaye yawar nahi raha
tashna labon mein saaqiye kausar nahi raha
bibi sakina amme ghazanfar nahi raha
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
thar-ra uthega gham se biyaban e karbala
royegi khoon shame ghariban e karbala
rassi mein baandhe jayenge mehman e karbala
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
darya-e-zindagi ka kinara nahi raha
be-aas bibyan hai sahara nahi raha
tha dil ko jis se chain wo pyara nahi raha
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
<<DIVIDER>>
zarraate karbala ba alam bolne lage
abbas ke firaq mein aansu ubhal pade
shabbir kis tarha ali fitrat ye gham sahe
fauje khuda ka haye alamdar gir pada
alamdar gir pada…
items.author: Ali Fitrat

items.title: Matami fazaein hai
items.body:
matami fazayein hai aansuon ka toofan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dastak-e-ajal sun kar zindagi hirasa hai
har taraf udaasi hai har nigah veraan hai
aur masjid-e-kufa farte gham se larza hai
matami fazayein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj gir gaya hoga phir ghilaaf kaabe se
beh raha hai khoon payham shah ke amame se
zakhme farq-e-haider ka ab khuda nigehban hai
matami fazayein hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm itna kaari hai chal na paoge maula
ghar bhi jald jaana hai aagayi geleem aaqa
dar pe muntazir zainab muztar-o-pareshan hai
matami fazayein hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
fikre karbala mein gum hai ali sare bistar
ghaliban nigahon mein hai koi tahe khanjar
dekh kar suye abbas chashm-e-shah giryan hai
matami fazayein hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay wafa skihan kufe be-pidar hui zainab
aaj ghar ke aangan mein nange sar hui zainab
kal jo hone wala hai aaj se numeinam hai
matami fazayein hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
itrat-e-payambar par sazishon ke ghayre hai
bujh gaya chiraagh aakhir har taraf andhere hai
chand gaam par shahid karbala ka maidan hai
matami fazayein hai…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Abbas ka sar
items.body:
haye abbas haye haye abbas
ghairat ka aasman zainab ka sayeban
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise zainab ki taraf dekhta abbas ka sar
sharm se khaak pe girta raha abbas ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke logon ne pathar se kiya isteqbal
jun hi bazar mein daakhil hua abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun bhi is sar se liya badr o ohad ka badla
hoo ba hoo baba ali jaisa tha abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sina par bhi na aaqa ke barabar aaya
sheh ki ta'zeem mein jhukta raha abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
paon ke aabile abid ko kahan yaad rahe
jab gira garm zameen par gira abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun bhi baandha gaya rahwaar ki gardan se isay
zulm nazdeek se dekhe zara abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle chadar se lahoo saaf kiya zainab ne
saath asbaab ke jis dam mila abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr pe jis ghadi abbas ne dam toda tha
dilbar e zahra ki godhi mein tha abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad zeeshan sar e shere khuda aane laga
gurz se aise shikasta hua abbas ka sar
kaise zainab ki taraf...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ahsantum ya husain
items.body:
naize pe gaye jab shaah e umam
sar peet rahe thay ahle haram
sadaat mein ek bezaari thi
kohraam tha aur gham khwari thi
jab shaah ne yeh manzar dekha
sar peet rahe hai aal e aba
shabbir ne pad ke bismillah
bar nok e sina quran padha
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dayr mein phir manzar badla
kam hone lagi matam ki sada
khush rang fizayein chaane lagi
ahsan ki sadayein aane lagi
pahunchi jo falak tak sheh ki sada
allah ne bhi khush ho ke kaha
ahsantum ya hussain
ahsantum ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
arwaah mein jo waada tha kiya
wo tum ne nibhaya hai
islam ki khaatir jangal mein
ghar apna lutaaya hai
raazi hoon mai tujhse mere wali
ay ibne batool ay ibne ali
karta hoon mai tera shukr ada
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunkar ye sukhan allah ke
kehte thay ye rasool allah
qurban mai tujh par sau jaan se
waah mere hussaina waah
bachpan mein ay mere lakhte jigar
waada jo kiya tha ay dilbar
wo tum ne kiya hai aaj wafa
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize ki ani par aa kar bhi
quran sunaya hai
hum jeet gaye sar de kar bhi
dunya ko bataya hai
dekhi jo shuja’at bete ki
aur sun ke tilawat bete ki
hyder ki najaf se aayi sada
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ne kaha ay laal tujhe
tanha na karungi mai
jayega agar tu shaam talak
to saath chalungi mai
hai naaz bahot tujh par beta
jo sheer pilaaya tha us ka
kya khoob kiya hai farz ada
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya khoob fareeza ay bhai
anjaam diya tum ne
jo kaam na koi kar paata
wo kaam kiya tum ne
shabbir se kehte thay ye hassan
bas ab na karo tum ranj o mehan
hai zaat tumhari fakhre khuda
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas dilawar aun o mohamed
qasim o akbar hai
naizon pe sar e shabbir ke sang
shohda ke kate sar hai
aankhon se rawan hai ashk magar
hai saare shaheedon ke lab par
hum aap pe ho har baar fida
ahsantum ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi zameen e karbobala
gumnaam zameen thi mai
lagta tha kumail o aamir
dunya pe nahi thi mai
pehchaan dilaayi sarwar ne
kya shaan badhaayi sarwar ne
ta hashr yehi hai meri sada
ahsantum ya hussain...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Ali akbar ali asghar
items.body:
ali akbar ali asghar
sadaye de rahi hai thokare khaati hai maa dar dar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan sote ho kyon dete nahi awaaz uth uth kar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaon par sadayein de raha hai baap hal min ki
musibati ki ghadi hai chain se sote ho tum dilbar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeefi mein pidar yun thokarein khata hai dar dar ki
koi aisa nahi de de sahara jo zara badh kar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
faras se khaak par girne ko hai jaan-o-dile zehra
hazaro zakhm hai aur ek jisme sibte payghambar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kise awaaz doo kisko pukarun is musibat mein
guluye shaahe deen par chal raha hai shimr ka khanjar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
madad ke waaste kisko pukarun aah qaime mein
lagi hai aag aur ghash mein pade hai abid e muztar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
galay mein tauq bedi paon mein haaton mein hatkadiyan
chala jaata hai meer e kaarwan pehne hue langar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan par so rahe ho ghairate aale bani hashim
sare bazaare kufa hoo mere sar par nahi chadar
ali akbar ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
phuphi amma chupaye chehra e ismat ko balon se
khule sar jaa rahi hai shaam ke darbar mein dilbar
ali akbar ali asghar...

items.title: Amma mera sar
items.body:
jab sar e hussain kat ke khaak pe gira
aa rahi thi shaah ke badan se ye sada
maa haye maa haye maa
<<DIVIDER>>
maa tumhari godh mein ab hussain kaise soyega
amma mera sar nahi raha
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki tum nazar utaarti rahi ho maa
aankhein wo kahan wo mera chehra ab kahan
zulfein tum sawaarti thi kitne pyar se
maatha kaise choomogi hussain ka yahan
hasratein nikalogi aaj kaise khud batao na
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr kaat'ta tha amma jab mera dahan
kuch qadam se dekhti rahi meri behen
baalon se utha ke sar wo saath le gaya
khaak par tadapta reh gaya mera badan
mere khushk halq par khanjar itni dayr tak chala
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma koi kurta le gaya hussain ka
koi khoon bhara amaama le gaya mera
ungli meri kaat di angoothi ke liye
dekho ab mere badan pe kuch nahi bacha
loot'te rahe mujhe shamiyon ko jab pata chala
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi hoke jab zameen par gira hussain
pyasa mar gaya tumhara laadla hussain
dafn kar chuka hoon apne sheerkhwar ko
dekho ek din mein kitna thak chuka hussain
haath bhai ke kate seena chid gaya jawan ka
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaar saal jisko maine pyar se rakha
kha chuki hai aaj wo tamacha shimr ka
kurta jal chuka hai chin gayi hai baaliyan
baba tum kahan ho de rahi hai wo sada
ab sakina dasht mein kaise dhoondegi badan mera
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab aayegi jab amma meri laash par
wo yahin giregi bhai bhai bol kar
pattharon ko laash se wo jab hatayegi
chaahta tha dekh loon behen ko ek nazar
haye hasrata magar mai behen ko kaise dekhunga
amma mera sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan abidi ye goonji dasht mein sada
beta tere paas aagayi hai fatema
maa to maa hai godh mein utha legi tujhe
sar nahi to kya hua badan to hai tera
soja meri godh mein dekh maa se ab na bolna
amma mera sar...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ay alamdar e wafa
items.body:
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi
chin gayi meri rida ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hua shaam e ghariban ka andhera ban mein
goonj utha khaak nasheeno ka ye nauha ban mein
aagayi binte ali dene ko pehra ban mein
thi yehi lab pe buka ghazi
dekhle aake zara ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera ghar loot liya shaam ke khazzaqo ne
chaadare cheen ke aada ne jalaye qaime
maine amma ki suni thi ye sada rote huwe
chod ke tu jo gaya ghazi
bad gayi aur jafa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf aag dhuan shor e buka wawaila
ye sitam kaisa ghareebon pe hua wawaila
hogayi khaak basar aale aba wawaila
tu nahi kuch na raha ghazi
khaak hai sar ki rida ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-sukoon mai hoo alamdar tere jaane se
zindagi ban gayi aazaar tere jaane se
pyase bache hai azadaar tere jaane se
teri furqat hai saza ghazi
kya kahoo aur bhala ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya tanha mera bhai tere jaane se
bad gayi aur bhi tanhaai tere jaane se
mere bhai pe qaza aayi tere jaane se
jab chali taygh e jafa ghazi
thi mere lab pey buka ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro padi aaya e tatheer sar e karbobala
jab chini chadar e hamsheer sar e karbobala
lut gayi zehra ki jaageer sar e karbobala
mere ashkon ne kaha ghazi
alqama chod ke aa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-qata bali sakina pe ghashi hai taari
aankh mein ashk hai aankhon se lahoo hai jaari
tujhse faryaad ye karti hai ghamon ki maari
ay wafadaar chacha ghazi
mere maqtool e jafa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ay mere wafadaar sitam ka manzar
ek naize pe rida ek pe shabbir ka sar
haye pardes mein kya waqt pada hai mujh par
kya mere paas raha ghazi
hasrat o yaas ke siwa ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bai ye safdar o mazhar thay nabi zaadi ke
le gaye loot ke khazzaq ridayein sar se
dekh hum khaak nasheeno ki musibat aa ke
ghar jala dil bhi jala ghazi
mera kunba na raha ghazi
mera barbaad hua ghar
ay alamdar e wafa ghazi...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ay zaafare jin
items.body:
ay zaafare jin aap bhi aaye thay wahan par
kya aap ne dekha
ashoor ke din lut gaya zehra ka bhara ghar
kya aap ne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke pisar neemche haaton pe uthaye
aur khoon mein nahaye
darya ki taraf pusht kiye mar gaye dilbar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein kahin kya koi masnad bhi bichi thi
dulhan bhi khadi thi
jab kholi gayi laashaye nowshah ki chadar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re wo saani e hyder ba alamdar
wo sheh ka wafadar
kis tarha gira ghode se be-dast zameen par
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hai ke barchi mein kaleja nikal aaya
sakte mein hai dunya
khenchi hai sina shaah ne jo ya ali keh kar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ka khoon lene se inkaar kiya hai
jab arz-o-samaa ne
tab sheh ne mala chehre pe khoone ali asghar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom ke seene pe tha sawaar sitamgar
tha hashr ka manzar
aur khushk galay par tha rawan shimr ka khanjar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab phail gayi charon taraf shaam e ghariban
mahol tha giryan
bachi koi baba ko sada deti thi rokar
kya aap ne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar ka bistar ho ke baysheer ka jhoola
sab jal gaya wallah
shahid na tha is zulm ka koi bhi wahan par
kya aa pne dekha
ay zaafare jin…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Bismillah wa billah
items.body:
zakhmon se choor hoke jo quran gir gaya
ro'o saron ko peeto qayamat hui bapa
naiza sambhale daaye se ibne anas bada
baayi taraf se maarne ibne ashas chala
dono ne waar shaah pe jo ek saath kar diya
phasli mein jaake naize mein naiza ulajh gaya
ibne anas ne chaaha ke naiza nikaale
shabbir chaahte thay ke khud ko sambhale
is kashma kash mein phasliyan baahar nikal padi
roti bilakti qabr se zehra nikal padi
girte huwe zameen pe ye shabbir ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
bismillah wabillah wala millate rasoolillah
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode se gir ke baithe hi thay sibte mustafa
ek teer san sanata hua teen bhaal ka
seene mein aake shaahe shaheedan ke gad gaya
haathon se usko kheench ke shabbir ne kaha
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadme hazaar hone lage naazneen par
patthar kisi ne khaynch ke maara jabeen par
teora ke aah gir pade maula zameen par
girte hi teer jism mein chubne lage siwa
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor choor hoon yawar nahi raha
akbar nahi raha mera asghar nahi raha
chautees saal waala baradar nahi raha
ab kya karunga jee ke bhara ghar nahi raha
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha khoon mein joshe faatahe khyber ki al amaan
uth kar khade huwe kabhi baithe shahe zamaan
naiza jigar se khayncha to kheenchi kabhi sina
phir leke khoon haath mein bole shahe huda
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
chullu ka khoon phaynka jo hi aasman par
sakta sa taari hogaya saare jahan par
laakhon layeen tooth pade ek jaan par
aandhi chali larazne lagi arze karbala
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar liye wo haath mein shimr e layeen badha
sarwar ne sar ko sajda e khaaliq mein rakh diya
subhana rabbi aala wo mabood hai mera
khanjar chala to shaah ne besaakta kaha
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar chalaya pyase pe ek baara martaba
pehli jo zarb khaayi kaha wa mohammada
aur doosri pe kehne lage haye murtuza
deen e nabi pe hota hai ab khaatma mera
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir teesri pe tadpe kaha amma fatema
chauti lagi to kehne lage bhai mujtaba
phir uske baad sheh ne kisi se na kuch kaha
sookhi hui ragon se ye aati rahi sada
bismillah wabillah...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir ali ka laal wo zehra ka dil ka chain
ainee lahoo mein lot'te thay shaahe mashraqain
chalti rahi churi aur ye kehte rahe hussain
kat'te huwe galay se ye aati rahi sada
abbas abbas abbas abbas
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Darya kanare teri aal
items.body:
darya kanare teri aal pyasi
ghar ko luta ke pardes aa ke
<<DIVIDER>>
shaahe madina jangal basa ke
darya kanare teri aal pyasi
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein aansu sau zakhm dil par
baithe hai bache jalti zameen par
kuch khaali kooze dil se laga kar
sote hai pyase jalti zameen par
sab zakhm khaake karbobala ke
darya kanare...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne masayib jhele hai dil par
zainab ne dekhe pur dard manzar
akbar ka laasha qasim ke tukde
abbas ka laasha bhai pe khanjar
laashe utha ke maqtal saja ke
darya kanare...
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte bala mein tanha haram hai
pardesiyon par laakhon sitam hai
ummat ne aisi ki hai jafayein
sab ke saron se cheeni ridayein
ummat se paa ke sadme rida ke
darya kanare...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise kafan de bhai ko zainab
jakde huwe hai shaane rasan se
ahle haram sab kehte hai ro kar
ye dard paaye aa kar watan se
sab kuch luta ke roti hai jaa ke
darya kanare...
<<DIVIDER>>
har gham to apne dil se laga kar
roti hai ban mein bali sakina
ammu na aaye baba na aaye
mai kya karoo ay shaahe madina
is dil pe khaake naawak jafa ke
darya kanare...
<<DIVIDER>>
waada nibhane deen ko bachane
jangal mein aulaad teri
dene khuda par jaanein luta ne
maqtal mein aayi aulaad teri
waada nibha ke deen ko bacha ke
darya kanare...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran e gham ki karke tilawat
rota hai safdar nauhe suna kar
mera qalam bhi khoon raha hai
likhte huwe ye pur dard manzar
gham karbala ke dil mein basa ke
darya kanare...
items.author: Safdar Abbas

items.title: Ek sada hai
items.body:
dhal na jaaye raat
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima qaima ek sada hai allah khair kare
pyason ke lab par ye sada hai allah khair kare
<<DIVIDER>>
har bibi hai zeb e musalla aankhon mein hai ashk musalsal
dil ki dhadkan mehwe buka hai allah khair kare
qaima qaima ek sada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shabe ashoor ka manzar roti hai namoose payambar
raat guzarne par ye sada hai allah khair kare
qaima qaima ek sada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni hasrat se bhai ko dekh rahi hai saani e zehra
jaane khwaab mein kya dekha hai allah khair kare
qaima qaima ek sada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke mashriq ki jaanib kehti hai bhai se zainab
aaj ye suraj kya kehta hai allah khair kare
qaima qaima ek sada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke roti hai bano jhoole mein asghar ka chehra
jaise jhoola khud kehta hai allah khair kare
qaima qaima ek sada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai dil thaam ke laila jee bhar ke akbar ko dekhun
kisko khabar kal kya hona hai allah khair kare
qaima qaima ek sada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhne se khaasir hai mazhar kaise likhe us raat ka manzar
dil mein gham ka dard utha hai allah khair kare
qaima qaima ek sada hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ghazi alamdar teri
items.body:
ghazi alamdar teri qasam
jhukne nahi denge tera alam
<<DIVIDER>>
teri amanat samajh kar isay
tere alam ko uthaate hai hum
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
le kar alam suye darya gaya
maujon ne choome thay tere qadam
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhe huwe hont bachon ke thay
is gham mein aankhein rahi teri nam
ghazi alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri wafa tere paikar mein thi
paaya tha hyer ka jaah o hasham
