ibne hassan ki kaisi shadi
bhooke pyase sab baraati
loot liya zaalim ne bhara ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek kar ke laashe laaye
sar se paa tak khoon mein nahaye
laashon se tha bhara hua ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm kisi ne na khaaya us par
teer se chida halq e asghar
khaak aur khoon mein doob gaya ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh ka taara jalti zameen par
seene pe qatil halq pe khanjar
ek sajde mein loot liya ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajda e haq se sar na uthaya
sar de kar islam bachaya
hashr talak yaad aayega ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jao khuda hafiz ay akbar
dekh bhi lo har baar palat kar
mushtaq e deedar khada ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aab ke aewaz teer e sitamgar
maut ki hichki dast e sheh par
bebas dekh raha tha dilbar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisi mehman ki khidmat
teen dino se pyaas ki shiddat
khatra e aab nahi paaya ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
godi se aur gehwaron se
bichde hai bache maaon se
karta hai qurban kya kya ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan bahattar ne de di hai
deen ki shamma roshan ki hai
hum par ye ehsaan kiya ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard moharram hai ashkon ka
matam ka aur majalison ka
hota hai veeran bhara ghar zehra ka
karbal tu ne loot liya...

items.title: Kehti thi maa
items.body:
barsa falak se khoon larazne lagi zameen
aandhi siyaah dashte bayaban mein chali
ye waqt bhi qayamat e kubra se kam nahi
jalti zameen pe aakhri sajde mein hai jabeen
baali pe maa hussain ki aur pusht pe layeen
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi maa teher zara shimr teher jaa
do boond mere bacche ko pani to pila de
<<DIVIDER>>
sun kar duhaai faatahe badr o hunain se
ye dasht goonjta hai mere shor o shain se
akbar ko qatl kar ke bhi baithe na chain se
kya dushmani hai tumko mere dil ke chain se
kya bugz tumko ho gaya mere hussain se
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe dahum se laashe uthaata raha yahan
roya hai is ghareeb ki ghurbat pe aasman
bacche shaheed ho gaye maare gaye jawan
haathon pe is ke qatl hua ek bezaban
ab is ke khoon ke pyase huwe khanjar o sina
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya jo qatlgaah mein ye zulm ka aseer
pursaane haal tha na koi aur na dastgeer
pathar kisi ne maare kisi ne sina o teer
naiza kisi ne maara chalaye kisi ne teer
ye zulm dekha rone laga khuld ka ameer
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
gash khaake jo ghode pe jhuka mera dilafgaar
khoon behne laga aur sar e mazloom pe talwaar
sar thaam ke haathon se jo seena hua ek baar
barchi kisi layeen ke seene se hui waar
tar ho gaya lahoo se badan dil hua figaar
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron ki nazr chaand sa seena jo ho gaya
in zaalimon ne seene ko teeron se bhar diya
zeen se zameen pe aane laga jab pisar mera
aaya nahi zameen pe teeron pe ruk gaya
is zulm par bhi rehm na aaya tujhe zara
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sang dil khuda ka payambar ka khauf kar
kassaab bhi zabeehon ko zibha se teher kar
itna to pani dete hai ho jaaye halq tar
zakhmon se choor chooor hai pyasa mera pisar
khanjar chalega kis tarha pyase ke halq par
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab hai ek rayt ke teele pe nauhagar
manzar ye dekhti hai sambhale huwe jigar
aankhon mein ashk lab pe buka aur barehna sar
mar jayegi wo khwahare mazloom dekh kar
tan se juda na kijiyo is waqt sheh ka sar
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadpze zameen pe khaak udaate huwe hyder
aaye khadija aur payambar bhi nauhagar
saydaniyon mein bain dar e qaima pe dukhtar
nazdeek tha wo waqt ke kat jaaye sheh ka sar
zahra ne gala rakh diya bete ke galay par
kehti thi maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar kahan se laaun mai wo taaqat e bayan
mai likh sakun shahadate mazloom ab yahan
hamraah mere rone lage ye saaton aasman
farhan nahi nahi ye kalaam bhi hai nauhakhwan
bete ko qatl hote huwe dekhti thi maa
kehti thi maa...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Koi bachale hussain
items.body:
sada ye deti thi zehra mera hussain hussain
hai teen roz ka pyasa mera hussain hussain
khada hai dasht mein tanha mera hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bachale hussain ko mere
sada ye fatema zehra ki goonji maqtal mein
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mera laal akela nahi koi yawar
taras to khao koi is ghareeb o muztar par
chala na de ye sitamgar hussain par khanjar
koi bachale hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa ajr diya tum ne meri khidmat ka
koi to karde ada aaj haq risalat ka
madad ko aaye koi waqt hai qayamat ka
koi bachale hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zara to socho mohamed ka ye nawasa hai
ay logon deen e khuda ka yehi asaasa hai
bala ke dasht mein seh roz ka ye pyasa hai
koi bachale hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin se aate hai pathar kahin se teer o tabar
sitam hai kaisa hazaron hai zakhm ek dil par
ghira he nargha e aada mein mera lakhte jigar
koi bachale hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo mujhpe beet rahi hai bata nahi sakti
jo zakhm dil pe lagay wo dikha nahi sakti
mai apne lakhte jigar ko bacha nahi sakti
koi bachale hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ek maa hoo mujhe sabr kis tarha aaye
nabi ki beti hoo mujh par koi taras khaaye
mai qatl gaah mein karti hoo bain ye haye
koi bachale hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamaam ahle jahan ne sada suni safdar
ghareeb maa ki ye aah o buka suni safdar
fughan ye sab ne sar e nainawa suni safdar
koi bachale hussain ko...
items.author: Safdar Abbas

items.title: Le gaya shimr bete
items.body:
maqtal may sar ko peet ke kehti thi fatema
zaalim mere hussain ke sar ko na kar juda
zakhmi hai mera lakhte jigar khushk hai gala
pyasa hai teen roz ka ye mera mehleka
zaalim ne ek maa ki na aah o buka suni
aakhir galay pe phayr di farzand ke churi
<<DIVIDER>>
le gaya shimr bete ka sar kaat kar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne mar gaya haye noor e nazar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar chalata raha behaya
waqt e aakhir na pyase ko pani diya
haye chalti rahi jab churi halq par
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ghadi roye bekas pa arz o samaa
kha ke ghash gir gayi dasht may sayyeda
baal pakde huwe jab chala le ke sar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sookhe galay par chali jab churi
apni maa ko sada ro ke sarwar ne di
amma pyasa hoo kehta raha ek pisar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa bajaa jism par teer khaye huwe
kaisa shakir hai khaaliq ke sajde may hai
zakhmi teeron pe bete ka tan dekh kar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki muntazir hai wo dukhiya udhar
mar gaya dasht may us ka baba idhar
koi pahunchade yasrab may haye khabar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise dekhun ye haalat pisar ki bhala
kar raha hai layeen tanse sar ko juda
gham se hone laga mera tukde jigar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh may jis ko rakhti thi apne sada
zulm aada ne us par ye kaisa kiya
laash uski hai jalti hui khaak par
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek qayaamt ka manzar wo rehan tha
kaise danish raqam ho wo aah o buka
haye bekas ka naize pe aaya jo sar
reh gayi ek maa khoon rote huwe
le gaya shimr bete ka...
items.author: Danish Mirza

items.title: Maidan se lekar
items.body:
ashoor ke din wo shor utha
maidan se le kar qaime tak
thi teeron ki ghanghor ghata
maidan se le kar qaime tak
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko uthaya jab sheh ne
aur paon se wo khat dete chale
ek naksh zameem par banta gaya
maidan se le kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ka janaza kaandho par
zehra ka pisar laaya to magar
sau bar zameen par gir ke utha
maidan se le kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon pe utha kr mayyat ko
chalte hai kabhi ruk jaate hai
allah wo rasta kaise kata
maidan se le kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye chand sa chehra asghar ka
mitti mein chupaunga kaise
ye soch ke sheh ne pyar kiya
maidan se lekar
<<DIVIDER>>
ek laash utha kar laaye hai
ek laash uthane jaate hai
ashoor ko bas ye hota raha
maidan se le kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode se ye apne ro ke kaha
bin baazuon waale ghazi ne
ay asp mujhe pahuncha de zara
maidan se le kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka laasha ro ro kar
darya ki tarayi par choda
laaye hai alam shabbir jhuka
maidan se le kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki shahadat ka logon
zainab ko yaqeen tab aa hi gaya
rehwaar jo aaya khoon mein bhara
maidan se le kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt bhi aamir sarwar ka
nazrana koi maqbool hua
har gaam pe ainee shukr kiya
maidan se le kar...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Matti ko bhi shifa
items.body:
matti ko bhi shifa ka wasila bana diya
sarwar ne karbala ko masiha bana diya
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ta qadm kuch aise sawara hussain ne
akbar ko mustafa ka sarapa bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakar uroos e taygh ne qasim ke haath mein
maidan e kaarzaar ko dulha bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne hunar se tadabbur se sabr se
darya ko pyaas pyaas ko darya bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid hamein khuda ne aza e hussain par
insaniyat ki aankh ka taara bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi ko har qadam pe hai izzat ka apni taab
chaadar nahi to baalo se parda bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Mere hussain ko rote
items.body:
farshe majlis pe fatema zehra
lamha lamha shumaar karti hai
ay azadaro aao majlis mein
fatema intezar karti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay azadaro suno keh rahi hai sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek chahne waale ko bakshwa doongi
mere hussain ko rote raho dua doongi
<<DIVIDER>>
tum apne ghar mein azakhane jab sajaoge
jaza rasool se iski zaroor paaoge
khuda bhi raazi rahega ali bhi aur mai bhi
gham apna bhool ke ashoor jab manaoge
tumhare dil ke har ek zakhm ki dawa doongi
mere hussain ko rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb haal se aaungi mai sare mehshar
ke laaungi mai wahan godh mein hussain ka sar
mai laaungi mere abbas ke kate huye haath
to saath laashaye asghar bhi aur hassan ka jigar
khuda se baba ki ummat ko bakshwa doongi
mere hussain ko rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba waqt e asr guluye hussain kat'ta tha
pisar ke gird phiri roohe fathema zehra
nidaye fathema aati thi aah wavaila
ke chakki pees ke maine hussain ko paala
karo na qatl isay mai tumhe dua doongi
mere hussain ko rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri sakina o zainab ki sab kaneezein sune
wasiyat ek meri hai dhyan mein rakhe
kabhi jo zikr ho zainab ki be-ridayi ka
to ek lamha bhi khud ko wo berida na kare
mai tumko betiyan zainab si baah la doongi
mere hussain ko rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum is jahan mein hamara sahara ban jao
hamare bhai se izzat to banke dikhlao
na aiso ho apne kisi amal se kabhi
aza ki rooh ko nuksaan tum na pahunchao
ye mere wada hai mai tumko bakshwa doongi
mere hussain ko rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo umr bhar mere bachon ka nauha khwan hoga
ba roze hashr wo utna hi shadman hoga
jo nauhe likhte rahe mazhar abdi yuhin
qalam ye ta ba qayamat yuhin rawan hoga
har ek bayt pe jannat mein ghar dila doongi
mere hussain ko rote...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Mushkil may hai
items.body:
mushkil mein hai hussain musibat mein hai hussain
baba madad ko aaiye mushkil mein hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
barsa raha hai aag biyaban e karbala
akbar gire hai bar sare maidan e karbala
moo tak raha hai bete ka mehman e karbala
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer hai hussain ki ghurbat pe ashk baar
kadiyal jawan se sheh ki zaeefi hai sharm saar
akbar ne kuch hussain se maanga hai pehli bar
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat mein nabz e jaan ko rawani kahan se de
tu hi bata de yusuf e saani kahan se de
baba se jaan maang le pani kahan se de
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai inteha hussain ke ranj o malaal ki
khwahish kahan se poori kare naunehaal ki
haalat hai ghair saaqi e kausar ke laal ki
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein sar jhukaye hai tashna dahan hussain
akbar ko kaise shaad kare khastatan hussain
haathon ko mal raha hai ghareebul watan hussain
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
noor e nazar ki pyaas se haalat ajeeb hai
abbas hi hai saath na darya khareeb hai
allah re hussain ka kaisa naseeb hai
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
honton pe aisi pyaas hai kadiyal jawan ke
chubte hai dil mein baap ke kaante zaban ke
chehra dhuan dhuan hai to laale hai jaan ke
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kumla rahi hai pyaas gulaab e hayaat ko
be noor kar na jaye pisar kayenaat ki
hasrat se dekhti hai nigahein furaat ko
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bechainiyo ne ghera hai zehra ke chain ko
sadma bada hai aamir o akhtar hussain ko
pani si cheez de na saka noor e ain ko
sharma raha hai booda pidar apne aap se
do ghoont pani maanga hai bete ne baap se
mushkil mein hai hussain...
baba madad ko aaiye...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Aap ki qasam
items.body:
sar ko jhukaye kehte hai zainab ke ye pisar
aap ki qasam amma aap ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
sharminda hone denge na hum tumko umr bhar
aap ki qasam amma aap ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aun o mohamed ay aun o mohamed
ay aun o mohamed ay aun o mohamed
aap ki qasam amma aap ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle tumhare laadle maqtal ko jayenge
nusrat mein shaahe deen ki hum sar katayenge
hum dono ke bhi dasht mein paogi tum ye sar
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma hum apne mamu pe qurban jayenge
waada hai jo kaha hai wo kar ke dikhayenge
haathon ko rakh ke haathon pe kehte thay ye pisar
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber ki yaad phir se dilaaun layeeno ko
nana ki shaane jang dikhaun layeeno ko
bhaagenge aada dasht se phir peet phayr kar
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakhenge tere sheer ki izzat abhi yahan
pehnenge dono taaj e shahadat abhi yahan
apne lahoo mein dono nahayenge tar ba tar
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam kar de padh ke naade ali ruqsati ke waqt
jaane lage qaza ke liye zindagi ke waqt
waada kiya jo maa se to aaya ye honton par
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
kausar ke jaam nana pilayenge khuld mein
seene se hum ko dada lagayenge khuld mein
lenge hum unse daade shuja'at bhi arsh par
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma dua karo ke pisar kaamiyab ho
karbobala mein noore nazar kaamiyab ho
jhukne na denge tera kabhi sharm se ye sar
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushman ke sar kaat ke lao to khush hoo mai
karbobala mein taygh chalao to khush hoo mai
taaqeed maa ne ki thi to nikle ye bol kar
aap ki qasam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir o shams dekho ye tareekh ne likha
maa ki lehad pe jaake ye zainab ne phir kaha
apne jigar ke tukdon ko royi na umr bhar
aap ki qasam...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Abbas kahan ho
items.body:
sar kat gaya jab dasht may zehra ke pisar ka
hilti thi zameen kaampta tha arshe moalla
surkh aandhi chali khoon ugalne laga sehra
wehshat ka ye aalam tha ke hilta tha kaleja
thi ek qayamat sar e maqtal jo bapa thi
goonji hui sehra may faqad ek sada thi
abbas kahan ho aajao jahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pa sina kha chuke akbar gaye maare
khaali hua jhoola ali asghar gaye maare
tanha hui saydaniya sarwar gaye maare
zainab hai pareshan chale aao jahan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
namoose payambar ko badi aas thi tum se
kya aisi bhala bhai khata hogayi hum se
phat jaye kaleja kahin zainab ka na gham se
kyon roothay ho kis waaste nazro se niha ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
is dashte musibat may kahan kho gaye bhai
naize ki ani aayaye tatheer tak aayi
aajao zara chorke darya ki taraai
chaadar sare zainab se utarti hai kahan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ahle sitam aur qayamat na machade
sab loot ke asbab e haram aag lagade
darr hai kahin bemaar ka qaima na jalade
phir char taraf sirf dhuan sirf dhuan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
dhaane pa sitam aur sitamgar tulay hai
talware liye sab dare qaima pa khade hai
mardo may fakad abid e bemaar bache hai
khanjar kahin abid ke galay par na rawan ho
abbas kahan ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha koi rota hai udhar taapo may aake
bachi koi roti hai idhar khaake tamache
laa'un to bhala laa'un zuban aisi kahan se
alfaaz nahi haal jo bachon ka bayan ho
abbas kahan ho....

items.title: Ali akbar ka janaza
items.body:
umme laila ali akbar ka janaza aaya
khoon may dooba hua laal ka sehra aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema sughra ka khat pad kar ye bole shabbir
naam tere ali akbar khat e sughra aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baith kar sochti rehti thi ye sughra ghar may
mere bhai ka na shaadi ka bulawa aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
le to aaye shah e deen laash e jawan qaime tak
aisa lagta tha ke shabbir ka laasha aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne athara baras paala tha us se poocho
kis tarha barchi may akbar ka kaleja aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawan laal ke seene se nikaali barchi
waqt mazloom musafir pe ye kaisa aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ko armaan tha shadi ka wo maa kya karti
jis ki taqdeer may ta umr tadapna aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na akbar hai na abbas na koi nasir
ay zafar ye lab e shabbir pe nauha aaya
umme laila ali akbar ka...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Amma mujhe chupa lo
items.body:
bazaar mein ye zainab fizza se keh rahi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar mein ye zainab fizza se keh rahi
abbas ki bahen ko har aankh dhoondti hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha na murtaza ne jisko baghair chadar
na-mehramo mein haye wo aagayi khule sar
qatle hussain se bhi dushwaar ye ghadi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
himmat nahi hai meri kaise khadam badhaun
is shehre be-amaan mein khud ko kahan chupaun
haathon mein leke pathar ummat khadi hui hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaare karbala ke aankhon se khoon hai jari
ye soch kar badan mein larza hai uske taari
beparda shamiyon mein beti batool ki hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
pooche to koi inse cheena hai kya tumhara
pardesi bewatan hai kya jurm hai hamara
kaisa hai ye tamasha ye bheed kyun lagi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
is naam se hamesha aayi hai mujhko ghairat
paala hai tumne mujhko tum jaanti ho aadat
bazaar zindagi mein zainab kahan gayi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe laashe ghazi us dam tadap gayi thi
sar se chini thi chadar jab binte murtaza ki
wo raat thi andheri ye din ki roshni hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya khayaal jab bhi aansu lagi bahane
bazaar ka takallum kaisa asar tha jaane
aksar watan mein zainab ye kehke chaunk uthi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Ay alamdara rasha
items.body:
ay alamdara ghazi abbasa
ay alamdara raasha zamarora
ghazi abbasa raasha zamarora
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun bewaon ki chadar ko bachaye aa kar
laashe sab waali o waaris ke pade hai be-sar
meri awaaz pe koi nahi aata ghazi
hogayi dasht e bayaban mein tanha khwahar
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm karte hai hamay tanha samajh kar aada
berida balwe mein rote hai haram wawaila
sar pe masoom sakina ke nahi dast e karam
chingaye uske gohar aag se daaman bhi jala
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay alamdar fughan lab pe sakina laaye
har taraf aag dhuan hai wo kahan par jaaye
ghurkiyan ranj o alam tashnalabi daagh e padar
suye darya na chali jaaye sakina haye
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum to aaye thay yahan tere sahare ghazi
tu magar sogaya darya ke kanare ghazi
bewatan tashna dahan maara gaya bhai mera
chin gayi chadarein ab sar se hamare ghazi
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere parde ke zaamin ay alamdar aaja
mere ghazi ay mere monis o ghamkhwar aaja
aake pardes mein bigda hai muqaddar mera
teri zainab ka nahi koi madadgaar aaja
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri hamsheer hai balwe mein khule sar ghazi
ab nahi koi mera monis o yawar ghazi
tere jaane se bharam toot gaya zainab ka
haye be-aas hui aale payambar ghazi
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar e khasta jigar mera qalam bhi bhi roye
karbala roti rahi ahle haram bhi roye
bain karti thi ye abbas ki khwahar ran mein
sun ke faryad meri mashk o alam bhi roye
ghazi abbasa ghazi abbasa raasha zama rora
ay alamdara...

items.title: Ay zaairon qadam
items.body:
azadaro soghwaro rone walo pursadaro
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zaairon qadam ko rakho dekh bhaal kar
kis kis ka khoon baha hai na jaane kahan kahan
ay zaairo qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
halq e sagheer teer se jab zakhmi ho gayi
sehra e karbala mein bahi khoon ki nadi
aur mayyat liye hussain bhi tadpe hai kis qadar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naujawan tha jiska jigar chalni ho gaya
kitna badan mein khoon tha akbar ka beh gaya
thi shakle mustafa ke lahoo se zameen tar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat jawan pisar ki liye jab chale hussain
phir naujawan ki laash liye gir pade hussain
seene mein phat na jaye kahin shaah ka jigar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
farwa ke ek chand ko aisa grehan laga
maqtal mein jiske jism ka tukda hai ja ba ja
dhalta hai khaak o khoon se shabbar tera pisar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
reti pe khoon hai ab bhi sayeed o zohair ka
hai ja ba ja habib ka hurr ka burair ka
har jism tha zameen pe naizon pe sab ke sar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
is sar zameen pe khoon hai mohamed ke aon ke
is sar zameen pe khoon ke katre hai john ke
arz e bala mein ahle falak bole aan kar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko hussain ka chalna muhaal tha
maqtal ka waqt e asr tha zahra ka laal tha
roya kiye hussain yehi soch soch kar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sibte mustafa ke galay par churi chali
zainab khadi hai ye samaa dekhti rahi
behre madad bulaati kise haye nauhagar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
har laash ran mein ghodon se pamaal ho gayi
ashoor ko ye arz e bala laal ho gayi
sajjad bhi pukaar uthe ghash se chaunk kar
kis kis ka khoon...
ay zaairon qadam...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha raqam ho kis tarha ay arze karbala
rehan ke bayan pe mubarak ne ki buka
hum karbala pahunch ke pukare ba chashme tar
labbaik ya hussain
labbaik ya hussain
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Baba mere baba
items.body:
karti thi buka shaam ke zindan mein sakina
baba mere baba baba mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
aa jaaiye aa jaaiye ab jald khudara
baba mere baba baba mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
mai dar pe khadi takti thi jab aap ka rasta
ek loot machi aag lagi zulm ye toota
hum par thi qayamat ki ghadi haste thay aada
baba mere baba baba mere baba
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khaynch rahe thay mere durr kaano se ashraar
aur zad pe tamachon ke thay baba mere ruqsaar
ammu ko kabhi tum ko bulaati thi mai dukhiya
baba mere baba baba mere baba
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir baand ke rassi mein hamay haye khule sar
bazaron mein darbaron mein laaye ye sitamgar
khaati thi tamache mai tumhe jab bhi pukara
baba mere baba baba mere baba
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tak na sula lete thay seene pe mujhe aap
karte na thay apne se juda haye mujhe aap
kya mujhse khata hogayi kyun aap ne choda
baba mere baba baba mere baba
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai khaak basar nauha kuna shaam o sahar hoon
ab taalib e deedar e shahe jinn o bashar hoon
khud aap hi aaye na qaza ne mujhe poocha
baba mere baba baba mere baba
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zinda na rahungi mai agar aap na aaye
mar jaungi zinda hi mai ek roz mein haye
ab mujhko judaai nahi ek pal bhi gawara
baba mere baba baba mere baba
karti thi buka...
<<DIVIDER>>
phat'ta tha jigar maa ka phupi jaan balab thi
sajjad tadapte thay ghadi gham ki ajab thi
masroor wo jab kehti thi laut aaiye baba
baba mere baba baba mere baba
karti thi buka...
items.author: Masroor

items.title: Darya se kabhi
items.body:
darya se kabhi qaime ko jayenge na abbas
chehra bhi sakina ko dikhaenge na abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
kooze liye haaton may jo atfaal khade hai
nazrein bhi kabhi unse milayenge na abbas
darya se kabhi…
<<DIVIDER>>
naize ki ijazat hai so naize se ladenge
talwaar kabhi ran may chalayenge na abbas
darya se kabhi…
<<DIVIDER>>
jee bhar ke unhe dekhle ab saani e zehra
jayenge to ab laut ke aayenge na abbas
darya se kabhi…
<<DIVIDER>>
sharmindagi itni hai bhatiji se ke ta-hashr
mashkeeze ko seene se hatayenge na abbas
darya se kabhi…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha se wo zeen se aayenge zameen par
haaton ka sahara bhi to payenge na abbas
darya se kabhi…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid yehi meraaj e ita'at hai jari ki
ankhein rukhe sarwar se hatayenge na abbas
darya se kabhi…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Har sadi hai bas
items.body:
wo sadi bhi thi ghame hussain ki
ye sadi bhi hai ghame hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
har sadi hai bas ghame hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
is zameen o aasman ko hai fanaa
chand aur kehkashan ko hai fanaa
aadmi ki daastan ko hai fanaa
zindagi hai bas ghame hussain ki
har sadi hai bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaagta hai kyun zameer e aadmi
ye to tu ne socha hi nahi kabhi
kyun chaman mein hai bahaar e zindagi
taazgi hai bas ghame hussain ki
har sadi hai bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
fikr hai tujeh azal se bas yehi
na masjidon mein majlisein kare koi
khaana e khuda libaas matami
aagahi hai bas ghame hussain ki
har sadi hai bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kinriya to deen ko rasool ko
zindagi mili har ek usool ko
hai salaam is liye batool ko
baat ki hai bas ghame hussain ki
har sadi hai bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai bhai yun to hai sabhi magar
bat gaye hai nafraton mein jaan kar
phailta gaya bughz ka shajar
dushmani hai bas ghame hussain ki
har sadi hai bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sada hai dil ki mazhar abidi
fikr ko hayaat e javeda mili
raat din mera kaam hai yehi
shayari hai bas ghame hussain ki
har sadi hai bas...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Jab ada khanjar talay
items.body:
jab ada khanjar talay shabbir ka sajda hua
karbala ka dasht ahle zarf ka kaaba hua
<<DIVIDER>>
mustafa ke baad haq e fatema cheena gaya
maal o daulat ke liye islam ka sauda hua
jab ada khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ghulamane ali kasrat se ghabrate nahi
hai hamare qalb par nade ali likha hua
jab ada khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf matam ki sada aur matame shabbir se
dushmane aal e nabi hai aaj tak sehma hua
jab ada khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur kitne gham uthane hai abhi shabbir ko
laasha e qasim hai ran mein khaak par bikhra hua
jab ada khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
khauf kar ay shimr zainab dekh kar mar jayegi
kund khanjar gardan e shabbir par chalta hua
jab ada khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun bandhe haathon pe ho shaam o sehar laakhon salam
chaak dil haathon se kufr o shirk ka parda hua
jab ada khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay muhib khoon e jigar ashkon mein dhal jaane ke baad
yaad pyason ko kiya jis waqt ye nauha hua
jab ada khanjar talay...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Jism mazoor hai
items.body:
koi majboor nahi koi majboor nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
zikre sheh ke liye hargis koi majboor nahi
jism mazoor hai par fikr se mazoor nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi seene se meri maa ne lagaya hum ko
zikre shabbir hi lori mein sunaya hum ko
ashke gham shaah ka ghutti mein pilaya hum ko
is liye aur kisi gham se bhi ranjoor nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ka kuch gham nahi dekhi nahi dunya hum ne
chand o suraj ka nahi dekha ujaala hum ne
haan magar dekhi hai qabre shahe waala hum ne
kaun kehta hai ki aankhein meri pur noor nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pa piyada to sabhi karbobala jaate hai
azm o himmat se meri koh bhi tharrate hai
sar ke bal chalte huwe hum bakhuda jaate hai
hausle kehte hai manzil meri kuch door nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
is qadar mujhpe meherban hai aaqa mera
bin kahe baat samajh jaata hai maula mera
dil kisi ka bhi dukhata nahi lehja mera
ye zaban jhoot kahe rab ko ye manzoor nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha shaan badhata hai wo rabbe akbar
ek na-beena hi tha shaah ka pehla zaayir
baareha maine bhi dekha hai hareem e sarwar
roshni deti hai aankhein meri ye koor nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi majlise shabbir mein aata hoon mai
haath matam ke liye apna uthata hoon mai
khud ko ha qaaba o qosain pa paata hoon mai
is bulandi pa magar hum kabhi maghroor nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
is liye haq se nahi koi shikayat hum ko
usne bakshi hai ghame shaah ki daulat hum ko
jaan se pyari hai shabbir ki ulfat hum ko
kufre nemat kare is qaum ka dastoor nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shukriya ainee jo andaze bayan bakhsha hai
nutqe ehsaas ko lafzon ka jahan bakhsha hai
hum thay khamosh hamay zore zaban bakhsha hai
kaunsa dil hai jo aamir tera mashkoor nahi
zikre sheh ke liye...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Karbala aagaye
items.body:
karbala aagaye islam bachane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
bichgaya farshe aza chid gayi shabbir ki baat
arsh waale bhi hai ab farsh pe aane waale
karbala aagaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar chain se sotay hai sare karbobala
deene islam ki taqdeer jagane waale
karbala aagaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
mere aaqa teri ghurbat pe zaeefi pe salaam
ay jawan bete ki mayyat ko uthane waale
karbala aagaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
be-khatar hoke satayenge sakina ko udoo
ab kahan zulm se bachi ko bachane waale
karbala aagaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr ke roz jahanum mein jalenge aakhir
ban mein saadaat ke qaimon ko jalane waale
karbala aagaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab tere shayr zamane ko sunaate hai gohar
padne waale ho naye chaahe purane waale
karbala aagaye…
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Kehti thi madar
items.body:
kehti thi madar ay ali akbar
ran se do awaaz mujhe
maa tumhe khud le aaye jaa kar
ran se do awaaz mujhe
kehti thi madar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere abroo kaman soye hue ho kahan
moo se to bole zara dhoondti hai tumko maa
maine ye socha tha kab ay mere tisdhna-dahan
daaghe pisar pa'ungi tha ye mujhe kab gumaan
socha tha aisa kab dilbar
reh gaye saare khaab bikhar kar
ran se do awaaz mujhe
kehti thi madar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko yehi lagta hai jaise abhi aaoge
aate hi qadmo se tum maa ke lipat jaaoge
meri pareshani par kuch to taras khaoge
harfe tasalli se tum dil mera behlaoge
dogay dilaasa ali akbar
aisa magar hone laga kyon kar
ran se do awaaz mujhe
kehti thi madar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinpe mujhe naaz tha sabko khaza aagayi
gulshane umeed ki har kali murjhagayi
ghar ke charago ko ye kis ki nazar kha gayi
teeragi-e-shame gham charon taraf se cha gayi
dhaate hai aada sitam hum par
jalte hai qaime chinti hai chadar
ran se do awaaz mujhe
kehti thi madar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghareeb aa gayi raat hui jab ayaan
sayyade sajjad thay ghash mein pade neem jaan
aise mein zainab bani ghamzadon ki pasban
honton pe mohsin magar laila ke thi ye fughan
royegi tumko sada maadar
ay mere pyaase ay mere dilbar
ran se do awaaz mujhe
kehti thi madar...
items.author: Mohsin Shakeeb

items.title: Maidane karbala mein
items.body:
tareekh e karbala ka sab ko sabakh hai yaad
hai khoon e sheh ke sadqe tauheed zindabad
chauda sau saal guzre lekin labe rawan se
aati hai ye sadayein masjid ki har azan se
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan e karbala mein khamosh mayyaton ne
islam ki baqa ka elaan kar diya
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ke lahoo ke cheento ki rehmato ne
dunya ke har bashar par ehsaan kar diya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah e mardan shere yazdan quwate parwardigar
la fata illa ali la saif illa zulfeqaar
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hai ali ka rutba abbas unka beta
teeron ki barishon mein mashkeeza bhar raha hai
maidan e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
aale iba pani ki ek ek boondh ko haye taraste hai
ahle haram registano mein maare maare phirte hai
sehra e karbala mein un zaalimo ke haathon
sarkar e do jahan ka pyara sa ghar luta hai
maidan e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hai rutba aale nabi ka aao mohamed se poocho
baaghe jina ke shehzadon se aun o mohamed se poocho
sajde se sar utha'ta kaise nabi khuda ka
kaandhe pa apne jisne noore nazar liya hai
maidan e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi gaya maqtal ki taraf laasha uska wapas aaya
aada ne har ek mujahid ko dhoka de kar maara
ansar e shaah e deen ne tauheed ko bachane
ishq e ali mein khud ko qurban kar diya hai
maidan e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shahe deen zainabe muztar deen ka alam lekar nikli
shaam aur kufa ke darbaron ko wo ulat kar hi palti
baatil samajh raha tha qatl e hussain kar ke
tauheed ka tasavvur dunya se mit gaya hai
maidan e karbala mein...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi, Fanoos Barwani

items.title: Maujon may talatum
items.body:
maujon mein talatum hai aur shor hai mehshar ka
andaza hai darya ko abbas ke tevyar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
dushman ke liye tujhme jo ghaiz o ghazab dekha
kyunkar na jalaal aaye waaris hai tu hyder ka
andaza hai darya ko abbas ke tevyar ka
maujon mein talatum hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
hathyaar mein ghazi ke bas paas hai ek naiza
har fard hai kyun larza phir shaam ke lashkar ka
andaza hai darya ko abbas ke tevyar ka
maujon mein talatum hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeze mein darya ko ab ammu le aayenge
reh jaye bharam baakhi ye dukhtare sarwar ka
andaza hai darya ko abbas ke tevyar ka
maujon mein talatum hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis yaas se ay zainab tu bhai ko takti hai
tanha wo muhafiz ho jaise teri chadar ka
andaza hai darya ko abbas ke tevyar ka
maujon mein talatum hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
rehwaar se maqtal mein be-dast gira kaise
kis tarha tasavvur ho aise kisi manzar ka
andaza hai darya ko abbas ke tevyar ka
maujon mein talatum hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid mere ghar hogi ta-hashr azadari
ghar par alam mere abbas-e-dilawar ka
andaza hai darya ko abbas ke tevyar ka
maujon mein talatum hai…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Mere hussain mujhe
items.body:
mere hussain mujhe karbala dikha dije
mai muztarib hoo mere dil ka gham mita dije
<<DIVIDER>>
bas apne dil mein ziyarat ki ilteja le kar
mai baitha rehta hoo tasweer e karbala le kar
fana mein baitha hoo mujhko baqa bana dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaanta hoo bahot kam naseeb hoo maula
mujhe hai ilm bahot hi ghareeb hoo maula
ye kam naseebi o ghurbat meri mita dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan pe barchiyan kha kar giray ali akbar
jahan pe rakha hai gehwara e ali asghar
maqam e akbar o asghar mujhe dikha dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kazmain o najaf dekhun saamara dekhun
jahan jahan mere maula hai wo jagah dekhun
ye ilteja hai ke zaayir mujhe bana dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ho sake mujhe ashoor par bula lije
ay mere mola as mujhe ye sharaf ata kije
ke karbalayi mere naam mein laga dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye chata hoo wahan ashk se wazoo mai karun
karun mai seena zani khoon ka bhi pursa doo
wahan ki khaak mein mera lahoo mila dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi baras ye mera intezaam ho maula
chalun mai shauq se paidal najaf se karbobala
mere qadam bhi rahe arsh par laga dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zareeh e hazrat e abbas ko bhi choomun mai
dar e huzoor pe mashkeeze ko bhi dekhun mai
to rasta e kaf e abbas bhi dikha dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua hai majid o mukhtar ki mere maula
jo momineen na ziyarat pe jaa sake aaqa
sab hi ko zaayir e karbobala bana dije
mere hussain mujhe...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Noha tha kulsoom ka
items.body:
noha tha kulsoom ka haye qayamat hui
bhai ko zibha kiya haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon hoshiyar ho bacho ko godhi may lo
hilti hai arze bala haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaat liya sheh ka sar aate hai aada idhar
kaun inhe rokega haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kare bekas behan hota hai pamaal tan
baade khaza ye jafa haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthne laga hai dhuan qaimon se jaaye kahan
aada ne cheeni rida haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon se bahar chalo jaan ki hifazat karo
sholon ne halqa kiya haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima e sajjad bhi zad pa hai ab aag ki
wo to hai ghash may pada haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
<<DIVIDER>>
noha anees e hazeen lik gaye shaukath makeen
jisne jahan bhi suna haye qayamat hui
noha tha kulsoom...
items.author: Shaukath

items.title: Aap ne hazrate mukhtar
items.body:
jab koi qaatile shabbir giraftaar hua
ye khabar sunke koi khidmate maula mein gaya
ashk barsaate huwe abid e muztar ne kaha
tune badla liya mukhtaar hai ehsaan tera
<<DIVIDER>>
qalbe zehra ke har ek zakhm pe marham rakha
aap ne hazrat e mukhtaar bada kaam kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke hausle kar dete hai qaumon ko jawan
aap ke khoon mein hyder ki mohabbat thi rawan
aap ke hubb mein imran ka jazba tha ayan
aap ke josh pe nazaan hai bahot karbobala
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag jo dil mein hai us aag ka darya kya hai
ek maula ke azadaar ka jazba kya hai
inteqam e ali asghar ka takaza kya hai
aap ke khoon mein tha josh abu talib ka
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ko aal e payambar ka tha kitna ehsaas
bhool paaye na kabhi aap sakina ki pyaas
pani peete huwe thi ek sada ya abbas
aap ne daste bureeda ka liya tha badla
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rajat e jism e murattab hai wo manzar kya hai
hujjat e asr ki azmat ka samandar kya hai
jiske lashkar mein ali honge wo lashkar kya hai
wo sadi aayegi mukhtaar thay jiska lamha
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ke daur mein mazloom ki taaqat mukhtaar
jabr ke saamne inkaar ki himmat mukhtaar
hashr tak dil pe yazeedon ke hai haibat mukhtaar
aap ne laakhon jigar chaak kiye hai tanha
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz hote hai yahan kitne azadaar shaheed
faisla kar liya ab zulm nahi sehne mazeed
kaat kar rakhdo azadaron zara nasle yazeed
aap ke josh se milta hai hamein bhi jazba
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to allah ki nemat hai shahadat lelo
ashke shabbir se talwaar ki taaqat lelo
mat daro hazrat e mukhtaar se himmat lelo
daad deti hai inhe roohe shahe karbobala
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baaqi rehta hai abhi jor o jafa ka badla
noke naiza se chini ek rida ka badla
apni hadh mein jo liya karbobala ka badla
inteqam asl mein baaqi hai abhi waaris ka
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay qamar sog badha chain dilon ne paaya
saamne aap ke jis dam sar e hurmal aaya
zere lab jis tarha sajjad ne ho farmeina
aap ne hazrat e mukhtaar bada kaam kiya
aap ne hazrate mukhtaar...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Abbas kahan ho
items.body:
ghazi ka alam aaya to sheh bole ye ro kar
abbas kahan ho abbas kahan ho
ro ro ke na mar jaye kahin zainab e muztar
abbas kahan ho abbas kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mashk o alam laaye thay ran se shahe waala
ek hashr bapa tha
nauha tha yehi zainab e dilgeer ke lab par
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
le jaaun mai kis tarha jawan bete ka laasha
maidan se tanha
haathon se kamar thaame huwe kehte hai sarwar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab fauje khuda qatl hui raahe khuda mein
is dasht e bala mein
marne ke liye jaata hai nanha ali asghar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ki taraf jab ke chali sheh ki sawari
zainab ye pukari
ay mere jari bhai mere sher e dilawar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kooze liye baithe hai raste mein tumhare
seh roz ke pyase
in bacchon ka kya haal hai dekho zara aa kar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jayegi is dasht mein ro ro ke sakina
dushwaar hai jeena
do aake dilaasa usay seene se laga kar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab dashte bala qaiz mein kohraam bapa hai
har lab pe buka hai
kuffaar ke narghe mein hai aulaad e payambar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke bulaati hai nabi zadiyan tum ko
kyun sunte nahi ho
qaimon ko jalaata hai sitamgaaron ka lashkar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se rida thaam ke zainab ye pukari
ho jaaun mai waari
chin jaaye na sar se mere bhaiya meri chadar
abbas kahan ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hi tadap jaata tha abbas ka laasha
gohar labe darya
jab kehti thi saydaniya hasrat se tadap kar
abbas kahan ho...
items.author: Gohar

items.title: Ali akbar sidharo
items.body:
ali akbar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe waala ne di awaaz ay hamshakle paighambar
ali akbar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
baqa e haq ki khaatir baandh lo beta kafan sar par
ali akbar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho wo bade aate hai aada jaanib e qaima
bado aur bad ke beta rok do badta hua lashkar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
gala kat jaaye lekin haq pe aanch aane nahi paaye
hifazat deen ki hum pe hai hum hai aale paighambar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo raah e haq mein maut aaye to mar jaana shahadat hai
shahadat ka ye saagar shehed se shireen hai ay dilbar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baazuon mein quwwate baazu e haider hai
tumhare saamne kya hai bhala ye fauj ye lashkar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ani khud bad ke barchi ki lagalo apne seene se
jigar par khao ab zakhme sinaan o teer has has kar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ijazat maa se haan ab jaa ke qaime mein zara lelo
phuphi se hum ijazat khud dila denge tumhe chal kar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
pisar ko barchiyon mein bhejna aasaan nahi beta
hai fitrat ka taqaza ghash bhi ho sakti hai maa sun kar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
phuphi ke saath hi ay laal hai bemaar ka qaima
ye rakhna dhyaan chank uthe na ghash se abide muztar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikayat pyaas ki ab jaa ke dada jaan se karna
tumhe sairaab beta ab karenge saaqi e kausar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina khaa kar jo girna khaak par gir kar sada dena
tumhari laash pe sajda karunga shukr ka dilbar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan bete ka laasha kis tarha laate hai maqtal se
zamana dekh lega daur e ibne faatahe khyber
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye lamha dard ka cha jayega yun deen e aalam par
na bhoolega zamana hashr tak ye dasht ye manzar
ali akbar sidharo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sun lega mera bhai tumhe jaane nahi dega
wo bebas mujhko kar dega mere qadmon pe sar rakh kar
ali akbar sidharo...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Amma na jao
items.body:
ghar se jo zehra ke mayyat uthi
ghar mein ali ke qayamat hui
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi zainab ye sar peet kar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
veeran hojayega ab ye ghar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
<<DIVIDER>>
uth uth ke karti thi shab ko fughan
dil kaat jaata tha gham ka bayan
khamosh ho kuch to bolo na maa
uth jao zainab ki faryaad par
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
de kar sadayein bulao hamein
seene se apne lagao hamein
furqat ke din na dikhao hamein
kyun aaj hum se hui be-khabar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon pe koh e alam gir pada
sar ko jhukaye hai sher e khuda
kulsoom o fizza hai mehwe buka
hasnain rote hai thaame jigar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ka apne judaai ka gham
darbaar jaane ka dil par sitam
ummat se paaye hai is darja gham
sab se chupa ke wo zaqme jigar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu pe jalta hua dar gira
mohsin ka maqtal ye ghar ban gaya
is gham ne tum ko na jeene diya
sab zakhm dekhe hai tum ne magar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu shikasta jhuki hai kamar
ek haath pehlu pe ek qalb par
zeb e musalla thi tum raat bhar
ab kyun ho khamosh lagta hai darr
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
altaf o safdar ho kaise raqam
khairunnisa pe jo guzre sitam
khirtaas par likh ke roya qalam
hai ek jumle ka dil par asar
amma na jao mujhe chod kar
kehti thi zainab...
items.author: Altaf Hussain

items.title: Ay alamdare haram
items.body:
ay alamdar e haram
<<DIVIDER>>
saaqi e tishna labaan ay alamdar e haram
hyderi sher e jawan ay alamdar e haram
marhaba sher ejawan ay jawan ay jawan ay jawan
ay alamdar e haram
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shehanshah e wafa saani e hyder maula
ay sakina ke chacha fatema zehra ki dua
fauje shabbir ke salaar alamdar e wafa
bani hashim ke qamar naaz e shah e karbobala
maula qurban dil o jaan ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo shaam e ghariban wo qayamat ka samaa
haye sadaat ke jalte huwe qaimon ka dhuaan
bibiyan karti thi ro ro ke yehi aah o fughaan
aao abbas ridaon ke muhafiz ho kahan
ho kahan sher e jawan ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab na bibi ko alamdar chacha yaad aaya
aaya jab shaam ka bazaar chacha yaad aaya
na mila saaya e deewar chacha yaad aaya
jab tamanche lage har baar chacha yaad aaya
thi sakina ki fughan ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum azadaron ki taqdeer jaga do maula
karbala ka hamein zawwar bana do maula
apni jageer ka deedaar kara do maula
rauza e hazrat e shabbir dikha do maula
hai yehi wird e zaban ay alamdar e haram
saaqi e tishna laban...
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Ay zaamine ghariban
items.body:
ay zaamin e ghariban
lajpal raza maula sarkar raza maula
rote hai tere gham mein
ghamkhwar raza maula
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun zehr de diya hai kazim ke gulbadan ko
ghurbat mein maar daala mazloom bewatan ko
phir lut gaya tumhara ghar baar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab mein teri behna karti hai yaad tujhko
bhai se ab mila de parwardigar mujhko
ho na saka behen ko deedar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere laal keh kar wo pyaar se bulana
maathe ko choomna aur seene se bhi lagana
yaad aayega taqi ko tera pyar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sitamgari ne kya haal kar diya hai
haan zehr ke asar se tukde jigar hua hai
khoon ugle jaa rahe hai sardar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
taboot se lipat kar kehte hai rone waale
hum tere matami hai rauze pe ab bula le
ek baar hum bhi dekhe darbar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay fatema ke bete ye hai hamara waada
karte rahenge tere qatil pe hum tabbara
rokegi ab na koi dewaar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan o shadmaan ye nauha suna rahe hai
yaad aagayi shahadat angoor bhi saje hai
taboot hogaya hai tayyar raza maula
ay zaamin e ghariban...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Bawafa bawafa
items.body:
bawafa bawafa ghazi alamdar e wafa
baazu e shabbir hai fatema ki hai dua
<<DIVIDER>>
kulle emaan hai ali kulle wafa abbas hai
karbala ke zaairon ka rehnuma abbas hai
hai yehi babul hawaij hai yehi haajat rawa
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap quran e shuja'at ye hai quran e wafa
baap hai saaqi e kausar ye hai pyason ki dua
aaj tak qabze mein iske hai furaat o alqama
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ragon mein khoon abu talib ka iske maujizan
bu-tarabi khoon hai kyun kar na ho baatil shikan
tod daala is jari ne khyber e karbobala
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aas dhaaras dastageeri khaadime shabbir bhi
karbala walon ka saqqa karbala jageer bhi
uske parcham ki hawa hai surat e khaake shifa
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaye baazu qalam aur khoon mein dooba alam
hat sake na alqama se phir bhi ghazi ke qadam
turbat e abbas par pehre pe hai darya khada
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
noke naiza par ruke sar kis tarha abbas ka
berida zainab ko dekhe ye shehenshahe wafa
isliye noke sina par sar na ghazi ka ruka
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo bali sakina aur tamachon ke nishan
kaan zakhmi tashnalab ahle sitam ke darmiyan
haath kano par rakhe kehti rahi mere chacha
bawafa bawafa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhlo rehaan aur rizwan ghazi ka bharam
kha nahi sakta hai koi aaj bhi jhooti qasam
hai ata'on par ata nakshe qadam abbas ka
bawafa bawafa...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Bohat yaad aaye
items.body:
jab utri saron se bhaiya ridayein
tum yaad aaye bohat yaad aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha so rahe ho behan ko bhulaye
tum yaad aaye bohat yaad aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
khule sar sar e bazm mujhko bulaya
aziyat se durron ki mujhko rulaya
doon awaaz kis ko kise doon sadayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha dushwaar chalna magar mai chali thi
mere haal par bekasi ro rahi thi
qadam dar qadam toot'ti thi jafayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgar ne jab hum ko durron se maara
khuda ke liye seh liya dard saara
magar jab saron se utri ridayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
manadi sada de raha tha barabar
ye baaghi hai baaghi karo zulm in par
jahan tak ho mumkin inhe hum satayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kharashein kharashein yateema ke tan par
lahoo jam raha hai jale pairahan par
ye kehti thi dukhiya chacha ko bulayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kise kya kahun mai naseebon ki maari
sitam hum pe karte hai sab kaari kaari
jo aale payambar pe tooti jafayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiye maine faaqe isi khastatan par
ye roodad e gham likh rahi hai rasan par
mukhalif bhi apni hui hai hawayein
tum yaad aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir wo laashe jari par gayi thi
faqat shams ro ro ke ye keh rahi thi
jo guzri hai hum pe wo kya kya batayein
tum yaad aaye...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Darya se koi ja kar
items.body:
darya se koi jaa kar ghazi ko bula laye
aisa na ho ghurbat may ghar zehra ka lut jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baap zaeefi ke aalam may akela hai
aur sher se bete ke laashe ko uthaana hai
koi to sahara de lilaah koi aaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh kar ke suye darya haathon se kamar thaame
akbar ke janaze par sheh kehte thay ro ro ke
kya baat hui ab tak abbas nahi aaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai laakhon adoo ran may aur sibte nabi tanha
zakhmi hai bahot zakhmi pyasa hai bahot pyasa
mazloom ki gardan par shamsheer na chal jaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ka jari bhai maara gaya maqtal may
ghabrayi hui behna insaano ke jangal may
ek ek se ro ro kar ye kehti rahi haye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloomo ke qaimo may ab gham ka basera hai
kal tak thi jahan raunak ab gehra andhera hai
shaam aagayi ghurbat ki tareek huwe saaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat ke qaimon ko hai ghere huwe shole
kehti hai nabi zaadi ghabrayi hui ro ke
ghar lut gaya is ban may chadar bhi na chin jaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haalat hai ajab gohar masoom sakina ki
khoon behta hai kaano se lagte hai tamache bhi
naazon may pali bachi ro ro ke na mar jaye
darya se koi jaa kar...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ek sar kya tha
items.body:
ek sar kya tha shaheede karbala ke saamne
rakh diye sheh ne bahattar sar khuda ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
jhil-milate hi rahenge hashr tak ashk e aza
jhil-milate hi rahenge ye diye
hum ne jalaye hai hawa ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay tabeeb e asr dauran kya maseehai teri
ay tabeeb e asr dauran khaak hai
teri dawa khaake shafa ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak wo log ruswaye zamana hogaye
hashr tak wo log ruswa aagaye thay
jo shahe karbobala ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
cha gaya bankar jalaale hyderi darbar mein
cha gaya bankar jalaale khutbaye
zainab yazeede be-haya ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna sar saahil se takrane lagi mauje furaat
apna sar takra jab sakina
mashk laayi thi chacha ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye kya ho ba waqte izn maa ke dil ka haal
dekhiye kya ho ba waqte layenge
qasim ko jab dulha bana ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer jab asghar ne khaya ro rahe thay ashkiyan
teer jab asghar ne khaya aur asghar
has rahe thay ashkiyan ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
le gaya sar kaat kar shabbir ka shimr e layeen
le gaya sar kaat kar zainabe
khasta jigar ke ilteja ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
saniye zehra ke sar se us rida ko le gaye
saniye zehra ke sar se dono aalam
sard goo thay jis rida ke saamne
ek sar kya tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine paayi sar balandi maine paaya hai urooj
maine paayi sar balandi sar jhuka
rehta hai mera karbala ke saame
ek sar kya tha...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Ghazi e bawafa
items.body:
ghazi e bawafa chin rahi hai rida
nehr se laut aa chin rahi hai rida
<<DIVIDER>>
maal o asbaab sab loot'te hai layeen
jalte qayyam mein ghus rahe hai layeen
hashr hai ek bapa chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan se saydaniyan ab guzar jayengi
maut se pehle hi saari mar jayengi
hai ye waqte qaza chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
is se pehle ke sar ran mein ho berida
saari saydaniyan kar rahi hai dua
maut de ay khuda chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
tere baazu kate sabr maine kiya
sab sahare chine sabr maine kiya
ab nahi hausla chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf ab yahan aag hi aag hai
jaaun aakhir kahan aag hi aag hai
zulm is par siwa chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
be-ridayi ka gham bhai kaise sahoon
tu hi aa kar bata mai sada kis ko doon
sun behan ki buka chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse kehte thay ye mere baba ali
hogi tu berida ay meri laadli
waqt wo aagaya chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
main teri aas par aayi thi karbala
tere hote huwe kyun chinegi rida
qatl tu ho gaya chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
<<DIVIDER>>
noor har laash se khoon ubalne laga
laasha e bawafa bhi tadapne laga
jab ye goonji sada chin rahi hai rida
ghazi e bawafa…
items.author: Noor Ali

items.title: Har simt hai udasi
items.body:
har simt hai udaasi ujda hua samaa
kya kya na huwe zulm o sitam zer e aasman
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar abbas qasim o shabbir na rahe
namoos e mustafa ka abid hai paasban
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se khoon hai jaari daadi rangeen hai
goya jhuka hua hai par azm hai jawan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
majdhaar may hai kashti toofan ka zor hai
teeron se phat gaya hai safeene ka baadban
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujda hai do pahar may shabbir ka chaman
maqtal may reh gaya hai qaimon ka ab dhuan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
oonton se gir rahe hai bacche zameen par
jaane kahan rukega ghareebon ka kaarwan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne ameer aate thay wo mutma'in nazar
jinke raha saron par tayghon ka saayeban
har simt hai udaasi...

items.title: Jab alam se koi
items.body:
jab alam se koi mashkeeza bandha hota hai
kisi bedast ka izhare wafa hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise rehwar se girta hai koi be-baazu
gurz ka zakhm bhi jab sar pe laga hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
isko lilaah na kholo ke hai pamaal badan
aisa laasha kahin chadar may khula hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe deen sirf alam qaimae may laaye honge
ye jo ek shor qayamat ka bapa hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barasta hai fizaon se larazti hai zameen
kundh khanjar se jo sar sheh ka juda hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sajjad ke pairon may wo zanjeer-e-garan
aabilon ke liye har kaanta laga hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk dikhlake bahate hai zameen par pani
roz ek zulm sakina pe naya hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
qalbe akbar se sina gardan e baysheer se teer
khaynche waala shahe karbobala hota hai
jab alam se koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek awaaz haram sunte hai har shab shahid
pase zindan koi noha sada hota hai
jab alam se koi…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Jisne sajda kiya
items.body:
jis ne sajda kiya chaand zehra ka tha khanjar talay
jis ka koi na raha chaand zehra ka tha khanjar talay
<<DIVIDER>>
veeran karbobala aabaad jis ne kiya
ummat ne kyun kar bhala kaata hai uska gala
nok e sina jisne quran pada chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina ke dur le gaye ghazi ke baazu kate
shimr tamache maare kis jurm ki hai saza
hai ye saza jis ka koi na raha chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ne ki jaan fida qasim ke tukde huwe
aun o mohamed abbas akbar bhi maare gaye
maare gaye khoon dukhtar ka tha chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki cheeni rida abid ke kode lagay
bibiyan qaidi hui qaime bhi jalne lagay
qaime jalay jis ne quran pada chaand zehra ka tha
khanjar talay
jis ne sajda kiya...

items.title: Koi charagh jalao
items.body:
koi charagh jalao bahot andhera hai
sakina ko na jagao bahot andhera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain dikha kar yateem bachi ko
sitamgaron na rulaao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye rote rote huwe sogayi hai jaag na jaye
thapak thapak ke sulaao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aayi raat ye din kab dhala nahi maloom
phupi charagh jalao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina bibi ka zindan mein jee hai ghabrata
khudara rehm to khao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sakina ne ro kar meri phupi amma
mujhe na chod ke jao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
andhera zindan andheri qabr hai ay mirza
charagh dil ke jalao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Maidane karbala mein
items.body:
maidane karbala mein wo akbar teri azan
sunkar hussain rodiye mehve fughan thi maa
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sehr payame ajal mein dhali hui
maghmoom tere sehre ki ek ek kali hui
zainab tamaam shab rahi sajdon ke darmiyan
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo azan thi jisme tha lehja rasool ka
isme dikhayi deta tha sajda batool ka
isme namaziyon ka musalla tha aasman
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
haa is ada ne arsh ka suraj jaga diya
itne dilon mein shaukhe shahadat badha diya
sunkar habeeb ibne mazahir hue jawan
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
thi ek azan sehar ki to ek asr ki azan
tha kitna farkh dono azano ke darmiyan
akbar azane asr talak kha chuke sina
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan teri shaadi ka poora na ho saka
kanga bandha na mehndi lagi wa musibata
behno ke dil udaas hai nauha kuna hai maa
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
bali sakina nayg mein ab kya talab kare
karbobala larazti hai zainab ke bain se
kha kar sina rawana hue tum suye jina
maidane karbala mein....
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban aagayi qaime sulag uthe
bache tamaam khaakh pe pyaase hi sogaye
akbar phuphi ke shaano mein bandti hai reesma
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar talay hussain ne tumko kiya tha yaad
maa zinda laash hogayi akbar tumhare baad
aise gaye ho ghar se ke milta nahi nishan
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle mustufa thay dilon ka kharaar thay
tum to zaeef baap ka daaro madaar thay
hai tere baad gulshane shabbir mein khiza
maidane karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir jawani-e-ali akbar ka waasta
nauhe mein apne jis ghadi rehaan ne diya
sar par ridaye zehra hui misle sayeban
maidane karbala mein…
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Maula abbas
items.body:
hai saaya fighan do aalam par
saqqaye sakina tera alam
tu shere khuda ka saani hai
rakha hai wafa ka tune bharam
hai saath alam har gaam tera
hai ukta kushaai kaam tera
hai zikre wafa inaam tera
abbas e ali hai naam tera
abbas abbas abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jispe karam hai tera
hai usay raazi khuda
maula abbas maula abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
babul hawaij tera laqab hai
zinda wafa bhi tere sabab hai
tere alam ka faiz hai jaari
sunta hai tu faryaad hamari
hai jo lahoo mein wafa
ye bhi hai teri ata
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera alam har gham ki dawa hai
teri taraf har daste dua hai
tere waseele par jo yaqeen hai
ki dua radd hoti nahi hai
rab se kahun bhi to kya
jo maanga tune diya
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine zamane ko ye bataya
hai ye saqi rab ka humsaaya
saare jahaan ko paalne wala
rab ke khazane ka rakhwala
bin maange sunle dua
aisa saqi hai mera
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere ghazi hum hai sawaali
bhar de hamari jholiyan khaali
teri kaneezon ne hai pukara
de de ali asghar ka sadqa
tere to dar se kabhi
khaali na koi gaya
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera karam be-dast hai aisa
kaun bhala tang dast rahega
kasaye jo har waqt utha kar
dar pe khade hai tere gadagar
maula ali ki tarha
hai tu bhi mushkil kusha
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum hai faqeer aur tu hai shahensha
hum hai mareez aur tu hai maseeha
saath jo tera pyar ho maula
koi kahan bemaar ho maula
tera karam wo dawa
taale jo sar se khaza
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere masayab bhoole kahan hum
aati hai jab bhi aat moharram
rote hai parcham tera saja kar
bachon ko apne saqqa bana kar
karte hai matam bapa
ye keh ke ahle aza
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa tha dard bhara wo manzar
sheh ne kaha zainab se ye rokar
dekho zara ye halqa e matam
tishna dahan aur ghazi ka parcham
karte hai pyase sabhi
ye keh ke matam bapa
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere ghulam irfan aur mazhar
teri wafa se dil hai munawar
ek amanat tera alam hai
hum par jab ye daste karam hai
jaari rahega sada
ye kaarwan e aza
maula abbas...
jispe karam hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Mere janaze se zainab
items.body:
ali ke ghar mein ye kaisi ali pe ghurbat thi
hussain seene se lipte thay kya qayamat thi
ukhadti saans thi haye khareeb rukhsat thi
ali ke honton pe ye aakhri wasiyat thi
<<DIVIDER>>
mere janaze se zainab ko mat chudana hussain
wo jab talak na kahe chehra mat chupana hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jo beti dekh nahi paayi mera sar zakhmi
na jaane kaise mujhe wo kafan mein dekhegi
wo seh na payegi dunya se mera jaana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sambhalna meri mayyat pe mar na jaaye behen
wo jaanti hai ke tum ko nahi milega kafan
khayal rakhna kafan jab muhje udaana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare chehra pe wo gham na dekh payegi
yateem beti meri aur toot jayegi
tum uske saamne aansu nahi bahana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chali thi kis tarha talwaar ye bata dena
jo mera haal tha masjid mein wo suna dena
amaama khoon mein dooba nahi dikhana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka shukr adaa kar ke haye bole ali
mere janaze ki raunaq hai betiyan meri
khuda ko tohfa hai ghar betiyon ka aana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kafan mein dekh ke saansein hi rukh na jaaye kahin
jahan wo baithe suno tum bhi baith jaana wahin
wo ghash mein aaye to shaano ko tum hilaana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakhoge haath ab unke saron pe tum jaa ke
yateem kufa ke be-aasra na ho phir se
tum apne haathon se khaana unhe khilana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sukoon milta hai jab paas hoti hai beti
ye jaan jaaoge kyun khaas hoti hai beti
sakina aaye to seene se tum lagana hussain
mere janaze se...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukare roke ay zeeshan aur raza ye ali
uthaane dena janaza agar meri beti
tum uske saamne abbas ko bulana hussain
mere janaze se...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Muslim ka laasha
items.body:
kufe may phiraya jaata hai
muslim ka laasha eid ke din
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bhi uthane aata nahi
bekas ka janaza eid ke din
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai bhi nahi bete bhi nahi
koi bhi nahi rone waala
muslim ke janaze par baithi
roti rahi zahra eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aah sunayi deti hai
ek laash dikhayi deti hai
be-saakhta aansu aate hai
yaad aaye jo kufa eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
tooti hai qayamat ye kaisi
dono pe nazar hai maula ki
muslim ki hameeda roti hai
betaab hai sughra eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim se bachne ki khaatir
zindan se chudane ki khaatir
umeed yehi hai bachon ko
aayenge baba eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim ke yateemon ko sheh ne
seene se laga kar pyar kiya
ye haal yateemi ka logon
samjhi thi sakina eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek waar ali ke sajde se
muslim ki shahadat tak pahuncha
yun aale nabi ko ummat ne
har baar rulaya eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghar may koi mar jaata hai
sab aa kar pursa dete hai
hum kisko de maula mehdi
muslim ka pursa eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dastoor zamane se hai yehi
hum ahle aza ka baade namaz
hum sun ke masayib dete hai
zahra ko pursa eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dafnaya nahi kafnaya nahi
kaisi ye takallum ghurbat hai
kufe may musalman saare thay
muslim tha akela eid ke din
kufe may phiraya...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Noha tha sakina ka
items.body:
zindan may sakina ki hai sada aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka aajao mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil hai mera jeena aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon behta hai kano se ruqsaar bhi hai neele
jalta hai mera kurta aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
har gham may musibat hai durro ki aziyat hai
ye haal hai ab mera aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
loota gaya zewar bhi cheeni gayi chadar bhi
dhaate hai sitam aada aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ran ko gaya baba wapas wo nahi aaya
qaime may hai sannata aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pa sina khaaye akbar bhi gaye maare
pamaal hua dulha aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte hai sabhi qaime faryad kare kis se
ab kaun bachayega aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
neendh aayegi ab kyunkar soyegi kahan dukhtar
yaad aayega wo seena aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
chadar bhi nahi sar par le jaate hai wo dar dar
hai qaid may wo kunba aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehdije hilal us ja ek shor tha girya tha
jab kehti thi wo dukhya aajao mere baba
noha tha sakina ka...
items.author: Hilal Mirza

items.title: Aa asghar
items.body:
aa ali asghar aa
<<DIVIDER>>
aa asghar bin tere mai chain kahan se paaun
aa laut ke aaja laal tere jee bhar ke naaz uthaun
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankh ka taara hai tu mujhko jaan se pyara hai
maa dukhiyari ke jeene ka tu hi laal sahara hai
tujhe chod ke tanha maqtal mein mai kaise shaam ko jaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri wo masoom adayein teri yaad dilaati hai
tere pyar ki wo sab baatein mujhko bahot rulaati hai
mai teri judaai mein beta ro ro ke mar na jaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyon waale ye to tere naaz uthanae ke din thay
aankhon mein teri khushiyon ke khwab sajane ke din thay
aa laut ke asghar aa beta tera kurta mai badlaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool nahi sakti maa asghar pyase hont tere beta
khali godh hai aur zindan hai aaja maa ke pass aaja
aa nanhe mujahid mai teri ashkon se pyas bhujaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni hai bechain sakina tere naaz uthane ko
subho shaam tarasti hai wo tera dil behlane ko
teri laadli behan sakina ka mai dil kaise behlaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Aap par salam zainab
items.body:
marhaba shareekatul hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aap par salaam zainab
baad e shahe karbala aap ne poora kiya
itna bada kaam zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
maa se jo kiya tha waada khoob wo nibhaya
saath saath bhai ke rahi hai ban ke saaya
kaam jo koi na kar saka wo kar dikhaya
karbobala bhai ne fatha ki aur aap ne
fatha kiya shaam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl ho chuka ali ka laal jab furaat par
bibiyon ke bayn cha rahe thay kayenat par
saari zimmedariyan uthayi apni zaat par
bibiyan ghabra gayi pehre pe aap aagayi
jab jale qayaam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
misle shaah e deen nigahein zulm se milayi thi
faujein jis ghadi qayam lootne ko aayi thi
abid e hazeen ko aap hi bacha ke laayi thi
dekh ke ye hausla keh rahe they marhaba
khud shahe anaam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise kaise imtehan bibi aap ne diye
karbala ke dasht se aseer hoke jab chale
aap hi to aasra thi ahlebait ke liye
gham mein giraftar thi phir bhi alamdar thi
karbala se shaam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na ehteram aap ka ho khaas o aam mein
aap hai shareek e kaar maqsad e imam mein
pehli majlis e hussain wo bhi qaid e shaam mein
koi nahi ho saka baani e farshe aza
sirf hai ek naam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi ko waqf kar diya khuda ke naam par
dono laadle fida kiye wafa ke naam par
ek ek ashk shaah e karbala ke naam par
khutba kuch aise diya zulm ko ruswa kiya
hai ye sada aam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiyon ko har ghadi rakha dua ke saaye mein
aap ka ye sabr o hausla jafa ke saaye mein
hai khuda ka deen aap ki rida ke saaye mein
shukriya kehte rahe aap ko sajda kare
aap ke ghulam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki ata jo ho to choole asmaan sab
saare zakireen nauhakhwan o soz khan sab
mesum aur mazhar abidi kare bayan sab
kaare numeina sabhi aap ki lachaargi
aap ka maqaam zainab
aap par salaam zainab...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abbas ke baad
items.body:
maa pareshan hai kitni hairaan hai
laal reh jayega tanha mere abbas ke baad
mere abbas ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
bain karti hai ye zehra mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha mere abbas ke baad
mere abbas ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
har tarf teer o tabar aur ye khanjar bhaale
chaar soo honge faqat zulm hi karne waale
kaun imdad karega mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal e dil kis se kahe kaun mera hai ya rab
qatl karte hai mere laal ko aada be-sabab
zulm ab dhaate hai aada mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
laal ne zakhm ye khaye hai isi maqtal mein
har sitam is ne uthaye hai isi maqtal mein
kaunsa paaya na sadma mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye qasim ali akbar na rahe na asghar
kisko imdaad ko apni ye bulaye muztar
hoga shabbir akela mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hoke do zaanu shahe jinn o bashar baith gaye
kehke maqtal mein haye laashe pisar baith gaye
amma guzri hai bhala kya mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
pushte gardan pe kahin chalta hai khanjar dekho
kaise ye kund bhala karta hai khanjar dekho
kehke rone lagi zehra mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise hoti hai musibat ay falak dekh to le
jiska gehwara hilaate thay malak dekh to le
ran mein kehta nahi aaqa mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer paywast hai itne ke nikalun kaise
koi batlade kaleje ko sambhalun kaise
fatema karti hai nauha mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti reti pe pada reh gaya laasha uska
shams aamir ye bayan fatema zehra ne kiya
kaise utthega janaza mere abbas ke baad
laal reh jayega tanha...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Amma nisar utho
items.body:
amma nisar utho baba ki jaan sakina
gardan se kholti hai maa reesma sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ko chod kar tu moo apna mod kar tu
zindan se jaa rahi suye jina sakina
amma nisar utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi ab uth ke baitho amma nisaar dekho
laaya hai shimr shayad lo baaliyan sakina
amma nisar utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shaah ke fidaayi kaisi ye neendh aayi
de paasban na aakar phir ghurkiyan sakina
amma nisar utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haal hai ye beti dil phat raha hai mera
reh reh ke le rahi ho kyun hichkiyan sakina
amma nisar utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho zara khudaara jaane imam waala
sar par gira hai maa ke ab aasman sakina
amma nisar utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar mein bhool jaana is ko na shahzaadi
hilmi bhi hai tumhara wo madhakhan sakina
amma nisar utho...
items.author: Hilmi Afandi

items.title: Ay alamdare hussain
items.body:
ay yadullah ke bedast pisar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoondti hai tujhe har ek nazar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
tu numa'inda ali ka hai sare karbobala
aur alam haq tera
tu madine se hai itrat ki sipar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
jang karne ki ijazat na mili sarwar se
jaante thay anjaam
ye mashiyat hi rahi peshe nazar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm par shaah ke mashkeeza o naiza lekar
rukh kiya darya ka
tune samjhaya ata'at ka hunar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
laash qaime may na lejaye khudara hargiz
sab se hoo sharminda
sheh se kehta tha tera deedae tar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek maa roz dua karti hai bete ka amaan
sheh e deen bach jaye
to usi maa ka hai ek laqte jigar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
tera sar bandh ke rumaal may jo rakha hai
kya sabab iska hai
kyun sina par nahi aaya tera sar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt shahid hai ke az karbobala ka ye sira
kya masaib guzre
tay hua kaise ye zainab ka safar ay abbas
ay alamdare hussain…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Ay zaeefa meri
items.body:
dekha zainab ko to abdullah ne ro kar poocha
ay zaeefa meri zainab ko kahin dekha hai
kis liye aayi hai karne mere ghar tu girya
ay zaeefa meri zainab...

aao ye waada hum kare mil kar hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala bhool na payenge hai jab tak zinda
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
hashr tak yaad rahega wo ghamon ka khissa
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
rab ne chaaha to mere maula nahi chutega
aap ke gham mera rishta nahi tootega
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sabeelein ye azakhane sajane ki lagan
nahi chootega kabhi ye azadari ka chalan
ta abad bichta rahega mera ghar farshe aza
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
aap ke gham se agar qalb munawar honge
ashk aankhon se girenge to wo gauhar honge
<<DIVIDER>>
ye alam taaziye taboot uthaunga sada
aap ke gham ko mai seene mein basaunga sada
baad mere meri naslon ka ye hoga shewa
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
aap ghar se wafadari nahi chodenge
mere maula ye azadari nahi chodenge
<<DIVIDER>>
ho balayein ya wabayein ya koi ho mushkil
bas yehi kehta hai har ek azadaar ka dil
hum bichayenge har ek haal mein ye farshe aza
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
deen pe mar mitne ko tayyar hai mashallah
kaisa shedayi wafadaar hai mashallah
<<DIVIDER>>
dosti kehte kise hai ye bata jaunga
aap ke naam pe ye jaan bhi luta jaunga
aayi kufe se habeeb ibne mazahir ki sada
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
nasl dar nasl mere kunbe mein aisa hoga
har koi hazrat e shabbir ka shehda hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
hai fida tum pe meri jaan hussain ibne ali
mere maa baap bhi qurban hussain ibne ali
bas yehi bolega ghar ka mere baccha baccha
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
sadqe shabbir ke hai mera naseeba chamka
maine jo daaman e shabbir ka saaya paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kabhi daaman e shabbir na hum chodenge
godh mein azmat e islam ki dam todenge
hurr yehi kehta hua jaanibe maqtal hai chala
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
bhool jaun mai wo aada ke sitam na mumkin
yaad mujhko na rahe bhai ka gham na mumkin
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zameen aur falak shajr o hajar mehshar tak
gham manayenge tera jinn o bashar mehshar tak
laashe shabbir pe ro ro ke ye zainab ne kaha
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
bandagi cheez hai kya aur ibadat kya hai
aap ka aakhri sajda ye sabakh deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke aakhri sajde ka bharam rakhenge
hum azadar namazein na kabhi chodenge
hone denge na kabhi koi namaz apni qaza
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
aap ka zikr nahi chodenge ye waada hai
zakiron ka mere sarkar yehi waada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
thak nahi sakti zaban ruk nahi sakta hai qalam
dam mein aamir ke shanawar ke hai jis dam tak dam
aap ke naam ka karte hi rahenge charcha
ay hussain aap se ye waada raha
karbala bhool na payenge...
items.author: Shanawar Makanpuri

items.title: Abbas ke baazu
items.body:
qaime may jo sheh laate hai abbas ke baazu
kulsoom ko tadpate hai abbas ke baazu
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir bhi maare gaye mai kar na sak kuch
is baat pa khoon rote hai abbas ke baazu
qaime may jo sheh laate...
<<DIVIDER>>
chin jaati hai phir zainab o kulsoom ki chadar
maqtal may jo kat jaate hai abbas ke baazu
qaime may jo sheh laate...
<<DIVIDER>>
hal min ki sada sunte hi shabbir ki ran se
darya pa tadap uth'te hai abbas ke baazu
qaime may jo sheh laate...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ne sakina se kaha maar ke durre
kaise tujhe chudwate hai abbas ke baazu
qaime may jo sheh laate...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki rida lut'ti hai bazaar may jab bhi
sajjad ko yaad aate hai abbas ke baazu
qaime may jo sheh laate...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha ali akbar ka utha to nahi sakte
aapas may hi takrate hai abbas ke baazu
qaime may jo sheh laate...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhta hai aqeel aal e nabi ke jo masayib
to behre ata uth'te hai abbas ke baazu
qaime may jo sheh laate...
items.author: Aqeel Abbas

items.title: Aina aina ay ali akbar
items.body:
yusuf e laila shabihe payambar
kehte thay ye ran mein sarwar
ay ali akbar ay ali akbar
ay jaane dil e sarwar ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
buka ye sunlo zaroor beta
huwe ho tum jab se door beta
gaya in aankhon se noor beta
huwe hai tareek do jahan
dhoondun mai kahan jaa kar
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaye maine tamaam laashe
na haath larze na paaon kaampe
sada tumhari suni hai jab se
laraz raha hai badan mera
ye kehta chala ro kar
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi tasalli na kuch dilaasa
mai kaise dhoondun tumhara laasha
labon pe naale badan mein raasha
bhatak raha hoo mai jaa baja
hai naad e ali lab par
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
madad ko aayega kaun beta
habeeb o hurr hai na john beta
na mera qasim na aun beta
har ek maqtal mein so chuka
tanha hai padar dilbar
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bhook aur pyaas ki nakahat
aur uspe beta tumhari furqat
qadam qadam par nayi hai zehmat
lagi jo thokar to ye kaha
de mujhko sada akbar
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise abbas ko bulaun
sitam raseeda ka kyun sataun
batade tu hi kahan mai aaun
kahan pe ghode se tu gira
aa jaunga nauhagar
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamaam waade nibha chuka hoo
lahoo mein apne naha chuka hoo
jo dil pe guzri bata chuka hoo
bas ek baaki hai marhala
takmeel pe hai mehzar
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
phupi ki awaaz aa rahi hai
wo beta tujhko bula rahi hai
gham apne tujhko suna rahi hai
de usko awaaz tu zara
kehti hai yehi muztar
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi tha sheh ka bayaan mazhar
tha jis pe ab nauhakhwan safdar
qalam bhi rota hai likh ke manzar
hussain padte thay marsiya
tha haath kaleje par
ay ali akbar
aina aina ay ali akbar...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Amma tere bete ko
items.body:
amma tere bete ko sitamgaron ne maara
sajde may hua qatl bhara ghar tera pyasa
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ali akbar ke kaleje se nikaali
ashoor ko mayyat bhi akele hi uthayi
phir bhi sheh e deen par na kiya rehm zara sa
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki laashe pe ye sarwar ne sada di
bhai teri ruqsat ne kamar tod di meri
jab so gaya haye mera ghazi labe darya
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zulm o sitam shaah pe maidan may toote
zakhmon pe lage zakhm shenshah e huda ke
be jaan tha wo jab suye zameen zeen se aaya
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar liye jo shimr badha jaanib e sarwar
bachi ne kaha maar na zaalim na sitam kar
phat'ta tha jigar door se manzar jo ye dekha
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gardan e sarwar pe rakha shimr ne khanjar
beti se kaha baba ne tehro na yahan par
sajde may layeen ne sar e shabbir ko kaata
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanha sa gala rakh ke shah e deen ke galay par
bachi ne kaha shimr chala hum pe bhi khanjar
beti ka laga saamne baba ke tamacha
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar jo chala sheh ke galay par sar e maqtal
har zarb se barpa hua mehshar sar e maqtal
sar peet ke nabiyon ne kiya shaah pa girya
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar kaat ke ye zulm kiya aur unho ne
pamaal kiya laasha e shabbir sumon se
aaza e shahe deen ko musalmano ne kaata
amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron ke lagay zakhm shahe deen ke badan par
zakhmi tha bahot naizon se tauheed ka mazhar
phir jalti hui rayt ko har zakhm pa daala
