amma tere bete ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehan o erum bas wo qayamat ki ghadi thi
jab qabr pa zehra ki ye zainab ne buka ki
be gor o kafan dasht may tha shaah ka laasha
amma tere bete ko...
items.author: Shumaila Erum

items.title: Ay alamdare hussain
items.body:
aah uftade zitan daste alamdare hussain
ay alamdare hussain ay alamdare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay behan matame abbas e ali kije bapa
karte thay peet ke sar hazrat e shabbir buka
hogaya qatl mera bhai nahi dil ko chain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
di khabar sheh ne juhin qatl alamdar huwe
chadare gir padi ye sunke haram ke sar se
karti thi aale iba shiddate aalaam se bain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bahan tere biradar ki kamar toot gayi
bhai ka daagh meri quwwate dil loot gayi
kyun na matam karoo sar peetu karoo ro kar bain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime ke dar pe abhi tak hai sakina zainab
ye khabar sunke na mar jaye hazeena zainab
kis tarha usko batayega ye mazloom e hussain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kahan zauja e abbas yahan bulwao
pursa hum denge unhe bachon ko bhi le aao
haaye dunya se utha murtuza ka noor e ain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...

items.title: Ay zahra ke baba
items.body:
ay zahra ke baba ay shaahe madina
yun beti ko teri sataya gaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta hai pehlu shikasta hai baazu
lahoo fatema ka bahaya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
madine ki kya thi mai haalat bataun
tumhe sayyeda ki musibat bataun
kabhi aag dar par lagayi hai uske
kabhi haath us par uthaya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada aa rahi thi ye ghar hi mita do
jo rehte hai ghar mein unhe bhi jala do
taharat ka kaaba jalane ki khaatir
jama'at ko saari bulaya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bhi na samjha shahe lafata ko
ye gham khaa gaya hai teri fatema ko
madine ki galyion mein qaidi bana kar
tere janasheen ko phiraya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
na uth'te thay bacche na rukte thay aansu
sambhale farishton ne dono ke baazu
badi mushkilon se janaze se maa ke
hussain o hassan ko hataya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali murtaza ki ajab thi ghareebi
teri laadli par hase jab namazi
sanad kardi tukde mazaak is tarha se
teri sayyeda ka udaya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
giri khaak par arsh par rehne waali
shikasta hui uske kaano ki bali
lahoo chashme zahra mein bharne laga tha
tamacha hi aisa lagaya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ko jo masjid bulaya gaya tha
teri laadli ko jalaal aagaya tha
ali ne diya waasta apne haq ka
madine ko aise bachaya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ne banayi thi chalees qabrein
pata poochti hai takallum ki aahein
zameen e madina mein jaane kahan par
khazana tumhara chupaya gaya hai
ay zehra ke baba...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Bole akbar jo watan
items.body:
bole akbar jo watan laut ke jaana amma
meri roothi hui sughra ko manana amma
<<DIVIDER>>
mere qadmon ke nishanon pe rakhe hogi wo sar
us se kehna nahi aayega kabhi ab akbar
ghar ki dehleez se tum us ko uthana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne se pehle galay mil liya akbar sab se
kaash ek baar mai seene se laga leta usay
meri jaanib se usay seene lagana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
pooche asghar ka to keh dena humakta tha bahot
naam lete thay tumhara to wo hasta tha bahot
ghutniyo chalne laga tha wo batana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
is rida se usay aa jayegi khushboo meri
ye mera khoon hai sunte hi wo mar jayegi
meri sughra se rida apni chupana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar wo pooche ke mere bhai ko kaise maara
kehna bas ho gaya allah ko pyara sughra
mujhko maari thi sina ye na batana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
us se kehna ke wo naraaz na ho ammu se
wo to khud naam mitaate huwe uska roye
chaahte thay wo usay saath may laana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hai beemar na kar payegi meelon ka safar
bas wahin baith ke ro le wo mujhe shaam o sahar
ek nishan qabr ka aangan may banana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khat e sughra meri mayyat pe sunana aise
jaise talqeen padha karte hai bilkul waise
dono haathon se mera shaana hilaana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad ye tha aakhri akbar ka bayan
jab madine may tumhe aayegi awaaz e azaan
chup ke sughra se kahin aansu bahana amma
meri roothi hui...
bole akbar jo...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Dasht mein khoone
items.body:
ye mila karbal mein ahmed ko risalat ka sila
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein khoone shahe ahmed bahaya jaa raha hai
yun charaghe fatema zehra bujhaya jaa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak zehra hai udaati peet'te hai sar nabi
gardane shaahe zaman pe khanjar chalaya jaa raha hai
dasht mein khoone...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa lipat kar ro rahi hai jhoole se baysheer ke
aur udhar teer e sitam se pani pilaya jaa raha hai
dasht mein khoone...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi qayamat ki ghadi maidan mein shabbir par
naujawan bete ka laasha tanha uthaya jaa raha hai
dasht mein khoone...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali aao madad ko ro ke fizza ne kaha
ab tumhari betiyon ko qaidi banaya jaa raha hai
dasht mein khoone...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar o abbas o qasim khoon se baysheer ke
is tarha irfan e deen ka gulshan sajaya jaa raha hai
dasht mein khoone...

items.title: Ek shehensah ki
items.body:
bachpan mein buzurgon ne batayi thi karbala
ek saahib e aalam ne basayi thi karbala
maa ne mujhe lori mein sunayi thi karbala
us din se mere dil mein samayi thi karbala
maa ne sunayi thi suno meri zabani
mazloom shehenshah ki mazloom kahani
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shehenshah madine mein raha karta tha
jis ki maa fatema zehra thi ali tha baba
jis ka bhai tha hassan aur nabi tha nana
sab se afzal tha zamane mein isi ka kunba
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
us shehenshah ka ek bhai tha abbas e jari
ek beta ali akbar bhi tha hamshakle nabi
ek farzand tha shehzada ali asghar bhi
ek beti thi sakina jo sukoon e dil thi
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek pisar aisa shehenshah ko khaaliq ne diya
naam sajjad laqab zainnulliba tha jis ka
ek behan zainab e kubra thi haya ki malka
bhia ke saath jo saaye ki tarha thi wallah
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen e mabood pe jab waqt e musibat aaya
us shehenshah ne ek khaafila tayyar kiya
betiyon behno ko beton ko bhi hamraah liya
ek ajab shaan se nikla tha suye karbobala
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
do moharram ko sar e karbobala jab pahuncha
chaar jaanib se layeeno ne usay ghayr liya
shaam ki faujon ne darya pe lagaya pehra
bas yahin se hua aaghaz e sitam wavaila
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
us shehenshah ke kunbe pe badhe ranj o alam
band haftum se huwe aab o ghiza haye sitam
tashnalab peer o jawan nauha kuna ahle haram
us shehenshah ke qaimon mein bapa tha matam
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekasi charon taraf qaimon pe mamoor hui
dard ke chaaye andhere shab e ashoor hui
cha gayi tashnalabi mauj e rawan door hui
aagayi subhe dahum zindagi be-noor hui
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shehenshah ne phir waade nibhaye saare
apne aangan ke diye ban mein bujhaye saare
ek ek kar ke janaze bhi uthaye saare
dard aur zakhm kaleje se lagaye saare
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shehenshah tha maqtal mein akela logon
ek musafir ko sitamgaron ne ghera logon
kund khanjar se gala pyase ka kaata logon
hogaya qatl mohamed ka nawasa logon
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bar sare farshe aza ashk fishani safdar
khoob ki lafzon ne bhi marsiya khwani safdar
sun chuke ahle aza meri zabani safdar
ek shehenshah ki pur dard kahani safdar
tum bhi kaho mai bhi kahun
goonj uthe saare zamane mein yehi shor o shain
hussain hussain imam hussain
hussain hussain...
items.author: Safdar Abbas

items.title: Ghazi ka parcham
items.body:
shabbir ka matam hai ruk na sakega
abbas ka parcham hai jhuk na sakega
<<DIVIDER>>
sada uncha ghazi ka parcham rahega
isi ke to saaye may aalam rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan ibne zehra ka parcham rahega
wahan ibne maryam ka sar kham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hilaale aza ne nikal kar sada di
kamar may hamesha meri kham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaala ghilaaf aaj bhi keh raha hai
haram may hamesha moharram rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jise apni raahein badalna ho badle
julooson ka rasta to mohkam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
chale jao rubaahon se bole ghazi
bas is taraayi pe zaigham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada mohtabar aab e zam zam hai maana
magar ashk e majlis muqaddam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan kooze bharti mashke sakina
sabeelon pe pani kahan kam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada chashme momin barasti rahegi
hamesha moharram ka mausam rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
rahe na rahe saari dunya may koi
magar ibne zehra tera gham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sheh ne akbar ka laasha utha kar
hamari kamar may sada kham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali dekh kar bole ghazi ko sajjad
tere haath may mera parcham rahega
sada uncha ghazi ka...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Hussain ki beti
items.body:
ro ke boli hussain ki beti
baap beti se milne aata hai
poori hasrat hui sakina ki
baap beti se milne aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sochti hoo ke apne baba se
neel kaise chupaun chehre ke
khauf aata to hai andheron se
phir bhi hai ilteja meri sab se
aaj roshan na ho diya koi
baap beti se milne aata hai
ro ke boli hussain ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise zainab phuphi ko dada ne
be-rida umr bhar na dekha tha
mere baba ne bhi sakina ko
aaj tak sar khule nahi dekha
kaash chadar kahin se mil jaati
baap beti se milne aata hai
ro ke boli hussain ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye paywast meri gardan mein
khud mai isko hata nahi sakti
apne gardan bureeda baba ke
saamne yun mai jaa nahi sakti
koi gardan se khol de rassi
baap beti se milne aata hai
ro ke boli hussain ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mai milti thi apne baba se
baahein gardan mein haar karti thi
tan bureeda ka sar jo aayega
kaise gardan mein baahein daalungi
tera zarbon se hoke ab zakhmi
baap beti se milne aata hai
ro ke boli hussain ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad baysheer ki sataati hai
bhaiya akbar ki yaad aati hai
karbala waale kaise baste hai
kaise kat’ti hai bhai qasim ki
unse mai sab ka haal poochungi
baap beti se milne aata hai
ro ke boli hussain ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain akbar thay ye sakina ke
aa rahe hai pidar mujhe lene
ek muddat se jaagi beti ko
loriyon se wo khud sulayenge
mujhko batla gayi hai khud daadi
baap beti se milne aata hai
ro ke boli hussain ki...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Karbala chalo
items.body:
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada karbala chalo
abbas peshwa hai mera karbala chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ke dard o gham ki dawa karbala mein hai
jannat ki khush gawari fiza karbala mein hai
kya gham ki ab bhi khaake shifa karbala mein hai
ab bhi sitamgaron ki khaza karbala mein hai
awaaz de rahi hai wafa karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
zahra ki hai dua ke azadaar kam na ho
sarwar ka gham ho sab pe zamane ke gham na ho
ya rab jahane faani ka gauhar alam na ho
bekaar raaston pe kisi ke khadam na ho
bas ek hi hai raahe khuda karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ke zulm o jor batane ke waaste
ghazi ko haal apna sunane ke waaste
zakhme jigar ye sheh ko dikhane ke waaste
karbobala mein noha sunane ke waaste
karne baeed ranj o bala karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai rauza e hussain mera maqsade hayaat
uljhan mein din guzarte hai be-chainiyo mein raat
wo dekhle jahan pe kate thay jari ke haath
hum jaaye karbala bhi to maa ki dua ke saath
paane ko dard e dil ki dawa karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
humse milenge aakhri rehbar wahin kahin
hasnain ka suna hai ke ghar hai wahin kahin
rehte hai karbala mein payambar wahin kahin
le jaaye kaash humko muqaddar wahin kahin
subhe masa yehi hai dua karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
shehre najaf hi shahe najaf ka dayaar hai
gulshan shahe zaman ka wahin la zawaal hai
guncho ke lab pe salle ala baar baar hai
gunche wahin pe wahin pe jina ki bahaar hai
leni hai gar jina ki fiza karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke alam ko liye dosh par nikal
karbobala hai jaana to paidal najaf se chal
bayyat ko apne paon se tu bhi zara kuchal
sajjad chal rahe thay jahan par sambhal sambhal
zainab ki yaad aaj rida karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se hui naseeb mubarak ko karbala
aakhein lahoo barasti hai rehan baareha
sarwar ka hai nashayb mein rauza bana hua
zainab bhi haye shaam se karti hai ye sada
tanha hai ab bhi bhai mera karbala chalo
zahra ki aa rahi hai sada...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Kehti thi sakina
items.body:
kehti thi sakina aao chacha
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
allah re mujh par jo ro jafa
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shumre sitamgar maahile shaar
hai zulm se uske chalni jigar
padte hai tamazhe subho masa
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maa phupiyon ki hasrat tum se kahoo
ya apni musibat tum se kahoo
har roz hai hum par zulm naya
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar bhi huye aankhon se niha
qasim ka bhi kuch paaya na nashan
baba ka bhi milta hai na pata
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ki nigaahein hum se phiri
saydaniya sab nazron se giri
kya tum bhi huwe ho hum se khafa
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ki wo girti deewarein
ranjoor dilon ki wo aahein
dehshat se jigar phat'ta hai mera
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam aati hai zindan mein jis dam
ghabrata hai dil mera us dam
chillati hoo keh kar aao chacha
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder bas rok apna qalam
majlis mein hui har chashm hai nam
hai josh pe darya matam ka
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
items.author: Hyder

items.title: Lekar janaza dosh
items.body:
lekar janaza dosh pe shere khuda chale
daare fana ko chod ke jab mustufa chale
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ujad gayi ke madina ujad gaya
sadaat saath saath ye karte buka chale
lekar janaza…
<<DIVIDER>>
nabiyon ka khatm hota hai dunya se silsila
ahmed chale jahan se kul ambiya chale
lekar janaza…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hogaya ali ko jo khamosh chal diye
rassi galay mein daal ke jab ashkiyan chale
lekar janaza…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab jaante hai kya hua shabbar ki laash par
kya kya musibatein hui aur teer kya chale
lekar janaza…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ki aaj hi bunyad pad gayi
kisko bithaye takht par aur kis tarha chale
lekar janaza…
<<DIVIDER>>
tay ho raha hai kis tarha maare hussain ko
hai kaun aisa leke inhe karbala chale
lekar janaza…
<<DIVIDER>>
barbaad kis tarha kare zehra ke baagh ko
toofan kis tarha ka aur kaisi hawa chale
lekar janaza…
<<DIVIDER>>
noha ye noor ka hai sikandar ki hai zaban
padte hue har ek ye karke aza chale
lekar janaza…
items.author: Noor

items.title: Mere kadiyal jawan
items.body:
sinan ibne anas ko dekh kar kehti thi ye laila
mere kadiyal jawan bete ne tera kya bigada tha
<<DIVIDER>>
kaleje pe ali akbar ke maara kis liye naiza
mere kadiyal jawan bete ne tera kya bigada tha
<<DIVIDER>>
duayein maanga karti thi mai jiske waaste har dam
karoongi zindagi bhar ab usi farzand ka matam
tere naize ne meri zindagi mein likh diya rona
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mere dil ki thandak tha meri aankhon ka taara tha
ay zaalim kya pata tujhko wo mujhko kitna pyara tha
qaraar aata tha mere dil ki chehra dekh kar uska
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina seene pe tu ne maar di itna bhi na socha
ki maa jab umr kho deti hai tab palta hai ek beta
meri sab mehnaton ko pal me hi pamaal kar daala
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehega ghao ab ye hashr tak mere kaleje par
bahot pyasa tha jab dunya se utha hai mera akbar
usay pyasa hi tu ne maar daala rehm na khaaya
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai apne laal ki baraat le kar jaane waali thi
ali akbar ki dulhan ghar mein le kar aane waali thi
na ban'ne paaya mera laal tere zulm se dulha
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
<<DIVIDER>>
bata deta agar che tujhko maal o zar ki laalach thi
mai apne laal pe sab maal o zar qurban kar deti
kaleja kaat daaal tu ne ay jallad maadar ka
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam dhaaya hai tu ne mere dil ke chain pe zaalim
liye naize pe sar hasta hai mere bain pe zaalim
zara sa bhi tujhe na maa ki mamta ka khayal aaya
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina ki nok pe roye shahe mazloom ay waiz
bohat royi tadap kar zainab o kulsoom ay waiz
janabe umme laila ne padha jis waqt ye nauha
mere kadiyal jawan bete...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Muslim ka qatl
items.body:
muslim ka qatl hona aaghaaz e karbala hai
syed ka khoon bahana aaghaaz e karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tha safeer e sarwar usko shaheed karna
phir baandh kar rasan mein har raah se guzarna
laashe ko yun phirana aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
<<DIVIDER>>
khat bhej kar hazaron shabbir ko bulaana
muslim se waada sheh ki nusrat ka aake karna
waade ko bhool jaana aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
<<DIVIDER>>
saf baandh kar namazi sab fajr padh rahe thay
maghrib ke waqt muslim tanha khade huwe thay
aale nabi se dhoka aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaiyan udaasi pardes tang raahein
bache bhi kho chuke hai jo saath wo thay laaye
has has ke khoon rulaana aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek raat jab ke tehre wo aake ghar mein jaa kar
dayra bana ke ladne tab aa gaye sitamgar
wo aake ghar pe hamla aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoka diya gaday mein muslim ko hai giraya
sar kaat ke badan ko galiyon mein hai phiraya
pamaal laash karna aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
<<DIVIDER>>
dewaar khoon se tar thi sab raahein khoon se tar thi
pardes mein yun muslim ki laash dar badar thi
dushman hai saara kufa aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
<<DIVIDER>>
maara gaya kumail kufe mein ye bhi pyasa
shabbir ko haqeer pyasa shaheed karna
ek jaisa zulm dhaana aaghaaz e karbala hai
muslim ka qatl hona...
items.author: Jawad Haqir

items.title: Aaqa e do jahan bhi
items.body:
aaqa e do jahan hai mushkil kusha bhi hai
hyder ba qaul e qaum e nusairi khuda bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaabe my budh shikan hai to masjid may hai imam
jibreel keh rahe hai ali la fataa bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ab na paltenge darya liye baghair
badta hua qadam kabhi peeche hata bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e ahlebayt hai abbas naam hai
talwaar khaynch le to ye sher e khuda bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber may kaise waar se sheh par nahi kate
hyder ki zulfeqar se koi bacha bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
toofan uth raha hai to uthe hazaar baar
kashti ke saath saath mera nakhuda bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar na kyun ho apne muqabil pa fathe yaab
zor e ali hai haath may maa ki dua bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khandaq may kaun jayega dushman ke saamne
islam may ali ke siwa doosra bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho adab se rauza e shabbir ki taraf
mahir khayal e azmate karbobala bhi hai
aaqa e do jahan hai...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Abbas ke baba ki
items.body:
masjid e kufa se lekar taaba khaake karbala
qatl sajdon mein hua hai mustafa ki aal ka
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke baba ki jabeen khoon se tar hai
dooba hua gham mein bani hashim ka qamar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke chehre pe hai zainab ki nigahein
ye poochti ho jaise mera baba kidhar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa pahonchi hai zehra ki shahadat bhi ali tak
kufe pe bhi lagta hai madine ka asar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal beti pe barsenge inhi galiyon mein pathar
in galiyon se baba ke janaze ka guzar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha se ab jeena hai ye poochlo zainab
kufe ke yateemon ko yateemi ki khabar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqa pe liye jaate hai taboot ali ka
humraah e pidar aakhri beton ka safar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaila hua mabood hi ka khoon hai akbar
jis khoon se rangeen hua mabood ka ghar hai
abbas ke baba ki jabeen...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Aina ali akbar
items.body:
ghode se ran mein jab gire hamshakle mustafa
baba mera salaam ho di aakhri sada
daude kamar ko thaam ke yun shaahe karbala
aankhon se ashk jaari thay honton pe marsiya
aankhon ka noor kho gaya dhoondun kahan tujhe
beta kahan ho aakhri awaaz do mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
aina ali akbar aina ali akbar
awaaz do baba ko kahan ho mere dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhta nahi aankhon se sada do mujhe beta
girta hoon sambhalta hoon jigar thaam ke tanha
ghurbat pe tere baap ki haste hai sitamgar
aina ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta utho seene se zara haath hatao
dikhlao hamay kya hua hum se na chupao
yun thaam ke dil aediyan ragdo na dilawar
aina ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haal mere laal tera hogaya haye
allah kisi baap ko ye din na dikhaye
peeri mein falak ne hamay dikhlaye jo manzar
aina ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha mere laal tere dard ko thaamun
seene se tere kis tarha barchi ko nikalun
aajaye kaleja na kahin seene se baahar
aina ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun chod ke ghurbat mein na jao mujhe beta
bas tum hi ho jeene ka sahara mere beta
kis tarha teri laash uthaunga mai dilbar
aina ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maadar se teri jaa ke bhala kaise kahunga
akbar ko tere ran mein qaza aagayi laila
wo dekh rahi hogi teri raah khule sar
aina ali akbar...
items.author: Ali Rizvi Sachey

items.title: Ay ali teri tanhaiyan
items.body:
aaj tak koi samjha kahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan
bas faqat hai teri raazdan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
jagmagati na tauheed mein
gar simat'ti na tauheed mein
aakhirash phir simat'ti kahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
poochti hai salooni yehi
hai koi ilm kash hai koi
haye koi nahi tha wahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa koi salam o kalam
jab nahi hai jawab e salam
uff ye tauqeer e ilm al-amaan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai jo shaam o sahar
fatema teri tanhaai par
fatema par hai girya kuna
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ko yaara kare guftagu
goongti hai yahan sirf hoo
bolti hai khuda ki zaban
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibtida inteha kibriya
ambiya aulia ausiya
sab hai chup bolti hai jahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam ba dam pae ba pae jaa baja
keh rahi hai ye kun ki sada
kaadh leti hai khud se jahan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaat e shahid mein mash'hood mein
yan wajood aur maujood mein
kam se kam hai fasl e kamaan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
<<DIVIDER>>
husn ki deed ki ain tak
jalwa e qaaba qausain tak
haan bas ek parda e darmiyan
ay ali teri tanhaiyan...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Ay zuljana
items.body:
ay zuljana kya kiya apne sawaar ko
dilbande mustufa shahe gardo viqar ko
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jaanta tha mar gaye sab khaish o akhraba
phir kis pe chod aaya ghareeb-ud-dayaar ko
ay zuljana…
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal se daudta hua khaali phira hai kyun
viswas aa raha hai dil e beqarar ko
ay zuljana…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zuljana is tarhe se aane ka fayeda
jab khairiat se leke na aaya sawaar ko
ay zuljana…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun sar jhukaye sharm se rota hai zaar zaar
kya khaak par gira diya apne sawaar ko
ay zuljana…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hogayi yateem sakina bala naseeb
kyun ro roha hai dekh ke us dilfigaar ko
ay zuljana…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis manzile akheer ka bachpan se shauk tha
kya us jaga utaara hai apne sawaar ko
ay zuljana…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay qais ahle shaam ne andhayr kar diya
gul kar diya nabi ke charaghe mazaar ko
ay zuljana…
items.author: Qais Zangipuri

items.title: Baba musafiron pe
items.body:
baba musafiron pe qayamat guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunche ghareeb jis ghadi qabre hussain par
ye keh ke roye qabr pe sajjad nauhagar
baba suno ghareebon se ab haalat e safar
ummat ne bewatan ko phiraya hai dar badar
zainab dayaar e shaan mein jab nange sar gayi
baba musafiron pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal se hum chale thay to haathon mein thi rasan
baba muaaf karna na hum de sake kafan
pamaal ho chuke thay shaheedon ke sab badan
tha kor khoon mein dooba hua tha tamaam ban
aulaad e fatema sar e maqtal bikhar gayi
baba musafiron pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal se is tarha se guzara gaya hamay
khoon ke samandaron mein utaara gaya hamay
baba har ek gaam pe maara gaya hamay
baaghi ki aal keh ke pukara gaya hamay
ranj o alam ki taygh jigar mein utar gayi
baba musafiron pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar e shaam aur wo logon ka ijdehaam
aise mein shimr leta tha saydaniyon ke naam
us shaam mein hua tha aseeron ka qatle aam
koi na tha jo karta hamara bhi ehteraam
qaatil hi dikh rahe thay jahan tak nazar gayi
baba musafiron pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan e shaam pahunche to ye bhi ghazab hua
amma rabab karne lagi girya o fughan
ek karbala ke baad hui ek karbala
zindan ke dar se deti thi ammu ko jo sada
aakhir yehi hua ke sakina bhi mar gayi
baba musafiron pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke ghamzada ne kiya aakhri salaam
royenge jaa ke shehre madina mein subho shaam
sughra ko denge kaise tasalli e tashna kaam
ghar jaa ke yaad aayenge jalte huwe qayaam
basti zafar ghareebon ki ashkon se bhar gayi
baba musafiron pe...
items.author: Zafar Abbas Zafar

items.title: Baysheer mere aaja
items.body:
baysheer mere aaja tujhe lori sunaungi
apne ali asghar ko godhi may sulaungi
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal tasavvur may de de ke tujhe lori
maqtal may tere khaali jhoole ko jhulaungi
baysheer mere aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
milne ke liye maa se kuch dayr ko aajao
mujh dukhiya pe kya guzri sab haal sunaungi
baysheer mere aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate huwe qaime se jo tu ne kiye beta
un tere isharon ko mai bhool na paungi
baysheer mere aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar fauje sitam aayi aur cheeni meri chadar
is dasht e bayaban may mai kis ko bulaungi
baysheer mere aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
aana ho agar mushkil awaaz do maadar ko
maqtal se tumhe lene mai khud chali aaungi
baysheer mere aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
godhi may tujhe le kar mai socha ye karti thi
is sher ko mai apne abbas banaungi
baysheer mere aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehte huwe gohar ghash kar gayi wo maadar
mai tere bina asghar waapas nahi jaungi
baysheer mere aaja...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ek sitam sajjad par
items.body:
haye sajjad haye haye sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sitam sajjad par aisa hua
jab talak jeeta raha rota raha
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sitam tha beridayi shaam mein
sar khule zainab jo aayi shaam mein
tauq deta tha duhaayi shaam mein
aankh se khoon e jigar behta raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasman rota tha roti thi zameen
qalb thay zakhmi to zakhmi thi jabeen
bibiyon ke naam lete thay layeen
thaam kar dil saarban sunta raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
sang dil ahle jafa ke saamne
kya koi jaata ridayein maangne
dard o gham kitne diye hai shaam ne
har qadam par ek gham milta raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasman waale zameen par aagaye
gham ke baadal chaar jaanib chaa gaye
rote rote qalb o jaan pathra gaye
dil ko ye maahol bhi dasta raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisko suraj ne na dekha ho kabhi
haye us bibi ki chadar chin gayi
maut ka saaman thi bas ye ghadi
imtehan dene ko wo jeeta raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bediyon ke zakhm saare bhool kar
nauha karta tha nabi ki aal par
aur kabhi rota tha sar ko peet kar
khoone dil bhi aankh se behta raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi thi har qadam par ek saza
saans karti thi haram par marsiya
bain karna bhi wahan par jurm tha
haan magar ye jurm wo karta raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya likhe roodad mazhar abidi
likh nahi sakta wo sadme koi bhi
ban gayi nauha magar ye baat hi
jab talak jeeta raha rota raha
ek sitam sajjad par...
jab talak jeeta raha...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ghazi ke alam ko
items.body:
sadiyon se utha rakha hai ghazi ke alam ko
baatil na jhuka sakta alam ko hai na hum ko
<<DIVIDER>>
marna ho jisay haq pe alam par wo rakhe haath
ho khauf jise jaan ka badaye na qadam ko
sadiyon se utha rakha…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai matame shabbir ka bharpoor yehi haq
dhaata chala aaya hai har ek qasre sitam ko
sadiyon se utha rakha…
<<DIVIDER>>
biqre hue quran ke auraaq pade hai
ay karbobala tuhpe kahan rakhun qadam ko
sadiyon se utha rakha…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar kaat ke shabbir ka qaimon ko jala kar
beparda musalman ne kiya ahle haram ko
sadiyon se utha rakha…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zaayir e shabbir idhar aa idhar aaja
aankhon se laga loo mai tere naqshe qadam ko
sadiyon se utha rakha…

items.title: Haram
items.body:
qadam jis waqt maine karbala ki khaak par rakha
tha manzar saamne do bhaiyon ki badshaahat ka
mai jab baabul hawaij ke haram ke saamne pahuncha
utha kar haath ro ro kar kaha maine salaam aaqa
bohat toota hua hoon paas ab mujh ko bula lijiye
lipat jaaun mai bachon ki tarha rauze ki jaali se
<<DIVIDER>>
ziyarat ki tamanna mein haram tak aagaya hoon mai
ijazat dijiye darbar mein rakhun qadam maula
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dil mein ziyarat ki tadap jis dam badi hadh se
kareem e karbala se ye kaha tha maine ro ro ke
mere saahib mere aaqa kahe ye chote hazrat se
mujhe zaair bana dijiye dikha dijiye haram maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar jab se hui mujhko bulawa aagaya mera
chala ghar se yahan pahuncha na neend aayi na chain aaya
ajab hai kaifiyat dil ki yaqeen aata nahi mujhko
nazar gumbad ki jaanib hai meri aankhein hai nam maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi muslim koi hindu koi sikh koi eesaai
tere darbaar mein koi nahi tafreeq mazhab ki
haram ke saamne aakar adab se sar jhukate hai
hai sab ki aankh mein aansoo hai sab ke dil mein gham maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan apne liye maula kahan kuch maangta hoon mai
lipat kar aap ki turbat se rona chaahta hoon mai
suna hai aap ki turbat ali asghar ke jaisi hai
na jaane aap par kya kya huwe zulm o sitam maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar e ummul baneen ke paas jaa kar baith jaaunga
suna kar aap ka nauha wahan aansu bahaunga
gire jab aap ghode se nahi thay aap ke baazu
raha is baat ka bas aap ki maadar ko gham maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan se jaaunga maula bade maula ke rauze par
badi ghurbat mein maara hai jinhe nau laakh ne mil kar
judaai aap ki seh kar kamar kham ho gayi haye
jinhe akbar ki furqat mein nazar aata tha kam maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaleje mein sina khaye tadapta tha jahan akbar
wahan par yaad aayega mujhe ghurbat ka wo manzar
ali akbar ye kehte thay na barchi khaynchiye baba
pidar ke godh mein nikla jawan bete ka dam maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan khanjar se zaalim ne gala shabbir ka kaata
wahan sattar qadam ka faasla bhai behen mein tha
behen ne us ghadi kitna pukaara aap ko haye
tadapti reh gayi zainab hua jab sar qalam maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha zeeshan ne haye raza wo pal rulayenge
ay mere bawafa maula ye din jab beet jayenge
chala jaaunga ghar lekin yahin dil chod jaaunga
mujhe phir se bula lena sakina ki qasam maula
ziyarat ki tamanna mein...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Hussain ki dukh
items.body:
hussain ki dukh bhari kahani
tamaam dunya suna karegi
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ro padega usay jahan mein
ali ki beti dua karegi
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ki laashe be-kafan se
ye keh ke zainab juda hui hai
jo tere maqtal mein bach gaya hai
wo kaam meri rida karegi
hussain ki dukh bhari...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain baqir se keh rahe thay
meri sakina ko saath rakhna
safar ke har mod par ye bachi
tumhe dilaase diya karegi
hussain ki dukh bhari...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb maa hai ke cheh mahine
ka laal qurban kar rahi hai
kabhi jo asghar ki yaad aayi
rubab zindan mein kya karegi
hussain ki dukh bhari...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain waada hai ye behan ka
rehaai zindan se payegi jab
behan tumhari yazeed ke ghar
tumhari majlis bapa karegi
hussain ki dukh bhari...

items.title: Jo bandagane khuda
items.body:
jo bandagane khuda naam par khuda ke chale
furaat o neel may bhi raasta bana ke chale
<<DIVIDER>>
unhi ke dam se rawan hai ye kaarwan e hayaat
khud apni raah may jo farsh e khoon bicha ke chale
jo bandagane khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
riyaaz e majlis e sarwar bhi hai ajab ke jahan
fiza bhi aaye to daaman bacha bacha ke chale
jo bandagane khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb haal tha aale nabi ka baad e hussain
ke khoon baha na diya ashk e khoon baha ke chale
jo bandagane khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayaan e sidq se halchal si hai sar e darbaar
aseer e karbobala faisla suna ke chale
jo bandagane khuda...
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir dekho zameen e anees hai ye zameen
charaagh leke kahan saamne hawa ke chale
jo bandagane khuda...
items.author: Naseer Turabi

items.title: Karbala chelum manane
items.body:
namak se roti kha ke khwahishon ko chod kar
hazaar sakhtiyon ke bawajood ye safar
thakan ki fikr hai na mausamon ka kuch asar
qudoom choomti hai zaairon ki rahguzar
alam utha ke dosh par labon pe hai sada
salaam ya hussain salaam ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala chehlum manane jaa rahe hai khafile
shaah par aansu bahane jaa rahe hai khafile
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zameen dekhenge jaa kar jo ke hai jannat nazeer
ghar luta kar jis zameen par sogaye gham ke aseer
us zameen par sar jhukane jaa rahe hai khafile
karbala chehlum manane...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimagah e zainab o kulsoom aur nehre furaat
har jagah majlis karenge chaahe din ho ya ke raat
deep ashkon ke jalane jaa rahe hai khafile
karbala chehlum manane...
<<DIVIDER>>
girya o zaari karenge yun kafe abbas par
ho fida jaanein hamari aat din ki pyaas par
bas yehi nauha sunane jaa rahe hai khafile
karbala chehlum manane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ko kehte hai maqam e hamshabihe mustafa
pursa denge umme laila ko wahan ahle aza
farshe gham har jaa bichane jaa rahe hai khafile
karbala chehlum manane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah jhoola rakha hai aaj tak baysheer ka
marsiya jaa kar padhenge hum dil e shabbir ka
mannatein apni badhane jaa rahe hai khafile
karbala chehlum manane...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum pyada jayenge najaf se karbala
ishq ka safar karenge ho ke ghamzada
mausamon ki fikr hogi aur na thakan
sab jawan o peer honge ishq mein magan
raah ke moaqqibon mein hogi shab basar
maayein behnein ba-hijab hogi humsafar
is fareeze ko nibhane jaa rahe hai khafile
karbala chehlum manane...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ke khafile mein safdar o mazhar bhi hai
phir to wajib hai safar mein bas yehi nauha padhe
karbala chehlum manane jaa rahe hai khafile
karbala chehlum manane...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Kehti thi sakina ab
items.body:
kehti thi sakina aajao baba ab aajao
lillaah na itna tadpao
kehti thi sakina…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ye kaisa waqt pada
koi bhi nahi meri sunta
ho jaa'ungi mai tumse khafa
dekho na mujhe yun rulwao
baba ab aajao
kehti thi sakina…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis jurm ki hai aakhir ye saza
sunte hi nahi beti ki sada
roothe hai chacha bhaiya hai khafa
ab kisko pukarun batlao
baba ab aajao
kehti thi sakina…
<<DIVIDER>>
na-moose nabi ka paas nahi
darr aa na chale aate hai layeen
chin jaaye na chadar sar se kahin
hai waqt e museebat jald aao
baba ab aajao
kehti thi sakina…
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte hai qayaam uth'ta hai dhua
har simt lagi hai aag yahan
ab jaaun to mai jaaun kahan
itna to mujhe batla jaao
baba ab aajao
kehti thi sakina…
<<DIVIDER>>
rote rote jhoole ke kareeb
darr hai ke na dede jaan kahin
amma ko bulalo paas wahin
ya shakl unhe dikhla jaao
baba ab aajao
kehti thi sakina…
<<DIVIDER>>
kab se ro ro chillati hoo
aao ke tamache khaati hoo
acha mai wahin aa jaati hoo
sotay ho kahan par batlao
baba ab aajao
kehti thi sakina…
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar bhi nahi asghar bhi nahi
ammu bhi nahi lashkar bhi nahi
ab to sar par chadar bhi nahi
aajao baba aajao
baba ab aajao
kehti thi sakina…

items.title: Koi misle shahe
items.body:
koi misle shah e deen ho to aaye
zaeefi may jawan ka daagh uthaye
<<DIVIDER>>
uthi taazeem ko har mauj e darya
sar e saahil jun hi abbas aaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
aray logon mera naushaah aaya
lahoo ki haath may mehndi lagaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaleja thaam kar chillayi maadar
shah e deen laasha e qasim jo laaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaho behno se aanchal sar par daale
koi naushaah ki masnat bichaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh e qasim se sehre ko hata do
dulhan aati hai ghoonghat ko hataye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo dehki laash akbar ki to maa ne
alam se poch ke chille badhaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha bano ne asghar tum kahan ho
ye maadar ab kise jhoola jhulaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
aray baysheer ki koi khabar le
mera baccha lehad may darr na jaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
chali aandhi falak se khoon barsa
shah e bekas lahoo may jab nahaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
aray ye kya sitam hai ay layeeno
behan bhai par rone bhi na paaye
koi misle shah e deen...
<<DIVIDER>>
samajh lo ashq jannat hai usi ki
gham e sarwar may jo aansu bahaye
koi misle shah e deen...
items.author: Ashq Lakhnavi

items.title: Mere khanjar dekha
items.body:
ek behan bhai ke maqtal ka wo manzar dekha
haye zainab ke galay par mere khanjar dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ka waqt hai tanha hoon saath hai na koi
meri maa khuld se bete ko bachane aayi
tujhe girte huwe zeen se zameen par dekha
haye zainab ke galay par...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere rone pe khushi se wo layeen hasta raha
kund khanjar se mera sar wo zibha karta raha
shimr ke haathon mein zainab ne mera sar dekha
haye zainab ke galay par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin se teer koi naize kahin se bhaale
jis ko kuch bhi na mila us ne pathar maare
meri mazloomi ko zainab ne bhi ro kar dekha
haye zainab ke galay par...
<<DIVIDER>>
inteha hai ke ye chode na mere kurte ko
ek angoothi ke liye kaate meri ungli wo
ek ek zulm ko khwahar ne tadap kar dekha
haye zainab ke galay par...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoondte dhoondte maqtal mein jo aayi zainab
sab ke laashon ke darmiyan gir gayi zainab
mere nazdeek mein jab laasha e akbar dekha
haye zainab ke galay par...
<<DIVIDER>>
akhtari naize pe jab aagaye saqqa e haram
uska sar naize se girta tha khaak par paiham
khud ko jab bhai ke naize ke barabar dekha
haye zainab ke galay par...
items.author: Raza Akhtari

items.title: Muslim ka tha ye
items.body:
muslim ke pisar haye kufe may bhatakte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe may tahe khanjar muslim ka ye nauha
bachon ko mere unki maadar se mila dena
<<DIVIDER>>
tum log to sab mil kar kal eid manaoge
bachon ko bhi tum apne seene se lagaoge
mil jaaye mere bete to un pe taras khaana
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom hoo khud mai bhi mazloom hai wo dono
kamsin bhi hai wo dono masoom hai wo dono
un ko to madine ka maloom nahi rasta
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jallaad chalata hai khanjar meri gardan par
phekega bulandi se wo mera tan e laaghar
tum log ghaseetoge galiyon may mera laasha
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
latkega mera laasha darwaza e kufa par
mere tan e besar par barsayenge sab pathar
kya guzri hai baba par bachon ko na batlana
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt sar e kufa sadaat e haram pahunche
awaaz ye aati thi us laasha e besar se
mai muslim e tanha hoo lo mere salaam aaqa
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tab zauja e muslim ne laashe se kaha ro kar
jo aap pe guzri hai zaahir hai wo sab mujh par
phat'ta hai jigar mera jab sunti hoo ye nauha
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ne udhar lekin bachon pe sitam dhaaya
haa saamne bhai ke bhai ka gala kaata
masoom ki gardan ka khoon rayt pe girta tha
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim ka tan e besar khayncha gaya kufe may
yan bhaiyon ke laashe phaynke gaye darya may
mohtaj e kafan bache mohtaj e kafan baba
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo masjid e kufa ho ya shehr musayyab ka
baba hai udhar tanha bache hai idhar tanha
mukhtar aur ay majid ye goonjta hai nauha
bachon ko mere unki...
kufe may tahe khanjar...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Noha zainab ka tha
items.body:
noha zainab ka tha ay gaysuwo wale akbar
kis tarha gham tera madar ye uthale akbar
noha zainab ka tha…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya khabar thi tujhe zaalim ki nazar khayegi
tere seene mein ani barchi ki dhar aayegi
chand si shakl teri khaak mein mil jaayegi
maut bhi aayegi baali se to sharmeinegi
door nazron se hue ghar ke ujaale akbar
noha zainab ka tha…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye thay saath madine se phuphi ke beta
ghar ke is dasht mein ab saath tumhara choota
baap majboor hai ke aankh ka taara toota
haye pardes mein aada ne bhara ghar loota
maa khadi roti hai seene se lagale akbar
noha zainab ka tha…
<<DIVIDER>>
apne taqdeer ka teri ye tamasha dekha
baap ke haaton pe binjaaye ka laasha dekha
phool qismat mein na thay khoon ka sehra dekha
maa ki aankhon se wo behta hua darya dekha
teri ghamqaar ko ab kaun sambhale akbar
noha zainab ka tha…
<<DIVIDER>>
koi abbas ko darya se bulaale jaa kar
ho khabar kaise unhe mar gaye ran mein akbar
kyun nahi lete khabar mamu ki aun o jafar
baap se ut'thegi kis tarha laashe pisar
kaun baakhi hai jo ab sheh ko sambhale akbar
noha zainab ka tha…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime jalte hai nahi koi sahara beta
dhal chuki shaam hua shab ka andhera beta
daad ras koi nahi gham mein hamara beta
teri furqat mein nahi jeena gawara beta
sar se chinti hai rida aake bachale akbar
noha zainab ka tha…
<<DIVIDER>>
haatif e ghaibi ki nagaar sada ye aayi
waqt tha asr ka jab sheh ne shahadat payi
kaisi anjum ye qayamat ki ghadi thi aayi
laash pe rone ko beta tha na koi bhai
kaun bachon ko bhala aake sambhale akbar
noha zainab ka tha…
items.author: Anjum Zaidi

items.title: Aa gaya madina
items.body:
aa gaya madina
<<DIVIDER>>
lutke aa gaya watan fatema ka kunba
aa gaya madina aa gaya madina
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ye udasiyan fizaon par hai taari
aa rahe hai qudsiya alam siyaah amaari
kaisa dardnaak hai musafiron ka kissa
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon ko phir wohi bahaar yaad aayi
jo ujad chuki wo yaadgaar yaad aayi
door se nazar jo aaya mustafa ka rauza
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ki betiyon kaleje ko sambhalo
baazuon pe neel ke nishan sab chipalo
tez hai hawa rida gire na sar se fizza
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek do nahi tamaam ghar ki hai sunani
karbala ne cheen li madine ki nishani
rote hai haram basheer pad raha hai nauha
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
is qadar khamosh kyon ho ay rabab bolo
apni laadli ko dogi kya jawaab bolo
hai kahan mera sagheer poochegi jo sughra
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha wo gham ka maajra kahenge abid
sochiye chacha se apne kya kahenge abid
wo jo poochle gale mein zakhm hai ye kaisa
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay basheer alqama pe kya hua batao
maa sawaal kar rahi hai waqiya sunao
qaime jab jale to mera laadla kahan tha
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahe hai poochne ko haal ahle yasrab
wo musibatein bayan karogi kaise zainab
jin musibaton ne tum ko kar diya zaeefa
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha sitamgaron ne cheeni thi ridayein
betiyan safar ka haal maa ko kya sunayein
ek hashr jannatul baqi mein hai barpa
aa gaya madina...
<<DIVIDER>>
le chala naseeb jab bhi rauza e nabi par
soch kar tadap uthe ye aamir aur nayyar
ye jagah wo hai jahan hussain phir na aaya
aa gaya madina...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Aaqa hussain
items.body:
qadam badta rahe aao karbala ki taraf
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
aarzu e ambiya ziarat e hussain hai
nusrat e imam hai ye nusrat e hussain hai
azm zayareen ka ye taaqat e hussain hai
dil se aa rahi hai ye sada ek hi lagan hai karbala
har qadam pe badh raha hai dil ka hausla
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok hi nahi saka hai koi khaar phool ko
zaayeron ka ilm kya ho daaishi jahool ko
kaat denge zayareen kufr ke babool ko
sabr ka liye hai asleha haath mein hai parchame wafa
dekhte hai rokta hai kaun raasta
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehnuma ka rehnuma hai zaayire hussain hai
fatema ki ye dua hai zaayire hussain hai
iska martaba bada hai zaayire hussain hai
khidmaton mein mehwe dam ba dam
zaayiron ke kaam aaye hum
maadar e hussain se milega hausla
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aarzu e murtaza hai ye dua e fatema
faqr se zameen de isko rahi hai raasta
mehr o maah hai safar mein chal raha hai khaafela
bhai hai behan hai aur maa bache boodhe saath hai jawan
lashkare hussain mein hai aaj faisla
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyderi jo walwala hai ishq e arz e toos hai
azm hai shahadaton ka maut to uroos hai
karwan jo chal raha hai matami juloos hai
matam e hussain ka asar buzdilon ke phat gaye jigar
darr ke har yazeed apne ghar mein chup gaya
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq hai ye hussain ka najaf se karbala chalo
poora khaandan leke misl e shaah tum badho
choomte hai raaste har ek zakhm zakhm ko
abid e hazeen hai raah par zainab e hazeen hai humsafar
paon mein pade hai aable to kya hua
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz o shab tadap raha hoo zindagi ki kya khabar
maanta hoo maula hoo gunahgaar kis qadar
ek bar pahunchun bus mai rauza e hussain par
bhai aur bhatije ki talaash cheh mahine ke pisar ki laash
pursa dene aap ko har ek shaheed ka
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
roze maine rakhe aur khums bhi ada kiya
waqt par padi namaz ki nahi kabhi qaza
matami mai aap ka hoo meri zindagi aza
dil ki ye tadap hai ek baar aaqa mai hoo ek gunahgaar
hurr ki tarah haath jod kar hoo mai khada
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala hi zindagi meri hai mai hoo matami
khoon e dil se jo likhe hai lafz wo hai roshni
ay qamar ziyarat e hussain hogi laazmi
zulm ke khilaaf har qadam hai hussainiat mera qalam
door karbala se mai shaheed ho gaya to kya
aaqa hussain maula hussain
aa raha hoo mai bhi...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Ali ali hai
items.body:
badal raha hai nizame do aalam
qadam qadam inquilaab payham
magar hamari zaban pe har dam
ali ali hai ali wali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye naame naami isme aazam
isi se milta hai azme mohqam
sanad mili jisko la fata ki
wo marde maidan yehi ali hai
ali ali hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zabane adam pe ya ali hai
zabane khaatam pe ya ali hai
wo ibteda thi ye inteha hai
ajal ali hai abad ali hai
ali ali hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
bayane qum wo nabi ka qutba
dikha rahe hai wasi ka chehra
idhar baland ho rahe hai maula
udhar se aayat utar rahi hai
ali ali hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghubaar dil ka hai rukh pe chaaya
alam ali ne hai ran mein paaya
kisi ka chehra damak raha hai
kisi ki rangat udi udi hai
ali ali hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zamana dekhe to zulm ki had
hue hai aale nabi muqayyad
ba-rehna sar hai ali ki beti
rida bhi aada ne cheen li hai
ali ali hai…

items.title: Amma tumhara asghar
items.body:
apne haathon se baba ne
turbat mein sulaya tha mujhko
aur shaam ke zaalim lashkar ke
naizon ne sataya tha mujhko
turbat mein mujhe rehne na diya
sar mera bhi naize pe utha
amma amma
<<DIVIDER>>
amma tumhara asghar naize pe aagaya hai
do baar zibha mujhko ran mein kiya gaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
noke sina pe amma dohra hai dard mera
ek naize par barabar mein aap ki rida hai
amma tumhara asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaale pade hai kaise zakhmi huwe hai kaise
kuch to batao amma haathon ko kya hua hai
amma tumhara asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna khayaal rakhna meri na fikr karna
dadi ne mujhko apni godhi mein le liya hai
amma tumhara asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke ali ka din bhi hai cheh moharram
maa dekhti hai ab bhi jhoola kahan saja hai
amma tumhara asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nikla tha jab watan se tha godh mein tumhari
hamraah ab tumhare sar kat ke jaa raha hai
amma tumhara asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ka hoon bhatija aankhein mai kholun kaise
maine suna hai amma behno ka sar khula hai
amma tumhara asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize se mai sakina ko dekhta raha hoon
chehra meri behen ka zakhmon se bhar gaya hai
amma tumhara asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan bhi dhoop mein thi turbat bhi dhoop mein hai
bano ne ay takallum waada nibha diya hai
amma tumhara asghar...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Ay aspe wafadar
items.body:
jab aakhri ruqsat ko chale sayyede waala
hamsheer ko dukhtar ko bhi allah ko saumpa
phir rote huwe aspe wafadaar se bole
aa tu bhi wida bekas o mazloom se ho le
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aspe wafadaar ay aspe wafadaar
<<DIVIDER>>
maana ke bahot zakhm hai tere bhi badan par
asghar ki tarha pyasa hai meri tarha muztar
ye aakhri khidmat hai ada kar paye hyder
gardan pe meri shimr ki chalne ko hai talwaar
ay aspe wafadaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu to mere nana ki sawari mein raha hai
ab tujhse bichadne ka mujhe ranj bada hai
par kya karun mehzar mein mera naam likha hai
raakib tera marne ko chala hai mere rehwaar
ay aspe wafadaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab girne lagun zeen se maqtal ki zameen par
jab mujhpe barasne lage har simt se pathar
aur shimre layeen tan se juda karne lage sar
zainab na kahin dekhkle ban jaaiyo dewaar
ay aspe wafadaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha mera pamaal karenge ye sitamgar
maarega koi teer koi pherega khanjar
rehne nahi denge mera malboos badan par
tadpega sar e nehr mera bhai alamdar
ay aspe wafadaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sun ke tadapne laga kehne laga ro kar
behtar hai ke jaan dedun mai kuffar se lad kar
ay kaash ke chal jaaye mere halq pe khanjar
mai aap pe jaan dene ko tayyar hoon sau baar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sayyede abraar ay sayyede abraar
<<DIVIDER>>
de hukm to is fauje sitamgar ko kuchal dun
naksha mai zara dayr mein maqtal ka badal dun
har ek sitamgaar ko paigham e ajal dun
ay ibne ali hukm hai bas aap ka darkaar
ay sayyede abraar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sun ke hui tar mere maula ki nigahein
gardan mein bade pyar se phir daal di baahein
aur aspe wafadaar bhi bharne laga aahein
maula ne kaha jaa tera allah madadgaar
ay aspe wafadaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab hashr mein hum tujhse mulaqaat karenge
maqtal mein basar aaj se din raat karenge
hum khuld mein nana se teri baat karenge
royenge tujhe dekh ke sab mere azadaar
ay aspe wafadaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan nazar aati hai jab sheh ki sawari
aankhon se azadaron ke khoon hota hai jaari
kehte hai ke qurban ho jaan tum pe hamari
dekha nahi tujh jaisa koi shaah ka ghamkhwar
ay aspe wafadaar...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Baba na jaaiye
items.body:
baba na jaaiye baba na jaaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki ye buka hai khudara na jaaiye
hum ko jahan may chod ke tanha na jaaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
beti lipat ke baap ki mayyat se ro padi
kehne lagi ke aap ke bin kya hai zindagi
hum ko bahot satayegi dunya na jaaiye
zainab ki ye buka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadmaat sab ali ke kafan may ayaan huwe
mayyat ki band aankh se aansu rawan huwe
beti ne itne karb se bola na jaaiye
zainab ki ye buka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ke dar pe doodh ke pyale liye huwe
kufe ke har yateem ne naale yehi kiye
maula na jaaiye mere maula na jaaiye
zainab ki ye buka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ko mere kaun sambhalega murtaza
arz e baqi pe dard bhari hai yehi sada
boli tadap ke fatema zehra na jaaiye
zainab ki ye buka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsoom aur zainab e muztar ki hai sada
abbas e naamdaar ke lab par hai ilteja
koi nahi hai aap ke jaisa na jaaiye
zainab ki ye buka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zarbat ki subh qayamat e kubra se kam na thi
dar par ali ne phaila qadam bhi rakha abhi
murghabiyo ne shor machaya na jaaiye
zainab ki ye buka hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasir ye ajre haq hai imamat ki hai azan
maula imam e waqt ki aati hai ye sada
sajid suna ali ka ye nauha na jaaiye
zainab ki ye buka hai...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Bazaar aa raha hai
items.body:
bazaar aa raha hai bazaar aa raha hai
sharm o haya ki malka be-maqna o rida hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sab qatl ho chuke hai shabbir ke fidaayi
ansar o aqraba bhi
kis ko bulaye haye sunta nahi hai koi
faryad bekason ki
behaal gham ke maare bemaar e karbla hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi hai ye qayamat hai kaisi ye ghadi hai
hai kaisi bekasi hai
sar berida hai sab ke haathon mein bibiyon ke
rassi bandhi hui hai
bemaar ke galay mein tauq e garan pada hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya zulm kya sitam hai aayi hai qaid hokar
aulaad mustafa ki
bemaar saarban ke pairon pe sar ko rakh ke
roti hai bediyan bhi
sun sun ke ye sadayein har zakhm ro raha hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baalon se moo chupa kar saydaniyan pukari
aa kar hamay bachao
abbas jald aao abbas jald aao abbas jald aao
ek ghul hai chaar jaanib ek shor uth raha hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom bibiyon ko hote hai khush rula kar
ahle sitam jafagar
faryad kar rahi hai saydaniya tadap kar
koi dilaade chadar
abbas ko bulao zainab ki ye sada hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaaron taraf sakina qaidi yateem bacchi
hasrat se dekhti hai
kya waqt aagaya hai abbas ki bhatiji
chup chup ke ro rahi hai
sehmi hui hai bacchi ye khauf khaa raha hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaiz o ghazab ke maare larza hai ek sina par
kadiyal jawan ka sar
rukta nahi hai haye ghazi ka sar sina par
gir jaata hai zameen par
aankhon se sheh ki khoon ka behna bata raha hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne ro ke jis dam poocha ye shaahe deen se
hukme imam kya hai
aayi sada ye gohar shaahe umam ke sar se
bhai bhi chal raha hai
chal meri dukhiya behna haafiz tera khuda hai
bazaar aa raha hai...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Bole shaah kya
items.body:
bole sheh kya mai jawab e khat e dukhtar likhun
naamawar dekh le jo haal hai kyun kar likhun
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise likhun ke tere chaahne waale na rahe
hogi is gham ki wo kis tarha se khoogar likhun
bole sheh kya mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaar likha hai jise jaan se pyara keh kar
mar gaye teer e sitam kha ke wo asghar likhun
bole sheh kya mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum se shikwa o shikayat hai bahot sughra ko
naiza khaye huwe so rahe hai wo akbar likhun
bole sheh kya mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat gaye shaane chidi mashke sakina afsos
bichde pardes mein abbas e dilawar likhun
bole sheh kya mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ko dulha bane subhe shahadat paayi
laash qasim hui pamaal ye kyun kar likhun
bole sheh kya mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
do huwe kufe mein do karbobala mein maqtool
haye muslim ke pisar mar gaye kyun kar likhun
bole sheh kya mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne tanha thay hussain asr ke hangaam anees
gham se phat jaye kaleja jo wo manzar likhun
bole sheh kya mai...
items.author: Anees

items.title: Dashte bala may
items.body:
haye maara gaya ibne hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte bala may goonji ye shabbir ki sada
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim hamare bhaiya hassan ki tha yaadgaar
ab kaun hum ko keh ke pukarega ay chacha
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas tum bhi saath chalo dashte zaar may
wo laasha hum se tanha samayta na jayega
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo paara paara laash uthaane ke waaste
keh kar bichayi sarwar e mazloom ne aba
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli batool ghurbat e shabbir dekh kar
teri madad ke waaste aayi hai fatema
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukdon ki ghatri kaandhe pe rakhi hussain ne
yun suye qaimagah chala ibne fatema
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dulha ajeeb shaan ka hai qasim e hassan
ke jis ka sehra sajne se pehle bikhar gaya
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghatri ko le ke godh may ye keh rahi thi maa
beta tumhare byaah ka armaan reh gaya
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab qaimagah pahunche to nauha yehi padhe
maula se hai ye majid o mukhtar ki dua
laasha hassan ke laal ka tukdon may bat gaya
dashte bala may goonji ye...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Ek sookha sa sarwar
items.body:
haye hussain haye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sookha sa sarwar ka gala
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek maa ki thi maqtal mein sada
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
<<DIVIDER>>
har samt sitam ki baarish mein
roti hui ek maa tanha thi
khanjar ke talay bhi zehra thi
aur teer ki zad pe bhi zehra thi
haye zehra ne bhi dekh liya
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek sookha sa sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah se bache ke upar
ye arz o samaa bhi rota raha
ek kund sa khanjar sarwar ke
sookhe se galay par chalta raha
pamaal hua be-jurm o khata
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek sookha sa sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ki zameen ko saaf kiya
ek maa ne pareshan baalon se
ek maa ne sawara asghar ki
zulfon ko bade armaano se
dil dekh ke dono ka toota
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek sookha sa sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek uska gala tha jisko kabhi
lete thay mohamed khud bosa
aur ek galay ko ro ro kar
khud shaah e zaman ne chooma tha
dono sare maqtal kaata gaya
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek sookha sa sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke be-sar laashe par
haye bali sakina ki aahein
is tarha dilaasa deti thi
kehti thi sakina se maayein
hum ne bhi dekh ke sabr kiya
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek sookha sa sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tashna dahan ek tashna suqan
dono hi to thay be-gor o kafan
ek jalti zameen ke andar tha
aur ek ka tha teeron pe badan
kehti thi ye zahra wavaila
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek sookha sa sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shams ajab ghurbat ka samaa
tha ehle aza ke chehron par
jab maine kaha shabbir ka aur
asghar ka gala tha naizon par
rehan labon par tha nauha
ek sookha sa asghar ka gala
ek sookha sa sarwar...
items.author: Shams Tabrez

items.title: Hussain ki madad
items.body:
ye keh rahe hai mustufa
ye keh rahe hai murtuza
ye keh rahe hai mujtaba
ye keh rahi hai fatema
ye keh raha hai khud khuda
hussain ki madad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
jo nasir e hussain thay
wo khaak o khoon mein ad chuke
zameen pe qasim e hazeen
tukdiyon mein bat chuke
jo baazu e hussain tha
usi ke haath kat chuke
hai ghazi ab bhi keh raha
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina jigar mein ghus chuki
pisar bhi kya dikhayi de
hai boodha baap sochta
sada koi sunayi de
nazar ka noor chin chuka
kya usay dikhayi de
wo ghutniyo hai chal pada
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek taraf wo zalzala
meinan e shark o gharb tha
hussain ki sada suni ajeeb
us mein karb tha
ruka na asghare hazeen
yehi to waqt e harb tha
ye kehke jhoole se gira
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai sher e bawafa
akela reh gaya hussain
na akbar e hazeen raha
akela reh gaya hussain
sagheer bhi chala gaya
akela reh gaya hussain
behen ne karb se kaha
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap raha hai khaak o khoon mein
fatema ke dil ka chain
zameen se arsh tak baland
zainab e hazeen ke bain
har ek ki laash legaye
pada hai laasha e hussain
layeen hai har kuchal raha
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh rahi hai fatema
ho khatm din malaal ke
tum ashk jo bahaoge
rakhungi mai sambhal ke
ye ashk leke jaaungi
bharenge zakhm laal ke
azaa ka farsh hai bicha
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
urooj e ghairat e nabi
kisa ka noor e lazawaal
na shaam ko bhula saka
usay hai aaj bhi malaal
hussain ki hai aarzoo
rakhe hijaab ka khayal
saron pe tum rakho rida
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo apna gham chupa raha hai
aaj ka hussain hai
jo ashk e dil baha raha hai
aaj ka hussain hai
madad ko jo bula raha
hai aaj ka husain hai
suno imam ki sada
hussain ki madad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
imam e asr ki nazar mein
kya amal ka hai maqam
qamar azaa ke saath hum ne
kya kiye hai jin ke kaam
guroh kitne ban gaye
magar akela hai imam
ye aaj ki hai karbala
hussain ki madad karo...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Jo bhi parcham
items.body:
ya abal fazlil abbas
ay alamdare karbala ghazi
ay wafadare fatema ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi parcham tera uthaata hai
wo dua fatema se paata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
us alam par jo ek panja hai
panjetan paanch hai batata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera ghazi ka wo bhatija hai
teer khaa kar jo muskurata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ye kehti hai kamiyab hoon mai
mera beta alam uthaata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shareefun nasab ka shewa hai
har koi kab alam uthaata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
daad dete hai khud hussain usay
jab namazi alam uthaata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz karta hai ye alam khud par
daste ghazi mein jab bhi aata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
iske saaye mein jo bhi palte hai
unko ye sher dil banata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
bewafaon khareeb mat aana
ye alam shajre jaan jaata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
us se khush kaise ho mera ghazi
bhaiyon ka jo dil dukhata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai alam mein jo ek mashkeeza
kya mohabbat hai ye batata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai alam ki mukhalifat phir bhi
ye zamane pe chaaya jaata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye alam mard ki alaamat hai
ab bhi mardon mein paaya jaata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud sakina duayein deti hai
jab bhi parcham koi sajata hai
jo bhi parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sharar naqvi shadman kaho
ye alam aasman banata hai
jo bhi parcham...
items.author: Sharar Naqvi

items.title: Karbala dikha to
items.body:
ay mere maula hussain
ay mere aaqa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere maula ay mere aaqa
marne se pehle karbala dikha de
<<DIVIDER>>
allahum arzukhna shafatal hussain
allahum arzukhna ziaratal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mai mar na jaaun tumse mile bin
ye soch kar mai rota hoo har din
mas kar ke tere rauze se maula
apna kafan sab laate hai lekin
tera kafan mai laaunga mujhko
ay bekafan koi raasta dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat ka aalam sab se chupa kar
karbobala seene mein basa kar
shauk e ziyarat mein jee raha hoo
mai bhi namak se rotiyan kha kar
muflis hoo kaise rauze pe aaun
maula tu koi maujiza dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaair banoo mai uske haram ka
sab par hai saaya jis ke alam ka
tum to kareem e karbobala ho
mai muntazir hoo tere karam ka
ab bhi jahan hai mashk e sakina
mujhko wo rauza e bawafa dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
us bawafa ka chehra jahan par
zakhmi huwa tha ghode se gir kar
baazu kahin thay paon kahin thay
kis tarha dekha tumne wo manzar
ghazi jahan par bikhra huwa tha
haye wo nehr e alqama dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ko qasam hai us naujawan ki
jis ke jigar mein tooti sina thi
matam karun mai jaa kar wahan par
akbar ke baba hasrat hai meri
khaynchi jahan par seene se barchi
aankhon ko meri wo jagah dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein jahan tum thak kar gire thay
uthna tha mushkil zakhmi thay itne
phir us muqaam e mehdi se chal kar
tum qatl gaah tak aaye thay kaise
kohniyo ke bal chalna hai mujhko
wo raah e sidratul muntaha dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa rahi hai karbobala ki
sunlo sada zeeshan o raza ki
bulwa lo hum ko is arbaeen par
hai ye tamanna ahle aza ki
paidal najaf se aana hai chal ke
jannat ka mujhko tu raasta dikha de
karbala dikha de
allahum marzukhna...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Lelo zainab salaam
items.body:
alwida alwida ay behen alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ye sheh ka kalaam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam aakhri
<<DIVIDER>>
khatm hai zindagi ka safar
ab to saansein bhi hai muqtasar
jaa rahe hai shahadat ko hum
ab na aayenge hum laut kar
hai ye pyase ki shaam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ka waqt jaane ko hai
teeragi ran mein chaane ko hai
dhalne waala hai suraj behen
shaam e aalam aane ko hai
shaah ka hai dawaam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o akbar ko mai kho chuka
chid chuka bezaban ka gala
ab hai fauje sitam aur mai
aur zakhmi hai seena mera
bar zaban hai kalaam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke ye qaul e sheh pur mahan
sabr darkaar hai khastatan
ab to shohda ke mehwar mein haan
meri maajayi meri behan
bas hamara hai naam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad mere tera maareka
kufa aur shaam mein hai saja
sher dil khwahare shaahe deen
tujhko karna hai sar bakhuda
ab hai mera qayaam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sakina alaike salaam
de raha hai sada tishnakaam
phir na paogi lehja mera
sunlo aakar basad ehtemaam
guftugu e imam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ho abid watan waapsi
mere shiyon se kehna yehi
yaad kar le meri pyaas ko
jab piye thanda pani kabhi
dena mera payaam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam o yazdan sheh ke sukhan
sun ke roye zameen o zaman
baazuon mein rasan jab bandhe
sabr karna ay meri behen
kaam ye tishnakaam aakhri
lelo zainab salaam...
tha ye sheh ka kalaam...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Muslim ke dono bete
items.body:
muslim ke dono bete jahan se guzar gaye
do shaahzade aalam e ghurbat mein mar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
baahein galay mein bhai ne bhai ki daal di
yun apni jaanein shaah pe qurban kar gaye
muslim ke dono bete…
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein yateemon ki ghurbat ka tha ye haal
dunya se dono tashna dahan khoon mein tar gaye
muslim ke dono bete…
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim bhi phoot phoot ke rote thay dekh kar
darbar mein jo chand se bachon ke sar gaye
muslim ke dono bete…
<<DIVIDER>>
junhi suna ke kufe mein bache huwe shaheed
khanjar se dil mein ghamzada maa ke utar gaye
muslim ke dono bete…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peet ke ye kehti thi ek beqaraar maa
dhoondun kahan unhe mere bache kidhar gaye
muslim ke dono bete…
<<DIVIDER>>
nikle thay deen bachane bachaya khuda ka deen
muslim ke laal laut ke wapas na ghar gaye
muslim ke dono bete…
<<DIVIDER>>
gohar wo apne noor ki khairaat baksh kar
islam ka wujood ujaalon se bhar gaye
muslim ke dono bete…
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Noke naiza pe
items.body:
haye bekasi bhai aur behan ki
shaam haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
berida dekh kar ro raha hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab mera aasra hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
<<DIVIDER>>
sura e kehf ki hai hai tilawat
mere bhai ke sookhe labon par
bas kalaam e khuda ki hai qiraat
mere bhai ke sookhe labon par
kibriya ki sana kar raha hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
berida dekh kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat e jad ko khud bakhshwane
aaya tha karbala mera bhai
aur shifa'at ke raste bataane
aaya tha karbala mera bhai
ahde tifli ada kar raha hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
berida dekh kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangti hoon rida jab kisi se
thartarata hai naize pe bhai
mar gaye haye tum mere bhaiya
maut mujhko magar kyun na aayi
par dilaase mujhe de raha hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
berida dekh kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chin rahe hai sakina ke gauhar
khaa rahi hai tamache wo paiham
keh rahi hai wo ay mere baba
kar rahi hai wo ro ro ke matam
bebasi se usay dekhta hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
berida dekh kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi jo bhai ke aankhon ki thandak
haye wo binte shaahe madina
karbala se chale hum jo kufa
gir gayi raaste mein sakina
khud ba khud raah mein ruk gaya hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
berida dekh kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne is tarha se zindagi mein
aise raste to dekhe nahi thay
usi kufe ke bazaar se hum
kabhi be-parda guzre nahi thay
bas yehi soch kr ro raha hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
berida dekh kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jo bibi pe raste mein guzre
phat rahe hai jigar us alam se
shadman tha jo zainab ka nauha
likhdo majid wo apne qalam se
mera ghamkhwar har dam raha hai
nok e naiza pe bhai mera
berida dekh kar...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Aaram kahan
items.body:
aaram kahan haye haye aaram kahan
dashte aalam mein zainab ko bhala, aaram kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl shabbir bhi abbas bhi akbar bhi huve
kat gaye aun-o-mohamad ke bhi maqtal mein galay
laashae ibne hassan ho gaya paamale jafa
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer jab asghar e masoom ki gardan pe laga
deti thi qaime ke dar pe khadi bano ye sada
bin tere chain milay kaise mere mahelakha
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
chid gayi mashke sakina labe darya afsos
be-kafn khaak pe hai sher ka laasha afsos
pyase bachon ka koi chahne wala na raha
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
chin gayi sar se rida jal gaya asbaab tamaam
baade shabbir namudar huvi kaisi ye shaam
khoon kano se baha bachi ka daaman bhi jala
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar shaheedo ke sare nauke sina qaid haram
ek do ka nahi seene mein bahattar ka hai gham
bediyan pehne huve laaghiro beemar chala
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi maara gaya talwar se naize se koi
laash maqtal mein kisi dulha ki pamaal hui
hogaye baazu e abbase alamdar juda
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro kehti hai sakina mere ammu aao
mujko maare na layeen aake inhe samjhao
kyun nahi sunte ho deti hoo tumhe kab se sada
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafela jaata hai aab shaam ke baazaro mein
chalte hai ahle haram zulm ke angaro mein
har qadam hoti hai beemar pe ek taaza jafa
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache jo khaak pa girte hai kuchal jaate hai
gham se dil maa'on ke seene se nikal jaate hai
koi sunta nahi bewa'on ki faryad-o-buka
aaram kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh roti hai qalam likhta hai noha rehaan
hai karam mujhpe shahe karbobala ka rehaan
nowha jab tak na likhoo roz shahe deen ka naya
aaram kahan...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Abbas ke hote hue
items.body:
thi haram ki ye sada abbas ke hote huwe
kaun cheenega rida abbas ke hote huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnagi be aab sehraon ki wehshat kuch nahi
dushmanane deene paighambar ki kasrat kuch nahi
khanjaron teeron ki talwaron ki taaqat kuch nahi
gham bhala kis baat ka abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaamp uthegi faza us sher ki lalkaar se
taygh kya shamsheer kya bas abruon ke waar se
faujein takrayegi jaa kar shaam ki deewar se
kya karenge ashkiyan abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath mein wo khushk kooze aur sada e alatash
hont neele zard chehre aur sada e alatash
saaqi e kausar ke bacche aur sada e alatash
kis ne socha tha bhala abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz aayenga tere deedar ko ahle jahan
teri azmat ko salaami dega bad kar aasman
har zameen ta hashr dohrayegi teri daastan
gham na kar ay karbala abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko sone hi nahi deti mere dil ki chuban
thay yehi waqt e wasiyat mere baba ki sukhan
ay meri zainab bandhegi tere shaano mein rasan
maan loo kaise bhala abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine maana hongi faujein dushmano ki saf ba saf
ye to batlao zara beti ko ya shaah e najaf
dekhein nazron ko utha kar ashkiyan meri taraf
kaise mumkin hai bhala abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
is bulandi par muqaddar ke sitaare dekh kar
chaaro jaanib apne athara sahare dekh kar
roz kehti thi sakina apne goshware dekh kar
kaun cheenega chacha abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gaya karbobala mein fatema zehra ka ghar
marsiya padne laga jis dam basheer e motabar
ghaiz mein ummul baneen boli asa ko thaam kar
ye sitam kyun kar hua abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
marzi e shabbir ke akkaas ko kuch mat kaho
meri chaahat ko mere ehsaas ko kuch mat kaho
tum ko zainab ki qasam abbas ko kuch mat kaho
ghar salamat tha mera abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
marzi e maula pe raazi hai bilal e kazmi
kehdo ay aamir namazi hai bilal e kazmi
shayar e abbas e ghazi hai bilal e kazmi
khauf mehshar ka bhala abbas ke hote huwe
thi haram ki ye sada...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Aisa hua barbaad
items.body:
ujad gaye sadaat
<<DIVIDER>>
ho na saka phir shaad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad bhara ghar zehra ka
<<DIVIDER>>
chehel pehel jab ghar aangan mein hoti hai
tanhaai saaye se lipat kar roti hai
aa jaata hai yaad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein dooba mashkeeza hai parcham hai
jangal hai pyase bacche hai matam hai
gham ki hai roodad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl huwe sab koi nahi hamdardon mein
ghash se utho ek tum hi bache ho mardon mein
ujad gaya sajjad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein kuch bhi na bacha ashoor ke din
aaj aisa taaraaj hua ashoor ke din
phir na hua aabaad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
doobi hai ashkon mein duayein ek maa ki
aati hai maqtal mein sadayein ek maa ki
maut na kar barbaad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ki har cheez jala di qaimon mein
bedardon ne loot macha di qaimon mein
karta raha faryad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na watan mein qasim akbar lautenge
ek faqad bas abid e muztar lautenge
sughra mat kar yaad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq galay mein hai pairon mein zanjeerein
ghoom rahi hai aankhon mein sab tasveerein
bhoole nahi sajjad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aankhon mein khoon ke manzar aaj talak
gham ki qaid se aamir o akhtar aaj talak
ho na saka azaad bhara ghar zehra ka
aisa hua barbaad...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Ali ali hai zaban
items.body:
ali ali hai zaban par kabhi hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke zikr ko apni baqa samajhte hai
hum aap in ki fazilat ko kya samajhte hai
khuda samajhta hai ya mustafa samajhte hai
nahi samajhte jo in ko khuda samajhte hai
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda nahi hai magar wajhe kirdagaar to hai
ye do jahan mein khudayi ka aetbaar to hai
jahan mein doshe payambar ka sheh sawaar to hai
raza e haq pe unhe poora ikhtiyar to hai
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ohad ki jang mein dekhe ajab ajab kirdaar
kahin hai zikre shuja'at kahin hai zikre faraar
zameen se taaba falak hai ali ali ki pukaar
utar rahe hai malayek liye huwe talwaar
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
samajh saka na zamana maqam e ahlebait
kalaam haq hi samjhe kalaame ahlebait
jagah jagah pe sunao payame ahlebait
karo jahan mein raaij nizaam e ahlebait
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo nahi jinhe dunya khareed sakti hai
ye wo hai jinke tasadduq mein khalk palti hai
sune wo jinko mohabbat ali ki khalti hai
qadam se in ke shariyat nabi ki chalti hai
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ke saath jo rehte thay us zamane mein
wohi thay aale mohamed ka ghar jalane mein
kuch aise naam bhi shaamil hai is fasane mein
hijab aata hai ab tak hamay batane mein
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua e fatema zehra hai jab talak qayam
na ruk sakega kisi se hussain ka matam
sune zamana hai jab tak hamare dam mein dam
rakhenge yunhi buland hum hussain ka parcham
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kasar kisi ne na chodi hamay mitane mein
khuda hi apna muhafiz tha har zamane mein
ye rok tok hai kyun sheh ka gham manane mein
yazeed kya abhi zinda hai is zamane mein
ali ali hai zaban par...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Ammu bhi nahi aaye
items.body:
ammu bhi nahi aaye baba bhi nahi aaye
kya baat hai darya par jo jaaye wo reh jaaye
ammu bhi nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
batlade koi itna kis ja hai mere ammu
mai jaake mana loongi koi mujhe samjhaye
ammu bhi nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar hai na qasim hai na aun o mohamed bhi
ghar laut ke maidan se ab tak to nahi aaye
ammu bhi nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad ke behal jaata dil jhoola jhulane se
nanha sa mera bhai asghar bhi chuta haaye
ammu bhi nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz to do baba hai hadde nazar laashe
ab dhoondne koi bhi jaaye to kahan jaaye
ammu bhi nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se mere cheene jo shimre sitamgar ne
baba jo gohar mujhko jo thay aap ne pehnaaye
ammu bhi nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
naalon se sakina ke moo ko hai jigar aaya
khamoshi anees-e-gham ye qalb na phat jaaye
ammu bhi nahi....
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Ay azadaron utho
items.body:
ay azadaron utho sheh ke ansaar bano
pairawi hurr ki karo waqt ko jaane na do
aagaya maahe buka maahe alam maahe aza
jiske ek din mein luta zehra ka ghar wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
ye maahe moharram ye aza e shahe waala
is maah mein loota gaya shabbir ka kunba
is maah mein sadaat ne gham khaye hai kya kya
is maah mein kaunain mein barpa hua larza
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aamad e shabbir azakhana sajao
taqdeem karo taaziya haathon se banao
abbas ka parcham bhi kareeb aake lagao
humraah e alam mashke sakina ko bi lao
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam e ali asghar pe sabeelon ko lagao
raahon mein azadaron ke palkon ko bichao
lillaah karo zikr na dunya ko dikhao
jo kuch hai azadri e sarwar mein lutao
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayaat shahadat ki padho sab ko sunao
jazba hai wafadari ka dunya ko batao
hurr ban ke dar e hazrate shabbir pe aao
khud haathon se bigdi hui taqdeer banao
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
is maah mein farwa se chuta qasim e muztar
pamaal hua laasha e ibne bine hyder
phoolon ki tarha jism ke tukde thay zameen par
sheh laaye jisay ek ghatri mein rakh kar
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
is maah mein laila se chuta godh ka paala
maidan se phir lauta nahi gaysuon waala
naize ki ani aur jawan laal ka seena
kis tarha ye manzar shahe abraar ne dekha
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
is maah ne sughra ko madine mein rulaaya
har saans naye karb ka ehsaas dilaaya
sheh qatl huwe dasht mein ye aake bataya
zauf e jasad e sughra ko kuch aur badhaya
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
is maah mein sadaat ko aafaat ne ghayra
aalam o masayab ke parindo ka basera
dekha nahi bachon ne sukoon baksh savera
chaaya raha taqdeer ki dunya mein andhera
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham khaate rahe sabr ka daaman nahi choda
saabir na nazar aayega shabbir ke jaisa
dekha na falak ne koi is shaan ka banda
laashon pe shaheedon ke kiya shukr ka sajda
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
is maah ne shabbir ko kunbe se chudaya
aankhon se lahoo hazrate zehra ko rulaya
is maah ne abid ko bahot zakhm diye hai
har gaam mazaalim dil emuztar pe sahe hai
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ke ewaz ashk e ghame shaah piye hai
maula hi batayenge wo kis tarha jiye hai
abid ke liye kaisi qayamat ki ghadi thi
be-gor o kafan laasha e shabbir padi thi
ay azadaron utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
is maah mein ay dayam o yazdan ye rah dhyaan
is maah ka har haal mein baakhi rahe irfan
padte raho qurbani e shabbir ka quran
batalaate raho dunya ko shabbir ka ehsaan
ay azadaron utho...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Baba na jao
items.body:
meri dunya ujad na jaaye khudara ruk jao
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bain ye zainab ka baba na jao
ho jaaye na ghar soona baba na jao
<<DIVIDER>>
kal khwab mein dekha tha baba hai lahoo mein tar
veeran pada hai ghar
kufe mein wavaila baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
murghabiyan hyder ke daaman se lipat'ti hai
baba wo tadapti hai
manzar hai qayamat ka baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ki judaai ko mai bhool nahi paayi
zainab pe tanhaai
dil mera hai ghabraya baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk jaaye zara baba sadqa mai utarungi
jee bhar ke mai dekhungi
baba ka haseen chehra baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se bichadne ki ye aakhri shab aayi
bechain hai dono bhai
ghabrata dil kyun baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagta hai ke zainab par hai waqt yateemi ka
