mabood karam farma
afsurda hai dil mera baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mujhe sadma hai amma se bichadne ka
dil phat'ta hai kyun mera
zainab ke labon par tha baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt mohib ghar se maula e zaman nikle
aflaak larazte thay
beti ka ye nauha tha baba na jao
hai bain ye zainab ka...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Bazaar aa raha hai
items.body:
ye kaun khoon rota bazaar aa raha hai
lab pe sawaal e chadar aankhon mein karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mahol hai sharabi uryan aayatein hai
ghairat ke na khuda par ghurbat ki imtehan hai
ye kaun khoon rota…
<<DIVIDER>>
abid haya ka kaaba kaise na khoon roye
namoos us jari ki balwe mein berida hai
ye kaun khoon rota…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghairat se khoon mein tar har aankh hai sina par
darbar waqt e payshi nazdeek aa chuka hai
ye kaun khoon rota…
<<DIVIDER>>
hilne lagi zameen aur bazaar thar tharaya
zainab ka patharon se jab zakhmi sar hua hai
ye kaun khoon rota…
<<DIVIDER>>
balon mein aa chuki hai masooma ke safedi
shimr e layeen ne uspe itna sitam kiya hai
ye kaun khoon rota…
<<DIVIDER>>
haider karenge matam is baat ka hashr tak
sajjad ki jawani bazaar kha gaya hai
ye kaun khoon rota…
items.author: Haider Awan

items.title: Dashte karbala
items.body:
dasht e karbala mein jaan e syeda par
chal raha tha khanjar dasht e karbala mein
apne dil ko thaame bekasi se khwahar
dekhti thi manzar dasht e karbala mein
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi wo pyasa kar raha tha sajda
dhoop se lipat kar ro raha tha saaya
har taraf udaasi chaa gayi thi aisi
ro diye payambar dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham zada hawayein khoon fisha fizayein
bewatan musaafir ab kahan ko jaaye
jal chuke hai qaime lootne ko chadar
aa gaya tha lashkar dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
be kafan thay laashe lashkar e khuda ke
khoon ubal raha tha ban mein karbala ke
goonjta tha nauha binte murtuza ka
lut gaya mera ghar dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kare sakina zakhmi hai wo seena
neend kaise aaye ay shah e madina
khaa chuki tamache shimr behaya ne
cheene mere gohar dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan kise de bezaban ki maadar
lab pe har ghadi hai haye haye asghar
jal gaya hai jhoola ye sitam hai kaisa
dhoondti hai maadar dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sitam ki barchi naujawan ne khaayi
ek sada e gaibi aasmaan se aayi
sabr kar le zainab is jawan ko apne
dil pe rakh ke pathar dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim e jawan ka tukde tukde laasha
jab aba mein chun kar laaye mere maula
aasman roya tha zameen ko sakta
dekh ke ye manzar dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bureeda baazu alqama kanare
naam par wafa ke apna khoon baha ke
keh gaya jahan se ashk e khoon fisha se
mai hoo aaj hyder dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir e shah e deen khuld ke thay raahi
ay rehaan is ki kyun na doon gawahi
jaan nisaar saare apni jaan haare
ibne murtaza par dasht e karbala mein
dasht e karbala mein...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ghazi ki yaad mein
items.body:
saqqa e sakina abbas e alamdaar
haye abbas haye abbas haye abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ki yaad mein yun royi sakina
patthar aankhein bhar aaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ka lahoo to arzhan tha
pani ki wohi mehengaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko pyasi bhatiji se
waada jo tera poora na hua
pani pe larazti hai ab tak
abbas teri parchaiyan
patthar aankhein...
<<DIVIDER>>
farzande ali zahra ke pisar
jald aao taraayi se uth kar
phir khaana e zahra jalta hai
laut aayi hai phir balwaiyan
patthar aankhein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis din se gaye farzande nabi
sooni hai padi ek ek gali
hum jholiyan ban gayi sughra ki
beeti yaadein tanhaiyan
patthar aankhein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay daaman e saahil tu inko
abbas ke shaane mat kehna
ye zabte wigha mein hai ghazi ki
do tooti hui angdaiyan
patthar aankhein...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein aun o mohamed ne
darya ki ye taraf rukh bhi na kiya
dekhi na gayi yun pyason ki
pani se ye be-parwahiyan
patthar aankhein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ek rasan mein baara galay
saaye ke sataye dhoop jale
be parda phirayi jaati hai
abbas teri maajaiyan
patthar aankhein...
<<DIVIDER>>
nau ras ghunche pamaal huwe
gul phool samar behaal huwe
zehra o ali ke aangan mein
ulti chal gayi purwaiyan
patthar aankhein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhe shadman rota hai ab tak
ay seena e zakhmi akbar ke
dekhi hai sarosh ne ashkon mein
tere zakhm ki si gehraiyan
patthar aankhein...
items.author: Agha Sarosh

items.title: Haram ko kushtae
items.body:
haram ko kushta e khanjar ki yaad aayegi
watan ko ho ke bhare ghar ki yaad aayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar padi jo kabhi maa ki adh khile gul par
tabassum e ali asghar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sula ke qabr mein baysheer ko na jao rabab
khulegi neend to maadar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rabab baali sakina ko royegi din bhar
andheri raat mein asghar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthegi koyi bhi mayyat jab ehtemam ke saath
behen ko laasha e sarwar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
madina kaamp uthega behen ke naalon se
watan mein jab bhi biradar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain se ro kar kaha sakina ne
tumhe bhi kya kabhi dukhtar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
behen ko aakhri rukhsat mein dekh lo shabbir
gala katega to khwahar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rida chinegi to yaad aayega furaat ka sher
rasan bandhegi to akbar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jao ganje shaheedan ki simt ay zainab
base basaye huwe ghar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalega dasht se jab khafila aseeron ka
qadam qadam pe bhare ghar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
suroor rok di jayegi pursishe ehwaal
lehed mein jab ghame sarwar ki yaad aayegi
haram ko kushtae khanjar...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Hifazat ki dua
items.body:
jo bichate hai moharram mein sada farshe aza
fatema unki hifazat ki dua karti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
apna gham bhool ke karte hai jo matam sheh ka
fatema unki hifazat ki dua karti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chaand aata hai nazar maahe aza ka jis dam
sheh nasheenon mein azadaar sajate hai alam
jab wo karte hai hussain ibne ali par girya
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
laut kar des mein pardes se aa jaate hai
apni daulat jo ghame sheh mein luta jaate hai
aam karte hai jo har saal ghame karbobala
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein rakhte hai sada ahle haram ka ehsaas
yaad mein unki pehente hai jo bas kaale libaas
rashk un logon pe karta hai libaas e kaaba
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
shah ke matam mein jo sholon pe chala karte hai
naam e shabbir pe jo jaan fida karte hai
unko hota hi nahi jaan ka koi khatra
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bahate hai ghame sibte nabi mein aansu
aur zanjeer o qama kar ke bahaate hai lahoo
unka hota hai har ek lamha madadgaar khuda
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
parchame hazrate abbas uthane waale
pa barahna hai julooson mein jo aane waale
apne honton pe liye haye hussaina ki sada
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ke maqsad ke muhafiz bhi hai ghazi bhi hai
jo azadaar bhi hai aur namazi bhi hai
farshe majlis pe jo karte hai khuda ka sajda
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
door rehti hai bala karbobala waalon se
munsalik hai jo sada karbobala waalon se
unki har gaam pe karte hai hifazat maula
fatema unki hifazat ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz karte hai wazeefa ye kumail o aamir
dil mein rakhte hai aqeeda ye kumail o aamir
jo bhi padhte hai hussain ibne ali ka nauha
fatema unki hifazat ki...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Jab chand moharram
items.body:
jab chaand muharram ka nikalta hai falak par
roti hai bahot hazrate shabbir ki maadar
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ke azadaron ko wo chaand dikha kar
roti hai bahot hazrat e shabbir ki maadar
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai azadaron ke ghar fatema zehra
deti hai dua shaam o sahar fatema zehra
har sheh kai azadar ki quwwat ko badha kar
roti hai bahot hazrate...
jab chaand muharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab majlise shabbir mein aate hai azadar
pyason kai liye ashk bahate hai azadar
rumaal azadaron ki aankhon se laga kar
roti hai bahot hazrate...
jab chaand muharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloomon ka jab sog manaati hai kaneezein
aur chudiyan haathon se badhati hai kaneezein
kubra ki kaneezon ko kaleje se laga kar
roti hai bahot hazrate...
jab chaand muharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai sakina bhi azakhane ke andar
ghazi ke masayab pe bilakti hai wo muztar
aaghosh mein masoom sakina ko uhta kar
roti hai bahot hazrate...
jab chaand muharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
daadi se ye jab kehti hai masoom sakina
ye kaun hai karte hai mere baba pe girya
hai sheh ke azadar yateema se bata kar
roti hai bahot hazrate...
jab chaand muharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hai nazar parchame abbas pe jis dam
shehzadi bahot roti hai sar peet ke us dam
phirta hai nigahon mein taraayi ka wo manzar
roti hai bahot hazrate...
jab chaand muharram ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kismat pe bahot naaz hai hum ghamkhwar hai bibi
hum sab tere bacchon kai azadar hai bibi
jab kehte hai waiz ye azadar tadap kar
roti hai bahot hazrate...
jab chaand muharram ka...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Jo bijli tayghe hyder
items.body:
jo bijli tayghe hyder ki sar e khyber nazar aayi
sar e marhab pa chamki sheh par e jibraeel par aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
padi thi kuch ajab andaz se mursal ne khyber may
ali ki shakl may naade ali sab ko nazar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
qayamat kyun na ho abbas ka hamla sar e saahil
nazar aaya jo darya baazu ki machli ubhar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunati thi butool e paak ko sab jang ki baatein
palat kar jang se taygh e ali jab apne ghar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke haath ki zarbat hai goya zarbat e qaadir
sar e arzaq pa chamki thi ke badkar ta kamar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ko ahle emaan dekh kar kaabe may kehte hai
mohamad ke liye allah ke ghar may sipar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shamsheeer e ali hai ya hai baraste abr may bijli
wahan kaundhi yahan garji udhar chamki idhar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhe thay haath se khud panjetan ke naam kashti par
tabhi to nooh ki kashti sar e toofan ubhar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
wohi hurr ghayr kar laaya tha jo shabbir ko ban may
usi hurr ko rukhe shabbir may jannat nazar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
azaab aata hua rukwa diya apni sifarish se
ata e shaah e deen mahir sar e mehshar nazar aayi
jo bijli tayghe hyder...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Karbala ek aaftab
items.body:
karbala ek aaftab aur uski tanveerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
ek kitabe aagahi jiski hai tafseerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
panjetan ke naksh seene mein saja kar rakh liye
kaatib e taqdeer ne dikhlayi tasveerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bahattar tan shareek e maqsad e zibhe azeem
ek khaleeli khaab tha jiski hai tabeerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
fauq e akbar ne azan mein bhar diya kuch aur rang
yun to mehshar tak suni jayengi takbeerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
nusrate haq mein teri uqba bani hurr e jari
haath mal kar reh gayi dunya ki jageerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk saka kab raasta sher e khuda ke sher ka
rokne ko laakh thi saahil pa shamsheerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
bezaban asghar ne pathar dil hila kar rakh diye
sun chuke thay ashqiyan pur soz taqreerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
goshware khaynch kar ghudka tamache bhi lagaye
jaise thi us phool si bachi ki tafseerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
<<DIVIDER>>
bediyan pairon mein aur gardan mein tauq e khaardaar
phir bhi pehnayi gayi abid ko zanjeerein bahot
karbala karbala ek aaftab
items.author: Izzat Lakhnavi

items.title: Kehti thi umme laila
items.body:
kehti thi umme laila laashe jawan pe ro kar
mujhko na maut aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
kadiyal jawan ka laasha aaya hai khoon mein tar
mujhko na maut aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch soojta nahi hai aankhon mein hai andhera
dunya se jaa chuka hai mera jawan beta
kehti rahungi ab mai bas ye tadap tadap kar
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarhane naujawan ke baithi hai umme laila
moo choom kar pisar ka ye keh rahi hai dukhiya
ab saari zindagi mai bas ye kahungi ro kar
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
arshe bari pe us din mera naseeb hota
kaandhe pe leke chalte jab tum mera janaza
afsos maa se pehle tum mar gaye gule tar
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek maa ki zindagi mein ye din kabhi na aaye
bete ki laash maa ko allah na dikhaye
meri tarha ye keh kar roye na koi maadar
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se apne jiske gaysu sawarti thi
jis laal ki mai har dam nazrein utaarti thi
maara layeen ne naiza us gulbadan ke dil par
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara saal jisko tha mannaton se paala
nazron ke saamne hai us naujawan ka laasha
haye re meri kismat haye mera muqaddar
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
roye bahot tadap kar us waqt shaahe waala
zainab se jab lipat kar royi hai umme laila
ye keh rahi thi dono tum mar gaye ay akbar
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz na likh sakega us ghamzada ki haalat
bas maa'ein jaanti hai kya hai pisar ki ulfat
zinda thi umme laila jab tak ye tha labon par
mujhko na maut aayi...
kehti thi umme laila...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Koi na tha jo karata
items.body:
nisaar kar chuke jab raahe haq mein asghar ko
tab aaye qaime mein sheh ruqsate muqarrar ko
bayaan kaise karoon bekasi ke manzar ko
thi pesh manzilein dushware ibne hyder ko
koi na tha jo karata sawaar sarwar ko
bithaya ghode pe hamsheer ne biradar ko
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek bibi ka dil gham se tha taho-bala
na koi monis-o-yawar na godh ka paala
koi lipat'ti thi daaman se karti thi naala
khade thay sar ko jhukaye huwe shahe wala
koi na tha jo karata…
<<DIVIDER>>
buland hoti thi qaime se al-atash ki sada
sakina kehti thi maqtal se jald aao chacha
kabhi pukarti koi ke aao shere khuda
madad ka waqt hai shabbir ho rahe hai juda
koi na tha jo karata…
<<DIVIDER>>
pukari zainab-e-muztar kahan ho ay akbar
akela fauje adoo mein chala nabi ka pisar
khabar na loge chacha ki ay qasim e mustar
kahan pe hai mera shere jari wafa paykar
koi na tha jo karata....
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nauha karti thi maqtal mein zainab-e-kubra
bachane waala koi mere bhai ka na raha
gulu bureeda se deta tha har shaheed sada
mile hayaat to phir ho hazaar baar fida
koi na tha jo karata…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha hussain ne zainab se alvida hamsheer
bula rahe hai paye jang kab se bepeer
khayal rakhna sakina ka hai bahut hi sagheer
muaf karna jo karde kabhi koi tafseer
koi na tha jo karata…
<<DIVIDER>>
lajaam thaam ke ghode se bole ye shabbir
hamare saath hai zulm o sitam ka tu bhi aseer
safar hai aakhri tujh par mera ye ay dilgeer
tuhi hai munis-o-ghamkhwar mera waqte akheer
koi na tha jo karata…
<<DIVIDER>>
imam-e-waqt se jab zuljana ne ye suna
zubaan e haal se wo bezuban huwa goya
huzoor aap pe sau baar meri jaan fida
zehe naseeb ke ye farz aap ne sawmpa
koi na tha jo karata…
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaanta hoo ke ye aakhri sawari hai
karoo jihad ye khud mujhko beqarari hai
sumon se lipti hui aap ki dulaari hai
mere padar ko na leja ye lab pe jaari hai
koi na tha jo karata…
<<DIVIDER>>
anees ruqsate aakhir ke waqt tha mehshar
koi to peet'ti thi seena koi bibi sar
kabhi pukarti thi apne pyaro ko ro kar
kahan pe ho zara ye haal dekh lo aa kar
koi na tha jo karata…
items.author: Anees

items.title: Lene aao bhai
items.body:
waqt e aakhir ye kaha akbar ne baba jaan
dekhlun ek baar phir se behna ko jo hai wahan
haa usi lamha nazar aayi madine ki zameen
kar rahi thi ye bayan sar ko jhukaye nazneen
<<DIVIDER>>
lene aao bhai mujhko ghut raha hai dam yahan
<<DIVIDER>>
dar pe apne sar ko rakh kar keh rahi thi nazneen
bhai akbar lene mujhko ab talak aaye nahi
yaad mein teri ye behna mar na jaye bhai jaan
lene aao bhai mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se uske bahe jaate thay ashkon ke chiraag
bekasi aur bebasi ka dil mein tha uske jo daagh
maathe ki har ek shikan se uth'ta tha gham ka dhuan
lene aao bhai mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogayi hai wo firaaqe gham mein is tarha nidhaal
dekh kar sunsan dar ko lochti thi sar ke baal
yaad aate hai jo akbar sunti thi jab bhi azan
lene aao bhai mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki shafqat kabhi aur maa ki mamta thi kabhi
bhai behno ki mohabbat pyar karti thi phupi
phirta tha aankhon mein uske har ghadi saara samaa
lene aao bhai mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye bemaari ka aalam uspe hai tanhaiyan
choomti hai bhai akbar ke khadmon ke nishan
ashkon se likh likh ke khat mein kar diya sab kuch bayan
lene aao bhai mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baith kar din bhar musalle par ye karti thi dua
kunbe se mere milaado mujhko ay behre khuda
ghutniyon chalta ab hoga mera asghar be-zuban
lene aao bhai mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ka khoon ban kar siyaahi karta hai ahmed raqam
aur rahega ta qayamat dil mein ye irfan ke gham
sogh mein tere ay bibi rota hai saara jahan
lene aao bhai mujhko...
items.author: Ahmed

items.title: Maula hussain
items.body:
hussain mera hai kehte hai zamane waale
ke baadshahi har ek dil pe hai ab tera hussain
nahi hai deen o mazahib ka yahn koi bandish
ye tera ishq hi sar char ke bolta hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain se ye deen hai
wo deen jo azeem hai
khaaliq bhi kya kareem hai
banaya usko is tarha
baatil se jaake wo lada
yazeediyat ke chehre se naqaab ko ulat diya
hussain uska naam hai jo waaris e quran hai
rasool e paak ne kaha mai is se hoo wo mujhse hai
khuda ne bad ke di sada zibhe azeem tu bana
ay nafse mutmaina tera intezar mujhko hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne raza e haq ke liye jaan ko qurban ki
deen e payambari ke liye jaan ko qurban ki
jis ne azeez aqroba ko deen pe qurban ki
<<DIVIDER>>
insan pe har aan tu ehsaan bana hai
maula hussain maula hussain
har ek azadaar ka pehchaan bana hai
maula hussain maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
uska lahoo to zarb hai karbal ki zameen mein
na sochna wo dab gaya karbal ki zameen mein
insaniyat ko jazba e emaan diya hai
maula hussain maula hussain
insan pe har aan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaaba bacha quran bacha deen bhi bacha
lekin hussain ka bhara ghar hogaya tabaah
hai fakhr mohamed ko wo nawasa mera hai
maula hussain maula hussain
insan pe har aan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai fikhr na gham jaan lutaane ka zara bhi
kya josh hai himmat hai kasam rab e jahan ki
raahe khuda mein shaukhe shahadat sikhaya hai
maula hussain maula hussain
insan pe har aan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim kabhi akbar kabhi abbas sa bhai
ran mein shaheed hote thay har ek sipaahi
apne zeef kaandhe pe laasha uthaya hai
maula hussain maula hussain
insan pe har aan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaate pade hai pyaas ki shiddat se zaban mein
aur garm hawa garm zameen dashte bala mein
aasan na tha aisa jihad is ne kiya hai
maula hussain maula hussain
insan pe har aan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki duaon ka talabgaar hai aazam
ahsan padho nauha karo sar peet ke matam
shauke ghame hussain to naslo ka pata hai
maula hussain maula hussain
insan pe har aan...
items.author: Azam Hussain

items.title: Mere laal hussaina
items.body:
maa aayi hai mazloom mere laal hussaina
aaja meri aaghosh may behaal hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal may baqiyya se thi jis waqt mai pahunchi
ghodon se teri laash thi pamaal hussaina
mere laal hussaina mere laal hussaina
maa aayi hai mazloom...
<<DIVIDER>>
hae hae mere bete ka badan khoon may tar hai
aulaad e payamabar ke ujadne ki khabar hai
poshak hai zakhmon se teri laal hussaina
mere laal hussaina mere laal hussaina
maa aayi hai mazloom...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hogayi barbaad qayamat ki ghadi hai
be-gor o kafan ran may teri laash padi hai
ghurbat may tera hogaya kya haal hussaina
mere laal hussaina mere laal hussaina
maa aayi hai mazloom...
<<DIVIDER>>
phat jaaye na sadme se kahin maa ka kaleja
aankhein tu zara khol de maa ayi hai beta
baahon ko galay may tu mere daal hussaina
mere laal hussaina mere laal hussaina
maa aayi hai mazloom...
<<DIVIDER>>
na zeen pe laasha hai tera aur na zameen par
aaja ay mere laal ke sar zaanu pa rakh kar
baandhungi tere sar pe mai rumaal hussaina
mere laal hussaina mere laal hussaina
maa aayi hai mazloom...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko rida tujhko kafan bhi na milega
ghurbat pe teri royegi ta hashr ye dukhiya
kholungi teri laash pe mai baal hussaina
mere laal hussaina mere laal hussaina
maa aayi hai mazloom...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khaule payambar hai mohib mit na sakega
ek khaum zamane may khuda khalq karega
gham tera manayegi jo har saal hussaina
mere laal hussaina mere laal hussaina
maa aayi hai mazloom...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Muslim ke pyare
items.body:
muslim ke pyare bachon ka sar tan se kat gaya
darya mein jaake laashe se laasha lipat gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
haaris ne haye zulm wo dhaya furaat par
bachon ke haath baandh ke laaya furaat par
utri saron se topiyan daaman bhi phat gaya
muslim ke pyare bachon ka...

shaam o kufa may sitamgar ye sitam bhi dhayenge
meri jaanib teer nazron se chalaye jayenge
ghairat e abid karegi saamna har teer ka
aur guzar hai darmiyan se berida hamsheer ka
ek taraf ghazi ka laasha...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauhagar yasir o sajid hai jo har ahle aza
haye zainab haye zainab haye zainab ghamzada
yehi nauha tha tan e sajjad par zanjeer ka
aur guzar hai darmiyan se berida hamsheer ka
ek taraf ghazi ka laasha...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Haram ko leke
items.body:
haram ko leke suye shaam jab badi zainab
kabhi hussain bani aur kabhi ali zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bekhabar thay ke tareek ho rahi hai raqam
jo keh rahe thay isay teri bebasi zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka deen hai zinda hussain ke dam se
hussainiat ko mili tujhse zindagi zianab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeediyon ne bahot koshishein to ki lekin
kisi se kam na hui teri bartari zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
usay giraana tha khutbon se shaam ka khyber
ali ke lehje mein kyun kar na bolti zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ko jo shab e hijrat khuda ne bechi thi
ali se tu ne wo marzi khareed li zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
huwe na khatm pas e karbala bhi zulm o sitam
gayi hai shaam talak tere tashnagi zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay ek rasan may jo baara galay rasan basta
rasan khuli to sakina nahi rahi zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi nahi ke rasan basta haath hai tere
ghazab hua ke rida sar se chin gayi zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
badan sikasta rasan basta majma e aada
azaan may naam e nabi sun ke ro pari zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne maanga kaneezi mein jab sakina ko
jigar pakad ke pukaari ali ali zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaai paa ke watan ke liye rawana hui
tadap ke kehti thi abbas ghar chali zainab
haram ko leke...
<<DIVIDER>>
qalam ki aankh se behta hai khoon ali ansar
wo dastan e haram khoon se likh gayi zainab
haram ko leke...
items.author: Ali Ansar

items.title: Hijabe zainab
items.body:
alam jhuka to hijabe zainab
pe mushkilon ke sairaab chaaye
rida e tatheer lootne ko
layeen bekauf hoke aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
bhale wo shabbir aur zainab
hai phir bhi abbas ki judaai
ke wa hijaaba behan pukari
hussain rote hai sar jhukaye
alam jhuka to hijabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin pe tera alam pada hai
kahin pe baazu kahin pe laasha
kahan kahan se batao ghazi
hussain tumko uthane aaye
alam jhuka to hijabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhara hona hi ek bhaiya
wo is ghareebi mein tha sahara
batao pardes mein bhala kaun
zaalimo se hamein bachaye
alam jhuka to hijabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tere hone se jaagte thay
wo so rahe hai hamein jagaye
zara batao to kaise zainab
yateem sehme huwe sulaaye
alam jhuka to hijabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri rida aur hussain ka sar
teri hifazat ki aad mein tha
tumhare jaane ke baad dono
pe cha gaye hai sitam ke saaye
alam jhuka to hijabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai pani to laut aao
sakina tum bin na reh sakegi
wo jhel legi jo uska asghar
tadap ke jhoole mein bil bilaye
alam jhuka to hijabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua e zehra sawaal e hyder
ata e khaaliq rida e zainab
yehi to ghazi hai jaun khud mein
jo inka rabte ziya dikhaye
alam jhuka to hijabe...
items.author: Jaun

items.title: Hussain kya hai
items.body:
tu phir bhi hum se ye poochta hai
hussain kya hai hussain kya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zameer e insan jagaya jis ne
falak zameen ko banaya jis ne
sina pe quran sunaya jis ne
nishan e baatil mitaya jis ne
khuda ke deen ko bachaya jis ne
hussain wo hai hussain wo hai
tu phir bhi hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke lashkar ka ameer e lashkar
wo jis pe naaza hai rabb e akbar
hai jis ke ghar may farishte naukar
faqeer jis ke hai sab qalandar
hai jis ki tashnalabi samandar
hussain wo hai hussain wo hai
tu phir bhi hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ne karbobala banayi
wo jis ne bazm e wafa sajayi
ali ka beta hassan ka bhai
kare jo nabiyon ki rehnumayi
khuda na de di jisay khudayi
hussain wo hai hussain wo hai
tu phir bhi hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ne khaake shifa banayi
wo jis ne nafse jahan chalayi
wo jis ne shamme amal jalayi
har ek asmat hai inka haayi
hai jis ka abbas jaisa bhai
hussain wo hai hussain wo hai
tu phir bhi hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain sardar e aalameen hai
hussain dunya may misle deen hai
risalaton ka yehi ameer hai
bahot haseen hai bahot haseen hai
wo jis ke jaisa koi nahi hai
hussain wo hai hussain wo hai
tu phir bhi hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zamana karwat zaroor lega
har ek maozzin azan ye dega
zara teher ja ti khud kahega
juloos jis ka na ruk sakega
wo jis ka matam sada rahega
hussain wo hai hussain wo hai
tu phir bhi hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo maqtalon may hayaat baante
bata do gohar ye wo saqi hai
nahi hai kismat may tere bete
rasoll e haq bhi ye kehde jis se
jo saath bete usi ko de de
hussain wo hai hussain wo hai
tu phir bhi hum se...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Jab chand moharram
items.body:
jab chand moharram ka dekha
mazloom ka khissa yaad aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab ki udaasi yaad aayi
aur ujda madina yaad aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha jo mahe nau gardoon par
khoon behne laga aansu ban kar
naize ki ani ke saath jawan
bete ka kaleje yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaabu na raha kuch bhi dil par
seene mein laga gham ka nishtar
jab chand ko dekha misle kamaan
baysheer ka khissa yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein jo pahunchi fauje khuda
tharrayi zameen gardoon kaampa
shabbir ko sehra yaad aaya
abbas ko darya yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se kaleja thaam liya
aur dekh ke maqtal ko roye
jab sarwar e deen ko waqte safar
sughra ka tadapna yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bazme hussaini mein dekha
lehrate huwe parcham haq ka
darya ki taraayi yaad aayi
abbas ka shaana yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqe se tadap kar maajayi
maqtal mein giri behosh hui
jab zer e falak be-gor o kafan
maajaye ka laasha yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaunk uth'ti thi sote mein aksar
raaton ko rabab e khasta jigar
zindan ke andhere mein usko
godhi ka ujaala yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe mein jo pahunche aale nabi
pabande rasan thay sab qaidi
hyder ki dulaari beti ko
baba ka zamana yaad aaya
yasrab ki udaasi...

items.title: Jo dil ghame shabbir
items.body:
jo dil ghame shabbir mein maghmoom bahot hai
goya wo khareebe shahe mazloom bahot hai
<<DIVIDER>>
be hubbe ali zikr namazon ka na chedo
aisi to namaze hamein maloom bahot hai
jo dil ghame shabbir…
<<DIVIDER>>
hairaan hoo ke asghar ki hasi kaise bayan ho
us mauje tabassum ke to mafhoom bahot hai
jo dil ghame shabbir…
<<DIVIDER>>
haasil hai abhi sab kahan daulat e daarein
shabbir ke gham se abhi mehroom bahot hai
jo dil ghame shabbir…
<<DIVIDER>>
pur soz hai lekin ghame shabbir ki roodaad
afsane to yun dard ke markhoom bahot hai
jo dil ghame shabbir…
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shahe mazloom sabhi gham mein hai lekin
ek bali sakina hai ke maghmoom bahot hai
jo dil ghame shabbir…
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Karbala ek baar
items.body:
misle hurr qismat jaga kar dekhna
karbala ek baar jaa kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr e akbar keh rahi hai doston
naujawani ki shahadat aisi ho
khud ko yun haq par mita kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpane ka dost wo sheh ka habeeb
rauza e sheh ki hai darbani naseeb
is tarha waada nibha kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e sheh par hai asghar ka maqaam
haye wo mazloom maa ka laal-faam
dil ke jhoole mein jhula kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon ke karwan ko saath lo
qalb ke soze neha ko saath lo
tab dua ko haath utha kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala tatheer waale ka hai ghar
keena o makr o hasad ko chod kar
khud ko tum taahir bana kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haajiyon se kehti hai qabre nabi
chaahte ho tum agar meri khushi
is tarha hajj ko saja kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye abbas e ghazi ka haram
aaj bhi baaqi hai ghazi ka hashm
wo haram nazrein jhuka kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao majid chalke dekhein wo maqam
dard mando ko jo karde shadman
waqt ko taara bana kar dekhna
karbala ek baar...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Kehti thi ye fatema
items.body:
kehti thi ye fatema sughra
aaoge to kab aaoge
ay mere bhai ay mere baba
aaoge to kab aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
kehke gaye thay aayenge lene
tum ko ay meri dukhtar
chod diya kyun mujhko tanha
aaoge to kab aaoge
kehti thi ye fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed asghar o qasim
sab ko nigahein dhoonti hai
pooch raha hai shehre madina
aaoge to kab aaoge
kehti thi ye fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ki veerani mein jo izafa
ho jaata hai aur shaam dhale
nauhagar hai khaali hujra
aaoge to kab aaoge
kehti thi ye fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi chiraagh jalane waala
shehre madine mein na raha
veeran hai sarkar ka rauza
aaoge to kab aaoge
kehti thi ye fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
roshni hogi kab hujron mein
kab veerani jayegi
ghayr raha hai mujhko andhera
aaoge to kab aaoge
kehti thi ye fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
subho ko rona shaam ko rona
sab mausam hai rone ke
rukta nahi ashkon ka darya
aaoge to kab aaoge
kehti thi ye fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao zafar rehan dilaasa
de dukhiyari sughra ko
karti rahi bemaar ye nauha
aaoge to kab aaoge
kehti thi ye fatema...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Muslim ki karbala
items.body:
logon ye shehr e kufa muslim ki karbala hai
ek be-watan yahan bhi faujon mein ghir gaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor se bhi pehle ashoor ka hai manzar
khush ho rahe hai zaalim muslim ka khoon baha kar
talwaar hai layeen ki mazloom ka gala hai
logon ye shehr e kufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
barse hai teer is par maare gaye hai naize
laakhon se phir bhi muslim ladta raha akele
na bhai hai na bete na koi aasra hai
logon ye shehr e kufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaynka gaya hai jis dam inko bulandiyon se
awaaz tootne ki aayi thi pasliyon se
mazloom ke labon par bas haye sayyeda hai
logon ye shehr e kufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota gaya izaafa bekas ki bekasi mein
khayncha gaya hai laasha kufe ki har gali mein
shabbir ki tarha se sar jism se juda hai
logon ye shehr e kufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe mein dar badar thay muslim ke shaahzade
apne padar ko aakhir kaise kafan wo dete
sajjad par jo aaya waisa hi marhala hai
logon ye shehr e kufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasid shahe huda ka pyasa tha be watan tha
chalees din hue thay laasha bhi be kafan tha
jo sheh ke saath hoga sab kuch wohi hua hai
logon ye shehr e kufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
azlan aur mesum tha sayyeda ka nauha
ay mere laal tujhko maara gaya hai pyasa
muslim ki laash par bhi zehra ki ye buka hai
logon ye shehr e kufa...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Aasman barsa de
items.body:
aasman barsa de pani
pani barsa de aasman
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh wo pyase bacche sheh ke
haathon mein hai khaali kooze
dekh udhar darya ki rawani
us pe sitam hai tashna dahani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik e kausar pani ko tarse
aur pani phir bhi na barse
sookhe hai lab aur zubanein
rukne lagi saanson ki rawani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasman tujhko taras na aaya
ab tak na pani barsaya
sookhe huwe kooze bhi sunaye
tishna labon ke gham ki kahani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein har soo zulm ke lashkar
pehre lagaye hai pani par
qaid hui darya ki maujein
ghere huwe hai zulm ke baani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu to hai sairaab is neymat se
soch zara lekin shiddat se
tujhko jaa kar kaun bataye
tashna labi ke kya hai mu’aani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna ek din aayega wo
pani se mehroom rahe jo
saare jag mein hongi sabeelein
tashna labon ki ban ke nishani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai tujhse khaak e bayaban
bacche hai betaab hirasan
aati hai rone ki sadayein
kehte hai ro kar pani pani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun hai in par rehm jo khaaye
aur pyason ko pani pilaye
door hai ye apne watan se
aaye hai kar ke naql makani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashkon se apni pyaas bujhayi
pyase dete hai ye duhaai
dekh ke rote han darya ko
sookhe labon ka rang hai dhaani
aasman barsa de pani...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi dil par zakhm hai taaza
is se tu kar le andaaza
pani piyein farhan o mazhar
pyason pe kar ke fateha khwani
aasman barsa de pani...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Aisa musafir na ayega
items.body:
mehman tera pyasa raha sookha gala kaata gaya
ay dashte karbala ay dashte karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
bete shaheed ho gaye bhai juda hua
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashein utha utha ke kamar choor hogayi
jeene ki arzoo to bahot door ho gayi
akbar shaheed ho gaya mai sochta raha
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu kata ke nehr pe abbas so gaya
hasrat se ahlebait ko mai dekhta raha
ab mere baad meri sakina ka hoga kya
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ansaar e bawafa mere mujh par fida huye
tayghon ke moo ko unke galay choomte rahe
ek shab ka mehman tha hurr wo bhi mar gaya
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ki maut meri ghareebi pe royi hai
daulat hassan ki maine bayaban mein khoyi hai
qasim kahan hai dasht mein mai dhoondta raha
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare thay mujhko jaan se zaianb ke laadle
wo aediyan ragad ke mera dil dukha gaye
laashon pe unki haye mai tanha khada raha
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah jaanta hai jo dil par guzar gayi
asghar ke baad jeene ki taaqat nahi rahi
wo phool mere haath pe murjha ke reh gaya
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek karke monis o yawar guzar gaye
jeete thay jinko dekh ke wo laal mar gaye
karta sawaar jo mujhe baaqi koi na tha
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zeen se zamaan pe ya-rab gira tha mai
amma mere sirhane thi ghash mein pada tha mai
khanjar layeen galay pe mere phayrne laga
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan shaah e deen ne kaha rab e zuljalaal
zaahir hai tujhpe aale mohamed ka saara haal
jibreel hai gawah sar e maqtal e jafa
humse kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
aisa ghareeb aisa musafir na aayega
ay dashte karbala...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ali ali karte raho
items.body:
ya ali maula ya ali maula karte raho
ali ali ali ali karte raho
ya ali maula ya ali maula karte raho
<<DIVIDER>>
nukta e baa hai ali ali ali ali
rab ne kaha hai ali ali ali ali
marzi e daawar nafse payambar
shere ghazanfar faatahe khybar
saaze wila hai ali ali
raaze khuda hai ali ali
bete ne jiske jaake padha hai naize par quran
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil ka hal ali ali ali ali
karam ka baadal ali ali ali ali
lauhe azal hai haq ki ghazal hai
saaze amal hai qaul atal hai
shaane jali hai ali ali
rab ka wali hai ali ali
hijrat ki shab usko mili hai marzi e rehman
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
hilm ka ghar hai ali ali ali ali
ilm ka dar hai ali ali ali ali
qalb o jigar mein fikr o nazar mein
ilm o hunar mein shaam o sahar mein
gyan ka suraj ali ali
dhyan ki sajdhaj ali ali
naam e ali ki maala japna momin ki pehachan
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
makki madani ali ali ali ali
ajami arabi ali ali ali ali
rang chaman bhi boo e saman bhi
rooh e sukhan bhi tann mann dhan bhi
kahin saqi hai ali ali
kahin aqi hai ali ali
naam se uske ho jaati hai har mushkil aasan
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ka qaseeda ali ali ali ali
fatha ka surah ali ali ali ali
taara utre suraj palte
khyber ukhde saamp ho tukde
ran ki sada hai ali ali
shere khuda hai ali ali
zarb se jiski goonj raha hai khandaq ka maidan
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan e haram hai ali ali ali ali
shaan e haram hai ali ali ali ali
banda e rab hai sajda e rab hai
lahja e rab hai chehra e rab hai
nooh ka taqwa ali ali
khizr ka jalwa ali ali
koi kahe allah ka banda koi kahe bhagwan
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
auje fasahat ali ali ali ali
nahje balaghat ali ali ali ali
marzi e khudrat rooh e risalat
jaan e wilayat shaan e imamat
tum hi mashiyat ali ali
tum hi shariyat ali ali
sajde mein tum ne khaayi hai zarbat ay kulle emaan
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop mita do ali ali ali ali
dhoop saja do ali ali ali ali
phool khila do chao bicha do
zahen jaga do jeena sikha do
hum ko asar do ali ali
daaman bhar do ali ali
apne karam se qayam kar do daher mein amn o amaan
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
<<DIVIDER>>
nayyar ka gun ali ali ali ali
aamir ki dhun ali ali ali ali
shamma ki lau mein subh ki pau mein
husn ki zau mein ishq ki rau mein
aayat aayat ali ali
surat surat ali ali
yun lagta hai jaise ali ki madha kare quran
ali ali ali ali karte raho...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Ammu jaan
items.body:
ammu jaan ammu jaan
waadiye ghurbat ke mehman
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ki dukhtar laashe chacha par
nehr kanare thi nalaan
ammu jaan ammu jaan
waadiye ghurbat ke mehman
dilbare hyder saani e jafar
shere dilawar tashna dahan
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baaghe nabi gulzaare ali
pamaal kiye ran mein aada
na baba na bhaiya
rayth hai ban mein laashon ka
jaye taraai dil ko kushaai
kar gaye kunbe ko veeran
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheen ke darya pani ko roka
pyason ko pani bhi na diya
amre dagha bachon ka
aah na kuch bhi paas kiya
dard ye utha dil hai tadapta
kiski dawa hai na darmaan
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi dagha hai kaisi jafa hai
haath juda hai shaano se
dil tukde tan purze
teer o tabar shamsheeron se
qalb hai muztar jaan labon par
dekh ke tumko lahoo lahaan
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekas utho bebas utho
ghayre hai qaimon ko naari
haye khaari dukhyaari
bibiyan karte hai zaari
maa hai munawar fidyaye daawar
neend se jaago o nalaan
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayda mere saqqa
mere jangal mein ho uff tada
wa darda wa darla
haye sajjada la takiya
rayt pe jalti laash hai tapti
dhoop kadi soona maidan
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu e anwar aah sitamgar
gurze giran se choor kiya
sar taapa wa darda
behne laga khoon ka darya
nehr kanare laash ko chode
sar hai chadaye noke sinaan
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimre badakhtar khaynch ke khanjar
khaufna laakar kaata gala
sayyed ka murshad ka
daagh mujhe kamsini mein diya
maare sadaqat maahe imamat
hogaya mitti mein veeran
ammu jaan ammu jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e sarwar haye sitamgar
haif na rutba ruk jaana
aaqa ka maula ka
pad kar kalma ahmed ka
fatema zehra jannat se aa
laashe par hai nauha kunaan
ammu jaan ammu jaan...

items.title: Ay baba dekhte rehna
items.body:
sakina kehti jaati thi sar e shabbir se ro kar
bithaata hai mujhe shimr e sitamgar pushte naaqa par
ay baba dekhte rehna
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke waaste rakhna nazar mujhpar mere baba
na jaane kyun sataata hai ye mujhko darr mere baba
kahin aisa na ho ke raah mein mar jaun mai gir kar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere nazdeek se shimr e sitamgar jab guzarta hai
yateemi par khuda jaane meri kyun tanz karta hai
kahin aisa na ho rakh de gulu e khusk par khanjar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm khaaya na meri kamsini par baani e shar ne
shutar ki pusht se baandha hai ay baba sitamgar ne
mai sar se paon tak odhe huwe hoon zakhmon ki chadar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankhon ke aage aap ka chehra rahe baba
mujhe dedaar dauraane safar hota rahe baba
har ek sadma saha karlungi lekin mujhko mud mud kar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai saabir baap ki beti hoon dunya ko bataungi
mujhe jis haal mein le jayenge aada mai jaungi
na aayega kisi bhi mod par shikwa mere lab par
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha abbas ka sar kyun nazar aate nahi mujhko
mai kab se dhoondti hoon par nazar aata nahi mujhko
teher jaaye to batlana sar e naiza chacha ka sar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri kismat ne ay baba ye kaise din dikhaye hai
khuda jaane ke ab tak kitne pathar maine khaaye hai
mai roti hoon to ghurbat par meri haste hai ahle shar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laga rakhi hai ay baba mere rone pe pabandi
bata sakti nahi jo kaifiyat is waqt hai meri
musalsal khaa rahi hoon pusht par kode kabhi pathar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
karun mai daastan e ranj o gham asif bayan kaise
sunaye ahle emaan ko sakina ki fughan kaise
sada ye aaj bhi ay shadman aati hai reh reh kar
ay baba dekhte rehna
bithaata hai mujhe...
items.author: Asif Bijnori

items.title: Baba nahi rahe
items.body:
arshe bari se aayi jo ta'damat sada
kufa shehr mein hashr ka hangaam hogaya
goonji fiza mein jab ye sada haye murtaza
nauha kuna kaha jo manadi ne alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab rida ko thaam ke karne lagi buka
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid hai soghwar musalla hai ghamzada
sajde mein sar ali ka shikasta kiya gaya
kufa shehr mein aaj hai aaghaz e karbala
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
zainab rida ko thaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
be aasra huwe thay jo bacche tadap gaye
pyale jo doodh ke thay wo haathon se gir gaye
dar par ali ke saare yateemon ne di sada
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
zainab rida ko thaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
raaton ko uth ke pani pilayega kaun ab
bole hussain pyaas bujhayega kaun ab
amma ke baad aagayi baba ko bhi qaza
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
zainab rida ko thaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha bade jo bhai ko rone lagi behan
haye hassan pukaar ke boli tera badan
dekhungi an-khareeb mai teeron bhara hua
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
zainab rida ko thaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki dua ne usko alamdaar kar diya
abbas tha wo hyder e karrar kar diya
kaise kare yaqeen wo abbas e bawafa
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
zainab rida ko thaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye soch kar ke mujhko ye beti kahe abhi
mayyat pe apne baap ki nade ali padhi
ab tak qubool kar na saki binte sayyeda
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
zainab rida ko thaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim ke saath masjide kufa mein ya khuda
pursa batool e paak ki beti ka ho bapa
zarbat ki jaa pe bain kare yasir e aza
baba nahi rahe baba nahi rahe
zainab rida ko thaam ke...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Bazaare shaam
items.body:
bazare shaam aagaya
akbar mere jawan kisko bulaye maa
zainab ki lo khabar abid hai natawan
bazare shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte bala ko chor kar khake shifa ko odh kar
ay faqre kibriya suno kehti hoo haath jodh kar
kaise chalegi maa ay mere naujawan
bazare shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
qismat ki paasban hai wo khairunnisa ki jaan hai wo
ghurbat ki inteha hui ghairon ke darmiyan hai wo
shazadiye jina sehti hai saqtiyan
bazare shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaatil tera mere pisar sajjad ka hai humsafar
kam to nahi hai ye sitam sehta raha hai wo magar
kaise sahe bhala bemaar saar baan
bazare shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
maine suni hai ye sada kehte hai shaam may sabhi
badla ali ka lenge hum binte ali se aaj hi
pathar se hai bhari logon ki jholiyan
bazare shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
na-mehramo ki bheed may uth'ti nahi nazar meri
abbas ki qasam nahi tashnalabi ka gham koi
dukh hai ye meri jaan sehmi hai bibiyan
bazare shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
paala hai jisne umr bhar akbar tujhe hijab may
ghazi ke saamne bhi wo beta rahi naqaab may
ghairon may be rida jaati hai al-amaan
bazare shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
noke sina ko dekh kar yawar ye keh rahi thi maa
aa dekh tu bhi naujawan madar ka apni imtehan
aankhen na band kar ghairat se aasman
bazare shaam…
items.author: Yawar Abbas

items.title: Boli maa khasta jigar
items.body:
boli maa khasta jigar aakhri lori sunlo
ay mere noore nazar aakhri lori sunlo
<<DIVIDER>>
mera armaan meri jaan meri aas ho tum
apne maa ke liye asghar nahi abbas ho tum
aaj ki raat ghanimat hai mere paas ho tum
ay mere rashke qamar aakhri lori sunlo
boli maa khasta jigar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sooni kar ke meri godhi mujhe tadpaoge
chod kar roti hui maa ko chale jaoge
aise jaoge ke wapas nahi aaoge
door ka hai ye safar aakhri lori sunlo
boli maa khasta jigar...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aaghosh mein ye aakhri shab hai pyare
is tasavvur se mere chalte hai dil par aare
subha beh jayenge ran mein tere khoon ke dhaare
tujhko aayegi qaza aakhri lori sunlo
boli maa khasta jigar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal sare dashte bala hoga qayamat ka samaan
tum khuda jaane kahan hoge kahan hogi ye maa
raakh reh jayegi kal aaj ye qaime hai jahan
kal ujad jayega ghar aakhri lori sunlo
boli maa khasta jigar...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahe thay abhi haye shahe karbobala
qatl ho jayegi is dasht mein kal fauje khuda
ay mere laal larazta hai kaleja mera
raat jaaye na guzar aakhri lori sunlo
boli maa khasta jigar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadiyano ki sada aane lage hai ran se
suye maidan chale ansaar shahe waala ke
khatm hone ko hai ye raat ke ay laal mere
hone waali hai sehar aakhri lori sunlo
boli maa khasta jigar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr ka lamha tha gohar wo qayamat ki ghadi
karwatein leta tha shehzada tadapta tha kabhi
dard mein doobi hui sun ke sada maadar ki
aagaya waqt e safar aakhri lori sunlo
boli maa khasta jigar...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: De kar alam jo sheh
items.body:
de kar alam jo sheh ne hyder bana diya
saqqa ne saara saahil khyber bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye ali to rab ne khush aamdeed keh kar
deewar may haram ki ek dar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
saj kar imambara hum ye samajh rahe hai
jannat ke raaste may ek ghar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehnayi ja rahi hai dunya may mannato se
abid ne hathkadi ko zewar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar bapa kiye hai do ungliyan ali ki
bachon ka ek gharonda khyber bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
naame yazeed dar dar phirta hai moo chupaye
aisa hussain tumne be-ghar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne mujahidon ko saj kar hussain ne bhi
salman bana diya hai buzar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki suja'at saahil pa koi dekhe
hyder se milta jhulta tewar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
mimbar pa jaa ke khoon may mursal e murtaza ko
maula bana ke sab se bar-tar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
madhe ali ki khaatir kitne hi meesamo ne
dunya may sooliyon ko mimbar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
kismat ne mujhko mahir meraaj baksh di hai
mujhko ghulame shaah e qambar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Ek zaeefi ye duja
items.body:
haye akbar haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
ek zaeefi ye dooja mulk paraya akbar
baabe te zaalimanu na tars aaya akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
is zaeefi mein tera laasha uthaun kaise
dekh baba pe tere waqt ye aaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahun dil pe mere beeth gayi kya beta
qasid e sughra khat e sughra jo laaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere laashe pe kahin mar hi na jaaye zainab
jis ne seene pe tujhe apne sulaaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh qaime mein teri maa ye buka karne lagi
itne armaan se tera seha banaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu abhi zinda hai aur noor gaya aankhon se
haath jo taygh pe tha seene pe aaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya ghareebi hai teri laash uthaane ke liye
kaam aaya na koi apna paraya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum bhi auron ki tarha chod gaye saath mera
sirf ghurbat ne mera saath nibhaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhta hoo mai usi seene mein barchi ki ani
kal isi seene ko seene ko lagaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman hoga sar e hashr hai mazhar ko yaqeen
jisne dunya ko tere gham mein rulaya akbar
ek zaeefi ye dooja...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ghazi tere baad
items.body:
pardes mein hussain ki basti ujad gayi
ghazi tere baad qayamat guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
darya se jab na lauta sadaat ka sahara
aulaad e fatema ne phir chain hi na paaya
zahra ki kaynaat hi ban mein bikhar gayi
ghazi tere baad qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri laadli sakina sadme utha rahi hai
jab se gaya hai ghazi us ko bula rahi hai
soti nahi hai chain se itna wo darr gayi
ghazi tere baad qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas jab talak tha sheh ko na koi gham tha
mehfooz thi ridayein jab zaamin e haram tha
wo kya shaheed ho gaya har aas mar gayi
ghazi tere baad qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne baad tere kya kya sitam uthaye
dil ke wo zakhm saare kis ko bhala dikhaye
honton pe tera naam tha zainab jidhar gayi
ghazi tere baad qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ka tha baazu kunbe ki jaan tha wo
shehzadiyon ke sar pe ek sayeban tha wo
sab ko judaai ye teri be-aas kar gayi
ghazi tere baad qayamat...
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Haram sarae hussaini
items.body:
haram sara e hussaini ke pasban abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
wafa ka laakh khusoos e amal kiya abbas
shabihe faatahe khyber rahi nishan abbas
haram sara e hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shamma jisko yazidi bujha nahin sakte
jala gaye hai sare raah e imtehan abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar to jaati hai insaan pahunch nahi sakta
fareed e azm o amal ke hai aasman abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka azm hai talwar chalaye fazle hussain
wo inkare taqaddus ke darmian abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye haath hote hifazat hayaat hote agar
jahan jahan hai shah e deen wahan wahan abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ki raah may tu ne kata ke haathon ko
ajal ki tod ke rakh di kalaiyaan abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
idhar ghash aa gaya shayad sakina bibi ko
pukarte hai tumhe shaah e ins o jaan abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
usool e tashnalabi ka agar bahadar tha
har ek maut se uthne laga dhuan abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
<<DIVIDER>>
aseer ho ke sab ahle haram shaheedon ke
suni to hongi sakina ki imtihan abbas
haram sara-e-hussaini...
items.author: Izzat Lakhnavi

items.title: Hilale mahe moharam
items.body:
hilale mahe moharam pe pad gayi jo nazar
to yaad aa gaya zehra ke laal ka wo safar
raqam ho kis tarha phat'ta hai gham se qalb o jigar
watan se ruqsat e aakhir ka phir gaya manzar
lipat lipat ke wo sughra ka baba se israar
mujhe bhi saath mein le kar chalo shahe abraar
<<DIVIDER>>
suna raha hoo suno dastane dard o alam
ye kiske gham mein hai masroofe girya-o-matam
ye kaun tha jise rote hai is tarha se hum
bafaize shahe shaheeda karoon jawab raqam
aza ka maah isi maah ko jo kehte hai
hilal dekh ke chote bade wo rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeede faasiq-o-faajir ki jab na bayyat ki
to aur bad gaya jo bugz dil mein tha zaleel
samajh raha tha pase parda kya hai haq ka wali
safar ka faisla karne mein kuch na dayr lagi
watan chutay to chutay hurmate madina rahe
mai hoo na hoo magar islam ka kareena rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
mai sab batata chaloon kaun tha ye haq ka wali
hai uska naame gira aur hussain ibne ali
rajab ke maah mein do din thay baaqi aur abhi
chala madine se makke ki simt sipte nabi
wahan bhi dekh ke aba mein chipe hue khanjar
libaase haajiyon mein tha wo sham ka lashkar
<<DIVIDER>>
hazaron dushmane jaan dar libase dost milay
baqa e kaaab thi peshe nazar na kate galay
ye sochte thay ke sailaab e kufr kaise talay
badalke umre mein hajj ko ba dard-o-yaas chalay
abhi thay raah mein koofe ki jo ye aayi khabar
ke qatl hogaye muslim wahan ni qasta jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sunke tha shahe abraar ko bahot sadma
bulaake hazrate abbas ko ye hukm diya
bajaye kufa koi aur raah lo bhaiya
bala se dasht ho sehra ho jo khuda ki raza
ye kufe waale farebi hai aur jhoote hai
hamare saath mein kuch bibiyan hai bache hai
<<DIVIDER>>
gharaz ke teen moharam ko nainawa pahunche
tamaam khaafile ke saath mustufa pahunche
malaik aur ajina o aur ambiya pahunche
hassan ke saath zehra-o-murtaza pahunche
hussain ne rakhe karbobala mein apne khadam
nidae ghaib ye aayi ke tere saath hai hum
<<DIVIDER>>
huwe thay teen shab-o-roz thi na aabo ghiza
jo aayi mahe moharam ki subhe aashura
sagheer bachon ka tha ghair haal had se siwa
buland hoti thi qaimon se al-atash ki sada
layeen dikhate thay pani ko aur bahaate thay
nabi ki aal ko lekin nahi pilaate thay
<<DIVIDER>>
anees aale mohamed ka hai to royega
na chain din ko milega na shab ko soyega
ye zaade raahe haqeeqi hai kaise khoyega
ye haq hai baad mein ehsaas tujhko hoyega
rafeeq wo nahi jo gham mein saath ko choday
khushi mein saath ho lekin alam mein moo moday
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Hussain maqtal mein
items.body:
hussain maqtal mein chup khade hai
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo lahoo hai libaas saara mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein chup khade hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb manzar hai karbala ka
zameen pa bikhre pade hai laashe
yahan hai sadaat pe musibat
wahan layeen peet'te hai taashe
udasiyan padh rahi hai nauha mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb e zehra ke rukh pe asghar
ka khoone na haq laga hua hai
abaa ka daaman jawan akbar
ke khoon se ghiltan ho chuka hai
nazar jami hai suye sakina mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain mal mal ke apni aankhein
zameen par dekhe jaa rahe hai
hai ek ghatdi jo khoon mein tar hai
usi pe aansu baha rahe hai
ye ghatri qasim ka hai sarapa mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
behen ke bacche jawan bhai
jawan bhatija guzar chuka hai
na ab hai ansaar koi baakhi
habeeb bhi ab to mar chuka hai
ke ghar ka ghar lut gaya hai saara mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai murtajiz saath saath sheh ke
imam ke gird ghoomta hai
kabhi pakadta hai sheh ka daaman
kabhi wo qadmon ko choomta hai
hai sheh ka ghoda bhi mehwe girya mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain mud mud ke dekhte hai
khayaal zainab ka aa raha hai
keaane waali hai shaam e ghurbat
jabhi to dil dooba jaa raha hai
bachega kaise haram ka parda mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamein hai yasir raza ye dhaaras
ke muntaqim hai imam e mehdi
yazeediyon se khuda ke lenge
hussain ka inteqam mehdi
wo soch kar kar rahe hai girya mere khudaya
hussain maqtal mein...
items.author: Yasir Raza

items.title: Jab gardane shabbir
items.body:
mai khud ko sar e karbobala dhoond raha hoo
zinda hoo ke murda hoo agar hoo to mai kya hoo
ye karbala maazi hai ke hai haal ke farda
mai tha ke nahi hoo ke nahi hoonga na hoonga
kya waqt ka phaylao hai ashoor ka arsa
nazdeek ka arsa hai ke ye door ka arsa
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gardane shabbir pe shamsheer rawan thi
ay waye kahan tha mai meri rooh kahan thi
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aandhiya uth'ti thi larazti thi zameen jab
tooti hui jab seena e akbar mein sina thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab maa thi dar e qaima pe bikhraye huwe baal
khole huwe jab teer ali asghar pe kaman thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde dil e shabbar ke thay jab dasht mein bikhre
jab ghodon ke taapon talay ek laashe jawan thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hotay thay dhuan aag se maa'on ke kaleje
sar khole huwe khaak pe jab maa'on ki maa thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hatkadi haathon mein thi tha tauq galay mein
jab paon mein sajjad ke zanjeer e giran thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se tapakta tha lahoo jalta tha daaman
ghabrayi hui sholon mein jab nanhi si jaan thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
do baazu tadapte thay juda tan se sar e khaak
jab khoon ki nadi mashk e sakina se rawan thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ho ke bazaar ho darbaar ke zindan
mai bhi tha wahin haye meri rooh jahan thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zakhm naved aah bhara hai na bharega
jab chadar e tatheer sare noke sina thi
mai bhi tha wahin haye meri rooh jahan thi
ay waye kahan tha mai...
jab gardane shabbir pe...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Karbala hai naqshe
items.body:
karbala hai naqshe saani kaaba e islam ka
shakl o surat ek jaisi farkh hai bas naam ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kaaba e dil mein guzar hone na do asnaam ka
aaeene mein baal aajaye to phir kis kaam ka
karbala hai naqshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi zinda hai dekho maujizein shabbir ke
aaj bhi har roz suraj doobta hai shaam ka
karbala hai naqshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tun samajhte ho ke zakhmi thay hussain ibne ali
zulm ke teeron se chalni tha badan islam ka
karbala hai naqshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar e shaam e ghariban yaad aata hai mujhe
phailne lagta hai jab aa kar andhera shaam ka
karbala hai naqshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
munkir e aale mohamed ki sana mai kyun karun
kyun qalam se kaam loon lafzon ke qatle aam ka
karbala hai naqshe...
<<DIVIDER>>
madhe sheh se do jahan mein mil gaya mujhko urooj
zaat par sach hai asar padta hai uske naam ka
karbala hai naqshe...

items.title: Kehti thi ye zainab
items.body:
kehti thi ye zainab se mohamed ki dulari
mai kya karoon bibi
qismat may judai ki ghadi aa gayi apni
mai kya karoon bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer pe kuch bas nahi chalta hai kisi ka
ek roz hai marna
kya maa ki judaai ka alam jhel sakogi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jayega shabbir mera karbobala ko
maidan e wagha ko
jayegi meri jaan sawari bhi tumhari
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mere abbas ke saahil se hatenge
pyase hi rahenge
atfal ki durron se wahan pyas bujhegi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum aun o mohamed ko raza marne ki dogi
khamosh rahogi
jab saamne aayegi mohamed ki jawani
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil jayegi matti may payambar ki nishani
par ay mere jaani
seene may hi ghut jayega dum ro na sakogi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jayega pyasa lab e darya mera saqqa
qasim na rahega
tum bhai hassan ko bhi bahot yaad karogi
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peet'ti reh jaogi tum qaime ke dar par
aur shimr ka khanjar
chal jayega mit jayegi hyder ki nishani
mai kya karoon bibi
kehti thi ye zainab se...

items.title: Koi pooche jo wafa
items.body:
koi pooche jo wafa aur wafadar ki baat

<<DIVIDER>>
waada e tifli na shabbir ka poora hota
khaiz guzri na badi ran mein alamdar ki baar
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hujjate haq se bhi jab baat na maani jaaye
tabdali karte hai talwar se talwar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan di ki na magar kufr ki bayyat hargiz
rakh li is tarha se jarrar ne jarrar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay hussain ibne ali teri shahadat ki qasam
reh gayi taaba abad ahmed e mukhtar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk namoose mohamed ke nikal padte hai
yaad aa jaati hai jab shaam ke bazaar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
nange sar ahle haram haath mein oonton ki muhaar
poochta kaun bhala abid e bemaar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame shabbir hai gham saare zamane ka urooj
hai ye baat is jahan ki nahi do chaar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Maula karbala bulale
items.body:
khaafile hai rawan jaa baja mai phir se tanha reh gaya
nikaal koi raasta maula
maula tadap raha hoon dar dar bhatak raha hoon
faryad kar raha hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
maula karbala bulaale rauza dikha de maula
<<DIVIDER>>
din raat aisi koi nahi jo tujhko nahi pukara
majlis mein ja ke aansu baha ke har saal hai guzara
ye saal bhi hai beeta phir intezaar jeeta
aaya nahi bulawa
maula karbala bulaale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bhi dua hai jab bhi bulana aisa sabab banana
maa baap mere aulaad meri aaye mera gharana
mere paas kuch nahi hai na zar hai na zameen hai
tujhpe hi bas yaqeen hai
maula karbala bulaale...
<<DIVIDER>>
hoon beqaraar kitna hai pyaar ek baar aazma le
jitni thakan ho sookha dahan ho ya paaon mein ho chaale
paidal safar karunga sab sakhtiyan sahunga
nauha tera padhunga
maula karbala bulaale...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein zawwaron ka mai khadim bana rahunga
muaqqib mein jaa ke khaana khila ke saqqayi bhi karunga
palkein bichaunga mai sab ko bulaunga mai
paaon dabaunga mai
maula karbala bulaale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ke dar pe de ke salami aaunga tere dar par
do badshahon ki saltanat mein jannat ka hoga manzar
aise haseen lamhe qismat mein meri likh de
ay baadshah bula le
maula karbala bulaale...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere haram ki jaali pakad ke lipta rahunga aise
muddat ke baad masoom bacha lipta ho maa se jaise
sajde karunga maula ro ro ke doonga pursa
armaan kar de poora
maula karbala bulaale...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhunga nehre alqama matam karunga pyaas ka
zeen se gira tha tu jahan maqam e saahib uz zamaan
ja kar kaf e abbas par matam karo sar peet kar
khaayi jahan pe thi sina maqam e akbar hai wahan
maqam e asghar pe jaaunga jhoole pe mannat badhaunga
wo qaimagaah e bekasan karunga majlis mai wahan
bhulaun kaise tu bata wo ek teela rayt ka
sattar qadam ka faasla jahan hai teri qatl gaah
wahan se dekha tha behen ne chala tha khanjar shimr ka
<<DIVIDER>>
farhan o mazhar hai dua maula sar e karbobala
de qabr ki hum ko jagah
<<DIVIDER>>
ya maula karbala bula le rauza dikha de maula
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Muslim ki laash par
items.body:
muslim ki laash par ye zehra ka marsiya hai
muslim teri shahadat tamheed e karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke jalte sehra mein das moharram
ek aag se ugalte sehra mein das moharram
honi hai jo qayamat ye uski ibteda hai
muslim ki laash par ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
paon mein tere rassi baandhi hai zaalimon ne
galiyon mein laash teri khaynchi hai zaalimon ne
ghurbat mein haye kaisa tujh par sitam hua hai
muslim ki laash par ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim teri madad ko ab aaye kaun haye
beta tera janaza dafnaye kaun haye
is dar pa tera laasha kab se latak raha hai
muslim ki laash par ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye soch kar hai larza muslim mere badan mein
ghode se jaise mera ghazi girega ran mein
chath se zameen pa aise tu moo ke bal gira hai
muslim ki laash par ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera jo laadla hai uska safeer hai tu
marne ko jo chala hai uska safeer hai tu
mere hussain se ab kuch door karbala hai
muslim ki laash par ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghaz e karbala ka ehsaas de gaya tu
marte huwe zara sa pani na pee saka tu
logon ne qatl tujhko pyasa hi kar diya hai
muslim ki laash par ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaqoob aur raza hai ye raaz karbala ka
kufa dikha raha hai andaaz karbala ka
muslim se ibteda hai sarwar pe inteha hai
muslim ki laash par ye...
items.author: Yaqoob JARCHVI

items.title: Noore muhammadi
items.body:
noore muhammadi ka ye aejaz ek hai
chauda hai aks aur rukhe naaz ek hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed se leke taa ba muhammad har ek ki
banda nawazion ka bhi andaaz ek hai
noore muhammadi ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise ali ki zarb ko haasil hai imtiyaz
sajda tamaam sajdon mein mumtaz ek hai
noore muhammadi ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
noke sina pe padh ke bataya hussain ne
quran o ahle bayt ki awaaz ek hai
noore muhammadi ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
kausar pe ja milenge ye dono rasool se
anjaam inka ek hai aghaaz ek hai
noore muhammadi ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
leh tootne na paaye kabhi ya hussain ki
azm jawan ke waaste ye karz ek hai
noore muhammadi ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
marna jo jaante hai wohi jee rahe hai aaj
ho maut zindagi ka yehi raaz ek hai
noore muhammadi ka…

jaati hai jaan jaaye aza e hussain mein

noore muhammadi ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bhai ek behan ki kahani hai karbala
andaz ek hai asar andaz ek hai
noore muhammadi ka…

items.title: Aati hai gardoon se
items.body:
aati hai gardoon se ye payham sada
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda
qaanae haq mein ye ghazab ho gaya
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
gham se hai zainab nidhaal, khol diye sar ke baal
kehti hai ye pur malaal, dekho to baba ka haal
dete hai gibreel ye kaisi nida
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda
aati hai gardoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath pade jalwagar, kehti hai sar peet kar
phat-ta hai mera jigar, koi to laaye khabar
ghar mein khuda ke ye sitam kya hua
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda
aati hai gardoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to hasnain ja, baba ko ghar mein to lao
aisa laga sar pe ghao, mujko khudara batao
poocho to jarraah se hogi shifa
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda
aati hai gardoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
nashtare gham dil pa khaye, daud kar hasnain aaye
dekha ajab haal hai, khoon mein hai baba nahaye
farsh se ta arsh hai mehshar bapa
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda
aati hai gardoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye qayamat hui, taygh sitam ki chali
maara ali-e-wali, girya-e-roohe nabi
kaisi layeen ne ye ki jor o jafa
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda
aati hai gardoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere zakhmi imam, tum pa durood-o-salaam
khoob ki tableegh e aam, de diya khaatil ko jaam
hoga anees aisi koi peshwa
qatl hue sajde mein shere khuda

items.title: Abbas ke naukar
items.body:
abbas ke naukar hai pani to pilayenge
badle may duayein hum shabbir se payenge
<<DIVIDER>>
shia ho ya sunni ho hindu ho ya esayi
jo hurr ki tarha aaya seene se lagayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke pilaate hai in haathon se hum pani
is kaam na aaye to kis kaam ye aayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jarob kashi kaisi hum palkein bichayenge
jis raah pe sab zaair chalte nazar aayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani peelo aao pyason ko yaad karo
saqqe ki tarha hum ye awaaz lagayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota jo luaab e nabi beshak wo mila dete
hum sache hai jhoota bhi pani na milayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ziarat to karwayenge har soorat
ya hum ko bulayenge ya khwab may aayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saans aati hai saanson ki shabbir ke matam may
gar chod diya matam hum jee nahi payenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye fazal sakina se bolay jo mila pani
baba ki qasam pehle hum tumko pilayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad o takallum aur ye mir hassan kya hai
khud khizr bhi jannat may kehte nazar aayenge
abbas ke naukar hai...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Aisa safar na ho
items.body:
sajde may hai zameen to falak hai qayaam may
quwwat nahi hai utne ki bemaar imam may
aaya sar e hussain to kohraam mach gaya
goonji sada sakina ki zindan e shaam may
baba kisi ghareeb ka aisa safar na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat may is tarha koi taraaj ghar na ho
aisa safar na ho aisa safar na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mai dekhti rahi ke hua qatl aap ka
dihklaye rab na beti ko ye haal baap ka
sar jism se kisi ke juda is qadar na ho
aisa safar na ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaghe yateemi kya hai khabar tak na thi mujhe
ye baat aap hi ne to batlaayi thi mujhe
baccha wohi yateem hai jiska pidar na ho
aisa safar na ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi tamache maarta tha shimr e bad gohar
baba tadap tadap ke mai gir jaati khaak par
beti ke aage baap ka naize pe sar na ho
aisa safar na ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
har pal tumhe bulaati thi baba ab aaiye
meri madad ko kyun nahi aaye bataiye
mumkin na ho ke aap ko meri khabar na ho
aisa safar na ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe ki raah may kabhi bazaar e aam may
ahle sitam ke saamne darbar e shaam may
meri tarha kisi ka bhi uryan sar na ho
aisa safar na ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jakda hua tha mera gala rassiyon ke beech
mai berida khadi thi tamashaiyon ke beech
bazaar e shaam jaisi koi reh guzar na ho
aisa safar na ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kamsini may koh e musibat to dekhiye
zindan e shaam may meri haalat to dekhiye
pinjre may jaise panchi ho aur jiske par na ho
aisa safar na ho...
<<DIVIDER>>
godhi may leke sar e shaah e ins o jaan
mohsin mujeeb bali sakina ne ki fughan
mujh ghamzada ki tarha koi bepidar na ho
aisa safar na ho...

items.title: Ali ali maula
items.body:
ali ali maula maulana ali
ali ali maula maula maulana ali
<<DIVIDER>>
quwwate parwardigar lafata illa ali
shaahhe mardan shere yazdan
quwwate parwardigar ya ali ya ali ya ali
ali maula ali maula ali maula ali maula
<<DIVIDER>>
tu dil mein hai basa hua tu dhadkano mein goonjta
tu rooh ka hai rehnuma tu nafs hai aasra
hai lab pe meri ye sada hai tu khuda ka aeena
ali maula ali maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zindagi tere liye ye bandagi tere liye
ye dosti tere liye ye dushmani tere liye
rasool e haq ne sach kaha hai tu sach ka tarjuma
ali maula ali maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibadaton ke dil mein tu sadaqaton ke dil mein tu
hidayaton ke dil mein tu hai aayaton ke dil mein tu
shariyaton ka sayeban khuda ke deen ka paasban
ali maula ali maula...

tu hi khuda ka noor hai ye kehta kohe toor hai
jise na ye sha'oor hai wo haq se koson door hai
hai tujhse haq ki ibteda hai tujhpe haq ki inteha
ali maula ali maula...

jahan mein guftagu teri samaan mein guftagu teri
makan mein guftagu teri azan mein giftagu teri
tu saajidon ka naaz hai na tere bin namaz hai
ali maula ali maula...

shifa hai teri khaak mein dawa hai teri khaak mein
baqa hai teri khaak mein wafa hai teri khaak mein
hai dar pe tere ay ali har ek nabi ki naukri
ali maula ali maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa waqt aagaya ali pe haye kibriya
lahoo hai sar se beh raha hai khoon mein tar ali tera
hai ranj tujhpe teeragi bujhayi tu ne roshni
ali maula ali maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayan kaise ho bhala wo zakhm bu-turab ka
na taabe zakhm laa saka zamane se guzar gaya
zaban pe uske nauha hai jo nasir aaj rota hai

items.title: Ammu mujhe bachalo
items.body:
shabbir ki yateema ro ro ke keh rahi hai

ammu mujhe bacha lo
<<DIVIDER>>
tera chacha sitam se tujhko agar bachale

tum ko pukarne ki zaalim ne choot di hai

phir shimr aa raha hai ab le ke taziyana
tewar se lag raha hai phir se hoo mai nishana
bebas mai ho gayi hoo kaisi ye bebasi hai

kaise bhala mai ammu ab ye sitam sahungi
raahon mein kis tarha se panjo ke bal chalungi
chote hai paaon mere takleef ye badi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...

gustaakh kar raha hai mujhse ye bad tameezi
uska mutaaliba hai mere liye kaneezi
chalni jo rooh bhi ye sun kar laraz gayi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...

le lega jaan meri zindan ka ye andhera
kehti hai ye sakina dam ghut raha hai mera
chaaron taraf hai pehra kaisi ye bekasi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...

dekhi nahi hai maine aisi koi musibat
ab tak laraz rahi hai choti si ek turbat
jaise koi bhatiji ab tak ye bolti hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsar neelgu hai kaano se khoon hai jaari
daaman jala hua hai mujh par ghashi hai taari
ab har ghadi hi mujh par aafat ki ek ghadi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jao karbala to yasir ye kaam karna
sajid mere chacha ko mera payam dena
kehna teri bhatiji ab tak ye keh rahi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...

items.title: Ay baba mai kaise
items.body:
baba baba baba mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
ay baba mai kaise jiyoo
is dunya may tere bina
<<DIVIDER>>
naazon ki pali bachi par
ye kaisi qayamat aayi
ghurbat ke ghane jangal may
hai ghere huwe tanhaai
baba hi rahe na bhai
ay baba mai kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tashna dahan shehzadi
hai sola peher ki pyasi
haal apna sunaye kis ko
ab koi nahi hai baaqi
maqtal may hui faryadi

<<DIVIDER>>
hai charon taraf tanhaai
aur charon taraf veerana
rota hai meri haalat par
ye jangal ye veerana
mai kaise rahungi tanha

shabbir ki raaj dulaari
kis haal may hai bechari

durr cheen liye aada ne

har ek layeen kehta hai

wo raat jahan raunak thi

maare hai tamache mere
roka na kisi ne aa ke
ay baba mai kaise...

items.title: Baba sakina ko
items.body:
baba sakina ko ab godh mein lelo

hai zakhmi raaste ghurbat ka safar

bas aakhri ek baar seene se laga lo

teri beti mein ab himmat bhi nahi

khulwado zara aa kar gardan ki rassi

bas aakhri ek baar seene se laga lo

items.body:
boli rabab dasht mein kaisa hai ye dayaar

sookhe gale jo pyaas se bechain hai bahot

<<DIVIDER>>
maa'on ke bain aur ye bachon ki siskiyan

boli rabab dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh hai gawah ke sadme uthaye hai
jab jab kiya hai ummat e aasi pa aetbaar
boli rabab dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hi jaa rahe hai sitam hum pa ashkiyan
shaamil nahi kisi ki tabiyat mein inkisaar
boli rabab dasht mein...

jis ne jawan bete ki mayyat uthayi ho
