boli rabab dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke dasht mein hum sab ko ghayr kar
bedard maut karti hai ek ek ka shikaar
boli rabab dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache dahel ke so gaye godhi mein maut ki
jalte qayaam ban gaye un ke liye mazaar
boli rabab dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko ye kis maqaam pa le aayi zindagi
kuch gham pa apna bas hai na khushiyon pa ikhtiyar
boli rabab dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ko bhi dekho shaah pa rota hai ay raza
kul kayenat hai mere maula ki soghwaar
boli rabab dasht mein...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Deen ko bacha liya
items.body:
fatema ke chain ne ali ke noore ain ne
bakhuda hussain ne deen ko bacha liya
<<DIVIDER>>
harf aa raha tha deene mustufa ke naam par
mimbare rasool bik raha tha takhte shaam par
deen ki asaas ne daste haq shanaas ne
ummate mohamadi ko khwab se jaga diya
deen ko bacha liya
fatema ke chain…
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf se band ho chuke thay haq ke raaste
khoon maangta tha deen zindagi ke waaste
deen ke usool ne nayabe rasool ne
zindagi ka karz apne khoon se chuka diya
deen ko bacha liya
fatema ke chain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ameer e shaam bangaya tha saamp aasteen ka
khusravi ke sar pe rakh raha tha taaj deen ka
baadshahe deen ne boriya nasheen nay
aarzu e khusravi ko khaak mein mila diya
deen ko bacha liya
fatema ke chain…
<<DIVIDER>>
phir se shirk ki taraf palat na jaaye aadmi
raahe mustaqeem se bhatak na jaaye aadmi
shaahe tashnakaam ne waqt ke imam ne
haq ki raah par lahoo se ek diya jala diya
deen ko bacha liya
fatema ke chain…
<<DIVIDER>>
halqe bezaban se zulm ki kamaan tod di
sheh raghe gulu se khanjaro ki dhaal modh
naazishe hayat ne asre kayenat ne
sar kata ke aadmi ka sar baland kar diya
deen ko bacha liya
fatema ke chain…
<<DIVIDER>>
badte badte baat jab usoole deen pe aa gayi
aur yazeediyat ki shakl mein urooj pa gayi
badke phir dilayr ne shere haq ke sher ne
do pahar mein taqt o taaj qasre shaam dha diya
deen ko bacha liya
fatema ke chain…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil kahan se laaun jo karun ye waqeya bayaan
teen din ki pyaas mein wo hausla tha al-amaan
zulm ke aseer ne ran mein ek sagheer ne
muskurake fauj e shaam ko rula rula diya
deen ko bacha liya
fatema ke chain…

items.title: Ek zuljana ek zulfiqar
items.body:
ek zuljanah hai ek zulfeqar hai
hain ek taygh imam ki ek rahwaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
utri hai tayg arsh se quran ki tarha
tehra faras hawa pe suleman ki tarha
khaadim thi wo ali ki jo salman ki tarha
is par saware dosh e mohamad sawaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwar chand banke chamakti thi raat mein
duldul haseen lagta tha maula ke saath mein
talwar zeb deti thi hyder ke haath mein
saaya abu turab ka duldul ka haar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
choomi hai zulfeqar ne maula ki ungliyan
duldul ka jism chooti thi hyder ki aediyan
bal deti thi jo usko ali ki kalaiyan
gardann pe uske daste khuda ka dulaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwar jiske moo ko dhulati thi fatema
rehwaar jisko ran mein khilaate thay murtaza
zehra jo zulfeqar ko karti thi aaina
maathe pe uske paa e ali ka ghubaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwar kaat'ti thi agar zulm ki kamar
ghode ki taap tod'ti thi sarkashon ke sar
be izn zulfeqar ki uth'ti na thi nazar
rehwaar bhi ali ka ita'at shiyaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
duldul bhi apni shaan mein rafraf se kam nahi
talwar mein to kham hai jalalat mein kham nahi
raftaar uski choo le hawaan mein dam nahi
is par har ek fath ka daar o madaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono hai kaarkhaana e khudrat ke shaahkaar
dono ali ke paak gharane ke gham gusaar
asghar se wo ye bali sakeena se sharm saar
wo soghwaar ye bhi bahot soghwaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mastoor hai imame zaman chup hai kayenat
gardan mein hai ali ki rasan chup hai kayenat
lut'ta hai fatema ka chaman chup hai kayenat
roti hai tayg nauha kuna rahwaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein pyaas na dono ki bujh saki
ashoor ko na poochiye ghode ki tashnagi
kya ser hoti taygh saron ki rahi kami
dono ki rooh aaj talak beqaraar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar jisko nanhi lehad khodni padi
ghoda wo hai sawaar hui jiski waapsi
baage kati hui thi to zeen thi dhali hui
poochegi ab sakina kahan sheh sawaar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab parr hai ab ye nayyar o aamir ki ilteja
ay waaris e hussain sabab dayr ka hai kya
phir taygh o zuljanah ko ghaibat se le ke aa
dono ka karbala ko bahot intezar hai
ek zuljanah hai...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Ghazi tu laut aa
items.body:
aa mere ghazi
mai ho gayi beparda
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar aa gaya ghazi tu laut aa
sar par nahi rida ghazi tu laut aa
<<DIVIDER>>
baalon se moo chupaye
chalti hoon sar jhukaye
majma ye shaamiyon ka
mujhko na dekh paaye
de mujhko hausla
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab has rahe hai koi
aata nahi bachane
bemaar har qadam par
khaata hai taaziyane
sajjad ko bacha
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ghar se garm pani
phaynka gaya hai hum par
kaante biche huwe hai
bhai qadam qadam par
mushkil hai raasta
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
badla liya hai sab ne
ghar se nikal nikal kar
zainab ko shaamiyon ne
maare hai itne patthar
sar zakhmi ho gaya
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
baalon se jab pakad kar
shimr e layeen ne maara
kehti rahi sakina
sar dekh kar tumhara
mar jaaungi chacha
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
panjon pe chal rahi hai
kab se meri sakina
baazu mere bandhe hai
dam ghut raha hai uska
rassi mein hai gala
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ki tarha mujhko
ye gham bhi hai uthana
mujhko bhi mere bhai
darbar mein hai jaana
zehra ka waasta
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan kaise likhe
farhan gham ka manzar
ghairat ke baadshah ka
naize se gir gaya sar
zainab ne jab kaha
ghazi tu laut aa
bazaar aa gaya...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Hasan haye husaina
items.body:
haye hussaina
hassan haye hussaina
hussain haye hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
karti thi zehra dasht mein girya
shimr ne kaata sar shahe deen ka
hassan haye hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
arz o sama ke aur fiza ke
dasht e jafa ke lab pe hai naala
hassan haye hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize ke upar aur sare sarwar
taapon ki zad shaah ka laasha
hassan haye hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimo se uthay aag ke sholay
kaun bachaye raande hai tanha
hassan haye hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ko uthaye kis ko chudaye
kis ko bachaye saani e zehra
hassan haye hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyon na anees hum yun kare matam
dil pa hai wo gham tukde hai seena
hassan haye hussaina...
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Ho ali akbar kahan
items.body:
kehti thi rokar ye maa seene mein dil hai tapan
ek hai kadiyal jawan doosra hai bezuban
dono sidhare jina dasht mein tanha hai maa
soona hai saara jahan ujdha pada hai makan
aankhon se khoon hai rawan
ho ali akbar kahan
ho ali asghar kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
karti hoo kabse buka dete nahi tum sada
kyon hue mujhse khafa kya hui mujhse khata
jis tarha choote ho tum mujhse mai tum par fida
is tarha koi pisar maa se na hovay juda
dasht mein tum meri jaan hogaye kisja niha
ho ali akbar kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri ummedein gayi mere sahaare gaye
jinko samajhti thi jaan haye wo pyare gaye
pyaas se thay jaan-balab pyase hi maare gaye
karbobala mein wo aaj zulm se maare gaye
haathon se khoon hai rawan tum ko mai paa'un kahan
ho ali akbar kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
muft jawani teri raayega akbar hui
khaak mein posheeda aaj surate asghar hui
sar se rida chin gayi qaid bhi madar hui
ran mein na ab tak amaan mujko meinassar hui
tum ho sidhare jahan mujhko bulalo wahan
ho ali akbar kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima jala ghar luta baad-e-shahe do jahan
ab koi mumkin nahi poochne wala yahan
ay mere roohe rawan ay mere taabo tawan
waadiye ghurbat mein aaj chut gayi dono se maa
ek ka gala chid gaya ek ne khaayi sina
ho ali akbar kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli musawwir ye maa gham ki ghata cha gayi
ran mein mere sher ko kiski nazar kha gayi
hasliyon wala jo tha usko bhi maut aagayi
ghar ko to veeran kiya karbobala bha gayi
dil mein hai ek ke sina teer ne li ek ki jaan
ho ali akbar kahan...
items.author: Musawwir

items.title: Hussain pe ye waqt
items.body:
aayi jo leke godh mein shabbir ko batool
bacche ko dekha khush huwe phir ro diye rasool
zehra ne poocha aap huwe kis liye malool
bole rasool mujhpe wahi ka hua nuzool
zehra suno mai khush hua ye deen bachayega
rota hoon tanha dasht mein ye maara jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein hussain pe ye waqt aayega
ek laasha leke aayega ek lene jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
rehne na denge chain se yasrab mein ahle shar
karbobala mein jaa ke lutayega apna ghar
laashon se karbala ka ye maqtal sajayega
pardes mein hussain pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase hi qatl honge sab ansaar o aqraba
zainab ke laadle ho ke qasim sa mehlaqa
hurr jaise jaanisar pe aansu bahayega
pardes mein hussain pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kadiyal jawan beta bhi tadpega khaak par
uglega khoon haathon pe cheh maah ka pisar
nanhi si qabr dasht mein ro kar banayega
pardes mein hussain pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
beenayi leke jayega akbar ka gham magar
bhai ke gham ke tootegi mazloom ki kamar
hal min kahega dasht mein koi na aayega
pardes mein hussain pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir apni qatl gaah mein aayega ye pisar
barsenge teer o naiza o talwaar is khadar
zehra ye tera laadla khoon mein nahayega
pardes mein hussain pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sattar qadam se dekhegi zainab ye majera
kaatega shimr sayyed e mazloom ka gala
pani bhi waqte zibha na koi pilayega
pardes mein hussain pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar bhi bain karta hai aur mazhar abidi
kaise bayan karenge shahadat hussain ki
ye misra sab ko khoon ke aansu rulayega
pardes mein hussain pe...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Jab ghir gaye kufe
items.body:
jab ghir gaye kufe mein muslim ke dulaare
pardes mein tanha thay taqdeer ke maare
<<DIVIDER>>
dono bacchon ka wahan koi madadgaar na tha
sirf tanhaai thi yawar na thay ghamkhwar na tha
wo bhatakte rahe dar dar koi dildaar na tha
koi dono ki madad karne ko tayyaar na tha
thak kar ke jo girta tha kabhi chota baradar
chalta tha bada bhai usay godh mein le kar
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chote bhai ne bada bhai se ro kar poocha
bhaiya itna to batado ke kahan hai baba
hum musafir hai yahan koi nahi hai apna
hum ko pardes mein ab kaun sahara dega
har simt andhera hai kahan jayenge bhai
lagta hai hamay baba na mil payenge bhai
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat kaali thi andhere mein wo dono bacche
sehme sehme huwe ek payd pa chup kar baithe
raat bhar lipte thay aapas mein wo gham ke maare
siskiyan lete thay aur rote thay chupke chupke
aahat jo koi hoti thi ghabrate thay dono
patte bhi khadakte thay to darr jaate thay dono
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek kaneez aayi subah usko tha pani bharna
usne masoomon ka pani mein jo dekha chehra
dono bacchon se ye ghabra ke usi dam poocha
kaun ho aaye kahan se ho bata do itna
dono ne kaha zakhm bahot khaaye hai bibi
hum log madine se yahan aaye hai bibi
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam yasrab ka suna jab to wo tadpi ek baar
leke bacchon ko chali ghar ki taraf wo deedar
jaa ke malkan se batane lagi sab haale zaar
momina ne kiya shehzadon ko ro ro kar pyar
kehne lagi darna na meri jaan ho dono
aaqa ke dulaaron mere mehmaan ho dono
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mutmaeen ho gaye jis waqt ke wo mahelaqa
le gayi bacchon ko hujre mein kaneez e zahra
khaana pani jo diya bacchon ka dil bhar aaya
saamne nazron k emaa baap ka chehra aaya
baba ke liye mehwe buka ho gaye dono
bin khaaye piye rote huwe so gaye dono
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye muslim ke pisar chand sitaare dono
khwaab se chaunk ke utthe jo dulaare dono
aahein bharne lage hujre mein wo pyare dono
roye be-saakhta taqdeer ke maare dono
rone ki sada sun ke utha haaris e maloon
khanjar liye hujre mein gaya haaris e maloon
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha haaris ko to masoom bahot ghabraye
zulfein zaalim ne jo pakdi to jigar tharraye
le chala khaynchta masoomon ko zaalim haye
momina ne kaha haaris tujhe maut aa jaye
masoom hai pardesi hai in par na sitam kar
hyder ke guletar hai ye zahra ke guletar
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna maloon tha haaris ko taras na aaya
momina ki na suni ek usay qatl kiya
baal bacchon ke pakad kar wo sitamgar nikla
bacche kehte thay hamay maar ke kya payega
dirham tujhe dilwayenge jitna to batade
le kar ke madine hamay amma se milade
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
le ke maloon yateemon ko neher pe pahuncha
taygh masoomon ko dikhla ke ye zaalim bola
tum hi batlao gala kaatun mai pehle kiska
chote bhai ne gala apna badha kar ye kaha
mai deta hoon sar tagh idhar mod de haaris
bas mere bade bhai ko ab chod de haaris
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir bade bhai ne chote ko hataya badh kar
rakh diya apna gala taygh ke neeche ja kar
bola haaris se ki ehsaan ye karna mujh par
mere bhai ko dikha kar na chalana khanjar
maloon tha be-deen tha wo dushman e hyder
sar kaata bade bhai ka chote ko dikha kar
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chote bhai ne lahoo bhai ka dekha jis dam
lot kar khoon mein bhai ke wo tadpa pur gham
dekh kar suye nehr kehta tha kar ke matam
bhai tehro ke zara dayr mein aate hai hum
ye dekh ke maloon ne talwaar chalayi
aur hogayi bekas ke sar o tan mein judaai
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko jab kaat chuka tan ko neher mein daala
chote bhai ki taraf bhai ka laasha aaya
haye shehzadon ka aapas mein jo lipta laasha
dono mazloomo ki mazloomi pe roya darya
waiz jo sitam dono yateemon pe hua hai
us zulm ko likh kar ke qalam kaamp raha hai
jab ghir gaye kufe mein...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Jo maango wo
items.body:
baabul hawaij ya abbas
saqqa e ahle haram
ooncha hai jiska alam
kaisa waseela rab ne diya hai
baabe hawaij jisko kaha hai
dunya se lau na lagao
dil ki muradein pao
aao dar e abbas pe aao
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo mil jaayega
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hazrate abbas ka dar hai
jo maango wo mil jaayega
<<DIVIDER>>
apni kismat jagane aajao
apni mannat uthane aajao
dil ka jo haal hai na dil mein rakho
jo bhi gham hai sunane aajao
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab muradein yahan pe paoge
jholiyan apni bhar ke jaoge
kaise mumkin hai na sune ghazi
tum jo faryad le ke jaoge
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bakht milta hai sikandar ko
bheek milti hai har tawangar ko
ye bulandi hai iske chaukat ki
aasman ne jhuka diya sar ko
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ghamon ka elaaj hai ye dar
khush naseebi ka taaj hai ye dar
be-zaron ko bana diya buzar
kya sakhawat mizaaj hai ye dar
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali daaman jo ho khwahar
nek aulaad maang le aakar
ye hai shabbir ka saqi bhai
jitne maango ataa karega pisar
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
barkate rizq ki dua maango
har maraz ki yahan shifa maango
bhool jaoge gham zamane ka
tum ghame shaahe karbala maango
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
zor e baazu shahe madina ka
ye chacha hai usi sakina ka
khaali lauta de ho nahi sakta
waasta do agar sakina ka
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta do rida e zainab ka
pyase bacchon ka maanglo sadqa
waasta de ke bas hussain ka tum
dar pe ghazi ke ek baar zara
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo kehta hai har ghadi safdar
baat sacchi bhi hai yehi mazhar
sab milega khuloose dil se agar
maula ghazi ke dar pe tum aakar
jholiyan phailao malango
jo maango wo...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Karbala hogi jo
items.body:
karbala hogi jo barpa to qayamat hogi
dasht mein aayengi zehra to qayamat hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein akbar se tadpte huwe bole sarwar
tere seene mein jo paywast hai mere dilbar
maine khayncha jo ye naiza to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne dekha tha bhatije ki taraf kuch aise
aankhon aankhon mein hi qasim se kaha ho jaise
tu ne taweez jo khola to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baareha shaah ne abbas ko roka hoga
aisa lagta hai ye shabbir ne socha hoga
chid gayi mashk e sakina to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmala ne jo kamaan dashte bala mein khaynchi
bas yehi soch ke bano pe qayamat guzri
teer asghar ne jo khaaya to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ko dekh ke zehra ne pukaara zaalim
teen shab roz ka pyasa hai teher ja zaalim
tu ne khanjar jo chalaya to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar fauje yazeedi ko pukari zehra
seena e shaah pe asghar ka hai be sar laasha
tum ne ghodon se jo raundha to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki laash pe royegi behen ye keh kar
kaise mai tujhko kafan doo nahi sar par chadar
waqt jis waqt ye aaya to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
<<DIVIDER>>
har azadaar ko majlis mein bata do yasir
sayyeda aayi hhai kuch ashq e aza ki khaatir
koi majlis mein na roya to qayamat hogi
karbala hogi jo barpa...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Kehti thi yehi jeene
items.body:
kehti thi yehi jeene se bezaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
lene ke liye bhai ko bheja nahi ab tak
baba ko khabar di hai ke lachaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jee bhar ke abhi dekhlo tum chehra e akbar
phir bhai se milna bada dushwaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar se kahe aaye mujhe lene ko jaldi
ay baba safar ke liye tayyar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shehre madina jahan aksar hai musalman
tanha shahe waala ki azadar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt lagi rehti hai darwaze pe nazre
is karbe musalsal may giraftar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya aagayi awaaze azane ali akbar
kis ranj o musibat may giraftar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka sar kat gaya abbas ke baazu
ab zainab-o-kulsum hai darbar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
acha hi hua tum na gayi saath safar may
maa behne hai aur shaam ka bazaar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra se kahe kaun zafar margaya wo bhi
jis asghare nadan se tujhe pyar hai sughra
kehde koi akbar se ke bemaar hai sughra
kehti thi yehi jeene se...
items.author: Zafar

items.title: Mere maula aane
items.body:
mere maula aane waale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
agar hussain ke maqsad se hai wafadari
to phir imam ki nusrat hai ye azadari
imame asr ko ghar may agar bulana hai
bas itna karna hai farshe aza bichana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ghar me bicha do farshe aza
maula ko dena hai pursa
ke bas maula aane waale hai
haa mere maula aane waale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyan guzri hai phir bhi safar
wo karbobala ka jaari hai
ye rasme azadari hai kya
ye nusrat ki tayyari hai
nasir honge sab ahle aza
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaari hai azadari sheh ki
bachhe hai lahoo may aaj bhi tar
ay maaon shaheedon ki maaon
qurban kiye hai tum ne pisar
maula khud denge iska sila
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ka pisar ab aayega
azaad karayega kaaba
aayega waaris e karbobala
badla wo lega baqayye ka
hoga tameer har ek rauza
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay maaon behno sharm o haya
aur izzat ka bhi dhyan rahe
zehra ki mehnat ka ho khayal
aur zainab ka bhi maan rahe
rakhna hai tumhe qayam parda
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ke pisar ke khaatir ab
ghar kaise sajaya hai tum ne
maahol ho maula ke qaabil
khud unko bulaya hai tumne
dar khol ke baitho taqwe ka
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ke tukdon ka badla
har shaam ke pathar ka badla
zehra ki musibat ka badla
zainab ki chadar ka badla
jaoge kahan tum ahle jafa
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin haath gire jab ghode se
kaisi ye musibat thi haye
ghazi ki ek hi khwahish hai
maula ki ziyarat ho jaaye
ay maut de mohlat mujhko zara
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula sab se pehle lenge
mohsin ki shahadat ka badla
bacchi ke tamachon ka badla
sajjad ki zehmat ka badla
ya saarallah ka hai naara
mere maula aane...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shadman aur qamar ab hum
dushman ke muqabil datt jaye
tukde ho laakh dhamakon se
kat'te hai haath to kat jaaye
thaame rahe parcham maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ghar may bichado frashe aza
maula ko dena hai pursa
mere maula aane...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Muslim ki shahadat
items.body:
muslim ki shahadat pa ye kehti hai ruqayya
baba ye hua kya
kufe ka safar aap ko kya raas na aaya
baba ye hua kya
<<DIVIDER>>
sunti hoo ke bhai bhi mere maare gaye hai
darya mein pade hai
kamsin thay layeeno ne zara bhi nahi socha
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe ke musalman musalman nahi thay
insaan nahi thay
khat bhej ke bulwaya gaya aur diya dhoka
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
is umr mein socha na tha jumle ye sunenge
ghut ghut ke rahenge
ab log bulaate hai hamein keh ke yateema
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hai ke masjid mein namazi to bahot thay
bayyat bhi kiye thay
phir aap ko bejurm khata kis liye maara
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis din se shahadat ki khabar unko mili hai
wo chot lagi hai
dekha nahi jaata hai chacha jaan ka chehra
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne ki khabar aayi magar kuch nahi maloom
har baat se mehroom
kab aap ko maara gaya kab utha janaza
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein teherte hi nahi hai mere aansu
aur ujde hai gaysu
tar hogaya ashkon se mera chota sa kurta
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aap wahan karbobala jaata hai kunba
dushwaar hai rasta
kya soch ke hum logon ne choda tha madina
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishrat unhi lafzon mein asar ghol raha hai
jo dil ki sada hai
ro ro ke sunaya tha ruqayya ne jo nauha
baba ye hua kya
muslim ki shahadat pa...

items.body:
aajao asghar aajao

gham mein tumhare marti hoo

ab to taras khao dilbar
aajao asghar aajao...

sannaton ka ye mausam
chaaron taraf huu ka aalam
kitna darona hai manzar
aajao asghar aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
door talak saaya bhi nahi
tapta sehra jalti zameen
neend tumhe aayi kyunkar
aajao asghar aajao...

sach kehti hoo ay beta
maa se nahi rootha jaata
maan bhi jao ay dilbar
aajao asghar aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
neendh ye aayi hai kaisi
sunte nahi awaaz meri
kab se bulaati hai maadar
aajao asghar aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaunkoge jab raaton ko
jhoola bana ke haathon ko
tujhko jhulayegi maadar
aajao asghar aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
binte shahe dilgeer hai ye
teri bhi hamsheer hai ye
le ke sakina ke gohar
aajao asghar aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein balayein leti hai
tujhko sadayein deti hai
bekas dukhiya ye maadar
aajao asghar aajao...

kaise mai jaaun shaam bhala
sar hai khula aati hai haya
maa ke liye lekar chaadar
aajao asghar aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gayi chaahat ki dunya
uth gayi waali ka saaya
rooth gaye tum bhi jaa kar
aajao asghar aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir jaan khota hai bilal
saara jahan rota hai bilal
rakh qalam itna likh kar
aajao asghar aajao...

items.title: Aisi nahi thi zahra
items.body:
dekho madine waalon zakhmi hai jiska chehra
aisi nahi thi zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
tooti hai phasliyan aur pehlu bhi hai shikasta
aisi nahi thi zahra

ummat ne sayyeda ka itna lahoo bahaya
pehlu se fatema ke jab jalta dar uthaya
zahra ko dekhte hi ro ro ke boli fizza
aisi nahi thi zahra
dekho madine waalon...

aulaad waalon socho kya waqt hoga maa pe
bacchon ke saamne jab khaati thi wo tamache
chadar mein ab chupa kar rakhti hai gaal apna
aisi nahi thi zahra
dekho madine waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar jab gayi thi haalat nahi thi aisi
lauti hai jab se dekho baalon mei hai safedi
athaarwein baras mein lagti hai ek zaeefa
aisi nahi thi zahra
dekho madine waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye qabre mustafa par ro kar ali pukare
zahra ko zaalimon ne hai taaziyane maare
jab aap ne ali ko saumpa tha haath uska
aisi nahi thi zahra
dekho madine waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai chalte chalte fizza mai gir na jaaun
hai warm is khadar ke uth'te nahi hai paaun
chalti hai apne ghar mein ab le ke wo sahara
aisi nahi thi zahra
dekho madine waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi ko dafn kar ke zeeshan bole maula
choda hai saath uska ay rooh tu ne warna
baade rasool haye chode ali ko tanha
aisi nahi thi zahra
dekho madine waalon...

items.title: Ammu nahi aaye
items.body:
kehti thi ye ro ro ke sakina mere baba
ammu nahi aaye
mai kab se khadi dekhti hoo raasta unka
ammu nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kaash na mai bhejti saahil pe chacha ko
aameen kahe haath uthaati hoo dua ko
ghar khair se aa jaye chacha jaan khudaya
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab mashk-o-alam leke suye nehr gaye thay
aur deke gaye thay wo mujhe kya kya wo dilaase
sab bhool gaye nehr ka paaya jo kanara
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kooza liye haaton mein sare raah khadi hoo
hai soch na dushwar magar soch rahi hoo
shayad unhe mujhse bi hai zyada koi pyara
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay ke darya se abhi laata hoo pani
kuch dayr jo hojaye to rona nahi jaani
qaime se zara door hai darya ka kanara
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi unhe dede mera paigham zabani
aa jao chacha ab mai nahi maangungi pani
gham se phata jaata hai mera aah kaleja
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
reh reh ke mera seene mein kat'ta hai kaleja
maidan se lauta nahi ab tak mera saqqa
mashkeeza chida khoon mein hai tar alam aaya
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai darti hoo allah bura waqt na laaye
kuch dayr jo darya se abhi aur na aaye
dam tod'de jhoole mein asghar kahin pyasa
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyon takti hai hasrat se phuphi jaan rida ko
kya hogaya darya pe bata ay zara mujhko
kis ke liye rota hai ye kunba mera saara
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa na ho aada ne unhe ghayr liya ho
mashkeeze pe teer aaye ho seene pe laga ho
saahil pe kahin doob gaya ho na safeena
ammu nahi aaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
yawar ye buka karti thi ro ro ke sakina
ammu ki khabar lijiye ya shaahe madina
ammu ke baghiar mera dushwaar hai jeena
ammu nahi aaye...

items.title: Ay baqia mujhe
items.body:
ay baqia mujhe tera gham hai
is liye to ye aankh purnam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se tera ye inhedaam hua
dil mein bas gham ka hi khayaam hua
ab to ek ezteraab e payham hai
ay baqia mujhe…
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre zehra jo dhaayi aada ne
kya bigada tha inka dukhiya ne
hum to jitna bhi roye wo kam hai
ay baqia mujhe…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jo be-saaya turbat e sajjad
kyun na hum ghamzada kare faryad
is se bad kar bhi koi kya gham hai
ay baqia mujhe…
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr baqar ki aur jafar ki
hai shakista jo qabr shabbar ki
har taraf sog ka sa aalam hai
ay baqia mujhe…
<<DIVIDER>>
keh utha dekh kar dil e muztar
haye re qabre maadar e hyder
is ki tauqeer to muqadam hai
ay baqia mujhe…

jab bhi tashreef layenge mehdi
hoga taameer phir baqia bhi
mujhko ek yehi aas har dam hai
ay baqia mujhe…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na awaaze haq uthaye hum
kaise baatil se khauf khaye hum
sar pe jab bawafa ka parcham hai
ay baqia mujhe…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne zehra ka dil dukhaya hai
aur unhe umr bhar rulaaya hai
us pe lanat hi ab to har dam hai
ay baqia mujhe…
<<DIVIDER>>
chain izhaar yun nahi aata
har ghadi hai alam baqia ka
har ghadi dil mein shor e matam hai
ay baqia mujhe…

items.body:
ali ali ali ali ali ali ya ali
asadullah yadullah saifullah wajhullah

parwana e hyder hoo

ishqe hyder hai sukoon ishqe hyder hai junoon
kaam kuch aur nahi bas yehi kehta phirun
ye ibadat hai meri ye hai tasbeeh meri
ali ali ali ali...

meri fitrat mein yehi hai ke mai haq bolta hoo

farsh se arsh talak jaante hai ye malak

maalik e mulk e adam unke siwa koi nahi

unka deedar ho jab phir sukoon paaye nazar

har ghadi safdar o mazhar ka hai damsaaz ali

items.title: Hussain raazi ho
items.body:
hussain raazi rahe fatema rahe raazi
chalo hussain ki mil kar kare azadari
hussain ahle aza ka khuloos dekhte hai
ghame hussain mein hargiz na ho riyakari
yazeediyat se ho nafrat amal hussaini ho
yehi hussain se dar asl hai wafadari
<<DIVIDER>>
chalo sabeel lagayein hussain raazi ho
sabhi ko pani pilayein hussain raazi ho

karo hussain ka matam bichao farshe aza
tumhare ghar mein bhi aayegi fatema zehra

qatl e akbar ki sadayein aa rahi hai dasht se

sayyeda ya sayyeda...

saaqi e kausar ka waaris hai alamdar e hussain
ab sakina ka usay saqqa banaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...

ek bi aisa na tha jo zaalimo se poochta
aur mazloom pa kab tak zulm dhayaa jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...

jinke parde ke muhafiz akbar o abbas thay
aah unko bar sare darbar laaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...

ran mein qasim ke sarhane chup khade hai shaah e deen
kis tarha pamaal laashe ko uthaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...

poochte hai zulm ke masoom rukhsaaro ke neel
kab tak aakhir in yateemon ko rulaaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...

waqt kaisa aa gaya aale nabi par baad e shah
rayt par masoom bachon ko sulaaya jayega
sayyeda ya sayyeda...
