charon taraf se ghere hai mujhko zulm ka lashkar ay mere laal
tujh bin tera boodha...
maqtal mein shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai tujhko maloom mai tujhse kitni mohabbat karta hoon
yaad aate hai jab nana mai teri ziyarat karta hoon
baba jaan se na rootho hamshakle payambar ay mere laal
tujh bin tera boodha...
maqtal mein shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta apne baba ki aankhon ka taara hota hai
beta rahe nazdeek to aankhon mein ujiyara hota hai
mujhko nazar ab kuch nahi aata tujhse bichad kar ay mere laal
tujh bin tera boodha...
maqtal mein shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise samjhaun tujhko apni ulfat ka mafhoom
tere bhi aulaad agar hoti to tujhe hota maloom
tujhko rukhsat kar ke kya guzri hai mujhpar ay mere laal
tujh bin tera boodha...
maqtal mein shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko tanha jaan ke zaalim aur satayenge beta
behre madad ab ghurbat mein hum kisko bulayenge beta
ab nahi zinda tere chacha abbas e dilawar ay mere laal
tujh bin tera boodha...
maqtal mein shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay akbar mai ab kis tarha se qaime mein jaunga
teri phuphi amma ko jakar kaise moo dikhlaunga
bali sakina ko samjhaunga kya keh kar ay mere laal
tujh bin tera boodha...
maqtal mein shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash jawan bete ki ran se leke chale hai jab sarwar
khaynch rahe thay khat akbar ke pair zameen e karbal par
sheh ki zaeefi roti thi waiz ye keh kar ay mere laal
tujh bin tera boodha...
maqtal mein shaahe...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Dekh kar haibate
items.body:
zamana tehra dekh kar haibate abbas
inteha ye hai ke behta hua darya tehra
<<DIVIDER>>
hai alamdar teri jurrat o himmat ke misaal
door pani se tere jism ka saaya tehra
dekh kar haibate…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki hai zameen aur farishton ki jabeen
sajdaga hai to kahan shaah ka rauza tehra
dekh kar haibate…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha ab dil e betaab ko behlaye maa
godh khaali hai nazar aata hai jhoola tehra
dekh kar haibate…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sakina ko rahe shaam mein girte dekha
kaarwan jispe sar e shaah wo naiza tehra
dekh kar haibate…
<<DIVIDER>>
tadpa qaime mein jo awaaz kamaan ki sunkar
zinda ta-umr wo madar ka kaleja tehra
dekh kar haibate…

items.title: Faatahe karbobala
items.body:
faatahe karbobala ay sibte paighambar hussain
tu binaye la ilaah ay sibte paighambar hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu wiqar e hashmi hai deen ke sarwar hussain
deen e haq ke waaste tu aahni paykar hussain
raah e haq mein kar diya qurban apna ghar hussain
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ka maareka wo kaarnama hai tera
bacha bacha aalam e islam ka tujhpar fida
tere gham mein ro rahe hai aaj tak ahle aza
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
quwate baazu e hyder fatema ke noore ain
naazishe kauno makan tu hai imame mashraqain
aalam e islam par ehsan hai tera hussain
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
millate haqqa ka beda ghark hojata magar
quwate baatil ke aage hogaya seena sipar
marzi e khaaliq pe tune de diya sajde mein sar
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
tere dam se hashr tak khayam hai deene mustufa
tere qurbani se hai deene mohamed ki baqa
ambiya hairat zada hai tujhpe nazaan hai khuda
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab giray ghode se akbar khaake seene par sina
paane waahid mein hua ek khoon ka darya rawan
garm reti par tadapkar margaya kadiyal jawan
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim e naushah ka pamaal laasha hogaya
umme farwa ka kaleja tukde tukde hogaya
zindagi bhar ke liye kubra ko randsala mila
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
teer khakar baap ke haaton pe tadpa sheerkhaar
haye is sadme se maa ka hogaya seena figaar
is anokhe zulm par insaniyat hai soghwaar
faatahe karbobala…
<<DIVIDER>>
chal base dunya se abbas e alamdare hussain
aur bahattar ay kaleem as'hab o ansar e hussain
surk roohe do jahan mein aaj sarkare hussain
faatahe karbobala…
items.author: Qaiser Kaleem

items.title: Ghul hai ke janasheen
items.body:
ghul hai ke janasheen e payambar hua shaheed
girya karo batool ka shauhar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaaye na kyun andhera sar e chashm e momineen
deen ke falak ka mehr e munawar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuffaar ke dilon mein raha khauf ban ke jo
wo mard e jang faatahe khyber hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajdon ko jis pa naaz hai jannat ko faqr hai
wo ghamgusaar saaqi e kausar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
rab ki riza bana ke rahe manzil e muraad
haq ke safar mein deen ka rehbar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunain mein mahafiz e islam e haq shinaas
azm o wafa o sabr ka paikar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
dast e nabi se jis ko mila deen ka alam
wo meer e kaarzaar ghazanfar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay jiske ilm o fahem mein asraar e kayenaat
dunya mein aisa shahid e daawar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran jis se kar liya karta tha dil ki baat
aisa musafir aisa sukhanwar hua
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
danishwaraan e dehr mein kohraam mach gaya
jab baab e ilm naam e khuda par hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehrab o masjid o dar o dewaar hai khamosh
bazm e jahan mein saahib e mimbar hua shaheed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
<<DIVIDER>>
fayyaz zulfeqar e falak kyun na ho malool
aisa shuja'a naazim e lashkar hua shaheeed
ghul hai ke janasheene...
items.author: Fayyaz Lakhnavi

items.title: Hussain raazi rahe
items.body:
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
hamesha bichta rahe ghar mein mere farshe aza
hussain raazi rahe bas hussain raazi rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
zamana roothe ya phir choote koi bhi rishta
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye majlisein ye azakhane aur ye farshe aza
sabeelein aur tabaruk ko baatne ka maza
hussain ke hi liye sab hai aur ye mansha
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaye wo ran ki taraf jab hussain ne chaaha
sipaahi haq ki samajhte thay falsafa rab ka
wohi wo karte rahe jo hussain kehta raha
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye apne bachon ko maa'on ne tarbiyat di hai
ghame hussain manao ye pursa daari hai
jiyo hussain ke gham mein ye baap ne bhi kaha
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhana rabial aala rasool padhte rahe
ke unki pusht pe jab tak hussain baithe rahe
bina hussain kaamil nahi koi sajda
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain dil hai hussain jaan hai
dilon ki dhadkan mein bhi rawan hai
tapish mein gham ki ye sayeban hai
hussain tauheed ki zaban hai
khuda ka kalma jahan jahan hai
hussain mera wahan wahan hai
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
padho ziyarat e maula khuda ko raazi karo
suno hussain suno gar padho hussain padho
aza ke farsh pe baitho khuda se mango dua
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin pe bhai ke baazu kahin behan ke pisar
khuda ki raah mein di hai jawani e akbar
jis imtehan mein laati rahi khuda ki raza
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi najaat ka zariya banega mehshar mein
sar apna faqr se uncha rahega mehshar mein
ab is khaiyaal se badkar bhi aur kya hoga
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain tu jo nahi hai to ghar nahi kuch bhi
kate jo ishq mein tere to sar nahi kuch bhi
habeeb ibne mazahir ki dosti ne kaha
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya hussain ne aamir tujhe safeer e aza
ata se unki mai shayar e ahlebait hua
khuda se paa'un shanawar ye khidmaton ka sila
bus hussain raazi rahe hussain raazi rahe
hamesha bichta rahe...
items.author: Shanawar Makanpuri

items.title: Jab haal dekha
items.body:
jigar ko thaam ke jab haal dekha akbar ka
ani ke saath mein nikla kaleja akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen e karbobala par hai phaila khoone pisar
bhara tha zakhmon se wo jism saara akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ani jo khaynchi to khoon aaya chehre par sheh ke
tadap ke reh gaye dekha hai chehra akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ye meri za'eefi ka tha sahara jawan
sitam ke naize ne cheda hai seena akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dulhan biyaah ke laila na ghar mein la paayi
bane hai khoon bhare gaysu ye sehra akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo khat hai aaya kaho kya jawab doon iska
ye keh ke naam hai ro kar pukara akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ugla khoon dehan se to dekh kar roye
wo hichki lena wo saansein ukhadna akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
gale pe waar hai aisa ke bol bhi na sake
labon pe aah thi aur dam tha nikla akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan shaah ka dunya se ho chuka ruqsat
hai laaya qasid e sughra bulawa akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke ghazi ko sheh ne pukara hai saayib
uthaun kaise bata do ye laasha akbar ka
ani ke saath mein...
items.author: Saayib Zaidi

items.title: Jo sajda hota hai
items.body:
jo sajda hota hai mukhtas payambari ke liye
rasool ne usay choda hussain hi ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi khuda ke liye hai ali nabi ke liye
na ho ye raat to koi nahi kisi ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ali hi kiye jao zindagi hai yehi
hai arsh mehwe sama'at ali ali ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali wali bhi hai nafse nabi bhi maula bhi
shaoor shart hai quran se aagahi ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zara ye dekhna ay dil wo karbala to nahi
chala hai kaaba kidhar kasbe roshni ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam khaana e zehra tere charaghon par
bujhe hai shamme risalat ki roshni ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
faraat mein bhi sakina ka aks hi dekha
hai tashnagi ka hai eesaar tashangi ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan wo raakibe doshe nabi kahan khanjar
ye lamha dard ka unwaan hai har sadi ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na cheen chadare zainab na cheen sar se rida
khuda ke waaste ay kalmago nabi ke liye
jo sajda hota hai...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Karbala jaisi aalam
items.body:
karbala jaisi aalam ki tareekh mein
dukh bhari daastan koi hai hi nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
deen par jo mite un shaheedon mein bhi
misle akbar jawan koi hai hi nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
maahe ramzan mein dada ne de thi azaan
subhe ashoor potay ne bhi di azaan
goonji kufe mein wo goonji karbal mein ye
dono jaisi azaankoi koi hai hi nahi
karbala jaisi aalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand laila ka jis waqt ran ko chala
hukme sarwar se mud mud ke dekha kiya
qalbe sarwar se aati thi us dam sada
misle akbar jawan koi hai hi nahi
karbala jaisi aalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
maanga akbar ne pani to shabbir ne
le li sookhi zaban moo mein farzand ki
usne wapas zaban khaynchi kehte huwe
aisi sookhi zaban koi hai hi nahi
karbala jaisi aalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
inko hamshakle ahmed thay sab maante
phir bhi barsayi tayghein ye kehte huwe
dekho saare gharane mein shabbir ke
aisa kadiyal jawan koi hai hi nahi
karbala jaisi aalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunche shabbir farzand ki laash par
khaynchi seene se barchi to nikla jigar
mar gaya aediyon ko ragad ke pisar
aisa sakht imtehan koi hai hi nahi
karbala jaisi aalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi qaime mein laashe shabihe nabi
dil pe laila ke aaafat ki barchi lagi
phir bhi sajde mein allah ke jhuk gayi
umme laila si maa koi hai hi nahi
karbala jaisi aalam...

items.title: Maula zawwar bana
items.body:
ya hussain shaah e karbala
aap hai kareem ba khuda
poori kijiye meri dua
is baras ke arbaeen mein
karoro zaireen mein
naam ho mera likha hua
<<DIVIDER>>
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein meri rooh mein armaan basa hai
khwabon khayalon mein mere karbobala hai
aankhon mein aansu hai labon par ye dua hai
mere tadapne ki wajah tum ko pata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhein meri kassh ke dar aap ka dekhe
haath mere rauze ki jaali ko jo thaame
lab ye mere aap ki choukat ko jo choome
log mujhe aashiq e shabbir pukare
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
shaano pe mai rakhe huwe shaal e aza ko
ghar se mai jis waqt chalun karbobala ko
baazu pe baandhunga mai taweez e raza ko
maa meri seene se lagayegi dua ko
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala shehr e najaf se mai badhunga
sardi ho garmi ho mai paidal hi chalunga
raah mein zawwaron ki khidmat mai karunga
parcham e abbas utha kar mai rakhunga
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoola nahi aap ke akbar ki jawani
yaad hai asghar ki mujhe tishna dahani
ban gaya zawwar to mannat hai ye maani
naam e sakina pe pilaunga mai pani
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shah e karbobala mujhe zawwar bana
ye tamanna hai meri apna darbar dikha
chal diye ahle aza sar pe parcham hai khula
sab ki manzil hai wohi karbala karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe apna bana le ay mere maula hussain
mujhe ek bar sada de ay mere maula hussain
mujhe maulayi bana de ay mere maula hussain
meri taqdeer jaga de ay mere maula hussain
maula karbala bula le ay mere maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe ek baar sada de
meri qismat ko jaga de
apna darbaar dikha de
ya maula ya maula
maula zawwar bana de
items.author: N. Sarwar & Salman Azmi

items.title: Mere naseeb mein
items.body:
bahot udaas hoo aur dil tadap raha hai mera
badi tamanna thi dekhunga aap ka rauza
mai dekhta raha sab jaa rahe thay ay maula
kyun is baras bhi nahi jaa saka mai karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
mere naseeb mein kya karbala nahi maula
ghulam aap se ab tak mila nahi maula
<<DIVIDER>>
mai matami hoon bula lein mujhe bhi rauze par
lahoo bahaya apne watan mein reh ke magar
haram mein aap ke pursa diya nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai chal raha hoo julooson mein arbaeen ke din
hai ye bhi aap ke hi ishq ka safar lekin
najaf se karbala paidal chala nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chupa rakhi hai ziyarat ki aarzoo mann mein
bahot ghareeb hoo kuch bhi nahi hai daaman mein
siwa tumhare kisi se kaha nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dikha dein maujiza ek baar karbala aaun
ya mai bhi sughra ki tarha watan mein mar jaaun
aur intezaar ka ab hausla nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haram mein aath moharram alam uthaana hai
muqam e akbar o asghar mujhe bhi jaana hai
mai qaima gaah bhi ab tak gaya nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bula lo waasta ghazi ke zakhmi chehre ka
zameen pe chehre ke bal zeen se jis tarha wo gira
kata ke haath koi bhi gira nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zaireen se maine suna hai rote huwe
hussain aap jahan teen roz pyase rahe
wahan unhe koi pyasa dikha nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai intezar mein zeeshan abidi kab se
habeeb se kahe ashoor par bula le mujhe
raza ka naam bhi ab tak likha nahi maula
mere naseeb mein...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Mustafa girya kuna
items.body:
mustafa girya kuna murtaza girya kuna
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon seene se ubalta hai koi to roke
saath hi dum bhi ukhadta hai koi to roke
jaan se jaata hai payambar sa jawan
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
mustafa girya kuna…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi naushah ki laash aayi hai maqtal se abhi
aur dulhan koi khamosh hai sakte may khadi
sare qaima hai qayamat ka samaa
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
mustafa girya kuna…
<<DIVIDER>>
gurz ka waar laga sar pa to sambhla na gaya
apne rehwaar se bedast zameen par aaya
mashk seene se magar hai chaspan
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
mustafa girya kuna…
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe baysheer liye qaime ki simt aate hai
jaane kya soch ke phir shaah palat jaate hai
muntazir hai dare qaima par maa
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
mustafa girya kuna…
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barasta hai fizaon se larazti hai zameen
shah-e-deen sajdaye aakhir may jhukate hai jabeen
yehi sar hoga sare noke sina
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
mustafa girya kuna…
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm sajjad ka is tarha se rista jaye
tauq gardan may lahoo tauq pa girta jaye
aur paon may wo zanjeere garan
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
mustafa girya kuna…
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr barchi se utarega jo zainab ki rida
ran may shahid tadap uthega jari ka laasha
ab haram ka nahi koi nigaran
fatema noha kuna mere mazloom hussain
mustafa girya kuna…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Abbas ki wafa ko
items.body:
abbas ki wafa ko shabbir ka salam
zahra ki shahzadi hamsheer ka salam
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ke dil ki dhadkan shabbir ka qaraar
tishna labon ka saqqa qaimon ka pehredaar
uske liye hai zainabe dilgeer ka salaam
abbas ki wafa ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe karke qabza jo tashnalab raha
chullu mein leke pani pani nahi piya
abbas tujhko sabr ki jageer ka salam
abbas ki wafa ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka alam tha ke zainab ki rida thi
ghazi tere parcham ki hawa mein bhi wafa thi
hyder ki tamanna'on ka markaz tera paikar
humraah tere fatema zahra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
abbbas ke alam ki dunya mein roshni
phaili to milgayi hai wafaon ko zindagi
bazme ghame hussain ki tanveer ka salam
abbas ki wafa ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aankh tere rouze ke hai khaab dekhti
us khaab mein hai roohe aqeedat chupi huvi
pakeezgi ye khaab ko tabeer ka salam
abbas ki wafa ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske lahoo se parcham e islam hai dhula
pehchaan us dilayr ki mashkeeza hogaya
ghazi ko mere waaris e tatheer ka salam
abbas ki wafa ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shane qalam kara diye pani jo choo liya
qaime mein us dilayr ka laasha nahi gaya
sharminda tha sakina se hyder ka laadla
abbas tujhko royegi ta hashr karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu kata ke jisne rakhli wafa ki laaj
karti hai jisko sajda uski wafaein aaj
us ba-wafa ko maadare shabbir ka salam
abbas ki wafa ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar bhi tashnalab tha to ghazi bhi tashnalab
be-jurm qatl ye huwa aur wo bhi be-sabab
us faatahe faraat ko baysheer ka salam
abbas ki wafa ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan mai ghulam hoo hyder ke sher ka
mere qalam ko soz hai abbas ne diya
nauhon mein dhal gaya meri tehreer ka salam
abbas ki wafa ko...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ay bekaso muztar
items.body:
ay bekas o muztar ke wafadar alamdar
ay jaan o dil e hyder e karrar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se badan choor hua jaata hai jaago
ay mere sipar mere wafadar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ta umr mujhe tum ne bas aaqa hi kaha hai
bhai bhi to kehdo zara ek baar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sone nahi deta tha jinhe khauf tumhara
ab chain se soyenge wo ashraar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se lahoo poch ke shabbir pukare
bhai ka karo aakhri deedar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde ke tahaffuz ka kiya jinse tha waada
kya unse kahe zainab e lachaar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas baradar ki ye ghurbat bhi to dekho
tanhaai hai aur sayyed e abraar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
us fauj ke marne ka yaqeen aaye to kaise
jis fauj ka tum jaisa ho jarraar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab raaton ko pehre pe bhala kaun rahega
abid hai faqad wo bhi hai bemaar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yaad bilal aaj bhi baba ki wasiyat
shabbir se ab tak hai khabardar alamdar
ay bekas o muztar...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Baba tera ek shab
items.body:
beti se kaha sheh ne meri jaan sakina
baba tera ek shab ka hai mehman sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ki ghurbat mein aseeri ke safar mein
be-rehm zamane mein rahe baad padar ke
har gaam khuda tera nigehban sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar bhi tamacha kabhi durra bhi lagela
badlega kayi rang tera phool sa chehra
haan daure yateemi nahi aasan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aap ki aagosh mein chup jaungi baba
aur akbar o abbas ko bulwaungi baba
tanha to na hogi sar e maidan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein na kooza liye khaali chali aana
abbas ko ro ro ke na darya se bulaana
hojayenge sharminda chacha jaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tera qatil kya musalman nahi hai
kya yaad nabi ka usay farmaan nahi hai
shabbir ki baaton pe hai hairaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal jayega ghar baar to ghabraogi bibi
kal shab kahin baba ko na tum paogi bibi
na rehm karenge ye musalman sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin bacchon ke jal jaate hai ghar sote hai kaise
mar jaaye jo gar baap to phir rote hai kaise
batlao na baba ke hai nadaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaano ke tere zakhm tujhe sone na denge
zaalim mere laashe pe tujhe rone na denge
tarsegi tu rone ko meri jaan sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
sone ki tere seene pe zid chod ke baba
so jayegi zindan ki zameen od ke baba
ho jayegi islam pe qurban sakina
baba tera ek shab...
beti se kaha sheh ne...
items.author: Naqvi

items.title: Bazare shaam may
items.body:
bazare shaam may darbare aam may
qaidi rahi nana roti rahi nana
do tohfe laayi hoon mai aap ke liye
ek bhai ka kurta aur bazu'on ke neel
karbal se shaam tak be-maqna o chadar
pur-khar raho par chalti rahi nana
bazare sham may...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bekasi bhari aayi wo shame gham
asbaab lut gaya qaime bhi jal gaye
jis dam mere sar se cheeni gayi rida
abbas ko sada deti rahi nana
bazare sham may...
<<DIVIDER>>
balon ka tha parda baazu may reesma
bali sakina ka jakda huwa gala
karte rahe aada jo sang baariyan
har ranj o musibat sehti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad natawan pe zulm ka toofan
haton may hathkadi pairon may bediyan
durre lagate thay har gaam pe aada
us bekasi pe mai roti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ka laadla asghar bhi chal basa
akbar bhi chal basa qasim bhi chal basa
mahe bani hashim ghazi bhi chal basa
ashoor ko din bhar lut'ti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal ki dasht may ye kya sitam hua
mai be-rida rahi wo bekafan raha
tapte zameen pe laasha pada raha
mai kuch na kar saki ghut'ti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan e shaam ka aalam ajab sa tha
din may thi tez dhoop raton may oas thi
maa'en tadapti thi bache bilakte thay
har pal wahan pe mai marti rahi nana
bazare sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed badi ghamgeen zainab ki dastan
kaamp uth'ti lehad ahmed ki ay hassan
mushkil ka marhala tay karke aayi hoo
bhai ki maut par roti rahi nana
bazare sham...
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Bosagahe ahmed
items.body:
bosagahe ahmed par shamsheer nazar aayi
yun khwab e khaleeli ki tabeer nazar aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hurr ki baseerat thi jisko shabe isiyan may
taqdeer banane ki tadbeer nazar aayi
bosagahe ahmed par…
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk e ghame sarwar ke aaina e roshan may
jannat bhi hamay apni jageer nazar aayi
bosagahe ahmed par…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis khaak pe soye hai zehra ke jigar paare
wo khaak do aalam ko akseer nazar aayi
bosagahe ahmed par…
<<DIVIDER>>
bache ki taraf zaalim kyun teer chalaya hai
masoom ki kya tujhko taqseer nazar aayi
bosagahe ahmed par…
<<DIVIDER>>
aghyaar bhi ro uthe moo phayr ke raahon may
jab paon may abid ke zanjeer nazar aayi
bosagahe ahmed par…
<<DIVIDER>>
aansu ghame sarwar may nikle jo urooj apne
har ashk may kausar ke tasveer nazar aayi
bosagahe ahmed par…
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Dekh kar hairaan
items.body:
dekh kar hairaan khuda hai asghar e baysheer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
<<DIVIDER>>
chad ke naize pe bachaya tu ne asghar la ilaah
deen e ahmed pe hua yun teer kha kar tu fida
marhaba kehna pada khud kaatib e taqdeer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid ki tanhaiyan aur is pe zaalim ke sitam
bhool jayegi layeen ko aur kaano ke zakhm
qabr bhoolegi na teri haye kabhi humsheer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath jab baba ke asghar ko na payegi rubab
leke khaali godh kaise shaam jayegi rubab
bas khayal aata hai maqtal mein yehi shabbir ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoolta naize pe jhoola na ye bhoolega jahan
ta abad royenge us ko ye zameen o aasman
kar gaya nakaam zaalim ki jo har tadbeer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar asghar ka hasna ro rahe thay ashqiyan
dekh asghar ki shuja'at jhoomte thay ambiya
saare mil kar dekhte thay deen ki tanveer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahi khursheed hai ab bhi sada e karbala
na chupega us ka khoon hai jo bina e la ilaah
laakh dunya ye chupaye khoone be-taqseer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Fakhre maryam
items.body:
zainab kuja bazaar kuja
<<DIVIDER>>
fakhre maryam be rida hai shaam ka bazaar hai
saj raha darbar hai shaam ka bazaar hai
bheedh hai bazariyon ki
saj raha darbar hai shaam ka bazaar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise guzregi ali ki betiyan bazaar se
sang baari ho rahi hai raasta dushwaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas na chalta tha magar abid se wo kehti rahi
maarta hai kyun tamache mujhko ye badkaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa siwa sajjad ke mere bacha koi nahi
yun na maaro zaalimon bemar hai lachaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mas'ala ye hai ke tum ne usko pehchana nahi
jisko baaghi keh rahe ho khuld ka sardar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
roo baroo baba ke apne jo na boli thi ameer
teen din deti rahi bazaar may niruvaar hai
bheed hai bazariyon ki saj raha darbar hai
fakhre maryam be rida hai...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Ghurbate batool
items.body:
kahan batool ki ghurbat ko hum samajh paaye
hamari saans ruki aur na hum ghash khaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi bhi khaak e baqayya sadayein deti hai
khuda kare ke ye pehlu se khoon ruk jaaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dar ke jis pe jhukate thay sar nabi apna
usi pe aaj musalman diye chale aaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeef hogayi darbar jab gayi bibi
siyah sar mein safedi utar gayi haye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
utha ke haath sitamgar ne kehkahan maara
hassan ke saamne zehra pe ye sitam dhaaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir ek waqt wo aaya ke kund khanjar se
rag e hussain pe bibi ne haath katwaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham batool ka sajjad se koi pooche
rida e zainabe muztar pe ashk barsaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame imame zamana ko koi kya jaane
ke jiski maa ki lehad roz dhoop jhul saaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bara e fatema zehra dua karo yasir
khuda kare ke zahoor e imam hojaye
kahan batool ki ghurbat...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Ho kahan ay laal
items.body:
haye asghar ki sada aati hai ab bhi raat ko
goonjta hai naala e qalbe rababe karbala
jab jhapak jaati thi palke chaunk uth'ti thi rabab
jaise koi kaan mein kehta ho asghar aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ho kahan ay laal asghar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ab na qasim hai akbar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
<<DIVIDER>>
tu mere dil ka sukoon hai tu mere dil ka qaraar
yaad mein teri sakina kar rahi hai intezaar
ye batado ho kahan par kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai andhera soona jangal darr na jaana mere laal
ye teri lambi judaai kar gayi mujhko nidhaal
mar na jaye teri madar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ki aandhi ne tujhko kar diya mujhse juda
kis sitam ke abr mein hai chup gaya chehra tera
thokare khaati hoon dar dar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ne ye khat mein likha kaisa hai asghar mera
ghutniyon chalta wo hoga jaan meri us par fida
kya kahegi us se maadar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
chin gayi chadar bhi meri jal gaya jhoola tera
poochti hoo har kisi se hai kahan asghar mera
mujhko ghere hai sitamgar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mein tere ro rahe hai ye zameen-o-aasman
mohsin-o-ahmed bhi roye ro rahe hai do jahan
keh rahi thi gham se madar kis tarha dhoonde ye maa
ho kahaan ay laal…
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Hussain saari ye
items.body:
hussain saari ye kainaat tere dam se hai
ye dil abaad hashr tak bhi tere gham se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha tha kis ne ye maula teri sharafat pe
ke hum hussain se hai aur hussain hum se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kata ke tu ne jo sar deen ko kiya zinda
har ek aankh ashk baar tere gham se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ufaq pe aaj jo surkhi hai khoone na-haq ki
zameen udaas abhi tak bhi tere gham se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
namaz e ishq ada ki jo tu ne teeron mein
namaz aaj bhi qaayam tere alam se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere namoos jo darbar mein thay beparda
hairaan aalam e islam is sharam se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
karenge seena zani jab talak hai ye dunya
hamara deen emaan aap ke hi gham se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya tha parcham e islam par jo khoon tera
mashaf fizaon mein ab tak tere karam se hai
hussain saari ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaga bhi denge ye soye huwe naseebon ko
dar e batool pe sardar aankh nam se hai
hussain saari ye...
items.author: Sardar

items.title: Jab hum ne suni
items.body:
jab hum ne suni masjid se azan
hamshakle payambar yaad aaye
takbeer ki aayi jaise sada
har ek ko akbar yaad aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
hasta jo koi bacha dekha
chaah maah ke asghar yaad aaye
yaad aayi hum ko karbobala
ek dukhiya maadar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
khat bhej ke ye sughra ne kaha
kya bhool gaye mujhko baba
deedar ko tarsi hai dukhiya
har waqt baradar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab asr ka suraj hai dhalta
aur shimr ka khanjar hai chalta
shabbir ka aisa hai sajda
ke sajda e hyder yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi hai musibat ranj o alam
kufe mein barehna sar hai haram
har samt khade hai na mehram
tatheer ki chadar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
meraaj e haya thi naize par
rukta hi na tha abbas ka sar
kethi hai ye zainab ro ro kar
bazaar ke manzar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan se qaidi jab choote
aur wapas yasrab mein pahunche
dil ahle madina ke toote
har ek ko sarwar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi sakeena amma jaan
baysheer mera bhaiyya hai kahan
kya us se kahe dukhiyari maa
be saaqta asghar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ghar mein bana koi dulha
yaad aa gaya qasim ka sehra
nauha bhi pada matam bhi kiya
aur dilbar e shabbar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jaah par kahin pani barse
aur dekhe hum ne khet haray
asghar ka lahoo rukh par apne
malte huwe sarwar yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kaun muneer apna hamsar
kyunkar ho hamein khauf e mehshar
ho aankh ghame shabbir mein tar
aur nazha mein hyder yaad aaye
jab hum ne suni...
items.author: Muneer Lakhnavi

items.title: Jo shaamile bazme
items.body:
jo shaamil e bazme ghame shabbir nahi hai
haasil usay emaan ki jageer nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qurbani e shabbir hata do to ye islam
wo khwab hai jis khwab ki tabeer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
be hubbe ali sajde hai yun meri nazar mein
goya to hai quran ki tafseer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar ke paon ki taraf dekhne walon
islam ka langar hai ye zanjeer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kufiyon be-parda hai ye hurmate islam
be-parda yahan zainab e dilgeer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ne ye ashoor ki shab khwab mein dekha
jhoole mein mera asghare baysheer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki shahadat ne kiya zulm ko ruswa
ab tarkashe aada mein koi teer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
<<DIVIDER>>
jisme na rawani ho na ho shaukate alfaaz
mehshar wo tere khaak ki tehreer nahi hai
jo shaamil e bazme…
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Maine ay sughra
items.body:
maine ay sughra andheron se rifaqat kar li
qaid e zindan may sakina ye sada deti thi
<<DIVIDER>>
jabse baba ka behan seena hua mujhse juda
mar gayi seene may umeed mere jeene ki
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
neele rukhsar tere hote behan meri tarha
ye to acha hi hua tum na yahan par aayi
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri awaaz bhi hai meri tarha qaid may ab
bas isi tarha se ab qaid may mar jaungi
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
neend jab aati nahi qaid e sitam may khwahar
loriyan yaad bahot aati hai mujhko maa ki
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
garche khaaliq ki har ek shay hai mujhe yaad magar
roshni cheez hai kya ab to yahan bhool gayi
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ko mai dukhda sunaungi gale se lag kar
qaid se jald rihaai ki ho surat sab ki
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to zindan ki tareeki ka hai saath mera
roshni yaad nahi ab mujhe madine ki
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab mayassar hai mujhe khaak ka takiya bistar
chain ki neend madine may mujhe aati thi
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne hi qadmon ki aahat se seham jaati hoo
is khadar hai dar o deewar se wehshat taari
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
din bhi rehta hai yahan chadare zulmat odhe
kya bayan shab ke andhere ka kare yan koi
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
khushk lab yaad sakina ke mujhe aaye najaf
qalb do paara hua aagayi ankhon may nami
maine ay sughra...
qaid e zindan may...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Maut aayi aur
items.body:
maut aayi aur ali asghar ko behla legayi
haye wo bhi teen din ka bhooka pyasa le gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
aag qaimon mein lagi asghar ka jhoola jal gaya
ek nishani reh gayi th, wo bhi dunya le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki aankhon ke aage mar gaya kadiyal jawan
seena e akbar se jab barchi kaleja le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
shab ki biyahi apni aankhon mein basa kar dasht se
khoon mein lipta hua dulha ka sehra le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne bacchon par na royi bhai ke gham ke siwa
ashq aaye bhi to zainab dil ko samjha le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par tadpe hai kya kya gulbadan ghuncha dahan
subhe ashoora baharein baaghe zehra le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein bacchi ne dam toda hai is sadme ke baad
tashnagi meri mere ammu ko darya le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka gham baazoun par neel aur be-pardagi
leke kya aayi thi zainab aur kya kya le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid se chut kar madine jaa ke bano kya kare
zindagi ki aakhri hasrat sakina le gayi
maut aayi aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par har umr ka laasha pada hai ay suroor
do peher mein maut ghar ka ghar ye kiska le gayi
maut aayi aur...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Na alam na chacha
items.body:
na alam na chacha na shahe karbala
shaam hogayi
jo bhi ghar se gaya wo na phir aa saka
shaam hogayi
<<DIVIDER>>
raah takti rahi shiddate pyas mein
kat gaya din isi aas hi aas mein
koi aaya nahi jaane kya hogaya
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani lene gaye dayr kitni huwi
din dhala ay chacha sham-e-gham aagayi
khushk hai ay chacha mera ab tak gala
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisko aawaz doo huk ke maidaan mein
kaun hai jo sune is biyaban mein
de rahi hoo tumhe jaane kab se sada
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
laut aao ke pani nahi chahiye
khao mujh par taras ab khuda ke liye
mashk khaali hi le aao ab to chacha
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa ke maidaan mein baba bhi aaye nahi
ab to jhoole mein asghar bhi haye nahi
qaima jalta hai yun jaise koi diya
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai phuphi chin gayi hai rida
maarte hai tamache mujhe ashkiyan
qaima jalta hai yu jaise koi diya
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu'on mein rasan baandhne aa gaye
khaynch ke legaye durr mere kaan se
hogaya khoon se tar saara kurta mera
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
lo chacha suye zindan chali ghamzada
alvida alvida ay qateel-e-jafa
lijiye aap se ho rahi hoo juda
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha rehaan majlis mein sunke tera
chasme giriyan ko ye hosh kab hi raha
kab sahar hogayi aur kab dhin dala
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Abbas ko haaton
items.body:
ek khwab mein dekha kisi aalim ne ye manzar
kehta hai koi qarz mera zikr hai tum par
mazloomi e abbas bayan kyun nahi karte
tum log kabhi mere masayib nahi padte
sar choor tha paywast tha jab teer jabeen par
bin haaton ke abbas gire kaise zameen par
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil mein hai abbas musibat mein hai abbas
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka sahara koi de de
<<DIVIDER>>
jab nehr se pani liye wapas hua ghazi
bhagi hui wo faujein udoo laut ke aayi
baarish hui pyase pe wahan teer e sitam ki
baazu bhi kate maskh chidi beh gaya pani
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
saabir hai ladayi ka kahan izn mila hai
dil toot gaya mashk pe jab teer laga hai
ghazi ka lahoo mashk e sakina se baha hai
ghode pe ye lehrata hua dekh raha hai
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-baam ka dar kis tarha girta hai zameen par
be-dosh ka sar kis tarha girta hai zameen par
bes-haak shajar kis tarha girta hai zameen par
be-dast bashar kis tarha girta hai zameen par
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya jaafar e tayyaar madad ke liye aao
ya sayyed e abraar madad ke liye aao
ya hyder e karraar madad ke liye aao
ay sab ke madad gaar madad ke liye aao
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ka hai ghode pe wo naam e shahe dilgeer
saahii ki tarha jism hua itne lage teer
girta hai magar girne mein hojati hai takheer
dekhein koi mazloomi e abbas ki tasveer
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai teer meri aankh mein mushkil ki ghadi hai
zakhmi hai badan mera ajal paas khadi hai
pani nahi pahunchaya wasiyat ye kadi hai
is waqt sakina se hamein sharm badi hai
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo saath nibahate thay madad ke liye aayein
jo naaz uthaate thay madad ke liye aayein
jo mujhko sulaate thay madad ke liye aayein
jhoola ko jhulaate thay madad ke liye aayein
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushman mere aaqa ke yahan saare layeen hai
kuch dayr ke mehman hai hum khaak nasheen hai
jo haath gire kat ke tarapte wo wahin hai
mai kaise dua maangun mere haath nahi hai
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sar se baha khoon ka darya hai zameen tak
bin haathon ke abbas ko aana hai zameen tak
zehra ka qamar kis tarha pahuncha hai zameen tak
ay pushte e faras faasla kitna hai zameen tak
is doobti kashti ko kinara koi de de
abbas ko haaton ka...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Ajal hussain ki
items.body:
hussainiyo ye tum pe hogaya laazim jo tum hussaini ho
ajal hussain ki surat jiyo ali ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
hussainyo ye tumhe karbala bataati hai
jo qaum apne shaheedon ko bhool jaati hai
qadam qadam pe ajal se fareb khaati hai
phir aisi qaum ki qismat mein be-sabaati hai
hussainyo karo jo pairawi to hurr ki pairawi ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi hussaini kabhi maut se nahi darta
ali ka naam kabhi be-sukoon nahi karta
ali ke bughz ka jo zakhm hai nahi bharta
ali ka maan'ne waala kabhi nahi marta
hussainyo jo inpe marta hai wo hai shaheed hi ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke bacchon ko jo maut se daraata hai
wo apni fikre najis se fareb khaata hai
ali ki raah se jo bhi qadam hataata hai
nabi ka beta bhi toofan mein doob jaata hai
hussainyo nabi ke bete agar ho raho nabi ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke jeene ka andaaz kia niraala hai
ali ne maut ko bhi rizq de ke paala hai
khuda ke ghar mein shahadat bada hawala hai
ali ne maut ko bhi mushkilon mein daala hai
hussainyo hassan hussain bhi zinda rahe inhi ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo haq parast hai wo sab ghulame hyder hai
nazar mein badr o ohad ke tamaam manzar hai
jo haq parast nahi buzdilaan e khyber hai
jo haq parast hai unke jale huwe ghar hai
hussainyo sha'oor e haq ki zaroorat hai qambari ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
inhi ke dar pe ajal aa ke ho gayi majboor
hayaat o maut ka banta hai inke ghar manshoor
inhi ke laal banate hai sabr ka dastoor
munafiqat hai hamesha dar e hussain se door
hussainyo huqooq rakhte hai saare ye daawari ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
sanad ghulami ki de de to khuld mil jaaye
ye muskuraye to murjhaya phool khil jaaye
zameen ko ghaiz se dekhe falak bhi hil jaaye
yahan se maangne dhadkan nabi ka dil jaaye
hussainyo kareem sab hai yahan rab e akbari ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali se zindagi qaatil ali ka kya cheene
ke jaam e shireen jisay daste hyderi se mile
ali ne neend se bedaar kar diya ho jisay
ali se zindagi wo cheenta bhala kaise
hussainyo ajal pe kaun gira dehr mein ali ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun jaata hai marne lahoo lahoo hai badan
faras ke dosh pe suraj ki jaa rahi hai kiran
jalaal kehta hai ye shakhs to hai maut shikan
tadap rahi hai dar e qaima pe ye kis ki behan
hussainyo ye kayenat larazti hai sarsari ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kis ke halq pe ruk ruk ke taygh chalti hai
hayaat roti hai aur maut haath malti hai
zameen e garm se ek aag si nikalti hai
ye kis ki maa hai jo girti hai aur sambhalti hai
hussainyo ye kayenat pe chalti hai kya churi ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
<<DIVIDER>>
hayaat o maut ka ye falsafa diya kis ne
ajal ka jaam khuda ke liye piya kis ne
ye marhala tha kathan tay magar kiya kis ne
rehaan azmi mar ke bata diya kis ne
hussainyo hayaat o maut hai be-sar hussain hi ki tarha
ajal hussain ki surat...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ay bhai hussaina
items.body:
bin tere na aaram kahin payegi behna
ay bhai hussaina ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke teri yaad mein mar jayegi behna
ay bhai hussaina ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
ujde huwe kunbe ko sambhalungi mai bhai
har haal mein abid ko bachaungi mai bhai
lab par koi shikwa na kabhi layegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu aalam e ghurbat mein akela tha akela
aur tha tere haathon pe jawan bete ka laasha
manzar wo kabhi bhi na bhula payegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabraegi zainab jo rida sar pe na hogi
mar jayegi zainab jo rida sar pe na hogi
bazaar mein kis tarha bhala jayegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bewaon yateemo ko liye bekas o muztar
darbar e yazeedi mein rasan basta khule sar
jaana hua yun bhi to na ghabraegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein royi jo tere gham mein sakina
dhoondegi jo sone ke liye baap ka seena
us bachi ko kis tarha se behlayegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
de de ke sadayein tujhe jaan khoyegi zainab
tanhaai mein ghut ghut ke bahot royegi zainab
ghar jaa ke tujhe jab ke nahi payegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ne jo poocha ke kahan hai mere bhaiya
batlao phupi amma kahan reh gaye baba
kya jaa ke bhala sughra ko batlayegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
be gor o kafan laash jahan hai teri bhaiya
abbas e dilawar ki behan karti hai waada
rauza tera aa kar wahin banwayegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
gohar ye kaha aur wo behan khaak se uthi
bhaiya tere qaatil ko mai jeene nahi doongi
baatil ko mita kar hi yahan aayegi behna
ay bhai hussaina...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Bazare sham se
items.body:
ek zaair shaam se jab aaya tha uske labaon par nauha
poocha jo kisi ne ay zaair kya tune wahan par dekha
bola ro kar haye mat poocho
phat'ta hai jigar haye mat poocho
bazaare shaam se aaya hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
us shehr e sitamgar mein ab tak be-ghairat log hi baste hai
kal ahle haram par haste thay ab ahle aza par haste hai
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
kya manzar mai dekh aaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
un raahon ko bhi dekha hai sadaat jahan thay be-chadar
thay ahle haram pabande rasan aur unpe baraste thay pathar
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
kya zakhm jigar laaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sau baras guzre lekin wo aaj bhi reet nibhate hai
bazaar sajaye jaate thay bazaar sajaye jaate hai
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
wo galiyan mai dekh aaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne ajdaad ki rasmon ko wo ahle shaam nahi bhoole
kal bhi thay tamashaai zaalim ab tak wo log nahi badle
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
ye dard wahan se laaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar ke raste dekhe to sajjad ka rona yaad aaya
haste hue chehre dekhe to sajjad ka rona yaad aaya
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
kya yaad wahan se laaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
un sham ki galiyon mein kaise abbas ki khahar aayi thi
haaton mein rasan thi zainab ke aur haye khule sar aayi thi
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
ye soch ke mai thar'raya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil khoon ke aansu rota tha sajjad ka un bazaron mein
be parda haram ki haalat par haste thay sharabi raahon mein
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
dil mein ye dard basaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye soch ke dil phat jaata hai sajjad pe kya guzri hogi
baabe saa'at par ruk kar aulaad e payambar roti thi
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
kaise zinda laut aaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai shaam ke un bazaron se ye zakhme jigar laaya mazhar
tum poochte ho tehreer mein kya roodade safar laaya safdar
haye mat poocho haye mat poocho
nauha ye zuban par laaya hoo
bazaare shaam se...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Buland hote hai
items.body:
buland hote hai sholay batool ke ghar se
yehi wafa hai madine ki kya payambar se
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta pehlu se behta hua lahoo to nahi
lahoo jo pocha hai zehra apni chadar se
buland hote hai sholay...
<<DIVIDER>>
hua hai kaise ye paywast gaal may gohar
lahoo tapakta hai kaisa batool rone se
buland hote hai sholay...
<<DIVIDER>>
aseer karte hai damaad e mustafa ko wohi
wafa ka daawa tha jinko janabe sarwar se
buland hote hai sholay...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun hai ke jo karta hai zulm se jaari
nabi ki beti pe fatwa nabi ke mimbar se
buland hote hai sholay...
<<DIVIDER>>
chipayi kyun gayi zehra ki qabr baat khuli
hassan ki laash pe yasrab may teer jab barse
buland hote hai sholay...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kayenaat ki maalik hai uski turbat ka
nishan banaya gaya hai bas ek pathar se
buland hote hai sholay...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aab o daana to haq mehre fatema lekin
hai uska kunba jo sehra may aabe kausar se
buland hote hai sholay...
<<DIVIDER>>
safed hogaye kyun sar ke baal zahra ke
layeen ne kya kaha akbar nabi ki dukhtar se
buland hote hai sholay...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Dekh kar pamaaL
items.body:
dekh kar pamaal laashe karbala roti rahi
ban ke laashon ka kafan khaake shifa roti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kate darya pe baazu bawafa abbas ke
waaris e tatheer ke sar ki rida roti rahi
dekh kar pamaal laashe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar diya zakhmi sina ne haye akbar ka jigar
dekh kar hamsheer jis ka raasta roti rahi
dekh kar pamaal laashe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kaha bache ne maa se muskurakar alwida
choom kar maa nanhe asghar ka gala roti rahi
dekh kar pamaal laashe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat chuki sajde mein gardan jab ali ke laal ki
khol kar baalon ko binte mustufa roti rahi
dekh kar pamaal laashe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya jawwad roye suye maqtal dekh kar
aasman larza zameen e nainawa roti rahi
dekh kar pamaal laashe...
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Farde aamaal bas
items.body:
fard e aamaal mein bas ashk hamare honge
hashr ke din yehi bakshish ke sahare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr mein chain se soyenge azadaar e hussain
aankh kholenge to kausar ke kanare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafila khuld ki jaanib jo badhega apna
raahwar hazrate abbas hamare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle matam ko bhala rok sakega koi
baabe jannat pe jo zehra ke dulaare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
kin tamannaon se atthara baras zainab ne
kitne sadqe rukhe akbar ke utaare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
isko ek maa hi samajh sakti hai baade akbar
kaise din zeest ke laal ne guzaare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ka kya haal hua hoga ali akbar jab
le ke marne ki raza ran ko sidhare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ko shadi ke thay armaan magar thi na khabar
ye jawan honge to allah ko pyare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
ro lo aaj haathon se sar peet ke asghar ko rabab
kal ko rassi mein bandhe haath tumhare honge
<<DIVIDER>>
jaam ashkon ke liye karbobala tak pahuncho
dekhte raah wahan pyaas ke maare honge
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Ghusl kaise mai doo
items.body:
boli ghassala bano se ro kar
ghusl kaise mai doon sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
ro padi bibiyan bhi ye sun kar
ghusl kaise mai doon sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
neele rukhsar kyun hai ay bibi
ye giraftaar kyun hai ay bibi
hai rasan ke nishan gardan par
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya ye tanhaiyon ki maari hai
ab bhi kaano se khoon jaari hai
kya wajah hai jo mar gayi ghut kar
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm khaati thi ashk peeti thi
kis tarha se yahan pe jeeti thi
koi batlade mujhko ye bad kar
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
iske honton ki papdiyan dekho
kitni sookhi hai haddiyan dekho
dil ye karta hai ro'un mai is par
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
uff ye mayyat ka haal hai kaisa
dekh ke phat'ta hai kaleja mera
royi aurat koi ye keh keh kar
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ragon mein to tashnagi paywast
hai qaza mein to zindagi paywast
apna begaana royega is par
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
chil gaya zakhmon se badan iska
kaise chipka hai pairahan iska
zakhm itne hai jism e athar par
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
doosra kurta tan ka hai ke nahi
koi saaman kafan hai ke nahi
bano se poochti thi wo ro kar
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash bacchi ki ab uthao to
aray taqt par isko ab litao to
ho ijazat to ghusl doon bad kar
ghusl kaise mai doon...
<<DIVIDER>>
shams aamir jo jao karbobala
dena jaa ke hussain ko pursa
marsiya dekho padhna ye jaa kar
ghusl kaise mai doon...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Hasliyon waale mere
items.body:
haye ali asgharam haye ali asgharam
<<DIVIDER>>
hasliyon waale mere ho chuke bas ab khafa
haye ali asgharam haye ali asgharam
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein tum kho gaye jaa ke kahan so gaye
maut ko apna liya mujhse khafa ho gaye
kya meri aaghosh se bad ke hai teer e qaza
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ke andhere bhi ab poori tarha cha chuke
dekh parinde sabhi laut ke ghar jaa chuke
baat meri maan le laal mere laut aa
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola bhi khamosh hai qabr bhi veeran hai
aaj se bistar tera khaak e biyaban hai
socha tha kya kya magar haye ye kya hogaya
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ye mai kaise sahun bin tere zinda rahun
tu hi batade mujhe bibiyon se kya kahun
poochti hai mujhse sab chand kahan hai tera
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola jhulaungi mai lori sunaungi mai
apne jigar band dil ko mein chipaungi mai
kehti hai ro ro ke ye kab se meri maamta
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
phool se lab khol de pyar se has bol de
phir mere ehsaas ke kaano mein ras ghol de
aa bhi jaa acha nahi dayr talak roothna
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunti hoon lipte ho tum khoon bhari poshak mein
neend nahi aayegi pairahan e khaak mein
zakhm dhula doon tere kurta badal doon tera
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
rooth gaya aasman hogayi dushman zameen
kisko mai apna kahun hai bhi to koi nahi
ujdi hui godh par tu hi taras kha zara
hasliyon waale mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghair huwe jaate hai aamir o nayyar ke haal
hai teri dargaah mein dono sarapa sawaal
maa teri qurban ho inki tu sunle dua
hasliyon waale mere...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Ho ke mehmaan
items.body:
ho ke mehmaan mohamed ka nawasa aaya
dashte khoon khaar mein lakhte dil e zehra hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tum muslaman ho dar o baam charaghan na karo
shaamiyon lut ke mohamed ka gharana aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufiyon sharm se aankhon ko jhukaye rakhna
nange sar hyder e karrar ka kunba aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ne khaynch to li seena e akbar se sina
saath lipta hua barchi se kaleja aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doobi hui akbar ki jawani dekhi
haye aaya bhi to kab qasid e sughra aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ke guzri ali asghar pe wo roodad na pooch
haye pyasa lab e darya se bhi pyasa aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khaane mein sada girya e zaari ki hai
tauq o zanjeer ko sajjad pe rona aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed o zehra o hyder ko hassan ko shaah ko
hurmala teer se kis kis ko na tadpa aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah guzaron ye sada girya e zehra ki hai
kaun bemaar ye zanjeeron mein jhakda aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid kar ke sar e bazaar phiraaya unko
jin ke ghar hi se musalmon mein parda aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
raah takti rahi bacchi ka jigar thaam ke maa
khoon mein dooba hua baysheer ka laasha aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin bano kahin zainab kahin lipti hai rabab
ek qayamat liye aaghosh mein jhoola aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye us bibi ki meinoos nigahein shamsi
laut kar jis ka chacha aur na baba aaya
ho ke mehmaan...
items.author: Shamsi

items.title: Hussain sab teri
items.body:
hussain sab teri qurbaniyo ka sadqa hai
ke aaj tak dile insaniyat dhadakta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame hussain mein aansu phir uske baad iram
khareed lo ke ye sauda bahot hi sasta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
mubahile ki ye soorat bata rahi hai hamein
ke panjetan ke muqabil jo aaye jhoota hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussainiyat ko lahoo chahiye baqa ke liye
yazeediyat ne phir ek baar sar ubhara hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
usay hussain se nisbat na do khuda ke liye
jo maslehat se ghame sheh mein kaam leta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kya jawaaz e sitam ay zameene karbobala
ke teen roz se mehmaan tera pyasa hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
elaahi khair kisi ki nazar na lag jaye
zaeef baap ka kadiyal jawan beta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
jise hussain ne athara saal paala tha
zameen e garm pe wo aediya ragad'ta hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
khudara isko tamache na maar ay zaalim
ye bachi gham ki satayi hui sakina hai
hussain sab teri…
<<DIVIDER>>
na loot chadare zainab na cheen sar se rida
ye binte zehra hai zaalim ye binte zehra hai
hussain sab teri…

items.title: Jab kiya jayega
items.body:
jab kiya jayega mehshar may ibadat ka sawaal
aayega aal e payambar ki mohabbat ka sawaal
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske haathon se shajar phoola phala islam ka
aaj dunya kar rahi hai us se bayyat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab pe aa jaata hai naam abbas ka be-saakhta
jab kabhi aata hai jurrat aur shuja'at ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
bad'dua karti layeeno ke liye zainab zaroor
saamne hota na gar nana ki ummat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki aaghosh may asghar humak kar aa gaye
jab kiya sarwar ne emaan ki himayat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek taraf akbar sa beta aur maa ki maamta
ek taraf deen e elaahi aur nusrat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha qasim ne chale aayenge kya ghar may udoo
aaya jab nanhe se asghar ki shahadat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...

items.title: Jo tha batool ka
items.body:
jo tha batool ka wo azadaar wo uth gaya
bewaon ka yateemon ka ghamkhaar uth gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
aafat na aaye koi bhare ghar ki khair ho
maa ki dua hai aale payambar ki khair ho
ab khaafile ka khaafila salaar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat pe ajab hai masayab ka silsila
kufe ki sar zameen pe ye kya ghazab hua
mazloomiyat ka aaj tarafdaar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ke khoon se hogaya tar khaana e khuda
sar peet'te hai dete hai jibreel ye sada
mushkil kusha e ahmed e mukhtar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhookon ko kaun khana khilayega shab dhale
ab kaun gham ghareebon ka batega shab dhale
bewarison tumhara madadgaar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote hai gham may hyder e safdar ke khaas o aam
be-aas ro ke lab pe ubharta hai ye kalaam
hum lut gaye hamara nigehdaar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rauze pe mustafa ke hai ek hashr ka samaa
zehra pukarti hai lehad may ke al-amaan
aulaad e mustafa ka madadgaar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ke baad baap ka saaya nahi raha
kehti hai sar ko peet ke ye binte mustafa
haye haye saron se saaya e dewaar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
<<DIVIDER>>
juz ashke gham bahane ki dayam nahi sabeel
yazdan ye keh raha hai sar e arsh jibraeel
matam karo ke hyder e karraar uth gaya
jo tha batool ka wo...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

mera ghazi na raha ya hussaina
mai hogayi berida ya hussaina

karbala karbala karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra mein kitne laashe dekhe teri behen ne
majboor kar diya hai mujhko taygh e tabar ne
<<DIVIDER>>
mai lut gayi bhaiyya ya hussaina
mera ghazi na raha ya hussaina
mai hogayi berida ya hussaina
ab kis ko mai doo sada
karbala karbala karbala...

qaime jala ke zaalim khushiyan mana rahe thay
kamsin yateem saare aansu baha rahe thay
<<DIVIDER>>
mai lut gayi bhaiyya ya hussaina
mera ghazi na raha ya hussaina
mai hogayi berida ya hussaina
ab kis ko mai doo sada
karbala karbala karbala...

zakhmi jo laash aayi laila ke gulbadan ki
phir tukde tukde dekhi tasveer bhi hassan ki
<<DIVIDER>>

mai hogayi berida ya hussaina

karbala karbala karbala...

<<DIVIDER>>
mai lut gayi bhaiyya ya hussaina
mera ghazi na raha ya hussaina
mai hogayi berida ya hussaina
ab kis ko mai doo sada
karbala karbala karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
bechain hai sakina karbobala ke ban mein
sau teer dikh rahe hai baba tere badan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
mai lut gayi bhaiyya ya hussaina
mera ghazi na raha ya hussaina

ab kis ko mai doo sada
karbala karbala karbala...

baazu kate jo mere abbas bawafa ke
karbal mein goonjte hai ye bain ambiya ke
<<DIVIDER>>
mai lut gayi bhaiyya ya hussaina
mera ghazi na raha ya hussaina
mai hogayi berida ya hussaina
ab kis ko mai doo sada
karbala karbala karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
afzaal likh raha hai ye roke nauha gham ka
har ghar pe saaya hoga abbas ke alam ka
<<DIVIDER>>

mera ghazi na raha ya hussaina

items.author: Afzal Hussain

items.title: Khaak par neendh
items.body:
khaak par neendh nahi aati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ka seena to teero se bhara hai baba
aapke seene pe teero ki rida hai baba
chain ek pal bhi nahi paati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahoo pyaas se hai kitni nakahat baba
meri taqdeer bani haye musibat baba
kis tarha qalb ko behlaati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhun maidan may bikhre hue be-sar laashe
aur us par ye andhera ye sitam ke narghe
warna hargiz na mai ghabrati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to acha hi hua saath nahi thi sughra
jo sitam maine sahey seh nahi paati dukhiya
wo to is dard se mar jaati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke seene pe aaram se sojaati thi
aap ki baahon may hi neend mujhe aati thi
ab to har saans hai tadpaati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi meri to ashkon se ibarat tehri
garm reti pe kahan soye dukhon ki maari
neend aise may kahan aati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ye garm hawaein hai sitam ka sehra
maut ka charon taraf sakht laga hai pehra
kaash ye maut hi aajati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sada safdar o mazhar jo sakina ki suni
laasha e shaah se awaaz ye aayi beti
ye na kar bain ke mar jaati baba
mai zameen par hoo bahot garm hawa hai
khaak par neendh nahi...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Lo baazu e shabbir
items.body:
qaimon mein bapa ahle haram ki ye buka hai
lo baazu e shabbir bhi marne ko chala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe kehti hai yehi zainab e dilgeer
tum chal diye haafiz mere parde ka khuda hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya se zara mashk ko bhar lao ay bhai
bachon ne kayi roz se pani na piya hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun mashk o alam le ke rawana hua ghazi
jis tarha koi sher taraayi ko chala hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naize se abbas ne faujon ko bhagaya
darya ko alamdaar ne qabze mein liya hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar chali kat gaye baazu e alamdar
ek teere sitam mashk e sakina pe laga hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mashk se guzra to laga seene pe wo teer
ab qaimon mein kiya jaayein ke dil toot chuka hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab laasha e abbas pe pahunche shahe wala
dekha ke jawan sher hai dam tod raha hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ne kaha laasha mera leke na jaayein
sharminda sakina se bahot uska chacha hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne dam tod diya zaanu e sheh par
darya ki har ek mauj mein matam ki sada hai
qaimon mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ki shahadat jo hui majid o mukhtar
zainab ki aseeri ka ye aaghaaz hua hai
qaimon mein bapa...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Maut ki lori usay
items.body:
maut ki lori usay ran may qaza deti hai
aur maa qaimon may jeene ki dua deti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh mahine ka gala aur seh pehlu paikaan
jaane kis jurm ki ummat ye saza deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hawa hai jo samajhti hai tamanna maa ki
khaali jhoola ali asghar ka jhula deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad maa ko jo sataati hai ali asghar ki
aah ek bharti hai aur khaak udaa deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar jalta hua jhoola ye kehti thi rabab
kaisi ummat hai nishani bhi jala deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
<<DIVIDER>>
maamta ko ye tasalli bhi hai bas zindan talak
maa jo pehlu may sakina ko sula deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek to neend hi aati nahi maa ko asghar
is pe soye to teri yaad jaga deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ki aurtein karti thi ye abid se sawaal
dhoop may kaun hai ye kisko sada deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat hoti hai to zindan may maadar akbar
loriyon ki jagah ek nauha suna deti hai
maut ki lori usay...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Mere parde ka
items.body:
ay mere bawafa ghazi
hai behen berida ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ki khwahar jab qaidi ban kar
le kar chali kaarwan
honton pe tha marsiya
karti thi bas ye fughan
shaam jaana hai intezam to kar
mere parde ka bawafa ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam o kufe ki raah guazaron se
kaise jaaungi berida ghazi
shaam jaana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad tere layeen zadon ne
noke naiza se cheen li chadar
teri ghairat ne khoon rulwaya
jab aseer e rasan hui khwahar
yaad aaya safar madine ka
aayi honton pe ye buka ghazi
shaam jaana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai maidne ki shaahzadi hoo
mehmilein aayi na amaari hai
mai tamasha hoo aur tamashayi
mere nana ki qaum saari hai
aise aalam mein ek siwa tere
kis ko awaaz doo bata ghazi
shaam jaana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaifiat dil ki kya bataun mai
dil ye kehta hai mar hi jaaun mai
mera sajjad khoon rota hai
chehra baalon se jab chupaun mai
ek chadar ka ab sawaali hai
sabr o ghairat ko wo khuda ghazi
shaam jaana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab ye socha tha ay mere ghazi
zindagi aise aazmeinegi
teri zainab baghair tere hi
berida ho ke shaam jayegi
ay mere sher kar madad meri
sirf tujhse hai aasra ghazi
shaam jaana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaeno se sajaye hai bazaar
log haste hai mere rone par
is khadar sakht imtehan hai ye
khoon rulaata hai mujhko ye manzar
ek naize pe meri chadar hai
ek naize pe sar tera ghazi
shaam jaana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard tehreer mein nahi aate
lafz karte hai ilteja mazhar
ek jumla bahot qayamat hai
lab pe aate hi ro diya safdar
shaam jaa kar kaha jo bibi ne
mere marne ki kar dua ghazi
shaam jaana hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Na bhoolne dengi
items.body:
na bhoolne dengi na bhoolne dengi
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ko faramosh yun karne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab kabhi marne nahi dengi
<<DIVIDER>>
parcham mai teri fatha ka lehra ke rahungi
ghar ghar mein tera naam mai pahuncha ke rahungi
aankhon ko kabhi ashkon se bharne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
baatil se kabhi haq ka wali dar nahi sakta
waada hai mera mar ke bhi tu mar nahi sakta
khursheed e imamat kabhi bujhne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jaaye mera laal fida ho mera akbar
allah ki is raah mein lut jaaye bhara ghar
asghar ko bhi ab maut se darne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
rutba jo tera hai wo kabhi ghat nahi sakta
jeete ji mere naam tera mit nahi sakta
parcham tere inkaar ka jhukne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab naala o shewan bhi na ghabra ke karungi
matam tere qatil ke hi ghar jaa ke karungi
bayyat ka kabhi naam bhi utne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek ko sunaungi teri tashna dahani
paaya na mere bhai ne do boond bhi pani
hal min ki sada ab kabhi dabne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya mai bandhe haathon se ye kaam karungi
ek ek musibat mai teri aam karungi
dil soz shahadat teri chipne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai meri rasaayi meri awaaz jahan tak
pahunchaungi mai ab tera paigham wahan tak
is rang e azadari ko ghatne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir ye azadaar hai zainab ki dua se
ainee ye sada aati hai har farshe aza se
matam kabhi mazloom ka rukne nahi dengi
bhaiya tujhe zainab....
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Aa palat aa ay
items.body:
ghaib se aayi sada aa palat aa ay hussain
tujhse raazi hai khuda aa palat aa ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
asre ashoor ka hangaam qayamat ka samaan
dhoop mein jalti hui rayt se uth'ta hai dhuaan
bhook aur pyasa ka maara hai har ek peer o jawan
shiddate pyaas se hai tadkhi hui teri zuban
khushk hai tera gala aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera har ek amal nayk hai tabinda hai
maareka haq ke liye tera ye paainda hai
sabre ayyub tere sabr se sharminda hai
qatl jo haq ke liye hogaya wo zinda hai
tere haq mein hai baqa aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne islam ko akbar ki jawani dedi
thi jo nana ki nishani wo nishani dedi
nafs emaan ko ashkon ko rawani dedi
khatm jo ho na sakegi wo kahani dedi
naam ooncha hai tera aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
subh se tu ne kayi laashe uthaye hai hussain
zakhm par zakhm har ek gaam pa khaye hai hussain
dushmane deen bohat tujhko sataye hai hussain
khanjar o taygh o sina tujh pa chalaye hai hussain
tu ne har zulm saha aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim ke rakhe tukde abaa mein tu ne
wakf ki apni zuban hamd o sana mein tu ne
dar kiya apna fida raahe khuda mein tu ne
zulm kya kya na sahe karbobala mein tu ne
kar diya waada wafa aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya qatl har ek nasir o yawar tera
tera qasim hai na ab hai ali akbar tera
aun hai aur na mohamed hai na asghar tera
sogaya nehr pa abbas e dilawar tera
tu akela hai khada aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa mere paas mohamed ke nawase aaja
ay mere teen shab o roz ke pyase aaja
jaanibe arshe bari karbobala se aaja
ab to milne ke liye apne khuda se aaja
mera sab kuch hai tera aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera nauha tere akhtar ne likha hai shabbir
tere irfan ne nauha ye padha hai shabbir
majlis e gham mein ajab hashr bapa hai shabbir
ye bhi ek tera karam teri ata hai shabbir
de ke ummat ko dua aa palat aa ay hussain
ghaib se aayi sada...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Abbas ko pukaro
items.body:
ghazi to hai na un se hi kehna
ay dunya waalon dar dar na jao
kya gham hai tumko aa kar sunao
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hai alam hum se
meinoos na ho gham se
abbas ko pukaro
<<DIVIDER>>
ya hazrate abbas mere gham ki dawa
mera bhi koi hai ye zamane ko bata do
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya se nahi maango kay degi tumhe dunya
allah ne rakha hai ummeed ka ek rasta
dehleez se ghazi ki ho jao wo wabasta
do waasta zainab ka phir kaam bane sab ka
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil toota hua ho to apno ko bulaata hai
dukh apne to har koi apno se hi kehta hai
bpno ki pareshani apna hi samajhta hai
wo sab ka sahara hai apno se bhi pyara hai
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek pyasi bhatiji ki ammu se guzarish hai
hum sab ki duaon mein ye mashk sifarish hai
samjho ko ata'on ki din raat jo baarish hai
radh hogi dua kaise ammu hai sakina ke
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
moo mod liya sab ne kya chod diya sab ne
halaat se tang aake dil chota nahi karte
abbas ki soorat mein ek aas to baakhi hai
har gham se nikalega seene se lagalega
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo dil pe guzarti hai har baat bataani hai
bemaari pareshani sab inko sunaani hai
maine to har ek mannat abbas se maani hai
meinoos na jaaoge jo maanga wo paaoge
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
toofan e hawa jis se ghabrana nahi logon
aghiyaar ki chaukat pe tum jaana nahi logon
tum ne mere ghazi ko pehchana nahi logon
kar dega meherbani jaisi ho pareshani
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dil ki muradon ko sunta hai mera ghazi
jo maango aqeede se deta hai mera ghazi
saath apne muhibbon ke rehta hai mera ghazi
taqdeer ki ho pasti aajaye jo tang dasti
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
maslak hai wafadari fitrat mein jalaali hai
ye apni sakhawat mein dunya mein misaali hai
kab haath faqeeron ki is sher ne taali hai
lab hilne nahi paaye aur jholiyan bhar jaaye
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...
<<DIVIDER>>
farhan aqeeda ye maa baap se paaya hai
abbas ki chaukat pe sar sab ne jhukaya hai
likh likh ke zamane ko mazhar ne bataya hai
aa jaye koi mushkil gharbaye bahot jab dil
abbas ko pukaro
babul hawaij alamdar alamadar
kehta hai alam hum se...

items.title: Ajal se bachane ko
items.body:
ajal se bachane ko aansu bahaye
magar maa ki godhi may asghar na aaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye himmat thi asghar ki dunya pa jaye
hasi aa gayi aur aansu na aaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo saahil par abbas bharte hai pani
magar behti maujon se daaman bachaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
chale aao asghar tadapti hai maadar
akela hai jhoola kahan tak jhulaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
na asghar may dam hai na raazi hai maula
ye kya dekhte hai nigahein jhukaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajal poochti hai shah e deen se ran may
kise laa rahe hai aba may chupaye
ajal se bachane ko...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Ali bahot roye
items.body:
bada azeem tha sadma ali bohat roye
bana ke turbat e zehra ali bohat roye
<<DIVIDER>>
na roye haath ke chaalo ko dekh kar maula
na roye ghar may raha teen roz tak faaqa
shikasta pehlu jo dekha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
galay may baandhi gayi rassiyan to sabr kiya
dar e batool se ut'tha dhuwan to sabr kiya
bana ke turbat e zehra ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta pehlu jo dekha to sabr hona saka
kuch aisa zaqkhm tha gehra to sabr hona saka
utha ke zakhmi janaza ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to qabr e rasool e zaman bhi thi taaza
ali ke zaqmon ka kis tarha hoga andaaza
jo ghar may reh gaye tanha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukara maa ko tadap kar hussain ne jis dam
rakha tha maa ne bhi us waqt maamta ka bharam
kafan ka bandh jo toota ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shareeke gham ki lehad par bahaye thay aansu
ba waqte gusl bhi aankhon may aaye thay aansu
pakad ke apna kaleja ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek musibat o ranj o alam may saath diya
nabi ke baad har ek ranj o gham may saath diya
na jaane soch ke kya kya ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya tha hausla kulsoom aur zainab ko
tasalli de ke wahan chup kara diya sab ko
hassan hussain ko dekha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
sulaa ke zer e zameen binte musatafa ko ali
kiye wo bain ke saari zameen larazne lagi
hisaar e sabr jo toota ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
<<DIVIDER>>
zafar wo subbat alayya masayibun kehna
ye shadman ke lab par batool ka nauha
jo yaad aaya ye nauha ali bohat roye
bada azeem tha sadma...
items.author: Zafar

items.title: Ay bhai hussaina
items.body:
shabbir se milne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ko ziyarat ke liye laayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
saumpi thi amanat jo mujhe aap ne bhaiya
wo pyari sakina
afsos usay shaam may chod aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya mere akbar ki qasam sabr kiya hai
shikwa nahi lab par
raahon may har ek gaam pe dukh paayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se mai tumhe chod ke maqtal se gayi hoo
kya guzri hai tum par
kuch to kaho sadqe gayi maajayi ay zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange thi aur haath bhi gardan se bandhe thay
jis basti se guzri
paigham tera sab ko suna aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad pa teri dekh ye behosh pade hai
kis kis ko bataun
jis jis ko aseeri se chuda laayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra jo ye poochegi kahan hai mera asghar
mai us se kahun kya
kehdungi tere paas sula aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauqeer laraz jaata hai shabbir ka rauza
ye aaj bhi sun kar
shabbir se milne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay bhai hussaina...
items.author: Tauqeer Zaidi

items.title: Baba tere baghair
items.body:
baba tere baghair bhala kaise jiyungi
tanha rahungi qaid may zindan may marungi
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hui behna ko chacha chod na jaana
ye aakhri rishta bhi kahin tod na jaana
pani ke liye aap se ab mai na kahungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko dekti thi to aate thay nazar teer
ek pal may sakina se juda hogaye shabbir
seene se laga lo mujhe ab kis se kahungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzregi kis tarha se meri shaam e ghariban
asghar ko sada dungi mai laashon ke darmiyan
haathon may hoga magar mai na piyungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aal e mohamed ka hoo anmol nagina
rakha hai aap hi ne mera naam sakina
ab qaidi sagheeron ki mai salaar banungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
tasveer payambar ki dikha kyun nahi dete
baba mujhe asghar se mila kyun nahi dete
ye sadma judaai ka bhala kaise sahungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ka rasta rok ke raahon may khadi hai
masoom sakina pe qayamat ki ghadi hai
ro ro ke ye kehti hai ke jaane nahi dungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bheed qayamat ki patharon ki hai barsaat
mai haath uthaun to mitt jaye kayenaat
ye bad'dua jahan ke liye mai na karungi
baba tere baghair...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime bhi jala daale jala daale hai quran
phir bhi ye apne aap ko kehte hai musalman
hai baat bade dukh ki ye nana se kahungi
baba tere baghair...

items.title: Bazaro may darbaro
items.body:
in jhakde huwe haathon ki qasam
ghazi ki behan ka waada hai
matam hoga matam hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zainab ne elaan kiya
bazaron may darbaron may
ghazi ka mere matam hoga
bazaron may darbaron may
<<DIVIDER>>
na taqt raha na taaj raha
na zulm raha na raaj raha
ek shor hai matamdari ka
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
na qaatil na baatil hai
ay dunya aa ke dekh zara
shabbir ke matam ki hai sada
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum thok ke seena kehte hai
hum rukne nahi denge matam
har haal may ye matam hoga
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye seene nahi deewarein hai
ye haath nahi talwarein hai
lo aa gaya lashkar zainab ka
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
o shaamiyon himmat hai roko
mazloom behan ko bhai ka
hum dene aaye hai pursa
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
de hukm agar tu shehzadi
ye behte huwe ashkon ki qasam
hum khoon ka bichade farshe aza
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
is shaam ke is bazaar se hi
ye keh kar guzri thi zainab
ghazi ka alam lehrayega
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
paband e rasan majboor hoo mai
ay shiyon khule ho haath to phir
shabbir ka tum matam kar lo
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki tamanna hai gohar
ho aisa qayamat ka matam
khud dekhne aaye karbobala
bazaron may darbaron may
ye zainab ne elaan...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Bulao apne ammu
items.body:
maar kar rukh par tamache bola shimr e behaya
ay sakina ab bulao apne ammu jaan ko
<<DIVIDER>>
chaahte hai wo tumhe kitna mai dekhun to zara
ay sakina ab bulao apne ammu jaan ko
<<DIVIDER>>
baal bacchi ke pakad kar khaynch kar dono gohar
bad nasab kehne laga rukh par tamache maar kar
kyun nahi kuch bolti sar kyun tumhara hai jhuka
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono haathon se tamache maarta tha be-rehm
kar raha tha be jhijhak bekas yateem par sitam
har tamache par ye kehta tha chacha ko do sada
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz tha tumko bahot jis par usay awaaz do
jao darya ki taraf jaa kar usay awaaz do
apne dil ka dard batlao usay jaa kar zara
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
maarta hoon mai tumhe koi bachata kyun nahi
jaan jo tum par lutaata tha wo aata kyun nahi
ho gaya kya ab tumhara chaahne waala khafa
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tumhe maarunga durre aur tamache tab talak
tum tadap kar padh nahi dogi ye nauha jab talak
mai bahot mushkil mein hoon imdaad ko aao chacha
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha qayamat khaiz dard angez wo manzar ajeeb
laaya bacchi ko layeen abbas ke sar ke khareeb
kaske phir rassi galay ki be-rehm kehne laga
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ghadi sar peet kar roye bahot ahle haram
jab kaha zaalim ne dikhla kar ke ghazi ka alam
ye alam to hai kahan hai ab alamdar e wafa
ay sakina ab bulao...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi thi dukhtare shabbir waiz zaar zaar
ay ali thay dard se ahle haram sab beqarar
karbala se shaam tak shimr e layeen kehta gaya
ay sakina ab bulao...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Dekh shireen
items.body:
ran mein laashe hai pade naizon pe sar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa tere ghar aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baal chehre pe hai jiske teri shehzadi hai
jiske shaano pe nishan rassi ka faryadi hai
kitne nashtar dile zainab mein utar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ka pehra kabhi abbas diya karte thay
naukri jinki malayek aake kiya karte thay
tere ghar aaj wohi khaak basar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunsa hashr ka manzar na nighaon mein phira
sar bhi naize se sar e raah kayi baar gira
dekh kis haal mein hashim ke qamar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath seene pe dhare baithi hai umme laila
dard jo dil mein hai tab hogaya wo aur zyada
jab bhi qaatil ali akbar ke naar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne daalaan mein daala hai ye kiska jhoola
teer se chidh gaya maqtal mein gala asghar ka
cheh mahine ke hai naize pe magar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sakina hai jo sehmi hui baithi hai wahan
jaa ke nazdeek zara dekh tamachon ke nashan
sar pe chadar hai na kaano ke gohar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme farwa ko bhi pursa do zara qasim ka
gham na bhoolegi kabhi karbobala qasim ka
