laash bhi tukdon mein taqseem jo kar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh zanjeeron mein jakda hai tera shehzada
phupiyan beparda hai uth'ta nahi sar abid ka
le ke kunbe ke ujadne ki khabar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne aamir tujhe ye deeda e nam baksha hai
dar pe ghazi ne bula kar ye qalam baksha hai
tab tere misron mein nayyar ye asar aaye hai
dekh shireen tere aaqa...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Farmate thay
items.body:
farmate thay ye sayyede abraar
abbas alamdar
ay lashkare islam ke salaar
abbas alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kaun tere baad nigehban haram ka
batlao to waris hai bhala kaun alam ka
uthega kahan daag o bala ranjo alam ka
hai kaun yahan mera madadgaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat jo hue hazrate shabbir haram se
gehre hai haram lipte hue shaahe umam se
ek bachi bhi lipti hui thi sheh ke khadam se
thay ghash mein udhar abid e bemaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmo se badan choor hai aur haal hai muztar
kis tarha tanha mujhse uthe laasha e akbar
aao meri imdad ko ay mere biradar
tum ho pisare hyder e karraar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
le jayega kumbe ko mere shaam ka lashkar
sar nange haram jayenge darbar mein kyon kar
ek ek se faryad karegi meri khaahar
bemaar mera khaafila salaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehj ayegi beyar o madadgaar sakina
kis tarha sahegi bhala aazaar sakina
ab hogi na pani ki talabgaar sakina
darya se ab aa jao wafadar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ahle aza karte hai shabbir ka matam
is gham se nahi badke hume aur koi gham
bas saaya figan sar pa rahe aap ka parcham
kehlaate hai hum aap ke ghamkhaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pur dil se mere door nahi aap ka rauza
rehta hai mere seene mein ek dard ka darya
daala hai isi mauj mein nowhe ka areeza
mehshar bhi hai ek adna azadaar
abbas alamdar...
farmate thay ye...
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Giri hai khaak pe
items.body:
giri hai khaak pe zainab sambhaal ay fizza
ali ki beti ka sadqa nikaal ay fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye fizza se shabbir ne dam e ruqsat
meri sakina ka rakhna khayaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rida na denge layeen maang mat rida inse
bas ab to khaak hi baalon pe daal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to shaam ke raste hai sabr kar ke guzar
abhi to hone hai mushkil sawaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sawaal ke badle ye sang maarenge
na kar tu reham ka inse sawaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha layeeno ki nazron se binte zehra ko
banale khud ko tu zainab ki dhaal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
karega kis tarha ye guftugu sharabi se
batool zaadi ki mushkil ye taal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bula habash ke ghulamon ko tu madad ke liye
hai qaid aaj payambar ki aal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar hai abid e muztar ko ya hai tujhko khabar
jo hai butool ki beti ka haal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na kyun jhukaye tere dar pe sar ko noor ali
ke tujhko maa kahe zehra ke laal ay fizza
giri hai khaak pe...
items.author: Noor Ali

items.title: Ho mere laal kahan
items.body:
ho mere laal kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jangal ka wo sannata wo pur haul fiza
aur aise mein kisi dukh bhare dil ki wo sada
jaise bichdi hui aulaad ko dhoonde koi maa
ho mere laal kahan…
<<DIVIDER>>
tum gaye jab se ajab haal hai beta mera
koi soorat se nahi qalb sambhalta mera
godh ujdi hai nazar aata hai jhoola veeran
ho mere laal kahan…
<<DIVIDER>>
khud ba khud haat uthe jaate hai lene ko tumhe
kab se bechain hoo mai loriyan dene ko tumhe
ho gayi raat bas aa godh mein aao meri jaan
ho mere laal kahan…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ki aagosh hai is ban mein basayi beta
neendh kis tarha mujhe chod ke aayi beta
maa ko bhi paas bulalo wahin sotay ho jahan
ho mere laal kahan…
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm gardan ka khuda jaane dhulaya ke nahi
jism se khoon bahara kurta wo utaara ke nahi
kya lahoo zakm se nawak ke abhi tak hai rawan
ho mere laal kahan…

items.title: Hussain sar na katate
items.body:
hussain sar na katate to aaj kya hota
khuda ke deen ka chehra utar gaya hota
<<DIVIDER>>
agar na hota san eksat ka roz e ashura
to aaj tareek e emaan to hi kya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
bait may di akbar ki jawani
aur asghar tadpa bin pani
jaan pa khela laal ali ka
khaak pe aanch jo aayi tere
agar na hota san eksat ka roz e ashura
to aaj taarek e eeman to hi kya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
na hote hazrate abbas ke jo naqsh e qadam
to aastane wafa kab ka mit gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaakh pa qabza kar ke choda
daal diya darya may ghoda
khoon ko pani karne waale
aah teri saqqayi dekhein
na hote hazrate abbas ke jo naqsh e qadam
to aastane wafa kab ka mit gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua e badh may jo zainab ke haath uth jaate
to yazidiyat ka janaza nikal gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
aal e nabi ko yun beparda
jin aankhon se tune dekha
mar na gaya o shaam ke haakim
laaj na tujhko aayi zaalim
dua e badh may jo zainab ke haath uth jaate
to yazidiyat ka janaza nikal gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...

items.title: Jab laashae hussain
items.body:
jab laasha e hussain na qaime mei jaa sake
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha uthane waala to koi nahi raha
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein laash shaah ki ab leke jaaye kaun
koi nahi hai laasha e sarwar uthaye kaun
haan dekh kar hussain ki ghurbat ka maajera
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta bacha hai ke wo bemaar hai magar
maqtal se kar na payega qaime talak safar
maqtal talak qayaam se karti hui buka
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasne lage ye dekh ke saare sitam shiyaar
aapas mein ek dooje se kehte thay baar baar
is se siwa hussain pe hogi bhi kya jafa
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kaisa hoga wahan bibyon ka haal
laashe se bhi shaheedon ke karne lage malaal
aah o buka se unko ye mehsoos hogaya
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil par hussain apne har ek gham ko seh gaye
laasha har ek shaheed ka qaime mein le gaye
laasha magar hussain ka maqtal mein hi raha
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin bibiyon ka saaya bhi dekha nahi gaya
wo bibiyan hai laasha e sarwar pe berida
hilne laga ye dekh ke maidan e karbala
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein jab ke hogaya kohram ek bapa
abbas ke janaze pe fizza ne ye kaha
uth kar zara ye dekh le ay mere bawafa
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jauhar pada tha laasha e shabbir be-amaan
rukti bhi kaise qaime mein zehra ki betiyan
safdar bala ke dasht mein aakhir yehi hua
khud bibiyan hussain ke laashe pe aagayi
jab laasha e hussain...
items.author: Jauhar

items.title: Jo tu raazi
items.body:
ye kaun zee waqar hai bala ka sheh sawaar hai
ye kis jari ke haath mein ali ki zulfiqar hai
ghamon ki dhoop hai magar isay ajeeb chain hai
ye bil yaqeen hussain hai nabi ka noor e ain hai
dua ko haath hai uthe labon pe hamd e kibriya
hussain keh rahe thay bas khuda tera shukriya
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tu raazi to mai raazi
jo tu raazi to mai raazi
subhana rabbiyal aa'la
subhana rabbiyal aa'la
<<DIVIDER>>
sajda e shukr mein rakh di tere bande ne jabeen
fajr se asr talak ghaiz mein aaya na kahin
tu ne bachpan mein khilayi thi ghiza jannat ki
aaj hai teesra faaqa to koi baat nahi
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad hai sab mujhe aejaaz jo baksha mujhko
tu ne malboos mera khuld se bheja mujhko
maine bachpan mein bahot pehne hai jannat ke libaas
kya hua ab jo kafan bhi na milega mujhko
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
door e dandan mere nana ne tujhe nazr diya
le gayi nazr ko pehlu e shikasta zehra
surkh roo hai tere darbar mein mera baba
dil ke tukde mere bhai ne kiye tujhpe fida
aaj shabbir bhi un sab ke muqabil ho jaaye
gar mera sar teri sarkar ke qaabil ho jaaye
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhse jo waada kiya hai wo nibhayega hussain
asr dhalte hi tere qurb mein aayega hussain
shimr naize pe uthaye to uthaye mera sar
ab na sajde se kabhi sar ko uthayega hussain
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir karam ki ho nazar mujhpe khuda ay baari
tere darbar mein aane ki hui tayyari
wo saga ab tere mehboob ki kat jaayega
phir bhi har zarb pe tasbeeh hi rahegi jaari
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl akbar to mera ho chuka ay rabbe ghafoor
ab agar tujhko na ho nasle imamat manzoor
qatl abid ko karun aap mai bano ke huzoor
mai khaleel aur wo zabeeh aaj se howe mashoor
haath ruk jaaye gale par to qalam haath karun
haath se zibha karun lab se munajaat karun
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
irja'ee sun ke wahin taygh ko roka maine
mud ke dekha nahi phir qaimon ka rasta maine
ye sakina hai khadi wo hai behen teele par
tujhko dekha to kisi ko nahi dekha maine
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine qurban kiye tujhpe kayi ismaeel
hai kayi hajera qaimon mein gawah hai jibraeel
haath akbar ke khule thay meri aankhein thi khuli
mai nahi roya mere sabr pe rote thay khaleel
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun to dil ko ali akbar ka bahot hai sadma
par tere husne karam se wo kahan pyara tha
mera abbas mera zor e kamar tha lekin
dil ko dhaaras hai tu bekas ko na girne dega
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir sajjad kahan khatm hua sheh ka kalaam
chal gayi gardane mazloom pe zaalim ki husaam
kat gayi sookhi ragein hamd magar jaari thi
sheh ka sar naize pe ye kehke chala jaanibe shaam
jo tu raazi to mai raazi...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Lo jaa rahi hai
items.body:
veeran hua mera ghar zehra tumhare baad
kaise jiyega hyder zehra tumhare baad
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat pe sayyeda ki hyder ne ye pukara
lo jaa rahi zehra
ay bachon aakhri hai dedaar fatema ka
lo jaa rahi zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
haq maange wo pahunchi par khaali haath lauti
darbariyon se boli
ab khaali haath ho kar tum sab gawaah rehna
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sholon ki zad pe aa kar darwaza jal chuka tha
zehra pe gir raha tha
bas ek sada ye aayi fizza mujhe bachana
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo chote chote bache dar ko hata rahe thay
maa ko bacha rahe thay
maa keh rahi thi bachon haafiz ali tumhara
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi shab e shahadat zehra ne ki wasiyat
suniye shahe wilayat
bache hai mere chote inka khayaal rakhna
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab se roke boli tum mere baad ghar mein
maa ki jagah ho beti
sarwar jahan bhi jaaye tum saath saath jaana
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mere charon bache aur mera sab gharana
tere hawale fizza
tujhko to karbala tak inke hai saath jaana
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos muslimon ne yasrab mein dar jalaya
karbal mein ghar jalaya
wo thi shab e ghariban jab keh rahi thi zehra
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mukhtar aur majid ek karb hai musalsal
ye fikhra sayyeda ka
shiyon ko ya ali tu mera salaam kehna
lo jaa rahi zehra
mayyat pe sayyeda ki...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Majboor hoo behna
items.body:
majboor hoo behna tumhe dafna nahi sakta
qaidi hoo sakina mai kafan laa nahi sakta
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha mai akele hi uthaunga tumhara
ghairon se tera laasha mai uthwa nahi sakta
majboor hoo behna...
<<DIVIDER>>
lachaar hai sajjad se kyun rooth gayi tum
beemar gohar aap ke dilwa nahi sakta
majboor hoo behna...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum qabr mein aaram karo bali sakina
ab saath mai ghar leke tumhe jaa nahi sakta
majboor hoo behna...
<<DIVIDER>>
behna inhi kapdo mein tumhe dafn karunga
majboor hoo nanha sa kafan laa nahi sakta
majboor hoo behna...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas chacha aao sakina ko manao
mai leke usay aap ke paas aa nahi sakta
majboor hoo behna...
<<DIVIDER>>
taboot uthane ko na akbar hai na abbas
mai ehle watan ko yahan bulwa nahi sakta
majboor hoo behna...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise khabar doo tere marne ki padar ko
wo aa nahi sakte mai wahan jaa nahi sakta
majboor hoo behna...

items.title: Mere qatl ki tayyari
items.body:
din hai ashoor ka aur asr ki aayi hai ghadi
gird laashon ke akela hai hussain ibne ali
ghayr lo maaro isay shor hai lashkar may yehi
dekho zakhmi bhi hai pyasa bhi hai taari hai ghashi
haye sar peet'ti maidan may aayi zehra
maa ko jab dekha shah e deen ne ye ro ro ke kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
teer talwar liye fauj khadi saari hai
amma dekho ye mere qatl ki tayyari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
koi talwaar se maare koi maare khanjar
bhaala maara hai kisi ne to kisi ne pathar
khoon se chehra bhara gurz laga hai sar par
khaak jalti hui phaynki hai mere zakhmo par
zakhm itne hai ke har zakhm se khoon jaari hai
amma dekho ye mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma mera ye badan chalni hua kuch aise
teer seene pe lagay pusht se baahar nikle
ek naiza hai hua paar jo pehlu se mere
dard uth'ta hai har ek tooti hui phasli se
saans lene may bhi amma badi dushwari hai
amma dekho ye mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm khaate huwe ghode se zameen par mai gira
tha nidhaal aisa ke utha bhi nahi jaata tha
dekha ye haal to phir shimr meri samt bada
qatl geh tak mujhe baalon se pakad kar laaya
haa tamache mujhe thokar bhi mujhe maari hai
amma dekho ye mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tez khanjar jo abhi shimr ne haathon may liya
maar ke zor se pathar pe isay kund kiya
meri haalat pe usay rehm nahi aayega
tera zarbon se mera sookha gala kaatega
pase gardan pe har ek zarb bohat kaari hai
amma dekho ye mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha jaata nahi amma badi mushkil hai ghadi
rayt ke teele pe dekho meri zainab hai khadi
bhai ka kat'ta gala aaj behan dekhegi
ro ke chillayegi sar peetegi ghash khayegi
ek ek lamha ye zainab pe bohat bhaari hai
amma dekho ye mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli phir mazhar o farhan ye zahra ro kar
mai tere saath hoo har lamha mere lakhte jigar
haye tharrayi zameen chalne laga hai khanjar
rakh diye haath teri maa ne teri gardan par
bole shabbir ke haye meri laachari hai
amma dekho ye mere...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Na ghabraye hussain
items.body:
de diya har imtehan
beh gaya saara lahoo lekin na ghabraye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
apne hi haathon pe apni laash le aaye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e akbar mein barchi dekh ke royi qaza
fatema ke laal par ye imtehan ka waqt tha
boli zainab haye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ke baad ek laasha dasht se laate rahe
godh ke paalon ka dil par zakhm bhi khaate rahe
kitne laashe laaye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr asghar ki bana kar aaya ibne bu-turab
maut boli teri daulat dekh ay umme rabab
dasht mein chod aaye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl ghazi ho gaya jab ho chuke baazu qalam
boodhe kaandho par utha kar khoon mein dooba alam
dasht se jab laaye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat chuki jab fauj saari dil tha gham se payemal
teen din ke bhooke pyase aur zakhmon se nidhal
jang ladne aaye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek taraf zehra ka beta ek taraf nau laakh taygh
wo chamakte teer o naize sab the pyase khoon ke
zulm se takraye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
choor thay zakhmon se maula teer aur talwar ke
aakhri sajde ki khaatir pusht se rahwaar ke
jab zameen par aaye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ki mazloomiyat par hogayi zehra gawah
jhaadti thi apne baalon se pisar ki qatl gaah
maa pukari haye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
likho mazhar abidi jab ho chuke sab imtehan
shukr ka sajda kiya tha sheh ne ho kar shadman
qatl hone aaye hussain
na ghabraye hussain
beh gaya saara lahoo...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Oqado zaleelan
items.body:
oqado zaleelan fi damishqa qa annani
minaz zanje abdun ghaaba anhu naseerun
<<DIVIDER>>
chaayi hui ghurbat ki ghata hai
bemaar pe ye kaisi jafa hai
chaalon se ab tak khoon ris raha hai
aaya hoon haye kaanton pe chal kar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
charon taraf bazaar saje hai
haath pase gardan se bandhe hai
sar ko haram niwaye khade hai
jeene se ab to marna hai behtar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah jaane kaisa safar hai
raste mein saaya hai na shajar hai
noke sina par baba ka sar hai
dekhun mai kin aankhon se ye manzar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaidi samajh ke tadpa rahe hai
jis raaste se bhi jaa rahe hai
bacche saron par barsa rahe hai
lele ke apne haathon mein pathar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake tamache mujhko hazeena
dekhti hai hasrat se sakina
kehti hai ab pahunchado madina
bhaiya yahan jeena hua doobhar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa sitam dekha bhi nahi tha
kaanton pe mai guzra bhi nahi tha
ye to kabhi socha bhi nahi tha
hogi phupi balwe mein khule sar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saare badan mein chaale pade hai
talwon mein kitne ghaar chube hai
kitne qayamat ke marhale hai
tauq galay mein paon mein langar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ka samaa aafat ki ghadi hai
paon mein dohri bedi padi hai
har so meri tash'heer hui hai
kaun kahe abbas se jaa kar
oqado zaleelan...
<<DIVIDER>>
yunhi ada ho gham ka fareeza
hai ye bilal is dil ki tamanna
kar le qubool isko mere aaqa
laaya hoon nauha ashkon se likh kar
oqado zaleelan...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Aa rahe hai teri janib
items.body:
aa rahe hai teri jaanib ay zameen e karbala
mashk e nusrat ke liye hai arbaeen e karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahe hai teri jaanib ay zameen e karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
auratein bache hai boodhe aur jawan bhi saath hai
qudsi o jinn o malak kaun o makan bhi saath hai
zaaire karbobala mehdi e jaan bhi saath hai
badh rahe hai shauq se sab shayaqeen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
rauza e hyder se hoti hai wafa ki ibteda
maujiza jisko hai samjha ye hai zahra ki dua
hai karoron ka juloos aur saath hai farshe aza
ab najaf tak bich gayi hai sar zameen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ziyarat ke safar mein saahib e kirdaar hai
parcham e abbas haathon mein hai sab bedaar hai
ay imam e asr nusrat ke liye tayyar hai
muntaqim ke muntazir hai momineen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar e mehdi ka rob o dabdaba ye manzilat
ye najaf se karbala tak ka safar hai maarifat
marg bar taghoot hai ye marg bar sufyaniat
nusrat e mehdi karo zer e nageen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaana e kaaba ki deewaron se utha shor o shain
aasman ko dekhta hai fatema ka noor e ain
hajj ko umre mein badal kar chal diye maula hussain
aazmeen e hajj huwe hai aazmeen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
parda e ghaibat uthega mere maula aayenge
gar bulasya aap ne paidal bhi chal kar jayenge
saath mein maa baap bache aur bhai laayenge
kar qabool in zehmaton ko ay makeen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek majlis hogi rauzon par pahonch kar aur bain
ek taraf abbas honge ek taraf maula hussain
kaisa girya hoga kya zaakir ki hogi zeb o zain
ek jagah honge bahattar saamaeen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda farsakh tak hamein khaana khilata kaun hai
zaair e shabbir ko pani pilaata kaun hai
saaf joote kar ke ye aansu bahata kaun hai
allah allah dekho shaan e zaireen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho sharaf haasil ziyarat ka qamar maango dua
shadman har ek qadam par bas yehi hai sochta
rauza e abbas dekhunga to haalat hogi kya
saamne jab aayegi mere zameen e karbala
aa rahe hai teri jaanib...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Abbas kya kare
items.body:
haye abbas kya kare
roka hua hai taygh ko ghazi hai tashnakaam
hukm e imam e waqt se majboor hai ghulam
armaan saara jang ka ashkon mein beh gaya
abbas aaj laashe uthaane ko reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
milti nahi hai ran ki riza jab imam se
abbas kya kare
laashon pe laashe aate rahe dekhta rahe
abbas kya kare
<<DIVIDER>>
koi baccha maqtal se jab
khoon mein naha kar aata hai
aaqa laasha laate hai to
sharm se sar jhuk jaata hai
tukde huwe hai khaak pe wo godh ke pale
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ijazat milti nahi
aaj bahot sharminda hoo
aun o mohamed jaan se guzre
aur mai ab tak zinda hoo
binte ali ke lakhte jigar dono mar gaye
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein kya haal hua hai
aaqa hassan ke bete ka
dil mein mere zakhm bana hai
qasim ke har tukde ka
ghatri bana ke laayi gayi mere saamne
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tadbeer ye maqtal ki hai
mashk mai le kar jaunga
bibi sakina ki khaatir mai
pani le kar aaunga
maangi hai is ne izne wigha haath jod ke
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya saamne behta hai bas
izn wigha ka mil jaaye
saaqi e kausar ke bacchon par
pani bandh hua haye
rote huwe ye aas se hai mujhko dekhte
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwahish ye hai aakhri lamha
unki ziyarat hum paayein
aisa nahi ho laash utha kar
mere aaqa thak jaaye
aaye madad ko aaqa mere kis tarha kahe
abbas kya kare...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman pani lene gaye
abbas ki mushkil kam na hui
teer qamar aankhon mein laga tha
khoon baha aur mashk chidi
sar pe laga hai gurz mere haath kat gaye
abbas kya kare...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Ana qateeul abra
items.body:
ana qateelul abra
mai kushtae ibrat hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ne paraye des mein dekha aisa khooni manzar
shimre layeen ne be-rehmi se phera halq pe khanjar
jis ko ek dukhiyari maa ne chakki pees ke paala
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ke nabi ne jisko bithaya dosh pe naaqa ban ke
eid ke din rizwan e jina khud laaya jis ke kapde
usko kafan dene ke bajaye pairahan bhi cheena
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri behna dekh ke mujhko kyun na pachade khaaye
haye mera bemaar pisar behosh na kyun hojaye
zakhm badan par mere lage hai mo-e tan se zyada
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
binte nabi ki qalb ki raahat laqte dile hyder hoon
ranj o alam se choor hua hoon bekas hoon muztar hoon
meri mazloomi pe zamana khoon ke aansu roya
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhte rehte thay hasrat se jis ko baba hyder
subho masa jis halq ko chooma karte thay paighambar
shimre layeen ne roze dahum us halq pe khanjar phera
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok ke khutba jisko uthaya godh mein mere jadh ne
jis ke liye apne sajde ko tool diya ahmed ne
kalma goyon ne sajde mein qatl usay kar daala
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma tum jis dasht mein shab bhar aaho buka karti thi
jis ko apne baalon se tum saaf kiya karti thi
haye sitamgaaron ne wahin par mera khoon bahaya
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hoon shaheede raahe khuda aur paikare sabr o raza hoon
karbobala hai shahid aisa kushta e tayghe jafa hoon
jis ke janaze ko maqtal mein teeron ne hai uthaya
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sharte wafa bas itini hai mil jaaye jo thanda pani
yaad kare mazloom ki aur bekas ki tashna dahani
zainab ye paigham hamare shiyon se keh dena
ana qateelul abra...
<<DIVIDER>>
rooh ko bhi mil jaaye sukoon aur qalb ko chain aa jaaye
karbobala se kaash bilal awaaz e hussain aa jaaye
dard mein dooba mere shayar khoob ye nauha likha
ana qateelul abra...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Ay bhaiya abbas
items.body:
kehte thay hazrate shabbir ay bhaiya abbas
bache pyase hai inhe pani pilaana abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sookha hua mashkeeza sakina laayi
ab galay mil ke chacha se ye hazeena boli
laut kar aaoge ye waada karo ya abbas
kehte thay hazrate shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine sab bachon se qaimon may kiya hai waada
pani laane ke liye nehr pe jaate hai chacha
tum hi waade ko sakina ke nibhaana abbas
kehte thay hazrate shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
chal diya nehr ki jaanib wo jari ibne jari
nehr par qabza kiya pani se wo mashk bhari
palta qaimon ki taraf nehr se pyasa abbas
kehte thay hazrate shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke zaanu pe dam tod diya ghazi ne
shaah ghazi ka alam le ke suye qaima chale
ye alam tera hai ab mera sahara abbas
kehte thay hazrate shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
wapas aata jo alam dekha sakina ne kaha
bachon tayyar raho le ke sab apna kooza
dekho wo pani liye aata hai pyara abbas
kehte thay hazrate shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi qaime may daakhil huwe shaahe aalam
bole shabbir liye haathon may ghazi ka alam
chod do aas sakina nahi zinda abbas
kehte thay hazrate shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon may majid o mukhtar ajab tha aalam
gird sab bache thay aur beech may ghazi ka alam
thi ye zainab ki sada ay mere bhaiya abbas
kehte thay hazrate shabbir...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Bunyade lailaah
items.body:
bunyade la ilaaha wujood e azan hussain
khad khamatis salaat ke roohe rawan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mere rasool e paak hai quran ki tarha
sher e khuda ki zaat hai juz daan ki tarha
aur sayyeda hai sura e rehman ki tarha
sulhe hassan hai amn ke maidan ki tarha
roohe kalame paak ke hai darmiyan hussain
bunyad e lailaaha…
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ali jahan bhi hai haq saath saath hai
quran ki bandishon mein waraq saath saath hai
aur aasman pe jaise shafaq saath saath hai
kalma hai aur deen ka sabakh saath saath hai
islam jis jagah hai samajhlo wahan hussain
bunyad e lailaaha…
<<DIVIDER>>
badnaam o be-nishan lashkar yazeed ka
dozakh ki aag bangayi bistar yazeed ka
ruswayi bangayi hai muqaddar yazeed ka
koi mehal hai ghar na koi dar yazeed ka
jannat se bad gaya hai tera aastan hussain
bunyad e lailaaha…
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil ke waqt aata hai khyber shikan ka naam
dhaaras hai mere qalb ki shaahe zaman ka naam
jaise azan mein akbare gulpairahan ka naam
mehshar ke dil pe naqsh hai yun panjetan ka naam
ye dil bana hua hai tera gulsitan hussain
bunyad e lailaaha…
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Dekha jo zere taygh
items.body:
dekha jo zer e taygh gala apne bhai ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ro ke zainab e khasta jigar figaar
mushkil kusha ye waqt hai mushkil kushai ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
karke muqatib akbar e mehru ko bole sheh
beta khayal rakhna zara chote bhai ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde jo dekhe hazrate qasim ki laash ke
sarwar ko yaad aaya jigar apne bhai ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ye kehke qabr e sakina pe gir gayi
utho sakina hukm mila hai rehaai ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha se luta hai bhara ghar hussain ka
dekha na phir falak ne wo manzar tabaahi ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dosh par hussain ke kadiyal jawan ki laash
dil thar'thara raha hai khuda ki khudaayi ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
bad kar galay se apne ajal ko laga liya
dekhe to hausla koi nanhe sipahi ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...
<<DIVIDER>>
logon ne aaj zikre shahe mashraqain ko
kawish bana liya hai waseela kameini ka
dil paash paash hogaya zehra ki jaayi ka
dekha jo zer e taygh...

items.title: Farsh par rab ki
items.body:
farsh par rab ki ye ek ataa hai
bekhata jisko tu maarta hai
kuch khabar hai tujhe ibne muljim
ye zamane ka mushkil kusha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
isne sajdon pe sajde kiye hai
isne rozon pe roze rakhe hai
iska khana hai ek jau ki roti
iske sone ko ek boriya hai
farsh par rab ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
peshwa uth gaya hai jahan ka
soone soone hai mehrab o mimbar
kis khamoshi se ghar bhi khuda ka
aaj masroofe aah o buka hai
farsh par rab ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pe daaghe yateemi sajaye
gham ka paikar hai shabbir o shabbar
jis ko dekho wohi ro raha hai
ghar imamat ka matam kada hai
farsh par rab ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun rulaata hai aale nabi ko
kya bigaada hai tera ali ne
is sitamgar se hashim ye poocho
kya ye ajre rasool e khuda hai
farsh par rab ki...
items.author: Hashim

items.title: Ho salaam uspe jo
items.body:
ho salaam us pe jo kehti thi mere veer hussain
khaak mein kis ne mila di teri tasveer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
apne do beton se sadqa bhi utaara tera
rok paayi nahi mai zulm ki shamsheer hussain
ho salaam us pe jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine sadmo mein bhi choda nahi daaman tera
be-kafan tu raha aur be-rida hamsheer hussain
ho salaam us pe jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera zarbon se gala kaata gaya hai tera
koi batlaye to mujhko teri tafseer hussain
ho salaam us pe jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl jab tu hua rote thay lehad mein hyder
khaak udaati rahi khud maadar e dilgeer hussain
ho salaam us pe jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tere halq se jalti hui reti pe gira
karbala hogayi us khoon se tameer hussain
ho salaam us pe jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jashn maqtal mein manaate rahe qaatil tere
bain dil thaam ke karti rahi hamsheer hussain
ho salaam us pe jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
baat ye safdar o mazhar ne kahi dunya se
karbala aaj bhi hai aap ki jageer hussain
ho salaam us pe jo...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Hussain shah jee
items.body:
baadshah e karbala salaam
tu ne kar diya azeem kaam
hazrat imam hussain alaihis salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
yun to qabron se bante hai qabrstan
tu ne magar qabron se karbala sajayi
ek saltanat banayi
us saltanat ka tu hai baadshah
baad e khuda baad e nabi
shaahion ke silsile ke teesre imam
<<DIVIDER>>
tera naam tera kaam hamesha rahega
tu baadshah rahega
aashikon ke dil ki dhadkano se aa rahi hai sada
hussain hussain hussain shah jee
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waale hussain shah jee
maula hamare hussain shah jee
har dil ye pukare hussain shah jee
maula maula hussain shah jee
<<DIVIDER>>
baadshah aisa zabardast hai tu shah saahib
shahiyan chod ke sab aate hai teri jaanib
tu hai mahraaj hussain takht aur taaj hussain
tere mohtaaj hussain
ban ke naukar jo tere dar pe chala aata hai
phir kahin bhi dar tera wo chod kar nahi jaata
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waale hussain shah jee
maula hamare hussain shah jee
har dil ye pukare hussain shah jee
maula maula hussain shah jee
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne teeron ke musalle pe ibadat ki hai
tu ne har daur mein dunya pe hukumat ki hai
ya abaabdillah do jahan mein wallah
hukm chalta hai tera
fatema ke pisar hai hamein ye khabar
tu ne jo bhi keh diya wo taalta nahi hai khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waale hussain shah jee
maula hamare hussain shah jee
har dil ye pukare hussain shah jee
maula maula hussain shah jee
<<DIVIDER>>
aao zawwaro mere saath chalo rauze par
sheh ki awaaz pe labbaik pukaro mil kar
bola shah ast hussain baadshah ast hussain
deen ast hussain deen panah ast hussain
le ke hathon mein alam taaba rehna dam ba dam
ja raha hoo mein najaf se karbala ye kehta hua
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam hussain jaan salaam hussain jaan
hussain hussain jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shaah e mashraqain hai
ye shaah e maghrabain hai
nabi ki jaan ali ki dil
ye fatema ka chain hai
qasam hussain ki qasam nahi hai koi doosra
khuda ki kayenat mein hussain bas hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ya hussain ilal hussain ya hussain ilal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
saari dunya mein hussain
nasl e zehra mein hussain
chauda baara mein hussain
koi nahi tere siwa
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waale hussain shah jee
maula hamare hussain shah jee
har dil ye pukare hussain shah jee
maula maula maula maula
har hussain dil pe tera naam hai likha
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke dil par hussain likha hai
us ke sar par dua e zehra hai
baandh leta hai wo kafan sar par
aur marne ki aarzu le kar
teri khidmat mein aa ke kehta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
deewana tera deewana
mera dil ya hussain tera deewana
<<DIVIDER>>
shauzab habeeb o john zohair aur saeed ki
maqtal se aa rahi hai sada har shaheed ki
deewana tera deewana
mera dil ya hussain tera deewana
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala karbala karbala karbala
zindabad arz e karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala aisi emarat hai ke sarwar ke siwa
ek din mein koi tayyar nahi kar sakta
hurr ke haathon ko ye kehte huwe khola sheh ne
ab tujhe koi giraftar nahi kar sakta
hurr ke chehre ki chamak roz e dahum mat poocho
lashkar e yazeed se nikal gaya ye kehta hua
sada baadshahi hai bas hussain ki
kyun na phir sada ho har malang aur faqeer ki
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waale hussain shah jee
maula hamare hussain shah jee
har dil ye pukare hussain shah jee
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb jang thi wo jang e karbala jis mein
jo log qatl huwe thay wo log zinda hai
tum jo kehte ho ke wo jang thi shehzadon ki
ham bataate hai ke dono ki haqeeqat kya thi
lanatullah udhar salamullah idhar
wo umaiya ka pisar ye mohamed ka pisar
wo tha allah ke kaabe ko jalane waala
aur ye khaana e kaaba ko bachane waala
us ke lashkar ko mili zillat o ruswayi magar
is ke lashkar mein mila sab ko nishan e hyder
hussain jeet gaye aur yazeed haar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
aao zeeshan o irfan e aza
mil ke dete hai sada
lanat bar shajra e khabeesa
salaam bar shajra e taiyaba
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Jab madine ka
items.body:
jab madine ka musafir koi paa jaata hoo
hasrat aati hai ye pahuncha mai raha jaata hoo
do qadam bhi nahi chalne ki hai mujh may taaqat
shauq khaynche liye jaata hai mai kya jaata hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafile waale chale jaate hai aage aage
madad ae shauq ke peeche mai raha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaarwan may rahe yasrab may hoo aghaaz zera
sab may shaamil hoo magar sab se juda jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab madine ka musafir koi paa jaata hoo
hasrat aati hai ye pahuncha mai raha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
faiz e maula se abhi sabr ki taqat hai ameer
jo kadi saamne aati hai utha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab madine ka musafir koi paa jaata hoo
hasrat aati hai ye pahuncha mai raha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Jod kar nanhe se
items.body:
namaz e shab mein koi baap maangta hai dua
allah allah allah allah
sukoon e dil ke liye kar mujhe sakina ataa
<<DIVIDER>>
jod kar nanhe se haathon ko sakina ne kaha
kya isi din ke liye mujhko tha maanga baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kyun jashn manate hai sata kar mujhko
apne bachon ko hasate hai rula kar mujhko
shamiyon ne mere rone ko tamasha samjha
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaan is ka sabab kya hai khuda hi jaane
fatema naam kisi ko jo bataya maine
be jhijhak us ne sakina ko tamacha maara
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ne eid pe jo durr mujhe pehnaye thay
shimr ne kaano se is tarha wo gohar noche
durr nahi khoon bhi hai shimr ke haathon mein mera
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr tak bhool na payegi tumhari beti
kaat kar ungli tumhari jo angothi khaynchi
pehn kar us ko hi zaalim ne tamacha maara
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khums mein maang raha hai mera bhai chadar
shaam ke log humein maar rahe hai patthar
aurtein phenk rahi hai meri jaanib sadqa
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki laash ko jis tarha se pamaal kiya
jeete ji mera layeeno ne wohi haal kiya
baandh kar ghodon se paidal mujhe daudaya gaya
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ne abbas ke badle yun sakina se liye
reh gaye haathon mein zaalim ke kuch baal mere
mujhko aaya hi nahi koi chudane waala
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke mohsin ye buka karte thay sab arsh nasheen
jo sakina thi sukoon us ke muqaddar mein nahi
khoon mein doobi hai tumhari wo tahajjud ki dua
kya isi din ke liye...
jod kar nanhe se...
items.author: Mohsin Jaffri

items.title: Khaak pe baithi
items.body:
haye zainab haye yateemi
kufe waalon lut gayi zainab
uth gaya sar se baap ka saaya
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak pe baithi sar ko jhukaye
dukhiya kya kya dekh rahi hai
aaj ali ki laadli beti
kal ka kufa dekh rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har bibi hai dar ke sarhane
le le kar abbas ka naam
apne baazu apne gaysu
apna chehra dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
choomte hai abbas ke baazu
faatahe khyber aur zainab
dard o alam ke is manzar mein
daste bureeda dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr mein doobi taygh lagi hai
farqe ali se khoon hai rawan
aur is gehre zakhm mein zainab
zamkh e hussaina dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashq fishan hai chaahne waale
dar pa hai laakhon ka hujoom
phir bhi zainab jaane kyun
sarwar ko akela dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch to piya tha tayghe sitam ne
zehr abhi kuch shaam mein hai
is liye zainab sad paara
shabbar ka kaleja dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki mayyat mil jhul kar
kaandhe pe uthaate hai shabbir
zainab dukhiya teeron par sarwar
ka janaza dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
subha ko hyder dafn huwe hai
shaam ko hyder ki jaayi
misle sakina khaak pe baithi
baap ka rasta dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ke is zulm pe shayad
yaad aate hai nana rasool
baap la laasha dekh ke zainab
suye madina dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ko hamare hota hai
mehsoos ye aamir aur bilal
shayad zainab laasha e sarwar
khoon mein dooba dekh rahi hai
khaak pe baithi...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Kufa udaas hogaya
items.body:
kufa udaas hogaya maula khamosh hai
surki rukhe falak pe hai kaaba khamosh hai
meraj ki hayaat ka lehja khamosh hai
unneesvi ki subho ka taara khamosh hai
mehraab ashk baar hai ajra khamosh hai
kufa udaas hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanzeem e kayenat ki surat bigad gayi
be-aasra hayaat ki basti ujad gayi
chehre udaas hogaye raunak bichad gayi
bechain zindagi ka maseeha khamosh hai
kufa udaas hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ne jo kaha tha haqeeqat bayan hui
ahle haram pe subhe qayamat ayaan hui
zainab se karbala ki musibat ayaan hui
dekha behan ne bhai ka chehra khamosh hai
kufa udaas hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
bechain hai ghulam ke aaqa nahi rahe
rote hai sab yateem ke maula nahi rahe
hasnain beqaraar hai baba nahi rahe
roohe rasool o fatema zehra khomosh hai
kufa udaas hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi jabeen fareed jo dekhi hussain ne
zainab se ek nigaah uthaayi hussain ne
ki ikhtiyaar phir jo khamoshi hussain ne
kya jaane kya khayaal mein aaya khamosh hai
kufa udaas hogaya...
items.author: Fareed Baig

items.title: Lo mil gayi zindan se
items.body:
lo mil gayi zindan se sakina ko rehaai
sajjad ne ye kehte hue laash uthaai
lo mil gayi....
<<DIVIDER>>
baba chale aao ke mai tanha hoo yahan par
bas itna bata jao ke dafnaun kahan par
kya qaid may hi dafn kare behn ko bhai
lo mil gayi....
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar jaane ki hasrat o barabar na hui par
dam toot gaya hogayi azaad tu dukhtar
maa beti ka choom ke deti thi duhaai
lo mil gayi....
<<DIVIDER>>
ab shimr tamache na isay maar sakega
aaram se soyegi tahe khaakh ye dukhiya
laashe se yehi kehti rahi fatima jaayi
lo mil gayi....
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ne zameen khod ke jab qabr sawari
rote hue mayyat suye turbat jo utaari
zindan ki dewaron se awaaz ye aayi
lo mil gayi....
<<DIVIDER>>
band aankhein kiye qabr may aaram karegi
maa shaana hilati rahe phir bhi na uthegi
yun maut ne lori hai sakina ko sunaai
lo mil gayi....
<<DIVIDER>>
abid pe takallum wo musibat ki ghadi thi
jin haaton may kheli thi wo masoon si bachi
un haaton ne turbat bhi sakina ki banayi
lo mil gayi....
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Mayyat hai sakina ki
items.body:
mayyat hai sakina ki andhera haye zindan
allah na dikhlaye ab aisa zindan
<<DIVIDER>>
kurte ka kafan ghusl diya ashkon se jisko
dafnaya usay kaise ye sajjad se poocho
khamosh hui bachi to rota raha zindaan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
udte huwe dekhe jo parinde to pukari
ay taayiron sughra ko khabar do ye hamari
tum khush raho sughra mere kismat may tha zindan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kano ka lahoo chand se chehre pe jama tha
qaimo may lagi aag to daaman bhi jala tha
tanhai may bachi ko dasta raha zindan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehmi hui rehti thi sitamgaaron ke dar se
shikwe kiya karti thi fakhad baap ke sar se
likha gaya kismat may ye kaisa zindan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab khaak pe soti hoo na takiya hai na bistar
rakta nahi ek shamma koi ab to jala kar
jeene nahi deta hai ay baba zindan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi phuphi qaid se kab hogi rehaai
amma mere ammu ki khabar kyon nahi aayi
tukde kiye deta hai kaleja mera zindan
<<DIVIDER>>
sar baap ka paaya to wo phir is tarha soyi
phir royi nahi uske liye maut thi royi
deta raha sajjad ko pursa sada zindan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa kehti rahi aao utho neend se jaago
azaad hui qaid se mai jaati hoo ghar ko
milne chalo sughra se ke ab khul gaya zindan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar jaane ka arman tha sakina ko jo rehaan
marke bhi na pura hua us bachi ka armaan
masoom sakina ka marqad bana zindan
mayyat hai sakina ki...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Mere raaj dulare
items.body:
mere raaj dulaare qasim
haye qasim haye qasim
farwa ke labon par maqtal mein
thay dard ke naare qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chashme falak purnam purnam
hai arsh pe bhi tera matam
rote hai teri pamaali par
ye chand sitaare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein phirte hai dar dar
ghurbat ki ghatayein hai sar par
ab kaun hame pahunchaye watan
jab tum hi sidhaare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum mujhse juda yun hote ho
kyun khaak pe bikhre sote ho
maqtal se palat kar aa jao
maa zulfein sawaare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
waari bhi hua nazron se niha
aur tum bhi sidhaare suye jina
ye umr meri guzregi bhala
ab kiske sahare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu teen dino ka pyasa hai
kausar mein talatum barpa hai
teri pyaas pa girya girya hai
tasneem ke dhaare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
ki fauje jafa ne kaisi jafa
jeete ji tujhe pamaal kiya
yun dasht mein tum bikhre jaise
quran ke paare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
is soone soone jangal se
tum karbobala ke maqtal se
ay laal palat kar aajao
maa tumko pukaare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote thay haram phat'te thay jigar
hota tha bapa us dam mehshar
jab kehti thi ye dukhiya ro kar
mere aankh ke taare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
<<DIVIDER>>
khairaat pe shahe zeeshan ki
rakh laaj bilal o irfan ki
mehshar mein khade hai ye dono
bas tere sahaare qasim
haye qasim mere raaj...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Na jao chod ke
items.body:
janaze par ali ke ghamzada zainab ka hai nauha
na jao chod ke baba
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi kuch dayr pehle hi pukara naam tha mera
na jao chod ke baba
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha tha kal hi to mujhse na ghabrao meri beti
ye ro ro kar hai boli
tumhara saaya utha to nahi hai lutf jeene ka
na jao chod ke baba
janaze par ali ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khamoshi mere dil par chalati hai bade khanjar
pukaro beti to keh kar
abhi karni hai baatein tumse kaisa hai ye sannata
na jao chod ke baba
janaze par ali ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pidar se betiyon ko aas hoti hai bahot saari
mai tum par hoti hoon waari
utho seene se phir mujhko laga lo ay mere baba
na jao chod ke baba
janaze par ali ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zara aankhein to kholo dekho roti hai bahot zainab
tadapti hai bahot zainab
kafan mein dekh ke tumko mera dil khoon hai rota
na jao chod ke baba
janaze par ali ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kafan ko thaam kar boli mujhe bhi saath lete jao
na moo yun mod kar jao
sahara hai bada tum se nahi chodo mujhe tanha
na jao chod ke baba
janaze par ali ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan bhaiya hata do tum kafan baba ke chehre se
mai dekhun chehra jee bhar ke
tadap ke chehra dekha phir jabeen ko keh ke ye chooma
na jao chod ke baba
janaze par ali ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
giri hai khaak par saayib ali ki laadli beti
sada baba ko deti thi
janaza nikla tha ghar se to zainab ke labon par tha
na jao chod ke baba
janaze par ali ke...
items.author: Saib Zaidi

items.title: Paal kar zainab
items.body:
paal kar zainab ne sab ko karbala tayyar ki
deen ki hurmat par lutaane ko rida tayyar ki
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sada nikli dile zainab ban kar ya hussain
de ke sar sheh ne jo hal min ki sada tayyar ki
paal kar zainab ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan yehi zainab hai jisne ek saaye ki tarha
pusht par bhai ke reh kar karbala tayyar ki
paal kar zainab ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gaya is mein simat kar sirre ramz e la ilaah
ya hussaina ki jo zainab ne sada tayyar ki
paal kar zainab ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho salaam us par ke jisne khoon ka nazrana diya
ummato ke waaste khaake shifa tayyar ki
paal kar zainab ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon baha us maa se poocho uski waaris hai wohi
jisne bete ki shahadat ko qabaa tayyar ki
paal kar zainab ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
la ilaah ko jisne sarnaama banaya ay naved
jisne apne khoon se unki bina tayyar ki
paal kar zainab ne...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Aa rahi hai ye sada
items.body:
aa rahi hai ye sada zainab e dilgeer ki
laash be gor-o-kafan hai dasht mein shabbir ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
ab nahi abbas-e-ghazi qasim-o-akbar kahan
haaye ab koi uthaye laash be-takseer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
jiska maatha choom ke is dil ko milta tha karaar
aaj us shabbir ke gardan pe hai khanjar ki dhaar
haye wo cheh maah ka bacha tadapta reh gaya
maa kaleja thaam ke rone lagi hai zaar zaar
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
kardiya quran zaqmi hurmala ke teer ne
jante na thay muasalman azmate baysheer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi ummat nabi ki aag lekar haat mein
laaj rakh lena khudaya chadare tatheer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein is tarha se ghar luta shabbir ka
zulm ki badli mein parda kho gaya hamsheer ka
ek teer hurmala se zakhm hai kitne azaa ke
maa ka dil sarwar ka baazu aur gala baysheer ka
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
sar diya gulzaar jab islam par shabbir ne
khoon ke khatron ne phir khake shafa akseer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
items.author: Gulzaar Jafri

items.title: Aaye jo is jahan
items.body:
aaye jo is jahan mein hamshakle mustufa
aisa laga ke chand zameen par utar gaya
aaya phupi ki godh mein jis waqt mehlaqa
peshani uski choom ke zainab ne ye kaha
charcha karo jahan mein is shaah kaar ka
tohfa mila hussain ko parwardigar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
al qissa shehr shehr khabar hogayi ye aam
akhbaar mein likha gaya mazmoon ye tamam
akbar pe husn ka kiya khaaliq ne ikhtetaam
na tha na hai na hoga hussain aisa was salaam
mehboob e haq hai shakl mein hyder hai shaan mein
baaham huwe nabi o ali phir jahan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
par ashk baadshah e halab ko siwa hua
uske khameer mein ye namak tha mila hua
jis roz khalq yusuf e aale abaa hua
us roz wo bhi morid e fazl e khuda hua
dil mein ali ka ishq tha ye aarzoo mili
shaahe halab ko chand si beti ataa hui
<<DIVIDER>>
shaahe halab ne paayi musarrat ki ye khabar
utra hai aaj sehne mohamed mein ek qamar
khush hogaya wo shaahe halab bas ye soch kar
beti ka meri aqd ho is chand se agar
us roz se halab ka wo sultan e naam daar
taaron ke badle chand kiya karta tha shumaar
<<DIVIDER>>
atharwan baras hua akbar ko jab shuru
shaahe halab ke bakht ka suraj hua tuloo
chaaha ke rasme aqd ka ye saal ho vuquu
ye soch ke hussain se usne kiya rujoo
sultan ke khat ko paaya jo zehra ke chain ne
khat ka diya jawab usay yun hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
pahuncha tera areeza hui ittelaa e haal
beti ke aqd ka ali akbar se hai khayal
armaan hai kamaal teri aarzoo kamaal
mai bhi dua karunga mubarak ho tujhko saal
hai marzi e mabood to inkar kya mera
taqdeer mein nahi hai to iqraar kya mera
<<DIVIDER>>
shaahe halab ko pahuncha juhin ruqqa e imam
khush hogaya naseeb ke khulne pe nek naam
zauja se apni karne laga is tarha kalaam
beti ke aqd ki karo tayyariyan tamam
dunya o aakhirat mein teri aabroo bane
beti teri hussain ke ghar ki bahu bane
<<DIVIDER>>
saaman yahan to tha ali akbar ke byaah ka
nikla udhar wo khaafila yasrab ke shaah ka
aate hi dasht mein hua nargha sipaah ka
ghera adoo ne qaima risaalat panaah ka
dulhan ke ghar mein log ghiza nosh karte thay
dulha ke ghar mein tifl mein faaqon se marte thay
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra wahan bana ali akbar ke waaste
yan maut nauhagar thi usi sar ke waaste
poshak thi wahan dil e hyder ke waaste
yan bekafani thi usi dilbar ke waaste
sadqe rasool zadiyan murde pe hoti thi
zainab sirhane paainti maa behne roti thi
<<DIVIDER>>
ab maajera halab ka sunaun ke kya hua
shaahe halab ka mehel tha kaisa saja hua
yasrab ka qazd tha dil mein chupa hua
itne mein ek shaks wahan roonuma hua
usne sunaani aan ke di badshaah ko
maqtal mein maar daala shahe deenpanah ko
<<DIVIDER>>
sultan patak ke taaj pukara ke kya hua
usne kaha hussain shaheed e jafa hua
gharkaab ashk mazhar e noor e khuda hua
yani tabaah gulshane aale aba hua
ye baat sun ke rone laga phir wo nek naam
shadi ke ghar mein hogaya majlis ka ehtemam
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein pahuncha ahle haram ka jo kaarwan
dekha ke ek uroos hai laashon ke darmiyan
bas ay dabeer khatm karo marsiya yahan
sar nange baal khole wo karne lagi fughan
jaane hussain ki mujhe is dam talaash hai
ay karbala kidhar mere dulha ki laash hai
items.author: Mirza Dabeer

items.title: Ajeeb hai dastane
items.body:
ajeeb hai daastane gham ajeeb hai
nabi ki itrat pe ye sitam ajeeb hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoolne waali baat nahi thi
ghar ghar iska charcha tha
ye to kal ki baat thi khud apni
aankhon se dekha tha
maulai ka kaad nabi ne
qum mein isko ata kiya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hi noor ke do tukde hai
ek mohamed ek ali
dono hai mehboobe elaahi
dono ko meraj hui
ek ko haq ne kar diya zaahir
ek parde mein chupa diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
zindabad ay jazba e matam
mehnat ab rang laayi hai
chauda sau saala nafrat
ab khul kar saamne aayi hai
aaj yazeediyat ne parda
rukh se apne hata diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
tehr nahi sakte thay baghair
izn farishte jis dar par
naqshe nishane paaye mohamed
saqt thay jis ki chaukat par
waaye musalmano ho tum par
tumne wo dar jala diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
haaton mein hai shimr ke khanjar
zaanu ke neeche hai hussain
qaime ke dar par karti hai
zainab sar kholay hue bain
baba ab tum kab aaoge
bhai ka kat'ta hai gala
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko tan se juda kiya
sar chada diya phir naize par
laashon par ghode daudaye
bujhi na dil ki aag magar
kalma-goyo ne khud apne
nabi ke ghar ko jala diya
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
aise mein ek bachi nikli
qaimon se ghabrayi hui
khoon tapakta tha kano se
rukh pe yateemi chaayi hui
kaamp rahi thi khauf se wo
aur shimr tamache maarta tha
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman mein thi aag lagi aur
suye najaf tha rukh uska
roti thi chillati thi
geh deti thi baba ko sada
rooth gaye kyon aap sakina se
baba kya ki thi khata
ajeeb hai daastane…
<<DIVIDER>>
bain sakina ke sun sun kar
thar'rati thi laashe hussain
saahil par ek laasha
uth uth padta tha hokar bechain
aati thi reh reh ke sada jab
aajao aajao chacha
ajeeb hai daastane…
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Ali hai sajde mein
items.body:
ali hai sajde mein tar khoon mein peshani hai
zameen se taa ba falak chaayi pareshani hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka qatl bhi saazish ka shaakhsana tha
chale hai silsile phir se wohi kahani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhala koi apne bhi mohsin ko qatl karta hai
ye musalmano ki dar asl mein nadani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abu turab ko samjhe to mustafa samjhe
ali ki zaat ko ya zaate khuda jaani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya jo maula ne qaatil ko apne jaam ataa
ali kareem hai kis baat pe hairani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali wali ke hashr tak rahenge charche ameer
baqa unhi ko hai bas ye jahan faani hai
ali hai sajde mein...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Ana zawaar
items.body:
salam karbobala ya hussain ya maula
salam haye shaheedan e karbala e wafa
har ek zarre se matam ki aa rahi hai sada
<<DIVIDER>>
ana zawwar e hussain ibne ali
arbaab hussain ibn e ali
<<DIVIDER>>
chala hoo karbobala hai zaban pe bismillah
hai dil mein kalma e haq lailaha illallah
safar qubool kare ya hussain sarallah
<<DIVIDER>>
hum log azadar e hussain arewallah
hum log wafadar e hussain arewallah
hum log tarafdar e hussain arewallah
ay aaqa mere ay maula mere
naukar hai sada zawwar tere
ana zawwar e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam iska ke hum ko bula liya maula
salaam iska ke zaaer bana liya maula
salaam iska ke dil mein basa liya maula
hum ahle yaqeen ahle aza arewallah
hum fatema zehra ki dua arewallah
hum saare safeeran e aza arewallah
ay aaqa mere ay maula mere
naukar hai sada zawwar tere
ana zawwar e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka shukr dayaar e hussain dekh liya
in aasuon ne mazaar e hussain dekh liya
naseeb mera wiqaar e hussain dekh liya
kya shaan teri karbobala arewallah
hai khaak teri khaak e shifa arewallah
jageer e alamdaar e wafa arewallah
ay aaqa mere ay maula mere
naukar hai sada zawwar tere
ana zawwar e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
arbaab hussain ibn e ali

items.title: Dekha na sakina ne
items.body:
chehra na tera saamne gar paungi baba
tareeki e zindan may ghabraungi baba
darti hoo andhere may nazar kuch nahi aata
dewaaron se takrati hoo mar jaungi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha na sakina ne zindan may savera hai
mai kya bataun baba yahan kitna andhera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har roz maarte hai mujhko tamache zaalim
teri laadli ka baba zakhmi hua chehra hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pabandi hai rone pe mai bain karoo kaise
akbar ke qaatilon ne zindan ko ghera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota nahi guzar bhi zindan se hawa ka
gardan may tang rasan hai dam ghut raha mera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ke seene pe mai kis tarha so jaaun
bhai ka paak seena zanjeeron ne ghera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ka khoon bhara wo kurta nahi mai bhooli
aur yaad mujhko baba qasim ka wo sehra hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere galay ko zakhmi khanjar ne kiya baba
rassiyon se gala zakhmi ab hogaya mera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasa zibha kiya hai in zaalimon ne tujhko
mai bhi rahungi pyasi ab waada ye mera hai
dekha na sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
salman poochti thi baba se ye sakina
mujhse bhi zyada zakhmi kyun aap ka chehra hai
dekha na sakina ne...
items.author: Salman Awais Khan

items.title: Farshe aza
items.body:
khul gaya mera naseeb jab ghar ashoor khana saja
do jahan ki mili naymatein aur maangu mai kya
mere ghar mein bicha farshe aza aa gayi zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
qismat pe karun naaz kabhi sajde mau jaaun
har ek azadaar ko ye jaa ke bataun
ro ro ke kiya shukre khuda aa gayi zehra
mere ghar mein bicha...
<<DIVIDER>>
paaya hai talab se bhi siwa kaisa karam hai
naukar ke bhi naukar pe kiya kaisa karam hai
ghar khuld ghareebon ka bana aa gayi zehra
mere ghar mein bicha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai chashme tasavvur se samaa dekh raha hoo
nabiyon ki khatarein bhi yahan dekh raha hoo
taazeem karo ahle wila aa gayi zehra
mere ghar mein bicha...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha to nahi aayi hai ghar maadar e shabbir
kulsoom sakina bhi hai aur zainab e dilgeer
dete hai sada zainul-liba aa gayi zehra
mere ghar mein bicha...
<<DIVIDER>>
purse ke liye aaye yahan sher e khuda bhi
akbar bhi hai qasim bhi hassan sabz qaba bhi
is waqt sar e farshe aza aa gayi zehra
mere ghar mein bicha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek marsiya maine jo padha tashna labon ka
jab naam sakina ka mere honton pe aaya
bas naam sakina ka suna aa gayi zehra
mere ghar mein bicha...
<<DIVIDER>>
paigham to dena hai yehi safdar o mazhar
matam se na sharmao kabhi farshe aza par
purse ke liye ahle aza aa gayi zehra
mere ghar mein bicha...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Godhiyon may sone
items.body:
godhiyon mein sone waali
so gayi zindan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
bole abid kya bataun
dard ke toofan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar armaan tha
ho kar reha jaaungi ghar
kis khadar khush hogi sughra
mujhko zinda dekh kar
kya khabar thi jayengi ghar
baaliyan saaman mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ka sar tab mila
jab tan se kuch rishta na tha
godh mein sar le ke boli
haye baba mai fida
kaise rakhun sar tumhare
is jale damaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se bad ke baba
zulm e qaid e shaam hai
raat din mujhko rulaana
zaalimon ka kaam hai
kab ta'aluq toot jaaye
jism mein aur jaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid e tanhaai hai baba
goke kunba saath hai
mai jahan qaidi hoo baba
din chadhe bhi raat hai
reh rahi hoo baad e ammu
waadi e sunsaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand lamhon ki hoo mehman
saath le jaana mujhe
phir na jaane aap ko
kis waqt kab fursat milay
dard hai baba kayi din
se hamare kaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bhai saath hai
wo bhi bada majboor hai
neend jaise door mujhse
wo bhhi mujhse door hai
ab watan jaana nahi
shayad mere imkaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis kaleje se padhun
nauha bhala mai shadman
aa gayi hai ek ek
misre pe meri lab pe jaan
soz kis ne bhar diya hai
qaama e rehaan mein
godhiyon mein sone waali...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Hassan hussain pukare
items.body:
qabr e rasool par yehi hasnain ke thay bain
nana tumhare baad na amma ne paaya chain
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan hussain pukare ab aao ay nana
hamari amma hai zakhmi bachao ay nana
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare jaane se maa ko bohat aziyat hai
pahaad waqt hai har lamha ek musibat hai
lehad se uth ke galay se lagao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta hogaya pehlu hamari amma ka
hamara bhai wo mohsin shaheed e zulm hua
hamay na maarde humko bachao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaya jalta hua dar jo bibi fizza ne
to dekha maykhein gadi hai badan pe amma ke
ye kis khata ki saza hai batao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo janasheen tumhara hamara wo baba
gala khuda ke wali ka rasan se baandha gaya
gala chuda ke galay se lagao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi nabi ke bhi bachon pe kya ye zulm hua
jala ho dar kahin durra kahin tamacha laga
hum ahlebait e nabi hai batao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda hi jaane ke kab tak sitam uthana hai
hamay to sar ko katana hai ghar lutana hai
jahan ho tum wahin hum ko bulalo ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay nana qabr se dekha to hoga wo manzar
gira tha jalta hua dar jo amma ke upar
har ek zakhm pe marham lagao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan hussain ay majid jo roye zaar o qataar
laraz rahi thi wahan qabre ahmed e mukhtar
bilak ke kehte thay bache bachao ay nana
hassan hussain pukare...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Hoagaya qatl shahe
items.body:
hogaya qatl shahe karbobala wavaila
rote hai peet ke sar ahle aza wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
teer se hogaya zakhmi ali akbar ka jigar
umme laila ne kaha laash pe ay noore nazar
maa se kuch baat karo utke zara wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jalte huwe sehra may tadap bachon ki
hogaye nehr pe abbas ke baazu zakhmi
koi bachon ka muhafiz na raha wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash dulhe ki kuch is tarha se pamaal hui
umme farwa ne jo dekha to na pehchan saki
haye qasim pe hui kaisi jafa wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat gaye pyaas may phir aun-o-mohamed ke gale
fidya e raahe khuda hogaye godi ke pale
hogaya qaimon may kohram bapa wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ne bade naazon se jise paala tha
jo payambar ke gharane hi ka ujiyala tha
asre ashoor kata uska gala wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm dhaate rahe sajjad pe har waqt layeen
berida dekh ke zainab ko tadapti thi zameen
aasman girya kuna gham se huwa wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalgaye qaime to saydaniya aayi ban may
laashe jitne bhi thay be-gor o kafan thay ran may
chingayi bibiyon ke sar se rida wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bober rok qalam tukde jigar hota hai
sunke nauha tera har jinn o bashar rota hai
chagayi charon taraf gham ki fiza wavaila
hogaya qatl shahe...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Hussain shahe karbala
items.body:
hussain shaahe karbala
hussain deene mustufa
wo deene haq ka khaafila
chala jo suye karbala
yehi hai jaadae wafa
qadam qadam ye thi sada
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunch ke dashte karbala
luta ke gulshane wafa
khiraj is tarha liya
shikaste zulm ne kaha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kaun kaaba e yaqeen
ay jaane khatme mursaleen
wohi hai bas panaah e deen
ye keh rahe hai ambiya
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zikr hi namaz hai
khuda ko jispe naaz hai
wo sar hi sarfaraz hai
jabeen pa jiski hai likha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam shab tha imtehan
yaqeen-o-shaq ke darmiyan
hui jo suboh ki azaan
to hurr ke dil ne ye kaha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
utha ke laasha e jawan
chale jo shaahe inso-jaan
na tha koi bhi paasban
magar ye haq ki thi sada
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain deen panaah hai
bina-e la ilaah hai
kitaab e haq gawah hai
waraq waraq ye hai likha
hussain shaahe…
<<DIVIDER>>
hazaar koshihe hui
magar na ruk saka kahin
fareed zikre shaahe deen
rahega hashr tak sada
hussain shaahe…
items.author: Fareed Baig

items.title: Jab mai bhi karbala
items.body:
jab mai bhi karbala ki ziarat ko jaunga
pyason ke zayareen ko pani pilaunga
<<DIVIDER>>
poochunga dard kaisa hai pehlu ka shaah se
hargiz na apna haal mai unko sunaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr e ghareeb e zehra pe ashoor waale din
sajjad ki taraf se kafan le ke jaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bandhwa ke apne haathon ko hurr ki tarha se mai
sultan e karbala tere rauze pe aaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko yaqeen hai maa wahan hogi hussain ki
nazrein na qatl gaah ki jaanib uthaunga
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ko sunaunga akbar ka marsiya
abbas ko sakina ki sunaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jaah giri thi naaqe se beti batool ki
wajib samajh ke khud wahan par giraunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ragdi thi jis jagah ali akbar ne aediyan
dil keh raha hai mai to wahan mar hi jaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad zayareen ki khidmat karunga mai
is kaam bhi na aaya to kis kaam aaunga
jab mai bhi karbala ki...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Khaake shifa pe
items.body:
khaak e shifa pe farz jo sajda hai ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya tere wajood ko maanegi ek din
kya teri manzilat hai ye jaanegi ek din
shayad ke teri qabr bhi kaaba hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere lahoo ka ek ek khatra hai la jawab
milti nahi jahan mein teri koi bhi misaal
ye martaba ke maa teri zehra hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe sar patakta hai maujaon ka ikhtiyar
jaise ke roye asghar e baysheer ko rabab
pyasa lab e furaat pe kunba hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
tune lahoo diya to bacha deen e mustafa
maqrooz tere hogaye ye saare ambiya
dunya mein har jagah tera charcha hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko jhukaye chalta hai kaaton pe wo magar
gardan mein tauq paon mein bedi lahoo jigar
saabir teri tarha tera beta hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab hai sar barehna agar tu hai be-kafan
taqdeerein uski ban gayi ye zulm ki rasan
zainab ke dil pe ek hi sadma hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange dekh aayi hai bazaar e shaam tak
qaidi ki tarha pahunchi hai darbar e shaam tak
ye imtehan e zapt bhi kaisa hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mazhar abidi ka aqeeda bhi hai bata
jayega tere rauze pe humraah kamran
dil mein ye aarzoo tha padna hai ay hussain
khaak e shifa pe farz...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Kufe ka nagar logon
items.body:
hai betiyan zahra ki kufe ka nagar logon
chadar ki jagah sar par hai khaak e safar logon
<<DIVIDER>>
kal ummat e ahmed ne darwaza jalaya tha
darwaza jalaya tha zahra pe giraya tha
ab loota hai ummat ne phir aaj wo ghar logon
hai betiyan zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tauq may jakda hai shabbir ka beta hai
shabbir ka beta hai bemaar hai tanha hai
wo kis tarha kaatega tanha ye safar logon
hai betiyan zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bibi jo zainab hai kufe ki hai shehzadi
maa fatema hai iski aur parde ki hai aadi
us samt nahi daalo tum apni nazar logon
hai betiyan zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bacchi yateema hai aur naam sakina hai
na ammu ki godhi hai na baap ka seena hai
is bacchi ab hoga zindan may ghar logon
hai betiyan zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat hai ye in par sadqa to nahi phenko
ye phool hai zahra ke pathar to nahi maaro
kya tum ko nahi kuch bhi allah ka darr logon
hai betiyan zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsoom hai bechadar zainab bhi khule sar hai
sad haif sakina ke cheene gaye gohar hai
ye dekh ke rota hai abbas ka sar logon
hai betiyan zahra ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum naala kuna maajid hum pairawe sarwar hai
hum matami akbar ke hum nasir e asghar hai
matam may hi karte hai hum umr basar logon
hai betiyan zahra ki...
items.author: Majid

items.title: Mal li hai karbala
items.body:
mal li hai karbala ki jabeen par utha ke khaak
poochega mujhse qabr mein ab koi aake khaak
<<DIVIDER>>
so jaaunga sukoon se phoolon ke sej par
farshe lehed pe karbobala ki bicha ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
wabasta jo batool ke dar se nahi usay
haath aayega rasool ke rauze pe jaa ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
deta wo kya rasool ki beti ka haq bhala
mayyat ko de saka jo na uski utha ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah wo rasool ko kya moo dikhayega
jisne kiya batool ke dar ko jala ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
poochega aake aakhri beta batool ka
bechi hai kisne turbate sheh ki saja ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaa kar raha hussain dil e kayenat par
harbein tamaam hogaye ahle jafa ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab baade qatle shaah saron se chini rida
dhaampa saron ko ahle haram ne uda ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer e sitam chala ke abhi dil bhara nahi
kya dhoondta hai bine kaahil hata ke khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
behno se bhai maaon se bacche bichad gaye
ghar ho gaya batool ka is ran mein aake khaak
mal li hai karbala ki...

items.title: Mayyat hassan hussain
items.body:
mayyat hassan hussain padar ki uthaate hai
ahle madina khhak saron par udaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ekkeeswi ko ho gaye maula ali shaheed
hum sab isi liye gham e hyder manaate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai ek ek se kulsoom kya karun
amma ki tarha chod ke baba bhi jaate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki siyaah aandhiyan ut'thi hai chaar soo
aasaar kayenaat ke phir dagmagate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsoos qatl kar diya hyder ko sajde mein
zalim khuda ke ghar ko bhi maqtal banate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho ajeeb haal hai ummal baneen ka
kaabu mein dil nahi hai khadam dagmagate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas bole maa se ke baba se poochiye
ye to bataye kis pa hamein chode jaate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadma hai gibraeel ko poocho na is qadar
aaqa pe apne khoon ke aansu bahate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
lillaah koi pooch le zainab ke dil ka haal
reh reh ke zakhm seene par nashtar chalate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate huwe janaze ko dekha to ro padi
murghabiyon mein bain hai razzakh jaate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
daamad e mustafa ka hai kya momino kusoor
kyun ashkiyan janaze pa pathar chalate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
qismat hai jin ki achi wohi jaaten hai najaf
jo door hai wo ashkon ki chadar chadate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansu baha ke shaah par taskeen milti hai
dunya ke gham raza mujhe jab bhi satate hai
mayyat hassan hussain...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Mere zakhm baba
items.body:
lahoo se hai rangeen kurta baba
baba ye dekho mere zakhm baba
<<DIVIDER>>
yateemi ki aisi mili hai khabar
tamache lage mere ruqsaar par
hai chehra sakina ka neela
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
angoothi lagi shimr ki jis ghadi
shikasta huwe mere dandaan bhi
lahoo se baha khoon mera
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo may jo doobi hui hoo bahot
mai kaanto pa paidal chali hoo bahot
laga har qadam taaziyana
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
musibat may dadi ki jaisi hui
meri phasliyan bhi hai tooti hui
chadhaya gaya mujhpa naaqa
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yun taaziyano se zakhmi badan
mujhe bhi milega na ghusl o kafan
juda ho sakega na kurta
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
chadhe jaise sooli pe mujrim koi
rasan se galay ki wo haalat hui
hai dushwaar saanson ka lena
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada haath uska tha rukh se mere
tamache lagaye hai yun shimr ne
hai badla mere nanha chehra
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamachon se behosh jab bhi hui
sare khaak jab moo ke bal mai giri
tamachon se aa kar uthaaya
baba ye dekho mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hilal aur ifran ghurbat badi
sakina ye kehte huwe mar gayi
bahot hai judaai ka sadma
baba ye dekho mere...
items.author: Hilal Rizvi

items.title: Na jee payegi
items.body:
na jee payegi fizza
zainab na tujhe chod ke jee payegi fizza
ro ro ke teri qabr pe mar jayegi fizza
zainab na tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi tujhe maine kabhi tanha nahi choda
hadh ye hai masaib mein bhi rishta nahi toda
nauha yehi turbat pa padi jayegi fizza
zainab na tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushwar hai pardes mein is gham ka uthana
mat aalam e ghurbat mein mujhe chod ke jaana
kya jaake watan walon ko batlayegi fizza
zainab na tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se tapakta hai abhi khoon badan pe
kaala hai abhi neel bhi shano mein rasan ke
kis tarha kafan laash ko pehnayegi fizza
zainab na tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na dil ko sukoon hai na tasalli hai zara si
dunya se sidhaari hai mohamed ki nawasi
sar peet ke turbat pe ye chillayegi fiiza
zainab na tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein ye kis ki nazar kha gayi bibi
mai zinda rahi tumko ajal aagayi bibi
ye daur judaai ka na seh payegi fizza
zainab na tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir qabr se awaaz ye aayi kayi baari
is zor se turbat pa na kar girya o zaari
amma meri turbat mein tadap jayegi fizza
zainab na tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
in zakhmon ka akhtar kabhi marham na milega
kaabe ki zameen aur kabhi arsh hilega
jab jab bhi masaib tere dohrayegi fizza
zainab na tujhe...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Paani
items.body:
haye sakina haye sakina
haye yateema haye yateema
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne khaak pe dikhla ke jo phaynka pani
dekhti reh gayi masoom sakina pani
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon ankhon mein utar aaya yateema royi
apni ghurbat pe tadap kar ke wo dukhiya royi
kar ke rukh dayr talak jaanibe darya royi
yaad saqqa ki bahot aayi sakina royi
roke deti thi sada dekh lo aakar ammu
ek khatre ke liye khaati hoon thokar ammu
shimr ne khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaifiyat pyaas ki kaisi thi koi kya jaane
kitni shiddat se wo pyasi thi ye allah jaane
pyaas ki kaunsi manzil pe thi dukhiya jaane
ye to bas baali sakina ka kaleja jaane
mashk pani ki jidhar thi wo udhar jaati thi
ghudkiyan shimr jo deta tha to darr jaati thi
shimr ne khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne baalon ko pakad kar ke tamache maare
dono kaano ki lawein cheer ke cheene bunde
jisne barsaye yateema pe musalsal durre
khaali kooze ko liye aayi jab uske aage
darr ye kehta tha sakina se na maango pani
pyaas kehti thi bas ab jald pila do pani
shimr ne khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne shimr ke lekar ke gayi jab kooza
daant kar baali sakina ko ye zaalim bola
pehle sairaab suno shaam ka lashkar hoga
phir ye umeed dilaayi ki tumhe bhi dunga
apne haiwano ko zaalim ne pilaya pani
aur yateema ko dikha kar ke bahaya pani
shimr ne khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aas jab tod di bacchi ki sitamgaron ne
aur ek zulm kiya badh ke jafakaron ne
khaynch kar baalon se bekas ko gunehgaron ne
khaak par phaynk diya zor se badkaron ne
aur ye kehne lage awaaz lagao usko
jis dilawar ki dulaari ho bulao usko
shimr ne khaak pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo masayib wo qayamat wo musibat waiz
kaun likhega yateema ki wo ghurbat waiz
thi ajab dukhtare shabbir ki haalat waiz
le gayi qabr talak pyaas ki shiddat waiz
aaj tak mujhko riwayat mein kahin ye na mila
pani kab aur kahan baali sakina ne piya
shimr ne khaak pe...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Aa rahi hai yehi
items.body:
aa rahi hai yehi har matami seene se sada
hashr tak jaari rahega ye ghame karbobala
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
saaya-gar apne saron par hai alam ghazi ka
hum azadaar hai hum par hai karam ghazi ka
gham manayenge isi tarha se hum ghazi ka
kiski himmat hai ke is gham se hamein roke bhala
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
aa rahi hai yehi har...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki taqdeer mein shabbir ka matam hoga
us ko dunya ka na mehshar ka koi gham hoga
wo to nabiyon ki bhi nazron mein mukarram hoga
us ko bakhshish ki sanad dega nussairi ka khuda
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
aa rahi hai yehi har...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din sab ko shifa degi shifa ki khushboo
ek din aayegi har dil se wafa ki khushboo
ek din chaar soo mehkegi azaa ki khushboo
ek din aayegi har ghar se ye matam ki sada
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
aa rahi hai yehi har...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen par hai tera ehsaan mere maula hussain
tu hai islam ki pehchaan mere maula hussain
tujhpe qurban meri jaan mere maula hussain
tere sadqe mein mili deen e mohamed ko baqa
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
aa rahi hai yehi har...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere lashkar ka alamdar hai wo sher e jari
jis ki haibat se larazta hai ajal ka dil bhi
dhoom kaunain mein hai jiski wafadari ki
jis ne pani pe likha pyaas se quran e wafa
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
aa rahi hai yehi har...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hoon ek khaadim e sarkar e shahenshah e wafa
naam gohar hai mera aur ye daawa hai mera
paak paakeeza lahoo jis ki ragon mein hoga
us ko matam mein bhi aayega ibadat ka maza
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
aa rahi hai yehi har...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Aayi shame ghariban
items.body:
jab gardane shabbir pe phera gaya khanjar
pardes mein loota gaya zahra ka bhara ghar
qasim hai na akbar hai na abbas e dilawar
kunbe ki nigehban hai ab zainabe muztar
aayi shaam e ghariban zainab hui tanha
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha tadap raha tha kisi ka labe furaat
cheeni thi shimr ne sar e zainab se jab rida
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
bache ko apne dhoondti hai maa andhere mein
haathon pe hai liye huwe jhoola jala hua
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
dulhe ka laasha ghodon se pamaal hogaya
ye kaisa waqt hazrate kubra pe aa gaya
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
ammu bachaiye mujhe shimr e layeen se
ek bachi dasht mein yehi deti rahi sada
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhraye apne baalon ko roti thi fatema
jis dum tha halq e shaah pe khanjar layeen ka
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon ki raakh bikhri padi thi zameen par
baitha tha sar jhukaye aseeron ka khaafila
aayi shaam e ghariban....
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed bayan karta hai karbal ke waqiyaat
mohsin jigar ko thaam ke padta hai marsiya
aayi shaam e ghariban....
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Abbas madad ko
items.body:
maqtal mein kaha sheh ne ro kar
abbas madad ko aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha uthe laashe akbar
abbas madad ko aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil se chale aao bhaiya
uthwao bhatije ka laasha
hai seena e akbar mein naiza
har samt andhera hai chaaya
be-noor hai aankhein tooti kamar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se ani jo hai khaynchi
mai kaise bataun kya guzri
hamshakle nabi reti pe gira
to rone lage khud pyare nabi
khud dekhlo maqtal mein aa kar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kayi baar gira is manzil mein
akbar tak pahuncha mushkil mein
jo seena e akbar mein hai laga
wo naiza hai mere dil mein
hai door hua mujhse dilbar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dekha akbar ka chehra
yaad aaye mujhe mere nana
kis tarha sambhalun mai dil ko
reti pe tadapta hai laasha
khoon mein hai shabihe paighambar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra se kiya tha jo waada
wo waada akbar toot gaya
ab sochta hoon kya bolunga
jab khat aayega sughra ka
tooti hai qayamat ab mujh par
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
nau laakh ke lashkar ne mere
bete ko ghayr ke maara hai
ummat ye bhool gayi lekin
ye mursal ka aaeena hai
chalta hai mere dil par khanjar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt bapa ek mehshar tha
jab khoon mein ghaltan akbar tha
ek nauha sheh ke lab par tha
yazdan wo kaisa manzar tha
sheh kehte thay ro ro kar asgher
abbas madad ko aajao...
items.author: Syed Asgher Ali

items.title: Ajeeb waqt pada hai
items.body:
ajeeb waqt pada hai yateem bachi par
meinaan e karbobala ro rahi hai khaak basar
<<DIVIDER>>
ye beti uski hai jo ke hai do jahan ka ameer
pali hai jo bade naazon mein dukhtare shabbir
pade hai neel usi shaahzadi ke rukh par
ajeeb waqt pada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
musibaton mein giraftaar shaahzadi hai
watan se door hai be-aasra hai pyasi hai
labon pe bain hai ghurbat ki khaak hai sar par
ajeeb waqt pada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin pe laashein kahin khoon hai shaahe khuda
akeli dasht e musibat mein aagayi ye kahan
andheri raat mein mar jaye na ye dar dar kar
ajeeb waqt pada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhala sakina ko kaise qaraar aayega
hamesha bachi ko ye gham haye rulayega
chala hai saamne baba ke halq par khanjar
ajeeb waqt pada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina zulm o sitam aur seh nahi sakti
zyada dayr wo ab zinda reh nahi sakti
khudara kar do ye abbas e bawafa ko khabar
ajeeb waqt pada hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi tamache lagaate hai taziyana kabhi
koi satata hai haye rula raha hai koi
nahi hai koi jo usko dilaasa de gohar
ajeeb waqt pada hai...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ay chacha mai tera
items.body:
ay chacha mai tera sajjad hoo pehchaan mujhe
kha gaye haye sitam shaam ke zindan mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
ay chacha sunle ye pur dard kahani meri
dhal gayi ranj o alam sehte jawani meri
taziyano se sataya gaya har aan mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
karz yun ajre risalat ka chukate thay layeen
kalma pad pad ke mujhe durre lagate thay layeen
yaad hai aaj bhi ummat ka ye ehsaan mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay chacha shaam ki wo raahein ajab raahein thi
tees thi zakhmo may aur lab par mere aahein thi
jeena dushwaar tha aur marna tha aasan mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi zindano se guzra kabhi darbaro se
dard sehte huwe guzra hoo mai bazaaron se
gaam dar gaam rulaate thay musalaman mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinki hadh koi nahi aise alam dekhe hai
bhare bazaar may beparda haram dekhe hai
saikdon gham thay jo karte thay pareshan mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ne loota hai jangal may bhara ghar mera
is tarha ujda hai maqtal may bhara ghar mera
bhari basti bhi nazar aati hai veraan mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai lahoo rota tha wo zakhm lagate thay mujhe
shaami pani ki jagah pyaas pilaate thay mujhe
qaidkhano may rakha jaata tha mehman mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay chacha ye bhi qayamat ki ghadi aayi hai
jalay kurte may behan qaid may dafnayi hai
sone deta nahi hamsheer ka ye dhyan mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha abid ka tha jab aaye watan noor ali
peet kar sar yehi karte thay sukhan noor ali
dafn karna pade khud haathon se armaan mujhe
ay chacha mai tera sajjad...
items.author: Noor Ali

items.title: Dekhe to koi
items.body:
dekhe to koi raunaq maqtal may zara aake
shabbir ke aane se din phir gaye sehra ke
dekhe to koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime se janaze ki ruqsat ka sa manzar hai
aayenge na phir akbar maidan may ab jaa ke
dekhe to koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal sumay aspa aisa na hua koi
bikhre hue tukde hai har simt may dulha ke
dekhe to koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay azm talab ghazi ab koi nahi baakhi
abbas zara aansu ruk jaane to do aaqa ke
dekhe to koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
ammu ke kabhi khisay baba ki kabhi baatein
bachi ko sulaati hai zainab yehi behlaake
dekhe to koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki sada sun kar khanjar talay sajde se
qaime ki taraf dekha shabbir ne ghabrake
dekhe to koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid ye azakhane veeran nahi honge
ta-hashr bhi gar dushman maare hamay aa aa ke
dekhe to koi…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Hogaya khamosh
items.body:
shaam ke zindan mein bali sakina kho gayi
qabr mein haye haye baba kehte kehte so gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya khamosh zindan hai udaasi chaa gayi
hai khiza mein baaghe ismat ki kali murjha gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke zindan mein bas goonjti thi siskiyan
thay andhere char soo na paas baba tha na maa
haye masooma ko hai zindan ki garmi khaa gayi
hogaya khamosh zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ke seene bina ab neend aati hai kahan
na mite ta marg zulmi tamachon ke nishan
dekh kar jor o sitam haye maut bhi ghabra gayi
hogaya khamosh zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
muntazir jiski madine mein rahi sughra behan
reh gayi haye shaam mein jaa sakina hai watan
karke wo islam zinda wo rayghe ghareeban paa gayi
hogaya khamosh zindan...
