<<DIVIDER>>
cheene durr hai zaalimon ne par utaare na rasan
haye jo kurta tha jala wohi bana uska kafan
chod usko shaam mein hai maa watan tanha gayi
hogaya khamosh zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis o matam mein hai khursheed shaamil ambiya
ay azadaron zara do mil ke matam ki sada
laadli shabbir ki dene dua aa gayi
hogaya khamosh zindan...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Hussain tanha hai
items.body:
bahaar simt se ahle sitam ne ghayra hai
kahan ho ay mere sheron hussain tanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mere rafeeqon madad-gaar ab chale aao
gira hai bekas o gham-khaar ab chale aao
nahi hai koi taraf-daar ab chale aao
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ho mere rafeeqon bula raha hai hussain
ke ab zameen pe ghode se aa raha hai hussain
tumhe ye nauha e hal min suna raha hai hussain
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bewafai ye ummat ki daastan hai ajeeb
kiya hai dasht mein farzande mustafa ko ghareeb
kahan ho hurr e dilawar kahan ho mere habeeb
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dashte karbobala ye ajal ka sannata
ye bekasi ki ghata aur ye shor lashkar ka
ye rayge garm ye farzande fatema zahra
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ke haaton mein khanjar kisi ke hai bhaale
ye dekho toot pade mujh pa barchiyon waale
suno suno ay mere saathiyon mere naale
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai paas e adab kuch sitam ki dunya ko
kiya hai teeron ne behaal ibne zahra ko
sitamgaron ne hai ghayra tumhare aaqa ko
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar ye nehr pe jaakar zara sunaye koi
ali ke sher ke shaane zara hilaye koi
mai zibha hota hoo abbas ko bataye koi
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bilak bilak ke bhatiji tumhari roti hai
utha hai dard judaai ka jaan khoti hai
bas itna kehdo sakina yateem hoti hai
kahan ho ay mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhe jo bain ba-har soorate kamaal likhe
musibaton ki ibadat ghamon ka haal likhe
milay jo aap ka irfan to phir bilal llikhe
kahan ho ay mere...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Jab na aada se
items.body:
jab na aada se kisi tarha safayi tehri
subhe ashoor e muharram ko ladayi tehri
poocha zainab ne ke kya hai mere bhai tehri
shah ne farmaya behen tumse judaai tehri
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj pyaron se mulaqaat bani mat jaano
ay behen aaj ki ye raat ghanimat jaano
<<DIVIDER>>
mai inke shar se amaan paaun ghair mumkin hai
watan may aal ko pahunchaun ghair mumkin hai
yahan se paon bhi sarkaaun ghair mumkin hai
mai kal ko qatl se bach jaaun ghair mumkin hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda se sabr o riza ka hai khast gaar hussain
bas ek raat ka mehmaan hai bedayaar hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bala may kushta e ranj o alam ko rehne do
faqat musafir e raah e adam ko rehne do
sitam raseeda paband e gham ko rehne do
na tum raho na ali ke haram ko rehne do
<<DIVIDER>>
hamare baad ye nachaar dar badar na phire
rasool zadiyan balwe may nange sar na phire

items.title: Khaali jhoola
items.body:
khamosh hai veeran hai sunsaan hai maqtal
ek maa ki sada sun ke pashemaan hai maqtal
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali jhoole ko ye maa kaise jhulaye asghar
tera jaana jo mere dil ko dukhaye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
aa tere khoon bhare kapde badal doon beta
khaak aur khoon mein hai chand sa chehra tera
maa ye ashkon se tera chehra dhulaye asghar
khaali jhoole ko ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa tere qadh se bada teer jo maara tujhko
aaja aaghosh meri degi dilaasa tujhko
chand lamhon ke liye chain to paaye asghar
khaali jhoole ko ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere jhoole ki taraf dekh ke dil rota hai
kya kisi se pidar yun bhi juda hota hai
zakhm furqat ka teri maa ko rulaye asghar
khaali jhoole ko ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh le ghar ki tarha godh bhi ujdi meri
maa ki aankhon se juda kaise ho tasveer teri
neend aaye na mujhe gham ye jagaye asghar
khaali jhoole ko ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhpe kya baat gayi kaise bataun asghar
dhoop mein qabr teri dekh rahi hai maadar
tu bata kaise ye maa saaye mein jaaye asghar
khaali jhoole ko ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool sakti hi nahi jhoole se jaana tera
khaa ke ek teer e sitam pyaas bujhana tera
jiske seene mein hai dil usko rulaye asghar
khaali jhoole ko ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki faryad suni safdar o mazhar hum ne
mera waada hai sanad khuld ki doongi mai usay
jo tere jhoole pe ye nauha sunaye asghar
khaali jhoole ko ye...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Kufe ke shehriyo ko
items.body:
kehdo koi hawa se khaak is tarha udaye
kufe ke shehriyo ko zainab nazar na aye
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon ko band karke zainab hai moo chupaye
kufe ke shehriyon ko zainab nazar na aye
<<DIVIDER>>
ab jam chuki saron par qaimon ki raakh ud kar
chaadar nahi saron par ab sar hai aur pathar
in bibiyon ke sar se ab uth gaye hai saaye
kufe ke shehriyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu bandha ke apne maqtal se jaa rahi hai
aaye nazar jo usko ek laash aa rahi hai
kaise nazar hataye kaise qadam badaye
kufe ke shehriyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar apna chaube mahmil se maarti hai zainab
behta hai khoon jaise jaan waarti hai zainab
naize pe sar jo sheh ka mahmil ke pass aaye
kufe ke shehriyo ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
badta hai jab bhi koi khud bad ke tokti hai
har taziyana apne haathon pe rokti hai
fizza jo apne peeche zainab ko hai chupaye
kufe ke shehriyo ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dewaar o dar ko sughra kya de jawab aakhir
sannata poochta hai kab aayenge musafir
sughra ka haal kya hai kaise koi bataye
kufe ke shehriyo ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye karz aansuon ka haaye chuke to kaise
hai ye naved darya darya ruke to kaise
zainab ke be-ridayi sajjad ko rulaaye
kufe ke shehriyon ko...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Mam maata hubbe
items.body:
raahe hussaini par jo insan chalta nahi
zinda reh kar bhi wo insan zinda nahi
hubbe aale mohamed mein jo mar jaaye
to wo mar bhi jaaye agar to marta nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
mam maata aala hubbe aale mohamed
maata shaheeda
<<DIVIDER>>
aale nabi ki ulfat mein logon
jo mar gaya wo marta nahi hai
hai haq ka waada aur sacha waada
usko khuda khud rakhta hai zinda
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam to hoga matam to hoga
har simt hoga har ghar mein hoga
roze azal se roze abad tak
zehra se hai ye khaaliq ka waada
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai karbala ki awaaz paiham
apna hai rehbar ghazi ka parcham
har matami ka jazba to dekho
ghazi ka parcham girne na dega
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
muslim habeeb o john aur haabis
shabbir ke sab be-misl naasir
jab ladte ladte maidan mein girte
sab ke labon par tha ek naara
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo qasim haye wo asghar
abbas e ghazi haye wo akbar
ro ro ke un par hum jaan denge
poora karenge hum apna waada
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi shahadat paata hai koi
shabbir usko aate hai lene
aansu baha kar khud shaah e deen ko
deta hai pursa karbobala ka
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum rone waale karbobala ke
darte nahi hai jor o sitam se
gardan katayi baazu kataye
lekin na choda gham karbala ka
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay meri maaon ay meri behno
darna nahi tum daur e sitam se
sughra ke gham se laila ke gham se
bad kar nahi koi gham hamara
mam maata aala hubbe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maajid ye likh kar sab ko bata do
ay shadman tum sab ko suna do
hum matami hai shaah e huda ke
mar kar bhi hum to rehte hai zinda
mam maata aala hubbe...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Mayyat jawan pisar
items.body:
mayyat jawan pisar ki uthayi hussain ne
saari kameini apni lutayi hussain ne
ummat ki nao paar lagayi hussain ne
dunya ko haq ki raah dikhayi hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ko de diya ali akbar ko de diya
bhai ko de diya ali asghar ko de diya
raahe khuda mein apne base ghar ko de diya
izzat khuda ke deen ki bachayi hussain ne
mayyat jawan pisar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
baakhi na be-zuban hai na akbar sa mehlakha
abbas e jaan wafa hai na qasim sa dilruba
har haal mein hussain ne shukre khuda kiya
peshani hukme haq pe jhukayi hussain ne
mayyat jawan pisar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam par thi kufr ki chaayi hui ghata
bechain thi lehad mein udhar roohe mustufa
sar de ke apna shaah ne deen ko bacha liya
bujhti hui ye shamma jalayi hussain ne
mayyat jawan pisar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kha kar sina jo seene pe akbar guzar gaye
pakde hue kaleje ko sheh laash par gaye
bolay ye roke ay mere dilbar kidhar gaye
tanha pisar ki laash uthayi hussain ne
mayyat jawan pisar ki...

items.title: Paband agar ghazi
items.body:
paband agar ghazi alamdar na hota
zainab ka khula sar sare bazaar na hota
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ko ladne ki agar hoti ijazat
phir ghazi sakina se sharam saar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte na wazoo khoon se hussain ibne ali bhi
masoom jo pani ka talab gaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati na kabhi aag mein haye saani e zahra
jalte huwe qaimon mein jo bemaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsar e sakina pe tamache bhi na lagte
is tarha yateemi ka bhi izhaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ko ghash aata na raahon mein kabhi yun
zainab teri chadar ka jo takraar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde mein agar sar ko na shabbir katate
yun deen e mohamed ka bhi parchaar na hota
paband agar ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha sar e zindan na kabhi marti sakina
baba se sakina ko agar pyar na hota
paband agar ghazi...

items.title: Aa teere garan le
items.body:
aa teer e garan le gardan par
ab poora kar ashoor asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
manzoor hai wo hum dono ko
allah ko jo manzoor asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
ab baat na karna godhi ki
ab baat na karna lori ki
hona hai hamesha hi ke liye
tujhe apni maa se door asghar
aa teer e garan le...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar shahadat sab ke liye
do baar shahadat tere liye
ek teer e garan aur ek naiza
is gaam pe hai mamoor asghar
aa teer garan le...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum pyaas liye hai zabano par
wo qabza kiye hai daya par
mansoor ye hum mazloomon ka
wo zaalim ka mansoor asghar
aa teer garan le...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shaami kufi pathar dil
kuch dayr mein ye sab royenge
mumkin jo na tha ho jayega
hasne se tere wo zaroor asghar
aa teer garan le...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaamil hai azal ke waade mein
chehre pe mere ho tera lahoo
aabaad ho teri tajalli se
aagosh ka mere toor asghar
aa teer garan le...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch din hi jiyegi baad tere
tujhe godh mein paalne waali maa
bacchon ki judaai ke zakhmon se
us ka dil hoga choor asghar
aa teer garan le...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid tere gham ka kaatib hai
abid tere dar ka sajid hai
hai jo bhi likha hai jo bhi padha
sab tu ne diya hai shaoor asghar
aa teer garan le...

items.title: Aayi zahra ki sada
items.body:
aayi zahra ki sada pyasa hai baccha mera
shimr khanjar na chala
<<DIVIDER>>
jurm kya isne kiya kuch to kar khauf e khuda
mujhpe ye zulm na dhaa
aayi zahra ki sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar jalaya mere mohsin ko bhi maara tum ne
zehr shabbar ko pilaya tumne
meri beti ke liye hai nigehban ye baccha
aakhri beta mera
aayi zahra ki sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
soch kar neend may ye pyaas se jaage na kahin
paani le kar mai khadi rehti thi
kis tarha dekhe ye maatu sirhane pe yahan
leke khanjar hai khada
aayi zahra ki sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera baccha jo suye qaima nazar karta hai
yaad abbas usay aata hai
zere khanjar bhi yahi iske lab par hai sada
haye zainab ki rida
aayi zahra ki sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai sakina se tujhe maang ke laa doongi gohar
le le sab ahle haram ke zewar
maa ka phat'ta hai jigar itni tauheen na kar
payr seene se hata
aayi zahra ki sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath pyase ki na gardan se hatayegi ye maa
apne bacche ko bachayegi ye maa
ab nahi fikr mujhe haath kat jaaye mere
katne doongi na gala
aayi zahra ki sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad maa ke jo behen shaah ki maa jaisi thi
jis ghadi qaime se wo nikli thi
khushk tha sheh ka gala zere lab itna kaha
jaa behen qaime may jaa
aayi zahra ki sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl maadar hui hamsheer bhi beti bhi hui
jab churi shaah pe akbar thi chali
kya qayamat tha samaan tanha mazloom kahan
qatl khanjar se hua
aayi zahra ki sada...

items.title: Abbas mar gaya
items.body:
qaime mein aaye maqtal e ghazi se jab hussain
khaali alam uthaye thay aur thay zaban pe bayn
zainab ne jab ye poocha wo hyder ka noor e ain
aaya na ghar ko laut ke kyun mere dil ka chain
<<DIVIDER>>
rote hue hussain ne zainab se ye kaha
abbas mar gaya
hamsheer ab badhado alam apne bhai ka
abbas mar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
saansein ukhar rahi thi jawan mere bhai ki
bedast tha jari
meri nazar ke saamne jaan se guzar gaya
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
behta tha khoon aankh mein paywast teer tha
manzar tha dard ka
zainab hamare bhai pe itni hui jafa
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
har khatra aab ka usay pyara tha jaan se
maqtal mein is liye
lagte hi teer mashk pe pani juhin baha
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
boli sakina bachon ke honton pe pyas hai
mujhse hi aas hai
mai unko kis tarha se bataun mera chacha
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar kahan ho baap ko aa kar sambhaal lo
mushkil mein saath do
sarwar ka ab koi bhi sahara nahi raha
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab baade asr kaun hai qaimon ka paasban
mehshar ka hai samaa
ghabrayi binte fatema jab shor ye utha
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ki baat kaise bhala taal'ta jari
khaahish thi shaah ki
par bhai kehke hogaya khamosh bawafa
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
izhaar ho ke ghamzada farmate thay hussain
loota gaya hai chain
ab andhiyon ki zad pe hai zainab teri rida
abbas mar gaya
rote hue hussain ne…
items.author: Ali Izhaar

items.title: Ajeeb zid hai
items.body:
ajeeb zid hai ke islam aal se mat lo
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek baat suno har kisi se fatwa lo
kahe jo aale mohamed usay kabhi na suno
ek shehre ilm ka dar hai udhar ka rukh na karo
suni sunayi hui baat par yaqeen karlo
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban pe lao na hargiz nabi ki aal ka naam
jhukao ghair ke dar par jabeen ko subho shaam
ye ahlebait hai bas laaeq e darood o salaam
inhe to door se hi bas salaam karte raho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
badhayi jis se ibaarat hai ye wo aazam hai
usool e deen hai ibne rasool e khaatam hai
imam e jafar e sadiq imam e aalam hai
khuda ke waaste kuch to samajh ki baat karo
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghatao martaba aale mustafa din raat
usool e kasrat e aara se unko dedo maat
ye inteha e adawat hai ke har ek wo baat
jawan ke haq mein kahi jaaye usko kufr kaho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke waaste is zid se baaz aajao
jahan mein dushmane aale nabi na kehlao
gala kata chuke shabbir kuch taras khao
nabi ki aal pe ab to sitam rawan na rakho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ahlebait hai haasil inhe ye azmat hai
ke lab pe naam bhi aajaye to ibadat hai
sune wo deen e mohamed se jinko nisbat hai
hai char chand lage in se deen e ahmed ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek bashar ko ye haasil kahan sa'adat hai
jali huroof se quran mein ibaarat hai
ke sirf aale ibrahim mein imamat hai
wahan bhi shart rakhi hai na zalimeen mein ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aal rooh aur islam us ka qalib hai
qadam qadam pe wo inki riza ka taalib hai
hai kaun jis pe durood o salaam wajib hai
hai haq parasti ka daawa to haq ki baat kaho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban se kehte ho dil se yaqeen gar ho jaye
kham ahlebait ki chaukat pe tera sar ho jaye
mai karbala kahun aur teri chashm nam ho jaye
azeez jaan se zyada hussain ka gham ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain jaan dil e mustafa pe jaan nisaar
nazar mein taab kahan hai jo dekhe haalat e zaar
tan e hazeen pe hai itne sina o teer ke waar
shumaar karne pe aaye magar shumaar na ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pisar ki laassh pe baithe thay sayyed e waala
ke ek mard khush atwar saamne aaya
salaam kar ke kaha mai hoon qaside sughra
tadap raahi hai bulaya hai us ne akbar ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
suna jo fatema sughra ka naam sarwar ne
kaleje thaam liya fatema ke dilbar ne
tadap ke khaak pe karwat li laashe akbar ne
larazte haathon se thaama hussain ne khat ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
likha tha khat mein hazaron salaam akbar ko
duayein bali sakina ko pyar asghar ko
chacha ko likha tha aadaab aur sarwar ko
likha tha baba gaye bhool aap bhi mujhko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai raat din yahan bhai ki raah dekhti thi
aur aap ne wahan shadi racha di kubra ki
kisi ko aayi na aise mein yaad sughra ki
bigad gaya hai muqaddar kahun mai kya isko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha ke paas sakina hai mai hoon kaun bhala
phupi ko bhi nahi aaya khayal kuch mera
samajhti hongi ye amma ke mar gayi sughra
kisi ka bhi na jahan mein aisa naseeb ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye pad ke aah jo ki sheh ne aasman larza
hila ke shaana e akbar kaha ke ay beta
bulaya hai tumhe sughra ne doon jawab mein kya
madine jaoge kab tak behen ke laane ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke phir ye sada di hussain ne abbas
koi nahi hai is aafat mein jo bandhaye aas
tarayi chod ke aajao do ghadi ko paas
jawab maanga hai sughra ne kya likhun usko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhi batao ke mai dil ka haal kis se kahun
khareeb e asr hai mehman do ghadi ka hoon
bilak rahi hai wo dukhiya watan mein kya keh doon
raha hai kya mere paas ab usay batane ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir iske baad qasid se sheh ne farmaya
shaheed hogaye abbas chal basa dulha
ye dekh saamne akbar ka hai pada laasha
koi na aaya meri laash tak uthane ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi sitam hai mujhe aur sehna ay qasid
sada kise hai zamane mein rehna ay qasid
ye jaa ke fatema sughra se kehna ay qasid
jo ho sake to wo ab bhool jaye asghar ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...

items.title: Andhere ban mein
items.body:
andhere ban mein hai baba sakina kyun chali aayi
lahoo mein dooba hai laasha sakina kyun chali aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
na ab neend aayegi tum ko na ab baba sulayenge
hai zakhmi teeron se seena sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
akeli tum bachi ho baap ki mayyat pe rone ko
yahan hai maut ka pehra sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha se koi kehde tum abhi tak ran mein pyasi ho
unhi ke paas hai darya sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phupi har samt tumko dekhti aur dhoondti hongi
jale qaime mein hai tanha sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare waaste jo khoon mein dooba hai darya par
tadap jaata hai wo laasha sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere ban mein hai...

items.title: Ay dariya
items.body:
pyase qaimon may musalsal hai fughan ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya hai kahan ay dariya
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni hasrat se takay jaate hai sheh ko abbas
jab se goonji ali akbar ki azan ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya…
pyase qaimon may…
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk par teer jo aaya to ye mehsoos hua
jaise seene may utar aayi sina ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya…
pyase qaimon may…
<<DIVIDER>>
haath katne pa bhi abbas kay tayvar hai wohi
shaah bach jaye chali jaye ye jaan ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya…
pyase qaimon may…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kabse dar-e-qaima pa khade hai bache
sukhe honton pa rakhi khushk zaban ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya…
pyase qaimon may…
<<DIVIDER>>
noke naiza se utaari gayi zainab ki rida
sogaya khaak pa jab sher-e-jawan ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya…
pyase qaimon may…
<<DIVIDER>>
tere saahil pa kabhi shaah ke maqtal may kabhi
roti phirti hai musalsal koi maa ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya…
pyase qaimon may…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye juz sham e ghariban nahi koi shahid
roke kehta hai ye qaimo ka dhuan ay dariya
tune ghazi ko chupaya…
pyase qaimon may…

bhook hai pyaas hai beemari hai aazaari hai

maarta koi sakina ko to kehte abid
maar le mujhko mere baba ki ye pyari hai
be rida bibiyon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
logon dekho ye kata sar hai mere baba ka

be rida bibiyon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole ye laashe sakina ko utha kar abid

aaj bhi aal pe ummat ka sitam jaari hai
be rida bibiyon ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
fath e abid ka ye elaan hai har soo majid
ye jo har qariye mein sarwar ki azadari hai
be rida bibiyon ki...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Chaar saal ki bachi
items.body:
sar jhukaye baithi hai chaar saal ki bacchi
pani ko tarasti hai chaar saal ki bacchi
<<DIVIDER>>
sab buzurg hasrat se dekhte hai chehre ko
soghwaar baithi hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dete hai tasalli sab kya rabab kya zainab
jis ke paas jaati hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne baap ka laasha raat ke andhere mein
dhoondne nikalti hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwatein badalti hai uski laash maqtal mein
jis ka naam leti hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ki sadaon ne itna dil dukhaya hai
aahaton se darti hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
goshwaar chinte hai aur tamache lagte hai
girti hai sambhalti hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek pahaad bano ke dil pa aur tootega
lo jahan se uth'ti hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal tha baap ka seena waalida ka aanchal tha
ab lehad mein soti hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab ye haal hai ishrat peet'ti hai sar bano
jab bhi yaad aati hai chaar saal ki bacchi
sar jhukaye baithi hai...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Farshe azae sheh
items.body:
farshe aza e sheh ki azaan ya hussain hai
yani khuda jahan hai wahan ya hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbiriyat milegi khuda ki asaas mein
ghamkhwar jaante hai ye kaale libaas mein
kaabe ke bhi labon ka bayan ya hussain hai
farshe aza e sheh ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
qurbat mein jab nijaat ka aaya tha marhala
bole malayeka hai amal koi to bata
maine ye keh diya tha ke haan ya hussain hai
farshe aza e sheh ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
har saans keh rahi hai ke tujh par salaam hai
tu jannati hai tujhpe jahannam haram hai
teri to zindagi mein rawayan ya hussain hai
farshe aza e sheh ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke baad hai ye bhi to maujiza
hota jahan jahan tha mere rab ka tazkira
har us jagah pe wirde zaban ya hussain hai
farshe aza e sheh ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor aaj bhi hai wahin par ruki hui
gardan jahan hussain ki sookhi hui kati
zehra wahin pe nauha kuna ya hussain hai
farshe aza e sheh ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil kusha ke aur payambar ke bain hai
haye hussain khaaliq e akbar ke bain hai
dono jahan mein aah o fughan ya hussain hai
farshe aza e sheh ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasir ye keh rahe hai sar e arsh ambiya
farshe azaa pe bhej de hum ko bhi ay khuda
muslim ke aaj lab pe wahan ya hussain hai
farshe aza e sheh ki...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Goonj uthi allahu
items.body:
sheh ne kaha bete se utho akbar jawan
uthjao do azan allahu akbar allahu akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
goonj uthi allahu akbar ki sada maidan mein
hashr barpa ho gaya hai ya khuda maidan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri hai aaj hamshakle payambar ki azan
ab fizayein sun na payegi ye akbar ki azan
rehgaya hil kar dile shaahe huda maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath bete ko liye shabbir qaime mein gaye
ruqsate akbar hai bole shaahe deen rote huwe
bibiyon ghar lutgaya akbar chala maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pakde hai daaman koi to thaame shana hai koi
ja raha hai ghar se akbar ya janaza hai koi
sabki khwahish hai na jaye mahelaqa maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hai jiska laal wo hai fatema zehra ka laal
kuch to karlo sibte payambar ki ghurbat ka khayal
kalma goyo hai shabihe mustafa maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shor maqtal mein uthalo chal gaya barchi ka waar
hogaya hai asl mein naiza dile laila ka paar
kab faqat ek qalb akbar ka chida maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kha raha hai ran mein akbar thokare boodha padar
hai andhera uski ankhon mein nahi aata nazar
kis taraf aaye bata baba tera maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ne akbar ke seene se sina to khaynch li
jism kya larza zameene karbala hilne lagi
baap ke hathon pe beta margaya maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun shaja'at aur ahsan ho na ab nauha kuna
dekh payegi na chashme dehre akbar sa jawan
aagayi hai ye jawani ko qaza maidan mein
goonj uthi allahu akbar...
items.author: Shajaat Zaidi

items.title: Hogaye haath qalam
items.body:
hogaye haath qalam mashk bachayi na gayi
pyaas saqqa se sakina ki bujhayi na gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kya keh gaya bhai se alamdare jari
laash abbas ki sarwar se uthayi na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheen kar nehr ab aaram se sota hai koi
baad marne ke bhi qabze se taraai na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye re bekasi ye sayyede sajjad e hazeen
laash zindan se sakina ki uthayi na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash andhere mein sakina ki thi mohtaj e kafan
shamma tak shaam ke zindan mein jalayi na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se hai bahot door sakina ka mazaar
aaj tak baap se beti ki judaai na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe akbar pe ye laila ne kaha ro ro kar
haye kismat teri shaadi bhi rachayi na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khatm hai sayyede sajjad pe ye tarze jafa
phir imamat kabhi kanton pe chalayi na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu e shaah mein ek teer tha haath uth na sake
laash asghar ki kaleje se lagayi na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk gaya haath mera haath tak aate hi viqar
mujse abbas ki tasveer banayi na gayi
hogaye haath qalam...
items.author: Viqar Nagri

items.title: Hussain tere lahoo
items.body:
hussain tere lahoo ki khushboo
falak ke daaman se aa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khoone na-haq chupega kyun kar
jise ye dunya chupa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain laasha jawan ka le kar
chale hai maqtal se suye qaima
magar zaeefi qadam qadam par
utha rahi hai bitha rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun hai jiski guftugu mein
ali ka lehja jhalak raha hai
ye kaun hai jiske walwalon mein
hussainiyat jagmaga rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba-rehna sar hai ali ki beti
magar wohi azmat e mohamed
wo jiski khaatir bhara hua ghar
luta ke karbal se aa rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukari dashte bala mein zainab
kahan ho abbas laut aao
utha ke haathon mein khali kooza
sakina tum ko bula rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bujha ke paikan se pyaas apni
tu garam reti pe so raha hai
tujhe khayalon mein ab bhi asghar
rabab jhoola jhula rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayare shaam o dayare kufa
jo hoke aayi hai binte zehra
nabi ke rauze pe jaate jaate
nishan rasan ke chupa rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan hai maqtal kahan madina
tadap ke boli ye umme salma
jo ghash se jaagi hai teri sughra
bas ek nauha suna rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...

items.title: Jab qaid hui shaam
items.body:
jab qaid hui shaam ke zindan mein sakina
kehti thi ye rokar mere baba mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
lo jald khabar aan ke dum ghut-ta hai mera
is shaam ke zindan mein bala ka hai andhera
mar jaye na is aalame ghurbat mein sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye haal sakina ka huwa zulm o sitam se
kano se lahoo behta hai ruksaar hai neele
mar jaye na is aalame ghurbat mein sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
is darja andhera hai koi shamma jalade
jaa kar koi abbas e dilawar ko bulaade
mar jaye na is aalame ghurbat mein sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun ghurkiyan dete hai mujhe aan ke aada
kuch dayr ko aajaiye pyare mere baba
mar jaye na is aalame ghurbat mein sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
is darja sitamgaron ne bachi ko sataya
us shaam ke zindan mein dam ghut gaya uska
ab khaak pe zindan mein soti hai sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun syed-e-sajjad ka dil kaamp raha hai
laasha jo sakina ka andhere mein rakha hai
ab khaak pe zindan mein soti hai sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise kahoo gham se jigar phat'ta hai mere
kurta jo badan pe tha wohi uska kafan tha
ab khaak pe zindan mein soti hai sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch bhi na meinasar tha wahan ghusl o kafan ko
kurte mein hi dafna diya bhai ne behen ko
ab khaak pe zindan mein soti hai sakina
jab qaid hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ahle haram laut ke hai aagaye ashraf
sajjad basad aah-o-fughan kehte thay ashraf
ab shaam ke zindan mein tanha hai sakina
jab qaid hui...
items.author: Ashraf

items.title: Karbala ke ban
items.body:
karbala ke ran mein jab gardan kati shabbir ki
jang is ke baad zainab ne lasi shabbir ki
<<DIVIDER>>
apne pyaron ke janaze sab utha kar le gaye
reh gayi jo dasht mein wo laash thi shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye marte waqt akbar ne kiya pani talab
dil ko thaame kaamp uthi bekasi shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha daane bikhar jaaye kisi tasbeeh ke
asr e ashoora ko yun aulaad thi shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte qaimon se uthi zainab to keh kar ya ali
shaam mein paywast kar di roshni shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ki be-rehm shab mein dayr tak jaagi hui
shaam ke zindan mein bacchi so gayi shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
tum rehaai paa chuke waqte safar bhi hai magar
khaafile waalon kahan hai laadli shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop ke sehra se guzra tha mera pyasa qalam
phir bhi kab likhi gayi tashna labi shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e majlis log saare jaa chuke ghar se magar
dayr tak us ghar mein maa roti rahi shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
<<DIVIDER>>
majlison mein baatiye fikre husaini ki ziya
is ko kehte hai musaddiq naukri shabbir ki
karbala ke ran mein jab…
items.author: Musaddiq Lakhani

items.title: Khaali jhoola bulata
items.body:
khaali jhoola bulata hai kab aaoge asghar
maa ka dil ghabrata hai kab aaoge asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
har soo dasht mein shaam e ghariban
ke saaye lehrane lage
maut ki baahein phail gayi
tanhaai ke baadal chaane lage
suraj run mein qatl hua
darya khoon mein doob gaya
sannata tadpata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash agar bas chalta mera
maut se tujh ko bacha laati
qaime se khud ran mein aa kar mai
teer galay par khaa leti
rooth gaye kyun ay dilbar
jaata hai jab koi baher
shaam ko wo aa jaata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer galay par khaake bataya
qurbani kya hoti hai
has has ke yun dam toda hai
maut bhi tujh par roti hai
khoob hui ye mehmani
paaya na marte dam pani
teer koi yun khaata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum hi batao jaaun kahan mai
band hai sab raahein meri
jholi mein ab kuch bhi nahi
veeran hui baahein meri
beta mai tujhse bichad gayi
dunya meri ujad gayi
gham mujhe khaye jaata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aane waale aaye magar
is tarha dilaase deke gaye
aag lagayi qaimon mein
ghar loota chadar leke gaye
haal kahun kya ay jaani
pursa deti hai veerani
dard mujhe samjhata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke dasht mein aakar
phoot gayi qismat meri
ran ki zameen se uthke zara sa
dekh to lo haalat meri
kaise kahun kyun jeeti hoon
khoon ke aansu peeti hoon
moo ko kaleja aata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein bhi bhoole se meri
aankhon mein agar neend aati hai
khwaab mein chehra dekh ke tera
chaunk ke maa uth jaati hai
kho gayi jhoole ki dori
kis ko sunaun mai lori
haath yuhin lehrata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqta likhte likhte nayyar
mujhko achanak aisa laga
jaise kisi ne rakh diya laa kar
mere tasavvur mein jhoola
aamir ne nauha jo padha
dil ko ye mehsoos hua
loriyan koi sunaata hai
kab aaoge asghar
khaali jhoola bulata hai...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Lori phir se
items.body:
aayi jab ran mein asre ashoora
ek qayamat ka tha samaan barpa
jab na sambhale hussain ghode par
gir ke tehre zameen pe teeron par
haye har zulm seh rahe thay hussain
aur maqtal mein keh rahe thay hussain
apni aghosh mein sulalo maa
lori phir se wohi sunado maa
ay mere laal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpane se hai mera ek sapna
waada poora mai kar sakun apna
aisi mujhko to ab dua do maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer o talwaar ki chubhan se nidhaal
hua sadmon ki mai thakan se nidhaal
mujhko godhi mein ab sulalo maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna sookha hai mera dekho dahan
hogaya paash paash mera badan
teer tan se mere nikalo maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha maadar ko to ye sheh ne kaha
chalni teeron ne kar diya kurta
apni chadar mujhe udhado maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushmani saari inki mujhse hai
ye faqat mere khoon ke pyase hai
apni gardan ko tum hatalo maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk aankhein meri bahati hai
yaadein bachpan ki phir satati hai
apne pehlu mein tum litalo maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho amma ye phasliyan tooti
kaise dekhogi haddiyan tooti
gir raha hoon mujhe sambhalo maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere pehlu mein jab bhi sota tha
raaton ko uth ke mai ye kehta tha
mujhko pani zara pilado maa
lori phir se wohi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dua shams aur aamir ki
amma kar do ye aarzoo poori
apne rauze pe tum bulalo maa
lori phir se wohi...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Man buka lal hussain
items.body:
man buka lal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho maqtal may ali khaak udate hai nabi
halq e sheh par hai churi
man buka lal hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye majlis may ali binte zehra o nabi
hai qayamat ki ghadi
man buka lal hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye barchi ki ani qalbe akbar may lagi
qalbe laila may lagi
man buka lal hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye abbas e jari mashk pyason ki chidi
tashnagi haath mali
man buka lal hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa dekha na jari teer ki zad par hasi
ro pada dekho shaqi
man buka lal hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah e deen jaane ali teri wo tashnalabi
bekasi roti rahi
man buka lal hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki dunya may pali dekhiye aal e nabi
qaid hokar hai chali
man buka lal hussain…

items.title: Mayyat khuda ke sher
items.body:
mayyat khuda ke sher ki suye najaf chali
har samt ek shor hai maula ali ali
mayyat khuda ke sher…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahzade shahzadiyan baba ko rote hai
haq ke wali ko khalq ke maula ko rote hai
zehra ke ghar may kaisi musibat ye aagayi
mayyat khuda ke sher…
<<DIVIDER>>
deewaro dar hai nauhakuna shehr soghwaar
sar ko patakte jaate hai maula ke jaanisar
ek tayghe zehr baar ne dunya ujaad di
mayyat khuda ke sher…
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloomiyat ka haq ka madadgar mar gaya
bewa'on ka yateemon ka ghamkhar mar gaya
mushkil kusha juda hua mushkil ye aagayi
mayyat khuda ke sher…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki nazrein baba ko payengi ab kahan
kulsoom roti jaati hai le le ke hichkiyan
baba ki yaad aati hai har waqt har ghadi
mayyat khuda ke sher…
<<DIVIDER>>
lo soghwaron mehre wilayat hai shaam ki
mayyat uthao kaandho par zakhmi imam ki
kehte chalo yahan se najaf tak ali ali
mayyat khuda ke sher…

items.title: Pabasta e zanjeer
items.body:
pabastae zanjeer ke chehre ko bhi dekho
ay sham ke baazariyo lehje ko bhi dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
lehje may wohi faatahe khyber ki garaj hai
karaar ki jaraar ki safdar ki garaj hai
pyase ke garajte hue khutbe ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sar ke jo naize pe tilawat may hai mashghool
wo sar to azal se bhi ibadat may hai mashghool
us sar ke zara khaak may sajde ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab log ye kis sar ki ziarat ke liye hai
shayad ke payambar ki ziarat ke liye hai
hamshakle payambar ke kaleje ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
nanha sa wo ek sar bhi sare noke sina hai
jispe ke faqat teer se katne ka nishan hai
be-ghairaton cheh maah ke bache ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan may bilakte hue bachon ko to dekha
shabbir ke jalte hue qaimon ko to dekha
naizon se ridaon ke utarne ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
honton pe bhatiji ke raha naam chacha ka
is naam ne har dukh may diya kaam dawa ka
is naam pe zaalim ke tamache ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid hai falak door bahot aur zameen sakht
bazaar se darbar ki manzil hai kahin sakht
is baat pe zainab ke tadapne ko bhi dekho
pabastae zanjeer…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Ab aaj se bin
items.body:
hai dunya mein beti bahot aise bacche
sada baap nahi jeete hai kisi ke
ab aaj se bin baap ki kehlaogi beti
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bali sakina se ye farmate thay ro kar
ab aaj se bin baap ki kehlaogi beti
<<DIVIDER>>
aa lag jaa kaleje se sukoon e dil e sarwar
ab aaj se bin baap ki kehlaogi beti
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch lamhon mein ghir jaunga mai fauje jafa mein
sab khoon ke pyase hai mere karbobala mein
phayrega layeen sookhe galay par mere khanjar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ke is dehr mein dastoor hai aise
zinda nahi rehte hai sada baap kisi ke
jo dehr mein aaya hai usay jaana hai dilbar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
maanind yateemon ki tujhe aah mai banadun
aa tujhko mai poshak e yateemi bhi pinhadun
maare na kahin shimr tamache tere rukh par
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein chali jao meri jaan sakina
sab hogaye ab deen pe qurban sakina
imdad ko aayenge na abbas e dilawar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa tujhko kaleje se mai ek baar lagalun
ek baar tujhe aur mai seene pa sulalun
ab aaj se soyega mere seene pa asghar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
waada karo mujhse ay meri raahate jaani
ro ro ke na zainab se meri maangogi pani
jab royegi tu royega naize pe mera sar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab zid na karo chodo meri beti aba ko
kuch lamho mein cheenege udoo teri rida ko
ho jaogi ab aaj se be-maqna o chadar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab haafiz o nasir tera allah sakina
hoga na meinassar tujhe ab mera ye seena
ye khaakh ki ab aaj se hoga tera bistar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir ye sada sun ke tadapti thi sakina
aalam yehi farmate thay jab shaahe madina
ab baad mere tum ko satayenge sitamgar
ab aaj se bin baap ki...
items.author: Alam Sultanpuri

items.title: Andhere dasht may
items.body:
andhere dasht mein dukhiya sakina kyun chali aayi
tan e be-sar ye kehta tha sakina kyun chali aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
pade hai khaak par tukde yahan talwaron naize ke
na zakhm aaye koi gehra sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere dasht mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
bachaye ksi tarha tum ko sitamgar ki jafa'on se
bahot majboor hai baba sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere dasht mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
na do awaaz itne karb se sehra e khooni mein
ajal ka hai yahan pehra sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere dasht mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil e baba kya guzri tumhe is haal mein paa kar
ye pehne khoon bhara kurta sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere dasht mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhatak jaogi ran mein kaun pahuncha-ega qaimon tak
nahi koi aneez aisa sakina kyun chali aayi
andhere dasht mein…
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Ay dilbarane jafare
items.body:
ay dilbarane jafare tayyar alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
binte ali ye bachon se kehti thi baar baar
ran ko sidharo auno mohamed ye maa nisar
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
jafar ka ifteqar badana jihad mein
nana ki apne shan dikhana jihad mein
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
sher e khuda ki beti ke tum dono sher ho
maidan mein jao fatha mein ab kuch na dayr ho
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
har baat apne dil ke siwa ho to baat hai
wo ran pade ke hashr bapa ho to baat hai
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayre rahe sipah magar moo na modna
hyder ki yaadgar ho maidan na chorna
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr o umar ke sar jo utaro to khush hoo mai
dushman ko jhoom jhoom ke maaro to khush hoo mai
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to ye arzoo hai ke tum ran mein kaam aao
chehre ke badle khoon bhare chehre mujhe dikhao
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon zaeef mamu ko zehmat na dijiyo
laashe uthaye bhai to jumbish na kijiyo
ay dilbarane jafare…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase jo aaoge to sila degi tum ko maa
khud daud kar galay se laga legi maa
ay dilbarane jafare…
items.author: Zameer Akhtar

items.title: Dekho abbas chale
items.body:
mashk kaandhe pe liye ya ali kehke uthe
dekha jibreel ne jab darr gaye kehne lage
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho abbas chale dekho abbas chale
<<DIVIDER>>
alqama khair mana wo alamdar e wafa
khaa ke zehra ki qasam saath zainab ki dua
teri jaanib hai chala kaun rokega usay
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulfein wal lail hasham aankhein wan najm baham
tayghe hyder ki tarha dodo ab unke thay kham
seena tha misle asa baazu parcham se khule
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab alam unka khul;a hogayi saaf fiza
boli panje ki chamak marhaba salle alaa
alqama kehni lagi maut koi na bahe
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
daf'atan kaami zameen aagaya sab ko yaqeen
lashkare shaam ki ab khairiat koi nahi
al-amaan ki thi sada ghaiz aankhon may liye
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase bachon ne kaha tishnagi hogi fana
chal ke qaimon ki taraf aayega ab darya
khaali koozon ne kaha lelo haathon may mujhe
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi sakina ki sada mil ke karte hai dua
ya ali kije madad hai jo ghusse may chacha
jaa ke darya pe unhe jang na yaad rahe
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
nagahaan shor hua sher ghode se gira
aas bachon ki gayi jab alam jhukne laga
jhuk gayi sheh ki kamar ro ke farmane lage
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash sakina ko hua khaak pe kooza gira
khud ba khud girne lagi sar se zainab ki rida
boli darbaar may ab mai pukarungi kise
dekho abbas chale...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt rehaan tha kya ho ke be-baazu gira
saahil e zulm pe jab wo alamdar e wafa
haye us waqt raza keh ke shabbir gire
dekho abbas chale...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Farshe majlis pe
items.body:
ay azadare shaahe karbobala
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
tum se lene hussain ka pursa
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
kya ye kaafi nahi hai rone ko
apni chashme aza se tum dekho
leke ek khoon may bhara kurta
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
boond pani nahi mila us ko
aaj tak bhi hussain pyasa hai
apni aankhon se do unhe darya
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath phaile huwe hai bibi ke
ek kafan ek rida ki taalib hai
kya karega unhe koi hadya
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo aun aur mohamed thay
jin ke laashon pe maa nahi royi
maa ko beti ke gham ka do pursa
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
uski mehwi saja ke ay logon
koi ghatri bana ke le aao
karne qasim ki laash par girya
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao us par kare bapa matam
jis ke seene may ek sina tooti
karne akbar ke gham may wavaila
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke laashe pe jaa ke royi thi
jis ke baazu utha ke royi thi
koi ooncha kare alam uska
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye amal khair bhi karo yasir
tum se raazi batool ho jaye
tum jhulaao sagheer ka jhoola
farshe majlis pe aagayi zehra
ay azadare shaahe...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Hussain tere lahoo ki
items.body:
hussain tere lahoo ki khushboo
falak ke daaman se aa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khoon e nahaq chupega kyun kar
jise ye dunya chupa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sabr tera teri ibadat
wo raah e haq mein teri shahadat
teri sadaqat ki daastanein
zamane bhar ko suna rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam aalam ko ye dikhaya
kata ke gardan ko deen bachaya
magar ye ummat abhi bhi aale
nabi ko dekho sata rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb maula ki bekasi pe
ghareeb maula ki bebasi pe
abhi talak wo zameen e karbal
lahoo se aansu baha rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan bete ki laash lene
chale hai maqtal ko shaah e waala
magar zaeefi qadam qadam par
utha rahi hai bitha rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
barehna sar hai ali ki beti
magar wohi azmat e mohamed
wo jis ki khaatir bhara hua ghar
luta ke karbal se aa rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun hai jis ki guftagu mein
ali ka lehja jhalak raha hai
ye kaun hai jis ke walwalo mein
hussainiyat jag maga rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb hai ye karbala ka manzar
rawan hai sheh ke galay pe khanjar
zamana karwat badal raha hai
sakina aansu baha rahi hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain maidan e karbala mein
ajeeb moti luta rahe hai
jawan bete bhatije bhai
ki laashein tanha utha rahe hai
hussain tere lahoo ki...

items.title: Karbala ke ban mein
items.body:
karbala ke ban mein koi khafila loota gaya
ay azeezo khandane mustufa loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
hoti hai maa ko tamanna naujawan dulha bane
umme laila ka wo armaan bekhata loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ki betiyon ka aasra abbas thay
zainab o kulsoom ka wo aasra loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
asre ashoora ko do bache atash se mar gaye
nehr par pyason ke dil ka muddua loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
gyarveen shab roshni dekhi to zainab ne kaha
zaalimo lootoge ab kya ghar bhara loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
boli sughra bibiyon ki godiyon ko dekh kar
bibiyon nanha sa wo ghuncha bhi kya loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
ya khuda loota na jaye koi kunba is tarha
jis tarha zehra ka kunba ja-baja loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke zindan mein aakar margayi binte hussain
maa phupi behno ke dil ka aasra loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
hulle jannat ke khuda ne bheje jinke waaste
pairahan tak us shahe mazloom ka loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…

items.title: Khaali jhoola hai
items.body:
jhoole mein khelne waale
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere ghuncha dahan khaali jhoola hai tera
tha ye ek maa ka sukhan khaali jhoola hai tera
<<DIVIDER>>
raas aaya nahi pardres mein jeena tujhko
dhoondti phirti hai godhon mein sakina tujhko
kaise bhoolegi behen khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko tanhaai bohat qabr ki tadpayegi
neend jangal mein mere laal kahan aayegi
hai yehi ranj o mahan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
beh gaye khwaab sabhi khoon ke fawware mein
asr se pehle mera chand tha gehware mein
lag gaya haye gahan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
laut aayega to lori bhi sunaungi tujhe
apni aaghosh mein mai leke sulaungi tujhe
hogi din bhar ki thakan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki aghosh se jaati nahi khushboo teri
usko tasveer nazar aati har soo teri
dil mai hoti hai chubhan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aghosh mein aaja ke sawarun tujhko
tu hi batlade ke kya keh ke pukarun tujhko
naazishe shaah e zaman khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
pooche mamta se ke kya hota hai aulaad ka daagh
kar diya maut ne gul dasht mein jhoole ka charagh
ab kahan koi kiran khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
garmi e qabr tujhe aab o hawa kya degi
ye kadi dhoop tujhe dasht mein jhulsa degi
phool jaisa hai badan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi maa aamir o akhtar ye sada deti hai
apni awaaz se jhoole ko hila deti hai
aa bhi jaa jaane chaman khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Kufe mein karbala ke
items.body:
kufe mein karbala ke hai aasaar ya hussain
sher e khuda pe chal gayi talwaar ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak udh rahi hai masjide kufa mein har taraf
phir lut gayi rasool ki sarkar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko dekh dekh ke rote hai murtaza
yaad aa raha hai shaam ka bazaar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
behno ke ashk pochne waale to aap hai
haye magar sakina ke rukhsaar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tehrega tera zarbon pe jaa kar ye silsila
sajde mein aaj pehla hua waar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
koozon mein sheer aaya to takte thay baar baar
tere labon ko hyder e karraar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa raha hai nazha mein maula ko wo samaa
zainab hai aur koocha o bazaar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab maa ke saath baap ko royengi betiyan
gham aur dega eid ka tehwaar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar kiya ali ne shahadat se ehtemaam
kufe se chunke apne wafadaar ya hussain
kufe mein karbala ke...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Loriyan deke jise
items.body:
loriyan de ke jise zindan ne sulaya hoga
seena baba ka tujhe yaad to aaya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
khaakh ka aaj bichona hai naseebon mein tere
haa kabhi baap ne tujhe seene pe sulaya hoga
loriya deke jise…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas baba ki tujhe yaad to aayi hogi
pani fizza ne jo honton pe lagaya hoga
loriya deke jise…
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se lahoo behta hai ruqsar hai neele
is haal mein dushwaar hai ek saans bhi lena
neend aati nahi khaak ke bistar pe mujhe to
amma mujhe kyun milta nahi baba ka seena
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr bhoolegi bhala kaise tamache tere
chain masooma ne mar kar bhi na paaya hoga
loriya deke jise…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye zanjeeron mein jakda tha janaza tera
kaise bemaar ne zindan se uthaya hoga
loriya deke jise…
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein ro ro ke ye kehti thi sakina
khulwado rasan tum mujhe baba se milado
gar ye nahi mumkin to meri pyari phupi jaan
soorat ali asghar ki mujhe la ke dikha do
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne bhi dil mein basaya hai tera gham bibi
usko jawaad ke nauhe ne rulaya hoga
loriya deke jise…
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Mayyat se fatema
items.body:
bebasi hum ko chod ke girya chali gayi
allah ne bula liya amma chali gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat se fatema ki jo lipte rahe hussain
amma ki band aankhon ko rote rahe hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
amma se kehde baba ke uth jayein ek baar
khamosh kyun hai baatein karein hota hoon nisaar
faryad meri sunlo ye kehte rahe hussain
mayyat se fatema ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar mujhko haathon se khaana khila do maa
mai hoon hussain mujhko to seene lagalo maa
kuch bolti nahi hai tadapte rahe hussain
mayyat se fatema ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera khayal rakhega kaun ab tumhare baad
pani mujhe pilayega kaun ab tumhare baad
hasrat se bas janaze ko takte rahe hussain
mayyat se fatema ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise jiyunga amma yahan par tere bagahir
veeraniyan bhi kaatengi dar dar tere baghair
aansu baha ke bain ye karte rahe hussain
mayyat se fatema ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin maa ke zindagi mein andhera hai chaa gaya
ye zeest se hamari ujaalon ko khaa gaya
ro ro ke haal dil ka sunaate rahe hussain
mayyat se fatema ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ko khuda ka waasta deta hai mera dil
tum ko kafan mein dekh ke phat'ta hai mera dil
aankhon ko kholo maa se kehte rahe hussain
mayyat se fatema ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sayib wo shor o shain wo bacchon ki thi fughan
tukde kaleje hota tha rota tha aasman
mukhtar ro ro maa ko bulaate rahe hussain
mayyat se fatema ki...
items.author: Sayib Zaidi

items.title: Aabrue la ilaha
items.body:
aabru e la-ilaha sajda-e-shabbir hai
tere dam se ya hussaina naara-e-takbeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
likh diya khoon se hussaina parchame islaam par
sar katana raahe haq mein deen ki tauqeer hai
aabru e la-ilaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashaye akbar utha kar bole shahe karbala
khaakh-o-khoon mein sarware kounain ki tasveer hai
aabru e la-ilaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye ayoob aa kar sabr ki manzil zara
haaton pe shahe zaman ke laasha-e-baysheer hai
aabru e la-ilaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha dafnaye zainab laash ko teri hussain
haaton mein rassi bandhi hai sar khule hamsheer hai
aabru e la-ilaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha irfan hota hai farize haq adaa
khoon mein doobi hui peshani-e-shabbir hai
aabru e la-ilaha...
items.author: Irfan

items.title: Ab aankhein khol
items.body:
jab suni shaah ne awaaz jawan bete ki
laash par aake ye farmane lage sibte nabi
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aankhein khol do akbar sirhane aagaya baba
zaeefi mein jawan laasha uthane aagaya baba
<<DIVIDER>>
guzar jayenge hum is imtehan se ya ali keh kar
nikal jayegi ye barche na ghabrana mere dilbar
tumhara haath seene se hatane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
unhone kya samajh rakha tha akbar be-sahara hai
ishare se bata do kisne kisne tum ko maara hai
ulat kar aastin mehshar uthaane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
chali aayi thi aadhe raaste tak saani e zehra
badi mushkil se bheja hai qasam de kar teri beta
behen kaise tadapti hai batane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha tha kisi ne seene mein tumhare tod kar naiza
ye manzar dekh kar shabbir zinda reh na payega
khabar kar do usay barchi chudane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
lade ho dayr tak thak to gaye hoge mere dilbar
mujhe mat rokna hargiz tumhe meri qasam akbar
tumhare chand se baazu dabane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaata dhoom se mayyat agar hota madine mein
kafan mai de nahi sakta yehi hai dard seene mein
amaama tumko nana ka udhaane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo rota dekhti mujhko tadap jaati meri madar
mai khul kar ro nahi paaya mohamed ke janaze par
jo aansu reh gaye thay wo bahane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar kaise lagegi ab badan saanso se khaali hai
kalayi se tumhari kaali dori khulne waali hai
phupi ki aakhri mannat badhane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar aa jayega tumko behen hai ab kahan beta
utho dekho hamari ungliyon ke darmiyan beta
tumhe sughra ki tanhaai dikhane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
<<DIVIDER>>
padhi nade ali le kar chale sheh laasha e akbar
takkalum aayi pehlu se sada e faatahe khyber
mere beta teri himmat badhane aagaya baba
ab aankhein khol do...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Abbas mera maula
items.body:
saqi abbas hai maula
abbas mera maula abbas mera aaqa
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sher karbala ka farzand fatema ka
abbas mera maula abbas mera aaqa
<<DIVIDER>>
har dard ki dawa hai ibne shah e huda hai
rag rag mein khoon e hyder ghazi ki bolta hai
salaar e karbala hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk o alam mein jaan hai ghairat ka aasman hai
sar ta qadam jari mein allah jaanta hai
hyder ka dabdaba hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram ka saqqa dhaaras shah e zaman ki
pardes ki fiza mein umeed hai behan ki
zainab ka aasra hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
chullu mein le ke pani rasm e wafa nibhayi
tashna dahan ke lab tak ek boond bhi na aayi
ye zabt ka khuda hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani pe apna parcham lehra ke keh raha tha
ab taa abad rahega darya pe mera qabza
pakka ye qaul ka hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu qalam huwe to wapas na ran se aaya
pani baha tha jitna utna hi khoon bahaya
kis darja ba-haya hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ke alam ko jab se zainab ne hai sambhala
raunaq bana hua hai har majlis e aza ka
shabbir ki dua hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ki ye sabeelein asghar ki hai daleelein
abbas ki wafa ko ahl wafa se poochein
zinda ye maujiza hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir hussain ka hai rehaan karbala bhi
zainab ki aarzu bhi zehra ki hai dua bhi
hyder ka laadla hai sher e khuda ka saaya
abbas mera maula...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Andhere dete hai
items.body:
andhere dete hai pehra lehad pe bibi ki
ujaala aa nahi sakta lehad pe bibi ki
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain shaam dhale kehte honge akbar se
chalo chale mere beta lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhukaye rakhna khabardaar apne nazron ko
ke roz aati hai zehra lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin ye hazrat e abbas to nahi hai dil
ye kaun karta hai girya lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek shaam ko shamma jalane aati hai
janabe zainab e kubra lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai koi maa jo ye saydaniyo se kehti hai
rida baghair na aana lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda karega takallum wo din bhi aayega
padhunga jaake ye nauha lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Ay doston kami na
items.body:
ay doston kami na ho ab shor o shain mein
zainab bhi hai aza e shahe mashraqain mein
phat jaye dil wo dard hai dukhiya ke bain mein
lo fatema bhi aagayi bazme hussain mein
chehre pe khaak baal pareshan kiye huwe
godhi mein ek nanha sa laasha liye huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
goya ye keh rahi hai batool e falak maqam
ay bewatan ke taziyadaron mera salaam
matlab ye hai ke aaj majalis hui tamam
ruqsat talab hai ahle aza maadar e imam
dil par hujoom hai gham o ranj o malaal ka
pursa batool o paak ko do unke laal ka
<<DIVIDER>>
rolo ke ye tazkira e gham bhi khatm hai
fasle aza e sarwar e aalam bhi khatm hai
matam karo ke aaj ye matam bhi khatm hai
majlis bhi marsiya bhi moharram bhi khatm hai
hyder bhi sab ke saath hi aansu bahate hai
yaaro hussain taaziya khane se jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay rone waalon aankhon se darya e khoon bahao
matam karo hussain ka sar par khaak udao
farshe aza lapet ke rakho alam badhao
das din ka mehman chala taaziya uthao
ashkon ki nazr de ke imame anaam ko
ruqsat karo hussain e alaihis salaam ko
<<DIVIDER>>
ro kar kaho ke ay shahe abraar alwida
ay kaarwan e dard ke salaar alwida
ay ummate rasool ke ghamkhwar alwida
kadiyal jawan pisar ke azadaar alwida
kya jaane agle saal jiye ya marenge hum
par qabr mein bhi taziyadari karenge hum
<<DIVIDER>>
ay be-dayar o be-sar o samaan alwida
ay ummate rasool ke mehman alwida
hyder ki rooh fatema ki jaan alwida
ay mustafa ki godh ke quran alwida
ashre ke khatm hote hi hum se bichad gaye
maula tumhare taaziya khane ujad gaye

items.title: Baba tumhari fatema
items.body:
kitni ghareeb hogayi baba tumhari fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
jisko kaha tha maa tum ne usko hi sab ke saamne
jhooti kaha gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar jab se dekha hai kitni zaeef lagti hoon
pehchan yun karati hoon ro ro ke khud batati hoon
haan mai hoon fatema
kitni ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beton ke saamne baba maine tamacha khaaya hai
kuch bhi nahi wo kehta hai bas sehma sehma rehta hai
beta hassan mera
kitni ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi hai ungliyan itni tasbeeh pad nahi sakti
kunfuz ne taziyane se teri fatema ke haathon pe
aisa sitam kiya
kitni ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dar pe aap rukte thay us dar pe aag le aaye
apne hi dar ke sholon mein dekhi hai teri beti ne
yasrab mein karbala
kitni ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat thi wo tamache ki mai moo ke bal zameen pe giri
itna wo haath tha bhari toota hai goshwara bhi
zakhmi hai fatema
kitni ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba madine waalon ne maari hai thokarein mujhko
wahid ye jurm tha mera mujhse ali bachane ka
badla liya gaya
kitni ghareeb hogayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek tooti qabr se mohsin awaaz ab bhi aati hai
ye kaise hogaya baba mai zinda reh gayi mera
mohsin nahi bacha
kitni ghareeb hogayi...
items.author: Mohsin Jaffri

items.title: Dekho hurr aa raha
items.body:
fauj e sitam ko chod ke suye shah e huda
dekho hurr aa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pyase ke paas pyaas wo apni bujhayega
dekho hurr aa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pehnega thodi dayr mein wo khoon bhara kafan
aankhon pe pattiyan hai to haathon mein hai rasan
mujrim ki tarha soorate qaidi bana hua
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula meri khata'on ko kar dijiye bihil
bete ke saath aata hai sharminda o khajil
lene ko us ke shaah ka akbar bhi jayega
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe wo qadmon se sheh ke lipat gaya
bola khata maaf ho ay sibte mustafa
shah ne utha ke usko galay se laga liya
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza se ro ke kehne lage khwahar e imam
is taazah mehman ko hamara kaho salam
binte al? ke qaime mein pahunchi jo ye sada
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr e jari ke lene ko badne lage hussain
abbas se ye kehne lage shaah e mashraqain
bhaiya hamari fatha ka aelaan ho gaya
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle jo ibne hurr gaya aur qatl ho gaya
laasha uthaane sheh bhi chale hurr ke hamnawa
fauje adoo ne haste huwe shor ye kiya
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha utha ke sheh chale suye qaimagah
hurr ka kamar pe haath tha aur thi labon pe aah
maqtal mein goonjti thi kisi bibi ki sada
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bete ke baad hurr ne bhi izne wigah liya
jangal se jaise sher ne wo hamla kar diya
thi al'amaan ke shor mein dushman ki ye sada
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr ki jabeen pe baandha jo rumaal e fatema
shabbir ne ay majid o mukhtar di nida
amma tumhare bete ka shedayi mar gaya
dekho hurr aa raha hai
fauj e sitam ko chod ke...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Faryaad
items.body:
zulm kya kya na huwe mere nabi aap ke baad
chain se aale nabi reh na saki aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
zul asheera ke lage zakhm saqeefa mein khule
saamne aagaye nasoor e khafi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
tera mimbar teri mehrab gawahi denge
sayyeda bar sare darbar gayi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre zahra pe faqad zabt ka daama choota
roye bas ek dafa maula ali aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon jiska tha tera khoon badan tera badan
khoon mein hai ghark wohi farqe ali aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
raakib e doshe nabuwwat wo tere shaahzade
haif unse hui bayyat talabi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
teer yun barse janaze pe hassan ke nana
usko pehlu mein zameen mil na saki aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
haal kaise ho bayan sibte nabi ka aaqa
kaat kar legaya sar ek shaqi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
aale athaar se phirne ka nateeja hai raza
hurmate ummate aasi na rahi aap ke baad
items.author: Hasan Raza Rizvi

items.title: Gurohe chaak gariban
items.body:
jo fatema ki rag e jaan ali ka hai dilbar
hussain minni kahe jisko shaafa e mehshar
wo jiska kar diya taraaj karbala mein ghar
musibaton ki hadein khatm ho gayi jis par
guroh e chaak gariban salaam karta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qayam e sheh ka nigehban hussain ka bhai
wo jisne ki thi sakina ki ran mein saqqayi
lab e furaat kate haath jiske maut aayi
wafa ne jis se jahan mein hayaat e nau paayi
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
na maa ka doodh na pani mila jise wo sagheer
wo jisko dekh ke tukde jigar ho wo baysheer
wo jisko le gaye maidan mein hazrat e shabbir
wo jiska nanha gala aur hurmala ka teer
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo quwwat e dil e laila tha khoobroo wo jawan
wo jisko dekh ke hota tha mustafa ka gumaan
wo jisne ain e jawani mein khaayi dil pa sina
wo jiske byaah ka maadar ko reh gaya armaan
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
wohi jo thay shahe karbobala ke dil ka chain
wo kamsini mein jinhe maut aayi haye hussain
tha jinki maut se qaimon mein ek shor o shain
wo yani zainab e aali nasab ke noor e ain
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jisko seene pa apne sulaate thay sarwar
wo jiske kaano se tapka lahoo chinay gauhar
yateem jaan ke todi musibatein jis par
rahi aseeron ki jo shaam tak shareek e safar
guroh e chaak gariban...

items.title: Hogayi aah bepidar
items.body:
hogayi aah bepidar zainab
kam hai ab roye jis qadar zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj hai farshe gham pe ahle aza
baap ke gham may nauhagar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hil raha hai mazaar roti hai
maa ki turbat pe khole sar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok le aansuon ko apne zara
ab to rona hai umr bhai zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibteda hai abhi to kufe may
tujhko hona hai dar badar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna ek din dikhayegi
shaam tujhko yehi sehar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
majma e aam hoga galiyon may
aur hogi barehna sar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai jis tarha yateem basar
ab karo umr yun basar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raunaqein uth rahi hai dunya ki
jaa raha hai tera pidar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sayyeda aagayi hai jannat se
saara matam kada hai ghar zainab
hogayi aah bepidar...

items.title: Jab raat ko ghar
items.body:
aaja ali akbar aaja ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
jab raat ko ghar mein na tumhe payegi sughra
mar jayegi sughra
deewaron se sar dekhna takrayegi sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mujhe ab tum se shikayat nahi koi
ro ro ke tumhe jaan se guzar jayegi sughra
mar jayegi sughra
jab raat ko ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab waqte fajr hota hai yaad aate ho akbar
mai raah dekhti hoon kab aaoge akbar
ashkon se wazoo kar ke tujhe maangu khuda se
awaaz e azan mujhko sunao ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz e azan kaan mein jab aayegi baba
tanhaai mein bhai ko kahan payegi sughra
mar jayegi sughra
jab raat ko ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ghar se gaye jab se mera haal na poocha
tum khud hi kaho kis tarha jee payegi sughra
mar jayegi sughra
jab raat ko ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan tha sehra tere sar pe mai sajaati
naazon se tujhe bhaiya dukha mai banaati
afsos tera laasha haye ran mein pada hai
pardes mein ho kaise tumhe dekhne aati
<<DIVIDER>>
veeran nazar aayega jab aap ka hujra
aankhon se lahoo qalb ka barsayegi sughra
mar jayegi sughra
jab raat ko ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan magar kaun ye sughra ko bataye
jab aisi madine mein khabar payegi sughra
mar jayegi sughra
jab raat ko ghar...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Kaabae dil gira
items.body:
kaaba e dil gira diya haye
rauza e paak dha diya haye
<<DIVIDER>>
jo nishan sabr ki alaamat tha
us nishan ko mita diya haye
kaaba e dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke pehlu pe dar giraya tha
us ka rauza gira diya haye
kaaba e dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jo sarkar hi ka tukda thi
uska rutba bhula diya haye
kaaba e dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke dar par nabi salaami thay
us ke ghar ko jala diya haye
kaaba e dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek beti ke gham mein baba ko
qabr mein phir rula diya haye
kaaba e dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki maadar ka ghar jalaya tha
uska qaima jala diya haye
kaaba e dil...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka haq ajr tha risalat ka
usko ummat ne kya diya haye
kaaba e dil...
items.author: Zain Raza Rizvi

items.title: Karbala ke dasht
items.body:
karbala ke dasht mein ek la-makaan aabaad hai
noor e haq aur maalik e kaun o makaan aabaad hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon pe asghar ko le kar keh rahe hai ye hussain
ek tabassum se tere ye do jahan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa mere akbar ke mit­'te ja rahe hai naqsh e paa
bas dam e ruqsat ka aankhon mein samaa aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtare zahra tera mamnoon hai deen e khuda
shaam ke har mod pe tera bayan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz e ashoora ke dhalte hi udaasi dekhlo
aaj bhi shaam e ghariban ka dhuan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abh raza kuch aur kya maange dar e lajpaal se
dil mein jab shabbir ki aah o fughan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
items.author: Ali Raza

items.title: Khadim al hussain
items.body:
khidmat guzaraan e karbobala
kehte hai tum se ye shaah e huda
haq e mohabbat ada kar diya
tum mujhse raazi mai tum se raazi
dete hai tum ko dua murtaza
<<DIVIDER>>
raazi hongi tum se fatema
ahsant khadim al hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tum hamari shaan ho
tum bhi mezbaan ho
raazi hongi tum se fatema
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
zairon ki khidmat par mamoor ho tum
is azeem nemat se mashoor ho tum
karbala ki ye fiza keh rahi hai marhaba
ghazi de rahe hai hausla
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo najaf se jaate hai paidal haram ko
tum sahara dete ho har ahle gham ko
jaa baja sabeel hai ishq ki daleel hai
ehtemaam aab aur ghiza
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
har qadam moakib jo tum ne banaye
jo safar se thak jaaye aaram paaye
ho koi mareez e gham ya zaeef e mohtaram
sab ko baant'te ho tum dawa
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabeena zaair ki beenayi tum ho
maazoor zaair ki besaakhi tum ho
is qadar hujoom mein de rahe ho rahatein
kyun na zaairon ki ho sada
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
halabikom
sada dete hai shabbir
bana doonga mai taqdeer
chale aao ay zawwar
mere gham ke talabgaar
masayib se na ghabrao
dar e ghazi pe aa jao
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam kare ata
badhaate jaaye hausla
dikha rahe hai raasta
tumhare ishq pe fida
ata kare tumhe sila
<<DIVIDER>>
zaairon ki naalain bhi jodte ho
kab tum is fareeze se moo modte ho
khoob naukri hai ye qalb ki khushi hai ye
hai nijaat ka ye raasta
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ki hai shaah rahon pe khidmat guzari
mausamon ki shiddat mein bhi pursadari
din ho raat ho ya shaam apne kaam se hai kaam
boli haar maan kar hawa
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon mein bhi aayi aadat tumhari
naslon ko ye baat tum ne sikha di
matam o buka karo tum bhi marsiya padho
tumse bhi kahengi sayyeda
ahsant khadim al hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khadimeen e karbal ki jo naukri hai
mazhar ki mesum ki khwahish yehi hai
khadimon mein naam ho aisa intezam ho
hum se bole shaah e karbala
ahsant khadim al hussain...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Loriyon waala mera
items.body:
loriyon waale raj dulaare
ay mere pyare haye ali asghar
haye ali asghar haye ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyon waala mera jal gaya jhoola tera
tu kahan hai mere asghar dhoondti phirti hai maa
<<DIVIDER>>
godh ujdi hai meri ghar bhi ujda hai mera
tu kahan hai mere asghar dhoondti phirti hai maa
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun hua mujhse khafa kya hui maa se khata
kar ke jo veeran jhoola tu gaya suye qaza
hai nigahon may meri har ghadi chehra tera
tu kahan hai mere asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere noor e nazar ay mere lakhte jigar
band jab aankhein karun mai aaye bas tu hi nazar
khwab may doo loriyan doo kabhi dar pe sada
tu kahan hai mere asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa dhula doo moo tera khaak o khoon may hai atta
aa mere asghar badal doo khoon bhara kurta tera
teer jab tujhko laga khoon may tar hogaya
tu kahan hai mere asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat e gham kha gayi qalb ko tadpa gayi
maa ke bin ay laal tujhko kis tarha neend aagayi
kisne di lori tujhe dasht may ye to bata
tu kahan hai mere asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi dushwar hai maa teri ghamkhwar hai
dhoop may hai qabr teri maut matamdar hai
raaton ko uth uth ke mai karti rehti hoo buka
tu kahan hai mere asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer se karke shaheed mutmain kab thay yazeed
qabr se laasha nikaala phir kiya tujhko shaheed
le gaye wo sar tera baad uske kya hua
tu kahan hai mere asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mesum o mazhar wo gham ho nahi sakte raqam
bain jab karti thi maadar rote thay ahle haram
sirf is faryad par qaime may kohraam tha
tu kahan hai mere asghar...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Mazaar e zehra
items.body:
baade tadfeen fatema zehra
shor o ghul ye madine mein utha
kyun ali ne hamein na bulwaya
kyun akele hi unko dafnaya
zillatein hum na ye sambhalenge
laash ko khod kar nikalenge
jab ali ne suna to ghaiz aaya
surkh aankhein thi zard tha chehra
muddaton se rakha hua ghar mein
aaj jangi libaas pehna hai
khoon marhab ka hai piya jisne
aaj wo zulfeqar uthi hai
al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bole khaynch ke talwar faatahe khybar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
<<DIVIDER>>
rasan galay mein padi sabr kar liya maine
batool roti rahi sabr kar liya maine
ye hadh hai aag lagi sabr kar liya maine
magar na aaj bachenge tumhare jism pe sar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan mein ab bhi shahe zulfeqar zinda hai
sar e batool ka ye tajdaar zinda hai
khuda ke deen ka ek zimmedar zinda hai
abhi jihad ke bhoola hoo mai jauhar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zamana jaan le ek baar phir ali hoo mai
nabi ka nafs hoo allah ka wali hoo mai
ke raaz e maqfi bhi aur aayat e jali hoo mai
mai hi hoo qaatile marhab o qaatile antar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
giraya pusht pe darwaza par ali chup tha
rasool zaadi giri khaak par ali chup tha
shaheed hogaya mohsin magar ali chup tha
chali jo taygh hamari to aaj barsenge sar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqar e ismat o hurmat bhula diya tumne
nabi ki beti ke ghar ko jala diya tumne
qadam jo ek bhi aage badha diya tumne
na daal paoge bewon ke sar pe ek chadar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bataun kaise jo tum ne gunah kar daala
nabi ki beti ko naraaz aah kar daala
hamara hasta hua ghar tabaah kar daala
tadap ke reh gaye bache guzar gayi maadar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khoob ajr e risalat ada kiya tumne
ke chote bachon ko maa se juda kiya tumne
zara sa socho to wallah kya kiya tumne
sadayein dete hai maadar ko aah ro ro kar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
na dekhi aisi jahan ne ali ki phir tasveer
ke ashk aankhon mein hyder ke haath mein shamsheer
padi thi paon mein ghazi ke sabr ki zanjeer
magar ye kehte thay har ek se sher ke tewar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb ainee madine ka aah manzar tha
lehad pe zehra ki biphra hua ghazanfar tha
lahoo mein joshe shuja'at malaal dil par tha
fiza mein kehti thi aamir ye taygh lehra kar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Na paae sheh ko
items.body:
na paa e sheh ko hai koi larzish
na dast e sheh thar thara rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ko awaaz de ke laasha
jawan pisar ka utha rahe hai
na paa e sheh ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
rabab khoyi hui si baithi
hai ashk aankhon se jaa rahe hai
jo haath jhoola jhula rahe thay
wo ab bhi jhoola jhula rahe hai
na paa e sheh ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ko haathon pa leke pachunche
kisi ka laasha utha ke laaye
hussain maqtal ko jaa rahe hai
hussain maqtal se aa rahe hai
na paa e sheh ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunche baali pa naujawan ki

items.title: Ankhein kholo zakhmi
items.body:
zainab ka tha nauha baba mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zainab hoon pehchano zara
aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun sunte nahi beti ki sada
aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrat ka musalla hai khaali
kya subha qayamat laayi hai
suraj ko jagaate thay tum to
ab neend ye kaisi aayi hai
mai kab se hilaati hoon shaana
aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
qurban mai uski ghairat ke
khamosh tumhara beta hai
dehleez pe hujre ki kab se
sar apna jhukaye baitha hai
abbas pe jaari hai sakta
aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
logon ke dilon mein aaj talak
sab badr o ohad ke keena hai
amma bhi nahi ab tum bhi nahi
phir kis ke sahare jeena hai
yun chod ke mat jao tanha
aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
mai zainab hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar utho in se poocho
baaghi to nahi bolenge mujhe
bin aap ke jab mai aaungi
pathar to nahi maarenge mujhe
in kufiyon se lelo waada
aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
mai zainab hoon...

shaano ko choom ke kehte thay
be-rehm zamana hai zainab

aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
mai zainab hoon...

amma ki niyabat karti hoon
mai bhooli nahi hoon mansab ko

aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
mai zainab hoon...

kya likhun janaze ka manzar
ek hashr takallum tha har soo
aankhein to na kholi zer e kafan
aankhon se nikalte thay aansu
taboot pe jab beti ne kaha
aankhein kholo zakhmi baba
mai zainab hoon...

items.title: Ay ghareebe zahra
items.body:
ay ghareeb e zahra ay ghareeb e zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
asr e ashoor ye ek maa ki hai maqtal mein sada
ay ghareeb e zahra ay ghareeb e zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bete mai teri pyaas bujhaun kaise
kund khanjar se tujhe laal bachaun kaise
khaak maqtal mein uda kar ye pukari mamta
ay ghareeb e zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe ashoor se ab tak thay jo muztar laashe
tu ne kaandhon pe uthaye wo ekhattar laashe
gham ye hai tujhko mayassar nahi koi kaandha
ay ghareeb e zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer hi teer badan mein hai nikaale koi
maa tadapti hai tujhe laal bachaale koi
phir ye boli tera akbar tera ghazi na raha
ay ghareeb e zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr khanjar na chala maa ye tadap kar boli
mar chuka laal mera waqte zohr pehle hi
qasim o akbar o asghar ka utha kar laasha
ay ghareeb e zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere shabbir ki hai teeron pe mayyat ghazi
hai sabab iska tumhari ye shahadat ghazi
laashe abbas pe maa kehti hai kar ke girya
ay ghareeb e zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl ke baad ye sadma mujhe tadpayega
sar e naiza mere bete tera sar jayega
sang maarega tere sar pe ye shaam o kufa
ay ghareeb e zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr se apni sakina ko bachana beta
tum wahan jaa ke usay saath mein laana beta
qaid khane mein sakina jo kare wavaila
ay ghareeb e zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye waada tere yasir ko shifa'at doongi
tere ghamkhwar ko jannat ki zamanat doongi
jab bhi sajid mujhe dega tere gham ka pursa
ay ghareeb e zahra...

items.title: Chadare fatema
items.body:
rizq hai jumbishe chadar e fatema
rozi e aalameen chadar e sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
ay maadar bekas maadar mazloom maadar
<<DIVIDER>>
teri khaak e paa se na hum sar uthayein
wahin par ajal ko galay se lagayein
rahe teri chadar ka saaya saron par
shifa'at ke saaye mein hum sar chupayein
ay maadar bekas maadar...
rizq hai jumbishe...
<<DIVIDER>>
falak par dilon ke tujhi se ujaala
jahaano ko teri dua ne sambhala
ho kaise hi toofan ho kaisi qayamat
musibat se tu ne hamesha nikaala
ay maadar bekas maadar...
rizq hai jumbishe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye palkein itaa'at ki daaim bichayein
hamesha isi dar pe ye sar jhukayein
ghulamo ki khwahish dua aur tamanna
gharane pe zahra ke jaane lutayein
ay maadar bekas maadar...
rizq hai jumbishe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazab hai tere ghar ka wo dar jala tha
jo baab e shifa tha jo baab e ataa tha
payamabr bhi us dar pe aate thay paiham
khuda ki riza tha jo baab e khuda tha
ay maadar bekas maadar...
rizq hai jumbishe...
<<DIVIDER>>
adoo se ladi bhi ali ko bachaya
saha taziyana tamacha bhi khaaya
wilayat ki khaatir hi mohsin gawaya
imamat ke mansab ko phir phir bhi bachaya
ay maadar bekas maadar...
rizq hai jumbishe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke galay mein jo rassi bandhi thi
musibat ye zahra ke dil pe badi thi
na tha koi yawar ghazab ki ghadi thi
ali ke wo daaman ko pakde khadi thi
ay maadar bekas maadar...
rizq hai jumbishe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mukhlis pe aur shadman pe karam hai
gham e sayyeda mein jo aankhein ye nam hai
mawaddat ki raahon ke ye hum safar hai
wilayat ke raste pe ye hum qadam hai
ay maadar bekas maadar...
rizq hai jumbishe...
items.author: Imon Rizvi

items.title: Dekho maula ali
items.body:
dekho maula ali sabhi ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
saaf farmaan ye nabi ka hai
dekho maula ali sabhi ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rang aur nasl aur zuban kya hai
behrobar uar aasman kya hai
chand kya cheez kehkashan kya hai
roshni sab ali se paate hai
faisla khud ye roshni ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya arab kya ajam ki wus'at hai
inki charon taraf hukumat hai
zikr inka badi ibaadat hai
pad ke naad e ali nabi ne kaha
naam mushkil kusha isi ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
rab ne shamsheer di nabi ne alam
rakhe dosh e nabi pe kis ne qadam
tode kaabe mein jaa ke kis ne sanam
palta hai kis ke hukm se suraj
maujiza aur kya kisi ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
aeliya ya bul hassan ali maula
murtuza bu turab aur aaqa
sher e yazdan nussairiyon ka khuda
itne ausaaf ksi ne paaye hai
kis ka har kaam bandagi ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ne goondha khameer e adam ko
bante dekha hai kis ne aalam ko
kis ne paida kiya hai mausam ko
nehje asraar padh ke dekho to
kaam ye sab ka sab ali ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sadiyon se kis ka matam hai
kis se mansoob ye moharram hai
kis ke gham mein harr aankh pur nam hai
kis ne quran sunaya naize par
haan ye farzand bhi ali ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ne sajde mein zarb khaayi hai
innama kis ke haq mein aayi hai
hal ataa kya payaam laayi hai
fuzto be rabbe kaaba ksi ne kaha
kaun manshoor zindagi ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein luta hai kis ka ghar
kis ke bete ka sar tha naize par
kis ki beti ki chin gayi chadar
kis ke bachon ki pyaas par ab tak
nauha darya pe tashangi ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ke pothe ke paon mein zanjeer
daali aada ne haye be taqseer
betiyan kis ki hogayi thi aseer
baazu kis ke pisar ke kaate gaye
sisila kyun ye dushmani ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sakina wo dukhtare shabbir
jiska daada ho khud janabe ameer
jaari kaano se uske khoon ki lakheer
jisko mar ke rehaai mil na saki
marte dam naara ye usi ka hai
dekho maula ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo farhan ashk o girya hai
majlis e gham mein ye jo nauha hai
iska mehwar to ek pyaasa hai
kyun na rehaan ka qalam bole
farshe gham naam bandagi hai
dekho maula ali...

items.title: Guzar gayi jo qayamat
items.body:
guzar gayi jo qayamat kisi ko kya maloom

guzar gayi jo qayamat...

guzar gayi jo qayamat...
