ba waqte sajda kiya waar ibne muljim ne
utha na paaye imam apna sar sajde bhi se
faza mein goong uthe jibraeel ke naale

guzar gayi jo qayamat...

sukoon ke saath koi lamha bhi guzar na saka

ye aaftaab yun dooba ke phir ubhar na saka
ali shaheed huwe...
guzar gayi jo qayamat...

wo aftaab ki surat se roz ubharta tha
wo dushmano ki bhi mushkil kushai karta tha
ushi ko zakhm diya hai jo zakhm bharta tha
ali shaheed huwe...
guzar gayi jo qayamat...

unhe padar ki judaai ka hogaya ehsaas
zaban se kuch nahi kehte khamosh hai abbas
bade adab se khade hai magar hussain ke paas

guzar gayi jo qayamat...

nabi ke baad kuch is tarha se phiri dunya
phir ek din bhi ali ki na ho saki dunya
suroor mere nazar se bhi gir gayi dunya
ali shaheed huwe...
guzar gayi jo qayamat...

items.title: Haya ala qairil amal
items.body:
haya ala qairil amal
hai waqt abhi nadaan sambhal
khudrat ka hai kanoon atal
meezane muwaddat par kal ko
tul jaayega ek ek amal

wo sehra wo awaaze azan
maulayi ke ahdo paymaan
chauda sau baras guzre ab tak
deta hai sada qum ka maidan

mai jiska maula hoo uska
hai mera baad ali maula
paalane shutar ke mimbar se
dete hai sada mehboobe khuda

<<DIVIDER>>
kaandhon pe ali haaton pe ali
kaabe mein kabhi mimbar se kabhi
aalam ko nabi e akram ne
batlaya ye hai mera wasi
haya ala qairil…
<<DIVIDER>>
zaahir mein kabhi baatin mein kabhi
andaz wohi atvaar wohi
ye bughze ali ki bemaari
is waqt bhi hai us waqt bhi thi
haya ala qairil…
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal jangal sehra sehra
basti basti khariya khariya
aalam mein payame haq ban kar
goonjegi qayamat tak ye sada
haya ala qairil…
<<DIVIDER>>
har soo na bhatak har dar pe na ja
kyun phirta hai maara maara
ab bhi hai khuli haq ki raahein
deti hai sadaye karbobala
haya ala qairil…
<<DIVIDER>>
subhe ashoor jab aati hai
tareekh e wafa dohrati hai
har saal zameen e aalam ko
paigham yehi de jaati hai
haya ala qairil…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai subhe dahum mehshar hai ayan
saf baandhe khade hai peer o jawan
dil kaamp uthe jis waqt goonji
maqtal mein ali akbar ki azan
haya ala qairil…

items.title: Hogayi khatm jafa
items.body:
asghare baysheer ke saath hogayi khatm jafa
khud sitam roya hai mil mil ke galay teer ke saath

daudte jaate hai sheh akbare dilgeer ke saath

<<DIVIDER>>
saath choda nahi zainab ne kabhi bhai ka
sar barehna phiri dar dar sare shabbir ke saath

items.body:
hussain tum pe jo emaan laa nahi sakta

barehna sar hai behen saamne dam e aakhir

<<DIVIDER>>
mujahid apna to emaan hai ghame sarwar
koi hamare qadam dagmaga nahi sakta

items.title: Kaabe pe alam
items.body:
ab waqt ke zaalim hosh mein aa
abhi aakhri hyder baakhi hai
wo zlum o sitam baakhi na rahe
shabbir ka lashkar baakhi hai
uth'ta hai alam batlane ko
abbas e dilawar baakhi hai
phir saani e hyder hi toote
naize se qayamat layega
kaabe pe alam lehrayega
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aale payambar ke dushman
sun ghaur se wo din door nahi
parde mein jo sheh ka waaris hai
mukhtar hai wo majboor nahi
wo hukme khuda ka taabe hai
lachaar nahi be-noor nahi
jab shaane wigha dikhlayega
bin maut hi tu mar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
tum karbobala kaise loge
wo karbobala shabbir ki hai
daakhil nahi ho sakte hargiz
wo jaye amaan baysheer ki hai
aur jo bhi shahe mazloom ki hai
wo sarwar ki hamsheer ki hai
sehra e atash tu kya lega
jab shaam nahi le payega
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shaam mein zainba ka rauza
zindan mein sakina ka rauza
rauzon pe abhi bhi rehta hai
abbas aur akbar ka pehra
qabron hi hifazat ko ek din
wo saakin e ghaibat aayega
phir hashr tumhara kya hoga
jab tayghe ali dikhlayega
<<DIVIDER>>
har ghar mein bapa majlis hogi
har ghar mein bichegi farshe aza
nauhon ki sadayein goonjegi
har soo sheh ka matam hoga
tameer baqayya mein hoga
phir aale payambar ka rauza
ujda hai jo gulshan barson se
dubara sajaya jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
gulshan gulshan sehra sehra
koocha koocha pariya pariya
har zarra padhega dunya ka
bas iski adalat ka kalma
kaunain mein raaij hoga faqad
maula ke gharane ka sikka
ab jald hi kaabe ki chath par
ghazi ka alam lehrayega
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e jari ne parcham ko
gaada bhi to gaada pani mein
ye mashke sakina milne ko
aajaye na maula pani mein
rehan o mubarak is tarha
tehrara pursa pani mein
jis tarha jari pyasa palta
wo maula mera batlayaga
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Khafela roko
items.body:
rahwaare hussani jab tehra aur ek qadam aage na badha
kuch khaak utha ke haathon mein abbas se ye maula ne kaha
sar apna yahan katwayenge is khaak pe hum so jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
khafela roko ghazi khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala khafela roko ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
hai safar khatm hua yehi maqtal hai mera
khafela roko ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke zahra ki buka jaan chali jaati hai
is zameen se to mere khoon ki boo aati hai
maa ki aati hai sada dil bhi kehta hai mera
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni manzil se kahin aage nahi jaana hai
humko sajjad ne bhai yahin dafna hai
roti behno se hamay yahin hona hai juda
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
soong kar khaak ko aisi hui riqqat taari
inna lillaah hua sheh ke labon se jaari
sajda e shukr kiya mud ke bhai se kaha
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zameen paaon pakadti hai mere ruk jao
sar khule aaye thay jibreel abhi ruk jao
ay sakina ke chacha aagaya amr e khuda
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal e ishq ki jo maange wo qeemat dedo
ye zameen naam pe hamshakle nabi ke lelo
kaun basta hai yahan poochlo jaake zara
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho wo chand mujhe aise hi kham hona hai
is tarayi mein mera baazu qalam hona hai
khoon mein doobega yahan ek bhatiji ka chacha
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam tum par na raqam saare azadaron ke
is jagah aayenge ab khafele zawwaron ke
mera matam hoga aayenge ahle aza
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh mahino se safar mein hai musalsal asghar
kaan mein kehde koi aagaya ab aakhri ghar
teer khayega yahan wo mera maaheleqa
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek wo din tha takallum ke ali ki beti
berida gyara moharaam ko yahan se jo chali
roke deti thi sada dukhtare sher e khuda
khafela roko ghazi
aagayi karbobala...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Lutgaya aap ka ghar
items.body:
lut gaya aap ka ghar aap kahan thay baba
kat gaya shaah ka sar aap kahan thay baba
<<DIVIDER>>
baap se shaam e ghariban ye kaha zainab ne
mil gaya khaak may ghar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer asghar ke laga barchi ali akbar ke
bichde sab noor e nazar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bhaiya ne uthaye hai sehar se laashe
jhuk gayi sheh ki kamar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash farzand ki sarwar ne uthayi kaise
ujdi aagosh e pisar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah girte thay tanabo may ulajh kar har soo
sunke awaaz e pisar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mere bhai ke seene pa chada tha qaatil
amma aayi thi magar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chini meri rida dhoond rahi thi har soo
aap ko meri nazar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag daaman se sakina ke bujhayi maine
jal gaye qaime idhar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehra mai ujhdi baharon ka diye jaati hoo
chip gaye shams o qamar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti hyder ki thi masroof e shikayat anwar
mil gaya khaak may ghar aap kahan thay baba
lut gaya aap ka ghar...
items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Manam husssainiyam
items.body:
hussainiyam qalandaram mastam
banda e shaah e karbala hastam
peshawa e tamaam ahle gham
ke sage kuwe ibne hyderium
<<DIVIDER>>
manam hussainiyam
<<DIVIDER>>
mai azadaar hoo karbobala hai dil pe raqam
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka shukr hai farshe aza bichata hoo
ghame hussain mein ashk e aza bahata hoo
dua e fatema zehra se hai ye khaas karam
manam hussainiyam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaanta hoo ata'on ke saare raazon ko
mai jaanta hoo wafa ke sabhi takazon ko
isi liye mai utha'ta hoo bawafa ka alam
manam hussainiyam...
<<DIVIDER>>
utar ke arsh nasheen karbala mein kehte hai
jhuka ke apni jabeen karbala mein kehte hia
elaahi tu ne dikha di hamein bhi aaj irum
manam hussainiyam...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeedi fauj ne jis ko rakha tha pehre mein
wo aaj turbat e abbas par hai sajde mein
furaat choom ke kehti hai bawafa ke qadam
manam hussainiyam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai matami hoo khuda se mili hai ye neymat
hai daste hazarate abbas par meri bayyat
kisi yazeed ke aage ye sar na hoga kham
manam hussainiyam...
<<DIVIDER>>
faqat mera hi nahi hal ata ka kehna hai
tamaam ahle aza innama ka kehna hai
kalaam aaj bhi ye kar rahe hai lowh o qalam
manam hussainiyam...
<<DIVIDER>>
dikha ke pyaas ki shiddat mein hausla apna
har ek shaheed ne ye keh ke diya sar apna
hussain aap pe qurban hai ye mera dam
manam hussainiyam...
<<DIVIDER>>
kalaam e muslim o yasir hai ye khuda mere
ghame jahan se apni panaah mein le le
jo de raha hai to de de hamein hussain ka gham
manam hussainiyam...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Meri behna
items.body:
hote hi reha farshe aza mera bichana
meri behna meri behna
bhai ka jo paigham hai dunya ko sunana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hoo meri tanhai hai aur dashte bala hai
maine abhi asghar ka lahoo rukh pe mala hai
marne ke liye jaata hoo aur khushk gala hai
zainab miljaye jo pani to meri nazr dilaana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
sab mere asaase mein abhi aag lagegi
baysheer ke jhoole mein abhi aag lagegi
sajjad ke qaime mein abhi aag lagegi
zainab bemaar ko jalte huwe sholo se bachana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
ab chain sakina bhi meri paa na sakegi
ghairat se koi zakhm bhi dikhlana sakegi
maqtal ki zameen par usay neendh aa na sakegi
zainab tum usko kahani mere marne ki sunana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam ke bazaar mein jaaogi khule sar
barsayega aansu sar e abbas e dilawar
koi bhi nahi hoga jo dede tumhein chadar
zainab is khaakh bhare chehre ko balon se chipana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
aayegi bahot narghaye kuffaar mein ghairat
khamoshi se seh lena magar saari musibat
gar royi to aajayegi dunya mein qayamat
zainab dil thaam ke apna bhare darbar mein jaana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aayega zindan mein sakina ko madina
hojayega dushwaar usay qaid mein jeena
jab aane lage maut ka maathe pe pasina
zainab tab meri tarha tum use seene se lagana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab ke taraf jaana agar qaid se chutkar
nana ko dikhana hai mere qatl ka manzar
rakh dena mera khoon bhara ammama lehad par
zainab aur poochna kya waada wafa hogaya nana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
amma se ye kehna ke ho jab waqt e shafa'at
aaye jo sava naize pe khursheed e qayamat
abbas ke shaano ko banaade wo zamanat
zainab hojaye azadaron ki bakshish ka bahana
meri behna meri behna
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ujde huwe ghar ke azadaar hai dono
sajjad se bemaar ke bemaar hai dono
haan teri dua'on ke talabgaar hai dono
zainab mushkil se sada nayyar o aamir ko bachana
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Na pooch karbobala
items.body:
na pooch karbobala kis tarha basayi gayi
falak rida se lahoo se zameen banayi gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
saja diya gaya har ek ashk abid ka
rida e arsh se taaron se jab sajayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghuta hai shaam ke zindan may dam sakina ka
kise khabar ye hawa kis tarha chalayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahi hai mashk e sakina se pyaas asghar ki
sabeel pani ki ye kis tarha lagayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ek diya shab e ashoor jo bujhaya gaya
usi ke sadqe may ye roshni banayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kise khabar sar e zainab se li gayi chadar
ahad ke parde may tauheed jab chupayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasam hai asr ki hal min se li gayi awaaz
sada e kun jo ba-roz e azal lagayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nauha tab kahin jaa kar hua supurd e qalam
naved aankh se jab juwe khoon bahayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Paighame hussain
items.body:
zinda rehega paigham e hussain ibne ali
islam sada zinda painda rahega
paighame hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
mit jayega har naksh har ek sheh ko fana hai
lekin shahe mardan ki qasam haq ko baqa hai
shabbir ne khanjar ke talay waada liya hai
islam sada zinda painda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed ke nawase ka haqeeqat mein karam hai
islam salamat hai hifazat mein haram hai
shabbir to insan ki azmat ka bharam hai
hai azmat ka ye taara yuhin raqshinda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
phir soch le hai waqt abhi khoob samajh le
shabbir ko azmat ki kasauti pe parakh le
ye baat haqeeqat hai isay zehn mein rakhle
haq ubhrega baatil sada sharminda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
har saal muharam mein manate hai yehi gham
karte hai yuhin sayyede abrar ka matam
hum ahle aza daur badalte nahi har dam
jo kal tha wohi aaj hai aainda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka matam na rukega na ruka hai
wallaha ye masooma e aalam ki dua hai
is gham ke mukaabil mein jo gham laaya gaya hai
baatil hai wo mit jayega haq zinda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
phir khel rahe hai wo wohi khel purana
iblaagh ki quwwat se haqeeqat ka dabana
ye sach hai ke jhooton ka jahannam hai thikana
sharminda sada zulm ka karinda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
sach sach hai zamane mein fasana hai fasana
aasan nahi haq ki ye awaaz dabana
aalam mai hai mumtaz muhamad ka gharana
ye kaaba abad haq ka numainda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaeene ke surat se har ek chehra ayan hai
ghar kiska hai saudagar emaan kahan hai
kuch dushman ye aal ki had ahle jahan hai
kab tak ye dilon mein tay sare hinda rahega
paighame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne wallah bada kaam kiya hai
islam pe jo teer chala dil pe liya hai
khoon e ragay gardan se isay ghusl diya hai
islam ka chehra yuhin tabinda rahega
paighame hussain....
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Aagaya bazare shaam
items.body:
aa gaya bazare shaam aa gaya bazare shaam
bibiyon mein hai koraam aa gaya bazare shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
sang ki barsaat hai kehkahe hai char soo
be rida hai bibiyan sar se behta hai lahoo
has rahe hai ahle shaam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle shar hai har taraf haath mein pathar liye
hai koi naiza liye hai koi nashtar liye
har taraf hai ek kohraam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq hai nauha kuna ro rahi hai bediyan
haye rassi mein bandhi dekhti hai bibiyan
taaziyane aur imam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
chin gayi teri rida bach gaya hai la-ilaah
ab tujhe darbar mein hai bachana karbala
ab hai zainab tera kaam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasman haye zameen par toot kar girne ko hai
dekh kar bemaar ko khaak par girne ko hai
hai koi zainab ko thaam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere baazu choom kar roye thay jis ko ali
jis ko rote aaye hai aaj tak saare wali
haa yehi hai wo maqam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diye ahle haram tauq ke aazaar par
shaam ke bazar mein haye ek bemaar par
ho gayi mushkil tamam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
rassiyan hai baazuon mein aur naaqe tez tar
godh se maa'on ke bache gir rahe hai khaak par
hashr hai har ek gaam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon e dil mein doob kar tune jo likha naved
jab talak hai karbala hai tera nauha naved
karbala to hai dawaam aa gaya bazare shaam
aa gaya bazare shaam...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Abbas mere laal
items.body:
beta meri ghurbat ki kamayi ko sambhalo
abbas mere laal ko tum aake bachalo
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas al madad mere abbas al madad
abbas mere laal ko tum aake bachalo
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke liye maujiza dikhla nahi sakte
tum baabe hawaij agar aa nahi sakte
maqtal ke ilaaqe ko taraayi se milado
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch yaad hai kya tumse kaha tha dam e ruqsat
kya bhool gaye umme baneen ki wo wasiyat
wo maa hai unhe rootne se pele manalo
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka gala kat'te huwe dekhegi kaise
tukdon may usay bat'te huwe dekhegi kaise
zainab ko zara rayt ke teele se hatalo
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba se bichad kar usay neend aayegi kaise
seena na milega to sukoon payegi kaise
taskeen e sakina ki koi raah nikalo
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
utha bhi nahi jaata mere tashna dahan se
kaise kahun paala hai isay kitne jatan se
hyder ki dua fatema zehra ki dua lo
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo char qadam mujhse chala bhi nahi jaata
pehlu hai shikasta to utha bhi nahi jaata
baazu e bureeda se mujhe aake sambhalo
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron ke musalle pe hai yasrab ka namazi
lillaah chale aao kahan ho mere ghazi
shabbir ke is aakhri sajde ko bachalo
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum umme wafa umme masayib ki kali ho
ay ibne ali tum bhi to ek nade ali ho
islam pe jo mushkilein aayi hai wo taalo
abbas mere laal ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra tere nauhon ka karam kam hai ye hum par
hai aaj bhi har maa ki dua aamir o nayyar
ghazi mere bete ko musibat se chudalo
abbas mere laal ko...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Ali jaisa ho
items.body:
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ummate nabawi aisi ho zindagi
zeenat ho ali ki kirdaar tumhara ho
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
<<DIVIDER>>
tum aale nabi ki aan bano
wallah mard e maidan bano
ay momino kaam wo kar jaana
sajde mein sar ko katwana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ajr e risaalat yaad rahe
asghar ki shahadat yaad rahe
akbar ki azaan ye kehti hai
quran ka muhafiz kehlana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo tauq e garan wo zanjeerein
wo pusht pe zulm ki tehreerein
bazaar e sitam mein tafseerein
khutbe mein wo lejha apnaana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka seena yaad rahe
mazloom sakina yaad rahe
itrat ka nagina yaad rahe
mushkil mein na tera ghabrana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis pe zinda islam rahe
bas pesh e nazar wo kaam rahe
aijaaz mawaddat ki khaatir
kar daalo dil ka nazrana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
items.author: Aijaaz ali

items.title: Ankhein to zara
items.body:
uthjao ali asghar
aankhein to zara kholo aise to nahi rootho
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
lori tujhe sunaungi jhoola jhula'ungi
ashkon se tera chehra asghar mai dhula'ungi
awaaz meri sunkar lillaah zara jaago
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar…
aankhein to zara…
<<DIVIDER>>
suraj to ja chuka hai hone laga andhera
tareek shaam aayi bhoolo na ghar ka rasta
mai dar rahi hoo bhaiya jangal mein dar na jao
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar…
aankhein to zara…
<<DIVIDER>>
amma to bekhabar hai maidan mein kya hua hai
lekin mujhe khabar hai zakhmi tera gala hai
haazir hai ashk mere zakhmo ko apne dholo
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar…
aankhein to zara…
<<DIVIDER>>
khusboo tere lahoo ki sanson mein aa rahi hai
tum aao wagar na meri ab jaan jaa rhai hai
dil keh raha hai mera bhai ko apne rolo
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar…
aankhein to zara…
<<DIVIDER>>
aa kar dikhao chehra dam ghut raha hai mera
mai bhi to dekhun bhaiya hai zakhm kitna gehra
ab mere sabr ko tum asghar na aur tolo
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar…
aankhein to zara…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khaali khaali jhoola mujhko sata raha hai
tere baghair asghar dil dooba ja raha hai
tumko jo ran se laaye awaaz doo mai kisko
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar…
aankhein to zara…
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan jab sakina ye bain kar rahi thi
asghar ki maa bhi uska nauha ye sun rahi thi
kehti thi ay sakina ye baat ab na bolo
kuch bolo mere bhaiya asghar
uthjao ali asghar…
aankhein to zara…
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ay ghazi abbas
items.body:
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas ay ghazi abbas
mai bhi aata hoo tere paas ay ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
dard tum mujhse judaai ka na seh paoge
bin mere khuld e bari mein bhi reh paoge
mujhse ulfat jo hai kuch khaas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaane ye tere nahi baazu kata hai mera
bhai chautees baras waala chuta hai mera
ho gaya mujhko ye ehsaas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab se deta hoo sada khaak se ab uth jao
aakhri baar kaleje se mere lag jao
nehr aayi na tumhe raas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh ke saamne laasha hai mere bhai ka
ashkiyan dete hai taana mujhe tanhaai ka
kya nahi tum ko ye ehsaas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise le jaun mai qaime mein alam ko bhaiya
tumse dhaaras thi bahot ahle haram ko bhaiya
sab ki ab toot gayi aas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
<<DIVIDER>>
utho sharminda hai ab tashna dahani tumse
haye maangegi na hargiz kabhi pani tumse
ab sakina ko nahi pyaas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gaya sakht musibat mein safeena mera
aa ke pardes mein chatka hai nagina mera
toot'ta hai mera almaas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee qaime mein jo abbas ka parcham paaya
jo bhi behosh tha aamir wo labe dam aaya
shor utha ye basad yaas ay ghazi abbas
ab nahi jeene ki kuch aas...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Ayuhal badru tamam
items.body:
qaime se is tarha se laila ka chand nikla
tha arsh se zameen tak phaila hua ujaala
lab phol aankh jugnu aabroo hilaal jaise
zulfein se aah jaise kamli mein kamli waala
shabihe mustafa akbar jamaal e karbala akbar
jo dekhe wo pukar uthe rakhe tujhko khuda akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam
<<DIVIDER>>
wo palkein aayaton jaisi wo quran ki tarha seena
wo hyder ki tarha baazu wo lehja mustafa jaisa
ali samjhun nabi kehdun kahun mai tujhko kya akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo kausar se dhule gaysu hilaal e eid se abroo
badan se chan ke aati thi rasool e pak ki khushboo
bana kar tujhko naazan tha mohamed ka khuda akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen par paon rakhte thay falak ko rashk aata tha
falak ko dekh lete gar sitara jhoom jaata tha
sitaare maangte thay tere chahre se ziya akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
balayein maa liya karti phupi naad e ali padti
lage na nazre bad unko behan har dam dua karti
liya karti thi bose husn e yusuf ki ada akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
azan e subho ka manzar sar e karbobala kya tha
azan kya thi wo akbar ki nabi ka saaf lehja tha
kiya sadqa to mitti ban gayi khaak e shifa akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina seene pe jab khaayi sada shabbir ki aayi
ali akbar hui rukhsat meri aankhon se beenayi
tere marne se zainab ka kaleja phat gaya akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawani raas na aayi kaleje par sina khaayi
madine mein behan khush thi ke ghar aayega ab bhai
magar ye khwaab tha us ka jo poora na hua akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha armaan byaah ka dil mein lagayi khoon ki mehendi
kaha laila ne mayyat par rachayi kis tarha shaadi
jawan ho kar ye kaisa daagh maadar ko diya akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali akbar ka sadqa hai qalam rehaan kehta hai
wahan mai mohtaram tehra jahan majlis hai nauha hai
ab is izzat ke badle rab se maangun aur kya akbar
ayuhal badru tamaam...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Chadaron ka naam
items.body:
chadaron ka naam sun kar ro padi binte ali
shaam ke darbar may
wa hijaba keh rahi thi sayyeda ki laadli
sham ke darbar may
<<DIVIDER>>
kursiyon par qaatilane shaah thay baithe hue
saaya e deewar may thay sab haram lekin khade
ba-wafa ko dhoondti thi dukhtare shere jari
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr dekha to sakina sehm kar rone lagi
door hoja shimr fizza cheekh kar kehne lagi
khauf se murjha rahi hai baaghe ismat ki kali
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
<<DIVIDER>>
tasht may baba ke sar par jab padi uski nazar
apne zakhmo ki rahi na phir sakina ko khabar
daudti baba ki jaanib laadli beti chali
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun hai zainab pukara jis ghadi firaun e shaam
haye ghurbat kehke utha tha mera qaidi imam
ashk khoon ke ro raha tha shaah ka beta ali
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalimo ko mil rahe thay zulm karne par enaam
kehkahon par kehkahe thay jaam par chalte thay jaam
rote rote shaam logon aal e ahmed ki dhali
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm haakim ne sunaya maar do bemaar ko
is jagah hi qatl kar do khaafila salaar ko
gir padi abid ke upar haye nazon ki pali
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ali akbar ke sar ko saamne laaya gaya
hogayi behosh maa se na sambhal paaya gaya
dukhtarane fatema padne lagi nade ali
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab e kubra ne rokar jis ghadi khutba diya
haye ay tauqeer abid ka badan tha kaampta
hathkadi par maarta tha sar wali ibne wali
sham ke darbar may
chadaron ka naam sun kar…
items.author: Tauqeer Kamalvi

items.title: Faryad e zainab
items.body:
saamne behen ki aankhon ke
gardan pe khanjar chalaya
ek mazloom pyase par
zaalim ko tars na aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
haa mera ujad gaya ghar baar
haa mai tanha matamdaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana
haye mai ujad gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
chali dil pe mere talwaar
ab maut ke hai aasaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana teri ummat ne mere
jeene ke sahare cheen liye
is karbobala ke jangal mein
aankhon ke sitare cheen liye
mai bekas mai lachaar
sab kunbe ki ghamkhwar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya ke kanare jalta hua
ghar aaj talak dekha kis ne
quran sar e naiza nana
padta hua sar dekha kis ne
kiya bayyat se inkaar
bhai pe chali talwaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo shaam e ghariban ka manzar
bemaar ka sholon mein bistar
wo behta hua kaano se lahoo
wo neel sakina ke rukh par
kaano se lahoo ki dhaar
jab zakhmi thay rukhsaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sher taraayi mein soya
jo aas tha pyase bachon ki
jo mashk bachane ki khaatir
qurbani de gaya haathon ki
parde ka zimmedaar
maara gaya aakhir kaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zulm bhi dekhe hai maine
jo din ko raat bana dete
mai ro na saki aansu mere
pani mein aag laga dete
bhai ka tha ye israar
bas sabr meri ghamkhwar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaano pe nishan hai rassi ke
saughat e safar ye laayi hoo
hai dil mein daagh bahattar ke
ay nana mai dukh paayi hoo
thi tang ki wo bauchaar
rota tha alam bardaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ibne hassan pamaal badan
dulha jo bana ek shab ke liye
maqtal ki zameen par uska badan
ghodon ne kiya tukde tukde
seene pe zakhm hazaar
ek sar ke tukde chaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki sada har majlis mein
nauhon ki zubani aati hai
bibi ki sada dohraata hai
jisay nauha khwani aati hai
rehaan mere ash'aar
dil e zainab ki hai pukaar
haye mai ujad gayi nana...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Haye abbas
items.body:
baazu e shahe karbobala hazrate abbas
saqqa e haram sher e wigha hazrate abbas
abbas abbas haye abbas haye abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki ita'at thi faqat unki shariyat
mashoor zamane mein hai maula ki shuja'at
paayi asadullah ki kul tumne virasat
baatil ke liye misle qaza hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar hukm mile karde abhi shaam ko tashkeer
abbas ke kabze mein ali ki jo hai shamsheer
bas muntazir hai izn jo de hazrate shabbir
de wada khilaafi ki saza hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke lashkar ke alamdar hai abbas
kehta hai alam hyder e karrar hai abbas
baatil ke liye aahini dewaar hai abbas
islam ke parcham ki baqa hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmate thay shabbir ho tum zeenate lashkar
qayam hai tere dam se meri shaukat e lashkar
ek aah ki farmeina ke ye qismat e lashkar
hai kaun jo lashkar mein ruka hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
paate hi riza maula se lene chale pani
darya ko chala tab asadullah ka jaani
thay nehr pe qabza kiye wo zulm ke baani
kab daud padi fauje jafa hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko jab maara gaya shaah ka lashkar
aur pyaas se bache nazar aane lage muztar
dekha na gaya ghazi se wo karb ka manzar
sarwar se chale lene riza hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeze mein tab pani ko bharne lage maula
ghode se kaha tu hai kayi roz se pyasa
rehwaar ye bola ke nahi mujhko ye zeba
phir aab ko chullu mein liya hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza liye qaime ke jaanib chale hazrat
teer aate thay padne lagi talwaron ki zarbat
mashkeeze pe jab teer laga ghut gayi taaqat
shabbir ko dete thay sada hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab na kisi bhai ko manzar ye dikhaye
jis tarha kamar pakde wahan shaah thay aaye
abbas se farmate thay mai kya karoo haye
kyun hote ho tum hum se juda hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein hussain aaye liye ghazi ka parcham
qaimo mein haram ke tha bapa ghazi ka matam
thay bain sakina ke labon par yehi payham
kyun sogaye darya pe chacha hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bain thay zainab ke suno mere dilawar
tanha hai hussain aur udhar laakhon ka lashkar
baad'az shahe deen hoyega barpa yahan mehshar
cheenenge layeen meri rida hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aijaz qalam rok lo mehshar ka samaa hai
ghazi ke alam mein ye buka shor o fughan hai
aqif yahan matam mein har ek peer o jawan hai
hai sab ke labon ki ye sada hazrate abbas
abbas abbas...
items.author: Aijaz Rizvi

items.title: Hogi na inteha koi
items.body:
hogi na inteha koi is inteha ke baad
sajda na kar saka koi phir karbala ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ke sar pe rakh ke dastaar shaah ye bole
ek aur karbala hai is karbala ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam kiya lahoo ka aankhon se zindagi bhar
na aisa matami hai zainulliba ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise tamache khaaye baba ke baad us ne
soyi nahi sakina phir karbala ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri laash pe aaun kaise batao akbar
aata nazar nahi hai teri qaza ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi nida e khaaliq meri raza ke maalik
mai karbala se pehle tu karbala ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujda hai jis tarha se ghar fatema ka shahid
ujda na koi aise aale abaa ke baad
hogi na inteha koi...
items.author: Shahid

items.title: Kaabe se jaa raha
items.body:
jis waqt ye zamana makkeh mein aa raha hai
tera hussain tere kaabe se jaa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab gawah rahiyo sadme utha raha hai
tera hussain tere kaabe se jaa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nana ki qabr chodi maa ka mazaar choda
bhai hassan ka marqad apna dayaar choda
ab ye naya sitam bhi dil par utha raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ibne hajira hoon makkah mina ka beta
mai ambiya ka waaris marwa safa ka beta
ro ro ke aabe zam zam mujhko bula raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
fakhr e khaleel mai hoon shaan e kaleem hono mai
maalik tu jaanta hai zibhe azeem hoon mai
tifli ka aaj apna waada nibha raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaabe ke teri hurmat pamaal hona jaaye
mere lahoo se makkah sab laal hona jaaye
baadal musibaton ka ab sar pe cha raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehraam mein chamakte khanjar chupe huwe hai
in hajiyon mein khooni lashkar chupe huwe hai
qismat ka ab sitaara gardish mein aa raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
maalik ye hajre aswad bhi jaanta hai mujhko
makkeh ka zarra zarra pehchanta hai mujhko
rutba magar muslman mera ghata raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheenti ko bhi amaa hai makkeh ki sar zameen par
par mujhko chain haye milta nahi kahin par
thokar pe aaj thokar shabbir khaa raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
haji sabhi mina mein qurbaniyan karenge
par karbala mein akbar qurban hum karenge
is waaste pisar bhi hamraah jaa raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-aab karbala mein mehman ye bhi hoga
akbar ka zikr kya hai qurban ye bhi hoga
godhi mein maa ke asghar jo muskura raha hai
tera hussain tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsaas kaise likhe lafzon mein aah ainee
mudh mudh ke dekhte thay kaabe ko shaah ainee
aamir ye shaahe deen ka nauha suna raha hai
tera hussain tere...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Karbala khamosh hai
items.body:
aagayi shaam e ghariban karbala khamosh hai
hogaya maqtool quran karbala khamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ke laadle sab zulm se maare gaye
murtaza ki aankh ke roshan sabhi taare gaye
mushaf e ismat ke jitne thay sabhi paare gaye
hal ata par gham hai taari innama khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal gaye hai saare qaime kya kare saydaniyan
chadarein bhi chin gayi hai kya kare saydaniyan
zulmaton ke bheed mein hai mustafa ki betiyan
chup hai abbas e jari aur alqama khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
maadar e baysheer ko zainab sambhale kya kare
godh mein saare yateemon ko uthaale kya kare
abid e muztar ko sholon se nikaale kya kare
ek zainab hai akeli khaafila khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek taraf qaime jale aur ek taraf masnad jali
har taraf dil ki sada hai ya mohamed ya ali
aise mein zainab bani hai khud hussain ibne ali
azme zainab dekh ke har maujiza khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkilein is raat mein jab mehwe ghairat hogayi
ek phupi aur ek bhatiji kohe ghairat hogayi
har musibat jhel kar faqre mashiyat hogayi
sabr o gham ka is jagah har falsafa khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhirash mir e najaf khud bhi ye manzar dekh kar
aagaye karbobala beti ko muztar dekh kar
keh uthi hyder se ye hyder ki dilbar dekh kar
mere baba aap ka har dilruba khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman o mir tusi gham ke in halaat mein
aansuon ki dard ki ehsaas ki barsaat mein
tum ko padhna mujhko likha mil gaya khairaat mein
tum ko sun kar dehr ka har khushnawa khamosh hai
aagayi shaame ghariban...
items.author: Mir Tusi

items.title: Khafila jaa raha
items.body:
khafila jaa raha hai watan ke liye
karbala mein qayamat ka ek shor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khafila jaa raha hai watan ke liye
koi roti hai apne jawan laal ko
ro rahi hai koi kam-sukhan ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chale thay madine se sab saath thay
aun o jafar thay akbar thay abbas thay
jaa rahi hoon madine to koi nahi
ab musibat faqat hai behan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi chadar na thi kaisi bedaad thi
haath hote huwe bhi na azaad thi
kitni majboor kar di gayi thi behan
apne bhai ke dafn o kafan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni barbadiyon ko gawara kiya
khoon mein doobe gulon ka nazara kiya
de diya fatema ka bhara gulsitan
karbala tere ujde chaman ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre sarwar pe ke behan ne kaha
kya bataun ke bhaiya sitam kya hua
kufa o shaam mein hoon phiri berida
aap mohtaj yan thay kafan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre qasim se hai yun mukhatib phupi
teri shadi kuch is tarha ban mein hui
koi sehre ka bhi phool baaqi nahi
warna le jaati qabre hassan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain karti thi ye banu e shaahe deen
mai kahin reh gayi mera asghar kahin
godh khaali hai meri sakina nahi
mar gayi qaid mein wo watan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh mahine ki jaan asghar e bezuban
ho gayae karbala ki zameen mein nehan
soone jangal mein ab jaa ke dhoondun kahan
maa tadapti hai us gulbadan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab e dil hazeen seh ke ranj o mahan
jab madine mein pahunchegi ye khasta tan
umr bhar haath malti rahegi behen
bhai abbas se saf shikan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kasre zaalim kabhi qaid khaana kabhi
nok e naiza kabhi taziyana kabhi
kaun si thi aziyyat jo di na gayi
har jafa thi aseer e mehan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
naala e gham sehelta hai charkhe kohan
qabr e qasim pe aati hai bewa dulhan
chadare ashk laati hai behre kafan
ran mein teeron se chalni badan ke liye
khafila jaa raha...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Kund khanjar na
items.body:
garm reti pe sar e dasht ajab hai manzar
koi saaya hai jo deta hai sada ro ro kar
dekh zakhmi hai musafir hai mera lakhte jigar
kam se kam pani se tar kar le layeen tu khanjar
qabr ko chod ke yan aayi hoo dilgeer hoo mai
naam zehra hai mera maadar e shabbir hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar na chala shimr e sitamgar ruk ja
waasta rab ka tujhe behre payambar ruk ja
<<DIVIDER>>
is ke farzand jawan ne abhi khaayi barchi
is ke seene mein hai paywast wo naize ki ani
zakhm par zakhm na de ab to sitamgar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
iske chehre pe lahoo asghar e baysheer ka hai
ghao seene mein abhi is ke kisi teer ka hai
hai abhi sajda e mabood mein ye sar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bhai tha jo bekas ki kamar tod gaya
ek bhatija tha bilakta hua jo chod gaya
mai dua doongi tujhe haath utha kar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
be gala jisko samajhta hai tu sarwar ka gala
ghaur se dekh ye hai tere payambar ka gala
kuch na samjhe to yehi baat samjh kar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jurm kya hai mere bache ka tu itna to bata
is ke nana ka padha karta hai tu bhi kalma
muntazir is ki hai ek choti si dukhtar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa lagta hai ke hamsheer nahi hai teri
warna rakhta nahi pyase ke galay par tu churi
qaime ke dar pe hai mazloom ki khwahar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
chakkiyan pees ke mehnat se isay paala hai
is ne jo keh diya khudrat ne kahan taala hai
ye dila sakta hai jannat mein tujhe ghar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar e khasta jigar gham ye bayan kaise karun
chashme zehra jo se tapka tha wo ek khatra e khoon
tu bhi rehaan qalam rakh de ye keh kar ruk ja
kund khanjar na chala...

items.body:
luti dunya ali e murtuza ki
shahadat ho gayi hai sayyeda ki

khadija khuld mein nauha kuna hai
duhaai de rahi hai wo khuda ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
mila baagh e fidak ka dil ko sadma
sitam ye aur mohsin ne qaza ki
luti dunya ali...

hai gham mein mubtila rooh e payambar
lehad tharra rahi hai mustafa ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
milayzakhmon pa usko zakhm itne
zaroorat thi bahot jisko dawa ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha mayyat par yehi zainab ka nauha
saza paayi hai hum ne kis khata ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha hasnain ne qabr e nabi par
aray nana meri maa ne qaza ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba waqte ghusl e mayyat roye hyder
shikasta phasliyan thi ehliya ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
na le kar jaaiye maadar ko meri
padar se betiyon ne ilteja ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
madina ro raha tha khoon ke aansu
uthi mayyat jo ghar se fatema ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
musmalmano na maaro is pa pathar
ke mayyat hai ye binte mustafa ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham e zehra mein girya ho raha hai
moharram hai safon mein ambiya ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool e paak ka gulshan hai zad mein
sitam ki aag hai aisi bala ki
luti dunya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame sheh par raza kyun kar na roye
haqeeqat jaante hai karbala ki
luti dunya ali...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Manzar pase manzar
items.body:
manzar pas e manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hussain ibne ali aur wo shimr ka khanjar
manzar pas e manzar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko kahan maloom hai shabbir ka rutba
payambar ke bete hai bhala tujhko khabar kya
na waqif e anjaam hai tu dhyaan ye rakhna
jis deh ki hukumat ke liye aaya hai ladne
wo ab teri qismat may hai kab tera muqaddar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khaak ki kya tujhko khabar kitni bhali hai
is dasht ke ausaaf may aqwaal e jali hai
firdaus ka tukda to sar e dasht yehi hai
ta hadde nazar aaj yahan hai mere aghyaar
kal honge yahan chaaron taraf zaair e sarwar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum binte payambar ke chaheete hai khabardaar
hum hyder e safdar ke dulaare hai khabardaar
hum ahmed e mursal ke nawase hai khabardaar
mukhtar hai hum tum hame majboor na samjho
chaahe to abhi khaak kare shaam ka lashkar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehra hai labe nehr atash lab pe hamare
tum ne to taraayi pe bitha rakhe hai pehre
ye aaj ki tasveer hai ekaad ke bete
kal pyason ke isma e girami ke tasadduq
dunya may rawan hoga sabeelon ka samandar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu fauj ki kasrat pe na itra pisar e saad
kal khud hi tu ye bolega lo hogaye barbaad
lashkar se sada aayegi imdad ho imdad
us waqt ka manzar na kabhi bhoolegi dunya
aayega paye jang mera jab ali asghar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ne apne hi liye hum ko banaya
ye jaan ke bhi tum ne hame dukh diye kya kya
hum uski hi tauheed tale karte hai sajda
sar tan se juda hoga magar dekh na zaalim
aayegi kate sar se sada allahu akbar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ishq ki meraj hai qurbani e shabbir
faqre yade bezaam hai islam ki taqdeer
maqsad se mere khoob hai waqif mera baysheer
khamoshiyan kyun odh ke nikle hai watan se
manzoor hai hum logon ko taskeen e payambar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum logon ne jis dasht ko pur khaar kiya hai
tum logon ne jis dasht ko aazaar diya hai
tum logon ne jis dasht ko laashon se bhara hai
wo dasht azadaron ke phoolon se bharega
kal maqtal e shabbir ka tum dekhna manzar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dayam o yazdan yehi sheh kehte thay sunle
ye dhoop ye sehra ye baraste huwe sholay
ye gulshan e sehra sipaahe shaam ke qabze
ye aaj ki tasveer hai ye aaj ka manzar
kal chamkega is dasht ka aabaad manzar
manzar pas e manzar...
wo hussain ibne ali...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Mazloom bada hai
items.body:
karbala kehti hai mazloom bada hai asghar
zibha maidan mein do baar hua hai asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
haath mein taygh nahi aur ulat de faujein
jaise abbas lade waisa lada hai asghar
karbala kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar hai naize pe rakha aur badan reti par
haye kis haal mein bano ko mila hai asghar
karbala kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke halmin ki sada dasht mein jaane ke liye
ghutniyo shaah ke qaime mein chala hai asghar
karbala kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ke aakhri sajde ke liye maula ne
apne chehre pe tera khoon mala hai asghar
karbala kehti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera ehsaan na bhoolega takallum maula
mujhko sab kuch tere jhoole se mila hai asghar
karbala kehti hai...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Na poocho dushmane
items.body:
na poocho dushmane emaan se
noor e ali kya hai
jo khud andha hai wo kaise bataye
ke roshni kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban katwa ke apni kar gaye ehsaan ye meesum
samajhna sabse mushkil kaam tha ishq e ali kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohamed aur ali dono ka jalwa ek jalwa hai
koi kaise batayega nabi kya hai wasi kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya hamla kaha abbas ne darya ki faujon se
zara tehro bataate hai jalaal e hyderi kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
sare saahil qayamat dekhna kuch dayr guzre to
abhi to ghaiz may abbas aate hai abhi kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere shabbir de do saath bete aaj raahib ko
riza e rashk e maalik ho tumhe maula kami kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ne ek shab e hijrat may khud paighambari ki hi
ali se poochiye batlayenge paigambari kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hai dozak ka angaara wo hai firdaus ka maalik
yazeed e shaam kya hai aur farzand e nabi kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali se taaba qayam silsila hai noor ka khaayal
wo baara manzilein hai noor ki baaradari kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai mahir kya karunga dekh kar dunya ko nazron se
dar e shabbir par baitha hua hoo ab kami kya hai
na poocho dushmane...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Aagaya maahe aza
items.body:
gham ki chaayi hai ghata aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza aansu bahalo momino
<<DIVIDER>>
haye darya ki tarayi par jari abbas ka
zulm se baazu kata aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand dikhte hi falak par saj gaye har ghar alam
aur bicha farshe aza aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar o aun o mohamed qasim e naushah ko
yaad karke tum zara aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ke haaton pe teere hurmala ki nok se
halqe asghar bhi chida aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
baade ashoora sabhi saydaniyo ke haye haye
chin gayi sar se rida aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne aansu marhame zakhme shahe mazloom hai
kuch nahi iske siwa aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi aajaye moharram zindagi may ay bober
kehte rehna tum sada aansu bahalo momino
aagaya maahe aza...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Ab ay hussain aa
items.body:
aayi ye arsh e paak se allah ki sada
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja palat ke rab ki taraf aa hussain aa
ay mere mustafa ke kalaf aa hussain aa
ay laqte qalbe shaahe najaf aa hussain aa
sar kar gaya hai jaan bakaf aa hussain aa
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ke laal fatema zehra ke noore ain
noore nazar rasool ke zehra ke dil ke chain
jannat ke baadhshah shehensahe mashraqain
tere liye hai kaun o makan ke ye zeb o zain
<<DIVIDER>>
nana se apne tu ne jo waada kiya hussain
mesaaq waale ehd ko poora kiya hussain
tu ne jo mere saamne sajda kiya hussain
haq bandagi ka tu ne ada kar diya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ab tere mere beech nahi koi faasla
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
aayi ye arsh e paak se...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron par teer tere badan par baras gaye
pani ki boondh boondh ko bacche taras gaye
ghazi ne tere nehr pe katwa diye hai haath
zinda rahenge haath ye mashk o alam ke saath
<<DIVIDER>>
islam sar barehna khada tha jo saamne
zainab ne apne sar ki rida baksh di usay
zehra ne chakki pees ke paala tujhe hussain
in dushmano ne maar hi daala tujhe hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne jawan pisar ali akbar bhi de diya
shish maah bezuban ali asghar bhi de diya
ghar ko mere bachane bhara ghar bhi de diya
islam ki baqa ke liye sar bhi de diya
<<DIVIDER>>
ab saari kayenaat tere naam hai hussain
islam tere dam se hi islam hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haa mai hoo tera tu hai mera
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
aayi ye arsh e paak se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor choor hai tera badan hussain
jangal mein lut gaya tera saara chaman hussain
laashon se saj gayi hai teri anjuman hussain
ab karbala ki khaak hai tera watan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak e shafa hai maine teri khaak ko kiya
takmeel tujhse panjetan e paak ko kiya
tu mera aaena hai mai hoo aaena tera
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa
aayi ye arsh e paak se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain marzi e khaaliq hai tere haathon mein
payam o haq o sadaqat hai tere haathon mein
<<DIVIDER>>
ba ho chuki ye jang har ek maareka hua
raazi hussain tujhse tera kibriya hua
rakh ay hussain apni ye shamsheer niyam mein
aa baargahe jalwa e rabbe anaam mein
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se saara jism sajaya hua hai tu
apne lahoo mein aaj nahaya hua hai tu
tanha khada rahega bhala kab talak bata
ab ay hussain aa ab ay hussain aa

items.title: Abbas meri shimr se
items.body:
abbas meri shimr se chadar to dila do
balwe mein khule sar hoo zara parda bana do
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt lagi aag mai kis kis ko sambhalun
sajjad ko jalte huwe qaimon mein nikalo
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
paband e rasan shaam ko tayyar khadi hoo
mehmil pe zara aa ke mujhe aap bitha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman mein lagi aag na jal jaye sakina
masooma ke daaman ki zara aag bujha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehme huwe masoomo ko neend aayegi kaise
ek baar zara aa ke inhe aap sula do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa akbar o asghar ki mere saath hai kehti
sughra ko madine mein ye paigham pahuncha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
waaqif mai nahi shaam ki raahon se ay bhaiya
ek baar mujhe shaam ka rasta to bata do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ajre risalat diya ummat ne tere baad
abbas ye zewar mere haathon mein pehna do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sardar ko gham tera hai aulaad se pyara
kehta hai shab e roz mere bakth jaga do
abbas meri shimr se...
items.author: Sardar

items.title: Ali jaisa namazi
items.body:
ali jaisa namazi todta hai dum musalle par
manati hai namazein murtaza ka gham musalle par
<<DIVIDER>>
bujha kar zehr may shamsheer apni ibne muljim ne
lagayi us ghadi zarbat lagayi ibne muljim ne
ali e murtaza ne jab kiya sar kham musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaqi ne waar sheh par ain sajde may kiya aisa
sar e hyder hua do neem ubla khoon ka darya
tadapta reh gaya sultane do aalam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda jaane ye himmat kaisi dikhlayi hai shabbar ne
namaze fajr ki takmeel phir bhi ki hai shabbar ne
ali ke sar se behta tha lahoo paiham musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada deta hai kufa keh raha hai bait e daawar bhi
gawahi de rahe hai masjid o mehraab o mimbar bhi
hai ab bhi mehwe sajda waarise aadam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jabeen sajde may hai aur zehn may kufa ka manzar hai
nazar may zakhmi sar hai nauha e hyder labon par
ke aansu kar rahe hai shaah ka matam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rulaati hai hamesha shaah e khyber geer ki yaadein
sada tadpati rehti hai hamay shabir ki yaadein
namazon ke liye aate hai jab bhi ham musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo rehan roye waaris e kaaba ki furqat may
mujeeb afkaar ne nauhe padhe roze ki haalat may
kiya unnisween ramzan ne bhi matam musalle par
ali jaisa namazi...
items.author: Mujeeb Alipuri

items.title: Ay godiyo ke paale
items.body:
ay godiyon ke paale laila ke dil ki dhaaras
islam ki tajalli emaan ke ujaale
<<DIVIDER>>
bujhti hui jawani ye bhool jaane waale
kaise samajh sakegi wo maut ke ishare
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
parda pada hua hai kis tarha maa pukare
ay maut ki nazar se aakhein ladane waale
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujde huwe chaman ki khilti kali hai akbar
har saans keh rahi hai tum zindagi ho akbar
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay noor e chasm e laila taqdeer ke ujale
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat ka dil par gham ha akbar salaam le lo
ye aakhri alam hai akbar salaam le lo
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hui ada hai ab khatm hai ye naale
hai qaum tum par sadqe jibraeel ke dulaare
ay godiyon ke paale...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ke sahare emaan ke shaahzade
ye roshni ata ki athara saal waale
ay godiyon ke paale...

items.title: Bechain hai zainab
items.body:
bechain hai zainab aaja
veeran hai ghar ali akbar
mere laal tu laut ke aaja
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes ki is ghurbat mein
hum jaaye kahan batla jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras paala tujhko
tu ghar se gaya na baahar
din doob gaya hai beta
ghar laut ke ab to aaja
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai waasta tere baba ka
haathon ke mere nawaalon ka
marne ki umr thi teri
ek baar mujhe samjha jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagta hai watan na jaungi
ghut ghut ke mar jaungi
jeene ki karungi tamanna
ek baar tu wapas aaja
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeer mein jakda hai kunba
sar naize par hai tera
aankhon se lahoo barsaun
mai kab tak ye batla jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri yaadein hai aur zainab hai
hamshakle payambar akbar
doo dil ko tasalli kaise
ye baat zara batla jaa
bechain hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan fughan thi zainab ki
ye shaam ke bazaron mein
dukhiyari phuphi kehti hai
akbar mere akbar aaja
bechain hai zainab...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Chal diye shabbir
items.body:
chal diye shabbir ya rab sar katane ke liye
kaun hai ab chadare zainab ko bachane ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
aa ke ya abbas dekhe bekasi shabbir ki
aayi zainab zeen par shaah ko bithane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
choom kar baazu kaha shabbir ne hum to chale
tum raho tayyar zainab shaam jaane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak deodi pe maa karti rahegi intezar
bhej kar baysheer ko pani pilaane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe asghar godh mein hai aur laashon par nazar
shah kise awaaz dein turbat banane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre asghar khud bana li fatema ke laal ne
godh mein jhoole ke aadi ko jhulane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil gaye hyder ka dil zabte hassan sabre hussain
gardan e asghar se paikaan kheench laane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ki aamad se bana buth khana ay khana e khuda
reh gayi aulaad unki qaid khane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun rahe zulmat mein hum jab ke nisar apne hussain
noor ka minaar hai saare zamane ke liye
chal diye shabbir...
items.author: Baba Nisaar Haideri

items.title: Faryad hai baba
items.body:
zainab ye buka aaj bhi karti hai khule sar
faryad hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
be-parda phirayi gayi aulaad e payambar
faryad hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mujhe ab koi na pehchaan sakega
ye haal hai mera
kuch itne sitam dhaaye hai taqdeer ne mujh par
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal hua qasim e naushaah ka laasha
bewa hui kubra
mehendi bhare haathon ko dulhan reh gayi mal kar
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
is gham se phata jaata hai seene may kaleja
mai reh gayi tanha
shabbir sa laaungi kahan se mai biraadar
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
paywast hua seene may is tarha se naiza
khinch aaya kaleja
aur khoon may tadapta raha shakle payambar
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..
<<DIVIDER>>
le kar mai alamdar ke do daste bureeda
aur khoon bhara kurta
aaungi ye kehti hui baba sar e mehshar
faryad hai baba
zainab ye buka aaj bhi..

items.title: Haye abbas
items.body:
wa min tehril le ya ali kadam enaa
haye abbas haye abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
aapke baad na hum raaton ko soye bhaiya
kam hui aankhon ki beenayi jo roye bhaiya
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna abbas tha raub o jalaal aada par
raaton ko so nahi sakta tha yazeedi lashkar
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
chain se sotay thay jo log wo hai ab bedaar
khatm sab hogaye ansar o azeez aur ghamkhaar
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi saydani nahi soti thi aisa tha hiraas
hota tha zulm jo bachon par ko kehte abbas
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum to darya pe pade sote ho ay shere jari
raat din rehte hai yahan naala o shewan may sabhi
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir na soyi kabhi saydaniya gham ki maari
haye maqtal may hui is tarha shab be daari
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gayi qaid may ro ro ke sakina pur gham
karti rehti thi shab o roz buka aur matam
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
pad gayi jab ke madine pa anees unki nazar
marsiya padti thi kulsoom yehi ro ro kar
wa min tehril...
haye abbas...
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Hussain waala
items.body:
hussain waala har ek lamha
hussain ka gham mana raha hai
aza e sarwar hai farz is par
so farz apna nibha raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bichata hai farshe majlis
fareeza isko samajh ke apna
koi hadees e kisa ko pad kar
kare hai aaghaaz majlison ka
hai koi aisa ke rone walon
may ho raha hai shumaar jiska
hai koi aisa jo baade majlis
hame ziarat pada raha hai
hussain wala har ek lamha…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne seekha hai farshe majlis
pe aake soz o salaam padna
likha anees o dabeer ne jo
wo marsia bazm may sunana
kisi ne seekha hai shaahe waala
ki majlison se khitaab karna
jo zeb o mimbar hua hai wo hi
viqaar apna badha raha hai
hussain wala har ek lamha…
<<DIVIDER>>
bana raha hai koi aqeedat
se taaziya aur zareeh e sarwar
wo is amal se bata raha hai
ke hai wo shaahe zaman ka naukar
saja raha hai koi to parcham
may mashk tashna labon ko ro kar
uthake phir wo jari ka parcham
wafa jari se nibha raha hai
hussain wala har ek lamha…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ke hisse may aaya naame
hussain maula pilaana pani
jagah jagah par saja raha hai
ba-naame asghar sabeel koi
wo jiske hisse may aayi rakhwali
zuljanaah shahe zaman ki
wo aspe shaahe zaman saja kar
naseeb apna jaga raha hai
hussain wala har ek lamha…
<<DIVIDER>>
koi to matam kuna hai pyason
pe majlison may bana ke halqa
ye pesh zahra ko kar raha hai
sada e matam se sheh ka pursa
kisi ne zanjeer ka kiya hai
kisi ne matam kiya qamah ka
jo de raha hai lahoo ka pursa
jo khoon apna baha raha hai
hussain wala har ek lamha…
<<DIVIDER>>
farishte sattar hazaar nauha
kuna hai qabre shahe umam par
ye keh rahe hai ke haye shabbir
haye abbas haye akbar
usi bashar ko duayein karbobala
se dene ko aaye sarwar
jo rauza e dukhtare ali ke
difaa may jaan luta raha hai
hussain wala har ek lamha…
<<DIVIDER>>
koi to izhaar likh raha hai
qalam se shaahe zaman ke nauhe
ye likh ke nauhe bata raha hai
ke reh gaye shaahe deen pyase
rula raha hai koi jahan ko
hussain maula ka nauha pad ke
ye nauhakhwan padke nauha sab ko
kahani gham ki suna raha hai
hussain wala har ek lamha…
items.author: Ali Izhaar

items.title: Jab sakina ko qaza
items.body:
jab sakina ko qaza qaid mein aayi hogi
haye abid ne lehad kaise banayi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
jaake tasveere nabi khoon mein nahayi hogi
maa ne atharvi mannat na padhayi hogi
jab sakina ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kya kya na dile shah pa guzri hogi
qabr mein nanhi si mayyat ko litayi hogi
jab sakina ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj har simt fiza nauha sunaati hogi
paye abid mein jo zanjeer pehnayi hogi
jab sakina ko…

items.title: Kaash abbas mera
items.body:
baade ashoor ye zainab ke labon pe thi sada
kaash abbas mera maara gaya na hota
<<DIVIDER>>
pyas ke maare tadapti na sakina beti
baap ke kaandhe pe na bete ki mayyat hoti
yun na chalti mere shabbir ki gardan pe churi
is tarha ujda na hota ye gharana mera
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khelta asghar e baysheer mere aangan mein
haye cheh maah ka bacha nahi jaata ran mein
chid gaya nanha gala teer se uska ban mein
dushmano mein kya koi saahib e aulaad na tha
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maara gaya is dasht mein mera lashkar
qasim o aun o mohamed nahi na hai akbar
turbate asghar e baysheer bana kar sarwar
ashk se marqade baysheer ko sairaab kiya
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun imdad kare aata nahi koi nazar
betiyan jaati hai ahmed ki phirayi dar dar
baaghi keh keh ke chalate hai wo hum par pathar
yun na be-aas mohamed ka na hota kunba
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule koocha o bazaar phir aayi zainab
be rida shaam ke darbar mein aayi zainab
khoon ke ashk har ek pal hai bahayi zainab
dil mein gham leke bahattar ko hoo zinda bhaiya
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke seene pe soti thi sakina aksar
ab meinassar hai usay khaak ka takiya bistar
zaalimo kuch to taras khao meri bachi par
baap ki laadli hai baap ki shafqat se juda
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
chal basa mursale aazam ka gharana saara
haye zaalim ne sakina ko tamacha maara
bibiyan peet ke sar dene lagi ye naara
ghair hai charon taraf koi nahi hai apna
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis mein himmat thi mere baandta baazu mein rasan
noke naiza pe nahi hota sar e shaahe zaman
kitne khush haal raha karte thay hum apne watan
ye to acha hua karbal mein na aayi sughra
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar o asghar e baysheer na maare jaate
ek ek karke na nana ke dulaare jaate
sab mere saath watan aaj hamare jaate
haye zindan mein na rehti sakina tanha
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke karbal mein najaf zainab e muztar ka bayan
shaah ke laashe se bhi hone lagay ashk rawan
nehr pe tadpa udhar laasha e abbas e jawan
ashke afshan huwe matam mein idhar ahle aza
kaash abbas mera...
baade ashoor ye...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Karbala ki kahani
items.body:
tareekh e karbala hai ye tareekh e karbala
haye ghareeb hussain haye ghareeb hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aao sunaun tum ko mai tareekh e karbala
yani ghareeb e fatema zehra ka marsiya
zehra ka laal shaam ki faujon mein tha ghira
qurban ho chuke thay sab ansar o aqraba
ghurbat ki bekasi thi shah e mashreqain thay
nau laakh fauj e shaam mein tanha hussain thay
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai dhoondti hai wo lashkar kidhar gaya
tooti hui kamar hai jawan bhai mar gaya
noor e nazar ke saath hi noor e nazar gaya
armaan tha jiski shadi ka wo bhi guzar gaya
rota hai dil shabih e payambar nahi raha
sughra ki yaad aati hai akbar nahi raha
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kis tarha bayan karun us waqt kya tha haal
kha kar sitam ka teer jo asghar hua nidhaal
jab hichkiyan wo leta tha masoom naunehaal
bano na dekh le kahin sheh ko tha ye khayal
jitna lahoo ugal diya maah e muneer ne
utna to doodh bhi na piya tha sagheer ne
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache ki apne qabr banane lage hussain
khud bebasi ki laash uthaane lage hussain
pyase labon pe ashk girane lage hussain
matti mein apna chand chupane lage hussain
thi itni garm rayt ke ghabra gaye hussain
chehre pe khaak daal ke tharra gaye hussain
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote huwe imam jo qaime ke dar pe aaye
thay hamsafar hussain ke tanhaiyo ke saaye
awaaz kis ko de kisay mazloom ab bulaye
koi nahi bacha mere maula ka haye haye
aayi sada ye fikr ke shaah e umam na kar
zainab tujhe sawaar karayegi gham na kar
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye hussain ran mein safon ki safayi ki
aada se bhook pyaas mein aisi ladayi ki
faujon se aa rahi thi sadayein duhayi ki
aise mein sheh ko laash nazar aayi bhai ki
goonji sada ye fatema zehra ke chain ki
abbas uth ke dekho ladayi hussain ki
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
baatein tasavuraat mein karte thay shaah e deen
itne mein gherne lagay maula ko sab layeen
ghode pe dagmaga gaya zehra ka mehjabeen
bibi pukaarti thi batao to ahle keen
pyase ko kyun lahoo ke ghareeb-ud-dayaar ke
tum ko milega kya mere bacha ko maar ke
haye ghareeb hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad kya bayan ho wo karb ki ghadi
chalne lagi jo halq pe mazloom ke churi
sattar qadam se ek behan dekhti rahi
tauheen shimr karta tha zainab ke bhai ki
kehti thi ghazi aa ke bachana hussain ko
jab shimr maarta tha tamacha hussain ko
haye ghareeb hussain...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Kya kare abbas
items.body:
sawaale hurmate kaaba hai kya kare abbas
behen hujoom mein tanha hai kya kare abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ghairaton ke liye ek sawaal hai ke nahi
to ab sina pe teherna muhaal hai ke nahi
aseer zainabe kubra hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bharosa jin pe tha tukdon mein ab wo bat bhi chuke
jo thay rida ke muhafiz wo haath kat bhi chuke
nigaah mein koi waada hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
waraq waraq hai badan aur qalam qalam shaane
ghulam par jo guzarti hai koi kya jaane
sina ki nok pe aaqa hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
banun sakina ka saqqa badi tamanna thi
mila dun qaime se darya badi tamanna thi
ab aankh khoon ka darya hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jisne pyason se waada kiya tha pani ka
haram ko jis pe bharosa tha paasbani ka
kata hua wohi shaana hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina ki nok se akbar ki pyaas bujh bhi chuki
sitam ke teer se asghar ki pyaas bujh bhi chuki
sakina aaj bhi tashna hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zakhm khud ko mile unki koi fikr nahi
magar sakina ko durre laga rahe hai layeen
ye zakhm to abhi taaza hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb hashr hai aaakhon mein aamir o nayyar
rula raha hai lahoo dil ko shaam ka manzar
labon pe ek hi nauha hai kya kare abbas
sawaale hurmate kaaba...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Luti kin fizaon mein
items.body:
luti kin fizaon mein aale payambar
na mai keh sakoonga na tum sun sakoge
hua kaise khaali ali ka bhara ghar
na mai keh sakoonga na tum sun sakoge
<<DIVIDER>>
lagi dil pe barchi jigar moo ko aaya
sada aayi maqtal se baba kahan ho
chale kis ka laasha uthane ko sarwar
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo khoonkhar sehra wo wehshi hawaein
wo sunsan jangal wo maa ki sadayein
kahan sogaye jaake jhoole se asghar
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada shimr khanjar liye kiski jaanib
pukara tha maqtal se kis ne ali ko
nazar aaya sar kiska noke sina par
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahoo umme laila ka mai haal kaise
bayan kya ho kulsoom ki bebasi ka
utaari gayi kaise zainab ki chadar
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
<<DIVIDER>>
na poocho nakahad si taari thi kis par
na poocho kisay ghash pe ghash aa rahe thay
ab aise mein jalne laga kiska bistar
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
<<DIVIDER>>
sataya tha ghurbat mein kis ko shaki ne
kahoo kaise ruqsaar thay kis ke zakhmi
tamache lagata tha kis ko sitamgar
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo be-chaadari wo aseeri ka aalam
wo pur-haul sehra wo bedafn laashe
wo shaam e ghariban ka dil soz manzar
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
<<DIVIDER>>
viqar aah kis dil se ab mai bataun
jo guzri hai zainab ke qalb e hazeen par
wo bazaar o darbare koofe ka manzar
na mai keh sakoonga...
hua kaise khaali...
items.author: Viqar Nagri

items.title: Mazloom hussaina
items.body:
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
lachaar hussaina beyaar hussaina
ay bekason ke khaafila salaar hussaina
wo khanjar e bepeer kuja haye muqaddar
aur bosagahe ahmed e mukhtar hussaina
balkhaye na kyun dil mera jab noke sina par
bandh jaye tere gaysu e khamdaar hussaina
adam safiuallah se ta isie dauran
aisi na luti thi koi sarkar hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom hussaina mazloom hussaina
maghmoom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
hai aale nabi be-sar o samaan hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar fatema ka hogaya veeran hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki hai faryad nahi koi madadgaar
sajjad hai bemaar
dhaate hai sitam hum pe musalman hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ye khiza aayi ke hum hogaye barbaad
zainab ki hai faryad
ujda hai payambar ka gulistan hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ke din lut gayi zehra ki kameini
ya rab hai duhaai
islam pe ghar hogaya qurban hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zianab pe hai tanhaai wo ab kisko bachaye
kya hogaya haye
hai ahle haram ran mein pareshan hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos jawan laal ko dulha na banaya
sehra na sajaya
poora na hua maa ka ye armaan hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad e nabi lut gayi barbaad hua ghar
zainab hai khule sar
ay tashna dahan kaari e quran hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar kar diya qurban magar deen bachaya
har ranj uthaya
hai deen e khuda par tera ehsaan hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarkar e jina dosh e nabi ka wo makeen hai
nabiyon ka yakeen hai
ummat ne bhulayi hai teri shaan hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar tan se juda hogaya aur baad e shahadat
hai teri ye azmat
padta raha naize pe tu quran hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko abhi shaam ke bazaar hai jaana
aur ashk bahaana
manzil hai meri shaam ka zindan hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazdan ke labon par hai muhib ab yehi nauha
maghmoom hai zehra
hai bain ye dukhiya ka meri jaan hussaina
mazloom hussaina maghmoom hussaina
ghar fatema ka hogaya...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Meri jaan ali asghar
items.body:
aa tujhe lori suna'un ali asghar
aa tujhe jhoola jhula'un ali asghar
tere sadqe tere waari ay meri jaan ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi fauje sitam jhoola jalane ke liye
aakhri teri nishani ko mitane ke liye
gham na kar haath salamat hai jhulane ke liye
aa tujhe lori…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar se madar ke chini shaam e ghariban mein rida
dhoondne kaise tujhe aa'un batade beta
apni maadar ke liye dasht se wapas aaja
aa tujhe lori…
<<DIVIDER>>
roshni din ki kahan raat ki tareeki hai
mai bhi aadi hoo teri tu bhi mera aadi hai
haath phailaye hue khaak pe maa baithi hai
aa tujhe lori…
<<DIVIDER>>
ran se laati hai hawaein tere khoon ki khusboo
apne dil par nahi rehta mujhe beta khaabu
reh gaya jaake kahan dashte bayaban mein tu
aa tujhe lori…
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jab shaam e ghariban ki sehar hogi ayan
sunti hoo shle haram jayenge suye zindan
hogi phir tujhse mere laal mulaqat kahan
aa tujhe lori…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se jo madine mein hawa aati hai
maa ki umeed to yawar wo jaga jaati hai
dhoop mein baithi hui bano yehi kehti hai
aa tujhe lori…
items.author: Yawar Abbas

items.title: Na ro ay phupi
items.body:
na ro ay phupi amma
ab na maloom hai sar pe rida nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tere aun o mohamed na rahe
mere asghar o akbar na rahe
udjad gaye hum haye na ro
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi yateemi aayi durr chinte hai
koi na ujde jo hum ujde hai
chalo ghazi se ye kehde
kis shaan se hum thay aaye
ujad gaye hum haye
na ro ay phupi amma...
<<DIVIDER>>
goonji sada maqtal may sharminda hai
teri rida ka zaamin tha jo haye
darya se laut na paaya
do baazu shaah jo laaye
ujad gaye hum haye
na ro ay phupi amma...
<<DIVIDER>>
do laashon ko laaye wo zakhmi hai
itne pyase thay wo bacche haye
chalo maaon se ye kehde
do nanhi qabrein banaye
ujad gaye hum haye
na ro ay phupi amma...
<<DIVIDER>>
toota naiza lekar shaam e ghariban
beti ali ki deti hai pehra haye
bemaar se koi ye kehde
kuch dayr ko wo so jaaye
ujad gaye hum haye
na ro ay phupi amma...
<<DIVIDER>>
andhiyare may ek maa laash ke tukde
dekh ke kehti thi ay maalik haye
dulha pamaal hua hai
dulhan ko kya samjhaye
ujad gaye hum haye
na ro ay phupi amma...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhiya maa maqtal may kis se pooche
dhoondte hai kya zaalim ran may haye
mera baccha nehr hua hai
phir zibha na ho jaaye
ujad gaye hum haye
na ro ay phupi amma...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ke laashe par ye bain thay maa ke
paalne waale mera baccha haye
aise pamaal hua hai
kaise koi dafnaye
ujad gaye hum haye
na ro ay phupi amma...

items.title: Abbas mujhe karbala
items.body:
is gham ne azadaron bohat mujhko rulaya
is saal bhi zawwaron mein jab naam na aaya
dil toot gaya karbala na jaane ke gham se
ro ro ke kaha maine lipat kar ye alam se
ek baar mujhe bhi to sada do
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas abbas abbas mujhe karbala dikha do
shabbir ka zawwar bana do
abbas mujhe karbala dikha do
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jaante ho koi nahi mera sahara
abbas kate haathon se tum kar do ishara
jab yaad hussain aate hai rota hai mera dil
mar jaunga maula se mila do na khudara
kitna bechain hai dil karbala hai manzil
jald aasaan karo maula meri mushkil
kab aaunga bas itna bata do
abbas mujhe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
milta hai koi jab safare ishq se aa kar
rota hoon bohat dayr gale us ko laga kar
mai bhi to azadar hoon kya dil nahi mera
zawwaron ki khidmat mein karun paaon daba kar
wahan paidal mai chalun saare maukab dekhun
wa hussaina keh kar khaak chehre pe malun
ek baar mashi mujhko kara do
abbas mujhe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
paaon thay kahin jism kahin haath kahin thay
rauza hai jahan khoon mein tar aap wahin thay
teer aankh mein tha chehra bhi zakhmon se bhara tha
jab zeen se gire aap ke baazu hi nahi thay
pursa dena hai mujhe aap ko ro ro ke
jahan dono baazu khaak par kat ke gire
dono kafe abbas dikha do
abbas mujhe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se lipat jaata hai jaise koi baccha
aise hai mujhe shaah ke rauze se lipatna
mas kar ke sabhi apna kafan laate hai lekin
mai unke liye le ke kafan jaunga maula
dil tadapta hai mera aaj bhi ay maula
bekafan ghurbat mein hai ghareeb e zahra
mujhko mere maula se mila do
abbas mujhe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab pehli nazar aap ke gumbad pe padegi
gir jaunga sajde mein dua maangunga ghazi
har saal yahan aata rahun aap se milne
sun lena alamdar tum aawaz ye dil ki
tum hi to sunte ho haan karam karte ho
hum azadaron ke dil mein tum rehte ho
tum maujiza ab koi dikha do
abbas mujhe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
zawwaron se aati hai mujhe aap ki khushboo
aankhon se nikal aate hai maula mere aansu
hasrat se unhe dekhta rehta hoon mai ro kar
us waqt nahi rehta hai dil par mere qaabu
dil ye kehta hai mera ay shahenshahe wafa
karbala mein mera kab bulawa hoga
ab jald koi raah bana do
abbas mujhe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas jahan par hui akbar ki shahadat
kya mere muqaddar mein nahi hai wo ziyarat
akbar ke kaleje pe jahan tooti thi barchi
tooti thi wahin dilbare zehra pe qayamat
dekh loon mai jaa kar wo maqame akbar
shaah pahunche thay jahan khaak par gir gir kar
akbar se mohabbat ka sila do
abbas mujhe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil kitna pareshan hai abbas se bolo
wo baabe hawaij hai tum umeed na chodo
aate hai wo khud shah ke zawwaron ko lene
ek baar unhe baali sakina ki qasam do
jald wo aayenge shaah bulwayenge
aur tumhe karbobala saath le jayenge
ay meesam o zeeshan sada do
abbas mujhe karbala...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Akbar ghar aaja
items.body:
andhere ghar mein sughra diye jalaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dil ghabrata hai jab yaad sataati hai
bemaar behan tujhko ro ro ke bulaati hai
akbar ghar aaja sughra ka waasta
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad mein teri ro ro kar mar jayegi sughra
akbar ghar aaja sughra ka waasta
<<DIVIDER>>
tu door hai mujhko ye gham hai
baba ki tujhe qasam hai
mai takti rahi tera raasta
madine se tu jab gaya karbala
karbala karbala haye karbala
mujhko bhi le chal poora kar de waada
akbar ghar aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab katt'te nahi hai raat aur din
mai kaise jiyun tere bin
yahan aagayi mujhe maut agar
mere bhai aana meri qabr par
qabr par qabr par haye qabr par
nana ki jaa kar karti hoon roz dua
akbar ghar aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz mein teri jeete ji
mai phir se azaan sun loo
tujhe dekhna hai mehrab mein
tu ek baar aaja mere khwaab mein
khwaab mein khwaab mein haye khwaab mein
maine dekha hai zakhmi tera seena
akbar ghar aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ye tamanna hai meri
mai shaadi rachaun teri
behan bhai hum dobara mile
badhani hai bhaiya mujhe mannatein
mannatein mannatein haye mannatein
maani hai maine dekhun tera sehra
akbar ghar aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chand moharram ka dekha
dil mera tadap ke bola
khuda se yehi dua maine ki
badha de mere bhai ki zindagi
zindagi zindagi haye zindagi
meri bhi tujhko lag jaaye mere bhaiya
akbar ghar aaja...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ne khat mein
zeeshan o irfan e aza ye likha
sar e karbala ye khat khol kar
hussain aa gaye ek jawan laash par
laash par laash par haye laash par
aakar sheh bole paigham hai sughra ka
akbar ghar aaja...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ay hurr hato jawan
items.body:
waqte aakhir hurr ke jo bete ne di sada
daude hussain hurr se bhi pehle basad buka
jis dum jawan laash uthane ko hurr badha
kaandhe pe rakh ke haath ye shabbir ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
ay hurr hato jawan ka laasha na uthao
hum leke laash aate hai tum qaime mein jao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
andher ye kya dasht mein tum karte ho bhai
kab kisne jawan bete ki mayyat hai uthayi
bas pyar karo bete ko seene se lagao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam tod gaya saamne nazron ke jawan laal
tere dil e malool ka hum ko pata hai haal
moo se na kaho dard e jigar laakh chupao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota hai jawan laal zaeefi ka sahara
is laal ke mar jaane ne hum sab ko hai maara
purse ke liye aate hai hum farsh bichao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai khoob jaanta hoo jigar chaak chaak hai
ab teri zindagani e dunya pe khaak hai
mat bain karo laashe pe mat khaak udao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna shareek e gham mujhe samjho ay pur malaal
nusrat ke liye aaya hai ye fatema ka laal
phir kya majaal bete ki tum laash uthao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha jawan bete ka kaise uthaoge
mujhko khabar hai dayr talak jee na paoge
maqtal mein khade hoke na yun ashk bahao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ka kuch hi dayr mein manzar badal gaya
ek baap phir jawan ke laashe pe hai khada
aur bebasi ye kehti rahi ashk bahao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr ke jawan bete ko sheh ne uthaya tha
akbar ki laash kaun uthayega ay khuda
ay shaah e najaf sheh ki madad karne ko aao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee kaleja dekhne walon ka phat gaya
aamir zaeef baap ne laasha utha liya
kehta raha jo hurr se ke na laash uthao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Bacche wo kya hue
items.body:
ay tifle ghamzada ay tifle karbala
as salaam as salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
baade hussain koi bataye mujhe zara
bacche jo bach gaye thay haram ke wo kya huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
dil par rakho jo haat bataun mai maajera
bacche jo bach gaye thay haram ke wo kya huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne suna hai akbar o asghar ka waqeya
qasim se gulazaar ka sarwar ka waqeya
abbas se shuja o dilawar ka waqeya
lekin khayaal tak na hamara idhar gaya
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban aayi udhar aayi fauje shaam
gauhar chine tamache lage jal gaye qayaam
faryad kar rahe thay yatimaane tashna kaam
lekin kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aate jo dekha fauje sitam ko dehel gaye
bacche sehem ke qaime se baahar nikal gaye
is kashma kash mein ghodon ke neeche kuchal gaye
us raat ke andhere mein andher hogaya
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunchi jo pushte qaima pe abbas ki behen
dekha zameen pe sote hai do phool se badan
neele pade hai ghodon ki taapon se khastatan
thay kis ke naunehal kisi ko nahi pata
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala se shaam ko nikla jo kaarwan
pushte shutar se bandh ke bacchon ke reesman
dhauda rahe they oont ko jallaad al amaan
nazuk si khaal jism se hone lagi juda
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacche tadap ke kehte thay ay baba pass aao
ham gir rahe hai oont se amma hame bacho
dil nikla jaa raha hai hame godh mein chupao
ye kehte kehte oont se har tifl gir gaya
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacchon ke khoon se pushte shutar laal hogayi
jo laash gir gayi wahin pamaal hogayi
dekha jo maa ne laash to behaal hogayi
kaise lagaye seene se baazu to hai bandha
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala se shaam talak gul khila diye
bacche jo gir gaye thay wahin par sula diye
zainab ne sang e meel ke katbe bana diye
do ashk unpe koi bahane nahi gaya
bacche jo bach gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee palat ke aayi jo yasrab mein bibiyan
ujdi hui thi maang o khaali thi godhiyan
bacchon ko de rahi thi tasavvur mein loriyan
aamir har ek se poochti thi un ki maamta
bacche jo bach gaye...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Chal pade shabbir
items.body:
chal pade shabbir karbal hogaya veeran madina
roti akbar tujhko sughra reh gayi tanha madina
<<DIVIDER>>
sar bhi dunga ghar bhi dunga behno ki chadar bhi dunga
deen bachane ke liye naujawan akbar bhi dunga
ab na zinda laut kar mai aaunga nana madina
chal pade shabbir karbal...
<<DIVIDER>>
behne le kar haram le kar karbala ko jaa raha hoo
ek gham hai mere dil mein jisko le kar jaa raha hoo
nana ummat ne nahi di qabr ki bhi jaa madina
chal pade shabbir karbal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ra raha hai ek sehra de raha hai wo sadayein
khoon khudara de ke apna maula mujhko aa basayein
ban jaunga mai muqaddas jis tarha makkah madina
chal pade shabbir karbal...
<<DIVIDER>>
subha ashoora jo goonji ban mein akbar ki azan
behne royi phupiyan royi roti hai akbar ki maa
sun ke royi behan bichdi bhai ki azan madina
chal pade shabbir karbal...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chal tha khaafila ye oonton ki thi sau khatarein
aaj shahid bibiyon ki koi sunta na pukarein
teen mehmil ek muhaari khaafila lauta madina
chal pade shabbir karbal...
items.author: Malik Shahid

items.title: Deti hai zanjeer
items.body:
deti hai zanjeer gawahi kis ka hai taboot utha
chauda saal ke baad hua hai zindan se mazloom reha
<<DIVIDER>>
kadiyon mein paband janaza le ke hai mazdoor chale
karne lagi hai aap ghareebi matam musa kazim ka
deti hai zanjeer gawahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baad e shahada ke bhi pusht na seedhi hoti thi
chauda saal ruku mein reh kar maula ka ye haal hua
deti hai zanjeer gawahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke haalat bewa maa ki betiyan hai behaal hui
sar mein khaak e yateemi le kar rota hai mazloom raza
deti hai zanjeer gawahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
angooron mein zeher khila kar maara hai pardesi ko
fil qurba ka aale nabi ko ummat ne ye ajr diya
deti hai zanjeer gawahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tha saatwan rukn e imamat dhaaya zaalim logon ne
