galiyon mein baghdad ki ro kar deta hai jibreel sada
deti hai zanjeer gawahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kalma go batlao kya ye paak nabi ka khoon nahi
be-waris baghdad ke pul par jis ka hai taboot pada
deti hai zanjeer gawahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar ke raqam maula ke masayeb rota hai jawad qalam
kazim ka hai sog manaati kar ke matam aap qaza
deti hai zanjeer gawahi...
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Faryad hai faryad
items.body:
karti thi ye ro ro ke fughan zainab e nashaad
faryaad hai faryaad
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein zehra ka bhara ghar hua barbaad
faryaad hai faryaad
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki ani seena e akbar mein lagi hai
kya maa pa bani hai
tasveer e nabi ran mein hui jaati hai barbaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeenat ke liye daale hai gardan mein jo quran
surat ke musalman
hum aale payambar hai inhe ye bhi nahi yaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kya na masayeb huwe kya kya na sahe gham
jab qaid huwe hum
har gaam par ek taaza sitam ek nayi uftaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein hum ahle haram aise lute hai
sar nange phire hai
ruk jaate to dete thay aziyat sitam eejaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tapti hui sehra ki zameen raah mein kaante
aur paon mein chaale
ghash khaa ke na gir jaaye kahin sayyed e sajjad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aun o mohamed hai na abbas na akbar
qasim hai na asghar
har ek ne ghar chod ke maqtal kiya aabaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
roti thi sakina jo kabhi gham se bilak kar
ho jaata tha mehshar
gaalon pa lagate thay tamache sitam eejaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrati thi zindan ke andhere mein sakina
dushwaar tha jeena
ab qaid mein soti hai wohi bekas o nashaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
sahir ghame shabbir mein aansu na rukenge
ta hashr bahenge
ab hum ko nahi kuch bhi masayab ke siwa yaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
items.author: Sahir

items.title: Hona to yehi tha
items.body:
inna lillahe wa inna ilahe rajeoon
<<DIVIDER>>
hona to yehi tha waada to yehi tha
sab bikhar gaye sab ujad gaye
mera waada to yehi tha
inna lillahe wa inna ilahe rajeoon
<<DIVIDER>>
parwardigar banda e aajis ki hai sada
de hausla sambhaal le mujhko mere khuda
kuch bhi raha na paas mere sab bikhar gaya
saathi koi hussain ka baaqi nahi raha
haye sab bikhar gaye sab ujad gaye
hona to yehi tha waada to yehi tha
mera waada to yehi tha
inna lillah inna lillah
inna lillahe wa inna ilahe rajeoon
<<DIVIDER>>
aansu ye keh rahe hai ke akbar kahan gaya
gehwara poochta hai ke asghar kahan gaya
baazu mera wo saani e hyder kahan gaya
abbas ke jo saath tha wo lashkar kahan gaya
haye sab bikhar gaye sab ujad gaye
hona to yehi tha waada to yehi tha
mera waada to yehi tha
inna lillah inna lillah
inna lillahe wa inna ilahe rajeoon
<<DIVIDER>>
koi nahi raha to bhala kya jiyunga mai
socha na tha ke jung akele ladunga mai
kaise haram ki tanha hifazat karunga mai
kaise namaz e asr akele padhunga mai
haye sab bikhar gaye sab ujad gaye
hona to yehi tha waada to yehi tha
mera waada to yehi tha
inna lillah inna lillah
inna lillahe wa inna ilahe rajeoon
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa hoon bewatan ke ab apna nahi koi
ghere huwe hai chaaron taraf se mujhe shaqi
haye ye bekasi meri haye ye bebasi
mai ek shab bhi chain se soya nahi kabhi
haye sab bikhar gaye sab ujad gaye
hona to yehi tha waada to yehi tha
mera waada to yehi tha
inna lillah inna lillah
inna lillahe wa inna ilahe rajeoon
<<DIVIDER>>
maana ke lut gaya era ghar baar ay khuda
lekin tere nabi ke nawase ki hai dua
mai is tarha se haq e shahadat karun ada
zinda rahe dilon mein hamesha ye karbala
haye sab bikhar gaye sab ujad gaye
hona to yehi tha waada to yehi tha
mera waada to yehi tha
inna lillah inna lillah
inna lillahe wa inna ilahe rajeoon
items.author: N. Sarwar & H. Naqvi

items.title: Jab sakina ne rokar
items.body:
jab sakina ne ro ke kaha
ay phupi ab madine chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala aa ke ghar lut gaya
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo ay phupi
<<DIVIDER>>
hum idhar apne ghar jayenge
pyaas ke zakhm bhar jayenge
gham ki mil jayegi kuch dawa
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai akbar na qasim rahe
mere ammu na asghar rahe
chin chuka zindagi ka maza
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
goshware bhi cheene gaye
aur tamache bhi maare gaye
seh liya har sitam seh liya
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
deed ke phool khil jayenge
saath ke log mil jayenge
kuch to aaraam mil jayega
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa ke dadi ko dekhenge hum
apni baaji se mil lenge hum
dekhte honge sab raasta
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
har musibat hai seena sipar
lag raha hai aseeri se darr
ho na jaaye kahin be rida
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gaye qaid ahle haram
bad gaye aur dard o alam
khaafila bas ye sunta raha
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
maar daalega dard e jigar
saans ruk jaye kab kya khabar
qaid khana hai ghar maut ka
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
godh jangal se veeran hai
maut ka meri imkaan hai
ro rahi hai meri waalida
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas ki talqiyan hai bahot
maut ki hichkiyan hai bahot
ab mera dam nikal jayega
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ye hasrat na poori hui
mar gayi shaah ki laadli
phir na ishrat ye goonji sada
ay phupi ab madine chalo
ab madine chalo…
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Kaash akbar tere
items.body:
kaash akbar tere jaisa tera beta hota
tujhko andaza mere darde jigar ka hota
<<DIVIDER>>
maangne aata jawani mein wo marne ki riza
aur beta bhi tera hota mohamed jaisa
pooch kar dil se bata haal tera kya hota
kaash akbar tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha karta jawan laal ko rukhsat beta
kaise deta usay marne ki ijazat beta
teri behno ne jise naaz se paala hota
kaash akbar tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaampte haath larazte huwe saanson ke qadam
kis tarha dekhta aankhon se nikalte huwe dam
pyaar bhi us se tujhe sab se zyada hota
kaash akbar tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere hisse mein meri jaisi ghareebi aati
waqt se pehle mere laal zaeefi aati
wo pisar saamne jab khoon mein dooba hota
kaash akbar tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhta aankhon se jab noor-e-nazar ke tukde
baap ke moo se nikal aate jigar ke tukde
saath barchi ke jo haathon pe kaleja hota
kaash akbar tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par khoon mein tadapti ho nabi ki tasveer
sabr kar leta bata haath mein rakh ke shamsheer
jab ke haste huwe qaatil ko bhi dekha hota
kaash akbar tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko maaloom bhi hota na uthega ye pisar
kya tere dil pe guzarti ye bata de akbar
uski sughra ka bhi khat aane hi waala hota
kaash akbar tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ye kehte thay takallum shah e waala ro kar
hoti akbar teri aulaad zamane mein agar
tujhko ehsaas mere dil ki tadap ka hota
kaash akbar tere...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Karbala ki rayt pe
items.body:
karbala ki rayt pe pyason ki hai ye daastan
hai sakina ki sada pe tham gayi nehr e rawan
<<DIVIDER>>
na rahe abbas ghazi na raha akbar jawan
ho gaye qasim ke tukde ashkhiyon ke darmiyan
karbala ki rayt pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar e baysheer ne kaisa diya hai imtehan
muskurana dekh kar hai ro pade arz o samaa
karbala ki rayt pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tay kiya kaise safar jakde huwe zanjeer mein
sayyede sajjad par hai ro rahi thi bediyan
karbala ki rayt pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab musibat ko teri hashim kare kaise bayan
be rida kulsoom o zainab hai shaki ke darmiyan
karbala ki rayt pe...
items.author: Hashim Bahadar

items.title: Kya kare bemaar
items.body:
kya kare bemaar sughra dil jo ghabraya kare
baap maa bhai behan ki yaad tadpaya kare
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khushi shadi mein akbar ki bulayenge zaroor
hasratein allah sabke dil ki bar laaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh lene ki tamanna dil mein lab par ye dua
sar pe bhai ke bandhe sehra behan saaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
badke kismat ne kaha poori na hongi hasratein
hai likha hamsheer bin bhai ki kehlaaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogayi bewa dulhan ek raat ki wa hasrata
phool umeedon ka khil kar yun na murjhaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay sarwar sada do ay ali akbar mujhe
thokare kab tak sare maidan padar khaaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali jhoola dekh kar asghar ka kehti hai rabab
maut gar aaye to pehle maa ko aa jaaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bhi aisa nahi aalam mein juz tere hussain
shukre haq karte huwe gardan ko katwaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon se us ghadi moo apna dholena qamar
jab musibat karbala ki yaad aajaya kare
kya kare bemaar sughra...
items.author: Qamar Jalalvi

items.title: Mazloom ka matam
items.body:
mazloom ka matam hai ruka hai na rukega
ye aisa diya hai jo hawaon mein jalega
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsaar e yazeedi pe lagega wo tamacha
jo haath azadaar ke seene pe padega
mazloom ka matam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bole ye haathon pe utha kar sar e maqtal
hai kaun jo asghar se mere baad karega
mazloom ka matam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada rahega hussain ka gham
ye shor e girya ye shor e matam
zehra ki dua hai ye matam
ye matam kaise ruk jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
seh roz ke pyason se ye pani ka hai waada
kaunain mein ab koi bhi pyasa na rahega
mazloom ka matam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr banke koi aaye to shabbir ki jaanib
ye aisa gharana hai jo maangoge milega
mazloom ka matam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ne kaha sheh se ulat doonga mai lashkar
baba mujhe do ghoont agar pani milega
mazloom ka matam hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baadshah e karbala deen ka hai aasra
teri majlis tera matam zindagi hai ye hussain
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
qaayim ko zara aane do ghaibat se takallum
ek halqa abhi khaana e kaaba mein lagega
mazloom ka matam hai...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Na ro na ro
items.body:
na ro na ro na ro masoom sakina
zindan may ab yaad na kar baba ka seena
<<DIVIDER>>
charon simt andhera paas hai nahi koi
ab to ghazi ki bhi aas nahi koi
kaun sune faryadein hai door madina
na ro na ro…
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko qaid na milti gar tanhai ki
beemari na badti tere bhai ki
rota khoon ankhon se sajjad kabhi na
na ro na ro…
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi teri maa ko ek pal chain nahi
zainab o kulsoom ka rukte bain nahi
godh rubab ki ujdi abaad hui na
na ro na ro…
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad usay baba ki jab tadpati hai
sar apna deewaron se takrati hai
ro ro ke kehti hai dushwaar hai jeena
na ro na ro…

items.title: Aagaye dashte karbala
items.body:
baqae la ilaah hussain hai
farmane mustafa hai ye qaule rasool hai
hussaino minni wa ana minal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
awwalona mohamed ausatona mohamed
aakhirona mohamed kullona mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
aagaye dashte karbala mein ye saare mohamed
kaho salaam ya rasulluah
ye dashte karbala hai ye dashte maarya hai
ye dashte nainawa hai
mohamed haye mohamed
mohamed haye mohamed
suno faryad mohamed
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnalabon ke lab pe sada wa mohameda
ghayre hue hai fauje jafa wa mohameda
sar pe khadi hai sheh ke qaza wa mohameda
dikhla raha hai waqt ye kya wa mohameda
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui zameen pe hai laasha hussain ka
be-gor o be-kafan hai janaza hussain ka
koi nahi hai poochne waala hussain ka
qaidi banaya jaata hai kunba hussain ka
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor choor hai sajda hussain ka
jism o sare hussain pade hai juda juda
dooba hua hai khoon mein sehra e karbala
laashe shahe zaman pe hai ghurbat ka marsiya
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadmon pe sadme khaate hai sarwar bachaiye
toote hue hai naiza o khanjar bachaiye
umran hua hai shaah pe lashkar bachaiye
zainab nikal na aaye khule sar bachaiye
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
badta hi ja raha hai masayib ka silsila
ab to nahi hai qaime mein abbas e bawafa
dete hai cheekh cheekh ke ye ahle shar sada
ab loot lo qayaam hussain e ghareeb ka
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pukarti hai yehi roke baar baar
maajaye tujhpe khahare khasta jigar nisar
aankhon ke saamne hai ye manzar jigar figaar
tanha behan hai aur bhare ghar ki soghwaar
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
halqe shahe ghareeb pe khanjar bhi chal gaya
baad e rasool kaise zamana badal gaya
qaima nabi ki aal ka karbal mein jal gaya
bano ka chand dashte musibat mein dhal gaya
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein panjetan ki nishani tamam hai
qismat mein ab aseeron ke bas gham ki shaam hai
ro'o ay momino ye buka ka maqam hai
bedi rasan hai tauq hai laagar imam hai
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha dayam o yazdan yehi zainab ka marsiya
maqtal mein bekafan hai janaza hussain ka
zakmon se choor choor hai zehra ka dilruba
rote thay sar ko peet ke sultan e ambiya
mohamed haye mohamed...
suno faryad mohamed...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Ab kisi se ruk
items.body:
ab kisi se ruk nahi sakta bayan e karbala
likh gaye abbas khoon se daastane karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
gham manate hi rahenge hum azadare hussain
ashk bante hi rehenge tarjumane karbala
ab kisi se ruk....
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan mohamed ki bahca kar so gaye jaise ali
deen bacha kar sogaya yun mehmane karbala
ab kisi se ruk...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan dekar karbala walon ne aasan kar diya
kis khadar mushkil tha warna imtehane karbala
ab kisi se ruk...
<<DIVIDER>>
shakl pehchani na jaati deen walon deen ki
wo to kahiye hogaya baakhi nishane karbala
ab kisi se ruk...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar e nadan ki danayi ki sadqe jaaiye
ye mujahid ban gaya hai haske jaane karbala
ab kisi se ruk...
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf deen e haq ki tafseerein bahattar hai urooj
ban gaye hai karbala walay zaban e karbala
ab kisi se ruk...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Akbar hame mar
items.body:
ghurbat ki ghadi ye aayi aankhon se chali beenayi
tum ghar se chale ho aise jaata hai janaza jaise
haye akbar haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar hame mar jaane do phir marne ko jaana
mujskil hai zaeefi mein jawan laash uthana
<<DIVIDER>>
phir laut ke aayegi na maqtal se sawari
maa ko bada armaan tha shadi ka tumhari
taboot pe mumkin to nahi sehra sajana
akbar hame mar jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime se zara door chalo ay mere dilbar
ye baat na sunle kahin zainab meri aakar
ay laal tera seena hai naizon ka nishana
akbar hame mar jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
maango na qaza mujhse tadapta hai mera dil
kismat ki lakeeron ka badalna nahi mushkil
hum umr badha denge zara haath dikhana
akbar hame mar jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka marna hai meri maut ka aelaan
kuch rehm karo meri zaeefi pe meri jaan
aasaan nahi seene se barchi ka chudana
akbar hame mar jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom ki tooti hai kamar aas na todo
ay laal mere saamne yun haath na jodo
acha nahi lagta hamay har baar batana
akbar hame mar jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
naiza dil e naazuk mein utarta hua dekhun
mai zinda rahun aur tumhe marta hua dekhun
tum mein nazar aate hai hamesha mujhe nana
akbar hame mar jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
utho mere qadmon se ijazat tumhe denge
acha chalo hum baat agar maan bhi lenge
mushkil hai bohat saani e zahra ko manana
akbar hame mar jaane...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar gaye maqtal mein gire zeen se zameen par
laashe se takallum ye kaha sheh ne tadap kar
tehro abhi kuch dayr na ho khuld rawana
akbar hame mar jaane...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Ali ka martaba
items.body:
ali ka martaba allahu akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
abu talib ka beta naam hyder
laqab karrar aur siddiqe akbar
asadullah karrar o safdar
qayamat tak na hoga jinka humsar
khuda ne taygh di ahmed ne dukhtar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
wiladat khana e kaaba may paayi
ajal bhi aayi to masjid may aayi
farishto ki tarhe haajat rawayi
khuda ne di jise mushkil kushai
kare murde ko zinda jis ki thokar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
mili jisko wilayat aur imamat
wo jis ki zauja ho khatoone jannat
mili shabbir o shabbar jaisi naymat
hai ek chutki may dunya bhar ki daulat
raha jo zeenat e mehrab o mimbar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
fazeelat aap ki kis'se bayan ho
jo masroofe raqam saara jahan ho
waraq chahe zameen-o-aasman ho
raqam phir bhi na inki daastan ho
agar ho raushnaai ye samandar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali gyara imamo ke pidar hai
nabi hai shehr to ye inka dar hai
payambar ke liye seena sipar hai
shabe meraaj haq ke humsafar hai
ali aur ahmed e mursal ka bistar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi binte asad si koi aurat
mili jisko khuda se ye fazeelat
pali aagosh may jis ki imamat
khuda ka ghar bana jaaye wiladat
hua jiske liye dewaar may dar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ghusse se shikan aayi jabeen tak
na ulti jang may bhi aasteen tak
laraz jaate thay jibraeel ameen tak
ali ka naam hai fathe mubeen tak
likhi daste ali pathar pe khyber
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
madad ko aagaye jisne pukara
diya dushman ko bhi apne sahara
diya toofan may kashti ko kanara
chamak utha muqaddar ka sitara
ali mushkil kusha saaqiye kausar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
karo har saal matam murtuza ka
manao gham ali mushkil kusha ka
ye hai taboot sher e kibriya ka
ke ghar ujda mohamed mustufa ka
ke hai naala kuna shabbir o shabbar
ali ka martaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka ye karam kya mujhpe kam hai
ali ka zikr aur mera qalam hai
ye sab taqdeer ki nazre karam hai
ali ka naam kitna mohtaram hai
kahe kunwa uthake sehto mehshar
ali ka martaba...
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay hurre dilawar
items.body:
laashe ko utha karke ye kehne lage sarwar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
<<DIVIDER>>
jaata hai hamein chod ke tu jaanibe kausar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein aakar sare hur zaanu pe rakha
aur kehte thay aaqa
leta hai ajab haal mein khaaye hue khanjar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehman nawazi teri hum kar nahi paaye
moo kaise dikhaye
sharminda hai tujhse ye tera sibte payambar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsan tera ye hai ke tu haq pe hai aaya
jaan apni gawaya
iski to jaza khuld mein dengi meri madar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne se tere ahle haram karte hai matam
unko hai bahot gham
tere liye rote hai mere qasim o akbar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani na piya tune ke pyasa hi chala hai
ye dashte bala hai
tu mujhpe fida hogaya ay nasir o yawar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayenge ziarat ko tere chaahne waale
karte hue naale
hoga tera karbal ke khareeb rauza e athar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte thay dua shaah bober laash pe jis dam
aankhein rahi purnam
matam tera hota rahe ta arsh e mehshar
ay hurre dilawar ay hurre dilawar
laashe ko utha kar...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Ayyame ali
items.body:
shion mein aaj kal ye qayamat ke roz hai
dunya se bu-turab ke ruqsat ke roz hai
yaaron saron ko peeto ye zarbat ke roz hai
rolo ke ye ali ki shahadat ke roz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aagaye ayyam e ali aagaye
momino matam karo sar peet ke
<<DIVIDER>>
chaand bhi ramzan ka nauha kare
aagaye ayyam e ali aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
kaale libason mein hai ahle aza ki fughan
yaum e shahadat ki sab karte hai tayyariyan
yaad kare matami aap ki tanhaiyan
farsh e aza ghar mein bichane lage
aagaye ayyame ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
taari abhi se hua hai shab e zarbat ka gham
koi padhe marsiya koi sajaye alam
tifl o jawan peer sab sunte hai nauhe baham
nauha suna aankh se aansu gire
aagaye ayyame ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlisein ghar ghar bapa hogayi ya sayyadi
nikle juloos e aza aaj gali dar gali
aap ke gham mein hua saara jahan matami
aayi sada ye dar o deewar se
aagaye ayyame ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo uneesween aayi jo gham ki sahar
ki bine muljim ne jab zulm ki hadh aap par
taygh e sitam chal gayi hogaya do paara sar
kehte thay jibreel bhi rote huwe
aagaye ayyame ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbar o shabbir jab aap ko le aaye ghar
bibiyan rone lagi seena o sar peet kar
koh e alam gir pada aaj to sadaat par
zainab o kulsoom ke ye bain thay
aagaye ayyame ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne taboot ka aagaya samaan jab
badne laga aur bhi seene mein ranj o taab
dil kahe be-saakhta haye ameer e arab
baat yehi khoon rulaye mujhe
aagaye ayyame ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
mesum o mazhar bhi hai barsare farshe aza
aap ke ghar waalon ko dono ne pursa diya
aap ke taboot par humne ye nauha padha
dard mein doobe huwe ash'aar se
aagaye ayyame ali...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Bediyan pairon may
items.body:
tha lab e zainab pa nauha bediyan pairon may hai
kya chale sajjad rasta bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole abid dafn mai kaise karun kyun kar karun
bekafan baba ka laasha bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
do qadam chalte hai gir jaate hai abid kya kare
zor hai tashnalabi ka bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai se umeed e hamdardi kare to kya kare
ro ke kehte hai sakina bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab sayyed e sajjad se ay mere laal
shaam tak tum ko hai jaana bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e sarwar dekhiye to abid e beemar ko
aa gaya aisa zamana bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali sajjad ki mushkil kushayi kijiye
hai atash se zard chehra bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
de sahara kaun ishrat sayyed e sajjad ko
dard ka seene may naiza bediyan pairon may hai
tha lab e zainab pa nauha...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Chala gaya abbas
items.body:
alam jo darya se aata hua dikhayi diya
sakina dar pe jo pahunchi to baap ko dekha
ye ro ke bacchi ne poocha kahan hai mere chacha
alam sakina ke haathon mein de ke sheh ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
alam badha do sakina chala gaya abbas
hussain hogaya tanha chala gaya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
yaqeen aata nahi tha ke mar gaya ghazi
mai thap thapata raha uske gaal ay beti
magar hussain ki us waqt aas toot gayi
jab aake maa ne bataya chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina pani se kis ki nazar utarogi
tum ammu jaan kise keh ke ab pukarogi
wo yaad aayega jab shaam tum sidharogi
nahi milega dobara chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunch ke nehr pe mashkeeza jab bhara us ne
sakina yaad teri pyaas ko rakha us ne
tha us ke saamne pani nahi piya us ne
tumhari tarha se pyasa chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne gurz jo maara to wo sambhal na saka
kate thay haath sahara wo kis tarha leta
zameen pe aise gira zakhmi ho gaya chehra
dobara uth nahi paaya chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan kahan usay royi hai meri tanhaai
kahin badan tha kahin haath kya ghadi aayi
bikhar gaya mera battees saal ka bhai
pada hai dasht mein laasha chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan bhai ka mar jaana sakht manzil hai
mai kaise zinda hoo ye jaanta mera dil hai
magar sakina ye ek kaam sab se mushkil hai
teri phupi ko batana chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
laga hai haath pe jo khoon ye usi ka hai
tha uski aankh mein jo teer maine khayncha hai
wo jaanta tha mere dil mein kya tamanna hai
pukaar kar mujhe bhaiya chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen pe girne se dandaan uske zakhmi thay
kate thay hont badan choor choor zakhmon se
tum aise haal mein ghazi ko dekhti kaise
jabhi to ghar nahi aaya chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghadi wo aayi thi zeeshan aur raza kaisi
kaha ye qaimon mein jab sheh ne mar gaya ghazi
giri zameen pe ghash khaa ke bibyan saari
koi bhi sun nahi paaya chala gaya abbas
alam badha do...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Deti rahi bacchon
items.body:
deti rahi bacchon ko sakina ye dilaase
pani ka mai keh aayi hoon abbas chacha se
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza rakha maine jo shaane pe chacha ke
rone lage baba unhe seene se laga ke
roti thi phupi dhaamp ke moo apna rida se
deti rahi bacchon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadpe thay chacha jis ghadi maine ye kaha tha
zinda nahi reh payega cheh maah ka baccha
mar jaaye na asghar kahin seh roz ke pyase
deti rahi bacchon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se kisi koozon ko girne nahi dena
ay pyaas ke maaro abhi kuch hausla rakhna
kuch dayr mein bhar jayenge pani se ye kaase
deti rahi bacchon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho jayega darya pe abhi qabza hamara
saahil pe unhe koi bhi awaaz na dena
bhatke na dhyaan unka kahin ran mein sada se
deti rahi bacchon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeze ki karte hai yun haathon se hifazat
jaise ho koi fatema zehra ki amanat
ummeed thi mujhko ehi daadi ki dua se
deti rahi bacchon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye mere baba ka baradar hua zakhmi
wo mashk chidi beh gaya maidan mein pani
bach jaaye chacha sab ye dua maango khuda se
deti rahi bacchon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ye fughan karti thi ro ro ke sakina
darya se palat kar nahi aaya mera saqqa
neend aa na gayi ho kahin saahil ki hawa se
deti rahi bacchon ko...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Honton pe mere
items.body:
honton pe mere naam e ali naam e ali hai
sunkar jise mushkil badi mushkil may padi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
apna to wohi rab wohi quran o nabi hai
chauda sau baras pehle jo tha deen wohi hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai baara imamo ki wohi rehbari ab bhi
ek baat bhi isme na badi hai na ghati hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai panjetan e paak kisi darse ibarat
apne liye jo raahe amal humne chuni hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
maa kehti thi qasim to suye khuld sidhare
kubra ke muqaddar may likhi dar badari hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ka ye nauha ke kab aaoge asghar
aghosh may lene ko ye maa dar pe khadi hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan se sakina ke koi khol de rassi
bachi ka gala ghut'ta hai ab saans ruki hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha chod gayi saath sakina
nanhi si lehad shaam ke zindan may bani hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
shehzadi kahi jaati thi koofe may jo zainab
be-parda wahin ab sare darbar khadi hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
beti hai yehi fatema zehra o ali ki
bazaron may jo saath chali jo ke phiri hai
honton pe mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye matame sheh zeest ka haasil hai mujahid
dam seene may jab tak hai yehi nauhagiri hai
honton pe mere…
items.author: Mujahid Lakhnavi

items.title: Kaash roze ashoora
items.body:
haye yateemi haye aseeri
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein sakina ye keh rahi thi ro ro kar
kaash roze ashoora mai bhi mar gayi hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
roz dam nikalta na is tarha se ghut ghut kar
kaash roze ashoora mai bhi mar gayi hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
jo chacha mujhe meri jaan se bhi pyara tha
meri pyaas ki khaatir khoon beh gaya uska
mai nisaar ho jaati kaash apne ammu par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine apne ammu ka khoon mein tar alam dekha
naujawan bhai ka aaya saamne laasha
mujhko maut aayi na mar gaya mera asghar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ka woohi khanjar mujhpe chal gaya hota
kaash us ghadi mera dam nikal gaya hota
shimr jab chadha mere baba jaan ke seene par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheen li layeeno ne jis ghadi rida meri
dono haath chehre par rakh ke mai bohat roye
ye sada niklti thi mere dil se reh reh kar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne tamachon se jis ghadi mujhe maara
roye nok e naiza par phoot kar mere baba
ye churi nahi chalti baba jaan ke dil par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono kaan zakhmi hai dono gaal neele hai
kya yateem bacchon par aise zulm hote hai
kaun tha taras khaata jo meri yateemi par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko jab kaneezi mein ek layeen ne maanga
soch kar yehi us dam mera dil bohat roya
mai ali ki poti hoon aur ye sitam mujh par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein gar meri nafz tham gayi hoti
mai bhi apne baba ke paas qabr mein soti
wo wahan tadapte na aur mai qaid ke andar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal aamir o waiz kya kahe yateema ka
qaid e shaam mein jis dam ghamzada ka dam nikla
maut ki har ek hichki le rahi thi ye keh kar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Karbala mein aayi hoo
items.body:
mai chut ke shaam se ab karbala mein aayi hoo
tumhari qabr pe ashkon ka tohfa laayi hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari thi jo amanat mai usko laa na saki
usay tamachon ki zemhat se mai bacha na saki
mai uski qaid mein turbat bana ke aayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhara kurta siya tha jo amma zehra ne
wo jisko loot liya waqt e asr aada ne
mai shaam se wohi kurta bhi saath laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
lo aagayi hai ye khwahar utho utho bhaiya
mai aur chal nahi sakti sahara do bhaiya
rasool ki hoo nawasi falak satayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhai hum bhare darbaar se guzaare gaye
ghazab to ye hai ke pathar bhi humko maare gaye
nishan e zakhm jabeen par saja ke laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
imam e waqt ye masoom abid e bemaar
har ek gaam pe jisne uthaye hai aazaar
mai jalte sholon se usko bacha ke laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mere aun o mohamed wo qasim o akbar
mai saath laayi hoo in sab ke bhi kate huwe sar
tumhara sar bhi badan se milaane laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab uthi roti hui qabre sheh se binte ali
ye bain karti hui tab suye furaat chali
jo mujhpe guzri ay ghazi sunaane aayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo qabre shaah wo chehlum ka din wo zainab e zaar
ye nauha goonj raha tha ay majid o mukhtar
salaam karne shaheedon mai tumko aayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Kya kare zainab
items.body:
shaam e ghariban shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
jal gaye qaime so gaya lashkar
lut gaya saara ghar zainab ka ab hai tanha
na sarwar hai na akbar hai na ghazi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
layeen naize se chadar cheenta hai kya kare zainab
thi jis bhai se dhaaras mar gaya hai kya kare zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
manata hai khushi zaalim dikhata hai mujhe khanjar
bula abbas ko apne ye kehta hai wo has has kar
lahoo chadar se meri pochta hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri har zarb ka ghazi behan se lega wo badla
layeen qaime mein aaya hai uthakar haath mein durra
tumhi binte ali ho poochta hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
badi ghurbat ka aalam hai bandhe hai haath gardan se
bujhaye aag wo kaise sakina tere daaman se
aur ab zaalim tamacha maarta hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha zainab ne abid se imam e waqt batlaye
yahin qaimon mein jal jaaye ya hum baahar nikal jaaye
utho sajjad mushkil marhala hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye saad ke bete ne aa kar ibne naufil se
safar mein chaahe sab soye magar zainab nahi soye
abhi se warm rukh par aagaya hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
usay ek maa ki tarha apne seene se laga leti
rasan haathon mein na hoti to girne se bacha leti
sar e ghazi sina se gir raha hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi apna nahi tanha khadi hai dasht mein dekho
kafan kaise de atthara bani hashim ke laashon ko
madina to nahi ye karbala hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ho laal aajao tumhe maa yaad karti hai
uthakar raakh haathon mein rabab ek simt baithi hai
ali asghar ka jhoola jal chuka hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai pehli shab yateemi ki usay neend aayegi kaise
ay zeeshan o raza baali sakina soti thi jis pe
wo seena ran mein teeron se bhara hai kya kare zainab
layeen naize se chadar...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Pamaal sumay aspa
items.body:
pamaal sumein aspa ay chaak badan qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
marne ke liye tune jab izn nahi paaya
khidmat mein shahe deen ki khat baap ka pahunchaya
phir ashk-e-musalsal thay aur shaah ka chehra tha
yaad aagaye kuch payma ay chaak badan qasim
pamaal sumein aspa…
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan se jaise hi awaaz teri aayi
faujon ki taraf jhapte abbas bhi sarwar bhi
bhagdar jo machi ran mein har samt qayamat thi
phir ruk na saka toofan ay chaak badan qasim
pamaal sumein aspa…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimo mein qayamat hai kubra pe falak toota
rone ki sada'ein hai madar ko hua sadma
nou shah ko chadar mein laate hai shahe wala
ab hogaya ghar veeran ay chaak badan qasim
pamaal sumein aspa…
<<DIVIDER>>
sandal hai na gehne hai ubtan hai na mehndi hai
is tarha ki shaadi bhi logon kahin hoti hai
maqtal mein hai baraati har samt udasi hai
aur khaak basar hai maa ay chaak badan qasim
pamaal sumein aspa…
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch deyr mein dulhan ke haaton mein rasan hogi
toote huye khabon ki ankhon mein chuban hogi
tay hoga safar tanha kya dil pe thakan hogi
mitti mein milay armaan ay chaak badan qasim
pamaal sumein aspa…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab farsh-e-aza par hai taqreeb-e-uroosi mein
soughat hai matam ki ashkon ki rawani mein
taa hashr hai gham shahid is majlis-e-shaadi mein
ghamkhar hai sab girya ay chaak badan qasim
pamaal sumein aspa…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Ab kisko teri madar
items.body:
ab kisko teri maadar lori sunaye asghar
raaton ko uth ke kiska jhoola jhulaye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat ki tashnagi mein jhoole se ran mein jaa kar
daste pidar pe ran mein khoon mein nahaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nusrat mein deen e haq ki gardan pe teer khaa kar
veeran kar ke godhi jangal basaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maadar ghareeb dukhiya kis ko jhulaye jhoola
chote se ye shalooke kis ko pinhaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar apni maa ki godhi mein chale aao
hasrat hai tum ko maadar ek pal sulaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon chidak ke bole turbat pe teri sarwar
jee bhar ke mujhko aada ran mein rulaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis din se maa ne dekha naize pa sar tumhara
haalat pa teri ro kar kehti hai haye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi ilteja e saabir matam ho tera ghar ghar
jhoola uthe jo tera sab khoon bahaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta ye anjuman hai matam sara tumhari
sar ta qadam jo saare khoon mein nahaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar mein wo yaqeenan jannat mein honge mazhar
dunya mein jo tumhara jhoola uthaye asghar
ab kisko teri maadar...

items.title: Abbas na jao
items.body:
seene se lago ya mujhe seene se lagao
abbas na jao
zainab ko ghash aaya hai usay hosh mein lao
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ho to usay apni rida yaad nahi hai
baba ka kaha tum na usay yaad dilao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai ke ye haath mere sar ki rida hai
lillaah na in haathon ko darya pe katao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jaate ho jabse ye khabar usne suni hai
wo khaak pe baithi hai sakina ko uthao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar ke alamadar ho tum ho mera lashkar
lillaah mere hote na hathyaar sajao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani se bhala hijr ki kab pyaas bujhegi
hai tashnalabon ki ye sada haye na jao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle mere halqoom pe chal jaane do khanjar
jeete ji mujhe tum to na ye daagh dikhao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir shimr hai aur shaam e ghariban ka andhera
chodun mai sakina ko kahan ye to batao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay bain ye qaime mein naved ahle haram ke
baad apne darindo ke liye chod na jao
abbas na jao
seene se lago...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Akbar huwe jawan
items.body:
akbar huwe jawan jo bachpan guzaar ke
laila ye samjhi aaye hai ab din bahaar ke
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kab khabar thi aayegi pardes mein qaza
armaan na honge poore dil e sogwaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko raas aaya na attharwan baras
loota khiza ne daur mein faslein bahaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
husn e jawani e ali akbar ko dekhiye
laila sarhane baithi hai zulfein sawaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle mustafa pa bhi aaya na kuch taras
ibne anas ne qatl kiya naiza maar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ka phal hai seene mein hichki hai maut ki
sheh ko salaam karte hai akbar pukaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ke dil mein reh gaya armaan byaah ka
baithi hai gham raseeda muqqadar se haar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
laaye hussain qaime mein akbar ki laash jab
maa dekh kar tadapne lagi cheekh maar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kubra ka ye bayan tha maadar se baar baar
behno ko de do bhai ka sadqa utaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos teen roz ke pyase huwe shaheed
kumla gaye hai hont mere gulzaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki lehad pa aaoge padhne ko fateha
baithoge tum khareeb hamare mazaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
muddat se dil mein maa ke tamanna thi mere laal
shaadi teri rachaungi sadqa utaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e hussain ahle haram hai barehna sar
zaalim ridayein le gaye sar se utaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas aakhri ye dil ki tamanna hai ay qamar
rauze pa jald pahunche shah e naamdaar ke
akbar huwe jawan jo...
items.author: Qamar Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay hussain jaan
items.body:
ay hussain jaan ay hussain jaan
ay ali ke laal ay shahe zaman
fatha kar liye tune do jahan
muskura utha jab ke bezuban
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
tu panahe deen tu hi shahe deen
warise nabi kaaba e yaqeen
naazish e haram haq ke paasban
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala jihad karbala qayam
tune hashr tak de diya payam
roohe karbala raaze kunfaka
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
de ke sar liya zulm se firaat
tujhse reh gayi ambiya ki laaj
ibne fatima faqre mursala
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr ka tazkira hai waraq waraq
sunke aagaya jo sadaye haq
subhe karbala maaniye azan
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi se door hogaye haram
jab hua shaheed aamile alam
jis ke dosh par haq ka tha nishan
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se hat gaye saare mursaleen
bad gaye nabi choomne jabeen
keh ke ya ali khaynchi jo sina
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis mareez par tha sitam tamam
dashte zulm se ta-ziyare shaam
wo aseere gham meer e karwan
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
madare hussain deti hai dua
goonjti rahe bas yehi sada
farshe khaak se ta ba aasma
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi tamam zikre karbala
nusrate imam girya-o-buka
lab pe suboh shaam ho yahi fughan
ay hussain jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
do sada fareed matame hussain
koi gham na ho juz ghame hussain
hashr tak rahe bas yehi samaa
ay hussain jaan…
items.author: Fareed Baig

items.title: Bachpan mein agar
items.body:
bachpan mein agar maa mar jaaye
is gham se bada gham koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se poocho to
is zakhm ka marham koi nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
ya mazlooma ya masooma
ya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
bacchon ko sambhale mazlooma
ya maula ki imadad kare
masoom imamon ki maadar
haye kis se faryad kare
ye zulm jo dhaane aaye hai
in logon mein kam koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar jalta hai uth'ta hai dhuaan
be-jaan hai binte paighambar
rote hai tadapte hai bacche
ghar mein hai qayamat ka manzar
aur haye nabi ki ummat mein
ranjeeda o barham koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
is gham mein nabi bhi rote hai
ye dard nahi tum ne jaana
fizza ne kaha ba-deeda e tar
is tarha ghar mein mat aana
ye noor e taharat ka ghar hai
aur tum mein mehram koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin ki shahadat pehlu mein
ye zakhm laga kitna gehra
deewar o dar ke beech mein phir
behosh hui gir kar zehra
ye dard bahra lamha hai
is jaisa aalam koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ke baad zamane mein
aisi mazloom hui zahra
deewar pakad kar chalti hai
kamzor zaeefa ki tarha
baazu zakhmi pehlu zakhmi
ek haath mein bhi dam koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
majrooh badan pehlu zakhmi
raaton ko neend aati hai
har ek qadam dukh deta hai
har saans qayamat dhaati hai
zehra ki tarha se dunya mein
hai chashme pur nam koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz hussain ke rone ki
jab kaan mein zehra ke aayi
phir band kafan bhi toot gaye
aur rooh badan mein ghabrayi
sab bharte hai dam dunya mein
maa jaisa hamdam koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat bhi nahi mazlooma ki
turbat ki jagah turbat ka nishan
is gham mein imame asr ke bhi
hai khoone jigar aankhon se rawan
is gham mein agar jo ro na sake
wo chashme adam koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shadman hum nauha padh kar
jab karte hai gham zehra ka
rote hai naseem us dam hyder
aur karte hai matam zehra ka
ye maadar e gham ka matam hai
is jaisa matam koi nahi
hasnain ke dil se...
items.author: Naseem Buknalvi

items.title: Bediyan roti rahi
items.body:
bediyan roti rahi abid e beemaar ke saath
khoon behta raha zanjeer ki jhankar ke saath
<<DIVIDER>>
khaar chubte rahe paon may qadam jalte rahe
durre khaate rahe sajjad e hazeen chalte rahe
bait paaye na kabhi saaye may deewar ke saath
bediyan roti rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauqe pur khaar se zaqmi tha gulu e athar
khoon rista tha galay se jo hilaate thay sar
aisa jakda tha gala tauqe garabaar ke saat
bediyan roti rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar jhukaye hai phupi amma se hai sharminda
chadarein laake udha bhi nahi sakte maula
roo ba roo kaise ho wo zainab lachaar ke saath
bediyan roti rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo itrat e shabbir ka phirna dar dar
arsh walon ne jinhe dekha nahi be chadar
berida kaise gayi fauje sitamgaar ke saath
bediyan roti rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye abid pe jawani may budhapa aaya
khoon aankhon se bahata raha mera maula
qaid hokar chali maa behne jab aghyaar ke saath
bediyan roti rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke baad bhi jab shaam koi kehta tha
maula sajjad ki aankhon se lahoo behta tha
gham hai kuch aise judhe shaam ke bazaar ke saath
bediyan roti rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aake majlis may hassan sar ko jhukaye rakhna
roke sajjad ko shabbir ka pursa dena
baithe honge wo kisi sheh ke azadar ke saath
bediyan roti rahi...
items.author: Hassan Mujtaba

items.title: Chala jab khafile
items.body:
chala jab khaafile ko leke suye koofa o shaam
mera mazloom imam
sar khule zainab e muztar thi aur tha majma e aam
mera mazloom imam
<<DIVIDER>>
sar jhukaye hue yun chalte rahe shaahe umam
aur bad jaata tha ye dekh ke bemaar ka gham
berida thi phuphi aur shaam ka bazaar e aam
mera mazloom imam
chala jab khaafile…
<<DIVIDER>>
baahon mein bediyan thi tauq galay mein tha pada
pushte bemaar ke haaton mein udoo ke durra
ghash kayi baar safar mein hue bemaar imam
mera mazloom imam
chala jab khaafile…
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro kehti thi sakina phupi ab kya hoga
jhoola jalne laga bhai bhi mera ran ko gaya
aag qaimon mein lagi jal gaya asbaab tamam
mera mazloom imam
chala jab khaafile…
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim ko sameinta shahe deen ne jis dum
mehendi haaton pe lagi dekh ke rote thay haram
rang ye sehre ki mili khaak mein kaisa tha sitam
mera mazloom imam
chala jab khaafile…
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon tapakta hai hassan noke qalam se ab to
dil phata jaata hai is soz e alam se ab to
girya karte hai malak roke yehi subho shaam
mera mazloom imam
chala jab khaafile…
items.author: Hassan

items.title: Faryade zindane
items.body:
faryad e zindan e shaam
mai hoon zindan e shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
maine dekhe hazaar ha qaidi
aise qaidi magar nahi dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doobe badan to dekhe hai
is qadar khoon mein tar nahi dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
maine dekhe hai jitne qaidi bhi
unki aankhon se ashk jaari thay
unke jismon pe zakhm kaari thay
unpe lamhe alam ke bhaari thay
jinka rona mujhe rulaata ho
maine yun nauhagar nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek qaidi to in mein aisa hai
tauq jiske galay mein bhaari hai
khaafile ka yehi muhaari hai
jiski aankhon se khoon jaari hai
sabr ke jo hunar hai paas iske
maine aise hunar nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam rote sahar ko rote hai
bekasi ke safar ko rote hai
thaam kar ye jigar ko rote hai
yaad kar kar ke ghar ko rote hai
aisa lagta hai in ghareebon ne
ek muddat se ghar nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise qaidi ke jin ke aane par
qaid khane sajaye jaate hai
khud rulaate hai aur rone par
taziyane lagaye jaate hai
qaidiyon par sitam to dekhe hai
par sitam is qadar nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
inke rone se aisa lagta hai
jaise ye do jahan rote hai
jab bhi karte hai ro ke ye naale
sab zameen asmaan rote hai
maine naale kisi bhi qaidi ke
is qadar pur asar nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud mein hi qaid ho raha hoon mai
dekh kar in ko ro raha hoon mai
kya bataun ye dard kaisa hai
jis ko dil mein samo raha hoon mai
maine mazloom to kayi dekhe
aise mazloom par nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
is museebat pe shukr ke sajde
itni ghurbat pe shukr ke sajde
ambiya bhi na kar sake honge
aisi haalat pe shukr ke sajde
jin ke sar par ho naaz sajde ko
maine to aise sar nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi qaamat hai inki noor ali
deen ki qaamat e daraaz hai ye
hai namazi ke khud namaz hai ye
dono aalam ke charasaaz hai ye
qaid mein qaidiyon ko dekha hai
qaid mein chaaragar nahi dekhe
maine dekhe...
items.author: Noor Ali

items.title: Haye abbas nahi
items.body:
dashte pur khaar may fizza ne kaha ye ro kar
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
sar pe aulaad e payambar ke nahi hai chadar
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas masoom sakina ki bujhado abbas
khaafila jaata hai maqtal se dua de abbas
jalte qaimon may haram ki ye sada thi lab par
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhidkiyan shimr ki sun kar wo kaha karti hai
mere ammu hai kahan bas ye buka karti hai
sehmi bachi se bhala kaun kahe ye jaa kar
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain sun sun ke sakina ke qaza roti hai
khaak udti hai hawa karbobala roti hai
haath may kooza liye baithi hai wo khaak basar
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hoo ka aalam hai koi monis o ghamkhar nahi
jis se dhaaras thi haram ko wo alamdar nahi
wo qayamat hai ke chinti hai haram ki chadar
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne haye sakina ko bhi sone na diya
be-kafan laasha e shabbir pe rone na diya
dasht may aale mohamed hai sitam ki zad par
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye zainab pe hai tanhaai andhere hai yahan
jal gaye qaima e athaar haram ki hai fughan
inna lillaah ki awaaz hai sab ke lab par
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
har sitam abid e muztar ko uthana hoga
aisa lagta hai darbaar may jaana hoga
kufa o shaam se hona hai aseeron ka guzar
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mohib rok qalam shor hai matam ka bapa
nauha yazdan se ye sunkar hai bapa shor e buka
har azadaar tadapta hai ye nauha sun kar
haye abbas nahi aaj abbas nahi
dashte pur khaar may...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Jab shaam jaana
items.body:
jab shaam jaana
bibi ko jaa kar nauha sunana
ahle aza tum jab shaam jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
tum hamesha yaad rakhna us zamane ka mehal
jis jagah tum ho wahin zainab rasan basta thi kal
thay yahin zanjeer mein jakde huwe zainuleba
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sakina ki lehed hai jis jagah hai roshni
sochiye ek din yahan par kis khadar thi teeragi
band thi saari sabeelein khatm tha har aasra
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyan paon uthaati thi magar uthta na tha
abid e beemar ka ghairat se sar uthta na tha
har taraf baazar mein tha aaina hi aaina
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo darwaza hai tehri thi jahan par bibiyan
kam nahi thay hashr ke manzar se wo ruswaiyan
has rahe thay berida sadaat par ahle jafa
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf se zulm ke patthar baraste thay yahin
waaris e tatheer chadar ko taraste thay yahin
goya barpa thi yahin par doosri ek karbobala
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
moo ko aata tha kaleja zainabe dilgeer ka
jis jagah ek tasht mein rakha tha sar shabbir ka
tha yahin baitha hua haakim sharabi behaya
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya khuda qaidi na ho aise yateemi mein koi
phir na maange is tarha bacchi kaneezi mein koi
tha sakina ke liye ek hashr ka wo samaa
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ki roodad batlayenge tumko raaste
thay yahin par ek rassi mein bandhe baara gale
ye ali ki betiyan hai thi munadi ki nida
ahle aza tum jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
nayyar o aamir ki hai tum se guzarish zaairon
ho sake to ek yateema ke liye lekar chalo
nanhi si do baliyan aur ek choti si rida
ahle aza tum jab...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Kaash tumko neend
items.body:
baba ki pyari sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban hai ye sakina
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
be-sar padar ka ban mein tha nauha
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar badan se hataun to kaise
lori tumhe mai sunaun to kaise
pehlu mein soja ay shaahzadi
seene pe tum ko sulaun to kaise
teeron bhara hai bistar tumhara
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer wapas jo aaya nahi hai
maine tumhe ye bataya nahi hai
lori sunayi hai teeron ne usko
asghar ko maine sulaya nahi hai
tum ko to lori dete hai baba
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt mujhpe bhi mushkil badi thi
pehlu mein maadar ke sota tha mai bhi
mai jaanta hoon ye mushkil hai kitna
bichdi thi jab mujhse dadi tumhari
mere liye bhi kehti thi zehra
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har taur khud ko sambhalegi zainab
go tum jo royi to royegi zainab
tum bhi samajhti ho phir bhi kahunga
gar tum na soyi to jaagegi zainab
zainab ki khaatir so jao beta
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho kuch door soye hai akbar
aun o mohamed hai soye wahan par
aadat hai pehre mein sone ki tumko
bibi muhafiz hai poore bahattar
charon taraf hai laashon ka pehra
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dher hai patharon ka zameen par
baithi ek bibi jis ke barabar
aulaad ke gham mein doobe padar ki
aati hai jis se sadayein ye akbar
jaagogi kab tak meri sakina
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Karbala mein kya
items.body:
karbala mein kya batayein hum ne kya kya dekha
hum ne laakhon mein hai shabbir ko tanha dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
yu to pani ko hai bechain pyase kitne
hum ne pyason ko taraste huwe darya dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na ashkon ki jagah khoon bahaye abid
jis ne maadar ka ho jalte huwe burqa dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ne jab seena e akbar se nikaala naiza
saat aate huwe akbar ka kaleja dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye us baali sakina ko kahan neend aaye
jis ne baba ka gala aankon se kat'ta dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki hasrat liye dunya se gaye sabz qaba
subhe ashoor wo lut'te huwe sehra dekha
karbala mein kya batayein...

items.title: Khamosh hai alqama
items.body:
khamosh hai alqama ki mauje
faza may bhi maut ka samaa hai
rida-e-zainab tera mohafiz
ukhadti saanso ke darmiyan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
hawa'on ke rukh badal rahe hai
qayaam darya se hat rahe hai
kisi ke teywar bata rahe hai
ke toot padne ko aasman hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam ki paykaan to kheynch lenge
hussain chashm-e-jari se lekin
khalish ka ek teer aur bhi hai
jo qalb-e-abbas may nihaan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina bibi ki tashnagi ka
jigar pe ab tak hai daagh baaqi
wahin wahin mashk bhi milegi
alam jari ka jahan jahan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ba chashm-e-purnam ba-waqte rehlat
ali ne jin baazu'on ko chooma
kahin wo baazu qalam huye hai
kahin pe in may reesma hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo lahoo paykar e tamanna
qareeb mashkeeza e sakina
gira hai rehwaar se wo aise
kahin pe baazu kahin nishan hai
khamosh hai…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Kya mai yateem
items.body:
kyun mujhpe sitam dhaane laga shimr e sitamgar
kya mai yateem hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein sakina ye buka karti thi ro kar
kya mai yateem hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
khaata hi nahi rehm ghareebon pe zara bhi
durre wo lagata hai kabhi deta ghudki
reh reh ke mujhe hota hai ehsaas yahan par
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam ghut'ta hai is zulm ke mahol se mera
yaad aati hai baba ki to phat'ta hai kaleja
sone ke liye mujhko mila khaak ka bistar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad bhi seene se lagate hai ye keh kar
ab laut ke aayenge nahi baba kabhi ghar
is baat pe chalte hai mere qalb pe khanjar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas itna bata dijiye mujhko phuphi amma
kab tak mujhe is dasht mein rehna hai hirasan
baba ko sada deti hoo aate nahi kyun kar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre huwe laashe hai bayaban mein har soo
is dasht mein kyun chod gaye hai mujhe ammu
kyun nahi leta koi khabar bhi meri aa kar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma mujhe aaghosh mein tum apni chupa lo
kuch dayr to pehlu mein zara mujhko sula lo
mai jaagti rehti hoon to rehta hai yehi darr
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay baba kahan ho mai tumhe dhoond rahi hoon
har laash ko baba ki samajh kar mai giri hoon
patthar se kabhi laashon se khaati hoon thokar
kya mai yateem hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin baap ki bacchi ki fughan safdar o mazhar
ek marsiya lagne lagi qirtaas pe aa kar
jab khaak udaate huwe kehti thi wo muztar
kya mai yateem hoon...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Meri kahani suno
items.body:
baba jaan baba jaan
meri kahani suno
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
<<DIVIDER>>
baba qasam khaa ke kehti rahi
karta nahi tha yaqeen ye koi
ab tum hi de do gawahi meri
in shamiyon se kaho
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor tak ye zaeefi na thi
baalon mein mere safedi na thi
tum jab gaye thay mai aisi na thi
lehje se pehchaan lo
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta tha zaalim satao isay
durre tamache lagao isay
naiza dikha kar darao isay
maloom tha shimr ko
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
baaghi ki beti samajh kar mujhe
bacchon ne maare hai pathar mujhe
rehna nahi ab yahan par mujhe
bas karbala le chalo
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
zid ki thi bachpan mein jab aap ne
aaye thay malboos firdaus se
aaj apni maadar se mere liye
mera kafan maang lo
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ka naksha badal jayega
kuch dayr mein dam nikal jayega
dil jaate jaate behal jayega
sughra ki baatein karo
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko tamacha hi aisa laga
nazron mein meri andhera hua
meri kamar mein bhi kham aagaya
daagh e rasan dekh lo
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar apne baba ke sar par rakhe
boli takallum wo rote huwe
sab maarne par tulay hai mujhe
tum keh do jeeti raho
baba tumhari sakina hoon mai
meri kahani suno...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Na tera bhai raha
items.body:
jab suna sughra ne laut aaya watan mein khafila
haye jab pahunchi to manzar dekh kar ro ke kaha
ay phuphi amma bhara ghar tha bhaiyon se mera
kya hua karbobala mein kuch to batlayein zara
<<DIVIDER>>
haye rote huwe zainab ne kaha ay sughra
na tera bhai raha na hi mera bhai raha
<<DIVIDER>>
baap jeeta bhi to kis tarha se ye gham seh ke
bhai ko pyar hi itna tha ali akbar se
jis ghadi seena e akbar se sina ko khayncha
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jis mashk mein asghar ke liye tha pani
haan usi mashk mein saansein thi mere ghazi ki
nehr par mashk pe jab teer laga pani baha
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath abbas thay akbar thay badi dhaaras thi
kis mein jurrat thi nazar hum pe uthata koi
tha yehi ek sabab hum jo huwe be-parda
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise batlaun sitam us ne uthaye kitne
shimr ne durre sakina ko lagaye kitne
kha gaya shaam ke zindan mein usay ye sadma
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to acha hi hua tum na gayi karbobala
tum se dekha hi nahi jaata jo maine dekha
seena akbar ka chida kat gaya sarwar ka gala
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri in aankhon ki thandak to mere bhai thay
maine in aankhon se dekha hai unhe marte huwe
kaise zinda hoon mai ab tak ye mujhe sughra bata
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas tere waaste aayi hai madine zainab
warna maqsad mere jeene ka nahi koi bhi ab
haye ab kaun sahara hai mere jeene ka
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema binte hassan se ye kaha kuch bolo
bhaiya qasim bhi nahi aate nazar kyun mujhko
fatema binte hassan kehne lagi ay sughra
na tera bhai raha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi behno pe judaai ye qayamat laayi
saari behno ki sadaon mein tha bhai bhai
sun ke zeeshan o raza roya madina saara
na tera bhai raha...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Pani ka band karna
items.body:
kis khaum may rawan hai pani ka band karna
aale nabi ko pyasa kisne zibha kiya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maari kisi ne barchi naiza kisi ne maara
dam tod'ta hai beta aur baap dekhta hai
kis khaum may...
<<DIVIDER>>
maare shimr ne baba moo par mere tamache
binte hussain tadpi mere durr bhi khenchta hai
kis khaum may...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e bawafa ne aisi wafa dikhayi
baazu kahin pade hai laasha kahin pada hai
kis khaum may...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab se koi pooche kaise mari sakina
zindan may akeli dam jiska ghut gaya hai
kis khaum may...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hurmala ne jaana pyasa nahi tha asghar
jiske galay ko chalni us teer ne kiya hai
kis khaum may...

items.title: Aagayi shaam ki nagri
items.body:
aagayi shaam ki nagri may khule sar zainab
maangti reh gayi ek ek se chadar zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
is liye zaalimon ne aur bhi pathar maare
jaante thay ke hai abbas ki khaahar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwatein lene lagi laashe hussain ibne ali
bhai ki laash pe aayi jo khule sar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
band ho jaati thi khud naize pe chashme abbas
jab nazar aati thi naaqe pe khule sar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa jaati thi us waqt usay nana ki
naize pe dekhti thi jab sar e akbar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko chadar na di kam zarf musalmano ne
gard ne daal di sar par tere chadar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi sar e shaam e ghariban wo misaale zehra
ban gayi shaam ke darbar may hyder zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal ye tha ke na pehchana usay shauhar ne
shaam ki qaid se aayi jo palat kar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diya kufe ke darbar may majid mukhtar
sar e darbar sitamgar thi khule sar zainab
aagayi shaam ki nagri may...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Ab koi ghar koi
items.body:
ab koi ghar koi takiya na bichona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe khaak pe sona hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke seene pe sone ki tujhe aadat thi
ab muqaddar may tere hogi zameen maqtal ki
shiddate pyaas may ashkon ko hi peena hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab sitamgaar ke taano pe guzar hoga tera
shimr e be-deen ke tamachon pe guzar hoga tera
odh ke qaid ke andhiyaron ko sona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
taziyano ki aziyat hi ghiza howegi
ek din saare aseeron se juda howegi
ek alag qaid ki tanhaai may rona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi aahat bhi sunegi to lagega aise
ek yateema ko bulaya ho padar ne jaise
chain aaram sukoon sab kuch hi khona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan maut sunayegi kabhi khauf tujhe
ek ek saans saza hogi meri furqat se
tujko ab chehra bhi ashkon se hi dhona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki badli may muqaddar ka sitara hoga
baba baba ki sada'on ka sahara hoga
sabr phupiyon ki tarha tujhko bhi karna hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman thi ye wasiyat hi shahe waala ki
jisko likhte huwe mazhar ki bandhi hai hichki
bas yehi keh ke chale rona hi rona hoga
aaj ke baad tujhe...
ab koi ghar koi...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abbas na laute
items.body:
abbas na laute sheh aagaye mashk aagayi
maqtal ki zameen bha gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
is shaan se maqtal ko sidhara tha alamdaar
aada ki nazar khaa gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab teer chala beh gaya sab mashk se pani
abbas ko sharm aagayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
rone ke liye laasha e shabbir pe ran may
firdaus se maa aagayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon may lagi aag to ammu ko bulane
masoom sakina gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
had hogayi bhai ko manane labe saahil
khud saani e zehra gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya jaaniye kyun rooth gaye kehti thi zainab
ruqsat ki ghadi aagayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
behta hua kano se lahoo sookhe hue lab
dikhlane sakina gayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
deti rahi awaaz pe awaaz sakina
aakhir ko khaza aagayi abbas na laute
abbas na laute...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ke liye mashk o alam le ke gaye thay
din dhal gaya raat aagayi abbas na laute
items.author: Wasi Rizvi

items.title: Ali ka zikr
items.body:
ali ka zikr mohamed ka naam baaqi hai
hussain tum se khuda ka kalaam baaqi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mitane waale imamat ke mit gaye lekin
khuda ke fazl se ab bhi imam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke laal ke dunya may naam baaqi hai
yazeed mit gaya zikre anaam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
mitaye laakh zamana mitenge hum kaise
hamare sar pe hamara imam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara unse kabhi faisla nahi hoga
yazeed mar gaya kuch rishtedar baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo aur honge yateeman e mazhab o millat
hamare sar pe hamara imam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
khareeb jhoole ke aa kar ye ro ke bole hussain
abhi shaheedon may asghar ka naam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
zara ay maut teher ja kaha ye akbar ne
zaeef baap ka thoda sa kaam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba waqte aakhri zainab se ro ke bole hussain
tumhare waaste darbar e shaam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujeeb ko bhi bulayenge apne rauze par
isi umeed may ab tak ghulam baaqi hai
ali ka zikr...
items.author: Fazl Lakhnavi

items.title: Ayyuhan naas
items.body:
ayyuhan naas shumara ba haq e khoon e hussain
lehja ee gosh numaya idari shewan o shain
<<DIVIDER>>
ayuhannas tumhe khoon e hussaini ki qasam
kam na ho ranj o alam aur ye shor e matam
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo matam hai jo zahra o ali karte rahe
asre ashoor ye matam to nabi karte rahe
jab luta fatema zehra ka bhara ghar ran mein
alqama roti thi aur karbobala karti thi bain
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
shud sakina chu giraftar e ajal dar zindan
na rafeeq e na anees e dam e gham khwaran
mar gayi shaam ke zindan mein sakina ghut kar
dafn ke waqt bhi aaye nahi bhaiya akbar
dil ki hasrat rahi dil mein hi rehaai na mili
khoon bhara kurta kafan ban gaya marqad zindan
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
murd farzand e jawan khurd seena bar seena
padari sokhta jaan girya kunad wawela
mar gaya saamne athara baras ka beta
haye is umr mein sajta hai saron par sehra
noor aankhon ka gaya thokarein khaate hai hussain
dar e qaima pe khadri roti hai binte zahra
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat e asghar e masoom ba maidan beeni
bar lehad ashk fishanand hussain ibne ali
ek nanhi si lehad khod ke maidan mein hussain
kehte hai saunpa khuda ko tujhe ay noor e ain
khwab sab aankhon ka paiwand huwe umme rubab
khaali jhoola hua aur kokh tumhari ujdi
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
rafta shud chadar e zainab sar e bazaar e jafa
seena kobi ba kunan ahle aza wawela
sar e bazar e jafa binte ali be-chadar
bhai athara thay koi na raha sar pe magar
rassiyan qaid e sitam ranj o alam kunbe ka gham
tan ba taqdeer hai is haal mein binte zehra
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
man na khwaham deegar e zindagi aakhir lashkar
baad e abbas alamdar o ali e akbar
jee ke ab kya kare shabbir ke lashkar na raha
wo alamdar wo abbas e dilawar na raha
asr ka waqt liye jaam e shahadat aaya
rakh diya sajda e mabood mein shabbir ne sar
ayyuhan naas shumara...
<<DIVIDER>>
chashme ma ashk fishan dar ghame shabbir hanooz
man na khwaham ma siwa matame shabbir hanooz
ashk aankhon se nahi thamte hai rehaan kabhi
yaad aa jaata hai jab shaam ka zindan kabhi
jab bhi qirtaas pe mai nauha e shabbir likhun
meri tehreer mein aata hai mere qalb ka soz
ayyuhan naas shumara...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Bada andhera hai
items.body:
sakina qaid ho kar shaam ke zindan mein jab aayi
wo bacchi us andhere ghar ki tareeki se ghabrayi
muqaddar ne ajab aafat ki pehli raat dikhlayi
zameen to farsh tha saaya fighan tha charkhe meenayi
phupi ke saath rehti thi na maa ke paas soti thi
barehna sar khadi zindan ke darwaze pa roti thi
<<DIVIDER>>
pukari ro ke sakina bada andhera hai
ye kaisi qaid hai baba bada andhera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
main ek kone mein baithi hui hoon sehmi hui
dikhayi kuch nahi deta bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jigar figaar hai kamsin hai aur akeli hai
na jee sakegi sakina bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari laadli tanha hai koi paas nahi
madad ko aaiye baba bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
agar ho aana to asghar ko saath mat laana
jahan mai qaid hoon baba bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamache lagte hai mere jo dar ke roti hoon
magar mai kya karun baba bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
behan se milne ko aao agar ali akbar
to ek charaagh bhi laana bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot tadapte thay sajjad ye sada sun kar
behan bulaati hai bhaiya bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi charaagh jalane na aa saka haye
pukarti rahi dukhiya bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ke hai ye musafir shikasta haal o ghareeb
kahan kiya hai basera bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab uska maqbara minaar e noor hai gohar
jo roz karti thi nauha bada andhera hai
pukari ro ke sakina...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Beemar bahot takleef
items.body:
hai shaam e ghariban ka nauha
beemar bahot takleef mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaram se hai zaalim dunya
beemar bahot takleef mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch din se ghashi ka aalam tha
jab aankh khuli to sannata
doobi hai lahoo mein karbobala
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chaaron taraf qaimon ka dhuan
aada to manate hai khushiyan
ab kaun sune zainab ki sada
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dil pe bahattar sadme hai
faryad pe durre lagte hai
hai ganje shaheedan mein kunba
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zulm ki kaisi manzil hai
do gaam bhi chalna mushkil hai
kaanton se bhara hai har rasta
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
dushman hai ye sab dunya waale
wo apni musibat kis se kahe
wo bheed mein reh kar bhi tanha
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se bhara har pehlu hai
chaalon se baha kuch itna lahoo
zanjeer ke har halqe ne kaha
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dil pa bahattar daagh liye
aakhir wo jiye to kaise jiye
dunya ko nahi hai andaza
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
jeene ka nahi koi armaan
balwe mein khule sar hai phupiyan
bechain bahot hai dil ye mera
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir gir ke sambhalna hai usko
har haal mein chalna hai usko
ruk jaaye to padta hai durra
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe chada hai baap ka sar
aur ahle haram hai be-chadar
kismat ne dikhaya hai kya kya
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein behen ko maut aayi
de ghusl o kafan kaise bhai
rakha hai sakina ka laasha
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab isko milegi azaadi
zanjeer hai iski faryadi
kab choot ke ghar jaana hoga
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab tauq khulega gardan se
kab khoon rukega gardan se
hai surkh lahoo se uski aba
beemar bahot takleef...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye likhna suroor aasaan nahi

wo fatema hoo mai

items.title: Haan mai abbas hoo
items.body:
hasab nasab mein hoon la saani
mashk o alam hai meri nishani
hai mere shaano mein bhi quwwate yazdani
agar karun darya ko ishara
qaimon mein aa jaaye wo saara
mere isharon par chalta hai darya ka pani
lo jaan lo mujhko pehchan lo mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
haan mai abbas hoon abbas
ayyohan naas ayyohan naas
haan mai abbas hoon
haan mai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
sun lo ye ta’aruf mera
mai beta hoon hyder ka
saqqa e sakina mujhko
kehti hai ye saari dunya
mai baazu e sarwar hoon
ghairat ka samandar hoon
khud zaat mein lashkar hoon
ayyohan naas ayyohan naas
haan mai abbas hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ghaiz mein waar karunga
aisi yalghaar karunga
ek laash ke do do tukde
phir do ke chaar karunga
mohlat hai sambhal jao
kasrat pe na itrao
mat sher se takrao
salar hoon jarrar hoon jeedaar hoon mai
haan mai abbas hoon abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
maine jo khat khaynch diya hai paar karun to jaanun
mujhse aa kar aankh milao phir mai tum ko maanun
sabaq wohi siffeen ka tum ko phir se yaad dilaun
palat ke dharti ulat ke darya tum ko ghaiz dikhaun
<<DIVIDER>>
ye taygh ye khanjar kya hai
bas dekh lo tewar kya hai
pairon se masal doon dharti
nau laakh ka lashkar kya hai
sar tan se uda dunga
mitti mein mila dunga
ek hashr macha dunga
ayyohan naas ayyohan naas
haan mai abbas hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai cheen ke tum se darya
bhar loonga abhi mashkeeza
tum dekhte reh jaoge
na rok sakoge rasta
jo keh doon wo karta hoon
kab maut se mai darta hoon
har baar yehi kehta hoon
ayyohan naas ayyohan naas
haan mai abbas hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mashk chidi pyason ki
aur beh gaya saara pani
ghazi ne kata ke baazu
tareekh wafa ki likh di
shabbir jo laashe par
pahunche to suna aakar
jumle thay yehi lab par
haan mai abbas hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aankh mein teer laga tha
shabbir ne jab wo nikala
zaanu pe rakha jab sar ko
ghazi ne kiya ye nauha
aankhon mein sakina ka
chehra hai mere aaqa
ab kaise ye bolunga
ayyohan naas ayyohan naas
haan mai abbas hoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sher wafa ka paikar
jab qatl hua darya par
karti thi tadap kar zainab
ye bain hi meesum o mazhar
ho jaungi jab tanha
tab khoon rulayega
ay bhai tera kehna
ayyohan naas ayyohan naas
haan mai abbas hoon...

items.title: Haye abbas pyase
items.body:
haye abbas pyase abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ki boondh boondh pe qabza tera hai ghazi
nehr e furaat se bhi rishta tera hai ghazi
kitna buland o baala rutba tera hai ghazi
tareekh mein likha hai kissa tera hai ghazi
jhoola tera jhulaya hai asmat ke phool ne
farzand tujhko apna kaha hai butool ne
haye abbas pyase abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke saath saath chali saari bibiyan
ghazi ne bade pyaar se dekhi sawariyan
aah o buka mein doob gayi yun nawasiyan
zainab ko ab satane lagi aur udasiyan
maula ne apne haath utha ke dua ye ki
allah tumhare deen ko bakshi hai zindagi
haye abbas pyase abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk o alam ko leke chale shaahe naamdaar
aankhon se khoon bahate hai ab shaahe pur waqar
bhai ki laash dekh ke rote hai zaar zaar
chehre se maula lagte hai bechain beqaraar
daudi sakina kehti ke ammu kahan gaye
baba batao jaldi ke ammu jahan gaye
haye abbas pyase abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek shor karbal mein hua wa musibata
pakde kamar hussain ne zainab se ye kaha
hyder ka sher maara gaya haye ghurbata
dhaaras thi jis se sab ki bandhi ab wo chal basa
laashe pe gir ke bhai se bhai ne ye kaha
tanha mai aaj reh gaya ay mere khuda
haye abbas pyase abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pukari maara gaya bhai naujawan
abbas jis ka naam tha hyder ka tha nishan
kaante pade thay lab pe thi sookhi hui zaban
uryan padi thi laash pe karti rahi fughan
ro ro ke ye kehti thi mera bhai na raha
zaamin mere hijab ka bachon ka aasra
haye abbas pyase abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas teri yaad mein roti hai kayenat
matam salaam o soz mein doobi hai kayenat
baatil ka sar jhuka hai dikhaati hai kayenat
aajao ek saff mein bulaati hai kayenat
dekho har ek simt mein dushman khada hai aaj
abbas e bawafa ka faqat aasra hai aaj
haye abbas pyase abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
raunaq se zikr sayyed e shohda ka hai ghazab
afzal bhi sun ke rota hai buzar ke saath saath
zehra hai aansuon ka tere karbala sabab
ghamkhwar ghamgusaar hai na koi bhi arab
ye sabr e fatema ka bada bemisaal hai
gham se nidhaal hogaya mohamed ka aal hai
haye abbas pyase abbas...

karbala walon mein dekho hosla islam ka

karbala walon mein…

items.title: Hussain ya maula
items.body:
jis ne bhi dhoonda tujhe rab ko hai paaya
tu hai zameen pe mohamed ka saaya
deen e mohamed ko tu ne bachaya
zindagi saath tere bandagi saath tere
karbobala ne ye sikhaya
mai haq ke saath kahun
bas yehi baat kahun
teri wila hai sarmaya
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
deene khuda ka manshoor tu hai
rasme wafa ka dastoor tu hai
ooncha jahan mein tera alam hai
kon a makan mein tu mohtaram hai
lab pe dua rahe yabnaz zahra hussain
teri adalat hai yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr ka muqaddar tu ne jagaya
john ko tu ne apna banaya
tu ne charaghe qaima bujha kar
sab ki wafaon ko aazma kar
aisa sila diya yabnaz zahra hussain
rab se mila diya yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sharte shifa'at teri mohabbat
sharte mohabbat teri ita'at
teri ita'at rab ki ita'at
tujhse adawat rab se adawat
dunya ka kya khabar yabnaz zahra hussain
hai kitna mohtabar yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayyat se tera inkaar maula
ahle sitam se paikaar maula
ghayr ke laaye saare sitamgar
jeet gaya tu haare sitamgar
goonji ban mein azan yabnaz zahra hussain
pursa kari kahan yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaati hai jaan chale jaaye hamay gham kya
raah e wafa ko kabhi chodenge hum kya
zehra se waada hum ne kiya hai
bas ye iraada hum ne kiya hai
chaahe mar jaaye hum yabnaz zahra hussain
zinda rakhenge gham yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kishte alaam se tu ne nikal kar
nok e sina ko bana diya mimbar
tu ne lahoo se maqtal sajaya
teri bahan ne zinda basaya
rote huwe kaha yabnaz zahra hussain
matam hoga tera yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban bhoole nahi hum
rote huwe bacchon ki sadayein
shimr e layeen ne qaime jala kar
ahle haram ki cheeni ridayein
nok e sina par ooncha tera sar
jaari tha quran teri zaban par
jo dekha jo suna yabnaz zahra hussain
raavi ne likh diya yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...

waada ye tujhse karte hai ro kar
farshe aza par safdar o mazhar

dil ko sukoon hai aah o buka se
tujhse wabastagi yabnaz zahra hussain
ho saari zindagi yabnaz zahra hussain
tu hai nabi ka noore ain
hussain ya maula hussain...

tu hi to faatah e karbobala hai
hussain hussain hussaina
saare jahan ke labon pe sada hai
hussain hussain hussaina

items.title: Jab suni hind ke
items.body:
tazeem karo aati hai shehzadi e shaam
ay aseeran e sitam utho karo aao salam

rehm dil bibi hai chahe to reha kar degi

jab suni hind ke aane ki khabar zainab ne
rakh diya khaak pe rote hue sar zainab ne

mere hissay ki jahan maut hai jakar la de

jab suni hind ke…

saamna hind ka kis tarha karoongi beta

jab suni hind ke…

qadiyon jaye adab hai chalo tasleem karo

sunke ye ashkon se daman kiya tar zainab ne
jab suni hind ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
hind ne naam jo poocha to haya aane lagi
binte zehra thi tadapne lagi sharmane lagi
yaad abbas ki bibi ko bahot aane lagi
ki sar e shaah pe us waqt nazar zainab ne
jab suni hind ke…

hind pehchan gayi jism mein larza aaya
phaynk kar apni rida royi bahot ghash aaya
sar rakha qadmo pe rote hue ye farmeina
kaisi haalat mein kiya yan ka safar zainab ne
jab suni hind ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise rehaan bayan qaid ka hoga manzar
hind ke sar pe jo zainab ne udhayi chadar
aur us waqt bhi bibi ka barehna raha sar
gham ka mahol mila dekha jidhar zainab ne
jab suni hind ke…

karbala mein roze…

items.body:

shabbir ke laashe par naala

items.title: Kya pad gayi zindan
items.body:
kya pad gayi zindan mein uftaad sakina
sab se juda hogayi nashaad sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
karti thi bayan laash pe ye bano e bekas
faryad hai faryad hai faryad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
takraati hai zindan mein dewaar se sar ko
tum mar gayi maa hogayi barbaad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
utho to zara paas phupi jaan khadi hai
hote hai tumhare liye nashaad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bedaad hui wo jo kisi par na hui thi
kuch apni zaban se kaho rudaad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe sulaane ke liye aaye hai baba
maa kehti hai utho meri nashaad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas chacha aaye hai karte huwe matam
inki suno apni kaho uftaad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat se yehi kehta hai zindan ka andhera
reh jayegi ta hashr teri yaad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai hathkadi haathon mein to paon mein hai bedi
dafnate hai phir bhi tumhe sajjad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
basti hai basayi hui gham ki ali fitrat
har dil hai teri yaad se abaad sakina
kya pad gayi zindan mein...

items.title: Meri laash ke tukde
items.body:
haye qasim haye qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
meri laash ke tukde chun chun kar
maqtal se utha lo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zehr mila mere baba ko
ek dil ke bahattar tukde huwe
dekho to zara ran mein aakar
meri laash ke tukde bikhre huwe
bete ki shahadat ka manzar
baba se milalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba aap ki hasrat jeet gayi
is laal ne waada poora kiya
baba ki wasiyat poori ki
taweez ka likha poora kiya
tehreer ke saare harfon ko
mere khoon se sajalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri laash ke saare tukdon ko
kabhi phool kabhi kaliyan samjho
maathe pe jo khoon ki dhaarein hai
unhe sehre ki ladiyan samjho
dulha to mai ban paaya na magar
aankhon mein basalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis chehre ko chand samajhti thi
us par ye kharashein dekh to lo
jo jism gulab tha ab us par
ye ghodon ki taapein dekh to lo
ghash kaa ke na ran mein gir jaana
dil apna sambhalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek shaheed ye kehta tha
nusrat ke liye aao aaqa
tha saare shaheedon mein lekin
mera rang juda mera dhang juda
maine kaha ghode se gir ke
mujhe aake bachalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukdon mein jigar ke hal kar di
maine ye lahoo ki laali bhi
do baar shahadat mujhko mili
do baar mili pamaali bhi
baba ki taraf se bhi aakar
mujhe galay lagalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya na koi durr pehne huwe
yun teeron mein talwaron mein
jaunga mai ab naizon naizon
bazaaron mein darbaron mein
mujhe dekh to le zara darya se
ammu ko bulalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime bhi jale chadar bhi chini
hai shaam e ghariban jangal mein
har mod pe qatil baithe hai
tum aaogi kaise maqtal mein
phupiyon ki tarha tum baalon se
chehre ko chupalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe jo daagh hai matam ka
mere ishq ki ek nishani hai
har lamha aankh mein nayyar ki
mera dard hai meri kahani hai
phir nauha sunaya aamir ne
phir ashk bahalo amma
meri laash ke tukde...

items.title: Aagayi shame ghariban
items.body:
aagayi shaam e ghariban kahan jaaye zainab

aagayi shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur hi rang tha jangal may jab aayi thi yahan
phool hi phool thay aanchal may jab aayi thi yahan
haye ab khaak badawan kahan jaaye zainab
aagayi shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab se zainab ko jo pyara tha wo bhai na bacha
reh gayi aun o mohamed ko bhi wo kar ke fida
karne is dard ka darmaan kahan jaaye zainab
aagayi shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangti hai wo qaza par na qaza aati hai
gar sakina ko bachaye to rida jaati hai
aise aalam may pareshan kahan jaaye zainab
aagayi shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par girta hai koi koi ghash khaata hai
koi bacha kahin sholon may ghira jaata hai
ek hai sab ki nigehbaan kahan jaaye zainab
aagayi shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ye shaam e ghariban kahan le aayi naved
shaah ka sar rota hai zainab ki hai tanhaai naved
kehne ko haye pareshan kahan jaaye zainab
aagayi shaam e ghariban...

items.title: Ab laut jao baba
items.body:
qaime se ran ke liye jab ali akbar nikle

haye baba haye haye baba

ye to faqat zameen hai gar aag ka ho darya

haye baba haye haye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
sar par musibaton ka ye aasman kab tak
baba mohabbaton ka ye imtehan kab tak
seene mein dil hai muztar ab laut jao baba

items.body:

items.body:
