girta hai jab koi to wo kehta hai ya ali
sikke ki tarha chalta hai khyber shikan ka naam
jab tak hai is jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
le aayi maut ghayr ke hyder ke saamne
marhab to sunke palta tha khyber shikan ka naam
jab tak hai is jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek ki zaban par hai zainab o hussain
kalme ke baad chalta hai bhai behan ka naam
jab tak hai is jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mauje adab se kyun na hate raah chod kar
kashti ke saat aata hai likha panjetan ka naam
jab tak hai is jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra mai bekafan raha zehra ka laadla
is sharm se safayd hai ab tak kafan ka naam
jab tak hai is jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mahir mai bazme panjetan e paak par nisar
maula bana hai deed ki is anjuman ka naam
jab tak hai is jahan may...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Kaata gaya hussain
items.body:
kaata gaya hussain ka maqtal mein jab gala
bas kuch hi faasle se behan dekhti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
sar tan se ho raha tha baradar ka jab juda
bas kuch hi faasle se behan dekhti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
ghera tha zaalimon ne shah e mashraqain ko
zainab bachane paayi na apne hussain ko
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
bekas behan tadapti rahi kuch na bas chala
kaata gaya hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar talay hussain ki gardan ko dekh kar
ay bhai keh ke girti thi dukhiya zameen par
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
wo waqt ek behan pe qayamat ka waqt tha
kaata gaya hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyari behan hussain ki sar peet'ti rahi
sookhe galay pe bhai ke chalti rahi churi
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
zanjeer bekasi ne kasi thi kuch is tarha
kaata gaya hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein ali ki dulaari thi beqarar
roti thi zaar zaar tadapti thi baar baar
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
har simt se hussain pe hoti rahi jafa
kaata gaya hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
narghe mein zaalimon ke thi beti batool ki
kuch bhi na karne paayi nawasi rasool ki
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
bhai ka sar nigahon ke aage hi kat gaya
kaata gaya hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe jab hussain ke shimre layeen chada
zainab ne sar ko peet ke darya ka rukh kiya
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
us waqt thar tharane lagi arze karbala
kaata gaya hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pe karbala mein jo kohe alam gira
toote na wo pahaad kisi pe bhi ay khuda
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
bhai ko qatl karta raha shimre behaya
kaata gaya hussain ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz na likh sakega kabhi bhi wo gham koi
zainab ke dil pe taygh jo ashoor ko chali
suye darya mud kar dekhti thi zainab
apne ghazi ko sada de rahi thi zainab
bhai ka khoon khaak mein milta chala gaya
kaata gaya hussain ka...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Karbala mera watan
items.body:
salaam karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ne kun jo kaha to kayenat bani
jo din to khalq kiya to din se raat bani
ye chand taare ye suraj ye do jahan bane
zameen bichayi gayi saaton aasman bane
bashar banaye gaye khaak se ba hukme khuda
inhi bashar mein huwe khalq khaas ahle aza
janabe fatema zehra ki ye dua se bane
karam hussain ka tha khaake karbala se bane
phir us khuda ne har ek ka chaman qaraar diya
har ek zameen ko kisi ka watan qaraar diya
to karbala ko hamara watan qaraar diya
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha jahan ne jab naam o pata
har matami ka yehi tha sukhan
karbala karbala mera watan
<<DIVIDER>>
rab ne hi kaun o makan ko sajaya
us ne hi dono jahan ko basaya
hum ko hai nisbat karbobala se
hum ko isi mitti se banaya
saari daleelein paas hai jab
phir mujhko kehne mein kya uljhan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala pehchaan hai meri
karbobala se hi shaan hai meri
karbobala meri rooh ke andar
karbobala mein hi jaan hai meri
mere watan ke misaal nahi
nazaan hai is par sharq e kohan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera watan hai zameen auliya ki
mera watan hai zameen ausiya ki
ye bhi to faqr hai mere watan ka
mera watan hai zameen ambiya ki
deen o shariyat ki hai amaan
deene khuda ka yehi hai chaman
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere watan ka ajab maujiza hai
khaak bhi iski khaak e shifa hai
ye darsagaah e sabr o raza hai
is ki hawa mein khushboo e wafa hai
sabr o raza ka wafa ka yehi
roze ajal se raha maskan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ke bete se pehle jo pahuncha
pesh e mohamed sar ko jhukaya
khuld e bari ki sanad tujhe de di
hurr se mohamed ne farmeina
hurr ne kaha mai rahunga wahin
ay mera aaqa rasool e zaman
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala hi naseeb hai mera
karbobala mein habeeb hai mera
karbobala mere gham ki dawa hai
karbobala mein tabeeb hai mera
chaahe kahin pe bhi aaye khaza
karbobala mein ho mera madfan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
haa ye zameen badi moatabar hai
chaand sitaron ki raah guzar hai
husn yahin se hai shams o qamar ka
sajdagaah e dil shams o qamar hai
hai kehkashano ka naaz yehi
khuld e bari ka yehi hai sahan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan ye zameen hai dil zainab ka
is pe kiya sajjad ne sajda
yehi zameen hai rasool ki masnad
hai ye zameen zehra ka musalla
jee nahi lagta aur kahin
bole ali se imame hassan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak yahin ki rida e haram hai
qalb e sakina ka marham hai
laasha e asghar is ne chupaya
seene mein iske sabhi ka gham hai
bhai mera sota hai yahan
kehti thi ro ke ghareeb behan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene mein is ke hai laashe bahattar
hai ye zameen gehwara e asghar
chod ke qabr yahin rehti hai
mehwe buka shabbir ki maadar
khoone shaheedan ki hai ameen
saare shaheeedon ka hai kafan
karbala karbala mera watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala se hai izzat o shohrat
karbobala se hai meri fasahath
ahle aza ke dilon ki sada hai
karbobala hi hamari hai jannat
hai mera ishq yehi safdar
is pe fida mera tan mann dhan
karbala karbala mera watan...

items.title: Khamosh hai maula
items.body:
haye haye ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha jawan bete ka hai saame pada
khamosh hai maula
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan tha jiski shadi ka wo laal mar gaya
khamosh hai maula
allah kitna saabir hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
shaana kabhi hilata hai chehra kabhi thapakta hai
kitna ghareeb baba hai
haste hai barchiyon waale akbar nahi uth'ta
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab na dekh le aakar ye ran mein kaisa manzar hai
bete ka godh mein sar hai
ek haath mein kaleja hai ek haath mein naiza
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara saal waale ke chehre pe kuch nishan bhi hai
aur tooti phasliyan bhi hai
bete ka haal dekh ke yaad aati hai zahra
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum sabr karna ay baba seene se khaynch kar barchi
akbar ki ye wasiyat thi
seene se khaynch li barchi poora hua waada
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne zaeef kaandhe par laashe jawan uthaate hai
uth'te hai baith jaate hai
ghazi ki yaad aati hai uth'ta nahi laasha
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein shaah le aaye kadiyal jawan ka laasha
kohraam hogaya barpa
bhai ke zakhmi seene se lipti hai sakina
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bebasi ka aalam tha aaya jo khat madine se
maula jawab kya dete
akbar ke zakhmi seene par rakh kar khate sughra
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha fatema ki beti ka kitna khayal dono ko
zeeshan abidi dekho
zainab sirhane baithi hai khamosh hai laila
khamosh hai maula
laasha jawan bete ka...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Kya poochte ho
items.body:
kya poochte ho abide khasta jigar ka haal
gham se kabhi bukhaar ki eeza se thay nidhaal
abbas o aur qasim o akbar ka tha malaal
yaad aa rahe thay aun o mohamed se naunehaal
ashoor ka tha din to qayamat ki raat thi
namoose mustufa ki hifazat ki raat thi
kya poochte ho…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zaalimo ne aag lagayi qayaam mein
quwwat nahi thi utne ki paa'ye imam mein
dena tha imtehan bhi ek raahe shaam mein
ek daagh aur bad gaya maahe tamam mein
qaimon mein aag se thi jo zainab ko bekali
sajjad uth khade hue kehkar ke ya ali
kya poochte ho…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima jala to khaak ke upar basar hui
mushkil tha aaj subho ka hona magar hui
har baat zaalimo se jo ki be-asar hui
abid ko jab aseeri ki apni khabar hui
kehne lage ke jaata hoo baba salam lo
haq mein mere huzoor duaon se kaam lo
kya poochte ho…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar karbala ko aapne kis sabr se kiya
mere liye hai koofe se taa shaam faasla
kuch kam nahi hai waise to mera bhi hausla
namoose mustufa ka hai dar pesh marhala
jayengi nange sar phupi darbar e shaam mein
dekhunga mai ye taab kahan hai ghulam mein
kya poochte ho…
<<DIVIDER>>
itne mein qaid karne ko aa pahunche ashkiyan
kehne lage phupi se ye bemaar e karbala
balon se moo chupa lo jo sar par nahi rida
manzil kathin hai aaj ki behtar kare khuda
mushkil mein ya ali madadi kehna baar baar
bachon se aur bali sakina se hoshiyaar
kya poochte ho…
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ki natawani pe hairaan thay layeen
manzil ko sar karega ye aata na tha yaqeen
ye itna ghamzada hai ke mar jayega kahin
iske sabaat o himmat o jurrat pe aafreen
ye azm hai ke khafila salaar ban gaya
aisa chala ke waqt ki raftaar ban gaya
kya poochte ho…
<<DIVIDER>>
yun karbala se ujda hua khafila chala
jaise kisi ka khafila salaar mar gaya
oonto se girte jaate thay bache bhi jan bajan
aayi sar e hussain se be-saakhta sada
kis haal mein ho bachi pe meri nazar nahi
zainab sakina gir gayi tumko khabar nahi
kya poochte ho…
<<DIVIDER>>
khaame ko rok dil mein nahi taab ay urooj
purnam hai saari mehfile ehbaab ay urooj
umda hua ashkon ka sailaab ay urooj
gulshan nabi ke deen ka shadab ay urooj
ya rab mai jee raha hoo panjetan ke saath
mehshar bhi mai rahoo mai isi anjuman ke saath
kya poochte ho…
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Maa bhi na ho
items.body:
ehsaas e yateemi hai veeran hai ali ka ghar
bin baap ke ye pehli raat aayi hai bachon par
roti thi kahin zainab shabbir kahin shabbar
fizza ne ye dekha to kehne lagi ro ro kar
<<DIVIDER>>
maa bhi na ho dunya mein aur baap bhi mar jaye
allah kisi par bhi ye waqt nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ye raat khuda jaane kis haal mein guzregi
bachon ki nigaahon mein tasveer hai baba ki
baba se juda ho kar kis tarha jiya jaye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat jahan rakhi thi zainab wahin baithi hai
abbas ke chehre ko ab dekh ke roti hai
kehti hai koi mere baba ko bula laaye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein ruqayya ke baba ka musalla hai
kulsoom ke haathon mein baba ka amaama hai
baba nahi aayenge ab kaun ye batlaye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa yaad jo aaye to ho aate thay turbat par
ruqsat kiya baba ko hasnain ne ye keh kar
milne kahan jayenge jab baap ki yaad aaye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab mujhko rulaata hai shahzadi ka wo kehna
fizza mere bachon se tum door nahi rehna
maa baap ke bin jeena mushkil hai bahot haye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
is aalam e gurbat mein maa zinda agar hoti
bin baap ke bachon ko seene se laga leti
aaghaz e yateemi hai dil gham se na phat jaaye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhooli hai kahan zainab wo choomna shaano ko
jab shaam mein dekhegi rassi ke nishano ko
yaad aayegi baba ki us waqt bahot haye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan o raza haye nauha tha ye fizza ka
ab betiyon ke sar pe saaya nahi baba ka
mushkil hai yateemon pe ye raat guzar jaaye
allah kisi par bhi...
maa bhi na ho dunya...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Mazloome karbala tak
items.body:
mazloome karbala tak mera salam leja
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal ko jaane wale ghurbat uthane wale
mazloom tak rasayi qismat se paane wale
is kushtaye jafa tak mera salam leja
mazloome karbala tak…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar jisne sab lutaya pyasa gala kataya
wo shaah jisne mar kar nana ka deen jilaya
us sibte mustafa tak mera salam leja
mazloome karbala tak…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo noor e chashme hyder wo fatema ka dilbar
wo jism o jaane ahmed bhai tha jiska shabbar
is paykare raza tak mera salam leja
mazloome karbala tak…
<<DIVIDER>>
haaton pe sheh ke aaya pani na jisne paaya
pani ke badle jis par teer e jafa chalaya
shesh maahe mehleqa tak mera salam leja
mazloome karbala tak…
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein gira jo akbar shikwa na laaya lab par
seh seh ke sakht eeza jaan dedi jisne aakhir
humshakle mustufa tak mera salam leja
mazloome karbala tak…
<<DIVIDER>>
seh seh ke jisne aafat deen ki bachayi izzat
khatron mein jisne payham ki deen ki himeinat
is aale mustufa tak mera salam leja
mazloome karbala tak…
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka biradar abbas ibne hyder
jo tha ameere lashkar jiska wafa tha zewar
us paykare safa tak mera salam leja
mazloome karbala tak…

items.title: Meri maa ne mujhe
items.body:
meri maa ne mujhe godh may ye wird sikhaya
kaha ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ne hai mujhko nauhakhwan banaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
paida kare momin jo badi unki shaan hai
wo khush naseeb maayein hai mera emaan hai
bachon ko hai jinho ne sach ka sabaq padhaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ke waarison ka hua band hai pani
pamaal hui ran may hai qasim ki jawani
jab hum ne suna hai gaya qaimon ko jalaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom pe rona hai rada kehta hai quran
sunnat adaa karo ye agar tum ho musalman
zinda hussain ka hai nabi sog manaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab koi masooma se aaghaz e safar hai
is zikr ke sadqe may sayyeda ki nazar hai
hai paak sakina ne mera bakht jagaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khursheed azadaron may kohraam bapa hai
har soo buland hogayi matam ki sada hai
sadiq hasan ne nauhon may hai sab ko rulaya
kaha haye hussain sab ne mil ke kaha
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
meri maa ne mujhe...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Aagayi zainab
items.body:
haye bazaar e shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi zainab khule sar shaam ke bazaar mein
raah mein khayegi pathar jayegi darbar mein
<<DIVIDER>>
tik ke baithe honge abid haye jis deewar se
bad gayi hogi daraarein haye us deewar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay khuda e lam yazal ye teri aankhein to nahi
kiski aankhein ro rahi hai deeda e khoon baar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
waaris e kul ambiya ki is liye waaris hai tu
jalwa e tauheed hai zainab tere asraar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baade qatle shaahe waala ek zamane par khula
himmat e zainab thi shaamil shaah ke inkaar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab thay raazi sar katane par bajuz sajjad ke
jaane kya mushkil chupi thi tauq ke aazaar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ba-sajda haibat e musa sawali hai jahan
kaun si haibat khuda jaane hai us bemaar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis kadhay mein baaqi hai sajjad ke girye ki dhaar
is khadar tezi kahan hogi kisi talwaar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baade qatle shaahe deen ye waqt ruk jaata naved
haye abid gar na hote waqt ki raftaar mein
aagayi zainab khule sar...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Akbar jawan abhi tere
items.body:
akbar jawan abhi tere marne ke din na thay
apne lahoo mein aap sawarne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
rukta nahi hai seene se jo khoon hai rawan
ay laal ye batado ke kis jaa lagi sina
apni riyazaton ka khazeena to dekh loo
akbar hatao haath mai seena to dekh loo
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum kya giray ho maqtal mein uth na saka hussain
tum ko sina lagi hai aur zakhmi hua hussain
aankhein jo tum churate ho dil chodte hai hum
tum hichkiyan jo lete ho dum todte hai hum
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad pe jab aata hai atharwan baras
khushiyan sameint laata hai atharwan baras
dulha se aap lagte thay har ek libaas mein
dil maa ka shaad rehta tha sehra ki aas mein
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasid khada hai pehlu mein ay laal dekh lo
sughra duayein deti hai aameen to kaho
rakhta hoo khat ko laash pe dilbar jawab do
sughra salaam kehti hai akbar jawab do
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher e kibriya mujhe quwwat ata kare
laashe jawan uthane ki himmat ata kare
aankhon ka noor le gayi noore nazar ki laash
khyber ke dar se wazni hai mere pisar ki laash
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ay raza kalaam ko kardo yahan tamam
mashgool e girya hogaya majlis mein khaas o aam
sadma badan ko akbar e zeeshan dete hai
subhe azan dete thay ab jaan dete hai
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
items.author: Raza

items.title: Apne bachon ko
items.body:
haye akbar haye zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
apne bachon ko kahan zainab e muztar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
<<DIVIDER>>
laal zainab ke sar e karbobala qatl huwe
laaye jab shaah e zaman dono ke laashe ran se
ek bhi pal ke liye unko na maadar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
apne bachon ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath par baap ke baysheer ka jab halq chida
apne asghar pe kiya binte ali ne girya
phir bhi kab banu e bekas ke barabar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
apne bachon ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakht dushwaar tha ye baat ka dil par sehna
nehr se saamne abbas ke qaime hatna
garche is zulm pe bhi zainab e muztar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
apne bachon ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangne aaya jo qaime mein jari ran ki riza
jod ke haathon ko khamosh khada tha saqqa
dekh kar apne baradar ka jhuka sar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
apne bachon ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ko pani na mila haye re wo khasta jigar
qatra e aab ko tarse huwe un bachon par
dasht mein sher e khuda aap ki dukhtar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
apne bachon ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj har noore nazar mujhse bichad jayega
soch kar ye hi ke ghar mera ujad jayega
subhe ashoor bohat shaah ki khwahar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
apne bachon ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis se dhaaras thi bohat haye wo saqqa e haram
jis ke mar jaane se pyason ka badha aur bhi gham
us ke parcham se lipat kar bhi to aksar royi
haan magar laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi
apne bachon ko kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham tha bas hashr mein izhaar yehi zainab ko
aa gaya yaad jo hamshakle nabi zainab ko
dekh kar nana ko aise sar e mehshar royi
jis tarha laasha e akbar pe tadap kar royi

items.body:
ay karbala ay karbala

sibt e rasool e do sara qatl ho gaya
ay karbala ay karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ko tha armaan bohat shaadi ka jiski
raat ko jiski sar e maqtal hui shaadi
subha ko maara gaya wo sher e jari bhi
shab ko bani thi jo dulhan bewa ho gayi
ay karbala ay karbala...

dasht mein pamaal huwa dulha ka laasha
ay karbala ay karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl hui aal e nabi ghar ujad gaya
ay karbala ay karbala...

parcham e abbas e jari khoon mein dooba
kat gaye us sher ke baazu lab e darya
pyasa hi maara gaya saqqa e sakina
toot gayi sheh ki kamar wa musibata
ay karbala ay karbala...

sheh ne kaha haye mera sher mar gaya
ay karbala ay karbala...

zakhmi hua akbar e zee jaah ka seena
barchiyan paywast hui gad gaya naiza
koi bhi us waqt madadgaar nahi tha
baap ne khud bete ke laashe ko uthaya
ay karbala ay karbala...

haye kisi ne na diya sheh ko sahara

sher e jari keh ke bulaati thi jise maa
ay karbala ay karbala...

maa se juda haye wo shehzada ho gaya

qatl hui aal e nabi ghar ujad gaya
ay karbala ay karbala...

hashmi sheron ka lahoo beh gaya ran mein

jakda gaya haye yateemon ko rasan mein
ay karbala ay karbala...

kitne huwe zulm o sitam is qadar jafa

qatl hui aal e nabi ghar ujad gaya

ho gayi maqtal mein nabi zaadi be rida

items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Aza e sarwar
items.body:
aza e sarwar karenge har dam
<<DIVIDER>>
dua e zehra wajood apna
musibaton mein bas inki rona
lahoo lahoo ho har ek seena
har aankh ho bas lahoo se pur nam
aza e sarwar karenge har dam
<<DIVIDER>>
ye maqtal e karbala hi haq hai
har ek chehra quran waraq hai
ibadaton ka yahan sabaq hai
ay ahle emaan hussain ka gham
aza e sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aaye ran mein ali ke paale
galay mein maut ki baahein daale
bade hi armaan e jang nikaale
labon pe shukre khuda tha har dam
aza e sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi shaan e abbas misle hyder
thi dhaal sheh ki haram ki chadar
kate do shaane shigaafta sar
har aaj tak bhi buland parcham
aza e sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabihe ahmed ki naujawani
hussain o zainab ki zindagani
na paaya waqt e akheer pani
hamesha taaza rahega ye gham
aza e sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam shiyon ko kar ke agha
ye bole pani piyo jo thanda
to pyaas ko meri yaad karna
hayaat saari na bhoolenge hum
aza e sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo waqt e ruqsat pe jaan e zehra
tha bibyon mein ek hashr barpa
gala kataane chala jo pyasa
ulat ke masnad bichi saf e gham
aza e sarwar...

items.title: Chale hai karbala
items.body:
chale hai karbala sarwar aza ka aakhri din hai
azakhana badhaya jaa raha hai dil pareshan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kin aankhon se dekhun ghar aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala sarwar aza ka aakhri din hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hamay jo zinda rakhe tha usi mehman ki rukhsat hai
jiyenge saal bhar kyun kar aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamari maa ali ashgar ka gehwara badhati hai
badhati hai alam baahar aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ghar hi acha lagta hai na dunya achi lagti hai
ye dil rota hai reh reh kar aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
gharon se taziye ki shakl mein shabbir jaate hai
qayamat ka hai ye manzar aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
azadaron ke chehron par udaasi hi udaasi hai
likha hai sab ke chehron par aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi kuch dayr mein farshe aza bhi uthne waala hai
zameen roti hai ye keh kar aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai baba ko tumhare kis tarha rukhsat karun ghar se
sahara do ali akbar aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
suroor agle baras tak zinda rehne ki dua maango
qayamat aa gayi sar par aza ka aakhri din hai
chale hai karbala...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Fatema ke bain
items.body:
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi karbala mein fatema ke bain
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht mein ab tak hai mehwe girya o zaari lahoo
gardan e shabbir se hai aaj bhi jaari lahoo
ab bhi teeron par hai laashe maalik e kaunain
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha bikhra badan tha fatema ke laal ka
ek ek tukda utha kar maa ne ye ro kar kaha
tera tan kaise milaun mere dil ke chain
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar shimr le kar jab teri jaanib badha
maine apna haath beta teri gardan par rakha
mai bacha na paayi tujhko phir bhi noor e ain
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere laashe ko kuchalne jab sitamgar aaye thay
maine laashe bawafa par bain ye farmeine thay
mere bete ko bachale ay wafa ki zain
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhpe roti hai zameen aur aasman e kibriya
ay mere pyase tumhari tashnagi par ba khuda
ashk barsaate hai ab tak alqama ke nain
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne kaandhon par uthaya laasha e kadiyal jawan
qabr mein tu ne utaara asghar e tashna dahan
yani qaimon aur maqtal ke raha ma-bain
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din ay laal mere maujiza ho jayega
ek taraf rauza tumhara ek taraf abbas ka
karbala mein do banenge sabr ke harmain
ya hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kaha zehra ne yasir hashr ke din aaungi
tera kurta khoon bhara jab roz e mehshar laaungi
tere gham mein khud kahega maalik e daarain
ya hussain ya hussain...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Haath pehlu se hataya
items.body:
haath pehlu se hataya nahi jaata baba
dard ne kar diya zahra ko zaeefa baba
<<DIVIDER>>
meri tazeem na ki haath uthaya usne
saamne beton ke tu kehke bulaya usne
bhoolun kaise mai ummat ka rawayya baba
haath pehlu se hataya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab wo darbar kahan baba mere kaabil hai
mera qaatil bhi wohi hai jo tera qaatil hai
tere qaatil ne mujhe maara tamacha baba
haath pehlu se hataya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye na socha ke nabi aake jahan rukte thay
jahan hasnain o ali shaam o sehar jhukte thay
teri zahra pe wo darwaza giraya baba
haath pehlu se hataya...
<<DIVIDER>>
rassi sartaj ki sheh rag ke karin roti hai
unki talwaar bhi ab zer e zameen roti hai
chup ke karte hai ali raat ko girya baba
haath pehlu se hataya...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard itne hai ke saare mai sunaun kaise
zakhm aise hai ke hyder ko dikhaun kaise
saare zakmon ki gawah hai meri fizza baba
haath pehlu se hataya...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe abbas pe sadiq ye khulega uqda
ek hi abbas o mohsin ka qaatil hoga
dushmani hogi kahan is se zyada baba
haath pehlu se hataya...
items.author: Saeed Sadiq

items.title: Hussain yun huwe
items.body:
hussain yun huwe ay mujraee watan se juda
ke jaise bulbul e nashaad ho chaman se juda
<<DIVIDER>>
watan may phir ke safar se na jeete jee aaye
ajab ghadi thi ke akbar huwe behan se juda
<<DIVIDER>>
nikaala gardan e asghar se teer jab sheh ne
galay se behne laga khoon juda dahan se juda
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina mar gayi qaid e sitam may ghut ghut kar
magar na chand si gardan hui rasan se juda
<<DIVIDER>>
jina may payenge ghar ahlebait ke madda
sila khuda se juda lenge panjetan se juda
<<DIVIDER>>
sipaah e shaam se nikla jo hurr malak bole
wo aaftaab e darakshaan hua gahan se juda
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheed e zulm hai dono nabi ke lakhte jigar
ghame hussain nahi matame hassan se juda

items.title: Kab aaoge ay baba
items.body:
moray baba
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ghar mein nahi lagta kab aaoge ay baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta kab aaoge ay baba
<<DIVIDER>>
neend udh gayi raaton ki aisi hai pareshani
ghar mein hai faqad baba chaayi hui veerani
wo zinda nahi rehta ho jaata hai jo tanha
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke nigahon mein dhundhla gaye sab manzar
jis simt bhi dekhun to aate hai nazar akbar
awaaz magar doo to koi bhi nahi aata
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab yaad tumhe kar ke roti hoo mai raaton mein
lagta hai koi bibi aati hai hijabon mein
seene se laga kar wo roti hai mujhe baba
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwabon mein sakina ko dekha hai bahot maine
wo kis ke kate baazu thaame huwe roti hai
khoon kaano behta hai ruqsaar hai kyun neela
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalta tha samar sheh ke halqoom pe jab khanjar
kehti thi raza us dam sughra yehi ro ro kar
khoon rota hai kyun baadal pani nahi barsaata
moray baba
pardes mein tum jaa ke kya bhool gaye waada
kab aaoge ay baba mar jayegi jab sughra
dil ghar mein nahi lagta...
items.author: Samar Zaidi

items.title: Karbala meri jaan
items.body:
har azadaar har ek waqt yehi kehta hai
karbala meri jaan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
matami jitne bhi hai sab ka yehi naara hai
karbala meri jaan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala roz e azal se hai wafa ka markaz
karbala hashr talak deen e khuda ka markaz
karbala khaana e kaaba ki baqa ka markaz
karbala dard ke maaron ki shifa ka markaz
jis pe jannat bhi hai qurban ye wo khitta hai
karbala meri jaan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi aadam kabhi saleh kabhi musa ne kaha
kabhi yusuf kabhi yunus kabhi eesa ne kaha
khizr ilyas baraheem zakriya ne kaha
nooh ayyub sulaiman ne yahya ne kaha
saare nabiyon ka rasoolon ka yehi kehna hai
karbala meri jaan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai meri shaan karbala
hai meri jaan karbala
mera emaan karbala
meri pehchan karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
mustafa ne ye kaha karbobala meri jaan
murtaza ne ye kaha karbobala meri jaan
fatema ne kaha karbobala meri jaan
mujtaba ne ye kaha karbobala meri jaan
kehne waalon ki isi saff mein khada kaaba hai
karbala meri jaan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sadiyon se shaheedon ki aza jaari hai
hum azadaron ki rag rag mein azadari hai
har ghadi karbobala jaane ki tayyari hai
hum ne jaan apni ziyarat ke liye waari hai
dil isi baat mein din raat laga rehta hai
karbala meri jaan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai meri shaan karbala
hai meri jaan karbala
mera emaan karbala
meri pehchan karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala door hai gar jaa nahi paate hai hum
karbala apne ilaaqe mein banate hai hum
aur pyason pe wahan khoon bahate hai
nauha pad pad ke zamane ko batate hai hum
karbala aur azadaron ka ye rishta hai
karbala meri jaan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon is khaak mein kamsin ali asghar ka mila
khoon is khaak mein qasim se gule tar ka mila
khoon is khaak mein hamshakle payambar ka mila
khoon is khaak mein abbas ka sarwar ka mila
bas isi khaak mein mil jaane ko dil karta hai
karbala meri jaan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai meri shaan karbala
hai meri jaan karbala
mera emaan karbala
meri pehchan karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
har azadaar ke dil ki ye sada hai waiz
jo bhi ghamkhwar hai sab ki ye dua hai waiz
yehi armaan har ek dil mein basa hai waiz
sab ki hasrat safar e karbobala hai waiz
dil ke andar bhi azadaron ne likh rakha hai
karbala meri jaan hai...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Kya sitam tha
items.body:
kya sitam tha karbala mein
dard o gham tha karbala mein
haye zehra ke paale pe shimr e layeen ka khadam tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti reti par pade thay
na bhatije na pisar thay
dhoop shiddat ki thi pyaas se honton pe dam tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
chau taraf ko dekhte thay
pani pani maangte thay
kaun aata madad ko shaheedon ka sar sab qalam thay
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
nikli zainab khaak udaati
peet'ti thi apni chati
dekhti kya hai naize pa sar shaahe deen ka alam tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab charinde ro rahe thay
sab parinde ro rahe thay
dekh haal shahe karbala ki har ek chashm nam tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmula jab teer maara
khoon ugalkar wo sidhara
apne baba ke gardan pa gardan kiye apni kham tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
dhal gayi wo pyari gardan
gir pade wo dono jaushan
khoon se chota kurta wo nanha sa nam tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha haathon par utha kar
maangte thay pani sarwar
haye wo cheh mahine ke bache ka honton pe dam tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bahadur zulm shah par
jo jo guzre unke upar
aaj tak aisa dekha suna hi nahi jo sitam tha
karbala mein
kya sitam tha karbala…
items.author: Bahadur

items.title: Maa dekh rahi hai
items.body:
cheh maah ka mujahid suye maidan chala hai
maa dekh rahi hai
chehra bada nazuk hai badi garm hawa hai
maa dekh rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim tujhe is baat ka ehsaas nahi hai
cheh maah ka bacha hai ye abbas nahi hai
kamsin ali asghar se tera teer bada hai
maa dekh rahi hai
cheh maah ka mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay behan tere saamne baba ke hai halaat
ab shaam e ghariban ko hi hoti hai mulaqat
mud mud ke sakina ki taraf dekh raha hai
maa dekh rahi hai
cheh maah ka mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmal ne qama khaynchi to larzi ye zameen hai
hai saamne qayyam tabhi usko yaqeen hai
parda badi bechaini se qaime ka hata hai
maa dekh rahi hai
cheh maah ka mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah mere allah ye duhaai ha duhaai
ummat ne sayyeda ki yun looti hai kamayi
ek behan ne bhai ka lahoo moo pe mala hai
maa dekh rahi hai
cheh maah ka mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
socha tha ke jee legi wo yaadon ke sahare
ummat ne jala daale hai armaan bhi saare
asghar tera jhoola tera kurta bhi jala hai
maa dekh rahi hai
cheh maah ka mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai haajira yaqoob o ibrahim ke kham sar
sar chaand se bete ka chada noke sina par
paband e rasan phool si beti ka gala hai
maa dekh rahi hai
cheh maah ka mujahid…
<<DIVIDER>>
imran mujhe quwwat e tehreer nahi hai
kaise mai likhun teer ke ye teer nahi hai
asghar ki taraf chal padi tezi se qaza hai
maa dekh rahi hai
cheh maah ka mujahid…
items.author: Imran Jatki

items.title: Maqtal hai waqte asr
items.body:
maqtal hai waqte asr hai tanha hussain hai
zaalim hai beshumar akela hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayre huwe hai fauje sitam char samt se
teeron ka khanjaron ka nishana hussain hai
maqtal hai waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir tamaam farze wafa ko nibha chuke
yaadein hai aur bekas o tanha hussain hai
maqtal hai waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko kho chuka ali asghar ko ro chuka
kis darja dil figaar o shikasta hussain hai
maqtal hai waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ne dushmani e ali mein bhula diya
paighambar e khuda ka nawasa hussain hai
maqtal hai waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehde koi sakina se daaman ko chod de
ab aakhri safar pa rawana hussain hai
maqtal hai waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
zad par hai aabroo e kalaab e khuda hilal
maqtal mein aayaton ka sahara hussain hai
maqtal hai waqt...
items.author: Hilal

items.title: Meri maa tum
items.body:
meri maa tum mera gham na karna
<<DIVIDER>>
bezuban ne ye jhoole se awaaz di
apne asghar ka lo ab salaam aakhri
meri maa tum mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein jis waqt hal min ki goonji sada
muztarib hogaya sheh ka mahelaqa
qaima e shaah mein shor e girya utha
apni maa se isharon mein kehne laga
mere baba ko hai ab zaroorat meri
unki haathon pe hogi shahadat meri
meri maa tum mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
farz ansaar apna adaa kar chuke
taygh khaa kar gire suye kausar gaye
ek abid hai bus wo hai ghash mein pade
kaun baba ki jaa kar madad ab kare
ran ko jaana hai ab zimmedari meri
aa gayi jaan dene ki baari meri
meri maa tum mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim ke maidan mein tukde huwe
maa ki aankhon se lekin na aansu bahe
jaan dene phupi ke dulaare gaye
shukr ke waaste maa ne sajde kiye
mai hoon asghar magar azm akbar ka hai
meri rag rag mein bhi khoon hyder ka hai
meri maa tum mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
bolna tak abhi mujhko aaya nahi
nanhe haathon se kuch bhi uthaya nahi
teer o shamsheer maine chalaya nahi
jang karna kisi ne sikhaya nahi
mere haathon mein naiza na talwaar hai
bas ye sookhi zuban mera hathyaar hai
meri maa tum mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitna dil chaahe ro mere baba pe ro
naujawani e akbar ka nauha padho
jiske shaane kate uska matam karo
mera kya hai suno meri maadar suno
cheh mahine ka hoon kuch bhi dekha nahi
soch lena mai dunya mein aaya nahi
meri maa tum mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri khwahar sakina ko batlaiye
ab na aayenge ammu ye samjhaiye
raat aaye to seene se liptaiye
mera gham chodiye usko behlaiye
koi zidd hi karunga na rounga mai
ab se baba ke seene pe sounga mai
meri maa tum mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhi maadar ne anwar jo laashe pisar
gham se dil phat gaya gir padi khaak par
ro ke kehne lagi peet kar apna sar
ay mere laal ay mere noore nazar
dekh kar tera gehwara jee loongi mai
keh gaye ho to ab ashk pee loongi mai
meri maa tum mera...
items.author: Anwar

items.title: Pani nahi chahiye
items.body:
dhal gaya din wo takti rahi raasta
haath se daaman e sabr jaata raha
rukh kiya suye darya ye ro kar kaha
chacha jaan pani nahi chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ab aap darya se aa jaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri pyaas to tum se bad kar nahi
mai mar jaungi mera karlo yaqeen
mujhe raas aayi na ye sar zameen
khudara na ab aur tadpaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha mujhko maloom hota agar
nahi aayenge aap bhi laut kar
to phir mashk deti nahi nauhagar
meri mashk khaali hi le aaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane wo kaisi ghadi aayi thi
padar se ijazat jo dilwayi thi
mai khud apni ghurbat se ghabrayi thi
khata dar guzar meri farmaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha ye sakina ka waada raha
ke ab al-atash ki na dungi sada
bina aap ke hai ye jeena saza
jiyun kaise itna to batalaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina pe jaan dene waale chacha
kiya mujhko kiske hawale chacha
bhula dungi honton ke chaale chacha
mujhe aa ke seene se liptaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar aap ke qatl ki yun mili
mere baba jaan ki kamar jhuk gayi
rida phaynk ke ro rahi hai phupi
ye manzar zara dekhne aaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chidi mashk meri koi gham nahi
meri aas tooti koi gham nahi
mai pyasi rahungi koi gham nahi
dawa mere zakhmon ki ban jaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mazhar ye mesum ye ahle aza
yehi kehke karte hai matam bapa
ye jumla sakina ka hai marsiya
bas ab aap darya se aajaiye
chacha jaan pani nahi...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Aage kate hue sar
items.body:
gyara moharram ki aayi sehar
aaye rasan le ke kuch ahle shar
qaidi bani saari shahzadiyan
ek reesma mein sabhi nauha gar
yun karbala se kiya aale nabi ne safar
aage kate huwe sar peeche khule huwe sar
<<DIVIDER>>
maaon ki nazaron mein noor e nazar
behno ki nazaron mein bhai ke sar
mehmil kajawe na haudaj koi
kaanton bhare raaston se guzar
nauha aseeron ka hai
kaise uthaayen nazar
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqe se bali sakina giri
aur khaafile se juda ho gayi
aaghosh mein sayyeda ne liya
itne mein zainab wahan aa gayi
ro kar kaha dekh lo
amma hamara safar
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
takreeb manzil pe chautha qayaam
esaayi muslim ne ki sulhe aam
ek shaks le aaya kuch chaadarein
tareekh mein jis ka yahya hai naam
maloom jab ye hua
aale nabi hai magar
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya zulm ki intaha ho gayi
nau baar chaadar mili phir chini
ab apne ghazi ko awaaz de
deta tha zainab ko taane shaqi
ye dekh kar gir gaya
naize se ghazi ka sar
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
majma layeeno ka raahe kathan
barsaye pathar sabhi mard o zan
zainab kare kaise apna difa
gardan mein haath aur us mein rasan
khud se nahi uth saki
jab gir gayi khaak par
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pe tehre na koi nazar
quran padne laga sheh ka sar
baba ko dekha to rone laga
zainab ko dekha hua nauhagar
sajjad bebas hua
jaaye to jaaye kidhar
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raaste mein aaya jo shireen ka ghar
shireen ke kaano mein pahunchi khabar
khush hoke nikli hussain aa gaye
rone lagi phir wo ye dekh kar
aaya hai kis haal mein
aaqa mera mere ghar
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram nauhagar aa gaye
naizon pe shohda ke sar aa gaye
shabbir waade nibhaate huwe
ek raat raahib ke ghar aa gaye
raahib ka dil phat gaya
ye khaafla dekh kar
aage kate huwe sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar to muqtasir hi sa tha
adtees ghanton mein wo tay hua
jab baabe saa'at pe pahunche haram
farhan o mazhar ajab waqt tha
kis tarha daakhil huwe
darbar mein nauhagar
aage kate huwe sar...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abbas pani lao
items.body:
zainab ye roke boli bhaiya na dil dukhao
kya dayr ka sabab hai ye to hamein batao
mashkeeza bhar ke jaldi darya se laut aao
bachi ki tashnagi ko tum aake khud bujhao
abbas abbas abbas pani lao
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ghamzada yaqeenan yaadon mein kho gayi hai
baba ko rote rote khud thak ke sogayi hai
ya tashnalab sakina behosh ho gayi hai
pani ka deke cheenta tum hi usay jagao
abbas abbas abbas pani lao
<<DIVIDER>>
haaton mein khaali kuze bache liye hue hai
gird e sakina dekho halqa kiye hue hai
bache na jaane kab ka pani piye hue hai
bin aab mar na jaaye pani unhe pilao
abbas abbas abbas pani lao
<<DIVIDER>>
is bekasi pe haaye aata hai mujko rona
purhaul hai andhera aur khaak ka bichona
seene pe soni waali kya jaane aise sona
pyasi hai mustarib hai aa kar usay sulao
abbas abbas abbas pani lao
<<DIVIDER>>
kaano mein al-atash ki awaaz aa rahi hai
aur uspe fauje aada ye zulm dha rahi hai
unko dikha dikha kar pani baha rahi hai
bache hai sheh ke pyase aada ko ye batao
abbas abbas abbas pani lao
<<DIVIDER>>
ulfat ki aag dil mein payham lagi hui hai
rouza tumhara dekhe ye hasrate dili hai
zaair bane tumhara ye khahishe zaki hai
aankhon ki tashnagi ko tum hi isay bujhao
abbas abbas abbas pani lao
items.author: Muhammad Zaki

items.title: Akbar jawan ki
items.body:
akbar jawan ki laash pe maadar ke hai ye bain
dooba hai khoon mein maara gaya mera noor e ain
<<DIVIDER>>
utho ay beta deti sadayein hai tujhko maa
shaana hila ke bete ka kehti hai ro ro maa
ay laal kuch to bolo mile dil ko mere chain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal tu hai baba ka aur mera laadla
naraaz ho to maa se kaho kya hai maajera
sun kar ye bain qaime mein hota hai shor o shain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
moo choom ke wo bete ka seene pe gir padi
seene ka zakhm dekha to dil dhoondne lagi
boli kaleje hai kahan ay shaahe mashraqain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
lakhte jigar ko mere jawani ye khaa gayi
shadi ke din thay beta tujhe maut aa gayi
sughra ko kya bataungi bolo ya noor e ain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
harkat nahi hai jism mein kart anahi kalaam
pani pilao aankhon ko kholega tashna kaam
akbar ko sota dekh ke rote hai kyun hussain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde jigar ye hota hai ay mere naunehaal
tanha na chodo kar lo zaeefi ka kuch khayaal
hasrat se choome bete ke maadar ne ro ke nain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein hai doobe gaysu to chehra hai khoon bhara
sehra kahan mai baandhun bata do koi zara
dukha banaun kaise tujhe bol dil ke chain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
saayib ye teer aur wo akbar jawan ki laash
bete ki laash pe hai dil e shaah paash paash
aankhon ka noor kho gaya kehte hai ye hussain
akbar jawan ki laash pe...
items.author: Sayib Zaidi

items.title: Ay karbala ay karbala
items.body:
baad e imam e lashkar e tashnadahan jo kuch hua
kis se kahun kaise kahun ay karbala ay karbala
kaise raqam ho bekasi behurmati ki dastaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ek kunba e aali mein sab ki dar badar ruswaiyan
ek mashk jisko kar gayi sairaab teeron ki zaban
ek sabz parcham jhuk gaya jo khaak o khoon ke darmiyan
ek aah jo seene se nikli aur faza mein kho gayi
ek roshni jo din ki dhalti saanson mein so gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
wo doodh maane hyderi ki aal e paighambar ki laash
wo aayaton ki godh mein soye hue akbar ki laash
wo ek bureeda baazuon waale alam parwar ki laash
wo doodh peete loriyan sunte ali asghar ki laash
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom bache wahshiyon ki jhidkiyan khaaye huwe
aun o mohamed chote chote haath phailaye huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad se zainab ka ye kehna ke maula jaagiye
ghaflat se aankhein kholiye luta hai kunba jaagiye
uth'te hai sholay dekhiye jalta hai qaima jaagiye
ay baaqi e zurriat e yaseen o taha jaagiye
<<DIVIDER>>
saare mohafiz so rahe hai ashkiyan bezaal hai
tauq o salasil muntazir hai bediyan tayyar hai
items.author: Mustafa Zaidi

items.title: Badan se noke naiza tak
items.body:
sar jo cheh maah ke baysheer ka naize pe chada
nok e naiza se ye asghar ki sada aane lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
badan se nok e naiza tak mera sar aa gaya amma
tera asghar bhi ek akbar ke barabar aa gaya amma
<<DIVIDER>>
galay par teer khaaye chain se soya hua tha mai
achanak qabr may naiza utar kar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kuch teer o sina par aur kuch baba ke chehre par
badan may khoon jitna tha wo baahar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
bataye aap ne ye raakh jo pehlu may baandhi hai
mera jhoola bhi kya sholon ki zad par aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e bazaar us lamhe bhi tumko sabr karna hai
mere sar ki taraf koi jo pathar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhala tum meri masooma behen ko kya batati ho
sakina poochti hogi ke asghar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera khoon may bhara kurta liye yasrab chali jaana
samajh lena tumhare saath mai ghar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
<<DIVIDER>>
ba roze hashr ahsan bas yehi sun'ne ki hasrat
ali asghar kahe mera sukhanwar aa gaya amma
badan se nok e naiza tak...
items.author: Ahsan Zaidi

items.title: Beh raha hai saamne
items.body:
beh rahi hai saamne nehre furaat
mustufa ki aal tishnakaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein shaad fauje shaam hai
khatm shahe deen ka sar anjaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pyas se bache hai shah ke jaan balab
umr ka lab rez unka jaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khatema bil khair lashkar ka hua
halq pyason ka tahe shamshaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
panjetan ka khatema hota hai aaj
garkh khoon mein kaukab-e-islam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke badal mein hai mehve mubeen
hai andhera hashr ka hangam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haale asghar dekh kar bole adoo
rehm ke khaabil ye tishnakaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hum pilayenge isay pani zaroor
jaan balab afsos ye gulfaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmula se phir ye bola naabkaar
sach bata tu taalibe inaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah ke haaton pe jo hai bezuban
tashnalab do din se ye gulfaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chahta hoo mai ye marjaye abhi
tere ek teere sitam ka kaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
waada e tifli bapa hone ko hai
shaah khush hai qalb ko aaram hai

items.title: Chale ho kis pe
items.body:
abbas mere bhai
chale ho kis pe shahe deen ko chod kar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe rahe saath umr bhar abbas
chale ho kis pe shahe deen ko chod kar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jaante ho sakina ka haal kya hoga
palat ke aaye na darya se tum agar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi hai nauha kuna aur koi tadapta hai
bana hai dard ki tasweer ghar ka ghar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kya hua saakit hai bolti hi nahi
palat ke dekhlo zainab ko ek nazar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar na hogi tumhe tum to so rahe honge
jab hogi zainab e dilgeer dar badar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaye jo tum suye maqtal zuban se kuch na kaha
khade na reh sake sibte nabi magar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
raha na ek bhi suraj hussain ke ghar mein
na hogi shaam e ghariban ki ab sahar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad jo hona tha wo hua aakhir
hussain mar gaye zainab hai nange sar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
wafa shiyaron mein hashim ka naam aajaye
bas ek nazre karam mujhpe ho agar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
items.author: Hashim Raza

items.title: Dhoondti phirti hai
items.body:
dhoondti phirti hai zainab laashon mein abbas ko
karti hai mehsoos ro ke aahon mein abbas ko
<<DIVIDER>>
fikr hai maqtal mein zainab ko faqat laahaq yehi
rassiyan aaye nazar na baahon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangne wapas zamanat chadaron ki aagayi
dekha hai jab barchiyon ki chaaon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bin baazuon ka laasha bhoolegi behan
ke jawan hote hai dekha haathon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr apno se bichadne ka kahin bhi gar hua
le hi aati thi wo dukhiya baaton mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir hi jaata hai sina ki nok se har baar sar
be-rida sar jab dikha hai raahon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo wafayein jaanti hai hai dilon mein ba-khuda
bandagi ka rutba haasil maaon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb e zainab hi salamat jaanta hai kis tarha
laut aayi hai wo lekar yaadon mein abbas ko
dhoondti phirti hai zainab...

items.title: Fatema kehti thi
items.body:
roti rahi hai sayyeda karti rahi aah o buka
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema kehti hai mai roti thi chillaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil se lipat jaati thi
<<DIVIDER>>
mere husain ka zakhmon se bhar chuka tha badan
khareeb hi dare qaime pe ro rahi thi behan
meri fughan se larazne laga tha saara ban
juda hussain ki gardan jo hui jaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
gira tha ghode se jis dam wo mera laqte jigar
utha ke godh mein rakha tha maine uska sar
giraati jaati thi aansu mai uske honton par
wo pyaas taygh talay aur badi jaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ro ke kehti thi zaalim se zulm ke baani
agar hai dil mein zara sa bhi dard e insani
ba waqte zibhe to de de husain ko pani
nabi ka waasta de de ke mai samjhati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai boli laashe uthaata raha hai ye din bhar
jawan bhai ke gham mein jhuki hui hai kamar
kadi hai dhoop udha de usay koi chadar
mai baal khole huwe dasht mein chillaati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi jo karbobala jao mesum o rehaan
tumhare kaano mein aayegi ek sada har aan
ghareeb maa teri ghurbat pe sabr par qurban
mai kuch na kar saki bas itna hi kar paati thi
haye mai khanjar e qatil...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Haaton may rasiyan
items.body:
haaton may rasiyan hai sar par rida nahi hai
zainab tera muhafiz abbas kya nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dharne ki til jagah hai bazaar may bhala kab
apni musibaton ko tu jaane ya tera rab
abbas ka sina par sar thayrta nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah se ahad ko tune bhi hai nibhana
in shamiyon ke haaton se uska deen bachana
tera hai aur kisi ka ye hausla nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mumkin agar hai bibi kuch aur sar jhuka le
chadar to ye na denge balon se moo chupa le
koi sadayein sunle ye wo jagah nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
parwardigar tujhpar nazrein jamaye hoga
qadmon may tere apna taaba bichaye hoga
tujhsa siwaye tere koi doosra nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana ke deen ki bibi tauqeer tu badha de
himmat se hausle se mushkil ghadi bata de
uska tere siwaye mushkil kusha nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab khadija saani zainab hi zehra saani
wo jaan bhaiyon ki wo noore aasmani
paband hai ahad ki be-aasra nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek taraf se hogi barsaat patharon ki
lekin hai jeet sar ki aur maut patharon ki
hai ya hussain lab par lab par dua nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki maa ka daaman khulne se tu bachana
aabad raakh se hai uska wo ashiyana
muddat se uska beta us'se mila nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ye paak bibi hi hai khuda ka parda
mumkin nahi hai isko chashme na jisne dekha
ye kya hai rab hi jaane mujhko pata nahi hai
haaton may rasiyan hai...
items.author: Abid Zaidi

items.title: Haye afsos raha
items.body:
haye afsos raha sab ko afsos raha
<<DIVIDER>>
itna mauqa ali akbar ko qaza ne na diya
maa tadapti rahi dulha bhi banane na diya
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kya soch ke seene se ali akbar ne
haath baba ko bahot dayr hatane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe akbar pe ye kehti thi tadap kar laila
fayeda koi tujhe maa ki dua ne na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
le gayi cheen ke baba se ajal akbar ko
khat bhi hamsheer ka bhai ko sunane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap sharminda hai is aalame ghurbat ne mujhe
chand khatre tujhe pani bhi pilane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag gayi maut ki bhar poor jawani mein nazar
haye taqdeer ne sehra bhi sajane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut se sirf rahega ye gila akbar ko
jo tha sughra se wo waada bhi nibhane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise uthega zaeefi mein janaza uska
baap ko jisne kabhi ranj uthane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag gaya chand ko laila ke gehen maqtal mein
maa ke armaano ko parwaan chadhane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke roti thi yehi aamir o akhtar ek maa
kaun sa zakhm mujhe karbobala ne na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Jab zehr ka imame
items.body:
jab zehr ka imame hassan par asar hua
khoone jigar se daaware didar batar hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jodha tujhe imam pa dhaate huwe sitam
khaufe khuda hua na zamane ka darr hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se ashk behne lage kaayenat ki
aalam ghame imam mein zer o zabr hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe zameen pa baith ke rone lage hussain
bhai ke saath ek safar muqtasar hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
larza thi qabr haye nabi o batool ki
dunya se jab imame hassan ka safar hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
barse hai teer haye janaze pe aap ke
ye ek aur taaza sitam aap par hua
jab zehr ka imame...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde gire hilal bahattar jo tasht mein
aaghaz e karbala se jahan ba-khabar hua
jab zehr ka imame...
items.author: Hilal

items.title: Kab aaoge baba
items.body:
tha shaam ke zindan mein sakina ka ye nauha
kab aaoge baba
ab aur kahan tak mujhe rulwaoge baba
kab aaoge baba
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi na khabar li to mai zinda na rahungi
mai bach na sakungi
dil kaampta hai dekh ke zindan ka andhera
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek raat bhi mai chain se sone nahi paayi
ammu hai na bhai
phat jaye kahin shiddat e gham se na kaleja
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya ali akbar hai na qasim hai na ammu
roothe hai ye sab kyun
chillaati hoo ro ro ke koi bhi nahi aata
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab mera muqaddar hai yehi khaak pe sona
takiya na bichona
sone ke liye aap ka seena na milega
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise yaqeen karloo ke faryad ye meri
tum tak nahi pahunchi
sunte rahe aur haal bhi mera nahi poocha
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-parda phiraye gaye bazaaron mein jis dam
kyun mar na gaye hum
har gaam pe maine tumhe ro ro ke pukara
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko bulaade koi ghut'ta hai mera dam
hai waqt bahot kam
bekas ki to faryad bhi koi nahi sunta
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...

items.title: Kya yateemi hai
items.body:
haye jab shaam e ghariban ka andhera chaaya
dhoondne baap ko maqtal may gayi ek dukhiya
darmiyan laashon ke ek laasha e besar dekha
aayi us laash se awaaz sakina aaja
jab suni baap ki awaaz to royi bacchi
laash e besar se lipat kar ye fughan karne lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad ye ehsaas hua hai baba
kya yateemi hai ye ab mujhpe khula hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
aag daaman may lagata hai sitamgar koi
koi kaano se gohar cheen raha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath kaano pe dhare di ye sakina ne sada
khoon is khaak may mera bhi mila hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap pehchaan na paoge yaqeen hai mujhko
haal jo aap ki beti ka hua hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
zibha se pehle tujhe pani diya zaalim ne
ya gala khusk tera kaata gaya hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
looto sadaat ko abbas nahi hai baaqi
shor hai samt yehi goonj raha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera pehlu bhi hai dadi ki tarha se zakhmi
pursa ummat ne ye mujhko bhi diya hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthke ammu se mere kehdo ke ab aajaye
dashte pur haul may dam ghutne laga hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj sar rakh ke sakina kahan soye bolo
saara seena tera teeron se chida hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna sehne hai sitam mujhko sitamgaaron ke
shaam tak ab ye muqaddar may likha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
items.author: Jaffer Tashna

items.title: Maa dekho na
items.body:
gire jo ghode se maqtal mein shaahe karbobala
hazaron zakhm thay saara badan lahoo se bhara
suni jo qadmon ki awaaz to uthe maula
kaha tadap ke ye jab maa ko saamne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ali akbar ko naiza maara
haye maa ho gaya seena paara paara
haye maa beh gaya uska khoon bhi saara
maa dekho na
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaya hai jab se uska laasha mai thak gaya hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak mai ujad gaya hoon maa
haye maa dekho na
<<DIVIDER>>
maa meri sakina kaise jiyegi
haye maa baap ka seena wo dhoondegi
haye maa mere bina wo mar jayegi
maa dekho na
sula ke mai khaak par sakina ko aa gaya hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa mar gaya meri godh mein ghazi
haye maa kat gaye baazu beh gaya pani
haye maa ho gaya uska chehra zakhmi
maa dekho na
nahi mile koi bhai se jaise mai mila hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa jiska badan tha phool ke jaisa
haye maa usko uthane jab mai pahuncha
haye maa bikhra tha qasim ka laasha
maa dekho na
sameta usko kahan kahan se mai jaanta hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa aun o mohamed mar gaye pyase
haye maa zinda na aaye wo darya se
haye maa mil nahi paaye wo sughra se
maa dekho na
magar sakina ko unke laashe dikha chuka hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ghutniyo bhi jo chal na paaya
haye maa teer gale par usne khaaya
haye maa asghar ko maine dafnaya
maa dekho na
wo kitna pyasa tha soch kar mai tadap raha hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa aapka beta reh gaya tanha
haye maa lakhon ne mil kar mujhko maara
haye maa teer lage aur khaaya naiza
maa dekho na
hai zakhmi sar dekho gurz kha kar abhi gira hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ran mein zeeshan aur farhan kaisa manzar
jab aake seene pe shimr baitha to bole sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
maa chalne waala hai ab khanjar
haye maa haath na rakhna tum gardan par
haye maa godh mein le lo mujhko aakar
maa dekho na
sukoon se maut aaye bas mai ye chaahta hoon maa
fajr se lekar asr talak...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Maqtal imam husain
items.body:
ay rone walon aayengi mehshar mein fatema
bibi ka haal dekh ke royenge ambiya
poochenge haath pehlu pe kyun hai rakha hua
kyun jhuk ke chal rahi hai bhala kya maajra
awaaz aayegi ye shah e mashraqain ki
sab nazron ko jhukao ye maa hai hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar mein ek hashr uthayengi fatema
ek daastan e zulm sunayengi fatema
royengi ahle gham ko rulayengi fatema
nanha sa ek laasha dikhayengi fatema
poochenge sab ye kis ka tan e paash paash hai
bibi kahengi ye ali asghar ki laash hai
<<DIVIDER>>
phir bibi badh ke arsh ka paaya hilayengi
bete ka apne khoon bhara kurta dikhayengi
haathon pe do kate huwe shaano ko laayengi
insaaf maangne ke liye haath uthayengi
ya rab qasoor kya tha mere noor e ain ka
ummat se pooch kaata gala kyun hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
hogi sada e ghaib suno fatema suno
tum khoon baha hussain ka jo chaahiye wo lo
lekin hamare saamne tum is tarha na ro
bolengi sayyeda ye guzaarish qubool ho
khul jaaye ek ek pe ghurbat hussain ki
ya rab dikha de sab ko shahadat hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ko dikhayi jayegi phir asr e karbala
mazloom khoon mein dooba nazar sab ko aayega
zahra kahengi dekhiye baba udhar zara
ye aap ka hussain hai faujon mein ghir chuka
ek pal nahi tha chain mere dil ke chain ko
nau laakh mil ke maar rahe thay hussain ko
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe kitne zakhm thay teeron ke dekhiye
leta tha saans behte thay fawware khoon ke
us par bhi ahle shaam ke hamle kahan ruke
bekas pe aisa waar kiya ek layeen ne
dandaan bhi shaheed huwe noor e ain ke
aise labon pe maara tha pathar hussain ke
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon ki samt rayt uda kar koi badha
koi chala ke baazu pe khanjar guzar gaya
talwaar koi maar ke mazloom par hasa
un zaalimon mein ek bine kaahil layeen tha
usne kiya wo waar ke mazloom dhal gaya
sab phasliyon ko tod ke naizah nikal gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dard tha ke zeen pe baitha nahi gaya
usne utarna chaaha par utra nahi gaya
paaon raqaab se bhi nikaala nahi gaya
aise kisi ko ran mein giraya nahi gaya
jab hurmala ka teer laga tha jabeen par
ghode se moo ke bal gira pyasa zameen par
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom ke sirhane gaya shimr e bad gohar
bekas ko maarta tha wo thokar idhar udhar
laaya wo qatl gaah talak zulfein khaynch kar
zainab pe uski nazrein thi zaanu hussain par
zahra ki betiyon ke dilon ko dukhata tha
daadhi pakad ke shimr tamache lagata tha
<<DIVIDER>>
tehra na minnton se bhi baba wo bad sifaat
ghurbat mein apne laal ka choda na maine saath
sab ko to ye pata hai ke zakhmi hai mere haath
baba khareeb aayein bataaun ek aur baat
zakhmi nahi hai haath faqat dil malool ke
khanjar chala hai baba galay par batool ke
<<DIVIDER>>
pehli chali jo zarb to sab ambiya hate
thi doosri hi zarb hassan bhi nahi ruke
wo zarb teesri thi ali jis pe ro pade
bas baba chouthi zarb talak aap saath thay
phir uske baad mai thi mere dil ka chain tha
khanjar tha meri jholi thi mera hussain tha
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad hashr hoga jo royenge khud nabi
bolengi zehra khatm musibat kahan hui
looti hai sab laash ghareeb ud dayar ki
baba mere hussain ki tauheen ki gayi
angushtri pe nazrein thi ek badnaseeb ki
ungli layeen ne kaati hai baba ghareeb ki
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Meri sakina soja
items.body:
meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah meri sakina soja
jaagti maa ne kaha meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tujhe khauf hai shayad mai usay kam kar doo
aaja aankhon pe tere naade ali dam kar doo
door kyun baiti hai aa meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke seene pe aadat hai tujhe sone ki
meri godhi tere qaabil to nahi hai phir bhi
hai mere dil ki sada meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaar barson mein na zehmat di kabhi tune mujhe
apni khidmat ka mujhe aaj to mauka de de
hoga ehsaan tera meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane mein jo aa jayenge tere baba
khud utha dungi tujhe shaana hila kar tera
acha kuch dayr zara meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse dekha nahi jaata ye tera darde jigar
ye batate hue acha to nahi lagta magar
ab na aayenge chacha meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah...
<<DIVIDER>>
saabiron ka ye kareena to nahi hai bibi
ye hai pardes madina to nai hai bibi
karke bas shukre khuda meri sakina soja
aaja asghar ki jagah...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Naam sakina rakhna
items.body:
koi surat ho magar narm hi lehja rakhna
apni beti ka agar naam sakina rakhna
<<DIVIDER>>
sakht awaaz mein hargiz na bulana usko
neend aajaye to seene pe sulana usko
ek lamhe ke liye bhi nahi tanha rakhna
apni beti ka agar...
koi surat ho magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh mein aise uthana ke lage koi gulaab
jaise rakhte thay sakina ko hussain aur rubab
paalna aise sakina ko sakina rakhna
apni beti ka agar...
koi surat ho magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gayi baali sakina sar e bazaar e jafa
nanhe haathon se chupati rahi chehra apna
usko kirdaar e sakina se shanaasa rakhna
apni beti ka agar...
koi surat ho magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
imtehan tha jo sakina ki gayi sar se rida
beti lekin na tumhari ho kabhi be parda
yaad har waqt ye ghairat ka taqaza rakhna
apni beti ka agar...
koi surat ho magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chid gayi mashk to karti rahi masoom fughan
boond pani ko tarasti rahi shabbir ki jaan
tum kisi haal mein beti ko na pyasa rakhna
apni beti ka agar...
koi surat ho magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naseehat hai jo baqar ne likhi hai safdar
naam beshak rakho nisbat se rahe dhyan magar
zinda sadaat ki hurmat ko hamesha rakhna
apni beti ka agar...
koi surat ho magar...
items.author: Baqar Hussain

items.title: Pani pilao
items.body:
pani pilao sabeelein lagao
<<DIVIDER>>
pani piyo to yaad karo pyaas imam ki
pyason sabeelein hai ye shaheedon ke naam ki
<<DIVIDER>>
mohamed ka pyasa nawasa hai ye
ali aur zahra ka pyara hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kayi roz ka haye tashnadahan hai
musafir hai aur ye ghareebul watan hai
ke toote dilon ka sahara hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare nabi ki pyari nishani
usay maar daalegi tashna dahani
mohamed ki aankhon ka taara hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
pilaye jo qatil ko sharbat ke saaghar
pilayega jo hashr mein jaam e kausar
usi sher e hyder ka beta hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo cheh maah ka asghar e bezaban hai
sakina si masoom tashna dahan hai
muslamano hum sab ka maula hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
safar ki aziyat uthayi hai is ne
ghareebon ki basti basayi hai is ne
madine se mehman aaya hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
karo pesh isko khiraaj e aqeedat
wo jis tashnalab ne bachayi shariyat
mohamed ki godhi ka paala hai ye
pani pilao...
<<DIVIDER>>
adaa ki shahdat ne ye shamdani
bujhi hauze kausar pe tashna dahani
zafar aur amjad ka nauha hai ye
pani pilao...
items.author: Zafar

items.title: Ab raat ho chuki
items.body:
jab khaak mein chupa chuke beti rasool ki
moo rakh ke apna qabr pe rote rahe ali
quran pad rahe thay jo ro ro ke murtaza
itne mein aayi fatema zahra ki ye sada
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad pe meri aise na aansu bahaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai bahot laut jaaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
maloom hai ye aap ko naazon ke hai palay
bache kabhi bhi raat mein tanha nahi rahe
ghar jaake pyaar kiye khana khilaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
bichde hai pehli baar jo maadar se naunehal
bachon ka mere ya ali rakhna bahot khayal
lipta ke apne seene se dhaaras bandhaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
milta nahi hai chain mere dil ke chain ko
raaton mein pyaas lagti hai mere hussain ko
ashkon ko uske pochiye pani pilaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab bahot hai choti ye gham seh na payegi
kehna bhi jo chahegi to kuch keh na payegi
bin maa ke kaise rehte hai usko sikhaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aarzu hai aap se marqad pe ya ali
le aaiyega bachon ko mere kabhi kabhi
mera nishan e qabr kayi jaa banaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad ka na qabr pe rone ka waqt hai
bachon ka mere ya ali sone ka waqt hai
lori thapak ke dijiye unko sulaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko yaqeen hai aaj wo hargiz na soyenge
chup chup ke mere hujre mein jaa kar wo royenge
meri nishaniyon ko wahan se hataaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee bhala wo kis tarha bechaargi likhe
aamir na jaane kaise ali qabr se uthay
awaaz bas ye aati rahi gham na khaaiye
ab raat ho chuki hai…
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Abbas piye kaise
items.body:
abbas piye kaise pani abbas ka aaqa pyasa hai
qaime may sakina pyasi hai aur bacha bacha pyasa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne jab peene ko kaha rehwaar ne bhi moo phayr liya
matlab tha yehi mai kaise piyu baysheer hamara pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
barsat ka mausam bhi to nahi pani ka barasna na mumkin
darya bhi udoo ki qaid may hai shabbir ka kunba pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
paaya jo sakina ne pani ye kehke badi maqtal ki taraf
asghar ko pilaungi pehle nanha mera bhaiya pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shere khuda ne pyaso ko kausar pa diya jaame kausar
moo phayr liya sab ne keh kar ahmed ka nawasa pyasa hai abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
laghar hai bahot bemaar bhi hai zanjeer badan se bhari hai
durre na laga abid ke shaqi wallah ye bhooka pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
azaad hui itrat lekin zindan may sakina hai ab tak
chidkao lehad par kaun kare har zarra zarra pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashkon ke ye jharne ankhon se chauda sau baras se jaari hai
sairaab abhi tak ho na saka rumaale zehra pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka jis may zikr na ho baysheer ki jis may pyas na ho
kitne bhi masayab ho anwar lekin wo noha pyasa hai
abbas piye kaise...
items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Akbar jawan thay
items.body:
kya sakht majera hai kahani hussain ki
be-waqt kya miti hai nishani hussain ki
akbar ka tha shabab jawani hussain ki
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
ye deen se lagao ye dunya se be-dili
barchi wegha mein aake kaleje se jab lagi
kya aan baan thi ke palak tak nahi hili
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
kya teen din ki pyaas mein tewar dikha gaye
dunya ke naujawano ki himmat badha gaye
phoolon mein tul rahe thay sinanon mein aagaye
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhiye maut aalam e imkaan e kis tarha
ye daagh utha liya shahe zeeshan ne kis tarha
dulha bana ke bhej diya maa ne kis tarha
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat ke waqt bano e shabbir chup rahi
behnein ghareeb surat e tasveer chup rahi
sab ek samt zainab e dilgeer chup rahi
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
maana ke sabr o shukr ka dil mein wafoor tha
bacche ka gham na ho ye mohabbot se door tha
maadar ko inke byaah ka armaan zaroor tha
akbar jawan thay jee se guzarne ke din na thay
ay dashte karbala abhi marne ke din na thay
items.author: Najm Afandi

items.title: Ali ke shehr kufa
items.body:
ali ke shehr kufa mein samaan zainab pe kya aaya
kuja burqa shariyat ka rida ka bhi nahi saaya
<<DIVIDER>>
janaza jis ki maadar ka utha tha parda e shab mein
zamana us ki beti ko sar e bazaar le aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ro kar sakina ne chacha muslim duhaai hai
wo dekho phir mujhe zaalim tamache maarne aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
darazi manzilon ki rayt ke tapte huwe raste
anokha saarban hai bediyan pehne huwe aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
saje hai baam o dar kufa mein aamad hai aseeron ki
tamasha aale ahmed ka musalman dekhne aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo khutba tha ke haibat cha gayi darbar saare par
ali ki sher dil beti mein hyder sa jalaal aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sajjad se zainab ne ro ke kuch to batlao
najaf se le ke chadar kyun mera baba nahi aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan baba ki shaahi thi usi darbar mein zainab
nisar aayi barehna sar ye kaisa inquilaab aaya
ali ke shehr kufa mein...
items.author: Baba Nisaar Haideri

items.title: Apni aghosh mein
items.body:
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
chal rahi hai meri gardan pe churi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahe the ye hussain ibne ali
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna lab naazon ka paala hai tumhara beta
qatl ab hone hi waala hai tumhara beta
rukne waali hai har ek saans meri
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne bachpan ka nibhata hoo ye waada dekho
maine badla to nahi apna iraada dekho
sar mera kaatne waala hai shaqi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
thak gaya laashein utha kar bhare lashkar ki
laash qasim ki mai laaya hoon kabhi akbar ki
khud banayi hai lehad maine ali asghar ki
do tasalli mujhe seene se laga lo amma
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni bechain hai amma meri zainab khwahar
aake teele pe wo khud dekh rahi hai manzar
ho rahi hai usay takleef badi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaya mera jari bhai magar sabr kiya
mere akbar ne sina khaayi magar sabr kiya
mil gayi khaak mein tasveer e nabi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
haajira aasia maryam bhi isi dasht mein hai
nooh bhi hazrate aadam bhi isi dasht mein hai
ro rahe hai meri ghurbat pe sabhi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kho diye dasht mein aankhon ke ujaale maine
khaliye dil pe bahot dard ke bhaale maine
maut aati hai to aa jaaye abhi
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
kalmago khoon rulaate hai mujhe maqtal mein
dekhlo kitna sataate hai mujhe maqtal mein
hil gayi dekhlo maqtal ki zameen
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek guzarish hai meri tum se ab itni maadar
amma baba ki qasam dhaamp lo moo par chadar
dekha jayega na ab tum se ye khooni manzar
aray qatl hota hoo nigaahon ko hata lo amma
haye ya hussain haye ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
arz karte hi nawab ho gaya mehshar barpa
khaak udhane lagi maqtal mein janabe zahra
shadman jab ye sada shaah ne di
apni aaghosh mein le lo amma
chal rahi hai meri...
items.author: Nawab Cholasvi

items.title: Ay karbala mein haq
items.body:
ay karbala mein haq ke safeeron salam lo
ay bekason yateemon aseeron salam lo
<<DIVIDER>>
ay haamiyan e aal-e-payambar tumhe salam
ay nasiran e bekaso muztar tumhe salam
ay karbala ke hamza-o-jafar tumhe salam
ay pasbaan e itrate hyder tumhe salam
ay karbala mein haq ke...
<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: Bade sarkar
items.body:
kehte hai hussain jab bhi aao karbala
pehle maango mere chote bhai se riza
zaairon do sada baadshahe wafa
yaad aa rahi hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hai maula sakhi maula
tum iraada karo ziyarat ka
dil nahi todte kabhi maula
izne ziyarat chote sarkar se le ke
aao chale bade sarkar se milne
<<DIVIDER>>
tizurooni aaidkum taarifooni shafee'akum
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne rauze ke gumbad jo nazar aayenge
aankh mein aansu unhe dekh ke bhar jaayenge
dil se niklegi sada ya aba abdillah
aap par mera salaam ay hussain saarallah
rote huwe unhe awaaz ye denge
maula yahan aap mazloom thay kitne
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai fazl o karam fazl ke baba sab par
unko tum yaad karo babul hawaij keh kar
tumko lene ke liye khud wo aa jayenge
saath abbas ke hum karbala jayenge
waada karo in ziyaraat se pehle
royenge hum kafe abbas pe jaa ke
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein jo baat hai abbas se ja kar kehna
unke rauze ki taraf dekh ke rote rehna
do kate haathon ka unko pursa dena
kehna hum bhoole nahi alqama par jo hua
gurz laga haye jab aap ke sar pe
zakhmi huwe aap rahwaar se gir ke
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula abbas jise chaahe bula lete hai
wo ghareebon ko bhi zawwar bana dete hai
ay azadaron suno fikr kyun karte ho
maula bulwa lenge unse keh kar dekho
haath rakho jaa ke ek baar alam pe
zaade safar khud alamdar karenge
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
abadwallah ya zahra maaninsa hussaina
abadwallah ya zahra maaninsa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
maula jab sunta hoon naara mai abad wallah ka
dil mera kehta hai maaninsa hussaina zahra
haan wo halmin ki sada kabhi bhoolenge na hum
jab nazar aayega shaahe waala ka haram
bolenge hum door se haath utha ke
aa gaye hum ya hussain aap se milne
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
izn jab hazrate abbas se hum payenge
ya hussain aap ke rauze se lipat jayenge
waasta zehra ka mujhko rone dena
haath mere dil par maula tum na rakhna
haq to ye hai dil ye phat jaaye wahan pe
qatl huwe maula jis khaak pe pyase
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
wahin qasim ka badan ghode se pamaal hua
barchi akbar ko lagi seene ka kya haal hua
teer asghar ko laga chid gaya nanha gala
do thay zainab ke pisar dono ko maar diya
ahle haram jahan har laash pe roye
aaj bhi hai wahin sadaat ke qaime
tizurooni aaidkum...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne din ho gaye wo rauza nahi dekha hai
jis ke darwaze pe saaqi e atash likha hai
bolo zeeshan o raza ay shehenshahe wafa
zaairon mein ab to naam likh de mera
baithun kabhi mai bhi darbar mein aa ke
rota rahun haye awaaz ye sun ke
tizurooni aaidkum...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Behan sakina muaf
items.body:
behan sakina muaaf karna
rehaai bhi mai dila na paaya
lehad pe sajjad ka tha nauha
ye bhai tujhko bacha na paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo durr jo baba ne thay pinhaye
wo shimr ne is tarha se cheene
tujhe tamachon se shimr ke mai
ay mere pyari bacha na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bebasi se tera bilakna
jab aag daaman jala rahi thi
mai kitna majboor tha sakina
wo aag teri bujha na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum oont ki pusht se bandhi thi
badan tha zakhmi lahoo tha jaari
tadap rahi thi atash se jab tum
mai pyaas teri bujha na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo yaas o hasrat se tera kehna
ke qaid mein hai bahot andhera
charagh laa do bas ek khudara
charagh bhi mai jala na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai haal bhaiya kise bataun
nahi hai ammu kahan hai baba
bulaye baba ko mere bhaiya
behan mai unko bula na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
lita lo seene pe aaj bhai
ke yaad baba ki aa rahi hai
thay itne lohe ke tan pe ke itne zewar
behan mai tujhko lita na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu kitni hasrat se poochti thi
milegi kab qaid se rehaai
nahi rehaai tera muqaddar
behan mai tujhko bata na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo tauq o zanjeer o hathkadi mein
banayi kaise behan ki turbat
shameem likhe wo kaise manzar
jo mera maula bhula na paaya
behan sakina muaaf...

items.body:

phirta hi raha aankhon mein bhai ka wo laasha

items.title: Dhoop may hai
items.body:
dhoop may hai qabre zehra gumbad e khizra ke paas
ye nabi karte hai nauha gumbad e khizra ke paas
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz se paala tha is ko thi meri noor e nazar
meri ummat ne jalaya hai meri beti ka dar
ye sitam zehra pe dhaaya gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye athara baras may ye huwe is par sitam
kaise kaise aur kya kya mil gaye zehra ko gham
hogayi zehra zaeefa gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah sabr e hyder tha ye kaise marhala
fatema zehra ko jo darbar bulwaya gaya
imtehan e murtaza tha gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera kalma padhne waale kar gaye kaisi jafa
jab gul e ismat ke upar jalta darwaza gira
hogaya pehlu shikasta gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbar o shabbir ko tum ne hai kaisa gham diya
haye bachon ke saron se maa ka saaya uth gaya
ro ke kehti thi ye fizza gumbad e khizra ke paas
dhoop may hai qabre zehra...

items.title: Fatema khamosh hai
items.body:
pehlu shikasta fatema kis se kare bayan
dar is tarha giraya ke tooti hai phasliyan
har shab ko apni haal par roti hai fatema
lekin kabhi ali se na shikwa koi kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar fatema khamosh hai
zakhm ye dekhe na hyder fatema khamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan tooti hui hai dard ki hai inteha
kar rahi hai baith kar apni namazo ko ada
kab koi shikwa hai lab par fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pe mohsin ki shahadat ka abhi taaza hai gham
muntazir hai maut ki aur ashk se aankhein hai nam
gham sabhi apne chupa kar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khauf hai is baat ka dekhe na chehra murtaza
neel zaalim ke tamacha ka hai bibi ke pada
dard ki tasveer ban kar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazzato minni kaha jis ko nabi e paak ne
haif ke ummat ne har lamha sataya hai usay
qabr mein roye payambar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaas se maadar ko apni dekhte hai mujtaba
ro ke ye baba se kehte hai shahe karbobala
kyun meri awaaz sunkar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa ke ummat ne jalaya fatema zahra ka ghar
dekh kar hyder ko tanha khoon rota hai jigar
qalb pe chalta hai khanjar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi thi haq lene zahra zulm ke darbar se
kar diye tukde sanad ke be-haya badkaar ne
bikhre tukdon ko utha kar fatema khamosh hai
dard e gham pehlu ka sehkar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha rehan koi ghurbate zahra likhe
ye wo mazlooma hai jis par zulm ab tak na ruke
rota hai danish bhi likh kar fatema khamosh hai

items.title: Haye akbar
items.body:
haye akbar haye akbar haye akbar haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaye laal mere kha ke sina seene par
aagayi neend tumhe dasht e bala mein kyun kar

dil mein armaan thi shadi ki tumhari beta

marhala aur bhi aage hai ghame zindan ka

hum rasan basta huwe shaam ke bazaar gaye

qasre zaalim mein mohamed ke tarafgaar gaye
bediyan pehne huwe abid e bemaar gaye
kaise batalun tumhe zulm jo toote hum par
haye akbar haye akbar...

nauha akhtar ne tumhare ye kiya dil se raqam
aur padha is ko hai mohsin ne basad ranj o alam
majlis e sheh mein qayamat ka bapa hai matam
un pe ta hashr rahe shaah ke altaf o karam
dil se deti hai duayein ye tumhari maadar
haye akbar haye akbar...

items.body:

fatema zehra ke bachon par bahao aansu

<<DIVIDER>>
khuld mein leke jo aaye ye janabe zehra

haq pe jaan waar ke islam bachaya jis ne
