items.title: Naara laga mere
items.body:
labbaik ya hussain
hussain saarallah abaabdillah
<<DIVIDER>>
naara laga mere maula hussain ka
matam hua mere maula hussain ka
bich gayi farshe aza maula hussain ki
hoti hai majlis bapa maula hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamgeen nazar aata hai ye chand moharram ka
har ek ko rulaata hai ye chand moharram ka
khoon roke bahata hai ye chand moharram ka
nauha bhi sunaata hai ye chand moharram ka
din aaye hai rone ke ye chand batata hai
kaise ho ghame sarwar ye humko dikhaata hai
mere maula hussain mere aaqa hussain
naara laga mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaala libaas pehno ay sheh ke azadaron
ghar par alam sajaalo ay sheh ke azadaron
farshe aza bichalo ay sheh ke azadaron
dunya ko ye batado ay sheh ke azadaron
kyun karte hai ye matam hum aale mohamed ka
mazloom ka maqtal mein khoon kisne hai barsaya
mere maula hussain mere aaqa hussain
naara laga mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sheh ka azadaron ye gham to manana hai
dunya ko ghame sheh ki rudaad sunana hai
jo zulm huwe un par har ek ko batana hai
baatil ke iraadon ko matti mein milaana hai
ab aao kare matam roye ghame sarwar mein
majlis ho bapa sheh ki haq walon ke ghar ghar mein
mere maula hussain mere aaqa hussain
naara laga mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab royegi zehra bhi farshe shahe waala par
karna na siyasat tum majlis mein kabhi jaa kar
dekho na dukhe hargiz abid ka dile muztar
kidaar se batlao sarwar ke ho tum naukar
waada ye karo har dum ashkon ko bahaoge
hai maqsad e sarwar kya dunya ko bataoge
mere maula hussain mere aaqa hussain
naara laga mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko laga naiza bughze waliullah mein
asghar ka gala cheda bughze waliullah mein
ghazi ko bhi hai maara bughze waliullah mein
qasim huwe sau paara bughze waliullah mein
thi dushmani aada ko hyder se faqat ran mein
is waaste kaata tha sarwar ka gala ban mein
mere maula hussain mere aaqa hussain
naara laga mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote hai bahot sarwar akbar ki judaai mein
veeran hua hai ghar akbar ki judaai mein
matam karo seeno par akbar ki judaai mein
rona hai hamein shab bhar akbar ki judaai mein
gham mein ali akbar ke roti hai bahot laila
rota hai bohat kunba jangal mein payambar ka
mere maula hussain mere aaqa hussain
naara laga mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye hai wo din jisme hum jhoola sajate hai
ghazi ka alam lekar jhoole pe lagate hai

items.title: Aaiye maula
items.body:
ya maulana ya sahib az zaman
al ghaus al ghaus al ghaus adrikni
ya sahib az zaman

waasta hai shaam waali shaahzadi ka
aaiye maula aaiye maula
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke hai saath hum ko karbala jaana
aaiye maula
<<DIVIDER>>
sunnate sajjad aur zainab ada karte huwe

sar khule jisko phiraya shaam ke bazar mein

intezar ab bhi wo karti hai ke akbar aayenge

waasta hai shaam waali...

aap ko us cheh mahine ke sipahi ki qasam

waasta hai shaam waali...

waasta hai shaam waali...

<<DIVIDER>>
lut gaye ahle haram aur jal gaye qaime sabhi

<<DIVIDER>>
phat na jaye dil yateema ka sitam ke khauf se

items.title: Ali khamosh baithe
items.body:
haye ghurbat e ali
<<DIVIDER>>
zahra ko dafn kar ke jo hyder e karrar aaye
sar ko jhukaye aasteen ulte ba-haal e zaar aaye
daaman phata hua hai gareban chaak hai
sar par mazaare fatema zehra ki khaak hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali khamosh baithe hai udaasi ghar mein chayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par ye pehli raat aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin bistar pe moo dhaampe huwe zainab sisakti hai
kahin kulsoom chupke chupke roti hai tadapti hai
ke nanhi bacchiyon ke ashkon se bheegi chatayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
jidhar bhi dekhte hai jaan nazar aati hai bacchon ko
dar o deewar mein bas maa nazar aati hai bacchon ko
ye nanhe bacchon ko taqdeer kis manzil pe laayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahe kis se ali jo zakhm dil par khaaye baithe hai
kaleje se hassan hussain ko liptaye baithe hai
haye mushkil kusha pe waqt ye mushkil kushaai hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi kulsoom ko dekha kabhi zainab ko behlaya
kabhi sote huwe hasnain ke baalon ko sehlaya
kabhi pani pila kar shaah ko dhaaras bandhayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha bacchon ne ro ro kar khudara ab to aa jao
thapak kar loriyan de kar hamay amma sula jao
batao aaj tak tanha hamay kya neend aayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi lipte musalle se kabhi quran ko chooma
kabhi naalain dekhi bistare veeran ko chooma
kabhi tasbeeh maa ki aankhon se apne lagayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
andhere sar patakte hai ujaala kyun nahi hota
ye kaisi raat aayi hai savera kyun nahi hota
qasam is raat ne bhi aaj na dhalne ki khaayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aayi maa ki khusboo farq par ek saibaan le kar
wo bacche aur bhi kuch roye zyada hichkiyan le kar
ali ne chadar e zehra jo bacchon ko udhayi hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali hasrat se takte hai kabhi betaab hote hai
mere masoom bacche kis tarha bin maa ke sote hai
duhaai khaaliq e akbar duhaai hai duhaai hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
musalsal raat bhar aamir sabhi ke ashk behte thay
laga kar seene se ainee ali bacchon ko kehte thay
tumhari maa se aur hum se qayamat tak judaai hai
bina maadar ke bacchon par...

items.body:
arab ke jangal se jaa raha hai
luta hua khaafela kisi ka

ye dar paye jor hai zamana

arab ke jangal se...

sawaar shehzadiyan hai saari

ghayur bad kar zara khabar le

jawan beta bhi tha kisi ka

items.title: Ay karbala tere daman
items.body:
ay karbala tere daaman mein daastan hai koi
hussain ban na sakega na karbala hai koi
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki beti hoon nana hai mustafa mere
mai berida hoon mere sar pe na rida hai koi
ay karbala tere daaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
na laashe baba pe jaungi chod'de zaalim
ye keh ke nanhe se haaton ko jodta hai koi
ay karbala tere daaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
na pooch maadar e asghar ke dil ki bechaini

sahara meri zaeefi ka kho gaya ya rab

items.title: Azadari hai
items.body:
binte zehra ki tamanna ye azadari hai
al ajal kehte raho waqte madad gaari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chauda sadiyon ki ye tareekh gawahi degi
hai azadari ki zarbat jo badi kaari hai
binte zehra ki tamanna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk na paaye ye safar nauhagaron seena-zanon
ye aza nusrat e shabbir ki tayyari hai
binte zehra ki tamanna...
<<DIVIDER>>
aandhiyon mein bhi diya gham ka jalaye rakhna
zikre shabbir se izhaan mein bedaari hai
binte zehra ki tamanna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi shabbir akele hai sar e dashte bala
ab bhi bemaar ki aankhon se lahoo jaari hai
binte zehra ki tamanna...
<<DIVIDER>>
kasrate fauj pe nazaan tha yazeedi lashkar
fauj e nau lakh bahattar se magar haari hai
binte zehra ki tamanna...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm aur jabr ne chaaha ke haqeeqat chup jaaye
ek qaidi ki magar aaj bhi salaari hai
binte zehra ki tamanna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mohib karbobala deen ka sarmaya hai
karbala ishq o aqeede ki shajar kaari hai
binte zehra ki tamanna...

items.title: Badshah hussain
items.body:
hussain hussain hussain
badshah e mann
shehenshah e mann
qibla e dilam kaaba e dilam
hussain hussain

badshah hussain shehenshah hussain

hussain ya hussain

kayenat mein baat baat mein

<<DIVIDER>>
badshah hussain shehenshah hussain
deen ka aasra hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko dil waalon ka sultan kaha jaata hai

hai fana yazeed aur baqa hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
badshah hussain shehenshah hussain
deen ka aasra hussain hai
hussain ya hussain...

tu balandi hai zabardast hai aala tu hai
jisko abbas kahe maula wo maula tu hai
arsh waalon ko zameen baatne waala tu hai
kyun na farsh pe aasman jhuke
maalik e zameen e karbala hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
badshah hussain shehenshah hussain
deen ka aasra hussain hai
hussain ya hussain...

tu hi hai toote dilon ka sahara hussain
hai aashiqon ki sada tu hamara hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se seeno mein basaya hai tera gham maula

badshah hussain shehenshah hussain

<<DIVIDER>>
badshah hussain shehenshah hussain
deen ka aasra hussain hai
hussain ya hussain...

maut ko maar ke jo karbobala tak pahuncha

badshah hussain shehenshah hussain

hussaina hussaina

hussaina hussaina

<<DIVIDER>>
maangne par haq mila jo ummati ke haath se

<<DIVIDER>>
dukh rahi hai ya elaahi meri maa ki phasliyan

items.body:
ye faqre panjetan hai ye aks e murtaza hai

bat'tees saal waala jaane jigar hamara

paidal safar najaf se jab suye karbala ho

phir mere paas aao...

mai radh nahi karunga ghazi agar kahega

ye gham usay hai ab tak pyasi rahi sakina

phir mere paas aao...

gar tum se apna ab tak khafa kahin hai

phir mere paas aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
salman o shadman hai paigham e shaahe waala

phir mere paas aao...

items.body:
dono jahan mein dhoom hai
dono jahan mein dhoom

hussain zindabad

items.body:

mujhse kehte thay mera dil nahi lagta beti
aaja ab aaja meri godh mein aaja beti

kabse bechain hoo surat to dikhado mujhko
phupi amma mere baba se milado mujhko

wo yahin honge kahin aap zara de to sada
kahiye unse meri jaanib se ke beti ho fida
door hi se zara awaaz sunado mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...

gham se phat jayega beti ka kaleja baba
baksh do mujhko agar ki ho koi maine khata
hoo sazawaar par itni na saza do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
shukr allah ka mushkil hui asaan meri
kat gaye qaid ke din aagayi ruqsat ki ghadi
ab safar khair se guzre ye dua do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khushi ki ye ghadi aankh na kije purnam
aap ko deti hoo mai aun o mohamed ki qasam
muskurate hue jaane ki raza do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bandh aankhein hui jaati hai meri dekhe zara
loriyan deti hai mujhko koi manoos sada
neendh aati hai phupi jaan sulado mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
maangiye ab na duayein mere jeene ke liye
dekhiye aagaye baba mujhe lene ke liye
qibla rooh karke phupi jaan lita do mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye taqdeer ke mar kar bhi rahi zindan mein
qabr bhi paayi to bachi ne wahin zindan mein
kya khata ki thi sakina ne batado mujhko
kabse bechain hoo...
phupi amma mere...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Karbala na bhoolenge
items.body:
hum na bhoolenge hum na bhoolenge
karbala na bhoolenge karbala na bhoolenge
<<DIVIDER>>
rehbaron ki sar zameen hai ambiya ki rehguzar
mehwe sajda hai yahin par khaana e kaaba ka sar
sab ko milta hai yahan se khuld ka zaad e safar
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad baaqi hai khuda ki karbala ki yaad se
dhoom hai salle alaa ki karbala ki yaad se
saans chalti hai wafa ki karbala ki yaad se
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaf go bebaak hai karte hai ye waada hussain
gham hai seene chaak hai karte hai ye waada hussain
jin ke shajre paak hai karte hai ye waada hussain
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
saari dunya ko sunayenge bayan e karbala
apne seeno par likhenge daastan e karbala
hum kabhi jhukne nahi denge nishan e karbala
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni jaanein nazr kar denge shahadat ke liye
dher sajdon ka laga denge hifazat ke liye
sar ke bal aayenge hum iski ziyarat ke liye
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala to qasre laa ilaah ki bunyad hai
sayyed e sajjad ka khutba to hum ko yaad hai
matami seeno mein ab bhi karbala aabad hai
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se iska naam likh denge har ek manzar mein hum
farsh matam ka bicha denge zamane bhar mein hum
phir azakhana sajayenge khuda ke ghar mein hum
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doobe huwe pyason ke laashe yaad hai
sehme sehme tashnalab masoom bacche yaad hai
dasht mein jalte huwe veeran qaime yaad hai
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahi thi al-atash ki jo sadayein yaad hai
chin gayi thi jo saron se wo ridayein yaad hai
jo rasan basta thi wo majboor maayein yaad hai
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ay karbala ay karbala ay karbala
hashr tak chalta rahega ye hussaini khaafila
sun rahe hai aaj bhi hum log hal min ki sada
hum na bhoolenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
al-madad ay gohar e haq al-madad shaah e najaf
saaye mein aake alam ke hum uthaate hai halaf
raaste sab mod denge karbala teri taraf
hum na bhoolenge...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Maa hai akbar ki
items.body:
maa hai akbar ki khushjamali hai
shaam se shamma ek jala di hai
maa hai akbar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa tere baazuon ko choome hussain
tumne laashe kis qadar uthaye hai
maa hai akbar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
saj ke zainab ne beton ke hatyaar
aakhri aarzoo nikaali hai
maa hai akbar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
uski himmat par kayenaat fida
jisne qabre pisar bana di hai
maa hai akbar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi kehkar ke roti thi bano
jhoola khaali hai godh khaali hai
maa hai akbar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zameen jis par qatl honge hussain
maa ne baalon se saaj daali hai
maa hai akbar ki...
items.author: Izzat Lakhnavi

items.title: Maqtal may goonjti
items.body:
maqtal mein goonjti hai sada tashnalab hussain
wo tashnalab sada jo raha tashnalab hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein goonjti hai sada tashnalab hussain
haye hussain haye hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
har har qadam pa kehta hua ya ali madad
le kar jawaan ki laash chala tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ne apni godh mein bad kar utha liya
ghode se jab zameen par gira tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram pa ek qayamat guzar gayi
maqtal mein jab shaheed hua tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hua sakina ko qaime mein chod kar
khanjar ko de raha hai gala tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
lo karbala mein khaakh ke bistar pa so gaya
aagosh e fatema ka pala tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimre layeen kalaje pa rakhe huwe churi
kunbe se ho raha hai juda tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ka jisne aqd padha tha abhi abhi
ab uski laash le ke utha tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaafil kabhi raha nahi naam e hussain se
ishrat ne apne dil pa likha tashnalab hussain
maqtal mein goonjti hai...
haye hussain...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Mehdi ke sar se
items.body:
mehdi ke sar se saaya baba ka uth gaya hai
ranj o alam mein dooba narjis ka laadla hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mehdi ke sar pe aayi dastaare askari hai
bar masnade imamat farzand aakhri hai
ya rab ho khair iski faryaad e fatema hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhe labon se ghash mein pani talab kiya jo
honton se jaam kyunkar wapas palat diya wo
kya yaad askari ko abbas aa gaya hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak e yateemi sar mein sin paanch saal logon
ghaibat mein jaa raha hai narjis ka laal logon
noor e imam ojhal nazron se ho raha hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi hai fauj ghar se mehdi ko aaj lene
dar fatema ka khola phir thokare laga ke
haathon mein taygh koi sholay liye khada hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis aabru se beta mayyat utha raha hai
khud baap ka janaza mehdi padha raha hai
zehra ko yaad aayi abid ki karbala hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
<<DIVIDER>>
mehdi ko koi pursa deta galay laga ke
ghaibat mein askari ki farshe aza bicha ke
abbas ko kabhi wo zainab ko dhoondta hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna ilaahi uski ghaybat mein tool hoga
parde mein kab talak wo narjis ka phool hoga
izne zahoor ho ab dil ki yehi dua hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
<<DIVIDER>>
ho bheed phir khadi wo kufa ke raaston par
pathar baras rahe ho akbar ke qaatilon par
khooli ka sar sina par is baar dekhna hai
mehdi ke sar se saaya…
items.author: Syeda Naqvi

items.title: Meri taygh chashme
items.body:
mai jihad kar raha hoo meri taygh chashme tar hai
meri dushmano ko har dam mere aansuon se darr hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye alam mera tashakhkhus ye alam mera ta'arruf
aur isis ke zere saaya mere waqt ka safar hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hua hai karbala mein wo likha gaya bahot kam
jo chupaye hai mazaalim wo moarriqo ka shar hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere aansuon ne phir to ye bisaak hi ulat di
wo hussainiyo ke dil mein na to khauf hai na darr hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
magar itna yaad rakhan ke hai ghaib mein jo qayam
hamein intezar uska wo hamara muntazar hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jab aayega zameen par to phir inteqam lega
mera ek ek lamha bas usi ke naam par hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhe ay layeen khabar hai ke ye kaun khoon mein tar hai
jise zibha kar raha hai wo rasool ka pisar hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jo kohniyo ke bal par kisi laash par hai aaya
wo sina bhi khaynch lega ke jawan ka padar hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo lahoo falak ki azmat wo lahoo zameen ki hurmat
rukhe sheh pe jo saja hai wo lahoo azeem tar hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye makaye harf shahid mere paas hai amanat
ke farogh doo aza ko yehi mansabe hunar hai
mai jihad kar raha hoo...
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Nabi ki fikr
items.body:
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
na hoti ye to adhoori thi karbala e hussain
buland ab bhi fiza mein hai ye sada e hussain
yehi to hai ba-khuda baani e aza e hussain
meri shareek mera ham khayal hai zainab
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe musibat hai aur pareshani
shikast zulm ke haaton magar nahi maani
aseer kunbe ki karti rahi nigehbani
jawan hai azme faza phir nidhaal hai zainab
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain charke sadaqat ye aaftabe wafa
hussain deen ki baqa hai hussainiyat ki baqa
dayare koofa o darbare shaam mein ba-khuda
namoona e asade zuljalaal hai zainab
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal...
<<DIVIDER>>
watan se door gham o aansu aur bechaini
na poochiye ke ghareebul watan pe kya guzri
uthaye kis tarha zindan e shaam ki sakhti
aseer zulm sitam khastajan hai zainab
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal...
<<DIVIDER>>
nigahe dehr na dekhi na aisi qurbani
hua na saani e zehra ka phir koi saani
ghame hussain ki surat hai ye wila faani
baqa hussain ko hai la zawal hai zainab
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sabr o shukr ka andaz sayyeda ki tarha
amal ki raah mein tewar hai murtaza ki tarha
sifaat o azm hai abbas ba-wafa ki tarha
hussain hi ki tarha be-misaal hai zainab
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuli jo aankh to sadma uthaya madar ka
shafiq baap ka sadma kabhi biradar ka
musafirat ne diya daagh phir bahattar ka
azal se hi ba-khuda pur malaal hai zainab
nabi ki fikr ali ka jalaal...
items.author: Shafiq

items.title: Pani piyo
items.body:
sadaat pyase reh gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
pani piyo to yaad karo pyaas imam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye shaheedon ke naam ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar talay hussain ko pani nahi mila
pyason karo qabool ye tohfa hussain ka
chaahat hai ye hussain alaihis salaam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jannat mein kar chuka hai khuda jis ka ehtemam
kausar rakha hai aayat e kausar mein jis ka naam
jageer ye sabeel hai baara imam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai is sabeel pe ujdi wo bibiyan
yani ali o fatema zahra ki betiyan
ye bargah bhi hai shahe tishna kaam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ka intezaar sakina se poochiye
asghar ki maa rabab e hazeena se poochiye
rasm e sabeel jis ne zamane mein aam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab karbala shanawar o salman jayenge
pyason ke naam par wahan pani pilayenge
zahra ki naukri hai ye khidmat imam ki
pyason sabeel hai ye...
pani piyo to yaad karo...
items.author: Salman Azmi

items.title: Aaj bhi aati hai
items.body:
aaj bhi aati hai zehra ki baqayye se sada
baad baba ke kiye ummat ne kya jor o jafa
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise wo ghurbat ka manzar bhool paaungi bhala
taqt pe baitha tha zaalim aur kahdi thi fatema
sayyeda ko bar sare darbar jhutlaya gaya
aaj bhi aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baba baad tere hum ne jhele wo sitam
phasliyan tooti hai meri pusht hai zakhmon se kham
aake dekho to zara kya haal mera hogaya
aaj bhi aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal raha tha dar hamara aur sab haste rahe
murtaza ko baandh kar gardan se rassi le gaye
de rahi thi aap ko ro ro ke mai us dam sada
aaj bhi aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar giraya jab sitamgaaron ne mai kehti rahi
zaalimon mai fatema zehra hoon mai binte nabi
rehm na khaaya kisi ne aur na aayi kuch haya
aaj bhi aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab o kulsoom hasnain o ali e murtaza
ro rahe thay sab ke sab hilta tha arshe kibriya
jis ghadi baba mera mohsin hua hum se juda
aaj bhi aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayega ek roz jab ultega wo apni naqaab
lega ek ek se meri ghurbat ka wo saara hisaab
inteqam e fatema lega faqad mohsin mera
aaj bhi aati hai...
items.author: Ali Rizvi Sachey

items.title: Abbas qatl hogaye
items.body:
abbas qatl hogaye akbar juda hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na poocha ke kya hua
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ka laasha ghodon se pamaal ho gaya
maadar ko uska gham mein hamesha rulayega
tukdon mein aaya laasha e qasim bata hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke yehi kehte thay laashon se lipat kar
thay aun o mohamed mere akbar ke barabar
zainab ke jigar paaron ka sadma bada hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ke dil mein pani ka armaan reh gaya
mashkeeza chida khoon e alamdar beh gaya
hum laaye alam bhai ka khoon mein bhara hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir jaate thay ghash khaate thay har gaam tadap kar
dete thay sadayein ho mere laal kahan par
aur seena e akbar mein tha nazia laga hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil se bahot khayncha tha us teer ko maine
dafna to diya asghar e baysheer ko maine
yaad aata raha halq wo uska chida hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
ansaar o aqraba sabhi jaan se chale gaye
akbar ki laash laaye to asghar ko le gaye
bas do pahar mein khatm ghar bhara hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein andhera tha kamar toot chuki thi
majboor behan qaime ki dweodi pe khadi thi
bemaar natawan tha ghash mein pada hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
padh kar naseem shadman aansu bahayega
ghaibat mein bhi imame zamaan ko rulayega
misre pe mir anees ke nauha likha hua
hum se kisi ne ye bhi na...
items.author: Naseem Buknalvi

items.title: Akbar ka tha ye
items.body:
akbar ka tha ye nauha sughra muaaf karna
dam toot'ta hai mera sughra muaaf karna
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmo ke darmiyan hoo lamho ka mehman hoo
kaise nibhaun waada sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haale dil sunaaun aaun to kaise aaun
barchi mein hai kaleja sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
behaal ho chuka hoo har aas kho chuka hoo
mat intezar karna sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hashr ka samaa hai sehra dhuan dhuan hai
aankhon mein hai andhera sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu muntazir wahan hai bhai tera yahan hai
har khwaab hai adhoora sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzoor thi shahadat paayi na itni mohlat
milne bhi aa na paaya sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ki roshni se milta tha jo nabi se
ab bhool ja wo lehja sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
acha hai door tu hai qasim lahoo lahoo hai
mehndi hai aur na sehra sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ammu ko ra rahe hai beenayi kho rahe hai
baba hai be-sahara sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko paa sakogi jhoola jhula sakogi
lagta nahi hai aisa sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir bapa hai mehshar sheh sun rahe hai nayyar
aur keh raha hai beta sughra muaaf karna
akbar ka tha ye nauha...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Arbaeen aur imame
items.body:
zameen e ishq pe goonji azan e arbaeen
jigar figaar hua karbala ki hook uthi
ghame hussain ne qaime laga diye dil mein
tumhari yaad mein rone ke waaste maula
<<DIVIDER>>
libaas e sog mein ashkon ke khaafile phir se
andheri raat mein palkon pe aake utre hai
tumhare wasl ki khasrat mein jaagti aankhein
zareeh e paak ko choone ke khwaab dekhti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aarzu tere rauze pe arbaeen ke liye
mujhe naseeb se wo khaafila e ishq milay
ke sarbaan imam e zamaan ho jiske
najaf se karbobala khaar khaar chalte huwe
meri jabeen pe un raaston ki gard pade
ho jinpe mehdi e dauran ne apne paon dhare
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam wo kahin aas paas saath mere
kadodo logon mein tanha akele chalte ho
mai baar baar nigahon se poch kar aansu
har ek chehre mein mehdi ke noor ko dhoondu
har ek se poochu koi chalees baras ka jawan dekha hai
kya tumne bheed mein mera imam dekha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek lazzate dunya se bekhabar hoke
dayaar e ghair mein ho jaun be sar o saaman
taam maange bina mere haath mein deke
galay lagale koi mujhko bewatan keh ke
tumhare rauze ki jaanib payada paa mehman
<<DIVIDER>>
udaata khaak chale khasta jaan o tan pahunche
taqaiulaat mein phailaake apne daaman ko
ameer e karbobala dekh teri chaukat pe
nazar jameine huwe ye faqeer baitha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare dar pe ye dastak ka jo tasalsul hai
mere sawaal ki zaahir isi se shiddat hai
tere baghair zamana udaas hai saara
mai tashnalab hoo tu meri furaat hai maula
<<DIVIDER>>
mai chahta hoo isi raahe ishq mein kho kar
kabhi talaash karun apni zaat mein khud ko
kare jo mujhse baghawat wo hurr milay mujh mein
tere huzoor mein bakshish ki aarzu le kar
aseer e nafs tere dar pe kis tarha aaye
bandha ke haath chale ya ke sar kataye
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe bhi zindagi ki aarzoo hai mere hussain
mai tujhpe aisa maroo ke hayaat mil jaye
khafas se nikle parinda hawa mein ud jaye
magar raza o ita'at ka jaam khaali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ba naame ishq zaade raah paas kuch bhi nahi
tu jaanta hai mai kitna ghareeb hoo lekin
mai jaanta hoo tu kitna kareem hai maula
bajuz tere meri jaaye panaah kuch bhi nahi
tere siwa bhari dunya mein kaun hai mera
items.author: Syeda Naqvi

items.title: Ay khaake karbala
items.body:
ay khaake karbala tu har khaak se juda hai
shabbir ka kafan hai zainab ki tu rida hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kalmago se afzal kitna maqam tera
danagaah e shifa hai dunya mein naam tera
tu sheh ke khoon mein tar wo deen se juda hai
ay khaake karbala tu...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe teri likhi hai daastan unki
shimre layeen ke sheh par dhaaye gaye sitam ki
maa aayi hai lehad se aur uska haal kya hai
ay khaake karbala tu...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ne fatema ki rakhe qadam hai tujh par
pehre pe aayi ban kar wo hoo bahoo dilawar
jo kuch kiya hai bas wo zainab ka hausla hai
ay khaake karbala tu...
<<DIVIDER>>
kidmat mein sheh ki hurr ka aana to yaad hoga
maqtal mein uska pehle jaana to yaad hoga
iska sila yaqeenan roomal e fatema hai
ay khaake karbala tu...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ke dil pe barchi tu hai gawaah uski
qaima e shaahe deen mein ghash maa ki aah uski
lagta tha umme laila khud aap se khafa se
ay khaake karbala tu...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhpe ay khaak baitha sar ko jhukaye qaidi
aankhon ko apne khoon ka darya banaye qaidi
kaandhon pe jiske haye kul wazn e karbala hai
ay khaake karbala tu...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid hussainyo ka ye khaak aasman hai
sajdon mein lehad mein ye un sab ki nigehban hai
dar asl noor e zaahir ye khaak e karbala hai
ay khaake karbala tu...
items.author: Abid

items.title: Azadari ka mausam
items.body:
har ek jaanib udasi hai aza ki rooh pyasi hai
fazaon mein lahoo ki phir wohi manoos khushboo hai
bapa hai dhadkano mein tashnagane karbala ki pyas ka matam
na jaane phir kisay ye ruth meinassar ho
so ashkon ke areezo se alam ki chaon mein aakar
wafa ke ahed ki tajdeed karlije
ke ye mausam wafadari ka mausam hai
azadari ka mausam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sare farshe aza aao azadari ka mausam hai
lahoo aankhon se barsao azadari ka mausam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
utho ishqe ali walon tumhe manzil bulaati hai
suno karbobala walon sada hal min ki aati hai
sare maqtal chale aao azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
hateli pe dhara hai sar badan tayyar rakha hai
yahan har farde millat ne kafan tayyar rakha hai
adoo ko jaake batlao azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayaad e zakhm mein mashkeeza abhi rota hai ye pani
abhi maujon ke seene mein chupi hai ek tughyani
ay dunya bhar ke darya'on azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kathin halaat hai aise ke ab jeena musibat hai
ghutan aisi hai ay humdam ke dum lena ghaneemat hai
alam ghazi ka lehrao azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
binaye aale ahmed par khuda tumko jazayein de
nikharo aise auladein ke zehra bhi duayein de
hussaini khaum ki maa'on azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha shabbir ne maa ki tarha darbar jaogi
na dogi bad'dua tum jab sare bazaar jaogi
qasam zainab meri khao azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthake nanhe haathon ko duayein deke jaati hai
sakina karbala walon ka pursa lene aati hai
azakhano ko mehkao azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi shaam e ghariban hai jale qaime hai ghurbat hai
gareban chaak kar daalo ke zainab par musibat hai
hawaon baal bikhrao azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi rizwan hum hote hai jo halaat se muztar
hawa e parcham e abbas kehti hai suno mazhar
mere saaye mein aajao azadari ka mausam hai
sare farshe aza aao...
items.author: Mazhar Naqvi

items.title: Badshahe karbala
items.body:
karbala ai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
likh de meri taqdeer mein bainul harmain maula hussain
ay baadshah e karbala maula hussain maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala jannat meri karbobala chaahat meri
ab to mujhe deedar ho dil hai bechain maula hussain
ay baadshah e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai nauhakhwan mai matami karbobala hai zindagi
sunlo meri awaaz ko zehra ke chain maula hussain
ay baadshah e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ho ke aaye karbobala mai reh gaya tanha yahan
dedaar ko bas aap ke tarse hai nain maula hussain
ay baadshah e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
rauza tera ho saamne aansu mere behte rahe
dil se yehi aaye sada haye hussain maula hussain
ay baadshah e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan o irfan e aza naade ali ki hai dua
mujhko bula le karbala maula hussain
ay baadshah e karbala...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Di jo akbar ne azan
items.body:
di jo akbar ne azan allahu akbar
ro diye kaun o makan
allahu akbar allahu akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
naara e takbeer goonja bar sar e karbobala
lehja e akbar mein tanha jaane kaisa soz tha
gir gayi ghash kha ke maa allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise ruk ruk kar jo aati hai sada takbeer ki
ye moazzin ko satata hai ghame tishna labi
khusk hai uski zaban allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabt karna chaahte thay zabte gham na kar sake
sunke hamshakle payamabr ki azan rone lage
khud imame ins o jaan allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
is azan ke baad hongi sakhtiyan dar sakhtiyan
waaliyon ko dekhna hai bar sare nok e sina
ro rahi hai bibiyan allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
muztarib hai jo sakina usko ye ehsaas hai
is azan se do pahar par furqat e abbas hai
sakht hoga imtehan allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkare shabbir mein hai har taraf aah o fughan
de raha hai karbala mein yusuf e saani azan
ro raha hai aasman allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima e shabbir mein sab bibiyan hai dil figaar
dar pe qaime ke azan sun kar hai zainab bekaraar
le rahi hai siskiyan allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek behan baaghe madina par sare rayt e tapa
sun rahi hai yaas o hasrat se baradar ki azan
hai qayamat ka samaa allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke ye gehware mein ki azan e ashk baar
nusrat e sarwar ki khaatir ho raha hai bekaraar
asghar e guncha dahan allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bayan ho ay hameed o safdar e khasta jigar
lashkare shabbir mein ye gham ka manzar dekh kar
keh rahi hai khud azan allahu akbar allahu akbar
di jo akbar ne azan...
items.author: Hameed Abidi

items.title: Fatema yateem hogayi
items.body:
jiska jee chaahe wo zehra pe sitam dhaata hai
pursa kya aise yateemon ko diya jaata hai
mera darwaza jalaya kar diya pehlu shikasta
phasliyan tod di meri
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali hyder e karrar
<<DIVIDER>>
kya unhe khabar nahi ali
fatema yateem hogayi
zahra haye zahra zahra haye zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
sochti thi mustafa ki hoon mai laadli
pursa dene aayenge madine se sabhi
intezar farshe gham pe karti reh gayi
mere sar pe haath rakhne aaya na koi
teen din ke baad aaye to
ghar mera jala diya ali
kya unhe khabar nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalimon ne jalta dar giraya jis ghadi
haye mujhko fikr thi bas apne laal thi
phasliyon ke tootne ki kab sada suni
mera mohsin ab nahi bacha samajh gayi
jiska intezar tha mujhe
chehra uska dekh na saki
kya unhe khabar nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali hyder e karrar
<<DIVIDER>>
aap se na jaane unko kitna bughz tha
ya ali kaha to aage ek layeen bada
kya bataun jab talak wo thak nahi gaya
haath par wo taaziyane maarta raha
ungliyon mein itna dard hai
haath na uthega ab kabhi
kya unhe khabar nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise ye tamache ka nishan chupaungi
poochega hussain to mai kya bataungi
kaise apne bachon se nzazar milaungi
saamne hassan ke ab mai kaise jaungi
mujhpe haath utha jahan kabhi
bhool na sakungi wo gali
kya unhe khabar nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko dekhte hi masnad apni chod kar
karte thay adab mera jahan mere padar
jaane kab talak khadi thi mai magar
baithe has rahe thay sab wo mere haal par
unka ye sulook dekh kar
dekho mai zaeefa hogayi
kya unhe khabar nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi aur yateem meri tarha ya ali
hogi ek laadli mere hussain ki
choti zehra hone pe sitam uthayegi
qaid hoke jab wo shehre shaam jayegi
khayegi tamache shimr ke
raah mein sakina bhi meri
kya unhe khabar nahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise zeeshan likhe kis tarha farhan padhe
fatema zehra pe jo zulm madine mein huwe
bibi har zulm pe kehti thi yehi ro ro ke
kya yateemon pe sitam karta hai koi aise
hai dua waqt kisi maa pe na aaye aisa
saamne bachon ke jis tarha mujhe maara gaya
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Haye akbar ghar may
items.body:
maa ka naala laash tak aata hai
akbar ghar mein aao
dekh koi yun bhi rulwata
haye akbar ghar mein aao
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri dedaar mumkin ho to dikhlado mujhe
laash uthane ran mein baap aata hai
akbar ghar mein aao
haye akbar ghar mein aao
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde tukde hogaya nazuk kaleja waqte jang
is tarha barchi koi khata hai
akbar ghar mein aao
haaye akbar ghar mein aao
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqe ja'ungi wafa ehde jawani ne na kuch
itne jaldi koi mar jaata hai
akbar ghar mein aao
haaye akbar ghar mein aao
<<DIVIDER>>
tum yahan maqtal mein ho aur maa hai deodi par tapan
meri jaan ulfat mein farq aata hai
akbar ghar mein aao
haaye akbar ghar mein aao
<<DIVIDER>>
tumse milna kya tumhari maa ke kismat mein nahi
dil mera kaahe ko ghabrata hai
akbar ghar mein aao
haaye akbar ghar mein aao
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime ke dar par tumhare waaste roti hai maa
aisa koi maa ko rulwata hai akbar ghar mein aao
akbar ghar mein aao
haaye akbar ghar mein aao
items.author: Zakhir

items.title: Hukme shabbir se
items.body:
hukme shabbir se jo zabt ki deewar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
<<DIVIDER>>
mera abbas alamdar hai aisa ghazi
naam se harf e wafa jiske wafadar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk pehchaan alam jaan sakina dil hai
mil ke in cheezon se paikar tera tayyar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafila aale mohamed ka chala jab ghar se
tu alamdar hua khaafila salaar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaye haath qalam mashk bachane ke liye
tere jaisa na zamane mein wafadar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak baazu rahe mashk pe aanch aayi nahi
kat gaye haath to mashkeeza pe tab waar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere qadmon ki badolat hui mashoor furaat
paaon chu kar jo tere pani haya daar hua
shakle hyder mein wohi hyder e karrar hua
hukme shabbir se jo...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Hussain zindabad
items.body:
khudaye paak ka pyara hussain zindabad
nabi ki aankhon ka taara hussain zindabad
dile batool ka paara hussain zindabad
ali ka raj dulara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye naara hussain zindabad
kaho ye milke hamara hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
ameer e shehr e shahadat hai tera naam hussain
tujhi pe bheja hai islam ne salaam hussain
hai tere haaton mein kaunain ka nizam hussain
suna jo noke sina par tera kalaam hussain
pukar utha ye nazara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya hai pani tere hausalon ne pathar ko
shikast di hai teri pyaas ne samandar ko
fana ki qabr mein dafna diya sitamgar ko
ulat ke rakh diya tune har ek manzar ko
haqeeqaton ko ubhara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
dayare shab pe ujaalon ne hukmarani ki
jale diye to hawaon ne pasbani ki
mili zaeefi ko angdaiyan jawani ki
zaban hogayi mashoor be-zabani ki
ye tera faiz hai saara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
payame haq hai khuda ki qasam payame hussain
har ek cheez hai kaunain ki ghulame hussain
wo mohtaram hai jo karta hai ehtarame hussain
agar yazeed se lena hai intiqame hussain
lagao jhoom ke naara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ghar luta'ta hai usko hussain kehte hai
jo deen bachata hai usko hussain kehte hai
jo hur banata hai usko hussain kehte hai
jo jeet jaata hai usko hussain kehte hai
shuja'aton ne pukaraa hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
baraye jang ye lekar jo zulfiqar gaya
ameere shaam ko beta ali ka maar gaya
kiya ye waqt ne elaan ikhtedaar gaya
hussain jeet gaye aur yazeed haar gaya
khuda ka deen pukara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka laal shahe mashraqain zinda hai
wo qalbe fatema zehra ka chain zinda hai
shababe faatahe badr o hunain zinda hai
yazeed margaya mera hussain zinda hai
ye zindagi ka hai naara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye tera dost bhi tera adoo bhi kehta hai
chiragh aandhiyon ke rubaru bhi kehta hai
alam bhi taygh bhi chaake gulu bhi kehta hai
nazar bhi fikr bhi dil bhi lahoo bhi kehta hai
jo qatl hoke na haara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…
<<DIVIDER>>
wafa ka tazkira gauhar sada pasand rahe
nishane matame shabbir arjuband rahe
alam hussain ke lashkar ka sar baland rahe
yazeedi qabr ki gehrayion mein band rahe
jiye hussain hamara hussain zindabad
lagaye jao ye nara…

items.title: Jafar ka rone walon
items.body:
jafar ka rone waalon taboot uth raha hai
phir fatema ke ghar mein farsh e aza bicha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kazim tadap tadap kar ye bain kar rahe hai
afsos mera baba mujh se bichad gaya hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
misle hassan jigar hai jafar ka tukde tukde
haakim ne zehr haye masoom ko diya hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
har zulm seh rahe hai jafar imam e sadiq
farzande sayyeda par kaisa sitam hua hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
har zulm kalmago ne sadaat par hai dhaaya
aulaad e mustafa par ghurbat ki inteha hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid e sitam mein jafar rote hai shaah e deen ko
maula ki chashm e tar mein sehra e karbala hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
keh do muhib ye jaa kar kam zarf muftiyon se
sab se badi ibadat matam e hussain ka hai
jafar ka rone waalon…

items.title: Karbala noke sina
items.body:
karbala noke sina se ye khabar laayi hai
zindagi maut ki sehra se guzar aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek chiraaghe shabe ashoor ne gul ho kar bhi
farsh se arsh talak roshni phailayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishqe shabbir mein behne ke liye nehre furaat
hum azadaron ki aankhon mein simat aayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko imraad e dil o jaan ka koi khauf nahi
hum ne roohon ke maseeha se shifa paayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne haathon se banayege muqaddar apna
hum ne shabbir ke matam ki qasam khaayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag gayi kya ali akbar ke kaleje pe sina
sar khule binte ali ghar se nikal aayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaa gaye shaam e ghariban ke andhere ban mein
aale ahmed pe qayamat ki ghadi aayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa ke abbas ke marqad pe kaha zainab ne
utho abbas e dilawar ke behen aayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
har zamane ne ye tasleem kiya hai gohar
karbala waqt ki sab se badi sachayi hai
karbala noke sina se...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Khanjar hai sitamgaar
items.body:
khanjar hai sitamgaar ka pyase ka gala hai
zainab ghareeb dasht mein mashgool e buka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange nabi zaadiyan darbar saja hai
afsos musalman badi sharm ki jaa hai
khanjar hai sitamgaar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehne do sar e zainab e muztar pe ye chadar
kuch sharm karo saani e zehra ki rida hai
khanjar hai sitamgaar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein shahe deen ka dil ho gaya tukde
naiza jo jawan laal ke seene mein dhasa hai
khanjar hai sitamgaar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar baar diya shaah ne sar ko bhi kataya
kul ambiya jo kar na sake wo sheh ne kiya hai
khanjar hai sitamgaar ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khoon e hussain ibne ali ka hai maujiza
parvez suno haq ki azaano mein sada hai
khanjar hai sitamgaar ka...
items.author: Parvez

items.title: Kya ye wo chand
items.body:
hilal e maah e gham hilal e maah e aza
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar lut gaya batool ka laaya hai jo khabar
kya ye wo chand hai
jis chand mein huwe hai bahattar lahoo mein tar
kya ye wo chand hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jis chand mein rasool bhi rote hai zaar zaar
hoti hai jisko dekh ke zahra bhi beqarar
karta hai jo hassan ke kaleje ko taar taar
sadme se jis mein aaj bhi roti hai zulfiqar
aate hai jis mein aj bhi pyason ke sar nazar
kya ye wo chand hai...
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis chand mein batool ka gulshan ujad gaya
jis chand mein rasool ke pyaron pe thi jafa
jis chand mein ali ke dulaaron ka sar kata
jis chand mein lahoo se hui laal karbala
jis mein laga diya gaya pehra furaat par
kya ye wo chand hai...
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis chand mein hussain se akbar juda hua
seene pe naujawan ke barchi ka phal laga
toda gaya zaeef ka pardes mein asaa
cheena gaya hussain se jeene ka aasra
akbar ka jis mein baap ke haathon pe tha jigar
kya ye wo chand hai...
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka hussain ne paaya hai jis mein gham
jis mein kamar hui hai shahe karbala ki kham
jis chand mein dilayr ke shaane huwe qalam
thanda hua furaat pe jis chand mein alam
jis mein nehar pe doob gaya hashmi qamar
kya ye wo chand hai...
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhe galay pe teer laga jis hilal mein
ek sheerkhwar nehr hua jis hilal mein
chehre pe sheh ne khoon mala jis hilal mein
asghar ko roke dafn kiya jis hilal mein
ki jis mein bezaban ki lehad aansuon se tar
kya ye wo chand hai...
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor choor thay jis mein shahe huda
seene pe jis hilal mein shimr e layeen chadha
kaata gaya hussain ka jis chand mein gala
jis mein hussain qatl huwe ran mein bekhata
maadar thi jis mein laal ke laashe pe nauha gar
kya ye wo chand hai...
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hoti thi jis hilal mein din raat sakhtiyan
tadpi hai jis hilal mein hyder ki betiyan
ujdi hai jis hilal mein maa'on ki godhiyan
dikhta hai jis hilal mein qaimon ka wo dhuaan
pehre pe jis mein zainab e muztar thi raat bhar
kya ye wo chand hai...
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhta hai jab koi bhi surani ye daastan
hota hai jab ali ye bahattar ka gham bayan
hilti hai ye zameen larazta hai aasman
dete hai ghaib se ye sada saahib az zaman
rota hoon jis mein peet ke sar mai har ek peher
haan ye wo chand hai haan ye wo chand hai
ghar lut gaya batool ka...
items.author: Ali Raza Surani

items.title: Maqtal may khogayi
items.body:
maqtal may kho gayi hai akbar ki jawani
soyi hai sina khaake payambar ki nishani
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ko madine may ajab khaab ye aaya
lut'te huwe dekhi hai biradar ki jawani
maqtal may kho gayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde ali akbar ke kaleje ke jo dekhe
yaad aagayi phir maut ko shabbar ki jawani
maqtal may kho gayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras ka tha din byah ke aaye
tar khoon may magar hogayi akbar ki jawani
maqtal may kho gayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan shah e wala ka daaman hua khaali
bachpan raha asghar ka na akbar ki jawani
maqtal may kho gayi…
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Mehendi qasim tere
items.body:
mehendi qasim tere haathon may rachaye maadar
aaja aaja tujhe seene se lagaye maadar
<<DIVIDER>>
koi qasid bhi nahi hai jo madine jaaye
kaise sughra ko madine se bulaye maadar
mehendi qasim tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
phool ashkon ke piroti hoo tere sehre ke
sar pe aanchal tere aahon ka sajaye maadar
mehendi qasim tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath may kangna jo baandhun to padhun naade ali
nazr e bad se tujhe aada ki bachaye maadar
mehendi qasim tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri baraat may armaan ho baraati mere
aur sheh baala bhi asghar ko banaye maadar
mehendi qasim tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
aqd ka seegha padhe rooh tere dada ki
gul e jannat teri masnad pe bichaye madar
mehendi qasim tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand taaron ki kiran dhaanpu tere jodhe may
aur zehra ki rida sar pe udhaye maadar

items.title: Meri zainab gham se
items.body:
mere baba jaldi aajao

shabbir ne waada poora kiya
khanjar ke neeche sajda kiya

tera baba tere saath...

hum kam to nahi thay yateemi ke
aur us par zakhm aseeri ke
rukhsaar hai neele bacchi ke
shaano pe nishan hai rassi ke
rakhna bada dhyan sakina ka
tera baba tere saath...

aabaad kiya shabbir ne ban

bhai hai wahan be-gor o kafan
bechadar hai kufe mein behen
gham dono ka hai milta jhulta
tera baba tere saath...

dhaaras hai tu hi yateemon ki

tera baba tere saath...

maana ke bahot dukh paayi hai

sholon se bacha kar laayi hai
abid ke liye ban jaana asa
tera baba tere saath...

meri beti tujhsa koi nahi

mat haarna himmat gham se kahin

hai deen ke sar par teri rida
tera baba tere saath...

maqtal mein bhi hum tere saath rahe

darbar mein ab jaana hai tujhe

mujhe yaad hai apna har waada

ay aamir o nayyar jab jab hum

items.title: Nabi ki jaan dile
items.body:
nabi ki jaan dil e hyder ka aaj chehlum hai
makeen e dosh e payamber ka aaj chehlum hai
ke ibne faatah e khyber ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar ka aaj chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jhulasti rayt pa afsoos pyaas mein tadpa
shaheed ho gaya maqtal mein phool sa bacha
usi hussain ke dilbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahoo ashkon ko aur momino karo girya
dilao fateha aur majlisein karo barpa
hamare mohsin o yawar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ne raahe khuda mein kata diya sar ko
wo jis ne raahe khuda mein luta diya ghar ko
us ibne saaqi e kausar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen roti hai aansu baha raha hai falak
libaas e gham mein pareshan sabhi hai jinn o malak
ye ro ke kehte hai dilbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rawan hai bachon pa afsos zulm ke khanjar
pachade khaati thi zainab ye dekh kar manzar
musibaton ke samandar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ki laash ko raunda sitam ne maqtal mein
wo jis ki bewa bahaati thi ashk jangal mein
yateem saani e shabbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek khwaab baha zulm ki rawani mein
sina kaleje pa khaayi bhari jawani mein
hussain ke usi akbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aaj shiyon mohamed o aun ka chehlum
hussain ibne ali ki hai jaan ka chehlum
habeeb jaise dilawar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raza furaat pa apne kata ke shaano ko
hayaat de gaya ghazi wafa ki raahon ko
usi wafaon ke paikar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...

items.title: Pani sakina ko pilao
items.body:
ya abbas ya abbas

abbas kahan ho abbas kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
pani zara qaimon mein lao ghazi
pani sakina ko pilao
<<DIVIDER>>
bacchon ko tum chehra dikhao ghazi
pani sakina ko pilao
<<DIVIDER>>
ab tak na pyaas bujhi qaime ke dar pe khadi
roti hai kooza uthaye
asghar ko dekhti hai sab se ye poochti hai
mere chacha kyun na aaye
pani usay laa kar pilao ghazi
pani sakina ko pilao
pani zara qaimon mein...

bolo abbase jari kyun itni dayr hui

karte hai yaad tumhe phaila ke haath unhe
seene se apne laga lo
dekha nahi kab se aa jao ghazi
pani sakina ko pilao
pani zara qaimon mein...

kooze utha lo sabhi aate hi honge abhi
mashkeeza qaimon mein le ke
la denge pani hame rokega kaun unhe
ammu bahadur hai mere
toote na dil bacchon ka aao ghazi
pani sakina ko pilao
pani zara qaimon mein...

aa jao laut ke ghar neend aa rahi hai magar

tumko maloom hai sab soti hai paas hoon jab
tum aur baba ka seena
lori usay aa kar sunao ghazi
pani sakina ko pilao
pani zara qaimon mein...

jab se ye shor utha abbas maara gaya
tooti hai sab pe qayamat
karte hai ro ro ke dua darya pe ho ay khuda
ammu hamare salamat
hausla bacchon ka badhao ghazi
pani sakina ko pilao
pani zara qaimon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein jo bhi gaya wapas na laut saka
masoom ghabra rahe hai
dikhta nahi hai alam dil mein saqqa e haram
kya kya khayal aa rahe hai
phir se zara parcham uthao ghazi

pani zara qaimon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe sab ne dekha
parchame abbas utha
bali sakina ne kaha
dekho wo aate hai chacha
<<DIVIDER>>
jab wo alam paas aaya
bacchon ka dil toot gaya
khoon mein dooba wo alam
rakh ke shahe deen ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl alamdar ho gaya haye hum ghareeb ho gaye
sher jaisa bhai tha mera haye hum ghareeb ho gaye
bacchon ne kooze phaynke ro ro ke alam se lipte
dekho ay zeeshan o raza deta hai ta'seer sada

haye sakina haye pyaas

items.title: Ab sakina ko kabhi
items.body:

maa rasan basta hai aur qaid hai bhai bemaar

maar kar durra tadapne bhi nahi dega layeen

bhool payegi na ghazi ke kate shaano ko

ab sakina ko kabhi...

neend usay noor ali aaye to kaise aaye

gaam dar gaam jo pathar kabhi durre khaaye

items.body:

items.body:
yaad e abbas sare shaam e ghariban aayad

nange paa majlise shabbir mein shabbar aaye
safe matam hai bapa fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne haq se ghame sarwar ki baqa maangi thi
jo na murjha sake wo falze aza maangi thi
hum wo hai jin ke liye tum ne dua maangi thi
sunli khaaliq ne dua fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir azadaron ke ghar badle gulistano mein
nazb hone lage wo patke azakhano mein
jamma hone lage atfaal bhi daalano mein
taaziya sajne laga fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum azadaron ke upar hai karam ghazi ka
abhi panje se numayan hai hasham ghazi ka
ghame sarwar ka muhafiz hai alam ghazi ka
dekho ghazi ki wafa fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi royi kabhi sambhli kabhi uthi zainab
saath mein ahle haram ke kabhi jaagi zainab
isi majlis ke liye aap ki beti zainab
de gayi apni rida fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl suraj hua din gham mein dhala shaam hui
qaime jalte hai sar e dashte bala shaam hui
qaid hone koi bemaar chala shaam hui
ban mein ek hashr utha fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulmate shaame alam hai koi jugnu bhi nahi
laashe sarwar pe diya kaisa ke aansu bhi nahi
kaun matam kare abbas ke baazu bhi nahi
ro padi karbobala fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai maare gaye behno ki giraftaari hai
ek nayi karbobala ke liye tayyari hai
ye ghadi aap ki zainab pe bahot bhaari hai
hausla dedo zara fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ka laal hai wo baadhshahe jinn o bashar
ambiya bhi hai azakhane ke darwaze par
aaye hai nayyar o aamir bhi sawali ban kar
kar do in par bhi ataa fatema zehra aao
bich gaya farshe aza...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Haye akbar ki maa
items.body:
daal do koi zakhmon pe chadar
haye akbar ki maa aa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
seena akbar ka rakho chupa kar
haye akbar ki maa aa rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon mil ke halqa bana lo
maa jawan laal ki hai sambhalo
mar na jaaye wo laashe pe aa kar
haye akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh legi agar umme laila
apne bacche ka zakhmi kaleja
saans bhi le na payegi maadar
haye akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mannatein maan kar jisko paala
uske seene mein zaalim ka bhaala
kaise dekhegi maadar ye manzar
haye akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisko dulha banane ke din thay
jiski shadi rachane ke din thay
usko dekhegi maa khoon mein tar
haye akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi armaan dil ka na nikla
lut gayi umme laila ki dunya
bain karne ko laashe jawan par
haye akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh ke qaime mein akbar ka laasha
sar jhuka kar bahot roye maula
jab kaha bibi fizza ne ro kar
haye akbar ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain waiz ye qaime mein goonja
dekh le apne yusuf ka laasha
khaak udaati hui peet'ti sar
haye akbar ki maa...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Hum azadaar hai
items.body:
labbaik ya hussain labbaik ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hum azadar hai hum azadar hai
shaah e mazloom ke hum azadar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ki hamare liye aap zahra dua
hum hai sab se alag hum hai sab se juda
haathon mein apne hai alam e shaah e wafa
darsgaah hai hamari to bas karbala
jisne kalmaye quran hum ko diya
us nabi ke nawase ke ghamkhwar hai
hum azadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khuda ki khudayi ke hai raazdan
bane pajetan ke sadqe dono jahan
he nabi ki zaban hi khuda ki zaban
taabe inke amar ke hai kon o makan
dastaras mein inhi ke hai loh o qalam
ba-khuda ye hi jannat ke sardar hai
hum azadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao haq e mawadat ada hum kare
ali asghar ka akbar ka matam kare
mil ke qasim ka abbas ka gham kare
yaad mein apni aankhon ko purnam kare
saani e zehra ke thay jo paale huwe
sar kiye jin ke naizon pe akhwaar hai
hum azadar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah jaane wo kaise musalman thay
kalma go thay magar na pasheman thay
qatl unko kiya hai jo mehman thay
ban gaye jaan kar bhi jo anjaan thay
rona khursheed hai sirf is baat ka
laaye aale nabi ko wo bazaar hai
hum azadar hai...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Hussain zulmaton may
items.body:
hussain zulmaton mein gohar e tabinda hai
ke jiske hone se insaniyat painda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sawaar e dosh e risalat ke sar ne naiza par
quran suna ke dikhaya shaheed zinda hai
hussain zulmaton mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
na pahuncha pani na laasha bhi jaaye qaimon mein
kaneez zaada teri beti sai sharminda hai
hussain zulmaton mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitaare maand hai matam fizayain karti hai
ghame hussain mein maghmoom har parinda hai
hussain zulmaton mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
udaas rauza nabi rota hai dil sughra ka
shaheed teri shabi hogayi ke zinda hai
hussain zulmaton mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sar barehna nazar aayi ghazi ko zainab
to sar ne gir ke bataya shaheed zinda hai
hussain zulmaton mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
na tars bachon pe na paas kalma waalon ka
sipaah e shimr mein najfi har ek darinda hai
hussain zulmaton mein...
items.author: Afzal Hussain Najfi

items.title: Karbala se shaam
items.body:
baad e ashoor jo kiya hum pe sitam
karbala se kufa o shaam be makna o chadar
rassiyon mein hai jakde le gaye shaam
haye shaam haye shaam
karbala se shaam karbala se shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
jiya jab talak wo bekas imam
yehi thi fughan labon par mudaam
nahi bhoolunga kabhi raahe shaam
layeeno ka tha jahan azdo haam
khule sar jahan haram thay tamaam
haye shaam...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankhon se rawan ashk thay
haram shaah ke sabhi sar khule
zuban par meri fughan thi yehi
chali karb par mere ye churi
layeen le rahe thay zainab ka naam
haye shaam...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera ghar luta mera dar luta
huwe qatl sab padar bhi mera
mere tifl bhi rahe tashnalab
hua qaid bhi sabhi be-sabab
chini chadarein jale sab qayaam
haye shaam...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jafa par jafa nahi inteha
magar ki nahi kabhi bad'dua
imamat ka ye kathin tha safar
chali betiyan ali ki jidhar
chale saath mein sitamgar tamaam
haye shaam...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
karun kya bayan mai wo sakhtiyan
sar e raah thi sabhi bibiyan
isi dard se phata hai jigar
ali ke haram rahe nauhagar
sitam ke nahi kahin ikhtetaam
haye shaam...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi tak mujhe wo sab yaad hai
dayaar e sitam haram jab gaye
saron par wahan barasne lage
kahin sang aur kahin kehkahe
bhulaya gaya nahi wo maqaam
haye shaam...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nauha nahi ye hai marsiya
hassan kis tarha bayan ho bhala
qalam bhi mera tadapne laga
hui zapt ki yahan inteha
chala kanton par wo mera imam
haye shaam...
karbala se shaam...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Khanjar tale ali ka
items.body:
khanjar talay ali ka laal
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ka ek sagheer tha
sookhe galay par teer tha
baysheer tashna reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal dulha jab hua
armaan khaak mein mila
maqtalmen naushah reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza ran mein chid gaya
farkhe jari bhi shaq hua
abbas pyasa reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi jo akbar ko lagi
laila ke dil ko ched di
zakhmi kaleja reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo naujawani ka safar
barchi ka phal lakhte jigar
dil mein andhera reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde mein sar hai pesh e rab
shukre khuda mein khole lab
khanjar bhi chalta reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
iqbal wo zehra ka gham
sabir ke dil pe hai raqam
har baar naama reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
items.author: Iqbal Abedi

items.title: Maqtal may khoon se
items.body:
maqtal may khoon se laal hai bano ka nownehaal
maqtal may khoon se…
<<DIVIDER>>
abroo wohi hussain ke palke hussain ki
tewar wohi hussain ke ankhein hussain ki
aaena-e-jamaal hai bano ka nownehaal
maqtal may khoon se…
<<DIVIDER>>
sukhe labon ke gird wo chehre ki aab o taab
himmat nahi kisi may koi badke de jawab
shabbir ka sawaal hai bano ka nownehaal
maqtal may khoon se…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re wo teri tabassum bhari nigaah
ek aan may safay hi palat di khuda gawah
haybat may ek jalaal hai bano ka nownehaal
maqtal may khoon se…
<<DIVIDER>>
tera lahoo zameen par girne nahi diya
behte lahoo ko shaah ne chehre pe mal liya
yaqta dame khitaal hai bano ka nownehaal
maqtal may khoon se…
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ki samt jaye to kis tarha se hussain
palte hai saath baar dar e qaima se hussain
haaton pe nownehaal hai bano ka nownehaal
maqtal may khoon se…
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hai shore girya jo ek qaimagah se
sab ban ka ban larazta hai bano ki aah se
ek teer se nidhaal hai bano ka nownehaal
maqtal may khoon se…
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Nadan ali asghar
items.body:
nadan ali asghar mere
tanhai mein hona na pareshan ali asghar
nadan ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole ko jo chode ho to aa tujhko sawaroo
shish maah mujahid tere sadqe bhi utharoo
dil apna sambhalegi teri maa ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hal min ki sada sunte hi ay nasir e shabbir
kehte huwe labbaik giray farsh pe baysheer
ho roohe ali aayat e quran ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
takte hai teri raah ali aur payambar
islam bachana hai tumhe khoon mein naha kar
hona hai tujhe deen pe qurban ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil jayega ammu tera abbas wahin par
qasim bhi milega wahin mil jayega akbar
hone nahi denge tujhe naala ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
do baara zibha kar diye jaoge meri jaan
faryad na karna pisar e shaah e shaheedan
baba hai tere faqre sulaiman ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras ke tere bhaiya ki wo zarbat
baatil ke liye maut bana taaba qayamat
azaan e ali akbare zeeshan ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko na mila doodh na ek boondh bhi pani
royegi teri yaad mein darya ki rawani
jaa tumpe hai qurban teri maa ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha padhe jab tere nazeer gham mein tadap kar
matam kare har ahle aza ashk baha kar
hai aashiq e na-cheez ke armaan ali asghar
nadan ali asghar...
items.author: Aashiq Irani / Nazeer Irani

items.title: Ab sakina may dam
items.body:
ab sakina mein dam kahan amma
ab to khulwao reesma amma
<<DIVIDER>>
kam ye zindan nahi hai turbat se
maut behtar hai aisi dehshat se
dam ghuta ja raha hai wehshat se
shamma bhi to nahi hai kismat se
kaisa tareek hai makan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan zakhmi kiye liye lo lo
aur phir is pa hukm hai ke na ro
ye ghazab bhi ajeeb hai dekho
mai jo roti hoo apne baba ko
shimr deta hai ghurkiyan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
log dete hai kya yuhin pursa
dono ruqsaar mere dekhiyega
dega kitni yateem ko eeza
pooche shimr se bara e khuda
kitne khaun mai seliyan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
kisme haalat hai maar khane ki
koi surat karo bachane ki
kya mai khaabil hoo taziyane ki
shimr ki phir khabar hai aane ki
ruk rahi hai meri zuban amma
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar hai shaki ke dil mein kad
maarta hai jo dam ba dam murtad
ho chuki ho chuki sitam ki had
mere marne ke baad hi shayad
shimr kholega reesma amma
<<DIVIDER>>
wa hussaina ka haye wo naala
haye sone mujhe nahi deta
qaid khane ke paas hi hai goya
suboh tak naam leke baba ka
aake roti hai dadi jaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
chaahne waale hi na ho jiske
qaid khane mein kyun na wo roye
wo juda humse hum juda unse
karbala me hai karbala waale
kya kare reh ke hum yahan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
baba le jane aagaye lijiye
mujhko ab khibla roo litadije
itni takleef aur bhi kijiye
padne yaseen unse kehdije
ghash se uthe jo bhai jaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
li jo bachi ne maut ki hichki
ya ali kehke ghash huwi maa bhi
aake sab jamma hogaye qaidi
kehke nadaan ye mar gayi hilmi
ab to khulwao reesma amma
items.author: Hilmi Afandi

items.title: Abbas sakina ko
items.body:
saahil ki taraf dekh ke kehti thi ye zainab
abbas kahan ho mere abbas kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki ye faryaad hai daaman may chupalo
abbas sakina ko tamachon se bacha lo
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai sakina ke ajab haal hai haye
kooze liye baithi rahi ammu nahi aaye
baba bhi nahi kaun yahan humko bachaye
ek baar isay daste bureeda may utha lo
abbas sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena isay baba ka mayassar nahi kab se
zindan ki zameen par ye agar soye to kaise
abid ki ye zanjeer pe sar rakhe huwe hai
le jao isay godh may bachi ko sula lo
abbas sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan may zara chain nahi paati hai bachi
dukh hadh se guzarta hai to chillaati hai bachi
jab shimr hai badta to laraz jaati hai bachi
imdaad karo bhai yateema ki dua lo
abbas sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar par mere chadar nahi kuch aas nahi hai
maloom hai zinda mera abbas nahi hai
kehti hai sakina ke mujhe pyaas nahi hai
mai kis se madad maangu sakina ko sambhalo
abbas sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
beemar madad is ki koi kar nahi sakta
dar jaati hai ye jab hai koi isko jhidakta
kasno se lahoo is ke abhi tak hai tapakta
kehti hai chacha jaan mujhe paas bula lo
abbas sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
chillaati hai zindan may kidhar jaaye sakina
aisa na ho tanhaai may darr jaaye sakina
baba se judaai may na mar jaaye sakina
saahil se utho qaid se ab isko chuda lo
abbas sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan may zainab ki qamar hai yehi faryad
zinda na sakina rahi itni hui be-daad
tadfeen ho kaise ke hai zanjeer may sajjad
mayyat ko sakina ki koi bad ke utha lo
abbas sakina ko...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Akbar ki jawani ko
items.body:
akbar ki jawani ko qaza maang rahi hai
zehra ke charaghon ko hawa maang rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
faryaad hai faryaad hai ya saaqi e kausar
pyason ka lahoo taygh e jafa maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko mere barchiyon waalon se bachale
laila ye musalle pe dua maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki khaatir jinhe maanga tha ali ne
un haathon ko ab karbobala maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed ki nawasi pe ajab waqt pada hai
bazaar mein ek ek se rida maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye asr ka hangaam hai utho ali akbar
peeri shahe waala ki asa maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
suraj se kaho raat ke parde mein chala jaaye
ummat sar e zainab se rida maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ali asghar ko kaleje mein chupalo
ye chand bhi ghurbat ki ghata maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes se ghar laut ke aajao baradar
bemaar tumhari ye shifa maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal dashte musibat mein jo mohtaje kafan tha
aaj us se kafan khalq e khuda maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagta hai bilal aaj bhi shabbir ki beti
zindan se rehaai ki dua maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Arbaeen karne aayi
items.body:
arbaeen karne aayi hai zainab
zakhm par zakhm khaayi hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko bhai ke dafn karne ko
qabre sarwar pe aayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi guzri hai shaam o kufe mein
khoone dil se sunayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
seh ke har mod par sitam pe sitam
deene ahmed bachayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre abbas ibne haider par
ashk behad bahayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi dekhlo meri haalat
be-rida hoke aayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chut gayi qaid mein sakina bhi
qabr uski banayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya na dekhoge reesma ke nashan
jo ke baazu pe laayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre ghazi laraz gayi us dam
jab kaha utho aayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise roodad e gham bober likhe
jo bhi aafat uthayi hai zainab
arbaeen karne aayi hai...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Ay maa bata
items.body:
ek roz maa se poocha tha ye shadman ne
guzre isi aza mein hai sadiyon ke rath jage
jee khol kar hussain ko hum ro nahi sake
bachpan ka wo sawaal mujhe abhi yaad hai
daaman ko aansuon se bhigote hai kis tarah
ay maa bata hussain ko rote hai kis tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
tune aza ke farsh pe mujhko bitha diya
pani jo maanga maine to pani pila diya
aagosh mein aza ka saleekha bata diya
godi mein tune loriyan dekar sula diya
zindan ki zameen pe sote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan se humko tune hi zouqe aza diya
taboot ko saja diya farshe aza bicha
aankhon ko apni parcham e ghazi se mas kiya
aagosh mein utha ke dikhadi hai karbala
shaida aza e shaah ke hote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaye mein baap ke hai guzarti meri hayaat
hoti hai poore khwahishe ta hadde mumkenaat
sunte to hai hum shaam ke zindan ke waqiyat
hum jaante nahi hai sakina ke mushkilaat
kehte jinhe yateem wo hote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq pe lutayi saari kameini hussain ne
qurban haq pe kar diya bhai hussain ne
deene khuda ki jaan bachayi hussain ne
kadiyal jawan ki laash uthayi hussain ne
saare ghamon ko dil mein samote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein kab tha fatema zehra ke dil ko chain
tha inteha-e-sabr pe zehra ka noore ain
laashe pe har shaheed ke roke rahe thay bain
asghar ki qabr khod ke rone lage hussain
ashkon se khoon ke aankh bhigote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kurta jala huwa hai ye bachi ka haal hai
kaano se khoon behta hai daaman sawaal hai
chehre ka saara rang tamachon se laal hai
khamosh aansuon se sakina nidhaal hai
noke mija pe ashq pirote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zikre ghame hussain mein izzat naseeb ho
haq baat sab se kehne ki jurrat naseeb ho
daaman ko apne ashq e nadamath naseeb ho
hurr ki tarha hame bhi shahadat naseeb ho
isyan ke daag aaj bhi dhote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ilm o amal mein peshe nazar ho raza e rab
rauza namaz har ke faraiz ada ho sab
haq e imam ada ho ada ho namaze shab
maa aakhri jihad ko taiyar karde ab
nasir imam-e-asr ke hote hai kis tarha
ay maa bata hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao qamar bataun ke rone ka haq hai kya
jaari tha jaise ashke sakina ka silsila
jaise imam-e-asr ki aankhein hai karbala
rote hai aise jis tarha roti hai fatema
maa ne kaha hussain ko rote hai is tarha
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Baghdad ki zameen pe
items.body:
baghdad ki zameen pe matam taqi ka hai
zahra jigar figaar hai wo gham taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj aagayi qaza ko bhi maula hassan ki yaad
tukde jigar hua wohi aalam taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek muhib hai chaak gareban basad buka
matam kuna ba-deeda e purnam taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaayi naqi ke sar pa yateemi ki ek ghata
hai aaj sogwaar jo humdam taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi dil e batool tha ummat ke zulm se
us par mazeed dard ye paiham taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekiyan ghamon ki zamane pa cha gayi
dunya siyah posh hai matam taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hoti hai ashk baar ujalon ki anjuman
uth'ta jo aaj noor e mujasim taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
misle raza ghareeb e watan thay bine raza
jab zehr e mohtasin se ruka dam taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sad paash dil pa khaare masayib ki hai chuban
rota hai khoon jahan mein jo mehram taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula hussain hoke azadaar aaye hai
shiyon ye gham na hashr se kuch kam taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bughze ali ke zehr ka koi nahi ilaaaj
barsa jo ashke gham wohi marham taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
az farsh taaba arsh bapa majlisein hai aaj
ahle wila mein dard muqaddam taqi ka hai
baghdad ki zameen pe...
items.author: Wila Hallauri

items.title: Behen sina pe
items.body:
lahoo lahoo hai wafa zakhm zakhm hai waada
behen sina pe mera sar teher na payega
<<DIVIDER>>
mere kate huwe shaane thay teri sar ki rida
behen sina pe mera sar teher na payega
<<DIVIDER>>
koi aseer hai naaqe pe koi paidal hai
sina ki nok pe karbobala ka maqtal hai
ab imtehan mera aur kitna lega khuda
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool zaade bhala yun aseer hote hai
huroof e aaya e tatheer khoon rote hai
hai baal khole huwe bibiyan rasan basta
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina pe hai mere tashna dahan imam ka sar
kahan batool ka jaaya kahan ghulam ka sar
barabar aaqa ke apne mai chal nahi sakta
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
rula rahi hai lahoo mujhko khud meri ghairat
dikhaun apni sakina ko kis tarha surat
na mere haath salamat rahe na mashkeeza
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai rakh na paaya behan teri hasraton ka bharam
zaeef maa ne mujhe di thi apne sar ki qasam
hai meri aankh mein ummul baneen ka chehra
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaya mai nehr pe kis shaan se alam le kar
nazar mein jafar e tayyar ka hasham le kar
badal diya magar ek do pahar ne sab naksha
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
diya sitam ne ye kaisa khiraaj kufe mein
wo ek rida ki sawali hai aaj kufe mein
mili hai saare zamane ko jis ke ghar se rida
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
samajh sakega yahan kaun mere matam ko
mai kya bataun bhala zaid ibne arqam ko
yehi hai marsiya mera yehi mera nauha
behen sina pe mera...
<<DIVIDER>>
karenge hashr talak bain aamir o nayyar
na pa sakegne kabhi chain aamir o nayyar
bhula na payega dil us bureeda sar ki sada
behen sina pe mera...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Dil bande janabe
items.body:
dil bande janabe zahra is desh mein gar aa jaata
ghar ghar mein amaan mil jaati har dil mein jagah paa jaata
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaron mein yun zaninab ko sar nange na laaya jaata
mehmil mein bithaya jaata parde mein utara jaata
dil bande janabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan dil-e-laila ke yun khaak mein kyun mil jaate
athara baras wale ko parvan chadaya jaata
dil bande janabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir agar asghar ko is nagri mein laaye hote
quran ki lori dekar jhoole mein sulaaya jaata
dil bande janabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
is pyase hi shesh maahe ko hum teer na lagne dete
seene se lagaye rakhte har tarha bachaya jaata
dil bande janabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani bhi faraham hota aur doodh bhi haazir karte
begaane sitam se asghar yun pyasa na mara jata
dil bande janabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dulha jo banaya jaata is gaon mein apna qasim
kubra ke liye ek hujra phoolon se sajaya jaata
dil bande janabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch aur hi aalam hota abbas yahan gar hotay
darya pe na toka jaata pani se na roka jaata
dil bande janabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mirza yehi dil mein apne reh reh ke khayal aata hai
is mulk mein tum par maula yun zulm na toda jaata
dil bande janabe...
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Fatema zehra ka
items.body:
fatema zehra ka ya rab khoob hai gulzaar bhi
gul hi gul hai aur nazar aata nahi ek khaar bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
paanch harf islam may hai paanch harf emaan may
panjetan islam hai emaan ka minaar bhi
fatema zehra…
<<DIVIDER>>
waqte aakhir roke ye sheh se kaha abbas ne
ran may hoo chahta hoo aaqa aap ka dedaar bhi
fatema zehra…
<<DIVIDER>>
sayyede sajjad ke sar par qayamat aagayi
sar barehna hai haram aur shaam ka bazaar bhi
fatema zehra…

items.title: Hum azadare hussain
items.body:
hum azadar e hussain ibne ali
hum tafardar e hussain ibne ali
hum wafadar e hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hum dua e fatema ka hai samar
aur aadaab e aza se ba khabar
jaante hai hum ko sab jinn o bashar
hai hamari sar-parast binte ali
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne jis ke kata bhai ka sar
zibha pyase ho gaye noor e nazar
aur luta jangal mein jis ka ghar
bhai ke laash pe jo ro na saki
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum se poocho lazzat e saum o salaat
hum se poocho khadar e khhums o zakaat
hum se poocho kyun ruka hukme jihad
hum tawalla aur tabarra ke dhani
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hamari khadr ye zeb o zain
ashk hamari marhame zakhme hussain
ye aza fatema ke dil ka chain
hum se raazi hai khuda uska nabi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haasil e khilqat hamara hai aza
ye buka ye wa hussaina ki sada
hai hamari rooh ki girya ghiza
khoon baha to jism hote hai khavi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum se pooch gham hai kya kya hai khushi
hai jo dil mein ulfate aale nabi
gham hai unka gham khushi unki khushi
bas yehi hai apna tarz e zindagi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dilon mein hamare karbobala
hum na is se aur na ye hum se juda
kaise hal min ki bhala bhoole sada
goonjti hai al-atash har ghadi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mehekte seenon pe zakhmon ke baagh
aur dil mein gham ke jalte hai charaagh
hum hai wo jin ko nahi gham se firaaq
bas faheem haan yehi hai bandagi
hum azadar e hussain...
items.author: Faheem

items.title: Hussaina hussaina
items.body:
hussain bazm e jahan ko jaga ke soye hai
chiragh e quwwate baatil bujha ke soye hai
sitam ke qasr ko thokar se dha ke soye hai
udoo ke taygh talay muskurake soye hai
hussaina hussaina haye hussain hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
noha tha ye zainab e dilgeer ka
koi nahi sar pe raha aasra
waqt tha ye ahle haram pe kada
ghar bhara ujda chin gayi rida
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
dulha ka ran mein hua tukde badan
dekh ke roya kiye shaahe zaman
ho gaya pamaal sheh ka gulbadan
tukde badan tha kaun utha'ta
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamad jo gire khaak par
raahe haq mein ho gaye qurban pisar
pahunchi jo qaime mein ye gham ki khabar
maa ne kiya tha shukr khuda ka
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe akbar ke jab barchi lagi
sakht thi boodhe pidar pe ye ghadi
kaandhe pe leke laashe jawan laal ki
thokare khaata qaime mein pahuncha
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm kha cheh maah ka bacha hai ye
bano ka bhi sab ka dulaara hai ye
pyaas se gehware mein tadpa hai ye
pani mila na paas tha darya
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr pe abbas ke shaane kate
baith gaye shaah kamar thaam ke
zainab o kulsum ne naale kiye
ghazi ka laasha dekh ke roya
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl huwe kund churi se hussain
maadar e shabbir ye karti thi bain
kaise mile pyasi sakina ko chain
ahle haram ka tha yehi nauha
hussaina hussaina...
<<DIVIDER>>
as-salaam ya hussain as-salaam
roze pe ek roz ho uska qayaam
dije najaf ko raza ay imam
ay mere maula ay mere aaqa
hussaina hussaina...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Jafar ki shahadat
items.body:
jafar ki shahadat jo madine mein hui hai
phir aale mohamed pe qayamat ki ghadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde kiya turbat mein mohamed ka kaleja
jafar ko diya zehr jo mansoor e shaqi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bistar pa tadapte rahe shabbar ki tarha se
ek aag hai jo zehr ki shiddat se lagi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sam seene mein jafar ke jo pahuncha hai khudara
dil tukde hai andar se koi chalti churi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ilm ka khazzaan utha aaj jahan se
tafseer jo masoom ne quran ki ki hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jafar ke janaze pa hai yun moosiye kazim
ammama nahi sar pa yateemi ki ghadi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiq ki shahadat pa hai shiyyon ka ajab haal
sar peet'te hai koyi kahin seena zani hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sarfe aza aap ki aulaad ke gham mein
ye matami sangat jo rasoole arabi hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr baade nabi aale nabi kaise guzaare
ummat hai nabi ki jo kabhi chayn na di hai
jafar ki shahadat jo...
items.author: Hur Hyderabadi

items.title: Kabhi kabhi mai
items.body:
kabhi kabhi mai ye sochta hoo
ye sochta hoo kabhi kabhi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
adam ko jisne wujood baksha
wujood ko phir numood baksha
numood ko taazgi ata ki
ata ki hadh hashr se mila di
har ek zarre ko zindagi di
shaoor ko jisne aagahi di
hai jiska har shay pa naam hai kandah
wo kaun hai jiska mai hoo banda
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aasman ye barasta saawan
ye lehlehata mehakta gulshan
ye sabza-o-gul ka narm bistar
ye kehkashan ki haseen chadar
ye chand suraj chamakte taare
haseen khudrat ke ye nazare
damakte hai kis ki chaah mein ye
mehakte hai kis ki raah mein ye
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo noor jisme hai noor uska
wo fehm jisme shaoor uska
wo aankh jisse wo dekhta hai
zaban jisse wo bolta hai
jo jalwa e noor e kirbiya hai
tamam aalam ka aasra hai
zameen pe rehmat ka aasman hai
falak pe kiska wo mehman hai
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen hai na ye aasman hai
ajeeb aalam ajab samaan hai
niha nahi hai na wo ayan hai
hai koi maujood par kahan hai
udhar yakeen hai idhar guman hai
bas ek parda sa darmiyan hai
nikal rahe hai ye kiske baazu
simat rahi hai had e mano tu
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
mohamade mustufa se pehle
qadam kisi ke yahan na pahunche
yahan se bhi kuch zara sa aage
jahan pe jalwe hai la makaan ke
jo nubd ko saaz de raha hai
nabi ko awaaz de raha hai
ye kaun hai kya hai naam iska
yahan bhala hai kya hai kaam iska
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan meinane khuda-o-banda
wujood mumkin nahi kisi ka
jahan ke mehman ka saath dene
nabi ke haaton mein haath dene
jo noor paykar mein dhal raha hai
ye haath jiska nikal raha hai
khuda numaan hai ke ye khuda hai
khuda nahi hai to aur kya hai
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
khudaya mujko muaf karde
nigaah mein haq ka noor bhar de
ye parda e darmiyan utha de
haqeeqat e murtaza dikha de
habeeb ka waasta hai tujhko
elaahi itna batade mujhko
jo tujhse mansoob tera dar hai
tera hi hai ya ali ka ghar hai
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
makaan hai ye tu la-makaan hai
kisay pata teri hadh kahan hai
koi nahi aur jis-se poochun
na tujse poochun to kis se poochun
ghata ki soorat mein log ghir ke
ye daare kaaba ke gird phirke
ye kisko sajde guzarte hai
ye kisko aakhir pukarte hai
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ajab hai banda khuda numaan sa
khuda nahi hai khuda hai lagta
hai milta jhulta kalaam iska
khuda hi jaisa hai naam iska
har ek jaa is ka noor bhi hai
jala chuka kohe toor bhi hai
hawa jo kaabe se aa rahi hai
ali ali gunguna rahi hai
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sharaf ye jo bhi mujhe mila hai
ye uski qidmat ka hi sila hai
jabeen e mehboob ka sitara
khuda ne ghar mein mere utaara
sadaqaton ka usool ban kar
wo aayi ghar mein butool ban kar
jo paara e qalb e mustafa hai
jo markaze noor e innama hai
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo deen e haq par nikhaar hai ye
usi ke dam ki bahaar hai ye
ye do jahan jis ke waaste hai
wo gul isi shaakh par khile hai
hassan se sar sabz do jahan hai
hussain surkhi e gulsitan hai
inhi se hai haq ki raah roshan
hai kalma e la-ilaah roshan
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka chehra ali ke baazu
ali ki aankhein ali ke gaysu
ali ka jism aur ali ki khusboo
ali ke rag rag mein hai rawaan tu
har ek karwat har ek pehlu
nahi koi farq sare moo
har ek ada mein teri hi khubahoo
