hai tu ali ya ali mein hai tu
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
wujood mein jab wo dhal raha tha
mai saath karwat badal raha tha
falak se jab wo zameen pe aaya
mai aaya saath uske banke saaya
wo arsh pe jabke mehmaan tha
wahan pe mai shakle mezbaan tha
kahin pe chora na saath uska
hai kabse haaton mein haath uska
kabhi kabhi mai....
<<DIVIDER>>
nida ye aayi na behko itna
zaban kholo hai ilm jitna
wo bistare noor jispe sokar
wo haath jispe baland hokar
zameen se mai aasman hua hoo
baraye wehm o gumaan hua hoo
wo asl hai aur usool hoo mai
shareeke noore rasool hoo mai
kabhi kabhi mai....
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke munkir habal ke bande
kadooratein dil mein zehn gandhe
munaafiqat ki naqaab daale
hasad ke tan pe sajaye bhaale
safon mein islam ki sama kar
wujood se zayada khad badha kar
jo kalma e haq mitaane nikle
hussain sar ko katane nikle
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain apna jo sar na dete
rahe khuda mein jo ghar na dete
sulagte sehra mein gar labe joo
na dete abbas apna baazu
jo sar se zainab rida na deti
jo nakshe baatil mita na deti
to jaanta kaun deen kya hai
daras fathe mubeen kya hai
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo fatema ke jigar ka paara
wo khoon mein apne dooba taara
wo bhooka pyasa nidhaal tanha
bashariyat ka kamaal tanha
luta ke raahe wafa mein ghar ko
kata ke raahe khuda mein sar ko
baqa ke doshay gara ke utha
utha to noke sina pe utha
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
usoole deen ka kamaal ban kar
yazeediyat ka zawaal ban kar
madeene se aake karbala mein
utar ke sehra e nainawa mein
jo deene haq baqa ki khaatir
rahe khuda mein khuda ki khaatir
hussain ne kul kameini de di
khuda ne saari khudaai de di
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo maadane noor ka sitara
wo haq ki jaanib khula ishara
pukarta hia jise tadap kar
hai naam jis ka ye us ke lab par
wohi hai manzil uloohiyat ki
wohi to had hai qubooliyat ki
wohi hai sajdagahe do aalam
hussain ka sar jahan pe hai kham
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
bashar ka sar fakhr se utha hai
tamaam aalam ka sar jhuka hai
bas ek awaaz aa rahi hai
tamaam aalam pe cha rahi hai
qubool teri har ek dua le
hussain sajde se sar utha le
le ummate mustafa ko baksha
tamam ahle wila ko baksha
kabhi kabhi mai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mehrame raaze kunfaka aa
ay bazme wehdat ke raazdan aa
zameen par haq ke aasman aa
ay mutmeinin nafse do jahan aa
tamam raahe saji hui hai
falak ki baahein khuli hui hai
ay marsade do jahan pe cha ja
tu noor hai noor mein sama ja
kabhi kabhi mai…

items.title: Karbala se shaam
items.body:
karbala basa kar apna ghar luta kar
godh ke sabhi pale rayt mein chupa kar
karbala se shaam ja rahe hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe quran suna rahe hai hussain
karbala se shaam ja rahe hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jang e karbala ko maine fatha kar liya
faatahe damishq hogi binte sayyeda
ye qadam qadam bata rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibyon ke sar khule koi na dekh le
har nigaah meri samt hi jami rahe
sab ko maujiza dikha rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain thay sakina ke mai ro nahi saki
baba kitne din huwe mai so nahi saki
lori beti ko suna rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-rida haram hai chaar samt ahle shar
khoon ro raha hai saarban jhukaye sar
us ka hausla bada rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag aur patharon ki barishein hui
zakhmi sar behan ka hai lahoo lahoo jabeen
zakhm patharon se khaa rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab suna ye shireen ne to ro ke di sada
jaag utha naseeb mera ay mere khuda
aaj mere ghar pe aa rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bete bhanje bhatije ban mein so chuke
alqama pe sher jaisa bhai kho chuke
waada aakhri nibha rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafile se mutmain imam ho gaye
shaam pahunche khatm saare kaam ho gaye
nana se duayein paa rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
<<DIVIDER>>
maante hai matami bhi aur farhan bhi
daastan e gham safar ki mazhar abidi
likh raha hoo mai likha rahe hai hussain
naize pe quran suna...
karbala se shaam...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Maa kehti thi asghar
items.body:
maa kehti thi asghar tujhe seene mein chupalun
barsaat hai teeron ki tujhe kaise bachalun
<<DIVIDER>>
garmi ke hai ayyaam kahin saaya nahi hai
is haal mein kaise mai tujhe ghar se nikalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya naara e hal min ki sada ne kiya bechain
tu jaata hai aanchal mai tere sar pe to daalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghosh ko veeran meri kar ke na jao
roothe ho tumhe loriyan de de ke manalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ke liye tum to meri jaan thay beta
tehro zara abbas ko darya se bulalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ahle jafa hai inhe insan na samajhna
kis tarha se mai apne kaleje ko sambhalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein gaya jo bhi palat kar nahi aaya
ek baar tujhe aur mai jhoola to jhulalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kangi karun baalon mein tera kurta badaldun
mai dulha bana kar tujhe armaan nikalun
maa kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan ne nauha ali asghar ka likha hai
is nauhe ko farhan mai majlis mein sunalun
maa kehti thi...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Maqtal may ro ke
items.body:
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi zehra mere hussain
aa godh mein aaja mere hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas mar gaya tera akbar nahi raha
godhi mein jisko paala tha asgahr nahi raha
sab mar chuke hai roti hai zehra mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde badan ke bikhre huwe dekhti rahi
qasim ke tukde tu ne chune dekhti rahi
ro kar uthaya tu ne jo laasha mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne apni nasl be-jaan kar diya
bhai pa apne bachon ko qurban kar diya
laasahon ke darmiyan kiya sajda mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ka tu ne kaise janaza utha liya
tooti kamar thi phir bhi wo laasha utha liya
manzar wo kaise laila ne dekha mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
lilaah na kar tu zibha ye mera hussain hai
ay shimr teen roz ka pyasa hussain hai
sar peet ke ye kehti hai zehra mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan ab katega tera gala maa ke saamne
sar hoga tera tan se juda maa ke saamne
royegi dil ko thaam ke zehra mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne gala kata diya islam ke liye
di jaan apni deen ke paigham ke liye
khaaliq ka naam kar diya ooncha mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat'ta tha sar hussain ka roti thi bebasi
ay hashmi hussain ki maa dekhti rahi
manzar ye kisi maa ne na dekha mere hussain
maqtal mein ro ke kehti thi...
items.author: Alamdar Hashmi

items.title: Aaj ghar se nahi
items.body:
kya ajab si sehar ye aayi hai
jis taraf dekhiye udaasi hai
baap jaata hai ghar se masjid ko
beti faryad karti jaati hai
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke zainab ye hyder se boli
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise samjhaye tumko ye dukhiya
kaifiyat ko meri samjho baba
khauf hai mere dil mein ajab sa
koi hum se tumhe cheen lega
hoga hum pe yateemi ka saaya
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maan lo aaj ye baat meri
pyare baba pareshan hai beti
aaj ka din laga mujhko aise
jaise darbar ko maa gayi thi
waasta hai tumhe sayyeda ka
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal se kufe mein hai khauf phaila
shakhs dekha gaya ek aisa
zehar mein doobi talwaar thaame
wo bhi masjid ki jaanib gaya tha
ilteja sun lo meri khudara
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaanti hoon mai ye baade zahra
ghar mein lagta nahi dil tumhara
aaj ke roz bas reh lo ghar mein
saani e fatema hoon mai baba
meri chadar ko kar lo musalla
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bataun tumhe dil ki haalat
toot jayegi hum par qayamat
jab se maa se juda hogaye hai
hai nahi gham ko sehne ki himmat
dekh sakte nahi hum janaza
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum to khud jaante ho na baba
bewafa hai ye saara hi kufa
ye to pursa bhi hum ko na denge
fitraton mein hai inki madina
jaane kyun khinch raha hai kaleja
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
raasta roka murghabiyon ne
haath jode hai khud betiyon ne
phir bhi masjid ki jaanib badhe wo
dekha azlaan sab kufiyon ne
bolti hi rahi binte zahra
aaj ghar se nahi jao baba
ro ke zainab ye...
items.author: Arslan Azmi

items.title: Abbas se kehna hai
items.body:
ay ishq e hussaini mujhe aejaz dikha de
tu meri aqeedat ka mujhe aisa sila de
ek baar mujhe khwaab mein ghazi se mila de
jo baat hai is dil mein wo sarkar se kehna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai abbas se kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai alamdar se kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai
ghazi alamdar e wafa ghazi alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai ke tum shaah e wafa ho
tum sheh ke alamdar sakina ke chacha ho
aur saare muhibbon ke liye dast e ata ho
abbas ghulami ki sanad aap se lena hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo shaan e alamdar wohi shaan e alam hai
dono hi hamare hai ye maalik ka karam hai
maula ye alam aap ka ham sab ka bharam hai
hum ko to alam ke hi sada saaye mein rehna hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum baab e hawaij ho waseela ho hamara
aata hai muraade liye chaukhat pe zamana
haa dar se tumhare koi khaali nahi jaata
allah se maanga hai magar tum ne dilana hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham koi bhi jab dil ko hamare hai satata
jab koi kada waqt kabhi hum pe hai aata
abbas alam aap ka himmat hai badhata
dil toote to toota hua dil tum ko bulata hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sayeen mere sarkar mere murshid o maula
is baar moharam mein ho mera bhi bulawa
likhwado mera naam bhi zawwaro mein aaqa
ro ro ke tumhe nauha sakina ka sunana hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo jo bhi sitam baad e alamdar hua hai
sadaat ne pardes mein jo zulm saha hai
har mod pe zainab ne yehi ro ke kaha hai
is dil pe jo guzri hai kisi se nahi kehna hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas se kehna hai ke ghar aao na maula
tum apni ziyarat hamein karwao na maula
ek tohfa tumhara hai wo le jao na maula
pani se bhari mashk sakina tumhe dena hai
abbas se kehna hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas mere rab ka anmol waseela hai
mashoor zamane mein saqqa e sakina hai
har toote huwe dil ka abbas waseela hai
ye baab e hawaij hai har gham ka madawa hai
har lab ka wazeefa hai har dil mein dhadakta hai
girton ko uthaata hai doobo to bachata hai
taqdeer jagaata hai qismat ko sajaata hai
abbas se kehna hai abbas se kehna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ka sadqa do abbas se kehna hai
jholi ko meri bhar do abbas se kehna hai
mushkil meri hal kar do abbas se kehna hai
parcham ki hawa dedo abbas se kehna hai
rauze pe bula bhejo zawwari ata kar do
maula ye karam kar do
abbas se kehna hai mujhe abbas se kehna hai
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri

items.title: Akbar ki laash
items.body:
akbar ko maar daala ye jab ran mein shor utha
laashe pe aake rone lage shaahe karbala
dil mein sina thi aur badan tha kata hua
bete ka haal dekha to sambhla nahi gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki laash par gire kehte huwe hussain
kya haal mere chaand se bete ka hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne bhari jawani mein khaayi hai barchiyan
akbar ko maut aa gayi kaise sunegi maa
rakhti thi jisko ghar mein bhi laila naqaab mein
kiski nazar lagi mera ye laal mar gaya
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
milte nahi thay tum mujhe ay mere naujawan
mai is liye bhi aaya hoon ghutno ke bal yahan
rakh rakh ke haath laashon pe dhoonda tera badan
beta tumhara gham meri beenayi le gaya
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah kitne zakhm hai akbar ke jism par
talwarein sab ne maari hai ye bol bol kar
akbar ko maar do khud hi mar jayega hussain
bhoolunga kis tarha ye layeeno ka bolna
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole hussain dekh ke tooti hui sina
zaalim ne mere sabr ka lena tha imtehan
ye keh ke barchi todi hai ibne numair ne
niklegi jab ye barchi kaleja bhi aayega
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad kisi ne gurz bhi maara hai khaynch kar
sehra mai kaise baandhunga zakhmi hai tera sar
attharwein baras mein hi jaata hai chod kar
dulha tujhe banaaun ye armaan reh gaya
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaana hila hila ke ye bole shahe zaman
mayyat na apne bhai ki dekhe koi behen
sughra watan mein reh gayi acha hua magar
laasha tera sakina se kaise chupaunga
akbar ki laash par...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki zakhmi laash se lipte huwe wahin
zainab na saath deti to mar jaate shaahe deen
haye kisi bhi baap pe aaye na ab kabhi
maula pe jaisa waqt tha zeeshan aur raza
akbar ki laash par...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ali maulana
items.body:
ta surat e paywand e jahan bood ali bood
ta naqsh e zameen bood zamaan bood ali bood
shaahi ke wali bood o wasi bood ali bood
sultan e sakha o karam o jood ali bood
ham adam o ham shees o ham idris o ham ayub
ham yusuf o ham yunus o ham hood ali bood
ham musa o ham isa o ham khizr o ham ilyaas
ham saalih e paygambar o dawood ali bood
<<DIVIDER>>
taaron ne abhi aankh na kholi thi ali tha
na amn ka paigham na holi thi ali tha
daata tha duayein thi na jholi thi ali tha
khaaliq ki zaban kun bhi na boli thi ali tha
ali maulana ali ali maulana ali
<<DIVIDER>>
toote dilon ki sada ali maulana ali
taaj e wilayat tera ali maulana ali
haq ne kiya faisla khuld mein wo jayega
jo bhi mohib hai tera
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
angusht pe darwaza e khyber ko utaahle
jo doobte suraj ko ishaare se bulaale
toofano ka rukh phayr de mushkil se nikaale
jab chaahe jahan chaahe jise chaahe bachale
kulle emaan hai tu
rab ki pehchaan hai tu
deen ki jaan hai tu
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri jo fazeelat hai wo afsana nahi hai
munkir hai jise teri taraf aana nahi hai
juz zaat e mohamed koi pehchana nahi hai
dunya ne tujhe maana magar jaana nahi hai
ye tera jaah o hasham
saahib e tayg e do dam
hai tera sab pe karam
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu sab se badi khaliq e akbar ki nishani
na uska koi saani na tera koi saani
kehte hai ye quran ke tafseer o ma'ani
dunya ne abhi teri haqeeqat nahi jani
ayatullah bhi tu
wajhullah bhi tu
asadullah bhi tu
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum tere muqallid hai tu hi rehbar e azam
hai noor tera noor e khudawand e do aalam
ek bhai mohamed hai tera noor e mujassam
jhutlaye meri baat ko kis mein hai bhala dam
hai tu hi aala nasb
sher haq tera laqab
keh rahe hai yehi sab
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
doobte suraj ne kaha
chand sitaron ne kaha
laal qalandar ne kaha
tere liye hamd o sana
<<DIVIDER>>
na nooh thay na un ka safina tha ali tha
yasrab tha na makka na madina tha ali tha
abid na ibadat ka kareena tha ali tha
jis waqt pe marna tha na jeena tha na ali tha
<<DIVIDER>>
taskeen e dil o jaan to ibadat se milegi
tasdeeq ibadat ko mawadat se milegi
sajdon ko sanad teri wilayat se milegi
tauheed hamein teri mohabat se milegi
jo tujhe maane khuda
wo bhi munkir hai tera
ye aqeeda hai mera
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
padta hai teri shaan mein quran qaseede
alhamd se wal-naas talak hai tere charche
quran ki tilawat se khule raaz ye saare
wal-fajr bhi wal-shams bhi wal-layl bhi tu hai
aql mein aata nahi
qalb se jaata nahi
kya hai samajh aata nahi
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
juz tere kiya jis ne salooni ka ye daawa
jo poochna chahoge jawab uska milega
haathon ki hateli ki tarha se hai ye dunya
mai hota tere daur mein to pooch hi leta
kun faya kun ka safar
ye sitaron ka nagar
kya hai ye shams o qamar
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ne tere baad yateemo ko sataya
maula teri aulaad ko hai khoon rulaaya
ek pyase musafir ka lahoo ban mein bahaya
zainab ki rida loot ke qaimo ko jalaya
royi thi karbobala
aaiye sher e khuda
lut gayi aal e aba
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e ghariban ki rida dasht pe chaayi
ghazi ki behan ranj o masayib ki satayi
ek toota huwa naiza liye pehre pe aayi
haathon se jigar thaam ke deti thi duhaai
chin gayi meri rida
bhai bhi qatl huwa
aaiye karbabola
ali maulana ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai zamane se yehi mesum o mazhar
hum hyder e karraar ki dehleez ke naukar
rehti hai hama waqt sada ek labon par
is dar se bada saare zamane mein nahi dar
maalik e kauno makan
saat pardon mein niha
hai aqeedat ki azan
ali maulana ali...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Arbaeen mein
items.body:
maula bulalo karbobala arbaeen mein
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai sogwaar dua arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala arbaeen mein
<<DIVIDER>>
toote huwe dilon ki hai ye aas dekhle
ek baar hum bhi rauza e abbas dekhle
kar do sharaf ye humko ataa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasaan kijiye sabhi dushwaar raaste
kab se tadap rahe hai ziyarat ke waaste
dikhla do khuld ek dafa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaakar haram mein shukr ke sajde ada kare
maula har ek shaheed ki majlis bapa kare
hum bhi bichaye farshe aza arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula tumhe janab e sakina ka waasta
hum ko bhi dekhna hai wo jannat ka raasta
jaaye najaf se karbobala arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa baap se kiya hai ye waada dikhaunga
mai aap ko hussain ki dunya dikhaunga
karna hai mujhko waada wafa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt bas ye fikr hai mere khayal mein
lagta hai mar na jaaun kahin is malaal mein
mai ek dafa bhi jaa na saka arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
is baar kar do mere safar ka kuch intezam
har saal soch soch ke reh jaata hai ghulam
jaati hai saari khalq e khuda arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
is ghamzada ke qalb ki khwahish hai aakhri
jis waqt bhi ho aap ke rauze pe haazri
ho jaye meri rooh fanaa arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aamir o kumail ki maula se ilteja
hum bekason ka khalq mein tum hi ho aasra
kar lo qubool sab ki dua arbaeen mein
maula bulalo karbobala...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Ay maariya
items.body:
ay maariya ay nainawa ay dashte karbala
ye kya hua ay karbala ye kya hua ay karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar diya asghar diya hamshakle payambar diya
wo saani e jafar diya har ek naamwar diya
ummat ki khaatir shaah ne ek ek se bad kar diya
ay maariya ay nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed se haseen akbar sa wo maahe jabeen
wo haami e deen e mubeen raunaq e islam e deen
abbas sa kadiyal jawan abbas sa yawar diya
ay maariya ay nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naunehal e panjetan tha asghar e ghuncha dahan
cheh maah ka nazuk badan masoom aur tashan dahan
hum aasiyon ke waaste is ka bhi sheh ne sar diya
ay maariya ay nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
katwa diya hai bhai ko abbas se dildaar ko
shabbir se ghamkhwar ko lutwa diya ghar baar ko
deen e khuda ke waaste shabbir ne sar de diya
ay maariya ay nainawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer o sina khaaye hussain gardan ko katwaye hussain
khud khoon mein nahaye hussain ummat ko bakshwaye hussain
hum sab ki khaatir shaah ne har shay ko sadqe kar diya
ay maariya ay nainawa...

items.title: Azadaron ki manzil
items.body:
hamari shaan karbala hamari jaan karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
azadaron ki manzil karbala hai
lahoo mein inki shaamil karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein itni kashish bhar gaye hussain
jo ek baar jayega har baar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
farishte aasman waalon ki saff se
jabeen malne dar e shaahe najaf se
tajjalli paane noorani sharaf se
chale aate hai zaair har taraf se
har ek kashti ka saahil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha jannat ne jannat karbala ko
na bhaaye kis liye ahle aza ko
amal lagta hai ye acha khuda ko
mussalle par rakho khaake shifa ko
is aaine ke qaabil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein jaa ke ye kehte hai zaireen
jannat se uthke kaun samajhdaar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
hai charcha karbala ka aasman par
qaseeda hai rasoolon ki zaban par
wahan se kam nahi raunaq yahan par
na itrao falak waalon jina par
zameen waalon ko haasil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan is ka sharaf kaabe se kam hai
nigaahe kibriya mein mohtaram hai
isi ki chaaun mein roohe haram hai
hamay jaane se roke kis mein dam hai
ke ham sab ka mustaqbil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
khush hoke dil se us ko laga legi karbala
hurr ban ke jab bhi koi gunahgar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
musalmano khuda ka khauf khao
ziyarat is ki mat biddat batao
wafa kuch to mohamed se nibhao
chalo tum bhi hamare saath aao
nabi ke deen ka dil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
badan se jab nikal jaati hai roohein
kahan ki hai ye batlaati hai roohein
dar e shabbir pe aati hai roohein
ye khush ho ho ke chillati hai roohein
khuda waalon ki mehfil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaata hai kis ke saath bhala kaun qabr mein
khaake shifa ke saath azadaar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
wafa hum se nibhati hai lehad tak
hamara dil badhati hai lehed tak
sahara deti jaati hai lehed tak
hamare saath aati hai lehed tak
hamara radde mushkil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitaare aamir o akhtar falak par
fida hai iske zarron ki chamak par
bichate hai yahan apne malak par
hai iski roshni kaabe talak par
ab us manzil mein daakhil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Baghor sunle zamana
items.body:
baghor sun le zamana hussain aise thay
baqa fana ko banaya hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
churi ke neeche wo khaliq se pyar ki baatein
ajal ko ho gaya sakta hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
mukhalifat pe zamana tha us taraf lekin
wohi kiya jo kaha tha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
sipahe shaam shujaat ka loha maan gayi
dabe na laakhon se tanha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar ko baandh ke peeri may jalti reti se
uthaya bete ka laasha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ki laash uthayi banayi qabre sagheer
kahin bhi azm na badla hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
hazar shukr ke sajday shaheed karta hay
banaya qatre ko darya hussain aise thay
items.author: Shaheed Lakhnavi

items.title: Bekafan baap ki
items.body:
be kafan baap ki mayyat se guzara mujhko
kitna ummat ne mere baba sataya mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
aablo se mere pairon ke lahoo jaari hai
ek qadam rakhna zameen par bhi mera bhari hai
haye kaanto pe kuch is tarha chalaya mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad phir aap ke aada ne jalaye yun khayaam
jal ke qaime may hi mar jaata shariyat ka imam
jalte qaimon se phuphi jaan ne nikala mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne mere kaneezi may behen ko maanga
haye saadaat pe ummat ne hai sadqa phaynka
maar daalega mere baba ye sadma mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kabhi raah may qaidi ne jo paaya saaya
thak ke ek pal ke liye baithna chaaha baba
maar kar durra sitamgar ne uthaya mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bediyan payr may langar hai kamar may mere
zauf beemar ke tan may hai chale to kaise
tauq gardan may hai aada ne pinhaya mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti hai mujhe pani pilao bhaiya
mujhko zaalim ke tamachon se bachao bhaiya
hasrat o yaas se takti hai sakina mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
har kisi baap ki chaahat ye hua karti hai
apne bete se bas umeed yehi hoti hai
gar marunga to pisar dega ye kaandha mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekafan baap ke laashe se guzarta mai tha
aisa lagta tha ke dam mera nikal jayega
iss qadar aap ki ghurbat ka tha sadma mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye danish mere maula ki ghareebi ka samaa
laasha e shaah pe kehta tha ye beta rehan
dard ab aur bhi hai baba uthana mujhko
be kafan baap ki mayyat...
items.author: Danish Mirza

items.title: Dil chota mat karo
items.body:
dil chota mat karo wo bulayenge karbala
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
sun kar areeza ghazi ne paigham hai diya
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
fehrist mujhse maang rahe thay mere imam
likhwa diye hai maula ko tum sab ke maine naam
baaqi hai bas batool ki beti ka faisla
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ankhein tumhari sach hai ke pur aab hai bahot
wo khud bhi tumse milne ko betaab hai bahot
ek baar dekho dil se to de kar unhe sada
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaafil nahi kisi se bhi ibne abu turab
misle mujaab aayega har ek ka jawab
labbaik ya hussain ki dete raho sada
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo reh gaya watan mein usay kehna gham na kar
khud pursa lene aayenge shabbir tere ghar
bas shaah se ziyarat e ashoor maangna
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna tum us se jis ne wasail ka tha kaha
tera to rizq shaah ne kab ka badha diya
le aaye apne bachon ko is saal karbala
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
farzand e fatema ki badi bargaah hai
akbar ke baba jaan ki sab par nigaah hai
kab hai wahan pe farq ameer o ghareeb ka
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala jo laa na saka waledain ko
wo jaanta nahi abhi aaqa hussain ko
roze pe unke aaye bina mar gaye to kya
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo matami jawan hai akbar ke pursa daar
un sab ka khaas rehta hai maula ko intezar
maango jawano waasta de kar jawan ka
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
paison se kaun kehte hai jaate hai karbala
aata hai bas wo jisko bulaate hai karbala
jis jis ne bhi yaqeen hai is baat par rakha
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazdeek jab hussain ki turbat ke jaoge
niyyat karo sakina ki ghurbat sunaoge
sun'ne ko apni laadli beti ka marsiya
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bayan ho sughra ki haalat ajeeb thi
bemaar apne ammu se aakar lipat gayi
sughra se ye tasalli mein abbas ne kaha
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas is ki baat ka rakh lena tum bharam
tere bharose chalta hai sajjad ka qalam
is ne to de diya hai zamane ko aasra
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Fatema zehra ke
items.body:
ho tasavvur aur ghame shabbir ho
haath ho seene pe zehn pa baysheer ho
ashk e gham mein kabhi tankeed ki parwa na karo
sada e girya ho yaade shahe dilgeer ho
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ke bachon par bahao aansu
aah bhar ke ghame sarwar par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo san e iksat hijri aur bala ka manzar
chaar jaanib thay darinde aur wo tanha sarwar
yaad e mazloomi e sarwar par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeef kaandhe pe laash tha jawan ka logon
aur dile zainab e muztar ka tadapna logon
har nafas ghurbat e sarwar par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ka darr na karo tum ho azadar e hussain
tumko deti hai dua azadar e hussain
bhool kar khauf e waba sheh par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne maa behno se karta hoo guzarish is dam
berida hoke kabhi tum na manana ye gham
khastatan saani e zehra par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho moharram ko tasavvur mein faqad ho sarwar
na siyasat ho zara dil mein faqad ho sarwar
khuloos e dil se shaheedon par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha jo tu ne likha aazam jaza o ahsan
khatra jo aansu ke nikle hai bane wo marham
soch kar zakhmi shahe deen par bahao aansu
fatema zehra ke bachon par...
items.author: Azam Hussain

items.title: Haye ali akbar
items.body:
baap se maange ijazat ran ki jab kadiyal jawan
thaam kar dil shaah bole pehle do akbar azan
rodiye kauno makan jab kaha wo naujawan
allahu akbar allhu akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doobi ali akbar ki jab aayi sada
ladkhadate suye maqtal chal diye shaahe huda
haye ali akbar haye ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
pahonch kar dekha ali akbar ka sheh ne haale zaar
seene mein barchi gadi hai dard se hai be-qaraar
haye ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e akbar se barchi ko nikale jab hussain
sheh ke qaime se utha wa akbara ka shor o shain
haye ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gul hua pal bhar mein laila ki umeedon ka charaagh
rehgaya ek maa ke dil mein hasrat o armaan ka daagh
haye ali akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ki nazron mein hui tareek aashiq kayenaat
sar jhuka kar ro rahe hai hoor o hilma ek saath
haye ali akbar...
items.author: Aashiq Irani

items.title: Jahan may fana ke
items.body:
baakhi raha hai kaun jahan mein fana ke baad
zinda magar hussain hai khatle jafa ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaqa hai wo hamara hum uske ghulam hai
khabza hai kayenaat pe jiska khuda ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai marqade hussain tamanna e aakhri
jannat bhi gar milay to na le karbala ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nusrat ko aa rahe hai malak chod kar falak
paaya sharaf hussain ne ye ambiya ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde ki aayaton ki ye tafseer dekhlo
balon se moo chupaye haram hai rida ke baad
baakhi raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karke baland haaton pe asghar ko bolay shaah
baakhi nahi hai ab koi is mehlakha ke baad
baakhi raha hai...

items.title: Karbala tayyar hai
items.body:
masjid bhi ro rahi hai kaaba bhi ro raha hai
hyder ka qatl kya hai aaghaaz e karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala tayyar hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai karbala tayyar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sogh mein doobi fiza hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai karbala tayyar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye jab masjid se ghar mein zakhmi ho kar murtaza
baap ko tar khoon mein dekha ro ke zainab ne kaha
ab mujhe aisa laga hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi sakte mein fizza kyun ye kya jaane koi
paaon mein baithi thi beti aur sarhane koi
keh ke ghazi chup khada hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme haani aur khadija ro ke ye kehne lagi
is qadar hai zakhm gehra khoon mein tar hai jabeen
haan ye manzar keh raha hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
fajr se yun rote rote bol uthi shaam e aza
rozadaron khaak udao hai ye ayyaam e e aza
dil sabhi ka sochta hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaynk kar chadar saron se betiyan hai mehwe gham
shaahe deen nauha kuna hai baith kar zer e alam
binte zehra berida hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehla gham zehra ka jaana doosra hyder ka gham
khud saf e matam bicha kar bol uthe shaah e umam
farshe gham ki ibteda hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kahan taab e sukhan hai bas labon par jaan hai
safdar o mazhar ye nauha dard ka quran hai
ek mukammal marsiya hai karbala tayyar hai
khoone hyder keh raha hai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Khat e sughra
items.body:
asghar ko jaga de koi
akbar ko bata de koi
bemaar behan ne khat mein
sab haal e zaar likha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko duaein di hai
asghar ko pyar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein
sab haal e zaar likha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ne na poocho khat mein
kya kya tehreer kiya hai
poocha hai har ek bhai ko
zikre hamsheer kiya hai
kyun bhol gaye dukhiya ko
sab rishtedaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya ne khoob behan ki
ulfat ka karz chukaya
pardes mein jaa kar apna
waada bhi yaad na aaya
lene ko na aaye akbar
shikwa har baar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis din se aap gaye hai
udti hai khaak watan mein
kab jaane bahaar aayegi
umeed ke is gulshan mein
baba hai akele ghar mein
jeena dushwaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
furqat mein jhula kar asghar
khaali tera gehwara
yaadon mein teri sughra ka
kat jaata hai din saara
nanhe se musafir tujh par
sadqe sau bar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
itni si dabe lafzon mein
sughra ne jasarat ki hai
ammu se gila furqat ka
baba se shikayat ki hai
kyun bhool gaye gurbat mein
sab zimmedar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aun o mohamed mujhko
tanhaai mein yaad aate hai
do chand se chehre
meri nazron mein samaa jaate hai
kab hoga na jaane unka
mujhko dedaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun door watan se jaa kar
saare ehbaab base hai
aankhon mein mere bhaiya ki
shadi ke khwaab saje hai
karti hoo khayalon mein mai
sehra tayyar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
padte hai shahe deen jab khat
har laash tadap jaati hai
qasim ko hijab aata hai
akbar ko haya aati hai
kya koi nahi hai baba
mera ghamkhwar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baap ne aamir o akhtar
mushkil se jigar ko thaama
akbar ki laash pe rakha
ye keh ke behan ka naama
khud uth ke maseeha padh le
haal e bemaar likha hai
bemaar behan ne khat mein...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: La denge tumhe
items.body:
mere ammu abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jab pyaas badi pani na mila
to ro ke sakina ne di sada
ay mere chacha mai tum pe fida
asghar hai mera kab se pyasa
tum pyason ki saqqayi karo
darya se hame pani la do
sar choom ke phir shehzadi ka
abbas e jari ne farmaya
<<DIVIDER>>
la denge tumhe pani ye bacchon ko batado
hum nehr pe jaate hai ay shehzadi dua do
<<DIVIDER>>
hum baithe hai do zaanu tum aage badho bibi
khud haathon se mashkeeza kaandhe pe rakho bibi
ay pyasi sakina hume saqqa to bana do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaaun jo maidan mein teele pe chali aana
khud dekhna aankhon se saahil pe mera jaana
tum roz hi kehti thi ke siffeen suna do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah kare jaldi ye khatm udaasi ho
abbas ke hote bhi seh roz se pyasi ho
mere bandhe haaton ko azaad kara do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
izhaar na ho paya is quwwate baazu ka
majboor e ita'at hai dil phat'ta hai ammu ka
lillaah ab na kehna meri pyaas bujha do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khidmat mein bhatiji ki kaam aaye mere baazu
bil-farz jo darya par kat jaaye mere baazu
tadpogi nahi bibi yaqeen mujhko dila do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ruqsat e aakhir hai baba ko tujhe saumpa
ab teeron ki baarish mein jaata hai tera saqqa
ek shor hai faujon mei kamar sheh ki jhuka do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pur khoon mein takallum jab wo mashk o alam dekhe
abbas ke bete ne ro kar kaha bibi se
baba ki tarha se hame mashkeeza to laa do
hum nehr pe jaate hai...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Mehman e lucknow
items.body:
ay hussain e karbala ay mehmaan e lucknow
tere qadmon ki badaulat ab hai shaan e lucknow
<<DIVIDER>>
dard se maula bhar aaya hai tere shayar ka dil
de ijazat to zuban ho tarjuman e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
thays lag jayegi tere qalb e zakhmi ko shahab
warna kar deta wazahat se bayan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere gham ke mah siwa ye gham bhi hai is qaum ko
kya thay aur kya reh gaye hai haadiyan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal ki wo shaahi azakhaano mein teri majlisein
jin mein ab tak kuch nazar aati hai shaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ali ke laadle daaman na chodenge tera
jis tarha se chaahe kar le imtehan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas chale gar chaahne waalon ka tere ay hussain
tere rauze ko utha laaye miyaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
do mahine aat din tak tere maatam mein hussain
arsh se jaa jaa ke takrayi fughan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuld mein shaam o sehar ki majlison ke waaste
fatema ne chun liye do khushbayan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dabeer e do-jahan hai ek anees e kayenaat
ek rooh e lucknow hai ek jaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj hai matam ka tere aakhri din ay shahab
jaa rahi hai ye baharein gulsitan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha ruqsat kare ay zeenat e dosh e rasool
tujhse sharminda hai maula saakinaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere akbar ke tassaduq tere asghar ke nisaar
har jawan e lucknow har bezuban e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to kahiye aap ke bhai ki yan dargaah hai
warna kab tak mit gaya hota nishan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh to mud kar zara ye apni ruqsat ka sama
kis tarha ujda pada hai har makaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
alwida ay fatema zehra ke dilbar alwida
har taraf goonji hui hai ye fughan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate jaate mere maula ye bataate jaaiye
saal bhar tak kya karenge saakinaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum gareebon ki taraf se chand aansu kar qubool
aur de sakte hai kya hum muflisaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
daagh e matam aur ye aansu pesh kar dena shaheed
aakhri shabbir jab aaye miyaan e lucknow
ay hussain e karbala...
items.author: Shaheed Lakhnavi

items.title: Mil saka na jab
items.body:
mil saka na jab ali akbar ka laasha dayr tak
ghutniyo chalte rahe maqtal mein maula dayr tak
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kis tarha tamache shimr ne maare usay
siskiyan leti rahi pyasi sakina dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha e abbas ke tukdon ko rakh kar qabr mein
jaane kya kehte rahe sajjad maula dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ka qasim yehi hai shaah ko kehna pada
maa kahan pehchaan paayi apna beta dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
do kate haathon ka tha zainab ko itna intezar
khaak par rakhe rahi laashe sakina dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kaha mukhtar ne ay shimr tu khud hi bata
kis liye tadpe zyada mere maula dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr bola kya bataun mera khanjar kund tha
is liye tadpe zyada tere maula dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
le gaya tha shimr to sar kaat kar shabbir ka
laash par roti rahi bete ki zahra dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha takallum mar ke bhi aun o muhamed ka jalaal
taygh ka qabza na shehzado ne choda dayr tak
mil saka na jab...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Nafraton ki dhool se
items.body:
nafraton ki dhool se chehra hata dekhega kaun
hum hai misle aaina humko bhala dekhega kaun
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se aaj tak aale rasool e paak par
jo pasay parda nahi hai karbala dekhega kaun
nafraton ki dhool se…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbate to dekhte hai sab gulon se haar ke
wo jo inke darmiyan hai faasla dekhega kaun
nafraton ki dhool se…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na qasim hai na akbar hai na abbas e jari
dukhtare shere khuda ka hausla dekhega kaun
nafraton ki dhool se…
<<DIVIDER>>
chal basi bali sakina ay alamdare hussain
ab dare zindan pe tera raasta dekhega kaun
nafraton ki dhool se…

items.title: Paon mein chaale
items.body:
kehte thay ye abid e muztar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
dushman hai raste ka manzar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni aziyat kitni bechaini hai kahe kis se
padti hai har gaam pa thokar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein hatkadiyan hai aur tauq hai gardan mein
saath mein hai beparda bhara ghar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pair utha kar rakhte hai to hoti hai takleef
jalti reti aur baraabar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise rasta chalte hai sajjad zara socho
durron ki chotein hai badan par
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek badan hai do takleefein aur akele hum
dard kisi se dil ke andar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni pareshani hoti hai rasta chalne mein
charon taraf kaanton ki chadar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala se shaam ki raahein kitni mushkil hai
dhoop ki garmi tapte pathar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise kare sajjad ki kaifiyat ko raqam ishrat
peet pa durre jism hai laaghar
paon mein chaale hai paon mein chaale hai
kehte thay ye...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Aaj hai chaliswan
items.body:
shaam se jab ahlebait barsare uryan chale
yani suye karbobala chaak gareban chale
leke shaheedon ke sar besar o saaman chale
karte huwe ye bayan ba dile naalan chale
aaj chai chaliswan hazrate shabbir ka
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
raah mein unse koi poochta gar aan kar
kiske ho namoos tum kisko ho laqte jigar
kisne loota hai tumhe kisne kiya bepadar
kehte thay ahle haram ro ro ke ba chashme tar
tujhse bayan kya kare hum apne ehwaal ko
dafn karne hai chale fatema ke laal ko
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
wo haram e mohtaram shaah ke ba sad buka
manzilein tay karte haye pahunche thay jo karbala
door se jab qatlgaah inko dikhayi diya
ro ro ke kehne lage hazrate zainul liba
oonton se utro tum ab karte huwe shor o shain
ro ke chalo pyada paa yan se ba laashe hussain
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate sajjad se sun ke haram ye kalaam
peet'te rote huwe onton se utre tamaam
sar ko lage peetne waarison ke leke naam
aaye jo laashon ke paas haye wo nashaad kaam
chadarein sar se utaar aansu bahane lage
haathon se us ban ki khaak sar pe udhaane lage
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate zainul liba nauha ye jab pad chuke
bibiyon se is tarha ro ro ke kehne lage
pehle kaho kiski laash qabr mein abid rakhe
bewa e abbas yun boli mai sadqe tere
pehle mere waali ki laash ko uthwaiyo
deke kafan qabr mein phir usay dafnaiyo
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
al gharaz abbas ko jis ghadi madfoon kiya
matam e abbas tab jinn o malak mein hua
bewa e abbas tab royi wahan khoob sa
ro ro ke abid ne tab apni chachi se kaha
jinn o malak mein hui bas yehi guftaar hai
khaak mein madfoon hua sheh ka alamdar hai
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jo tha ibne hassan qasim e aali nasab
byaah ke din haye haye qatl hua tashnalab
shadi ka joda jo tha mil gaya matti se sab
uska hi chehlum hai aaj waye sitam hai ghazab
hazrate sajjad ne sar ko badan se mila
de ke kafan qabr mein laasha e qasim rakha
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi akbar ki maa ay mere kadiyal jawan
choot ke zindan se karne ko chaliswan
khasta jigar aayi hai sehti hui sakhtiyan
dekh to noore nazar kis tarha roti hai maa
fateha dilwaungi ashkon ki barsaat mein
zakhm hare ho gaye seena e sadaat mein
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon se bichde huwe zainab e lachaar ko
beet gaye kitne din muztar o ghamkhwar ko
ab jo rehaai mili haye dilafgaar ko
aun o mohamed ke phir seena o ruqsaar ko
pyar kiya aur ye kaha ay mere sheron suno
karna hai chaliswan bibiyon matam karo
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
<<DIVIDER>>
boli rubab e hazeen laasha e baysheer par
kyun na gire bijliyan maadar e dilgeer par
khoon hai abhi tak laga zulm ke us teer par
aaj wo din aagaya uff meri taqdeer par
karti hoo chaliswan nanhe se quran ka
sadqa mai dila saki haye teri jaan ka
syed e mazloom ka zehra ke masoom ka
aaj hai chaliswan
items.author: Mirza Dabeer

items.title: Ab tak hai zabano
items.body:
ay jaan o dil e hyder e karrar alamdar
zinda hai jahan mein tere aasar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk o alam ab bhi hai khoon baar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
lehre abhi leta hai fiza mein tera parcham
parcham se numeina hai wafa ka teri aalam
bhulegi na dunya tera esaar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya e mohabbat mein rawan hai teri kashti
bache teri takhleed mein bante hai bahishti
zaahir hai sakina se jo tha pyaar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pa raha yaad mohabbat ka kareena
wo pyaas mein do roz ki pani ka na peena
yaad aati hai ye manzil e dushwaar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya seena sipar mashke sakina ka raha tu
ek teer na aane diya jab tak rahe baazu
is shaan se chamki teri talwar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhse hi sakina ko tha pani ka sahara
kya jaane ye kis dard se tha usne pukara
ay lashkare shabbir ke jarrar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis shaan se baba ka alam tune uthaya
himmat ne tujhe zinda e javed banaya
raas aaya hai kya mansabe karrar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tevar pa fida tashna dahani pa tasadduq
millat ke jawan teri jawani pe tasadduq
sab teri mohabbat mein hai sarshaar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyon se hai kaandhe pa alam tera uthaye
haa ek nigahe lutf yadullah ke jaye
himmat hai dilon mein teri darkaar alamdar
ab tak hai zabano pe...
items.author: Najm Afandi

items.title: Akbar ki naujawani
items.body:
akbar ki naujawani asghar ki bezubani
ek gham ki daastan hai ek dard ki kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
pabandiya hazaro aayad kare zamana
roke na ruk sakegi askhon ki ye rawani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekaar koshishe hai matam ko rokne ki
matam sada rahega ye gham hai kya ledani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waaqeya hai jiska dooba hua lahoo may
dunya bhula sakegi kis tarha wo kahani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
le kar chale hai sarwar asghar ko ran ki jaanib
shayad pilaade koi do ghoont isko pani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam tod te hai akbar ran may tadap tadap kar
parwaan chad rahi islam ki jawani
akbar ki naujawani...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole hussain ya rab jaata hai ab wo marne
husn o shabab may jo ahmed ki hai nishani
akbar ki naujawani...

items.title: Arbaeenul Hussain
items.body:
arbaeen arbaeen arbaeen ul hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
labbaika yabna zahra labbaika ya hussain
arbaeen arbaeen arbaeen ul hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hum jis se zinda hai wo azadari hai
ye azadari to ek zimmedari hai
aur jo zawwaron ki ye khidmat gaari hai
mehdi ke lashkar ki ye bhi tayyari hai
chaahe ye ghar jale chaahe ye sar kate
roke rukega na ye khaafila
<<DIVIDER>>
arbaeen arbaeen arbaeen ul hussain
labbaika yabna zahra labbaika ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye suye karbala paidal jo chalna hai
sajjad o zainab ki ghurbat ka pursa hai
manzar ye baatil ki neendein udaata hai
labbaika ya hussain ka har soo naara hai
ye taziyat hussain teri nusrat hussain
hai ye payaam e aza o wila
<<DIVIDER>>
arbaeen arbaeen arbaeen ul hussain
labbaika yabna zahra labbaika ya hussain
items.author: Shahid Baltistani

items.title: Ay maarkae quwwate
items.body:
ay maarka e quwwate islam ke jauhar
cheh maah ki muddat mein qayamat ke barabar
nanhe se mujahid ali asghar ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
maqsad tha wiladat ka faqat kaar e shahadat
ye baat hui aur kisi ko na meinassar
yakta hai teri khoon mein doobi hui tasveer
tareekh dikhati nahi aisa koi manzar
nanhe se mujahid ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ke sab andaaz hai dada ke tareekhe
neend aa gayi reti pe na takiya hai na bistar
uljhe hua baalon pa fida shaam e shab e gham
doobi hui nafson pa sitaron ki nichawar
nanhe se mujahid ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhalki hui gardan pe yadullah ke bosay
sookhe hue honton pe tasadduq lab e kausar
chitwan mein chipaye hue akbar ki jawani
mutthi mein dabaye hue sajjad ke jauhar
nanhe se mujahid ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein chalakta hua masoom tabassum
gardan se tapakta hua khoon e dil e maadar
tareekh mein hai sab tere bachpan ka saleeka
tu maut ki aagosh mein aaya tha humak kar
nanhe se mujahid ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt hui mohar tere zakhm e gulu ki
poora hua shabbir ke eesaar ka daftar
aaram se so ay shab e ashoor ke jaage
lori tujhe deta hai tere najm e sukhanwar
nanhe se mujahid ali asghar...
items.author: Najm Afandi

items.title: Azae ehle haram
items.body:
aza e ahle haram ke din hai
ye zikre daure sitam ke din hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara girya hamara matam
suna raha hai hussain ka gham
laraz raha hai tamaam aalam
jahan may shaahe umam ke din hai
aza e ahle haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
tabaah zehra ka ghar hua hai
galay pe sheh ke khanjar chala hai
supurde jaan ka ye silsila hai
haram pa dard o alam ke din hai
aza e ahle haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ka laasha aba may aaya
kisi ne seene pa zakhm khaaya
koi zamane pe muskuraya
hussain bekas pe gham ke din hai
aza e ahle haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
dukh apna zainab kise sunaye
batao darbar kaise jaaye
behen ko abbas yaad aaye
faza e mashk o alam ke din hai
aza e ahle haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
safar se zainab palat ke aayi
salam leeje hussain bhai
watan ko jaati hai maa ki jaayi
qadam qadam chashme nam ke din hai
aza e ahle haram…
<<DIVIDER>>
na kam ho shahid hussain ka gham
sada bahe yuhin ashke payham
na jaane kal ho bhi ya na ho hum
ye momino pe karam ke din hai
aza e ahle haram…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Bahot akela hoo
items.body:
hussain kehte hai bhaiya bahot akela hoo
na jao chod ke tanha bahot akela hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
sukoon ho meri dhaaras ho mera shaana ho
tumhi to jism ho mera tumhi to saaya ho
ujad gayi meri dunya bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb haal may bhaiya ye saara ban dekha
kahin pe haath kahin sar kahin badan dekha
bahot bada hai ye sadma bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhara bhai ho sadqe tumhare shaano par
ay bhai bhai kaho ek baar to uth kar
utho utho mere bhaiya bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bhi saath nahi hai jo thaam le aa kar
har ek laash pe jaata hoo ghutniyon chal kar
badan ke choor hai aaza bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
amama dekho mera aur payrahan dekho
hai khaak o khoon se aalood ye badan dekho
raha na koi sahara bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare saath may rehna hamari aadat hai
jawan bhai ka marna bhi ek qayamat hai
hai dasht khoon may dooba bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek simt udaasi hai beqaraari hai
hamari fauj ki tum pe hi zimmedaari hai
karo na hum ko akela bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaa ke qaime may zainab se kya kahoo bolo
bas ek baar hi qaime may mere saath chalo
karunga phir na ye shikwa bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shams tera muqaddar faraaz tak pahunche
sada ye aap ki aamir hijaaz tak pahunche
hussain padte hai nauha bahot akela hoo
hussain kehte hai bhaiya...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Bekafan hai laashae
items.body:
bekafan hai laasha e sibte payambar khaak par
ro rahi hai fatema baithi khule sar khaak par
bekafan hai laashae...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay imame waqt sab kuch jaante thay shaahe deen
aediyan ragdrega ek din ran may akbar khaak par
bekafan hai laashae...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra e qasim may din ko maa ne boonda tha abhi
dekho murjhaye pade hai wo gulay tar khaak par
bekafan hai laashae...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki godhi se juda hokar batao meri jaan
kis tarha se neend aayi tumko asghar khaak par
bekafan hai laashae...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali mushkil kusha imdad ka ye waqt hai
aa rahe hai dekhiye ghoday se sarwar khaak par
bekafan hai laashae...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra samaytegi unhe rumaal may
gir rahe hai aankh se najmi jo gowhar khaak par
bekafan hai laashae...
items.author: Najmi

items.title: Chalo karbala
items.body:
chalo rone walaon chalo pursa daaron
hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ke soghwaron chalo karbala chale
pyason ke soghwaron chalo karbala chale
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein jis jagah pe kata baazu e jari
roye jahan pe teer se ek mashk thi chidi
hone ko ashkbaar chalo karbala chale
sarwar ke soghwaron...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhe jahan ghareeb ka kunba hua tabaah
goonji thi jis jagah pe kisi tashnalab ki aah
rone ko beshumaar chalo karbala chale
sarwar ke soghwaron...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ke waaste koi jhoola bhi le chalo
haathon se apne see ke shaluka bhi le chalo
ghamkhwar sheerkhwar chalo karbala chale
sarwar ke soghwaron...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-dast ba-wafa ki ghareebi pe royenge
chaukhat haram ki ashkon se ro ro ke dhoyenge
royenge jaan zaar chalo karbala chale
sarwar ke soghwaron...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal saja hua hai shahadat ke waaste
jazba bara e nusrat e sarwar liye huwe
matloob e kaarzaar chalo karbala chale
sarwar ke soghwaron...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaye wahan jahan pe chida halq e bezuban
roya tha jis jagah pe lahoo aa ke aasman
asghar ke soghwaron chalo karbala chale
sarwar ke soghwaron...
<<DIVIDER>>
daayim muaaf shaah karenge hai ye yaqeen
ek ek se keh rahe hai yehi nasir e hazeen
mehboob e kirdigaar chalo karbala chale
sarwar ke soghwaron...
items.author: Dayim

items.title: Dil ka kaaba
items.body:
makke mein kaaba meri jabeen ka
hai dil ka kaaba karbala mein
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aab e zam zam ke peene walon
koi hai pyasa karbala mein
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun hai baqqiya mein ye udaasi
rauza mohamed ka kyun hai khaali
bete ko rone baba ko lekar
aayi hai zehra karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ko maa'ein jhoola jhula kar
batla rahi hai lori suna kar
dasvi moharam ko jal gaya tha
nanha sa jhoola karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mai madine se karbala ki
jaanib chala to awaaz aayi
pani pilana kyun ke hai pyasa
mera nawasa karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad yahan ho shayad wahan ho
aaun kidhar mai baba kahan ho
poocho khuda se kitna chali hai
bali sakina karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa rahi hai wo dosti bhi
bachpan mein jisne humko milaya
ibne mazahir ko sheh ne likha
mai hoo akela karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek aayat ne siskiyan li
ek ek surat bharti thi aahein
jab barchiyon par kuch hafizon ne
quran uthaya karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
maara gaya ye kis ka mohamed
iska kaleja cheda gaya kyun
bolay musalman apne nabi ko
hum hi ne maara karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-hurmati kyun karte ho meri
aayat to padte tatheer ki tum
roya musalman ki ghairaton par
zainab ka parda karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ammar is gham ne khoon rulaya
jo mustafa ke kaandhon pe baitha
ummat ne uske laashe ko haye
ghodon se raundha karbala mein
makke mein kaaba...
hai dil ka kaaba...
items.author: Ammar Rizvi

items.title: Fatema zehra ki
items.body:
ay mere laal hussain ay mere laal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein ye thi fatema zehra ki sada
lut'ti hai meri ran mein kameini baba
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mera qasim hua ran mein pamaal
kya hoga bhala sochiye us maa ka haal
taqseem hua tukdon mein beta jiska
lut'ti hai meri ran...
maqtal mein ye thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aun o mohamed ke do laashe aaye
aansu dil e zainab ne nahi barsaye
laashon pe kiya shukr ka maa ne sajda
lut'ti hai meri ran...
maqtal mein ye thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab seena e akbar pe lagi thi barchi
tab qaime se zainab bhi nikal aayi thi
tooti thi kamar sheh ne uthaya laasha
lut'ti hai meri ran...
maqtal mein ye thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko chala pani pilaane jo hussain
bacche ka gala teeron ke aaya ma-bain
baba ki tassali ko wo baysheer hasa
lut'ti hai meri ran...
maqtal mein ye thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zarbon se shabbir ka sar kaata gaya
nazdeek se zainab ne ye manzar dekha
us waqt mera ran mein yehi tha nauha
lut'ti hai meri ran...
maqtal mein ye thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar lut gaya zehra ka sar e karbobala
mukhtar isi waaste matam hai bapa
hai aaj bhi majid ye buka e zehra
lut'ti hai meri ran...
maqtal mein ye thi...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Haye ali ali
items.body:
haye ali ali ali
haye ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl huwe shaahe zamaan
ran mein hai mehshar ka samaan
qaimon se uth'ta hai dhuaan
jaaye kahan aale nabi
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid e betaab o tawan
qaid huwe aake kahan
haathon mein hai hatkadiyan
paon mein bedi hai padi
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun ye be-jaan hua
be-sar o saaman hua
ghar hai ke veeran hua
ban hai ke shamshaan hua
kaun hai ye nauha kuna
goonjti hai kiski fughan
roti hai shayed koi maa
khasta jigar kokh jali
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
naazishe khatme ambiya
waarise fakhre ausiya
sayyede bazme auliya
haye kise qatl kiya
shamme imamat hui gul
bosagahe khatme rusul
khoon se hui kul
haye kahan taygh lagi
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaahe zaman paas nahi
pehre pe abbas nahi
bewon ko kuch aas nahi
zulm ko ehsaas nahi
ban mein hai dehshat ki fiza
chalti hai tham tham ke hawa
maut ki chaayi hai ghata
neend na aayegi kabhi
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
uff ye yateemi ye sitam
haye ye sayli ye waram
dil mein liye baap ka gham
ban mein kahan rakhe qadam
laashe hai ta-hadde nazar
kis se kahe jaane pidar
chin gayi kaano se gohar
kurte mein bhi aag lagi
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
waaris e mazloom utho
maadar e masoom utho
bekas o maghmoom utho
zainab o kulsoom utho
binte shahe jinn o bashar
dhoondne ko baap ka sar
chod ke ujda hua ghar
tanha suye dasht chali
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim o akbar bhi nahi
aun bhi jafar bhi nahi
saath baradar bhi nahi
parde ko chadar bhi nahi
kya kare mazloom behen
ban gayi haathon mein rasan
baap to tha khalla shikan
beti hai lachaar khadi
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
seh ke sitagar ke ghazab
bacche mere soyenge jab
lootne ko aise mein ab
aata hai ye kaun arab
kis khadar aazaar sahun
gham mein giraftar rahun
apni fughan kis se kahun
aaoge kab baba ali
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre hai laashe ran mein
nikli hoon tanha ban mein
jaan hai mushkil tan mein
phir bhi nahi uljhan mein
faatahe khyber utho
beti ki faryad suno
aao kuch imdad karo
dekho ye khyber shikani
haye ali ali ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
nayyar o aamir kyun kar
hum se bayan ho manzar
soche to phat jaye jigar
us shabe gham ka manzar
kis tarha wo waqt kata
dasht mein tha hashre aza
gham mein tha kohraam bapa
ek qayamat thi machi
haye ali ali ali...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Hum ek hai
items.body:
bolo na bolo na maula maula hussain
hussain hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
saare jahaan mein hai mazhab do hi
ek yazeedi ek hussaini
kaam nahi hame dunya se koi
hum ne to chunli raah tumhari
jo haq pe jeete marte hai
jo baatil se takrate hai
jo dil mein tujhe basate hai
hum unko gale lagate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi pukare naam tumhara
hum uske hai wo hamara
hum ek hai ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke parcham ke saaye mein
ek hai ya hussain
hum ek hai ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
maula tu zindabad rahega
saare jahan ne hai maana
kaam hi aisa tu ne kiya hai
har dil hai tera deewana
tere liye ab haath utha kar
bolega saara zamana
ho wo shia ya sunni
ban kar saare hussaini
mil ke lagayenge naara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum zinda qaum hai hum ne bataya
jab bhi muharram aaya
ek alam ke saaye mein aaye
aur ittehad dikhaya
yaade hussain mein pani pilaya
apna ho ya ho paraya
kaale libaas waale
hum hai abbas waale
hum ko hussain hai pyara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain jab tu ek hai to
teri qaum ho kaise juda juda
hai jo bhi tere chaahne waale
unhe salamat rakhe khuda
hum ek hai hum ek hai
dil ek dhadkan ek hai
har dil ki sada hai
ya hussain ya hussain
seeno pe likha hai
ya hussain ya hussain
tera naam hai pyara
millat ka hai naara
tu hai maula hamara ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke parcham ke saaye mein
ek hai ya hussain
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek khuda hai ek mohamed
ek kitaab hamari
ye teri mehnat ka sarmaya
ek hai ummat saari
ab saari qaumein karti hai mil kar
maula teri azadari
ghar ghar mein safe matam
ghar ghar pe tera aalam
ye bhi karam hai tumhara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi pukare naam tumhara
hum uske hai wo hamara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
halqa e matam mein jaa kar hi
dekhe hai hum ne nazare
na koi rang na mazhab millat
farq mita diye saare
karbobala se farshe aza se
milte hai hum ko ishare
har aane waale hurr ko
bas ye kehte hai hum to
dil se hai dil dil ko sahara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
taareekh mein likhi jayengi
safar e ishq ki baatein
har rango nasl ke log khade hai
sab ki alag hai zabanein
sab tujhse milne aate hai maula
teri taraf hai nigahein
chal kar dekh zamana
najaf se karbobala
ye keh raha hai har nazara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke parcham ke saaye mein
ek hai ya hussain
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zulm kahin par hota hai
khamosh kahan hum rehte hai
na darte hai na jhukte hai
hame log hussaini kehte hai
haq ki ladayi ho to hum ko
jaan nahi hai pyari
kisne kaha hum ek nahi hai
sun le ye dunya saari
chaahe jahan bhi rehte ho lekin
yek jaa hai qaum hamari
dunya mein baat jab bhi
hussainiat pe aayi
hum jeete hai yazeed haara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi pukare naam tumhara
hum uske hai wo hamara
hum ek hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishq kiya jaata hai kaise
saare jahan ko bataya
ashoor ki shab aap ne maula
jab wo charaagh bujhaya
jisne yahan se jaana hai jaaye
ansaar se farmaya
koi gaya na uth kar
kehne lage bahattar
saath na chodenge tumhara
hum ek hai ya hussain...

kaise uthaya laasha e akbar

items.title: Kadiyal jawan akbar
items.body:
kadiyal jawan akbar marne ko ja raha hai
khamosh hai khudaai sakte mein karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maa sher se pisar ko hasrat se tak rahi hai
chehre pe bekasi hai aankhon mein bebasi hai
akbar rahe salamat honton pa ye dua hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad kar rahi hai behne tadap tadap kar
ro ro ke keh rahi hai mat jao bhai akbar
behno ko bhi kisi ne kya ye bata diya hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peet'ta hai koi karta hai koi matam
hai aisa gham ke maare saydaniyo ka aalam
qaimon mein shaahe deen ke kohram mach gaya hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya ki simt dekha thokar jo ran mein khayi
kuch dayr ko to aaja abbas mere bhai
ye kehke mera maula maqtal mein gir gaya hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bano tadap ke boli armaan to badha loo
apne jawan pisar ko dulha to mai bana loo
aayega ab na wapas akbar mujhe pata hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh hogayi hai kuch bolti nahi ab
sehmi hui zameen par baithi hui hai zainab
shabbir ne na jaane zainab ko kya kaha hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke ban mein akbar hai aage aage
athara saal paala jisne galay laga ke
akbar ke peeche peeche wo baap jaa raha hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai bhatije yawar koi nahi hai gohar
allah re ye ghurbat ye bekasi ka manzar
dashte bala mein tanha mazloom e karbala hai
kadiyal jawan akbar...

items.title: Karbala tere abbas
items.body:
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham ko salami denge
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak chand sitaro mein chamak baaqi hai
jab talak arshe salamat pe chamak baaqi hai
jab talak phool ke daaman mein mehak baaqi hai
tere shabbir ke matam ki dhamak baaqi hai
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak seene mein dil dil mein hai dhadkan baaqi
jab talak apni yazeedo se hai anban baaqi
noore haq banke chamkte huwe panwan baaqi
ta qayamat rahe shabbir ka gulshan baaqi
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufr taadi ka ye sailaab rukega ek din
baarwa laal imamat ko uthega ek din
naam hinda ke ghar aane ka mitega ek din
zaalim mazloom ki chaukat pe jhukega ek din
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere abbas ke parcham ki qasam khaate hai
tashnalab shaahe do aalam ki qasam khaate hai
ta qayamat jo hai is gham ki qasam khaate hai
tere shabbir ke matam ki qasam khaate hai
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala tere jiyalon ki qasam khaate hai
seeno mein toot'te bhaalo ki qasam khaate hai
binte zehra tere naalo ki qasam khaate hai
khoone asghar ke ujaalo ki qasam khaate hai
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere sehra mein luta fathima zehra ka chaman
haye wo qasime nowshah ka pamaal badan
haye wo shimr ka khanjar wo aqi ki gardan
haye wo yaas ke mahol mein majboor behan
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer se hogayi jab mashke sakina jhalni
jhuk ke ghazi ne kaha shahe najaf adrikni
seena e akbare mehru me wo naize ki ani
khuld se aagaye zehra-e-rasoole madani
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrato yaas ke aalam mein hazeena bibi
is tasavvur hi se phatne laga seena bibi
baad e abbas bhi kya tha tera jeena bibi
zakhmi kaano jale kurte mein sakina bibi
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool sakta nahi irfan qayamat ka samaa
baade abbas zainab pe gira tohe giran
nagahan uthne laga shaah ke qaimo se dhuwa
arshe aazam ko hilaati huwi zainab ki fughaan
karbala karbala
tere abbas ke parcham...
items.author: Irfan

items.title: Khat mein ye sughra
items.body:
khat mein ye sughra ne likha kya hua
kyun nahi aate ho bhaiya kya hua
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali jhoole ko jhulati hai rabab
jhoolne waala wo baccha kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun pooche abid e bemaar se
do peher mein saara kunba kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme laila laasha e akbar ke paas
poochte hai maa ki mamta kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis liye chup ho mere kadiyal jawan
moo se kuch bolo to beta kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
poochti hai mayyat e qasim se maa
mere bacche tera sehra kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro padi zainab badan ko dekh kar
sher sa bhai hamara kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro pade sughra ka khat padh kar hussain
kya likhun beti yahan kya kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...
<<DIVIDER>>
berida aale payambar hai suroor
tujhko ay ehsaas e dunya kya hua
khat mein ye sughra...

items.title: Maa kehti thi qurban
items.body:
maa kehti thi qurban tumhare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar mere pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
tum pyaas bujhane ke liye ran may gaye ho
darti hoo koi teer na maare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tum na rahe paas to jeene ka maza kya
bolo mai jiyun kiske sahare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehwara hai khaali kaho ab kisko jhulaun
tum to huwe allah ko pyare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya meri tareek hai tum jab se gaye ho
aaja meri aankhon ke taare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai may jaan khoti hai ro ro ke sakina
kehti hai ke aajao hamare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi gaya maidan may wo wapas nahi aaya
maa laal kisay keh ke pukare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e jari bhool gaye pyaas khud apni
yaad aaye jo darya ke kanare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-aasra zahid ko na samjhe ye zamana
zahid ke hai masoom sahare ali asghar
maa kehti thi qurban...
items.author: Zahid

items.title: Mehman hai chand
items.body:
mehman hai chand roz ki zehra abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj o alam masayeb o furqat wo siskiyan
sab khatm hone waali hai zehra ki saqtiyan
lene ko aane waale hai baba abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
takleef mere rone se ummat ko thi badi
shikwa tha sab ko girya e zehra se ya ali
soyega ab sukoon se madina abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar par lagi thi aag har ek samt tha dhuan
deewar o dar ke fatema zehra thi darmiyan
meri madad ko koi na aaya abal hasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ho raha tha mujhpe musalsal sitam shadeed
pehlu shikasta hogaya mohsin huwe shaheed
maa bhi na keh saka mera baccha abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagti hai pyaas sakht mere dil ke chain ko
raaton mein uth ke pani pilaana hussain ko
hove na uspe pyaas ka ghalba abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
shehzadiyon se mere na hargiz ho be-khabar
meri judaai ka kabhi un par na ho asar
samjhe na khud ko wo kabhi tanha abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsin hai ghar mein maa ki jo mehsoos ho kami
taareekiyon mein shab ki khudara kabhi kabhi
bacchon ko meri qabr pe laana abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ilteja hai aap se ay sher e zuljalaal
ghusl o kafan ke saath ho is baat ka khayaal
shab mein hi uthay mera janaza abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
altaf ye wasiyatein zehra ka tha bayan
safdar jo sun ke rote thay moula e do jahan
bibi ne marte waqt pukaara abalhasan
hai aap ke hawaale ye kunba abalhasan
mehman hai chand roz ki...
items.author: Altaf Hussain

items.title: Nahi dekha
items.body:
aankhon se rawan ashk ka darya nahi dekha
har bache ne jalta hua qaima nahi dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
yun jeet li abbas ne darya pe ladaayi
pani pa kahin phir kabhi pehra nahi dekha
aankhon se rawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya noor ke paikar shab e ashoor jama thay
shamma to bujhi lekin andhera nahi dekha
aankhon se rawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam to jaaga ali akbar ki azan se
aur iski jawani ne savera nahi dekha
aankhon se rawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ke janaze pe qayamat ki ghadi thi
shabbir ko aisa kabhi rota nahi dekha
aankhon se rawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha tha kadi dhoop may bete ka janaza
laila ko kabhi saaye may baitha nahi dekha
aankhon se rawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun dekh ke roye na taqi apna bhara ghar
zehra ki tarha ghar koi ujda nahi dekha
aankhon se rawan...

items.title: Aaj hai khafile ki
items.body:
aaj hai khaafile ki khaafila salaar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan jaati hai lachaar behan
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne maare sakina to tamache bhaiya
sehm ke khauf se wo rone na paayi bhaiya
ghaiz se kaamp gayi aap ki lachaar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi ranj o bala se mai suye shaam gayi
baalon se moo ko chupayi thi na kuch dekh saki
is liye kar na saki bhai ka dedaar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye karta tha dandaan se wo be-adabi
aap ke sar se itra ke phiraata tha chadi
haath malti thi tadap kar teri lachaar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar badar zaalimon ne bhaiya phiraya hum ko
cheen ke sar se rida qaidi banaya hum ko
nange sar dekh chuki shaam ka bazaar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko kuffaar ki jaanib se nawazish ye hui
khoon baha leke khata baksh ki khwahish ye hui
kis tarha karti qabool aap ki ghamkhwar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya mai aap ko do gaz bhi kafan de na saki
chalte chalte bhi tumhe pursa behan de na saki
kis khadar dasht may majboor thi lachaar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
de ke abbas ko awaaz bula do bhaiya
aake tum mujhko amaari may bitha do bhaiya
tum se karti hai ye minnat teri ghamkhwar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
so chuke neend se utho mere bhaiya utho
apni sughra ke liye koi nishani de do
saath milne ke liye karti hai irqraar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may dooba hua baysheer ka kurta lekar
aur sakina ka wo toota hua bunda lekar
nana ke rauze pe chalne ko hai tayyar behan
utho bhaiya ke watan...

items.body:

chalees saal sayyade sajjad karke yaad

akbar ki pyaas ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye nazar jo mashk o alam tumko ek saath
karlena yaad dukhtare sarwar ki pyaas ko
akbar ki pyaas ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
auron ka zikr kya hai jigar thaam kar ghulam
khanjar se pooch shimr ke sarwar ki pyaas ko
akbar ki pyaas ko...

items.title: Arey o shaam walon
items.body:
hua jab qatl ahmed ka nawasa
layeeno ne har ek qaima jala diya
<<DIVIDER>>
haram ko lootne jab aaye aada
ye nauha pad rahi thi binte zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
arey o shaam walon meri chadar na cheeno
arey o kalmagoyo meri chadar na cheeno
<<DIVIDER>>
shabe hashr mehboob e khuda hai
musalaman jiska kalma pad raha hai
mera nana mohamed mustufa hai
meri chadar na cheeno
arey o shaam walon...

mera baba ali e murtaza hai

meri chadar na cheeno

agar suye najaf mud kar pukarun
mai ek awaaz mein unko bulalun
jo chahun khaak mein tumko miladun
meri chadar na cheeno
arey o shaam walon...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera bhai hai abbas e dilawar
bhatija sahib e ghairat hai akbar
na sar par aasman gir jaye phat kar
meri chadar na cheeno
arey o shaam walon...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bachpan mein ye ek din hua tha
achanak sar jo mera khul gaya tha
to suraj sharm o ghairat se chipa tha
meri chadar na cheeno
arey o shaam walon...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bhai ko maara chup rahi mai
mere ghar ko ujada chup rahi mai

meri chadar na cheeno
arey o shaam walon...
<<DIVIDER>>
agar mai bad'dua ko haath uthadun

har ek zaalim ko mitti mein miladun
meri chadar na cheeno
arey o shaam walon...
<<DIVIDER>>
suni faryad kab zainab ki anwar

ye kehti reh gayi sarwar ki khwahar
meri chadar na cheeno
arey o shaam walon...

shabbir jawan laashe pisar kaise uthaye

dilband e ali fatema zehra ke dulaare

<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>
