items.title: Azakhane hai jiski
items.body:
azakhane hai jiski shaan ye mera mulk mera emaan
mere maula ki khwahish ka naam hai hindustan
<<DIVIDER>>
chand muharram ka jab nikla gaon huwe saare aabaad
gali gali se shor utha ke nasle yazeedi murdabad
hindu'on ke lab par hai shabbir hamara zindabad
dunya ke har mulk se zayed hind mein hai hum sab azaad
isi se saari dunya se acha hai hindustan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
u.p m.p karnatak gujrat goa dehli aasaam
manipur bihar himachal hai laddakh baland maqam
in sab ki qismat ki jabeen par likha hai shabbir ka naam
subho azane akbar se hai shaam e gariban inki shaam
dashte bala ki yaad mein tapta hai wo rajasthan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
haryana punjab mizoram andhr tamil keral kashmir
daman diu telangana pandicherry gham ki tasveer
andaman chattisgarh aur uttrakhand gham ki tanveer
maharashtr ho ya ke odisa shaane aza ki hai jageer
sheh ki azadari ka in sab par hai bada ehsaan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid ke jo ehtaram ki ek hadh par ruk jaata hai
hindu wo lekin ye sach hai farshe aza par aata hai
qaumi yekjehti ka hunar ye farshe aza sikhlata hai
sikh esaayi apni muradein farshe aza se paata hai
farshe aza par aane se ghabrata hai shaitan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mulk hai mera sab se pyara mulk se hai hum sab ko pyar
iski khaatir jeena marna asl hussaini hai kirdaar
sheh ki azadari se hi ye mulk hua har soo zaubaar
iski azadi mein shaamil karbobala ka hai eesaar
aise watan se ulfat karna nisf hua emaan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
maana ke dunya ke har goshe mein raaij sheh ki aza
lekin apne mulk ki raaij sheh ki aza ka kya kehna
karbobala se door bani taskeen ki laakhon karbobala
kalmago kya hindu'on ke ghar mein aza ka farsh bicha
sheh ki azadari se hai ye bharat desh mahaan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
waadi waadi sehra sehra matam e sheh jangal jangal
darya darya saahil saahil khushki ho yaa ke jal thal
sadiyon se hai zikre shahe deen sa’at sa’at har ek pal
gulshan gulshan koh ka daaman sausan ho ya phool kawal
patta patta boota boota mausam e gham ki shaan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaland meghalay sikkim arunachal jharkhand tripura
asle namaze ishqe aza har ek ne ki hai in mein adaa
inke dil ke daaman mein pur noor hui hai karbobala
lakhsdeep aur chandigarh mein goonji hai matam ki sada
sheh ki azadari hi unki asl mein hai pehchaan
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hindu muslim sikh eesaai ke hai labon par shaah ka naam
qaumi yekjehti ka kya is behtar hoga paigham
ganga jamna ki hai sabeelein tashna labon ki yaad mein aam
uth'ta hai bangaal se badal liye huwe ashkon ka jaam
aamir aur nayaab ke jazbe bharat pe qurban
azakhane hai jiski shaan...
items.author: Nayab Balyavi

items.title: Bahot akeli hoo
items.body:
ye bain karti thi sughra bahot akeli hoon
safar mein hai mera kunba bahot akeli hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bhi paas nahi hai jo khairiyat pooche
ke dil ka haal hai kaisa bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dukh sa dukh hai watan haan aisi hai tanhaai
koi nazar nahi aata bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzaar deti hoon raaton ki raat aankhon mein
na koi neend na sapna bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi hasi koi aahat na koi kilkaari
hai be-sada mera hujra bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
buland hoti thi jis se rasool ki awaaz
na ab wo lab na wo lehja bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo intezar hai dhundhla rahi hai beenayi
bhula na doon koi chehra bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi nahi jo giroon mai to thaam le bad kar
kahan ho meri sakina bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo toot jaaye ye dam bistar e alaalat par
uthega kaise janaza bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamari sochon ke yasrab se nayyar o aamir
na mit sakega ye nauha bahot akeli hoon
ye bain karti thi...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Bekason ka khaafla
items.body:
bekason ka khaafla hai shaam ka bazaar hai
khwahar e abbas e ghazi khaafla salaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na rone ki sada aaye dar o dewaar se
berida saydaniya hai aur bhara darbar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha maange ghulamo se bhala abid rida
ye hai ghazi ka bhatija aur bada khuddaar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun hikharat se na dekho sayyed e sajjad ko
ye koi muflis nahi kaunain ka sardar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak sar pa taaziyano ke nishan hai pusht par
tauq hai zanjeer hai aur abid e bemaar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya elaahi kaise guzrega ye naazon ka pala
paaon may chaale pade hai raasta pur khaar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
taaziyane mat lagao mat satao zaalimo
ye bhaot zakhmi bahot pyasa bahot bemaar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chup hai abid ghamzada ghabra rahi hai bibiyan
ab bahot nazdeek shayad shaam ka darbar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh raha hai shaah ki aankhon se khoon behta hua
shaam ke bazaar ki manzil bahot dushwaar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo gharana lut gaya tha dasht may gohar kabhi
aaj wohi do jahan ka maalik o mukhtar hai
bekason ka khaafla hai...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Haye ali haye ali
items.body:
haye ali haye ali haye ali haye
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne jis ghadi suni purdard ye sada
aayi tadap ke dar ke khareeb ye deti hui nida
khaana e khaaliq may hui kaisi jafa haye
haye ali haye ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ko pukara wo aaye to ye kaha
masjid may jaake dekho to ye majara hai kya
kaisi ye awaaz hai jo arsh ko hilaye
haye ali haye ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain daude jaanib e masjid barehna pa
dekha to neem hogaya hai farte murtuza
baith ke pehlu may sukhan lab pe yehi laaye
haye ali haye ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
halqe khai gileem pe zakhmi pidar hua
leke hue rawana suye bayte fatima
aaye dare zehra pe waqt ke sataye
haye ali haye ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar may nabi ke jab hue dakhil hassan hussain
ehle haram ne halqa kiya aur kiye ye bain
zainab-o-kulsoom ke lab par ye sukhan tha
haye ali haye ali…
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt-e-madad hai ab dar khata iski kijiye
maula aneese gham ki khabar jald lijiye
daure masaib may wo ghut ghut ke na marjaye
haye ali haye ali…
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Jaisa apna hai nabi
items.body:
jaisa apna hai nabi koi payambar na mila
saff shikan dekh liye ek bhi hyder na mila
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema aisa koi noor ka mehwar na mila
aaj tak shabbar o shabbir ka hamsar na mila
panjetan paak se kaunain mein behtar na mila
jaisa apna hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat bhar tadpa kiya pyaas ke maare ki tarha
khamoshi lab pa thi darya ke kanare ki tarha
yaad e sheh dil mein thi behte hue dhaare ki tarha
dar e shabbir pa pahuncha hai sitaare ki tarha
hurr ke manind naseebe ka sikandar na mila
jaisa apna hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aam logon mein kahan nafse payambar ka jawab
khaak ke putle nahi noor ke paikar ka jawab
har sipahi kahan ban jaata hai lashkar ka jawab
kaise mil jayega as'haab mein hyder ka jawab
bazm e as'haab mein jab doosra buzar na mila
jaisa apna hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baaghe firdaus e iram chaahiye kausar ke liye
noor hi zeb hai kuch noor ke paikar ke liye
ek samandar ki zaroorat hai samandar ke liye
rab ne hyder ko chuna binte payambar ke liye
chashme khudrat ko bhi is ghar ke siwa ghar na mila
jaisa apna hai nabi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shab ke ta'binda sitaron se unhe kuch na mila
dil ke rangeen nazaron se unhe kuch na mila
is zamane ki baharon se unhe kuch na mila
behte darya ke kanaron se unhe kuch na mila
zindagi mein jinhe mahir gham e sarwar na mila
jaisa apna hai nabi...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Kafan auno mohd
items.body:
paraya des hai ghurbat hai maa ye seh na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed tumko zainab de na payegi
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan hone se pehle bekhata maara gaya tumko
thay pyase teen din se phir bhi na pani diya tumko
tumahre bin tumahri maa bhi zinda reh na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye suraj ki tapish jalti zameen zakhmi badan haye
nahi hai paas kuch maa ke tumhe kis tarha dafnaye
kafan ke bin magar tadfeen hargiz ho na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
huwe armaan mere khaak sab karbobala aa kar
jinhe paala tha naazon se unhi ko dasht mein kho kar
ye dukhiya gham zada aafat raseeda jaa na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamon ne ek din mein hi zaeefa kar diya mujhko
bhara ghar qatl kar daala mera mai ro'un kis kisko
kisi bhi laash pe jee bhar ke zainab ro na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari kamsini par bhi kisi ne rehm na khaaya
tumhe maara gaya phir jism pe ghodon ko daudaya
hai laashe tukdo mein dono ke maadar chun na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tadpungi har ek lamha kabhi na chain paungi
rahungi jab talak zinda faqat aansu bahaungi
tumhe royegi maa din raat hargiz so na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
saron se chadarein chinti hai saaman loote jaate hai
qayamat ho gayi ahle sitam qaime jalaate hai
behen abbas ki beparda reh kar jee na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghira hai sholon mein kis tarha abid ko nikalun mai
dilaasa raando ko doo ya yateemo ko sambhlun mai
badan zakhmi hai saara phir bhi zanab ruk na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
<<DIVIDER>>
qamar buknalvi zainab hui jis dam rasan basta
badi hasrat se aamir dono laashon ki taraf dekha
kaha phir laashon se maa jaati he ab keh na payegi
kafan aun o mohamed...
paraya des hai ghurbat...
items.author: Qamar Buknalvi

items.title: Karbala tu hi bata
items.body:
karbala tu hi bata
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhpe kyun zulm hua kya thi asghar ki khata
karbala tu hi bata
<<DIVIDER>>
mere pyason pe to khud pyaas bhi tharrayi hai
tashangi haddion mein itni utar aayi hai
beh raha hai darya karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankhon mein qayamat ka dhuan chaaya tha
saath barchi ke kaleja bhi nikal aaya tha
haye akbar mera karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi aage ko badhun aur kabhi peeche jaaun
kis tarha qaime mein asghar ko mai lekar jaaun
nahi uth'ta laasha karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawan laash zaeefi mein uthayi maine
aur baysheer ki turbat bhi banayi maine
waada sab poora kiya karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun thaamega hussain ibne ali ke baazu
nehr par kat gaye abbas e jari ke baazu
hogaya mai tanha karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghodon ki taapon se pamaal hua ibne hassan
laash ke tukdon se is tarha nazar aaya tha ran
jaise dil shabbar ka karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde tukde mera tan hogaya shamsheeron mein
haddiyan toot ke uljhi hai meri teeron mein
mai hoon zakhmon se bhara karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ummat ki mohabbat hai ye shabbir ke saath
qatl karti hai mujhe naara e takbeer ke saath
mai hoon mehwe sajda karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhaadne aayi hai maqtal ki zameen baalon se
rayt nam ki hai hateli ke bhare chaalon se
ro rahi hai zehra karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool payenge na ehsaas ke maqtal mujhko
royenge aamir o nayyar bhi musalsal mujhko
mai hoon aisa nauha karbala tu hi bata
mujhpe kyun zulm hua...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Laadli zahra
items.body:
apne baba ki laadli zahra
choor zakhmo se ho gayi zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
koi aaya nahi bhujhane ko
jalta dar dekhti rahi zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kis tarha maara zaalim ne
moo ke bal khaak par giri zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere rukh par nishan tamache ka
kaash zainab na dekhti zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala shaam saamara mashad
kitne hisson mein bat gayi zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag se jinke jal gaye daaman
ek sakina hai doosri zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai tasavvur mein ghurbate hyder
saans leti hai aakhri zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
moo ke bal gir pade ali sun kar
ab jahan mein nahi rahi zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh ke mayyat lahad mein bole ali
ab wo zahra nahi rahi zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay takallum hai jaane qabr kahan
itni bekas hai aaj bhi zahra
apne baba ki laadli...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Maa kehti thi ro
items.body:
maa kehti thi ro ro kar so jao mere beta
masoom mere asghar so jao mere beta
hai karbobala mehshar so jao mere beta
<<DIVIDER>>
nazron se layeeno ki mai tum ko bacha leti
mamta bhare aanchal ke saaye mein chupa leti
majboor hai ye maadar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise mein sabhi apne maujood sahare hai
hai paas ali akbar ammu bhi tumhare hai
hai waqt yehi behtar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bechain tera chehra kis kis se chupaungi
gar pooch liya sheh ne kya unko bataungi
socho to zara dilbar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaagoge agar aise ghabra ke mai ro doongi
sookhe tere honton ko ashkon se bhigo doongi
ay jaane dile maadar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sochti hoo beta tum par na sitam dhaaye
soye huwe bache par shayad ye taras khaaye
zaalim hai bahot lashkar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhein hai tere neeli surat hai teri pyari
uljhe huwe gaysun par maa sadqe ho maa waari
sashmaah mere asghar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko kal ran mein ek hashr bapa hoga
har simt se goonjega ek shor qayamat ka
neend aayegi phir kyun kar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maehsoos karo beta ek maa ki pareshani
kya doo mai tumhe ghar mein ek boond nahi pani
bas ashkon ke hai saagar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache bhi kabhi maa se hote hai khafa aise
kya rooth'ta hai koi apno se bhala aise
dukhiya pe taras kha kar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya baat hai kyun chup ho kuch moo se kaho beta
bechain tumhe itna pehle to nahi dekha
jo dil mein hai wo keh kar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kin uljhano mein ho tum ek shab ke mere mehman
ho jayegi kal ran mein mushkil teri har aasaan
jaaoge lab e kausar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal hai biyaban hai har simt andhera hai
jaana hai bahot aage aur door ujaala hai
samjhaun tumhe kyun kar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye arz o samaa kya hai rote hai falak taare
ghamgeen hai sabhi hoorein rote hai malak saare
ye bain raza sun kar so jao mere beta
maa kehti thi ro ro kar...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Maqtal suno sakina
items.body:
sar e hussain se ye keh rahi hai ek dukhiya
ay baba jaan mere maqtal suno sakina ka
<<DIVIDER>>
qasam tumhare baradar ki jhuk gayi hai kamar
mai maa ke paas bhi jaati hoon ghutniyo chal kar
sitam hi itne huwe chaar saala zehra par
mujhe bhi theek se baba nazar nahi aata
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai taziyano se zakhmi mera badan baba
galay ke zakhm mein paywast hai rasan baba
yehi libaas banega mera kafan baba
badal na payegi ghussala bhi mera kurta
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam uthaye hai kya kya tumhari beti ne
tamacha aap ko maara tha ek khooli ne
na jaane khaye hai kitne tamache bacchi ne
unhi tamachon se soojha hua hai ye chehra
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
galay mein mere rasan ban gayi hai ye khanjar
raghon se khoon tapakta hai mere kurte par
tum ek baar huwe qatl karbala mein magar
mai baar baar hui zibha ay mere baba
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab is andhere se kab aur darne waali hoon
mai kooch shaam ke zindan se karne waali hoon
mujhe pata hai mai is shab mein marne waali hoon
thay lene aaye mujhe khwab mein abhi bhaiya
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunaun kaise riwayat shaheed hone ki
ajeeb tarha se khairaat kar rahe thay shaqi
khajoorein phaynk rahe thay meri taraf shaami
ye zakhm dil pe mere patharon se hai gehra
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay baba shimr mujhe shaam tak satata raha
wo pani pee ke mere saamne bahata raha
jo durra pusht pe sajjad ki lagata raha
wo durra usne mere moo pe maara hai baba
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunaun shaam e ghariban ka aap ko manzar
layeen ne noch liye mere kaan se gohar
tamaam khoon mera beh gaya hai ris ris kar
safed hogaya beti ki aap ka chehra
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
bataya bacchi ne sajjad baap ko ro kar
har ek shehr mein maare gaye mujhe pathar
mai seedhi ho nahi paayi chali hoon jhuk jhuk kar
hai dard tooti hui phasliyon mein shiddat ka
ay baba jaan mere...
sar e hussain se ye...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Mehman hoo karbala
items.body:
raqm hai waqeya tareekh mein logon aise
de chuke ghusl o kafan fatema zehra ko ali
ro ke phir aap ne hasnain se zainab se kaha
aakhri waqt hai dedaar karo maa ka sabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke baba ki sada aaye hassan aur zainab
aur na mayyat ke kareeb aaye hussain ibne ali
karbala ka hoo mai mehman sada do amma
roke shabbir ye bole ke mai aaunga tabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
amma amma mehman hoo mai karbobala ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar sada de ke kaleje se lagalo
dil ko mai sambhalunga mujhe tum to sambhalo
jo aag hai seene mein zara usko bujhalo
hai aakhri dedaar sada deke bulalo
ye hi hoga jeene ke liye mera sahara
amma amma mehman hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle hi muqaddar mein bahot ranj o alam thay
ab tum bhi mujhe chod ke jaati ho jahan se
qaboo na raha qalb pe gham toote hai aise
sab jaanta hoo aap ne sadme jo uthaye
kaise bhoolun mai aap ke sadmon ko khudara
amma amma mehman hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din mein bahattar ke uthaunga mai laashe
shikwa na magar lab pe mere hoga khuda se
khojayenge is dasht mein sab godh ke paale
asghar hoke ya qasim hoke ya zainab ke dulaare
dunya meri is tarha ujadenge ye aada
amma amma mehman hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
chin jayegi har cheez meri dashte bala mein
khoon hoga jawan laal ka zainab ki rida mein
ho jaunga be-aas jo mai dashte bala mein
hal min ki sada goonjegi us waqt fiza mein
us dam koi na aake mujhe dega sahara
amma amma mehman hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khojayenge sab karbobala mein mere atfaal
abbas sa bhai hoke akbar sa jawan laal
hojayega us waqt behan ka bhi bura haal
ho jaunga jis waqt sare dasht mein pamaal
hoga zaamin zainab ke liye naam khuda ka
amma amma mehman hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar mein zainab ko phirayenge sitamgar
har mod pe aulaad e ali khayegi pathar
kaanto pe chalega wo mera abid e muztar
gir jayegi naaqe se sakina meri duhktar
tum hi to phir bachi ko wahan dogi dilaasa
amma amma mehman hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar mai likhun lafz wo khirtaas pe kaise
jab bande kafan khulne lage binte nabi ke
safdar ye kaha bibi ne haye mere bache
lag ja mere seene se mere naazon ke paale
kaise hoga karbal mein mera laal akela
amma amma mehman hoo...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Milke sab matame
items.body:
milke sab matame shabbir kare
dil ba dil seena ba seena
karbala tameer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye matam pehchan hamari
is pe jaan qurban hamari
jism yehi ye jaan hamari
ye matam hai shaan hamari
kehta hai emaan hamara
saare jawan o peer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar teri pyaas ka matam
akbar ka abbas ka matam
hasrat ka aur yaas ka matam
haasil hai ehsaas ka matam
laakh zamana hum ko roke
hum iski tash'heer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye matam mazloom ka matam
zehra ke masoom ka matam
pani se mehroom ka matam
taygh tale halqoom ka matam
is matam se hum jo chaahe
waqt ko zanjeer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ki zanjeer ka matam
kushk galay aur teer ka matam
zainab ka shabbir ka matam
dil se kare dilgeer ka matam
jo matam zainab ne kiya tha
hum uski tafseer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam kya hai sheh ka alam hai
ye matam to deen ka bharam hai
jis se khushi ho wo ye gham hai
haq ka yehi matam parcham hai
is parcham ko is matam ko
seeno pe tahreer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam jis ka darya darya
jiski wafa emaan ka chehra
jiske alam ka khoon mein pharera
doob gaya wo chand na dooba
uski wafa kehti hai hum se
dunya ko tasqeer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad mein teri shaam e ghariban
matam karne waale insan
karte hai jab chaak ghareban
zehra khud hoti hai giryan
sunnate zehra hai ye matam
is ko aalamgeer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
karna saki jo bhai ka gham
us zainab ki yaad mein ab hum
ranj o khushi se kar ke baaham
har din samjhe maahe muharam
zakhme dile zainab ki khaatir
koi dawa akseer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinke rassan mein haath bande thay
kaise bhala wo matam karte
unke dilon mein yaad basa ke
nauhe ki matam ki sada se
ehle aza zehra ki dua se
khuld ko jageer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula aisa zarf ata kar
ye matam saughaat bana kar
le jaye seeno pe saja kar
shehre najaf mein dil mein basa kar
apni azadari ka tohfa
nazr e khyber-geer kare
milke sab matame...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh denge rehaan o sarwar
hashr mein jab khatoon e mehshar
poochengi ye baat jo aa kar
chahiye kya matam ki bina par
hum keh denge hum ko ghulame
shabbar o shabbir kare
milke sab matame...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Nahi dekha
items.body:
karbal may kisi ghar ko ujadta nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai ke aisa nahi dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar teri maadar pe tera sadma hai kaisa
us ko kabhi saaye se guzarta nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
surat to dikha jao ke bechain hai maadar
armaan tha maa ne tere sehra nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir gir ke sambhalti rahi bazaaron may zainab
pehle kabhi bazaar ka rasta nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun to lade dunya may kayi baar mujahid
haste hue koi bache ko ladta nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas tere baad yun roti thi sakina
aansu jo giray uske to tham'ta nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne be-chadari zainab ki jo dekhi
naize pe sar e ghazi sambhalta nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab qatl huwe tanha hai ab sayyede sajjad
aisa sipay salaar zamane ne nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir tere sajde se zinda hai namazein
teeron pe kabhi aisa musalla nahi dekha
tareekh ne maana hai...
items.author: Syed Qasid Abbas

items.title: Parchame abbas
items.body:
parchame abbas hai ye parchame abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle darya e mawaddat mein naha kar dekho
dil ko ehsaas ke zewar se saja kar dekho
tum ko dunya hi mein firdaus nazar aayegi
parchame hazrate abbas utha kar dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber ki wigha mein isay hyder ne uthaya
aur khoon se abbas e dilawar ne sajaya
aur shaane kata kar usay maqtal mein bachaya
jo bhi uthayega isay fatema zehra usay deti hai dua
parchame abbas hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein jo saqqa e sakina ke jo alam hai
us ki hai ajab shaam ajab jaah o hasham hai
islam ki zeenat hai ye emaan ka bharam hai
jab bhi uthaate hai isay choomne aajati hai jannat se hawa
parchame abbas hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
is jaisi chamak chand sitaron mein kahan hai
is ke hi ujaalon se munawwar ye jahan hai
sajde mein wahan arsh hai ye nasb jahan hai
ghaur se dekho jo isay is my nazar aati hai ghazi ki wafa
parchame abbas hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ke parcham mein ye jo mashk saji hai
pani ki jagah is mein faqat tashna labi hai
hum jaise ghareebon ki bhi umeed bandhi hai
milta hai sukoon qalb ko jab paate hai hum iske pharere ki hawa
parchame abbas hai ye...

items.title: Ab tera bichona
items.body:
ashoor ki shab beti se kehte thay ye sarwar
ab tera bichona khaak hai sakina
kal nahi milega baap ka ye seena
<<DIVIDER>>
maine maana garm rayt par na so sakogi
karwatein badal badal ke raat bhar jagogi
yaad aayenge hum aur kabhi madina
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-shikasta hoke bhi guzaarni hai raatein
yaad aayengi hamare baad saari baatein
yun tadap tadap ke ab tujhe hai jeena
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi guzaarni hai ab yateem ho kar
jaise hum jiye hai apne baap maa ko kho kar
mere baad jeena seekh lo sakina
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan ye shab to jaag ke guzaar lo magar kal
nanhi nanhi aankhein neand se jo hongi bojhal
kya korogi us dum soch lo hazeena
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal ka din rulayega tumhe bhi aur hame bhi
waqt aazmayega tumhe bhi aur hame bhi
sabr ka ye daaman chodna kabhi na
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan ye shab wohi hai jiske waaste khuda se
maine tumko maanga tha duaon ke sahare
ab ye imtehan hai mai kahun sakina
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka raaj hai wafa ki saari kayenat par
pani ke liye usay na bhejna furaat par
warna laut kar wo aayega kabhi na
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak hai naseeb tera khaak pairahan hai
ab teri rida bhi khaak khaak hi kafan hai
khaak hi may hoga dafn ye nagina
ab tera bichona...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar abidi wo kaisi asr ki ghadi thi
baap ko sakina bekasi se dekhti thi
shaah keh rahe thay alwida sakina
ab tera bichona...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abbas tu jeeta rahe
items.body:
tu haram ki shaan hai tu haram ki jaan hai
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye zainab ki dua
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hai sarwar ka asa
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
tu sukoon e dil hai jaane fatema ke waaste
har ghadi dhaaras hai tu shaahe huda ke waaste
tujhko maanga hai ali ne karbala ke waaste
ay alamdar e wafa
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri ghairat aasman hai naazishe ummul baneen
karbala mein faqr se kehta hai zainab ka yaqeen
mutmain sab bibiyan hai dekh kar parda nasheen
kaun cheenega rida
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk bahrne ke liye qaime se nikla jis ghadi
baazuon ko choom kar bhai ke zainab ro padi
ghamzada zainab ke dil ki aur bechaini badi
kaampte dil ne kaha
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
de ke ghazi ko alam kehte thay ye shaahe zaman
tere hone se badi dhaaras hai jaan e panjetan
apni chadar ka muhafiz tujhko kehti hai behan
tu hai sarmeina mera
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar ehsaas tha ahle haram ki pyaas ka
kat gaye baazu to mashkeeze ko daaton mein liya
isko kehte hai itaa'at isko kehte hai wafa
goonjti thi ye sada
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
quwwat e baazu hai tu sher e khuda ke laal ka
yunhi lehrata rahe parcham tere iqbal ka
aasra hai karbala mein tashnalab atfaal ka
ay sakina ke chacha
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang karne ke liye kab haath mein talwaar li
sar jhuka kar bhai se daad e wafa har baar li
nehr se qaime hataye apni khwahish maar li
keh rahi hai fatema
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
faqr se takti hai zainab baap ki tasveer ko
hai bahot tujh par bharosa shaah ki hamsheer ko
kaun jakdega rasan mein zainab e dilgeer ko
hamsar e sher e khuda
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sune ummul baneen ne karbala ke waqiyaat
aamir o akhtar tasavvur mein thay bas ghazi ke haath
sehn e khaana mein bana kar chaar qabrein ek saath
ek pa ashkon se likha
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Akbar ki sawari
items.body:
wawaila haye wawaila
na jaa akbar na jaa
na jaa akbar na jaa
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon se sadayein aati hai
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein bapa hai wawaila
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
na jaa akbar na jaa
na jaa akbar na ja a
<<DIVIDER>>
hamshakle payambar jaata hai
dil baap ka dooba jaata hai
sar peet rahi hai maa dukhiya
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras naazon se jise
parwaan chadhaya zainab ne
gulshan hai ujda zainab ka
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi sakina ro ro kar
laut aao bhai ali akbar
qadmon se lipti masooma
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar se sakina jab lipti
shabbir ko sughra yaad aayi
usay kaise bataye ye baba
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dayr ruko beta akbar
mai tumko bana to loo dulha
afsos na raas aaya sehra
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri yaad bahot tadpayegi
maa jeete ji mar jayegi
maadar ke labon par hai nauha
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jao akbar jao akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh kehte thay jao akbar
mujhe dekhte rehna mud mud kar
deta hai sada boodha baba
akbar ki sawari jaati hai
qaimon mein bapa hai...
items.author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri & A. Jee

items.title: Ay maut teher ja
items.body:
jee bhar ke dekhle to zara
ay maut teher ja ke mera laal hai jawan
jee bhar ke dekhle to zara usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
<<DIVIDER>>
usko jawan palkon ke saaye mein hai kiya
kaanta bhi uske paaon my chubne nahi diya
dekhegi kaise seene mein barchi ko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan hai uske haaton mein mehendi lagaun mai
taaron se uski shaadi ka sehra banaun mai
kaise bhula sakegi bhala usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai na suna hai kabhi aisa waqiya
baysheer ke galay pe chala teere hurmala
dekhegi ye kin aankhon se manzar ko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta to ek zameen par chal paaya na mera
jhoole se jo gaya tha wo ghar aaya na mera
jhoole mein abhi dhoondti hai usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaungi kaise chod ke maqtal ko mai bhala
sotay hai yahan bete aur sartaj bhi mera
kehti hai ek bete se ye usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar ko bhi chain kahan baade karbala
zakhmo pe zakhm usko bhi ek saat hai mila
lo jaa rahi hai chod ke ab usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunchu dare haider pe hai armaan naeem ka
nauha padhun mai rauze pe hamshakle nabi ka
deti hai dua aaj ye bas usko uski maa
ay maut teher ja...
items.author: Naeem

items.title: Azal se dil hai
items.body:
azal se dil hai ghame sibte mustufa ke liye
ye aeena to bana tha isi jila ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda e paak ne bakshe hai arsh ke gowhar
hassan hussain sa zewar hai fatema ke liye
azal se dil hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada jigar tha tera ay rasool ki beti
pisar hussain sa paala tha karbala ke liye
azal se dil hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
dare hussain hai manzil numeine zaate khuda
dare hussain pa sajde karo khuda ke liye
azal se dil hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
dua ko haath uthaye ke bas murad aayi
hussain aisa waseela bane dua ke liye
azal se dil hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zamane bhar ke hai sajde umeed bakshish par
magar hussain ka sajda faqat khuda ke liye
azal se dil hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb dil ki bhala nazr aur kya hogi
mera salaam shaheedan e karbala ke liye
azal se dil hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
labe furaat qalam hoke baazu e abbas
sutoon ban gaye tameer e karbala ke liye
azal se dil hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazab ka waqt hai aale rasool yun mohtaj
kafan ke waaste bhai behan rida ke liye
azal se dil hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame hussain ko aasan samajh rahe ho wasi
ye imtehan hai dile sabr o aazma ke liye
azal se dil hai…
items.author: Wasi

items.title: Bahot gham milay
items.body:
bahot gham milay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein baba ka sar jo mila
bali sakina ne nauha kiya
pardes mein hogayi be-amaan
bahot gham milay baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kya na dhaaye sitam ashkiyan ne
khaati rahi bibiyan taaziyane
thi ek rasan aur baara galay
mai khad mein choti sab thay bade
ghuton pe meelon chali bibiyan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban ka ghamnaak manzar
qaime hamare thay sholon ki zad par
bistar jala bhai sajjad ka
gehwara e bezaban bhi jala
manzar tha wo al hafeez o amaan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ban mein aayi gyara moharram
baba tha mujh par aseeri ka aalam
phir mere dil par sitam ye hua
naize pe sar aap ka aa gaya
aankhon se khoone jigar tha rawan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko tamache sitamgar ne maare
sajjad khaata raha taaziyane
tishna labi aur safar ki thakan
karte bhi kya dono bhai behan
dete rahe sabr ka imtehan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kaan zakhmi kurta jala tha
chaale zuban par sookha gala tha
soti to sone na dete zara
royi to rone pe pehra laga
mujh par hui hai badi sakhtiyan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha ye taqaza unki wafa ka
gham mujhse poocho mere chacha ka
dekhe jo phupiyon ke sar berida
naize se ammu ka sar gir gaya
hai yaad wo shor e aah o fughan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
haa mere baba hai yaad ab bhi
jab pushte naaqa se mai gir gayi thi
tumse bichad kar mai soti na thi
aaghosh e zehra mein neend aagayi
baad uske phir neend aayi kahan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
balon pe mere jo hai safedi
gham ki fazayein dekhi hai aisi
nauhon ka kamsin saheefa hoo mai
ek chaar saala zaeefa hoo mai
kham hai kamar meri misle kamaan
bahot gham milay...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha jo likha hameed abidi ne
likhwaya shabbir ki laadli ne
nauhon se safdar ki pehchaan hai
bali sakina ka ehsaan hai
jo aaj nauha hai wirde zaban
bahot gham milay...
items.author: Hameed Abidi

items.title: Bemaar behan ka
items.body:
bemaar behan ka nauha tha
kyun aaye nahi bhaiya akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
kya lena mujhe tab aaoge
mar jayegi jab sughra akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar behan se jaate huwe
waada ye kiya tha aaunga
baba ne tujhe kyun rok liya
itna to mujhe batla akbar
bemaar behan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai sochti rehti hoo aksar
aur dekhti rehti hoo raahein
kyun dayr hui aane mein tujhe
ab majboori hai kya akbar
bemaar behan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kha jayega mujhko soona ghar
ab phail rahi hai maayusi
veeran hui saari raahein
aur ghar mein hai andhiyara akbar
bemaar behan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhai mere ye dhyan rahe
gar dayr hui pachtaoge
kab aaoge mujhko lene ko
jaldi mujhe khat likhna akbar
bemaar behan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai gor kinare hoo khud hi
naraaz hua hai kyun mujhse
ya mujho bata de bas itna
kab tak dekhun rasta akbar
bemaar behan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ghar mein akeli baithi hoo
sab chaahne waale rooth gaye
ashkon ki rawani mein padhle
kya haal likhun dil ka akbar
bemaar behan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bhai ki furqat mein zafar
nauha ye lab e sughra pe raha
gar dayr hui mar jaaungi
hai waqt ab bhi aaja akbar
bemaar behan ka...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Chaman chaman kali
items.body:
chaman chaman kali kali ali ali ali ali
mera shahe zaman ali jari o bu shikan ali
shareeke panjatan ali charaghe anjuman ali
khuda ka kaun hai wali ali ali iali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka daaye khambari ata kare qalandari
ali hai faqre buzari hai jiska naara hyderi
shehr shehr gali gali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali khuda ki shan hai rasool ki zaban hai
ibatado ki jaan hai bilal ki azan hai
namaz jisme hai dhali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo aql bhi shaoor bhi wo ghaibat o zahoor bhi
wo mustufa ka noor bhi wo noor ka ghurooro bhi
hai jiski zaat munjali ali ali iali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo lashkar e sipaah bhi kahin wo baadshah bhi
karam ki baargah bhi hamari sajdagah bhi
ye kehke har bala tali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen pe bu turaab hai falak pe aaftab hai
khuda ka inteqab hai jahan may la jawab hai
khuda ka naam bhi ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo taygh ki chamak bhi hai wo deen ki kumak bhi hai
wo deen ka falak bhi hai nusairiyo ka shak bhi hai
kisi ka hai mahabali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo deen ka viqar hai khuda ki zulfiqar hai
wo adl ki pukar hai wo aisa taajdaar hai
malak ne jiske aur dhali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen bhi hai zaman bhi hai makeen bhi hai makan bhi hai
ayan bhi hai niha bhi hai yahan bhi hai wahan bhi hai
rasool ka hai mursali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
namaz hai wazu hai tu khuda ki guftuga hai tu
aza ki aabroo hai tu hamari justujoo hai tu
likha najaf ki har gali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ka ehteraam ho rasool ka nizam ho
ali ka intezam ho durood ho salam ho
sada ho ye gali gali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mustufa ka ja-nasheen dua e mehshar e hazeen
kiya hai laaj jab kahin madad ko aa gaye wahin
saynjali saynjali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman kali kali…
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Dil ki zaban pe
items.body:
dil ki zaban pe naam rahega hussain ka
har ashk e gham sunayega nauha hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
chalti hui galay pe hai shimr e layeen ki taygh
wo rayghe karbala pe tadapna hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe rasool karwate leti thi qabr mein
jalti hui zameen pe tha laasha hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
phirta hai apni aankhon mein jannat liye huwe
dekha hai jis kisi ne bhi rauza hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
us aadmi se poochiye azmat namaz ki
hai jisko yaad aakhri sajda hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hone ko hai hussain ke lashkar ka khatema
aata hai ran mein aakhri fidya hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah wo naqahate peeri ke ba-wajood
akbar ki laash ran se uthana hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
apno ka zikr kya hai tabarruk ke naam se
khaate rahenge ghair bhi sadqa hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya saqt imtehan thay sibte rasool ke
aasan nahi tha ghar ko lutana hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe hai hussain ke shimre layeen sawaar
jibreel ne jhulaya tha jhoola hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaade hussain ban gayi zainab ki kayenaat
ankhon mein phirta rehta hai chehra hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula madad ko aaiye apne hussain ki
koi nahi hai bekas o tanha hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko viqar khoon ke aansoo rulayega
qabre nabi pe ashk bahana hussain ka
dil ki zaban pe...
items.author: Viqar Nagri

items.title: Haye ali qatl hogaye
items.body:
haye ali qatl hogaye
jibreel de rahe thay nida ke ghazab hua
hyder ko qatl qanaye khaaliq mein kar diya
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
shehzadiyo ne jyon hi suni gham ki ye sada
betaab hoke royi aur hasnain se kaha
masjid mein jaake dekho zara kya hai maajra
ye kaun keh raha hai hue qatl murtaza
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
zarbe layeen se hogaya jis dam do para sar
us dam alam se hilte thay masjid ke baam o dar
mehraab aur musalla hua saara khoon mein tar
kaampa falak to zalzala aaya zameen par
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
daude ye sunte hi suye masjid hassan hussain
dekha namazi karte hai naale ba shor o shain
apne lahoo mein laut'te hai shaahe mashraqain
paaya pidar ko aise kiye dono ne ye bain
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha namaziyo ne jo beton ko hat gaye
hasnain bad ke apne pidar se lipat gaye
naale kiye wo sunke jigar gham se phat gaye
riqqat se doston ke kaleje ulat gaye
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
yan ho rahi thi seena zani naala-o-buka
aayi kahin khareeb se fizza ki ye sada
zehra ki betiyon ko nahi yaara zabt ka
bechain hai wo dekhne ko haale murtaza
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haal hai pidar ka na aakar bataoge
hasnain se kaho ke jo unse chupaoge
hyder ko jald ghar mein agar tum na laaoge
zainab ko sar khule hue masjid mein paaoge
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz sunke bole ali ye baja nahi
hum be-sahara be-kaso be-aashna nahi
hai paas sab rafeeq ye ahle jafa nahi
kufa hai kehdo beti se ye karbala nahi
haye ali qatl...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain leke baba ko pahunche khareebe dar
sab hatgaye anees jo aaya ali ka ghar
betaab hoke betiyan nikli barehna sar
lipti pidar se aah hui is tarha nohagar
haye ali qatl...
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Hum hussaini hai
items.body:
hussain hussain hussain
hum hussaini hai dunya mein phaile huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
sakhtiyan karbala ki hai jhele huwe
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hum pe saaya wafa aur wafadar ka
dhoop mein jaise saaya ho dewaar ka
sar pe parcham hai sheh ke alamdar ka
har qadam bad rahe hai ye kehte hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye dharti agar laal shehbaaz ki
laal shehbaaz ke bhi wali hai ali
sarfarazi isi dar se sab ko mili
wajd mein kyun na har ek qalandar kahe
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khwaja ajmer ho ya nizam o fareed
sheh ke dushman ko kehte hai ye bhi yazeed
sheh ka gham inke maslak mein haq ki naveed
kitne aizaaz inko ye keh kar milay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haq parasti ke dunya mein haami raho
gar ho mazloom zaalim ko badne na do
zer e khanjar hussaini sada wo suno
aaj bhi jis se zaalim hai dehle hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mard wo hai jo waade ko poora kare
zer e khanjar bhi haq baat kehta rahe
sar rahe ya na rahe ghar lutay ya bache
juz tere aur kis mein hai ye hausle
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aandhiyan hum ko roke ye mumkin nahi
moo gham e sheh se moday ye mumkin nahi
rasme gham kaise choday ye mumkin nahi
hum to roz e azal se hi tere hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kul e emaan mushkil kusha hai ali
keh rahe hai nusairi khuda hai ali
ye khuda jaanta hai ke kya hai ali
saare ausaaf hyder ke tujh mein milay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber o khandaq o nehrwaan o jamal
zarb e hyder ka koi nahi hai badal
ay zamane kabhi raah e hyder pe chal
tere dil bhi milega ye kehte hue
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hum azadaar hai kitne khuddaar hai
de ke khushiyan jo gham ke talabgaar hai
shadi o gham mein sarwar ke ghamkhwar hai
ek hi naam hai lab kabhi jo hilay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk roke agar hum to phat jaye dil
gar na matam kare hum to kat jaye dil
apne markaz se mehwar se hat jaye dil
teri bazme aza gar na hum ko milay
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo roz e ashoora wo sheh ki behan
dekhti thi ujadta jo apna chaman
khoon e akbar se gul rang tha pairahan
de rahi thi sada ban mein sar peet ke
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
teri maadar ka shab ko janaza utha
teri hamsheer balwe mein hai berida
haye tujhko kafan bhi nahi mil saka
zakhm ab tak hamare nahi wo bhare
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nanhi si turbat banayi thi jab
bekasi pursa dene ko aayi thi jab
laashe asghar zameen mein chupayi thi jab
daaman e sabr choota na kyun haath se
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
koi pooche to abid ke dil se zara
tay safar shaam o kufa ka kaise kiya
betiyan fatema ki thi jab berida
chalne dete na thay paaon ke aabile
hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay rehaan azmi fikr ho bas yehi
matam e sheh mein hone na paaye kami
hai yehi zindagi hai yehi bandagi
mere ajdaad bhi mujh se ye keh gaye
hussain hussain hussain
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Hussainiyo bade chalo
items.body:
hussainiyo bade chalo hayaat ko jhinjhod do
sitam shiyaar jo badhe kalaiyan madod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka sher aayega to jang bach na payegi
ye keh rahe thay ashkiyan taraai aaj chod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ne sagheer se isharon mein ye keh diya
kamaan e zulm cheen lo jo teer aaye tod do
hussainiyo badE chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dil se hurr ne faisla kiya lahoo ki raat ko
hussain hi ka saath do sipah e shaam chod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo se dasht e karbala ubhal pade abhi abhi
hussain shukr karke tum jo aag thi nichod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool zadiyaan hai ye jo berida hai shaam mein
hussain qatl ho chuke jafayein ab to chod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke boli mayyat e hussain ibne fatema
madad ko phir uthenge hum jo tan ko sar se jod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham e shaheed e karbala mein badh ke salik e hazeen
jo khoon e dil na ro sake un aablon ko phod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
items.author: Salik Lakhnavi

items.title: Jaise alamdar gira
items.body:
laash abbas ke qaime mein nahi laaye hussain
le ke bas mashk o alam mehwe buka aaye hussain
ro ke zainab se kaha kitni musibat dekhi
maine har chaahne waale ki shahadat dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
zeen se khaak pe har ek wafadar gira
aise koi na gira jaise alamdar gira
<<DIVIDER>>
mask pani se bhari aur suye qaima chala
teer se mashk chidi aas gayi dil toota
pusht e rahwaar pe sadme se kayi baar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis khadar pani baha khoon bahaya us ne
aise aalam mein bhi ye zarf dikhaya us ne
is musibat mein kahan sabr ka meinaar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahun tum se behan dil pe chale thay khanjar
aisa lagta tha ke ghode se giray hai akbar
khaak pe kat ke jo ek baazu e jarraar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
jin se sadaat ko dhaaras thi wo baazu na rahe
itna roya hoo ke ab aankh mein aansu na rahe
dil mera toot gaya jab mera salaar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
gurz jab sir pe laga ghode pe shambhla na gaya
mere abbas ne rote huwe de mujhko sada
aaiye aaqa ke ab aap ka ghamkhwar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahuncha jab bhai ke laashe pe to dekha manzar
amma zehra bhi hai aur faatahe khyber bhi magar
khaak par ghutno ke baal deen ka sardar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh ke zaanu pe sar e ghazi kaha tha maine
zulm ki dhoop mein ab tanha hi jalna hai mujhe
tu jo ghode se gira saaye e dewaar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke phir mera wafadar pukara aaqa
laasha qaime mein na le jaana khudara aaqa
apni nazron se hai pyason ka alamdar gira
aise koi na gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
marsiya ban gayi roodad e sitam kaghaz par
aaj bhi rote hai ye keh ke raza aur mazhar
kaise bin haathon ke reti pe wafadar gira
aise koi na gira...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Kaha abbas ne
items.body:
kaha abbas ne aaqa ka mansha aaj le lenge
sakina ke liye abbas aada se darya aaj le lenge
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke sher hai abbas ke tewar batate hai
sitamgaron ke qabze se ye darya aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgaron se ye aun o mohamed ran mein kehte thay
mere hamle dayare shaam o kufa aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
wiladat keh rahi hai budshikan ki sehn e kaaba mein
khuda waale buthon se apna kaaba aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
saji hai karbala teeron se talwaron se naizon se
ye ansar e hussaini jaane kya kya aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
nikal jayegi hasrat jang ki abbas kehte thay
sakina ki sifarish ka sahara aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jis se azmate kaaba zameene karbala boli
jabeen e shaah e deen se hum wo sajda aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ibne kareema ka ho ye hurr sheh se kehta hai
hum apne haath se daaman tumhara aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ulat kar aasteen abbas be-deeno se kehte hai
ye darya hi nahi hum saari dunya aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum aate hai kaha abbas ne ay lashkar e aada
jo kal darya tumhara tha wo darya aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhapak jaye nigaah e barq jisko dekh kar salik
ali ki madha se aisa ujaala aaj le lenge
kaha abbas ne aaqa...
items.author: Salik Lakhnavi

items.title: Khatm ho gaya
items.body:
lut gaya hussain lut gaya hussain
khatm ho gaya khatm ho gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din mein sab hussain ka ghar khatm ho gaya
zehra ki hasraton ka safar khatm ho gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein hassan ke laal ko pamaal kar diya
is gham ne ek maa ka bura haal kar diya
rehwaar ke sumon mein pisar khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek lassh aane waali hai khud ko sambhalna
kis ke liye sajaye ho chota sa paalna
bano tumhara noore nazr khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki zad se seena e akbar na bach saka
afsos hum shabhi e payambar na bach saka
laila teri dua ka asr khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke dil pa kohe masayib gira diye
maqtal mein do charagh ajal ne bujha diye
ek maa ki godh lut gayi ghar khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye roshni hai shaam e ghariban qaraar ki
pehchan ab to dekh ke surat sawaar ki
zainab ghubaar e raah guzar khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke ashk aankhon se sarwar ki beh gaye
abbas jaate jaate hamay bhai keh gaye
ab shikwa e khameeda kamar khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe pe bekasi hai shahe mashraqin ke
tan par libaas tak bho na choda hussain ke
ay karbala shaoor e bashar khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo gham tha umr kat gayi ranj o malaal mein
baba ko itna roye hai chalees saal mein
abid ka saara khoone jigar khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqbooliyat ko aamir o akhtar ye kam nahi
wo kaunsi hai aankh jo majlis mein nam nahi
nauhe mein kaise keh dein asar khatm ho gaya
khatm ho gaya...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Laal hussain
items.body:
tanha ali ka laal tha nau laakh ashkiyan
zakhmon se choor garm hawa khushk tha gala
shimr e layeen aasteen ulte huwe badha
khanjar abhi chala nahi tha ke ek maa ne di sada
<<DIVIDER>>
ban mein thay maa ke ye bain
kaise mai paaungi chain
o mere laal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad ko apne chod ke sehra mein aayi hoon
muztar hoon ghamzada hoon falak ki satayi hoon
aankhon mein ashk ko chupa kar mai laayi hoon
bikhre huwe hai baal ye deti duhaai hoon
o mere laal hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
paala hai chakki pees ke kitne jatan kiye
sookhe abhi nahi mere haathon ke aabile
kis tarha dekh paungi khanjar talay tujhe
maa keh ke ek baar to awaaz de mujhe
o mere laal hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan mein tujhko dhoop mein jaane nahi diya
aur aaj tere jism se suraj guzar gaya
haye haye kisi ne aake udhayi nahi rida
aa mere bikhre baalon ke chaon mein baith ja
o mere laal hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhpe nahi ye taygh mere dil pe chalti hai
ek aah mere seene se paiham nikalti hai
jalte hai zakhm tere zameen itni jalti hai
majboor teri maa hai khadi haath malti hai
o mere laal hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se khaak saaf karungi rida se mai
wapas na jaungi kabhi ab karbala se mai
poochungi ye sawaal abhi alqama se mai
teri jafa ka shikwa karun kya khuda se mai
o mere laal hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu gham na kar chalegi tere saath saath maa
ho kar sawaar naize pe jayega tu jahan
tere baghair ab mujhe aaraam hai kahan
nauha kuna rahegi ye kehte huwe zaban
o mere laal hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-gor o be-kafan mere bacche tujhe salaam
bakshi na jayegi kisi surat ye fauje shaam
ay tashna lab ghareeb mohamed ke laal afaam
jageer daar khuld ki jageer tere naam
o mere laal hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala larazti thi zehra ke bain se
binte rasool hogayi mehroom chain se
uth'ta tha shor qabre shahe mashraqain se
rehaan jab ye kehti thi zehra hussain se
o mere laal hussain...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Maa kehti thi seene
items.body:
maa kehti thi seene se laga loo tujhe aaja
ek baar to phir laut ke asghar mere aaja
maa kehti thi…
<<DIVIDER>>
furqat mein teri neend bhi aati nahi beta
ab kis ke sahare pe ye maadar jiye aaja
maa kehti thi…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ab to mere haath bhi azaad rasan se
aa godh mein loo dil mein chupa loo tujhe aaja
maa kehti thi…
<<DIVIDER>>
sunti hoo ke ab nehr pe pehra bhi nahi hai
aa pani pila laa'un tujhe nehr se aaja
maa kehti thi…
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra tujhe poochegi to kya us se kahoongi
bin tere na jaa'ungi watan shaam se aaja
maa kehti thi…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyon kar ye bataungi laga halq pe naawak
kya keh ke bhala doongi tasalli usay aaja
maa kehti thi…

items.title: Maqtale hussain
items.body:
shabbir ke zakhmon par mehdi
aankhon se khoon bahate hai
tere sookhe galay ko kaata gaya
ye kehke tadapte jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pa jo tere naiza laga
wo pusht ki jaanib se nikla
aur ek shaqi ka teer e sitam
tere maathe phir aake lagaa
un zakhmon par phir aake layeen
has kar pathar barsate hai
shabbir ke zakhmon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheda hai badi bedardi se
asghar ki tarha tera bhi gala
ek teer tere phir dil pa laga
jis se tujhe akbar yaad aaya
tere dil ki ragein ab naizon se
be dard musalman kaat'te hai
shabbir ke zakhmon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri dayen taraf ki phasli par
jab naiza laga tu bayen gira
jab bayen taraf ki phasli par
ek naiza laga tu dayen gira
zahra ki tarha ay maula teri
ab zaalim phasliyan tod'te hai
shabbir ke zakhmon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin e kaahil ka ek zehr bhara
phir teer tere maathe pe laga
ek zaalim ne aage bad kar
ek gurz tere sar par maara
maloon tujhe phir naizon se
bhaalon se zameen par laate hai
shabbir ke zakhmon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi loot'ta hai phir teri aba
koi loot'ta hai ammama tera
koi tera kamarband khaynchta hai
koi khaynchta hai kurta tera
aur garm zameen ki khaak tere
zakhmon mein sitamgar daalte hai
shabbir ke zakhmon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere zakhmi galay ko shimr e layeen
phir kaat'ta hai lakdi jaisa
zainab se layeen wo kehta hai
abbas ko ab bulwao zara
dekhe wo ke kaise hum sheh ke
marne par khushiyan manaate hai
shabbir ke zakhmon par...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron pe pada tha sehra mein
be-gor o kafan sheh ka laasha
nasir na koi tha maula tera
jab laasha tera pamaal hua
yun fatema zahra aur ali
teri ghurbat par ghash khaate hai
shabbir ke zakhmon par...
items.author: Nasir Hussain

items.title: Parchame hazrate abbas
items.body:
parchame hazrate abbas sajaye rakhna
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ke saath har ek saans hai insan ki nang
seekho shabbir se marne ki ada jeena ka dhang
ghame shabbir hai baatil se musalsal ek jang
ghame shabbir ko talwaar banaye rakhna
parchame hazrate abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aake baaton mein subuk jaan ke farshe gham ko
kho na dena kahin shabbir ke is matam ko
khushk hone nahi dena kabhi chashme nam ko
aandhiyo mein bhi diya haq ka jalaye rakhna
parchame hazrate abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
rowe dastaar fazilat mein na aa jaana kahin
shaq o shubhaat mein padkar na gawa dena yaqeen
ghame shabbir ibadat hai koi rasm nahi
shor e matam se zamane ko jagaye rakhna
parchame hazrate abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulmate kufr mein dar aati hai emaan ki lakheer
kufr kar sakta nahi haq ke iraadon ko aseer
paak kar deta har rijs se zikre shabbir
zikre shabbir ko emaan banaye rakhna
parchame hazrate abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak raahe mawadat yuhin abaad rahe
ye dua e dil e zehra hai zara yaad rahe
umr bhar rote yuhin thay nahi sajjad rahe
apni naslon ko azadaar banaye rakhna
parchame hazrate abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame shabbir se abaad mera seena hai
mai azadaar hoo chehra mera aaena hai
sar buland hoke zamane mein agar jeena hai
sar dare sibte payambar pe jhukaye rakhna
parchame hazrate abbas...

items.title: Aaj matam bapa hai
items.body:
aaj matam bapa hai maula ka
zikr ghar ghar hua hai maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
waar aise kiya hai zaalim ne
zarb se sar phata hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogayi surkh masjid e kufa
khoon aise baha hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke hasnain karte hai naale
unko sadma bada hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibne muljim ne maah e ramzan may
khoon na haq kiya hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj mushkil kusha ki rehlat hai
matami ghamzada hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
peet'ti sar hai zainab o kulsoom
jab janaza chala hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr thar'ra rahi thi zehra ki
dafn jis dam hua hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukh zada hai bober isi gham may
aaj taboot utha hai maula ka
aaj matam bapa hai...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Abbas tu kahan hai
items.body:
pasban e rida ay shehenshahe wafa abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
sharm o haya ki malka balwe mein berida hai
abbas tu kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
beghairaton ka majma bazaar bhi saja hai
abbas tu kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr e layeen ye bola binte ali se aakar
abbas ko bula le tha tujhko naaz jis par
sadaat sun ke roye fizza ki ye buka hai
abbas tu kahan hai
sharm o haya ki malka...
<<DIVIDER>>
napaak zaalimon ne narghe mein shaahzadi
baalon se moo chupa kar zainab ne ye sada di
pathar dilon se chadar sajjad maangta hai
abbas tu kahan hai
sharm o haya ki malka...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe bhai ka sar roya khule saron par
sajjad pehne langar roya khule saron par
har gaam zulm seh kar har dil pukarta hai
abbas tu kahan hai
sharm o haya ki malka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jakde rasan mein qaidi bazaar mein jo aaye
barsa rahe thay pathar ahle damishq haye
in zakhm qaidiyon ka har zakhm poochta hai
abbas tu kahan hai
sharm o haya ki malka...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera sau meel ki wo kya sakht thi musaffat
sab choor thay thakan se pahunche jo baabe sa'at
ab qaidiyon ki peshi ek aur marhala hai
abbas tu kahan hai
sharm o haya ki malka...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehra ke taziyana haakim pukaara jao
abbas ke behan ko darbar leke aao
zaalim ka hukm sun kar shimre layeen badha hai
abbas tu kahan hai
sharm o haya ki malka...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar bhi nauhakhwan hai aur mazhar abidi bhi
alfaaz ro rahe hai aur saare matami bhi
zainab ki bekasi par ek misra marsiya hai
abbas tu kahan hai
sharm o haya ki malka...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Akbar ko fajar
items.body:
akbar ko fajar shaah ko asar roti hai
zainab ko magar shaam o sahar roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mila azan ko muazzan na baad akbar ke
lehja akbar ko azanon ki satar roti hai
akbar ko fajar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na akbar ki jawani pe jawani roye
jis pe hasnain ke nana ki qabr roti hai
akbar ko fajar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo shaam e ghariban ke andhere may rabab

items.title: Azan do akbar sahar
items.body:
dashte bala mein kehti thi maadar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
leke balayein sadqe ho maadar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to mai samjhi sote ho ghaafil
kya karun lekin sooni hai mehfil
is liye tum se kehti hai maadar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaah e zaman ke saath jinhone
jalti zameen par sajde kiye hai
aaye hai wo bhi khaak pe besar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
naine to jaana jaage huwe ho
zakm bhi tan par khaaye huwe ho
tum ko jaga doon ran mein ye keh kar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaf agar tum keh do ye mujhse
zakhme sina mein dard siwa hai
phir na kahun mai shana hila kar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
is pa taa'jub hota hai mujhko
need ye kaisi aayi hai tum ko
uth'te nahi ho kehti hoo ro kar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh diya hota mujhse jo sheh ne
qalb me tere naiza laga hai
kaahe ko kehti tumse ye muztar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai nahi kehti qaime mein aao
garmi ki eeza tan pe uthao
aarzu itni aayi hoo le kar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chup gaya dekho saara andhera
ho gaya bilkul noor ka tadka
padlo namaz e aakhri uth kar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai

halki si ran mein phaili safedi

nikle hai taayir bol ke aksar
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehwe ibadat hai saari khilqat
dil mein chupi hai uski mohabbat
naame khuda hai sabki zuban par
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
charkh pa kam kam taare hai baaqi
baithe hai uth ke saare namazi
baaghe iram se aaye hai hyder
azan do akbar sahar hui hai
dashte bala mein...

items.title: Bahot kareeb hai
items.body:
bahot kareeb hai kausar se karbala e hussain
waseela haq ka koi nahi siwae hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bata rahi ye tareekhe karbala hum ko
jise mitaye zamana usay banaye hussain
bahot kareeb hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aale paak ke munkir hai unko batlado
zia e deen labe hai faqad zia e hussain
bahot kareeb hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
na kooch jis ke be-rang jab nazar aaye
wo zere khanjar e qaatil bhi muskuraye hussain
bahot kareeb hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
madad ko sheh ne pukara tha jab dam e aakhir
fiza mein goonj rahi hai wohi sada e hussain
bahot kareeb hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
udoo ye samjhe ke quran le ke aaye hai
jab apne haaton pe asghar ko leke aaye hussain
bahot kareeb hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye laasha e abbas par shahe deen ne
sakina pyasi hai pani kahan se laaye hussain
bahot kareeb hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen pe jab kahin zikre hussain hota hai
falak se aati hai awaaz ab bhi aa ay hussain
bahot kareeb hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
siyah habakh hai ya kafire mohabbat hai
nazar muqarb pe jisne nahi wilaye hussain
bahot kareeb hai…

items.title: Bemaar ka janaza
items.body:
allah re qayamat allah re qayamat
mazloom ka janaza lachaar ka janaza
<<DIVIDER>>
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza lachaar ka janaza
<<DIVIDER>>
khaye hai taziyane zakhmi hai pusht saari
hai sheh ke gham mein ab bhi aankhon se ashk jaari
tasveer e gham bana hai ghamkhwar ka janaza
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ne zulm dhaaye kufe ki rehguzar mein
jisko qadam qadam par loota gaya safar mein
hai aise khaafile ke salaar ka janaza
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle aza tadap kar aansu baha rahe hai
taboot ko ye keh kar kaandha laga rahe hai
kaise uthaye apne sardar ka janaza
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
bharne ko bhar chuke hai sab zakhm pindliyon ke
lekin nishan ab bhi baaqi hai bediyon ke
dekho hussain apne dildaar ka janaza
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
saydaniyan tadap kar sar apna peet'ti hai
saansein to ruk gayi hai aankhein khuli hai
baqir ke muntazir hai deedar ka janaza
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se khoon tapka tharra gaya kaleja
baqir ke dil se poocho kaise lehed mein rakha
abid ka muttaqi ka deen daar ka janaza
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir bhi ro raha hai akhtar ki aankh nam hai
beemar e karbala ka sab ke dilon mein gham hai
nazron mein ghoomta hai khuddar ka janaza
aahista se uthao bemaar ka janaza
mazloom ka janaza...

items.title: Chaman chaman kali
items.body:
chaman chaman kali kali
nagar nagar gali gali
kahin khafi kahin jali
wohi wasi wohi wali
pukara jab bala tali
ruki thi nafs jo chali
ali ali ali ali ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt ka imam hai ali
khud khuda ka naam hai ali
kahin nazar kahin gohar kahin dua
kahin asar kahin khabar
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasman pe jab gaye nabi
tha wahan bhi lehjaye ali
haram haram iram iram zameen zameen
arab arab ajam ajam
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
izn se tere hawa chale
tujhse pooch kar diya jale
imame haq nizaame haq usoole haq
kaleeme haq kalaame haq
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...

mil gaya jo hukme bu-turab
aagaya palat ke aaftab
dua bhi tum ataa bhi tum yaqeen ki
ibteda bhi inteha bhi tum
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
kayenat ka sha'oor hai
kirdigaar ka ghuroor hai
likho ali padho ali nafas nafas
kaho ali suno ali
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab turab tum abu-turab
tum har ek sawaal ka jawab
seher mein tum qamar mein tum
yaqeen mein tum safar mein tum hazar mein tum
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
taal'te ho sab ki mushkilaat
tum chala rahe ho kayenat
umang bhi tarang bhi
pukare baadhshah bhi malang bhi
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe ki nazar badal gayi
murtuza pe taygh chal gayi
wo shor utha ghazab hua
ay momino manao gham karo aza
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay jalaal e khandaq o hunain
ek nazar ho jaanib e hussain
tera chaman hai be-kafan
lute haram chini rida bandhi rasan
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir aur nayyar e ghareeb
tere nauha khwan tere khateeb
karam bhi tu qasam bhi tu
zaban bhi tu sukhan bhi tu qalam bhi tu
ali ali ali ali ali ali
chaman chaman...

items.title: Dil ki zeenat
items.body:
dil ki zeenat dard e hussaini
sar ki zeenat paaye hussain
aankh ki zeenat khaalis aansu
lab ki zeenat haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dars e hussaini allah allah
yun na samajh mein aa jaye
apne khuda ki jis azamat ko
sar de ke samjhaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne apne sinf o sin ke
kaise numainde nikle
karbobala ke tapte ban mein
chaant ke jinko laaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam o kufa manzil manzil
sar tha naize par hamraah
zainab ka kya saath diya tha
zainab ke majaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ke azadaron se poocho
gham ki lazzat gham par naaz
sab ko daawat har dam charcha
ghar mein hamare aaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitna kehna chaaha kehle
keh paate to kya hota
zehne aalam mein na sameina
jitna kehne paaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhab o millat ke jhagde kya
markaz e haq to ek raha
jaise har insan ke dil mein
qadre shahadat jaye hussain
dil ki zeenat...

items.title: Haye amma
items.body:
haye amma meri amma
amma na hamein chod ke jao
naraaz ho kyun kuch to batao
<<DIVIDER>>
bin aap ke ek pal na sukoon paunga amma
jab tak na bulaogi na paas aunga amma
ab uth ke kaleje se lagao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
haa maine suna aap ka pehlu hai shikasta
ruksaar pe kis shakhs ne maara hai tamacha
shabbir ko bas itna batao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aap ka beta bada maghmoom hai amma
zakhmi hai badan aap ka maloom hai amma
baba ko utho zakhm dikhao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein bhi aap ko zaalim ne sataya
aur pehlu pe jalta hua darwaza giraya
marham utho zakhmon pe lagao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
markaz pe khada ashk bahaega ye mazloom
amma utho roti hai bahot zainab o kulsoom
behno ki mere aas bandhao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum hum ko sula kar hi sada soti thi amma
hum se kabhi naraaz nahi hoti thi amma
pyasa hoo bahot pani pilao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
phat'ta hai jigar dekha nahi jaata hai manzar
ghurbat mere baba ki zara dekho to uthkar
chehre se kafan apne hatao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chaunk ke uth jaata tha mai raaton ko aksar
tab lori sunaati thi mujhe godh mein lekar
phir mujhko wohi lori sunao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir o aalam hai yehi dil mein tamanna
ay kaash sada aaye yehi sayyade waala
bachpan ka mera nauha sunao
amma na hamein...
naraaz ho kyun...

items.title: Hum ko ya hussain
items.body:
ho dil mein ishq ki shiddat to la ilaah padho
gira do qalla e beyat to la ilaah padho
ho mishle hurr jo riyazat to la ilaah padho
dil o nazar mein ho ghairat to la ilaah padho
zuban se keh bhi diya la ilaah to kiya haasil
dil o nigaah musalman nahi to kuch bhi nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt ke yazeed ko barbaad kar diya
hum ko ya hussain ne azaad kar diya
labbaika ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi hussain hai roshni hussain hai
aagahi hussain hai bandagi hussian hai
sir farosh hoon meri aashiqi hussain hai
hurr ne aisa raasta eejaad kar diya
hum ko ya hussain ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaqilon ke shehr mein zulmaton ke behr mein
saans le rahe hai hum nafraton ke zehr mein
ya hussain aasra zaalimon ke dehr mein
aansuon ko aap ne imdaad kar diya
hum ko ya hussain ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
daulat kya hai matti hai shohrat kya hai matti hai
jo ho saron per dil par na ho aisi hukumat matti hai
khaake shifa ek tere siwa sab ki haqeeqat matti hai
khaake karbala ne dil aabaad kar diya
hum ko ya hussain ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
suno suno
kaleja thaam ke roodad e ishq saare suno
bara e nusrat e emaan ek muslim tha
jise bulaya tha mehman ek muslim tha
saja tha kufe ka deewan ek muslim tha
thay baaqi saare musalman ek muslim tha
bula ke kufa usay zaalimon ne chod diya
kiya tha waada jo maula se sab ne tod diya
<<DIVIDER>>
suna watan mein jo zehra ke pyare bete ne
hussain chod kar madina karbala ko chale
saeed o john zuhair aur osaja bhi jude
kaha ye hurr ne akela tumhe na chodenge
tumhari pyaas pe maula ye jaan de denge
natawan qalb ko faulaad kar diya
hum ko ya hussain ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
utha ke laashon pe laashe laaya
nabi ka beta hussain tanha
tha tapte sehra mein bhooka pyasa
ghareeb e zahra hussain tanha
jis ne jawan ko marte dekha
qasim ke tukdon ko bhi sameta
nanhe galay se teer nikala
ghazi ko ghode se girte dekha
aun o mohamed ke laashe laaya
ghareeb aisa koi nahi hai
wo jis ne sajde mein sar kataya
kiya tha waada jo wo nibhaya
khuda bhi darvesh phir pukara
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam hussain salaam hussain

items.title: Hussainiyo ke liye
items.body:
hussainiyo ke liye josh o walwala abbas
yazeediyo ke liye qehre kibriya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
duayein aaj bhi maqbool hai tere dar ki
buland paaya hai wo tune martaba abbas
hussainiyo ke liye…
<<DIVIDER>>
chala to mashke sakina ko bhar ke suye qayam
ghazab hai teere sitam ka hadaf bana abbas
hussainiyo ke liye…
<<DIVIDER>>
rahegi zaamine tameele hukme shaahe umam
labe furaat wo pyasi teri wegha abbas
hussainiyo ke liye…
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek gaam pe kehte thay sayyede sajjad
madad ko aaiye behre khuda chacha abbas
hussainiyo ke liye…
<<DIVIDER>>
dayaare shaam mein zainab pukaar uth'ti thi
ridaye paak ke waaris hai be-rida abbas
hussainiyo ke liye…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhatak na paaye wo azhar jo sheh ka zaair hai
ye karbala mein dikhate hai maujeza abbas
hussainiyo ke liye…
items.author: Azhar

items.title: Jaise khwaja ne kaha
items.body:
alal elaan kaho sar e maidan kaho
hai hussain ibne ali deen ki jaan kaho
<<DIVIDER>>
us namazi pe na ho kaise allah ko naaz
toote teeron pe ada ki hai maqtal mein namaz
haq hai uska jo ise haq ki pehchan kaho
alal elaan kaho sar e maidan kaho
jaise khwaja ne kaha deen panah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
pehno ehraam agar choomo kaabe ka ghilaf
jaake kaabe mein karo jab bhi kaabe ka tawaf
shukriya jaane ali hajj ke dauran kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya kehne lage dekh ke is ki taraf
isne baksha hai hame sar faraazi ka sharaf
har shariyat ka yehi hai nigehban kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocho kaabe se kabhi uske sajde ki chamak
roshni phail gayi saatwein arsh talak
arsh waalon pe bhi hai us ka ehsaan kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
is liye chaaron taraf dhoom is naam ki hai
aaj bhi karbobala dhaal islam ki hai
baat insaaf ki hai sab musalman kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ne muqtal mein rakhi lafze islam ki laaj
maut se isne kiya chadh ke naize pe khiraaj
roohe islam kaho jaane quran kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ki raahon mein fida apna ghar baar kiya
thak ke soya tha bashar usne bedaar kiya
mazhare zaate khuda hai ye insan kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir akhtar bakhuda ye na hota jo kahin
rakhta kis simt bashar apni sajde mein jabeen
jaane zehra pe hai ye jaan qurban kaho
alal elaan kaho...
jaise khwaja ne kaha...

items.title: Kaha abbas ne

kaha abbas ne ek aan may naksha palat jaye

alamdare hussaini hoo ijazat sheh ki gar paaun

kaha abbas ne…

layeen ye kehke bhaage nehr se wo sher aata hai

kaha abbas ne…

hussaini hoo mere qadmo ko jumbish ho nahi sakti

kaha abbas ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hasrat hai sana e murtaza may ghair ke haaton
zaban meri bhi misle meesame tammaar kat jaye
kaha abbas ne…

nabi se kaun baatein karta tha hojaye ye zaahir

kaha abbas ne…
<<DIVIDER>>
dua khaaliq se uth'te baith'te karta hoo ye asghar
nabi ki aal hi ka zikr ho aur umr kat jaye
kaha abbas ne…

items.title: Karbala wale hussain
items.body:
fatema zehra ke dilbar karbala waale hussain
kushtaye tayghe sitamgar karbala waale hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kya aalam hua hoga dile sad paash ka
jab uthaai laashe akbar karbala waale hussain
fatema zehra ke dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi bhar saani e zehra ka nauha tha yehi
tashnalab mere biradar karbala waale hussain
fatema zehra ke dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse badkar kaun hoga is zamane mein ghareeb
be kafan tum mai khule sar karbala waale hussain
fatema zehra ke dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se beghar hogaye nana ka rauza chut gaya

fatema zehra ke dilbar...

qasim o aun o mohamed bhi gaye abbas bhi
