fatema zehra ke dilbar...

items.title: Mar gaya baap
items.body:
ajeeb waqt hai ye fatema ke beton pe
janaza baba ka ghar se uthaye wo kaise
behan ko jan bhi chudate hai bad ke mayyat se
wobaar baar lipat'ti hai baap se jaa ke
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaya baap magar maanti nahi zainab
chudane se bhi kafan chodti nahi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi wo baba ke gaalon pe gaal rakhti hai
kabhi wo shaane hilaati hai maatha choomti hai
yateemi kya hai abhi jaanti nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khareeb aa ke kabhi chehra dekhte hai hussain
behan ki saanson ki awaaz sun rahe hai hussain
pidar se lipti hai kuch bolti nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye pehla gham hai abhi rok le behan aansu
kaha hussain ne zainab ke choom kar baazu
ye tera kufe may gham aakhri nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
giray jawan ke laashe pe jis tarha koi
giri thi baap ki mayyat pe us tarha beti
hassan uthaate rahe par uthi nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ro ke fizza se kehne lagay hussain o hassan
wo zakhm dekh rahi hai hata hata ke kafan
shikasta baap ka sar bhoolti nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nishani baba ki seene se jab lagayegi
usay amaame se baba ki khusboo aayegi
lahoo laga hai magar pochti nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
madad ko aaye baqaya se fatema zehra
wo dekh dekh ke roti hai baap ke chehra
abhi kisi ki taraf dekhti nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari aas pe jee legi ab behan abbas
khareeb aa ke chuda do tum hi kafan abbas
tumhara kehna kabhi taalti nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khareeb aaye jo ghazi behan ne choda kafan
to bolay ghazi se zeeshan aur raza ye hassan
tumhara chehra agar dekhti nahi zainab
chudane se bhi kafan chodti nahi zainab
mar gaya baap magar...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Milti hi nahi koi
items.body:
milti hi nahi koi misaal aisi dahar may
be gor-o-kafan bhai hamsheer safar may
milti hi nahi koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
haq fatema zahra ka ghasab jisne kiya hai
wo dost bhala kya hai payambar ki nazar may
milti he nahi koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke bache ko bhi naize pe chadaya
kya choda hai ummat ne mere bhai ke ghar may
milti hi nahi koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh chali jaaun bhala shaam may kaise
shabbir ka laasha hai meri raah guzar may
milti hi nahi koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ne kaha khoon yuhin rota rahunga
phuphi ki aseeri ne kiye zakhm jigar may
milti hi nahi koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
tarsi thi khawateen mulaqaat ko jis may
zainab sar e uryan hai usi koofa shehar may
milti hi nahi koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
behte hai ghame shaah may jo aansu wo kahan hai
mehshar may milenge wo tumhe laal o gohar may
milti hi nahi koi…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun kar na ameer aaj kahe gham ka ye nauha
har zulm ka manzar hai meri deeda o tar may
milti hi nahi koi…
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Parchame islam hai
items.body:
parchame islam tujh par salaam
moula ghazi ka alam hi parchame islam hai
apni jad amjad se paaya virsa mein inaam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
tu shabeehe murtaza aur waarise jaah o hashm
ud gaya haibat se teri kufr ka araam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ke nana ke liye aalam hua taqleeq hai
berida wo bibiyan hai aur balwa aam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jinhe bhi haq ne banaya tha karbala ke liye
wo sab ke sab hi namoona thay do sara ke liye
magar yaqeen ye kaamil ke hazrate abbas
bataur e khaas banaye gaye wafa ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar teri wafa ke charche hai aqwaam mein
thi wafa benaam warna tu wafa ka naam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
matam o majlis azadari shaah mazloom ki
saari dunya ke liye haq ka yehi paigham hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab lage pathar barasne to sakina ne kaha
ye sitamgaron ki nagri phuphi amma shaam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
seh roz ke pyase bachon ki afsos ke pyaas bujhi na
aagaya beech bhawar ke logon hyder ka paak safina
chacha ko kabse dekhti hai par aaya nazr kahin na
asghar ke waaste dekhi hia lekar ke jaam sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
muntazir apne chacha ki hai sakina laadli
kab se asghar ke liye wo leke baithi jaam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ameer apni ibadat tazkera shabbir ka
madhe aale rasool karna yehi apna kaam hai
parchame islam hai…
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Aaj meri maa
items.body:
jab aaye qabr mein dafna ke fatema ko ali
kaha hussain se aayengi ab na amma kabhi
tumhe pilaunga beta mai aaj se pani
ye pehli raat yaad aayegi bahot maa ki
tumhari fikr mein hogi lehad mein maa bechain
subha se jaage ho so jao thodi dayr hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
badh kar ali ne galay jab lagaya
ye keh ke shabbir ne sar uthaya
aaj meri maa chali gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mujhe ye batayein
kyun chod jaati hai maayein
seene se apne laga kar
ab kaun dega duayein
nazron se jaata nahi maa ka chehra
kaise mujhe neend aayegi baba
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hoon jab se suna hai
maa ko tamacha laga hai
aulaad ke saamne kya
maa ko koi maarta hai
ye waqt baba kisi par na aaye
maa apne bacchon se chehra chupaye
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaza maa par gira kar
kehne laga ek sitamgar
aaj itna zehra ko maaro
uth na sake zindagi bhar
hasta raha maar kar taziyane
aaya nahi maa ko koi bachane
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu hi jab toot jaaye
kaise koi haath uthaye
bete ko is haal mein maa
seene se kaise lagaye
phir bhi mere naaz uthaati thi amma
takleef mein muskurati thi amma
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa mar gayi hai pata tha
par dil nahi maanta tha
aur aap ne mere baba
jab ghusl unko diya tha
yun cheekh kar aap roye thay baba
us waqt mujhko yaqeen aagaya tha
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye mai darbar se ghar
aaya tha jab maa ko le kar
raste mein amma ke paon
khat khaynchte thay zameen par
aise khadam wo uthaati thi baba
chalti thi phir baith jaati thi baba
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
maara tha zaalim ne baba
jis haath par taaziyana
bhoolunga kaise mai maa ka
wo haath mujhse chupana
wo neel meri nazar mein tab aaya
maa ne kafan khol kar jab bulaya
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab door apne watan se
mehroom ho kar kafan se
laasha pada hoga mera
lut jayega sab badan se
jaaunga ek roz karbobala mai
lekin ghareeb aaj se hogaya mai
aaj meri maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se apne laga kar
us dam bahot roye hyder
haye raza aur zeeshan
jab bole shabbir ro kar
maa mar gayi ab jiyunga mai kaise
ay kaash mar jaata mai unse pehle
aaj meri maa...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Abbas tum kahan ho
items.body:
ya aqi ho kahan
aina abbas aina abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pukari rokar abbas tum kahan ho
hote hai zulm hum par abbas tum kahan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek hi rasan mein baara gale bandhe hai
har ek qadam pe bhai dam sab ke ghut rahe hai
ay bawafa dilawar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aada ne kar diya hai dushwar iska jeena
har saans le rahi hai mushkil se ab sakina
ab jaan balab hai dukhtar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum sab ke sar khule hai abid ka sar jhuka hai
sadme se sar jhuka kar bemaar ro raha hai
mar jaaye na ye laaghar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri behen pe durre barsa rahe hai aada
kis ko bulaye zainab itna bata do bhaiya
koi nahi hai yawar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna nahi hai koi aa kar jo inko roke
baaghi ki ye behen hai shaami ye kehke mujhpe
barsa rahe hai patthar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram pe zaalim angaare phaynkte hai
arz o samaa hamari ghurbat pe ro rahe hai
ghayyur sher e hyder abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne alam ko laa kar meri rida bana do
darbar ja rahi hoon kuch hausla badha do
sar par nahi hai chadar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz ali mohammad wo dard ki ghadi thi
darbar mein ye zainab jab roke keh rahi thi
hai hashr ka ye manzar abbas tum kahan ho
zainab pukari rokar...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Akbar ko na maaro
items.body:
ay baba alaika minni as salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ye awaaz suni jawan bete ki
shaah gir gir ke uthe suye maidan chale
haath akbar ka kaleje pe jo dekha to kaha
ay barchiyon waalon akbar ko na maaro
mere akbar ko na maaro
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah kahin teer kahin bhaala hai
kya isay barchiyan khaane ke liye paala hai
ye mera noore nazar shabihe paighambar
ye agar maara gaya mai bhi na jee paaunga
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye abbas ke marne se kamar may kham hai
aur akbar ki judaai may nazar bhi kam hai
dekho mai tanha hoo ghareeb kitna hoo
mera ab koi nahi hai ali akbar ke siwa
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayr kar dasht may tum maar rahe ho jis ko
mil ke do maaon ne parwaan chadaya is ko
naiza bardaron ruko kuch to ehsaas karo
seh na payengi ye gham zainab o umme laila
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi akbar to kabhi suye madina dekha
dasht may jaate huwe yaad jab aayi sughra
bole maula ro kar wo yahan hoti agar
dekhti kaisi jawan bhai ka zakhmi seena
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya tumhari koi aulaad nahi hai bolo
beta kis tarha jawan hota hai mujhse poocho
gurz se zakhmi hai sar hai lahoo chehre par
mera armaan tha akbar ke ho sar par sehra
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula jab bete ke paas aaye suno kya dekha
aediyan khaak pe akbar ko ragadta dekha
sabr phir toot gaya shaah ne ro ke kaha
shiddat e dard se mar jaaye na akbar mera
ay barchiyon waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kabhi socha hai zeeshan aur irfan e aza
kaise us baap ne bete ka uthaaya laasha
haye jo qaimon se ghutniyo chalte huwe
naujawan laash tak aaya ye sada deta hua
ay barchiyon waalon...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Ali rone lage
items.body:
rone waalon rone waalon
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar beti ke aansu khud bhi ro jaata hai baap
kitna bebas betiyon ke gham mein ho jaata hai baap
<<DIVIDER>>
sar shikasta hogaya lekin ali khamosh thay
betiyon ka jab khayal aaya ali rone lage
<<DIVIDER>>
dard ki shiddat mein bhi na aankh se aansu bahe
betiyon ka jab khayal aaya ali rone lage
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hassan ne baap ka sar apne zaano par rakha
zakhm gehra dekh ke shabbir ne girya kiya
apne beton ko musalsal hausla dete rahe
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyon ke haal ka tha baap ki aankhon mein gham
haye zainab haye chadar keh rahe thay har qadam
masjid e kufa se ghar tak raaston ko dekh ke
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke is haal mein mar jaaye na zainab meri
saamne uske mai ghar se chal ke aaya tha abhi
apne beton ke sahare haye ghar jaate huwe
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala yaad aayi to chooma gala shabbir ka
aur phir abbas ke shaano ka bhi bosa liya
haan magar sajjad ke nanhe se paon choom ke
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne manzar aa rahe thay murtaza ke roo baroo
zakhmi sar se beh ke aa pahuncha jo chehre tak lahoo
shaam mein sar pe baraste patharon ka soch ke
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gayi darbar zahra thay sahabi saamne
shaam ke darbar mein honge sharabi saamne
aakhri sanson mein naame fatema lete huwe
betiyon ka jab...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun ali ki aankh se hote rahe aansu rawan
bas wo samjhega khuda ne di hai jis ko betiyan
dil tadap kar reh gaya jab ye suna zeeshan se
betiyon ka jab...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: As sham as sham
items.body:
abid se jab watan mein kisi ne kiya kalaam
guzre kalak zyada kahan tumpe ya imam
abid ne teen baar kaha shaam shaam shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
as-sham as-sham as-sham kaha
bazaar mein jaana yaad raha
<<DIVIDER>>
pabande rasan beparda haram
bazaar mein aayi maa bandi
un galiyon mein bazaaron mein
abid pe qayamat kya guzri
pathar dil un bedardo ka
bazaar sajana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab yaad wo manzar aata tha
sajjad ka dil khoon rota tha
aankhon se lahoo barsaata tha
ek dard jigar mein hota tha
bemaar tadapta tha keh kar
ghurbat ka zamana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
naizo pe shaheedo ke sar thay
aur ahle haram be chadar thay
lachaar haram bazaaron mein
bas ahle sitam ki zad par thay
pardes mein khoon rokar mujhko
ye zakhm uthana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ahle shaam tamashayi
hum par pathar barsate thay
bazaaron se darbaron tak
hum sar ko jhuka kar jaate thay
ghairat ki sabab un raahon mein
sar apna jhukana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaati thi tamache zaalim ke
masoom sakina raahon mein
dil ab bhi laraz jaata hai mera
wo dard tha uski aankhon mein
meri mazloom sakina ka
ghazi ko bulana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki khwahar ko zaalim
baaghi ki behan jab kehte thay
dil khoon ke aansu rota tha
jis waqt ye taane sehte thay
wo meri phupi ka is gham se
ashkon ka bahana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki khwahar be-chadar
ye baat to khoon rulaati thi
zainab ke khule sar par jab bhi
ghazi ki nazar pad jaati thi
naize ki ani se ghazi ka
sar khaak pe aana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ka ye nauha likh kar
dil rone laga mera safdar
namoose nabi bazaaron se
kis tarha gayi hogi rokar
jis gham ke sabab abid ko sada
sar apna jhukana yaad raha
as-sham as-sham...

items.title: Ay mere baba jaan
items.body:
us waqt jab ke zainab darbar may gayi thi
khaari namaziyon se mehfil saji hui thi
zaalim ye poochta tha ghazi tera kahan hai
balon se moo chupaye zainab ye keh rahi thi
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere baba jaan ho rahi hai azan sar chupa'un kahan
majmaye aam may bewatan be-ama aa gaya karwan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhi hoo marzia binte khairun-nisa
mere lehje may hai baba teri aada
naam zainab mera tune jo rakh diya dedi apni zuban
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaan mai rida maangti reh gayi
baam o dar sajgaye jeete ji mar gayi
halqae shaam may naam sunkar mera margaya natawan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
haath kaano pe hai neel gaalo pe hai
aur nishan jo sakina ke shaano pe hai
har nishan se yahi aa rahi hai sada baba jaan baba jaan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
sham e ashoor se shaam o kufa talak
maine maanga nahi hai khiraaje fadak
meri chadar se hai meri maa ka sukoon sunle zalim jahan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaan ye tera aakhri tha bayaan
teri chadar bachayega ghazi jawan
margaya bawafa chingayi hai rida kehti hai bibiyan
abbas abbas abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk na paaya mere bawafa ka wo sar
noke naiza se aane laga khaak par
behan ko darbadar dekh kar nange sar seh na paya jawan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
kal thi maa aaj mai bhi hoon darbar may
misle zahra khadi hoon mai aghiyar may
us taraf hai shaqi is taraf rehgaye bepadar betiyan
ay mere baba jaan…
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa khutba diya maine darbar may
likh raha hai jo yawar tere pyar may
lehjaye hyderi har azan ke liye hai sada e azan
ay mere baba jaan…
items.author: Yawar Abbas

items.title: Azan do ay mere dilbar
items.body:
azan do ay mere dilbar savera hone wala hai
tumhare baad aalam mein andhera hone wala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sarwar ne akbar se ujala hone wala hai
bala ke ban mein ek khooni savera hone wala hai
hamare khoon se rangeen sehra hone wala hai
kaleje se tumhare paar naiza hone wala hai
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool allah ki itrat par aafat aane wali hai
ali ke naunehalon par musibat aane wali hai
nabi ki aal par subhe qayamat aane wali hai
aseerane haram ki shaam e ghurbat aane wali hai
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheede zulm hojayenge bhai bhi bhatije bhi
tahe tayghe sitam hojayenge bache bhi boodhe bhi
chidegi gardane asghar jawano ke kaleje bhi
chalenge teer bhi talwar bhi khanjar bhi naize bhi
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
juda shaane kisi ke aur kisi ke sar qalam honge
na abbas e jari honge na tum honge na hum honge
hamare qaanwade par bahot zulm o sitam honge
jafaon par jafa hogi bala honge alam honge
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
labe darya mere haaton pa naazon ka pala hoga
zaban sookhe labon par hogi aur manka dhala hoga
sitam insaniyat par is se bad kar aur kya hoga
mere baysheer ki gardan mein teer e hurmala hoga
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgaron ka nargha hoga aur aale abaa hogi
rasan basta hamare baad binte murtaza hogi
bhare darbar mein zehra ki beti berida hogi
meri nanhi sakina par tamachon ki jafa hogi
azan do ay mere dilbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shab e ashoor sheh ke qaimo mein mirza tha ek mehshar
basad hasrat pisar se apne farmate thay jab sarwar
mere kadiyal jawan ay hoo baroo hamshakale payghambar
tumhare baad ay noore nazar hai khaak aalam par
azan do ay mere dilbar...
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Bahot roya hai
items.body:
daair e raahib mein jo sarwar ka kata sar aaya
noor chehre ka jo dekha to bahot ghabraya
utha tazeem ko naize ke barabar aaya
godh mein leke wo sar hujre ke andar aaya
saaf karta tha lahoo mehwe buka tha raahib
moo pe moo rakh ke yehi soch raha tha raahib
<<DIVIDER>>
laashein ghar bhar ki utha kar ye abhi soya hai
dekh kar chehre ko lagta hai bahot roya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
warm aankhon ka batata hai bahot saabir hai
haye baalon ki safedi se yehi zaahir hai
ho na ho isne barabar ka pisar khoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane ye kaun hai dil mera phata jaata hai
ya nabi zaada koi hai ya wali zaada hai
baad marne ke bhi naize pe jo ye goya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ragein khushk batati hai bada pyasa tha
jis ghadi taygh se zaalim ne gala kaata tha
kaunsi maa hai ke jisne ye pisar khoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baal sab khoon mein matti mein atay hai is ke
hont bhi pyaas ki shiddat se phate hai is ke
apne ashkon se hi in honton ko bhigoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
log kehte hai badi eeza uthayi is ne
qabr masoom se bacche ki banayi is ne
khoon e masoom se hi zakhme jigar dhoya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhyaan jab aaya behan ka tahe khanjar roya
sar khule dekha to phir naize ke upar roya
ye muqaddar isay kis mod pe le aaya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hont masoom si bacchi ke bhi pyase dekhe
haye lagte huwe gaalon pe tamache dekhe
rassiyon se bandha nanha sa gala dekha hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi qasim e muztar gaye maare roya
bhai ki laash pe darya ke kanare roya
dono haathon se kamar pakde huwe pahuncha hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shadman godh mein rakhe tha qamar ko raahib
bain kehta tha yehi choom ke sar ko raahib
godh mein chand ka tukda ye meri soya hai
dekh kar chehre ko...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Beparda shaam ki
items.body:
haye zainab haye baazar
<<DIVIDER>>
be parda shaam ki galiyon mein
tatheer ki chaadar waali hai
khoton se baraste hai patthar
athara baradar waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ki jo maajayi hai
wo qaidi ban ke aayi hai
ek jashn bapa bazar mein hai
namoos e payambar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar zakhmi hai zakhmi hai badan
be chadar hai haathon mein rasan
jurrat bhi shuja'at bhi lekin
abbas e dilawar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
be gor o kafan islam tha jab
de kar chadar boli zainab
ye saari sakhawat khoon mein mere
taaseer ye hyder waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
durron ki aziyat sehti hui
taa shaam gayi ye kehti hui
ye khutbon ki talwaar nahi
tehreer ye shabbar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt azan raahon mein suni
sar dhaamp ke haathon se boli
ay nana din ye dard ke hai
ye baat muqaddar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka sar naize se gira
sar zainab ka dekha jo khula
ye taaza musibat ghazi par
shamsheer sikandar waali hai
be parda shaam ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar e sitam mein shahzadi
pahunchi to qayamat barpa thi

kab jayenge zindan se ghar

hum log mar gaye tere marne se ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
unnesvi ki subha qayamat ki thi khabar
faaqe hai teen rooz se hum bekason ke ghar
dunya se tum gaye to ye dunya badal gayi
hum log mar gaye...

kehta hai har yateem ke tanha na chodiye
le jaye mujhko saath akela na chodiye
kufe may hum ghareebon ka baaqi nahi koi
hum log mar gaye...

naabina ek zaeef ye kehta hai baareha

aayega kaun poochne ab khariyat meri
hum log mar gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
lekar pyaale sheer ke aaye yateem sab
roye hassan se mil ke yateemane kufa jab
darwaza e ali pe qayamat bapa hui
hum log mar gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
har haal may sambhalne waala chala gaya
ghurbat may humko paalne waala chala gaya
kis tarha se bhulayein kareemi imam ki
hum log mar gaye...

pehle hi muztarib thi tabiyat hussain ki
yaad aa gayi imam ko phir apni laadli
dar par sada jo kufe ke bachon ne aa ke di
hum log mar gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baahar jo ghar se aaya janaza imam ka
rone se ahlebayt ke kufa laraz gaya
charon taraf se aati thi aawaz bas yehi
hum log mar gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun bibi hai jo janaze ke saath hai
jhuk jhuk ke chal rahi hai wo pehlu pe haath hai
kya fatema ye sunke madine se aa gayi
hum log mar gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maayein ye kehke mir takallum hui nidhaal
rakhte thay in yateemon ka kitna ali khayaal
mehsoos hogi bachon ko ab baap ki kami
hum log mar gaye...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Hussaino minni
items.body:
sada e rabb e jahan
jabeen kushada hussain
batool zaada hussain
mera iraada hussain
nibhane waada hussain
malaeka ki safon se nuzool tak pahuncha
phir ambiya ki safon se rasool tak pahuncha
mere hussain ka dunya mein jab zahoor hua
rasoole haq ne padha hukme rabb se ye kalma
hussain o minni wa ana minal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bata gaya hai nabi khuda ka
hussain mujhse hai mai hussain se hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
misaal e faatah e badr o hunain mera hussain
meri batool ki aankhon ka chain mera hussain
khuda ke deen ki hai zaib o zain mera hussain
hai mere baad shahe mashraqain mera hussain
zamane bhar ki pukaar hai ye
mere lahoo ka weqaar hai ye
ye mera jism meri jaan mere deen ki baqa
hussain o minni...
<<DIVIDER>>
kul ambiya ki amanat isi ke haath mein hai
usoole deen shariyat isi ke haath mein hai
meri baqa meri izzat isi ke haath mein hai
kalaam e paak ki hurmat isi ke haath mein hai
lahoo se aisa payaam dega
shariaton ko amaan dega
meri hadees ki tafseer hogi karbobala
hussain o minni...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke hukm ki tameer hogi maqtal mein
ali ke ishq ki takmeel hogi maqtal mein
bisaat deen ki tabdeel hogi maqtal mein
hayaat maut ki qandeel hogi maqtal mein
hussain mujhko nijaat dega
ye deen e haq ko hayaat dega
ye raaz jaan ke mere nabi ko kehna pada
hussain o minni...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye meri godh mein hai aur tasavvurat mein kya
mere hussain ka maqtal bani hai karbobala
ghamon se choor thakan se nidhaal sar pe qaza
mita ke bayyate faasiq bacha ke deene khuda
lahoo se darya ko laal kar ke
yazeediyat ka qetaal kar ke
jo qatl gaah ki jaanib badha to rabb ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
shukriya shukriya shukriya
hussain tera shukriya
shukriya shukriya shukriya
hussain tera shukriya
<<DIVIDER>>
keh raha hai khuda hussain tera shukriya
ke tu ne deen bacha liya hussain tera shukriya
jo ambiya se nahi ho saka wo tu ne kiya
shukriya shukriya shukriya
hussain tera shukriya
<<DIVIDER>>
teri himmat pe ye kaunain fida tashna dahan
tu ne jo waada kiya poora hua tashna dahan
khoon se maqtal ko jo sairaab kiya tashna dahan
ibne zahra o ali ay wali ibne wali
tujhse mai raazi hua ay shahe karbobala
aisa maqtal saja diya tu ne
mar ke jeena sikha diya tu ne
hashr tak karte rahenge ye shaheedane wafa
as-salaam o alal hussain wa ala ali ibnal hussain
wa ala aulaadil hussain wa ala as'haabil hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis o matam ki baqa hussain
hai ye tere ahle azaa hussain
matami seeno se suno hussain
aati hai labbaik sada
labbaik ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye matami lashkar hai himmat ka samandar hai
aayi jo alamdari har fard dilawar hai
dekho to wafadari dekho to ye khuddari
marne ki ye tayyari aur lab pe sada jaari
kya nazha ki takleefon mein maza
jab maut aaye jawani mein
kya lutf janaza uthne ka
har gaam pe jab matam na ho
hussain ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne chala jo ghar se koi matami jawan
ye kehke azm uska badhati hai uski maa
roke hai meri aankh se aansu abhi rawan
lekin jo maut saamne aaye to meri jaan
himmat na haar jaana qasam hai batool ki
kar lena yaad jang shabihe rasool ki
hussain ya hussain..
<<DIVIDER>>
wo teen din ki pyaas wo akbar wo fauj e shaam
wo dhoop razm gaah ki wo nusrat e imam
tayghon ki chaon teeron ka meyaar o ajdahaam
naiza kisi ka aur jigar e akbar e anaam
bijli si har taraf khaso khashaak par giri
tasveer mustafa ki juhin khaak par giri
hussain ya hussain..

items.title: Jal chuke qaime
items.body:
jal chuke qaime shahe deen ke fiza khamosh hai
huu ka ek aalam hai dashte nainawa khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...

mehwe hairat hoo zamana kis khadar hai sang dil
sun raha hai karbala ka waqaya khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash mein hai bemaar lab ko taab e goyaii kahan
chin rahi hai sar se zainab ke rida khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ilaahi kaunsi quwat dil e zainab mein hai
de ke bachon ko shahadat ki dua khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro to le khul kar zara akbar ko maa hat jaiye
shaahe deen pase adab se maamta khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
har qadam par hai jo bhai ki wasiyat ka khayaal
taaziyane khaake binte murtaza khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doobi huwi hai sibte paighambar ki laash
kashti e ummat bacha kar na-khuda khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kare kis dil se de shabbir marne ki raza
sar jhukaye saamne bhai khada khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahi hai al-atash ki qaima e sheh se sada
sar kataye ghaat par saqqa pada khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine jab poocha bata kya hai wafa ki inteha
keh ke ya abbas tareekh e wafa khamosh hai
jal chuke qaime...

items.title: Karbala wale tera
items.body:
ye hamare dil mein jo emaan hai
karbala wale tera ehsaan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
rehti duniya tak hai tera gham hussain
ruk nahi sakta tera matam hussain
hum uthayenge tera parcham hussain
tere parcham ki anokhi shaan hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
aandhiyan uthengi toofan aayenge
tere matam se na hum ghabrayenge
har fiza-e-zulm par cha jayenge
yeh hamara ahd hai payman hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak lehraega parcham tera
kam nahi hogi kabhi iski ziya
de raha hai aaj bhi darse wafa
haye kya tere alam ki shaan hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
laakhon ab toofan uthe aandhi chale
laakh ho daaro rasan ke marhale
sabr ke khaleq tere parcham talay
ab hamein har marhala aasan hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
khud musalmano ne loota ghar tera
sach to ye hai ay shaheede karbala
hogayi tujhpe sitam ki inteha
kya imame waqt ki pehchan hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
sarware deen kaam jo tune kiya
hazrate ayub se kab ho saka
tune akbar sa pisar bhi de diya
sabr tere sabr par hairaan hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
rayg zaare garm par kaata gaya
zulm ke khanjar se jab tera gala
haq pukar utha shaheede karbala
rehti duniya tak tera farman hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
tere haaton par jo ek masoom tha
pyas ki shiddath se jo maqmoom tha
kya laeeno ko nahi maloom tha
tere haaton par bhi ek quran hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
bezaban ke ran mein aane ki ada
dushmano ke dil hilaane ki ada
muskurakar teer khaane ki ada
har ada mein haq ke ek elaan hai
karbala wale tera…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zaheer ek ye bhi kaare sawaab
kehke maine ya ali ya bu turaab
kitne chehron se ulat di hai niqaab
naame hyder qalb ki mezaan hai
karbala wale tera…
items.author: Zaheer Jaffery

items.title: Khayal e sughra
items.body:
khayaal e sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar aayi aane ko hai khaafila
to sughra ne qalbe hazeen se kaha
tadapne se rone se ab kaam kya
tera shukriya rab ada kaise ho
ke bichde huon ko milaata hai tu
phir uth kar ye ghazi ki maa se kaha
chalo amma aaya hai kunba mera
<<DIVIDER>>
ab mai kahan roti hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
ujaale meri simt badhne lage
ke baba hussain aaj ghar aa rahe hai
mai baba ko dekhungi to jee uthungi
balayein sakina ki asghar ki lungi
bahot khush hoo aata hai akbar mera
ab mai kahan roti hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai baba ke jhuk kar qadam choom lungi
bhulaya mujhe unse shikwa karungi
na tum aaye baba na ghar aaye akbar
na paate hamein dayr hoti jo dam bhar
tum aaye karun kyun na shukre khuda
ab mai kahan roti hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajaalun mai akbar ka hujra zara
suna hai mera bhai dulha bana
na yaad aayi behna hai dil mein chuban
magar khush hoo layega akbar dulhan
to saaya karungi mai quran ka
ab mai kahan roti hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
na pyasi ho meri sakina kahin
hai pehla safar aur jalti zameen
na garmi se sookhe huwe ho galay
banalun mai sharbat sabhi ke liye
pilayenge ghar aake sab ko chacha
ab mai kahan roti hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo guzri phupi ko bataungi mai
galay mil ke amma se roungi mai
liye hongi asghar ko chadar talay
ke nanhi se jaan zer e saaya rahe
meri godh mein hoga asghar mera
ab mai kahan roti hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
achanak utha shor aaye haram
badhi kehke sughra elaahi karam
galay mil ke ghazi ki maa se kaha
chalo amma aaya hai kunba mera
na ro'o khudara khushi ki hai jaa
ab mai kahan roti hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo nikli to aahon ka toofan tha
nazar aaya ujda hua khaafila
jo ghash khaake wo gham ki maari giri
to naaqe se maa ki amaari giri
kabhi phir na goonji fiza mein sada
ab mai kahan roti hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
madine ki galyion mein ab bhi samar
ye dekha hai phat'ta hai gham se jigar
fiza saari ashkon se bheegi hui
ye kehti hai sughra to ab na rahi
hai khamosh honton pe nauha raza
ab mai kahan roti hoo...

items.body:

laash abbas ki sarwar se...

ye to ghurbat hai tere laal ki ay umme rabab
warna naize pe koi laash uthayi na gayi
laash abbas ki sarwar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar laasha e qasim ko ye farwa ne kaha
aisi baraat kisi dulha ki aayi na gayi
laash abbas ki sarwar se...

kar diye bhai pe qurban pisar zainab ne
phir kabhi rasm ye dunya may nibhayi na gayi
laash abbas ki sarwar se...

chauda sadiyon se bahate hai samandar aansu

laash abbas ki sarwar se...

baad e shabbir hua seena ba seena matam

jaise maa roti hai kuch aise sakina royi

items.title: Maa ko salaam
items.body:
nusrate shaah mein har dard bhari maa ko salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
ek wo maa wohi athara baras waale ki maa
jis ne marne ke liye bhej diya apna jawan
naiza seene mein laga lut gaye saare armaan
shakl laila mein usi sabr ke quran ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek wo maa ke pisar jiska tha nanha sa sagheer
jiske bacche ko mila pani ke badle ek teer
jisne khud bante huwe dekhi thi qabr e baysheer
ay rabab aap ko aur kushta e paikan ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek shabbar ki wo bewa wo umme farwa
jisne tukde huwe qasim ka sarapa dekha
ashk barsaati rahi par kabhi shikwa na kiya
bibi farwa ko aur us kushta e aspa ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…

zainabe khasta jigar aun o mohamed ki wo maa
bhai par sadqe kiye jisne do maahe taaban
laashein jab qaime mein aaye kiya shukre yazdan
jis mein zehra ki shabahat thi usi maa ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
laash jab ausaja ki aayi dar e qaima par
zauja e ausaja ne bhej diya apna pisar
haye wo chota sipahi wo bhayanak lashkar
tha ye jiske liye jazba usi insan ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…

ay rabab aap pe ye dohri musibat aayi
halq asghar ka chida qaid sakina bhi hui
godh mein apni jala jhoola liye baithi rahi
karbala mein jo bacha tha usi saaman ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein to har ek maa ka yehi jazba tha
pisar e zehra pe hojaye pisar mera fida
aaj ke daur mein jis maa mein bhi hai ye jazba
uski mamta ko salaam uske har armaan ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
gar tumhe nemat e aulaad khuda se ho ataa
lashkar e shaah ka tum usko sipahi kehna
uska har haal mein mazboot aqeeda rakhna
us se kehna ke kare waaris e quran ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
majid un maa'on pe hum sab ke ho maa baap fida
shadman rehti thi jo nusrat e sarwar mein sada
sheh pe qurban kiya apne jigar ka gosha
aise bacchon pe salaam aisi har ek maa ko salaam
maa ko salaam
nusrate shaah mein…

items.title: Mar gaya sher darya
items.body:
mar gaya sher darya pe jaa kar
ran mein kisko pukaregi zainab
dilbar e fatema tere sadqe
tujhko kaise bachayegi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
thi jis se qalb ko quwwat guzar gaya hae hae
nigahein dhoond rahi hai kidhar gaya hae hae
lab e faraat mera sher mar gaya hae hae
apne bhai ko ahle sitam se
haye kaise bachayegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
hujoom e ahle sitam aur ali ka noor e nazar
sipaahe shaam ke lashkar mein mustafa ka qamar
hadh e nigaah talak ahle zulm ahle shar
is qayamat mein afsos kis ko
sheh ka munis banayegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb yaas se takti hai chehra e sarwar
na bhai bhanje bete na munis o yawar
na ab hai aun o mohamed na qasim o jafar
behre imadad ghurbat mein ghazi
bolo kisko bulayegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
faza e nehr haram ki sada se goonjti hai
chale bhi aao ke aale rasool pyasi hai
tadap ke zainab e nashaad bas ye kehti hai
hai yateem baad tere baradar
bahi ko ro na payegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere jari teri ghairat ko hai salaam mera
tujhe ghareeb baradar ka kitna dhyan raha
janaza sheh ko na laane diya suye qaima
itna batlade kaise tera gham
apne dil pe uthayegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
qawi thay tere hi dam se imam ke baazu
huwe hai kham teri furqat se zeest ke gaysu
shikasta hogaya umeed e aal ka pehlu
ab tere baad waada hai tujhse
laashe akbar uthayegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rida bhi sar pe na howegi ay mere safdar
hujoom e dard o alam aur qalb e khasta jigar
har ek qadam nayi mushkil jafa shiyar ka darr
aise aalam mein itna bata do
shaam kis tarha jayegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
nigahein phayr li kyunkar mere ghayoor jari
utho utho zara uth kar khabar lo tum be keen
sada e dayam o yazdan labe ghareeb pa thi
baad tere nishan e mazalim
haye kisko dikhayegi zainab
mar gaya sher darya pe...

items.title: Nahi tha kuch bhi
items.body:
nahi tha kuch bhi hussain tab hai
<<DIVIDER>>
quran jis ko qadar hai likhta
hussain logon wohi to shab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...

wo jiske nana ki jutiyon ka
tawaf karte ho farishte
wo jiske dada ke zer e saaya
rasool e haq aur imam palte
koi to dikhlao is jahan mein
ke jiska aisa hasab nasab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...

mere khayalon ki inteha se
hussain ki ibteda hui hai
sha'oor o fiqr o nazar ke daaghon
se jiski basti badi hui hai
hussain tum ko samajh mein aaye
qasam khuda ki bahot ajab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...

wo jiske tewar khuda ke tewar
wo jiski bakshish khuda ki bakshish
bahishton uski khushi ke peeche
wajood e dozakh ho jiski ranjish
na khaufe dozakh na shauke jannat
hussain ki bas hamay talab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...

wo jo ke baad'az khuda hai sab se
azeem izzat ye bhi badi hai
hussain ki maa ko dekh kar wo
rasool tazeem mein khade hai
rasool e aazam pe jiski maadar
ka dekho wajib hua adab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...

sina ko doshe nabi samajh ke
namaz e wehdat ada kare jo
yazeediyat ke bhawar ke aage
chataan ban ke utha kare jo
hayaat e deen e khuda ka sunlo
hussain ibne ali sabab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye adl e parwardigar e aalam
ki ek ajab si ada hai dekho
khuda ne sab kuch diya hai jisko
usi se sab kuch liya hai dekho
khuda to khaliq hai imtehan ka
hussain sabr o raza ka rab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
faraat ki har leher nidamat
se pani pani hui salamat
hayaat e kausar ki kar rahi thi
rawani e alqama tilawat
sairaab jis ne kiya hai deen ko
wo ibne zahra to tashnalab hai
hussain kaise kahan o kab hai
nahi tha kuch bhi...

items.title: Pardes hai ghurbat
items.body:
muslim ke dulaare
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes hai ghurbat hai muslim ke dulaare hai
hai door watan dono taqdeer ke maare hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bichda hai pidar jab se dono pe musibat hai
bhooke hai kayi din ke aur pyaas ki shiddat hai
jaayein to kahan jaayein ye soch ke rote hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal apna batane ko hamdard kahan paayein
anjaan hai kufe se jaayein to kahan jaayein
chup chup ke wo pardesi din raat bitaate hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chote ko bada bhai godi mein uthaata hai
bhai ka safar bhai aasaan banaata hai
mil jayega ab rasta ye soch ke chalte hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer yateemon ko din rat sataati hai
aur baap ki furqat bhi dono ko rulaati hai
kufe mein bhatakte hai aur ashk bhaate hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dono ke baal uljhe kapde bhi huwe maile
koi bhi nahi aisa aa kar ke jo ye pooche
ye soye nahi kab se aur kab ke ye jaage hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa kar ke koi inko seene se laga leta
aur raah madine ki dono ko bata deta
ye dono musafir hai hyder ke dulaare hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek pal bhi ajal inke peeche se nahi hat'ti
aur ranj o musibat ki badli bhi nahi ghat'ti
do phool se bacche hai aur maut ke saaye hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dono musafir thay pardes mein bewaaris
jab kar ke giraftaari le kar ke chala haaris
rukh kar ke madine ka amma ko bulaate hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
haaris ne yateemon par waiz jo sitam dhaaye
wo zulm ali kaise reh reh ke na yaad aaye
talwaar hai zaalim ki aur chand se bacche hai
pardes hai ghurbat hai...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Aaj saaya baap ka
items.body:
uth gaya zainab ke sar se aaj saaya baap ka
ab na dekhegi kabhi ghamkhaar chehra baap ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat e aakhir ki manzil hai elaahi khair ho
hai qayamat ghar se jaata hai janaza baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya nabi allah behre fatema aa jaiye
aan ke de dijiye bachon ko pursa baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
baam o dar arshe elaahi ke larazte hai udhar
padh rahi hai zainab o kulsoom nauha baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyon ko sabr ki talqeen koi kya kare
saamne jis waqt ke rakha ho laasha baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye re aulaad e zehra ki ghareebi al amaan
waqt ne kaisa diya ghurbat may sadma baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha ashkon ko roke fatema ki betiyan
khoon may dooba hua dekha hai chehra baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
beh padegi chashm be-saaqta ashk e furaat
yaad jab aa jayega beti ko lehja baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek beti zakhmi sar ko dekhti thi baar baar
ek beti dekhti hai zakhmi seena baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam o yazdan likhe kaise bahot dushwar hai
betiyon ke saath jo hota hai rishta baap ka
uth gaya zainab ke sar se...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Ab watan jaa rahi
items.body:
ab watan jaa rahi hoon ay bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bekas behan ka tha nauha
shamiyon ne bula ke karbobala
mere bhai ko zibha kar daala
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
asre ashoor ko na akbar tha
aur na abbas sa baradar tha
sheh ka pamaal kar diya laasha
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo masayeb uthayi hai zainab
qaid mein jaa ke aayi hai zainab
apna waada nibhayi hai zainab
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e bazaar phir ke aayi hoon
bhare darbar jaa ke aayi hoon
sabr ki inteha dikhayi hoon
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal e karbala ka har manzar
naqsh hai haye mere seene par
kaise maara gaya mera akbar
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki turbat pe pehle jaaungi
saari roodad e gham sunaungi
neel baazu ke bhi dikhaungi
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogi bas intezar mein sughra
bolo bhaiya usay kahun kya kya
dil bahot beqaraar hai mera
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahe thay kaleem ahle aza
aa rahi thi sada e wavaila
bain karti thi saani e zehra
maa ko sab kuch sunaungi jaa kar
ab watan jaa rahi...
items.author: Qaiser Kaleem

items.title: Akbar ko sada deti
items.body:
akbar ko sada deti thi maa sholon mein ghir kar
kab aaoge akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate hai mere sar se rida leke sitamgar
kab aaoge akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
gharabayi hui phirti hai maa qaime ke andar
be-maqna o chadar
ab aag mein jalne ko hai gehwara e asghar
kab aaoge akbar
akbar ko sada deti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt se sholon ne hamay ghayr liya hai
aur tez hawa hai
aajao ke jalne ko hai sajjad ka bistar
kab aaoge akbar
akbar ko sada deti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zad par hai tamachon ki wo hai naizon ki zad par
hai sholon ki zad par
kaano se sakina ke khiche jaate hai gohar
kab aaoge akbar
akbar ko sada deti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo haal hai kis ko hai khabar kaun kahan hai
har simt dhuaan hai
sakte mein hai zainab bhi khadi qaime ke dar par
kab aaoge akbar
akbar ko sada deti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein dhuwein ke siwa paati nahi kuch bhi
milta nahi koi
ek qaime se ek qaime mein jaati hoon khule sar
kab aaoge akbar
akbar ko sada deti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beta mai sitamgaaron se sar kaise chupaun
aakhir kahan jaaun
andar hai lagi aag adoo qaimon ke baahar
kab aaoge akbar
akbar ko sada deti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
girti hai rahi khaak se uth'ti rahi laila
ek hashr tha barpa
nauha tha naved uske labon par ye barabar
kab aaoge akbar
akbar ko sada deti thi...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Ali se behtar
items.body:
bayan karne ko yun to dunya
sharaf bayan karti hai sabhi ke
magar jo akhle saleem rakhta hai jaanta hai
siwa nabi ke nahi hai koi ali se behtar
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
hunain o badr o ohad se poocho
amal ke do neem sar se poocho
ali ki do ungliyo ki taaqat
hai kya ye khyber ke dar se poocho
qasam khuda ki misaale hyder
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghadeer se jab ke maine poocha
hai tujhko maloom saar kissa
siwa ali ke hai aur koi
banaya jis ko nabi ne maula
tadap ke bola ye qum ka mimbar
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki talwaar chal rahi hai
nabi ka chehra damak raha hai
koi data hai ohad may koi
nazar bacha kar sarak raha hai
nabi ke paas ab siwaye hyder
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
lagaye wo naara e salooni
madina e ilm ka jo dar ho
nabi ke farmaan ke mutabiq
jidhar ko mud jaye haq udhar ho
siwaye hyder ke aisa rehbar
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
chali jo binte asad ko bad kar
dewaare kaaba ye boli has kar
isi tarha aur isi jagah par
khadi thi ek din ek aur maadar
magar tumhare sharaf se bad kar
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
patak rahi hai sar apna mauje
kataye baazu pada hai saqqa
ajeeb aalam hai bekasi ka
hussain ran may khade hai tanha
alam alamdaar aur lashkar
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
sina kaleje pe khaaye beta
pyasa karwat badal raha hai
hussain hasrat se dekhte hai
jawan ka dam nikal raha hai
sahara dede zara jo bad kar
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
tamaam bhai bhatije bete
pade hai maqtal may sar kataye
tamam saathi bichad chuke hai
koi nahi jo mada ko aaye
khade hai ran may akele sarwar
koi nahi hai koi nahi
siwa nabi ke…

items.title: Ay mere baba jaan
items.body:
maqtal ke sannate mein
nauha karti hai naadan
ay mere baba jaan
ay mere baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
baaki nahi ab mere
jeene ka koi imkaan
ay mere baba jaan
ay mere baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal hainghar bhi nahi hai
koi yawar bhi nahi hai
ab to akbar bhi nahi hai
sar par chadar bhi nahi hai
yun hi ab qaidi ho kar
jaana hai mujhko zindan
ay mere baba jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab se khaati hoo tamache
dono aariz hai neele
pehnaye thay jo bunde
wo bhi aada ne cheene
beti ki haalat dekho
zakhmi hai dono hi kaan
ay mere baba jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
loota qaima bhi ghar bhi
gehwara bhi bistar bhi
maqna bhi aur chadar bhi
hasli bhi aur gauhar bhi
aada ne aag laga kar
loote hai ghar ke saaman
ay mere baba jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye akbar ki mayyat hai
wo asghar ki turbat hai
ye farwa ki hasrat hai
wo zainab ki ghairat hai
bikhre pade hai ran mein
zehra ke dil ke armaan
ay mere baba jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum thay ahmed ke nawase
doori thi kya darya se
zabha huwe kyun pyase
batlaun kya dunya se
tum ko kalmagoyo ne
maara bula ke mehman
ay mere baba jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hai ammu ke baazu
ye hai akbar ke gaysu
qasim bikhre hai har soo
mai hoo aur mere aansu
kal tak thi is maqtal mein
mere kunbe ki kya shaan
ay mere baba jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe mein ghabraungi
kyun kar himmat laaungi
balwe mein sharmaungi
ghairat se mar jaungi
rukh par matti hi mal do
hone na paaye pehchaan
ay mere baba jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
majalis mein jab aate hai
ashk e gham barsaate hai
matam mein kho jaate hai
rote hai rulwaate hai
nayyar aur aamir ki tum
mushkil kar dena aasaan
ay mere baba jaan...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Azan hai mustafa
items.body:
azaan hai mustufa aur murtaza meri iqamat hai
yehi mazhab hai mera aur yehi meri ibadat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kyun shabbir ki daryadili par hurr ko hairat hai
khatayein baksh dena is gharane ki to aadat hai
azaan hai mustufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aseeri beridayi hai atash hai sar hai naizon par
zara dekho nabi ki aal par kaisi qayamat hai
azaan hai mustufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
sahara do zara abbas aa kar apne bhai ko
zaeefi hai nakahat hai jawan bete ki mayyat hai
azaan hai mustufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
isay to dedo pani sheh ye farmate thay aada se
bhala cheh maah ke bacche se tum ko kya adawat hai
azaan hai mustufa...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan hai karbala uqba mein hai baaghe iram mehshar
yahan bhi ek jannat hai wahan bhi ek jannat hai
azaan hai mustufa...
items.author: Mehshar Lakhnavi

items.title: Bain karta hua khaak
items.body:
bain karta hua khaak udata hua
tashana lab be-rida lo chala khaafla
sun ke shor e fughan ek kohram hai
bar sare karbala lo chala khaafla
<<DIVIDER>>
rasm e parda gari jiske ghar se chali
shaahzadi wohi be-rida hogayi
mar na jaye kahin gham se binte ali
haye ab hoga kya lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni surat dikha do mujhe meri jaan
phir khuda jaane aana ho ya ke na ho
aao akbar utho hum ko ruqsat karo
maa ne ro kar kaha lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
saani e fatema binte sher e khuda
kaise bazaar mein jayegi be-rida
kaise tay hoga wo shaam ka raasta
ro rahi hai faza lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyar se jisko paala tha shabbir ne
usko jakda gaya tauq o zanjeer se
raah purkhaar par pa barehna safar
kaise hoga bhala lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
raakh qaime huwe sab asasa luta
be-sahara payambar ka kunba hua
shaam e ghurbat ke qaidi chale shaam ko
le chale ashkiyan lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai nabi zadiyan sar khule be-rida
kya ghazab hogaya kya sitam hogaya
be kajawa sawari aur aal e aba
shor e matam utha lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
jinki chahat pe kaunain ko naaz hai
jis ka saani zamane mein koi nahi
chaahne waale wo bhai aur wo behan
ho rahe hai juda lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaar jaanib se ye aa rahi hai sada
alvida alvida alvida alvida
apne pyaron ke laashon se ho kar juda
khoon rota hua lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal us waqt ka kaise gohar likhe
dekh kar suye maqtal sabhi ro diye
sab shaheedon ke laashe tadapne lage
jab ye aayi sada lo chala khaafla
bain karta hua...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Beqarar hai maadar
items.body:
beqarar hai maadar haye jal gaya jhoola
haye jal gaya jhoola haye jal gaya jhoola
<<DIVIDER>>
uski yaad jab aati dekh kar sukoon paati
sabr aayega kyun kar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh ho gayi khaali qatl ho gaya waali
kis se mai kahun jaa kar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon ban ke sadmon se beh raha hai aankhon se
dil pe chal gaya khanjar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis qadar hai sannata kuch nazar nahi aata
hai dhuaan dhuaan manzar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ke dil se aankhon tak jiski raakh phaili hai
wo nishani e asghar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehla zakhm ye khaaya wo na laut kar aaya
doosra laga nashtar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise din guzarungi bas yehi pukarungi
khaak ho gaya bistar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoolna hai na-mumkin yaad aayega har din
kaise dil karun patthar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay suroor wo muztar bezuban ki turbat par
keh rahi thi ro ro kar haye jal gaya jhoola
beqaraar hai maadar...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Chand qadmon se sakina
items.body:
chand qadmon se sakina ne ye manzar dekha
shimr ka baba pe chalt ahua khanjar dekhka
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par girti rahi bachi dehekte ran may
baap ki zulfon may jab daste sitamgar dekha
chand qadmon se sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm to ye hai ke qatl karne se pehle usne
maar kar beti ko shabbir ko has kar dekha
chand qadmon se sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera zarbon se zyada hussain tadpe jab
shimr ke zulm se neela rukhe dukhtar dekha
chand qadmon se sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok le haath to shayad wo na phir waar kare
sheh ki gardan pe gala beti ne rakh kar dekha
chand qadmon se sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah chain se soti rahi wo yasrab may
chalni teeron se sakina ne wo bistar dekha
chand qadmon se sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
door tak bibi ne daudayi thi apni nazrein
na kahin ghazi nazar aaye na akbar dekha
chand qadmon se sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap par chalti hui dekhi jo zarbein mohsin
ek masooma ne karbal may yun mehshar dekha
chand qadmon se sakina ne...
items.author: Mohsin Riyaz

items.title: Dil mein ghame
items.body:
dil mein ghame hussain basaye hue hai hum
yun saari kayenat pe chaye hue hai hum
<<DIVIDER>>
raushan kiye jo dashte bala mein hussain ne
wo sab charaagh dil mein jalaye hue hai hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
hairat se hum ko dekh rahi hai balandiyan
baatil ka har nishan mitaye hue hai hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab dil nahi hai seene mein ek aaftab hai
seene se kiske gham ko lagaye hue hai hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo aur honge jinko hai jannat ki aarzoo
jannat hamara haq hai jo paaye hue hai hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
bach bach ke kyun na guzre zamane ki gardishe
abbas ke alam ko uthaye hue hai hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
bete bhatije bhanje aur bhai mar gaye
kis kis ta daagh dil pe uthaye hue hai hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
rauze pe sayyeda ke ye zainab ke bain thay
amma utho ke door se aaye hue hai hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sab tufail e aale mohamed hai ay urooj
dunya mein ye urooj jo paaye hue hum
dil mein ghame hussain…
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Fizza na ye batana
items.body:
ek roz roke fizza se zehra ne ye kaha
pehlu shikasta ho gaya tumko hai bas pata
ye raaz raaz rakhna ke tooti hai phasliyan
fizza meri musibatein karna na tum bayan
fizza na ye batana
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu hua shikasta fizza na ye batana
hyder se meri ghurbat lillaah tum chupana
fizza na ye batana
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu hua shikasta tum ko bhi na bataati
zehra tumhe madad ko hazrgiz na phir bulaati
mushkil agar na hota dar ko mera uthana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se hua hai fizza pehlu mera shikasta
pehlu se haath mera uth'ta nahi hai fizza
bachon ko chaahti hoo apne galay lagana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
<<DIVIDER>>
deewar o dar may pis kar mohsin bhi mar gaya hai
tooti hai phasliyan sab darwaza yun gira hai
ye raaz raaz rakhna bachon se bhi chipana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu ka dard mujhko har aan maarta tha
pehlu ke tootne se mushkil tha saans lena
tadpi hoo dard se mai kitna nahi batana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
<<DIVIDER>>
be parda shaamiyon may jayegi meri beti
tum aaj se ay fizza goya ke maa ho iski
zainab ke saath tumko bazaar bhi hai jaana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jaanti ho fizza lagti hai pyaas usko
mera hussain shab may awaaz de jo mujhko
pani mere pisar ko fizza tum hi pilaana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
<<DIVIDER>>
badle ali ke shaami beti se meri lenge
jis waqt laadli ko pathar meri lagenge
zainab ke badle pathar fizza tumhe hai khaana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
<<DIVIDER>>
danish rehan tumse razi rahenge hyder
kausar ka jaam denge tum ko ba-roze mehshar
zahra ki tum musibat har gaam par sunana
fizza na ye batana
pehlu hua shikasta...
items.author: Danish Mirza

items.title: Haye asghar kya
items.body:
haye asghar kya karoon ay jane madar kya karoon
<<DIVIDER>>
thi ye bano ki fughan dunya mein reh kar kya karoon
maut ne barbad kar dala mera ghar kya karoon
hai rage jaa ke liye har sans nashtar kya karoon
hasraton ka dil mein ek barpa hai mehshar kya karoon
haye asghar kya karoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere noor e nazar tumko agar pa'ungi mai
dekh lena raat bhar seene se lipta'ungi mai
surk phoolon se chaman gulshan ke mehka'ungi mai
ab na bhejungi tumhe mai ghar se baahar kya karoon
haye asghar kya karoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum samajhte ho yahan se apne ghar ja'ungi mai
chor kar tanha tumhe beta kidhar ja'ungi mai
qabr se takrake sar jangal mein mar jau'ngi mai
phayr loon kyon na galay par apne khanjar kya karoon
haye asghar kya karoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch nahi tum ko khabar sheh ka makaan loota gaya
sayedde abrar ka ran mein makaan loota gaya
dashte ghurbat mein hussaini kaarwan loota gaya
ab na akbar hai na abbase dilawar kya karoon
haye asghar kya karoon...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ne khud loriyan di neend laane ke liye
ran mein aaye zalzale jhoola jhulane ke liye
tum chale maidan mein kaise teer khane ke liye
ab tumhe turbat se gehware mein laa kar kya karoon
haye asghar kya karoon...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Hussainun
items.body:
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
dilon par hai likha hua karbala
hussain ya hussainan hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
muqaddas duaon ke paale hai hum
ke farshe aza ke ujaale hai hum
zamana bohat dekhe bhaale hai hum
sitam se kahan darne waale hai hum
hame de gayi hausla karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
azadaron tum haq ki jaanib badho
hussaini ho khud ko hussaini kaho
chalo raahe karbobala par chalo
ke izzat se jeene ka waada karo
tumhe de rahi hai dua karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hame fakhr hai hum azadaar hai
shahadat dilon ke parastaar hai
sar apna katane ko tayyar hai
hai zanjeer mein phir bhi mukhtar hai
ke hum par hai teri ata karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasam khao dil dil se jodenge hum
hussain aap se moo na modenge hum
kaleje se barchi ko todenge hum
yazeedon ko zinda na chodenge hum
dil o jaan tujh par fida karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain aap hai mustafa ka jamaal
tamanna e zehra ali ka kamaal
libaas e bashar mein khuda ka jalaal
khuda ki tarha hashr tak be-misaal
yaqeenan hai ek maujiza karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek mulk me hai hussaini nishan
hai masroof majlis mein har ek zaban
jahan dekhiye farshe gham hai wahan
hai kitna bada haq ka ye karwan
hai phaili hui jaa baja karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
faza majlison ki hai kitni bhali
har ek zindagi hai wafa mein dhali
hawa zikre sarwar ki aisi chali
sada aayi har simt se ya ali
kaha badh ke kaabe ne ya karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
juda ab bhi bharat teri shaan hai
yahan laal zehra ka mehman hai
ye ganga bhi ashkon ka wardaan hai
ho pyason pe qurban ye armaan hai
hai hindu ke ghar taziya karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho nayyar pe aamir pe ya rab karam
salamat rahe ye zaban ye qalam
saron par hamare rahe ye alam
ke naslon mein baaqi rahe sheh ka gham
jo aaye unhe bhi dikha karbala
hamare lahoo ki sada karbala
hussain ya hussainan...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Jal chuke qaime
items.body:
jal chuke qaime yateemon ke andhera reh gaya
raat roti reh gayi rota savera reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jo baraati bach gaye wo qaid hoke chal diye
saare dasht e nainawa may ek dulha reh gaya
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaadgarein reh gayi do maadar e asghar ke paas
ek kurta khoon bhara aur ek jhoola reh gaya
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme laila ro ke boli shaah e deen jaldi chalo
nok pe barchi ki akbar ka kaleja reh gaya
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra e akbar ki ladiyan khoon may tar hogayi
haye sughra ka har ek armaan adhoora reh gaya
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab hi laashon ko utha kar chal diye kufe ke log
tapti reti par mohamed ka nawasa reh gaya
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
phool zahra ke chaman se sab hi tode jaa chuke
jalte qaimon may bas ek bemaar tanha reh gaya
jal chuke qaime...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule zainab chali qaimon se ye keh kar raza
khanjaron ki bheed may bhai akela reh gaya
jal chuke qaime...
items.author: Raza Sirsvi

items.title: Karbala walon
items.body:
karbala waalon
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhara gham rahe zinda hamesha karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko zahra karbala waalon
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo mein doob kar apne kiya sairaab darya ko
tumhari pyaas ka ab tak hai charcha karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi pyasa nahi dunya mein ab itni sabeelein hai
tumhara hogaya saara zamana karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum apne marne waalon ka bhi gham karte nahi is mein
moharram hai tumhara aur rahega karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
imam e asr se keh do kisi surat chale aaye
sakina shaam mein ab tak hai tanha karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda par baat aa jaaye to sar pyara nahi karte
sikhaya tumne ye sab ko saleekha karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare naam ki majlis har ek shadi mein hoti hai
khushi mein bhi tumhara gham hai taaza karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhara marte dam tak rasta takti rahi sughra
madine tum nahi aaye dobara karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kitne din karti rahi hai dhoop sehra ki
tumhare bekafan laashon pe saaya karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki betiyon ke saath pathar tum ne khaye hai
gaye naizon pe tum shaam o kufa karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin pani pilaane par takallum ko bhi rakh lena
jahan mein aaoge jab tum dobara karbala waalon
duayein deti hai tum sab ko...
tumhara gham rahe zinda...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Laash akbar ki jo
items.body:
laash akbar ki jo maqtal se utha laaye hussain
par lahoo seene ka maa se na chupa paaye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
yun sajega tera sehra yun lagegi mehndi
ran se kya haaton pe akbar ki racha laaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ghurbat ki ghadi noore nazar bhi na raha
bekasi roti hai keh keh ke tujhe haye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa phupi roti hai laashe pe ali akbar ke
kaun hai mere siwa unko jo samjhaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye peeri may jawan laal tadapta dekha
apne yusuf ko kyun is dasht may le aaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
laal zainab ne kiye sadqe ali akbar ke
maut akbar ki talay aur na gham khaaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahe qaside sughra se ke akbar na rahe
bekhabar bete ko kya soch ke ghabraye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap zinda rahe beta ho jahan se ruqsat
haif jeene may kahan haye na mar jaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shauq e ziarat may ye jeete hai hassan aur ahasan
rashq kismat jo hamay rauze pe bulwaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
items.author: Hassan Abbas Rizvi

items.title: Maa mujhe neend
items.body:
maa ko jalte huwe qaimon mein wo tadpati hai
ek ujdi hui turbat se sada aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
seene lagalo lori suna do mujhko sulado maa
maa mujhe neend aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban mein asghar ne ran se pukara maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat hai pehli qabr ke andar kaise rahunga tanha
tera aanchal paas nahi hai kis se bhala khelunga
tu hai kahan par ye to bata de kyun hai andhera maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
uski kya aulaad nahi thi pani tha jis se maanga
jis se giraate hai naaqon ko teer wo mujhko maara
zulm to dekho teer wo mere qadh se bada tha maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri qasam maa teer galay par kha kar mai nahi tadpa
dekh ke behta khoon mere moo se baba roye mai nahi roya
lekin ay maa teer se mujhko dard hua tha maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti zameen par mujhko lita kar qabr banayi meri
sabr se baba jaan ne aadhi laash chupayi meri
lekin matti daal ke moo par ro diye baba maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya ali akbar se zyada zakhmi hai mera seena
sehm gaya dil chaunk gaya mai naiza jo mujhko maara
mai to sukoon se qabr mein apni soya hua tha maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhhri kaam tu kar de ye mera qabr bana de meri
ghodon se pamaal na kar de laash chupa de meri
kaat ke sar ko le gaye zaalim reh gaya laasha maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize se sajjad tadap kar maa se asghar bole
kaise utha'ti godh mein mujhko maa tu bandhe haathon se
shaam se pehle mar gaya mai bhi acha hua na maa
maa neend aati hai neend aati hai
maa mujhe neend aati hai...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Mar gaya tu jo
items.body:
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaya tu jo meri jaan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
kya isi din ke waaste beta
tujhko athara saal paala tha
yun na le mera imtehan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu na hoga to kaun bolega
mere haathon ko kaun kholega
jab satayengi rassiyan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaudvi shab ke maahtab ki maut
haye ye aalam e shabab ki maut
tujhko royega ek jahan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun na bichde kisi ka laal jawan
ye jo awaaz aa rahi hai yahan
hai teri maa ki siskiyan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao zindan hai bahot soona
waqt hai ye namaz ka beta
qaid khane mein do azan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere seene se khinch chuka naiza
aake mehdi mera nikalega
mere dil mein hai jo sina akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ne hashim bahot kiya israr
mat bichad jaan e syed e abraar
kya rahega mera yahan akbar
maa tujhe payegi kahan akbar
mar gaya tu jo...
items.author: Hashim Raza

items.title: Pardes mein ghar
items.body:
pardes mein ghar lut gaya bano ki thi faryad
ay sayyade sajjad
pardes mein ghar…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ke bina hogayi dunya meri barbad
ay sayyade sajjad
pardes mein ghar…
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ki judaai mein hai zainab ka bura haal
kubra bhi hai behaal
laila ka jigar chalni hai farwa bhi hai nashaad
ay sayyade sajjad
pardes mein ghar…
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar hai na asghar hai na ab shaahe mubeen hai
har samt layeen hai
tumhi mere waris bhi ho tumhi meri aulaad
ay sayyade sajjad
pardes mein ghar…
<<DIVIDER>>
raton ko bhi aksar jo sakina nahi soti
uth uth ke hai roti
aankhon mein phira karte ho shayad sitam ejaad
ay sayyade sajjad
pardes mein ghar…
<<DIVIDER>>
parde hai amari hai na chadar na saron par
khushki hai labon par
rassi ki ghiraft se koi baazu nahi azaad
ay sayyade sajjad
pardes mein ghar…
items.author: Hasnain Jaffery

items.title: Aaj zainab yateem
items.body:
kufe ki galiyon mein kohraam hai
uth gaya baap ka sar se saaya
aaj zainab yateem ho gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahe hai ye mehrab o mimbar
keh rahe hai ye jibreel ro kar
ibne muljim ne ye zulm dhaaya
aaj zainab yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh par mustafa ro rahe hai
sab ke sab ambiya ro rahe hai
hai farishton mein kohraam barpa
aaj zainab yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise unneeswi ki sahar thi
ye sahar ek gham ki pahar thi
ibne muljim sitam tu ne dhaaya
aaj zainab yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi kulsoom ko de dilaasa
aur tadapti hai gham se khadija
maula abbas karte hai girya
aaj zainab yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne hai log kufe mein aise
jin ke maula ne dukh dard baate
chin gaya aaj unka maseeha
aaj zainab yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar mein farsh e aza bich gaya hai
aaj kufe mein matam bapa hai
sogh mein dooba ghar sayyeda ka
aaj zainab yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth raha hai janaza ali ka
ek mehshar ka aalam hai barpa
sab ke honton pe hai ek nauha
aaj zainab yateem...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain karte hai farhan o mazhar
farsh e majlis pe ye baat keh kar
dijiye apni bibi ko pursa
aaj zainab yateem...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Ab wo lashkar hai
items.body:
sar jhuka kar shahe waala se ye ghazi ne kaha
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to tanhaai ke hamle hai ghamon ke dere
sar kataye huwe sote hai sipaahi mere
dam ulajhta hai mera qaidi e aazaar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi ehsaas kiye rehta hai mujhko bechain
mere hote huwe pyase rahe tiflaane hussain
ab ye aalam hai mera jeene se bezaar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere maalik o mukhtar shahenshaah e umam
do mujhe izn tumhe pyasi sakina ki qasam
nehr ki samt rawan hone ko tayyar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tamanna hai mere dil mein ujaagar kar doo
zindagi aap ke bachon pa nichawar kar doo
roz e awwal khuda e shahe abraar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekasi zauf o naqaahat nahi dekhi jaati
pyase bachon ki ye haalat nahi dekhi jaati
jaan dene ke liye bachon pa tayyar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamzada bekas o mazloom hazeena ke liye
jaan jaati hai chali jaaye sakina ke liye
aap ka aap ke bachon ka wafadaar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ka izn jo mil jaaye shehenshaah e hazeen
nehr qaime mein na laaun to mai abbas nahi
jis ko maanga tha ali ne wohi jarraar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rone lage us waqt shahe nek hizaal
jis ghadi sher e dilaawar ne farmeina bilal
aap par jaan fida karne ka haqdaar hoo mai
ab wo lashkar hai kahan jis ka alamdar hoo mai
sar jhuka kar...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Abbas utho mai
items.body:
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ki wasiyat yaad karo
mujh bekas ki imdad karo
chinti hai mere sar se chadar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna gehra sannata hai
wehshat se jigar tharrata hai
is jangal mein mai jaun kidhar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal mein sakina khoyi hai
kya jaane kahan wo soyi hai
dhoondun mai kahan usko jaa kar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pe ye kaisa waqt aaya
hum khaak pe baithe hai bhaiya
hai qabre paymabar zer o zabar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kab se bulati hoon tum ko
faryad sunati hoon tum ko
aa jao tarayi se uth kar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghosh e imamat ke paale
ay mere rida ke rakhwale
balwe mein khadi hoon nange sar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukh dard ke baadal chaate hai
jab shaahe huda yaad aate hai
chalte hai mere dil par khanjar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman mein koi dilbar bhi nahi
hadh ye hai ali asghar bhi nahi
akbar bi gaye barchi khaa kar
abbas utho mai lut'ti hoon
abbas utho...

items.title: Akbar mein naiza
items.body:
reh gaya jab seena e akbar mein naiza dayr tak
maut se ladta raha laila ka beta dayr tak
<<DIVIDER>>
saath mein noore nazar ke noor nazron ka gaya
thokre khaate rahe maqtal mein maula dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena e akbar se khayncha sheh ne keh kar ya ali
dil mein uljha jab nikal paaya na naiza dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath mein barchi ke nikla jab ali akbar ka dil
banke aansu khoone dil aankhon se nikla dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ragad kar aediyan be-jaan akbar hogaye
sheh ki aankhon mein raha chaaya andhera dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth na paayi jab zaeefi mein jawan bete ki laash
apni mazloomi pa roye ibne zehra dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
le ke sheh kuch door aage badh gaye phir rakh diya
jab na sambhla naujawan bete ka laasha dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
le ke boodha baap jab aaya jawan bete ki laash
qaima e sheh mein hua kohraam barpa dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise le jaaye jawan ki laash maa ke saamne
yaas se dekha kiye sheh suye qaima dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aalam e ghurbat mein sheh ko jab khat e sughra mila
shaahe deen dekha kiye tehreer e sughra dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat e akbar pa maa ne yun zafar girya kiya
silsila rone rulaane ka na toota dayr tak
reh gaya jab seena e akbar...
items.author: Zafar Azmi

items.title: As-shaam
items.body:
kisi bemaar ke honton pe raha ek hi naam
haye as-shaam haye as-shaam haye as-shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
jabaja koocha o bazaar mein logon ka hujoom
jaise mele ka samaa jaise kisi eid ki dhoom
aur zanjeer mein jakda hua mazlom imam
haaye ash-shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
noke naize pa wo quran sunate hue sar
apne chehron ko wo balon se chupate hue sar
aur is haal mein phir umme habiba se kalaam
haaye ash-shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
saat sau kursi nasheeno se bhara wo darbar
haram e shaah ke hamraah wo bebas lachaar
usi laaghar ke garajte hue lehje ko salaam
haaye ash-shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
tasht mein farqe shahe deen pa wo hakim ki chadi
dil e bemaar pa wo lamha qayamat ki ghadi
zabt ki aakhri had paar hai imamat ka qayaam
haaye ash-shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab aseeron ke liye ek andhera zindan
us andhere mein tadap kar kisi bachi ka fughan
kis ko neend aayegi aise mein kahan ka aaraam
haaye ash-shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
raat ke pichle peher baap ko jo roti thi
margayi shaam ke zindan mein phir wo bachi
ek bhai pe guzarte rahe kya kya aalaam
haaye ash-shaam…
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e ashoor jo rota raha chalees baras
zehr e maloon se mara gaya aakhir bekas
aakhri waqt bhi shahid yehi kehta tha imam
haaye ash-shaam…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Ay mere baradar
items.body:
abbas ke laashe par bayan karte thay sarwar
ay mere baradar
gardan pe chalega meri ab shimr ka khanjar
ay mere baradar
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir na koi aur na madadgaar hai mera
mai hogaya tanha
loota gaya pardes mein amma ka bhara ghar
ay mere baradar...
abbas ke laashe pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo mere wafadar thay sab mar gaye ansaar
koi nahi ghamkhwar
ab mera alamdar raha aur na ye lashkar
ay mere baradar...
abbas ke laashe pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum sogaye abbas jo darya ke kinare
shaano ko kata ke
chin jayegi ab zainab o kulsoom ki chadar
ay mere baradar...
abbas ke laashe pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaza e qaima pe hai bechain sakina
bekal hai hazeena
roti hui darya pe chali aaye na muztar
ay mere baradar...
abbas ke laashe pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
atfaal uthayenge meri pyaas ki eeza
pani na milega
dam todenge bache mere pyase hi tadapkar
ay mere baradar...

items.title: Azan ki kokh ujdi
items.body:

nikal jayega seena tod kar jaise abhi baahar

azaan ki kokh ujdi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne poocha jab ehwaal laila se to yun boli

azaan ki kokh ujdi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chutay kadiyal jawan jis maa se aur shauhar bhi mar jaye
wo bewa har nafas apni qaza ko hi bulaati hai
azaan ki kokh ujdi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bulalo paas apne maa ko ye jeena bhi jeena hai
tumhari yaad har lamha hamay aa kar sataati hai
azaan ki kokh ujdi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan bete ki maa se poocho kitni hoti hai chaahat

azaan ki kokh ujdi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi baccha kahin rota tadap kar kehti thi bano
mere asghar ke rone ki suno awaaz aati hai
azaan ki kokh ujdi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua deti hai zehra aa ke jannat se anees unko

azaan ki kokh ujdi...

items.title: Bain karti thi ye
items.body:
bain karti thi ye zehra mere mazloom hussain

<<DIVIDER>>
na to akbar hai na asgahr hai na zainab ke pisar
kat gaya sab terq kunba mere mazloom hussain
bain karti thi ye zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak se uth ke lago amma ki chaati se zara
gham se jalta hai kaleja mere mazloom hussain
bain karti thi ye zehra...

apne pushton ko to aada ne diya gor o kafan

bain karti thi ye zehra...

dayr se laash pa khaati hoo pachade waari

beh raha hai rag e gardan se lahoo reti par

tukde tukde ho badan zulm ki talwaaron se

items.title: Dil mein karbala hai
items.body:
hussain ne apna dil allah ko ata kiya
aur allah ne hussain ko laakhon dil ata kiye
<<DIVIDER>>
ishq e khuda karbala
dars e wafa karbala
raahnuma karbala
raah e baqa karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki dawa
haq ka pata
deen ki sada
rab ki ata
<<DIVIDER>>
seeno mein hai karbala
zehno mein hai karbala
dhadkano mein karbala
saanson mein hai karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kabhi na ja saka karbala
ho ke jo bhi aa gaya karbala
sun sako to do dilon ki ek hi sada hai
dil hai karbala mein dil mein karbala hai
sote jaagte nigah mein haramsara hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi mein aisa koi shakhs to dikha nahi
jo ye keh de karbala mein maanga aur mila nahi
dhoondhte ho tum kahan hai yahin pe la makaan
karbala hussain ki hussain ka khuda hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
is qadar buland ye zameen be sabab nahi
tishnalab ki sarzameen pe koi tishnalab nahi
rizq ilm aagahi mil rahi hai zindagi
jis ke haath kat gaye yahan wo baanta hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaayri ka jab sharaf mila hussain ki qasam
pehli baar karbala mein maine jab rakhe qadam
kaifiyat bataun kya haal e dil sunaun kya
aisa lag raha tha bas yehi watan mera hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
har nabi ko karbala dikhayi hai khuda ne
karbala ki manzilat batayi hai khuda ne
zakhm ho ya ho qaza har maraz ki hai dawa
sar zameen e karbala ki khaak bhi shifa hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
qarz hai yehi lahoo pe aur farz bhi yehi
majlis e hussain ko hai waqf saari zindagi
farsh e gham bichaye hum aur alam sajaye hum
bachpane mein walidayn se yehi suna hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya zehra ya zehra ya zehra ya zehra
abad wallah ya zehra maaninsa hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
waada syeda se jo kiya tha wo nibhayenge
aane waali nasl ko bhi karbala sunayenge
ishq ke ye marhale tay karenge ishq se
majlis e hussain se yehi sabakh mila hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar mein jo alam saja rahe hai hum
majlis e aza kara rahe hai hum
har baras ye gham mana rahe hai hum
nauhe marsiye suna rahe hai hum
daawa jab kiya hai to saboot bhi diya hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab e hazeen ne qaid e shaam mein yehi kaha
mere laal mera bhai aur mera bawafa
sabke laashe hai wahan mai aseer hoo yahan
is liye to har ghadi labon pe ye buka hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mesum aur mazhar abidi daleel chahiye
jab jahan jise nijaat ki sabeel chahiye
usko mashwara ye do wird raat din karo
bas yehi nijaat hai agar tu keh raha hai
dil hai karbala mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte rahe ahle aza
hussain hussain hussain hussain
lab pe rahe zikr tera
hussain hussain hussain hussain
tujhse kare yuhin wafa
hussain hussain hussain hussain
tere azadaar sada
hussain hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain tere liye hussain tere liye
aqeeda bas ye kahe hussain tere liye
sada ye dil se uthe hussain tere liye
ye haath khalk huwe hussain tere liye
ye dil dhadakta rahe hussain tere liye

items.title: Furaat ka pani
items.body:
tha taraayi pe hashr ka manzar
naizon uchla furaat ka pani
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe abbas tadpi darya par
naizon uchla furaat ka pani
<<DIVIDER>>

tadap ke reh gayi janabe sayyeda

naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...

sheh ki gardan pe jab chala khanjar
naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...

kat gaya jab hussain ka hulqoom
peet kar royi zainab o kulsoom
tadpati reh gayi ali ki betiyan
kode barse jo dono behno par
naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...

jaanibe qaima e shahe waala

naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...

loot kar maal o zar layeeno ne

naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...

tadpati reh gayi ali ki betiyan
jab wo royi chacha chacha keh kar
naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab layeeno ne cheen li chadar
apne abbas ko sada de kar
tadpati reh gayi ali ki betiyan
royi jis waqt zainab e muztar
naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne maa ke nanhi turbat se
noke naiza chubho ke zaalim ne
zameene karbala ko aaya zalzala
jab nikaali hai laasha e asghar
naizon uchla furaat ka pani
tha tarayi pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono haathon mein jab bandhi rassi
haye waiz ali ki shehzadi
tadpati reh gayi ali ki betiyan
royi jis waqt apni ghurbat par
naizon uchla furaat ka pani

jo bhi gaya ran ko nahi aaya wo palat kar
abbas na akbar
ab aap ka sadma mai utha paungi kyun kar
mar jaungi baba mar jaungi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
zakir bana ke baksha hai zehra ne ye farhan

items.author: Aijaz Rizvi

items.title: Mera abbas ghazi
items.body:
ghuroore fauje sitamgar ko tod sakta hoo
rukhe furaat nigahon se mod sakta hoo
ali ka beta hoo mojiz numaiyon ki qasam
mai aftaab se pani nichod sakta hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
mera abbas ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
maani e riffat e esaar o wafa hai abbas
jazba e hausla e sher e khuda hai abbas
rooh e ehsaas e rasool e do sara hai abbas
yaani allah ke maqsad ki baqa hai abbas
raasta rehbar e islam ki rukne na diya
kath gaye haath alam deen ka jhukne na diya
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jo ejaaz dikhaun to ye naksha badle
arsh pe fasl ugay farsh pe suraj nikle
nehr se gard udhe sang se chashma phoothe
aag pani may lage aag se pani nikle
ghoor ke dekhun to tum sab pe mammaat aajaye
mere toote huwe naize pe furaat aa jaaye
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri talwaar se jibreel ke par kaampte hai
meri haibat se sabhi jinn o bashar kaampte hai
tum to kya cheez ho sher'on ke jigar kaampte hai
maut se pehle hi ajsaam ke sar kaampte hai
maine talwaar jo ek baar chalayi hoti
saari dunya may duhaai hi duhaai hoti
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang e siffain ka maahol dobara hojaye
khaynch loo taygh to dunya may savera hojaye
alqama ko jo mera ek ishaara hojaye
qaima e shaah hi darya ka kanara hojaye
khatm pyason ki abhi tashnadahani kardun
mai agar chaahun pahadon ko bhi pani kardun
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
poore maqtal ko ek ungli pe nacha sakta hoo
tum jo mar jao to thokar se jila sakta hoo
aag behte huwe pani may laga sakta hoo
tum ko ab rooh ke ishaare se bhaga sakta hoo
haath katne pe bhi ladne se mai mazoor nahi
hukme shabbir ka paband hoo majboor nahi
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haa magar gardish e dauran ne ye manzar dekha
kat gaye baazu e abbas sare raah e wafa
sar pe bhi gurz laga aankh pe bhi teer laga
aas bhi toot gayi mashk se pani jo baha
ho salaam aap pe aaqa ye pukare abbas
nehr se jaanib e firdaus sidhare abbas
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab suna nehr pe saqqa e haram maara gaya
gir gayi bibyon ke sar se ye sunte hi rida
bibi zainab ki sada aane lagi wawaila
gir gaya daste sakina se zameen par kooza
boli ye ro ke mujhe aas nahi hai ammu
jald aajao ke ab pyaas nahi hai ammu
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke shabbir pukare mere bhaiya abbas
mere ghamkhwar mere aashiq o shaida abbas
mujhko pani to pilado mai hoo pyasa abbas
mai gira jaata hoo do mujhko sahara abbas
qaima e fatema zehra ki sipar toot gayi
haath bhai ke kate meri kamar toot gayi

items.title: Misaale mauj par
items.body:
misaale mauj ajal par ubhar ubhar ke chale
