<<DIVIDER>>
zohair aaye habeeb aaye nusrat e shah ko
qamar ke gird sitare nikhar nikhar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka sher suye nehr yun chala jaise
shikaar dekh ke zaigham tehar tehar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nigaah kehti hai abbas ki sar e saahil
kahan hai fauj e udoo hum to mashk bhar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar habeeb ne baandhi jo nusrat e sheh may
jawaniyo ke iraade sawar sawar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...
<<DIVIDER>>
naha ke nikla hai laila ke aansuon may shabab
na kyun jawani e akbar nikhar nikhar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...
<<DIVIDER>>
safon ko tod ke jaate hai is tarah abbas
safeena maujon pa jaise ubhar ubhar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...
<<DIVIDER>>
tawaaf e rauza e shabbir ki tamanna may
farishte baam e falak se utar utar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...
<<DIVIDER>>
qalam uthaate hi madhe hussain may mahir
tasavuraat may mazmoon sawar sawar ke chale
misaale mauj ajal par...

items.title: Naize par
items.body:
ya hussain maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>

raah may poocha sakina ne jo baba hai kahan
khoon rote huwe abid ne kaha naize par

qabr jis chaand ki chup chup ke banate thay hussain

kis tarha tehre...
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat e pyaas hai tanha hai ghareeb e zahra

kis tarha tehre...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon abid ki tarha rote thay mazloom hussain
choo ke chadar ko jo aati hai hawa naize par
kis tarha tehre...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine parde may isay paala hai boli zainab
sar mujhe shimr na akbar ka dikha naize par
kis tarha tehre...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam tak baali sakina ne tamache khaaye
shaam tak rote rahe shaah e huda naize par
kis tarha tehre...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad may majlis e shabbir hui zindan may
pehle majlis hui chadar ki bapa naize par
kis tarha tehre...
<<DIVIDER>>
sirf aur sirf hussain ibne ali jaante hai
kaise hoti hai asad hamd e khuda naize par
kis tarha tehre...
items.author: Asad Naqvi

items.title: Pardes mein zehr se
items.body:
pardes mein zehr se maara hai naqi ko
jis tarha is se pehle raza aur taqi ko
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh saal umr thi ke huwe baap se juda
zaalim ne kamsini mein rakha qaid naqi ko
pardes mein zehr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom ko layeen ne bulaya iraq mein
phir tauq e salaasil mein rakha maula naqi ko
pardes mein zehr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye haye yateem saamra mein chod kar gaye
khud askari ne ghusl diya baba naqi ko
pardes mein zehr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishrat ko wo kalaam ata kijiye imam
saamra jaa ke pesh kare khud wo naqi ko
pardes mein zehr se...

items.title: Aaja abbas tujhe
items.body:
aaja abbas tujhe ro ro bulaye zainab
kaise pabande rasan shaam mein jaaye zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
kya karun ye to bata bhai nahi sar pe rida
sar pe baba bhi nahi kaun sune meri sada
hukm zaalim ka hai darbar mein aaye zainab
aaja abbas tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera baba hai ali aur mera nana nabi
dard o gham seh ke bhi mai deen bacha kar hoon chali
shaam mein goonj rahi thi ye sada e zainab
aaja abbas tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad shabbir ke saaye mein nahi aayi rabab
ghamzada behen ko is baat ka de bhai jawab
dhoop se usko bata kaise uthaye zainab
aaja abbas tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam manzil hai meri bhai hai be-gor o kafan
na hi matam hai kiya na hi kiya usko dafan
baat ye tu hi bata kaise bhulaye zainab
aaja abbas tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hai aasaan ye khursheed bhala nauhagari
jaante hai ye sukhanwar ke ye manzil hai kadi
baat banti hai jo hojaye ata e zainab
aaja abbas tujhe...
items.author: Khursheed Haider

items.title: Ab wo sajjad na
items.body:
haye haye shaam haye haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
nok e naiza se dekhlo baba
ab wo sajjad na raha sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi berida hui zainab
karbala mein hi mar gaya sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hai parda ye shaam waalon ko
teri daadi ne hi sikhaya hai
unhi logon ne meri phupiyon ko
berida shaam mein phiraya hai
kya ghazab hai ke haath phaila kar
maangta hai bas ek rida sajjad
nok e naiza se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jis ne baghair mehmil ke
ghar se baahar qadam na rakha tha
us phuphi ko zamane waalon ne
aap ke baad berida dekha
kaash abbas aaj hote to
ye qayamat na dekhta sajjad
nok e naiza se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe jab tak tha aap ka saaya
maa'on behno ke sar pe thi chadar
warna mai bhi ali ka beta hoo
jaanta hoo mai jang ke jauhar
dekh kar berida phuphi ka sar
sharm ke maare jhuk gaya sajjad
nok e naiza se...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhe bachon ke haath mein pathar
de ke maara gaya sakina ko
pusht e naaqa se bhi giraya aur
taziyane lage yateema ko
mai bandhe haath dekh kar roya
us ne har dard par kaha sajjad
nok e naiza se...
<<DIVIDER>>
badr o khyber ki jo adawat thi
uska yun inteqam lete hai
shaam ke log bheed mein har dam
meri phupiyon ka naam lete hai
taaziyane to seh gaya baba
tanz lekin na seh saka sajjad
nok e naiza se...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha se bandhe hai rassi se
haath mere galay yateemon ke
na jhukun to zameen se baba
paon uth'te hai nanhe bachon ke
bas ruku mein hi shukr ke sajde
kar ke guzrega ab tera sajjad
nok e naiza se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis behan ne hamesha jeene ki
haye abbas ko duayein di
berida sar pe rakh ke haathon ko
usne abbas ko sadayein di
sar sina se wahan gira unka
aur yahan khaak par gira sajjad
nok e naiza se...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne maula ke ek aansu ka
haq ada na sahaab kar paaya
girte ashkon ki roshnayi se
dil ke qirtaas par yehi likha
kitna gehra tha gham ridaon ka
ya khuda jaanta hai ya sajjad
nok e naiza se...
items.author: Arif Sahab

items.title: Ali sharminda hai
items.body:
tumhare baad badha dard aur kam na hua
kisi ke dil pe bhi itna bada sitam na hua
qadam qadam pe rahi tum ali ke gham mein shareek
ali ko gham hai tumhara shareek e gham na hua
ali sharminda hai zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot dunya ne tadpaya ali kuch bhi na kar paaya
ali sharminda hai zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
suni kab dard mein doobi tumhari siskiyan maine
na dekhi haye jeete ji shikasta phasliyan maine
na kuch tum ne hi batlaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe khud bhi na tha us waqt apne gham ka andaza
gira jab haye pehlu par tumhare jalta darwaza
madad ko bhi nahi aaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhare darbar mein ummat ke jhutlaya gaya tum ko
ali ke saamne dunya mein tadpaya gaya tum ko
tumhara haq na dilwaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
utaara qabr mein jis dam nabi zaadi ki mayyat ko
kabhi hasnain ko dekha kabhi zehra ki surat ko
yehi ro ro ke farmaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo royega dil shaam o sahar tumse juda ho kar
rahega ye khalaq kaunain ka mushkil kusha ho kar
na mohsin ko bacha paaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta phasliyon ka dard bhi kuch kam na kar paaya
maseeha ko yehi gham hai ilaaj e gham na kar paaya
isi aalam mein dafnaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi jab qabr par aaye baraye fateha khwani
yehi kehte thay rakh kar turbat pe peshani
koi khaatir na kar paaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
najaf se jab ali ne qabr e zehra par nazar daali
lehed ujdi hui dekhi tadap kar reh gaya waali
ye jumla phir se dohraya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho aaj bhi saaya nahi hai qabr e zehra par
kisi ki ye sadayein aa rahi hai aamir o akhtar
zamaane ne sitam dhaaya
ali sharminda hai...

items.title: Ay mere beta mere
items.body:
ay mere beta mere pyare ali asghar
noore nazar maa ke dulare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
gham teri furqat ka mujhe kha gaya beta
tere bina maa ka teri jee nahi lagta
aao ye maa tumko pukare ali asghar
ay mere beta...
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hui bano e muztar ye pukari
chain hua khatm gayi raunaqein saari
jab se tum is ghar se sidhaare ali asghar
ay mere beta...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hi bata kiske mai ab naaz uthaun
jhoola jhulaun kise lori sunaun
ab mai jiyun kiske sahare ali asghar
ay mere beta...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein tha armaan ke tu dulha banega
laal mere sar pe tere sehra sajega

ay mere beta...
<<DIVIDER>>
roti rahi na suni faryad kisi ne
teri behan pyari sakina ko shaqi ne
haye tamache bhi hai maare ali asghar
ay mere beta...
<<DIVIDER>>
aake zara dekh ay ghazi ke bhatije
le gaye chadar bhi sitamgar mere sar se
jal gaye qaime bhi hamare ali asghar
ay mere beta...
<<DIVIDER>>
fakhr hai mujhko mai hoo shabbir ka zakir
ab koi dunya ka mujhe darr nahi yasir
aap hai jab mere sahare ali asghar
ay mere beta...

items.title: Berida hai rasool
items.body:
berida hai rasool ki beti

bediyan ro ke bain karti hai

be-khata tauq aur salaasal mein
qaid yasrab ka shaahzada hai
berida hai rasool ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi aa kar bacha lo bacchi ko
mar na jaaye hussain ki beti
neele rukhsaar hai tamachon se

berida hai rasool ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr karna hai deen bachana hai
kya kare phir hussain ka beta
sun ke faryad maa'on behno ki
sher sar ko jhukaye rota hai
berida hai rasool ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ka sar tum sina pe laaye ho
tum ko maaloom hai musalmano
roz padte ho jis ka kalma tum

berida hai rasool ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke gohar hussain ke sar se
badi darbar ki taraf zainab
har sitam seh ke deen bachaungi
tujhse teri behan ka waada hai
berida hai rasool ki...

items.title: Chane lagi shame
items.body:
chane lagi shaam e ghariban
haye qayamat ka hai samaan
qaima e sadaat se utha dhuan
<<DIVIDER>>
dhal gaya din khatm ladaai hui
maut ki khamoshi hai chaayi hui

haye qayamat ka hai samaan
chane lagi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed nahi akbar nahi
qasim o abbas e dilawar nahi
haye koi monis o yawar nahi
qaima nahi maqna o chadar nahi
dasht mein hai aal e nabi be amaan
haye qayamat ka hai samaan
chane lagi...
<<DIVIDER>>
madar e akbar ka ajab haal hai
deta hai jab koi tasalli usay
kehti hai dil thaam ke rote hue
kho gaye is ban mein sahare mere
mar gaya haye mera kadiyal jawan
haye qayamat ka hai samaan
chane lagi...

haye ye be-chaargi ye bekasi
deta nahi usko dilaasa koi
darmiyan laashon ke akele khadi

dhoonde jaun tumhe baba kahan
haye qayamat ka hai samaan
chane lagi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa hoo har ek ranj uthaungi mai
rote hue khud chali jaungi mai
dhoond ke baysheer ko laaungi mai
uske bina jee nahi paungi mai
reh gaya haye mera bacha kahan
haye qayamat ka hai samaan
chane lagi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye gohar azmat e binte ali
sab ko sambhala bhi hifazat bhi ki
gham mein shahe deen ke bhi roti rahi
maamta pe aanch bhi aane na di
maa to hai bas aun o mohamed ki maa
haye qayamat ka hai samaan
chane lagi...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Dil se ghame husain
items.body:
dil se ghame hussain na ho kam khuda kare
le jaaun mai lehad mein yehi gham khuda kare
<<DIVIDER>>
hubbe ali ho dil mein zaban par ho ya hussain
jab waqte nazha nikle mera dam khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
thokar lage to aaye zaban par ali ka naam
har gham mein ho hussain ka matam khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe daagh matame shabbir ka rahe
daaman ho ashke gham se sada nam khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
phaile nishane hazrat abbas ki ziya
saare jahan pe chaaye ye parcham khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dukh mein yaad aaye shaheedan e karbala
har zakhme dil ka ho yehi marham khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar dar ke keh rahe thay ye aapas mein sab layeen
abbas ho na nehr pe barham khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
faujein adoo ki aati thi zainab ye kehti thi
aa jaaye koi shimr ka bhi kaam khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ne sheh ke saamne toda tha jaise dam
koi pidar na dekhe ye aalam khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein kar rahi thi sakina yehi dua
aa jaaye khairiyat se mere amm khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar palat ke aaye ye sughra ki thi dua
phir bhai aur behen mile baaham khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bole lab pe ye bakhshishe ummat ki ho dua
khanjar rawan ho halq pe jis dam khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke khatm kar do mujahid kalaam ko
badta rahe hussain ka matam khuda kare
dil se ghame hussain...
items.author: Mujahid Lakhnavi

items.title: Gala bandha hai
items.body:
gala bandha hai rasan mein malool o muztar hai
yehi hussain ki pyari sakina dukhtar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
isi ko sibte nabi seene pe sulaate thay
isi ko godh mein abbas bhi khilate thay
jo rooth jaati thi sau sau tarha manate thay
hussain naaz aise bacchi ke uthaate thay
gala bandha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nikal ke qaime se ran ko chale thay jab sarwar
yehi to lipti thi ghode ke paaon se aa kar
badha na asp to laaye hussain ye lab par
mera ye aakhri tum par hai raahwar safar
gala bandha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ishara kar ke zameen ki taraf ye usne kaha
sakina pyari ki haalat to aap dekhe zara
zameen e garm pe lipti hai pakde paaon mera
qadam badaunga bhala kis tarha se mai aaqa
gala bandha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
isi ko shimr ne maare tamache gaalon par
isi ke kaano se cheene layeen ne gohar
isi ke bain se zaahir ye hogaya sab par
shaheed hogaye karbal mein sibte paighambar
gala bandha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ek nanha sa sar jo rakha hai naize par
isi ka bhai hai cheh maah ka ali asghar
bala ke dasht mein naadan pani ko paa kar
pilaane ko isay daudi thi kooze ko le kar
gala bandha hai...
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Hai mere ammu kahan
items.body:
bali sakina yehi karti thi ro ro fughan
hai mere ammu kahan hai mere baba kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
hone lagi dasht may sham e ghariban ayan
hai mere ammu…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kidhar aaj sab nasir o yawar gaye
kaisi qayamat hui qasim o akbar gaye
justuju e aab may saani e hyder gaye
nanhe mujahid ke saath sipte payambar gaye
dhoond rahi hoo magar milta nahi kuch nishan
hai mere ammu…
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkare kuffar may dhoom hai kyon is khadar
soch rahi hoo yahi aayi hai kaisi khabar
chaak gareban kiye rota hai sab ghar ka ghar
hosh kisi ko nahi kya karoon jaa'un kidhar
koi bataye mujhe kyon hai ye aagho fughan
hai mere ammu…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimo may be-izn hi aagaye sab ehle shar
zulm ki had tod-di abide bemaar par
lootli sar se rida loot ke sab maal o zar
shimr e layeen legaya cheen ke mere gohar
jaake dikhaungi mai kano se khoon hai rawan
hai mere ammu…
<<DIVIDER>>
pyasi hoo ye lafz hi lab pe na laa'ungi mai
unki judaai ka gham kaise utha'ungi mai
maut se pehle unhe dekh bhi pa'ungi mai
jab bhi milenge mujhe unko bata'ungi mai
maare tamache mujhe shimr ne di ghurkiyan
hai mere ammu…
<<DIVIDER>>
aur anees e hazeen haal kare kya raqam
zulm ki jab sayliyan kha chuke ehle haram
aale mohamad pe phir toota naya ek sitam
dekho ke bacho may hai bali sakina bhi to
karti thi jo dam ba dam roke yehi ek fughan
hai mere ammu…
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Hyder
items.body:
khana e hyder mein bapa shor e buka hyder
wavaila haye wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
qatle ali ke kahabr aayi jo masjid se ghar
goonj tuhi naala o shewan ki sada hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe ki bewaon yateemon ka hai nauha
qatl hua aaj ghareebon ka sahara
karte hai nauha yehi saare masakeen bhi
gham ke aseeron ka maseeha na raha hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab o kulsoom ye deti hai duhaai
kyun bine muljim ne jafa aap pe dhaayi
kaisi qayamat hai ye taaza musibat hai ye
roti hai jibreel ke nauhe pe fiza hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe ke ghar ghar mein ye kohraam bapa hai
khoone ali sajda e khaaliq mein baha hai
rote hai jinn o bashar hai ye fughan arsh par
marqad e zehra o nabi kaamp utha hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise lafzon mein bayan hoga shahadat naama
khaak udaate thay haram mehwe buka thi fizza
haye ekkeeswi ramzan thi wo wavaila
ghar mein zehra ki hui kaisi qayamat barpa
kehte thay ahle haram taaza tha zehra ka gham
kar gaye dunya se safar aqda kusha hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi alamdar ki faryaad yehi hai
karbobala hogayi aaghaaz yahin se
daaghe yateemi mila nauha hai shabbir ka
bain ye karte hai hassan sabz qaba hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
utha janaza to bapa hogaya mehshar
sar pe na thi zainab o kulsoom ke chadar
kehti thi roohe nabi zehra ne faryaad ki
lagta hai ashoor ka din ye bakhuda hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo gham hai ke nahi jiska madawa mazhar
farshe majlis pe hua nauha kuna yun safdar
kyun na is roz ho ashoor ke jaisa manzar
taygh maula pe chali aur hamare dil par
zabt kare kaise hum gham hai bada umr kam
hashr talak aati rahegi ye sada hyder
khana e hyder mein bapa...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Jal raha hai fatema
items.body:
ya umme abiha ya umme faqiha
ya fatema zehra ya fatema zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
ay rasool lijiye khabar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
aaiye khudara laut kar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
shehr e mustafa dhuan dhuan
ro rahe hai arz aur samaa
de rahe hai ro ke ye khabar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
kushta e jafa ka tha ye bain
sayyeda ko kab mila hai chain
mehnato ka ye mila samar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
sayyeda ki tooti phasliyan
khaaye hai tamache sayliyan
waqt hai kathan kis khadar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
haye binte mustafa ka ghar
aur hai hujoom e ahle shar
zulm ho raha hai be khadar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtare nabi pe kya sitam
kar gaya hai wo shaqi raqam
roohe sayyeda hai khoon may tar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah binte mustafa
unke lab pe hai ye marsiya
beti aap ki hai nauhagar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
baadalon tumhi madad karo
aag par to pani daal do
dekh lo zameen pe ek nazar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm pe to zakhm aa chuke
haye wo sadayein de kise
jal chuka hai sayyeda ka ghar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaan khabar to lijiye
fatema ki simt dekhiye
aap kya gaye hai chod kar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
baad aap ke ye kya hua
pal may ye jahan badal gaya
dekhiye khudara ay pidar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam e hazeen wo ghamzada
yazdan pad raha hai marsiya
aaftab nikla nange sar
jal raha hai fatema ka ghar
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Kaha kisi ne sakina
items.body:
kaha kisi ne sakina se tum dua ye karo
koi bhi beti tumhari tarha yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jiska dil ho dukhi raat bhar nahi sota
duayein karte huwe jab bhi koi hai rota
suna hai uski duaon mein hai asar hota
hamare ghar ho salamat ye tum dua maango
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh rahe hai ke bemaar ko dawa denge
kafan shaheedon ko behno ko hum rida denge
ye chaar saal ki bacchi ko hum dua denge
hamein bhi ek dua chahiye ye is se kaho
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha kisi ne ke baba safar pe nikle hai
kaha ye maane ke is se duayein lete hai
hamare bibi bahot chote chote bacche hai
sakina sochne lagti hai laashe asghar ko
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nanhi bacchi ki haalat pe koi kehta hai
najaf mein iska koi rishtedaar rehta hai
chini hai baaliyan kaano se khoon behta hai
larazte haath hai ye dekh kar tamachon ko
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha kisi ne jo ye bibiyan hai bechadar
ye fakhre maryam o saara hai aale paighambar
ye tauq mein jo baradar hai abide muztar
imam e waqt hai ye de dua kaho in se
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye fatema ke hai ghar ki azeem hai rutbe
dua kare kaho mushkil kusha ki poti se
bahot khareeb hai bacchi ye arshe khaliq ke
dua ye maang le phaila ke nanhe haathon ko
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai aab ye kurte ko dho nahi sakti
ye rona chaahti hai aur ro nahi sakti
ye qaid khane mein ek pal bhi so nahi sakti
nahi hai baap ka seena bhi iske sone ko
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua to kar di sakina ne haath phaila kar
laraz raha hai qamar arshe khaaliqe akbar
phuphi ne thaama sakina ko phat gaya tha jigar
hussain ki tarha kitni kareem hai dekho
kaha kisi ne sakina se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sakina ne ahle aza salamat ho
sabhi ke noore nazar mahleqa salamat ho
bhatije bhaanje sab ke chacha salamat ho
duayein deti hoo har waqt apne shiyon ko
kisi ki beti bhi meri tarha yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina bibi tumhare ghulam haazir hai
bujhe jo pyaas to ashkon ke jaam haazir hai
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Karbala walon ki
items.body:
karbala walon ki zindan se rehaai ho gayi
turbate bali sakina se judaai ho gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
is khadar maare tamache hai shimr badkaar ne
hashr tak wo maut baba ki rulaai so gayi
turbate bali sakina se…
karbala walon ki zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
momino moo ko chupalo noch daalo sar ke baal
sar barehna dasht mein zahra ki jaayi ho gayi
turbate bali sakina se…
karbala walon ki zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
misl phoolon ki chune thay laashon ke tukde hussain
is qadar pamaal zehra ki kameini ho gayi
turbate bali sakina se…
karbala walon ki zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghare masoom ka wo muskarana maut par
dekh kar sharminda darya ki taraai ho gayi
turbate bali sakina se…
karbala walon ki zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar kata gulzaar jab mushkil kusha ke laal ka
ta qayamat deen ki mushkil kushaai ho gayi
turbate bali sakina se…
karbala walon ki zindan...
items.author: Gulzaar Jafri

items.title: Khogaye ho tum kahan
items.body:
khogaye ho tum kahan dhoondti madar
ay ali akbar mere ay ali akbar mere
kis tarha seh payegi gham tera khaahar
ay ali akbar mere…
<<DIVIDER>>
zakm seene par laga aur jigar tak chid gaya
khoon se rangeen hai sar zameen e karbala
haat rakh lo zakm par aati hai maadar
ay ali akbar mere…
khogaye ho tum kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aarzoo ye thi meri dekhun sehre ki ladi
haye qismat kya karun khoon mein mayyat bhari
sej phoolon ki kahan khaak ka bistar
ay ali akbar mere…
khogaye ho tum kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sakina si behan shal hai kodon se badan
uf gulu mein baandne shimr laaya hai rasan
zulm ki hai inteha chin gaye gohar
ay ali akbar mere…
khogaye ho tum kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin o yawar nahi shaah ka lashkar nahi
so gaye abbas bhi godh mein asghar nahi
saykdo ranj o mehan aur ek sarwar
ay ali akbar mere…
khogaye ho tum kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq ka aazaar hai abid e beemar hai
zainab o kulsoom aur shaam ka bazaar hai
baad tere ahle shar le gaye chadar
ay ali akbar mere…
khogaye ho tum kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid se jab jaungi mai madine jaungi
poochegi sugra tumhe kya usay batlaungi
kis tarha seh payegi gham tera khwahar
ay ali akbar mere…
khogaye ho tum kahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shaheed e karbala ay shabihe mustufa
waasta hai aap ko shabbar o shabbir ka
ab hassan ki kuch khabar lijiye aa kar
ay ali akbar mere…
khogaye ho tum kahan...
items.author: Hassan

items.title: Laasha mila
items.body:
wa ghurbata wa musibata
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ko yun abbas ka bikhra hua laasha mila
<<DIVIDER>>
do bureeda baazuon ke saath mashkeeza mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka bikhra hua laasha mila
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon mein wa-hijaba ka ajab kohraam tha
raaste mein bawafa ka jab kata shaana mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath malte reh gaye shabbir o zainab dasht mein
ek ghatri mein simat kar maa ko jab dulha mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka jee chaaha sakina ko tamache maarta
yun musalmano se usko baap ka pursa mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mutthiyan kholi gayi bano ki jab marne ke baad
raakh jhoole ki mili aur khoon bhara kurta mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab qaid khane ki ghutan apni jagah
shukr hai saydaniyo ko kam se kam parda mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bebasi se gir gaye shabbir jalti rayt par
laasha e akbar par jis dam qasid e sughra mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
uth gaye tazeem mein ummul baneen ke laal ki
naam le kar koi abid se jo ghazi ka mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne bas darvaish maangi marzi e maula e hussain
warna dar se bawafa ke jis ne jo maanga mila
sheh ko yun abbas ka...

items.title: Maa ne di akbar ko
items.body:
maa ne di akbar ko sada
ay meri jaan ay meri jaan
noore nazar roohe rawan
ay meri jaan ay meri jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
dil tha mera sehra tera
dekhungi mai in aankhon se
mehndi teri sehra kahan
ay meri jaan ay meri jaan
maa ne di akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
chehra tera nana jaisa
teri sada nana jaisi
kaise sunoon waisi azan
ay meri jaan ay meri jaan
maa ne di akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar tera akbar noha
likhta raha rota raha
hilte rahe arz o saman
ay meri jaan ay meri jaan
maa ne di akbar ko...

items.title: Mar jaye na sakina
items.body:
mar jaye na sakina zindan mein tanha hai
ghere huwe bacchi ko ghurbat ka andhera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisi yateemi hai jo hai wo rulaata hai
na koi tasalli hai na koi dilaasa hai
mar jaye na sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab khushk hai bacchi ke aur haath rasan basta
kuch khaak hai baalon mein boseeda sa kurta hai
mar jaye na sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehmi hui baithi hai ek kone mein shehzadi
aahat bhi jo hoti hai dil kaampne lagta hai
mar jaye na sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt tadapti hai baba ko sada de kar
masoom ki haalat par zindan bhi rota hai
mar jaye na sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal soyi thi shehzadi shabbir ke seene par
ab khaak ka bistar hai aur khaak ka takiya hai
mar jaye na sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
lillaah koi jaa kar bacchi ko chuda laaye
zaalim ke tamachon se behaal sakina hai
mar jaye na sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun tadpi sakina ke ghabra gayi zainab bhi
ro ro ke aseeron ne ghazi ko pukaara hai
mar jaye na sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas itna kaha gohar aur mar gayi shehzadi
bin baap ke dunya mein jeena koi jeena hai
mar jaye na sakina...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Mera abbas jo hota
items.body:
yun rasan basta na hoti kabhi binte zehra
mera abbas jo hota mera abbas jo hota
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun balwe mein phirata mujhe yun beparda
mera abbas jo hota mera abbas jo hota
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj tak maine suna bhi na tha bazaar ka naam
haan meri maa ne liya tha kabhi darbar ka naam
mai kahan aur kahan ahle jafa ka balwa
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun zaalim mere qaimon ko jalata aakar
kaun bemaar ko bistar se uthaata aakar
kahan jal sakta tha baysheer ka nanha jhoola
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj kufe mein na hoti meri ye barbadi
jahan qaidi hoon kahin jaati wahin shehzadi
shaane katwake na sota jo mera shehzada
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha aale nabi jaati na darbaron mein
naam zainab ka ne leta koi bazaaron mein
khaana e aaya e tatheer na hota ruswa
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
maarta hai jo sakina ko tamache koi
pushte abid pe laga jaata hai durre koi
nazar aata na yahan koi sitamgar zinda
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh mein maa ki humakta ali asghar mera
khaynchta aake qanaate ali akbar mera
raat bhar wo mere qaime ka talaaya phirta
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bacchon ko agar maut nahi aa jaati
apne ghar mai bhi kabhi chand si bahuein laati
baandhti aun o mohamed ke saron par sehra
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hoon zainab mere bhai thay hamee'at waale
hausle waale wafa waale shajaa'at waale
dekh sakta na tha suraj kabhi mera chehra
mera abbas jo hota...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha bahot aamir o nayyar ye bhen ko bhi khayal
kahan be-pardagi e ahle haram ka tha sawaal
khud hi ho jaata rida badh ke alam ka saaya
mera abbas jo hota...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Naize pe yun
items.body:
shabbir ne haq se ulfat ka
naize pe yun izhaar kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
sar kat bhi gaya lekin phir bhi
har bayyat ka inkaar kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
farmaan e khuda ko chod diya
ehkaam e shariyat bhool gaye
aakhir wo musalman kaise thay
sarwar pe jinho ne waar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom ki sookhi gardan par
chalta raha khanjar haye ghazab
nana ki zaalim ummat ne
zehra ka jigar khoon baar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuh faasle par thi behen khadi
chlati thi gale pe kund churi
sar kaat ke shimr e zaalim ne
dukhiya ke dil par waar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole mein tadapte hai asghar
aur khusk zaban hai honton par
sookhi hui gardan par ran mein
zaalim ne ye kaisa waar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hook si dil mein uth'ti hai
dil khoon ke aansu rota hai
aulaad e nabi par ummat ne
wo zulm sar e bazaar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir khat e sughra ko liye
takte hai laasha e akbar ko
jaari huwe aansu aankon se
tehreer ka jab deedar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch doori pe thi ghamkhwar khadi
aur khusk gale pe kund churi
allah allah is manzil ko
kaise zainab ne paar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal ke sulagte sehra mein
shabbir pe jaan dene ke liye
apne haathon se bacchon ko
har ek maa ne tayyar kiya
naize pe yun...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamkhwar ki matamdari mein
mazloom ka pursa dete huwe
dilshad ne sun'ne waalon ko
matam ke liye tayyar kiya
naize pe yun...
items.author: Dilshad Zaidi

items.title: Pardesi kunbe walon
items.body:
pardesi kunbe waalon ki yaad jo teer chubhoti hai
nana ke rauze pe sughra chupke chupke roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aane waale bhai ka rasta takti hai bemaar behen
bhai ki majboor jawani naiza khaaye soti hai
pardesi kunbe waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shehzadi qasim o akbar ab na milenge qasid ko
darwaze pe aas lagaye na-haq pehron roti hai
pardesi kunbe waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki shadi ki tamanna haye muqaddar sughra ka
sehre ki ladiyan to nahi ashkon ke haar piroti hai
pardesi kunbe waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa rona kaise aansu ashre ke din asr ke baad
sughra apne rukhsaron se gard e yateemi dhoti hai
pardesi kunbe waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke seene par soti thi ek zamana wo bhi tha
ek zamana ye hai sakina farshe zameen par soti hai
pardesi kunbe waalon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne ummat ki raahon mein farsh bichaya phoolon ka
ummat uske bemaaron ki raah mein kaante boti hai
pardesi kunbe waalon...

items.title: Aaja akbar
items.body:
armaan yehi hota hai
bete ke liye maadar ka
ek chaand si dulhan aaye
banjaye naseeb is ghar ka
socha tha ye sughra ne
mehndi rachaungi
aaja akbar tere sar pe sehra sajaungi
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
mai yaad tujhe karti hoo
chehra ashkon se dho kar
din raat tadapti hoo mai
teri yaad mein beta ro kar
ek karb musalsal hai dil mein
ye dard jo har pal hai dil mein
tu na aaya to teri qasam mar jaungi aaja
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan yehi hota hai
bete ke liye maadar ka
ek chaand si dulhan aaye
ban jaaye naseeb is ghar ka
ashkon sy banaungi sehra
tere sar pe sajaungi sehra
socha tha ye sughra ne mehndi rachaungi aaja
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
khud tujhko banaye dulha
jannat se hyder aa kar
masnad bhi sajaye teri
salman o abuzar aa kar
jannat se gul e tar mangwaun
yun sej uroosi banwaun
jitne armaan dil mein hai wo dikhlaungi aaja
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
nabiyon ki qatarein hongi
aur aage mohamed honge
rizwan padhega sehra
behno ko nayg milenge
jannat mein charaghan bhi hoga
jis waqt banega tu dulha
phoolon se mai ye saara jahan mehkaungi aaja
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein jo aaya laasha
hamshakle payambar tera
umeedein miti maadar ki
hasrat ka janaza nikla
is dil pe sitam hai furqat ka
kuch dosh hai meri qismat ka
batla mujhko ghar kaise laut ke jaungi aaja
haye akbar haye haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
farhan bayan is gham ka
lafzon mein nahi ho sakta
faryad hai ye maadar ki
mazhar ne likha jo nauha
kehti thi yehi ro kar maadar
maa tujhpe fida aaja akbar
haasil kya phir mai qabr mein jab so jaungi aaja
haye akbar haye haye akbar
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Akbar nahi aaye
items.body:
akbar nahi aaye asghar nahi aaye
din beet gaya ab raat hui dilbar nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
hum naam e ali humshakle nabi
jurrat thi siwa ghairat thi badi
lekin jab mushkil aayi ghadi
maa deti rahi ro ro ke sada
akbar nahi aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ye bano ro ro
lilaah bulado asghar ko
kya jaane kis aalam mein ho
ran ko gaye baap ke haaton par
phir ghar nahi aaye
akbar nahi aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya guzri laal mere tum par
kuch to bolo jaane maadar
kya baat hui ran mein sarwar
lekar to gaye thay haaton par
lekar nahi aaye
akbar nahi aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
tum par to hai sab haal ayaan
pani tha kahan jo deti maa
itni si baat pe de di jaan
ghar se gaye aise hoke khafa
mud kar nahi aaye
akbar nahi aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
aajao ay asghar aao
maadar par laal taras khao
ek baar galay se lag jao
mumkin hai laut ke phir dilbar
maadar nahi aaye
akbar nahi aaye…
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi hai gala majboor ho tum
beta zakhmo se choor ho tum
ab mai samjhi kyon door ho tum
mai jaan gayi ay lakhte jigar
kyon kar nahi aaye
akbar nahi aaye…

items.title: Aseer hoti hai
items.body:
bata rahi hai dilon ki badi hui dhadkan
atash ki aag se ab tak jhulas raha hai badan
qayaam jal chuke haathon mein band chuki hai rasan
aseer hoti hai atthara bhaiyon ki behan
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi masayib e karbobala se guzri hai
abhi to qaimon se baahar nikal ke baithi hai
kahan ho ay mere abbas ro ke kehti hai
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheed ho gaye sab bhai karbala aa kar
rida bhi chin gayi sar se hui barehna sar
jo dekh sakte ho abbas dekh lo manzar
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb haal se zainab guzar rahi hai yahan
jali qanaaton se ab tak nikal raha hai dhuan
ubhar ke aa gaye baazu pa rassiyon ke nishan
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pa madine ki yaad aati hai
yateem bachon ko taskeen deti jaati hai
kabhi bhatije ko bad kar gale lagati hai
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pase hussain munadi ye de raha tha sada
chuta madina to sab bhayion ne chod diya
mila hai karbobala aake ye naya tohfa
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kise bulaye kise de sada kare bhi to kya
koi bhi abid e beemaar ke siwa na raha
tumhare khat ka likhe kya jawab ay sughra
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruki ruki hui nafzein hai dil dhadakta hai
qadam qadam pa musibat ka daur dohra hai
jari furaat pa ye baat sun ke rota hai
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha itna sharm mein dooba hua sakina se
palat ke aaya na abbas mera darya se
kaha ye hazrat e zainab ne ro ke laila se
aseer hoti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan pa laayi hai zainab ko ghar kar qismat
hujoom e ranj o alam aur dard ki shiddat
zaban kaun si laaye jo ye kahe ishrat
aseer hoti hai...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay mere bhai hussain
items.body:
suno suno shabe ashoor ka ye manzar hai
sirhane bhai ke baithi ali ki dukhtar hai
wo keh rahi hai mera sabr azmaoge
ay mere bhai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe mujhe bhai yaad aaoge
ay mere bhai hussain ay mere bhai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sehar ko nana ka waada jo tum nibhaoge
ay mere bhai hussain ay mere bhai hussain
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri nigaah mein bachpan ki saari yaadein hai
kahi thi nana ne jo yaad wo bhi baatein hai
sahar se pehle charaghon ko tum bujhaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi sawari tumhari sawaar tum bhai
thay amma zahra ke dil ka qaraar tum bhai
aur aaj khoon mein apne hi tum nahaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare chehre ka ye itmenan jaanti hoon
tumhara hona hai jo imtehan jaanti hoon
behan se dard e jigar ko chupa na paaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
gulu e asghar e baysheer seena e akbar
sata raha hai tumhe sabr kar rahe ho magar
rida ki baat pe nazrein mila na paaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi to bali sakina ka zikr baaqi hai
abhi to shaam e ghariban ki fikr baqi hai
rakhoge yaad kise kisko bhool jaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na gham karo mere bhai tumhare baad bahan
rida na odhegi jab tak tumhe mile na kafan
ye dukh hai saath hamare watan na jaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha hussain ne sun kar kalaam zainab ka
hamari jaan ke badle bache tera parda
ye kya kaha ke mera sabr aazmaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere baghair mukammal nahi payaam mera
tere baghair adhoora hai ab to naam mera
kaho mai aaungi majlis mein jab bulaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye guftugu thi ke goonji azaan akbar ki
rehaan hoti thi yalghaar sheh pe lashkar ki
ali ki beti pukari hamay rulaoge
ay mere bhai hussain...
qadam qadam pe mujhe...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Azane akbar
items.body:
umme laila na bhula paayi azan akbar ki
ghut ke roti rahi zindan may maa akbar ki
<<DIVIDER>>
tod di seena e akbar may udoo ne barchi
kaun kar sakta hai bayan takleef bayan akbar ki
umme laila na bhula paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
akhri waqt may bete ne jo maanga pani
dekh kar ro diye sheh khushk zaban akbar ki
umme laila na bhula paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mout ki hichki pe pahuncha tha behan ka qasid
khat e sughra may thi atki hui jaan akbar ki
umme laila na bhula paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam may bhai ka sar dekh ke roya sajjad
yaad beemar ko aayi thi kahan akbar ki
umme laila na bhula paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme laila ne yehi keh ke mala sar pe lahoo
rakhun mai koi nishani to jawan akbar ki
umme laila na bhula paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhi darbar ki halat to pukari zainab
haye sajjad zaroorat thi yahan akbar ki
umme laila na bhula paayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zafar koi bhi nasir ya madadgaar na tha
siskiyan leti rahi raahon may maa akbar ki
umme laila na bhula paayi...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Bain karti thi ye
items.body:
bain karti thi ye zainab ke bachao bhai
qaime jalte hai madad ke liye aao bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
balwa e aam may beparda khadi hai zainab
binte zehra ko layeeno se bachao bhai
bain karti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash may hai sayyede sajjad jale qaimon may
aake bemaar ko godhi may uthao bhai
bain karti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum to pehchan sakoge na hamari surat
apni surat hamay ek baar dikhao bhai
bain karti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to akbar hai na qasim hai na bhai abbas
hai rasan basta haram inko chudao bhai
bain karti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai gala khushk sakina ka labon par dam hai
pani darya se isay laake pilao bhai
bain karti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hichkiyan leke wo roti hai bulaati hai tumhe
apne seene pe sakina ko sulao bhai
bain karti thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane se ye zainab ki sada aati thi
apni beti ke janaze ko uthao bhai
bain karti thi ye...

items.title: Berida hoke
items.body:
berida hoke payambar ke gharane waale
aaj darbar may zaalim ke hai aane waale
<<DIVIDER>>
sar barehna sar e darbar chali hai zainab
sar khule aaj rahe sog manane waale
berida hoke payambar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
bediya thaame hue aage hai sajjade hazeen
peeche peeche hai payambar ke gharane waale
berida hoke payambar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl waaris hue bazaar may tasheer hue
ab bhi thakte nahi bewon ko satane waale
berida hoke payambar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
khud chale aayegi tham tham ke na kar itni jafa
sayliyan bali sakina ko lagane waale
berida hoke payambar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule saamne zaalim ke sakina jao
mar gaye aap ke sab naaz uthane waale
berida hoke payambar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
daamane aale aba choot na jaye sadiq
ye hai mahtaaj ko sartaaj banane waale
berida hoke payambar ke....
items.author: Sadiq

items.title: Char baras waali
items.body:
ay baba maaf karna ay baba maaf karna
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr mein rakh ke sakina ko ye abid ne kaha
baba ye chaar baras waali amanat lijiye
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ke durron se mai isko bacha bhi na saka
baba ye chaar baras waali amanat lijiye
<<DIVIDER>>
laash aahista se beti ki sambhalo baba
godh mein leke kaleje se laga lo baba
aap ke pyaar ko tarsi hai bahot ye dukhiya
baba ye chaar baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba gaalon pe tamachon ke nishan mat dekho
halq e majrooh pe rassi ke ke nishan mat dekho
ye tahaif isay ummat ne diye hai baba
baba ye chaar baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad kar kar ke tumhe baba bahot royi hai
saal bhar baad kahin jaake ye ab soyi hai
chaunk jaaye na kahin dil se laga lo baba
baba ye chaar baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kis tarha se tha jism se chipka baba
mujhse utra nahi ye khoon bhara kurta baba
khaal bhi saath utarti thi jo karte thay juda
baba ye chaar baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
har tamache pe mujhe is ne pukara baba
mai tha zanjeeron mein aur tauq mein jakda baba
dekh kar reh gayi hasrat se ye mera chehra
baba ye chaar baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai amanat ki hifazat nahi kar paaya hoon
poori mai ek bhi chaahat nahi kar paaya hoon
jaisi saumpi thi amanat mai wh lauta na saka
baba ye chaar baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash khwahar ki uthaun to uthaun kaise
is ke marne ka sabab haye bataun kaise
kuch samjh mein nahi aata hai sunaun kya kya
baba ye chaar baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye do haat baramad huwe aamir us dam
ainee rone ki sada qabr se aayi paiham
haat par rakh diya ye kehke behen ka laasha
baba ye chaar baras...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Dilbande fatema pe
items.body:
dilbande fatema pe zaalim reham na aaya
tashna labi mein tu ne mehman ka khoon bahaya
<<DIVIDER>>
be-gor o be-kafan tha laasha shahe zaman ka
sar noke naiza par hai darbar e shaam aaya
dilbande fatema pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas tum kahan ho lo qaime jal rahe hai
beparda bibiyon pe hai aasman ka saaya
dilbande fatema pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko bezaban tha lekin tha khoone hyder
hurmal ne teer khaincha masoom muskuraya
dilbande fatema pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazar e shaam mein jab aayi ali ki beti
toofan patharon ka chaaron taraf se aaya
dilbande fatema pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran padne waale wo kaise musalman thay
tasveer e fatema ko darbar mein bulaya
dilbande fatema pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
gulzar karbala mein aaye quran waale
afsos bekason ko pani mila na saaya
dilbande fatema pe...
items.author: Gulzar Jafri

items.title: Hai mere dono laal
items.body:
hawa ke dosh pe goonji jo ek nayi sada
salaam alaik ibne rasool-e-shahe huda
khuda ka shukr ke deedaar aap ka to hua
tamaam aseeron ne dekha suye dare kufa
jo laash latki hai dar par wo thartharati hai
salaam karne ki awaaz usse aati hai
tadapke naize se farkhe hussain ne ye kaha
alaikum ay watan awaara o qateele jafa
adab se abide bemaar yun hue goya
khubool kijiye muslim chacha salaam mera
suna jo hazrate muslim bine aqeel ka naam
to ek bibi lagi laash se ye karne kalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
ki zowjaye muslim ne ye fughan
hai mere dono laal kahan
ehwaal karo kuch unka bayan
hai mere dono laal kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
thay saath jo mere do dilbar
wo fidiya kiye maine haq par
jo saath tumhare thay hai kahan
hai mere dono laal kahan
ki zowjaye muslim...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai basti basti ja'ungi
aur dhoond ke unko la'ungi
batlaiye kuch to unka nishan
hai mere dono laal kahan
ki zowjaye muslim...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab tak wo rahe zere saaya
aur kuch to taras un par aaya
kis ghar mein hai ab tak wo mehman
hai mere dono laal kahan
ki zowjaye muslim...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas itna bata dije waali
dunya to nahi unse khaali
kya milgayi unko jaaye amaan
hai mere dono laal kahan
ki zowjaye muslim...
<<DIVIDER>>
di laasha e muslim ne ye sada
de sabr ki taaqat tujhko khuda
ho jaayega tujh par jald ayaan
hai mere dono laal kahan
ki zowjaye muslim...
<<DIVIDER>>
koofe mein anees-e-ehle haram
thay naala kuna waqt-e-matam
sunkar ye sada mehshar tha ayaan
hai mere dono laal kahan
ki zowjaye muslim...

items.title: Haye baysheer asghar
items.body:
raat bhar door se awaaz e buka aati hai

haye baysheer asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
dil sambhaale hue dil thaame hue matamiyon

ek awaaz hai jo qalb ko thar'rati hai

kabhi haathon pe shahe deen ke to chehre pe kabhi
ye nami hai kaisi
ye kisi khoon ki surhki si nazar aati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaali gehware ko aakhir ye hilaata hai kaun
aur behlaata hai kaun
bekasi jis ki taraf dekh ke sharmati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
umr bhar saaye mein baithi na tere baad kabhi
aur na baithegi kabhi
dhoop us maa ke kareeb aake thitak jaati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi dukhiayi behan door bahot door kahin
hai musalsal ghamgeen
yaad teri usay har waqt hi rulwati hai
haye baysheer asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat ka pichla pehar hogaya shahid phir bhi
hai wohi bechaini
ek faryaad ki ley arsh se takrati hai
haye baysheer asghar...

items.title: Hum soorate ahmad
items.body:
ham soorat e ahmed ho hm naam e khuda akbar
kyon kar tumhe maa dede marne ki raza akbar
ham soorate ahmed…

is aalam e ghurbat may sheh kisko pukarenge
kis haal may hote ho baba se juda akbar
ham soorate ahmed…
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jaate thay maqtal may baba ko nahi dekha

jab tumne pukara tha maidan se sarwar ko

sheh leke to aaye thay qaime may tera laasha

is par hi masaib ka kuch zor nahi toota
shabbir ke haaton par asghar bhi gaya akbar
ham soorate ahmed…
<<DIVIDER>>
phir chain se sojana bas itna bata jao
hum kis se ghiza maange aur kis se rida akbar
ham soorate ahmed…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaise bataun mai zaidi ki tamanna hai
marte hue honton par ho naam tera akbar
ham soorate ahmed…

asadullha ali ainullah ali

hyder e karrar ali hyder e karrar
