<<DIVIDER>>
royi be-saakhta sar peet ke fizza waiz
jab padha fatema zehra ne ye nauha waiz
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
meri aaghosh ka haq maut ne cheen liya
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Kaha maadar ne
items.body:
kaha maadar ne bas itna bata do phir chale jaana
ali asghar mujhe surat dikha do phir chale jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
tabussum ka samandar le ke aa jao mere dilbar
lagi hai aag qaimon mein bujha do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jidhar bhi dekhti hoo bas udaasi hi udaasi hai
mera veeran ghar jannat bana do phir chale jana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe dekhun kalaje se lagaun baal suljhaun
bas itni dayr mera jee badha do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tassalli kuch to ho jaye mere toote huwe dil ko
mujhe jo tum pa guzri hai bata do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari yaad mein sughra madine mein tadapti hai
likhe kya khat mein sughra ko bata do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
andhere khaaye jaate hai mujhe shaam e ghariban ke
mujhe tum chand si surat dikha do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
judaai ka tassawur khaaye jaata hai mere dilbar
kahan tak gham uthaye ye bata do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tum ne hurmala ke teer se ki guftagu ran mein
wo baatein aa ke ghar bhar ko bata do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
suna hai teer khaake ran mein beta muskuraye thay
hamare saamne bhi muskurado phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi nauha tha ishrat maadar e asghar ke honton pa
meri bigdi hui dunya bana do phir chale jaana
kaha maadar ne bas...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Laasha yahin kahin
items.body:
ro kar pukare sayyade waala yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua laasha yahin kahin
<<DIVIDER>>
ay karbala bata mera pyara kidhar gaya
bhaiya hassan ka raaj dulaara kidhar gaya
ghode se wo abhi to gira tha yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
farwa ki jaan bhai ka jaani wohi to tha
sar ta qadam hassan ki jawani wohi to tha
wo naujawan maara gaya tha yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein khiza ne kha liya farwa ke baagh ko
nazrein talaashti hai hassan ke chiragh ko
gum ho gaya hai uska janaza yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
wallah koi bol de naushaah kahan gaya
ek raat ki dulhan ka wo dulha kahan gaya
usne abhi tha mujhko pukara yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram mein naala o faryad hai bapa
jaana hai leke laash mujhe suye qaimagah
miljaye mujhko mera bhatija yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peet kar qayaam mein roti hai bibiyan
aur dhoondta hoo laasha e qasim ko mai yahan
phat jaye na ghamon se kaleja yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir karbala ki khaak se shabbir ne kaha
milti nahi hai laash bhatije ki ye bata
kya tune kar diya hai dafeena yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi nida e karbobala ya shahe zaman
pamaal ho chuka hai tan e qasim e hassan
bikhra pada hai wo gul e taaza yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir rida mein kar ke tan e paash paash ko
bole kumail dekh ke shabbir laash ko
dede mujhe bhi maut khudaya yahin kahin
qasim ka tha pada hua...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Mar na jaye kahin
items.body:
zaanu pe rakh ke sar ko mazloom e karbala
kehte thay tadap kar
<<DIVIDER>>
mar na jaaye kahin wo maa akbar
is tarha lo na hichkiyan akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon jo seene se hai rawan akbar
kar ke tanha chale kahan akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha qaimon mein le ke jaana hai
zakhm maaon se ye chupana hai
aise ragdo na aediyan akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal e ghurbat tumhe sunana tha
maa ne seene tumhe lagana tha
aa gayi darmiyan sina akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ki dhadkan ko aasra de do
hum ko awaaz e mustafa de do
ab nahi doge kya azaan akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke teri sada e adrikni
daude kehte huwe ye ibne ali
aa raha hoo mai meri jaan akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri beenayi kho gayi hai pisar
mujhko aata nahi hai kuch bhi nazar
do na awaaz ho kahan akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath seene pe dhar liya beta
maine mehsoos kar liya beta
zakhm gehra hai meri jaan akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere yusuf tum hi thay ay pyare
meri aankhon ke tum hi thay taare
kho gaya mera kul jahan akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
<<DIVIDER>>
likh zoha dil mera bhi phat'ta hai
saath barchi ke dil bhi khichti hai
khaynchte hai wo jab sina akbar
mar na jaaye kahin...
items.author: Zoha Yusuf

items.title: Mita ke rakh diya
items.body:
mita ke rakh diya baatil ka naam zainab ne
payambarana kiya hai ye kaam zainab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
charaagh sabr ke maqtal mein yun kiye roshan
kiye wo azmat o kirdaar ke diye roshan
sahar bana di shahadat ki shaam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya zuban se wo hamla ali ke lehje mein
diya wo ghaiz mein khutba ali ke lehje mein
ulat ke rakh diya darbar e shaam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen kaamp uthi ahle zulm ghabraye
jo qadh zuban thay wo bezuban nazar aaye
kiya jalaal mein jis dam kalaam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi to bhai ke matam mein aah o zaari ki
kabhi jale huwe qaimon ki pehredari ki
guzari is tarha ghurbat ki shaam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
laraz ke reh gaya darya ajab hua ehsaas
tadapta reh gaya saahil pe laasha e abbas
pukara jis ghadi ghazi ka naam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
bala ke dasht mein apne lahoo mein doobe huwe
ghayoor sheron ke laashe tadap tadap uthe
kiya jo aakhri sheh ko salaam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
na apni pyaas na bete kisi ko yaad kiya
hamesha bhai ki tashna labi ko yaad kiya
kabhi jo pani piya tishna kaam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya tha waada jo gohar usay nibhaya hai
aseer ho ke bhi islam ko bachaya hai
batool zaadi alaihe salaam zainab ne
mita ke rakh diya...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Aaja akbar
items.body:
aaja akbar shabihe paighambar
shakle zehra tujhe bulaati hai
khaali hujron mein yaadon ke
roz sughra diye jalaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya ujde gharon ki tanhaai
kaise dekhegi teri maajayi
bain kar ke ye khud bhi roti hai
nani salma ko bhi rulaati hai
aaja akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khatm muddat ho ab judaai ki
nana surat dikha de bhai ki
gham ki roodad jo ke dukiyari
roz nana ko ro sunaati hai
aaja akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
deti paigham hai parindo ko
koi akbar se jaa ke ye keh do
lab pe sughra ke naam hai tera
ashk shaam o sahar bahaati hai
aaja akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
din ko takti hai raah wo teri
raat kat'ti hai yaad mein teri
jab se bichda behen se tu akbar
chain ek pal kahan wo paati hai
aaja akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab kabhi dekhti hai gehwara
yaad aata hai hasliyon waala
deti hai loriyon khayalon mein
jhoola asghar ka wo jhulaati hai
aaja akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli jawwad shaah ki dukhtar
yaad karti hai tujhko ro ro kar
kya kabhi tujhko bhi ali akbar
bhool kar meri yaad aati hai
aaja akbar...
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Ali ya ali
items.body:
afsos ali ka ummat ne
sajde mein khoon bahaya hai
kaisa ye waqt qayamat ka
aulaad e nabi par aaya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
us zakm se zarb e muljim ke
zainab ka kaleja chalni hai
is qaum ki khaatir sajde mein
jo zakm ali ne khaaya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid mein huwe zakhmi hyder
baba ki jabeen hai khoon mein tar
ye masjid e kufa mein nauha
abbas ke lab par aaya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jiska badan pamaal hua
wo jisko kafan ran mein na mila
mazloom wo apne baba ka
taboot utha kar laaya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ne sar ko peeta hai
zainab pe yateemi aayi hai
kufe mein udaasi chaayi hai
aflaak ka dil thar'raya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki judaai ke gham ko
ab tak na bhula wo paayi thi
phir aaj ali ki beti par
ghurbat ka zamana aaya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ke baba qatl huwe
jibreel sada ye deta hai
abbas ke aansu behte hai
shabbir ka dil bhar aaya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh gawahi deti hai
wo kufa ho ya karbobala
ummat ne mohib har zulm o sitam
aulaad e nabi par dhaaya hai
ali ya ali ya ali...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Aseeri ki hawa
items.body:
ye aseeri ki hawa kaise chali hai abbas
aaj zainab sar e darbar khadi hai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ke waali bhi nahi godh mein bacche bhi nahi
ye behan saath unhe le ke chali hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhala aur ghareebul watani kya hogi
sar pa chadar nahi aur dhoop kadi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bujh gaye shaam e ghariban ke wo sholay lekin
dil e zainab mein abhi aag lagi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bemaar bhatija hai faqath saath mere
us ke pairon mein bhi zanjeer padi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
log sadqe ke khajoorein meri jaanib phaynke
kya yehi martaba e aal e nabi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab e sarwar pa chadi maar raha hai zaalim
aur hasrat se behan dekh rahi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baith kar padti hoo raaton ko namazein bhaiya
ab to meri bhi kamar toot gayi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye aseeri hai faqath maqsad e sheh ki khaatir
warna zainab tere saanche mein dhali hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaksiyat zainab e muztar ki bayan kya ho bilal
kabhi zehra kabhi sarwar to kabhi hai abbas
ye aseeri ki hawa...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Ay mere dilo jaan
items.body:
ay mere dil o jaan ali asghar ali asghar
maa tujhpe ho qurban ali asghar ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
deti mai kafan tujhko rida sar pe jo hoti
mil jaata ta jo pani to tere zakhm ko dhoti
hoon be-sar o saaman ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to sare shaam e ghariban meri ghurbat
jhulsa hua jhoola hai to ujdi hui turbat
ujda hai gulistan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauhon ki sadaon mein badal bhi chuki lori
jhoola hi salaamat hai na ab jhoole ki dori
godhi bhi hai veeran ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo need se aur dhoop se jalti hui aankein
yaad aati hai wo ashk ugalti hui aankhein
mamta hai pareshan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis teer ne chedi thi teri phool si gardan
maa kaise batayein bhala us teer ki uljhan
seene mein hai paikaan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat thi ke baandhun mai tere maathe pe mai sehra
aur sehre mein dekhun tera hasta hua chehra
ujde mere armaan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa baandhun tere nanhe se sar par mai amaama
aur choomun tera phool sa moo chand sa maatha
haste huwe quran ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas rayt hai maqtal ki na takiya na bichona
ab hashr talak tujh ko isi ban mein hai sona
maa jaati hai zindan ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha shaam e ghariban ka dhuaan aamir o nayyar
khaak ujde huwe jhoole ki bikhri thi jahan par
kehti thi wahin maa ali asghar ali asghar
ay mere dil o jaan...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Azane akbar bula
items.body:
allahu akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
aao namaze fajr hai
azaane akbar bula rahi hai
khuda ki wehdaniyat ka humko
paighame haq ye suna rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
isi azaan ke liye sayyed
jawan akbar fida kiye hai
raahe khuda mein shaahe shaheedan
masoom asghar bhi de diya hai
hussain lekar chale jo maqsad
kyun aaj dunya bhula rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chale azaane fajar jo de kar
to bole sheh ye batao akbar
judi hai saansein wo jiski tum se
wo bin tumhare jiyegi kyun kar
mazaare nana pe roz jaa kar
diye jo sughra jala rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran kaafi hai jo thay kehte
yehi hai quran ke wo kaari
hai wo jo naatiq quran logon
usay karenge ye qatl kaari
karenge pamaal iska laasha
ghadi asr ki wo aa rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ke tukde huwe hai ban mein
ghilaaf e kaaba utaar daala
hussain ko karbala mein ummat
hai pyasa khursheed maar daala
usi ki mazloomiyat pe dunya
ye aaj aansu baha rahi hai
aao namaze fajr hai...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Bain tha sakina ka
items.body:
bain tha sakina ka shaam hone waali hai
kab tak aaoge baba shaam hone waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khushk hai zaban meri teen din se hoo pyasi
kaun pani layega shaam hone waali hai
bain tha sakina ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
subha ke charaghon ki tarha hai sabhi khamosh
cha raha hai andhiyara shaam hone waali hai
bain tha sakina ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
neend kaise aayegi soyun kiske seene par
jald aaiye baba shaam hone waali hai
bain tha sakina ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ke ujaale mein ghar luta ke baithi hoo
phir na lootle aada shaam hone waali hai
bain tha sakina ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke tasavvur se kaampti hoo reh reh kar
ghut raha hai dam mera shaam hone waali hai
bain tha sakina ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai bhi chacha bhi hai kya tumhare saath ab tak
koi bhi nahi aaya shaam hone waali hai
bain tha sakina ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya saeed kehta hai haale dil sakina ka
subha se hai hungama shaam hone waali hai
bain tha sakina ka...
items.author: Saeed Shaheedi

items.title: Berida shaam ke
items.body:
berida shaam ke bazaar mein jaati hai behan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai is chand se chehre ko na lag jaye grahan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
<<DIVIDER>>
teri ghairat ye gawara na karegi bhaiya
sab tamashayi hai aur bhai behan be-parda
badti jaati hai ay abbas kaleje mein chuban
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumko abbas bahot tha mere parde ka khayaal
aa gaya shaam ka bazaar aur zainab hai nidhaal
tere marne se badi zainab e kubra ki thakan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay wafadaar sakina ka gala jakda hai
ashk ke badle teri aankh se khoon behta hai
hoga ye ranj bhatije ke hai haathon mein rasan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
thodi hi dayr ko rukta tera sar naize par
be-rida sab mera sar dekh ke phir tera sar
khauf hai soch ke rukh jaye na dil ki dhadkan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ghatri mein hamein laash mili qasim ki
dasht mein baad tere aisi qayamat tooti
ran mein pamaal hua is tarha naushaah ka tan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab ke sakina ki rida aayi hai
na yateema hai na zinda mera bhai hai
thi wo rehan o mubarak to ajab si uljhan
aankhein abbas khuli mat rakhna
berida shaam ke bazaar...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Charaghe chehraye
items.body:
charaghe chehrae akbar na ghul ho ye dua hai
lahoo aankhon se laila ki musalsal beh raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ba zaahir zakhm to hai seena e akbar may lekin
haqeeqat may wo naiza seena e sheh may gada hai
charaghe chehrae akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam akbar ka laaya sheh ke balon may safedi
gayi beenayi aankhon may andhera cha gaya hai
charaghe chehrae akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ulatkar aasteen ya ali kehte hai sarwar
ke barchi khayncha qalbe pisar se maujeza hai
charaghe chehrae akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
phuphi aajaye na maqtal may shaahe deen ke peeche
sakht akbar ke liye ye marhala hai
charaghe chehrae akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rache shadi jo akbar ki to mujhko yaad rakhna
madine se kisi bemaar ne khat may likha hai
charaghe chehrae akbar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali akbar ki shahid aakhri ruqsat ka manzar
bhare ghar se janaza jaise koi jaa raha hai
charaghe chehrae akbar...
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Dile akbar sambhal
items.body:
dil e akbar sambhal lo baba
chubti barchi nikaal lo baba
<<DIVIDER>>
sunta hoon dam nikalna mushkil hai
baahein gardan mein daal do baba
dil e akbar sambhal...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek khat ke likh ke meri sughra ko
khabr e inteqal do baba
dil e akbar sambhal...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum se kadiyal jawan na uthega
laasha ghode pe daal do baba
dil e akbar sambhal...
<<DIVIDER>>
nikal aayi ho gar phupi baahar
kisi surat se taal do baba
dil e akbar sambhal...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma hasrat nikaal le apni
sehra phoolon ka daal do baba
dil e akbar sambhal...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt kuch aur hai khuda hafiz
moo pe chadar to daal do baba
dil e akbar sambhal...

items.title: Hai momino pe farz
items.body:
hai momino pe farz ita'at hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
karboabala mein zulm o jafa ka riwaj tha
sar pe yazeediyat ke khilafat ka taaj tha
shabbir ka lahoo jo maseeha mizaaj tha
warna munafiqat ka maraz la-ilaaj tha
yun karbala mein fikr o nazar ki dawa hui
karbobala ki khaak bhi khaake shifa hui
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye hai deen e haq ke liye karbala hussain
sibte rasool o laqte dil e murtuza hussain
hadi imam haq ke wali rehnuma hussain
tum ko pukarte hai azadaar ya hussain
aankhon mein apni ashke aza leke aaye hai
dil mein shaoor e karbobala leke aaye hai
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun karbala mein sheh ne bhara ghar luta diya
khud sogaye to deen ka muqaddar jaga diya
chehre se ahle kufr ke parda hata diya
asghar ne has ke saare jahan ko rula diya
baysheer mein asar tha ali ke shaoor ka
asghar ke has ke tod diya buth ghuroor ka
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
bedi pehen ke abid e bemaar aayega
is raaste mein shaam ka bazaar aayega
ye zikr baad sayyede abraar aayega
jab tasht mein ye sar sar e darbar aayega
zindan mein shor hoga zameen thar tharayegi
baba ka naam leke sakina bulayegi
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogi abhi to shaam e ghariban ki daastan
cheenga shimr baali sakina ki baaliyan
bazaar e shaam pahunchega lut kar ye karwan
qaidi banegi ahmed e mursal ki betiyan
baaqi musibatein hai abhi qaid khane ki
in qaidiyon pe hongi nigahein zamane ki
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ka laal sibte rasool e anaam hai
khanjar talay bhi bakshishe ummat se kaam hai
shabbir ka payaam khuda ka payaam hai
matloob e do jahan shahe aali maqam hai
paata raha urooj yuhin gham hussain ka
lehra raha hai aaj bhi parcham hussain ka
hai momino pe farz...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Hyder hyder
items.body:
dard may doobi fiza hai saara aalam soghwaar
har taraf se naala o shewan ki aati hai pukar
<<DIVIDER>>
tera matam mere maula kare dunya haye
har lab par tera nauha rahe maula haye
hyder hyder hyder hyder
<<DIVIDER>>
uneeswi ramzan ki kaisi sehar aayi
daaghe yateemi zainab o kulsoom ki laayi
jibreel ki faryad sun ke royi maajayi
fizza musalla chod ke ek baar chillayi
sar e masjid bain karte hai rozadaar
hai apne khoon may ghaltan syed sardar
hyder hyder hyder hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab masjid e kufa se ghar aap ko laaye
sab betiyan sar peet ke kehne lagi haye
kis shaan se baba gaye kis haal may aaye
hum log abhi tak maa ka sadma bhool na paaye
nahi baba zabt ka yaara hui jo bedaar
saara kufa ro ro kar kar ye faryaad
hyder hyder hyder hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
jarrah ne jab zakm ko dekha to ye bola
tukde jabeen maula ki hai aur zakhm hai gehra
khoon beh chuka hai is qadar ke zard hai chehra
kuch roz ka mehman hai ab khalq ka maula
ay logon farsh bichao ab matam ka
karo mil ke aah o zaari kaho alwida
hyder hyder hyder hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
saare namazi ro diye is baat ko sun kar
milke gale rone lage shabbir se shabbar
wa hasrata ke bain thay sadaat ke lab par
kulsoom ghash khane lagi aur zainb e muztar
sabhi karte thay wavaila peer o jawan
karte thay ahle kufa bas ye fughan
hyder hyder hyder hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se chale taboot ko lekar pisar jis dam
tha khaana e zehra may ek kohraam ka aalam
karte thay sab hi seena o sar peet ke matam
zainab pukari jee nahi payenge baba hum
chale sab hi khaak udaate tere hubdaar
tere gham may nauha padte hai matamdar
hyder hyder hyder hyder...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar bada dushwaar hai tehreer may laana
alfaaz may sadaat ke ehwaal batlaana
hai aansuon se zabt ka labrayz paimana
ek maujiza hai lafz ka nauhe may dhal jaana
kahe ye qirtaas aur khaama hyder maula
tere gham ashoor jaisa hyder maula
hyder hyder hyder hyder...
items.author: Safdar Abbas

items.title: Kaha rabab ne rokar
items.body:
kaha rabab ne ro kar watan chalo beti
ye maa ho tum pa nichawar watan chalo beti
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap tadap ke mai roti hoo har ghadi ab to
rehaai qaid se sun kar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khila pila ke sulaya karungi pehlu may
ye waada karti hai maadar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ab tamache na shimr e layeen ka darr hoga
na koi cheenega gauhar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek lamha jise yaad kar ke roti thi
hai muntazir wo tera ghar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahana shimr ka pani wo tum ko tadpa kar
na bhool paayi wo manzar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
andheri raat hai aur ek hoo ka aalam hai
sukoon paaogi kyun kar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi khushi ki tamanna wo maa kare kaise
ke jis pa toota ho mehshar watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rabab qabr e sakina se jab raza uthi
har ek lamha tha lab par watan chalo beti
kaha rabab ne ro kar...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Karbala walon pa
items.body:
karbala walon pa jo guzri qayamat aur hai
har payambar par jo aayi wo musibat aur hai
<<DIVIDER>>
asr tak kya jaane kya ho pyas ki shiddat ka haal
suboh se ashoor ke suraj ki hiddat aur hai
karbala walon pe…
<<DIVIDER>>
kat ke sar darul amaara par hai shah ka muntazir
kufiyon muslim ka andaz e sifarat aur hai
karbala walon pe…
<<DIVIDER>>
kheenchni hai seena e akbar se barchi ki ani
aakhri ye shaahe deen bete ki khidmat aur hai
karbala walon pe…
<<DIVIDER>>
rayg zaare garm par chadar bichate hai hussain
kya kare ke laasha e qasim ki haalat aur hai
karbala walon pe…
<<DIVIDER>>
baab e khyber ka uthana wo shuja'at aur thi
teer kha kar muskurana ye shuja'at aur hai
karbala walon pe…
<<DIVIDER>>
dushmanane karbala phir maareka aara hai aaj
majlis o matam ki shahid ab zururat aur hai
karbala walon pe…
items.author: Shahid Jafer

items.title: Khoon barsa
items.body:
khoon barsa khoon barsa
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barsa na barasna tha na badal barse
ek ek khatre ko pani ke shah e deen tarse
khoon barsa khoon barsa
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas jab hadh se badi ro ke sakina ne kaha
door kitni hai chacha nehr batao ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kahan khaak pe baithi ho sakina utho
kaun aaya hai palat kar jo gaya ran ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurkiyan shimr ki kahin jo kiya baap ko yaad
kaan ke dard se royi to tamache barse
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi shabbir hai zinda wahin tehro zainab
tum ko akbar ki qasam tum na nikalna ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere nana ke madine tujhe zainab ka salaam
thokare khaa ke palat aayi hoo main dar dar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq o baatil ka ho takrao to dil ladte hai
jang ye jeeti nahi jaati kabhi lashkar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...

items.title: Laashae abbas tanha
items.body:
laasha e abbas tanha reh gaya
dekh kar darya tadapta reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab gira ghoday se saqqa e haram
qalbe zehra ran may rota reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
chid gayi mashke sakina zulm se
pyase bache khaali kooza reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kham hui is gham se sarwar ki kamar
chashme tar se khoon tapakta reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
us taraf pyasi sakina reh gayi
is taraf laasha tadapta reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti thi chacha aajaiye
lab pe uske bas ye nauha reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunte hi bhai ke marne ki khabar
phat ke zainab ka kaleja reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nigehbane haram jabse gaya
tab se aafat hi may kunba reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheenli ghazi ne yun nehre faraath
hashr tak darya pe khabza reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gaye dunya may kitne taqt-o-taaj
bas azakhana hi sheh ka reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
parchame islam aur abbas ka
har taraf dunya may charcha reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai aaj bhi mauje faraath
ibne zehra haaye pyasa reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha e gham kis tarha likhe bober
jab qalam hi uska rota reh gaya
laasha e abbas...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Mera akbar jawan
items.body:
teri shadi ka armaan sughra ko tha
uske lab par hai shaam o sehar ye dua
mere bhai se mujhko mila de khuda
wo nahi jaanti hai ke naiza laga
<<DIVIDER>>
raas aayi na karbobala
mera akbar jawan mar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab suna ran mein ghode se akbar gire
thokarein ran mein khaate huwe sheh chale
khaak aur khoon mein hai wo ghaltan pade
haal dekha pisar ka to kehne lage
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhe zakhmi jigar ko shahe karbala
us mein barchi ka phal jo nazar aagaya
hai tasavvur mein nana rasool e khuda
jaise unki jawani ko naiza laga
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal sughra ka baba dikha dijiye
mujhko deedar-e-sughra kara dijiye
ayk bhai behan ko mila dijiye
mere zakhmi jigar ko chhupa dijiye
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
daali akbar ne suye madina nazar
ek zaeefa hai baba wo hai be-khabar
us pe teri judaai ka hai ye asar
wo zaeefa hai sughra teri muntazir
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri furqat mein ye haal e sughra hua
jhuk gayi hai kamar haath mein hai asa
sochti hai mera bhai kab aayega
jeete ji kya behen se wo mil payega
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
bole sheh kaise sughra sune ye khabar
muntazir raah mein hai bichaye nazar
ho gaya ran mein bhai ka zakhmi jigar
mar na jaaye kahin sunke noor e nazar
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
muntazir hai mere bhai saansein meri
dekh le aake dekhna ki tu bekasi
aisa lagta hai lamhon ki hai zindagi
phir na kehna ke sughra meri chal basi
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe sehra ho aana meri qabr par
apni dulhan ko laana meri qabr par
ek chadar chadhana meri qabr par
mera nauha sunana meri qabr par
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
padh ke tahreer roye shahe karbala
naama sughra ka ashkon se tar hogaya
bole qasid se jaa ke suna waqeya
teer asghar ko akbar ko naiza laga
raas aayi na karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok le apna shaukat qalam rok le
ashk ban kar siyaahi ke khatre kahe
bibi sughra ke jo bain tu ne likhe
chashme insan se ashkon ke darya bahe
raas aayi na karbobala...
items.author: Shaukath Bilgrami

items.title: Naizo may shababe
items.body:
naizo may shababe ali akbar nazar aaya
uljha hua khaaro may gule tar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun roye haram yaade shaheedane wafa may
har aankh may ashkon ka samandar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas chale nehr pe bachon ki bandhi aas
har haath may umeed ka saagar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shimr chala chod ke shabbir ka laasha
ek haath may sar ek may khanjar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sotay may bhi haat apna hilaati thi jo bano
kya khaab may gehwara e asghar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani sheh e mazloom abhi maang rahe thay
haaton pe tadapta ali asghar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haal hua hoga sitam-deeda behan ka
jab tashte tila may sare sarwar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
<<DIVIDER>>
samjhunga nisar aankhon ne dekha dare jannat
kismat se agar rauza e sarwar nazar aaya
naizo may shababe...
items.author: Nisar Nagri

items.title: Abbas aa ke dekho
items.body:
zainab ki ye sada thi zaalim sata rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho zaalim sata rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
meri rida sina par mujhko dikha rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat ke saron se chinti thi jab ridayein
aale nabi ne di thi us dam tujhe sadayein
ab khaake karbala se sar ko chupa rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naazon se jo pali thi bhaiya teri bhatiji
ab hai sitam ke zad par haye sakina meri
usko sata rahe hai durre laga rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein aag jis dam zaalim laga rahe thay
tujhko madad ki khaatir hum sab bula rahe thay
sajjad ka bhi bistar aada jala rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na-mehramon mein zainab sar nange ab yahan hai
zaamin meri rida ke na jaane tu kahan hai
be-pardagi pe meri aada rula rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
salman ek qayamat karbobala mein guzri
sun kar sada e zainab ghazi ki laash larzi
meri rida sina par mujhko dikha rahe hai
abbas aa ke dekho
zainab ki ye sada thi...
items.author: Salman Rizvi

items.title: Akbar naujawan
items.body:
akbar e naujawan tujhko dhoondun kahan
nauha laila ka tha akbar e naujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
tere barchi lagi maa ka dil chidh gaya
ab jeeye kis tarha teri dukhiyari maa
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
roye ansar o ahle haram kehke ye
aakhri hai ye aks e nabi ki azan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri tarha lage har jawan ki sada
dekhti hoo jahan tu dikhe hai wahan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khat mila aa ke le jao bemaar ko
kyun ho naraaz sughra se ay bhai jaan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab pisar ne bulaaya madad ke liye
shaah karte thay girte sambhalte fughan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne khaynchi sina kehke jab ya ali
phasliyon se tha baahar dil e bekaraar
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaysuon waale tujh par phupi ho fida
thi yun zainab bhi laashe pe nauha kuna
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash mein pyasi sakina ye kehti rahi
mujhko dilwado bhaiya meri baaliyan
akbar e naujawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ay mirza ye nasir ne nauha padha
ashk aankhon mein thay lab pe tha ye bayan
akbar e naujawan...
items.author: Javaid Mirza

items.title: Asghar aajao
items.body:
maa dhoond rahi hai kabse asghar aajao aajao
chaaya hai har simt andhera dilbar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
tumse bichad kar dilbar mere
tadpoongi mai shaam savere
kaise jiyegi maa bin tere
aajao aajao asghar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhuka aalam gor andhera
soone jangal mein hai basera
ghut'ta hai dam khauf se mera
phaile hai har simt sitamgar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
khushk gala hoga mere jaani
aao pila laa'un tumhe pani
kuch to pata do kuch to nishani
khaati hoo mai thokare dar dar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja mere raaj dulare
aa meri aankhon ke taare
dukhiya maa ro ro ke pukare
kaise jiyungi tumse bichad kar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
jabse suna hai fikr siwa hai
nanhe galay mein teer e jafa hai
dil ko ek dhadka sa laga hai
chalta hai dil par mere khanjar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoondh rahi hoo kabse ro ro
chain se maqtal mein sotay ho
tarsogay maa ke soorat ko
jaati hoo mai shaam khule sar aajao
maa dhoond rahi…

items.title: Ay mere hussain
items.body:
ay mere hussain as-salam
ay mere imam as-salam
bekas o ghareeb as-salam
shaahe tishnakaam as-salam
<<DIVIDER>>
alqama pe jab alam gira
goonji ye taraai mein sada
al-madad ay shaahe karbala
kehta hai ghulam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sitam ye aur ho gaya
qalbe akbar-e-hazeen chida
akse mustufa ne di sada
ya shahe inaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ye shaah ki behan
haye be-dayaro be-watan
berida hoo kaise doo kafan
jaa rahi hoo shaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay habeeb ay hure jari
aun-o-akbar-o-mere aqi
yun hi saare dard mein ghiri
mere nayk naam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
tum kahan ho paaraye jigar
dhoondti hai tum ko ye nazar
chin chuki rida jala hai ghar
mere la-laqaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
<<DIVIDER>>
maine ye kalaam jo likha
is ko nazre shaah kar diya
hai yahin pa mohsin ab mera
harfe istetaam as-salam
ay mere hussain…
items.author: Mohsin Shakeeb

items.title: Bain ye zainab ka
items.body:
bain ye zainab ka tha shaam e ghariban bata
kya hua kunba mera shaam e ghariban bata
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim e naushaah ki laash ke tukde huwe
kaisa ye sehra bandha shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun ye har ek aankh se khoon ke aansu giray
kaise hai gham ki ghata shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid e beemar par shah ke ghamkhwar par
kyun hai ye jor o jafa shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas may asghar mera rayt par tadpa kiya
pani kya usko mila shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ye aayi hai shaam khauf har ek soo hai aam
aur iraada hai kya shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed mere ganj e shaheedan may thay
dono ka hai haal kya shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon se jalte huwe maut ke sholay uthe
kya koi zinda bacha shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye yateemon ke saath aur aseeron ke saath
hai yehi insaaf kya shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mera akbar jawan mar gaya kha kar sina
laasha kya uska utha shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar e zeeshan ke zakhm bahatar lage
hai yehi karbobala shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai bhi palta nahi pani bhi aaya nahi
kya hua ghazi mera shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye garoh e hussain padti hai zainab ke bain
kyun na ho ghamgeen raza shaam e ghariban bata
bain ye zainab ka tha...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Berida shaam ki
items.body:
be rida shaam ki galiyon se guzar zainab ka
phir se abid pe hai tehreer safar zainab ka
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon e shabbir ki har boond ka maqrooz bashar
khoon e shabbir hai maqrooz ye magar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir pada khaak pe abbas ka sar maqtal may
nok e naiza se na dekha gaya sar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar e shaam ki tayghon may ghira hai akbar
chup gaya kitni ghata'on may qamar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash e akbar se lipat kar ye hawa kehti thi
kitna chalni kiya barchi ne jigar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye alag baat ke mehfooz raha deen e rasool
ye alag baat ke loota gaya ghar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah shaam e ghariban ki ho majlis barpa
zikr hota hai wahan taa'ba sehar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur goonjega abhi arz o samaa may mohsin
matam e ibne ali may hai asar zainab ka
be rida shaam ki galiyon...
items.author: Mohsin

items.title: Charaghe hussain
items.body:
charagh e hussain
phaili hui hai khushbuein baaghe hussain ki
har simt roshni hai charagh e hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
ye woh charag jise sheh ne aagahi di hai
isi charagh ne dunya ko roshni di hai
isi charagh ne gul hoke shaam e ashoora
hussaniyat ke iradon ko zindagi di hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
isi ke noor se dunya ye jagmagayi hai
hayaat shams o qamar ne isi se paayi hai
dayaar e zulm se hurr is taraf jo aaya hai
isi charag ke lou hurr ko khaynch laayi hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussaniyat ka jigar mein charagh jalta hai
shaour o fikr o nazar mein charahg jalta hai
kabhi namaz ki surat kabhi azan ban ke
khuda e paak ke ghar mein charagh jalta hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye baat haq hai ke noor e tahoor is mein hai
tajalliyaat raheem o ghafoor is mein hai
har ek shaks isy dekh hi nahi sakta
jo koh e toor pe chamka woh noor is mein hai
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
shumaar iska hai mabood ke nageeno mein
isi ki aag hai maulaiyon ke seeno mein
isi charagh se hai raunaq e azadari
yehi charahg to roshan hai sheh nasheeno mein
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sadi ki sada hussain zindabad
bayaz e dil pe likha hussain zindabad
payambaro ne kaha hussain zindabad
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi to surat e baysheer mein hai muskaya
bana ye seena e akbar sina ka phal khaaya
hussain ban ke yehi noor baad e ashoora
quran padhte huwe bar sar e sina aaya
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khusha naseeb jo hum ko mili hai karbobala
hussaniyo ke liye zindagi hai karbobala
jise ye saara zamana salaam karta hai
usi charagh se roshan hui hai karbobala
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sune ye saara zamana wafa hussain se hai
hamari khuld ka har raasta hussain se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dar e hussain pe jo shaqs jaa nahi sakta
hisaar e noor mein is ke woh aa nahi sakta
hussain ibne ali ne isay jalaya hai
isay koi bhi yazeedi bujha nahi sakta
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
noor uska chupa nahi har ek ko dikha nahi
dushman ko mila nahi zaalim se bujha nahi
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeediyat ke andheron ko maarne waala
yehi hai dasht mein hal min pukaarne waala
shahadaton ko ziya baar kar diya is ne
yehi hai joun ki surat nikhaarne waala
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua hai phoolta phalta rahe charagh e hussain
hawa e zulm kuchalta rahe charagh e hussain
faqat yehi hai dua e kumail o aamir ki
aza ki shakl mein jalta rahe charagh e hussain
charagh e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera imam hussain mera kalaam hussain
hai subho shaam hussain tumhara naam hussain
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Din dhal gaya
items.body:
din dhal gaya shaam aa gayi abbas abbas na laute
shaam aur ghazab dha gayi abbas abbas na laute
<<DIVIDER>>
baakhi nahi ansar na hai monis o yawar
maqtool-e-jafa ran may hue sarware aalam
karte hai haram shiddate aalaam se matam
sab khurdo kalzam aaho buka karte hai payham
ye kiski nazar kha gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo kaunse hai zulm jo bedeeno ne choday
atfaal e hussaini pe sitam haye ye today
ghash may pade bemaar ko maare gaye koday
taraaj kiya qaimon ko dauda diye ghoday
sadaat pe aanch aa gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar loot liya cheeni rida qaime jalaye
zar loot ke saydaniyo ko durre lagaye
hai kaun jo aada ki jafa'on se bachaye
zainab kisay imdaad ko ab apni bulaye
ghurbat ki faza chagayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
dar aaye qayame pisar-e-sheh may sitamgar
zakhmi kiya durro se tan e abide mustar
khayncha sitam afgaaro ne bemaar ka bistar
dekha gaya aflaak o zameen se na ye manzar
karbobal tharra gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zainab-e-kubra ne khabar gham ki ye paayi
maqtal may kahin kho gayi shabbir ki jaayi
us waqt suqan lab pe ye binte ali laayi
ay dashte jafa kaisi jafa aur ye dhaayi
maa ghamzada ghabragayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghosh tumhari hai na hai baap ka seena
zid karti hai jaan khoti hai ro ro ke hazeena
aisa to kabhi dekha na tha bhai khareena
kyon aayi na darya pe tumhe yaad sakina
kya cheez wahan bha gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
raat aagayi daaman may liye apne qayamat
aaram se sab sogaye sar share shahadat
phir zulm-o-sitam dhaane lage ehle shaqawat
bewariso ke sar kule karne ko hifazat
balwe may bahan aa gayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha likhoon aur karoon kaise ye ada mai
kya kya na jafa'ein hui zindan-e-jafa may
rehte thay haram yun to shab-o-roz buka may
ek roz sakina ko anees hijre chacha may
zindan may neend aagayi abbas abbas na laute
din dhalgaya shaam aagayi…
items.author: Anees

items.title: Gar haq ki justuju
items.body:
gar haq ki justuju hai to bazme aza may aa
batlaun tujhko majlis o matam hai kyun bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ki arsh farsh may phaili hui zia
haq kehte hai usay jo hai meezan e kibriya
haq kehte hai jise wo hai emaan e ambiya
haq ki sifat to khaas may hai ek mustufa
gar haq ki justuju…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mustufa ke jinka mohamed hai paak naam
wo jinke khaul o fayl se haq ka mila dawam
yani baghair wahi jo karte nahi kalam
quran bata raha hai jo hai inka martaba
gar haq ki justuju…
<<DIVIDER>>
haq kya hai kya bataun ke wo la hudood hai
aale nabi may noore khuda ka wujood hai
hamd o sana may isliye shaamil durood hai
haq iska hai ye haq kay nahi koi faasla
gar haq ki justuju…
<<DIVIDER>>
ulfat ba hukme rab thi isi noore ain se
ye baarha suna hai shahe mashraqain se
mera hussain mujhse hai aur mai hussain se
kya farq hai hussain o nabi may raha bata
gar haq ki justuju…
<<DIVIDER>>
bayyat na ki hussain ne to qatl kar diya
badkar to iske baad ko kyun ghar jala diya
saydaniyo ko loot liya cheen li rida
aale rasool ki thi bhala isme kya khata
gar haq ki justuju…
<<DIVIDER>>
saydaniyo ke sar thay khule ajdaham may
aseer karke le gaye darbar e aam may
phi bhi na choda qaid kiya ino shaam may
ajre risalat is tarha ummat ne ki ada
gar haq ki justuju…
<<DIVIDER>>
jispar pahad tootega gham ka wo royega
aayega chain din ko na raton ko soyega
hoga rafeeq joyi to ye haal hoyega
tareekh jab aayegi gham hoyega siwa
gar haq ki justuju…
<<DIVIDER>>
apne nabi ko gham hai to hum door kyun rahe
lene ko pursa jaate hai girya ko na chale
mil kar anees kyun nahi matam bapa kare
sibte nabi ke gham may hai ye majlise aza
gar haq ki justuju…

items.title: Hai shahadat hasan
items.body:
aaj majlis may sab hai khule sar
hai shahadat hassan askari ki

khud imam e zamana hai muztar
hai shahadat hassan askari ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak udaati hai turbat may zehra
janasheen e naqi mera pota
zehr se tujhko maara sitamgar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr ki seh ke maula aziyyat
karte hai aaj dunya se rukhsat
kamsini hi may haye muqaddar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera waali gaya aaj maara
mai hui aaj se be-sahara
kehti jaati hai narjis tadap kar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalimon ka hassan tha nishana
ro rahe hai imam e zamana
ghamzada hai ali o payambar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
lijiye momino ka bhi pursa
karte hai do mahine se girya
haq adaa ho saka na baraabar
hai shahadat hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj maghmoom shia hai saare
unke aaqa hai jannat sidhaare
kyun na roye bober bhi tadap kar
hai shahadat hassan...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Haye bemaar chala
items.body:
haye bemaar chala
<<DIVIDER>>
bediyan pehne huwe khaafila salaar chala
haye bemaar chala
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahi hai dar o dewaar se rone ki sada
haye bemaar chala
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jalti hai zameen aag ugalti hai zameen
koi saaya bhi nahi
aabile pad gaye pairon mein badan tapne laga
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
pair kya haathon pe gardan pe pade hai chaale
koi pani daale
tapte hai tauq o salasil hai bahot garm hawa
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaante chub jaate hai chaale kabhi chil jaate hai
haye dukh paate hai
haye kis haal mein hai ibne shahe karbobala
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aah karte hai to durron ki saza paate hai
yun tadap jaate hai
pa barehna ye aziyat ka safar aur ye jafa
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyan deke jise sulaate thay jise shaahe umam
hogaya kaisa sitam
ab wohi naazon ka paala hai giraftaar e bala
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
taziyane kabhi maare kabhi pathar maare
haye sheh ke pyare
kis khadar zakhmi musafir pe hui jor o jafa
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheekh uth'ti hai to zakhmon se lahoo behta hai
har sitam sehta hai
kis se faryad kare bhai na baba na chacha
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr se bali sakina ko chudaye kaise
jaan bachaye kaise
hatkadi haathon mein hai tauq mein jakda hai gala
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule maayein hai behnein hai sitamgaaron mein
haye bazaron mein
sar jhukaye huwe rota hua khuddar chala
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar bete ki haalat ko tadap uth'ti ha maa
ye bhi hota hai gumaan
aa na jaaye kahin bemaar ko raste mein qaza
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kis haal mein hai sibte payambar ka pisar
khaak udao gohar
peet kar seena o sar bain karo ahle aza
haye bemaar chala
bediyan pehne huwe...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Hum zinda hai
items.body:
hum zinda hai matame shabbir ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
daure umayya may ye kiska khoon tha jo ke behta tha
ahle wafa ko ahle aza ko deewaron may chuna gaya
phir bhi ek sada e payham aati thi deewaro se
hum zinda hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
har jaabir se har zaalim se hum thay jo takrate thay
is matam ki khaatir humne ghar ke ghar qurban kiye
ghalib aakhir haq aaya baatil ne ghutne tayk diye
hum zinda hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
toofano ki zad pe hamesha hum ne diye jalaye hai
itne ziddi sarkash haasid humko mitane aaye hai
deewano ke khaab adhoore ab tak poore ho na sake
hum zinda hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ahlebayt ke dar ko chode apna ye kirdaar nahi
har insan ko rehbar kehde ye apne atwaar nahi
kal bhi jo apna maula tha aaj bhi apna maula hai
hum zinda hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch deewane hai aise bhi karbobala ko bhool gaye
allah allah yaad rakha aur aale abaa ko bhool gaye
raahe wafa se hatne walon tumko kaun ye samjhaye
hum zinda hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar de kar ghar baar lutakar hum ne ye gham paaya hai
iski khaatir jaane kitna apna khoon bahaya hai
jo khoon sare tareekh baha us khoon ke katre bol uthe
hum zinda hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jazbaye meesam lekar hum ne nafrat ka rukh mod diya
zulm o sitam ki zanjeero ko apne amal se tod diya
naam o nishan tak mit jaate hai hum ko mitane walon ke
hum zinda hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
nauhagaro aur seena zano ko zainab deti hai ye dua
ghar na ujde haye kisi ka jaisa mera ghar ujda
bas ek armaan hai zainab ka qaayam ye gham sada rahe
hum zinda hai…

items.title: Hyder ka janaza
items.body:
kufe mein har ek samt ajab shor bapa hai
sajde mein namazi pa bada zulm hua hai
is zulm ki shiddat se jahan kaamp raha hai
sab rote hai maghmoon zamane ki sada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ka janaza hai ye hyder ka janaza
hasnain ke kaandhon pe hai hyder ka janaza
<<DIVIDER>>
ay momino sarwar ki yateemi ka hai ye waqt
kulsoom ki shabbar ki yateemi ka hai ye waqt
ab uthne ko tayyar hai rehbar ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki bhi aankhon mein nazar aate hai aansu
abbas jo rote hai ajab hashr hai har soo
ay shio hai ye deen ke muqaddar ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
rone ki sadayein hai ajab aah o fughan hai
jibreel ke honton pe musalsal ye bayan hai
kufe mein utha faatahe khyber ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain se ek ye bhi wasiyat thi ali ki
le jaana ujaale mein na mayyat ko hamari
beton hai payambar ke dilawar ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bibi ke jis bibi ki todi gayi phasli
mazlooma wohi bibi payambar ki thi beti
hai ye us gham-khayi ke shohar ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay momino rowo ke ali hogaye ruqsat
hai qaana e zehra mein bapa ek qayamat
uth'ta hai zamane ke bahadar ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bhala inki musibat likhe koi
rone ke liye momino jumla hai ye kaafi
hyder ka janaza hai ye hyder ka janaza ye
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
is waaste ghazi ne ki sarwar se wasiyat
maula nahi le jaana meri qaimon mein mayyat
uth'ta nahi bhai se baradar ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ke janaze ko bhi sarwar ne uthaya
irfan sharar phat'ta hai ye sunke kaleja
maidan se utha nahi sarwar ka janaza
hyder ka janaza...

items.title: Jalta hua bistar
items.body:
jalta hua bistar koi beemar na dekhe
be-jurm o khata tauq e girabaar na dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jaaye na sadme hi se beemar ilaahi
be parda haram ko sar e bazaar na dekhe
jalta hua bistar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maango ye duayein shab e ashoor sakina
ye raat kabhi subho ke aasaar na dekhe
jalta hua bistar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi fikr ye zainab ko rida bhi nahi sar par
is haal may abbas e alamdaar na dekhe
jalta hua bistar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar naize se ghazi ne giraya hai zameen par
zainab ka khula sar koi badkaar na dekhe
jalta hua bistar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
maare hai sitamgar ne sakina ko tamache
zaalim ne zara phool se rukhsaar na dekhe
jalta hua bistar koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
milti hai kaleem usko sakina se duayein
bachon ko jo be-yaar o madadgaar na dekhe
jalta hua bistar koi...

items.title: Kaha ro kar sakina
items.body:
haye baba mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ro kar sakina ne mai kaise shaam jaungi
padar ki khoon bhari mayyat ko kaise bhool paungi
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaati hoon suye zindan magar mujhko ye lagta hai
wahan se laut kar shayad mai wapas aa na paungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot jaldi yateemi qabr tak le jayegi mujhko
bichad kar tum se ay baba bahiot din jee na paungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pada hai dhoop mein laasha mere baba ka jo ran mein
mujhe wapas mili chadar to wo laasha chupaungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari yaad mein baba mere din raat guzrenge
hai waada shaam ka zindan azakhana banaungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha ki laash par ro kar ye kehti reh gayi bacchi
mai mushkil mein ghirungi to bhala kisko bulaungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi sar pe rida mere bata do ay ali akbar
azaan hogi jo raste mein to sar kaise chupaungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mumkin to nahi lekin agar pani koi dega
chacha ki yaad aayegi mai pani pee na paungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot kamszor o laaghir hoon hai dil bas char barson ka
tamachon se mai khud ko shimr ke kaise bachaungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamache is tarha se shimr ne maare hai ke ashhar
mujhe lagta hai ruqsaron ke bal ab so na paungi
kaha ro kar sakina ne...

dasht e ghurbat mein bhai ko bhai
mere bhai
chod kar is tarha se na jaaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke boli sakina ke hae hae
mere ammu
aap aise gaye phir na aaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...

aayi shaam e ghariban to zainab
ro ke boli
kaun hai ab jo aa kar bachaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...

boli zainab madad kar madad kar

dekhe sheron se bhai ka laasha

maange ro kar shah e deen ki dukhtar

kar rahe hai jafayein sitamgar

items.title: Mera akbar maar
items.body:
maara gaya hai naize se beta hussain ka
ye sun ke ajab haal tha maula hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi girte thay kabhi uth'te thay
kehte thay hussain ye ro ro kar
mera akbar maar diya mera akbar maar diya
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha uthaunga laasha haye mai apne kaandhe par
mera akbar maar diya mera akbar maar diya
<<DIVIDER>>
bete ki judaai aankhon ki beenayi bhi le jaati hai
ek maa jaa jaa kar qaimon ki deewaron se takrati hai
jab baap sadayein deta hai ran mein laashon se takra kar
mera akbar maar diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan akbar ki shaadi ka mere dil mein hi dam tod gaya
socha tha mai usko apne haathon se banaunga dulha
ye baap sajayega haye ab sehra kis ke maathe par
mera akbar maar diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
atthara saal jise paala naazon se meri zainab ne
barchi ke baad us bete ko talwaron se maara sab ne
kis tarha kahunga qaimon mein jab jaunga laasha lekar
mera akbar maar diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe hausla de warna beta tera baba bhi mar jaayega
mujhse tere qaatil kehte hai tera akbar ab na aayega
wo naiza dikha kar haste hai jab kehta hoon mai ro ro kar
mera akbar maar diya...

chalte chalte ye kehte huwe haathon se kamar ko thaam liya
abbas agar tum hote to mera akbar bhi zinda hota
pehle tujhe maar diya aur ab in shaam ke logon ne mil kar
mera akbar maar diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab paas akbar ke pahunche to zakhmi uska seena dekha
bete ne aakhri hichki li jab toota hua naiza khayncha
shabbir ne bas ye kehte huwe sar rakh diya zakhmi seene par
mera akbar maar diya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan o raza jab beti ka khat bete ke seene pe rakha
shabbir ke ashkon ki tarha akbar ka khoon tapakne laga
jis haath se barchi khaynchi thi us haath se likha jab khat par
mera akbar maar diya...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Aaja ay laal asghar
items.body:
asghar aaja asghar aaja
veeran aaja veeran aaja
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja ay laal asghar jhoola jhulaun aaja
<<DIVIDER>>
paaya na teen din se pani ka tu ne khatra
gul ki tarha se beta nazuk hai jism tera
sholay ugal rahi hai ran ki zameen aaja
aaja ay laal asghar...

socha nahi tha aise lut jayegi kameini
is kamsini mein teri ho jayegi judaai
tere baghair beta kis kaam hai dunya
aaja ay laal asghar...

zufein teri sawarun chehra tera sajaun
teri balayien lelun sadqa tea utaarun
maangu duayein rab se jeene ki tere beta
aaja ay laal asghar...

toofan utha rahe hai har simt zalzalein hai
aandhi bhi chal rahi hai qaime bhi jal rahe hai

aaja ay laal asghar...

tere baghair kaise ab chain se rahungi
asghar mai tujhko khokar pal bhar na jee sakungi
maadar ko bhi bulaale tu jis jagah hai beta
aaja ay laal asghar...

zahid wo tera nauha mohsin suna raha hai
har maa ke dil ka armaan isme raqam hua hai
toofan e gham hai isme hai hasraton ka darya
aaja ay laal asghar...
items.author: Zahid Ali

items.title: Aliun waliullah
items.body:
goonji ye sada zameen par parwardigar ki
aliyun wali-ullah aliyun wali-ullah
mehnat ali ke laal ki rang laayi hai
sar deke apna shaah ne wilayat bachayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kya na gham uthaye wilayat ke waaste
laashon pe laash laaye wilayat ke waaste
zakhmon pa zakhm khaaye wilayat ke waaste
iske liye hussain ne dunya lutaayi hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ko naujawan ka jigar pesh kar diya
asghar ke jaisa noor e nazar pesh kar diya
iske liye hussain ne ghar pesh kar diya
khud mar ke sheh ne umr e wilayat bachayi hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
<<DIVIDER>>
marne ko sheh ke saamne chote bade gaye
honton pa apne pyaas saja kar lade gaye
maidan mein dua e wilayat pade gaye
ye shaan e karbala ke shaheedon ne paayi hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
<<DIVIDER>>
qurbani e hussain mein aisi umang thi
dunya bahot nabi ke nawase pe tang thi
karbobla wilayat e hyder ki jung thi
qurbani e hussain tasavvur pa chaayi hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re batool ke farzand ka jigar
hone ko hogaya tha juda sheh ka sar se tan
maqsad se phir bhi apne hatayi nahi nazar
naize pe daastan e wilayat sunayi hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha shaah e deen ke khoon ka pyasa har aadmi
karbobala mein lut'ti thi dunya hussain ki
dunya ko thi wilayat e hyder se dushmani
be-jurm taygh sookhe galay par chadhayi hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
<<DIVIDER>>
toda gaya pahaad ghamon ka imam par
baazu diye kise na wilayat ke naam par
pani tha band tifl e shahe tishnakaam par
qasim ne apne khoon se mehendi lagayi hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
<<DIVIDER>>
qurbani e hussain ki daulat sambhal ke
pyase mujahidon ki amanat sambhal ke
rakhna dilon mein apne wilayat sambhal ke
irfan ye shaheed e wafa ki kameini hai
mehnat ali ke...
sar deke apna...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Ay mere kadiyal jawan
items.body:
ay mere kadiyal jawan ay mere kadiyal jawan
ay pisar e naujawan ay pisar e naujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
peet ke sar dasht mein nauha ye karti thi maa
ay mere kadiyal jawan ay mere kadiyal jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hi tha mera sukoon tujhse tha aabaad ghar
jaate hi tere mera hogaya barbaad ghar
dasht mein ab dhoondne tujhko mai jaaun kahan
ay mere kadiyal jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu tha kameini meri tu hi tha haasil mera
barchi lagi hai tujhe zakhmi hua dil mera
khoon mere dil se bhi hone laga hai rawan
ay mere kadiyal jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ye kaisa hua haye sar e karbala
lut gaya asbaab sab chin gayi sar se rida
rota hai akbar tujha qaimon se uth'ta dhuwan
ay mere kadiyal jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk bahaungi mai khaak udaungi mai
roti rahungi sada sab ko rulaungi mai
hoga labon par mere nauha tera hi rawan
ay mere kadiyal jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere noor e nazar kha gayi kis ki nazar
hogi bhala kis tarha umr meri ab basar
royegi akbar tujhe jayegi maadar jahan
ay mere kadiyal jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mein sunungi azan yaad teri aayegi
khon har ek gaam pe yaad ye rulwayegi
dil mera phat jayega jab mai sunungi azan
ay mere kadiyal jawan..
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha ab laut ke jaungi mai karbala
kya kahun sughra ko mai itna tu maaa ko bata
gham tera sughra se mai kaise karungi bayan
ay mere kadiyal jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh ke paale mere paas bulaale mujhe
zulm o sitamgaar se aake bachaale mujhe
baandh rahe hai layeen shaano mein ab reesma
ay mere kadiyal jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
noor ali lab pe hai sab ke hi aah o buka
chaayi hai chaaron taraf ranj o alam ki ghata
nasir e zaidi kare kis tarha ye gham bayan
ay mere kadiyal jawan...
items.author: Noor Ali

items.title: Ba khuda hussain hai
items.body:
ya hussain ya hussain
ya hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sayyed o sardar e man
murshad o sultan e man
ya hussain ya hussain
akbar o salaar e man
mimbar e emaan e man
<<DIVIDER>>
wal asr ki qasam walfajr ki qasam
wan noor ki qasam yaseen ki qasam
allah ke bataye huwe deen ki qasam
keh raha hai khud ye kibriya
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda
deher mein binaye la ilaah
ba khuda hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
saansein nisar baadshahe mashraqain par
qurban dil ka chain bhi zahra ke chain par
apne lahoo se likhte hai akbar ke pursadar
sadqe ye do jahan hai imame hussain par
haq ki zaban raaz e azaan shaahe shaheedan
kashti e nabi ka nakhuda
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
uski bulandiyon ka ihata koi nahi
wo behr hai ke jiska kinara koi nahi
tareekh e kayenat mein aisa koi nahi
khilkat mein uski shaan ka band akoi nahi
noore haram shaahe umam deen ka bharam hai
do jahan mein naaze kibriya
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
as salaam as salaam as salaam
ya hussain as salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
maula hussain sayyed o salaar as salaam
au kushtagane ishq ke sardar as salaam
ay mehmana e assaib e noor as salaam
haye hussain tashna o ranjoor as salaam
ay aakhri nabi ke nawase tere nisaar
ay saahile furaat ke pyase tere nisaar
as salaam as salaam as salaam
sallal lahu wa alika ya abaab dillah
laayek e salaame kibriya
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
halqon mein chal rahi hai hawa ya hussain ki
daulat hamay hui hai ataa ya hussain ki
lagta hai aane waala hai ab aakhri hussain
kaabe se aa rahi hai sada ya hussain ki
baabe saqa rabbe ataa dar hai dua ka
matami ka sirf aasra
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
saje ko apne qibla e kaaba bana diya
khaali zameen ko arshe moalla bana diya
meraaj ke nazare dikhaye zameen par
qaime ko kohe toor ke jaisa bana diya
abre karam naaze ajamshaahe arab hai
aaj tak ameer e karbala
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
poora nabi ka khwab kiya hai hussain ne
maqtal ka inteqab kiya hai hussain ne
chadar chini hai zainab o kulsoom ki magar
dushamn ko be-naqaab kiya hai hussain ne
subhe azal shaame abad noore ahad hai
inqelaab e waqt ki sada
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor aur dasht ka manzar lahoo lahoo
asghar ka halq seena e akbar lahoo lahoo
zakhmon se choor ho ke mohamed ka laadla
aaya hai pushte zeen se zameen par lahoo lahoo
shor utha pyasa gala katne gala hai
bekas o ghareeb o bekhata
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
matam ki saf jahan bhi banate hai matami
daste khuda ka haath batate hai matami
tazeem mein utha hai takallum har ek bashar
ek shor hai ke hashr mein aate hai matami
aankhon mein nam seeno mein gham lab pe sada hai
kaarwan e haq ka peshwa
ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda ba khuda hussain hai
deher mein binaye la ilaah...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye shahe karbala
ya hussain ya hussain
fatema ka laadla
ya hussain ya hussain
ghar ka ghar tera luta
ya hussain ya hussain
koi na tera raha
ya hussain ya hussain
asghar e bekhata
hussain hussain hussain husssain
akbar e naujawan
hussain hussain hussain husssain
haye wo bawafa
hussain hussain hussain husssain
haye sheh ka gala
hussain hussain hussain husssain
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Bainul harmain
items.body:
ehsaas rulaata hai dil bibi se kehta hai
ay binte ali ay khwahar e hasnain
<<DIVIDER>>
ek samt haram hai ghazi ka
ek samt hai haram e hussain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza
hota bainul harmain
<<DIVIDER>>
ek jaa par bhai behan rehte
karte na bichad kar bain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza
hota bainul harmain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu sharam o haya ki malka hai
phirwaya tujhe un galiyon mein
jis jaa na kabhi jaati teri
izzat waali naalain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ke liye tu shaam gayi
gar us ki qabr yahin hoti
tujh ko bhi qaraar aa jaata aur
bhai ko bhi milta chain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza...
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad mein tumhe jab tadpata
akbar ke bichadne ka sadma
abbas dilaasa de deta
aur pochte ashq hussain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ki yaadon se bibi
dil tera kabhi jo ghabrata
asghar ko saath sula leti
aa jaata dil ko chain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bete jinhe tu ro na saki
shabbir ka matam karti rahi
karbal mein saath tere hote
wo tere noor e ain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor aur chehlum karne ko
meelon ki musafat tay kar ke
tu shaam se na aati bibi
karne ko yahan par bain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza...
<<DIVIDER>>
qurban teri mazloomi par
farhan bhi hai aur mazhar bhi
ek hum hi nahi kehte bibi
kehte hai yehi hasnain
ay bibi kaash tera rauza...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Charaghe shaame
items.body:
charaghe shaame ghariban ki roshni zainab
shareek e maqsad e shabbir ban gayi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
aza e shaah ki baani tu karbala ki safeer
hai pehli saare shaheedon ki matami zainab
shareek e maqsad e shabbir...
charaghe shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame hussain mein hi zindagi tamaam hui
na apne aun o mohamed ko ro saki zainab
shareek e maqsad e shabbir...
charaghe shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain aap ki us laadli sakina ko
tamache lagte rahe kuch na kar saki zainab
shareek e maqsad e shabbir...
charaghe shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ke rauze pe sughra se jab mili nazrein
zaban se kuch na kaha aur ro padi zainab
shareek e maqsad e shabbir...
charaghe shaame ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
zafar jala ke charagh e aza e shabbiri
yazeediyat ke diyon ko bujha gayi zainab
shareek e maqsad e shabbir...
charaghe shaame ghariban...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Din dhal raha hai
items.body:
din dhal raha hai pyasi sakina udaas hai
mashk o alam ki ab bhi yateemon ko aas hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dam ghut raha hai laut ke aajao ab chacha
asghar ko teen roz se pani nahi mila
bacche sisak rahe hai kayi din ki pyaas hai
din dhal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rahawaar se sakina ne ro ro ke ye kaha
rakhna khayal dasht mein baba hussain ka
is dashte karbala mein yehi meri aas hai
din dhal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye raat ye andhera ye zehra ki betiyan
maqtal say ek yateema ki aati hai siskiyan
kaano se khoon behta hai chehre pe yaas hi
din dhal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye waaris e rasool hai tujhko khabar nahi
khanjar se qatl jisko tu karta hai ay layeen
dilband e fatema hai ye haq ki asaas hai
din dhal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon khaar ban mein shaam e ghariban bhi aagayi
din mein tamaam shab ye sada goonjti rahi
baba tumhari laadli beti udaas hai
din dhal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao mohib namaz e mawaddat kare ada
emaan ki daleel hai ye gham hussain ka
rota hai jo hussain pe wo haq shanaas hai
din dhal raha hai...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Gardan pe teer
items.body:
roti rahi maadar haye ali asghar
asghar haye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan pe teer khaa kar
dunya se jaane waale
maa ko bhi ab bula le
<<DIVIDER>>
tujh se bichad ke asghar
maa kaise dil sambhale
maa ko bhi ab bula le
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se gaye ho beta
maa dhoop mein hai baithi
tum bhi to dhoop mein ho
ye baat mai na bhooli
ay qabr mein padar ke
seene pe sone waale
maa ko bhi ab bula le
gardan pe teer...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum yaad aa rahe ho
dil ro raha hai mera
mujhko wahin bula lo
ab tum jahan ho beta
seene tujhe laga ke
maa haal e dil suna le
maa ko bhi ab bula le
gardan pe teer...
<<DIVIDER>>
sookha hua gala tha
roti rahi taraayi
afsos hai mai tujhko
pani pila na paayi
kausar pe maa pahunch kar
pani tujhe pila le
maa ko bhi ab bula le
gardan pe teer...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal tera jhoola
veeran hogaya hai
bin tere mera ghar bhi
sunsaan hogaya hai
baakhi nahi hai meri
dunya mein ab ujaale
maa ko bhi ab bula le
gardan pe teer...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala se lut kar
jab shaam mai chali thi
naize pe tere sar ko
mai dekh kar pukari
mushkil se tujhko asghar
maa kis tarha nikaale
maa ko bhi ab bula le
gardan pe teer...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein tumhare
laashe pe ro chuki hoon
zindan mein apni pyasi
beti bhi kho chuki hoon
koi nahi hai kis ko
umme rubab paale
maa ko bhi ab bula le
gardan pe teer...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeehsan o shadman wo
maa dhoop se jo uthi
chaon mein ek paon
rakhte hi jaan nikli
awaaz phir na aayi
ay cheh mahine waale
maa ko bhi ab bula le
gardan pe teer...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Hai shame ghariban
items.body:
hai shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte huwe qaime hai har soo dhuaan dhuaan
hai shaam e ghariban hai shaam e ghariban
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal mein dhal gaye hai shaam e alam ke saaye
baithi hai dukhi zainab laashon pe sar jhukaye
hai dhoondti maqtal mein bacchon ko bibiyan
hai shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
waaris gaye sab maare jaaye to kidhar jaaye
al haafiz o hafeez ki hai aa rahi sadayein
hogayi hai sar barehna zahra ki betiyan
hai shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ki sada sun kar aayi laash pe sakina
jis seene pe soti thi aaya nazar kahin na
baba ka chida seena teeron ke darmiyan
hai shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalta hua daaman hai kaano se lahoo jaari
hai maarte tamache quran ke ye kaari
kehti thi ro sakina baba ho tum kahan
hai shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hasbuna thay kehte ye unhi ka hi chalan hai
khursheed karbala mein har laash bekafan hai
pamaal hua karbal hai naatiq e quran
hai shaam e ghariban...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Hyder ka janaza
items.body:
wasi e mustafa ka kul ke maula ka janaza hai
amaama jiska khoon mein bhar gaya uska janaza hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
<<DIVIDER>>
janaze se lipat kar betiyan behaal hoti hai
tadap kar zainab o kulsoom ka rona batata hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
qayamat dha rahi hai aaj tak uneeswi ramzan
jo ab har saal hi ekeeswi ramzan ko uth'ta hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaate hai na jaane kis tarha baba ki mayyat ko
ghamon ki raah par ye sarwar o shabbar ka nauha hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka khoone na-haq keh raha hai daastan gham ki
jo barpa hai zamane bhar mein wo matam ye kehta hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi ghul hai yateemon ka sahara uth gaya haye
ye dooba gham mein har majboor ka bekas ka chehra hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
julooson mein uthaate hai jo hum taboot hyder ka
hamari aankh se phir ashke gham ye kehke behta hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai turbat fatema zahra ki haye sog mein doobi
zameen par arsh par nauha ye saare ambiya ka hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
kise maloom hai kya dukh mila hai soghwaron ko
kisi ko kya khabar kis dil se ye izhaar likhta hai
ye hyder ka janaza hai
wasi e mustafa ka…
items.author: Ali Izhaar

items.title: Kaha sakina ne rokar
items.body:
kaha sakina ne ro kar kahan gaye ammu
hai meri jaan labon par kahan gaye ammu
<<DIVIDER>>
mere chacha ko elaahi tu khair se rakhiyo
kahin na phoote muqaddar kahan gaye ammu
kaha sakina ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada ye aati hai darya se kis ke rone ki
ye kis pe rote hai sarwar kahan gaye ammu
kaha sakina ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sun rahi hoo ke darya pe kar rahe hai jihad
laday na behre payambar kahan gaye ammu
kaha sakina ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai pani laane ko jaane na deti tum ko kabhi
ye dayr kyun hui aakhar kahan gaye ammu
kaha sakina ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamaam ehle haram hogaye be-parda
phupi ki chin gayi chadar kahan gaye ammu
kaha sakina ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bandhe hai mashk alam may pharera khoon may tar hai
mai pyasi reh gayi aakhir kahan gaye ammu
kaha sakina ne ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar apna peet ke ay saif kehti thi naadan
hamare chin gayi gauhar kahan gaye ammu
kaha sakina ne ro kar...

items.title: Khoon ke aansu
items.body:
khoon ke aansu lahoo lahoo ye manzar tere naam
tapti reti be-sar laashe sarwar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
chala abu talib ka beta aayi nidaye ghaib
farshe nabi par sone wale khyber tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
has kar boli binte asad se kaabe ki deewar
sher ki dukhtar sher ki maadar ye ghar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri ghulami rashke ameeri wah teri taqdeer
aal ki kidmat deen ki nusrat qambar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat mein jaan de di lekin daaman e aal na choda
haq ki rifaqat faqr ki daulat buzar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi chain ki neend aayi hai talwaron ke neeche
sone waale aaj nabi ka bistar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehre ka arman hai dil mein maa ko kya maloom
maut jawani ne likh di hai akbar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange hai jaane waali bazaar e kufa mein
khudrat ne tatheer ki likhdi chadar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand sa chehra khoon mein ghaltan baap ka baazu zakhmi
pyaas ki shiddat maut ki lazzat asghar tere naam
khoon ke aansu...

items.title: Maa zahra
items.body:
hassan hussain ki zakhmi ghareeb maa zahra
tamache khaati hai beton ke darmiyan zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar ke saath shikasta huye hai baazu bhi
tumhari tooti nahi sirf phasliyan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo saans leti hai pehlu may dard badta hai
ke ab to le bhi nahi sakti hichkiyan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamacha maara hai zaalim ne is tarha tum ko
zameen pe toot ke bikhri hai baaliyan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan hi jaane ke masjid se ghar tak aate huye
tamache khaake giri hai kahan kahan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chupaye kaise ali ki nigaah se fizza
tere lahoo se bhara hai tera makaan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch aur badti hai dushwaari saans lene may
kahin jo sunti hai bachon ki siskiyan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali se pooch rahe hai hussain rote huye
kya taaziyane ke khaabil hai meri maa zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi salaam ka deta nahi jawab usay
hai tanha faatah e khyber ki qadr daan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha ke laayi hai khanjar talay se apna imam
badi ameer thi zainab tumhari maa zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain tadpe takallum na kyun tahe khanjar
tumhare haath pe durron ke thay nishan zahra
hassan hussain ki zakhmi...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Mera bacha mere
items.body:
mera baccha mere maula ka azadar bane
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hussaini hoo meri jaan azadari hai
fathe shabbir ka aelaan azadari hai
mera maslak mera eemaan azadari hai
har qadam par meri pehchaan azadari hai
nauha shabbir ka lori mein sunaya mujhko
haa meri maa ne azadar banaya mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
maine gehwara e asghar pe jo maangi thi muraad
mujhko baysheer ke sadqe mein mili hai aulaad
kaash ye pairawe abbas e alamdar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqa e asghar e bayysheer hai baccha mera
fidya e hazrat e shabbir hai baccha mera
is ta'alluk se ye mazloom ka ghamkhwar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi wakf hai shabbir ke matam ke liye
maine aulaad ko paala hai moharram ke liye
khwaab tabeer mein dhal jaye wo kirdaar bane

mera baccha mere maula ka..

marte dam tak bhi kabhi matam e sarwar na chute

dil se abbas e dilawar ka wafadar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...

mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali keh ke mera laadla ghar se nikle
leke abbas ke parcham ko jidhar se nikle
har qadam manzil e dushwaar bhi hamwaar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi

mera baccha mere maula ka..

lab e baysheer ki khamosh takallum ki qasam
mere maalik tujhe abid ke tabassum ki qasam
godh ka paala mera qaadim e mukhtar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...

mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi

merey bache pe zamane ka asar kuch bhi na ho

mera baccha mere maula ka...
