items.author: Fakhri Meerthi

items.title: Mohamed ka kaisa
items.body:
mohamed ka kaisa gharana hai dekho
shah e deen ko jangal basana hai dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
hai akbar ka laasha pada ran may logon
kisi ghamzade ko uthaana hai dekho
shah e deen ko jangal basana hai dekho
mohamed ka kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhara ghar lutaya hai emaan ki khaatir
abhi tak ye rota zamana hai dekho
shah e deen ko jangal basana hai dekho
mohamed ka kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
qayamat hai yasrab ki godhi ke paale
kata kar gala deen bachana hai dekho
shah e deen ko jangal basana hai dekho
mohamed ka kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
na tha tujhko laazim sawaar e mohamed
muqaddar may laashe uthaana hai dekho
shah e deen ko jangal basana hai dekho
mohamed ka kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
kata kar ye pyasa gala zer e khanjar
ye emaan ki hujjat jataana hai dekho
shah e deen ko jangal basana hai dekho
mohamed ka kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
maray jo mohabbat may aale nabi ke
hai jannat may uska thikana hai dekho
shah e deen ko jangal basana hai dekho
mohamed ka kaisa...

items.title: Nala balabe zainab
items.body:
nala balabe zainabe lachaar hussaina
maujood hai asbaab na ansar hussaina
hai charo taraf narghae kuffar hussaina
faryad nahi koi madagar hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
ab koi nahi sab mahe anwar gaye maare
saaath aaye thay jitne wo dilawar gaye maare
hamshakle mohamad ali akbar gaye maare
soya hai labe nehr alamdar hussaina
nala balabe zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo margaye unpe bhi ajab zulmo jafa hai
ya dhoop hai ya khaak ya maqtal ki hawa hai
mazloomon ke laasho pe na saya na rida hai
wa hasrata wa aalame dara baar hussaina
nala balabe zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye saath thay ammo he giran sham e ghariban
aur sehme hue ahle haram dard badama
zaqmo pa namak pashi ka hone laga saaman
ab koi nahi muniso ghamkhar hussaina
nala balabe zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya azm tha ghurbat mein bhi ay saniye zehra
bacho ko sambhala kabhi bewa'on ko dekha
sajjad ko baqar ko sakina ko sulaya
maujood hai akbar na alamdar hussaina
nala balabe zainabe...
items.author: Mohsin Shakeeb

items.title: Pathar hai aankh jisme
items.body:
pathar hai aankh jis mein ke ashk e aza nahi
wo dil nahi ke jis mein ali ki wila nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
jis qalb mein mawaddat e aale iba nahi
samjho nabi se usko koi waasta nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas us pe zeb deti hai dastaar e mustafa
jo sar yazeediyat ke muqabil jhuka nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala najaat e bashar ki ikayi hai
karbobala ke baad koi karbala nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dil ghame hussain mein ek ashk ke aewaz
gar khuld mil rahi hai to sauda bura nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyon se jal raha hai charaghe ghame hussain
ashkon ka ye charaagh hawa se bujha nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ke waqaar pe khanjar chala tha ye
shabbir ke galay pe ye khanjar chala nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao ghame hussain mein matam bapa kare
ye wo namaz e ishq hai jiski qaza nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab khadi hai ad-jale qaimon ke darmiyan
kya waqt aagaya hai ke sar pe rida nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne be-ridayi se bazaar e shaam tak
wo kaunsa sitam hai jo dil par saha nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab tere nabi ki shariyat to bach gayi
aal e nabi ke ghar mein to kuch bhi bacha nahi
pathar hai aankh...
<<DIVIDER>>
ta zindagi muhib ne munafiq se jang ki
halaan ke uske haath mein koi asa nahi
pathar hai aankh...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Aaja ay mere baba
items.body:
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina ne tadapkar ye kaha
aaja ay mere baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
raat din roti hoo karti hoo faqad yaad tujhe
ek pal chain nahi aati hai zindan mein mujhe
ay mere baba judaai na mai seh paaungi
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab tere baad mai samjhi hoo yateemi kya hai
door jo ghar se hui samjhi aseeri kya hai
dard o gham aur sitam sehti hai dukhiya teri
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho rukhsaar pe kitne hai tamachon ke nishan
jism mein dekho zara kitne hai durro ke nishan
dard itne hai ke lagta hai mai marjaungi
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere seene pe hi soti thi lipat kar mai tujhe
ab bhala khaak pe neend aaye to aaye kaise
haye dekho to sakina ki zara bechaini
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kano se lahoo ab bhi tapakta hai mera
aur gardan mein bhi rassi ke nishan hai gehra
kitni zakhmi hoo mai aajao ye dikhlaungi
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj bhi kitni hoo pyasi mai bataun kaise
hont sookhe hai zaban khushk dikhaun kaise
saans leti hoo to tharra'ta hai ye jism mera
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baba tere zakhmo ko nahi bhooli mai
be-kafan laasha tera ab bhi nahi bhooli mai
yaad mein tere tadapti hoo jiigar hai chalni
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke gham mein wo aazam haye dam tod gayi
qaid khane mein har ek dil ko rota chod gayi
phir aqif aayegi zindan se na awaaz koi
aaja ay mere baba jaan
haye masoom sakina...
items.author: Azam Hussain

items.title: Abbas abbas
items.body:
pyasa kunba labe darya
rehgaye qaimon may tashna bache
ek sada hai sab ke labon par
haye abbas
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas abbas abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
halq sabhi ka sookh chuka hai
goya qareen ab waqt e qaza hai
sab ne faqat ye roke kaha hai
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbadari aur aale payambar
be-watani aur aale payambar
tashnalabi aur aale payambar
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye re asghar tashna dahani
ghair hui hai haalat uski
kuch lamha bas jaan hai baakhi
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
le ke alam dada ka jao
nehr utha kar qaime may lao
zor e yadullah hi dikhlao
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop sare baali hai ghazab ki
sab ka sahara aas ho sab ki
sunlo sada ab pyase lab ki
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas se kya haalat hai dekho
kuch bhi nazar aata nahi hum ko
behre khuda ehsaan ye kar do
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
leke chala ghazi mashkeeza
shaah ne nam aankhon se dekha
bachon bne rokar ye farmaya
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr se pani bhar ke wo palta
bhaagi hui faujon ne ghayra
padte rahe bache ye nauha
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne uthaya daste baradar
di ye sada atfaale payambar
ab na sada dena ye ro kar
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise kahoo bachon se hamare
mar gaye bhai nehr kanare
ab na bulaana kehke ye pyare
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab to bahot duhswaar hai jeena
kaise kahe ammu ye hazeena
pyase hai bache pyasi sakina
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam o yazdan pyason ka nauha
sunke ye sheh ne roke pukara
kis se kahoge ab ye khudara
le kar aao pani chacha
abbas abbas...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Akbar ne kaha
items.body:
akbar ne kaha zakhm kaleje ka chupa do
amma meri jeeti ho to ek baar mila do
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ne ye farmaya tha ghar laut ke aana
is chand si surat ko hamay phir se dikhana
yan khaak basar unka pisar hogaya baba
chehra to mera khoon mein tar hogaya baba
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
<<DIVIDER>>
behtar hai chupa de mere seene ke nishan ko
halaan ke khabar mil gayi hogi meri maa ko
kehna ke hai behaal ye bemaar tumhara
karne ko chala aaya hai deedar tumhara
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ne bade naazon se sadqa bhi utaara
dulha ki tarha hamay naazon se sambhala
akbar na koi tum pe musiabt khuda laaye
ay laal tumhe ran se salamat khuda laaye
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ye mera khoon to kapdon se hata do
acha to mujhe doosri poshak pinha do
ghaltan mujhe dekhegi agar khoon ke wuzoo mein
keh dengi mere doodh ki khusboo hai lahoo mein
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam haathon mein de jaata hai jab godh ka paala
phir zinda nahi rehti hai wo maa shahe waala
ye baar garan ay mere maula nahi uth'ta
maa'on se jawan bete ka sadma nahi uth'ta
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar jaane ki haalat to nahi aisi hamari
wo zakhm laga kaari ke dam lena hai bhaari
sar ooncha kiya aap ka batlaunga baba
amma ke qadam choomne ghar jaunga baba
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna ke pisar aap ne shabbir pe waara
maqbool kare aap ki qurbani ko zehra
amma ho mubarak ye bada kaam hua hai
zehra ki kaneezon mein tera naam hua hai
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ke jawan laal ka ay shadman nauha
ta'eed e hussaini se raza aap ne likha
allah re majlis mein bada josh e fughan hai
matlab ke yahan aur bhi ek marsiya khwan hai
akbar ne kaha zakhm...
items.author: Raza

items.title: Allah allah qayamat
items.body:
jo thi kaunain ki shaahzadi
sar barehna sar e shaam aayi
kyun na fizza ye de ab duhaai
behen abbas ki berida hai
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah qayamat bapa hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
ye sitam dil pe sab se bada hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai to aayi thi tere sahare
so gaya tu to darya kinare
shaam jayegi kis tarha zainab
dil tadapne laga gham ke maare
bibiyon ke labon par buka hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay alamdar e ghazi dua kar
gham se mar jaaye na teri khwahar
ay khuda e wafa ye bata de
zabt kaise karun is sitam par
shimr has kar yehi keh raha hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah...
<<DIVIDER>>
ban gaya mera sajjad qaidi
tauq pehne hai aur bediyan bhi
khaafile ka yehi saareban hai
is ki ghairat ye nauha karegi
ab to ehsaas jeena saza hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad tere ye pehla safar hai
har qadam gham se chalni jigar hai
aaj mehmil hai aur na kajawa
aur zainab pe sab ki nazar hai
tu nahi saath ye gham chala hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
log apne na apna watan hai
bas isi gham ki dil mein chubhan hai
kaise parda karun tu batade
mujhko jhakde huwe jo rasan hai
dil yehi soch kar ro raha hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab suni bekason ki sadayein
aasman ro pada aur hawayein
ro ke sajjad bhi keh raha hai
koi lillaah de de ridayein
kaise ajr e risalat mila hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain fizza ke lab par yehi hai
ya ali ye madad ki ghadi hai
dekh darbar hai ashkiyan ka
aur beparda aale nabi hai
waqt sajjad par ye kada hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr se jab ye haakim ne poocha
tu bata tera in'aam ho kya
bola badzaat haakim se has kar
haal tu dekh in qaidiyon ka
mujhko in'aam ye mil gaya hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke safdar se kehta hai mazhar
likh nahi sakta koi sukhanwar
jo sitam meri bibi pe toote
baad shere jari shaam jaa kar
bas ye misra hi khud marsiya hai
behen abbas ki berida hai
allah allah qayamat...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Asghar haye asghar
items.body:
asghar haye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baysheer mere reh gaya jaake kahan
dashte ghurbat mein kahan dhoondne jaye ye maa
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gayi shaam e sitam hogaye gehre saaye
cha gaya dashte bayaban mein andhera haye
jo guzarti hai mere dil pe karoo kaise bayan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin tere laal mujhe chain nahi aata hai
yaad aati hai teri dil mera ghabrata hai
godh mein aaja meri mere bete meri jaan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu mujhe rota hua chod gaya hai jab se
dhoonti phirti hoo mai dashte musibat mein tujhe
koi batlata nahi hai mera chand kahan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barasta kahin laashe pade hai ran mein
khaak par baithi hai shehzadiyan ujde ban mein
koi mazloomo ki ab sunta nahi aah o fughan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hai tatheer ke waaris wo huwe khaak basar
jal gaye qaime ridayein bhi nahi hai sar par
dekh to aa ke zara hai qayamat ka samaa
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khadar zulm sahe itne yahan gham paaye
maang bhi ujdi meri godh bhi ujdi haye
haal par mere hui bekasi nauha kuna
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab nahi aaya pisar dashte bala se gohar
khaak par gir padi maa rote huwe ye keh kar
ab kise loriyan de de ke sulayegi ye maa
haye baysheer mere...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Ay mere maula hussain
items.body:
ay mere maula hussain ay mere aaqa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon kiye qalbe ali monise islame nabi
fatema zehra ka pisar ibne rasoole arabi
haye purhaul biyaban hai koi monis o yawar bhi nahi
dasht mein tanha hai hussain ibne ali
ay mere maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeest ki aas nahi mera abbas nahi
koi ab paas nahi
haye uthe huwe qaimon ka dhuaan
shaam e gariban ka ye purhaul samaan
fauje jafa ki yalghaar
haye ab kisko bulaun paye imdad ye zainab ne kaha
mere khuda chinti hai chadar meri
ay mere maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
waaris e aale aba qaidi e joro jafa
jab suye shaam chala
gir pada khaak pe ghash khaake shahe deen ka pisar
kaampte honthon se bas itna keh kar
baap be-gor o kafan dashte bala mein hai pada
aur kafan tak bhi nahi haye re gurbat meri
ay mere maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
waali e har do jahan yaad hai wo bhi samaan
di jo akbar ne zaban
khanych li rote huwe apni zaban bano e muztar ke pisar ne bhi
sare qaima dahan se tere
waali e kon o makan shaahe zaman saaqi e kausar ke pisar
roze dahum haye teri tashnalabi
ay mere maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
garm maqtal ki hawa phool kumlaya hua
haye wo shishmaha
asre ashoor sare karbobala ahle aza teere sitamgar se faqat
gardane asghar hi nahi
chidh gaya dasht mein mamta ka gala saath mein hulqoome tamanna e padar
haye wo naawak figani
ay mere maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rota tha jahan dukhtare shaahe zaman
haye abbas ki jaan
shaam hote hi sakina ki rida cheeni gohar cheene layeeno ne
tamachon se aziyat de kar
haye afsos sitamgaaron ne itna bhi na socha ki ye
be-yaar o madadgaar hai beti sheh ki
ay mere maula hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard ka lehja bilal gham ka aeena bilal
ye tera nauha bilal
khoob aamir ne padha dard mein dooba hua ye nauha e gham
uthne lagi aah o buka ki awaaz
ab tamanna hai ke likha hai jo ye nauha e gham jald ho maqbool
sare baargahe aale nabi
ay mere maula hussain...
items.author: Bilal Kazmi

items.title: Baitha hai mushkilaat
items.body:
baitha hai mushkilaat ke raste pe haar ke
o bad-naseeb dekh ali ko pukaar ke
<<DIVIDER>>
marhab ka qatl bhi koi khyber mein qatl tha
phaynka tha zulfeqaar ka sadqa utaar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
khyber ke dar ne khul ke ishara ye kar diya
mazhar yehi hai quwwat e parwar digaar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ke dil ko dekh rahe hai shahe zaman
akbar ko ran mein bheja hai gaysu sawaar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar jigar ko thaam ke roti hai fauj e shaam
tum teer khaa ke aaye ho ya teer maar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar tumhara baagh e jawani ujad gaya
laila ne chaar din bhi na dekhe bahaar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
roo baah jang e aun o mohamed pa kehte thay
ye sher jaane choot gaye kis kachaar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekiyan wo shaam e ghariban ki ay qamar
taare bhi so gaye falak e kajmadaar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane sawaal kya huwe turbat mein ay qamar
chup hogaye thay hum to ali ko pukaar ke
baitha hai mushkilaat...
items.author: Qamar

items.title: Chashme sajjad ne
items.body:
ahle haram ko kufi o shaami satate hai
mushkil kusha ke potay ko qaidi banate hai
koofa wohi hai jiske ali hukmran rahe
unhi ki betiyon ko khule sar phirate hai
ahle haram ko...
mushkil kusha ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
chashme sajjad ne har dard ka manzar dekha
noke naiza pe sare sibte payambar dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rone lagi sajjad ki aankhein payham
jab se maa behno ko balwe mein khule sar dekha
chashme sajjad ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
maarte thay jo sakina ko tamache aada
jaane kis dil se ye bemaar ne manzar dekha
chashme sajjad ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
neele ruqsar thay aur kaano se behta tha lahoo
dukhtare shaah pa ye jore sitamgar dekha
chashme sajjad ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pa kya guzri sakina ke khuda hi jaane
tasht par baap ka rakha hua jab sar dekha
chashme sajjad ne...

ban ke gunehgar aaya hoon dene dar pe sada aap ko
ghutniyon baitha sar ko jhukaye honton pe tha ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mera lashkar sehra ke andar tha pyaas se jaa balab
abass o akbar aun o mohamed pani pilaate thay sab
meri wajah se haye wo lashkar pyasa raha ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
bali sakina asghar e naadan ka mai gunah gaar hoon
aale nabi ka dil hai dukhaya aisa sitamgaar hoon
maine kiya hai aap pe maula zulm o jafa ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere maula saaqi e kausar itna karam kijiye
is khatawar ki hai ye khatayein sar ko qalam kijiye
haathon ko jode sheh se ye bola dije saza ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ke qadam par sar ko jhuka kar rakhe raha dayr tak
aankhon se uski ashkon ka darya behta raha dayr tak
kaise uthaye sar ko wo apne aati haya ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere aaqa ay mere maula mai hi khata kaar hoon
be aab jangal mein leke aaya kitna gunhgaar hoon
ay ibne hyder ab bakhsh dije meri khata ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya aap mujhse raazi nahi hai hurr ne ye rokar kaha
mai bhi hoon raazi raazi khuda hai shabbir ne di sada
khush ho ke hurr ne awaaz ye di shukriya ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran ki ijazat de dije pehle mere jawan laal ko
sar ko kataye maidan mein jaa kar izzat mile aal ko
bas aap hi ka ghurbat ke ban mein hai aasra ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon se apne apne pisar ka laasha uthaunga mai
ghodhe se gir kar jab wo pukare maqtal mein jaunga mai
daaghe jawani ko bhi sahega seena mera ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab uske sar se maqtal ke andar behti thi khoon ki nadi
roomal e zehra sarwar ne baandha hai uski qismat badi
apne ghulamon ko de rahe thay ye martaba ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis o matam aur nauha khwani mein jo hui ho khata
shams aur aamir ki baksh dije wo sab khata ay khuda
hojaye ye bhi dunya ke andar hurr ki tarha ya hussain
maaf kar do hame...
items.author: Shams Rizvi

items.title: Marhaba ay hussain
items.body:
marhaba marhaba marhaba ay hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ne sar teri chaukat pe kham kar diya
bandagi ka saleeqa usay aa gaya
al-amaan zere khanjar wo sajda tera
ro ke ahmed ne jannat se di ye sada
marhaba marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tere naqshe paa par hua gaamzan
usko ho kya bhala khaufe daar o rasan
wo sikhaya hai marne ka tu ne chalan
de diya maut ko zeest ka baankpan
marhaba marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun farishton ne adam ko sajda kiya
roze ashoor aalam pe roshan hua
kund khanjar talay rakh ke sookha gala
tu ne insaniyat ka bharam rakh liya
marhaba marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi ko supurde khaak kar diya
jo fana thi usi ko baqa kar diya
is tarha haq se waada wafa kar diya
har khushi ko raza e khuda kar diya
marhaba marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bik raha tha sar e aam jab aadmi
haq o baatil ki pehchan thi mit gayi
de ke qurbani tu ne jawan laal ki
baksh di deen ko ek nayi zindagi
marhaba marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha se hai zaat e khuda ko dawaam
jaise baakhi jahan mein hai uska kalaam
roze ashoor tu kar gaya hai wo kaam
mit sakega na ta hashr tera bhi naam
marhaba marhaba...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir raha hai nigahon mein manzar abhi
laashe kadiyal jawan aalam jaan ki
teri himmat pe qurban ibne ali
qalbe akbar se tu ne sina khaynch li
marhaba marhaba...
items.author: Mujahid Lakhnavi

items.title: Mera bhai abbas
items.body:
hoke battees baras waale baradar se juda
laute maqtal se kamar thaame huwe shaahe huda
di sada lut gaya pardes mein bhai zainab
bhaa gayi sher ko darya ki taraayi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne rote huwe zainab se kaha
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham hamari kamar tod gaya
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri quwwat pe hua waar zainab
na raha mera alamdaar zainab
tanha mujhko mere dushman ne kiya
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt hai hum pe qayamat ka behan
aao matam kare ghurbat ka behan
daagh pardes mein bhai ka mila
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gaya fauj ka sardar ghareeb
ab kahan fauj ko salaar naseeb
lo badha do ye alam khoon se bhara
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mit gayi dasht mein tasveer e ali
khoon mein doob gaya sher e zari
mil gayi khaak mein baba ki dua
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
toota darya pe sakina ka bharam
maut ne cheen ke saqqa e haram
pyase masoomon ka dil tod diya
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein dooba alam laaya hoon mai
usko darya pe hi kho aaya hoon mai
jis pe hum sab ko bharosa tha bada
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
uske mar jaane ke ehsaas ka gham
maar dega hamay abbas ka gham
hum na jee payenge bhai ke bina
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
thaami zainab ne nadeen apni rida
ro ke jis waqt ye sarwar ne kaha
ay behan le gayi bhai ko qaza
haye ghurbat mein hua hum se juda
abbas mera bhai abbas...
items.author: Nadeem Sultanpuri

items.title: Mohamed ke alamdar
items.body:
zakhmi huwe sajde mein mohamed ke alamdar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil mein hai mushkil kusha nabiyon ke madadgaar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
<<DIVIDER>>
sar zakhmi hua dard se hai jism mein larza
sar thaame huwe haathon se kehte hai ye maula
khoon rukta nahi kaise karun doosra sajda
hai bheega hua khoon mein ab saara musalla
bekhuaf chale maut se karte huwe takraar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
roze mein kiya zarbe sitam maar ke zakhmi
to saara badan zard hai shiddat se zeher ki
ghash aate hai reh reh ke ye haalat hai ali ki
bistar pe tadapte hai nahi chain zara bhi
darwaze pe rote hai khade saare wafadaar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha baba ko seene se laga kar
na jao hamay chod ke mai waari hoon tum par
sadma na yateemi ka utha paungi dil par
aayi thi madine se yahan amma ko kho kar
nazdeek bahot eid hai ye soohiye ek baar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh ho kyun baba hassan ko ye batao
aankhon ko zara kholo to chehre ko utha lo
har din ki tarha seene se ab mujhko lagao
takleef agar zakhm mein zyada hai batao
qurban mai jaan aap pe karne ko hoon tayyar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir se ek pal na juda hote thay baba
tu jaan se zyada hai meri kehte thay baba
bosay meri gardan ke bahot lete thay baba
pani mujhe uth uth ke pila dete thay baba
ay sher e khuda utho karo uth ke mujhe pyar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek kone mein abbas khade rote hai baba
aankhein hai chadi ghaiz se aur surkh hai chehra
sar kaat ke rakh dega wo muljim ke pisar ka
hai waqt e qaza kehte hai shabbir se maula
ab tere hawale hai mera ghazi o jarrar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha shor qamar kufe mein maare gaye hyder
ay shadman tha charon taraf hashr ka manzar
sar peeto karo girya rakho khaak saron par
sab kehte thay ye maula ke darwaze pe aa kar
aa jaaye qaza maula ke bin jeena hai bekaar
hyder e karrar hyder e karrar
zakhmi huwe...
items.author: Qamar Buknalvi

items.title: Namaze shab mein
items.body:
shab ki tareeki mein namaze shab ke baad
mera mazloom imam dua maang raha hai
mere maula tujhe waasta is ghareeb ke ashkon ka
sukoone dil ke liye kar mujhe sakina ata
allah allah allah allah
<<DIVIDER>>
namaze shab mein koi baap maangta hai dua
allah allah allah allah
sukoone dil ke liye kar mujhe sakina ata
<<DIVIDER>>
diya hai sabr to mujhko qaraar bhi dede
mehek batool ki hyder ka pyar bhi dede
usay mai dekhun to yaad aaye mujhko maa zahra
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mere seene pe soye to dhadkane khush ho
chale wo ungli pakad kar to aahatein khush ho
wo maange pani to haathon ko mai karun kooza
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
suna hai beti janaze ki hoti hai raunaq
mujhe bhi chahiye quran e zindagi ka waraq
milay janaze ki raunaq bara e karbobala
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibadaton ka sila tujhse maangta hoo mai
yehi to ek dua tujhse maangta hoo mai
charaghe qaima bhujaun to wo ho misle diya
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
sataye yaad usay jab hamare seene ki
to qaid khane mein majlis bapa kare meri
phupi ke saath musalle pe wo kare girya
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ne sunli dua e hussain ibne ali
mili wo beti jo bilkul shabihe zahra thi
sukoon mil gaya sheh ko sakina naam rakha
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
magar sukoon ye karbobala mein jaata raha
hui yateem sakina bandha rasan mein gala
hussein rote thay kehke barsare naiza
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam ye shaam ke darbar mein hua kaisa
jise hussain ne apne khuda se maanga tha
usay kaneezi mein apni kisi ne maang liya
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
pasay hussain sakina ne wo sitam dekhe
tadap ke kehti thi bacchi padar ke laashe se
chupalo khoon bhare daaman mein mujhko ay baba
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain se aayi sada sar e maidan
namaz e shab ki dua ka asar sakina jaan
karenga teri hifazat wo naam hai jiska
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan azmi kehti thi karbala ki faza
hai baap beti ka ye imtehan kaisa khuda
har ek zulm pe dono ke lab pe hai ye sada
allah allah allah allah
namaze shab mein koi baap...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Aaja mere bhai
items.body:
ye shaam e ghariban mein thi zainab ki duhaai
aaja mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai reh gayi is dasht mein tanha mere bhai
aaja mere bhai
ye shaam e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab asghar o akbar hai na shabbir hai baaqi
ghurbat hai bala ki
sab lut gayi pardes mein amma ki kameini
aaja mere bhai
ye shaam e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ro ke sada deti thi wo dard ki maari
ay bhai mai waari
mazloom behan seh nahi payegi judaai
aaja mere bhai
ye shaam e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun pyaas ke maaron ki nahi sunte ho aahein
veraan hai nigahein
kya aisi mere bhaiya tumhe bhaayi taraai
aaja mere bhai
ye shaam e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zainab e dilgeer chali jaanib e zindan
behaal o pareshan
mud mud ke sada deti rahi gham ki satayi
aaja mere bhai
ye shaam e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam ke bazaar mein ye khaafila pahuncha
ek hashr tha barpa
awaaz larazte huwe honton se ye aayi
aaja mere bhai
ye shaam e ghariban…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek laasha labe nehr tadap jaata tha gohar
tha hashr ka manzar
jab kehti thi dil thaam ke ye fatema jaayi
aaja mere bhai
ye shaam e ghariban…
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Abbas abbas
items.body:
hai bekason ka ghareebon ka aasra abbas
wafa hai mulk to us mulk ka khuda abbas
janabe fatema zehra ka mudda'a abbas
janabe hyder e safdar ka aeena abbas
har ek simt do aalam me zikr hota hai
janabe fatema binte asad ka pota hai
abbas abbas abbas abbas
abbas abbas abbas abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sawaal se pehle jawab dete hai
jo zarra maango to ye aaftab dete hai
koi jo khatra kahe behre aab dete hai
sakhi hai kaanto ke badle gulaab dete hai
yehi ruke huwe toofan ka ishara hai
furaat par abhi abbas ka ijaara hai
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
usi furaat pe maare gaye ba- dard o malaal
pahunch ke laash pe sarwar ne tab kiya ye malaal
abhi mai poora karunga agar ho koi sawaal
jari ye ro ke pukara ke ay batool ke laal
laga hai aankh mein jo teer usay hata dije
huzoor apna ye chehra mujhe dikha dije
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ye aur suye firdaus chal diya ghazi
labe furaat har ek mauj khoon bahati rahi
ye choonke hazrate abbas ki wasiyat thi
jo laash saahil e darya pe shaah ne chodi
ye kehte jaate thay kis tarha ab jiye shabbir
alam ko leke suye qaima chal diye shabbir
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamam bacchon ne haathon se kooze phaynk diye
alam se haye chacha keh ke daud kar lipte
sakina boli chacha ko kahan pe chod aaye
na pani chahiye ab aur hai na pyaas mujhe
chacha ko ya to yahin par bula do ay baba
ya mujhko paas unhi ke par sula do ay baba
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban e haal se zainab pukari ay bhai
ho tum pe khwahar e dilgeer waari ay bhai
suno to aake hamari bezaari ay bhai
kahin lute na ridayein hamari ay bhai
magar hua wohi zainab ko jiska dhadka tha
jo shaam aayi to na chadar thi aur na parda tha
abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ke sar pe na baaqi rida thi ay majid
ajeeb tarha ki jor o jafa thi ay majid
ke ashk afshan wo chashme khuda thi ay majid
ke taaba shaam haram ki sada thi ay majid
kahan ho ab paye imadad aao ay abbas
hamay sitam se layeen ke bachao ay abbas
abbas abbas...
items.author: Majid Raza Abdi

items.title: Akbar tere seene se
items.body:
akbar tere seene se sina kaise nikalun
bas itna bata de ke jigar kaise sambhalun
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai mere laal meri maamta mujhse
is dard ko tere mai kaleje mein chupalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar ho na aziyaat jo tere zakhme jigar mein
ek baar mere laal galay tujhko lagalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay karbobala tu hi bata de koi rasta
mai maut se kaise ali akbar ko bachalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dayr tehar ja mere bache tu jahan mein
zakhmi tera seena tere dada ko dikhalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay waqt e qaza de de tu itni mujhe mohlat
mai apne jawan laal ko dulha to banalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khulti nahi aankhein ye nahi bolta mujhse
is neend se kaise ali akbar ko jagalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
bosa liya peshani e akbar ka ye keh kar
behte huwe ashkon ka mai sehra to sajalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
baithe thay zameen par yehi kehte huwe sarwar
ab dil ki tamanna ke charaghon ko bujhalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
is baap ki himmat ko zara de de sahara
maqtal ki zameen se mai tere laash uthalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab uth na saki laash to shabbir ne socha
bachon ko madad ke liye qaime se bulaalun
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
masroof e aza hote hi dil kehta hai yawar
aansu ali akbar ki musibat pa bahalun
akbar tere seene se...
items.author: Yawar

items.title: Allah bemaar dua
items.body:
allah bemaar dua maange dua maange hai
haye bemaar haye bemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj iska nahi ek din mein luta ghar mera
gham nahi iska ke pardes mein ye zulm hua
mujhko sab kuch hai gawara pa bache deen tera
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri daadi ne jise pees ke chakki paala
iske laashe ko sitamgaaron ne pamaal kiya
ab kisi par na sitam toote khudaya aisa
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekafan chod ke aaya hoon pidar ka laasha
apne baba ko mai dafna na saka wavaila
aisa majboor na ho jaaye kisi ka beta
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo teer e sitam aur wo asghar ka gala
kitne dil chid gaye aur hogaya khaali jhoola
maa ko chain aaye ye bechain labon par hai dua
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
na rahe qasim o akbar na hi abbas chacha
mar gaye aun o mohamed mera baba na raha
hausla de mujhe karta rahoon mai shukre khuda
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufa o shaam ki raahon ne bahot rulwaya
chadarein chin gayi maa behne huwe beparda
lagta suraj ko grahan chaata kabhi andhiyara
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq o zanjeer mein jakda hoon gila iska nahi
ye tamanna rahe shukr ke sajde mein jabeen
ummate jad ke liye aaye na lab par naale
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacche girte huwe oonton se safar jaari tha
maayein majboor rasan basta labon par nauha
ab kisi maa ke liye waqt na aaye aisa
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki yaad bhi aaye to na roye dukhtar
nanhe rukhsaar sakina ke tamachon ka safar
na mile aise zamane mein kisi ko pursa
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sakina ki musibat wo galay mein rassi
kaan zakhmi huwe khamosh thi pyasi bacchi
haye is din ke liye reh gaya kyun mai zinda
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyan saari rasan basta aseeri ghurbat
wo safar dhoop ka wo pyaas ki shiddat
kaash ye din mera khaleq na mujhe dikhlata
allah bemaar dua maange...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khadar zulm musalsal thay ghareebon pe rasheed
huwe thay abid e bemaar har ek gaam shaheed
phir bhi honton pe tha bemaar ke bas shukre khuda
allah bemaar dua maange...
items.author: Rasheed Shaheedi

items.title: Asghar ka lahoo
items.body:
asghar ka lahoo jab na liya arz o samaa ne haye
chehre pe mala khoon shahe karbobala ne
<<DIVIDER>>
kya jurm tha cheh maah ke bacche ka khudaya
kyun cheda hai asghar ka gala teer e jafa ne
asghar ka lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ne jaan apni fida kar di padar par
nusrat ke liye di thi sada shaahe huda ne
asghar ka lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu dekhle shabbir ki aaghosh may ya rab
aaya hai tera deen ye baysheer bachane
asghar ka lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
farmate thay shabbir hifazat se tu rakhna
hai dafn yahan karbobala mere khazane
asghar ka lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja mere bacche mai teri pyaas pe sadqe
khud aayegi maa ran may tujhe pani pilaane
asghar ka lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nok e sina par na chadaye kahin zaalim
shabbir chale laasha e baysheer chupane
asghar ka lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab qaime may aaya ali asghar ka janaza
kohraam bapa kar diya maadar ki fughan ne
asghar ka lahoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
sibtain bhala kaise bhulayega zamana
jang jeetli baysheer ki masoom ada ne
asghar ka lahoo...
items.author: Sibtain Kazmi

items.title: Ay mere nana payambar
items.body:
jo madine gayi zainab to na sambhla dil e muztar
to chali ashk baha kar ye kaha qabr e nabi par
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar lut gayi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
na wo sher aisa baradar na jigar gosha e shabbar
na wo hamshakle payambar na wo cheh maah ka asghar
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chal gaya seene pa naiza chida akbar ka kaleja
wo qayamat ka samaa tha mera bhaiya tha akela
suniye ye kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi laashe ko uthaya kabhi bachon ko bulaya
kabhi hyder ko pukara thay ajab haal mein sarwar
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi badna suye qaima kabhi qaime se palatna
kabhi baysheer ko takna kabhi seene se lagana
keh na sakungi
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi awaaz di asghar kabhi ro uthe tadap kar
kabhi moo rakh diya moo par hai mujhe yaad wo manzar
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ke baad ka kissa soch kar dil hai dehalta
qatl jab ho gaya pyasa pisar e fatema zahra
ghash mein thay abid
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe aada ne sataya mere qaimon ko jalaya
jhoola baysheer ka loota meri cheeni gayi chadar
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam o kufa ka fasana dil se mushkil hai bhulana
tha phira humse zamana qaid tha saara gharana
baal thay moo par
<<DIVIDER>>
intezamaat bade thay saare bazaar sajay thay
sab tamashayi khade thay hum thay ay nana khule sar
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
na qanatein na wo qaima na wo abbas ka pehra
ek samaa shab ka darauna meri godi mein sakeena
lipti hui thi
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hui shaam e gariban chandni phirti thi hairaan
wo khamoshi wo bayaban thay haram khaak ke upar
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
saqt mahir wo ghadi thi kaisi zainab pa padi thi
dar pa khamosh khadi thi pyaas sarwar ko badi thi
hashr bapa tha
<<DIVIDER>>
tha kahin mehr e munawar to kahin tha mahe anwar
thay sabhi taare zameen par asmaan tha tahe khanjar
lut gayi zainab
ay mere nana payambar...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Baab e saat par
items.body:
baab e sa'at par khadi hai fatema ki betiyan
shaam ke darbar may hai jashn ki tayyarian
<<DIVIDER>>
wa hussaina ki sada hai itrat e athaar may
jaane kya guzri hai in par shaam ke bazaar may
khoon may tar hogayi kaunain ki shehzadiyan
baab e sa'at par khadi...
<<DIVIDER>>
subho se thak jaate hai jab shaami pathar maar kar
shaam hote hi chale jaate hai zaalim apne ghar
raat bhar qaidi khade rehte hai zer e aasman
baab e sa'at par khadi...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham to ye hai chaar jaanib kalma go aabad thay
chadarein phir bhi na di sar ko chupane ke liye
sar khule kitni azan'ein sun chuki hai bibiyan
baab e sa'at par khadi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi jaa kar ye bata do bekas o mazloom ko
mil rahi hai ye yateemi ki saza masoom ko
ab sakina ko tamache de rahe hai loriyan
baab e sa'at par khadi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may baqir ke shaamil ghairat e abbas hai
hai abhi kamsin magar isko bhi ye ehsaas hai
bazm may noshi kahan aur saani e zahra kahan
baab e sa'at par khadi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ban gaya tareekh e ghurbat shaam o kufa ka safar
zulm jitne ho gaye hai be-khata sadaat par
mujrimon par bhi kahan hoti hai itni sakhtiyan
baab e sa'at par khadi...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid e bemaar aansu khoon ke barsata raha
be-ridayi ka isay zainab ki gham khaata raha
aate aate shaam tak boodha hua hai ye jawan
baab e sa'at par khadi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa ke chehlum par takallum ne ye dekha hai samaa
kal jahan se be-rida guzri thi sab saydaniya
chadarein ab naam pe zainab ke bat'thi hai wahan
baab e sa'at par khadi...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Bali sakina ki ye
items.body:
bali sakina ki thi ye fughan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
kuch to khabar do tum ho kahan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se gaye tum qaime se baba
ek pal ko bhi mai so na saki hoo
shimr ka darr hai mujhko hamesha
rona bhi chaahu ro na saki hoo
kis ko bulaun jaaun kahan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban qaimon may aa kar
aag lagadi jis dum layeen ne
khauf tha har soo saydaniyo may
darr se ay baba sehme thay bache
chaaya huwa tha har soo dhuan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jal gaye qaime chin gayi chadar
lut gaye jab ke asbaab saare
khaak pe jaa kar baithi thi maayein
soye thay bache maa ke sahare
ghurbat thi aur thi kuch siskiyan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maare tamache shimr e layeen ne
jis se hai mere ruqsaar neele
baad uske baba boondo ko mere
kuch aise cheena tha us shaqi ne
kaano se dekho khoon hai rawan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum hi batao ke koi bachi
aalam may hogi kya mere jaisi
chaar baras ki umr ho jiski
aisi yateema kab kisne dekhi
ye sin ho aur tooti phasliyan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid huwe jab ahle haram to
ek rassi thi aur baara galay thay
ek simt meri gardan bandhi thi
aur bibiyon ke shaane bandhe thay
dekho rasan ke hai ye nishan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
aale mohamed darbariyon may
laaye gaye jab qaidi bana kar
phupiyan khadi thi chehre chipa kar
abid khade thay nazrein jhuka kar
hum par tha toota kohe giran
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas ki shiddat se ab to mere
saare badan mai raashe pade hai
saans bhi lena hai mera mushkil
halq may mere chaale pade hai
lagta hai ab hai honton pe jaan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
moo rakh ke apna baba ke moo par
ay najm jab wo chup ho gayi thi
saari shikayat baba se kar ke
gham ki sataayi jab so gayi thi
phir na pukari wo neem jaan
ay mere baba ay mere baba
bali sakina ki thi ye...
items.author: Najam Azmi

items.title: Beta muaaf karna
items.body:
beta muaf karna mujhe dayr ho gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
noore nazar hassan ke mere paara e jigar
beta muaf karna mujhe dayr ho gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
phaile huwe zameen pe hai tukde kahan kahan
seene pe tere ghodon ki taapon ke hai nishan
bhagdar machi to ghode idhar se huwe udhar
beta muaf karna...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum saamne ho aur tumhari talaash hai
kaise uthaun tumko mai tukdon mein laash hai
jaise hua tha tukde mere bhai ka jigar
beta muaf karna...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehna gaya hai khaak pe farwa ka maahtab
gulshan mein hai batool ke bikhra hua gulaab
bhai ki yaad aati hai hoo dekhta jigar
beta muaf karna...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine bahot sulaaya hai aaghosh mein tujhe
laashe ko leke jaaunga ghathri mein baandh ke
maa mar na jaaye laash ke tukdon ko dekh kar
beta muaf karna...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai ye uroose ajal tum ko kya hua
sar par hai tere zakhmon ka sehra saja hua
kuchla hua badan hai jabeen hai lahoo mein tar
beta muaf karna...
<<DIVIDER>>
girte huwe kisi ne pukara jo door se
pahuncha hoo har maqam pe raftaar e noor se
ye gham ki inteha thi ke aata na tha nazar
beta muaf karna...
<<DIVIDER>>
haalat tumhari dekh ke seena hua hai shaq
ta hashr hoga ab dil e shabbir ko khalaq
afsos ye rahega na pahuncha mai waqt par
beta muaf karna...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Hai yehi waqt
items.body:
hai yehi waqt unka daaman thaam le
girne waale ab ali ka naam le
<<DIVIDER>>
marhabon ke sar pa hai tayghe ali
apna badla subho le ya shaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai maye hubbe ali kuch tundh o tez
hurr bane jo mastiyon se kaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ali ki neend hai hijrat ki raat
har nafas par rab se jo enaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai abuzar se wila to apne sar
haq parasti ka bhi ek ilzaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab hai mushkil haq o baatil mein tameez
koi karwat to dil e nakaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
ne-mawaddat aadmi mazoor hai
jis tarha jo maani e islam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhir is chaukhat pe aana hai tujhe
jaane waale ye bhi ek paigham le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn asghar ho gaye sheh ne kaha
mere bacche ab yahan aaraam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
asre ashoor aayi awaaz e rasool
fatema baazu e zainab thaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane mein koi bacchi hai dafn
ek amaanat aur mulk e shaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay turabi muft hai aabe hayaat
maut ke haathon se koi jaam le
hai yehi waqt...
items.author: Rasheed Turabi

items.title: Haye fizza
items.body:
haye fizza haye haye fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki betiyon ko yun bachayegi fizza
ke unke hisse ke patthar bhi khayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lipat ke royegi zainab se karbala ki hawa
rida jo khaake shifa ke udhayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
karegi yaad zamana ali ki shahi ka
aseer hoke jo kufe mein jayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
khule saron ko bohat yaad aayega ghazi
qabeele waalon ko jis dam bulayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
karegi qaid mein yun ehteram zainab ka
qadam ki khaak ko sar par uthayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarhane baithi hui turbate sakina par
na hogi shamma to aansu jalayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mili lehed bhi bohat paas shaahzadi ke
na chod kar kahin zainab ko jayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan jahan pe bhi zainab ka tazkera hoga
wahan wahan safe matam bichayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
khade hai marqad e fizza pe aamir o nayyar
inhe bhi lehja e quran sikhayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Hur ka sar hai
items.body:
hur ka sar hai zaanuye shabbir hai
marne waale kya teri taqdeer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khauf kya mehshar ka daaman-geer hai
haath mein jab daaman e shabbir hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne apno ke to kaam aate hai sab
ha ali maula e aalam-geer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyon na ho mai hoo ghulame bu turaab
baaghe jannat han meri jageer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar hata do noor-e-ahle bayt ko
kaunsi islam mein tanveer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ne jo khwaab dekha tha khaleel
karbala us khwaab ki tabeer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam hai mera azadare hussain
kaam mera matame shabbir hai
hur ka sar hai...
.
dekh ummat dekh le akbar ki laash
ye nabi ki khoon bhari tasveer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat raha hai taygh se sheh ka gala
aur baali par khadi hamsheer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jodta hai kyon kamaan se teer e zulm
hurmula asghar ki kya taqseer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe akbar dekh kar maa ne kaha
khwaab kya dekhe thay kya tabeer hai
hur ka sar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ali ke thi galay mein reesma
ek ali ke paaon mein zanjeer hai
hur ka sar hai...
items.author: Mujahid Lakhnavi

items.title: Hyder ki wasiyat
items.body:
hyder ki wasiyat hai ye saare zamane ko
zainab ko nahi aaye koi bhi rulaane ko
<<DIVIDER>>
taakeed hai hargiz ye koi na sitam dhaaye
shabbar ka janaza jab madfan ke liye jaaye
mayyat pe nahi aana tum teer chalane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatil ko hassan beta tum jaam pila dena
tum saaqi e kausar ke bete ho bata dena
hyder ki kareemi ka ehsaas dilaane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ko maula ne nazdeek bulaya tha
shaano pe diye bosay seene se lagaya tha
shabbir ke lashkar ka salaar banane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab se kaha beti shabbir na pyasa ho
maa jaise pilaati thi pani isay raaton ko
zehra ki tarha rehna tum pyaas bujhane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir se bole ye abid ko bata dena
jab shaam ho barpa to zainab na rahe tanha
bazaar ke manzar mein sadmaat uthane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza ke liye ki hai maula ne ye wasiyat
darbar e yazeedi mein jab zad pe hogi ismat
tum dhaal wahan hona tatheer bachane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
taskeen ki khaatir ye shabbir se farmeina
tum shaad raho beta aur shaad usay rakhna
beti jo khuda dega seene pe sulaane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhir mein kiya yasir maula ne ada kalma
muslim meri beti ki khaatir hai mera lehja
raahon mein bina chadar khutbaat sunane ko
hyder ki wasiyat hai...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Jalte hue qaimo
items.body:
jalte hue qaimon may sada goonj rahi hai
abbas abbas abbas ab aao
<<DIVIDER>>
ye lashkare be-deen rida cheen raha hai
saydaniyo pa shimr ki durro se jafa hai
abbas abbas abbas bachao
<<DIVIDER>>
na mehramo ka majma hai aur hum hai khule sar
ghayre hue hai dushmane deen aur sitamgar
abbas abbas abbas hatao
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim hamay lachaar samjhte hai baradar
naizo ki chubote hai ani pusht pa aa kar
abbas abbas abbas bachao
<<DIVIDER>>
durr bali sakina ke sitamgar ne utaare
rukhsaar pa be-jurm tamache bhi hai maare
abbas abbas abbas bulao
<<DIVIDER>>
zid karti hai soti nahi roti hai sakina
aagosh tumhari hai na hai baap ka seena
abbas abbas abbas sulao
<<DIVIDER>>
aada ne jala dala bayaban may maskan
jalta hai sakina ka teri aag se daaman
abbas abbas abbas bujhao
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kaash anees itna hi ban jaye muqaddar
bosa loo zarih e shah e abrar ka ja kar
abbas abbas abbas bulao
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Kaha sughra ne
items.body:
kaha sughra ne meri jaan ali akbar e man
poora kar do na ye armaan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se tum ghar se gaye lutfe azan jaata raha
laut aane ka jo waada tha wo rulwata raha
chand lamhon ki hoo mehmaan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi tanhaai ke tanhaai ko darr lagta hai
aise manzar hai ke beenayi ko darr lagta hai
ghar mujhe lagta hai zindan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere hote huwe aabaad thay raste saare
teergi mein bhi thay aangan mein chamakte taare
zindagi hogayi veeran ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu nahi aata to ek khat hi rawana kar de
mere jeene ka yehi ek bahana kar de
itna kehna to mera maan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na baba se shikayat hai na amma se gila
mai to bemaar hoo bemaar se rishta kaisa
gham ye hai bhooli phupi jaan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankhon mein tumhe ashk gawara hi na thay
tere bin kaatun ye bemaar ke lamhe kaise
maut hai saamne har aan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre zahra pe bhi ab jaane ki himmat na rahi
ab diya ghar mein jalane ki bhi taaqat na rahi
natawani ka hai toofan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi jhoka bhi hawa ka jo idhar aata hai
mujhse pehle mera dil jaanib e dar jaata hai
bas hai aahat pe lage kaan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kabhi socha behan dard se roti hogi
laut ke aao to wo qabr mein soti hogi
hai bahot iska bhi imkaan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya to pardes se sughra ka kafan le aao
ya mere jeete huwe apni dulhan le aao
rakho itna to mera maan ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya koi apna watan chod ke yun jaata hai
shaam ko ghar mein parinda bhi chala aata hai
ay mere ghar ki nigehban ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash ke aalam mein bhi rehan tha sughra ka bayan
kya dam e marg sirhane na padhoge quran
ay mere bolte quran ali akbar e man
laut aao na watan
kaha sughra ne...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Laashe akbar utha rahe
items.body:
laashe akbar utha rahe hai hussain
ya ali kehte jaa rahe hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mere beta zara galay se lago
kuch to baba se uth ke baat karo
dekho kab se bula rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
badi hasrat se jaanib e darya
apne bhai ka dekh kar laasha
sirf aansu baha rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh bhi kholte nahi akbar
kuch bhi ab bolte nahi akbar
bas galay se laga rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ki neend so gaya beta
hai khabar ab kabhi na uthega
haye phir bhi jaga rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
bani hashim ke bachon aa jao
naujawan ka janaza uthwao
bekasi may bu?a rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake maqtal se dasht e ghurbat may
laashe kadiyal jawan ki surat may
apni mayyat utha rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra baandha hai maut ne aa ke
khoon ki mehndi hai haath may jis ke
aise dulhe ko laa rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ko bete dete hai kaandha
laasha lekin jawan bete ka
apne kaandho pe laa rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mesum ab kya bayan ho ranj o malaal
naame abbas le ke mir hilal
zor e baazu dikha rahe hai hussain
laashe akbar utha rahe...
items.author: Hilal Rizvi

items.title: Mohamed ke shehr
items.body:
ghar kis ka jal raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
yeh kaun ro raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa ye waqt aaya koi jaanta nahi
beti nabi ki hai koi pehchaanta nahi
mazloom fatema hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare nabi ne jism ka tukda kaha jise
tazeem jiski karte thay uski hi pusht pe
darwaza gir raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ko ek dard ka marham na mil saka
kehta hai par har ek musalman barmala
har dard ki dawa hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baad e rasool qadr na jaani batool ki
darbar may khadi hai nishani rasool ki
mehroom fatema hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ke paas beti ki turbat na ban sake
hai koi chashme beena jo insaaf se kahe
ye kya sitam hua hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisne gale may daali hai hyder ke rassiyan
tooti hai kaise fatema zehra ki phasliyan
kya haadsa hua hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos kalma goyon ne is ko nahi suna
rehta tha jo batool ke honton pe marsiya
wo ab bhi goonjta hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re baqiyye ki ghurbat wo bekasi
sadiyan guzar gayi hai magar aaj bhi koi
ghut ghut ke ro raha hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kis ka jal raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir ye kalma goyon ne socha nahi kabhi
ainee janabe fatema jaan e rasool ki
marqad pe bhi jafa hai mohamed ke shehr may
ghar kiska jal raha hai...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Namazi maara gaya
items.body:
wavaila wavaila
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid mein namazi maara gya wawaila
hasnain ka baba qatl hua wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa ajab hai zulm hua
ahmad ke wasi ko qatl kiya
hai khoon mein doobi saari qaba
masjid mein namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsoom aur zainab roti hai
baba se lipat kar kehti hai
aankhein to zara kholo baba
masjid mein namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacchon se juda hote hai ali
zahra ne lehed apni chodi
hai binte pyambar ka nauha
masjid mein namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
behaal hai jaan khote hai hussain
ye keh ke bahot rote hai hussain
imdaad karo amma zahra
masjid mein namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ki ajab hi haalat hai
chehre pe ajab si ghurbat hai
sadma hai bahot dil par gehra
masjid mein namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
taboot e ali jab ghar se chala
beti ka kaleja phatne laga
ghash khaa ke giri zainab dukhiya
masjid mein namazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe mein qayamat barpa thi
hur jinn o bashar rote thay sabhi
sar peet ke kehti thi zahra
masjid mein namazi...
items.author: Hurr Sultanpuri

items.title: Pehchano mujhe
items.body:
aakhri raat sakina ka jab ye aalam tha
qaid khane mein tadapti rahi bekas tanha
sar e shabbir ko aghosh mein le kar apni
zakhmi honton pe yateema ke yehi nauha tha
<<DIVIDER>>
baba pehchano mujhe baba
mai teri sakina hoo
tere gham ne mujhe kar diya hai baba zaeefa
<<DIVIDER>>
meri poshak lahoo se hai bhari ay baba
bad gayi aur meri tashna labi ay baba
khud batayenge mere paon ke chaale tum ko
aaj bhi dhoop mein rehti hoo khadi ay baba
jis din se utha aap ka sar se mere saaya
baba baba pehchano mujhe baba
baba baba mai teri sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad ajab haal hua hai mera
ye badan phool sa zakhmon se bhara hai mera
pehla pursa hi tamachon ka mil hai mujhko
shaam waalon ne khayal aise rakha hai mera
pathar kabhi shole kabhi naiza kabhi durra
baba baba pehchano mujhe baba
baba baba mai teri sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ka karz sakina ne utaara baba
zaalimon ne mujhe har mod pe maara baba
kaise samjhaun samajh lo ye ishara baba
le ke dewaar ka chalti hoo sahara baba
baba mujhe aankhon se nazar hi nahi aata
baba baba pehchano mujhe baba
baba baba mai teri sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak se apni yateema ko utha lo jaldi
shimr aajayega godhi mein chupa lo jaldi
aap to chaahne waalon ko bula lete ho
door hoo kab se mujhe paas bula lo jaldi
bin aap ke achi nahi lagti mujhe dunya
baba baba pehchano mujhe baba
baba baba mai teri sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nazar ghaur se ghazi ki bhatiji dekho
gir ke naaqe se kamar jhuk gayi meri dekho
aankhein kholo zara bacchi ki zaeefi dekho
mere baalon mein utar aayi safedi dekho
lagta hai zaeefa hoo mai amma se zyada
baba baba pehchano mujhe baba
baba baba mai teri sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri amma ne madine mein sunaya tha mujhe
haal hazrat ki mohabbat ka bataya tha mujhe
aakhri hai ye guzarish meri tum se baba
jaise dunya mein duaon se bulaya tha mujhe
waise hi dua do ke mai ab chod doo dunya
baba baba pehchano mujhe baba
baba baba mai teri sakina hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane mein takallum hai abhi tak dukhiya
aaj tak baap pe karti hai musalsal girya
haye taqdeer rehaayi nahi paayi usne
aaj tak bali sakina ka rasan mein hai gala
wo qabr mein padhti hai yehi aaj bhi nauha
baba baba pehchano mujhe baba
baba baba mai teri sakina hoo...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Aaja mere hussain
items.body:
aaja mere hussain
aaja mere hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tu chand hai mere ghar ka
tu phool hai is aangan ka
tu is dil ki hai dhadkan
tu noor hai in aankhon ka
teri yaad mein tadpun din bhar
jaagun mai saari rayn
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya chakki pees ke beta
is din ke liye tha paala
khanjar hai galay par pyase
manzar ye dehun kaise
ahmed ka nawasa hai
ye beta hai mera hussain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar baar luta kar dekhun
ye haal bhi dilbar dekhun
tu tanha khada hai ban mein
ujdi hai kook is ban mein
chaale hai mere is dil par
ashkon se tar hai nayn
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon roti hai ye dukhiya
bebas hai kitni mamta
mehshar ka hai ye manzar
sajde mein sar aur khanjar
lillaah rehm tu karna
kaunain huwe bechain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-aab na zibha kar tu
allah se kuch to darr tu
kya soch ke tu badta hai
zehra ka ye fidya hai
kyun arsh ko tu dhaata hai
khudrat ke hai ye bain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil par hai udaasi chaayi
baalon se maqtal jhaadi
beenayi gayi hai maa ki
tooti hai kamar bhi meri
ye din bhi kaisa aaya
haider ke noore ain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar ko chalta dekha
pyase ko tadapta dekha
baakhi hai no koi ghar mein
meri dunya luti pal bhar mein
beemar bacha kunbe mein
thay maa ke shor o shain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-aas tadapti khaahar
nikli hai ghar se baahar
maqtal mein aayi zainab
kya uspe hai ye musibat
bichde hai ran mein us se
sardare jina hasnain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
saabir hai jahan mein iqtaa
iqbal hai jiska banda
qurbani ki ab khaatir
zehra hai ran mein haazir
aa godh mein meri aaja
maa kabse hai bechain
aaja mere hussain...
items.author: Iqbal Abedi

items.title: Akbar tere seene se
items.body:
darr hai ke nikal aaye na seene se kaleja
akbar tere seene se sina kaise nikalun
<<DIVIDER>>
ye soch ke dil tukde hua jaata hai mera
akbar tere seene se sina kaise nikalun
<<DIVIDER>>
aasaan nahi peeri mein sehna koi sadma
ek baap ka marna hai jawan bete ka marna
dam niklega tera to mai mar jaunga beta
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
seena tera zakhmi hai lahoo behta hai saara
ulfat ka taqaaza hai ke kuch bhi nahi dikhta
seene ko tere baap ne bachpan se hai chooma
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tar khoon mein bete ko bhala dekhegi kaise
jaari hai abhi khoon tere zakhm e jigar se
mar jayegi ye dekh ke maadar teri laila
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi jo nikaali to na reh paaoge zinda
mushkil mein bahot aaj hai beta tera baba
maloom hai mar jaaoge kuch dayr mein beta
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon mein nikal jayega dam ay mere beta
is dasht mein reh jaunga ab bekas o tanha
ye soch ke rota hai bahot ye tera baba
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim bhi nahi ab mera abbas kahan hai
har simt sitamgaar hai dushman ye jahan hai
tanha hi uthana hai mujhe ab tera laasha
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
baithi hai yehi aas lagaye huwe dukhiya
dulha mai banaungi mera aayega bhaiya
sehre ko sajati hui reh jayegi sughra
akbar tere seene se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay danish o rehan koi kaise likhega
ek baap ne dekha hai nikalte jo kaleja
kehte huwe shabbir ne jab naiza nikaala
akbar tere seene se...
items.author: Danish Mirza

items.title: Allah bohat bada hai
items.body:
sab ne yehi kaha hai allah bohat bada hai
quran mein likha hai allah bohat bada hai
har hadh se maawara hai allah bohat bada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mehr o maah o anjum daryaon mein talatum
chlati hui hawayein awaaz ka tarannum
khush rang taayeron ka phaila hua tabassum
tarteeb waar ghunche aise ke rashk e anjum
ye kun ka maujiza hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mitti ke paikaron mein tehreek daalta hai
suye falak zameen se taare uchaalta hai
pataal se jawaade wo hi nikalta hai
parwardigar wo hai dunya ko paalta hai
har hadh se maawara hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunain mein ayan hai ya rab jo noor tera
hai taab kis nazar mein dekhe zahoor tera
tasbeeh khwah hum kya hai koh e toor tera
jisko bhi mil gaya hai maula sha'oor tera
wo mustufa hua hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ba-kamaal jaisa waise tere payambar
sab tere madhakhwan hai sab hi tere sanagar
kya badshaah o kudsi kya muflis o gadagar
in saari hastiyaon mein wo aamina ka dilbar
wo bhi to lab kusha hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kausain ki thi manzil hairaan ambiya thay
jibreel ruk gaye thay ek marhale pe aake
raste banaye tu ne parde hata hata ke
meraaj par mohamed pahunche teri riza se
ek shor goonjta hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise hi guftugu ki allah ne nabi se
bole nabi ye lehja marboot hai ali se
hairaan huwe mohamed is lehja e khafi se
kya guftugu hai meri allah ke wali se
ye raaz ghaib ka hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah ki badayi yun to sabhi ne ki hai
lekin jo karbala ki tareekh bolti hai
nok e sina se rab ki tauseef ho chuki hai
tadbeer zer e khanjar shabbir ne kahi hai
mazloom ki sada hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisne kiya hai sajda khanjar tale jahan mein
kaante pade huwe thay jab pyaas se zuban mein
jab aag lag rahi thi zehra ke gulsitan mein
chup chup ke chand taare rote thay aasman hai
maula ne tab kaha hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya nafse mutmainna sajjad ne tha paaya
ek ek sitam pe jisne sajde mein sar jhukaya
tauq e garan pehen kar shikwa na lab pe laaya
kunbe ko apne lekar taa shaam tha jo aaya
har gaam par kaha hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe barchi khaa ke akbar ne ye sada di
ye aakhri hai manzil khushnoodi e khuda ki
khaake shifa bana di karbobala ki matti
bole rehaan o sarwar tareekh e karbala bhi
maula ne sach kaha hai allah bohat bada hai
sab ne yehi kaha hai...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Asghar ke baad
items.body:
asghar ke baad chain na aaya rabab ko
dekha tamaam umr tadapta rabab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
mai doodh bhi plia na saki apne laal ko
ta zindagi raha yehi sadma rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya mera laal aa gaya poocha rabab ne
zainab ne jab kabhi bhi pukara rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
kha kar galay pa teer sar e dasht e karbala
asghar ne kar diya hai akela rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ke baad saaye mein baithi nahi kabhi
deta raha tassaliyan kunba rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
daag e judaai de gayi zindan e shaam mein
asghar ke saath saath sakina rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarwar ke baad qaime jalayenge jab layeen
tadpayega jala hua jhoola rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasne ka kya sawaal tha lab tak nahi khule
itna gham o alam ne sataya rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu khidmat e aza mein hai masroof jis tarha
ishrat pasand aayega nauha rabab ko
asghar ke baad...
items.author: Ishrat Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay mere sar bureeda
items.body:
hussain
ay mere sar bureeda badan dareeda
sada tera naam bar gazeeda
<<DIVIDER>>
mai karbala ke lahoo dasht mein tujhe
dushmano ke narghe mein
taygh dar dast dekhta hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
mai dekhta hoo ke tere saare rafeeq
sab hum nawa sabhi jaan farosh
apne saron ki fasle kata chuke hai
gulaab se jism apne khoon mein naha chuke hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hawaye jaankaah ke bagulay
charagh se taab naak chehre bujha chuke hai
musafirane rahe wafa lut luta chuke hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aur ab faqat tu zameen ke is shafaq kadhe mein
sitara e suboh ki tarha
roshni ka parcham liye khada hai
ye ek manzar nahi hai
ek daastan ka hissa nahi hai
ek waaqia nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yahin se tareekh
apne taaza safar ka awaaz kar rahi hai
yahin se insaniyat
nayi rif'aton ki parwaaz kar rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai aaj is karbala mein
be aabru nigun sar
shikast khurda khajil khada hoo
jahan se mera azeem hadi
hussain kal surkh roo gaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaan bacha kar
fana ke daldal mein jaan balab hoo
zameen aur aasman ke izz o faqr
saare haraam mujh par
wo jaan luta kar
manara e arsh choo gaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam us par
salaam us par
items.author: Ahmed Faraz

items.title: Beti ghareeb hai
items.body:
naraaz aaj tak hai ummat se fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
ek shehr ka dekha gaya manzar ajeeb hai
baba hai shehenshah e arab beti ghareeb hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ke ehteram mein mursal khade huwe
hai turbate batool pe pathar pade huwe
rauza e mustafa bhi jis ke khareeb hai
ek shehr ka dekha gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehmat hai do jahan ke liye aale mustafa
hai noore khuda un pe raazi hai khud khuda
dozakh mein wo jalega jo inka raqeeb hai
ek shehr ka dekha gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kalma nabi ka pad kar kyun aal ko bhulaya
sajjad hassan baqir ka shaan kyun ghataya
nana nabi hai inka jo khuda ka habeeb hai
ek shehr ka dekha gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
tameer honge rauze momin tu gham na kar
aayenge jald jin ka zamana hai muntazir
mahdi ka hona zaahir ab an-khareeb hai
ek shehr ka dekha gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khuld ki mukhtar jo makhdooma e jahan
khursheed mili unko hai ye gor e ghareeban
ye dukhtare nabi ka kaisa naseeb hai
ek shehr ka dekha gaya...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Chehlum karne aayi
items.body:
chehlum karne aayi hai zainab
karbobala mein zindan se chut kar
<<DIVIDER>>
sar par odhe zakhmon ki chadar
chehlum karne aayi hai zainab
karbobala mein zindan se chut kar
<<DIVIDER>>
uth kar dekho raaj dularon
khaak nasheen quran ke paaron
dil pe le kar daaghe bahattar
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh pe udaasi chaayi hui hai
gham se behen ghabrayi hui hai
utho mere atthara baradar
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
farsh bicha do laa kar ran mein
khayncho khanatein aa kar ban mein
aao kahan ho qasim o akbar
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na watan mein jaungi bhai
ro ro yahin mar jaungi bhai
ban ke teri turbat ki mujawir
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dashte bala mein hashr tha us dam
pahunchi hai jis dam zainab e purnam
qabre jari par ghutniyon chal kar
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya mai bataun shaahe madina
mar gayi ghut gayi bali sakina
teri amanat shaam mein kho kar
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash teri shadi jo rachaati
phoolon ka sehra tujhko pinhaati
utho mere hamshakle payambar
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak pe baithi roti thi zainab
bain ye ro ke karti thi zainab
apne saron par kha kar pathar
chehlum karne aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne jo aalam nauha likha hai
aamir ne ro ro ke padha hai
ahle aza rote hai sun kar
chehlum karne aayi...
items.author: Aalam Sultanpuri

items.title: Do hi wajah se
items.body:
do hi wajah se baatil haq na chupa saka
ek hai rida e zainab asghar hai doosra
<<DIVIDER>>
do bhaiyon ke laashe ran mein pade huwe
zainab ke laadlon ka aakhir hai jurm kya
do hi wajah se baatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
beparda bibiyon ko na dekhe koi layeen
noke sina pe zinda quran bolne laga
do hi wajah se baatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe mein be-amaan hai muslim ke dono laal
dono ke kamsini mein aisa sitam hua
do hi wajah se baatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ke layeeno ne jhoole ke saath saath
afsos ke sakina ka daaman jala diya
do hi wajah se baatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dashte karbala ne bachaya hai deen ko
aur doosra wo mod hai bazaar e shaam ka
do hi wajah se baatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ka ek tabassum samjha gaya hai ye
daste hussain par tha quran khula hua
do hi wajah se baatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh rag ne kaat daala khanjar ki dhaar ko
pyason ki tishnagi pe darya bhi ro pada
do hi wajah se baatil...
<<DIVIDER>>
do hi sabab se deen ye baaqi raha mohib
ek karbala hai ek fidak ka hai ye waqia
do hi wajah se baatil...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Haye gharibul watan
items.body:
nauha ruqayya ka tha haye ghareebul watan
deti hoo kab se sada haye ghareebul watan
<<DIVIDER>>
pyar jo sheh ne kiya boli ruqayya chacha
baba ko kya hogaya haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ko jhukaye hussain kehte thay ay noor e ain
deen pe hua wo fida haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe may paaya na chain haye safeer e hussain
kufiyon ne ki dagha haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo aa ke ghar may ruke sajda e haq may jhuke
karte thay bas ye dua haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye na kufa imam sadqe ho unpar ghulam
kehta tha ye bawafa haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoke se ghera usay rassi se jakda usay
qaidi bana soorma haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ko kiya yun salam hum to huwe ab tamam
waali tumhara khuda haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hukme sitamgaar par kaata hai muslim ka sar
be-kafan laasha raha haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
paayi jo sheh ne khabar kehte thay sar peet kar
mar gaya aashiq mera haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
suniye akif o aijaz aah o fughan ki awaaz
kehte thay ahle aza haye ghareebul watan
nauha ruqayya ka tha...
items.author: Aijaz Rizvi

items.title: Hydere karar tanha
items.body:
ali ki aankh mein aansu thay aur honton pe ye nauha
jo dil ka haal hai mere kabhi ummat na samjhegi
ali kehte thay mai talwaar se maara na jaunga
magar zahra ye tanhaai to meri jaan le legi
<<DIVIDER>>
suno zahra madine mein tera ghamkhar tanha hai
tumhare baad zahra hyder e karaar tanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa waqt hai ke waqt ka sardar tanha hai
tumhare baad zahra hyder e karaar tanha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
madine waale mujhko dekh kar moo phayr lete hai
wo mimbar se nabi ke ab meri tauheen karte hai
fidak cheena tha jaisa us tarha mimbar bhi cheena hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasan jab daal ke gardan mein mere mujhko khayncha tha
mohamed ki qasam mujhko nazar bazaar aaya tha
na jaane kyun nigahon mein meri zainab ka chehra hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye pehli baar tha zahra jo mera haath kaampa tha
bahot mushkil se maine tumse darwarza hataya tha
wo manzar yaad aaye to mera dil khoon rota hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare laadle bachon ka aise dhyaan rakhta hoo
mai apne dil ke saare zakhm bhi unse chupate hoo
dar o dewaar ne ghar ke ali ka haal dekha hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe rota hoo mai zahra meri haalat pe tum ro lo
mai aajaun tumhare paas ye rab se dua maango
tera pehlu shikasta tha ali ka dil shikasta hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
azane fajr nauha ban gayi hai aaj kufe mein
kiya hai waar rozadaar pe zaalim ne sajde mein
lahoo itna baha sar se amaama khoon mein dooba hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zakhmi hoo magar takleef mujhko ye nahi bibi
mujhe to fikr khaye jaa rahi apne bachon ki
tum hi batalo mere baad kaun inka sahara hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke gham samajh sakta nahi azlaan koi bhi
jo tanhaai thi maula ki bayan ho hi nahi sakti
ali maula ki tanhaai ko bas zahra ne samjha hai
ye kaisa waqt hai ke...
tumhare baad zahra...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Kaha ye maa ne
items.body:
kaha ye maa ne ke akbar manaane aayi hoo
khafa thay laal galay se lagane aayi hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad mere sar se chin gayi chadar
jafa e shimr e sitamgar sunaane aayi hoo
kaha ye maa ne ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kashaan kashaan mujhe darbar le gaye aada
chalo watan mai tumhe ab manaane aayi hoo
kaha ye maa ne ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hua na byaah pur armaan mar gaye akbar

items.title: Karbobala lahoo ka
items.body:
karbobala lahoo ka safar dekhti rahi
maqtal ki samt raah guzar dekhti rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal may aediyon ko ragarta raha pisar
ankhon say khoon bahati hui baap ki nazar
barchi may naujawan ka jigar dekhti rahi
karbobala lahoo ka...

beton ne yun khayal rakha apni baat ka
jaan se guzar gaye na kiya rukh faraat ka
maa apni tarbiyat ka asar dekhti rahi
karbobala lahoo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
lekar aba may aaye jigar goshaye zamaan
laashe ko rakh ke saamne ibne hasan ki ma
dulhan ki chashme tar ke gohar dekhti rahi
karbobala lahoo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab qaimagah ja na saka sher laut kar
huzn-o-alam se hazrate abbas-e-naamvar
be-aab mashk khoon may tar dekhti rahi
karbobala lahoo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt kayenat ki gardish bhi tham gayi
qaime ke dar pay madare muztar khadi hui
paykan-e-hurmala tera shar dekhti rahi
karbobala lahoo ka...

khanjar ki pyas khoon se bujha kar utha layeen

karbobala lahoo ka...

shahid rakha imam ne ghurbat may bhi lihaaz

items.title: Khoon rulwati
items.body:
zainabe muztar hai aur manzar pa manzar karbala
khoon rulwati rahegi zindagi bhar karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ki aaghosh mein bete ne wo angdayi li
saath jis angdayi ke sarwar ki beenayi gayi
khoon mein tar akbar hue ke khoon mein tar karbala
zainabe muztar hai...
khoon rulwati...
<<DIVIDER>>
behgaya pani to phir sari umeedein rehgayi
hasratein sab sher ki mitti mein milkar rehgayi
warna ghazi ko thi kooze ke barabar karbala
zainabe muztar hai…
khoon rulwati...
<<DIVIDER>>
nafse dauran rukgayi aur aasman sakte mein hai
aur udhar qaime ke dar par ek maa sajde mein hai
bezaban ke saath hai payka ki zad par karbala
zainabe muztar hai...
khoon rulwati...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo ek natawan aur aahni tauqe giran
aur wo bemaar ke talwon mein kaante al-aman
ro rahi hai paaye abid se lipat kar karbala
zainabe muztar hai...
khoon rulwati...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaahe deen teeron pe tehra hai tera jisme figaar
zere khanjar thi magar yun mehve zikre kirdigaar
aagayi hai tere sajde mein simat kar karbala
zainabe muztar hai...
khoon rulwati...
<<DIVIDER>>
har nafas hai ye dua apni azadari rahe
majlis-o-matam ka har ek silsila jaari rahe
hashr tak shahid ho yuhin ashke sarwar karbala
zainabe muztar hai...
khoon rulwati...

items.title: Laashe muslim pe ye
items.body:
warid haram ka khaafila kufe mein jab hua
muslim ki laash dekh ke zainab ne ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe muslim pe ye zainab ne kaha ro ro kar
aap ki laash bhi be-gor o kafan hai bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
be kafan kabobala mein hai mere lakhte jigar
aap ki laash bhi be-gor o kafan hai bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ye aal e payembar pe musibat aayi
ranj ye dil pe sahay kis tarha zehra jaayi
bhai shabbir ka laasha hai pada reti par
aap ki laash bhi be-gor o kafan hai bhaiya
laashe muslim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun to zinda hoo magar jaan kahan baaqi hai

haye afsoos nahi sar pe hamare chadar
aap ki laash bhi be-gor o kafan hai bhaiya
laashe muslim pe...

zulm laashon pe shaheedo ke hai yun dhaaye gaye

gham ka manzar wo bayan hoga shuja'at kaise
kaamp uthi laasha e muslim bhi ye naale sun ke
saath naizon pe hai hamraah shaheedon ke bhi sar

items.title: Maar gaya baba
items.body:
maar gaya baba teri zainab ko
abbas ka marna maar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
bin baazuon ke wo ghazi ka
ghode se girna maar gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab qaime mein aaye shaahe umam
haathon mein tha bas ghazi ka alam
abbas nahi ab aayega
bhai ka ye kehna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai sher ke jaise bhai ka
pehchan nahi paayi laasha
qasim ki tarha se ghazi ka
tukdon mein bikharna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aankh se teer nikaala tha
mai dekh rahi thi qaime se
mere ghazi ka khoon sarwar ke
haathon se tapakna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shaam ke zaalim to apne
ghodon ko pilaate hai pani
haaathon mein liye khaali kooze
bachon ka bilakna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se ye suna hai ke pyasa
saqqa e sakina maara gaya
ab pani nahi mil payega
asghar ka samajhna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ne chadaya tha ran mein
jis naize par abbas ka sar

<<DIVIDER>>
rahwaar pe ho kar bhi jiske
khad paon zameen par khaynchte thay
us bhai ka asghar jaisi
turbat mein simatna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein bahot dhoonda usne
laasha na mila do haath mile
un haathon se meri bacchi ka
ro ro ke lipatna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeeshan kaha ye zainab ne
jab sheh chali tera zarbein
ghazi ko sadayein de de kar
bhai ka tadapna maar gaya
maar gaya baba...

items.title: Mera hi naam abbas
items.body:
maidan mein aaya hyder ka sher
nau laakh lashkar karne ko zer
mashk o alam ko utha kar
lab pe rajaz ye saja kar
mai waaris e zor e hyder hoo
saani e hamza o jafar hoo
mera hi naam abbas hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaur se dekho mujhe
mera hi naam abbas hai
mera baba ali maa hai ummul baneen
hoo alamdar e karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
mera aaqa hai wo jiske aage
sar adab se jhukata hai kaaba
mere seene mein imran ka dil
khoon ragon mein hai sher e khuda ka
gar badaun qadam kis mein hai itna dam
rok le aake rasta mera
ghaur se dekho mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko talwaar ki kya zaroorat
mai nigahon se dil kaat dunga
dekhna dekhte dekhte hi
dasht laashon se mai baat dunga
hukm e maula nahi warna mai to yahin
khaynch doon naksha siffeen ka
ghaur se dekho mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
soch kar tum jo akde khade ho
mai akela hoo tum itne saare
laakh do laakh se to akele
jang karte hai bache hamare
meer e lashkar hoo mai
sher e hyder hoo mai
kaun mujhse ladega bhala
ghaur se dekho mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
do rukhi aur aal e nabi se
iska matlab bhi samjhaunga mai
laakh paaon pade ab ye darya
mashk mein bhar ke le jaonga mai
pyaas ki qaid mein yaas ki qaid mai
ab rahega ye darya sada
ghaur se dekho mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaamiyon jang karne ki mujhko
mere maula ijazat jo dete
aayegi kis tarha se qayamat
apni aankhon se tum dekh lete
aati jaan se kabhi aasmaan se kabhi
al hazar al amaan ki sada
ghaur se dekho mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaamp kar reh gaya dil zameen ka
arsh larza falak thar tharaya
jhoom kar zaigham e murtaza ne
itna keh kar jo naiza uthaya
jaise tayghe ali gardano par chali
yun chalega ye naiza mera
ghaur se dekho mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri talwaar ke har nishan par
sab ne dekhi ali ki nishani
maine paaya shabaab e shujaat
maine paayi ali ki jawani
mere har waar par ud ke kehte thay sar
aa gaye ran mein sher e khuda
ghaur se dekho mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek qayamat hai farhan o gohar
lashkar e zulm sehma hua hai
mashk mein qaid darya ko kar ke
sher kehta hua jaa raha hai
aaj tak ba khuda jo kaha wo kiya
hum badalte nahi faisla
ghaur se dekho mujhe...

namazi zer e khanjar aa raha hai

items.title: Pehla sajda baghair
items.body:
aaj zainab karegi maqtal mein
pehla sajda baghair chadar ke
<<DIVIDER>>
roshni aur hawa ne bhi jiska
sar na dekha baghair chadar ke
<<DIVIDER>>
jisko dafna nahi saki zainab
bekafan tha jo dashte ghurabt mein
apne bhai hussain ka usne

wo jo uski rida ka zaamin tha
uske naqshe qadam mitaata tha
kaise guzregi uske laashe se
binte zehra baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jiska quran chehra padhta tha
sirf aayaat dekhti thi jise
aaj dekhenge usko galiyon mein
ahle kufa baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...

tum se zainab na hum kalaam hui
meri awaaz na suni tum ne
aao baba sunaaun mai tum ko
aaj khutba baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...

dono zakhmon ne khoon rulaya hai
qabr mein bhi khuda ki ghairat ko
ek laasha tha bekafan ran mein
ek janaza baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...

kaise un chadaron ke maqtal mein
teen din tak khadi rahi zainab
jis jagah maut se bhi mushkil tha
ek lamha baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi parde ko rone waali hai
waasta unko bibi zainab ka
binte zehra ki paak chadar ko
tum na rona baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak baalon mein baal chehre par
aur aankhon se ashk jaari hai
qaid khane mein aise zainab ka
saal guzra baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...
<<DIVIDER>>
uska parda tha zindagi uski
saans usko rida se milti thi
hai qayamat faraaz zainab ka
zinda rehna baghair chadar ke
aaj zainab karegi...
