items.title: Aaja mere hussain
items.body:
aaja mere hussain
ghurbat se maa ke thay bain
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja mere dil ke chain
aaja mere hussain
ghurbat se maa ke thay bain
aaja mere hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tera janaza maqtal mein tanha
mai ro rahi hoo ghurbat mein tanha
tu ne uthaye laashon hai pe laashe
kaise rahe maa hai mushkil mein beta
maa hoo mai beta hussain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalta tha meri ungli ko thaame
karti thi tujh par aanchal ke saaye
tu dhoop mein reh gaya suye maqtal
aaja tujhe maa kafan mein chupaye
mehsoos kar maa ke bain
aaja mere hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere gale par chala hai jo khanjar
aa kar laga hai teri maa ke dil par
ye soch kar mera dil jal raha hai
naize pe jayega beta tera sar
pareshan kiye maa ne bain
aaja mere hussain...

items.title: Abbas abbas jaati hai
items.body:
abbas abbas
jaati hai behan ab be-parda
saqqa saqqa
ek pyasi behan ka sar hai khula
<<DIVIDER>>
jab zeen se gire bin haathon ke
bhaiya mere moo ke bal thay pade
karwat bhi badalna mushkil tha
phir bhi na kisi se lab khole
haalat teri dekhe kaun bhala
saqqa hai behan ko ye sadma
abbas abbas jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha watan se laaye thay hum
waise hi bhala kaise jaaye
kya zulm huwe chadar bhi chini
kis tarha haram chadar paayein
utho bhaiya utho bhaiya
chadar to dilaado ay saqqa
abbas abbas jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher tu kitna pyasa tha
zainab ko teri ehsaas hua
aur tashna dahan bhi maara gaya
do ghoont tumhe pani na mila
mashkeeza chida dil toot gaya
pani nahi tera khoon baha
abbas abbas jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tak tu raha zinda bhaiya
nazrein na uthaata tha koi
zehra ki mai beti hoo ghazi
haa sar pe mere chadar na rahi
aa sar pe mere saaya kar de
ay bhayi mere phir so jaana
abbas abbas jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi teri khata bhi koi nahi
aur sar pe tumhare gurz laga
behnein roti hai ye keh kar
bhaiya ko mere kisne maara
sambhla na gaya tumse zeen par
sar khoon mein tera doob gaya
abbas abbas jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laaye thay watan se jis tarha
us tarha watan ab pahuncha do
bhaiya meri chadar dilwado
mehmil mein bhi mujhko bithwa do
abbas mere aa dekh zara
hai teri behen ka shaana bandha
abbas abbas jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis mein ye bhala jurrat aati
jo baandhta shaano mein rassi
bhaiya mere zinda hote agar
chadar na mere sar se lut'ti
mai saani e zahra hoo ghazi
kis tarha rahoongi beparda
abbas abbas jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehan o mubarak zainab ka
pardes mai yun ghar baar luta
bhai pardes mein maare gaye
shaana bandha parda loota gaya
maqtal mein chaudha sadi se
hai fatema zehra ka nauha
abbas abbas jaati hai...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Abhi hum zinda hai
items.body:
uncha rahega alam seene mein hai jab tak hai dam
karbobala ki qasam zinda rahega ye gham
pehre mein muqtar hai haq ke tarafdaar hai
gham ke talabgaar hai hum to azadaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab talak saans mein hai saans azadari rahegi
dil azadaar rahega har azadaar kahega
kaise jhukega hazrate abbas ka alam
kaise rukega hazrate shabbir ka matam
abhi hum zinda hai hum zinda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaho labbaik ya hussain labbaik ya hussain
ye matami ye azadaar hai dua e batool
isi liye to mila saaya e rida e batool
hussainiyo ki har ek saans hai baraye batool
kaise bhala mitenge zamane se ahle noor
hai maadare shabbir ka elaan ye har dam
abhi hum zinda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe ye farshe aza bichayenge hum
ghame hussain to har haal mein manayenge hum
gali gali mein charaghe aza jalayenge hum
nazre yazeed hazrate shabbir ki qasam
tera mita ke jayenge hum khaak mein bharam
abhi hum zinda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hawa ke rukh ko badaldenge hum khuda ki qasam
sar e yazeed kuchaldenge hum khuda ki qasam
amal ka rukne amal denge hum khuda ki qasam
humse hai ye zamana zamane se nahi hum
yuhin manaate jayenge har saal moharram
abhi hum zinda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlise unse wafa sheh ke matam se bapa
ta qayamat karenge hum
ya ali adrikni ya ali adrikni
ta qayamat kahenge hum
hil jayega zamana laraz jayenge qadam
goonjenge jab fazaon mein awaaz hama dam
abhi hum zinda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamari haami o nasir khuda ki zaat bhi hai
kiya hai azmat o himmat bhi hai sabaat bhi hai
hamare sar pe imame zamaan ka haat bhi hai
daawa bina daleel ke karte kahan hai hum
karte rahenge aag pe zanjeer ka matam
abhi hum zinda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
siwaye asghar e baysheer jab koi na raha
ghareeb dasht mein hal min ki de raha tha sada
tadap ke rehgaya har ek shaheede raahe wafa
maujood hum nahi thay wahan ay shahe umam
de ab tu isteghasa to labbaik kahe hum
abhi hum zinda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada e safdar o mazhar to har jagah hai yehi
ye pursadaar salamat rahe dua hai yehi
labon pe unke hama waqt ek sada hai yehi
kaise jhukega hazrate abbas ka alam
kaise rukega hazrate shabbir ka matam
abhi hum zinda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bola hijaab e ghaib se ye waqt ka imam
hum lene aa rahe hai shaheedo ka inteqam
haye hussainiat ke safeeron tumhe salaam
raahe khuda ke saare shaheedo tumhe salaam
shaamil meri dua mein meri tumhara hi naam hai
tum sab ke waalidayn pe mera salaam hai
ay azadaron utho maut se tum na daro
baandlo sar se kafan in yazeedon se kaho
abhi hum zinda hai...

items.title: Akbar teri behna ko
items.body:
akbar teri behna ko teri yaad sataati hai

bemaar shifa paaye akbar jo mera aaye

dhadkan tere aane ki bas aas bandhaati hai
veeran haveli mein...

abbas chacha tum hi baba se kaho jaa kar

dam ghut'ta hai akbar ki jab yaad sataati hai
veeran haveli mein...

zeeshan o raza ka bhi maqbool ho ye pursa

aawaz ye nasir ki har dil ko rulaati hai

allah hi allah maula hi maula
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki jawani ka bas khatam fasana hai
misle payambar akbar si khoon mein dooba hai
sogh manalo dunya walon
allah hi allah maula hi maula
<<DIVIDER>>
sab se badi ibadat hi matam karna hai
matam ki muqaalif se ab kya darna hai
sogh manalo dunya walon
allah hi allah maula hi maula
<<DIVIDER>>
mashke sakina ka ab se abbas sahara hai
pyason ki har aas ka abbas sahara hai
sogh manalo dunya walon
allah hi allah maula hi maula
items.author: Kashmiri

items.title: Ay mere sher abbas
items.body:
roke zainab ne kaha ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida ay mere sher abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jab mere sar se rida cheen rahe thay aada
aisa lagta tha mujhe mera jari aayega
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
tu na aaya bhaiya ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag qaimon mein layeeno ne laga di aakar
durre barsaye sakina pe yehi keh keh kar
kahan hai ab tera chacha ay ghamzada ay ghamzada
ab kahan hai saqqa ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne bali sakina ko tamache maare
aur mere saamne masoom ke cheene bunde
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
kuch na bas mera chala ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere ghazi mere haathon mein bandhi jab rassi
sar jhuka kar ke bahot dayr talak mai royi
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
rukh suye darya tha ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek rassi mein gala sab ka bandha tha bhai
haal us waqt sakina ka juda tha bhai
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
uska dam ghut'ta tha ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tera khaali alam khoon mein dooba aaya
mai usi waqt se ye jaan gayi ay bhaiyya
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
ab to bas hogi jafa ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere ghayyur wafadaar mere shaydayi
ro rahi thi meri ghurbat pe meri tanhaai
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
has rahe thay aada ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
us ghadi mere kaleje se nikalta tha dhuaan
jab layeen kehte thay atthara baradar hai kahan
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
dil bahot rota tha ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aaya hai bahot ghar se nikalna mera
tere parcham ke talay shaan se chalna mera
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
jab khula sar mera ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko jab shaam ke bazaar mein maare patthar
aur dehakte huwe angaare jo daale hum par
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
tu bahot yaad aaya ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
<<DIVIDER>>
thokarein khaati rahi zainab e muztar waiz
zulm hote rahe har ek qadam par waiz
ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa ay bawafa
bas yehi tha nauha ay mere sher abbas
chin gayi meri rida...
roke zainab ne kaha...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Baade rasool sadme
items.body:
baade rasool sadme uthaati rahi batool
rone ko bait e huzn mein jaati rahi batool
<<DIVIDER>>
dil murtaza ka pehle hi zakhmon se choor hai
maula se apne zakhm chupati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu shakista ho ke bhi shikwa nahi kiya
tanhaiyon mein ashk bahaati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
dene hai khutbe unko bhi darbar e shaam mein
zainab ko dil ka haal bataati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos ke liye bhi na aaya koi magar
farshe ghame rasool bichati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ke dukhon pe rote rahe zainab o hussain
yasrab mein karbala ko sajaati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaza e batool se uth'ta raha dhuaan
ajre rasool durron se paati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah bhi na zinda rahi bibi ay zafar
nauhe musibaton ke sunaati rahi batool
baade rasool sadme...
items.author: Zafar Abbas

items.title: Beti se pyari qaza
items.body:
mai jaane nahi dene thi baba ke sawari
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ko nahi jaaiye ruk jaye khudara
kya beti se pyari hai qaza ay mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon ke aziyat se sakina ko bacha len
jaate huwe haathon se inhe aap chupa len
kaano se gauhar nochne aa jayenge adaa
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra hoo samajhti hoo mai ismat ke ishaare
shayad na rahe chadarein ab sar pe hamare
kyun yaas se hai chadar e tatheer ko chooma
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsaron pe is tarha mujhe bosay kiye hai
jaise ke mere gaalon pe kuch neel pade hai
mai kis ko pukarungi agar shimr ne maara
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha utaara hai mujhe seene se baba
yaad aaya hai manzar mujhe yasrab ke safar ka
bhaiya ne tha mehmil se yun sughra ko utaara
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab mein mere naaz uthaate rahe jaise
taskeen e dil o jaan bulaate rahe jaise
ab kaun kahega mujhe is tarha sakina
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein hojaye jo bewa koi beti
bas baap hi reh jaata hai umeed dukhi ke
ro ro ke ye poochti hai aap se kubra
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bain jo uth'te hai abhi aap ke gham mein
shaamil hai meri daadi bhi in ahle haram mein
roti hui takti hai mujhe fatema zehra
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ki zaroorat hi nahi pyasi nahi hoo
kis aas pe ruqsat ki ijazat tumhe de doo
maine to koi laut ke aata nahi dekha
kya beti se pyari hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar tha ajab sajda e shabbir ka manzar
gardan pe layeen waar kiye jaata tha gin kar
har waar pe kaano mein yehi goonjh raha tha
kya beti se pyari hai...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Chehlum karo
items.body:
chehlum karo momino karbal ke mehman ka
matam karo momino shaah e shaheedan ka
jis ko layeeno ne pani ko tarsaya
chehlum karo momino karbal ke mehman ka
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan se chut kar behan aati hai karbobala
qabr e sakina se wo kis tarha hogi juda
zehra ke kunbe mein shor e qayamat bapa
hilti hai qabre nabi rote hai sher e khuda
chehlum karo momino...
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat se ghazi ki guzri jo dukh paayi
darya pe ay momino ek laash tharrayi
zainab ne ro kar kaha utho mere bhai
ab to tumhari behan zindan se ho aayi
chehlum karo momino...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki maa dekho ghut ghut ke roti hai
waaris hai maqtal mein mitti mein moti hai
kulsoom ashkon ki ladiyan piroti hai
bali sakina bhi zindan mein soti hai
chehlum karo momino...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye us ka chehlum hai jo ab tak hai jo bekafan
ghodon ki taapon se pamaal hai khasta tan
jaan e payambar hai zehra ka hai gulbadan
us ko kafan kaise de khud berida hai behan
chehlum karo momino...
<<DIVIDER>>
peeto ab ahle aza arsa hai mehshar ka
abid ko pursa do unke bhare ghar ka
gham se bura haal hai kulsoom muztar ka
taboot uth'ta hai zehra ke dilbar ka
chehlum karo momino...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar mein qayamat hai aale payambar ke
nauhe sunaana hai ujde huwe ghar ke
dekho zara hausle sajjad muztar ke
maula ne dafnaye laashe bahattar ke
chehlum karo momino...
<<DIVIDER>>
toofan e gham uthay nasir ke nauhe se
batlao karbal mein chehlum hua kaise
sheh ke azadaron matam karo aise
bete ki mayyat par roti ho maa jaise
chehlum karo momino...

items.title: Dono jahan may
items.body:
dono jahan may aaj hai charcha hussain ka
har shaks padh raha hai qaseeda hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram hai pyaas ki shiddat se bekaraar
nauha kuna hai dasht may kunba hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
tukdon may munqasim hua ibne ali ka laal
tashnadhan yateem bhatija hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hal min mughisuna ki sada sunke be-zaban
jhoole se gir gaya hai wo bacha hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
masroof kaar zaar hai zainab ke laadle
maadar ne kar diya unhe sadqa hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansu baha rahe hai jo gham may hussain ke
usko duayein deta hai baba hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashke sakina bhar ke chala sher ka pisar
baazu kate to toota sahara hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mitti pe so rahi hai sakina wo ghamzada
ab na milega isko wo seena hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash may pada hai qaime may bemaar natawan
kaise behan bachayegi beta hussain ka
dono jahan may...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmo pe zakhm khaaye najaf par kabhi nahi
zainab ne toda koi bhi waada hussain ka
dono jahan may...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Haye ghazi abbas
items.body:
karbobala ke dasht mein goonji hai ye sada
haye ghazi abbas haye ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
maara gaya hai dasht mein pyasa shahe huda
haye ghazi abbas haye ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
shaane kata ke sogaye darya ke kinare
bali sakina aap ko reh reh ke pukare
darya se aa ke bachi ko ab dedo dilaasa
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheeni hai uski baaliyan maare hai tamache
bali sakina roti hai do aa ke dilaase
kaisa sitam ye nanhi si bachi pe hogaya
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad tanha hai unhe aa kar ke bachalo
jalte huwe qaimon ki zara aag bujhado
aa ke sahara dijiye zainab hui tanha
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache hai tanha bibiyan ghabrayi hui hai
shaam e ghariban dekh ke tharrayi hui hai
ahle haram pe hoti hai har tarha ki jafa
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaaron se le jayenge hum ahle haram ko
sajjad bhala kaise sahe koh e sitam ko
kaise sahega zakhm ye sajjad akela
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
chayi hai ghata zulm ki har soo chale aao
zainab puakri akbare mehroo chale aao
abbas kahan hai unhe awaaz do beta
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho shakeel parchame abbas utha hai
dil thaam ke rehan ne ye nauha padha hai
mashke sakina dekh ke phat'ta hai kaleja
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
items.author: Shakeel Kazmi

items.title: Hydere karrar madad
items.body:
ye kis ne kaha zinda rahenge to kahenge
hum naame ali le ke marenge to jiyenge
<<DIVIDER>>
meri sanson mein ali hai nigahon mein ali
meri dhadkan ki sada seene mein har dam boli
hyder e karrar madad ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waalon ne ye baat bhi saabit kar di
ya ali jaane ukhuwat hai wilayat hai teri
ek lashkar mein lade john zuhair aur wahab
faisla ho gaya ye jang nahi mazhab ki
ya hussaini hai koi ya yazeedi hai koi
aao phir mil ke sada dete hai shia sunni
hyder e karrar madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang ke baad phir ek jang ki tayyari hai
asl mein karbobala aaj talak jaari hai
ek sayyed ki shahadat ne bataya sab ko
ek ghulam aaj bhi laakhon ke liye bhari hai
maut se kya darna ek din hai marna
wird ye jaari rahe chaahe ho gardan pe churi
hyder e karrar madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam ya ali madad
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam ay shaheedon as-salaam
khoon se apni shama deen ki jalayi tum ne
asl islam ki tasveer dikhai tum ne
kar diya waqt ke firaun ko tum ne ruswa
aur ali waalon ki izzat hai badhai tum ne
haq ada tum ne kiya nara e hyder ka
de di haq ke liye ye kehte huwe jaan apni
hyder e karrar madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu ne poochi hai imamat ki haqeeqat mujhse
haq tujhe meri tarha saahib e asraar kare
hai wohi tere zamane ka imam e barhaq
jo tujhe haazir o maujood se bezaar kare
<<DIVIDER>>
kya thi khybar ye tumhe yaad dilayega wohi
kaise ladte thay ali lad ke dikhaye ga wohi
uske hamle se na bach payega koi marhab
zulfiqar ab bhi hai khoon khaar batayega wohi
fatema zahra ka hai jalasli beta
mehdi ye kehte huwe todega tu dushman ki nali
hyder e karrar madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek lamhe ke liye aankhein karo band apni
mai dikhata hoon tumhe kaisi thi iksat hijri
wo mohamed ka nawasa tha hussain ibne ali
jis ne sar de diya zaalim ki nahi bayyat ki
bhai bhi maara gaya dafn asghar ko kiya
laash ye keh ke uthayi thi jawan bete ki
hyder e karrar madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
waada nana se kiya tha jo nibhaya usne
apna sab waar diya deen bachaya usne
qatl jab ho gaye maidan mein saare nasir
hausla dene lagi karbobala ki naashir
bhai se kehne lagi saath abhi hai zainab
kya hua bhai agar qatl huwe pyare sab
aaj abbas nahi koi bhi paas nahi
jab sawar aa ke kiya bhai ko zainab boli
hyder e karrar madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanqahon se nikal aao imamat ke liye
aane waala hai alamdar qayamat ke liye
naam par jiske jkhukate ho ziyarat mein sar
taqt tayyar hai ab us ki nizamat ke liye
socho darvesh e aza aur zeeshan zara
waqt kya hoga wo jab kehke ladega mehdi
hyder e karrar madad...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Janabe fatema
items.body:
khadi hai masjid e nabawi mein ho kar
bekas o muztar janabe fatema zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zehra hoon mujhe pehchano
ye kehti hai wo ro ro kar
janabe fatema zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
rasan basta gulu e hyder e safdar
kabhi dekha kabhi dekha hai dar jalta
shikasta phasliyon ko thaam kar
kehti hai ghut ghut kar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bacche chote chote sehm kar
maadar se lipte hai bahot betaab hote hai
wo bacchon ko sambhale ya rakhe
marham wo zakhmon par
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e darbar aayi qadmon pe
chalti hui zahra magar jab de chuki khutba
sahara leke fizza ka gayi
baba ki turbat par
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
masayib mujhpe jo toote dino par
wo agar padte to din raaton mein dhal jaate
mujhe tum paas bulwa lo
yehi kehti hai ro ro kar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta phasliyon ke zakhm mein
wo dard badta tha magar posheeda hi rakha
namazein pad rahi thi rakh ke
daaya haath pehlu par
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
falak bhi keh raha tha ye aziyat
dene waalon se ye kalma padne waalon se
jise jhutla rahe ho tum
wohi hai juzwe paighambar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
shab e rukhsat hai waqt e aakhri hai
dum ukhadta hai ke sab kunba bichadta hai
utha tareeki e shab mein
janaza haye ye keh kar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bibi ki aza ke din mai hoon
qalbe tapan majid ho kaise shadman majid
bas ek nauha ho lab par
haye zahra binte paighambar
janabe fatema zahra
khadi hai masjid...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Karbobala may arsh
items.body:
karbobala may arsh ke taare bikhar gaye
maqtal may bhook o pyaas ke maare bikhar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat thi aaftab ki ya roz e qatl e shaah
aahon se fatema ke sharaare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaysu e mushk o boo ali akbar ke raat bhar
maa ne hazaar baar saware bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe bhai dasht may farzand ran may do
mazloom ke tamaam sahare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
rudaad e teer keh na saka moo se be zaban
masoom ke fiza may ishaare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dauda diye faras jo layeeno ne laash par
aaza hassan ke laal ke saare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache kahin hai shaam e ghariban haram kahin
aandhi chale bala ki sitaare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ko aaj tak hai un auraakh ki talaash
jo nehre alqama ke kanare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra uthaane aayi hai majlis may ay urooj
gohar jo aansuon ke hamare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Laashe pa kar rahi
items.body:
laashe pa kar rahi hai laila ye nauha khani
nazron mein phir rahi hai akbar teri jawani
<<DIVIDER>>
allah walon bolo aakhir uthaye kyun kar
mayyat jawan pisar ki sarwar ki natawani
laashe pa kar rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghairon ka phir gila kya jab kalmago ke haathon
hamshakle mustafa ki mit-ti hai naujawani
laashe pa kar rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bolay maarte ho tum kis ke dil pe barchi
ay kalma padne walon ye hai nabi ka saani
laashe pa kar rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naazon mein palne wala naizon ki zad mein aaya
zainab suna rahi hai ye dard ki kahani
laashe pa kar rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe pe naujawan ke laila ye keh rahi thi
nasoor ban gayi hai bin tere zindagani
laashe pa kar rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
behosh ho gayi thi sunkar watan mein sughra
zainab ne thi sunayi akbar ki jab sunani
laashe pa kar rahi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj o gham o alam se abbas ko bacha lo
laila ke laal karke irfan pa meherbani
laashe pa kar rahi...

items.title: Marhaba sayyede abrar
items.body:
marhaba sayyede abrar hussain ibne ali
pisare fatema zehra hai hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye thay deen mohamed ka bachane ke liye
raasta haq se sadaqat ka dikhane ke liye
wo diya sheh ne jalaya jo zamane ke liye
bangaye masla e anwaar hussain ibne ali
marhaba sayyede abrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gulshane deen ko kiya apne lahoo se sairaab
aap ne kufr ke chehre se hataya hai naqaab
marne jeene ke zamane ko sikhaaye aadaab
kar gaye deen ko bedaar hussain ibne ali
marhaba sayyede abrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen par nana ke ek harf bhi aane na diya
tha jo baatil ka andhera usay chaane na diya
aur shariyat ke usoolon ko mitane na diya
aap hai suboh ke aasaar hussain ibne ali
marhaba sayyede abrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zikre shabbir to talwar hai marhab ke liye
aap to shamme hidayat hai yahan sab ke liye
gham ye maqsoos nahi hai kisi mazhab ke liye
sab tumhare hai azadaar hussain ibne ali
marhaba sayyede abrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek qaima bhi na jalne se bacha tere baad
tere paimaane wafa poora hua tere baad
khaafila leke aseeron ka chala tere baad
wo tera abid e beemaar hussain ibne ali
marhaba sayyede abrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri sajda hussain ibne ali ka hai urooj
sar juda hogaya dunya ka ho baala hai urooj
sar ko naize pe layeeno ne chadaya hai urooj
yun huwe haq ke tarafdaar hussain ibne ali
marhaba sayyede abrar...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Nana mai jaa raha
items.body:
nana mai jaa raha hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
kata ke sar deen ko bachane
mai jaa raha hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
katenge baazu bhi bawafa ke
chununga ibne hassan ke tukde
jawan bete ki laash uthane
mai jaa raha hoon
nana mai jaa raha hoon..
<<DIVIDER>>
namaz tujhko karegi sajda
mai aisa sajda adaa karunga
lahoo se khaake shifa banane
mai jaa raha hoon
nana mai jaa raha hoon..
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeed mujhse ye poochta hai
bata ana min hussain kya hai
usi ko ye silsila batane
mai jaa raha hoon
nana mai jaa raha hoon..
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mere seene pe sone waali
meri sakina hai meri pyari
usi ko zindan mein sulane
mai jaa raha hoon
nana mai jaa raha hoon..
<<DIVIDER>>
jo mere baba ki laadli hai
jo ghar mein paidal nahi chali hai
usi behen ki rida lutane
mai jaa raha hoon
nana mai jaa raha hoon..

items.title: Pehre par zainab
items.body:
shaam e ghariban ghup andhiyara
aur pehre par zainab hai
khoon mein dooba jangal saara
aur pehre par zainab hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sehme sehme se bache hai
bewa'on ke godhi mein
dashte bala ki khaak bhari hai
kuch maa'on ki godhi mein
dil hai ghamon se paara paara
aur pehre par zainab hai
shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra ke is sannate mein
ek zainab kis kis ko sambhale
jalti zameen par sote hai
sab khoon mein ghaltan godh ke paale
koi nahi ghurbat mein sahara
aur pehre par zainab hai
shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
koh e masayab toot pada hai
gham se kaleje chaak huwe hai
charon taraf nazron mein dhuan hai
jal kar qaime khaak huwe hai
chup hai mareez e gham bechara
aur pehre par zainab hai
shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
charon taraf bikre hai janaze
aur is mein masoom sakina
bojhal bojhal si aankhein hai
dhoond rahi hai baap ka seena
rota hai darya ka kanara
aur pehre par zainab hai
shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
saani e zehra ko bas ye
ehsaas rulaaye jaata hai
hijr tumhara hai bhaiya
abbas rulaaye jaata hai
kaam to tha ye bhai tumhara
aur pehre par zainab hai
shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke laashon ko maqtal mein
aahein bharti jaati hai
is bechaini ke aalam mein
raat guzarti jaati hai
khoon rota hai subha ka taara
aur pehre par zainab hai
shaam e ghariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir o akhtar sab ki muhafiz
zainab tanha raat mein hai
jaanib e darya dekh rahi hai
toota naiza haath mein hai
khaak basar hai kunba saara
aur pehre par zainab hai
shaam e ghariban...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Aaja meri jaan
items.body:
zakhmi kaano pe haathon ko rakhe huwe
nikli qaimon se ek bacchi roti hui
uska kurta jala surkh ruqsaar tha
baba baba ki wo de rahi thi sada
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baba haye baba haye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
haye larza tha uske haathon mein
baap ko dhoondti thi laashon mein
jab wo baba ko dhoond na na paayi
ek laashe se ye sada aayi
<<DIVIDER>>
aaja meri jaan sakina tu kahan hai
tera baba yahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aise ghabra nahi meri bacchi
hai tera baba tere saath abhi
dhood laashon mein ek laash aisi
jiski ek ungli kati hai beti
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke sakina ne kaha baba un haathon se
tum ne jo tohfe mein mujhe laa kar diye thay
shimr wo gohar le gaya baba kahan ho
khoon mere kaano se baha baba kahan ho
aaja meri jaan sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ilayya ilayya bunayya sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
meri awaaz sun ke aaja idhar
ho chuka hai mera badan be sar
waar itne kiye gaye mujh par
aa chuki meri ragein baahar
<<DIVIDER>>
aate huwe maine suna keh raha tha koi
phupiyon ke shaano se meri gardan bandhegi
chota hai khad sab se mera baba kahan ho
hoga mera zakhmi gala baba kahan ho
aaja meri jaan sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise pehchanogi mujhe bolo
mil ke maara hai tere baba ko
ay meri jaan meri baat suno
sab se zakhmi badan talaash karo
<<DIVIDER>>
maar ke jab tumko layeen qaimon mein aaya
baal mere khaynche mujhe maara tamacha
zakhmi hua chehra mera baba kahan ho
itna mujhe maara gaya baba kahan ho
aaja meri jaan sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab se jaagi hai paas aa mere
aa rahi hogi beta neend tujhe
tu magar soyegi yahan kaise
mera seena bhara hai teeron se
<<DIVIDER>>
teer nikalungi mai khud nanhe haathon se
baba magar soungi mai seene pe tere
ran mein andhera hogaya baba kahan ho
seena kahan dhoondun tera baba kahan ho
aaja meri jaan sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehli manzil hai ye musibat ki
zulm sehna hai tujhko aur abhi
jo sunega tu hai meri beti
aur maarega tujhko ay bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki beti hoo usay jab ye bataya
jaan ke aalim ne mera daaman jalaya
cheen ke legaya rida baba kahan ho
deti rahi mai ye sada baba kahan ho
aaja meri jaan sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bhi pehchaan hai meri sun le
jab giraya gaya mujhe zeen se
yun to talwarein bhi chali mujhpe
sab se gehre hai zakhm naizon ke
<<DIVIDER>>
naize ka jab naam suna boli sakina
is tarha khooli ne mujhe nazie se maara
chehre ke bal gira diya baba kahan ho
yaad bahot aaye chacha baba kahan ho
aaja meri jaan sakina...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoonda zeeshan aur raza har soo
aayi jis waqt baap ki khusboo
poch kar nahe haath se aansu
pahunchi laashe pe ho ke be-qaabu
<<DIVIDER>>
gham jo sahe bhool gayi jab dekha manzar
ghodon se pamaal badan aur tha kata sar
phir na sakina ne kaha baba kahan ho
uth ke suno haal mera baba kahan ho
aaja meri jaan sakina...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Abbas abbas meri
items.body:
toote dilon ki aas ay mere maula abbas
abbas abbas meri madad ko aao na
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dunya sitam jab dhaati hai
ya koi musibat aati hai
bas tere alam ke panje par
ye meri nazar ruk jaati hai
abbas abbas har gham se chudao na
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai doob raha hoo ay maula
jeene ka nahi koi rasta
jab tum ko bulaata hai koi
tum us ko bachaate ho maula
abbas abbas mujhko bhi bachao na
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab karbobala ko jaate hai
aur dil ki muradein paate hai
ek mai hi tarasta hoo maula
kyun aap mujhe tadpaate hai
abbas abbas zawwar banao na
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khwab dikhaya hai tum ne
rauze pe bulaaya hai tum ne
rauze se lipat kar sochoonga
seene se lagaya hai tumne
abbas abbas seene se lagao na
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aat moharram aati hai
maa saqqa mujhe banwati hai
jis ghar mein haazri hoti hai
wahan teri sawari aati hai
abbas abbas mere ghar bhi to aao na
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
girton ko sahara dete ho
doobe to kinara dete ho
jab toot raha ho koi dil
tum hi to dilaasa dete ho
abbas abbas girta hoo uthao na
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki sada yaad aati hai
abbas sakina pyasi hai
dil tukde huwe jaata hai mera
wo sookhi zaban dikhlaati hai
abbas abbas usay pani pilao na
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai buka mesum mazhar
aata hai yaad wohi manzar
hal min ki sadayein dete huwe
shabbir ye kehte hai ro kar
abbas abbas meri madad ko...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Akbar teri laash
items.body:
akbar teri laash uthaye kaise hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
dil thaame huwe aur kham hai kamar
beenayi nahi aur zakhmi jigar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay beta zaeefi hai aisi
raasha hai badan mein baba ke
abbas nahi qasim bhi nahi
imdad ki khaatir kaun aaye
liye boj isi gham ka dil par
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadmo ki thakan ne maar diya
din bhar to uthaye hai laashe
sab zabt ke bandhan tooth gaye
beenayi gayi tere gham se
tanha hai sare maqtal ye padar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal teri soorat ki qasam
ab taab nahi hai is dil ko
mai boodha padar aur tum ho jawan
kya waqt pada itna socho
mai bekas o tanha aur muztar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein tujhe roti hai phupi
aur zeb e musalla hai maadar
athara baras paala hai tujhe
tu khud hi bata ay mere pisar
kya beet rahi hogi dil par
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein mere noore nazar
jeete ji mujhe tu maar gaya
naize ki tarha ye gham akbar
hum sab ke dilon se paar gaya
roti hai teri maa ye kehkar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hoo duwayein khaaliq se
qismat na kisi ko de ye gham
ho saamne bete ka laasha
aur baap kare uska maatam
sunle ye dua rabbe akbar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer kisi maadar ko bhi
ye gham na dobara dikhlaye
beta ho shabihe payghambar
maa jeeti rahe wo mar jaye
mar jayegi ro ro kar maadar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tere kaleje mein thi sina
hai zakhmi usi se dil mera
kis tarha sina wo khaynchi thi
mai tujhko nahi batla sakta
dil tukde huwe jaata hai pisar
akbar teri laash...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bain kiye sheh ne ban mein
mazhar wo bayan kar sakta nahi
seene pe pisar ke sar rakh kar
ye kehte rahe bas shaahe deen
ab zinda rahoo mai bhi kyun kar
akbar teri laash...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Asghar ki kya khata
items.body:
kehte thay shah bata de asghar ki kya khata thi
kyun hurmala hamare asghar ki kya khata thi
<<DIVIDER>>
batla tu ibne kaahil pathar hai kya tera dil
maara jo yun jafa se asghar ki kya khata thi
kehte thay shah bata de...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha rabab ne jo asghar ka jism khoon mein
maa ne kaha tadap ke asghar ki kya khata thi
kyun hurmala hamare asghar ki kya khata thi
kehte thay shah bata de...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki tashnagi par rota hai khud khuda bhi
tauheed ke dulaare asghar ki kya khata thi
kyun hurmala hamare asghar ki kya khata thi
kehte thay shah bata de...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah jo ghani hai uska hai ek ye mazhar
is beniyaz bande asghar ki kya khata thi
kyun hurmala hamare asghar ki kya khata thi
kehte thay shah bata de...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ka bachpana ab sota hai karbala mein
kaunain ke sahare asghar ki kya khata thi
kyun hurmala hamare asghar ki kya khata thi
kehte thay shah bata de...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se us jari ke darya hai khoon ka behta
kehta hai dil ko thaame asghar ki kya khata thi
kyun hurmala hamare asghar ki kya khata thi
kehte thay shah bata de...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaukat aqeel o nasir mehshar mein ye kahenge
ab poocho hurmala se asghar ki kya khata thi
kehte thay shah bata de...
items.author: Shaukath & Nasir Hussain

items.title: Ay mere tashnadahan
items.body:
tha ye bano ka bayan
ay mere tashna dahan
<<DIVIDER>>
tum pe waari ho ye maa
ay mere tashna dahan
<<DIVIDER>>
laash aayi na teri maidan se
reh gaye lab tere haye pyase
nanhi gardan pe chalaya paikaan
ay mere tashna dahan
tha ye bano ka bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera gehwara pada hai khaali
loriyan de ke sulaane waali
yaad mein teri tadapti hai ye maa
ay mere tashna dahan
tha ye bano ka bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak mein khud ko mila kar ye kaha
raakh jhoole ki uda kar ye kaha
aise bikhre na kisi ke armaan
ay mere tashna dahan
tha ye bano ka bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh mein tujhko humakna tha abhi
ghutniyo chal ke chehekna tha abhi
thi ye chaahat tujhe dekhun mai jawan
ay mere tashna dahan
tha ye bano ka bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise dekhun ay mere laal bata
nok e naiza pe tera sar beta
leke aada hai sar e raah rawan
ay mere tashna dahan
tha ye bano ka bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh sughra ne likha hai khat mein
mar na jaaye wo kahin furqat mein
wo ye kehti hai ke asghar ho kahan
ay mere tashna dahan
tha ye bano ka bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
apni bakshish ki dua karta hoon
mai hassan us se wafa karta hoon
kat gayi khushk jo nanhi si zaban
ay mere tashna dahan
tha ye bano ka bayan...
items.author: Hassan

items.title: Baade shabbir hai
items.body:
asre ashoor hai aap ke shaah ka
zere khanjar gala
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala karbala karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shabbir hai saani e khaafila
dasht mein berida
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm hadh se bada qaima qaima jala
sar chupaye kahan berida bibiyan
rota hai aasmaan
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
kya qayamat hai ye noke naiza pe hai
farse shaahe huda
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
muztarib hai behan khatm hai panjetan
aasman gir pada aa gaya zalzala
roti hai fatema
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
garm reti pa hai rab pa takiya kiye
aap ka laadla
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab wo anjaan thay sab musalman thay
sabr ki daastan kis tarha ho bayan
ruk rahi hai zaban
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
pani maanga kiye aur tadpa kiye
shaah e karbobala
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr e ashoor tha dushmano ke talay
saf se aage bade sheh ko ghayre rahe
teer o khanjar chale
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht ki khaak par jisme shabbir se
khoon behta raha
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm dekha kare kis se zainab kahe
dilbar e murtuza bhai shabbir ka
nehr par so raha
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
har taraf hai dhuan aap ka ghar jala
shola bhadka kiya
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi yawar nahi jal raha hai makaan
uth raha hai dhuan jaaye raandein kahan
hashr ka hai samaan
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hai bibiyan laasha abbas ka
nehr par hai pada
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki hai inteha roti hai karbala
haal e beemar par bibiyan nauhagar
naiza naiza hai sar
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
jaanib e shaam ab ek rasan mein bandha
jaata hai khaafila
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise mahir bayan gham ki ho daastan
berida hai haram sabki ankhein hai nam
gardane sabki kham
ya rasoole khuda ya rasoole khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
lab par zainab ke hai ay nabi e khuda
aaiye karbala
khuld se mustafa dekhiye to zara
manzar e karbala...
items.author: Mahir Lakhnavi

items.title: Bali sakina tanha
items.body:
jab qaid se aseer reha hogaye tamam
qabre sakina par gaye rote huwe imam
matam kuna saath mein ahle haram tamam
aahista aa rahi thi rabab e khadista kaam
choti si qabr saamne nazron ke phir gayi
ek aah sard khaynch ke marqad pa gir gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan se rehaai sadaat ko mili hai
bali sakina tanha zindan mein reh gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ke bain sun kar har bibi ro rahi hai
bali sakina tanha zindan mein reh gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi shamiyon se bano ghareeb ro ke
is ka khayal rakhna naazon ki ye pali hai
har shab diye jalana marqad pe teeragi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba chacha ko tarsi aah o buka ko tarsi
zindan mein ye yateema taaza hawa ko tarsi
baba ko rote rote bas thak ke so gayi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi roz ro kar ab to phupi chalo ghar
zindan mein mar na jaye shabbir ki ye dukhtar
ye yaad kar ke zainab sar apna peet'ti hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamsin ho bekhata ho aur qaid e jafa ho
daaghe yateemi logon jaise koi saza ho
bano ke dil se poocho kaisi ye bekasi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad par thay pehre zakhme jigar thay gehre
ta marg mit na paye taqdeer ke andhere
kis jurm ki saza hai bachi ko jo mili hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
is qaid se nikalo aaghosh mein chupalo
kehti thi zaalimo se baba mujhe bachalo
ye bain karte karte khamosh ho gayi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab ghar chalenge bhai payenge kab rehaai
abid se poochti thi sadmon ki wo satayi
wo mar chuki hai lekin faryad goonjti hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar ki chasme nam bhi rote hai ahle gham bhi
mazhar bhi likh ke roya khirtaas aur qalam bhi
kya gham ka marsiya tareekh ro padi hai
bali sakina tanha...
zindan se rehaai...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Betiyan aayi hai
items.body:
baap ki mayyat ki raunaq betiyon ke dam se hai
aa rahi hai zainab o kulsoom haye sar khule
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyan aayi hai mayyat ke sirhane ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
di sada kufe mein rooh e fatema ne ya ali
betiyan aayi hai mayyat ke sirhane ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm kufe mein kiya hai kaisa ahle shaam ne
umr bhar zainab na aayi thi padar ke saamne
aaj kaise aayi hai mayyat pe jaane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ke aalam mein ruqayya ki wafa to dekhiye
kis tarha wo zainab o kulsoom se aage badhe
laash par aayi nahi aansu bahane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar zainab ki haalat yaad aata hai mujhe
us ghadi ummul masayib mere baba kehte thay
jis ghadi di thi hamay zainab khuda ne ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya bataun kya guzarti hai tere abbas par
hausla kaise kare zainab ko rota dekh kar
ghar se baahar hai wo pehre ke bahane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teen din se shor hai har ek azaan par bain ka
kis tarha se gham batta'un boliye hasnain ka
mere bacche aur yateemi ke zamane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki mayyat pe kaise aayi hai ye dekhiye
jaate jaate beti ka lehja to sunt jaaiye
shaam jaana hai isay khutbe sunane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahun baba ka kaisa haal tha aflaak par
gir gayi thi mai baqayya mein tadap kar khaak par
aap ne choome thay jab ghazi ke shaane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ka saaya ho na baaqi baap hi zinda rahe
jaate jaate betiyon ko itna batla dijiye
kaise palthe hai bhala aise gharane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ki akbar hui hai har taraf yun inteha
karbala kufa najaf yasrab se aati hai sada
aaye ab ibe hassan inko basaane ya ali
betiyan aayi hai...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Chehlum manane bhai
items.body:
chehlum manane bhai zainab tumhari aayi
phir zulm ke shehr may deti hui duhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai wo mera akbar taskeen e jaane maadar
jangal may so raha hai barchi jigar pe kha kar
tasveer mustufa ki ummat ne hai mitayi
chehlum manane bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas uth ke dekho baazu pe kya nashan hai
deti rahi sadayein bhai mera kahan hai
rassi se jab sitamgar baandhe meri kalayi
chehlum manane bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aun na mohamed kaisi ye bebasi hai
koi nahi hai mera ab kya ye zindagi hai
sab yaad aa rahe hai veerani si hai chaayi
chehlum manane bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab qatl ho gaye jab abid pe zulm dhaaye
sar se ridayein cheeni qaime sabhi jalaye
jab zulm ke shehr may shaam e ghariban aayi
chehlum manane bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai mai shaam ke bhi bazaar may phiri hoo
bhai mai sar barehna darbar may gayi hoo
ahmed ki mai nawasi mai dar badar phirayi
chehlum manane bhai...

items.title: Dooba hua hussain
items.body:
dooba hua hussain ka laasha lahoo may hai
ya mustafa ke qalb ka tukda lahoo may hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun be-khata pe zulm kiya tu ne hurmula
nanha sa chand bano ka dooba lahoo may hai
dooba hua hussain ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e naamdaar ke baazu qalam huwe
pani may khoon hai mashk e sakina lahoo may hai
dooba hua hussain ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
fawarra khoon ka jaari hai akbar ke seene se
is waqt mustafa ka sarapa lahoo may hai
dooba hua hussain ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
farwa ye boli dekh ke qasim ki laash ko
hai chand sa ye dulha nahaya lahoo may hai
dooba hua hussain ka…
<<DIVIDER>>
aale nabi ke khoon se nahaya hai is tarha
har aslaha layeeno ka dooba lahoo may hai
dooba hua hussain ka…

items.title: Ibne al hassan
items.body:
ek beta hai hassan ek hai hussain
dono hai zehra ka dil ka chain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ka janaza teeron par aa gaya
ek ke janaze par teeron ki hai bauchaar
boli ye ro kar maa ay mere noor e ain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ka kafan haye sabz qabaa ka tha
ek ka kafan haye khaake karbala hua
noore chashme ahmed zehra ke dil ka chain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
girya zameen hui girya falak hua
gham mein shehzadon ke khoon roye mustufa
hai hashr ka samaa barpa hai shor o shain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
turbat e mujtaba teht e shams o qamar
laasha e shaahe deen aur jalti rayt par
haye re haye re ye ghurbat e sibtain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baade qaza teeron ka silsila
dono ki laashon ka manzar hai ek sa
ummat ne kab diya aale nabi ko chain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb e maula hassan tukdon mein bat gaya
qalb e shaahe zaman zakhmon se phat gaya
kehti rahi ye maa haye haye hasnain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
itrat pe royenge ye arz ye samaa
royegi ta-abad tum dono ko ye maa
ay meri jaan hassan ay meri jaan hussain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
<<DIVIDER>>
dayam e gul figaar kaise paaye qaraar
chashme yazdan lahoo roti hai zaar zaar
sunke sar e majlis ek dukhiya maa ke bain
ibne al hassan ibne al hussain
haye hassan waye hussain
pukari maa mere shahzaade
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Janabe umme laila
items.body:
aayi jawan laal ke marne ki jab khabar
maa royi dono haathon se dil apna thaam kar
moo peet'ti thi apna kabhi peet'ti thi sar
kehti thi lut gaya mera karbobala mein ghar
barchi ne tod daala jigar meri jaan ka
sehra na dekh paayi mai apne jawan ka
<<DIVIDER>>
janabe umme laila yehi padti thi nauha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
<<DIVIDER>>
meri nazron ke aage luti hai meri dunya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
<<DIVIDER>>
duayein kar ke athara baras jis laal ko paala
lahoo mein doob kar aaya hai wo kadiyal jawan mera
kahan se laaun himmat mai kaise dekhun laasha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi tha saahibe aulaad kya wo be-rehm qatil
nikaala jiski barchi ne mere kadiyal jawan ka dil
mere bacche ko pyasa layeen ne maar daala
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
sila tha maine khud apne pisar ke byaah ka joda
bahot nazdeek tha din mere shehzade ki shadi ka
kahan mujhko khabar thi lutegi meri dunya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
bada armaan tha akbar ki hogi jab teri shadi
bulaungi teri dulhan ko mai yasrab ki shehzadi
magar qismat mein meri wo din aane na paaya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi tha door wo din jab tamanna meri bar aati
bahot hi dhoom se baraat mere laal ki jaati
magar karbobala ne mere yusuf ko cheena
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
saron ko peet ke ahle haram karne lage matam
ali akbar ke laashe par kaha laila ne ye jis dam
lagaun kisko mehendi banaun kisko dulha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hasrat thi mai apne laal ki shadi racha leti
ali akbar ki dulhan ko kaleje se laga leti
kaleja maamta ka na hone paaya thandha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh kar umme laila peet'ti thi sar kabhi seena
nahi hai maut se kam ab ali akbar ke bin jeena
luti uski jawani jo meri zindagi tha
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ujde maadare akbar ki tarha koi maa waiz
na maara jaaye ghurbat mein kisi ka naujawan waiz
na tadpe ab jahan mein ye keh kar koi dukhiya
na dekha maine apne jawan bete ka sehra
janabe umme laila...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Karbobala may kaisa
items.body:
karbobala may kaisa ye manzar zainab ne dekha
sar bhai ka zer e khanjar zainab ne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhe mujahid ka laasha jab ran se laaye hussain
teer e sitam ka zakhm galay par zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may nahaye aun o mohamed qatl huwe abbas
lut'ta hua apna hi bhara ghar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne jigar par barchi khaayi gaysuon waale ne
khoon may dooba laasha e akbar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibne hassan ke laashe par daudaye gaye ghode
tukde hua jab qasim e muztar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ko rasool allah hamesha chooma karte thay
chalte huwe us halq pe khanjar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
boondhe cheene shimr e layeen ne kaan huwe zakhmi
lut'ta hua masooma ke gowhar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman us bachi ne najaf jab qaid may phailaya
kaise aaya godh may ek sar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
items.author: Ali Naqvi Najaf

items.title: Laashe pe kehti thi
items.body:
laashe pe kehti thi maa ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar ali akbar
laila ke dilbar ali akbar ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron ke bal aaye jab sajde mein shaahe umam
ran mein unka sar hua kund khanjar se qalam
lootne sadaat ko aagayi fauje sitam
sar jhukaye khaak par baithe hai ahle haram
ro raha hai aasman ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah ye sitam allah allah ye jafa
durre lagaye hamein cheenli sar se rida
karbala mein har taraf ek andhera cha gaya
zalzale mein hai zameen khoon ugalti hai faza
qaima qaima hai dhuan ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein bhai bekafan aur behan hai berida
reesmane zulm hai aur sakina ka gala
durron se bemaar pe karte hai zaalim jafa
nanhe nanhe bachon mein ek qayamat hai bapa
lut raha hai karwan ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ka hangaam wo subho ka manzar nahi
rounakhein sab lut gayi ab wo bhara ghar nahi
nasir o yawar nahi shere dilawar nahi
aun o mohamad nahi qasim o asghar nahi
tumne bhi khaayi sina ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ka ye armaan tha laaun mai teri dulhan
shaadi rachaun teri ay mere tashna dahan
tapti hui dasht mein lut gaya mera chaman
kaisi musibat hai ye kaisa ye ranj o mehan
kuch to kaho meri jaan ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak hoke rehgayi bachi ki har aarzu
ho rahi hai zulm ki justaju pe justaju
kabse hai jakda hua uska rassi mein gulu
beh raha hai ab talak uske kano se lahoo
yun chini hai baaliyan ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhte hi dekhte kaisa aaya inqilaab
lut gaya pardes mein mere bete ka shabab
mil gaya sab khaak mein husne risalat ma'aab
maa ki aankhon ke liye hogaya bas ek khwaab
tera sehra meri jaan ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr chidte hi tera aankhein ho jaati hai nam
padte hai nauha tera ahmed-o-mohsin baham
khatm tujhpe hogaye jitne thay zulm o sitam
tera gham aisa hai gham jiske aage saare gham
bhooli bisri daastan ay mere akbar jawan
ay mere akbar jawan
humshakle payambar ali akbar…
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Maare gaye hussain
items.body:
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ran may hai zer e khanjar zehra ka noor e ain
fizza ka hai ye nauha maare gaye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi badan hai saara pyasa lahoo lahoo hai
saydaniyo ka ran may ye bain char soo hai
rahwaar se gira hai ab fatema ka chain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shimr jis galay par khanjar chala raha hai
ye teen din ka pyasa farzande mustafa hai
zehra ka laal hai ye khaliq ki zeb o zain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos fatema ki sarkar lut gayi hai
pyasi sakina kab se awaaz de rahi hai
dukhiya ko tujhse chut kar aayega kaise chain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom bekafan ka laasha zameen par hai
tan khaak par pada hai noke sina pe sar hai
pamaal ho chuka hai ab laasha e hussain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu shikasta bibi kab tak sitam uthaye
koi nahi hai kisko wo haal e gham sunaye
ek laashe bekafan par karti rahi ye bain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre huwe zameen par laashe pade huwe hai
beparda bibiyan hai qaidi khade huwe hai
ahle haram ka ran may barpa hai shor o shain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar par ghashi hai bistar bhi jal chuka hai
abbas aao zainab balwe may berida hai
jalte huwe qayaam se utha ye shor o shain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar talak mohib ye matam rahega jaari
armaan e sayyeda hai girya ye aah o zaari
emaan farhse gham hai matam hai nasb o laiin
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
items.author: Mohib Fazli

items.title: Marhaba ya hussain
items.body:
karbala mein is tarha ghar tera loota gaya
baap se beta choota hogaya bhai juda
tune har ek gham saha ay saware mustufa
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr wo ayub ka qatm hua tha jahan
ibteda-e-sabr thi teri wo shaahe zaman
sabr tera marhaba dilbare mushkil kusha
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
deen ki taqdeer ko apne khoon se likh diya
raahe khuda-wand mein kar diya sab kuch fida
ambiya bhi arsh se keh rahe thay marhaba
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
thi teri sookhi ragay shimr ke khanjar talay
tune har ek gaam par shukr ke sajde kiye
teri wafadari pe thi ye khuda ki sada
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke baazu diye seena e akbar diya
nanha sa asghar diya apna bhara ghar diya
deen ka moshin hai tu jaane dil e fathima
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sar diya aur na diya haath mein zaalim ke haat
hurr ke muqadar ko bhi bakshi hai tune hayaat
tera wajaho hashm tera buland martaba
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sar to juda hogaya par na tera sar jhuka
noke sina pe hussain sar tera ooncha raha
sabr ke aagay tere zulm nahi chal saka
marhaba ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr shahe deen ka fatema ke laal ka
ahmed-o-hassan se bhi haq na ada ho saka
aap ke dam se bacha ambiya ka martaba
marhaba ya hussain
items.author: Zulfiqar Ahmed

items.title: Moharam ka chand
items.body:
ye hai hilaal e gham
ye gham ka chand hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle aza ye chand moharram ka chand hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle aza ye chand moharram ka chand hai
nikla gham e hussain ke mausam ka chand hai
ye fatema ke laal ke matam ka chand hai
farshe aza bichao bade gham ka chand hai
is chand mein ali ka dulaara hua shaheed
is chand mein rasool ka pyara hua shaheed
ahle aza ye chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar mein sajao parchame abbas e bawafa
aur uske paas laa ke rakho sheh ka taazia
padhte raho hussain ki ghurbat ka marsiya
tha jiska intezar wo din phir se aa gaya
purse ko shaahzadi e kaunain aayengi
farshe aza pe maadar e hasnain aayengi
ahle aza ye chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
nikla hai jab ye chand safar mein hussain thay
asghar ko leke godh mein shabbir ro pade
kehne lage ye chand mere laal dekh le
is chand mein na chodenge ahle jafa tujhe
maarenge aise teer se tujhko ye ahle shar
haiwan bhi larazte hai jo teer dekh kar
ahle aza ye chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ko galay se lagaya hussain ne
qasim ko apne pas bithaya hussain ne
akbar ko bhi khareeb bulaya hussain ne
phir gham ka chand sab ko dikhaya hussain ne
kehne lage qkhareeb hai ab arze karbala
har chand karbala mein mera doob jayega
ahle aza ye chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
monis na bach saka koi yawar na bach saka
qasim na bach sake ali akbar na bach saka
battees saal waala baradar na bach saka
hadh ho gayi ki nanha sa asghar na bach saka
is chand mein ujad gayi kheti rasool ki
is chand mein luti hai kamayi batool ki
ahle aza ye chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke baad bhi padti thi jab nazar
laila tadap ke roti thi ye chand dekh kar
shiddat se yaad aata tha kadiyal jawan pisar
seene ka zakhm aur wo farzand ka jigar
kehti thi mera chand to mitti mein mil gaya
ay chand baar baar mere saamne na aa
ahle aza ye chand...
<<DIVIDER>>
waiz hilaale maahe moharram ko dekh kar
seene mein kaamp jaata hai aksar mera jigar
rota hai dil hussain ki ghurbat ko soch kar
jaati hai meri fikr sakina ke dard par
is chand mein hussain ki pyari hui yateem
seene pe sone waali dulaari hui yateem
ahle aza ye chand...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Aajao ab aajao
items.body:
aajao ab aajao ab aajao sakina
bano ki sada thi ke na tadpao sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
ab mujh se judaai ka alam uth na sakega
yun rooth ke maadar se na tum jao sakina
aajao ab aajao…
<<DIVIDER>>
phir pyar se maa kehke pukaro meri dilbar
amma ko na is tarha se tadpao sakina
aajao ab aajao…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki judaai ali akbar ki judaai
kaafi hai na tum bhi mujhe rulwao sakina
aajao ab aajao…
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se lahoo behta hai ruqsaar hai neele
ye shakl na abbas ko dikhlao sakina
aajao ab aajao…
<<DIVIDER>>
lipta ke kaleje se duayein meri kehna
ek nanhi si turbat jo kahin pao sakina
aajao ab aajao…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya mujhse khata hogayi kyun rooth gayi ho
is ghamzada madar ko ye batlao sakina
aajao ab aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sach hai bahot qaid mein dukh tumne uthaye
so baap aagosh mein sojao sakina
aajao ab aajao...

items.title: Abbas alam tera
items.body:
shabbir ka paigham sunate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera uthate hi rahenge
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe chidhi mashk kate baazu e abbas
seena dhuan dhuan tha sakina ki thi wo pyaas
tooti kamar hussain ki behne hui be-aas
chin jayegi ab sar se rida hogaya ehsaas
rudaad tishnagi ki sunate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladte hue darya pe gaye aun-o-mohamed
bhari thay hazaron ke liye aun-o-mohamed
takeed maa ki yaad rakhe aun-o-mohamed
pani na piye qatl huwe aun-o-mohamed
jo zulm huwe inpe batate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal ran mein hogaya jis dam hassan ka laal
is gham ka qalbe shaah pe kyunkar na ho malaal
kehti thi umme farwa ke ay rabbe zuljalaal
ek raat ke dulhe ki hui laash payemaal
shab ki dulhan ka haal sunate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi lagi akbar ko tadapne lage shabbir
pahunche jawan ki laash pe jab sarware dilgeer
zainab ki thi sada ke miti nana ki tasveer
kehti thi karbala mein meri lutgayi jageer
laila pe jo guzri wo sunate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
haaton pe sheh ke chid gaya masoom ka gala
roye tadap ke arz o samaa aaya zalzala
zehra-o-mustafa ne lehad se ye di sada
bacha wo cheh mahine ka wo teere hurmala
guzri jo bezaban pe sunate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab qatl hue koi na tha sheh ka madadgaar
jab khushk gala kaat chuka shimre bad-atwaar
naize ki ani par tha sare sayyade abraar
paighambar o zehra o ali thay jigar afkaar
tasveer karbala ki dikhate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui reti pe pada laasha e besar
qaime haram ke jal gaye aur chin gayi chadar
uth'te huwe sholo mein tha bemaar ka bistar
kurta bhi sakina ka jala chin gaye gohar
guzri jo yateemo pe sunate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun lutgaya ghurbat mein mohamed ka gharana
rota hai jise sunke abhi tak ye zamana
kyunkar na bober likhe karbal ka fasana
milta hai najaf se usay lafzon ka khazana
gham aale payambar ka manate hi rahenge
abbas alam tera...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Abhi khanjar na chala
items.body:
jab giray ghode se maqtal mein shahe karbobala
khanjare zulm liye shimre sitamgaar badha
di tadap kar dar e qaime se ye zainab ne sada
abhi khanjar na chala abhi khanjar na chala
zaalim abhi khajar na chala
<<DIVIDER>>
loot mat behre khuda fatema zehra ka chayn
aur kuch dayr teher ja arey zaalim ke hussain
bakshishe ummate jad ki abhi karte hai dua
abhi khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
teen din hogaye pyasa hai nabi ka jaani
zibha karna hai to do ghoont pilade pani
kund khanjar hai mere bhai ka sookha hai gala
abhi khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
bosagaahe nabawi hai ye gala ay zaalim
sheh ragay deen pe khanjar na chala ay zaalim
choomte thay isi halqoom ko mahboob e khuda
abhi khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
chod kar khuld zara faatahe khyber aa le
aur kuch dayr teher ja ke payambar aa le
aati hi hogi wo aa lene de amma ko zara
abhi khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya karoo ja'un kahan kis ko pukarun bhai
kaise dekhegi tumhe todte dam majaayi
ya ilaahi mujhe shabbir se pehle le utha
abhi khanjar na chala...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye kis dil se karoo tazkira e jor o jafa
kat gaya saamne zainab ke shahe deen ka gala
cheekhti reh gayi zainab sare maqtal ba khuda
abhi khanjar na chala...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Asghar ki saari umr
items.body:
asghar ki saari umr safar mein guzar gayi
tareekiyon mein haq ki ziya jis se bhar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ke har iraade ko barbaad kar diya
islam ke wujood ko azaad kar diya
itni si jaan utna bada kaam kar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab se karwan chala nilki sawariyan
gehwara pushte naaqa bana ghar maraiyan
raahe safar mein din gaya shaam o sehar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaghosh mein ajal ki wo aaya hayaat se
has has ke khelta raha baysheer maut se
aakhir jaza tabassum e asghar pe mar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhi zaban pheri labon par sagheer ne
pyase galay to tar kiya zaalim ke teer ne
nanhi si jaan maut ko hairaan kar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaa kar galay pe teer bhi jaari raha safar
baba ke saath saath ye maujood tha udhar
ho kar aseer baali sakina jidhar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar ye dekh dekh ke rota raha falak
karbobala se kufa to kufe se shaam tak
bhai ke saath saath behan nange sar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa se bichad ke chain na aaya sagheer ko
har gaam karta jaata tha maa ko talaash wo
naize pe dhoondta tha ke amma kidhar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe sar sagheer ka dekha rabab ne
mamta balayein lene lagi izteraab mein
chehre pe apne laal ke jab jab nazar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ke baad karti thi faryaad ek maa
saansein to chal rahi hai magar zindagi kahan
beta tumhare saath ye maadar bhi mar gayi
asghar ki saari umr...
items.author: Ali Rizvi Sachey

items.title: Ay meri jaan akbar
items.body:
jab ran ko chale qaime se hamshakle payambar

items.body:

sughra ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab tak mai bahaungi yaadon mein yuhin aansu
tanhaai mein baradar aajao ali akbar
aajao ali akbar
sughra ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwahar ye tumhari ab jaye to kahan jaye
aaram nahi pal bhar aajao ali akbar
aajao ali akbar
sughra ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasta mai tumhara yun dekhungi bhala kab tak
aajao ali akbar aajao ali akbar
aajao ali akbar
sughra ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashkon ki jagah khoon ab aankhon se tapakta hai
palkein hai lahoo mein tar aajao ali akbar
aajao ali akbar
sughra ne kaha rokar....
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi najaf rokar aajao mere bhaiya
ho jaye munavar ghar aajao ali akbar
aajao ali akbar
sughra ne kaha rokar...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Akbar tu kahan hai
items.body:
kehti hai sahar gham ki akbar tu kahan hai
sajde bhi hai afsurda betaab azaan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaadi ka teri waqt hai ya waqt e shahadat
sehra hai duaon ka aur maa ki zaban hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladiyan tere sehre ki choome tere seene ko
afsos magar tere seene may sina hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur iske siwa kya hai islam ka daaman may
ek sajda hai ek zarbat aur ek azaan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai pyaas ke aalam may akbar ko ajal aayi
aur saamne aankhon ke darya bhi rawan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan ye kehti thi maadar ali akbar ki
kya darr hai layeeno ka mera laal jawan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Ay musa e kazim
items.body:
ay musa e kazim ay mere baab e hawaij
mohtaaj e dua hoo mai tere dar ka gada hoo
mai risq e aza risq e wafa maang raha hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ghair ke dar ka to sawali nahi maula
maulayi hoo aur zarf se khaali nahi maula
pehle bhi to mai aap ke tukdo pe pala hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
neymat ghame shabbir ki naslon se na jaaye
baitha hoo tere dar pe msi daaman pe bichaye
maana hoo gunehgaar magar ahle aza hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aap ke nabiyon ke madadgaar hai maula
mansab wohi allah ne hai aap ko baksha
mai aap ke rauze ko najaf jaan raha hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqrooz hoo nadaar hoo bemaar o pareshan
hai aap maseeha e jahan waaris e quran
tukda tere khaane se bacha maang raha hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo godiyan aulaad ki neymat se hai khaali
pakde huwe wo aap ke rauze ki hai jaali
mai bhi kisi kone may yahin mehwe dua hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay baab e ata waasta zainab ki rida ka
matam se jo chadar ka diya karti hai pursa
un behno ke parde ki baqa maang raha hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch aisi kaneezein bhi hai sarkar tumhari
bachpan se sare farsh e aza umr guzaari
ghar unke base unke areeze ki nawa hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ka azadar namazi bhi bada ho
aaqa tere rauze pe ye maqbool dua ho
ye arz liye aap ki chaukat pe khada hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
baghdad may jo zulm o sitam aap pe guzre
wo soch ke maula mere aansu nahi rukte
us gham se sabab aaj bhi mai mehve buka hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeeron may jakda hua taboot rakha tha
mazdooron ne maula tere laashe ko uthaya
purse ke liye shehr e khurasan gaya hoo
ay musa e kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai musa e kazim ka azadar hoo rehaan
mashad may chalo pursa kuna is tarha rizwan
khud maula raza kehde tumhe deta dua hoo
ay musa e kazim...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Baade sheh zainabe
items.body:
baade sheh zainabe dilgeer ne kya kya dekha
sumein aspo ke talay bhai ka laasha dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
haq paraston ka wafadaron ka aur pyaron ka
sar ko naize pe jasad khaak pe bikhra dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaadare cheen ke kuffaro ne loota ghar ko
sar barehna shahe laulaak ka kunba dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne cheene gohar moo pe tamache maare
khoon kaano se sakina ke tapakta dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek rasan mein kiya paband bade choton ko
tauq o zanjeer mein bemaar ko jakda dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh se maa'on ki daurane rahe kufa o shaam
jo bhi bacha gira naaqe se kuchalta dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye jis shehr mein shehzadi kahi jaati thi
khud ko is koofe mein be-makna o chaadar dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein margayi ghut ghut ke sakina aakhir
markhad ek chota sa zindan mein banta dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye shabbir ne aur zainab o kubra ne anees
waqt ke saath zamane ko badalta dekha
baade sheh zainabe...
items.author: Anees

items.title: Bana ke turbate
items.body:
bana ke turbate asghar hussain rote hai
dil e rubab chupa kar hussain rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar shikasta hai kaise uthayenge laasha
utho utho ali akbar hussain rote hai
bana ke turbate asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tar aansuon se hai daadi pisar ki mayyat par
khat apni beti ka pad kar hussain rote hai
bana ke turbate asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada jo parde mein atthara bhaiyon ke rahi
wohi behen hai khule sar hussain rote hai
bana ke turbate asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ki aal tarasti hai boond pani ko
jhukaye sar lab e kausar hussain rote hai
bana ke turbate asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tamache maar raha hai koi sakina ko
jabhi to nok e sina par hussain rote hai
bana ke turbate asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
takallum aaj bhi zindan e shaam mein jaa kar
kisi lehed se lipat kar hussain rote hai
bana ke turbate asghar...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Betiyan to sab ko
items.body:
zindan e shaam mein wo qayamat ka waqt tha
saumpa gaya sakina ko jab sar hussain ka
baba ke zakhmi chehre se khoon saaf jab kiya
baalon se khaak jhaad ke beti ne ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
tum to kehte thay sakina
tum bin mera dil nahi lagta
phir kyun itni dayr ki aane mein tumne baba
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyan to sab ko pyari hoti hai na baba
dekho mujhko shaam ke logon ne kitna maara
<<DIVIDER>>
aap thay jab tak saath ay baba ye beti shehzadi thi
naaz uthaate thay sab mere sab ki pyari beti thi
haath chacha rakhte thay zameen par ghar mein jab mai chalti thi
mujhko sahara dene sab uth jaate thay jab girti thi
lekin ye masoom sakina jab giri naaqe se baba
mujhe sahara kyun dene koi bhi na aaya baba
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare ammu chod gaye thay pani ko mai tarsi thi
bas ye mai hi jaanti hoon bazaar mein kaise chalti thi
shimr tamache maarta tha jab bhi thak kar mai rukti thi
mujhko ye bhi yaad nahi tha ke mai kab se pyasi thi
apni betiyon ko ye shaami la la kar dete thay pani
jab mai pani maangti thi khaati thi kyun durra
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
choom ke baba ka zakhmi sar beti boli ay baba
kuch din pehle qaid mein mujhse milne aayi thi ramla
mere gohar pehni thi mujhko us baat ka gham na tha
mai ye soch ke rone lagi jab dekha ramla ka chehra
zaalim ne darbar mein baba mujhe kaneezi mein jab maanga
us ke ghar mein bhi to ek beti hai kyun na socha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba aap ka qaatil mere saamne jab bhi aata tha
aap ka jis pe khoon laga tha wo khanjar lehrata tha
baandh ke mujhko rassi se rahwaar wo jab daudata tha
nok e sina se mere chacha abbas ka sar gir jaata tha
naize par us waqt ay baba aap ko maine rote dekha
zaalim ne jab raah mein baalon se mujhe khayncha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag lagi thi daaman mein aur haath tha zakhmi kaano par
shaam e ghariban mein jab tumko dhoonde nikli mai baahar
baba maine dekha tha apni aankhon se wo manzar
dada ko awaaz phupi zainab ne jab di ro ro kar
beti ki awaaz pe haye dada ali to milne aaye
lekin mera haal kyun tumne na aa kar poocha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain pukara beti yaad karo na wo manzar
baba baba kehte huwe jab girti thi tum laashon par
maine hi to paas bulaya tha shehzadi ye keh kar
soja meri bacchi zakhmi seene pe tu sar rakh ke
be-sar tha beti ye baba paas tumhare kaise aata
tum ne jab awaaz de kar bola tha ay baba
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti baba se boli ab chod ke mujhko mat jaana
kab tak hai meri qismat mein zaalim ke durre khaana
tum bhaiya sajjad se keh do mujhko yahin par dafnana
baap se baatein karte karte aakhri hichki ka aana
ay zeeshan o raza ro ro kar baba ke moo pe moo rakh kar
baali sakina ne bas ye kehte huwe dam toda
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Dua deti hai zehra
items.body:
hum farsh bichate hai dua deti hai zehra
shabbir pe rone ka sila deti hai zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
har saal tabarruk mein kami yun nahi hoti
majlis mein mera haath bataa deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai roshni karta hoo azakhano mein jaa kar
turbat pe diya maa ki jala deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phailaate hai jo haath tabarruk ki safon mein
un logon ko hissay mein ana deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko jab tak na uthe taaziya sheh ka
maayein kahan bachon ko ghiza deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch hota nahi is liye zanjeer zano ko
sajjad ke sadqe mein shifa deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rumaal jo tar hota hai ashkon se hamare
wo shaah ke zakhmo pe laga deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bolay bahattar ke janazon pe ye ro kar
jeet raho tum sab ko dua deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
padti hai nazar zakhmon pe jab binte ali ke
shabbir ke zakhmon ko bhula deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ye gham aise kahan milta hai sab ko
khush ho to gham e shaah dila deti hai zehra
hum farsh bichate hai...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Gham dil pe uthaye
items.body:
haye zahra haye darbar
<<DIVIDER>>
gham dil pe uthaye binte nabi darbar se wapas jaati hai
lab par hai fughan us bibi ke kaunain ki tu shehzadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar e sitam mein ahle sitam haste thay meri haalat par
hasnain ke baba se ro kar shehzadi ye farmati hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq lene gayi thi jo apna athara baras ki bibi thi
kya uspe jafayein guzri jo baalon pe safedi chaayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein us pe kya guzri kya ahle sitam ne zulm kiye
baba ki lehad pe shehzadi sab haal sunaane aayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu pe giraya darwaza mohsin ka diya gham bibi ko
ummat se nabi ki shehzadi ye ajre risalat paati hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chaak gareban saare nabi aur sher e khuda hai khaak basar
ye kis ka janaza utha hai ye kaisi qayamat aayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunain ke waali ke ghar se rone ki sadayein aati hai
khaak udti hai har ek taraf har simt udaasi chaayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah gawahi deta hai jis bibi ki sachayi ki
afsos ghulamon ne ashtar uski hi sanad jhutlayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
items.author: Abbas Jarchvi

items.title: Hurr ki aisi na kisi
items.body:
hurr ki aisi na kisi aur ko taqdeer mili
jis ko dozakh ke ewaz khuld ki jageer mili
hurr ki aisi na kisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
panjetan kar gaye saabit jo amal se apne
us se behtar koi quran ki na tafseer mili
hurr ki aisi na kisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
teer kyun maar diya bache ko zaalim tu ne
hurmala kaun si baysheer ki taqseer mili
hurr ki aisi na kisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe chadar nahi phir bhi wo nahi nange sar
jinko parde ke liye chadar e tatheer mili
hurr ki aisi na kisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
koi ek baar madine msy na pehchan saka
qaid se choot ke jab zainab e dilgeer mili
hurr ki aisi na kisi…
<<DIVIDER>>
sab mile choot ke zindan se sakina ke siwa
haan magar fatema sughra se na hamsheer mili
hurr ki aisi na kisi…

items.title: Khuda hafiz
items.body:
hussain khusta e tayghe jafa khuda hafiz
tamaam hoti hai fasle aza khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
dasegi hum ko hamare gharon ki veerani
sajega kal se na ye taaziya khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunenge marsiye ab kis se sab azakhane
bhala ye kaise kahe fatema khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
wida hote hai abbas badh raha hai alam
hussainiyo kaho ay bawafa khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh baithe hai maaon ki godh mein bacche
kahe wo jhoole se kaise bhala khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan bahaar chadhati thi phool sehre ke
hai aansuon se bhari wo qaba khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar se hota hai ojhal amariyon ka juloos
nigahein choomti hai nakshe paa khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam e wida aaye sughra se pooche le koi
hai ek fikra ke ek marsiya khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jigar hilaane lage phir hussain ke jumle
behan ye bhai bhi marne chala khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan sakina ko aayi thi aakhiri hichki
wahin pe ab ye sada hai chacha khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kaise kahan hoga aap ne zainab
madine jaati hoo ay karbala khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada bhi aamir o nayyar ka saath chod na de
ke in labon se ho kaise ada khuda hafiz
hussain khusta e tayghe...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Laashe pe naujawan
items.body:
laash akbar ki jo maqtal se utha laaye hussain
ek kohraam tha qaime mein jo maula ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe pe naujawan ke chadar udhao zainab
akbar ka zakhmi seena maa se chupao zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
beenayi bhi nahi hai khat kis tarha padhunga
mai us se kya kahunga
qasid hai aane waala is ko jagao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka gham uthana aasaan nahi hai bibi
jee bhar ke ro le wo bhi
qaime mein naujawan ki behnein bulao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar lo behan tasavvur armaan kuch to niklein
hum sehra pad rahe hai
tum apne naujawan ko dulha banao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kurta lahoo mein tar hai mil jayega kafan bhi
khwahish bhi hogi poori
akbar ki shadi waali poshak lao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad isi tarha se dil ko qaraar aaye
beenayi laut jaaye
aankhon se naujawan ka kurta lagao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse zyada tum se nazdeek ye raha hai
tum ko to sab pata hai
akbar ke bachpane ki baatein sunao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ka haal ajab hai jab se khabar hai aayi
deta nahi dikhayi
baazu pakad ke maa ka laashe pe lao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha liye takallum qaime se sheh jo nikle
ro kar behan se bole
rukhsat yahin se kar do baahir na aao zainab
laashe pe naujawan ke...
items.author: Mir Takallum

items.title: Mera hussain shariyat
items.body:
dono jahan roshan huwe ahmed ke noor se
<<DIVIDER>>
mera hussain shariat ki roshnayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeed jabr ki aaghosh ka parwanda hai
hussain haq o sadaqat ki rahnumayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
usi ki zaat se kayenat mein ujaala hai
bajuz hussain ke tareekiyon se aayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bajuz bashar ke malayek falak abar roye
ali ke laal ko royi ye kul khudayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ataa ke baad ye hurr ne kaha ke ay maula
hussain teri tabiyat mein kibriyayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek baat yaqeen se mai keh raha hoon ameer
ali wali ke malango mein be-riyayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Nana suno
items.body:
aayi jo chut ke qaid se zehra ki laadli
aakar mazaar e ahmade mukhtar par giri
baalon ke rang se hi zaeefi thi aashkaar
kehti rahi ghamon ki satayi ye baar baar
<<DIVIDER>>
nana suno sunaungi maqtal ki dastan
qabre nabi pe zainabe muztar ka tha bayan
<<DIVIDER>>
nana mai kuch hi door khadi dekhti rahi
sukhe galay pe bhai ke chalti rahi churi
naiza layeen dikha ke daraate thay nana jaan
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jite jee le na paayi wo ek saans chain ki
nana yateem ho gayi beti hussain ki
hadh to ye hai ke cheeni gayi uski baaliyan
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana suno wo chota sa baccha hussain ka
ghutno ke bal bhi chalne ke qabil nahi raha
pyasa hi haye mar gaya le le ke siskiyan
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana hamare aun o mohamed nahi rahe
nusrat mein shaahe waala ki dono hi mar gaye
toota hua hai dil pe masayeb ka aasman
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
paala tha jisko naazon se athara saal tak
nana lahoo mein doob gaye uske baal tak
seene mein aise maari thi zaalim ne barchiyan
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ke siwa koi mardon mein tha nahi
behre madad bulaati kise khwahare hazeen
abbas e bawafa bhi nigahon se tha nehan
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana suno wo shaam e ghariban ki dastan
har simat dikh raha tha nigahon ko bas dhuan
bikhraye baal khaak pe baithi thi bibiyan
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek kar ke saare jalaye gaye qayaam
us mein pada hua tha mera waqt ka imam
bekas yateem e abid e bemaar e natawan
nana suno sunaungi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre nabi laraz gayi zainab ke sun ke bain
kaise milega aamir o farhan dil ko chain
lagta hai dil mein toot gayi dard ki sina
nana suno sunaungi...
items.author: Farhan Banarasi

items.title: Abbas alamdar
items.body:
kehti hai wafadari virsa hai alamdari
bedast hai phir bhi hai alamdar alamdar
hai abbas alamdar abbas alamdar
saqi abbas alamdar abbas alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e sakina hai mashkeeza batata hai
bhatke huwe logon ko manzil se milata hai
matam ke julooson may aage nazar aata hai
hai tera alam khaafila salaar alamdar
abbas alamdar…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ye tujhse hai izhare wafadari
pani ki sabeelein ye majlis ye azadari
tere kate shano ka sadqa hai mere ghazi
naukar hai tere saare azadar alamdar
abbas alamdar…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisi qayamat hai aulade payambar par
be-gor o kafan laashe seydaniya be-chadar
har bibi ye kehti hai dekho to zara aa kar
jaate hai haram shaam ke bazaar alamdar
abbas alamdar…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ka girna tha jalti hui reti par
sarwar ki kamar tooti zainab ki giri chadar
laashe pe nabi zaadi deti thi sada ro kar
maara gaya pyason ka madadgaar alamdar
abbas alamdar…
<<DIVIDER>>
yawar ye hakeekat hai masoom batate hai
maula ki ziyarat ko jo khaafile aate hai
jab karbobala ke wo nazdeek pahunchte hai
lene ke liye aate hai har baar alamdar
abbas alamdar…
items.author: Yawar Abbas

items.title: Abhi na maidan mein
items.body:
suye maidan na abhi chod ke jao mujhko
is tarha jaane padar door meri aankhon se
saath le jayegi ye teri judaai aakhir
ay mere tashna dahan noor meri aankhon se
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi na maidan mein jao akbar
ke laal zahra ka mar na jaye
idhar tumhari baraat nikle
udhar ye jaan se guzar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaeef baba jawan bete
ke baad jee kar bhi kya karega
raha na aankhon ka noor baakhi
to deeda e tar bhi kya karega
tumhare dam se jo saans baba
ka chal raha hai teher na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari furqat garan hai dil pe
andhera aankhon pe cha raha hai
tumhari ruqsat ke waqt dil ko
khayaal payham ye kha raha hai
tumhare marne se bibiyon ke
saron se chadar utar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari sughra ko khat mein baba
tasalli kaise bhala wo dega
batao itna to jaate jaate
jawab qasid ko kya wo dega
tumhare waade pe jo hai zinda
wo sughra bemaar mar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari shaadi ka jashn karne
kahan kahan se hai aaye zaalim
tumhe lagane lahoo ki mehendi
hai barchiyon ko sajaye zaalim
tumhare nazuk badan mein koi
sitam ki barchi utar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabih e ahmed ho tum ay akbar
tumhare dam se hi raahatein hai
tumhare sehre ki paak ladiyan
tamaam quran ki aayatein hai
ye gham hai humko zameen pe beta
tumhara sehra bikhar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ghash khaake gir pade hai
baraat akbar ki jaa rahi hai
samajh ke dulha shabih e ahmed
pe phool ummat gira rahi hai
ab aur natiq na likhna aage
ke phat hamara jigar na jaye
abhi na maidan...
