items.author: Natiq, Sarwar & Mazhar

items.title: Allah ki riza hai
items.body:
allah ki riza hai mohabbat hussain ki
poocho rasool-e-paak se azmat hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh hai gawah ke kufre yazeed se
islam ko bachagayi daulat hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya kinare laasha e abbas dekh kar
ahle aza na poochiye haalat hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran se jawan bete ka laasha uthate hai
sab se badi yehi hai musibat hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam toot'ta tha uska jo ankhon ka noor tha
jaati na kaise ran may basarat hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ali ki peet ke sar apna reh gayi
dashte bala may dekh ke haalat hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ubhrenge har zamane may kuch waqt ke yazeed
har daur ko rahegi zaroorat hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har majlise hussain may aati hai fatema
jabse hui hai ran may shahadat hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar ka khuaf unko hai humko nahi ghulam
humko naseeb hogi shifa'at hussain ki
allah ki riza hai...
items.author: Ghulam Abbas

items.title: Asghar mere asghar
items.body:
maa karti thi ye naale karbala ke biyaban mein
asghar mere asghar jaani asghar mere asghar jaani
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ne kiya wo zulm haathon pe shahe deen ke
dam tod diya asghar karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hook uthi dil mein dekha jo suye maqtal
rote hai khade sarwar karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer ki mayyat ko daaman mein chipa laaye
maa dekhti hai manzar karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
is nanhi si mayyat par thay bain sakina ke
dunya se gaya asghar karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu maa ka dulaara hai kunbe ka tu pyara hai
rote hai sabhi tujh par karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
din raat nigahon mein phirti hai teri surat
mar jaungi mai muztar karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer teri furqat kis tarha gawara ho
kya dil hai mera pathar karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
be ghusl o kafan asghar turbat jo bani teri
aankhon mein hai wo manzar karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai pe haste thay shabbir ke jo zaalim
sab mit chuke hai saabir karbal ke biyaban mein
maa karti thi ye naale...

items.title: Ay musalman aaj
items.body:
tera hussain mera hussain
rab ka hussain sab ka hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay musalman aaj bhi ye poochti hai karbala
kis jurm mein mustafa ke ghar ko hai loota gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin e insaniyat ke qatl ke fauran hi baad
chin gayi makhdooma e kaunain ke sar se rida
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se shaam tak zainab ko chadar na mili
kya yehi ajre risalat tu ne sarwar ko diya
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya dikhayega mohamed ko wo chehra hashr mein
mustafa ki betiyon ko jis ne hai ruswa kiya
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaz karta hai khuda bhi tere sajde pe hussain
teeron ke saaye mein tu ne jo kiya sajda ada
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar tujhe bhi chahiye khushnodi e zahra to sun
saani e zahra ke gham mein tu bhi to aansu baha
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar nahi sakta hamay mehroom shaahe gham se tu
farsh pe matam bapa hai arsh pe aah o buka
ay musalman aaj bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hum shabbir ka matam nahi karte ameer
karte hai matam malayik ro rahe hai ambiya
ay musalman aaj bhi...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Baaghe shabbar ke
items.body:
baaghe shabbar ke mehekte huwe armaan qasim
ye teri laash ke tukde biyaban qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi guzri bhi na thi tera baharein tujh par
haye kya jald hua maut ka samaa qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna lab dulha dulhan aur baraati pyase
haye kaisa teri shadi ka hai saaman qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein chalti hui wo zulm o sitam ki aandhi
maa ke seene se wo uth'ta hua toofan qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho ke ruqsat jo chale ran ko to boli kubra
jaaiye aap ka allah nigehban qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar haal tere jism ki pamaali ka
chaak karti hai ajal apna gareban qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein bikhre huwe ye tere badan ke tukde
khoon mein tar ye teri zulfein pareshan qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jamma karte hai teri laash ke tukde ran mein
thaam kar apna jigar shaahe shaheedan qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pe kubra ke jo guzri hai khuda hi jaane
laash jab laaye teri sarwar e zeeshan qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran ki khamosh fazayein hai tera laasha hai
bain kubra ke hai aur shaam ka zindan qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauhakhwan bazme aza mein hai vaqar e ghamgeen
hai tasavvar mein magar shaam ka zindan qasim
baaghe shabbar ke...
items.author: Viqar Nagri

items.title: Betiyon ke saamne
items.body:
ghar hua veeran hogaye hum yateem
baba baba baba
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyon ke saamne utha janaza baap ka
paara paara kar gaya dil haye sadma baap ka
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon mein dard o gham ka bhi safar dekhe koi
jaa ke un bachon ke dil ki kaifiyat pooche koi
jin ke sar se haye uth jaata hai saaya baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
odh ke chadar kafan ki zer e turbat soyenge
baap ko de kar sada ghurbat mein bache royenge
farsh e matam ghar mein ab bichta rahega baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se poshak tar thi aur chehra zard tha
sar pe gehra zakhm tha bechain thay shere khuda
betiyon ne kis tarha dekha tadapna baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki tooti phasliyon ka gham abhi bhoole na thay
baap ke saaye se bhi mehroom bache hogaye
ab na mil payega kufe mein sahara baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab judaai ki churi chalti rahegi qalb par
yaad mein royenge bache soona hujra dekh kar
ghar mein ab mumkin nahi phir se palatna baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se aansu rawan hai dil pa sadma hai bada
saaf karti hai lahoo chadar se zainab zakhm ka
khoon mein dooba hua hai aaj chehra baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm ye aisa hai mumkin jiska marham hi nahi
baap ki furqat ke gham jaisa koi gham hi nahi
umr bhar kaano mein ab goonjega lehja baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak uda kar aankhon se khoon e jigar barsayegi
haye baba keh ke zainab khaak par gir jayegi
khoon bhara jab jab bhi dekhegi amaama baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
<<DIVIDER>>
kam nahi hota hai ay rehan kuch ranj o malaal
zindagi bhar dard rehta hai bichadne ka hilal
hota hai bachon ke dil par aisa sadma baap ka
betiyon ke saamne...
items.author: Hilal Rizvi

items.title: Chin gayi chadar
items.body:
chin gayi chadar meri aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
kehti thi binte ali aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban mein jafa hogayi ghazi
roti rahi hyder e kararar ki beti
ahle jafa qaime jalaate rahe ghazi
aake na ghurbat mein kisi be bhi madad ki
badti rahi bekasi aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ki ghadi kaisi ye kismat ne dikhayi
dasht mein deti thi behan gham se duhayi
ghurbat e shabbir pr roti thi khudayi
laash zayeefi me jab akbar ki uthayi
gir pade sibte nabi aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
aale payambar ki buka goonji faza mein
shor khushi ka tha bahot ahle jafa mein
aur izaafa hua zehra ki aza mein
sookha gala sheh ka kata karbobala mein
chalti rahi jab churi aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum se chudaya gaya afsos watan bhi
aise luta fatema zehra ka chaman bhi
laasha e sarwar raha be-gor o kafan bhi
baandhi gayi haathon mein khwahar ke rasan bhi
hum ko aseeri mili aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ghadi pardes mein badte rahe sadme
khaaya na thoda bhi taras ahle sitam ne
lagte rahe bali sakina ko tamache
neela hua chehra anghoti ke nishan se
zulm ki had hogayi aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm o sitam yun bada tapte huwe ban mein
koi madadgaar nahi ranj o mehan mein
rukti hai saansein hai izaafa hai ghutan mein
baandhe gaye baara gale ek rasan mein
roti thi aale nabi aap the bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm o sitam dha ke sataya gaya mujhko
aalam e ghurbat me rulaya gaya mukhko
kufe ki galiyon mein phiraya gaya mujhko
jab sare darbar bulaya gaya mujhko
mere liye maut thi aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir hilaal aale payambar mein tha mehshar
chalta tha har dil pe gham o ranj ka khanjar
dekh ke abbas e dilawar ka kata sar
peet ke sar kehti thi jab dukhtare hyder
lut gayi dunya meri aap thay bhaiya kahan
ay mere bhai ay mere bhai
chin gayi chadar meri...
items.author: Hilal Rizvi

items.title: Dua e ziyarat
items.body:
ya rab hamein bhi ziarate e karbobala naseeb ho
shaahe zaman ke rauze pe hamein haazri naseeb ho
<<DIVIDER>>
kab tak deewana sheh ka kare intezar maula
ziarat ki aarzoo mein hai dil beqarar maula
rauze ko choomne ki sa'adat hamein naseeb ho
ya rab hamein bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya maula aqeedat kami reh gayi hamari
ya phir ghareeb hona yehi hai khata hamari
karta hoo ab dua ye bulawa tera naseeb ho
ya rab hamein bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum jaise aasiyon tera dar hai ek sahara
wa basta aap se hai ye umeed ab hamara
karbal mein jaa ke karloo gunah maaf ye naseeb ho
ya rab hamein bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
muddat se aarzu hai hai dil beqarar maula
rauze ki jaal thaam ke nauha padhoo mai maula
in aansuon ka taufa karoo pesh ye naseeb ho
ya rab hamein bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis sar zameen pe madfan jigar bande fatema hai
shabbir ke lahoo se jo khaake shifa bana hai
hum bhi karenge sajda khudaya wo din naseeb ho
ya rab hamein bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ka manzar kitna haseen hoga
hum sab ki tasavvur mein rehta hai sheh ka rauza
marne se pehle dekhoo wo manzar jina naseeb ho
ya rab hamein bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahsan ye dil mein hasrat liye jee raha hai aazam
karbobal mein ek din karunga zaroor matam
ek pal na thamne paaye wahan askh e gham naseeb ho
ya rab hamein bhi...
items.author: Azam Hussain

items.title: Hurr ki surat jo
items.body:
hurr ki surat jo samajh mein kahin aa jaye hussain
ek ek saans sada dene lage haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sar uthaata nahi sajde se khuda ka mehboob
aap hi pusht se jab tak na utar jaaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut bhi aayi to qadmon se uthi le ke hayaat
ban gayi khaake shifa khaake kaf e paaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ta hayaat ek ke baad ek pisar rahib ko
bakhshta jaye khuda kehta agar jaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
chod kar aa gaye kyun ran mein ali asghar ko
kis tarha banu e dilgeer ko samjhaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne halq pe pyase ke jo khanjar rakha
kund khanjar se sada aane lagi haye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke zainab ne kaha kaise sambhalun dil ko
bekafan dekh ke tujhko mere maajaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh ke sar sajda e mabood mein sarwar ne kaha
jo hai mansha e elaahi hai wo mansha e hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta de ke husain ibne ali ka maango
rad nahi karta khuda koi tamanna e hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
items.author: Sachey Bhai

items.title: Kahan hai ghazi
items.body:
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
hussain tujhko bula raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
akela maqtal ko ja raha hai
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamari nusrat ke waaste hi
pidar ne maanga khuda se tujhko
to phir kyun mujhko rula raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar jhuki hai jawan beta
bula raha hai mai kaise jaun
andhera aankhon mein cha raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai suye qaima le jaun kaise
jawan ka laasha ay mere bhai
zaeef to ladkhada raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
duhaai deti hai ban mein zehra
sukoon dil ka qaraar mera
wo qabr e asghar bana raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na dekho amma idhar na dekho
nazar jhukao moo apna phayro
lo shimr khanjar chala raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke boli ye ban mein zehra
koi nahi hai kise bulaun
qayam dushman jala raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bain karti ali ki beti
sakina kaise sahegi bhaiya
layeen tamache laga raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bain ahle haram ka sun ke
najaf ka qalb o jigar hai bekal
tadap ye nauha utha raha hai
kahan hai ghazi madad ko aaja
husain tujhko bula...
kahan hai ghazi...
items.author: Najaf Murshidabadi

items.title: Khuda ka chehra
items.body:
khuda ke ghar may sar e musalla
khuda ka chehra lahoo lahoo hai
<<DIVIDER>>
layeen ki zarbat se aaj dekho
hassan ka baba lahoo lahoo hai
<<DIVIDER>>
uthaya beton ne zakhmi baba
amama shabbar ne phir bandhaya
kiya ali ne khuda ko sajda
ali ka sajda lahoo lahoo hai
khuda ke ghar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
pukaare ghazi tadap tadap ke
sitam ye baba hua hai kaise
ye zulm dhaaya kis layeen ne
ke ghar khuda ka lahoo lahoo hai
khuda ke ghar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool marqad may ro rahe hai
hai aaj yasrab pe sog jaari
lehad may roti hai khoon zehra
baqayya saara lahoo lahoo hai
khuda ke ghar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
yateemi zehra ki betiyon pe
lo aaj kufe may aa gayi hai
hai chaak hasnain ka gareban
ghilaaf e kaaba lahoo lahoo hai
khuda ke ghar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai eid kaisi ye hum pe aayi
tadap ke boli ali ki jaayi
manaate khushiyan hai ahle kufa
shaheed e kufa lahoo lahoo hai
khuda ke ghar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai lab pe bachon ke aah o zaari
khabar na maula ne li hamari
yateem kufe ke ro rahe hai
sahara unka lahoo lahoo hai
khuda ke ghar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawad har lafz hai gawahi
udaasi tehreer par hai chaayi
qalam bhi roya hai khoon ke aansu
ali ka nauha lahoo lahoo hai
khuda ke ghar may...
items.author: Jawad Jaffri

items.title: Laashe qasim pe
items.body:
laashe qasim pe boli sakina
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
ek suhagan hui aaj bewa
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim hai aur ek dulhan hai
ye dulhan hi to meri behan hai
dekha jaata nahi is ka chehra
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne tukde huwe tere bhaiya
jab aba may tumhe laaye bhaiya
mai ye samjhi ke hai tera sehra
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya khabar thi ye mujhko ay bhai
maut aayi hai tujhko ay bhai
teri mayyat hai aur hai sakina
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri mayyat nahi dekhi jaati
wo kalayi bhi hai khoon may doobi
jis pa baba ne baandha tha kangna
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bewa jiyegi ay qasim
jab safar tay karegi ay qasim
nok e naiza pe sar tera hoga
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun us se batayega aakhir
bekason ka na tha koi nasir
kufiyon ne unhe maar daala
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim hai aur hai qayamat
ud gayi ruye kubra ki rangat
jis ghadi dekha waaris ka laasha
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha maa ne jo bete ka laasha
yaad waaris ka aaya kaleja
jin ka tukde jigar tasht may tha
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukh madine ki jaanib kiya jab
boli sun ke ye sughra ay ya rab
ho chuki hai behan teri bewa
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham mubarak o rehan roko
sunke behsoh hai farwa gham ko
ye sukhan sun ke roti hai zehra
mar gaya haye ek shab ka dulha
laashe qasim pe...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Marke bhi abbas ka
items.body:
mar ke bhi abbas ka saahil pe laasha reh gaya
hashr tak qabze mein pyase ke darya reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
fatha karne waale jung e karbala batlaye to
aaj dunya ki zaban par naam kiska reh gaya
mar ke bhi abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
itna dunya ne dabaya aur ubharta hi gaya
naksh hoke karbala tera fasana reh gaya
mar ke bhi abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
nusrate haq ke liye asghar to ran ko jaa chuke
ek tasavvur ek maa ek khaali jhoola reh gaya
mar ke bhi abbas ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke akbar ki shahadat ki khabar maa ne kaha
baad tere zindagi mein ab meri kya reh gaya
mar ke bhi abbas ka...

items.title: Mera ishq ya hussain
items.body:
mai arz e karbala hoo mera ishq ya hussain
mai aashiq e aza hoo mera ishq ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jao ambiya ke areezo se pooch lo
dunya ke la-ilaaj mareezo se pooch lo
mai markaz e shifa hoo mera ishq ya hussain
mai arz e karbala hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujh par karam khuda ka zamane se hai juda
mera bharam hai rauza e abbas e bawafa
mai qibla e wafa hoo mera ishq ya hussain
mai arz e karbala hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar taraash kar mai banati hoo durr usay
naabin koi jo ho to banati hoo hurr usay
bakshish ka aasra hoo mera ishq ya hussain
mai arz e karbala hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon ke noor aur dil o jaan e sayyeda
madfan hai meri zaat mein armaan e sayyeda
mai qabre fatema mera ishq ya hussain
mai arz e karbala hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhi hai maine gardane sarwar kati hui
dekhi hai maine chadare zainab luti hui
mai gham mein mubtela hoo mera ishq ya hussain
mai arz e karbala hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ki bebasi mein basayi gayi hoo mai
sar ki ridayein de ke bachayi gayi hoo mai
zainab ki mai sada hoo mera ishq ya hussain
mai arz e karbala hoo...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo phasliyon ko thaam kar ab tak hai nauhagar
yasir jo keh rahi hai ke pyaasa mera pisar
us maa ki mai buka hoo mera ishq ya hussain
mai arz e karbala hoo...
items.author: Yasir Abbas

items.title: Mohibo jaane payambar
items.body:
mohibbo jaane payambar ki ye sawari iai
hassan ke chote baradar ki ye sawari hai
butool e paak ke dilbar ki ye sawari hai
ke ibne hyder e safdar ki ye sawari hai
hussain kushta e khanjar ki ye sawari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
adab se qayede se sar jhukaye saath chalo
udake khaak kaho haye sayyade khush khoo
ye chahiye hai ke sar peeto aur girya ho
mila na ghusl o kafan jis ghareeb o bekas ko
usi shaheed ki bekas ki ye sawari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ibne ali tashnakaam khasta jigar
jhulaya jhoole mein gibreel ne jise aksar
janab e fatema zehra ki jaan noor e nazar
shaheed o bekas o mazloom fidya e daawar
nabi ke deen ke yawar ki ye sawari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
diya na aab layeeno ne jisko ghurbat mein
butool jiske liye peet'ti hai jannat mein
khuda ka shukr kiya jisne har musibat mein
layeen ne kaata gala jiska haq ki ta'at mein
usi ghareeb ki muztar ki ye sawari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheed ho gaya jo teen roz ka pyasa
libaas le gaye sab loot kar sitam aara
jo zulm ho gaye unko bayan kare koi kya
hua ye qaher ke pamaal ho gaya laasha
hazaar haif usi sarwar ki ye sawari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali bhi fatema bhi thi hussain ki shayda
ye motabar hai rawayet ke roz eid ka tha
libaas bheja khuda ne ye martaba paaya
kiya khush inko bane asht rahmat e wala
sawaar e dosh e payambar ki ye sawari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo ghareeb hai jisko mila na ghusl o kafan
raha hai dhoop mein be gor jiska zakhmi tan
jo tha butool ka dildaar aur imam e zaman
phiri hai barehna sar karbala mein jiski bahen
usi ghareeb usi safdar ki ye sawari hai

items.title: Aajao ali asghar
items.body:
maadar ka ye nauha tha aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar aajao ali asghar
chodo na mujhe tanha aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
surat teri ay asghar phirti hai nigahon mein
dikhlayi nahi deta in dard ki raahon mein
tadpao na yun beta aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo phool sa chehra phir hoga kahan dunya mein
ab dhoondne jayegi ye maa kahan dunya mein
jangal mein tum na sona aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi pyaas gawahi mein baysheer ki aahon mein
ek dard ki dunya hai shabbir ki baahon mein
dil doobta hai mera aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre pade hai laashe aaun kahan mai ran mein
dil khauf se darta hai karbobala ke ban mein
chodo na mujhe tanha aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai raaton mein uth uth ke wo jhoola jhulati thi
ro ro ke tumhe beta lori mai sunaati thi
veeran hua jhoola aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
behaal sakina hai dekho to zara aa kar
hai neel tamachon ke masooma ke gaalon par
mar jayegi wo dukhiya aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab khaak hai baalon mein andhayr hai aankhon mein
dikhlayi nahi dete tum mujhko bhi khaabon mein
dil mera larazta hai aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
iqbal ban mein saabir maa ye dua karti hai
matam jo kar rahe hai unki hi zindagi hai
bano ka tha ye nauha aajao ali asghar
aajao ali asghar...
items.author: Iqbal Abedi

items.title: Abbas alamdar alam
items.body:
abbas e alamdar alam ooncha hai tera
ay sayyed o sardar alam ooncha hai tera
<<DIVIDER>>
tu fatema zehra ki duaon ka sila hai
saqqayi ka mansab tujhe virse mein mila hai
pyason ke wafdaar alam ooncha hai tera
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehrata hai har ghar pe alam aaj bhi tera
hota hai ziyarat se hi momin ka savera
dil kehta hai har baar alam ooncha hai tera
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
deta hai mareezon ko shifa aaj bhi tu hi
mayoos dilon ki hai sada aaj bhi tu hi
hai dil mein tera pyaar alam ooncha hai tera
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke rauze se sada aati hai paiham
dekhun mai jidhar bhi nazar aaye tere parcham
ay fauj ke salaar alam ooncha hai tera
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo shaam e ghariban mein alamdar bani thi
kehti hai alam dekh ke tera wohi bibi
parde ke nigehdaar alam ooncha hai tera
abbas e alamdar...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar jo julooson mein alam maine uthaya
mazhar ki tarha naara yehi maine lagaya
ay sayyed e sardar alam ooncha hai tera
abbas e alamdar...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Abhi tak shaam ke
items.body:
janaza jiska chupaye thay shab ki tareeki
damishq mein ye usi fatema ki hai beti
na kal to shaam mein parda bacha saka tha koi
dukhi hussain ki maa keh rahi hai ya mehdi
dua ko haath uthaye hai maadar e zainab
bachaye rauze ko rauza hai chadar e zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
saron ko dhaamp kar aao tumhe zainab bulaati hai
abhi tak shaam ke bazaar se awaaz aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
batate hai ye raste jo abhi tak khoon mein doobe hai
yahan se sayyade sajjad zanjeeron mein guzre hai
tamachon se sakina ko kabhi zainab bachati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin durron ki baarish hai kahin hai maarte pathar
zameen kyun phat nahi jaati tamashe ko khule hai ghar
kabhi baalon se zainab apne chehre ko chupati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
na khud hai zainab e nachar bhi us ek rassi mein
bandhe hai abid e bemaar bhi is ek rassi mein
sakina kis tarha panjo ke bal par chal ke jaati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot rote hai abid dekh kar ye haalat e zainab
ke aisa imtehan nabiyon se bhi leta nahi ya rab
imamat sar jhuka kar khoon ke aansu bahati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
khudaya hai yehi mushkil kusha e waqt ki poti
ye saara shaam kehta hai sakina chup nahi hoti
lahoo kaano se behta hai tamache moo pe khaati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda aur mustufa ke deen ka paband hai koi
na majme mein hazaron ke bhi ghairatmand hai koi
musalmano ki ghairat par bahot aansu bahati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sharabi badnasab darbar mein kitne layeen dekhe
khadi zainab thi jis ne saat sau kursi nasheen dekhe
madad ko saatwein dar par ali ko ye bulaati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jaari shaam o kufa mein jafa ka silsila ab tak
ke bhai bekafan aur behan hai berida ab tak
nikal kar qaid khane se sakina yaad aati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
yehi zehra ki khwahish hai ziyarat shaam ki karna
wahan rauze pe jaa kar bhai ka pursa usay dena
aza ka farsh rauze par yehi bibi bichati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
safar hota nahi hai khatm ab bhi karb e zainab ka
hamari maayein behne kyun qamar hai aaj beprada
musiat ye imame asr ki gardan jhukaati hai
abhi tak shaam ke...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Akbar tujhe talash
items.body:
akbar tujhe talaash karun kis dayaar mein
sughra tadap rahi hai tere intezaar mein
<<DIVIDER>>
lene ko aayega mera bhaiya mujhe zaroor
mai jee rahi hoo ab to isi aetbaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai jab se maahe moharram ke chand ko
kyun dil mera nahi hai mere ikhtiyaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise jaa ke poochun bhala khaafile ka haal
dahleez par khade hai kayi gham khataar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas bhi nahi hai na baba hai mere paas
apno ko dhondti hoo mai askhon ki dhaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat bhari nigahein tadapti hai har ghadi
pathra gayi hai putliyan ab intezaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko khiza ke ashk rulaate hai baar baar
jo din guzaare saaya e fasle bahaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
pur haul ashiyan mein mujhe lag raha hai yun
jaise ke maut nikli hai mere shikaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki yaad seene mein chubti hai jis tarha
aise chuban to hoti nahi noke khaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra ke dil par girti hai reh reh ke bijliyan
har aarzu hai dil ki ghamon ke hisaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch aur gham uthaun alaalat ke saath saath
ithi sakhat kahan hai dil e soghwaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar kuch nahi to koi dilaasa hi de mujhe
kuch to qaraar aaye dile beqarar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
raatein guzar rahi hai madine mein is tarha
jaise koi tadapta ho apne mazaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
<<DIVIDER>>
kismat ke haaton ek khilona hai aadmi
kuch bhi nahi hai apne raza ikhtiyaar mein
akbar tujhe talaash...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Allah kya jigar tha
items.body:
ek do pahar mein apna bhara ghar luta diya
allah kya jigar tha janab e hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi badan firaaq e pisar tashnagi alam
tanhaai fauj e shaam ka nargha naye sitam
ansar o aqroba ke bichadne ka dil mein gham
qaime se aa rahi thi sadaye buka baham
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aaye izn lene ko abbas e bawafa
hasrat se unko dekh ke shabbir ne kaha
jao sidharo bhai nigehban hai khuda
hum jaante hai door nahi aap se khaza
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis waqt ishteghasa e abbas ko suna
jaate thay ran mein thokare khaate shahe huda
naagah ek simt mein baazu pada mila
dil thaam kar hussain ne usko utha liya
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke baad ran mein gaya naujawan pisar
barchi ne tukde kar diya uska dil o jigar
pahunche khareeb laash ke aur baithe khaak par
barchi jigar se khaynchi to haatif ne di khabar
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ayub dekho sabr e shehenshah e karbala
tanha jawan laal ka laasha utha liya
haathon pe leke qaime ki jaanib jari chala
dekha na hoga aisa kisi dil ka hosla
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab fauj qatl hogayi ab koi bhi nahi
nargha kiye hai sham ke aada udoo e deen
barsa rahe hai teeron ko har simt se layeen
haathon pe apne laate hai bano ka mehjabeen
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein sheerkhwar ko laaye juhin hussain
khoya sipaah e shaam ne apna sukoon o chain
paika galay se lipta hua kar raha tha bain
kis sabr se juda kiya wo shaahe mashraqain
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
dafna ke sheerkhwar ke laashe ko shaahe deen
aaye khayaam e zainab e kulsoom ke khareeb
lipti sakina qadmo se dil sog tha hazeen
baba na aap jaaiye kehti thi mehjabeen
allah kya jigar tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
lipta ke apni beti ko sarwar ne ye kaha
sab hogaye anees o aizza mere juda
hum jaaye qatl gaah mein hai ye marzi e khuda
ran ko sidhaare kehte huwe shaah alwida
allah kya jigar tha...
items.author: Anees

items.title: Asghar moray
items.body:
kehti thi bano asghar jaani
kab tum ghar mein aaoge
maa ko dikhane shakl suhani
kab tum ghar mein aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
saanj bhayi ghar aa dularwa
asghar moray aghar moray
maa baithi hai dyaan ma tohre
asghar moray aghar moray
<<DIVIDER>>
mukh chandan sa akhiyan roshan
mehka mehka man ka aangan
palkein sundar baal sunehre
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khelen waala sin tha bhaiya
soch rahi hai behni dukhiya
aao humre dil ke savere
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisan pahunche peewan pani
hoigayi ghar par maa veerani
phailan laage ghor andhere
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
teeran ki barkha barsat hai
door watan se ee aafat hai
ghup gaye khanjar dil ma moray
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
laagi hai humre dil ma agni
sookhat hai ab shaakh gulan ki
surkh bhaye hai akhiyan doray
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
orr chale ho kaahe ran ke
wan to laga naiza bayan ke
aon ki maa bilkat hai tadpe
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
godh mein baba ki humkat ho
shauq e shahadat mein jaagat ho
kaa bolat ho dheere dheere
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kurta lahoo ma doob gawa hai
gardan ma suraakh bawa hai
moo se zaban hai baahar tohre
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ee nauha rehaan o raza jab
aawe jaisan maahe aza tab
bhariyo royi nain katore
asghar moray aghar moray
saanj bhayi ghar...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Baap ka saaya
items.body:
kehti thi sakina na uthe baap ka saaya
bachon ke sada sar pe rahe baap ka saaya
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya may yehi unko badi neymate rab hai
jeete hai saron par ko liye baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaati na tamache na kabhi chinte ye gowhar
uth'ta na agar sar se mere baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch kam nahi hai unke liye lutfe zindagi
wo khush naseeb jinko milay baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayoosi zindagi may lagi rehti hai sada
aulaad ke sar se jo hatay baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tak mere baba thay koi gham na mujhe tha
jeeti rahi be-khauf liye baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehti na sitam is tarha ashoor se ab tak
hota jo agar sar pe mere baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko kahan kami thi kisi cheez ki bober
jab tak ke raha sar pe tere baap ka saaya
kehti thi sakina na uthe...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Beton ki maa
items.body:
khaafila zindan se chut kar jab madine aa gaya
daf'atan baab e madina par jo naqqara baja
ek manadi ne sada di odh kar shaale aza
chain se baithe ho kyun ay aashiqan e mustafa
jab suna ummul baneen ne fatema ka ghar luta
qatl sarwar hogaye zainab hui thi berida
maadar e abbas ne bechain ho kar di sada
kya nibhaya na mere abbas ne haq e wafa
<<DIVIDER>>
badi sharmindagi hai tum se bibi
mujhe beton ki maa bole na koi
<<DIVIDER>>
mera abbas kyun na kaam aaya
bacha na fatema zehra ka beta
banaya tha jise zaamin rida ka
bacha paaya na wo zainab ka parda
ali ka saamna kaisi karungi
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jeene dega ab mujhko ye sadma
laqab jiska khuda wande wafa tha
kaha tha jisko zehra ne bhi beta
sabaq jisko ghulami ka padhaya
nibhaya kyun nahi haq e ghulami
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
chida akbar ka seena halq e asghar
raha wo dekhne ko ye bhi manzar
raha na sar mere qasim ke tan par
lahoo mein tar huwe zainab ke dilbar
na uski nyaam se talwaar nikli
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap kar saani e zehra pukari
mai apne bhai pe sau baar waari
wohi to ek tha dhaaras hamari
thi uske dam se baaqi pardadari
khudara ab na ye kehna kabhi bhi
badi sharmandi hai...
mujhe beton ki maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
baha hai sab se pehle khoon uska
baghair taygh wo kis tarha ladta
usay izn e wigha kab hi mila tha
nibhaya marte dam tak hukm e aaqa
ye tum se kehti hai zehra ki beti
badi sharmandi tum se hai bibi
mera maara gaya abbas e ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
mai zainab berida hargiz na hoti
kamar hoti na kham ibne ali ki
na lagti seena e akbar mein barchi
agar maara na jaaata mera ghazi
mere ghazi ki kismat bewafa thi
badi sharmandi tum se...
mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sun kar maadar e abbas tadapti
kaha rab se hai ye faryad meri
har ek maa ko milay aulaad aisi
jawani jis ne aaqa pe fida ki
bina tasdeeq mai kya kya na boli
badi sharmandi tum se...
mera maara gaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
liya pursa raza zainab se aise
bayan rehaan ho lafzon mein kaise
diye zainab ne ro ro kar dilaase
sunaye saare manzar karbala ke
tumhari lut gayi amma kameini
badi sharmandi tum se...
mera maara gaya...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Chin gayi rida ghar
items.body:
dhalne lagi jo raat mein bewarison ki shaam
aata hua sawaar jo dekha suye qayaam
binte ali ne thaam ke dil thaamli lajaam
goonji sada e dukhtare zehra e nek naam
<<DIVIDER>>
chingayi rida ghar ujad gaya
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
ran mein kat gaya bhai ka gala
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
thaam ke wo dil khaak par gira
hoo bahoo jo tha shakle mustufa
uske seene par naiza jab laga
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanha sa gala teer se chida
khoon jab baha larzi karbala
chehre par wo khoon bhai ne mala
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk ki taraf teer jab chala
mere sher ka baazu jab kata
mashk jab chidi gurz jab laga
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoolungi na mai wo dard ki ghadi
chal rahi thi jab bhai par churi
de rahi thi mai us ghadi sada
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
lootne ko jab aaye ashkiyan
ghar ka ghar tha jab sholon mein ghira
chin rahi thi jab sar se ye rida
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag rahi thi jab moo pe sayliyan
haye kano se tha lahoo rawan
jab gohar chinay kurta jab jala
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baba tha honton par naved
ro rahi thi baag thaam kar naved
goonjti thi ye dasht mein sada
aap thay kahan haye baba jaan
chingayi rida ghar...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Gham ki maari
items.body:
gham ki maari ye boli sakina
koi ab to nahi haye apna
<<DIVIDER>>
ab na qasim rahe hai na bhaiya
ab na ammu rahe hai na baba
kis ko awaaz doon mai khudaya
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani lene ko darya kinaare
mere ammu yahan se sidhaare
dum bhi ghutne laga gham ke maare
ab to dubhar hua saans lena
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola asghar ka khaali pada hai
meri amma ko gash aa gaya hai
haath jhoole pe unka dhara hai
koi aa kar khudara uthaana
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya abid bhi ghash may pada hai
wohi is waqt sab se bada hai
unke charon taraf sab khadhe hai
unke maathe pe bhi hai pasina
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba jaane ko aaye hai dekho
kuch batane ko aaye hai dekho
kya sunane ko aaye hai dekho
ab to mushkil hua mera jeena
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukh pa dukh zaalimon ne diye hai
shimr ne mere bunde liye hai
kaan mere wo zakhmi kiye hai
haye rukta nahi khoon behna
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
rassiyan kab ye aakhir khulengi
sakhtiyan zulm ki kab rukengi
sayliyan yun hi padti rahengi
meri amma se jaa kar ye kehna
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid may kya sada hum rahenge
zulm kab tak ye aakhir sahenge
aisa lagta hai ab hum marenge
hua hargiz na sughra se milna
gham ki maari...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi tauqeer zaidi ye sun lo
ek bachi ye kehti hai ro ro
qaid khane se mujh ko chuda do
mere ammu ko jaa kar ye kehna
gham ki maari...
items.author: Tauqeer Zaidi

items.title: Haye hussain
items.body:
shor tha ashoor ko
haye hussain haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki fughan haye hussain
abbas ke baazu haye hussain
asghar ka gala haye hussain
zainab ki rida haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ko waqte asr sada
deta tha manadi khaaliq ka
chinti hai sare zainab se rida
ro ro ke ye kehti hai dukhiya
haye hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
humshakle nabi farzande jawan
wo pyaas may tar lehja wo zaban
takbeer may wo andaz e bayan
ashoor ke din akbar ki azan
haye hussain...
items.author: Anwar Zahir

items.title: Janaza hydere karrar
items.body:
ghul pad gaya ke sayyed e abraar mar gaye
matam karo ke hyder e karrar mar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se uth'ta hai janaza hyder e karrar ka
rote hai sab sun ke nauha zainabe ghamkhar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
baap bhi ab jaa raha hai maa ka saaya bhi nahi
haye tanhaai ka aalam shaah ke ghar baar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab o kulsoom kaise dekhengi baba ka haal
sar do paara ho chuka haid zakhm hai talwaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte hai abbas ro kar ay mere bhaiya hussain
ye safar hai aakhri khaaliq ke rozedaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diye ghar ki taraf aate huwe zakhmi ali
jis ghadi dekha tha manzar kufe ke bazaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hassan bole sambhalo bibiyon ko ay hussain
dekha jayega na manzar aakhri deedar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate abbas ki choti behan behaal hai
ab yateema hai laqab is kamsin o nachaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab e dilgeer ki chadar ko hyder choom kar
dayr tak dheka kiye chehra alam bardaar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro diye be-saakhta beti ko lipta kar ali
yaad us dam aagaya manzar bhare darbar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn majid kar rahe thay murtaza ko jab hassan
haath ubhra qabr se tab ahmed e mukhtar ka
ghar se uth'ta hai...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Kahan ho abbas
items.body:
aagaya shaam ka bazaar kahan ho abbas
mere monis mere ghamkhwar kahan ho abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
kis musibat mein hai bhaiya ye behen dekh to lo
mere ghazi mere haathon mein rasan dekh to lo
koi yawar na madadgaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nakahat hai chala bhi nahi jaata mujhse
baith'ti hoon to utha bhi nahi jaata mujhse
al-madad sheh ke alamdaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahun kis se kahun haal bhala abid ka
kaz gaya tauq ke kaanto se gala abid ka
saans lena bhi hai dushwaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde majrooh ek dard jaga deti hai
bediyan bhi tumhe ro ro ke sada deti hai
qaid hai abid e bemaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse pooche koi ehsaas e ghareebul watani
har nafas dil mein mere chubti hai barchi ki ani
mar gaya akbar e jarrar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise hota teri ghairat ko gawara bhaiya
naam lekar mujhe zaalim ne pukara bhaiya
hum pe haste hai sab aghiyaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
habashi aagaye fizza ki himayat ke liye
kyun nahi aate bhala tum meri nusrat ke liye
taziyano ki hai bauchaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khul ke roti nahi mazloom yateema bhaiya
siskiyan leti hai reh reh ke sakina bhaiya
kitna karti thi tumhe pyaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum nahi ho to sakina pe sitam hote hai
khushk aankhein magar kaan lahoo rote hai
marsiya padhte hai rukhsaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gaya ghar mera aur gham ki ijazat bhi nahi
kitni majboor hoon matam ki ijazat bhi nahi
hoon rasan basta azadaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai bapa shaam ke bazaar mein aamir mehshar
noke naize se gira jaata hai ek sar nayyar
bain karte hai giraftaar kahan ho abbas
aagaya shaam ka bazaar...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Karna hai ya hussain
items.body:
wo naaz e kibriya hai wo shaah e karbala hai
zahra ke dil ka chain hai wo hi mera hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein ashk e hyder ka ek diya jalana hai
karna hai ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sayyeda ke bachon ka farshe gham bichana hai
karna hai ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
laakh mushkilein aaye gardane bhi kat jaye
fatwa gar daleelein gar aasman se bhi laaye
hum ne apni naslon ko matami banana hai
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
karna hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo pursadari hai munkiro pe bhari hai
ay yazeediyo sunlo karbala hamari hai
rab ke sab khazano mein ye alag khazana hai
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
karna hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera lahoo rayegaan na jayega
behan ka waada hai ye rang zaroor layega
ye deen ki baqa bina e la ilaah hussain baadshah
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
karna hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
aansuon ke baadal se kya ladenge ye jalse
hai nigahe khaaliq mein ye roz e awwal se
ek taraf hussaini hai ek taraf zamana hai
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
karna hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujh gunahgaar pe har dam hai ye inaame hussain
meri har gaam adad karta ha zarghaam e hussain
choom leta hoo jahan dekhta hoo naam e hussain
karbala ashke manast o manam ghulame hussain
jaan se pyari meine ishqe wila hi mujhko
ye sila maa ki tahaarat se mila hai mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
sangaton ke lashkar hai kya ghazab ke tewar hai
ye nishane matam hi matami ka zewar hai
matami julosson ki shaan faatehana hai
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
karna hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham hai ye bahattar ka sayyeda ki chadar ka
karbla mein naize ki nok par kisi sar ka
sayyedon ko is gham ne hashr tak rulaana hai
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
karna hai ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr ki faza hogi masnade qaza hogi
kaun jannati hoga kisko kya saza hogi
sayyeda ne akthar ye faisla sunaana hai
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
karna hai ya hussain...
items.author: Akhtar Abbas Zaidi

items.title: Laashe qasim pe
items.body:
laashe qasim pe chillaye akbar
chod kar humko bhaiya na jao
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho qaime may shore fughaan hai
gham may har ek nauha kuna hai
baal bikhraye roti hai madar
chod kar humko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum nishani thay ammu hassan ki
bangaye aaj zeenat bhi ran ki
tukde tukde hua jism e athar
chod kar humko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baal bikhraye baithi hai kubra
khaak malti hai sehre pe dukhiya
dekho uthkar ye hasrat ka manzar
chod kar humko...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne gham may na itna rulao
rehm sheh ki zaeefi pe khao
do tasalli to ammu ko uth kar
chod kar humko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr tak hogi ab aah o zaari
sab uthayenge mehndi tumhari
bazme matam bapa hogi ghar ghar
chod kar humko...

items.title: Marne se pehle
items.body:
sirf ek baar dekhlun karbala marne se pehle
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hai har sheh ka azadar ye dua marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun karbala marne se pehle
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hi khwahish hai bas ab dil e ghamkhwar mein
naam ho mera rakham aap ke zawwar mein
hai dil e muflis ki aakhri ilteja marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne suna hai rauza e hazrat hussain ko
ek baar dekhna kayi hajj ka sawab hai
<<DIVIDER>>
apne azadaar ko moula bula lijiye
farshe zameen ki hamein khuld dikha dijiye
dekhle hum log bhi rauza aap ka marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye meri aarzoo mai bhi ziarat karun
rauza e abbas pe jaa ke ibadat karun
parchame ghazi ka choomlu pharera marne pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalte hai tere gham mein jahan saare ambiya
us raaste pe chalna hamein bhi naseeb ho
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhlun ek baar mai rauza e shaahe najaf
phir mai wahan se chalun karbobala ki taraf
mai bhi karun tay mashi ka raasta marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke darbar mein aap ka matam karun
aap pe girya karun aap ka nauha padhun
karbobala jaa ke mai padhun marsiya marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaaun wahan thay jahan ahle haram ke qayaam
dekhe nigahein meri akbar e sheh ka maqaam
ho meri aankhon ke saamne alqama marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
padh ke durood o salam panjetan e paak pe
shukr ka sajda baja laaun mai jab khaak pe
khaake shifa se hi mujhe bhi ho shifa marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula bas ek baar mai us dar choomlu
jis dar se aaj tak koi khaali nahi gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrat e babul hawaij ka haram dekhlun
us pe laga deen ka surkh alam dekhlun
do kate haathon ka dekhlun moujiza marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte hai aamir kumail aap se bas ye dua
hum pe musalsal rahe aap ki yun hi ata
ruk na sake aap ke gham ka silsila marne se pehle
sirf ek baar dekhlun...
items.author: Kumail Jafri

items.title: Mera jari na raha
items.body:
lipat ke baap se kehti thi saani e zahra
mera jari na raha meri rida na rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ek roz mein aisi ujad gayi baba
mera jari na raha meri rida na rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai ab koi monis koi mera yawar
nahi hai ab mera qasim mera ali akbar
nahi hai ab wo alamdar aur wo lashkar
sitam ne aap ki beti ko kar diya tanha
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri rida ka muhafiz tha jab talak zinda
mai roz chain se soti thi ay mere baba
talaya phirta tha qaimon ka bawafa mera
ye waqt dekh lo deti hoon aaj mai pehra
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda se aap ne maanga tha jis dilawar ko
jo shaahzadi hi kehta tha apni khwahar ko
jo apni jaan samjhta tha meri chadar ko
pada hai uska taraayi pe bekafan laasha
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mujhko yaad hai jab ghar se mai nikalti thi
to ek fauj mere bhaiyon ki chalti thi
hawa bhi khauf se khud apna rukh badalti thi
nahi hai ab wo nigehban meri mehmil ka
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi tha dam ye kisi mein nazar utha leta
mai jab nikalti thi bazaar band hota tha
tha aisa rob mere sher mere ghazi ka
nahi hai sar pe mere ab alam ka wo saaya
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina ki nok se cheeni gayi meri chadar
laga rahe hai tamache layeen has has kar
jo aa raha hai sitam dha raha hai jee bhar kar
paraya des hai aur zaalimon ka hai nargha
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke dayr talak royi zainab e dilgeer
ay baba aap ke aane mein ho gayi ta'kheer
lahoo mein doob gaye sab ke sab jawan o peer
bas ek din mein bhara ghar ujad gaya mera
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhuka ke sar ko bahot sher e kibriya roye
galay laga ke dulaari ko murtaza roye
ali ke saath hassan aur mustafa roye
tha dardnaak ay waiz wo bain zainab ka
mera jari na raha...
lipat ke baap se...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Mohsin ne kaha rokar
items.body:
farzande zehra ka tha ye nauha
<<DIVIDER>>
darwaze ke girne se jo phasliyan tooti hai
mai dekh raha hoo wo kis tarha tadpti hai
hai dard bhara manzar amma hai musibat mein
<<DIVIDER>>
mohsin ne kaha rokar amma hai musibat mein
pehlu pe gira hai dar amma hai musibat mein
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ko kameeno ne kuch aise rulaya hai
has has ke layeeno ne darwaza jalaya hai
dil par hai rawan khanjar amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaano pa layeeno ne durre bhi lagaye hai
talwar ke qabze se kuch zakhm bhi aaye hai
mehfooz nahi hai sar amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko bulaati hai ro ro ke meri amma
hyder ko bulaati hai mehdi ko kabhi amma
barpa hai ajab mehshar amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui seene mein ek keel chubhi hai jab
yaad aaya hai amma ko akbar ka tadapna tab
akbar ki musibat par amma hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
irfan hai amma ko meri bhi musibat ka
nasir tha mai amma ka par koi nahi mera
ek keel ke naize se beta hai musibat mein
mohsin ne kaha rokar...
items.author: Nasir Hussain

items.title: Nana tere shehr
items.body:
bazaar ho kar zindan se chut kar
zainab aagayi nana
pardes jaa kar ujda mera ghar
bichde baradar sab kuch luta kar
nana tere shehr mein zainab ujad ke aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
mai to ujad gayi hoo karbobala basa gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay nana sun sako to rudaad e gham sunaun
jo zakhm maine khaye wo sab tumhe dikhaun
sare karbala mera ghar luta
baradar gaye chini hai rida
mai to ujad gayi hoo
bhai se jo kiye wo waade sabhi nibha gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
maahe rajab mein mera bhai watan se nikla
ay nana baad tere ummat ne yun sataya
suye karbala chala khaafla
musafir bana tera laadla
mai to ujad gayi hoo
ab mera ghar lutega ye baat dil ko kha gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne zameen khareedi karbal hai naam jiska
itne mein ashkiyan ki faujon ne hum ko ghera
qayaam e haram khuda ki qasam
hatay nehr se hua ye sitam
mai to ujad gayi hoo
ye baat mujhko nana tasveer e gham bata gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir saatvi se nana pehre thay alqama par
pani ki bandishein thi aulaad e fatema par
mere tifl sab huwe jaan balab
ghareeb ul watan huwe tashna lab
mai to ujad gayi hoo
ye dard sehte sehte ashoor ki shab aa gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ki wo shab to rote huwe guzaari
subhe daham ki nana akbar ne jab azaan di
wigha zulm ki shuru hogayi
sare karbala qayamat hui
mai to ujad gayi hoo
bhai ne jo khareedi sab ko zameen ye kha gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek kar ke nana peer o jawan sidhare
maqtal mein koi soya koi nehr kinare
gule tan mere baradar mere
khafa hogaye kahin khogaye
mai to ujad gayi hoo
naion pe sab ke sar thay kaisi ghadi ye aa gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khanjar chala tha jis dum shabbir ke gale par
sab zulm dekhti thi ye bad naseeb khwahar
gala kat gaya mere bhai ka
kafan bhi usay nahi mil saka
mai to ujad gayi hoo
phir iske baad nana aandhi ghamon ki cha gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
larza nabi ka rauza mazhar ye bain sun kar
kaise bayan karega farshe aza pe safdar
kahan ho saka bayan qaid ka
yahin khatm hai mera marsiya
mai to ujad gayi hoo
kehti thi binte zehra nana mai lutke aa gayi
nana tere shehr mein...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Aajao watan ay
items.body:
chain sughra ko madine mein nahi aata tha
baap ki yaad mein dil uska phata jaata tha
roti thi tadapti thi buka karti thi sughra
tha fatema sughra ke labon par yehi nauha
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ye ro kar sughra
aajao watan ay baba
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shehre madina soona
soona hai nabi ka rauza
hai charon taraf sannata
aajao watan ay baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
main kaise bataun baba
din eid ka kaise guzra
aankhon se lahoo tha behta
aajao watan ay baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi to taras ab khaaye
aakar ke mujhe le jaaye
kab tak mai rahungi tanha
aajao watan ay baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha sukoon mai paaun
dil kaise mai ab behlaun
asghar bhi nahi hai mera
aajao watan ay baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola mai jhulati usko
seene se lagati usko
gar hota wo nanha bhaiya
aajao watan ay baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khwaab hai jab se dekha
mushkil mein hai mera kunba
hai tab se bahot hi sadma
aajao watan ay baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab rok qalam ay waiz
seene mein nahi dam waiz
mushkil hai bahot ab likhna
aajao watan ay baba...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Abhi zinda hai
items.body:
jaan ki ramaq hussain mein dekhi na jab koi
haibat se paas aate nahi thay magar shaqi
ye dekhne ke zinda hai kya dilbar e ali
bola shaqi ke qaimon ke jaanib badho abhi
ek haath utha lahoo mein shahe mashraqain hai
qaimon ko mat bado abhi zinda hussain hai
mat bado jaanib e qaima
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ismat o aaya e tatheer ke rakhwaale hai
hurmat e khaana e kaaba ye haram waale hai
jal na jaaye koi qaima
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar pe qaime ke hai hamsheer meri mazlooma
mere qaime mein sakina hai meri masooma
us taraf jaane na dega
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
lootne ke liye qaimon ki taraf ho jaate
dekh sakta nahi beti ko tamache khaate
shimr aage nahi badhna
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne abbas ke bhi kaat diye thay baazu
meri aaghosh mein cheda mere asghar ka gulu
keh ke ye shaah ne roka
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere chehre pe hai asghar ke lahoo ki surkhi
mere seene mein hai akbar ke jigar ki barchi
tukde qasim ka hai laasha
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri saans hai ay zaalimon mai ghalib hoo
mai hussain ibne ali ibne abu talib hoo
azm zakhmo se na toota
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jo badhte ho udhar mujhko jalaal aata hai
ya ali ye meri ghairat ka sawaal aata hai
aage badhne nahi dega
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer paiwast thay mai pushte faras se jo gira
mai ghaseet'ta hua qaimon ki taraf hoo badhta
beh gaya khoon ka darya
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yateem ismein hi sehmi hui kuch maayein hai
bain karti hui qaime mein ye bewayein hai
bibiyon ka hai sahara
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay qamar hona hai ek din mere mehdi ka zaroor
sheh ye kehte hai ke waaris mera aayega zaroor
le ke badla wo kahega
choor zakhmo se hai tanha
abhi zinda hai hussain
mat bado jaanib e qaima...
items.author: Qamar Hasnain

items.title: Asghar nisar karke
items.body:
asghar nisaar kar ke shabbir surkh roo hai
bach jaaye deen e ahmad bas yehi justuju hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zara dekh tu sitamgar teer e sitam chala kar
seh pehlu teer tera khayega muskara kar
imran ka ye khoon hai jo tere roobaru hai
asghar nisaar kar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
de kar azan akbar khaane sina chala hai
qurban ho gaya wo burqe mein jo pala hai
tasveer e mustafa ki akbar jo hoobahu hai
asghar nisaar kar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch aur bhi talab kar khaliq se keh raha hai
teri bargah mein haazir ye aakhri fidya hai
sar sajde mein khuda se wo mehwe guftagu hai
asghar nisaar kar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa dikhao koi is dehr mein namazi
ghar baar ko luta kar rab ko kiya hai raazi
karbobala mein jis ne khoon se kiya wuzu hai
asghar nisaar kar ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqte nizha ho maula shabbir ki ziyarat
is se badi nahi hai mere liye sa'aadat
khursheed mere dil mein bas yehi aarzu hai
asghar nisaar kar ke...
items.author: Haider Khursheed

items.title: Ay musalman ye
items.body:
ay musalman ye bata qatl pyasa kyun kiya
kya thi khata shabbir ki
na kiya khaufe khuda cheen li sar se rida
kyun waaris e tatheer ki
ay musalman ye bata…
<<DIVIDER>>
chal gaya sajde mein khanjar fatema ke laal par
jal gaya zahra ka ghar
lut gayi binte ali tune hi baad az nabi
is zulm ki tadbeer ki
ay musalman ye bata…
<<DIVIDER>>
be-khata in qaidiyon ki gham bhari ye daastan
sun ke rota hai jahan
shaam ke bazaar mein abid e bemaar ne
thi khoon se tehreer ki
ay musalman ye bata…
<<DIVIDER>>
madar e asghar tumhari zindagani ka samar
mar gaya islam par
hum na bhoolenge kabhi nok nazuk se galay mein
hurmala ke teer ki
ay musalman ye bata…
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se shaam tak aale payambar be-amaan
tazaiyane rassiyan
balwe mein laaya gaya haye aale mustufa
ki is tarha tauqeer ki
ay musalman ye bata…
<<DIVIDER>>
kab talak seh paati aakhir jhidkiyan aur sayliyan
qaid ki tanhaiyan
is khadar dhaayi jafa qabr zindan mein bani hai
dukhtare shabbir ki
ay musalman ye bata…
<<DIVIDER>>
saani e zehra barehna sar gayi bazaar mein
aur bhare darbaar mein
mehfile mehkhaar mein malka e sharm o haya ki
tume kyun tasheer ki
ay musalman ye bata…
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke jisko har ghadi rote hai saare matami
karte hai seena zani
aa rahi hai shaam se ab bhi wo awaaz e sarwar
tauq aur zanjeer ki
ay musalman ye bata…
items.author: Sarwar

items.title: Baap ka taboot
items.body:
alwida kaise kahe
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ka taboot hai hasnain hai tanhaai hai
dene bacchon ko dilaasa khuld se maa aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
arsh waale bhi nazar aate hai kuch mayyat ke saath
sogh mein doobi hui hai murtaza ke kayenat
kis qadr jaane ali ke zakhm mein gehrayi hai
baap ka taboot hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr aaye zainab o kulsoom ko parwardigar
sehne masjid se sadayein aa rahi hai baar baar
ek rozedar ne sajde mein zarbat khaayi hai
baap ka taboot hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tak raha hai kisko hasrat se na jaane noor e ain
kaun hai jo keh raha hai sabr kar mere hussain
kis ki ye awaaz hai kaano se jo takrayi hai
baap ka taboot hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaamp jaata hai kaleja dard ke ehsas se
mil ke jab shabbir rote hai gale abbas ke
dekho ek bhai ke gham ka aaena ek bhai hai
baap ka taboot hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon rota hai falak kufe ke manzar hai udaas
zainab o kulsoom aur shabbir o shabbar hai udaas
chehra e ummul baneen par murdani se chaayi hai
baap ka taboot hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ka gham bhoole na thay baba ka saaya uth gaya
haye ghar hasnain ka dekho dobara lut gaya
waqt ne phir se ghamon ki daastan dohrayi hai
baap ka taboot hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun si manzil mein likha jaye ab is sabr ko
apne haathon se mitaate hai nishane qabr ko
haye kis aalam mein mayyat baap ki dafnayi hai
baap ka taboot hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir o akhtar siyahi hai falak par har taraf
dono aalam par musallat hai ghame shaahe najaf
arsh ko kudrat ne poshak e aza pehnayi hai
baap ka taboot hai...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Bano ka naunehal
items.body:
be taygh ran ko jaata hai bano ka naunehal
kamsin hai bhooka pyasa hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
apni aba mein usko chupalo kadi hai dhoop
is gul badan ka dhoop se saula na jaye roop
naazuk bahot zyada hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan mein teer chalte hai maula na jaiye
madar ka dil dehelta hai ghar laut aaiye
teero ki zad pa aaya hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole ko dekh dekh kar phat'ta hai maa ka dil
asghar ke saath dasht mein jaata hai maa ka dil
nusrat ko sheh ki jaata hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
bali sakina rok rahi hai pakad ke haath
bhaiya na jao ran ko mai khelungi kiske saath
roko na mujhko kehta hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
kisne kaha ke pyas se rota tha sheerkhaar
izne jihad maang raha tha wo baar baar
maidan mein muskuraya hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
joday zaban ka teer labon ki kamaan se
nikla hai jang karne wo hyder ki shaan se
khyber shikan ka pota hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya paye jihad wo maqtal mein jhoole se
do ghutniyo bhi chal nahi sakta tha is liye
baba ko saath laaya hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho chala wo teer kaman se suye sagheer
kaampi zameen e karbobala roye be-zameer
jab teer khaake tadpa hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan azmi tere nohay ke soz se
ehle aza ke saath farishte bhi ro diye
tujhko duawein deta hai bano ka naunehal
bano ka naunehal
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Chod kar bali
items.body:
kya nabi ki aal par aayi musibat ki ghadi
tha qayamat ka samaa aur bibiyon mein khalbali
waqt e ruqsat baap ke seene pe rakh kar apna sar
dukhtare shabbir ro ro kar ye farmane lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
chod kar bali sakina ko abhi jaana nahi
jo bhi maqtal mein gaya wo laut kar aaya nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
dayr kitni hogayi aun o mohamed ko gaye
do ghadi mein maa ke armaano ke laashe aagaye
shukr ke sajde se ab zainab ka sar uth'ta nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawani laashe qasim par sisakti reh gayi
umme farwa raasta bete ka takti reh gayi
aaye tukde laash ke qasim magar aaya nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehdo saqqa se ke ab pani na mujhko chahiye
alqama ko chod kar ab jald ghar aajaiye
wo makaan zindan hai jis mein mera saqqa nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibiyon mein hai abhi kohraam barpa dekhiye
dayr se behosh hai maa umme laila dekhiye
baba jaan ab tak ali akbar bhi ghar lauta nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
legaye thay aap asghar ko sar e maidan kyun
kya hua bano ka quran khaali hai juzdaan kyun
ab kahin bhaiya ali asghar nazar aata nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash mai hi qatl ho jaati bajaye aap ke
kaun ab mera sahara hai siwa e aap ke
choote saare aqroba ansaar bhi zinda nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin tumhare baba jaan ghut ghut ke mar jaungi mai
kis ke seene par bhala raaton ko soungi mai
chod kar beti ko jaana aap ka acha nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ke dam mein khoon rote rahe mohsin mujeeb
bain ye karti jab dukhtare shaahe ghareeb
natawan bhai abhi bistar hai utha nahi
chod kar bali sakina ko...
items.author: Mujeeb Alipuri

items.title: Dukhtare shabbir hai
items.body:
haye sakina haye haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtare shabbir hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dard ki tasveer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay sajjad ro kar kaise behlaun mai khwahar
ye tera majboor bhai kya sunaye tujhko aa kar
paon mein zanjeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak hi bistar hai tera khaak hi takiya hai tera
raaigan ay meri khwahar har ghadi rona hai tera
ab yehi taqdeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kahan se laaun beta zakhm ka marham bata de
tujhko khaane hai yahan par ghurkiyan aur taaziyane
ek tu dilgeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashke gham peeti raho ab gham pe gham sehti raho
jis tarha bhi ho mayassar qaid mein jeeti raho
ab yehi tauqeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki furqat mein jeena hai bada mushkil magar
jo muqaddar mein likha hai sabr kar le sabr kar
dard ki tehreer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh tere gham mein roti hai phupi zainab teri
khatm ho jaaye na rote rote unki zindagi
waarise tatheer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sukoon ka saans lena bhi yahan mumkin nahi
jeete jee teri rehaai meri jaan mumkin nahi
waqt ki zanjeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein sajjad kehte thay ye mazhar abidi
kis tarha taqdeer bigdi mustafa ke aal ki
qalb mein ye teer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Gham may baysheer
items.body:
gham mein baysheer ke hota hai kaleja pani
jab bhi sunte hai ke shabbir ne maanga pani
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein koi insan nahi tha warna
waqte zibha to koi sheh ko pilaata pani
<<DIVIDER>>
daste abbas kate mashk chidi pyaso ki
roze ashoora hua khoon ka pyasa pani
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ali asghare masoom ke do hai qaatil
teer ne qatl kiya jaan se maara pani
<<DIVIDER>>
fitratan tashna-dahani hai isi se saabit
zikr pyaso ka chida aankh se nikla pani
<<DIVIDER>>
qaatilon hi ki tarha dushmane jaani nikla
tha sakina ke liye pyas ka darya pani
<<DIVIDER>>
jo khilate nahi be-dard dawa abid ko
kab pilayenge wo bemaar ko thanda pani
<<DIVIDER>>
naqsh hai sheh ki wasiyat ali fitrat dil par
yaad karlena mujhe jab kabhi peena pani
items.author: Ali Fitrat

items.title: Haye hydere karrar
items.body:
jibreel ro ke kehte hai haq ki duhaai hai
zarbat ali ne sajda e khaaliq may khaayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi hua masjid may payambar ka alamdar
haye hyder e karraar
lo chal gayi talwaar katne lagi dastaar
haye hyder e karraar
<<DIVIDER>>
rangeen hui mehraab wilayat ke lahoo se
islam ke ghar may chali emaan pe talwaar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti ne kaha baba ki ho khair ay ya rab
kyun sar se giri jaati hai chadar meri har baar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
<<DIVIDER>>
amma ke janaze ko bhi uth'te huwe dekha
ab zainab o kulsoom hai baba ki azadaar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye choom ke khete thay ali baazu e zainab
in baazuon ko rassiyo se baandhenge aghiyaar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya lab e hyder pe salaam aakhri jism dam
sar peet ke kehne lage maula ke sab ansaar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ka manzar hai nighaon may ali ki
abbas ko ro ro ke banate hai alamdaar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain ne baba ke janaze ko uthaya
ek arsh ke kaandhe pe hai ek arsh namudaar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid may ali taygh na sajde may jo khaate
tauheed na yun aati nazar majid o mukhtar
haye hyder e karraar
zakhmi hua masjid may...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Janaza uth raha
items.body:
haye zehra haye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
waqte ruqsat hai ye fatema ka
ho chuki hai namaz e janaza
bache mayyat se lipte huwe hai
aakhri hai ye deedar maa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai koi ab apna ali ko chod kar tanha
ali ke ghar ki raunaq jaa rahi hai
janaza uth raha hai fatema ka
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot zakhmi thi khud lekin ali ke zakhm bharti thi
utha kar haath pehlu se wo aansu saaf karti thi
ab aansu kaun pochega bahot yaad aayegi zehra
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bulaya tha jise maa ne kafan se haath phaila ke
usay lipta hua dekha to fizza ne kaha aa ke
janaze se hussain uth ja kafan ab chod de maa ka
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kafan jab bhi hataata hai tamacha yaad aata hai
wo zakhmi maa ka chehra choom ke aansu bahata hai
hassan ko gham hai chehre par tamache ka nishan le kar
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sirhane baith kar zainab ne maa ka haath jab chooma
ali kehne lage dekha nishan jab taziyane ka
chupa do saani e zehra ye zakhmi haath zehra ka
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ab lori sunayegi na wo jhoola jhulayegi
hussain ab fatema kaise tumhe pani pilayegi
wasiyat kar gayi zehra tumhe paalegi ab fizza
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
madine waalon ab apne gharon may chain se sona
satayega na ab tum ko nabi ki beti ka rona
gira tha jispe jalta dar wo tooti phasliyan lekar
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chuda kar maa se bachon ko ali ne jab kafan baandha
tadap ke haye zeeshan o raza kehne lage maula
hai taaza zakhm pehlu ka zara aahista do kaandha
ali ke ghar ki raunaq...
janaza uth raha hai...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi

items.title: Kahan ho ay mere
items.body:
zainab ko jo bazaar mein zaalim ne phiraya
us waqt lab pe tha ye kahan ho ay mere ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
ek izdehaam ka hai badkaar fasikon ka
bazaar sharabi se guzar saani e zehra ka
deti thi sada ro kar kahan ho ay mere ghazi
zainab ko jo bazaar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pur khaar raaste hai aur nange paon sadaat
mehshar se kam nahi hai ye sakhtiyan ye halaat
pairon se khoon hai jaari kahan ho ay mere ghazi
zainab ko jo bazaar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
atfaal hussaini pe hai zulm o sitam jaari
aur noke sina par sar quran ka hua taari
gham naak is fiza mein kahan ho ay mere ghazi
zainab ko jo bazaar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
nau baar rida sar se yun cheena hai zaalimo ne
haathon ko pusht e gardan baandha hai zaalimo ne
is darja musibat mein kahan ho ay mere ghazi
zainab ko jo bazaar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar saj gaye aur khushiyan mana rahe hai
baaghi ki behan keh kar zaalim sata rahe hai
haste hai layeen hum par kahan ho ay mere ghazi
zainab ko jo bazaar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj o alam mein dooba wo abid e muztar hai
sharm o haya ka paikar chalta jhukaye sar hai
dene ko ab dilaase kahan ho ay mere ghazi
zainab ko jo bazaar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
aazam mai likhun kaise bazaar ka wo manzar
sar nange bibiyon ke chalta tha dil pe khanjar
ahsan sada thi lab par kahan ho ay mere ghazi
zainab ko jo bazaar mein...
items.author: Azam Hussain

items.title: Khuda ki raah may
items.body:
khuda ki raah mein kaar e numeinan aise hote hai
tah e khanjar kiye sajde musalman aise hote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo pyari pyari shaklein dekh kar aale payambar ki
sitaron ne kaha ay chand insaan aise hote hai
khuda ki raah mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
musafir ka tan e be-sar hai aur shab ka andhera hai
kisi ki laash par gaysu pareshan aise hote hai
khuda ki raah mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam par sheh ka dam nikla habeeb ibne mazahir ka
mohabbat ke wafa ke ahd o paiman aise hote hai
khuda ki raah mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda hi jaane dil se kya kaha hoga nigahon ne
sakina ko khabar kya thi ke zindan aise hote hai
khuda ki raah mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
suna kar najm qissa karbala waale shaheedon ka
musalmano ko samjha do musalman aise hote hai
khuda ki raah mein...
items.author: Najm Afandi

items.title: Laashe qasim pe ye
items.body:
laashe qasim pe ye kehte thay shehenshahe zaman
kaise le jaaun mai mayyat teri farzande hassan
tukde tukde hai badan
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj qaime mein teri maa ko bada hai tera
phool sehre ke kahin jism pada hai tera
kitni bedardi se loota hai qiza ne chaman
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham se phat'ta hai kaleja mai agar sabr karun
kaun se dil se teri laash ko chadar mein bharun
baith kar uthne nahi deti zaeefi ki thakan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ne dasht mein kya haal kiya hai tera
jism bhi ghodon se pamaal kiya hai tera
tujhko dekhegi to mar jayegi ek shab ki dulhan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya guzarti hai mere dil pa bataun kaise
lassh bikhri hui maqtal se uthaun kaise
bhai ka haath batane ko chale aao hassan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi ummeed bhi maa ki na bachi ay qasim
tere haathon mein hina kaisi rachi ay qasim
lag gaya haste huwe chand ko maqtal mein grahan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek qayamat dil e bewa pa guzar jayegi
tere marne ki khabar sunte hi mar jayegi
isne kya kya na kiye thay tere shadi ke jatan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne armaano bhare dil se sajaya tha tujhe
joda shadi ka samajh kar jo pinhaya tha tujhe
kya khabar thi wohi ban jayega maqtal mein kafan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim pa thay akhtar yehi shabbir ke bain
kis tarha ghusl o kafan de tujhe ghurbat mein hussain
sharm aati hai mere laal paraya hai watan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Madad hussain ki
items.body:
madad hussain ki karne habeeb aaye hai
qadam qadam pe wafa ke naqoosh paaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
badal raha hai zamana ka jasba e nusrat
zaeef hoke jawani ko saath laaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sin ye saal ye azme wafa mubarak ho
galay lagaane tumhe khud imam aaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab e hussain ki jumbish may hai nigaah sab kuch
payaam sun ke shahadat ka muskuraye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe nabi ki nawasi salaam karti hai
habeeb martaba dekho to kaise paaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ho habeeb ke muslim zohair ho ke hilaal
qasam hai un ke kaleje pe teer khaaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ho rasool nabi ya payambarane salaf

mera junoon hai hussain...

mera junoon hai hussain...

jaun mai arbaeen mein hai meri aarzu
deta hoo mai usi ki qasam jo hai maahru
mujhse khatayen jo hui afwa kar de tu
nasir tadap ke kehta hai ay deen ki aabru
irfan se zari teri choomunga hussain
rauze ko tere dekh ke...
mera junoon hai hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ana majnunal hussain
tu deen ki izzat quran ki tilawat
hyder ki wilayat shabbar ki fasahat
sajjad ki zeenat baqir ki hai hikmat
sadiq ki sadaqat kazim ki hai taaqat

items.title: Allah mohamed ali
items.body:
kardo karam rakhlo bharam
mai ban ke sawali aap ke dar par aaya hoon
bin aap ke mera nahi koi sahara ho karam khudara
daaman phailaye baitha hoon kab se
nahi lautunga jab tak meri mushkil na ho aasan
<<DIVIDER>>
allah mohamed ali fatema hassan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke asghar ke jhoole se lipta hoon
be-auladon ke haq mein ye kehta hoon
jo bhi jhoole se kurta le kar jaaye
us bibi ki khaali jholi hai wo bhar jaaye
poori ye dua ho aulaad ataa ho
be-auladon ko aap ke sadqe mil jaye santaan
allah mohamed ali fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
jald shifa mil jaaye sab bemaaron ko
maaon se milwadein unke pyaron ko
jo maqrooz hai karz ada ho ab unka
rahe salamat maaon behno ka parda
ghame sheh ke siwae gham koi na aaye
karta hoon dua mehfooz rahe har maulai ki jaan
allah mohamed ali fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aati hai jab karbala dil rota hai mera
mujhe dekhna hai har baras abbas ka rauza
jaanta hoon muflis hoon ghar mein ghurbat hai
karbobala jaane ki phir bhi hasrat hai
door mai ab maula se reh na paaunga
unki yaad mein ro ro kar mar jaaunga
meri aas ko bhejein abbas ko bhejein
saqqa-e-sakina ki ghurbat par hona hai qurban
allah mohamed ali fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhta hoon apne bachon ka jab chehra
hota hai ehsaas ghar na hone ka
waasta deta hoon mai jalte qaimon ka
ho jaaye is saal mera bhi ghar apna
jahan alam sajaaun majlis karwaun
meri hasrat hai ke aap bane ek din mere mehman
allah mohamed ali fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula hussain ko akbar ka pursa de kar
hum ne shabe jumma ye dua maangi ro kar
chod gaye hai hum ko jitne bhi pyare
rehmatein naazil kijiye unki qabron pe
mushkil na ho raste barzakh ke safar se
mere marhumeen ki mehshar tak har manzil ho aasan
allah mohamed ali fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ne to pyaar sikhaya hai hum ko
apna chaahne waala banaya hai hum ko
yaad ye rakhna waqt koi bhi aa jaaye
apna hussaini rishta toot nahi paaye
parcham lehrao dunya ko batao
ye wird hamesha saath karenge hind aur pakistan
allah mohamed ali fatema...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaibat mein hai maula kitne saalon se
waakif hai phir bhi wo hamare haalon se
zinda rahe ya hum mar jaaye ya zahra
dekhna hai har haal mein maula ka chehra
wo khud aa jaayein ya hamein bulayein
wo saamne baith ke bole sunao phir se raza zeeshan
allah mohamed ali fatema...

items.title: Karo matam hussain ka
items.body:

items.body:
