nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saanson ki toot’ti hui dori gawaah hai
nauha jo ban gayi thi wo lori gawaah hai
asghar ki jang fatha ka alaan ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna labi mein teer ko sairaab kar diya
poora dil e hussain ka har khwaab kar diya
tabeer e khwaab marziye yazdan ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoole mein reh ke shauq e shahadat jawan tha
asghar ka shauq maa ke liye imtehan tha
maa shauq pe sagheer ke qurban ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo teer ran mein jaanib e quran tha chala
asghar ne pesh kar diya haste huwe gala
is tarha se hifazat e quran ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha likha hai aap ne us bezuban ka
khushnoodi e hussain hai jis nauhe ka sila
bakhshish to yun bhi aap ki rehaan ho gayi
asghar hase to...
nanhi si jaan...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Abbas ankhein khol
items.body:
jab sar e abbas zainab ko mila
sar se ye karne lagi ro kar gila
aa gayi bali sakina ko qaza
ab to ay abbas aankhein khol do
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane mein ye zainab ne kaha
ab to ay abbas aankhein khol do
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn hum ne kar diya ghamkhar ko
tum na aaye aakhri deedar ko
ho gayi hum se sakina bhi juda
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard aur gham ka dafeena dekh lo
ek nazar qabr e sakina dekh lo
ho nahi paayi wo mar kar bhi reha
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho gayi hai dafn wo zer e zameen
aaj bhi us ke liye pani nahi
qaid khana ban gaya hai karbala
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
rote rote khatm saansein ho gayi
khud bhi uski band aankhein ho gayi
jo tumhe deti thi ro ro kar sada
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mustaqil sehti rahi ranj o mahan
saal bhar pehne rahi ek pairahan
ho gayi ghurbat ki us par inteha
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab sakina pani maangegi nahi
mashk bhi apni tumhe degi nahi
na karegi tum se wo koi gila
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtar e shaahe madina ke liye
fateha padh do sakina ke liye
kar do apna farz tum ye bhi ada
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan se pyari sakina thi tumhe
de rahi hoo mai qasam uski tumhe
khol do ek baar tum aankhein zara
ab to ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir o yaqoob gham barpa hua
zainab e dilgeer ne jab ye kaha
mil gayi mujhko sakina ki rida
ab to ay abbas...
items.author: Yaqoob Jarchvi

items.title: Akela hai hussain
items.body:
jab girne laga jab hazrat e abbas ka parcham
ro ro ke sada dene lage ye shahe aalam
laut aao mere bhai khudara palat aao
kuch ho gaya agar tumko to mar jayenge phir hum
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta deta hoon sakina ka tumhe
laut kar qaimon mein aa jao akela hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haath ko jod ke ab tumko bulaata hai hussain
laut aao hamay maloom hai tum ho zakhmi
ab sakina bhi nahi maangegi tum se pani
waasta deta hoon sakina ka tumhe
tum bulao to tumhe lene ko aata hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas haye abbas haye abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ghayr kar qatl na kar de ye tumhe fauje yazid
jab talak zinda ho baaqi hai hamari ummeed
waasta deta hoon sakina ka tumhe
ay mere bhai tumhe khone se darta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj jee bhar ke tumhe dekha nahi hai maine
aaj baazu bhi tera chooma nahi hai maine
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
aao seene se tumhe apne lagata hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai kyun dil ko mere tod diya hai tum ne
mujhko marne ke liye chod diya hai tum ne
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
ab judaai ko teri seh nahi sakta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai hum dono ka bachpan se ajab hai rishta
door mai bhi nahi tu bhi nahi reh sakta tha
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
jaanta hoon ke tere dil mein dhadakta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum gaye jab se tabiyat meri ghabrati hai
theek se bhai mujhe saans nahi aati hai
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
bin tumhare badi mushkil se hi zinda hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aise azlaan ko zawwar bana lo maula
jeete jee mujhe rauze pe bula lo maula
waasta deta hoon abbas sakina ka tumhe
tumse maango to dua ko meri sunta hai hussain
haye abbas haye abbas...
items.author: Arsalan Azmi

items.title: Ay paalne waale
items.body:
sheh ran may ye farmate thay
ay paalne waale ay paalne waale
ek baap kaleje se sina kaise nikaale
<<DIVIDER>>
hum naad e ali padte hai aajayega aaram
yun aediyan ragdo na mere gaysuon waale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke giri qaime may maa dasht may shabbir
akbar gaye ruqsat huwe aankhon ke ujaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
yan garm lahoo behta tha akbar ke jigar se
padte thay kaleje pe wahan laila ke chaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad de jawab apni behen ka ali akbar
qasid ko koi laasha e akbar pe bulaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila se kaha sheh ne rida daal ke apni
is zakhm ko zainab ki nigahon se chipaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab laashon pe zainab ne har ek maa ko sambhala
ab laasha e akbar hai usay kaun sambhale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ye kehte huwe sheh ne rakha laasha
koi mere abbas ko darya se bulaale
ay paalne waale...

items.title: Baap ki tarha
items.body:
ekeeswi ki subha qayamat ka tha samaa
thar'ra raha tha chand larazta tha aasman
baitus sharaf may baithe thay sab log neem jaan
hyder ne baari baari har ek par nigah ki
zainab ko junhi dekha to ek sard aah ki
beti ko dekh dekh ke rone lage ali
sarwar ka haath thaam ke kehne lage ali
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki tarha kaleje se lagana beta
phir meri laash se zainab ko chudana beta
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyan baap se manoos bahot hoti hai
choti choti si musibat pe bahot roti hai
zakhm sar ka meri zainab se chupana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain ehsaan yateemi se kare ghabrakar
laash par meri jo gir jaye pachade kha kar
kar ke dam nade ali usko uthana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ye darr hai mujhe jaan ko khote khote
meri bachi kahin mar jaye na rote rote
chup ke zainab se kafan mujhko udhana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
karwan amn ka sab zulm o sitam lootenge
meri bachi pe bahot ranj o alam tootenge
har musibat se mere baad bachana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash par meri to jee bhar ke abhi rolegi
par teri laash pe ye laakhon sitam jhelegi
naaz saare meri zainab ke uthana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir ye kehne lage aankon se baha kar aansu
choom lena meri jaanib se behan ke baazu
jis ghadi marne ko maidan may jaana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
chain se raaton ko zainab na kabhi soyegi
mere veeran musalle pe bahot royegi
kar ke talqeen usay aas bandhana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr wo meri judaai pe na kar payegi
mujhko jo qabr may dekhegi to mar jayegi
saath may usko janaze may na laana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee khamoosh huwe maula shahadat paayi
utha taboot jo aamir to sada ye aayi
mujhpe jo guzri musibat na batana beta
baap ki tarha kaleje se...
items.author: Ainee Rizvi

items.title: Bano ye boli rokar
items.body:
bano ye boli rokar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar jhoole ke sone wale
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon mein rehne wale seene pe sone wale
baysheer mere asghar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gardan dhali hui hai manka dhala hua hai
sotay ho teer kha kar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani pila'un aaja seene laga'un aaja
kab se khadi hai maadar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
godhi hui hai sooni jhoola hua hai khaali
sunsan kar gaye ghar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
gehwara jal raha hai qaime bhi jal rahe hai
laa'un kahan se bistar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jangal ye soona soona ye har taraf andhera
ghabraiyo na asghar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aag si lagi hai dil gham se phat raha hai
aaye kharaar kyun kar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti zameen pe mirza pas murdaye kali hai
ghuncha-dehan khulay tar jhoole ke sone wale
sadqe gayi ye maadar...
bano ye boli rokar...
items.author: Mirza Murtaza Ali

items.title: Bhai ka pehla
items.body:
zindan mein zainab roti hai
bhai ka pehla chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar apna jhukaye baithi hai
bhai ka pehla chehlum hia
<<DIVIDER>>
wo nazr dilaye kis tarha
pani bhi nahi hai ek khatra
ghazi ki bahot yaad aati hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil khol ke rone na paayi
apne bhai ko maajayi
rone pa bhi pabandi hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha koi majboor na ho
aur itne ghamon se choor na ho
zahra ki dulaari qaidi hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsoom ke dil pe kya guzri
ye jaan nahi paaya koi
chehre pe bahot mayoosi hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baradar ki khwahar
kis tarha rajhe dil pe pathar
zindan hai aur lachari hai
bhai ka pehla...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ke andar ay waiz
hai hashr ka manzar ay waiz
ghurbat hai ali ki beti hai
bhai ka pehla...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Dunya may aaj
items.body:
dunya may aaj hashr ka din aashkaar hai
sibte nabi ke seene pa qatil sawaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mar jaunga mai aap hi ab thodi dayr may
qaalib may rooh ka koi dam ko qaraar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
unees sau hai taygh o sinaan o tabar ka zakhm
sang e sitam ke khoon se badan laal zaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zalzala zameen ko gehn may hai aaftab
baarish hai khoon ki chashme falak ashk baar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
chilla rahi hai qaime se zainab utar layeen
bhai ka mere zakhm se seena figaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay shaah shimr se mujhko na zibha kar
dunya hai chand roz ka kya aetbaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran hai saaf seena ye baith'ta hai jis pe tu
bosagah e rasool pe khanjar ki dhaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai an-khareeb phoonke sarafeel soor ko
bas hukme kibriya ka faqat intezaar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aage kar bayan na anees e jigar figaar
ye din wo hai ke saara jahan ashk baar hai
dunya may aaj hashr ka...
items.author: Mir Anees

items.title: Ghame baqir
items.body:
momino utha janaza
baqir e mazloom ka
qatle na-haq kalmago ne
phir kiya masoom ka
ahle arsh o farsh mein
mehshar bapa hai al amaan
gham se phat'ta hai kaleja
sadiq e maghmoom ka
<<DIVIDER>>
gham e baqir mein roti hai khudayi
jafa ye kalmago ne kaisi dhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
yun phir hai gulshan e saadaat ujda
madina sog e baqir mein hai dooba
sar apna peet ke kehti hai farwa
yateemi jafar e sadiq pa chaayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis se rahmatein hoti thi naazil
ye ummat hogayi uski hi qaatil
bata aakhir hua kya tujh ko haasil
mawaddat kaisi ummat ne nibhayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehad mein fatema ko phir rulaya
sutoon e rauza e hyder hilaya
hishaam e bad nasab ne zulm dhaaya
duhaai ya muhamed hai duhaai
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sada e haye wawaila lagaate
imam e ilm par aansu bahaate
chale hai marsiya qudsi sunaate
hai ta aflaak nauhon ki rasaayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe yasrab zara khidmaat dekhein
di ummat ne nayi saughaat dekhein
gham o aazaar hai din raat dekhein
luti phir fatema ki hai kamaayi
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam aisa hua aflaak roye
lehad mein sayyed e laulaak roye
hue jafar gareeban chaak roye
gira dil par hai ehsaas e judaai
gham e baqir mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
wila e hyder e safdar ki khaatir
shahe mazloom ke maqtal ka zaakir
hua ruqsat wo karbal ka musafir
aziyat jis ne bachpan se uthaayi
gham e baqir mein...
items.author: Wila Hallauri

items.title: Halchal hai fauje
items.body:
teero pe teer naizo par naize chalaate hai
halchal hai fauje shaam mein abbas aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kya waqt pad gaya hai mohamed ki aal par
chadar nahi hai baalon se moo ko chupate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko maa chupati hai jhuk jhuk ke godh mein
qaimon ko tod tod kar jab teer aate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil pani pani hota hai bachon ka pyas se
sookhi zaban hoton par asghar phirate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghode daudaye sham se lashkar jo aate hai
kam umr bache qaimon mein ghabraye jaate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ko de diya hai sabak ye hussain ne
raahe khuda mein kis tarha ghar ko lutaate hai
halchal hai fauje…
<<DIVIDER>>
allah re sabr sayyede waala ka dekhle
ran mein jawan bete ka laasha uthate hai
halchal hai fauje…

items.title: Haye jis kurte
items.body:
haye jis kurte may zindan talak laayi gayi
ay sakina tu usi kurte may dafnayi gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
tere kano se na ruk paaya lahoo ka behna
kab ruka shaam talak haye tamache lagna
har qadam haye aziyat tumhe pahunchayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko zindan may sar baap ka dikhlaya gaya
imtehan baap ki chahat ka tumhe dena pada
jitna tu royi koi bachi na rulwayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitna mayyat pe teri barsi ye ghurbat bibi
aise dafnayi nahi jaati hai koi bachi
do bandhe haaton se tu qabr talak laayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi gardan pe rasan aati kabhi jism bandha
haye thi kaisi tasalli ki chini teri rida
har nafas ek qayamat tere sar dhaayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
naam sunte hi tera bhai chala aata hai
shimr lagta hai aziyat tumhe phir deta hai
jab kabhi teri musibat kahin dohrayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dada ne to qaatil ko pilaya pani
aur mere baba ne haiwano ko baksha pani
par ek sakina hi meri pani ko tarsayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri khwahar ko kaneezi may koi maangta tha
aur koi raah may sadqa isay dikhlata tha
poti zahra ki aur bazaaron may bulwayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi dua baba ki mujhse na bichadne paaye
itna mai chahoo mere bin na usay neend aaye
sheh se rehan aur mubarak wohi chudwayi gayi
haye jis kurte may...
items.author: Mubarak Jalalpuri

items.title: Hussain aap ki ghurbat
items.body:
hussain aap ka gham kitna nafsiyati hai
zara si baat bahot dayr tak rulaati hai
hussain aap ki ghurbat bahot rulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda gawah mere dil ko roze ashoora
hussain aap ki ghurbat bahot rulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kadakti dhoop wo garmi wo pyaas ka ghalba
hussain aap ki ghurbat bahot rulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
musafirat mein ye ghurbat bhi aap ne dekhi
hussain aap ke dil par na jaane kya guzri
bana jab aap ka mehman hurr mere maula
nahi tha aap ke qaime mein boond bhar pani
kareem aap ka mehman reh gaya pyasa
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bala ke dasht mein ibne hassan ke tukde thay
zameen e garm pe qasim ke tan ke tukde thay
wo jisko aap ne khud baap ban ke paala tha
nazar ke saamne us gulbadan ke tukde thay
uthaya khaak se rote huwe har ek tukda
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi furaat kabhi arz e nainawa royi
hussain aap ki haalat pe karbala royi
na royi apne dularon ki laash par zainab
magar wo aap ki ghurbat pa jaa ba jaa royi
behen ne aap ki bas aap par kiya girya
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jigar tha aap ka ay ibne faatahe khyber
akele aap thay kadiyal jawan ke laashe par
jhinjhodti hai bahot aap ki wo tanhaai
uthaya aap ne peeri mein laasha e akbar
nahi tha aap ka pardes mein koi apna
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dilayr zaigham o jarrar mar gaya ran mein
hussain aap ka ghamkhwar mar gaya ran mein
jo haath aap ki quwwat thay ay mere maula
kate wo haath alamdar mar gaya ran mein
jari ne aap ke zaanu pe apna dam toda
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
salaam aap ki himmat ko sayyed e mazloom
chida hai teer se asghar ka jis ghadi hulqoom
dahaade maar ke roya hai sabr khud us dam
hua jab aap ke haathon pa munqalib masoom
wo be-zaban pisar aur wo teer e seh shoba
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jisay sukoon bataate thay aap khud apna
wo jisko aap ke seene pe chain milta tha
sakina aap se jis dam juda hui hogi
kaleja aap ka us waqt phat gaya hoga
wo char saal ki bacchi ko chod kar jaana
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe rulaya hai shaam waalon ne
musafirat mein sataya hai shaam waalon ne
kahan ye zulm kisi bewatan pe hota hai
jo zulm aap pe dhaaya hai shaam waalon ne
rula rula ke layeeno ne aap ko maara
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bekasi wo musibat wo aalam e ghurbat
paraya des zaeefi wo pyaas ki shiddat
wo dard aap ka kaise raqam kare waiz
bayan ali se na hogi wo aap ki haalat
lahoo ke ashk rulaata hai bas yehi jumla
khuda gawah mere dil ko...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Jangal may bhare
items.body:
jangal mein bhare ghar ko luta aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
abid ko kisi tarha bacha laayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
<<DIVIDER>>
bandwake rasan haaton mein aur khutbe sunake
ghar baar lutaake
dewaar bade kufr ke dha aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
jis shehr mein shehzadiyon ki tarha rahi thi
naazon se pali thi
sar nange usi shehr mein ho aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hijre padar mein rahe har waqt pareshan
soyi nahi ek aan
us bachi ko zindan mein sulaa aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
dhaaras thi bahot bhai ko jis bhai ke dam se
dil phat'ta hai gham se
saahil pe akela usay chod aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke asghar ko bhi jhoole ke bajaye
dukh dard chipaaye
aaghosh mein turbat ke sula aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
thay aun o mohamad jo meri ankhon ke taare
mamu ke dulaare
qurban unhe bhai par kar aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
tha akbare nashaad jo is ghar ka ujaala
wo gaysuon wala
marqad mein akela usay chod aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
naadim hai bahot laa saki qasim ko na humraah
wa hasrato darda
kubra ko magar saath liye aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani jo piye ehle watan pyaas na bhule
moo ashkon se dhole
kehne ko ye bhai ka payaam aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar wo bhula sakti nahi ta dame aakhir
hai kehne se qaasir
jo shaam ke darbar mein dekh aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
kis waqt khuda jaane qadam nikle thay ghar se
chaadar chini sar se
ab tak na masayab se nikal payi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir pe ab royega ta hashr zamana
hai gham ka fasana
majlis ki bina shaam mein daal aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
<<DIVIDER>>
reh jayega akhtar ufaqe gham pe tera naam
kya khoob hai inaam
nowha tera sun'ne ke liye aayi hai zainab
ay shehre madina
jangal mein bhare…
items.author: Zameer Akhtar

items.title: Kahan kahan mai
items.body:
haye hussain mere laal
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan kahan mai tujhe royun mere laal bata
har ek maqam se aati hai ek maa ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare qatl pe roya hai aasman bhi lahoo
zibhe azeem shaheede al kafa bekhata
har ek maqam se aati hai ek maa ki sada
kahan kahan mai tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb paaye hai aulaad e murtaza ne naseeb
baghair kafan hai bhai to behan hai berida
har ek maqam se aati hai ek maa ki sada
kahan kahan mai tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
rayees e aazam o sardar hoke jannat ka
kyun apne aap ko phir tu ghareeb kehta raha
har ek maqam se aati hai ek maa ki sada
kahan kahan mai tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai chain mujhe qabr mein bhi beta hussain
tumhari yaad mein rehti hoon roti subho masa
har ek maqam se aati hai ek maa ki sada
kahan kahan mai tujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere hussain ko royega jo bhi shaks ameer
mai doongi ajr bhi uske liye karungi dua
har ek maqam se aati hai ek maa ki sada
kahan kahan mai tujhe...
items.author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi

items.title: Karti hai bain
items.body:
ay mere laal hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
karti hai bain zehra aansu baha baha kar
bacche ko mere maara hai ran may rula rula kar
<<DIVIDER>>
allah rehm farma ek bezuban ki mayyat
aada nikaalte hai naiza chuba chuba kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli sakina ammu ye haal hai hamara
peete hai pani aada hum ko dikha dikha kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
maara hai usko pyasa jangal may zaalimon ne
paala tha jisko maa ne chakki chala chala kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ko apne maayein sarwar pe waarti hai
maqtal ko bhejti hai dulha bana bana kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai jin ke ghar se parda unko nabi ke dushman
dar dar phira rahe hai qaidi bana bana kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ghamzada tasavvur may apne laadle ko
lori suna rahi hai jhoola jhula jhula kar
karti hai bain zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dayam aur yazdan sarwar ke qatilon ne
dukhiyon ko maar daala paidal chala chala kar
karti hai bain zehra...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Khushbu e aza
items.body:
har taraf jaa baja saj gayi karbala
dene hum ko dua aagayi fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ghar se har ghar se har dil se
matam ki sada aane lagi
khushboo e aza aane lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
door hogi waba ab milegi shifa
khushboo e aza aane lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ke dil ke chain
assalaam alaika ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe aza bich gaya nauhon ki aayi sada
parchame ghazi khula hogayi majlis bapa
khuld e moalla se hawa aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar ke jo matam bapa tum ne kaha ya hussain
mil gaya ek baar phir fatema zehra ko chain
dekho baqayya se hawa aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui dhoop mein nikla juloos e aza
dekh kar ye walwala ulfate shabbir ka
jhoom ke rehmat ki ghata aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ulfate shabbir ke saanche mein dil dhalte hai
ya ali kehte huwe khaake shifa malte hai
chehra e momin pe jila aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
surat e tayghe ali sookhi zuban jab hui
asghar e baysheer ki jang yahan jab hui
naara e hyder ki sada aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
masnad e sheh jab bichi aur azakhana saja
ghar pe azadaar ke ghazi ka parcham saja
khul ke pharera jo hawa aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hua ya hussain khaafila e gham chala
haathon ne uth uth ke jab seeno pe sajda kiya
dushman e matam ko qaza aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ke jo ghamkhwar hai bakshne unko shifa
log jo bemaar hai bakshne unko shifa
leke shifa khaake shifa aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
<<DIVIDER>>
zikre aza jaa baja karne lage nauhakhwan
gauhar e haq kyun na ho qalbe nabi shadman
ishq e hussaini ki ziya aane lagi
khushboo e aza...
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Mafhoome karbala
items.body:
bataati jaati hai mafhoom e karbala sab ko
hussain is liye laaye thay saath zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
guzaari bhai ke laashe pe raat wo zainab
na paayi ranj se jis ne nijaat wo zainab
irada jiska hai koh e sabaat wo zainab
bajaye khud hai jo ek kainaat wo zainab
bataati jaati hai mafhoom e karbala sab ko
hussain is liye laaye thay saath zainab ko
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamon ka baar uthaati hui chali zainab
khuda ki raah dikhaati hui chali zainab
lahoo se shamma jalaati hui chali zainab
yazeediyat ko mitaati hui chali zainab
dayaar e shaam ka gham zabt kar gayi zainab
yazeediyat ko kuchal kar guzar gayi zainab
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mila jo hukm ke jao yazeed ke darbar
ali ki beti ne jaane se kar diya inkaar
phupi se kehne lagay ro ke abid e bemaar
ke hum aseer hai is waqt bekas o nachaar
ye zulm shaam ki manzil hai is ko sar kar lo
kisi tarha shab e gham ko phupi sehar kar lo
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye socha zainab e muztar ne nange sar hoo mai
ajeeb waqt hai mujh par ke darbadar hoo mai
hazaar bekas o majboor bhi agar hoo mai
yazeediyat ke liye ab bhi dard e sar hoo mai
ali ki beti hoo qasr e yazeed dhaa doongi
yazeed kaun hai mai kaun hoo bata doongi
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri majaal ke sar nange tu kare tash'heer
hamare sar pe azal se hai chadar e tatheer
jala ke khana e zehra hamein kiya hai aseer
aur apne aap ko kehta hai momino ka ameer
ye keh ke itrat e uqba se tu hua mehroom
teri nijaat ki zid ban gaye hai hum mazloom
bataati jaati hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeed paikar e zillat hai ay musalmano
yazeed dushman e ummat hai ay musalmano
yazeediyat hi aziyat hai ay musalmano
urooj ki jo zaroorat hai ay musalmano
yazeediyat ko mitao isay bala samjho
khuda ke waaste mafhoom e karbala samjho
bataati jaati hai...
items.author: Urooj Bijnori

items.title: Mashkeeza ghazi
items.body:
mashkeeza ghazi bhara hai leke chullu mein furaat
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde mein sarwar gaye jab asr ka hangaam tha
chal raha tha kund khanjar bas khuda ka naam tha
zainab e muztar ke lab par nauha subho shaam tha
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi khaye ran mein akbar teer khaye aur sagheer
berida ahle haram jab hogaye abid aseer
naiza par sar haye aqda aur thay farqe muneer
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar zulm o sitam aada ke mai tharra gayi
kya kahun sheh ki shahadat kis khadar tadpa gayi
haye wo bali sakina shimr se ghabra gayi
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki khatir behen maqtal mein roti aayi thi
dil ko thaame berida mai kya khun ghabrayi thi
jab chini sar se ridayein kis khadar sharmayi thi
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani ki khatir huwe jaate thay bacche bad hawas
seh gaya jor o sitam ghazi mera tha sheh ka paas
thi alamdar e hussaini se badi zainab ko aas
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
thi haram ko hazrat e abbas se dhaaras bandhi
baad e abbas e jari mujhko rasan baandhi gayi
bhai ke sookhe galay par shimr ne pheri churi
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath karwa kar qalam likhi hai tareekh e wafa
nusrat e shabbir mein ghazi bhi shaane de gaya
jaan se pyara rakha gham hazrat e shabbir ka
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhar chuka tha mashk mein pani na pani wo piya
nehr ke pani pe bhi saaya na uska hai pada
taa'at e shabbir mein shaamil huwe tan se juda
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate abbas se zaahir tha ejaaz e ali
karbal mein saani e hyder tha dam saaz e ali
bhaag utha hai lashkar e keen sunke awaaz e ali
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaiz mein aaya jari jibreel ke shay par khule
kya jari ke maujize thay raaz lashkar par khule
maqsad e shabbir par abbas ke jauhar khule
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar bali sakina ko wo rakhta tha azeez
khair o shar ki hogayi karbobala mein ek tameez
uske gham mein roti thi fizza bhi zehra ki kaneez
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo shaam e ghariban haye wo bazaar e shaam
thay layeeno ki zuban par bekason ke paak naam
ahlebaite mustafa thay aur nigaahe khaas o aam
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabir o iqbal thay wo zainab e muztar ke bain
baad e abbas e ali jab chin chuka tha sab ka chain
pyase zibha hogaye zehra ke shaahe mashraqain
mashkeeza ghazi bhara...
items.author: Iqbal Abedi

items.title: Momino hydere karar
items.body:
momino hyder e karrar bulaate hai tumhe
daastan e ghame shabbir sunate hai tumhe
dil e abid ka har ek zakhm dikhate hai tumhe
khud bhi rote hai sar e bazm rulaate hai tumhe
jalte qaimon se jo sholon ki lapak aati hai
shaam ke dasht mein bijli si chamak jaati hai
momino hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
saf e matam hai bapa is mein bhi shirkat ho jaaye
chand aansu jo baha loge ibadat ho jaaye
sar khule aao ke takmeel e mohabbar ho jaaye
is tarha hazrate shabbir ki bayyat ho jaaye
fatema zehra bhi hai sayyed e abraar bhi hai
yehi majlis hai jahan ahmed e mukhtar bhi hai
momino hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chashme hyder mein hai aansu zara matam kar lo
saf azadaar ki is bazm mein qaayam kar lo
jo ta'alluq hai nabi zaadon se mohkam kar lo
ghame shabbir ko har haal mein mehram kar lo
ya hussain ibne ali ibne ali kehte raho
ashk ban ban ke sar e karbobala behte raho
momino hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho shabbir ka kuchla hua laasha dekho
nanhi si qabr mein asghar ka janaza dekho
ali akbar ka ubalta hua seena dekho
kitna majboor hai saqqa e sakina dekho
bhai ne paayi shahadat raha tanha bhai
pyaas ay hussain ali asghar ki na bujhne paayi
momino hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
majlise shaam e ghariban hui barpa logon
bekafan soti hai laashe dil e zehra logon
teen din hogaye pyasi hai sakina logon
ab to do zainab e dilgeer ko pursa logon
kis khadar aale mohamed pe sitam toote hai
zaalimon ne badi shiddat se haram loote hai
momino hyder e karrar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin yaseen kahin taaha ki tajalli un mein
kahin rehman o muzammil ki tashaffi un mein
kahin kausar kahin asraa ki ta'alli un mein
kahin tatheer ki pur noor tasalli un mein
naam hum kaun sa le saikdon naam unke hai
aarzoo jinka nahi koi imam unke hai
momino hyder e karrar...
items.author: Aarzoo

items.title: Abbas ay shere jawan
items.body:
ahle haram ke pasban abbas ay shere jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta tha zehra ka pisar thaame huwe tooti kamar
bhai mere tum so gaye ab kaun le meri khabar
dekho meri tanhaiyan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum thay alamdar e jari lashkar ki tum se shaan thi
waqif thay tum is baat se tum se hai meri zindagi
koi nahi mera yahan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaane tumhare kat gaye ghode se tum kaise giray
sar par laga gurz e sitam tum kis khadar zakhmi huwe
saare badan se khoon rawan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
har gaam par thay hum safar har lamha thay seena sipar
ay tashnalab bhai mere choda mujhe kis mod par
har simt hai veeraniyan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis simt jaati hai nazar khanjar hai aur teer o tabar
abbas kuch hi dayr mein kat jayega mera bhi sar
ab hai hamara imtehan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum se tha har dil ko bharam thay mutmain ahle haram
ek tum juda kya ho gaye so jayegi fauje sitam
jaagegi saari bibiyan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hai sakina ki fughan aa jao ammu ho kahan
kaise usay samjhaun mai us se karun kya kya bayan
mar jayegi wo neem jaan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk e sakina chid gayi hasrat thi tujhko jang ki
koi bhi teri aarzoo bhai na poori ho saki
bechain teri hichkiyan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere bhai ba-wafa allah ne tay kar liya
tere waseele se agar jo bhi kare dil se dua
bhar dega unki jholiyan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne kaha mere jari dil ki tadap hai ab yehi
maula kaha aaqa kaha ek baar kehdo bas aqi
dekho meri bechainiya abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne bhai kaha bhai se bhai chut gaya
matam rasheed ab hota hai pyase jari abbas ka
girya kuna hai bibyan abbas ay shere jawan
abbas ay shere jawan...
items.author: Rasheed Shaheedi

items.title: Abid ki kahani
items.body:
haye bemaar haye bemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj o alam mein doobi abid ki kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
pairon mein aabile hai aankhon se aansuon ki
hoti hai rawani
ranj o alam mein doobi abid ki kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
is baat ka nahi gham bazaar behaya hai
ummat ki berukhi hai ummat se hi gila hai
zainab bhi berida hai badli hai zaeefi mein
abid ki jawani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaari namazi hafiz haaji khade huwe thay
bazaron mein musalman saare bhare huwe thay
zainab ki pusht par hi bemaar e sareban ki
guzri hai jawani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat ke liye hi raahon mein mushkilein hai
koday hai aur kaanthe pathron ki barishein hai
qaime jo karbala mein jalte rahe thay ya rab
barsa nahi pani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab karbala ko aaye choota watan madina
choda jo karbala ko tanha hui sakina
sarwar ki shaahzadi kaise sahegi ya rab
zindan ki veerani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ko imamat deti hai shaam e ghurbat
mazloom sayyedon se kehti hai shaam e ghurbat
purse mein de rahi hoo bemaar ko aseeri
karbal ko kahani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na mehramon mein zainab beparda jab khadi thi
ummat ki teri nana ghairat kahan gayi thi
majma laga hua tha zainab jo pad rahi thi
aayaat e qurani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
<<DIVIDER>>
saaya hata hi tha ke abbas ke bharam ka
aaghaz hogaya tha sadaat pe sitam ka
deti rahi dilaasa pardes mein zainab ko
ghazi ki nishani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad jis tarha se aankhon se khoon roya
armaan wo kalam se kaise bayaan hoga
bedaar hogaye hum matam bata raha hai
nauhon ki zubani
ranj o alam mein doobi...
items.author: Armaan

items.title: Ashk barsao
items.body:
momino ke lab pa hai aah o buka
ashk barsao moharam aa gaya
cha gayi har soo masayab ki ghata
ashk barsao moharam aa gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ke ho jazbaat har pal nauhagar
saara aalam ho faqat askhkon se tar
aisi goonje wa hussaina ki sada
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gaye pardes mein choota watan
jin ke laashe dasht mein thay bekafan
un aseeron ka karo matam bapa
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna maula wo husaain ibne ali
jis ke dam se deen mein hai roshni
asr e ashoora wo suraj dhal gaya
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool ke haalat ki ye abtari
apni aankhein ashke gham se ho bhari
hai ghame shabbir har gham ki dawa
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala se shaam jab qaidi chale
pad gaye pairon mein unke aabile
is qadar dushwaar tha wo raasta
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
in pa rote hai sabhi jinn o malak
hai zameen ghamgeen pareshan hai falak
itna hai pur soz zikr e karbala
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
ho na madham aansuon ki roshni
ye wasiyat hazrat e zainab ki thi
us wasiyat ka hai tum ko waasta
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ghulamane shah e abraar hai
karbala waalon ke matamdaar hai
ye zameen shabbir ka hai ghamkada
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa ho farsh e aza ka ehtemaam
sadqa e shabbir mein langar ho aam
har aza khana ho ek neymat kada
ashk barsao..
<<DIVIDER>>
majlis o matam ho nauhe aur salaam
marsiye ho aur zaakir ka kalaam
raat bhar jaari rahe ye silsila
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqsad e shabbir ho apni hayaat
ho rawan har aankh se nehre furaat
ho tassawur tashnagi e shaah ka
ashk barsao...
<<DIVIDER>>
jitna ro sakte ho ro lo shaah par
khatm ho jaye na jaane kab safar
kya bharosa zindigi ka ay raza
ashk barsao...
items.author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi

items.title: Ay parchame abbas
items.body:
ay parchame abbas pharere ki hawa de
bas jaye jo sanson may wo khusbu e wafa de
<<DIVIDER>>
baandhi hui ek mashke sakina hai alam may
ghazi tere parcham ki ye pehchan kara de
ay parchame abbas…
<<DIVIDER>>
ta hashr rahe parchame abbas ka saaya
jo ranj o musibat ki hawaon se bacha de
ay parchame abbas…
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab koi masooma na is tarha se tadpe
ro ro ke jo zindan ke dar o baam hilade
ay parchame abbas…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye soch ke jaati hai sakina suye darya
ammu mere daaman may lagi aag bujhade
ay parchame abbas…
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti rahi maadar se watan jayenge kab tak
aisi koi surat ho jo sughra se milade
ay parchame abbas…
<<DIVIDER>>
thukraya hai baiyat ko yun shabbir ne azhar
hai kaun jo dunya may sawal iska uthade
ay parchame abbas…
items.author: Azhar

items.title: Baap ko rote rote
items.body:
baap ko rote rote sakina
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha logon ne abid se aa kar
hai ye zindan may shor kaisa
hum pe tooti hai phir ek qayamat
ro ke abid ne bas ye bataya
wo jo raaton ko karti thi nauha
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabt karti rahi apna girya
shimr ke darr se royi nahi thi
jab se choota hai baba ka seena
ek lamha bhi soyi nahi thi
baap ke moo pe moo rakh ke dukhiya
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar shaheedon ke jis waqt aaye
qaid khane may tha shor e matam
baap ke sar ko seene laga kar
aise royi labon par ruka dam
maa ye samjhi ke jaagi hazeena
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon bhara ek kurta kafan hai
ghusl ashkon se hi isko doonga
log apne na apna watan hai
is ghareebi may bhai kare kya
bekafan baap ki ye yateema
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr may kaise isko utaarun
dast o paa mere zanjeer may hai
sab ko samjha gayi meri behna
aur bhi zakhm taqdeer may hai
jee raha hoo mai aur meri behna
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhte likhte tadapta hai mazhar
bain bano ke aise thay safdar
shaam ki aurton se ye boli
ek diya tum jala dena aa kar
is andhere may ro ro ke dukhiya
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Chupa ke roti hai
items.body:
sitam jo dhaaye musalman ne mujhpe baade nabi
tadap ke dekhe hai hasnain ne sitam wo sabhi
mai aansuon ko chupa loongi tooti phasli bhi
jhuki kamar ye zaeefi na chup sakegi kabhi
shikasta pehlu mera aa ke dhaamp de fizza
ke aise haal mein zainab na dekh le fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
chupa ke roti hai bacchon se phasliyan zahra
ali ko dekh ke leti hai siskiyan zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
giraya jis ghadi zaalim ne dar ko pehlu par
pukarti rahi fizza ko naagahan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek saans pe phasli ko thaam leti hai
ali bhi dekh ke kehte hai al-amaan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jigar ke tukde huwe jaa rahe thay bibi ke
sanad ke tukde uthaana tha imtehan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
utha ke tukde sanad ke larazte haathon se
bataun kaise chali jaanib e makaan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kaun sa ummat ne zulm dhaaya hai
zaeef ho gayi ek din mein naujawan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na maa ke rone ki awaaz betiyan sunle
sisak ke leti rahi haye hichkiyan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
alaida hoti nahi pal ko betiyan maa se
ke phir milegi ye aaghosh aur na maa zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo apni daadi ke qatil se khud nimat lega
pisar jo aap ka aayega gyarwan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthega maa ka jo saaya to aasim o rizwan
bohat satayega hasnain ko jahan zahra
chupa ke roti hai...
items.author: Asim Zaidi

items.title: Dunya se ab safar hai
items.body:
dunya se ab safar hai bemaar e karbala ka
badla hua hai aalam gulzaar e karbala ka
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab ki zindagi bhi zindan se kam nahi thi
mabood aansuon se kab chashme nam nahi thi
kab aap ke labon par rudaad e gham nahi thi
dunya se ab safar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazron mein phir raha tha guzra hua zamana
haye wo jism e laaghar haye wo taaziyana
haye wo zulm e aada haye wo qaid khana
dunya se ab safar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pesh e nigaah e abid bedaad ashqiyan thi
shaam o sehar zaban par rudaad e karbala thi
magmoom zindagi thi aur yaad e kibriya tha
dunya se ab safar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chalees saal apne baba ka gham mana kar
khud apne aansuon ke shamme jala jala kar
ab mutmain chale hai gham se najaat paa kar
dunya se ab safar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baade hussain kya kya sadme utha ke aaye
zindan mein behan ki turbat bana ke aaye
karbobala my apna sab kuch luta ke aaye
dunya se ab safar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa rahi thi aksa, zainab ki be-ridayi
nazron mein phir raha tha kadiyal jawan bhai
tadpa rahi thi dil ko baysheer ki judaai
dunya se ab safar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazron mein phir raha tha ashoor ka wo manzar
aalam wo bekasi ka jalta hua wo bistar
haye wo rayghe sehra haye wo laashe sarwar
dunya se ab safar hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe pe aayenge jab bekas imam e baqir
dekhenge jis ghadi wo baba ka jism laaghar
kis dil se ay zaheer ab kaise bayan ho manzar
dunya se ab safar hai...
items.author: Zaheer Jaffery

items.title: Ghame fatema
items.body:
haye mazlooma fatema zehra
haye mehrooma fatema zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ka bhare madine may
gham batane koi nahi aaya
ghar jalane ko kalmago aaye
ghar bujhane koi nahi aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
kya wo islam ka hi markaz tha
kya madina tha wo mohamed ka
lag rahe thay jahan pe zahra ke
taaziyane koi nahi aaya
fatema ka bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
rassiyan thi ali ki gardan may
aur bazaar se guzarte thay
sab tamashayi ban ke takte rahe
aur chudane koi nahi aaya
fatema ka bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar jala qatl hogaye mohsin
phasliyan sayyeda ki toot gayi
phir bhi kehte ho tum ke zehra par
zulm dhaane koi nahi aaya
fatema ka bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud hi chunne lagi nabi zaadi
bikhri tehreer apne baba ki
mustafa ki sanad ke tukdon ko
jab uthaane koi nahi aaya
fatema ka bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
har sitam fatema pe dhaaya gaya
jalta darwaza bhi giraya gaya
apne mehdi ko di sada usne
jab bachane koi nahi aaya
fatema ka bhare...
<<DIVIDER>>
aath shawwal ko hui akbar
phir shahadat nabi ki beti ki
gir raha tha mazaar bibi ka
aur bachane koi nahi aaya
fatema ka bhare...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Halmin nasirin
items.body:
thi yehi dashte musibat mein sada e sarwar
hai koi jo ke sune aaj nida e sarwar
kya hai koi jo chala aaye bara e sarwar
hal min nasirin yan surna
<<DIVIDER>>
haye is dasht mein be-monis o be-yaar hussain
har nafas khaate hai aghyaar se aazaar hussain
koi to aaye sada dete hai nadaar hussain
hal min nasirin yan surna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghir gaye fauje sitamgar mein shehenshah e umam
zakhm pe zakhm diye jaati hai tayghe payham
aur har zakhm hum tumko bulaate hai baham
hal min nasirin yan surna...
<<DIVIDER>>
aandhiyan teeron ki toofan hai talwaron ke
zakhm hai dil pe shahe deen ke ghamkharon ke
muntazir hai shahe deen dasht mein ansaron ke
hal min nasirin yan surna...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye pani na dam e marg hamein mil paaya
tashnalab tashna dahan reh gaya zehra jaaya
aur honton pe thi awaaz e hazeen wavaila
hal min nasirin yan surna...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe deen tanha hai aur dasht mein hangame bala
kho ke akbar sa pisar aur shahenshah e wafa
ab bulaye kise nusrat ko shahe karbobala
hal min nasirin yan surna...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin khanjar kahin talwaar kahin par naiza
har taraf chaayi hai maqtal mein qayamat ki ghata
haye koi nahi ghamkhaar raha ab mera
<<DIVIDER>>
aise aalam mein ho alfaaz e shahe karbobala
ab nahi kuch raha hamraah mere gham ke siwa
hil gaya farshe zameen kaamp utha arshe ulaa
<<DIVIDER>>
haye darya pe laraz utha jari ka laasha
sunke awaaz meri ro diya asghar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
labbaik labbaik labbaik ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
is sada ka to ye matlab hai ke hum haazir hai
itrat e ahmed e mukhtar ke hum nasir hai
surat e ashk to jazbaat sabhi zaahir hai
kaho labbaik ya hussain kaho labbaik ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jo shahadat hai usi sheh ke talabgaar hai hum
jaan dene ke liye aal pe tayyaar hai hum
door maqtal se hai par bar sare paikaar hai hum
kaho labbaik ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas zaban se nahi hum dil se hai maula ke ghulam
bas wohi karna hai jo shaah ko matloob hai kaam
zulm ko karte rahenge yuhin ta-dum na-kaam
kaho labbaik ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne aamaal se af'aal se kirdaar se hum
jang karte hi chale aaye hai aghyaar se hum
khauf kuch khaate nahi naiza o talwaar se hum
kaho labbaik ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi labbaik kaha bad gayi zimmedari
nusrat e shaah ki har rukh se ho ab tayyari
deen se qurbat ka safar dunya se ho bedaari
kaho labbaik ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqsad e hazrat e shabbir ho maqsad apna
bas wohi chahiye jis mein shahe deen ki riza
ar kuch bhi nahi darkaar hai is shay ke siwa
kaho labbaik ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan dene ko hai tayyar azadar e hussain
dayam o yazdan e ghamkhar hai ghamkhar e hussain
john sa hausla rakhte hai fida kaare hussain
kaho labbaik ya hussain...
items.author: Dayam Najafi

items.title: Haye khaak hai sar
items.body:
haye khaak hai sar mein zainab hai safar mein
kab hogi reha qaid se kab jayegi ghar mein
<<DIVIDER>>
tareekh teri jang ko dohraati rahegi
asghar jo ladi tu ne nanhi si umar mein
haye khaak hai sar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek waqt tha shehzadi thi haye kufe ki zainab
kis haal mein aayi hai baba ke shehar mein
haye khaak hai sar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre huwe baalon se moo dhaamp lo bibi
mahaul sharabi hai teri raah guzar mein
haye khaak hai sar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis parde ka zaamin tha abbas dilawar
hai zakhm usi parde ke abid ke jigar mein
haye khaak hai sar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
thay tan pe phatay kapde aur kaan bhi zakhmi
abid ne utaara jo sakina ko qabar mein
haye khaak hai sar mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke matam se haye rokne waalo
zainab ki ye sunnat hai momin ki nazar mein
haye khaak hai sar mein...

items.title: In ankhon ne dekha
items.body:
marqad pe bayan karti thi ye zainab e dukhiya
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane ke liye aayi hoon kya kya
in aankhon ne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir liye aaye abaa mein jo utha kar
tha dard ka manzar
pamaal shuda qasim e naushah ka laasha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki sada sun ke jo maidan gaye thay
bhaiya thay akele
bete ke jawan laash ko laate huwe tanha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha seena e aqdas pa chada shimre sitamgar
tha haath mein khanjar
khanjar ke talay aap ke bete ka gala tha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam hui ban mein to phir zulm naya tha
phat'ta tha kaleja
hote huwe pamaal mere bhai ka laasha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam e gariban mein jalaye gaye qaime
har simt thay shole
sholon ki lapeton mein wo jalta hua jhoola
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zulm o sitam shaam talak karbobala se
bacchi pa huwe thay
ruksaar sakina pa wo har ek tamacha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazron se sakina ki nigahon ko bachaye
darya ke kanare
haathon ko kataye mera abbas pada tha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum log rasan basta phiraye gaye dar dar
be-makhna o chadar
bazaron mein bante huwe khud apna tamasha
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad pa jameel ek qayamat ka samaan tha
zainab ka tha nauha
amma ye kaho aur sunaun tumhe kya kya
in aankhon ne dekha
amma mai sunane...
items.author: Jameel Moosavi

items.title: Jangal may mujhko
items.body:
jangal mein mujhko chod kar akbar kahan gaye
chilla rahi hai dayr se maadar kahan gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
sadme teri judaai ke kaise uthaye maa
awaaz kuch to do mere dilbar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene mein isteraab hai dar par nigaah hai
ay mere hum shabihe payambar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
paigham maut ka tha ye attharwan baras
noor e nigaah sibte payambar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay hashmi jawan tamanna e fatema
ay arzoo e saaqi e kausar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki nigaah mein tareek hai jahan
laila ke chand mere munawar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar hai udaas bali sakina hai beqarar
ay rooh e jaan e hyder o safdar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaise dekhe nana ki tasveer ko hussain
aaeena e jamaal e payambar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa tum ko dhoondti hai andhere mein raat ke
ghar bhar ki raushni mahe anwar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
aada e deen le gaye asbaab loot kar
chinti hai ab sakina ki chadar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya hai shimr qaime jalane ke waaste
chadar haram ki chinti hai akbar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa kar madine waalon ko mai doongi kya jawab
poochenge jab jawan ali akbar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
saydaniyo ke beech mein laila ke thay ye bain
maa ko akela chod kar akbar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab silsila hayaat ka tootega ay qamar
poochenge log khaadim e sarwar kahan gaye
jangal mein mujhko...
items.author: Qamar Lakhnavi

items.title: Kahin nahi hai
items.body:
kahin nahi hai safar may qayam zainab ko
abhi to jaana hai maqtal se shaam zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
luta ke apni kamayi jo pahunchi uske huzoor
bacha ke uski khudayi jo pahunchi uske huzoor
khuda ne pesh kiya apna jaam zainab ko
kahin nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
fana ke sayl may zainab ka bain reh jaye
khuda ka chehra liye ya hussain reh jaye
isi sabab se mila hai dawam zainab ko
kahin nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
azal abad ke tasalsul hai chahe din ho ke raat
har ek zamane may karna faqad hussain ki baat
nahi hai iske siwa koi kaam zainab ko
kahin nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahe to kis se jo us par guzar gayi haye
usay to kha gayi kufe ki khamoshi haye
magar hila na saka shor e shaam zainab ko
kahin nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo dekha sughra to kho diye hawaas tamaam
wo poochti bhi to sughra se kaise uska naam
ke khud na yaad raha apna naam zainab ko
kahin nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baraye arz o samaa raasta nikaalna hai
hudood e waqt se ye kaafila nikaalna hai
so de rahe hai qayadat imam zainab ko
kahin nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhe hussain ko ta-zinda kar diya hai naved
khuda ko usne jo pa-inda kar diya hai naved
ye khoon ka pursa hai yani salaam zainab ko
kahin nahi hai...
items.author: Ahmed Naved

items.title: Khutbae maula abbas
items.body:
kahin hurmat khuda ke ghar ki na pamal ho jaaye
tabhi farzand e kaaba hajj ko umreh se badal aaye
hussain ibn ali se taalib e bayyat jo dar aaye
ali ka sher biphra ghaiz se maathe pe bal aaye
sar e bait e khuda qamre bani hashim nazar aaya
ghazab se hazrat e abbas ne logon se farmaya
<<DIVIDER>>
sabhi hamd o sana uski ke jo hai khaaliq e akbar
zacha khaana mere baba ka ban jaata hai jis ka ghar
ye eenton ka makan kaaba bana jab aagaye hyder
sadaf ki qadr o qeemat kuch nahi hoti hai be gohar
ye qiblagaah e aalam asl mein tatheer ka ghar hai
wirasat hai mere ajdaad ki shabbir ka ghar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aray o kafiron roka hai jinka raasta tum ne
hai inki qurbatein nazdeek tar allah ke ghar se
agar mabood ki marzi nahi hoti to khud bad ke
ye hajr e aswad e kaaba mere maula ke le bose
jo farzand e nabi ke hukm ka pehra nahi hota
ye kaaba ek ghadi apni jagah tehra nahi hota
<<DIVIDER>>
agar marzi ye haq mansha mere maula ki na hoti
uqaab e hashmi ban kar karun parwaz mai aisi
parinde jitne udte hai hawaon mein ye bayyat ki
gire kat kat ke rayti pe bache na koi bhi baaqi
hussain ibne ali ke waste sar ko kata doonga
jo uthi aankh aaqa ki taraf to noch daalunga
<<DIVIDER>>
aray o buzdilon tum maut se kis ko daraate ho
hamay taygh o sina teeron kaman kyun kar dikhate ho
bani hashim ki jurrat aur shuja'at aazmate ho
ali ke sher ko lalkaar kar ghairat dilaate ho
saja rakhte hai har pal maut ko hum apni raahon mein
hamare ghar ke bacche khelte hai iski baahon mein
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan wo bad nasab fasiq sharabi ghasib o makkar
kahan aali nasab aur chashma e kausar ka ye sardar
zara socho ke kis ka ghar raha badkaar o bad kirdar
utaara kis ke ghar allah ne quran sa shaahkar
burayi ka sarapa wo ye sachayi ka paikar hai
wo ibne mawiyah tehra ye taahir ibn hyder hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chali rasme jahalat phir quraishi hum sifat tum se
wo pyase mustafa ke khoon ke thay tum nawase ke
na kar paaye jafa ahde ali mein ashqiyan jaise
hai zinda jab talak abbas tum kuch kar na paoge
koi haasil nahi mansooba e baatil ka ahle shar
khuda ka ghaiz tum par aur tumhari saari naslon par
items.author: Ali Rizvi Sachey

items.title: Magar bas hai khayal
items.body:
dabe jab hum na aglon se to inki kya haqeeqat hai
magar bas hai khayal iska ke ye nana ki ummat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ba-hamdolillah apne baazuon mein haq ki quwwat hai
garan saqlain se laraib apni ek zarbat hai
bashar kya shay hai mafooq ul bashar apni shuja’at hai
par e jibreel se poocho ke hum mein kitni taaqat hai
hamare saamne sab hech ye faujon ki kasrat hai
magar bas hai khayal...
dabe jab hum na...
<<DIVIDER>>
arab ke soormao’n ne muqabil aa ke dekha hai
sar e maidan shola taygh ka bhadka ke dekha hai
na bigda kuch to phir teeron ka mee barsa ke dekha hai
musalsal badr se siffeen tak takra ke dekha hai
dabe jab hum na...
magar bas hai khayal...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo khaynchun taygh paidal jaa ke aswaron sa takrayein
ke shole kufr ke dozagh ke angaaron se takrayein
ye baatil ki chatanein jaa ke kohsaro se takrayein
ye buzdil bhaag kar kufe ki deewaron se takrayein
ba-hamdolillah mujh tanha ke andar itni taaqat hai
magar bas hai khayal...
dabe jab hum na...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawanan e bani hashim to hai shab hi se aamada
namaz e subha se tayghein dhare hai zer e sajjada
wo dekho wo hassan ka laal wo akbar sa shahzada
alam ke zer e saaya sab se pehli saf mein istaada
mere sheron ko koi tok de ye kis mein himmat hai
magar bas hai khayal...
dabe jab hum na...
<<DIVIDER>>
faqat akbar mera nau laakh ke lashkar ko kaafi hai
ye tesha hi faqat har sang har patthar ko kaafi hai
ye peeri ka asa har saanp har ajdar ko kaafi hai
ali ki taygh hai saare zamane bhar ko kaafi hai
faqat keh doon ke haan jaan e pidar jao ijazat hai
magar bas hai khayal...
dabe jab hum na...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dekhenge ke pyase teen din ke kaise ladte hai
bahattar jin ko hum laaye hai unke kaise ladte hai
badon ka zikr kya sin kam hai jin ke kaise ladte hai
ye tez o tund toofano se tinke kaise ladte hai
ye samjhe hai ke bas moqoof pani par shuja’at hai
magar bas hai khayal...
dabe jab hum na...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye samjhe hai mere mauqaf se mujhko door kar lenge
ba-zor e taygh bayyat par mujhe majboor kar lenge
hata kar shamma parwano se kasbe noor kar lenge
sawaad e sham se haasil charagh e toor kar lenge
hamay bhi dekhna hai aaj in mein kitni taaqat hai
magar bas hai khayal...
dabe jab hum na...
items.author: Hasan Imdad

items.title: Mashko alam ka
items.body:
mashk o alam ka zikr wafa ki namaz hai
himmat ka tazkira hai magar dil gudaaz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
alfaz mukhtasar hai hikayat daraaz hai
abbas par nabi ke nawase ko naaz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas sher e haq ki adaon ka naam hai
abbas fatema ki duaon ka naam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ek naam hai insaniyat ka naam
abbas ek payam hai ikhlaas ka payam
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ek nizam hai akhlaakh ja nizam
abbas ek imam hai eesaar ka imam
<<DIVIDER>>
eesaar hai wafa hai murawwat hai sabr hai
barsega karbala mein jo khul kar wo abr hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaan o shikoh e jafar e tayyar ki qasam
hamza se bemisal jigar daar ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer se doshe hyder e karrar ki qasam
is ohda e jaleel ke meyaar ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
hum kyun kahe ke saani e karrar kaun hai
keh dega khud aalam ke alamdar kaun hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate hai is shikoh se abbas e ba-hasham
ek dosh par hai mashk to ek dosh par alam
<<DIVIDER>>
nazrein lagi hui hai suye qaima e haram
kehte hai ye samand se haan tez tar qadam
<<DIVIDER>>
neki ka hai ye kaam to ujlat ghazab ki hai
pyase rahe jo khud ye karamat nasab ki hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ke gham mein tha jo mohamed ka noor e ain
aankhon mein ashke gham thay to sookhe labon pa bain
<<DIVIDER>>
rote thay is taraf to shenshensahe mashraqain
abbas ke labon pa musalsal tha ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka naam leke jahan se guzar gaye
mashk o alam ki khair ho abbas mar gaye

items.title: Mere aansu
items.body:
moti hai shifa'at ke shifa hai mere aansu
naazan hoon ke zahra ki dua hai mere aansu
<<DIVIDER>>
har zakhm ka marham hai har ek gham ka madawa
aejaaz e maseeha hai dawa hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir jaata hoon sajde mein muaafi ke liye mai
ek pal ko jo lagta hai khafa hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mashk e sakina se baham in ki rawani
gehrayi mein zamzam se siwa hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar amaanat hai mere dosh e wafa par
ek ajre risalat bakhuda hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kausar se inhe koi alag kar nahi sakta
darya e mawaddat mein fana hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
aane do zara ghaib se is waaris e gham ko
khul jayega har aankh pe kya hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
har qalb o nazar ko nahi milti ye baharein
tahweel e alam jin ki ghiza hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaate nahi ek aankh bhi ye ahle sitam ko
paighame shah e karbobala hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zanjeer ki jhankaar se di jis ne azaanein
us abid e muztar ki ataa hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu baani o mukhtare aza e shahe deen hai
zainab teri mehnat ka sila hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sharminda na ho jaaye sar e hashr kaleem aa
kehlaane pade haq se qaza hai mere aansu
moti hai shifa'at ke...
items.author: Kaleem Zafar

items.title: Aakhri lori
items.body:
aakhri lori hai meri jaan kar bejaan hoon mai
ay khuda taala na mujhko aazmana maa hoon mai
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhe nanhe haath aur pyase labon ko choom kar
mai kaha karti thi asghar ab agar jaaungi ghar
mai padhungi teri surat tu kare quran hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
putliyan aankhon ki meri tujhse le kar roshni
itni roshan hogayi ke bheek maange chandni
ay mere mahtaab aaja muztar o giryan hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri shab hai sahar is shab ki kya dikhlaye rang
hai munajaate khuda yan us taraf tayyar jang
tu ladega kis tarha aada se yun hairaan hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
nusrate shabbir to karna hai tum ko bhi magar
muskurahat tere lab par aur udhar teer o tabar
tujhpe ay nanhe mujahid is liye qurban hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
saari maayein apni qurbani karengi pesh kal
chaahti hoon tu idhar maidan mein aise nikal
taake mai bhi keh sakun ek askari ki maa hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhyaan bas itna rahe behre viran jaate huwe
chand qatre pani pee leena jo qismat se mile
ek teri tashna dahani se bohat bejaan hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
subho se aaghaz hoga teer ki barsaat ka
khoon fishan chehra nazar aane laga hai raat ka
teeron se bach kar raho karti dua har aan hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa dua karti rahi rehaan jhoole ke qareeb
laaj rukhiyo maadare asghar ki rabbul aalameen
meri qurbani hai asghar be sar o samaan hoon mai
aakhri lori hai meri...
<<DIVIDER>>
guftagu maadar ki sunkar bezuban kehne laga
kaise so jaaun mai ke sona hai zameene garm par
mai to sojaunga khaa kar teer kal maidan mein
haan magar tum so nahi paaogi amma umr bhar
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Abid ki zanjeer
items.body:
ye kaisi rehaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ki zanjeer utaari jaati hai
roohe sakina sadqe waari jaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki turbat par girti hai naaqe se
qabr pe jab zainab ki sawari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ki takleef sakina se poocho
kaise yahan par raat guzari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoondne turbat maqtal mein shash maahe ki
ghutniyon chal kar maa bechari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ke pairon ka waram jaata hi nahi
saath lehed tak ye beemari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ki mayyat ek aisi mayyat hai
qabr mein jo do baar utaari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
roti hai darbar mein ghazi ki ghairat
zainab le kar naam pukari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadpati hai aun o mohamed ki yaadein
jab hujron mein maa dukhyari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
pusht pe abid ki durron se shaam talak
zulm ki ek tasveer ubhari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir o akhtar ashk na roko nauhe mein
jannat tak awaaz tumhari jaati hai
abid ki zanjeer...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Akeli hai zehra
items.body:
kahan jaaye aakhir bayaban har soo
shikasta hai pehlu akeli hai zehra
rone pe pehra masayab ka sehra
akeli hai zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
dar e fatema ko jalaya hai tumne
kiya waada apna bhulaya hai tumne
tamache na maaro musalmano jao
ali ko bulao akeli hai zehra
rone pe pehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayan kis se jaa kar karun dard apna
hai ghairon ki dunya nahi koi apna
koi jaake baba se jakaar ye kehdo
ke le jao aakar akeli hai zehra
rone pe pehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay lakhte jigar ay hassan ibne hyder
ye nana ke pehlu me sone na de gar
tum aa jaana pehlu mein so jaana maa ke
baqi mein yahan par akeli hai zehra
rone pe pehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe karbala ne kaha roke maa se
ye mazloom bete ne mazloom maa se
akela hoo mai bhi akeli hai zainab
akele hai baba akeli hai zehra
rone pe pehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
sare marg akhtar hai zahra ka nauha
kab aaoge mehdi kab aaoge beta
khuda ke liye ab ye parda hatao
chale aao aao akeli hai zehra
rone pe pehra...
items.author: Akhtar Zaidi

items.title: Ashke gham may
items.body:
ashk e gham may hai neha karb ke manzar kitne
chand khatron may simat aaye samandar kitne
<<DIVIDER>>
janisaran e hussaini hai parakhle dunya
hum bhi dekhe ke tere paas hai khanjar kitne
ask e gham may…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar to zakhmi hua apna ye magar jaan gaye
kis kamigaah se phayke gaye pathar kitne
ask e gham may…
<<DIVIDER>>
naam allah ka lene ke liye maaz-allah
log tameel kiye baithe hai khyber kitne
ask e gham may…
<<DIVIDER>>
ulfate aal ka dunya ne sila khoob diya
lutgaye kitne makeen khaak huye ghar kitne
ask e gham may…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aalam hai ke rota hai ghame sarwar may
bandh baandhenge jigar aap to ghar ghar kitne
ask e gham may…

items.title: Ay parindo dare zindan
items.body:
ay parindo dar e zindan se guzra na karo
ek yateema ko sar e shaam se sataya na karo
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aata hai har ek lamha madina usko
raas aaya na watan chod ke jeena usko
zakhm jo usko mile hai unhe taaza na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhti hai tumhe jab laut ke ghar jaate huwe
uski aankhon se ubhalte hai lahoo ke chashme
itna royi hai usay aur rulaaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ho azaad mubarak ho tumhe azaadi
qaid e zindan mein sakina hai magar faryadi
ek dukhe dil ko idhar aake dukhaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo zindan hai jahan qaid hai pyasi bacchi
ser o sehraab ho tum bujh na saki pyaas uski
raasta apna badal do idhar aaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap se pehle pehel chooti hai kamsin hai bahot
dekh kar tumko tadap jayegi mumkin hai bahot
abhi jao to teherne ka iraada na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumko maloom nahi kitni ghutan hai usko
dil bhi zakhmi hai safar ki bhi thakan hai usko
uski takleef mein ab aur izaafa na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
is yatema pe bahot tang hui hai dunya
tum jidhar chaahe chale jao badi hai dunya
qaid khane ke khareeb aa ke basera na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghair mumkin hai yateemi usay mehsoos na ho
aisi shamma hai ke jiska koi fanoos na ho
apne bacchon ka paron ka yahan saaya na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj tak qabre sakina par udaasi hai suroor
dil ye kehta hai wo bacchi abhi pyasi hai suroor
uspe rone ke siwa koi bhi nauha na karo
ay parindo dar e zindan...
items.author: Suroor Lakhnavi

items.title: Baap se uthega
items.body:
boli laila ke tu marne ko jo aamada hai
tune humshakle nabi ye bhi zara socha hai
tu ke kadiyal hai jawan aur padar boodha hai
ke baap se uthega akbar tera laasha kaise
<<DIVIDER>>
baap se uthega akbar tera laasha kaise
wo isay qaime mein le jayega tanha kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo to is aas pe jeeti hai ke tu aayega
apni behna ko bhare kunbe se milwayega
dekhna chod de sughra tera rasta kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
tune jin galiyon mein bachpan hai guzara apna
ab wahan kaun hai humshakle nabi tu hi bata
bhool jayega bhala tujhko madina kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
chaar jaanib hai yahan tashnalabi ke dere
tujhse bad kar hai zaban khushk padar ki tere
phir bhi dekhein tera baba tujhe pyasa kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
tune kyun us se hi marne ki raza maangi hai
jisne har dam tere jeene ki dua maangi hai
ye phupi bin tere reh payegi zinda kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
laal ko paala hai aankhon mein basa kar tumne
bar sare karbobala maadar e akbar tumne
zakhm seene pe jawan laal ke dekha kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se maqtal ko jo naazon ka pala aata hai
phir se aakar koi akbar se lipat jaata hai
yun uthe aur na gire qaime ka parda kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
gham raha bete ka beenayi to baakhi hi na thi
kaampte haath thay shabbir se pooche koi
tumne phal barchi ka seene se nikaala kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn laila ke thay zakhmi jo tere chehra hai
khaak balon mein hai peshani se khoon behta hai
ye batade mai banaun tujhe dulha kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne izhaar ghame shaah mein matam hi kiya
yaad e akbar mein sada aankh ko purnam hi kiya
ho bapa shaam o sehar dil mein na girya kaise
baap se uthega akbar…
items.author: Ali Izhaar

items.title: Bhai ki awaaz
items.body:
ay ali akbar zara pehchaan lo
ye to mere bhai ki awaaz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ya elahi khair se darya pe ho
ye to mere bhai ki awaaz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tukde tukde dil hai is awaaz se
mujhko milwa do mere hamraaz se
ghaur se beta ali akbar suno
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
do sahara baap ko noor e nazar
is sada ne tod di meri kamar
dasht mein naade ali padhte raho
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
maar daalega hamein bhai ka gham
kya nazar aata nahi akbar alam
kis liye khamosh ho kuch to kaho
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo bhi gir gaya ghode se lo
zainab o kulsoom ki dhaaras tha jo
jald us ke paas mujhko le chalo
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise uthega jawan bhai ka gham
ladkhadate hai ali akbar qadam
bad ke do beta sahara baap ko
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat gaye lagta hai baazu sher ke
maar daala dushmano ne ghayr ke
dayr ho jaaye na ab jaldi karo
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun faza e alqama ghamgeen hai
khoon se saari zameen rangeen hai
aa rahi hai mustaqil darya se jo
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
muntazir hai nehr par bhai mera
raasta takta hai shehdayi mera
bas isi awaaz par badhte raho
ye to mere bhai ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aamir o akhtar bala ka dard tha
sun kar ye awaaz chehra zard tha
fikr thi ran mein yehi shabbir ko
ye to mere bhai ki...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Chuth raha hai nana
items.body:
chuth raha hai nana ka aastan meri zainab
bhai ka hua dushman ye jahan meri zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
tang hai zameen mujh par har taraf se nargha hai
hai qareeb bhai par imtehan meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhta rahoo kab tak rang ye zamane ka
dab rahi hai saazon mein ab azan meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
waada apna tifli ka ab mujhe nibhana hai
haath mein rasan hogi pasban meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka safar tere laazmi hai ay khaahar
alqama pe tehrega karwan meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
deen e haq ki nusrat ko karbala ke jangal mein
khoon se naha'ega karwan meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
baad mere ahle keen zulm tum pe dhayenge
baazu'on mein baandhenge rassiyan meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid ho ke jaogi shaam aur kufay mein
pehne hoga abid bhi bediyan meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh safar ka pas manzar kehke chup hue saaghar
mai hoon haq ki marzi par shadman meri zainab
chuth raha hai…
items.author: Saghar Naqvi

items.title: Dunya se chale
items.body:
har ghar mein bichao farshe aza
dunya se chale zaamin maula
<<DIVIDER>>
kazim ke paak dulaare ko
mamoon ne qaatil zeher diya
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chaak gareban zakhmi jigar
aayi hai yateemi maula par
karte hai taqi maula matam
masoom huwe baba se juda
har ghar mein bichao...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadaat pe ghurbat chaayi hai
mashhad se sada ye aayi hai
phir aale nabi ka ghar ujda
phir ek ali hai qatl huwa
har ghar mein bichao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kazim ke laal ka hai matam
hai nauha kuna saara aalam
maula ko nasle umayya ne
hai qatl kiya be-jurm o khata
har ghar mein bichao...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis bhai se milne ke liye
hamsheer ne paidal safar kiye
afsos wohi bhai na raha
masooma e qum karti hai buka
har ghar mein bichao...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom raza ki mayyat par
rote hai nabi zehra hyder
girya hai shaam ki makhdooma
rota hai ghareeb e karbobala
har ghar mein bichao...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sog ka aalam hai taari
rote hai imame zamana bhi
jawad zamane mein jaari
matam hai imam e zaamin ka
har ghar mein bichao...
items.author: Jawad Jafri

items.title: Halmin nasirin
items.body:
ye kehte hai maqtal se ab bhi shahe abraar
haq baat pe mar jaana ay mere azadaar
hal min nasirin yansurna
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan gawa dena izzat na gawana
dekho mera sajda tum bhool na jaana
tum hi to ho mere maqsad ke alamdaar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakhna nigahon mein abid ki aseeri
haathon mein hathkadiyan aur paon mein bedi
hona jo zamane ki musibat mein giraftaar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
<<DIVIDER>>
rona jawano tum akbar se jawan ko
bhool nahi jaana awaaz e azan ko
ban jaana zamane mein islaam ka kirdaar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye ye majboori haye ye ghareebi
baap ne khud bete ki qabr banayi
hilti thi zameen ran ki jab roti thi talwaar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakhna hifazat mein behno ki ridayein
tumko khuda bakshe us sar ki wafayein
wo sar ke jo naize se gir jaata tha har baar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne abid ke tha hashr ka manzar
balwe mein zainab thi be maqna o chadar
tum bhool nahi jaana wo shaam ka bazaar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
<<DIVIDER>>
padta hua nauha karta hua maatam
dard liye dil mein aur haath mein parcham
yun aayega ghaibat se dunya ka nigehdaar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayar o zakir ho ay nayyar o aamir
haan tum mere nasir ho ay nayyar o aamir
abbas mera hoga tum sab ka madadgaar
hal min nasirin yansurna...
items.author: Nayyar Jalalpuri

items.title: Haye kis tarha kati
items.body:
haye kis tarha kati sham e ghariban zainab
kitna purhol tha karbal ka bayaban zainab
haye kis tarha…
<<DIVIDER>>
aag qaimon mein lagi bhai bhatije na pisar
kitni us waqt hui aap pareshan zainab
haye kis tarha…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek barchi ne jigar kar diya chalni warna
kitne thay dil mein tere hasrat o armaan zainab
haye kis tarha…
<<DIVIDER>>
aag ke sholon se sajjad ko laayi kyon kar
aaj tak qalb hai us haal pe giriya zainab
haye kis tarha…
<<DIVIDER>>
qalbe majrooh pe kya guzri shabe ghurbat mein
aaya jis waqt nazar ganje shaheedan zainab
haye kis tarha…
<<DIVIDER>>
toota sa naiza liye aap andheri shab mein
misle abbas rahi sab ki nigehban zainab
haye kis tarha…
<<DIVIDER>>
pusht par haath bandhe sar khule aada ke sitam
kaise dafnati bhala laashe shaheedan zainab
haaye kis tarha....

items.title: Hussain aaya hai
items.body:
hussain aaya hai dekho to ek nazar amma
sadayein deta hai kab se tera pisar amma
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho zainab o kulsoom ro rahi hai wahan
tadap ke bhaiya hassan kar rahe hai aah o fughan
na jao aise bhare ghar ko chod kar amma
hussain aaya hai dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun hum se rooth ke jaati ho is tarha bolo
mai tumko jaane nahi doonga aankh to kholo
nahi tumhare bina umr ka basar amma
hussain aaya hai dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa daur hamay waqt ne hai dikhlaya
saron se uthgaya bachpan mein aap ka saaya
katega kaise tere baad ye safar amma
hussain aaya hai dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tumko kab se jagata hoon kyun nahi uth'ti
sadayien deta hoon ro ro ke bolti hi nahi
khudara bolo ke phat'ta hai ab jigar amma
hussain aaya hai dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheed hogaya mohsin jalaya ghar amma
tumhara pehlu hai zakhmi giraya dar amma
jina mein dena ye nana ko sab khabar amma
hussain aaya hai dekho...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad maza kuch nahi hai jeene ka
hai sogwaar har ek baam o dar madine ka
mujhe bhi le chalo jaati ho tum jidhar amma
hussain aaya hai dekho...
items.author: Ali Rizvi Sachey

items.title: In kasarat zahri
items.body:
do haath haathon par liye kehte thay ye sibte nabi
bhai mera maara gaya kis kaam ki ab zindagi
in kasarata zahri ya aqi in kasarata zahri ya aqi
<<DIVIDER>>
monis nahi hamdam nahi nasir nahi yawar nahi
dushman ke lashkar char soo mera koi lashkar nahi
abbas aankhein khol kar dekho to tanhaai meri
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis se kahun dunya ne jo tujhpar mazalim dhaaye hai
aankhon se dekhun kis tarha jo zakhm tu ne khaaye hai
shaane kate sar shak hua aankhon mein aaye teer bhi
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh dunga kya kulsoom se zainab se kya batlaunga
teri sakina ko bhala kya keh ke mai samjhaunga
khaali alam le jaunga qaime ke dar par jis ghadi
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein hai mehwe dua sab behne teri chaah mein
bacche bhi hai muntazir aankhein bichaye raah mein
kooze liye hai haath mein teri bhatiji laadli
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil mein koi dehshat na thi khatra koi sar par na tha
bhaiya tere hote huwe dushman ka koi darr na tha
ab wo bhi ruqsat hogayi bacchon ko ek dhaaras jo thi
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab karbala ke dasht mein shaam e ghariban aayegi
qaimon se uthega dhuaan kaali ghata cha jayegi
aakhir sada degi kise meri behen ki bekasi
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti wo jis ke naaz khud hyder uthaate aaye ho
hamraah jis hamsheer ko athara bhai laaye ho
ab us behen ke sar se bhi us ki rida chin jayegi
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya alqama ke ghaat par matam kuna hai koi maa
kya baal apne khol kar roti hai khatoone jina
ye kis ke nauhe ki sada lohe se takrane lagi

nayyar nahi likh payega aamir nahi pad payega

jo marsiya sheh ne padha wo marsiya soche koi
in kasarata zahri ya aqi...

items.body:
jannat ke sardar ya hassan

panjetan ke gharane ka jo hubdaar nahi hai

wo haqdaar nahi hai

tehreer mohamed ki jo khatir mein na laaye

batlao tumhi kya wo gunahgaar nahi hai
mehshar mein shafa'at ka wo haqdaar nahi hai
wo hubdaar nahi hai

<<DIVIDER>>
seena zani ye aansu hai momin ki nishani

gham mein hussain ke jo soghwaar nahi hai
mehshar mein shafa'at ka wo haqdaar nahi hai

wo haqdaar nahi hai

beyaar o madadgaar mohamed ka nawasa

mehshar mein shafa'at ka wo haqdaar nahi hai

farmaan e khuda se jise aetbaar nahi hai
mehshar mein shafa'at ka wo haqdaar nahi hai

aajaiye khudara mere baarwein imam

items.title: Kaho ya hussain
items.body:
hussain deen hai hussain deen panah
bina e la ilaah hussain baadshah
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
lut gaya zehra ke dil ka chain
kaho ya hussain
uth gaya hyder ka noor e ain
kaho ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
deen e khuda pe shaah ne ghar ko luta diya
waada kiya jo nana se usko wafa kiya
rote hai iske waaste yun shaah e mashrakain
kaho ya hussain
lut gaya zehra ke...
uth gaya hyder ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
seh roz ki wo pyaas aur tanha wo dilawar
hairat se dekhte hai unhe saare payambar
har ek nabi ke honton pe hai aaj ya hussain
kaho ya hussain
lut gaya zehra ke...
uth gaya hyder ka...

ran ko sidhaare qasim o akbar se naujawan
haathon pe zibha hogaya hazrat ka bezuban
asghar ke intezar mein bano ko kab hai chain
kaho ya hussain
lut gaya zehra ke...
uth gaya hyder ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime se sheh ki ruqsate aakhir ho kya bayan
zainab ke rukh pe bikhra hai kya yaas ka dhuan
kehti hai haye lut'ti hai baba ki zeb o zain
kaho ya hussain
lut gaya zehra ke...
uth gaya hyder ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ko utha ke ye shabbir ne kaha
beta hamare baad ho tum deen ke rahnuma
ye sunke bibiyon mein hai kohram o shor o shain
kaho ya hussain
lut gaya zehra ke...
uth gaya hyder ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki godh mein sar e shabbir kat gaya
kat ke buland naiza e khooli pe ho gaya
sar khole ran mein fatema karti rahi ye bain
kaho ya hussain
lut gaya zehra ke...
uth gaya hyder ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
farsh e aza se paaya hai ahsan ne ye faraz
dekha hassan ne matam e sarwar ka ye aijaz

kaho ya hussain
lut gaya zehra ke...
uth gaya hyder ka...

items.title: Karti hai bayan
items.body:
karti hai bayaan umme laila
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
sadme se jigar phat'ta hai mera
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zakhm laga tujhko dilbar
seene se nazar aata hai jigar
chalta hai mere dil par bhaala
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
armaano ki basti khaak hui
tasveer e tamanna chaak hui
khwabon ka tasalsul toot gaya
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamraah nahi koi is dam
behaal hai gham se shaahe umam
aankhon mein andhera hai chaaya
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to qayamat ka manzar
hai sheh ka gala zere khanjar
hai shimr e layeen seene pe chada
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kurta bhi hai saara khoon mein tar
aur cheene gaye kano se gohar
dekho to behan ka haal zara
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
asbaab bhi saare lut'te hai
qaime bhi hamare jalte hai
chinti hai hamare sar se rida
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kin aankhon se dekhun ye manzar
hai noke sina par tera sar
be gor o kafan laasha hai pada
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
har lamha hai aazaron mein
hai ahle haram bazaron mein
hamdard koi baakhi na raha
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil se na gaya akbar ka khayaal
aur maa ka tha aalam ye hilal
ta umr ye lab par tha noha
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
items.author: Hilal Mirza

items.title: Labbaik ya hussain
items.body:
labbaika ya hussain labbaika ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor o arbaeen pe hum ko bula hussain
labbaika ya hussain labbaika ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde ne tere deen ki izzat badhayi hai
teri nazam kaabe ke bhi kaam aayi hai
zinda hai tere naam se naame khuda hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kitne momineen jo haj par na jaa sake
baithe hai apne dil mein ye armaan liye huwe
is saal tere rauze pe haj ho ada hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya karbala hai sirf ameeron ke waaste
kya door se hi dekh ke mazdoor khush rahe
koi sabeel koi to rasta bana hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
awaaz de qadam nahi peeche hataunga
koi kahega haath to gardan kataunga
is khaadim e habeeb ka waada raha hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay karbala ke sayyed o sardar as salaam
suraj tawaf karke ye kehta hai subho shaam
tere diye se jalta hai mera diya hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis ko dikhaye zakhm maseeha koi nahi
maula hamara poochne waala koi nahi
hai kaun hum ghareebon ka tere siwa hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ka laasha dasht mein pamaal kar diya
quran hassan ka dasht mein saara bikhar gaya
tukdon se uske aati thi phir bhi sada hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri yateem bachi bhi peeche nahi hati
panjo ke bal chali hai wo lekin nahi ruki
ye kehte kehte aagayi usko qaza hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar tha tere ghareeeb ka pathar ke waar pe
tere pisar ke pairon ke chaalon mein khaar thay
phir bhi zuban se kehte tha beta tera hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad wohi bante hai bas zaair e imam
apne qalam se likhte hai abbas unke naam
ghazi se kehke karbala humko bula hussain
labbaika ya hussain...
items.author: Mir Sajjad Mir

items.title: Mashko alam udas
items.body:
mashk o alam udas hai saqqa udas hai
binte shahe umam ko kayi din ki pyas hai
mashk o alam udas hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
keha hai kaun mashk alam se hai mubtasir
lipti hui chacha se bhatiji ki aas hai
mashk o alam udas hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani mila to kehti thi amma bulaiye
mujhse kahin siwa ali asghar ki pyas hai
mashk o alam udas hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaun hai faraat ke saahil pa tashnalab
darya tadap utha hai samandar udas hai
mashk o alam udas hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay teere hurmala kahin raste mein teher ja
maadar ke dil ka tujhko agar kuch bhi paas hai
mashk o alam udas hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zuljanah door isay le na jaaiyo
tera sawaar fatema ki kul ataas hai
mashk o alam udas hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kal tak yahan sukoon tha qaime thay log thay
ab aag hai dhuaan hai lahoo hai hiraas hai
mashk o alam udas hai…

items.title: Mere aaqa mere maula
items.body:
mere aaqa mere maula
mere be-dast jari mere ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
aabru pyaas ki tune labe darya rakhi
tere rehwaar ke tapon ki garaj sunte hi
fauj sar pat baaghi
khud ba khud tham gaya darya ka bhi behta pani
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
aslahe mein tera hatyar hai bas ek naiza
koi talwaar nahi
phir bhi larzeeza tere roab se hai har shaami
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha baandh ke naize se bhara mashkeeza
haat nam ho na saka
tujhsa mohtaaj falak ne bhi na dekha koi
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
al atash ki wo sadayein pe jigar kat'ta hai
aur dil rota hai
taziyane hai musalsal jo sama'at pa teri
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
doo badoo aake lade tujhse bhala kiski majaal
chupke karne lage waar
kat gaye haath kamin gaah se talwar chali
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath jaise hi kate mashk ko daaton mein liya
rukh kiya qaimon ka
daf'atan mashk pe ek teer laga mashk chidhi
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk se pani ka behna tha ke dil baith gaya
ab to kuch bhi na raha
aise mein durz laga sar pa qayamat tooti
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhal gayi shaam bade raat ke saaye shahid
teeragi phail gayi
toota naiza liye bibi koi maqtal ko chali
mere ghazi abbas
mere aaqa mere maula...
