items.title: Momino sibte payambar
items.body:
shaheed e karbala hussain
qateel e nainawa hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
momino sibte payambar ka janaza le chalo
qalbe zehra jaane hyder ka janaza le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
bekafan tashna dahan bekas ghareeb aashufta haal
kushta e shamsheer o khanjar ka janaza le chalo
momino sibte payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sayyed o masoom o mehman o shahe dunya o deen
bekas o maghmoon o muztar ka janaza le chalo
momino sibte payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeenat e mohr e nabuwat raakib e dosh e rasool
raahat e jaan e payambar ka janaza le chalo
momino sibte payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ne chakki pees kar paala jise
dilbar e khatoon e mehshar ka janaza le chalo
momino sibte payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalimon ne qatl jisko be-khata ran mein kiya
us shahe mazloom o be-sar ka janaza le chalo
momino sibte payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat e aasi ki bakshish mein jo koshaan hogaya
us shafi e roz e mehshar ka janaza le chalo
momino sibte payambar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ki ibadat jis ne khaaliq ki tahe mehraab e taygh
us shaheed e raah e daawar ka janaza le chalo
momino sibte payambar...

items.title: Aakhri raat hai
items.body:
shamma zindan may manga de koi
aakhri raat hai sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa rahi hai hussain ki beti
aakhri raat hai sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo gardan pe hai rasan ka nishan
saath turbat may iske jayega
koi umme rabab se kehde
ab ye chehra nazar na aayega
aaj jee bhar ke dekh lo bibi
aakhri raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
paas baba ke jaane waali hai
ab tamache na koi maarega
qabr may to ghamon ki maari ke
koi gohar nahi utarega
jaake turbat may chain payegi
aakhri raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai janab e ameer ki poti
inteha ispe hai ghareebi ki
aalam e nazha ho gaya taari
saans rukne lagi hai bachi ki
reesma ab to kholdo iski
aakhri raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rone waali ki chalti saanson ko
aaj is tarha roka jaata hai
band hojaye shor girya ka
sare shabbir laaya jaata hai
hai mulaqaat baap beti ki
aakhri raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shor ye bediyon ka kehta hai
koi uth'ta hai koi girta hai
hai khabar ye ghareeb bhai ko
dam behan ka nikalne waala hai
abhi legi ye aakhri hichki
aakhri raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke sajjad khud se kehte thay
kaise mayyat utha'unga iski
qaid zanjeer may hai haath mere
qabr kaise bana'unga iski
be-kafan jayegi behan meri
aakhri raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisa manzar tha qaid may akbar
chaar jaanib tha shor giryan ka
laake sajjad ne sakina ki
godh may sar jo rakha baba ka
sare shabbir se sada aayi
aakhri raat hai...
items.author: Hasnain Akbar

items.title: Abid ko saath lekar
items.body:
abid ko saath lekar zainab madine aayi
utho rasool dekho hamraah kya kya laayi
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke manzar dekhi jo binte hyder
roti thi yaad kar ke jab hogayi rehaai
abid ko saath lekar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise uthaya shah ne kadiyal jawan ka laasha
sarwar ke dil se poocho farzand ki judaai
abid ko saath lekar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke galay par jab chal raha tha khanjar
aankhon mein hai wo manzar zainab jo dekh aayi
abid ko saath lekar...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar par na thi ridayein baazu bande huwe thay
aulaad fatema ki bazaar ho ke aayi
abid ko saath lekar...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbaar ka tha manzar tashte tila mein wo sar
har har qadam pa nana abid ko maut aayi
abid ko saath lekar...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbal se shaam tak bhi pyasi rahi sakina
ghut ghut ke aakhir usko zindan mein maut aayi
abid ko saath lekar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehre thay aansoun par kya saktiyan thi sajid
baba ko yaad kar ke bacchi na rone paayi
abid ko saath lekar...
items.author: Sajid Razvi

items.title: Akeli zahra
items.body:
kalma goyon may hui haye akeli zahra
sar e darbar gayi baba jhutlayi gayi
aap ki beti zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
kar ke tehreer ke tukde mujhe lautaya gaya
mere masoom gawahon ko bhi jhutlaya gaya
kehkahe sehti rahi aur sanad chunti rahi
aap ki sachi zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis gali may mujhe zaalim ne tamacha maara
jeete jee mera hassan phir na wahan se guzra
wo na bhoolega kabhi us se dekhi na gayi
khaak pe girti zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm pehlu ka to bachon se chupaya baba
par ye sadma mujhe turbat may bhi tadpayega
jab tamache khaaye dekha bachon ne mere
rok na paayi zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki zahra thi jalte huye dar ke neeche
aur haste huwe us par se musalman guzre
thokre khaati rahi ya ali kehti rahi
baba tumhari zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan toot ke uljhi hai kuch aise baba
saans leti hoo to dukhta hai kaleja mera
hai shikasta baazu kar nahi sakti ruku
zakhmi hai itni zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse kehne lagi zainab ay zaeefa bibi
ye hai kaunain ki malka ka musalla bibi
aisi haalat thi meri wo na pehchaan saki
saamne baithi zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
mekh jalte hue darwaze ki jab surkh hui
mere pehlu se wo mohsin ke badan may utri
haye dam tod gaya wo mujhe chod gaya
zinda hai phir bhi zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre zahra ki khamoshi ye buka karti hai
mera mohsin hai jo parde may mera mehdi hai
ab fidak ki khaatir apne haq ki khaatir
kuch na kahegi zahra
kalma goyon may hui...
items.author: Mohsin Jaffri

items.title: Ashkon se maine
items.body:
ashkon se maine shaam ka darbar likh diya
phir khoone dil abid e bemaar likh diya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo naam us ka shaamil e fauje yazeed tha
qismat ne hurr ko sheh ka tarafdaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki bekasi ke kayi baab khul gaye
likhne ko maine kufe ka bazaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar e karbala ke masayab na likh saka
kaagaz pe maine tauq e girabaar lik diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
tafseel e bekasi e sakina na likh saka
zindan e shaam ke dar o dewaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid chale to paaon ke chaalon ne khaak par
bekas ghareeb e khaafela salaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhna to tha ghulam hoo qambar ay viqar
khud ko ghulam e hyder e karrar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
items.author: Viqar Nagri

items.title: Ay qamre bani hashim
items.body:
ay qamre bani hashim gham kaise ho kam tera
sadiyon se rulaata hai abbas alam tera
<<DIVIDER>>
is daur pur khatar may is daur be-amaan may
bas ek aasra hai sarkar haram tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagta hai ke lipti hai ammu se sakina jaan
jab dekhte hai ek jaa mashkeeza alam tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
phookon se nahi hoga gul shamme aza sheh ka
hai paasban khudrat jis gham ka wo tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye seena zani sheh ki matam ye lahoo aala
ehsaan zamane par karta hai raqam tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
har dard ki manzil se guzre hai ye keh keh kar
ta hashr rahoo maula mamnoon karam tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh kehte thay ay bhai tooti hai kamar meri
bardaasht karoo kaise ghurbat may alam tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
kin sadmon se guzra hai tu jis se mere ghazi
alfaz nahi jin may ho dard raqam tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai e sarwar ka tha haal ajab ran may
lipte huwe laashe se karte rahe gham tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis naam ka bharti hai dam ab bhi wafa arif
be tok kahe taha abbas wo dam tera
ay qamre bani hashim...
items.author: Mir Taha Istefa

items.title: Baat ayegi parde ki
items.body:
baat aayegi parde ki to yaad aayegi zainab
tareekhe gham-o-dard ko dohraegi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
ut'ti jo nahi laashe jawan dijiye awaaz
paala hai to laasha bhi utha layegi zainab

<<DIVIDER>>
kis kis ko sambhalegi kise degi tasalli
jalte huve qaimon se kise layegi zainab
baat aayegi parde...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange jise dekh ke suraj bhi na nikla
ab sar khule balwe may wohi jayegi zainab
baat aayegi parde...
<<DIVIDER>>
machlegi jo sone ke liye raat ko bachi
kya de ke tasalli usay behlayegi zainab
baat aayegi parde...
<<DIVIDER>>
chadar hi ka de deti kafan cheenli wo bhi
ab bhai ko kis tarha se dafnayegi zainab
baat aayegi parde...
<<DIVIDER>>
purse ko anees aayenge aur puchenge ehwaal
kis kis ko nishan durro ke dikhlayegi zainab
baat aayegi parde...
items.author: Anees Pehersari

items.title: Bhai ki kamar toot
items.body:
laashe abbas pe kehte thay hussain ibne ali

<<DIVIDER>>
aat pehron se jo pyasa tha wafadar mera
kar liya nehr pe qabza bhi to pani na piya
jee ke ab kya karun jeene mein nahi lutf koi
bhai ke marne se...
laashe abbas pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jiska koi nahi saani wo wafa kar ke gaya
ek mashkeeze pe do baazu fida kar ke gaya
is wafadar ki furqat mein kahunga mai yehi
bhai ke marne se...
laashe abbas pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye battees baras saath nibhaya jis ne
ek shajar ki tarha mujh par kiya saaya jis ne
umr bhar bhai ko bhai na kaha jis ne kabhi
bhai ke marne se...
laashe abbas pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab wo ghode se gira mujhko sada di aise
baap ko beta musibat mein pukare jaise
wo sidhara to mujhe jeene ki khwahish na rahi
bhai ke marne se...
laashe abbas pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
thokarein khaata jo maqtal chala karke buka
baazu abbas ke dekhe to wahin baith gaya
choom kar baazu e abbas kaha dil ne yehi
bhai ke marne se...
laashe abbas pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne zaano pe sar e sher e jari rakh ke kaha
sirf ek baar mujhe bhai pukaro bhaiya
kehna chaaha tha magar saans wafa kar na saki
bhai ke marne se...
laashe abbas pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha karne laga safar bhi ye keh kar mazhar
qaima e shaah ka us waqt ajab tha manzar
sun ke shabbir ke nauhe ko behen kehne lagi
bhai ke marne se...
laashe abbas pe...
items.author: Mazhar Abidi

items.title: Dunya se safar
items.body:
dunya se safar jaanib e uqba hai naqi ka
ghamgheen har ek chaahne wala hai naqi ka
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein maut aayi hai zehra ke pisar ko
shabbir ka gham sogh manata hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas alamdar madad karne ko aao
dam aalame ghurbat mein nikalta hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
neela hai badan zehr e halahal se sad afsos
reh reh ke dehn khoon ughalta hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun saamra aa jaye na yasrab se payambar
ghurbat mein musibat mein sarapa hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
saare hi imam aah tadapte hai basad gham
tanhaai ka aalam hai janaza hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad mein nahi chain taqi ko koi lamha
chain aaye bhi kyun haal hi aisa hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad ka gham maa se zyada kise hoga
zehra se koi pooche to gham kya hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha azeem aap ne likhi hai ye rudaad
alfaaz bhi kehte hai ye nauha hai naqi ka
dunya se safar...
items.author: Azeem Azmi

items.title: Ghame shabbir amanat
items.body:
ghame shabbir amanat hai mere seene mein
ek yehi baat hai jo dil hai laga jeene mein
<<DIVIDER>>
tera banda e ali hai ke khudaya tune
apni tasveer saja rakhi hai aaene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein hamshakle payambar ko na bheje maula
koi barchi na utar aaye kahin seene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye musalman ajab dushmane paighambar hai
dekh sakte nahi tasveer hi aaene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha cheh maah ka tha saamne darya tha rawan
kya ghata jaata tha do ghoont bhala peene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...

items.title: Hamara ansu hussain
items.body:
jo aati hai majlis mein maa sayyeda
wo ro ro ke deti hai humko sada
meri aarzu shehwan o shain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mohamed ke dil ka yehi bain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
dil e fatema ka yehi bain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye teri shahadat hai kitni azeem
ke kehna pada rab ko tu hai kareem
imamat ki tu zaib hai zain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shahadat ka jis dam suna waqia
tadap kar ye adam ne rab se kaha
ye dil mera rone ko bechain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
allah koi gham na de
siwaye ghame hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hue khalq ko rone ko rote hai hum
in ashkon ko chehro se dhote hai hum
najaat aansuon ke hi maa bain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sitamgar se zahra ne ro kar kaha
tu sukhe galay par na khanjar chala
ye sibte nabi shaan e harmain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
atash ki hai shiddat hai sookha gala
yehi zibha karta hai kyun be-khata
labe fatema par yehi bain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
lagi aag qaimon mein baad e pidar
hai sajjad ghash mein pade khaak par
sakina ke honton pa ye bain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tamache sitamgar ne maara hussain
sukoon hai na din mein hai raaton ko chain
sakina ki aankhein hai aur rayn hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dil e hashmi ki hai ye arze gham
ke rauze pe rote hue nikle dam
labon par jo irfan ke bain hai
hamara aansu hussain hai
items.author: Alamdar Hashmi

items.title: Inkaar na kar
items.body:
virse mein mila hai sabr tujhe
ye sabr to tera virsa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein zainab jaane se
inkaar na kar inkaar na kar
<<DIVIDER>>
sab mehnat apne bhai ki
bekaar na kar bekaar na kar
<<DIVIDER>>
kaandhon pe uthaale khud apni
ghairat ka janaza saydani
nana ka deen bachana hai
deni hai tujhe ye qurbani
ro kar apni takleefon ka
izhaar na kar izhaar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
honton pe agar is waqt tere
halki si shikayet aayegi
sadaat ki ghairat jaagegi
dunya mein qayamat aayegi
sone de sina par sheron ko
bedaar na kar bedaar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu zid pe agar adjayegi
wo tera hukm na taalega
todega badan ki zanjeerein
aur ghaiz mein taygh uthalega
abid ko behen ladne ke liye
tayyar na kar tayyar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar hai ye maynashon ka
jaana mushkil hai ay zainab
batla de tere bhi seene mein
shabbir ka dil hai ay zainab
chadar ka taqaza bhai se
har baar na kar har baar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab poch le aansu aankhon se
allah ye mushkil taalega
jab tu hi himmat haaregi
sajjad ko kaun sambhalega
bemaar ko mere aur behen
bemaar na kar bemaar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein honge na-mehram
chehre pa nidamat chayegi
tu dekhna mujhko naize par
teri himmat badh jayegi
mai saath hoon tere dil chota
ghamkhwar na kar ghamkhwar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil jaise sambhala jayega
is dil ko sambhalegi zainab
darbar e sitam mein jayegi
teri baat na taalegi zainab
ay bhai sina se ashkon ki
bauchaar na kar bauchaar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay aamir o aktar zainab ke
is bain mein dard zyada hai
naize pe na ro ay bhai ke sar
jaane pa behen aamada hai
har ranj sahungi tu fikre
darbar na kar darbar na kar
darbar mein zainab...
items.author: Akhtar Sirsvi

items.title: Jao ay phupi jaan
items.body:
deti thi sada qabr se shabbir ki dukhtar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
<<DIVIDER>>
mai qaid rahun qaid mein hai mera muqaddar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
<<DIVIDER>>
ay phupi meri rida karbobala le jaana
dhoop mein tha mere mazloom padar ka laasha
laashe pe udha dena meri nanhi si chadar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala jaana to baba se batla dena
roye na mere liye wo unhe samjha dena
keh dena sataate nahi ab mujhko sitamgar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna baba se ke ek pal bhi nahi soyi mai
aap jis din se gaye shaam o sehar royi mai
ab jaa ke mujhe chain mila qabr ke andar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya akbar jo mile kehna ye mere kalemaat
poochne aaye na ek din bhi behan ke haalaat
keh dena behan baandhi gayi rassi mein kas kar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein jo mera asghar e masoom milay
godh mein lena usay aur laga lena galay
moo choomna bhaiya ka meri simt se jaa kar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr pa jaa ke chacha jaan se keh dena salaam
kehna aada ke sitam seh na saki tishna kaam
keh dena ke wo mar gayi zindan mein ghut kar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere ammu ko dikhana mere dono bunde
eid ke din jo bade pyar se pehnaye thay
keh dena lawein cheer ke cheene gaye gohar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna ammu se sakina ko ye maloom na tha
pani maangungi to lut jayegi meri dunya
kat jayenge baazu mere ammu ke nehr par
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay phupi aaye nazar shehr e madina jis dam
kehna leti thi tera naam sakina har dam
qismat mein nahi tha ki aaye wo muztar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ghadi pahunchega yasrab mein ye ujda kunba
poochne aayegi mujhko meri pyari sughra
rona meri behna ko kaleje se laga kar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
<<DIVIDER>>
reh gayi qaid e sitamgar mein wo dukihya waiz
goonjta reh gaya zindan mein ye nauha waiz
mai qaid rahun qaid mein hai mera muqaddar
jao ay phupi jaan khuda hafiz o nasir
deti thi sada...
items.author: Waiz Sultanpuri

items.title: Kahun kaise musibat
items.body:
kahun kaise musibat fatema ki
lehad par bhi hai aafat fatema ki
<<DIVIDER>>
kiya pamaal marqad ko shaqi ne
badi jis se aziyat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri turbat pe tum har roz aana
ali se thi wasiyat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki aankh se behte thay aansu
rulaati thi shahadat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
kare sarkar khud tazeem us ki
koi samjha na azmat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
mil kab qabr may bhi chain us ko
hui mismaar turbat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujaala hai na marqad par hai saaya
bataun kya mai ghurbat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
nikal kar parda e ghaibat se maula
karo ta'meer turbat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
azadaron udao khaak sar par
hui hai phir se rehlat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
<<DIVIDER>>
mitaya jis ne qabr e aal e hyder
bober us par hai laanat fatema ki
kahun kaise musibat...
items.author: Mir Bober Ali

items.title: Karti thi bain ran
items.body:
karthi thi bain ran mein ro ro ke haye zainab
ay bhai tera laasha kaise uthaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas hai na akbar sab qatl ho chuke hai
koi nahi hai zinda kisko bulaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise uthaye aakar tapti hui zameen se
saaye mein tera laasha kis tarha laaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
sunta nahi hai koi faryad bekason ki
kya kya sitam hue hai kisko bataye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ki muntazir hai dar par khadi sakina
sheh qatl ho chuke hai kaise bataye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas-e-bawafa ka laasha tadap raha tha
jab ran mein zaalimo ne cheeni ridaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
sar par rida nahi hai qaime bhi jal chuke hai
maidan mein ro rahi hai sar ko jhukaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne yun tadap kar abbas ko sada di
thar-ra rahe thay laashe sunkar sadaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas jald aao chaane lage andhere
dashte bala mein tanha ghabra na jaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
dil kyun na khoon roye jaati hai qaid hokar
aayi hai kis tarha se kya bhool jaye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
nasir dua hai meri bibi qabool karle
gohar jo likh rah hai nauhe baraye zainab
karthi thi bain ran mein…
items.author: Gohar Jarchvi

items.title: Mai aagayi bhaiya
items.body:
al qissa pahunche karbobala mein wo nauhagar
zainab tadap ke reh gayi bhai ki qabr par
is tarha bain karti thi wo sokhta jigar
bhabi ki godh ujad gayi bhaiya karo nazar
tum ko khabar hai hum pe jo aafat guzar gayi
qaid e sitam mein bali sakina guzar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki duhaai thi mai aagayi bhaiya
kunbe ko tere kho kar zindan se bhi ho kar
mai aagayi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise bataun jo hui zulm o jafa hai
tum uth ke zara dekho jo kuch haal hua hai
bikhre hai mere gaysu zakhmi hai mere baazu
chadar luti bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab pusht se bemaar ki khayncha gaya bistar
us waqt usay aag se mai laayi bacha kar
ghash mein tha mera dilbar qaimon se usay laa kar
mai gir padi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayaat e khuda utri sada arsh se hum par
barsaye gaye kothon se hum logon pe pathar
jis waqt tere sar par ek maara gaya pathar
mai ro padi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek rassi mein hi baara galay baandh ke bhaiya
haiwan ki tarha khaynch ke le jaate thay aada
wo khaynchte has has kar hum uth'te thay gir gir kar
sharmaati thi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo tum ne amaanat jo mujhe saumpi thi bhaiya
zindan mein wo tumko hi sada deti thi bhaiya
thay neele nishan us par kaano se chine gohar
roti rahi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum khwab mein zindan se usay aaye thay lene
bas yaad tumhe karti rahi khwab se uth ke
zindanon mein ghut ghut kar haye phool si wo dukhtar
murjha gayi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ke andhere mein chupa aayi hoo bhai
ek nanhi si turbat mai bana aayi hoo bhai
waada hai mera sarwar mai qabre sakina par
phir jaaungi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ki lehad par jo gayi zainab e naalan
aankhon se rawan ashk thay ay majid o yazdan
aur gir ke wo turbat par ye kehti rahi ro kar
mai aagayi bhaiya
zainab ki duhaai thi...
items.author: Majid Raza Abidi

items.title: Masjid e kufa
items.body:
masjid e kufa se logon aa rahi hai ye sada
jo nabi ka jaanashin tha wo ali maara gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ki aamad ke liye dewaar e kaaba shak hui
halaat e sajda may uska khoon masjid may baha
masjid e kufa se logon...
<<DIVIDER>>
saazish e ahle saqeefa kaam apna kar gayi
aaj sajde may ali par chal gayi taygh e jafa
masjid e kufa se logon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufiyon khushiyan manao qatl hyder ho gaye
khana e zehra may lekin aaj hai matam bapa
masjid e kufa se logon...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha zainab ne sunli ye qayamat ki khabar
hausla bibi ko koi dene waala bhi na tha
masjid e kufa se logon...
<<DIVIDER>>
ambiya nauha kuna hai rote hai jinn o bashar
jaa raha hai aaj dunya se ali sher e khuda
masjid e kufa se logon...
<<DIVIDER>>
momino tum aaj milkar pursa do hasnain ko
uth gaya hai un ke sar se aaj saaya baap ka
masjid e kufa se logon...
<<DIVIDER>>
jafri mushkil kusha ke qatl ka nauha hai ye
jo musalle par usi ke khoon se likha gaya
masjid e kufa se logon...

items.title: Moosa kazim ka
items.body:
haye imam kazim imam
haye imam qaidi imam
<<DIVIDER>>
baghdad ka qaidi pardesi maula o mera qaidi maula
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khana musa e kazim ka maqtal ban gaya
baap ki mayyat uthaane aaiye maula raza
<<DIVIDER>>
ho salaam us par jise zindan mein maut aa gayi
haath ki zanjeer haye gosht jiska kha gayi
beh raha hai jis ke zakhmon se lahoo wa ghurbata
qaid khana musae kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid bhi aisi jahan seedhi na ho paaye kamar
kyun na wo aansu bahaate haalat e sajjad par
haye yaad aata tha jab bhi tauq aur zakhmi gala
qaid khana musae kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa ke ye masooma e qum ko koi dede khabar
ab nahi aayenge baba phir madine laut kar
aaj se baba ka apne dekhna mat raasta
qaid khana musae kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyon se haye jo mil na saka chauda baras
dekhta rehta tha yasrab ki taraf wo baap bas
betiyon ko yaad karke qaid mein rota raha
qaid khana musae kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbate aale mohamed par karo matam bapa
qaid khane se uthega ye janaza doosra
wo jo khaati thi tamache us sakina ki tarha
qaid khana musae kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeher se maara gaya hai phir se zehra ka pisar
haath pehlu par rakhe aayi hai turbat chod kar
baithi mayyat ke sirhane ro rahi hai fatema
qaid khana musae kazim...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj matam hai bapa us be-watan ki yaad mein
haye jo sab se zyada zakhmi tha baghdad mein
is liye farhan roya hai qalam zeeshan ka
qaid khana musae kazim...
items.author: Zeeshan Abidi
